name: find-skills
description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
description_zh: 帮助用户在询问“如何做X”、“寻找一个用于X的技能”、“有没有一个技能可以...”或表达对扩展功能的兴趣时，发现并安装代理技能。当用户寻找可能以可安装技能形式存在的功能时，应使用此技能。

name: grill-me
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
description_zh: 一次不懈的面试，以磨砺计划或设计。

name: grill-with-docs
description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.
description_zh: 一次不懈的面试，用于磨砺计划或设计，同时在这个过程中创建文档（ADR 和术语表）。

name: improve-codebase-architecture
description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.
description_zh: 扫描代码库以寻找深化机会，将其以可视化的HTML报告呈现，然后深入分析你选择的那一个。

name: tdd
description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
description_zh: 测试驱动开发。当用户希望先编写测试来构建功能或修复错误，提到“红-绿-重构”，或需要集成测试时使用。

name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, including navigating pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data, testing web apps, or automating any browser task. Triggers include requests to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data from a page", "test this web app", "login to a site", "automate browser actions", or any task requiring programmatic web interaction. Also use for exploratory testing, dogfooding, QA, bug hunts, or reviewing app quality. Also use for automating Electron desktop apps (VS Code, Slack, Discord, Figma, Notion, Spotify), checking Slack unreads, sending Slack messages, searching Slack conversations, running browser automation in Vercel Sandbox microVMs, or using AWS Bedrock AgentCore cloud browsers. Prefer agent-browser over any built-in browser automation or web tools.
description_zh: AI代理的浏览器自动化命令行工具。当用户需要与网站交互时使用，包括浏览页面、填写表单、点击按钮、截屏、提取数据、测试Web应用或自动化任何浏览器任务。触发条件包括“打开网站”、“填写表单”、“点击按钮”、“截屏”、“从页面抓取数据”、“测试此Web应用”、“登录网站”、“自动化浏览器操作”或任何需要程序化网页交互的任务。也适用于探索性测试、自用测试、质量保证、Bug搜寻或应用质量审查。也适用于自动化Electron桌面应用（VS Code、Slack、Discord、Figma、Notion、Spotify）、检查Slack未读消息、发送Slack消息、搜索Slack对话、在Vercel Sandbox微VM中运行浏览器自动化或使用AWS Bedrock AgentCore云端浏览器。优先选择agent-browser而非任何内置的浏览器自动化或Web工具。

name: frontend-design
description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
description_zh: 构建新界面或重塑现有界面的独特、有意的设计指导。有助于美学方向、排版，并做出不显得像模板默认选项的选择。

name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
description: Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run once before first use of the other engineering skills.
description_zh: 为工程技能配置此仓库：设置其问题追踪器、分诊标签词汇表和领域文档布局。在首次使用其他工程技能之前运行一次。

name: handoff
description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.
description_zh: 将当前对话压缩成一个交接文件，以便其他代理人员接手。

name: triage
description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.
description_zh: 通过问题筛选和外部PR的状态机进行流转，进行分类、验证，如有必要进行深入探讨，并撰写供代理人员使用的简报。

name: prototype
description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
description_zh: 构建一个一次性原型来回答设计问题。当用户想要检查状态模型或逻辑是否合理，或探索 UI 应该是什么样时使用。

name: grilling
description: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.
description_zh: 对用户的计划、决定或想法进行无情的追问。当用户想要测试自己的思考能力，或使用任何“追问”触发短语时使用。

name: vercel-react-best-practices
description: React and Next.js performance optimization guidelines from Vercel Engineering. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring React/Next.js code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React components, Next.js pages, data fetching, bundle optimization, or performance improvements.

name: video-edit
description: Edit existing video on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Wan 2.7 Edit-Video (general restyle / background swap / packaging swap, identity + motion preservation), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control (transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character), or Lucy Edit Restyle (lightweight identity-stable restyle / outfit swap). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "video edit", "edit video", "restyle video", "swap video background", "motion control", "outfit swap video", or any explicit ask to transform a video.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上编辑现有视频——这项技能是一个智能路由器，将用户的意图匹配到RunComfy目录中的正确编辑模型。选择Wan 2.7 Edit-Video（通用重制/背景替换/包装替换，保留身份+运动），Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control（将参考视频的精确运动转移到目标角色），或Lucy Edit Restyle（轻量级身份稳定重制/服装替换）。捆绑每个模型的文档化提示模式，使技能在不浪费错误模型的迭代次数的情况下获得更精准的编辑。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>`。在“视频编辑”、“编辑视频”、“重制视频”、“替换视频背景”、“运动控制”、“服装替换视频”，或任何明确要求转换视频的指令时触发。

name: ai-music
description: Generate AI music on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the music-model catalog. Routes to ElevenLabs AI Music Generation (premium 44.1 kHz stereo vocal tracks, 5 s–5 min, $0.0083/s) and ACE Step / ACE Step 1.5 (StepFun-AI open-weights, tag-driven composition, multilingual lyrics, $0.0002–0.0003/s, ~27× cheaper), plus ACE Step audio-inpaint (regenerate a time range inside an existing track) and ACE Step audio-outpaint (extend a track before or after). Picks the right model for the user's actual intent — premium vocal hook, cheap background music library, multilingual pop song, repair a bad chorus, lengthen a 30 s draft into a 2 min cut — and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate music", "make a song", "AI music", "background music", "instrumental track", "soundtrack", "jingle", "theme music", "royalty-free music", "compose", "music with lyrics", "extend music", "fix this song", "inpaint music", or any explicit ask to generate or edit music.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成 AI 音乐——一个连接音乐模型目录的智能路由器。路由至 ElevenLabs AI 音乐生成（高级 44.1 kHz 立体声人声轨道，5 秒至 5 分钟，0.0083 美元/秒）和 ACE Step / ACE Step 1.5（StepFun-AI 开放权重，标签驱动创作，多语言歌词，0.0002–0.0003 美元/秒，约 27 倍更便宜），此外还有 ACE Step 音频修复（在现有轨道内再生时间范围）和 ACE Step 音频扩展（在轨道前后延长）。根据用户的实际意图选择合适的模型——高级人声钩子、廉价背景音乐库、多语言流行歌曲、修复糟糕的副歌、将 30 秒的草稿扩展为 2 分钟的成品——并附带每个模型的文档提示模式及最简化的 `runcomfy run` 调用。在以下触发词时启动："生成音乐"、"创作歌曲"、"AI 音乐"、"背景音乐"、"器乐轨道"、"配乐"、"广告歌"、"主题音乐"、"免版税音乐"、"作曲"、"带歌词的音乐"、"扩展音乐"、"修复这首歌"、"音频修复音乐"，或任何明确要求生成或编辑音乐的表达。

name: ai-video-generation
description: Generate AI videos on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full video-model catalog: HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1, native in-pass audio), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (open weights, audio-driven lip-sync), ByteDance Seedance v2 / 1-5 / 1-0 (multi-modal cinematic), Kling 3.0 / 2-6, Google Veo 3-1, MiniMax Hailuo 2-3, ByteDance Dreamina 3-0. Covers text-to-video (t2v), image-to-video (i2v), and Veo's video-extend endpoint. The skill picks the right model for the user's intent (Arena-#1 quality, multi-shot character identity, in-pass audio, cinematic motion, fastest path, sub-15s clip, longest duration) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate video", "make a video", "text to video", "t2v", "image to video", "i2v", "animate", "AI video", "make X move", "video from prompt", "video from image", or any explicit ask to produce a video clip from prompt or still.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成 AI 视频——这是一个覆盖完整视频模型目录的智能路由器：HappyHorse 1.0（Arena #1，原生带音视频），Wan-AI Wan 2-7（开放权重，音频驱动口型同步），ByteDance Seedance v2 / 1-5 / 1-0（多模态电影感），Kling 3.0 / 2-6，Google Veo 3-1，MiniMax Hailuo 2-3，ByteDance Dreamina 3-0。支持文本转视频（t2v）、图像转视频（i2v）以及 Veo 的视频扩展接口。该技能根据用户意图选择合适的模型（Arena-#1 质量、多帧角色身份、带音视频、电影感动效、最快路径、15秒内片段、最长时长）并输出每个模型的文档提示模式及最简 `runcomfy run` 调用指令。触发条件包括“生成视频”、“制作视频”、“文本转视频”、“t2v”、“图像转视频”、“i2v”、“动画”、“AI视频”、“制作X动作”、“从提示生成视频”、“从图像生成视频”或任何明确要求从提示或静态图像生成视频片段的指令。

name: image-to-video
description: Animate any still image on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right i2v model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks HappyHorse 1.0 I2V (Arena #1, native audio, identity preservation) for general animations, Wan 2.7 with `audio_url` for custom-voiceover lip-sync, or Seedance 2.0 Pro for multi-modal animation from image + reference video + reference audio. Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the caller gets sharper output without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/image-to-video` (or endpoint variant) through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image to video", "image-to-video", "i2v", "animate image", "make this move", or any explicit ask to turn a still into video.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上为任何静态图像添加动画效果——这项技能是一个智能路由器，能够将用户的意图匹配到RunComfy目录中正确的i2v模型。对于常规动画，选择HappyHorse 1.0 I2V（竞技场#1，原生音频，身份保留）；需要自定义旁白口型时，使用带有`audio_url`的Wan 2.7；而进行多模态动画时，则选用Seedance 2.0 Pro（基于图像+参考视频+参考音频）。每个模型都捆绑了文档中记录的提示模式，以便调用者获得更精准的输出，避免在错误模型上浪费迭代次数。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/image-to-video`（或其端点变体）。当触发“图像转视频”、“image-to-video”、“i2v”、“为图像添加动画”、“让这个动起来”或任何明确要求将静态图像转换为视频的指令时，即可激活该功能。

name: ai-image-generation
description: Generate and edit images on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full image-model catalog: FLUX 2 (Klein 9B/4B, Pro, Dev, Flash, Turbo, Max), Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro, OpenAI GPT Image 2, ByteDance Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 and Dreamina 4-0, Alibaba Qwen Image and Z-Image Turbo, Wan 2-7. Covers both text-to-image (t2i) and image-to-image / edit (i2i) endpoints — the skill picks the right model for the user's actual intent (typography precision, photoreal portraits, sub-second iteration, multi-reference brand styling, open-weights workflow) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate image", "make a picture", "text to image", "AI image", "make an image of …", "image to image", "i2i", or any explicit ask to create or restyle an image.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成和编辑图像——这是一个覆盖完整图像模型目录的智能路由器：FLUX 2（Klein 9B/4B、Pro、Dev、Flash、Turbo、Max）、Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro、OpenAI GPT Image 2、字节跳动 Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 和 Dreamina 4-0、阿里巴巴 Qwen Image 和 Z-Image Turbo、万 2-7。支持文本到图像（t2i）和图像到图像/编辑（i2i）端点——该工具会根据用户的实际意图（字体精度、照片级肖像、亚秒级迭代、多参考品牌风格、开放权重工作流）选择合适的模型，并提供每个模型的文档化提示模式以及最小的 `runcomfy run` 调用。在“生成图像”、“制作图片”、“文本到图像”、“AI 图像”、“制作……的图像”、“图像到图像”、“i2i”或任何明确要求创建或重新设计图像的指令时触发。

name: hyperframes-cli
description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, history, clean, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.
description_zh: 使用 HyperFrames CLI 开发循环：init、add、catalog、capture、lint、check、snapshot、compare、grade-compare、preview、play、present、beats、keyframes、单次或批量渲染、publish、cloud、cloudrun、feedback、lambda、doctor、browser、info、upgrade、skills、compositions、timeline、history、clean、docs、benchmark、telemetry、transcribe、auth、tts 和 remove-background。在诊断构建或渲染失败时也使用。validate、inspect 和 layout 是已弃用的别名；请使用 check。涵盖本地、HeyGen 托管的云、AWS Lambda 和 Google Cloud Run 渲染。

name: teach
description: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
description_zh: 在这个工作区内，向用户教授一项新技能或概念。

name: domain-modeling
description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a GLOSSARY.md, or recording or editing an ADR.
description_zh: 构建和精炼项目的领域模型。在讨论代码库术语、编写或编辑 CONTEXT.md，或记录或编辑 ADR 时使用。

name: reddit-automation
description: Find Reddit threads where people are genuinely asking for what you offer, then draft short, genuinely helpful replies — disclosing your affiliation honestly and naming your product only when it truly answers the question. Two moves: discovery — scan the right subreddits for real needs (recommendation asks, expressed pain, competitor mentions) and rank the few threads where you can actually help; drafting — write from real experience, respect each community's self-promo rules, and keep a human in the loop to review and post. This markets on Reddit the honest way: contribute value, disclose who you are, never astroturf. Distilled from the playbook behind doany.ai's Reddit agent. Triggers on "find reddit opportunities", "reddit marketing", "reddit automation", "reply on reddit for my product", "reddit community engagement", "reddit lead gen", or any ask to turn Reddit threads into genuine, disclosed marketing replies.
description_zh: 找到那些真正在询问你所提供内容的相关 Reddit 主题，然后撰写简短且真正有帮助的回复——诚实地披露你的关联关系，并且只在你的产品确实能回答问题时才提及。两步操作：发现——扫描正确的 Subreddit 以寻找真实需求（如推荐请求、表达痛点、提及竞争对手），并筛选出你能实际提供帮助的少数主题；撰写——基于真实经验撰写，尊重每个社区的自我推广规则，并保持人类审核环节来审核和发布。这种方式诚实地在 Reddit 上进行营销：贡献价值，披露你的身份，绝不进行虚假宣传。源自 doany.ai Reddit 代理背后的操作手册。当触发“寻找 Reddit 机会”、“Reddit 营销”、“Reddit 自动化”、“为我的产品回复 Reddit”、“Reddit 社区互动”、“Reddit 领域生成”或任何将 Reddit 主题转化为真实、披露的营销回复的请求时，将自动执行。

name: hyperframes
description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.
description_zh: 必须入口：在进行任何请求以制作、创建、编辑、动画化或渲染视频、动画或动态图形（包括宣传片、解说视频、带字幕片段、标题卡、叠加层、幻灯片或交互式演示文稿、Remotion端口或任何HyperFrames HTML组合）时，请先阅读此内容。同时，您也可以使用它来检查、诊断、验证、预览、发布或批量渲染现有的HyperFrames项目。输入内容可以是网站URL、GitHub PR、Figma设计或URL、文本或简短描述、现有素材或音乐。它将恢复项目状态，在适用情况下捕捉意图，选择并安装所属工作流，并路由域功能。HyperFrames是默认输出框架，除非用户明确为交付物选择其他框架或仅要求录制浏览器会话。

name: codebase-design
description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
description_zh: 用于设计深度模块的共享词汇。当用户想要设计或改进模块界面、寻找深化机会、决定接口位置、使代码更易于测试或AI导航，或需要深度模块词汇的其他技能时使用。

name: diagnosing-bugs
description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
description_zh: 针对顽固性错误和性能回归的诊断循环。当用户说“诊断”/“调试这个”，或报告出现故障/抛出异常/失败/缓慢等问题时使用。

name: web-design-guidelines
description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
description_zh: 检查 Web 界面指南的 UI 代码合规性。当被要求“检查我的 UI”、“检查可访问性”、“审核设计”、“检查 UX”或“对照最佳实践检查我的网站”时使用。

name: code-review
description: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes: Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/spec asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".
description_zh: 请沿两个维度（标准规范和需求规范）审查自固定点（提交、分支、标签或合并基点）以来的变更：标准规范（代码是否遵循此仓库的文档化编码规范？）和需求规范（代码是否与原始问题/需求相符？）。在并行子代理中同时运行两次审查，并并排报告结果。当用户需要审查分支、拉取请求、进行中的变更，或要求“自X点以来的审查”时使用。

name: hyperframes-registry
description: Search, install, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use BEFORE hand-building any named visual — whenever a brief, a user, or a storyboard names a look, effect, treatment, or transition such as CRT scanlines, glitch, chromatic aberration, film grain, a shimmer sweep, a chart, a code or terminal window, a map, or a confetti burst — because roughly 400 hosted items already cover many of them and the search ranks all of them with nothing installed, no project, and no account. Also use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

This is not just a performance guide — schema, migration, security, and SQL authoring tasks need these rules too, even for a one-column change or a single query.
description_zh: 由 Supabase 维护的 Postgres 最佳实践，适用于任何地方的 Postgres 运行。在编写或修改任何存储在 Postgres 数据库中的内容之前，请先加载此技能：创建或修改表和列（包括选择列类型）、模式设计、迁移和声明式模式文件、RLS 策略及其验证测试、索引、触发器、数据库函数、队列和计划任务（pg\_cron、pgmq）、向量/语义搜索（pgvector），以及恢复转储（pg\_restore）或导入数据。在诊断慢查询、高 CPU、超时、EXPLAIN 计划、连接耗尽、锁定、膨胀，或行对错误用户或租户可见时，也需要加载它。这不仅仅是一份性能指南——模式、迁移、安全和 SQL 编写任务同样需要这些规则，即使只是单列更改或单个查询。

description_zh: 设置 Claude Code 钩子以阻止危险 git 命令（如 push、reset --hard、clean、branch -D 等）在执行前。当用户希望防止破坏性 git 操作、添加 git 安全钩子或阻止在 Claude Code 中的 git push/reset 时使用。

name: setup-pre-commit
description: Set up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged (Prettier), type checking, and tests in the current repo. Use when user wants to add pre-commit hooks, set up Husky, configure lint-staged, or add commit-time formatting/typechecking/testing.
description_zh: 在当前仓库中设置 Husky 预提交钩子，使用 lint-staged（Prettier）、类型检查和测试。当用户想要添加预提交钩子、设置 Husky、配置 lint-staged 或添加提交时格式化/类型检查/测试时使用。

name: wan-3-0-prime-reference-to-video
description: Build video clips from reference images, reference videos, and reference audio with Wan-AI Wan 3.0 Prime Reference to Video on RunComfy. Up to 10 reference images, 5 reference videos and 5 reference audio clips are bound to a prompt that names them as "Image 1", "Video 1", "Audio 1", giving character, product and scene consistency across a 2-30 second shot at 480p, 720p or 1080p with a synchronized audio track. Documents the full input schema, the counted-second pricing model (reference videos are billed as duration, images and audio are not), and when to route to Wan 3.0 Prime text-to-video / image-to-video, Wan 2.7 or Seedance 2.0 Pro instead. Calls `runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-3.0-prime/reference-to-video` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "wan 3 prime reference to video", "wan 3.0 prime", "wan3 prime", "reference to video", "ref2v", "keep the same character across shots", "video from reference images", or any explicit ask to generate video from references with this model.
description_zh: 使用Wan-AI Wan 3.0 Prime Reference to Video功能，在RunComfy平台上从参考图像、参考视频和参考音频中构建视频片段。最多可绑定10张参考图像、5个参考视频和5个参考音频片段，并在提示中将其命名为"Image 1"、"Video 1"、"Audio 1"，确保角色、产品和场景在2-30秒的480p、720p或1080p视频中保持一致，并配有同步音频轨道。文档记录了完整的输入架构、按秒计费模式（参考视频按时长计费，图像和音频不收费），以及何时路由至Wan 3.0 Prime文本转视频/图像转视频、Wan 2.7或Seedance 2.0 Pro。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-3.0-prime/reference-to-video`。当触发"wan 3 prime reference to video"、"wan 3.0 prime"、"wan3 prime"、"reference to video"、"ref2v"、"保持镜头间角色一致"、"从参考图像生成视频"或明确要求使用此模型从参考生成视频时，将自动触发。

name: seedance-2-5-image-to-video
description: Animate a single still image into a 4-30 second 720p cinematic clip with optional synchronized native audio using ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Image to Video on RunComfy. Documents the four-field schema (prompt, image, duration, generate_audio), the $0.35/s pricing, the fact that output aspect ratio follows the input image, and when to route to the Seedance 2.5 480p, text-to-video, reference-to-video or first-last-frame pages instead. Calls `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-2.5/image-to-video/720p` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "seedance 2.5 image to video", "seedance image to video", "seedance i2v", "animate this image with seedance", "bytedance image to video", or any explicit ask to turn a still into video with Seedance 2.5.
description_zh: 将单张静态图像制作成4-30秒的720p电影剪辑，并可选择同步原生音频，使用RunComfy上的ByteDance Seedance 2.5图像转视频功能。记录了四字段模式（提示词、图像、时长、生成音频），$0.35/秒的定价，输出宽高比遵循输入图像，以及何时路由到Seedance 2.5 480p、文本转视频、参考转视频或首尾帧页面。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-2.5/image-to-video/720p`。当触发以下任一指令时激活："seedance 2.5图像转视频"、"seedance图像转视频"、"seedance i2v"、"用seedance动画化这张图像"、"字节跳动图像转视频"，或任何明确要求使用Seedance 2.5将静态图像转为视频的请求。

name: seedance-2-5-reference-to-video
description: Generate reference-guided 1080p video with ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Reference to Video on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Feed up to 9 reference images, 1-3 reference video clips, and 3 reference audio files into one call and get a 4-30 second 1080p clip with native synchronized audio, identity and style locked to your references. Documents the full input schema (images / videos / audios / aspect_ratio / duration / generate_audio), the counted-seconds billing model ($0.53 per second of reference video duration plus output duration), the 480p draft-then-deliver workflow, and when to route to Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, image-to-video, or Seedance 2.0 Pro instead. Calls `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video/1080p`. Triggers on "seedance 2.5", "seedance 2.5 reference to video", "reference to video", "reference-to-video", "seedance 1080p", "ByteDance Seedance 2.5", "consistent character video", "style-locked video", or any explicit ask to generate video from reference images and clips.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上使用字节跳动 Seedance 2.5 参考视频生成 1080p 视频参考。将最多 9 张参考图片、1-3 段参考视频片段和 3 个参考音频文件一次性输入，即可获得 4-30 秒的 1080p 视频片段，具有原生同步音频，身份和风格锁定为您的参考内容。记录完整的输入模式（图片/视频/音频/宽高比/时长/生成音频），计费模式为按秒计费（参考视频时长每秒 0.53 美元加上输出时长），480p 草稿生成后交付的工作流程，以及何时路由至 Seedance 2.5 文本转视频、图像转视频或 Seedance 2.0 Pro。调用 `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video/1080p`。在输入 "seedance 2.5"、"seedance 2.5 reference to video"、"reference to video"、"reference-to-video"、"seedance 1080p"、"ByteDance Seedance 2.5"、"consistent character video"、"style-locked video" 或任何明确要求从参考图片和片段生成视频的指令时触发。

name: kling-3-0
description: Kling 3.0 video generation on RunComfy. Kling 3.0 (also called Kling V3.0) is Kuaishou Technology's third-generation multi-shot video model with native synchronized audio and consistent character identity across shots. This skill covers all six Kling 3.0 endpoints, spanning three rendering tiers (Standard, Pro, 4K) and two modes (text-to-video, image-to-video). Calls runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<tier>/<mode> through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "kling", "kling 3.0", "kling v3", "kling pro", "kling 4k", "kling text to video", "kling image to video", or any explicit ask to generate or animate with Kling 3.0.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上生成Kling 3.0视频。Kling 3.0（也称为Kling V3.0）是快手科技研发的第三代多镜头视频模型，具有原生同步音频和跨镜头一致的角色身份。该技能涵盖Kling 3.0的所有六个端点，覆盖三个渲染层级（标准、专业、4K）和两种模式（文本转视频、图像转视频）。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<层级>/<模式>`。当触发“kling”、“kling 3.0”、“kling v3”、“kling专业”、“kling 4K”、“kling文本转视频”、“kling图像转视频”，或明确要求使用Kling 3.0生成或动画化时，即可激活该功能。

description_zh: 创建符合代码检查规范的练习目录结构，包含章节、问题、解决方案和解释说明。当用户需要搭建练习框架、创建练习占位符或设置新的课程章节时使用。

description_zh: 写作，探索：挖掘原始碎片，尚未形成结构。

Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
description_zh: 创建新技能、修改和改进现有技能，并衡量技能性能。当用户希望从零开始创建技能、编辑或优化现有技能、运行评估测试技能、通过方差分析基准测试技能性能，或优化技能描述以提高触发准确度时使用。

name: high-end-visual-design
description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.
description_zh: 教会AI像高端广告公司一样设计。定义精确的字体、间距、阴影、卡片结构和动画，使网站看起来高端。屏蔽所有导致AI设计看起来廉价或通用的常见默认设置。

name: migrate-to-shoehorn

name: redesign-existing-projects
description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.
description_zh: 将现有网站和应用程序升级至高级品质。审核当前设计，识别通用人工智能模式，并应用高端设计标准，同时不破坏功能。兼容任何CSS框架或纯CSS。

name: codex-pet
description: Codex Pet generator on RunComfy. Build a Codex-compatible Codex Pet spritesheet.webp + pet.json from a single reference image, drop it into `${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/pets/<name>/` and Codex picks it up as a custom Codex Pet next to the 8 built-ins. This skill produces the exact Codex Pet atlas Codex expects (1536x1872 PNG/WebP, 8 cols x 9 rows, 192x208 cells, 9 animation states — idle, running-right, running-left, waving, jumping, failed, waiting, running, review). Calls OpenAI GPT Image 2 edit ONCE via the local RunComfy CLI as `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit` to produce a canonical Codex Pet pose, then assembles all 9 animation rows programmatically with ImageMagick micro-transforms — no Codex Pro, no `$imagegen`, no OPENAI_API_KEY required, only RUNCOMFY_TOKEN. Triggers on "codex pet", "create codex pet", "make codex pet", "hatch codex pet", "/hatch image", "desktop pet codex", "codex pets", "spritesheet.webp", or any explicit ask to build a custom pet for OpenAI Codex.
description_zh: RunComfy 上的 Codex Pet 生成器。从单个参考图像构建与 Codex 兼容的 Codex Pet spritesheet.webp + pet.json，将其拖入 `${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/pets/<name>/`，Codex 将其识别为 8 个内置宠物旁边的自定义 Codex Pet。此功能生成 Codex 期望的确切 Codex Pet 图集（1536x1872 PNG/WebP，8 列 x 9 行，192x208 单元，9 个动画状态——空闲、向右跑、向左跑、挥手、跳跃、失败、等待、奔跑、审核）。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 OpenAI GPT Image 2 编辑一次（`runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit`）来生成标准的 Codex Pet 姿态，然后使用 ImageMagick 微型变换程序设计性地组装所有 9 行动画。无需 Codex Pro、`$imagegen` 或 OPENAI_API_KEY，仅需 RUNCOMFY_TOKEN。当触发 "codex pet"、"create codex pet"、"make codex pet"、"hatch codex pet"、"/hatch image"、"desktop pet codex"、"codex pets"、"spritesheet.webp"，或任何明确要求为 OpenAI Codex 构建自定义宠物的指令时，将自动执行。

name: caveman-commit
description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.
description_zh: 编写一个仅包含意图的常规提交信息。用于“编写一个提交”、“提交信息”、“/commit”或“/caveman-commit”。

name: general-video
description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.
description_zh: 在没有任何专业工作流程适用，或BRIEF.md设置flow: companion时，可创建或编辑自定义HyperFrames组合。适用于较长的多场景作品、品牌和花絮短片、蒙太奇、静态循环、静态标题卡、素材混剪以及自由形式构建。对于包含动画标题的短篇无旁白动态优先单元，则应使用动态图形。在使用此技能前，请将新创作内容通过HyperFrames进行路由处理。

name: brainstorming
description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
description_zh: 您必须在任何创意工作之前使用此功能——创建功能、构建组件、添加功能或修改行为。在实施之前，探索用户意图、需求和设计。

name: caveman-review
description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".
description_zh: 压缩代码审查 - 每个问题一行，包含位置、问题和修复方案。用于 /caveman-review、"审查此 PR" 或 "审查差异"。

name: to-questionnaire
description: Turn a decision you can't fully answer into a questionnaire for someone else to fill in.
description_zh: 将一个你无法完全回答的决定转变为一份供他人填写的问卷。

name: caveman-compress
description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.
description_zh: 将内存文件（如 CLAUDE.md 或待办事项列表）压缩成原始人格式以节省输入令牌，同时保留可读的备份。触发：/caveman-compress。

name: ui-ux-pro-max
description: UI/UX design intelligence for web, mobile, and desktop. This skill should be used when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing interfaces, including pages, components, design systems, accessibility, interaction, responsive layout, typography, color, charts, and stack-specific UI implementation. Searchable local data: 79 searchable styles (50 active), 192 product palettes and reasoning profiles, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 105 icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, and 22 stacks.
description_zh: 网页、移动端和桌面端的 UI/UX 设计智能。此技能应在设计、构建、评审或修复界面时使用，包括页面、组件、设计系统、无障碍访问、交互、响应式布局、排版、颜色、图表以及特定堆栈的 UI 实现。可搜索的本地数据：79 种可搜索样式（50 种激活状态）、192 个产品调色板及推理配置文件、74 组字体搭配、119 项 UX 指南、105 个图标、17 个 GSAP 预设、25 种图表类型以及 22 个堆栈。

name: caveman-help

description_zh:
简体中文翻译：

原始人模式、技能和命令的快速参考卡。触发：/caveman-help 或 "caveman help"。

name: ai-video-generation
description: Generate AI videos on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full video-model catalog: HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1, native in-pass audio), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (open weights, audio-driven lip-sync), ByteDance Seedance v2 / 1-5 / 1-0 (multi-modal cinematic), Kling 3.0 / 2-6, Google Veo 3-1, MiniMax Hailuo 2-3, ByteDance Dreamina 3-0. Covers text-to-video (t2v), image-to-video (i2v), and Veo's video-extend endpoint. The skill picks the right model for the user's intent (Arena-#1 quality, multi-shot character identity, in-pass audio, cinematic motion, fastest path, sub-15s clip, longest duration) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate video", "make a video", "text to video", "t2v", "image to video", "i2v", "animate", "AI video", "make X move", "video from prompt", "video from image", or any explicit ask to produce a video clip from prompt or still.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成 AI 视频——这是一个覆盖完整视频模型目录的智能路由器：HappyHorse 1.0（Arena #1，原生带音视频），Wan-AI Wan 2-7（开放权重，音频驱动口型同步），ByteDance Seedance v2 / 1-5 / 1-0（多模态电影感），Kling 3.0 / 2-6，Google Veo 3-1，MiniMax Hailuo 2-3，ByteDance Dreamina 3-0。支持文本转视频（t2v）、图像转视频（i2v）以及 Veo 的视频扩展接口。该技能根据用户意图选择合适的模型（Arena-#1 质量、多帧角色身份、带音视频、电影感动效、最快路径、15秒内片段、最长时长）并输出每个模型的文档提示模式及最简 `runcomfy run` 调用指令。触发条件包括“生成视频”、“制作视频”、“文本转视频”、“t2v”、“图像转视频”、“i2v”、“动画”、“AI视频”、“制作X动作”、“从提示生成视频”、“从图像生成视频”或任何明确要求从提示或静态图像生成视频片段的指令。

name: ai-image-generation
description: Generate and edit images on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full image-model catalog: FLUX 2 (Klein 9B/4B, Pro, Dev, Flash, Turbo, Max), Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro, OpenAI GPT Image 2, ByteDance Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 and Dreamina 4-0, Alibaba Qwen Image and Z-Image Turbo, Wan 2-7. Covers both text-to-image (t2i) and image-to-image / edit (i2i) endpoints — the skill picks the right model for the user's actual intent (typography precision, photoreal portraits, sub-second iteration, multi-reference brand styling, open-weights workflow) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate image", "make a picture", "text to image", "AI image", "make an image of …", "image to image", "i2i", or any explicit ask to create or restyle an image.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上生成和编辑图像——这是一个覆盖完整图像模型目录的智能路由器：FLUX 2（Klein 9B/4B、Pro、Dev、Flash、Turbo、Max）、Google Nano Banana 2 / Pro、OpenAI GPT Image 2、字节跳动 Seedream 5 / 4-5 / 4-0 和 Dreamina 4-0、阿里巴巴 Qwen Image 和 Z-Image Turbo、万 2-7。支持文本到图像（t2i）和图像到图像/编辑（i2i）端点——该工具会根据用户的实际意图（字体精度、照片级肖像、亚秒级迭代、多参考品牌风格、开放权重工作流）选择合适的模型，并提供每个模型的文档化提示模式以及最小的 `runcomfy run` 调用。在“生成图像”、“制作图片”、“文本到图像”、“AI 图像”、“制作……的图像”、“图像到图像”、“i2i”或任何明确要求创建或重新设计图像的指令时触发。

name: runcomfy-cli
description: Run any model on RunComfy from the command line. The `runcomfy` CLI is one binary, one auth, hundreds of model endpoints — image generation, image edit, video generation, image-to-video, lip-sync, face swap, video edit, inpainting, outpainting, extend, ControlNet, relight, upscale, LoRA training and more. Submit a request, poll for status, download the output. This skill teaches the agent how to install, authenticate, discover model schemas, invoke models, stream / poll / no-wait, script in JSON output mode, and handle errors. Triggers on "runcomfy cli", "install runcomfy", "runcomfy login", "runcomfy run", "runcomfy whoami", "runcomfy api", or any explicit ask to call a RunComfy model from a script or terminal. Sibling skills (ai-image-generation, ai-video-generation, image-edit, video-edit, face-swap, lipsync, image-to-video, image-inpainting, image-outpainting, video-extend, controlnet-pose, relight) all dispatch through this CLI.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 中通过命令行运行任何模型。`runcomfy` 命令行界面（CLI）是一个二进制文件、一个认证、数百个模型端点——包括图像生成、图像编辑、视频生成、图像转视频、口型同步、人脸交换、视频编辑、图像修复、图像扩展、ControlNet、重新光照、放大、LoRA 训练等。提交请求、轮询状态、下载输出。这项技能将教会代理如何安装、认证、发现模型架构、调用模型、流式传输/轮询/无需等待、以 JSON 输出模式编写脚本，以及处理错误。当触发 "runcomfy cli"、"安装 runcomfy"、"runcomfy 登录"、"runcomfy 运行"、"runcomfy whoami"、"runcomfy api" 或任何明确要求从脚本或终端调用 RunComfy 模型的指令时，将触发此技能。同属技能（ai-image-generation、ai-video-generation、图像编辑、视频编辑、人脸交换、口型同步、图像转视频、图像修复、图像扩展、controlnet-pose、重新光照）均通过此 CLI 进行调度。

name: ai-avatar-video
description: Create AI avatar, talking-head, and lip-sync videos on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across ByteDance OmniHuman (audio-driven full-body avatar), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (audio-driven mouth sync via `audio_url` on a portrait), HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1 t2v / i2v with in-pass audio), and Seedance v2 Pro (multi-modal cinematic with reference audio + reference subject). Picks the right model for the user's actual intent — UGC voiceover, virtual presenter, dubbed product demo, lip-synced character, dialog scene — and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "talking head", "lip sync", "avatar video", "make X speak", "audio to video", "audio driven avatar", "virtual presenter", "AI spokesperson", "dubbed video", "UGC avatar", "HeyGen alternative", "Synthesia alternative", "digital human", "make this portrait talk", "video from voiceover", or any explicit ask to put words in a face.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上创建 AI 头像、口播视频和唇形同步视频。支持跨多个平台：ByteDance OmniHuman（音频驱动全身头像）、Wan-AI Wan 2-7（通过肖像上的 `audio_url` 实现音频驱动口型同步）、HappyHorse 1.0（Arena #1 的 t2v/i2v 功能，支持内嵌音频）、Seedance v2 Pro（多模态电影级效果，结合参考音频和参考主体）。根据用户的实际需求选择合适的模型——UGC 配音、虚拟主持人、配音产品演示、唇形同步角色、对话场景——并附带每个模型的文档提示模式及最小的 `runcomfy run` 调用指令。支持以下触发词："口播视频"、"唇形同步"、"头像视频"、"让 X 说话"、"音频转视频"、"音频驱动头像"、"虚拟主持人"、"AI 发言人"、"配音视频"、"UGC 头像"、"HeyGen 替代品"、"Synthesia 替代品"、"数字人"、"让这张肖像说话"、"配音生成视频"，或任何明确要求将文字合成到脸上的指令。

name: face-swap
description: Swap a face / character into video or images on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across community Wan 2-2 Animate (audio-driven character animation + identity swap), GPT Image 2 Edit (single-shot precise face swap on still images via reference composition), Nano Banana Edit (batch identity-preserving swap), Flux Kontext (single-ref high-fidelity local face edit), and Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro (transfer motion from one performance onto a target character). Picks the right model for the user's actual intent — single still vs video, full character vs face only, dialog scene vs silent motion. Triggers on "face swap", "swap face", "deepfake", "face replacement", "character swap", "head swap", "put X's face on Y", "make this video star X", "replace the actor in this video", "swap the character in the photo", "deepfake video", "ReActor alternative", or any explicit ask to substitute one identity for another.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` 命令行工具在 RunComfy 中将面部/角色替换到视频或图像中。涵盖社区 WAN 2-2 动画（音频驱动角色动画 + 身份替换）、GPT 图像 2 编辑（通过参考合成在静态图像上进行单次精确面部替换）、Nano Banana 编辑（批量身份保留替换）、Flux Kontext（单参考高保真本地面部编辑）以及 Kling 2-6 运动控制专业版（将一个表演的动作转移到目标角色上）。根据用户的实际意图选择合适的模型——单张静态图像与视频、完整角色与仅面部、对话场景与无声动作。在“面部替换”、“替换面部”、“深度伪造”、“面部替换”、“角色替换”、“头部替换”、“将 X 的面部放在 Y 上”、“让这个视频成为 X 的明星”、“替换这个视频中的演员”、“替换照片中的角色”、“深度伪造视频”、“ReActor 替代”或任何明确要求用一种身份替换另一种身份的请求时触发。

name: video-inpainting
description: Region edits across video frames on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — remove an object that appears across many frames, clean up wires or watermarks, replace a region with matching motion. Routes across Wan 2-7 edit-video (default, prompt-driven region edits with spatial language), Lucy Edit Restyle (identity-stable region-aware restyle), and Seedream 4-0 edit-sequential (when treating the clip as a frame stack). Picks the right route based on whether the change is prose-driven, identity-locked, or needs frame-by-frame still inpaint chained into a video. Triggers on "video inpaint", "video inpainting", "remove from video", "mask region in video", "clean up video", "remove object from clip", "video patch", "frame-by-frame edit", "remove watermark from video", "remove passing person", or any explicit ask to edit a region across video frames.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 中对视频帧进行区域编辑——移除在多个帧中出现的对象、清理线路或水印、用匹配的运动替换区域。路由选择包括 Wan 2-7 的 edit-video（默认，使用空间语言的提示驱动区域编辑）、Lucy Edit Restyle（身份稳定的区域感知重绘）以及 Seedream 4-0 的 edit-sequential（将片段视为帧堆栈时）。根据更改是文本驱动、身份锁定还是需要逐帧静态填充链式合成视频，选择合适的路由。触发条件包括“视频填充”、“视频填充修复”、“从视频中移除”、“视频中遮罩区域”、“清理视频”、“从片段中移除对象”、“视频补丁”、“逐帧编辑”、“从视频中移除水印”、“移除经过的人物”或任何明确要求跨视频帧编辑区域的指令。

name: vercel-composition-patterns
description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.

name: image-inpainting
description: Mask-driven image inpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Tongyi MAI Z-Image Turbo Inpainting (the dedicated inpainting endpoint with mask, strength, and control-scale) and to identity-preserving edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask isn't available and the region must be described instead. Use for object removal, watermark removal, region replacement, blemish cleanup, and any controlled local edit where a binary mask defines the target area. Triggers on "inpaint", "inpainting", "image inpaint", "remove from image", "fill region", "mask-driven edit", "remove watermark", "remove object", "patch the photo", "fill the hole", or any explicit ask to edit a specific masked region of a still.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上使用 `runcomfy` CLI 进行基于掩码的图像修复。当没有掩码可用且必须描述区域时，会路由到 Tongyi MAI Z-图像加速修复（专用的修复端点，具有掩码、强度和控制比例）以及身份保持编辑模型（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT 图像 2 Edit、FLUX Kontext Pro）。用于对象移除、水印移除、区域替换、瑕疵清理以及任何受控的局部编辑，其中二值掩码定义目标区域。在“修复”、“图像修复”、“填充区域”、“移除图像中的对象”、“填充区域”、“掩码驱动编辑”、“移除水印”、“移除对象”、“修复照片”、“填充漏洞”或明确要求编辑静态图像的特定掩码区域时触发。

name: controlnet-pose
description: Pose-conditioned generation on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro / Standard (transfer the motion / blocking of a reference video onto a target character), community Wan 2-2 Animate (audio-driven character animation with pose conditioning), and Z-Image Turbo ControlNet LoRA (pose-conditioned image generation from an OpenPose / DWPose / canny / depth control image). Picks the right route based on video vs still and stylized vs photoreal. Triggers on "controlnet", "control net", "pose control", "openpose", "DWPose", "transfer pose", "motion control", "pose driven", "character pose", "depth control", "canny edge", "use this pose", or any explicit ask to condition generation on a pose / skeleton / motion / depth / canny reference.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上通过 `runcomfy` 命令行界面进行姿态条件生成。包括 Kling 2-6 运动控制专业版/标准版（将参考视频的运动/遮挡效果迁移到目标角色上）、社区 Wan 2-2 动画（音频驱动的角色动画，结合姿态条件）、以及 Z-Image Turbo ControlNet LoRA（从 OpenPose / DWPose / canny / 深度控制图像生成姿态条件图像）。根据视频与静态图像、风格化与照片级真实感的差异选择合适的路径。当触发 "controlnet"、"control net"、"pose control"、"openpose"、"DWPose"、"transfer pose"、"motion control"、"pose driven"、"character pose"、"depth control"、"canny edge"、"use this pose" 或任何明确要求基于姿态/骨骼/运动/深度/canny参考进行条件生成时，将自动激活相应功能。

name: lipsync
description: Lip-sync a face to a specific audio track on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across ByteDance OmniHuman (audio-driven full-body avatar from a portrait + audio), Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro (state-of-the-art mouth sync onto a video), Kling lipsync (audio-to- video and text-to-video with synced speech), and Creatify lipsync. The skill picks the right endpoint for the user's actual intent — portrait still + audio (avatar-style), source video + audio (mouth- swap on existing footage), or generate-and-sync from a script. Triggers on "lip sync", "lipsync", "make this video speak", "match audio to mouth", "dub video", "sync lips to voice", "Sync Labs", "voiceover sync", or any explicit ask to drive a face's mouth from an audio track.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` 命令行在 RunComfy 中为特定音频轨道进行口型同步。支持 ByteDance OmniHuman（从肖像和音频生成驱动全身虚拟形象）、Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro（最先进的视频口型同步技术）、Kling lipsync（音频到视频和文本到视频的同步语音）、以及 Creatify lipsync。该技能会根据用户的实际意图选择合适的终端——肖像静态图+音频（虚拟形象风格）、源视频+音频（在现有素材上进行口型替换），或从脚本生成并同步。触发条件包括“口型同步”、“lipsync”、“让这个视频说话”、“音频匹配口型”、“配音视频”、“同步口型到语音”、“Sync Labs”、“配音同步”，或任何明确要求从音频轨道驱动虚拟形象口型的指令。

name: video-extend
description: Extend or continue an existing video clip on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Google Veo 3-1's `extend-video` and `fast/extend-video` endpoints — pick the source video plus a prompt describing what should happen next, and the model produces a clip that continues the original with consistent motion, lighting, and subject identity. Use when the user has a short Veo clip and wants it longer, or wants a chained narrative built shot-by-shot from a single seed clip. Triggers on "extend video", "continue video", "longer video", "video extend", "make this clip longer", "Veo extend", "chain video shots", "video continuation", or any explicit ask to take an existing video and add more frames after it.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上扩展或继续现有的视频片段。该功能路由至 Google Veo 3-1 的 `extend-video` 和 `fast/extend-video` 端点——选择源视频并输入一个描述接下来应该发生什么的提示，模型将生成一个延续原视频的片段，保持动作、光照和主体身份的一致性。适用于用户拥有一个较短的 Veo 视频片段并希望其更长的场景，或希望从单个种子片段逐帧构建成链式叙事。当用户触发以下指令时，该功能会被激活："扩展视频"、"继续视频"、"更长的视频"、"视频扩展"、"让这个片段更长"、"Veo 扩展"、"链式视频拍摄"、"视频延续"，或任何明确要求在现有视频后添加更多帧的请求。

name: elevenlabs-music-generation
description: Generate full songs and instrumental tracks with ElevenLabs Music on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. ElevenLabs Music turns a style description plus structured lyrics into studio-quality 44.1 kHz stereo audio — 5 seconds to 5 minutes — with section-level control (Intro / Verse / Chorus / Bridge), multilingual vocals, and commercial-friendly output. Generate a backing track, a full vocal song, a jingle, a podcast intro, a game loop, or an instrumental bed. Calls `runcomfy run elevenlabs/elevenlabs/music-generation` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "generate music", "make a song", "AI music", "background music", "instrumental track", "ElevenLabs Music", "soundtrack", "jingle", "theme music", "royalty-free music", "compose", or any explicit ask to generate music or a song from a text description.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上使用 ElevenLabs Music 生成完整歌曲和器乐曲目。ElevenLabs Music 将风格描述和结构化歌词转换为 44.1 kHz 立体声音频——时长 5 秒至 5 分钟——并支持段落级控制（Intro / Verse / Chorus / Bridge）、多语言人声以及商业友好输出。可生成伴奏、完整人声歌曲、广告歌、播客开场、游戏循环或器乐底轨。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run elevenlabs/elevenlabs/music-generation`。在以下触发词时触发："生成音乐"、"创作歌曲"、"AI 音乐"、"背景音乐"、"器乐曲目"、"ElevenLabs Music"、"配乐"、"广告歌"、"主题音乐"、"免版税音乐"、"作曲"，或任何明确要求从文本描述中生成音乐或歌曲的指令。

name: image-outpainting
description: Image outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend a still beyond its original canvas, fill in what the camera didn't capture, change aspect ratio (square → 16:9, portrait → landscape) while preserving the original content. Routes across Nano Banana 2 Edit (default, spatial-language driven), GPT Image 2 Edit (multi-ref with reference-style matching), FLUX Kontext Pro (single-shot maximum-preservation), and the brand edit endpoints (Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2). Picks the right route based on whether the outpaint is prose-driven, reference-driven, or brand-locked. Triggers on "outpaint", "outpainting", "extend image canvas", "expand the image", "fill in around the photo", "uncrop", "change aspect ratio", "extend frame", "wide-screen from square", or any explicit ask to add canvas around an existing still.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上进行图像外扩——将静态图像扩展到原始画布之外，填补相机未捕捉的部分，同时保持原始内容不变。可调整宽高比（方形转为 16:9，竖版转为横版）。支持以下路径：Nano Banana 2 Edit（默认，基于空间语言驱动）、GPT Image 2 Edit（多参考与参考式匹配）、FLUX Kontext Pro（单次最大保留）、以及品牌编辑接口（Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2）。根据外扩需求是文本驱动、参考驱动还是品牌锁定，自动选择最合适的路径。触发条件包括："outpaint"、"outpainting"、"扩展图像画布"、"扩展图像"、"填补照片周围"、"取消裁剪"、"调整宽高比"、"扩展画框"、"方形转为宽屏"，或任何明确要求在现有静态图像周围添加画布的指令。

name: relight
description: Relight a still image — change the lighting setup, color temperature, direction, or mood — on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Qwen Edit 2509's dedicated `relight` LoRA endpoint for purpose-built relighting, with fallback to identity-preserving edit endpoints (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when prose lighting language is enough. Use for product relighting (studio softbox → window light), portrait mood shift (overcast → golden hour), or color-grade change. Triggers on "relight", "relighting", "change the lighting", "make it golden hour", "studio lighting", "rim light", "blue hour", "soft window light", "change light direction", "color temperature", or any explicit ask to alter how a still is lit.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 中重新照亮静态图像——更改灯光设置、色温、方向或氛围。该功能会调用 Qwen Edit 2509 的专用 `relight` LoRA 端点进行定制化重光照，若仅需要通过文字描述灯光效果，则会回退至身份保留的编辑端点（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT Image 2 Edit、FLUX Kontext Pro）。适用于产品重光照（影室柔光箱 → 窗户光）、肖像氛围转换（阴天 → 金色时刻）或色彩调校。当输入“重新照亮”、“进行重光照”、“更改灯光”、“打造金色时刻”、“影室灯光”、“轮廓光”、“蓝调时刻”、“柔光窗户光”、“改变光线方向”、“色温”或任何明确要求调整静态图像光线分布的指令时，该功能将被触发。

name: video-outpainting
description: Video outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend the spatial canvas of a video, change aspect ratio (9:16 vertical to 16:9 horizontal or vice versa), add environment beyond the original frame while preserving the central action. Routes prompt-shaped spatial extension through Wan 2-7 edit-video and points the agent at dedicated ComfyUI outpaint workflows when seam quality matters for hero delivery. Triggers on "video outpaint", "video outpainting", "extend video canvas", "expand video frame", "uncrop video", "aspect ratio change", "vertical to horizontal video", "16:9 from 9:16", "TikTok to YouTube", or any explicit ask to extend a video spatially beyond its original frame.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上进行视频外绘——扩展视频的空间画布，改变宽高比（从 9:16 垂直变为 16:9 水平或反之），在保留中心动作的同时添加原始帧外的环境。通过 Wan 2-7 的编辑视频功能，将提示形状的空间扩展路由到 ComfyUI 外绘工作流，当英雄内容的接缝质量至关重要时，将代理指向专门的外绘工作流。在以下触发词或明确要求扩展视频空间画布时触发："视频外绘"、"视频外绘"、"扩展视频画布"、"扩展视频帧"、"去裁剪视频"、"宽高比改变"、"垂直到水平视频"、"从 9:16 到 16:9"、"从 TikTok 到 YouTube"，或任何明确要求将视频空间扩展到原始帧之外的内容。
