description_zh: 在AI生成的图像中保持角色一致性，参考表和LoRA技术。涵盖转向视图、表情表、调色板和风格一致性技巧。适用于：角色设计、游戏艺术、插画、动画、漫画、视觉小说。触发词：角色设计、角色表、角色一致性、角色参考、转向表、表情表、角色艺术、一致角色、角色概念、参考表、角色创建、原创角色设计、角色圣经。

name: writing-runbooks
description: Use when writing operational documentation - runbooks, setup guides, release procedures, migration guides, deprecation guides, troubleshooting entries, or any ordered procedure someone will execute under time pressure. Encodes the runbook skeleton, the risk legend, the symptom-first troubleshooting format, and the migration-guide rules (mapping table, mandatory rollback, deprecation dates, built-in expiry). Use whenever someone will execute the text, even if it is called a "guide" or "setup notes".
description_zh: 在编写操作文档时使用——运行手册、设置指南、发布流程、迁移指南、弃用指南、故障排除条目或任何需要人员在时间压力下执行的有序流程。它编码了运行手册框架、风险图例、以症状为先的故障排除格式以及迁移指南规则（映射表、强制回滚、弃用日期、内置过期）。无论是否被称为“指南”或“设置说明”，只要有人需要执行文本，就应使用。

name: writing-changelogs
description: Use when writing a changelog entry, release notes, or a "what shipped" summary after completing work. Encodes the entry shape, the handover template, and the honesty conventions. Use after shipping meaningful work, even if the user just says "summarize what we did".
description_zh: 在撰写版本更新日志、发布说明或完成工作后的“已发布内容概要”时使用。它编码了条目格式、交接模板和诚实性规范。即使用户只是说“总结我们做了什么”，在发布有意义的成果后也应使用。

name: storyboard-creation
description: Film and video storyboarding with shot vocabulary, continuity rules, and panel layout. Covers shot types, camera angles, movement, 180-degree rule, and annotation format. Use for: video planning, film pre-production, ad storyboards, music video planning, animation. Triggers: storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard
description_zh: 电影和视频故事板制作，包括镜头词汇、连贯性规则和面板布局。涵盖镜头类型、摄像机角度、运动、180度规则和注释格式。适用于：视频策划、电影前期制作、广告故事板、音乐视频策划、动画。触发词：故事板、故事板制作、镜头清单、电影策划、视频策划、前期制作、镜头构图、摄像机角度、场景策划、视觉脚本、动态影像、故事板面板、视频故事板

name: akshare-stock
description: A股分析全能 Skill（实时行情、技术面、基本面、板块、衍生品与跨市场），基于 akshare + 自然语言路由

name: angular-component
description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Create modern Angular standalone components following v20+ best practices. Use for building UI components with signal-based inputs/outputs, OnPush change detection, host bindings, content projection, and lifecycle hooks. Triggers on component creation, refactoring class-based inputs to signals, adding host bindings, or implementing accessible interactive components.
description_zh: 弃用 - 此技能已不再维护。请使用官方的 Angular 技能，访问 https://github.com/angular/skills。遵循 v20+ 最佳实践创建现代的 Angular 独立组件。用于构建基于 signal 的输入/输出、OnPush 变更检测、宿主绑定、内容投影和生命周期钩子的 UI 组件。在组件创建、将类输入重构为 signal、添加宿主绑定或实现可访问的交互式组件时触发。

name: context7
description: Retrieve up-to-date documentation for software libraries, frameworks, and components via the Context7 API. This skill should be used when looking up documentation for any programming library or framework, finding code examples for specific APIs or features, verifying correct usage of library functions, or obtaining current information about library APIs that may have changed since training.
description_zh: 通过 Context7 API 获取软件库、框架和组件的最新文档。当查找任何编程库或框架的文档、为特定 API 或功能查找代码示例、验证库函数的正确用法，或获取自训练以来可能已更改的库 API 的当前信息时，应使用此技能。

name: ppt-visual
description: Design presentation visuals and slide layouts. Create visual concepts, suggest graphics, and provide design specifications for impactful PowerPoint slides.
description_zh: 设计演示视觉效果和幻灯片布局。创建视觉概念，提出图形建议，并为具有影响力的PowerPoint幻灯片提供设计规范。

name: multi-agent-review
description: Use when a spec or plan needs review before execution begins - "review my spec", "is this plan ready to execute", "check this before I build it", "second opinion on this plan" - and specifically before writing-plans (spec mode) or before subagent-driven-development (plan mode). Reviews specs and plans, not code. Panels six reviewers across two model tiers and three topics, invokes a reasoning-tier juror only when the tiers disagree, and gates the next workflow step with a fail-closed Blockers / Warnings / Observations verdict.
description_zh: 在规范或计划执行前需要评审时使用——"评审我的规范"、"这个计划是否准备好执行"、"在我构建之前检查一下"、"对这个计划提出第二意见"——特别是在编写计划（规范模式）或子代理驱动开发（计划模式）之前。评审规范和计划，而不是代码。该面板在两个模型层级和三个主题上安排六位评审员，仅在层级意见不一致时才会调用推理层级陪审员，并使用"失败关闭的障碍/警告/观察"裁决来控制下一步工作流。

name: recording-decisions
description: Use when a decision needs recording - an ADR, a decision log entry, or when someone asks to write down why something was chosen, rejected, or superseded. Encodes the ADR and decision-log formats. Use whenever a choice was made that would otherwise live only in chat, even if nobody says "ADR".
description_zh: 当需要记录决策时使用——例如，创建一个 ADR（决策记录）、添加一条决策日志条目，或者当有人要求记录某项选择、拒绝或替代的原因时。它编码了 ADR 和决策日志的格式。无论何时做出选择，即使没有人说“ADR”，也应该使用它，因为这样的选择原本只会存在于聊天记录中。

name: writing-issues
description: Use when writing or refining tracker items - epics, stories, tasks, bug reports, spikes, or acceptance criteria - or when turning a discussion, review finding, or plan into tickets. Encodes the survives-without-you test, the issue-type glossary, and the story and bug skeletons. Use whenever work is written into a tracker, even from a rough verbal dump.
description_zh: 在编写或完善追踪项（如史诗、故事、任务、缺陷报告、探索性任务或验收标准）时使用，或在将讨论、评审发现或计划转换为工单时使用。它编码了无需你即可继续的测试、问题类型词汇表以及故事和缺陷骨架。无论何时将工作写入追踪系统，即使是从粗略的口头概述开始，都可以使用。

name: upgrading-react-native
description: Upgrades React Native apps to newer versions by applying rn-diff-purge template diffs, updating package.json dependencies, migrating native iOS and Android configuration, resolving CocoaPods and Gradle changes, and handling breaking API updates. Use when upgrading React Native, bumping RN version, updating from RN 0.x to 0.y, or migrating Expo SDK alongside a React Native upgrade.
description_zh: 通过应用 rn-diff-purge 模板差异、更新 package.json 依赖、迁移原生 iOS 和 Android 配置、解决 CocoaPods 和 Gradle 变更以及处理破坏性 API 更新，将 React Native 应用升级到新版本。在升级 React Native、提升 RN 版本、从 RN 0.x 更新到 0.y，或伴随 React Native 升级迁移 Expo SDK 时使用。

name: writing-postmortems
description: Use when writing a postmortem, incident report, or root-cause analysis after an outage, a defect that reached users, a data issue, or a near miss - or when turning an incident channel, alert log, or war-room thread into a durable document. Encodes the blameless framing, the evidence-only timeline, contributing factors, and owned action items. Use whenever something broke and the write-up must outlive the incident.
description_zh: 在撰写事后分析报告、事件报告或根本原因分析时使用，这些情况包括系统故障、用户遇到缺陷、数据问题或险些发生的事故——或者当需要将事件通道、告警日志或战情室线程转化为持久性文档时。它编码了无责归因框架、仅含证据的时间线、影响因素和负责行动项。每当出现问题时，且撰写内容必须超越事件本身时，均可使用。

name: agent-email-inbox
description: Use when building any system where email content triggers actions — AI agent inboxes, automated support handlers, email-to-task pipelines, or any workflow processing untrusted inbound email. Always use this skill when the user wants to receive emails and act on them programmatically, even if they don't mention "agent" — the skill contains critical security patterns (sender allowlists, content filtering, sandboxed processing) that prevent untrusted email from controlling your system.
description_zh: 在构建任何需要通过邮件内容触发操作的系统中使用——例如 AI 代理收件箱、自动化支持处理程序、邮件到任务管道或任何处理不可信入站邮件的工作流。当用户希望接收邮件并对其进行程序化处理时，始终使用此技能，即使他们没有提及“代理”——该技能包含关键的安全模式（发件人白名单、内容过滤、沙箱处理），以防止不可信邮件控制您的系统。

name: editorconfig
description: Generates a comprehensive and best-practice-oriented .editorconfig file based on project analysis and user preferences.
description_zh: 根据项目分析和用户偏好，生成一个全面且以最佳实践为导向的 .editorconfig 文件。

name: dotnet-upgrade
description: Ready-to-use prompts for comprehensive .NET framework upgrade analysis and execution
description_zh: 用于全面 .NET 框架升级分析和执行的即用型提示

name: svelte-code-writer
description: CLI tools for Svelte 5 documentation lookup and code analysis. MUST be used whenever creating, editing or analyzing any Svelte component (.svelte) or Svelte module (.svelte.ts/.svelte.js). If possible, this skill should be executed within the svelte-file-editor agent for optimal results.
description_zh: 用于 Svelte 5 文档查询和代码分析的命令行工具。在创建、编辑或分析任何 Svelte 组件（.svelte）或 Svelte 模块（.svelte.ts/.svelte.js）时，必须使用。如果可能，此功能应在 svelte-file-editor 代理中执行以获得最佳效果。

name: penetration-testing-with-strix
description: Pentest a web app, API, codebase, repository, URL, domain, or IP with Strix — autonomous AI penetration testing that exploits and proves vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10 and beyond — injection, XSS, SSRF, auth/access-control flaws, IDOR, business logic) instead of just flagging them. Runs self-hosted with the open-source CLI or via the managed app.strix.ai cloud, and returns validated findings with proof-of-concept exploits (Markdown, JSON, CSV, SARIF). Use when the user asks to pentest, hack, security-scan, security-audit, or find vulnerabilities in an app, API, website, or repo.
description_zh: 使用Strix对Web应用程序、API、代码库、存储库、URL、域名或IP进行渗透测试——这是一种自主AI渗透测试工具，能够利用并证明漏洞（包括OWASP Top 10及更高版本——注入、XSS、SSRF、认证/访问控制缺陷、IDOR、业务逻辑），而不仅仅是标记它们。支持在开源CLI上自托管运行，或通过管理的app.strix.ai云端运行，并返回经过验证的发现结果，附带概念验证漏洞利用（支持Markdown、JSON、CSV、SARIF格式）。当用户要求对应用程序、API、网站或存储库进行渗透测试、黑客攻击、安全扫描或安全审计，或寻找漏洞时使用。

name: shopify-polaris-app-home
description: Build your app's primary user interface embedded in the Shopify admin using the **iframe** model — a web app you host yourself, rendered with `@shopify/polaris-types` and App Bridge. Covers the Intents API (`shopify.intents.invoke`) for launching native workflows from App Home. For the Shopify-hosted `admin.app.home.render` extension target, use **`polaris-admin-extensions`** instead. If the prompt just mentions `Polaris` and you can't tell based off of the context what API they meant, assume they meant this API.
description_zh: 使用**iframe**模型在Shopify后台构建您的应用程序主要用户界面——这是一个您自己托管的Web应用程序，使用`@shopify/polaris-types`和App Bridge进行渲染。涵盖Intents API (`shopify.intents.invoke`)，用于从App Home启动原生工作流程。对于Shopify托管的`admin.app.home.render`扩展目标，请使用**`polaris-admin-extensions`**。如果提示中仅提到`Polaris`，且根据上下文无法确定其指代哪个API，则默认指代此API。

name: linear-cli
description: Manage Linear issues from the command line using the linear cli. This skill allows automating linear management.
description_zh: 使用 linear cli 从命令行管理 Linear 问题。这项技能允许自动化 Linear 管理。

name: python-resilience
description: Python resilience patterns including automatic retries, exponential backoff, timeouts, and fault-tolerant decorators. Use when adding retry logic, implementing timeouts, building fault-tolerant services, or handling transient failures.
description_zh: Python 弹性模式，包括自动重试、指数退避、超时和容错装饰器。在添加重试逻辑、实现超时、构建容错服务或处理瞬态故障时使用。

name: writing-unit-tests
description: Use when writing or refactoring unit tests - a new test file, added cases, a flaky test, an unreadable one. Encodes behavior-first testing: one behavior per test, names that state the claim, deterministic setup, mocks only at boundaries you do not own. Use whenever a test is being written, even a quick one, and whenever a test needs a sleep, a mock of your own code, or a copy of the implementation's math.
description_zh: 在编写或重构单元测试时使用——新测试文件、添加用例、不稳定测试、难以理解的测试。它体现了行为优先测试原则：每个测试一个行为，命名要明确声明，确定性设置，仅在你不拥有的边界处使用模拟。无论何时编写测试（即使是快速测试），或者测试需要休眠、模拟自己的代码或复制实现中的数学逻辑时，都可以使用。

name: marimo-pair
description: Drive a live marimo notebook as a workspace: run Python in the same kernel the user does, inspect live notebook state, and commit durable notebook changes. Use when the user wants to start a marimo notebook or pair on an active marimo session.
description_zh: 以活体.marimo笔记本作为工作空间：在用户相同的内核中运行Python，检查实时笔记本状态，并提交持久的笔记本更改。当用户想要启动一个新的.marimo笔记本或与活跃的.marimo会话配对时使用。

name: principal-engineering
description: Use when doing any non-trivial engineering work - implementing, debugging, refactoring, configuring, operating, or investigating why a system misbehaves - or any change where being wrong has a cost. Encodes the evidence-over-theory discipline, the hard safety rules, and the pre-change checkpoint. Use whenever code, data, or infrastructure is about to change or must be understood before it can, even if the task looks routine or is only "find out why". Foundation for the sibling skills.
description_zh: 在进行任何非平凡的工程工作时使用——包括实现、调试、重构、配置、操作或调查系统为何表现异常——或任何错误会产生代价的变更。它编码了“证据优先于理论”的纪律、严格的安全规则以及变更前的检查点。无论代码、数据或基础设施即将变更，或必须在其变更前理解，即使任务看似常规或仅仅是“找出原因”，也请使用。这是兄弟技能的基础。

name: documenting-legacy-codebases
description: Use when documenting an existing codebase whose documentation is missing, stale, or untrusted - an inherited system, a legacy application, a repo where the docs lie - or when regrounding a documentation tree against the code, or when someone asks what a system actually does. Encodes the survey-first inventory, the writer-side evidence hierarchy, depth-per-surface rules, the refactor test, dead-or-alive proofs, the quirks-and-findings split, the coverage ledger, the parallel campaign, and the docs-tree skeleton. Use whenever documentation must be reconstructed from the code rather than written alongside a change.
description_zh: 在记录一个缺少、过时或不可靠的现有代码库时使用——比如一个继承的系统、遗留应用程序、文档缺失的代码库，或者当需要将文档树与代码重新对齐时，或者当有人询问系统实际功能时。它编码了先调查的清单、编写者侧的证据层级、每个表面的深度规则、重构测试、死活证明、特性和发现分离、覆盖账本、并行战役以及文档树骨架。每当文档必须从代码中重建，而不是伴随变更编写时，都可以使用。

name: verifying-before-done
description: Use when about to say "done", "fixed", "passing", or "shipped", or when reporting the outcome of any change. Encodes verification as the definition of done: drive the change at its surface, run the verify command, report faithfully, distrust green suites, own failing gates. Use before every completion claim, even when the change was small and obviously correct, which is when this is skipped.
description_zh: 在准备说“完成”、“修复”、“通过”或“已发货”时，或报告任何变更的结果时使用。将验证编码为完成的定义：在变更表面驱动变更，运行验证命令，忠实报告，不信任绿色套件，拥有失败的关卡。在每次完成声明之前使用，即使变更很小且明显正确，这时也会跳过使用。

name: grounding-before-coding
description: Use when starting any non-trivial change, investigating a bug, or working in unfamiliar code - before the first line is written. Also use for pure investigation with no change planned yet - "dig into this", "figure out why", "sometimes the export is empty", intermittent errors after a deploy. Encodes the ground-first discipline: map the real code and data, quote evidence, never guess conventions. Use whenever a change or a conclusion is about to be built from belief instead of from the tree, even under time pressure.
description_zh: 在开始任何非平凡的变更、调查错误或处理不熟悉的代码之前使用——在编写第一行代码之前。也适用于尚未计划进行变更的纯调查——"深入研究这个"、"弄清楚原因"、"有时导出为空"、"部署后出现间歇性错误"。它体现了从实际出发的原则：映射真实代码和数据，引用证据，绝不猜测约定。无论何时，当变更或结论即将基于信念而非树形结构构建时，即使面临时间压力，也应使用。

name: guarding-architecture
description: Use when a change crosses module boundaries, adds a dependency direction between modules, touches a critical path, or conflicts with a stated principle - and when writing or updating architecture principles themselves. Encodes structural invariants as named, enforced contracts: statement, rationale, guard. Use whenever "we'll just import it from there for now" appears, which is how boundaries die.
description_zh: 当变更跨越模块边界、在模块间增加依赖方向、触及关键路径或与既定原则冲突时，以及编写或更新架构原则本身时使用。将结构不变量编码为命名、强制的契约：声明、理由、守卫。每当出现“我们暂时从那里导入就好”时使用，这是边界消亡的方式。

name: testing-changes
description: Use when deciding what tests a change needs - a feature, a bug fix, a refactor, any behavior change - or when reviewing whether a diff's tests are sufficient. Encodes tests-change-with-behavior, the bug-regression pattern, and assertion discrimination. Use whenever behavior changes and the test diff is empty, especially when the change is "too small to test".
description_zh: 在决定一个变更需要哪些测试时使用——无论是新功能、bug修复、重构还是任何行为变更——或者在使用diff审查测试是否足够时使用。它编码了测试-变更-行为、bug回归模式以及断言区分。每当行为发生变化且测试diff为空时使用，尤其是在变更“太小而无法测试”时。

name: keeping-one-source-of-truth
description: Use when adding data, config, state, constants, an enum-like string, a cache, or anything that could exist in two places - or when two sources already disagree. Encodes the one-fact-one-source doctrine for code and data: derive rather than store, extend the owner, absorb duplicates. Use at the moment copying a value feels faster than referencing it.
description_zh: 在添加数据、配置、状态、常量、类似枚举的字符串、缓存或任何可能存在于两个地方的元素时使用——或者当两个来源已经存在分歧时。它为代码和数据编码了“一事一源”原则：衍生而非存储，扩展所有者，吸收重复项。在复制值感觉比引用更快的时候使用。

name: cost-optimization
description: Optimize cloud costs across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI through resource rightsizing, tagging strategies, reserved instances, and spending analysis. Use when reducing cloud expenses, analyzing infrastructure costs, or implementing cost governance policies.
description_zh: 通过资源优化、标签策略、预留实例和支出分析，优化 AWS、Azure、GCP 和 OCI 的云成本。在减少云支出、分析基础设施成本或实施成本治理策略时使用。

name: gitops-workflow
description: Implement GitOps workflows with ArgoCD and Flux for automated, declarative Kubernetes deployments with continuous reconciliation. Use when implementing GitOps practices, automating Kubernetes deployments, or setting up declarative infrastructure management.
description_zh: 使用 ArgoCD 和 Flux 实现 GitOps 工作流，以实现具有持续调谐的自动化、声明式 Kubernetes 部署。适用于实施 GitOps 实践、自动化 Kubernetes 部署或设置声明式基础设施管理。

name: scoping-changes
description: Use when deciding how big a fix should be, when scope is drifting mid-task, when a plan is being quietly trimmed to fit, or when "while you're at it" appears in any form. Encodes size-to-trigger, decompose-not-descope, and drive-to-completion. Use whenever the work is about to grow past its cause or shrink below its promise.
description_zh: 在决定修复项的大小、任务范围在执行过程中发生漂移、计划在悄无声息中被缩减以适应情况，或出现任何形式的“顺便做一下”时使用。它编码了大小与触发的关系、分解而非缩小范围、以及驱动至完成的理念。每当工作即将超出其起因或缩小到低于其承诺时，都应使用。

name: market-sizing-analysis
description: Calculate TAM/SAM/SOM for market opportunities using top-down, bottom-up, and value theory methodologies. Use this skill when sizing markets, estimating addressable revenue, validating market opportunity for a new venture, or building investor-ready market analysis for a startup pitch or business plan.
description_zh: 使用自上而下、自下而上和价值理论方法计算市场机会的TAM/SAM/SOM。在确定市场规模、估算可触及收入、验证新创企业的市场机会，或为创业计划书或商业计划构建投资者准备的市场分析时，使用这项技能。

name: operating-safely
description: Use when an action touches live systems, shared state, or things that do not come back - deleting, overwriting, restarting, killing processes, editing shared config, handling secrets, or working beside concurrent sessions. Encodes the destructive-op guards, secrets hygiene, and concurrent-session safety. Use before the destructive command, not after, even when the command looks routine.
description_zh: 当操作涉及实时系统、共享状态或不可恢复的事物时使用——例如删除、覆盖、重启、终止进程、编辑共享配置、处理密钥或与并发会话协同工作。它编码了破坏性操作的防护、密钥卫生和并发会话安全。即使命令看似常规，也应在破坏性命令之前使用，而不是之后。

name: fastapi
description: FastAPI best practices and conventions. Use when working with FastAPI APIs, Pydantic models, dependencies, streaming responses including Server-Sent Events (SSE), and serving frontend apps. Keeps FastAPI code clean and up to date with the latest features and patterns.
description_zh: FastAPI最佳实践和约定。在与FastAPI API、Pydantic模型、依赖项、流式响应（包括服务器发送事件（SSE））以及服务前端应用程序时使用。保持FastAPI代码清晰，并使用最新的功能和模式。

name: handling-failures
description: Use when writing or touching any error path, catch block, fallback, default value, retry, or degraded mode - in any language, any repo. Encodes the no-silent-swallows contract and the fail-loud discipline. Use whenever an exception is about to be caught, a null is about to get a default, or a failure could pass unnoticed, even if the goal is "just make it not crash".
description_zh: 在编写或触及任何错误路径、捕获块、回退、默认值、重试或降级模式时使用——无论使用何种语言，无论在哪个代码库中。它编码了“不静默吞没”的契约和“失败要响亮”的纪律。无论何时即将捕获异常、某个空值即将获得默认值，或失败可能未被注意到，即使目标是“只要让它不崩溃”，也应使用。

name: python-observability
description: Python observability patterns including structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing. Use when adding logging, implementing metrics collection, setting up tracing, or debugging production systems.
description_zh: Python 可观察性模式，包括结构化日志、指标和分布式追踪。在添加日志、实现指标收集、设置追踪或调试生产系统时使用。

name: python-configuration
description: Python configuration management via environment variables and typed settings. Use when externalizing config, setting up pydantic-settings, managing secrets, or implementing environment-specific behavior.
description_zh: 通过环境变量和类型化设置进行 Python 配置管理。用于配置外部化、设置 pydantic-settings、管理密钥或实现特定环境的行为。

name: resend-cli
description: Operate the Resend platform from the terminal — send emails (including React Email .tsx templates via --react-email), manage domains, contacts, broadcasts, templates, webhooks, API keys, logs, automations, and events via the `resend` CLI. Use when the user wants to run Resend commands in the shell, scripts, or CI/CD pipelines, or send/preview React Email templates. Always load this skill before running `resend` commands — it contains the non-interactive flag contract and gotchas that prevent silent failures.
description_zh: 通过终端操作 Resend 平台——发送电子邮件（包括通过 `--react-email` 发送的 React Email .tsx 模板）、管理域名、联系人、广播、模板、Webhook、API 密钥、日志、自动化和事件，均通过 `resend` CLI 完成。当用户需要在 Shell、脚本或 CI/CD 管道中运行 Resend 命令，或发送/预览 React Email 模板时使用。在运行 `resend` 命令前，始终加载此技能——它包含非交互式标志契约和防止静默失败的注意事项。

name: adding-dependencies
description: Use when about to add, update, vet, or remove a dependency - a package, library, SDK, GitHub action, base image, or vendored code - or when a project's dependency posture needs declaring. Encodes the exhaust-what-you-have ladder, the vetting questions, and pin-and-prove updating. Use even for a tiny utility package: that is exactly how the tree grows.
description_zh: 在添加、更新、审核或移除依赖项（如软件包、库、SDK、GitHub操作、基础镜像或封装代码）时使用，或者当需要声明项目依赖状态时使用。它编码了“穷尽你所拥有的”原则、审核问题以及“固定并验证”的更新方法。即使是微小的工具包也需要使用：这正是树状结构生长的方式。

name: email-best-practices
description: Use when building email features, emails going to spam, high bounce rates, setting up SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, implementing email capture, ensuring compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL), handling webhooks, retry logic, making emails accessible (alt text, headings, contrast, screen readers), or deciding transactional vs marketing.
description_zh: 在构建电子邮件功能时使用，包括：邮件进入垃圾邮件箱、高退回率、设置SPF/DKIM/DMARC认证、实现邮件捕获、确保合规性（CAN-SPAM、GDPR、CASL）、处理Webhooks、重试逻辑、确保邮件可访问性（替代文本、标题、对比度、屏幕阅读器），或决定事务性邮件与营销邮件。

name: simple-english
description:
Write or rewrite text in plain, layman-readable English in the spirit of
ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, active voice,
simple tenses, one word one meaning, condition before command, every
technical term defined at first use, no AI slop. Default mode is Plain.
Strict mode applies full STE vocabulary compliance when the user names
STE, ASD-STE100, or compliance. Use for documentation, READMEs, runbooks,
procedures, error messages, release notes, incident reports, API guides,
and explanations for readers outside the field. Also use when the user
says "STE", "Simplified Technical English", "ASD-STE100", "plain English",
"layman's terms", "explain it simply", "no jargon", "de-slop", "make this
readable", "write for non-native readers", or asks for docs that translate
well. The same rules govern the reply: answer first, prose only.
description_zh: 以 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语的精神，用平实易懂的英语撰写或重写文本：短句、主动语态、简单时态、一词一义、条件在前命令在后、每个技术术语在首次使用时定义、无 AI 滥用。默认模式为“平实”。严格模式在用户指定“STE”、“ASD-STE100”或“合规”时生效，此时将完全符合 STE 词汇规范。适用于文档、README、运行手册、操作规程、错误信息、发布说明、事件报告、API 指南，以及面向领域外读者的解释。当用户说“STE”、“简化技术英语”、“ASD-STE100”、“平实英语”、“外行话”、“简单解释”、“无术语”、“去滥词”、“让这易读”、“为非母语读者撰写”，或要求翻译效果好的文档时，同样适用。回复亦遵循相同规则：先回答，仅用散文形式。

name: diagramming-processes
description: Use when a business process, workflow, lifecycle, or interaction between systems needs a diagram - a flow that prose serializes badly, a state machine, a message sequence, an enterprise process map - or when drawing the process documentation of a legacy campaign. Encodes diagrams-as-source, the notation ladder from ArchiMate to PlantUML, the kind-per-question table, behavior-level participants, the diagram index, and the same-change maintenance rule. Use whenever a document needs a graph rather than more paragraphs, even if nobody says "PlantUML".
description_zh: 当业务流程、工作流、生命周期或系统交互需要图表时——一个难以用文字顺序描述的流程、状态机、消息序列、企业流程图——或绘制遗留活动的过程文档时，请使用。它编码图表作为源，从ArchiMate到PlantUML的符号体系，按类型提问的表格，行为级别的参与者，图表索引以及相同变更维护规则。无论是否有人提出“PlantUML”，只要文档需要图表而非更多段落，就请使用。

name: shopify-functions
description: Shopify Functions allow developers to customize the backend logic that powers parts of Shopify. Available APIs: Discount, Cart and Checkout Validation, Cart Transform, Pickup Point Delivery Option Generator, Delivery Customization, Fulfillment Constraints, Local Pickup Delivery Option Generator, Order Routing Location Rule, Payment Customization
description_zh: Shopify 函数允许开发者自定义驱动 Shopify 部分功能的后端逻辑。可用的 API：折扣、购物车和结账验证、购物车转换、取货点配送选项生成器、配送自定义、履行约束、本地取货配送选项生成器、订单路由位置规则、支付自定义。

name: embedding-strategies
description: Select and optimize embedding models for semantic search and RAG applications. Use when choosing embedding models, implementing chunking strategies, or optimizing embedding quality for specific domains.
description_zh: 选择并优化用于语义搜索和RAG应用的嵌入模型。在选择嵌入模型、实施分块策略或针对特定领域优化嵌入质量时使用。

name: dart-run-static-analysis
description: Execute `dart analyze` to identify warnings and errors, and use `dart fix --apply` to automatically resolve mechanical lint issues. Use during development to ensure code quality and before committing changes.
description_zh: 执行 `dart analyze` 以识别警告和错误，并使用 `dart fix --apply` 自动解决机械性 lint 问题。在开发过程中使用以确保代码质量，并在提交更改之前使用。

name: documenting-contracts
description: Use when documenting an HTTP API, message payloads, queue contracts, DTOs, file formats, or webhooks - or when writing the api-reference of a legacy campaign, or when callers keep asking what a field means or which errors an endpoint returns. Encodes the four detail levels, the DTO-first catalog, wire types with source anchors, the generated-spec one-home rule, and omitted-versus-null semantics. Use whenever a machine interface needs documenting for its callers, even if nobody says "API docs".
description_zh: 在记录 HTTP API、消息有效载荷、队列契约、DTO、文件格式或 webhook 时使用——或在编写旧有活动 api-reference 时使用，或当调用者不断询问某个字段的含义或端点返回的错误时。它编码了四个详细级别、DTO 优先目录、带源锚点的线缆类型、生成规范的单点规则以及省略与空值的语义。无论何时需要为调用者记录机器接口，即使没人说“API 文档”，也请使用。

name: vue-options-api-best-practices
description: Vue 3 Options API style (data(), methods, this context). Each reference shows Options API solution only.
description_zh: Vue 3 选项 API 风格（data()、methods、this 上下文）。每个引用仅展示选项 API 的解决方案。

name: shellcheck-configuration
description: Master ShellCheck static analysis configuration and usage for shell script quality. Use when setting up linting infrastructure, fixing code issues, or ensuring script portability.
description_zh: 掌握 ShellCheck 静态分析配置和使用，以提升 shell 脚本质量。在设置代码检查基础设施、修复代码问题或确保脚本可移植性时使用。

name: dart-add-unit-test
description: Write and organize unit tests for functions, methods, and classes using `package:test`. Use when creating new logic or fixing bugs to ensure code remains correct and regression-free.
description_zh: 使用 `package:test` 编写和组织函数、方法和类的单元测试。在创建新逻辑或修复错误时使用，以确保代码保持正确且无回归问题。

name: scrape
description: Scrape web content as clean markdown/HTML/JSON via the Bright Data CLI (`bdata scrape`). Use when the user wants to fetch a page, extract content from a list of URLs, or crawl paginated listings. Hands off to `data-feeds` for supported platforms (Amazon, LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, etc.) and to `search` when URLs must be discovered first. Requires the Bright Data CLI; proactively guides install + login if missing.
description_zh: 通过 Bright Data CLI (`bdata scrape`) 以干净的 markdown/HTML/JSON 格式抓取网页内容。当用户需要获取页面、从 URL 列表中提取内容或爬取分页列表时使用。支持的平台（如 Amazon、LinkedIn、TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Reddit 等）交由 `data-feeds` 处理，而 URL 需要先发现时则交由 `search` 处理。需要 Bright Data CLI；若缺失则会主动引导安装和登录。

name: java-docs
description: Ensure that Java types are documented with Javadoc comments and follow best practices for documentation.
description_zh: 确保使用Javadoc注释对Java类型进行文档化，并遵循文档化的最佳实践。

name: darwin-skill
description: Darwin Skill 2.0 (达尔文.skill 2.0): autonomous skill optimizer, v2.0 integrates Microsoft Research SkillLens (arXiv 2605.23899) 9-dim rubric + SkillOpt (arXiv 2605.23904) validation-gated design + human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Evaluates SKILL.md files using a 9-dimension rubric (structure + effectiveness + meta-skill blacklists), runs hill-climbing with git version control, spawns independent judge agents for blind evaluation, validates improvements through test prompts with auto-break on diminishing returns, and generates visual result cards. Use when user mentions "优化skill", "skill评分", "自动优化", "auto optimize", "skill质量检查", "达尔文", "darwin", "帮我改改skill", "skill怎么样", "提升skill质量", "skill review", "skill打分".

name: mo-qa
description: Run and control Mo QA sessions with Momentic's `qa` CLI. Use for bug bashes, status checks, report export, replies to Mo, file transfer, or repairs based on Mo findings.
description_zh: 使用 Momentic 的 `qa` 命令行界面 (CLI) 运行和控制 Mo QA 会话。可用于 Bug Bash、状态检查、报告导出、回复 Mo、文件传输或根据 Mo 查找结果进行修复。

name: csharp-async
description: Get best practices for C# async programming
description_zh: 获取 C# 异步编程的最佳实践

name: go-concurrency-patterns
description: Master Go concurrency with goroutines, channels, sync primitives, and context. Use when building concurrent Go applications, implementing worker pools, or debugging race conditions.
description_zh: 掌握 Go 并发，使用 goroutines、channels、sync primitives 和 context。适用于构建并发 Go 应用、实现工作池或调试竞态条件。

name: threejs-geometry
description: Three.js geometry creation - built-in shapes, BufferGeometry, custom geometry, instancing. Use when creating 3D shapes, working with vertices, building custom meshes, or optimizing with instanced rendering.
description_zh: Three.js 几何体创建 - 内置形状、BufferGeometry、自定义几何体、实例化。在创建 3D 形状、处理顶点、构建自定义网格或使用实例化渲染进行优化时使用。

name: billing-automation
description: Build automated billing systems for recurring payments, invoicing, subscription lifecycle, and dunning management. Use when implementing subscription billing, automating invoicing, or managing recurring payment systems.
description_zh: 构建适用于周期性付款、开票、订阅生命周期和催款管理的自动化计费系统。在实施订阅计费、自动化开票或管理周期性付款系统时使用。

name: gh-fix-ci
description: Use when a user asks to debug or fix failing GitHub PR checks that run in GitHub Actions; use `gh` to inspect checks and logs, summarize failure context, draft a fix plan, and implement only after explicit approval. Treat external providers (for example Buildkite) as out of scope and report only the details URL.
description_zh: 当用户请求调试或修复在 GitHub Actions 中运行的 GitHub PR 失败检查时使用；使用 `gh` 命令检查检查项和日志，总结失败上下文，草拟修复计划，并在获得明确批准后实施。将外部提供者（例如 Buildkite）视为超出范围，仅报告详细信息的 URL。

name: create-auth
description: Scaffold and implement authentication in TypeScript/JavaScript apps using Better Auth. Detect frameworks, configure database adapters, set up route handlers, add OAuth providers, and create auth UI pages. Use when users want to add login, sign-up, or authentication to a new or existing project with Better Auth.
description_zh: 使用 Better Auth 为 TypeScript/JavaScript 应用搭建和实现身份验证。检测框架、配置数据库适配器、设置路由处理器、添加 OAuth 提供商，并创建身份验证 UI 页面。当用户希望使用 Better Auth 为新项目或现有项目添加登录、注册或身份验证功能时使用。

name: create-github-action-workflow-specification
description: Create a formal specification for an existing GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow, optimized for AI consumption and workflow maintenance.
description_zh: 为现有的 GitHub Actions CI/CD 工作流创建一份正式规范，优化以供 AI 消费和维护工作流。

name: dart-fix-runtime-errors
description: Uses get_runtime_errors and lsp to fetch an active stack trace, locate the failing line, apply a fix, and verify resolution via hot_reload.
description_zh: 使用 get_runtime_errors 和 lsp 来获取活动堆栈跟踪，定位失败行，应用修复，并通过 hot_reload 验证解决方案。

name: prometheus-configuration
description: Set up Prometheus for comprehensive metric collection, storage, and monitoring of infrastructure and applications. Use when implementing metrics collection, setting up monitoring infrastructure, or configuring alerting systems.
description_zh: 为基础设施和应用设置 Prometheus，以实现全面的指标收集、存储和监控。在实施指标收集、配置监控基础设施或设置告警系统时使用。

name: data-quality-frameworks
description: Implement data quality validation with Great Expectations, dbt tests, and data contracts. Use when building data quality pipelines, implementing validation rules, or establishing data contracts.
description_zh: 使用 Great Expectations、dbt 测试和数据合约实现数据质量验证。在构建数据质量管道、实施验证规则或建立数据合约时使用。

name: dart-resolve-package-conflicts
description: Workflow for fixing package version conflicts. Use this when `pub get` fails due to incompatible package versions.
description_zh: 解决包版本冲突的工作流程。当 `pub get` 因不兼容的包版本失败时，请使用此方法。

name: nature-shared
description: Internal shared-reference support package for installed Nature Skills, including nature-writing, nature-polishing, nature-response, nature-reader, and nature-paper2ppt. Do not invoke it as a standalone user workflow. Load only the specific core or journal-format file requested by another Nature skill.
description_zh: 内部共享引用支持包，用于已安装的《自然技能》，包括自然写作、自然润色、自然响应、自然阅读和自然纸转PPT。不要将其作为独立用户工作流程调用。仅加载其他《自然技能》请求的特定核心文件或期刊格式文件。

name: dart-use-pattern-matching
description: Applies Dart 3 pattern matching, switch expressions, and destructuring idiomatically to validate data schemas, handle algebraic data types, and decompose control flow. Use when refactoring complex if-else chains, parsing polymorphic JSON or API responses, destructuring Lists, URI/path segments, String.split() tokens, Records, or Maps, or enforcing exhaustiveness on sealed classes. Don't use for simple boolean conditions, single-variable type promotion (use `is`), or basic collection filtering.
description_zh: 使用 Dart 3 的模式匹配、switch 表达式和解构惯用法来验证数据模式、处理代数数据类型以及分解控制流。在重构复杂的 if-else 链、解析多态 JSON 或 API 响应、解构列表、URI/路径段、String.split() 令牌、记录或映射，或对密封类执行穷尽性检查时使用。不要用于简单的布尔条件、单变量类型提升（使用 `is`）或基本的集合过滤。

name: startup-metrics-framework
description: Track, calculate, and optimize key performance metrics for SaaS, marketplace, consumer, and B2B startups from seed through Series A, including unit economics, growth efficiency, and cash management. Use this skill when defining a metrics framework, calculating CAC/LTV/burn multiple, benchmarking business health, or preparing metrics dashboards for investors or board reporting.
description_zh: 跟踪、计算和优化SaaS、市场平台、消费者及B2B初创企业从种子轮到A轮融资的关键绩效指标，包括单位经济模型、增长效率及现金流管理。在定义指标框架、计算CAC/LTV/烧钱倍数、基准化业务健康状况或为投资者或董事会报告准备指标仪表盘时使用此技能。

name: threejs-materials
description: Three.js materials - PBR, basic, phong, shader materials, material properties. Use when styling meshes, working with textures, creating custom shaders, or optimizing material performance.
description_zh: Three.js材质 - PBR、基础、Phong、着色器材质、材质属性。用于设置网格样式、处理纹理、创建自定义着色器或优化材质性能。

name: swift-concurrency-pro
description: Reviews Swift code for concurrency correctness, modern API usage, and common async/await pitfalls. Use when reading, writing, or reviewing Swift concurrency code.
description_zh: 检查 Swift 代码的并发正确性、现代 API 使用情况以及常见的异步/等待陷阱。在阅读、编写或审查 Swift 并发代码时使用。

name: nanobanana
description: Gemini-native Nano Banana image generation and editing across Nano Banana, Nano Banana 2, and Nano Banana Pro. Use when you need text-to-image, image-to-image edits, repeated local references, batch generation, dry-run request inspection, or a custom Gemini-compatible base URL such as a self-hosted gateway.
description_zh: Gemini原生Nano Banana图像生成与编辑，支持Nano Banana、Nano Banana 2和Nano Banana Pro。当您需要文本转图像、图像转图像编辑、重复局部引用、批量生成、干运行请求检查，或自定义兼容Gemini的基URL（如自托管网关）时使用。

name: fix-security-vulnerabilities-with-strix
description: Fix security vulnerabilities found by a Strix pentest (open-source CLI or app.strix.ai cloud) — triage by severity, patch the root cause rather than the symptom, and re-run Strix to prove each fix actually closes the exploit. Handles injection, XSS, SSRF, broken access control, IDOR, and other validated findings. Use after a Strix scan reports findings, or when the user asks to remediate, patch, or fix security issues from a strix_runs report, vulnerabilities.json, findings.sarif, or a cloud scan.
description_zh: 修复Strix渗透测试（开源CLI或app.strix.ai云端）发现的安全漏洞——按严重程度进行优先级排序，修复根本原因而非症状，并重新运行Strix以证明每个修复确实关闭了漏洞。处理注入、XSS、SSRF、权限控制失效、IDOR以及其他已验证的发现。在Strix扫描报告发现后使用，或当用户要求从strix_runs报告、vulnerabilities.json、findings.sarif或云端扫描中修复、修补或解决安全问题时使用。

name: k8s-manifest-generator
description: Create production-ready Kubernetes manifests for Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets following best practices and security standards. Use when generating Kubernetes YAML manifests, creating K8s resources, or implementing production-grade Kubernetes configurations.
description_zh: 创建符合最佳实践和安全标准的、可用于生产环境的 Kubernetes 部署（Deployments）、服务（Services）、配置映射（ConfigMaps）和密钥（Secrets）的清单文件。适用于生成 Kubernetes YAML 清单文件、创建 K8s 资源或实施生产级 Kubernetes 配置。

name: framer-motion-animator
description: Creates smooth animations and micro-interactions using Framer Motion including page transitions, gestures, scroll-based animations, and orchestrated sequences. Use when users request "add animation", "framer motion", "page transition", "animate component", or "micro-interactions".
description_zh: 使用 Framer Motion 创建平滑动画和微交互，包括页面过渡、手势、基于滚动的动画和协调序列。当用户请求“添加动画”、“framer motion”、“页面过渡”、“动画组件”或“微交互”时使用。

name: context-driven-development
description: Creates and maintains project context artifacts (product.md, tech-stack.md, workflow.md, tracks.md) in a `conductor/` directory. Scaffolds new projects from scratch, extracts context from existing codebases, validates artifact consistency before implementation, and synchronizes documents as the project evolves. Use when setting up a project, creating or updating product docs, managing a tech stack file, defining development workflows, tracking work units, onboarding to an existing codebase, or running project scaffolding.
description_zh: 在 `conductor/` 目录下创建和维护项目上下文工件（product.md、tech-stack.md、workflow.md、tracks.md）。从零开始搭建新项目，从现有代码库中提取上下文，在实施前验证工件一致性，并随着项目的发展同步文档。在设置项目、创建或更新产品文档、管理技术栈文件、定义开发工作流、跟踪工作单元、接入现有代码库或运行项目脚手架时使用。

name: dart-generate-test-mocks
description: Define and generate mock objects for external dependencies using `package:mockito` and `build_runner`. Use when unit testing classes that depend on complex external services like APIs or databases.
description_zh: 使用 `package:mockito` 和 `build_runner` 定义并生成对外部依赖的模拟对象。在单元测试依赖复杂外部服务（如 API 或数据库）的类时使用。

name: dependency-upgrade
description: Manage major dependency version upgrades with compatibility analysis, staged rollout, and comprehensive testing. Use when upgrading framework versions, updating major dependencies, or managing breaking changes in libraries.
description_zh: 使用兼容性分析、分阶段发布和全面测试来管理主要依赖项版本的升级。在升级框架版本、更新主要依赖项或管理库中的破坏性变更时使用。

name: python-background-jobs
description: Python background job patterns including task queues, workers, and event-driven architecture. Use when implementing async task processing, job queues, long-running operations, or decoupling work from request/response cycles.
description_zh: Python 后台任务模式，包括任务队列、工作进程和事件驱动架构。在实现异步任务处理、工作队列、长时间运行的操作或使工作与请求/响应周期解耦时使用。

name: pricewin-flight-search
description: Search live flight fares for a route and date across Agoda, Trip.com, and Traveloka — one-way or round-trip, any cabin, with airline, times, stops, duration, and a direct booking link. Use when the user wants flight prices, plane or air tickets, cheap flights or airfare between two cities, comparing airlines for travel dates, or planning the flying leg of a trip.
description_zh: 搜索特定航线和日期的实时航班票价，涵盖Agoda、Trip.com和Traveloka——单程或往返，任何舱位，包含航空公司、时间、中转、飞行时长以及直接预订链接。适用于用户需要查询航班价格、飞机或机票、两城市之间的廉价航班或机票、比较不同航空公司的旅行日期，或规划行程中的飞行段。

name: apify-actor-development
description: Create, modify, debug, and deploy Apify Actors, and write their input and output schemas. Use when building an Actor from scratch, changing or troubleshooting Actor code, generating or updating .actor schema files, or pushing an Actor to the Apify platform. To wrap an existing non-Actor project, use apify-actorization instead.
description_zh: 开发、调试和部署Apify Actors——用于网络抓取、自动化和数据处理的无服务器云程序。在创建新Actor、修改现有Actor或排查Actor代码时使用。

name: pricewin-price-comparison
description: Compare live hotel room rates across Booking.com, Agoda, Traveloka, and OpenTravel for specific dates — which OTA is cheapest for the same property, per-room prices, and free-cancellation terms. Use when comparing hotel prices, checking room rates for a named hotel, asking which site is cheaper, or finding the best rate for given check-in/check-out dates.
description_zh: 比较Booking.com、Agoda、Traveloka和OpenTravel在特定日期的酒店房间实时价格——哪个OTA对同一物业最便宜，每间房的价格，以及免费取消条款。用于比较酒店价格，查询指定酒店的价格，询问哪个网站更便宜，或寻找给定入住/退房日期的最佳价格。

name: threejs-interaction
description: Three.js interaction - raycasting, controls, mouse/touch input, object selection. Use when handling user input, implementing click detection, adding camera controls, or creating interactive 3D experiences.
description_zh: Three.js 交互 - 射线投射、控制器、鼠标/触摸输入、对象选择。用于处理用户输入、实现点击检测、添加相机控制或创建交互式 3D 体验。

name: pricewin-hotel-search
description: Search hotels live across Agoda + Booking.com + Traveloka + OpenTravel with realtime pricing for specific dates. Use when user wants hotel prices for travel dates, comparing OTAs, or finding rooms.
description_zh: 在Agoda、Booking.com、Traveloka和OpenTravel上实时搜索酒店，针对特定日期提供实时价格。当用户需要查询旅行日期的酒店价格、比较在线旅行社（OTA）或寻找房间时使用。

name: dart-collect-coverage
description: Collect coverage using the coverage packge and create an LCOV report
description_zh: 使用 coverage 包收集覆盖率并创建 LCOV 报告

name: videoagent-video-studio
description: Generate short AI videos from text or images — text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-based generation — with zero API key setup. Use when the user wants to create a video clip, animate an image, or generate video from a description.
description_zh: 从文本或图像生成简短的AI视频——包括文本转视频、图像转视频和基于参考的生成——无需设置API密钥。当用户想要创建视频片段、动画化图像或根据描述生成视频时使用。

name: install-anti-slop
description: Install, configure, update, or upgrade vendored anti-slop Oxlint plugins. Use when adding anti-slop, picking up upstream rules or fixes, or migrating an existing installation while preserving local customizations.
description_zh: 安装、配置、更新或升级本地的反冗余 Oxlint 插件。在添加反冗余功能、获取上游规则或修复时使用，或在迁移现有安装时保留本地自定义设置。

name: memory-forensics
description: Master memory forensics techniques including memory acquisition, process analysis, and artifact extraction using Volatility and related tools. Use when analyzing memory dumps, investigating incidents, or performing malware analysis from RAM captures.
description_zh: 掌握使用 Volatility 及相关工具进行内存取证的技术，包括内存获取、进程分析和证据提取。在分析内存转储文件、调查事件或从 RAM 捕获中执行恶意软件分析时使用。

name: pricewin-booking-assistant
description: Recommend hotel rooms and complete a real booking end to end — reserve an OpenTravel direct property with a payment link (bank QR, card, or PayPal), check payment status, resend an expired link, or cancel a booking. Falls back to direct Booking.com/Agoda/Traveloka links for OTA-only hotels. Use when booking or reserving a hotel, getting room recommendations, paying for a stay, checking a confirmation code, or cancelling a reservation.
description_zh: 推荐酒店房间并完成全程真实预订——使用支付链接（银行二维码、信用卡或PayPal）预订OpenTravel直营物业，查询支付状态，重新发送过期链接或取消预订。对于仅限OTA的酒店，则回退至Booking.com/Agoda/Traveloka直接链接。在预订或预留酒店、获取房间推荐、支付住宿费用、检查确认码或取消预订时使用。

name: nature-paper-to-patent
description: Turn research papers or inventor materials into evidence-grounded Chinese invention patent drafts and technical disclosures. Use for 技术交底书、专利撰写、现有技术对比 and Chinese DOCX patent packages; not general manuscript writing.
description_zh: 将研究论文或发明资料转化为有证据支持的中文发明专利草案和技术披露文件。适用于技术交底书、专利撰写、现有技术对比以及中文DOCX专利包；不适用于一般性文稿撰写。

name: python-mcp-server-generator
description: Generate a complete MCP server project in Python with tools, resources, and proper configuration
description_zh: 生成一个完整的 MCP 服务器项目，使用 Python 工具、资源和正确配置

name: ml-pipeline-workflow
description: Build end-to-end MLOps pipelines from data preparation through model training, validation, and production deployment. Use when creating ML pipelines, implementing MLOps practices, or automating model training and deployment workflows.
description_zh: 构建从数据准备到模型训练、验证和生产的端到端 MLOps 管道。在创建机器学习管道、实施 MLOps 实践或自动化模型训练和部署工作流时使用。

name: dart-use-primary-constructors
description: Help users write syntactically and semantically correct primary constructors in Dart, and migrate/use the new constructor syntax, empty-body semicolon syntax, in-body initializer list syntax, and abbreviated concise constructor syntax.
description_zh: 帮助用户编写语法和语义上正确的 Dart 主要构造函数，并迁移/使用新的构造函数语法、空体分号语法、体内初始化列表语法和简写紧凑构造函数语法。

name: google-cloud-networking-observability
description: Investigates Google Cloud networking issues by analyzing logs, metrics, and diagnostics. Use when investigating VPC Flow Logs (including cost estimation), NAT, firewall, or threat logs, querying latency and throughput metrics, or running Connectivity Tests for path diagnostics. Don't use for generic VM management or non-observability tasks.
description_zh: 通过分析日志、指标和诊断信息来调查 Google Cloud 网络问题。在调查 VPC 流量日志（包括成本估算）、NAT、防火墙或威胁日志、查询延迟和吞吐量指标，或运行路径诊断的连接性测试时使用。不适用于通用 VM 管理或非可观测性任务。

name: cqrs-implementation
description: Implement Command Query Responsibility Segregation for scalable architectures. Use when separating read and write models, optimizing query performance, or building event-sourced systems.
description_zh: 实现命令查询职责分离（CQRS），以构建可扩展的架构。适用于分离读写模型、优化查询性能或构建事件溯源系统时使用。

name: expo-design-system
description: Framework (OSS). Build and maintain a design system inside an Expo app - a reusable theme of design tokens (color, spacing, typography, radius, shadow, motion), reusable component structure with variant/size/state prop conventions, and rules for when to extract a repeated view into a shared component. Use when creating or organizing theme files and design tokens (theme.ts / theme/), extending an existing theme or styling library (NativeWind, Tamagui, Restyle, Unistyles) in its own idiom, standardizing styles so screens (including AI-generated ones) look consistent and polished, fixing an app that looks AI-generated or generic instead of native (the named native-slop tells), building an in-app component library, or auditing an app for design-system drift (hardcoded colors, spacing, fonts). For platform styling specifics (semantic colors, HIG rules, native controls) use expo-native-ui; for folder layout of a new app use expo-project-structure.
description_zh: 框架（开源组件库）。在Expo应用内部构建和维护设计系统——一个可复用的设计令牌主题（颜色、间距、排版、圆角、阴影、动效），具有变体/尺寸/状态属性约定的可复用组件结构，以及何时将重复视图提取为共享组件的规则。适用于创建或组织主题文件和设计令牌（theme.ts / theme/），以自身方式扩展现有主题或样式库（NativeWind、Tamagui、Restyle、Unistyles），标准化样式以确保屏幕（包括AI生成的）看起来一致且精致，修复看起来像AI生成或通用的应用而非原生（native-slop命名提示），构建应用内组件库，或审计应用的设计系统漂移（硬编码颜色、间距、字体）。平台样式特定需求（语义颜色、HIG规则、原生控件）请使用expo-native-ui；新应用文件夹布局请使用expo-project-structure。

name: linkedin-profile-optimizer
description: Optimize LinkedIn profile for searchability, recruiter visibility, and engagement
description_zh: 优化领英档案的搜索性、招聘人员的可见性及互动性

name: airflow-dag-patterns
description: Build production Apache Airflow DAGs with best practices for operators, sensors, testing, and deployment. Use when creating data pipelines, orchestrating workflows, or scheduling batch jobs.
description_zh: 使用最佳实践构建生产环境的 Apache Airflow DAG，涵盖算子（operators）、传感器（sensors）、测试和部署。适用于创建数据管道、编排工作流或调度批处理任务。

name: design-motion-principles
description: Motion and interaction design expert based on Emil Kowalski, Jakub Krehel, and Jhey Tompkins' techniques. Two modes — build interactive components with purposeful motion, or audit existing animations to catch AI-slop motion patterns (audit emits a branded HTML report with looping demos). Use when creating, adding, animating, or reviewing UI motion: transitions, hover states, micro-interactions, enter/exit animations, or any motion design work in React, Framer Motion, CSS, or HTML. Provides per-designer perspectives with context-aware weighting.
description_zh: 基于Emil Kowalski、Jakub Krehel和Jhey Tompkins的技术，运动与交互设计专家。两种模式——构建具有目的性运动效果的交互组件，或审核现有动画以捕捉AI粗糙的运动模式（审核会生成带有循环演示的品牌HTML报告）。适用于创建、添加、动画化或审核UI运动：过渡效果、悬停状态、微交互、进入/退出动画，或React、Framer Motion、CSS或HTML中的任何运动设计工作。提供针对每位设计师的视角，并具有上下文感知权重。

name: dbt-transformation-patterns
description: Master dbt (data build tool) for analytics engineering with model organization, testing, documentation, and incremental strategies. Use when building data transformations, creating data models, or implementing analytics engineering best practices.
description_zh: 掌握 dbt（数据构建工具）用于分析工程，包括模型组织、测试、文档和增量策略。在构建数据转换、创建数据模型或实施分析工程最佳实践时使用。

name: dart-build-cli-app
description: Architectural patterns, entrypoint structure, exit codes, stream routing, and subprocess spawning for Dart command-line interface (CLI) applications. Use when building CLI tools, console utilities, scripts, argument parsing with `package:args` (ArgParser or CommandRunner), handling exit codes, configuring executables in pubspec.yaml, spawning Dart subprocesses, or compiling native CLI binaries. Don't use for Flutter UI widgets, web applications, or standalone HTTP backend servers.
description_zh: Dart命令行界面（CLI）应用程序的架构模式、入口结构、退出代码、流路由和子进程生成。适用于构建CLI工具、控制台实用程序、脚本、使用`package:args`（ArgParser或CommandRunner）进行参数解析、处理退出代码、在`pubspec.yaml`中配置可执行文件、生成Dart子进程或编译原生CLI二进制文件。不适用于Flutter UI组件、Web应用程序或独立的HTTP后端服务器。

name: temporal-python-testing
description: Test Temporal workflows with pytest, time-skipping, and mocking strategies. Covers unit testing, integration testing, replay testing, and local development setup. Use when implementing Temporal workflow tests or debugging test failures.
description_zh: 使用 pytest、时间跳过和模拟策略测试 Temporal 工作流。涵盖单元测试、集成测试、重放测试和本地开发环境设置。在实现 Temporal 工作流测试或调试测试失败时使用。

name: react-email
description: Use when building HTML email templates with React components, adding a visual email editor to an application using the React Email visual editor, rendering emails to HTML, or sending emails with Resend. Covers welcome emails, password resets, notifications, order confirmations, newsletters, transactional emails, and the embeddable email editor component.
description_zh: 在构建使用 React 组件的 HTML 邮件模板时使用，向应用程序添加 React Email 可视化邮件编辑器，将邮件渲染为 HTML，或使用 Resend 发送邮件。涵盖欢迎邮件、密码重置、通知、订单确认、新闻简报、事务性邮件以及嵌入式邮件编辑器组件。

name: storyboard-creation
description: Film and video storyboarding with shot vocabulary, continuity rules, and panel layout. Covers shot types, camera angles, movement, 180-degree rule, and annotation format. Use for: video planning, film pre-production, ad storyboards, music video planning, animation. Triggers: storyboard, storyboarding, shot list, film planning, video planning, pre production, shot composition, camera angles, scene planning, visual script, animatic, storyboard panels, video storyboard
description_zh: 电影和视频故事板制作，包含镜头词汇、连贯性规则和面板布局。涵盖镜头类型、摄像机角度、运动、180度规则和注释格式。适用于：视频策划、电影前期制作、广告故事板、音乐视频策划、动画。触发词：故事板、故事板制作、镜头清单、电影策划、视频策划、前期制作、镜头构图、摄像机角度、场景策划、视觉脚本、动态故事板、故事板面板、视频故事板

name: python-resource-management
description: Python resource management with context managers, cleanup patterns, and streaming. Use when managing connections, file handles, implementing cleanup logic, or building streaming responses with accumulated state.
description_zh: 使用上下文管理器、清理模式和流式处理进行 Python 资源管理。适用于管理连接、文件句柄、实现清理逻辑或构建具有累积状态的流式响应。

name: competitive-landscape
description: Analyze competition, identify differentiation opportunities, and develop winning market positioning strategies using Porter's Five Forces, Blue Ocean Strategy, and positioning maps. Use this skill when evaluating competitors, assessing market positioning, identifying sustainable competitive advantages, or preparing competitive strategy analysis for a startup or investor pitch.
description_zh: 运用波特五力模型、蓝海战略和定位图分析竞争，识别差异化机会，并制定制胜的市场定位策略。在评估竞争对手、评估市场定位、识别可持续竞争优势，或为初创企业或投资者路演准备竞争策略分析时，使用这项技能。

name: dart-migrate-to-checks-package
description:
Replace the usage of `expect` and similar functions from `package:matcher`
to `package:checks` equivalents.
description_zh: 将 `package:matcher` 中的 `expect` 和类似函数的用法替换为 `package:checks` 的对应功能。

name: hypit
description: Direct and produce videos with Hypit, primarily through generated media and authored components while incorporating briefs, references or supplied material; includes SVML/SVS/SVRun authoring and Runtime or credential setup.
description_zh: 使用 Hypit 直接制作和生成视频，主要通过生成的媒体和自主创作的组件，同时结合简报、参考资料或提供的材料；包括 SVML/SVS/SVRun 的创作以及运行时或凭证设置。

name: workflow-patterns
description: Use this skill when implementing tasks according to Conductor's TDD workflow, handling phase checkpoints, managing git commits for tasks, or understanding the verification protocol.
description_zh: 在根据 Conductor 的 TDD 工作流执行任务、处理阶段检查点、管理任务 git 提交或理解验证协议时使用此技能。

name: risk-metrics-calculation
description: Calculate portfolio risk metrics including VaR, CVaR, Sharpe, Sortino, and drawdown analysis. Use when measuring portfolio risk, implementing risk limits, or building risk monitoring systems.
description_zh: 计算投资组合风险指标，包括VaR、CVaR、夏普比率、索提诺比率以及回撤分析。用于衡量投资组合风险、实施风险限额或构建风险监控系统。

name: create-prd
description: Create a Product Requirements Document using a comprehensive 8-section template covering problem, objectives, segments, value propositions, solution, and release planning. Use when writing a PRD, documenting product requirements, preparing a feature spec, or reviewing an existing PRD.
description_zh: 使用一个包含问题、目标、细分市场、价值主张、解决方案和发布计划等八个部分的全面模板来创建产品需求文档（PRD）。在撰写PRD、记录产品需求、准备功能规范或审查现有PRD时使用。

name: managed-pentesting-with-strix
description: Run a managed pentest of a web app, API, repository, or local workspace on the app.strix.ai platform with the `strix cloud` CLI or REST API — no local Docker or LLM key needed. Safely review and upload local source, register assets, launch and poll scans, triage vulnerabilities, export SARIF, download compliance reports, start PR reviews, buy credits, and set up schedules or webhooks. Use for managed, continuous, scheduled, team-tracked, or sandboxed-agent security testing.
description_zh: 在 app.strix.ai 平台上，使用 `strix cloud` CLI 或 REST API 对 Web 应用、API、代码库或本地工作区进行托管渗透测试——无需本地 Docker 或 LLM 密钥。安全地审查和上传本地源代码、注册资产、启动和轮询扫描、处理漏洞、导出 SARIF、下载合规报告、启动 PR 审查、购买积分以及设置计划或 Webhook。适用于托管式、持续式、计划式、团队追踪式或沙箱代理式安全测试。

name: ai-prompt-engineering-safety-review
description: Comprehensive AI prompt engineering safety review and improvement prompt. Analyzes prompts for safety, bias, security vulnerabilities, and effectiveness while providing detailed improvement recommendations with extensive frameworks, testing methodologies, and educational content.
description_zh: 全面的AI提示工程安全审查与改进提示。分析提示的安全性、偏见、安全漏洞和有效性，同时提供详细的改进建议，包括广泛的框架、测试方法和教育内容。

name: video-ad-specs
description: Video ad creation with exact platform-specific specs for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn. Covers dimensions, duration limits, AIDA framework, and caption requirements. description_zh: 使用决策框架设计多云架构，以在AWS、Azure、GCP和OCI之间选择和集成服务。在构建多云系统、避免供应商锁定或利用多个提供商的最佳服务时使用。

name: daisyui
description: Official daisyUI component-library skill for Tailwind CSS. When you write HTML or JSX code, you must use it. Even if the user does not request it, use it.
description_zh: 官方的 Tailwind CSS daisyUI 组件库技能。当您编写 HTML 或 JSX 代码时，必须使用它。即使用户没有请求，也要使用它。

name: similarity-search-patterns
description: Implement efficient similarity search with vector databases. Use when building semantic search, implementing nearest neighbor queries, or optimizing retrieval performance.
description_zh: 使用向量数据库实现高效的相似性搜索。在构建语义搜索、实现最近邻查询或优化检索性能时使用。

name: spark-optimization
description: Optimize Apache Spark jobs with partitioning, caching, shuffle optimization, and memory tuning. Use when improving Spark performance, debugging slow jobs, or scaling data processing pipelines.
description_zh: 使用分区、缓存、洗牌优化和内存调优来优化 Apache Spark 任务。在提升 Spark 性能、调试缓慢任务或扩展数据处理管道时使用。

name: vector-index-tuning
description: Optimize vector index performance for latency, recall, and memory. Use when tuning HNSW parameters, selecting quantization strategies, or scaling vector search infrastructure.
description_zh: 优化向量索引的性能，以降低延迟、提高召回率和减少内存使用。在调整HNSW参数、选择量化策略或扩展向量搜索基础设施时使用。

name: saga-orchestration
description: Implement saga patterns for distributed transactions and cross-aggregate workflows. Use this skill when implementing distributed transactions across microservices where 2PC is unavailable, designing compensating actions for failed order workflows that span inventory, payment, and shipping services, building event-driven saga coordinators for travel booking systems that must roll back hotel, flight, and car rental reservations atomically, or debugging stuck saga states in production where compensation steps never complete.
description_zh: 为分布式事务和跨聚合工作流实现Saga模式。在微服务中实现分布式事务且2PC不可用时，设计跨越库存、支付和物流服务的失败订单工作流的补偿操作，为必须原子回滚酒店、航班和租车预订的旅行预订系统构建事件驱动的Saga协调器，或在生产环境中调试卡住的Saga状态（补偿步骤从未完成时）。

name: breakdown-feature-prd
description: Prompt for creating Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) for new features, based on an Epic.
description_zh: 创建新功能的产品需求文档（PRD），基于一个史诗（Epic）。

name: screen-reader-testing
description: Test web applications with screen readers including VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging accessibility issues, or ensuring assistive technology support.
description_zh: 使用屏幕阅读器（包括 VoiceOver、NVDA 和 JAWS）测试 Web 应用程序。在验证屏幕阅读器兼容性、调试无障碍问题或确保辅助技术支持时使用。

name: pdftk-server
description: Skill for using the command-line tool pdftk (PDFtk Server) for working with PDF files. Use when asked to merge PDFs, split PDFs, rotate pages, encrypt or decrypt PDFs, fill PDF forms, apply watermarks, stamp overlays, extract metadata, burst documents into pages, repair corrupted PDFs, attach or extract files, or perform any PDF manipulation from the command line.
description_zh: 使用命令行工具 pdftk（PDFtk Server）处理 PDF 文件的技能。当被要求合并 PDF、拆分 PDF、旋转页面、加密或解密 PDF、填写 PDF 表单、添加水印、盖印叠加、提取元数据、将文档拆分成页面、修复损坏的 PDF、附加或提取文件，或从命令行执行任何 PDF 操作时使用。

name: refactor-method-complexity-reduce
description: Refactor given method `${input:methodName}` to reduce its cognitive complexity to `${input:complexityThreshold}` or below, by extracting helper methods.
description_zh: 将给定的方法 `${input:methodName}` 重构，通过提取辅助方法，将其认知复杂度降低至 `${input:complexityThreshold}` 或以下。

name: scoutqa-test
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "test this website", "run exploratory testing", "check for accessibility issues", "verify the login flow works", "find bugs on this page", or requests automated QA testing. Triggers on web application testing scenarios including smoke tests, accessibility audits, e-commerce flows, and user flow validation using ScoutQA CLI. Use this skill proactively after implementing web application features to verify they work correctly.
description_zh: 当用户要求“测试这个网站”、“执行探索性测试”、“检查可访问性问题”、“验证登录流程是否正常”、“在这个页面上查找错误”，或请求自动化质量保证测试时，应使用此技能。该技能适用于Web应用程序测试场景，包括冒烟测试、可访问性审核、电子商务流程以及使用ScoutQA CLI进行用户流程验证。在实现Web应用程序功能后，应主动使用此技能来验证其是否正常工作。

name: hybrid-cloud-networking
description: Configure secure, high-performance connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud platforms using VPN and dedicated connections. Use when building hybrid cloud architectures, connecting data centers to cloud, or implementing secure cross-premises networking.
description_zh: 使用VPN和专用连接，配置本地基础设施与云平台之间的安全、高性能连接。适用于构建混合云架构、连接数据中心至云，或实施安全的多地网络。

name: convert-documents-to-markdown
description: Convert Word (.doc, .docx), PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx), Excel (.xls, .xlsx), OpenDocument (.odt, .ods, .odp), RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files to GitHub-Flavored Markdown. Use when a task needs the contents of an office document, spreadsheet, presentation, ebook, or PDF you cannot read directly.
description_zh: 将 Word (.doc, .docx)、PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx)、Excel (.xls, .xlsx)、OpenDocument (.odt, .ods, .odp)、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 文件转换为 GitHub 风格的 Markdown。当任务需要处理您无法直接读取的办公文档、电子表格、演示文稿、电子书或 PDF 内容时使用。

name: turborepo-caching
description: Configure Turborepo for efficient monorepo builds with local and remote caching. Use when setting up Turborepo, optimizing build pipelines, or implementing distributed caching.
description_zh: 为本地和远程缓存配置 Turborepo，以实现高效的 monorepo 构建。在设置 Turborepo、优化构建流程或实现分布式缓存时使用。

name: deep-research
description: Use when the user needs multi-source research with citation tracking, evidence persistence, and structured report generation. Triggers on "deep research", "comprehensive analysis", "research report", "compare X vs Y", "analyze trends", or "state of the art". Not for simple lookups, debugging, or questions answerable with 1-2 searches.

name: mobile-app-ui-design
description: Design high-quality mobile app UI/UX screens, flows, and components. Use this skill whenever the user asks to design a mobile app screen, create app mockups, build mobile UI components, improve an existing mobile app design, create onboarding flows, design mobile navigation, or requests any mobile-first interface work. Also trigger when the user mentions app design, mobile UI, mobile UX, screen design, app mockups, wireframes, or wants to build React Native / Flutter / SwiftUI style interfaces as visual prototypes. Even if the user just says "design an app" or "make this screen look better", use this skill.

name: plannotator-visual-explainer
description: Generate self-contained HTML visualizations with Plannotator theming. Use for implementation plans, PR explainers, architecture diagrams, data tables, slide decks, and any visual explanation of technical concepts. Plans and PR explainers follow Plannotator's prescriptive approach; all other visual content delegates to nicobailon/visual-explainer.
description_zh: 使用Plannotator主题生成自包含的HTML可视化。用于实施计划、PR解释器、架构图、数据表、幻灯片演示文稿以及任何技术概念的可视化解释。计划和PR解释器遵循Plannotator的指导性方法；所有其他可视化内容委托给nicobailon/visual-explainer。

name: linear
description: Manage issues, projects & team workflows in Linear. Use when the user wants to read, create or updates tickets in Linear.
description_zh: 在 Linear 中管理问题、项目和团队工作流程。当用户想要在 Linear 中阅读、创建或更新工单时使用。

name: nano-banana-pro-openrouter
description: Generate or edit images via OpenRouter with the Gemini 3 Pro Image model. Use for prompt-only image generation, image edits, and multi-image compositing; supports 1K/2K/4K output.
description_zh: 通过 OpenRouter 使用 Gemini 3 Pro 图像模型生成或编辑图像。用于仅使用提示词生成图像、图像编辑和多图像合成；支持 1K/2K/4K 输出。

name: dart-use-ffigen
description: Guide agents to use `package:ffigen` to automatically generate FFI bindings instead of writing them manually. Use this skill when a task involves writing new FFI bindings, extending C/Objective-C/Swift integrations, or replacing hand-crafted `dart:ffi` setups.
description_zh: 指导代理使用 `package:ffigen` 自动生成 FFI 绑定，而不是手动编写。在需要编写新的 FFI 绑定、扩展 C/Objective-C/Swift 集成或替换手工编写的 `dart:ffi` 设置时，使用这项技能。

name: shopify-customer
description: Write and validate GraphQL operations for developers integrating Shopify's Customer Account API. Generates code for Customer Account API integrations.
description_zh: 为集成 Shopify 客户账户 API 的开发者编写和验证 GraphQL 操作。为客户账户 API 集成生成代码。

name: projection-patterns
description: Build read models and projections from event streams. Use when implementing CQRS read sides, building materialized views, or optimizing query performance in event-sourced systems.
description_zh: 从事件流中构建读模型和投影。在实现 CQRS 读端、构建物化视图或优化事件源系统中的查询性能时使用。

name: pci-compliance
description: Implement PCI DSS compliance requirements for secure handling of payment card data and payment systems. Use when securing payment processing, achieving PCI compliance, or implementing payment card security measures.
description_zh: 实现 PCI DSS 合规性要求，以确保安全处理支付卡数据和支付系统。在保障支付处理安全、实现 PCI 合规性或实施支付卡安全措施时使用。

name: markdown-to-html
description: Convert Markdown files to HTML similar to `marked.js`, `pandoc`, `gomarkdown/markdown`, or similar tools; or writing custom script to convert markdown to html and/or working on web template systems like `jekyll/jekyll`, `gohugoio/hugo`, or similar web templating systems that utilize markdown documents, converting them to html. Use when asked to "convert markdown to html", "transform md to html", "render markdown", "generate html from markdown", or when working with .md files and/or web a templating system that converts markdown to HTML output. Supports CLI and Node.js workflows with GFM, CommonMark, and standard Markdown flavors.
description_zh: 将 Markdown 文件转换为 HTML，类似于 `marked.js`、`pandoc`、`gomarkdown/markdown` 或类似工具；或者编写自定义脚本将 Markdown 转换为 HTML，以及/或者处理类似 `jekyll/jekyll`、`gohugoio/hugo` 或类似利用 Markdown 文档的 Web 模板系统，将其转换为 HTML。在要求“将 Markdown 转换为 HTML”、“将 md 转换为 html”、“渲染 Markdown”、“从 Markdown 生成 HTML”，或处理 .md 文件和/或使用 Markdown 转换为 HTML 输出的 Web 模板系统时使用。支持 GFM、CommonMark 和标准 Markdown 风格的 CLI 和 Node.js 工作流程。

name: superdesign
description: Design or redesign frontend UI, presentations, and graphics on the Superdesign canvas with a choice of leading AI models. Use whenever the user wants to design a page, feature, flow, slide deck, or brand-new product; improve or reproduce existing UI; compare design results across top models; explore visual variants; set or extract a design system; build reusable components or multi-page flows; create presentations; or create posters and marketing graphics, even if they never say the word 'design tool'. Also supports generating supporting image or video assets when a design needs them.
description_zh: 使用 Superdesign 画布，结合领先的 AI 模型，设计或重新设计前端 UI、演示文稿和图形。无论用户是想设计页面、功能、流程、幻灯片集，还是全新产品；改进或复现现有 UI；比较顶级模型的设计结果；探索视觉变体；设置或提取设计系统；构建可重用组件或多页面流程；创建演示文稿；或制作海报和营销图形——即使他们从未提及“设计工具”这个词。此外，当设计需要时，还支持生成辅助图像或视频素材。

name: okx-cex-market
description: Use this skill when the user asks for: price of any asset, ticker, order book, candles, OHLCV, funding rate, open interest, OI change scanner, market screener (top movers, high-volume, newly listed), mark price, index price, recent trades, instrument list, stock tokens, metals prices (gold, XAU, XAG), commodities (oil, OIL), forex rates (EUR/USD, EURUSDT), bond instruments, non-crypto assets, or any technical indicator query (RSI, MACD, EMA, Bollinger Bands, KDJ, SuperTrend, AHR999, BTC rainbow, and 70+ more). All commands are read-only and do NOT require API credentials. Do NOT use for account balance/positions (okx-cex-portfolio), placing/cancelling orders (okx-cex-trade), or bots (okx-cex-bot). Do NOT use when the user wants to TRADE a directional view as an event contract — that is okx-cex-trade. Merely ASKING which way an asset's price is moving is a market-data question and belongs here.
description_zh: 当用户询问以下内容时，请使用此技能：任何资产的报价、交易代码、订单簿、K线图、OHLCV数据、资金费率、未平仓合约量、OI变化扫描器、市场扫描器（涨幅榜、高成交量、新上市）、市价、指数价格、最近成交、合约列表、股票代码、金属价格（黄金、XAU、XAG）、大宗商品（原油、OIL）、外汇汇率（EUR/USD、EURUSDT）、债券工具、非加密资产，或任何技术指标查询（RSI、MACD、EMA、布林带、KDJ、Supertrend、AHR999、BTC彩虹图，以及70多项更多）。所有指令均为只读，无需API凭证。请勿用于账户余额/持仓（okx-cex-portfolio）、下单/取消订单（okx-cex-trade）或机器人（okx-cex-bot）。当用户希望将方向性观点作为事件合约进行交易时——那是okx-cex-trade。仅仅询问某资产价格走势属于市场数据问题，应在此处理。

name: agentmemory-agents
description: How agentmemory wires into host coding agents via the connect command. Use when installing agentmemory into a specific agent, when asked which agents are supported, or when a connect adapter writes the wrong config path.
description_zh: 如何通过 connect 命令将 agentmemory 线路连接到主机编码代理。在将 agentmemory 安装到特定代理时使用，在询问哪些代理受支持时使用，或在 connect 适配器写入错误配置路径时使用。

name: employment-contract-templates
description: Create employment contracts, offer letters, and HR policy documents following legal best practices. Use when drafting employment agreements, creating HR policies, or standardizing employment documentation.
description_zh: 根据法律最佳实践，创建雇佣合同、录用通知书和人力资源政策文件。在起草雇佣协议、制定人力资源政策或标准化雇佣文件时使用。

name: dart-setup-ffi-assets
description: Guides agents in compiling and packaging C/C++ source code into dynamic or static libraries (Code Assets) using Dart's Native Assets hook system (via hook/build.dart and hook/link.dart utilizing package:hooks and package:native_toolchain_c). Use when a user asks to: 'setup native assets', 'compile C/C++ source code', 'bundle dynamic libraries', 'build native C code', 'link native assets', 'implement build.dart or link.dart hooks', or 'integrate C/C++ interop in Dart/Flutter'. Helps agents avoid manual toolchain orchestration and configures secure hash-validated binary downloads or advanced linker tree-shaking with package:record_use mapping.
description_zh: 指导代理将 C/C++ 源代码编译并打包成动态或静态库（代码资源），使用 Dart 的原生资源钩子系统（通过 hook/build.dart 和 hook/link.dart，利用 package:hooks 和 package:native_toolchain_c）。当用户要求执行以下操作时使用：'设置原生资源'、'编译 C/C++ 源代码'、'打包动态库'、'构建原生 C 代码'、'链接原生资源'、'实现 build.dart 或 link.dart 钩子'，或 '在 Dart/Flutter 中集成 C/C++ 互操作'。这有助于代理避免手动工具链编排，并配置经过安全哈希验证的二进制下载或使用 package:record_use 映射的高级链接器树摇。

name: meeting-minutes
description: Generate concise, actionable meeting minutes for internal meetings. Includes metadata, attendees, agenda, decisions, action items (owner + due date), and follow-up steps.
description_zh: 生成简洁、可操作的内部会议纪要。包含元数据、与会者、议程、决议、行动项（负责人+截止日期）以及后续步骤。

name: runpodctl
description: Runpod CLI for managing GPU/CPU workloads from the terminal — pods, serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, Hub deploys, models, SSH, and file transfer (send/receive). Use for terminal/CI/scripting, Hub browse/deploy, SSH setup, `doctor`, or when the Runpod MCP tools are not connected. For structured tool calls in an MCP-enabled session, prefer runpod-mcp.
description_zh: 用于从终端管理 GPU/CPU 工作负载的 Runpod CLI —— 支持Pod、无服务器端点、模板、网络卷、Hub部署、模型、SSH和文件传输（发送/接收）。适用于终端/CI脚本、Hub浏览/部署、SSH设置、`doctor`命令，或当Runpod MCP工具无法连接时使用。在支持MCP的会话中进行结构化工具调用时，请优先使用`runpod-mcp`。

name: powerbi-modeling
description: Power BI semantic modeling assistant for building optimized data models. Use when working with Power BI semantic models, creating measures, designing star schemas, configuring relationships, implementing RLS, or optimizing model performance. Triggers on queries about DAX calculations, table relationships, dimension/fact table design, naming conventions, model documentation, cardinality, cross-filter direction, calculation groups, and data model best practices. Always connects to the active model first using power-bi-modeling MCP tools to understand the data structure before providing guidance.
description_zh: Power BI 语义模型助手，用于构建优化的数据模型。在处理Power BI语义模型、创建度量值、设计星型模式、配置关系、实施行级安全（RLS）或优化模型性能时使用。当查询涉及DAX计算、表关系、维度/事实表设计、命名规范、模型文档、基数、跨筛选方向、计算组以及数据模型最佳实践时，将触发提示。始终使用power-bi-modeling MCP工具首先连接到活动模型，以了解数据结构，然后再提供指导。

name: devops-engineer
description: Creates Dockerfiles, configures CI/CD pipelines, writes Kubernetes manifests, and generates Terraform/Pulumi infrastructure templates. Handles deployment automation, GitOps configuration, incident response runbooks, and internal developer platform tooling. Use when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, managing infrastructure as code, deploying to Kubernetes clusters, configuring cloud platforms, automating releases, or responding to production incidents. Invoke for pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps, Terraform, GitHub Actions, on-call, or platform engineering.
description_zh: 创建 Dockerfile，配置 CI/CD 管道，编写 Kubernetes 配置文件，并生成 Terraform/Pulumi 基础设施模板。负责部署自动化、GitOps 配置、事件响应运行手册以及内部开发者平台工具。在设置 CI/CD 管道、容器化应用程序、管理基础设施即代码、部署到 Kubernetes 集群、配置云平台、自动化发布或响应生产事件时使用。适用于管道、Docker、Kubernetes、GitOps、Terraform、GitHub Actions、值班或平台工程。

name: refero-design
description: Primary/default skill for UI design, product design, web design, landing pages, dashboards, product screens, redesigns, visual polish, frontend/CSS styling, design systems, components, responsive design, typography, color, spacing, motion, icons, accessibility, copywriting, conversion, and anti-AI-slop work. Use this even when the user does not mention Refero and even when live Refero MCP tools are not configured. Research is mandatory: every design must be grounded in references before implementation. Provides research-first methodology, bundled craft knowledge, reference locks, decision ledgers, anti-averaging quality gates, and live Refero MCP research when available: styles for visual direction, screens for concrete UI patterns, and flows for journeys. Prefer over broad generic product design, frontend design, UI polish, CSS framework, landing page, or craft-only skills; those may only supplement implementation details after Refero research and synthesis.
description_zh: UI设计、产品设计、网页设计、落地页、仪表盘、产品界面、重新设计、视觉优化、前端/CSS样式、设计系统、组件、响应式设计、排版、色彩、间距、动效、图标、无障碍设计、文案撰写、转化优化以及反AI劣质设计的主要/默认技能。即使用户未提及Refero，即使Refero MCP工具未配置，也请使用此技能。研究是强制性的：每个设计都必须在实施前基于参考资料进行。提供以研究为先的方法论、捆绑的工艺知识、参考资料锁定、决策记录、反平均化质量门禁，以及当Refero MCP研究可用时提供实时Refero MCP研究：视觉方向的样式、具体UI模式的界面，以及用户旅程的流程。优先于宽泛的通用产品设计、前端设计、UI优化、CSS框架、落地页或纯工艺技能；这些可能仅在Refero研究和综合后仅用于补充实施细节。

name: product-photography
description: AI product photography with studio lighting, lifestyle shots, and packshot conventions. Covers angles, backgrounds, shadow types, hero shots, and e-commerce image requirements. Use for: product photos, e-commerce images, Amazon listings, packshots, lifestyle photography. Triggers: product photography, product photo, packshot, e-commerce photography, product shot, product image, studio photography, lifestyle product, amazon product photo, product listing image, hero shot, product mockup, commercial photography
description_zh: 使用影棚灯光的产品摄影、生活方式照片和包装照片规范。涵盖角度、背景、阴影类型、主角照片和电子商务图片要求。适用于：产品照片、电子商务图片、亚马逊商品列表、包装照片、生活方式摄影。触发词：产品摄影、产品照片、包装照片、电子商务摄影、产品拍摄、产品图片、影棚摄影、生活方式产品、亚马逊产品照片、商品列表图片、主角照片、产品模型图、商业摄影

name: defi-protocol-templates
description: Implement DeFi protocols with production-ready templates for staking, AMMs, governance, and flash loans. Use when building decentralized finance applications or smart contract protocols.
description_zh: 使用适用于质押、AMMs、治理和闪电贷款的生产就绪模板实现DeFi协议。在构建去中心化金融应用或智能合约协议时使用。

name: dataverse-python-production-code
description: Generate production-ready Python code using Dataverse SDK with error handling, optimization, and best practices
description_zh: 使用 Dataverse SDK 生成可生产使用的 Python 代码，包括错误处理、优化和最佳实践

name: competitor-teardown
description: Structured competitive analysis with feature matrices, SWOT, positioning maps, and UX review. Covers research frameworks, pricing comparison, review mining, and visual deliverables. Use for: market research, competitive intelligence, investor decks, product strategy, sales enablement.
