Use when gating content or rewards to Seeker owners, verifying a user holds an SGT, adding anti-Sybil checks to a Solana mobile app, or implementing one-claim-per-device logic.
description_zh: 验证Seeker设备所有权，通过检查Sign-in-with-Solana的Seeker Genesis Token（SGT）以及服务器端令牌验证。用于向Seeker所有者授权内容或奖励、验证用户持有SGT、为Solana移动应用添加反Sybil检查，或实现每设备限领一次逻辑。

name: agents-md
description: Creates and maintains concise AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md project instruction files. Use when asked to create AGENTS.md, update AGENTS.md, maintain agent docs, set up CLAUDE.md, document repository agent conventions, or keep coding-agent instructions minimal and reference-backed.
description_zh: 创建和维护简洁的AGENTS.md与CLAUDE.md项目说明文件。在要求创建AGENTS.md、更新AGENTS.md、维护代理文档、设置CLAUDE.md、记录仓库代理约定，或保持编码代理说明简洁并基于参考时使用。

name: ljg-rank
description: 给一个领域，找出背后真正撑着它的几根独立的力。十几个现象砍到不可再少的生成器——砍完能把现象一个个生回来，才算数。Use when user says '降秩', '找秩', '秩是什么', '这个领域靠什么撑着', '背后是什么', or wants to decompose any domain to its irreducible generators.
description_zh: 给定一个领域，找出支撑它的几股独立的力。将十几个现象削减到不可再少的生成器——削减完成后能将现象逐一还原，才算有效。当用户说“降秩”、“找秩”、“秩是什么”、“这个领域靠什么支撑”、“背后是什么”，或想将任何领域分解为其不可约生成器时使用。

name: integration-privy
description: Add Privy authentication to a Solana Expo Android app on top of Mobile Wallet Adapter, using Sign-In-With-Solana. Use when installing @privy-io/expo, mounting PrivyProvider, logging a user in with useLoginWithSiws, linking a wallet to an existing Privy account, reading the Privy access token from a backend, or debugging a Privy plus MWA setup.
description_zh: 在 Solana Expo Android 应用程序中添加 Privy 认证，基于 Mobile Wallet Adapter，使用 Sign-In-With-Solana。在安装 @privy-io/expo 时使用，挂载 PrivyProvider，使用 useLoginWithSiws 登录用户，将钱包链接到现有的 Privy 账户，从后端读取 Privy 访问令牌，或调试 Privy 与 MWA 的设置。

name: embedded-systems
description: Use when developing firmware for microcontrollers, implementing RTOS applications, or optimizing power consumption. Invoke for STM32, ESP32, FreeRTOS, bare-metal, power optimization, real-time systems, configure peripherals, write interrupt handlers, implement DMA transfers, debug timing issues.
description_zh: 用于开发微控制器固件、实现实时操作系统应用或优化功耗。适用于STM32、ESP32、FreeRTOS、裸机、功耗优化、实时系统、配置外设、编写中断处理程序、实现DMA传输、调试时序问题。

name: tiktok-marketing
description: TikTok content strategy, video creation workflows, posting optimization, and analytics. Based on n8n automation templates.
description_zh: 抖音内容策略、视频创作工作流、发布优化和分析。基于n8n自动化模板。

name: file-organizer
description: Intelligently organizes your files and folders across your computer by understanding context, finding duplicates, suggesting better structures, and automating cleanup tasks. Reduces cognitive load and keeps your digital workspace tidy without manual effort.
description_zh: 智能地根据上下文理解、查找重复项、建议更优结构并自动化清理任务，从而在您的电脑上组织文件和文件夹。减少认知负担，无需手动操作即可保持您的数字工作空间整洁。

name: seo-geo
description: Audit and improve content for AI Overviews and answer engines, including citability, entity clarity, crawler access, brand signals, and passage structure.
description_zh: 审计并改进AI概述和答案引擎的内容，包括可引用性、实体清晰度、爬虫访问、品牌信号和段落结构。

name: seo-technical
description: Audit technical SEO across crawlability, indexability, security, URLs, mobile, Core Web Vitals, rendering, structured data, and IndexNow. Exclude content strategy and backlinks.
description_zh: 对技术SEO进行审计，涵盖可爬取性、可索引性、安全性、URL、移动端、核心网页指标、渲染、结构化数据以及IndexNow。排除内容策略和反向链接。

name: plugin-structure
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "create a plugin", "scaffold a plugin", "understand plugin structure", "organize plugin components", "set up plugin.json", "use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}", "add commands/agents/skills/hooks", "configure auto-discovery", or needs guidance on plugin directory layout, manifest configuration, component organization, file naming conventions, or Claude Code plugin architecture best practices.
description_zh: 当用户要求“创建插件”、“搭建插件”、“理解插件结构”、“组织插件组件”、“设置 plugin.json”、“使用 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}”、“添加命令/代理/技能/钩子”、“配置自动发现”，或需要关于插件目录布局、清单配置、组件组织、文件命名规范或 Claude Code 插件架构最佳实践方面的指导时，应使用此技能。

name: dogfood
description: Exploratory QA of web apps: find bugs, evidence, reports.
description_zh: 探索性测试Web应用：发现错误、证据、报告。

name: platform-docs-get
description: Official Salesforce documentation retrieval skill. Use when you need authoritative Salesforce docs from developer.salesforce.com, help.salesforce.com, architect.salesforce.com, admin.salesforce.com, or lightningdesignsystem.com, especially when pages are JS-heavy, shell-rendered, or hard to extract with naive fetching. Use to ground answers in official Salesforce sources instead of third-party blogs or summaries. TRIGGER when: user asks for official Salesforce documentation, Apex or API reference, LWC docs, Agentforce docs, setup or help articles, or any doc from a Salesforce-owned domain. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user is asking for a code change, deployment task, or anything not requiring documentation retrieval — use the appropriate sf-* skill instead.
description_zh:
官方 Salesforce 文档检索技能。当您需要从 developer.salesforce.com、help.salesforce.com、architect.salesforce.com、admin.salesforce.com 或 lightningdesignsystem.com 获取权威的 Salesforce 文档时使用，尤其是在页面以 JS 为主、使用 shell 渲染或难以通过简单抓取提取时。使用此技能以确保答案基于官方 Salesforce 资源，而非第三方博客或摘要。  
触发条件：当用户询问官方 Salesforce 文档、Apex 或 API 参考、LWC 文档、Agentforce 文档、设置或帮助文章，或任何 Salesforce 自有域的文档时。  
不触发条件：当用户询问代码修改、部署任务或任何不需要文档检索的事项时——请使用相应的 sf-* 技能。

name: plugin-settings
description: This skill should be used when the user asks about "plugin settings", "store plugin configuration", "user-configurable plugin", ".local.md files", "plugin state files", "read YAML frontmatter", "per-project plugin settings", or wants to make plugin behavior configurable. Documents the .claude/plugin-name.local.md pattern for storing plugin-specific configuration with YAML frontmatter and markdown content.
description_zh: 当用户询问“插件设置”、“商店插件配置”、“用户可配置插件”、“.local.md文件”、“插件状态文件”、“读取YAML前文”、“项目级插件设置”或希望使插件行为可配置时，应使用此技能。该文档记录了使用YAML前文和Markdown内容存储特定插件配置的.claude/plugin-name.local.md模式。

name: knowledge-synthesis
description: Combines search results from multiple sources into coherent, deduplicated answers with source attribution. Handles confidence scoring based on freshness and authority, and summarizes large result sets effectively.
description_zh: 整合多个来源的搜索结果，生成连贯、去重且注明来源的答案。根据时效性和权威性处理置信度评分，并能有效总结大量结果集。

name: agentic-actions-auditor
description: Audits GitHub Actions workflows for security vulnerabilities in AI agent integrations including Claude Code Action, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, and GitHub AI Inference. Detects attack vectors where attacker-controlled input reaches AI agents running in CI/CD pipelines, including env var intermediary patterns, direct expression injection, dangerous sandbox configurations, and wildcard user allowlists. Use when reviewing workflow files that invoke AI coding agents, auditing CI/CD pipeline security for prompt injection risks, or evaluating agentic action configurations.
description_zh: 审计 GitHub Actions 工作流中的安全漏洞，涵盖 AI 代理集成，包括 Claude Code Action、Gemini CLI、OpenAI Codex 和 GitHub AI 推理。检测攻击路径，其中攻击者控制的输入会到达运行在 CI/CD 管道中的 AI 代理，包括环境变量中间件模式、直接表达式注入、危险沙箱配置和通配符用户允许列表。在审查调用 AI 编码代理的工作流文件、审计 CI/CD 管道中的提示注入风险或评估代理动作配置时使用。

name: dd-pup
description: Datadog CLI (Rust). OAuth2 auth with token refresh.
description_zh: Datadog CLI（Rust）。使用令牌刷新的OAuth2认证。

name: ljg-word
description: Deep-dive English word mastery tool. Deconstructs a single English word into core semantics and epiphany. Use when user asks to explain/master a specific English word.
description_zh: 深入探索英语单词掌握工具。将单个英语单词分解为核心语义和顿悟。当用户要求解释/掌握特定英语单词时使用。

name: ljg-relationship
description: Relationship analyst combining structural diagnostics (5-layer framework) with psychoanalytic depth (transference, unconscious patterns, resistance). Guides users through dialogue to "see" the real structure of their relationship issues. Use when user says "关系分析", "分析关系", "relationship", "人际关系", or describes a specific relationship problem they want to understand.
description_zh: 关系分析师结合结构诊断（五层框架）与精神分析深度（移情、无意识模式、阻力）。通过对话引导用户“看见”其关系问题的真实结构。当用户说“关系分析”、“分析关系”、“relationship”、“人际关系”，或描述他们想理解的具体关系问题时使用。

name: n8n-expression-syntax
description: Validate n8n expression syntax and fix common errors. Use when writing n8n expressions, using {{}} syntax, accessing $json/$node variables, troubleshooting expression errors, mapping data between nodes, or referencing webhook data in workflows. Use this skill whenever configuring node fields that reference data from previous nodes — expressions are how n8n passes data between nodes, and getting the syntax wrong is the most common source of workflow errors. Also use when asked whether a complex expression hurts performance.
description_zh: 验证n8n表达式语法并修复常见错误。在编写n8n表达式、使用{{}}语法、访问$json/$node变量、排查表达式错误、在节点间映射数据或在工作流中引用webhook数据时使用。每当配置引用前序节点数据的节点字段时，都要使用此技能——表达式是n8n在节点间传递数据的方式，语法错误是工作流中最常见的错误来源。此外，在询问复杂表达式是否影响性能时也使用。

name: stitch::react-components
description: Converts Stitch designs into modular Vite and React components, or syncs/updates existing React components to align with the latest Stitch designs, using system-level networking and AST-based validation.

name: grill-me
description: 一个用来打磨计划或设计的持续追问式访谈。
description_zh: 一种用于打磨计划或设计的持续追问式访谈。

name: tech-debt
description: Identify, categorize, and prioritize technical debt. Trigger with "tech debt", "technical debt audit", "what should we refactor", "code health", or when the user asks about code quality, refactoring priorities, or maintenance backlog.
description_zh: 识别、分类和优先处理技术债务。当用户输入“技术债务”、“技术债务审计”、“我们应该重构什么”、“代码健康”或询问代码质量、重构优先级或维护积压时触发。

name: seo-backlinks
description: Analyze a site's backlink profile, anchors, toxic signals, competitors, gaps, and disavow candidates. Use only when links or referring domains are the requested focus.
description_zh: 分析网站的背链配置文件、锚文本、有害信号、竞争对手、空白点和排除候选对象。仅在链接或来源域名是关注焦点时使用。

name: view-pdf
description: Interactive PDF viewer. Use when the user wants to open, show, or view a PDF and collaborate on it visually — annotate, highlight, stamp, fill form fields, place signature/initials, or review markup together. Not for summarization or text extraction (use native Read instead).
description_zh: 交互式PDF查看器。当用户希望打开、显示或查看PDF并对其进行视觉协作时使用——可以注释、高亮、盖章、填写表单字段、放置签名/草稿，或共同审阅标记。不用于摘要或文本提取（请使用原生的“阅读”功能）。

name: tushare
description: 面向中文自然语言的 Tushare 数据研究技能。用于把“看看这只股票最近怎么样”“帮我查财报趋势”“最近哪个板块最强”“北向资金在买什么”“给我导出一份行情数据”这类请求，转成可执行的数据获取、清洗、对比、筛选、导出与简要分析流程。适用于 A 股、指数、ETF/基金、财务、估值、资金流、公告新闻、板块概念与宏观数据等研究场景。
description_zh: 面向中文自然语言的 Tushare 数据研究技能。用于将“看看这只股票最近怎么样”“帮我查财报趋势”“最近哪个板块最强”“北向资金在买什么”“给我导出一份行情数据”这类请求，转化为可执行的数据获取、清洗、对比、筛选、导出与简要分析流程。适用于 A 股、指数、ETF/基金、财务、估值、资金流、公告新闻、板块概念与宏观数据等研究场景。

name: angular-testing
description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Write unit and integration tests for Angular v20+ applications using Vitest or Jasmine with TestBed and modern testing patterns. Use for testing components with signals, OnPush change detection, services with inject(), and HTTP interactions. Triggers on test creation, testing signal-based components, mocking dependencies, or setting up test infrastructure. Don't use for E2E testing with Cypress or Playwright, or for testing non-Angular JavaScript/TypeScript code.
description_zh: 已弃用 - 此技能未得到维护。请使用官方的 Angular 技能，访问 https://github.com/angular/skills。使用 Vitest 或 Jasmine 与 TestBed 和现代测试模式为 Angular v20+ 应用编写单元测试和集成测试。用于测试具有 signals、OnPush 变更检测、使用 inject() 的服务以及 HTTP 交互的组件。在测试创建、测试基于 signal 的组件、模拟依赖项或设置测试基础设施时触发。不要用于使用 Cypress 或 Playwright 进行的 E2E 测试，或用于测试非 Angular 的 JavaScript/TypeScript 代码。

name: testing-strategy
description: Design test strategies and test plans. Trigger with "how should we test", "test strategy for", "write tests for", "test plan", "what tests do we need", or when the user needs help with testing approaches, coverage, or test architecture.
description_zh: 设计测试策略和测试计划。当用户询问“我们应该如何测试”、“针对...的测试策略”、“编写测试用例”、“测试计划”、“我们需要哪些测试”或需要帮助时，触发测试方法、覆盖范围或测试架构。

name: platform-soql-query
description: Use when the user needs SOQL/SOSL authoring or optimization: natural-language-to-query generation, relationship queries, aggregates, query-plan/selectivity analysis, and performance or safety improvements. TRIGGER when the user writes, optimizes, or debugs SOQL/SOSL, touches .soql files, or asks about relationship queries, aggregates, or query performance. DO NOT TRIGGER for bulk data operations (use platform-data-manage), Apex DML logic (use platform-apex-generate), or report/dashboard queries.
description_zh: 当用户需要编写或优化 SOQL/SOSL 时使用：自然语言到查询的生成、关系查询、聚合、查询计划/选择性分析，以及性能或安全性的改进。触发条件：当用户编写、优化或调试 SOQL/SOSL，接触 .soql 文件，或询问关于关系查询、聚合或查询性能时。不触发用于批量数据操作（使用 platform-data-manage）、Apex DML 逻辑（使用 platform-apex-generate）或报告/仪表板查询。

name: agently-mail
description: 通过 agently-cli 命令行工具操作邮件：发送、回复、转发、搜索、读取、下载附件、管理收件箱。当用户需要进行任何邮件相关操作时使用此 skill。
description_zh: 通过 agently-cli 命令行工具操作邮件：发送、回复、转发、搜索、读取、下载附件、管理收件箱。当用户需要进行任何邮件相关操作时使用此技能。

name: printing-press-retro
description: Use when the user asks to retro, run a retrospective, file findings, or improve the Printing Press after a printed-CLI run. Trigger phrases: "retro", "retrospective", "what went wrong", "improve the press", "post-mortem", "lessons learned", "what can we improve", "file a retro", "submit findings". Do not use for printed-CLI polish or a single-CLI fix.
description_zh: 在用户要求回顾、运行回顾会议、记录发现或改进打印机（在打印-CLI运行后）时使用。触发短语："回顾"、"回顾会议"、"出了什么问题"、"改进打印机"、"事后分析"、"学到的教训"、"我们能如何改进"、"提交回顾"、"提交发现"。不适用于打印-CLI优化或单个CLI修复。

name: seo-schema
description: Detect, validate, or generate Schema.org JSON-LD for a supplied page or entity. Use only when structured data or rich-result markup is requested.
description_zh: 检测、验证或生成 Schema.org JSON-LD，适用于提供的页面或实体。仅在请求结构化数据或丰富结果标记时使用。

name: platform-metadata-deploy
description: Salesforce DevOps automation using sf CLI v2. TRIGGER when: user deploys metadata, creates/manages scratch orgs or sandboxes, sets up CI/CD pipelines, or troubleshoots deployment errors with sf project deploy. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex code (use platform-apex-generate), building LWC components (use experience-lwc-generate), creating metadata definitions (use platform-custom-object-generate or platform-custom-field-generate), or querying org data (use platform-data-manage).
description_zh:
使用 sf CLI v2 进行 Salesforce DevOps 自动化。  
触发条件：当用户部署元数据、创建/管理 Scratch Org 或沙盒、设置 CI/CD 管道，或使用 sf project deploy 解决部署错误时。  
不触发条件：编写 Apex 代码（使用 platform-apex-generate）、构建 LWC 组件（使用 experience-lwc-generate）、创建元数据定义（使用 platform-custom-object-generate 或 platform-custom-field-generate），或查询 Org 数据（使用 platform-data-manage）。

name: gh-cli
description: Enforces authenticated gh CLI workflows over unauthenticated curl, WebFetch, and MCP fetch patterns. Use when working with GitHub URLs, API access, pull requests, or issues.
description_zh: 强制使用经过身份验证的 gh CLI 工作流程，而不是未经身份验证的 curl、WebFetch 和 MCP 获取模式。在与 GitHub URL、API 访问、拉取请求或问题相关的工作中使用。

name: open-knowledge-write-skill
description: Use when the user wants to create, author, write, or design a new Agent Skill (a SKILL.md) — for OpenKnowledge or for their editors — including requests like 'help me write a skill', 'make a skill that…', 'turn this workflow into a skill', or improving an existing skill's triggering and discipline. Also use when capturing reusable agent guidance that should live as an installable skill rather than a one-off prompt. Covers choosing scope (project vs global), authoring inside a plugin or skills-distribution repo (write in the repo's own layout, never install), the SKILL.md frontmatter contract, progressive-disclosure structure, evaluating the skill, and installing it into the user's editors.
description_zh: 当用户希望创建、编写、设计新的 Agent 技能（即 SKILL.md）时使用——无论是用于 OpenKnowledge 还是其编辑器——包括类似“帮我写一个技能”、“创建一个技能……”、“将这个工作流转换为技能”，或改进现有技能的触发和约束等请求。也用于捕获可重用的代理指导，这些指导应作为可安装的技能存在，而不是一次性提示。涵盖选择范围（项目 vs 全局）、在插件或技能分发仓库中编写（使用仓库自身布局，永不安装）、SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 合约、渐进式披露结构、评估技能，以及将其安装到用户的编辑器中。

name: printing-press-reprint
description: Regenerate an existing printed CLI from scratch under the current Printing Press, with prior research, prior novel features, and prior patches (post-publish hand-fixes) carried into the writing pipeline as reconciliation context rather than dropped on the floor. Pulls the CLI from the public library if it isn't local, recommends reuse-vs-redo of prior research based on age, then hands off to /printing-press with the right context. Use when a machine upgrade would benefit a published CLI more than manual polish. Trigger phrases: "reprint <api>", "regenerate <api>", "redo the <api> CLI", "rebuild <api> from scratch", "this CLI would benefit from a reprint".
description_zh: 在当前印刷机下，从零开始重新生成现有的已印刷CLI，将先前的研究、先前的新功能以及先前的补丁（发布后的手动修复）作为协调上下文纳入编写流程，而不是丢弃。如果CLI不在本地，则从公共库中提取CLI；根据时间长短，建议重用而非重做先前的研究，然后将其传递给印刷机，并附带正确的上下文。当机器升级对已发布的CLI的改善效果优于手动润色时使用。触发短语："重新印刷 <api>"、"重新生成 <api>"、"重做 <api> CLI"、"从零重建 <api>"、"这个CLI将从重新印刷中获益"。

name: platform-custom-field-generate
description: Use when users create, generate, or validate Salesforce Custom Field metadata. Trigger on custom fields, field types, Roll-Up Summary, Master-Detail/Lookup relationships, formula fields, picklists, dependent (controlling) picklists, referencing a value set from a field, or scoping picklist values per record type; also field deployment errors, including a record type that won't deploy without a business process. DO NOT TRIGGER for creating/customizing the value set itself — a new GlobalValueSet or a StandardValueSet catalog like Industry — use platform-value-set-generate; this skill covers the field that references a value set, not the value set definition.
description_zh: 在用户创建、生成或验证 Salesforce 自定义字段元数据时使用。在自定义字段、字段类型、汇总字段、主从/查找关系、公式字段、选择列表、依赖（控制）选择列表、从字段引用值集或按记录类型范围选择列表值时触发；还包括字段部署错误，包括没有业务流程就无法部署的记录类型。不应用于创建/自定义值集本身——例如新的 GlobalValueSet 或像 Industry 这样的 StandardValueSet 目录，应使用 platform-value-set-generate；这项技能涵盖引用值集的字段，而不是值集定义。

name: web-scraping
description: Authorized web scraping with fallback cascades and access-failure handling. Use for social media, yt-dlp, CAPTCHA or 403 blocks.
description_zh: 授权网络爬取，支持备用级联和访问失败处理。适用于社交媒体、yt-dlp、验证码或403阻止。

name: audit-context-building
description: Understand a codebase before looking for bugs in it - what each function assumes, what it guarantees, and what it depends on elsewhere. Use when starting an audit, threat model, or architecture review on unfamiliar code, and before any vulnerability-hunting pass.
description_zh: 在查找代码库中的错误之前，先理解代码库——了解每个函数的假设、保证及其依赖的其他部分。在开始对不熟悉的代码进行审计、威胁模型或架构评审时使用，以及在任何漏洞搜寻过程之前使用。

name: clickhouse-js-node-rowbinary
description: Generate TypeScript/JavaScript code that reads/decodes AND writes/encodes ClickHouse RowBinary streams for the ClickHouse HTTP server. Use this skill whenever a user wants to parse or produce `RowBinary`, `RowBinaryWithNames`, or `RowBinaryWithNamesAndTypes`. Node.js only, doesn't cover browsers.
description_zh: 生成 TypeScript/JavaScript 代码，用于读取/解码 ClickHouse RowBinary 流，并为 ClickHouse HTTP 服务器写入/编码 ClickHouse RowBinary 流。当用户需要解析或生成 `RowBinary`、`RowBinaryWithNames` 或 `RowBinaryWithNamesAndTypes` 时，请使用此技能。仅适用于 Node.js，不适用于浏览器。

name: printing-press-import
description: Bring a published CLI from the public library into the internal library so it's identical to a freshly-generated copy — module path reverted, manuscripts placed alongside, ready for /printing-press-polish or /printing-press-emboss. Use when the public library has a CLI you don't have locally, or to recover from a broken/lost internal copy. Trigger phrases: "import the CLI", "bring it into my library", "fetch from public library", "I don't have it locally yet".
description_zh: 将公共图书馆中的已发布CLI导入内部图书馆，使其与全新生成的副本完全一致——模块路径恢复原状，文稿放置在旁边，准备好进行 /printing-press-polish 或 /printing-press-emboss 操作。当公共图书馆有您本地没有的CLI时，或需要从损坏/丢失的内部副本中恢复时使用。触发短语："导入CLI"、"将其导入我的图书馆"、"从公共图书馆获取"、"我本地还没有"。

name: platform-metadata-retrieve
description: ALWAYS USE THIS SKILL to retrieve metadata from an org to your local project with sf project retrieve start. Supports retrieval by all changes, source directory, metadata type (wildcards), manifest (package.xml), or package name, in source or metadata (ZIP) format. Use when the user asks to retrieve, pull, sync, or download metadata, Apex classes, or custom objects. DO NOT TRIGGER for deploying metadata (use platform-metadata-deploy), listing metadata, or generating a package.xml (use platform-manifest-generate). NEVER use MCP tools.
description_zh: 始终使用此技能，通过sf project retrieve start从组织检索元数据到本地项目。支持按所有更改、源目录、元数据类型（通配符）、清单（package.xml）或包名称进行检索，格式为源或元数据（ZIP）。当用户要求检索、拉取、同步或下载元数据、Apex类或自定义对象时使用。不要用于部署元数据（使用platform-metadata-deploy）、列出元数据或生成package.xml（使用platform-manifest-generate）。绝对不要使用MCP工具。

name: property-based-testing
description: Writes, reviews, and debugs property-based tests — Hypothesis, fast-check, proptest, jqwik, rapid, and Echidna or Medusa for Solidity invariants. Use whenever tests should cover a whole input domain instead of a hand-picked list of examples: encode/decode and serialize/deserialize pairs, parsers, canonicalizers and normalizers, validators, numeric and Decimal types, comparators and sort order, data structures, and smart-contract state invariants. Also use when adding cases to an existing @given, fast-check, or proptest suite, when judging whether existing property tests assert anything real, and when a generator has shrunk a counterexample and you need to tell a wrong property from a genuine bug. Not for coverage-guided binary fuzzing (libFuzzer, AFL), mutation-testing campaigns, static analysis, benchmarking, or end-to-end UI tests.
description_zh: 编写、审查和调试基于属性的测试——Hypothesis、fast-check、proptest、jqwik、rapid，以及用于Solidity不变式的Echidna或Medusa。当测试需要覆盖整个输入域而不是手动挑选的示例列表时使用：编码/解码和序列化/反序列化对、解析器、规范化和归一化器、验证器、数值和Decimal类型、比较器和排序顺序、数据结构以及智能合约状态不变式。在向现有的@given、fast-check或proptest套件添加用例时，在判断现有的属性测试是否断言任何真实内容时，以及当生成器缩减反例时需要区分错误的属性和真实错误时也使用。不适用于覆盖率引导的二进制模糊测试（libFuzzer、AFL）、变异测试活动、静态分析、基准测试或端到端UI测试。

name: kakaotalk-mac
description: Search local KakaoTalk archives on Apple Silicon macOS through the katok CLI. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过 katok CLI 在 Apple Silicon macOS 上搜索本地 KakaoTalk 存档。在돌쇠中，会通过官方表面进行后续操作。

name: connecting-to-data-source
description: Create and troubleshoot AWS Glue connections to JDBC databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, RDS), Redshift, Snowflake, and BigQuery. Gathers connection hints from user, discovers existing connections and RDS/Redshift candidates, registers credentials in Secrets Manager or IAM DB auth, configures VPC, and tests. Triggers on: connect to database, set up Glue connection, register data source, connect to Snowflake/BigQuery/RDS, connection timeout, test connection, troubleshoot connection. Do NOT use for moving data (use ingesting-into-data-lake), creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table), queries (use querying-data-lake), catalog exploration (use exploring-data-catalog), or SaaS (Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, MongoDB, Kafka).
description_zh: 创建和排错 AWS Glue 连接到 JDBC 数据库（Oracle、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、RDS）、Redshift、Snowflake 和 BigQuery。收集用户连接提示，发现现有连接和 RDS/Redshift 候选连接，在 Secrets Manager 或 IAM DB 认证中注册凭证，配置 VPC，并进行测试。触发条件：连接到数据库、设置 Glue 连接、注册数据源、连接到 Snowflake/BigQuery/RDS、连接超时、测试连接、排错连接。**不应用于数据迁移（请使用 ingesting-into-data-lake）、创建表（请使用 creating-data-lake-table）、查询（请使用 querying-data-lake）、目录探索（请使用 exploring-data-catalog）或 SaaS（Salesforce、ServiceNow、SAP、MongoDB、Kafka）。**

name: printing-press-output-review
description: Internal sub-skill: agentic review of a printed CLI's sampled command output for plausibility issues that rule-based checks can't encode (substring-match relevance, format bugs, silent source drops, ranking failures). Invoked via the Skill tool by the main printing-press skill at Phase 4.85 and printing-press-polish SKILL.md during the diagnostic loop. Not for direct user invocation — its actionable wrappers are /printing-press and /printing-press-polish.
description_zh: 内部子技能：针对打印式CLI采样命令输出进行基于规则的检查无法编码的合理性问题进行代理式审查（子字符串匹配相关性、格式错误、静默源丢失、排名失败）。由主打印机技能在4.85阶段和打印机抛光SKILL.md在诊断循环期间通过技能工具调用。不直接供用户调用——其可操作的包装器为 /printing-press 和 /printing-press-polish。

name: securing-s3-buckets
description: Create and secure S3 buckets following AWS best practices for access control, encryption, monitoring, and remediation of misconfigurations. Use when the user wants to secure a new bucket, audit an existing bucket, fix a security finding, configure encryption, or enable logging and monitoring. Do NOT use for general S3 data operations, S3 Tables setup, or discovering existing data assets.
description_zh: 根据 AWS 最佳实践创建并保护 S3 存储桶，涵盖访问控制、加密、监控和错误配置的修复。当用户需要保护新存储桶、审计现有存储桶、修复安全漏洞、配置加密或启用日志记录和监控时使用。不适用于一般 S3 数据操作、S3 表格设置或发现现有数据资产。

name: daiso-product-search
description: Look up Daiso products by store name and product keyword using official Daiso Mall store/search/stock surfaces. Use when the user wants to know whether a product is available at a specific Daiso store. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 使用官方Daiso Mall的store/search/stock界面，通过店铺名称和产品关键词查找Daiso产品。当用户想知道某个Daiso店铺是否有特定产品时使用。돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통해 후속 액션까지 진행한다。

name: dbs-jtbd
description: dontbesilent JTBD 任务澄清。用 Jobs to Be Done 识别具体情境中用户想推进的进展、切换方案的力量与可观察的选择标准，据此优化产品、内容、服务、决策和 AI 提示词。调用名：/dbs-jtbd。用户问「到底要解决什么」「为什么会选择这个方案」「用 JTBD 重写提示词」时使用。
description_zh: 不要沉默 JTBD 任务澄清。使用 Jobs to Be Done 来识别在具体情境中用户希望推进的进展、切换方案的力量以及可观察的选择标准，据此优化产品、内容、服务、决策和 AI 提示词。调用名：/dbs-jtbd。当用户问「到底要解决什么」「为什么会选择这个方案」「用 JTBD 重写提示词」时使用。

name: build-mcp-server
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "build an MCP server", "create an MCP", "make an MCP integration", "wrap an API for Claude", "expose tools to Claude", "make an MCP app", or discusses building something with the Model Context Protocol. It is the entry point for MCP server development — it interrogates the user about their use case, determines the right deployment model (remote HTTP, MCPB, local stdio), picks a tool-design pattern, and hands off to specialized skills.
description_zh: 当用户要求“构建MCP服务器”、“创建MCP”、“制作MCP集成”、“为Claude封装API”、“向Claude暴露工具”、“制作MCP应用”或讨论使用模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）构建某物时，应使用此技能。它是MCP服务器开发的人口点——它会询问用户的使用场景，确定合适的部署模型（远程HTTP、MCPB、本地stdio），选择工具设计模式，然后转交给专门的技能。

name: seo-page
description: Analyze one supplied URL across on-page, content, technical metadata, schema, images, and performance. Use only for a single-page review.
description_zh: 分析一个提供的 URL 在页面、内容、技术元数据、模式、图像和性能方面的表现。仅用于单页面评估。

name: code-reviewer
description: Analyzes code diffs and files to identify bugs, security vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, insecure deserialization), code smells, N+1 queries, naming issues, and architectural concerns, then produces a structured review report with prioritized, actionable feedback. Use when reviewing pull requests, conducting code quality audits, identifying refactoring opportunities, or checking for security issues. Invoke for PR reviews, code quality checks, refactoring suggestions, review code, code quality. Complements specialized skills (security-reviewer, test-master) by providing broad-scope review across correctness, performance, maintainability, and test coverage in a single pass.
description_zh: 分析代码差异和文件，以识别错误、安全漏洞（SQL注入、XSS、不安全的反序列化）、代码异味、N+1查询、命名问题以及架构问题，然后生成结构化的审查报告，并提供优先级排序的可操作反馈。在审查拉取请求、进行代码质量审计、识别重构机会或检查安全问题时使用。用于拉取请求审查、代码质量检查、重构建议、审查代码、代码质量。通过在一次扫描中提供跨正确性、性能、可维护性和测试覆盖率的广泛范围审查，补充专业技能（安全审查员、测试大师）。

name: chinese-novelist
description:
分章节创作引人入胜的中文小说。支持各种题材（悬疑/言情/奇幻/科幻/历史等），支持10-50章长篇创作，每章3000-5000字，结尾设置悬念钩子。强调深度润色去除AI痕迹，确保文字自然流畅。
当用户要求：写小说、创作故事、分章节写作、连续剧情、章节悬念、长篇小说时使用。

name: hads
description: Use when writing technical documentation that needs to be readable by both humans and AI models, converting existing docs to HADS format, validating a HADS document, or optimizing documentation for token-efficient AI consumption.
description_zh: 在编写需要人类和 AI 模型都能阅读的技术文档、将现有文档转换为 HADS 格式、验证 HADS 文档或优化文档以实现 AI 高效消耗 token 时使用。

name: printing-press-score
description: Score a generated CLI against the Steinberger bar, compare two CLIs side-by-side
description_zh: 将生成的CLI与Steinberger条进行评分，并并排比较两个CLI

name: delivery-tracking
description: Track CJ대한통운 and 우체국 parcels by invoice number with official carrier endpoints, and structure the workflow around a carrier adapter that can grow to more couriers later.
description_zh: 使用官方承运商端点，通过发票号码追踪 CJ대한통운 和 우체국 包裹，并围绕一个可扩展到更多承运商的承运商适配器来构建工作流程。

name: powerpoint
description:
Handle PowerPoint (.pptx) creation, design, and analysis. Use for pitch decks, status updates, and visual storytelling. Use proactively when precise layout positioning and design principles are needed.

Examples:
- user: "Create a 10-slide deck for the board meeting" -> use design principles + html2pptx
- user: "Convert this report into a presentation" -> extract text and map to template
- user: "Audit this deck for layout issues" -> generate thumbnail grid for inspection
description_zh:
处理 PowerPoint (.pptx) 的创建、设计和分析。用于制作路演幻灯片、状态更新和视觉叙事。在需要精确布局定位和设计原则时主动使用。

示例：
- 用户："为董事会会议创建一个 10 张幻灯片的演示文稿" -> 使用设计原则 + html2pptx
- 用户："将这份报告转换为演示文稿" -> 提取文本并映射到模板
- 用户："审核这份演示文稿的布局问题" -> 生成缩略图网格进行检查

name: jobs-to-be-done
description: Discover what customers truly need by analyzing the "job" they hire your product to do. Use when the user mentions "customer discovery", "why customers churn", "what job does this solve", "competing against luck", "product-market fit", "switching behavior", "milkshake moment", or "functional vs emotional jobs". Also trigger when investigating why users choose competitors, designing features around real customer needs, or reframing a value proposition. Covers JTBD interviews, competition analysis, and jobs-oriented roadmaps. For product positioning, see obviously-awesome. For rapid validation, see design-sprint. For non-leading interview technique, see mom-test.
description_zh: 通过分析客户雇佣你的产品所需要完成的“任务”，来发现客户真正的需求。当用户提到“客户发现”、“客户流失的原因”、“这个任务解决了什么问题”、“与运气竞争”、“产品-市场契合度”、“转换行为”、“奶昔时刻”或“功能性与情感性任务”时使用。在调查用户为何选择竞争对手、围绕真实客户需求设计功能或重新定义价值主张时也会触发。涵盖基于任务的访谈、竞争分析和以任务为导向的路线图。产品定位请参考obviously-awesome，快速验证请参考design-sprint，非主导性访谈技巧请参考mom-test。

name: asc-crash-triage
description: Triage TestFlight crashes, beta feedback, and performance diagnostics using asc. Use when the user asks about TF crashes, TestFlight crash reports, beta tester feedback, app hangs, disk writes, launch diagnostics, or wants a crash summary for a build or app.
description_zh: 使用asc对TestFlight崩溃、测试者反馈和性能进行诊断。当用户询问有关TF崩溃、TestFlight崩溃报告、测试者反馈、应用程序挂起、磁盘写入、启动诊断，或需要为构建或应用程序生成崩溃摘要时使用。

name: ucp
description: Use when the user wants to use the UCP CLI to find, compare, buy, or track products from online merchants, or to set up and troubleshoot the local UCP profile required for merchant-scoped operations. Covers global catalog search ("find me X under $Y"), named-merchant transactions ("buy this from Z.com"), order tracking, `ucp profile init`, `ucp doctor`, carts, checkout, orders, and UCP setup/help. Falls back to merchant-hosted handoff when direct in-protocol checkout isn't available.
description_zh: 当用户希望使用UCP CLI查找、比较、购买或跟踪来自在线商家的产品，或设置和排错商家范围操作所需的本地UCP配置文件时使用。涵盖全球目录搜索（“在$Y以下为我找到X”）、命名商家交易（“从Z.com购买这个”）、订单跟踪、`ucp profile init`、`ucp doctor`、购物车、结账、订单以及UCP设置/帮助。当直接协议结账不可用时，会回退到商家托管的手续交接。

name: streaming
description: Streaming wire protocols and backend helpers for assistant-ui, built on the assistant-stream package. Use when building a custom streaming endpoint outside the Vercel AI SDK with createAssistantStreamResponse, createAssistantStream, or createAssistantStreamController; choosing between the Data Stream protocol (useDataStreamRuntime, DataStreamEncoder, DataStreamDecoder) and the Assistant Transport protocol (AssistantTransportEncoder, AssistantTransportDecoder); decoding a response with AssistantStream.fromResponse, UIMessageStreamDecoder, or PlainTextDecoder; or wiring resumable streams through assistant-stream/resumable with in-memory, Redis, or ioredis stores. Route here for wire level symptoms: an unexpected part-start or text-delta shape, a tool call that never settles, a part that silently drops, a Content-Type mismatch, or a reload that cannot resume a response. For runtime hooks use runtime; for AI SDK route handlers without a custom protocol use setup; for cloud persistence use cloud.
description_zh: 为 assistant-ui 提供的流式协议和后端辅助工具，基于 assistant-stream 包构建。在 Vercel AI SDK 外部使用 createAssistantStreamResponse、createAssistantStream 或 createAssistantStreamController 构建 自定义流式端点时使用；在数据流协议（useDataStreamRuntime、DataStreamEncoder、DataStreamDecoder）和助手传输协议（AssistantTransportEncoder、AssistantTransportDecoder）之间进行选择；使用 AssistantStream.fromResponse、UIMessageStreamDecoder 或 PlainTextDecoder 解码响应；通过 assistant-stream/resumable 使用内存、Redis 或 ioredis 存储线路可续流的流。出现协议层问题（如意外的部分开始或文本增量形状、从未解决的工具调用、静默丢失的部分、Content-Type 不匹配，或无法续载响应的重载）时，请在此路由。使用 runtime 进行运行时钩子；使用 setup 处理没有自定义协议的 AI SDK 路由处理器；使用 cloud 进行云端持久化。

name: sharp-edges
description: Identifies error-prone APIs, dangerous configurations, and footgun designs that enable security mistakes. Use when reviewing API designs, configuration schemas, cryptographic library ergonomics, or evaluating whether code follows 'secure by default' and 'pit of success' principles. Triggers: footgun, misuse-resistant, secure defaults, API usability, dangerous configuration.
description_zh: 识别易出错的 API、危险配置和导致安全错误的“枪坑”设计。在审查 API 设计、配置模式、加密库易用性，或评估代码是否遵循“默认安全”和“成功陷阱”原则时使用。触发条件：枪坑、抗误用、安全默认值、API 易用性、危险配置。

name: refactor-module
description: Transform monolithic Terraform configurations into reusable, maintainable modules following HashiCorp's module design principles and community best practices.
description_zh: 将单体式 Terraform 配置转换为遵循 HashiCorp 模块设计原则和社区最佳实践的可重用、可维护模块。

name: api-designer
description: Use when designing REST or GraphQL APIs, creating OpenAPI specifications, or planning API architecture. Invoke for resource modeling, versioning strategies, pagination patterns, error handling standards.
description_zh: 在设计REST或GraphQL API、创建OpenAPI规范或规划API架构时使用。用于资源建模、版本策略、分页模式、错误处理标准。

name: automation-flow-generate
description: Generate Salesforce Flows using the MCP tool execute_metadata_action. Use when the user asks to create, build, or generate a flow — including Screen, Autolaunched, Record-Triggered (before/after-save), Scheduled. Also trigger for flow-like requests such as "when a record is created", "trigger daily at", "send an email when", "update the field when", "automate", "workflow", or "flow XML/metadata". This is the only skill for Salesforce Flow generation.
description_zh: 使用MCP工具的execute_metadata_action功能生成Salesforce流程。当用户要求创建、构建或生成流程时使用——包括屏幕流程、自动启动流程、记录触发流程（保存前/保存后）、计划流程。同时，也适用于类似流程的请求，例如“当记录被创建时”、“每日触发”、“发送邮件时”、“更新字段时”、“自动化”、“工作流”或“流程XML/元数据”。这是用于Salesforce流程生成的唯一技能。

name: tmux
description: Control tmux sessions/panes for interactive CLIs: list, capture output, send keys, paste text, monitor prompts.
description_zh: 控制交互式 CLIs 的 tmux 会话/窗格：列出、捕获输出、发送按键、粘贴文本、监控提示。

name: news-aggregator-skill
description: Comprehensive news aggregator that fetches, filters, and deeply analyzes real-time content from 44+ sources including Hacker News, Lobsters, Dev.to, GitHub, arXiv, Hugging Face Papers, AIHOT, TLDR AI, Import AI, BBC, The Guardian, Al Jazeera, France 24, Reuters fallback, AI Newsletters, WallStreetCN, Weibo, 少数派, InfoQ 中文, Podcasts, and user-defined OPML feeds. Use when user requests 'daily scans', 'tech news', 'finance updates', 'AI briefings', 'international news', 'deep analysis', or says '如意如意' to open the interactive menu.

name: block-no-verify-hook
description: Configure a PreToolUse hook to prevent AI agents from skipping git pre-commit hooks with --no-verify and other bypass flags. Use when setting up Claude Code projects that enforce commit quality gates.
description_zh: 配置一个 PreToolUse 钩子，以防止 AI 代理使用 --no-verify 和其他绕过标志跳过 git 预提交钩子。在设置强制执行提交质量门禁的 Claude Code 项目时使用。

name: sql-pro
description: Optimizes SQL queries, designs database schemas, and troubleshoots performance issues. Use when a user asks why their query is slow, needs help writing complex joins or aggregations, mentions database performance issues, or wants to design or migrate a schema. Invoke for complex queries, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, covering index creation, recursive queries, EXPLAIN/ANALYZE interpretation, before/after query benchmarking, or migrating queries between database dialects (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle).
description_zh: 优化 SQL 查询，设计数据库模式，并解决性能问题。当用户询问其查询为何缓慢、需要帮助编写复杂的连接或聚合、提及数据库性能问题，或希望设计或迁移模式时使用。适用于复杂查询、窗口函数、公用表表达式 (CTE)、索引策略、查询计划分析、覆盖索引创建、递归查询、EXPLAIN/ANALYZE 解释、查询前后基准测试，或在不同数据库方言（PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQL Server、Oracle）之间迁移查询。

name: seo-plan
description: Strategic SEO planning for new or existing websites. Industry-specific templates, competitive analysis, content strategy, and implementation roadmap. Use when user says "SEO plan", "SEO strategy", "SEO planning", "content strategy", "keyword strategy", "content calendar", "site architecture", or "SEO roadmap".
description_zh: 针对新网站或现有网站的战略SEO规划。行业特定模板、竞争分析、内容策略和实施路线图。当用户说“SEO计划”、“SEO策略”、“SEO规划”、“内容策略”、“关键词策略”、“内容日历”、“网站架构”或“SEO路线图”时使用。

name: korean-law-search
description: Search Korean statutes, articles, precedents, interpretations, and local ordinances via k-skill-proxy. Use when the user asks for Korean law/article/precedent lookups.
description_zh: 通过k-skill-proxy搜索韩国法规、文章、判例、解释和地方条例。当用户要求查找韩国法律/文章/判例时使用。

name: platform-custom-object-generate
description: Use when users create, generate, or validate Salesforce Custom Object metadata. Trigger on custom objects, .object files, sharing models, name fields, or validation rules — e.g. "create a custom object" — and deployment errors around sharing models and Master-Detail relationships. Also keep the object's <description> current when its fields or validation rules change. Do NOT use for non-Custom-Object metadata (Apex, Flows, LWC, Permission Sets, Custom Metadata Types) or standard objects.
description_zh: 在用户创建、生成或验证 Salesforce 自定义对象元数据时使用。在自定义对象、.object 文件、共享模型、名称字段或验证规则上触发——例如“创建自定义对象”——以及共享模型和主从关系周围的部署错误。同时，在对象的字段或验证规则发生变化时，保持其 <description> 的最新状态。不应用于非自定义对象元数据（Apex、Flows、LWC、权限集、自定义元数据类型）或标准对象。

name: platform-permission-set-generate
description: Generates correct, deployable Salesforce permission set metadata (PermissionSet XML) with object, field, user, and app permissions. Use this skill when creating or editing permission set metadata, object permissions, field-level security (FLS), tab visibility, or deploying permission sets.
description_zh: 生成正确的、可部署的 Salesforce 权限集元数据（权限集 XML），包含对象、字段、用户和应用程序权限。在创建或编辑权限集元数据、对象权限、字段级别安全（FLS）、标签可见性或部署权限集时使用此技能。

name: runpod-templates
description: Runpod's official prebuilt pod templates (ComfyUI, PyTorch, and others): what each image ships, which ports and paths it uses, how to pick one, how to pin a version, and what is missing on first boot. Use when a task says "run <X> on a pod" and an official template already covers it, instead of building an image — and when a user needs help with or wants to fix something about a Runpod template they are already running (won't boot, can't reach the UI, missing models, wrong CUDA line, broken ComfyUI workflow metadata on imported workflows): start here and route onward. Deploy with runpodctl or runpod-mcp; end-to-end walkthroughs live in the runpod router's golden paths.
description_zh: Runpod 官方预制 Pod 模板（ComfyUI、PyTorch 等）：各镜像内置了哪些内容、使用哪些端口和路径、如何选择模板、如何固定版本，以及首次启动时哪些配置缺失。当任务描述为“在 Pod 上运行 <X>”且官方模板已涵盖该场景时，优先使用模板而非自建镜像；当用户需要协助或修复其正在运行的 Runpod 模板相关问题（无法启动、无法访问 UI、缺少模型、CUDA 参数错误、导入的工作流中 ComfyUI 元数据损坏等）时：从此处入手，再按需路由至对应流程。使用 runpodctl 或 runpod-mcp 进行部署；端到端的完整操作指南位于 runpod 路由器的黄金路径中。

name: fine-dust-location
description: 에어코리아 기반 미세먼지/초미세먼지를 지역명 또는 위치 힌트로 조회한다. 기본 경로는 k-skill-proxy의 report endpoint다.
description_zh: 基于Air Korea查询地区名或位置提示的PM2.5/PM10。默认路径是k-skill-proxy的report endpoint。

name: seo-images
description: Image optimization analysis for SEO and performance. Checks alt text, file sizes, formats, responsive images, lazy loading, CLS prevention, image SERP rankings (via DataForSEO), and image file optimization (WebP/AVIF conversion, IPTC/XMP metadata injection). Use when user says "image optimization", "alt text", "image SEO", "image size", "image audit", "optimize images", "image metadata", "image SERP", "convert to webp", or "image file optimize".
description_zh: SEO和性能优化的图片分析。检查替代文本、文件大小、格式、响应式图片、懒加载、CLS预防、图片SERP排名（通过DataForSEO获取）以及图片文件优化（WebP/AVIF转换、IPTC/XMP元数据注入）。当用户说“图片优化”、“替代文本”、“图片SEO”、“图片大小”、“图片审核”、“优化图片”、“图片元数据”、“图片SERP”、“转换为webp”或“图片文件优化”时使用。

name: ljg-think
description: 追本之箭——纵向深钻思维工具。给一个观点、现象或问题，像箭一样一路向下钻到不可再分的本质。Use when user says '想透', '追本', '本质是什么', '为什么会这样', '深挖', '钻到底', 'think deep', 'drill down', or wants to trace any idea/phenomenon vertically to its irreducible root. Also trigger when user provides a statement and wants depth analysis, not breadth survey.
description_zh: 追本溯源——纵向深度挖掘思维工具。针对一个观点、现象或问题，像箭一样一路向下挖掘至不可再分的本质。当用户说“想透”、“追本”、“本质是什么”、“为什么会这样”、“深挖”、“钻到底”、“think deep”、“drill down”，或希望将任何观点/现象垂直追溯至其不可简化的根源时使用。也适用于用户提供陈述并希望进行深度分析而非广度概览的情况。

name: seo-local
description: Audit local SEO, including Google Business Profile, NAP consistency, citations, reviews, local schema, location pages, and multi-location structure.
description_zh: 审计本地SEO，包括Google商家资料、NAP一致性、引用信息、评价、本地结构化数据、位置页面和多地点结构。

name: open-code-review
description: Performs AI-powered code review on Git changes using the `ocr` CLI from alibaba/open-code-review. Use when the user asks to review code, review a pull request, review staged/unstaged changes, review a commit, or compare branches for code quality issues. Produces line-level review comments and can automatically apply fixes when requested. With appropriate review rules, can detect various types of issues including bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance problems, and code quality concerns.
description_zh: 使用 alibaba/open-code-review 的 `ocr` 命令行工具对 Git 变更进行 AI 驱动的代码审查。当用户要求审查代码、审查拉取请求、审查已暂存/未暂存变更、审查提交或比较分支以发现代码质量问题时使用。可生成行级审查评论，并在请求时自动应用修复。通过适当的审查规则，可以检测各种类型的问题，包括错误、安全漏洞、性能问题和代码质量问题。

name: whatsapp-automation
description: WhatsApp Business automation - customer support, notifications, chatbots, and broadcast messaging
description_zh: WhatsApp Business 自动化 - 客户支持、通知、聊天机器人和群发消息

name: coupang-product-search
description: k-skill-proxy의 공식 Coupang Partners API 경로로 쿠팡 상품을 검색하고 로켓배송·가격 후보를 비교한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过k-skill-proxy的官方Coupang Partners API路径搜索Coupang商品，并比较火箭配送和价格候选方案。在돌쇠中，将通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: korean-spell-check
description: Use Nara/PNU Korean spell-check surfaces conservatively to proofread Korean text, chunk long input, and return change-focused correction suggestions.
description_zh: 使用 Nara/PNU 韩语拼写检查表面谨慎地校对韩语文本，分块长输入，并返回以更改为中心的纠正建议。

name: mongodb-query-optimizer
description: Help with MongoDB query optimization and indexing. Use only when the user asks for optimization or performance: "How do I optimize this query?", "How do I index this?", "Why is this query slow?", "Can you fix my slow queries?", "What are the slow queries on my cluster?", etc. Do not invoke for general MongoDB query writing unless user asks for performance or index help. Prefer indexing as optimization strategy. Use MongoDB MCP when available.
description_zh: 提供 MongoDB 查询优化和索引帮助。仅在用户要求优化或性能时使用：例如“如何优化此查询？”、“如何为这创建索引？”、“为什么此查询很慢？”、“你能修复我的慢查询吗？”、“我的集群中哪些查询很慢？”等。除非用户询问性能或索引帮助，否则不要为一般 MongoDB 查询编写调用。优先使用索引作为优化策略。在可用时使用 MongoDB MCP。

name: kbo-results
description: Fetch KBO game schedules and results for a specific date with the kbo-game npm package. Use when the user asks for today's KBO games, yesterday's scores, or a date-specific scoreboard.
description_zh: 使用 kbo-game npm 包获取特定日期的 KBO 比赛日程和结果。当用户询问今日的 KBO 比赛、昨日的比分或特定日期的比分板时使用。

name: microinteractions
description: Design the small details -- triggers, rules, feedback, loops and modes -- that separate good products from great ones. Use when the user mentions "microinteraction", "button feedback", "loading state", "toggle design", "animation detail", "state transitions", "input feedback", "the interface feels dead", "make the UI feel responsive", or "add polish to interactions". Also trigger when designing form-validation responses, progress indicators, confirmation dialogs, or any element where the user expects immediate feedback. Covers trigger design, state rules, feedback mechanisms, and progressive loops. For overall UI polish, see refactoring-ui. For affordance design, see design-everyday-things.
description_zh: 设计那些细微之处——触发器、规则、反馈、循环和模式——这些细节区分了优秀产品与卓越产品。当用户提到“微交互”、“按钮反馈”、“加载状态”、“切换设计”、“动画细节”、“状态转换”、“输入反馈”、“界面感觉死气沉沉”、“让UI更具响应性”或“为交互增添光泽”时使用。此外，在设计表单验证响应、进度指示器、确认对话框或任何用户期望即时反馈的元素时也会触发。涵盖触发器设计、状态规则、反馈机制和渐进式循环。关于整体UI润色，请参考refactoring-ui。关于可供性设计，请参考design-everyday-things。

name: slack-cli
description: Invoke the `slack-cli` binary to read and act on a Slack workspace from the command line — list channels, read/search conversation history and threads, fetch unread messages, search users, manage user groups, post messages, add reactions, mark channels read, and manage saved items. Use whenever a task needs Slack data or actions, such as "what are the unread messages in
description_zh: 调用 `slack-cli` 二进制文件，从命令行读取和操作 Slack 工作区——列出频道、读取/搜索对话历史记录和线程、获取未读消息、搜索用户、管理用户组、发布消息、添加反应、标记频道已读以及管理保存项目。在需要 Slack 数据或操作的任务时使用，例如“哪些是未读消息”。

name: seoul-subway-arrival
description: Look up Seoul real-time subway arrival information with the official Seoul Open Data API. Use when the user asks when a train arrives, which trains are approaching a station, or how crowded Seoul subway timing looks right now.
description_zh: 使用官方首尔开放数据API查询首尔的实时地铁到站信息。当用户询问火车何时到达、哪些火车正在接近车站，或首尔地铁当前拥挤程度时使用。

name: zipcode-search
description: Look up a Korean postcode and official English address from a known address with the official ePost integrated search page.
description_zh: 通过官方集成搜索页面，根据已知地址查找韩国邮政编码和官方英文地址。

name: seo-hreflang
description: Hreflang and international SEO audit, validation, and generation. Detects common mistakes, validates language/region codes, and generates correct hreflang implementations. Use when user says "hreflang", "i18n SEO", "international SEO", "multi-language", "multi-region", or "language tags".
description_zh: hreflang 和国际 SEO 审计、验证和生成。检测常见错误，验证语言/区域代码，并生成正确的 hreflang 实现。当用户说“hreflang”、“i18n SEO”、“国际 SEO”、“多语言”、“多区域”或“语言标签”时使用。

name: dx-code-analyzer-run
description: Run Salesforce Code Analyzer to scan code for security, performance, best practice, and code style violations. Supports all engines (PMD, ESLint, CPD, RetireJS, Flow, SFGE, ApexGuru), targets (files, folders, git diff), categories, and severities. Also handles post-scan exploration: filtering results by engine/severity/category/file, and explaining what rules mean. TRIGGER when: user says 'scan my code', 'check security issues', 'run PMD/ESLint', 'find duplicates', 'analyze Flows', 'check vulnerable libraries', 'AppExchange review', 'lint my LWC', 'static analysis', 'code quality', 'show security violations', 'what is this rule', 'explain ApexCRUDViolation', 'filter results', or mentions engines/file types (.cls, .trigger, .js, .flow-meta.xml). Use this skill for scanning, exploring results, and listing rules. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user asks only about installation/configuration (use dx-code-analyzer-configure), or wants to create a custom rule (use dx-code-analyzer-custom-rule-create).
description_zh: 运行 Salesforce 代码分析器扫描代码中的安全、性能、最佳实践和代码风格违规问题。支持所有引擎（PMD、ESLint、CPD、RetireJS、Flow、SFGE、ApexGuru）、目标（文件、文件夹、git diff）、类别和严重程度。还处理扫描后的探索：通过引擎/严重程度/类别/文件过滤结果，并解释规则含义。触发条件为：当用户说“扫描我的代码”、“检查安全问题”、“运行 PMD/ESLint”、“查找重复”、“分析 Flows”、“检查易受攻击的库”、“AppExchange 审核”、“检查 LWC”、“静态分析”、“代码质量”、“显示安全违规”、“这个规则是什么”、“解释 ApexCRUDViolation”、“过滤结果”，或提及引擎/文件类型（.cls、.trigger、.js、.flow-meta.xml）时。使用此技能进行扫描、探索结果和列出规则。不触发条件为：当用户仅询问安装/配置（使用 dx-code-analyzer-configure）或想要创建自定义规则（使用 dx-code-analyzer-custom-rule-create）时。

name: playwright-skill
description: Complete browser automation with Playwright. Auto-detects dev servers, writes reusable test scripts, and supports screenshots, responsive checks, UX validation, login flows, link checks, and arbitrary browser automation. Use when the user wants to test a website, automate browser interactions, validate web functionality, or perform browser-based testing.
description_zh: 使用 Playwright 完成浏览器自动化。自动检测开发服务器，编写可重用的测试脚本，并支持截图、响应式检查、用户体验验证、登录流程、链接检查和任意浏览器自动化。当用户需要测试网站、自动化浏览器交互、验证网页功能或执行基于浏览器的测试时使用。

name: screenshot
description: Use when the user explicitly asks for a desktop or system screenshot (full screen, specific app or window, or a pixel region), or when tool-specific capture capabilities are unavailable and an OS-level capture is needed.
description_zh: 当用户明确要求截取桌面或系统屏幕截图（全屏、特定应用程序或窗口，或像素区域）时，或者当特定工具的捕获功能不可用且需要操作系统级别的捕获时使用。

name: pptx-generator
description: Generate, edit, and read PowerPoint presentations. Create from scratch with PptxGenJS (cover, TOC, content, section divider, summary slides), edit existing PPTX via XML workflows, or extract text with markitdown. Triggers: PPT, PPTX, PowerPoint, presentation, slide, deck, slides.
description_zh: 生成、编辑和阅读 PowerPoint 演示文稿。使用 PptxGenJS 从头开始创建（封面、目录、内容、章节分隔符、总结幻灯片），通过 XML 工作流编辑现有的 PPTX，或使用 markitdown 提取文本。触发器：PPT、PPTX、PowerPoint、演示文稿、幻灯片、演示文稿、幻灯片。

name: exploring-data-catalog
description: Full inventory and audit of AWS Glue Data Catalog assets across S3 Tables, Redshift-federated, and remote Iceberg catalogs. Triggers on: inventory the catalog, audit databases, list all tables, catalog overview, data landscape, enumerate catalogs, data inventory, search the catalog. Do NOT use for finding specific data (use finding-data-lake-assets), running queries (use querying-data-lake), or creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table).
description_zh: 对 S3 表格、Redshift 集成和远程 Iceberg 目录中的 AWS Glue 数据目录资产进行全面盘点和审计。触发条件包括：目录盘点、数据库审计、列出所有表格、目录概览、数据景观、枚举目录、数据盘点、目录搜索。请勿用于查找特定数据（使用 finding-data-lake-assets）、运行查询（使用 querying-data-lake）或创建表格（使用 creating-data-lake-table）。

name: querying-data-lake
description: Execute and manage Athena SQL queries across default and federated catalogs (Glue, S3 Tables, Redshift). Triggers on phrases like: query data, run SQL, athena query, analyze table, SQL query, workgroup status, profile table, query Redshift catalog, query S3 Tables. Do NOT use for finding specific data assets (use finding-data-lake-assets), full catalog audits (use exploring-data-catalog), importing data (use ingesting-into-data-lake).
description_zh: 执行和管理在默认和联邦目录（Glue、S3 表、Redshift）中的 Athena SQL 查询。触发短语包括：查询数据、运行 SQL、Athena 查询、分析表、SQL 查询、工作组状态、分析表、查询 Redshift 目录、查询 S3 表。不应用于查找特定数据资产（请使用 finding-data-lake-assets）、完整目录审计（请使用 exploring-data-catalog）、数据导入（请使用 ingesting-into-data-lake）。

name: asc-aso-audit
description: Run an offline ASO audit on canonical App Store metadata under `./metadata` and surface keyword gaps using Astro MCP. Use after pulling metadata with `asc metadata pull`.
description_zh: 在 `./metadata` 下对 App Store 规范元数据运行离线 ASO 审计，并使用 Astro MCP 揭示关键词差距。在用 `asc metadata pull` 拉取元数据后使用。

name: creating-secrets-using-best-practices
description: Creates and manages secrets in AWS Secrets Manager following security best practices. Always use this skill when creating secrets — it sets up dedicated KMS encryption keys, automatic rotation, least-privilege IAM policies, CloudTrail auditing, and lifecycle management that are essential for production-grade secret handling.
description_zh: 在 AWS Secrets Manager 中遵循安全最佳实践创建和管理密钥。在创建密钥时始终使用此技能——它设置了专用的 KMS 加密密钥、自动轮换、最小权限 IAM 策略、CloudTrail 审计和生命周期管理，这些都是生产级密钥处理所必需的。

name: real-estate-search
description: Korean apartment/officetel/villa/single-house real transaction price and rent lookups via k-skill-proxy. Based on tae0y's real-estate-mcp and MOLIT public data APIs.
description_zh: 通过k-skill-proxy查询韩国公寓/办公套间/别墅/独栋房屋的实时交易价格和租金信息。基于tae0y的房地产MCP和MOLIT公共数据API。

name: neon-auth
description: Add authentication to a new app. Use for "add auth", "add login", Neon Auth (Managed Better Auth), identity routing, sign-up, sign-in, password reset, email OTP, magic links, organizations, phone OTP, OAuth, passkeys, MFA, trusted domains, invalid domain, and @neondatabase/auth. No existing identity: default to Managed Better Auth. Keep working Better Auth, Clerk, Supabase Auth, or another IdP. User asked to migrate from Supabase Auth: Managed Better Auth. A required plugin outside Managed support: self-managed Better Auth on a Neon Function or the existing app host. Also use for auth APIs in @neondatabase/neon-js.
description_zh: 为新的应用程序添加身份验证。用于“添加认证”、“添加登录”、Neon Auth（更好的认证管理）、身份路由、注册、登录、密码重置、电子邮件 OTP、魔法链接、组织、电话 OTP、OAuth、密钥、MFA、受信任的域名、无效域名，以及 @neondatabase/auth。若不存在现有身份验证：默认使用更好的认证管理。保留 Better Auth、Clerk、Supabase Auth 或其他身份提供者的现有功能。用户要求从 Supabase Auth 迁移：使用更好的认证管理。Managed 支持范围之外的必要插件：在 Neon Function 或现有应用程序主机上部署自管理的 Better Auth。也用于 @neondatabase/neon-js 中的认证 API。

name: lotto-results
description: Check Korean Lotto draw results, latest rounds, and ticket matches with the k-lotto npm package. Use when the user asks for winning numbers, payout details, or whether their numbers matched.
description_zh: 使用k-lotto npm包检查韩国乐透开奖结果、最新轮次以及彩票匹配情况。当用户询问中奖号码、奖金详情或其号码是否匹配时使用。

name: dagster-expert
description: Use for any task involving Dagster, the dg CLI, assets, materialization, components, data tools or data pipelines, matching the situations the Dagster skill handles. This is the deprecated dagster-expert plugin. It carries no Dagster guidance and exists only to tell the user to move to the dagster plugin.
description_zh: 用于涉及Dagster、dg CLI、资产、材料化、组件、数据工具或数据管道的任何任务，与Dagster技能处理的场景相匹配。这是已弃用的dagster-expert插件。它不提供任何Dagster指导，仅存在告知用户迁移到dagster插件的用途。

name: grill-with-docs
description: 一个用来打磨计划或设计的持续追问式访谈，并在过程中创建文档（ADRs 和词汇表）。
description_zh: 一种用于持续追问式访谈来打磨计划或设计，并在过程中创建文档（ADRs 和词汇表）。

name: tools
description: Defines model-callable tools and renders their calls in assistant-ui. The authoring model: a "use generative" file whose default export is defineToolkit({...}), compiled by withAui from @assistant-ui/next, aui() from @assistant-ui/vite, or withAui from @assistant-ui/metro, mounted with AuiConfig({ tools: Tools({ toolkit }) }), and exposed to the model with new AISDKToolkit({ toolkit }).tools({ frontend }). Covers the tool kinds (backend, "use client" frontend, humanTool(), providerTool(), externalTool(), stubTool(), defineMcpToolkit()), render and display, ToolCallMessagePartProps, approval gates, MCP servers, MCP Apps, WebMCP, and sub-agent messages. Reach for it when a tool is never called, a tool UI does not render, a frontend result never reaches the model, humanTool() throws at runtime, or an approval gate cannot be answered. For model-composed UI use generative-ui, for MCP servers users add in the browser use react-mcp, and for the styled ToolFallback and ToolGroup use elements.
description_zh: 定义模型可调用的工具，并在 assistant-ui 中渲染它们的调用。创作模型：一个“使用生成式”文件，其默认导出为 defineToolkit({...})，由 @assistant-ui/next 的 withAui、@assistant-ui/vite 的 aui() 或 @assistant-ui/metro 的 withAui 编译，通过 AuiConfig({ tools: Tools({ toolkit }) })挂载，并通过 new AISDKToolkit({ toolkit }).tools({ frontend })向模型暴露。涵盖工具类型（backend、"使用客户端"前端、humanTool()、providerTool()、外部工具()、stubTool()、defineMcpToolkit()）、渲染与显示、ToolCallMessagePartProps、审批门禁、MCP 服务器、MCP 应用、WebMCP 和子代理消息。当工具从未被调用、工具 UI 无法渲染、前端结果从未到达模型、humanTool() 在运行时抛出异常，或审批门禁无法被回答时，请使用。对于模型组合的 UI 使用 generative-ui，MCP 服务器用户在浏览器中添加使用 react-mcp，对于样式的 ToolFallback 和 ToolGroup 使用元素。

name: storing-and-querying-vectors
description: Store and query vector embeddings using Amazon S3 Vectors, a cost-effective long-term vector storage service with its own API namespace (s3vectors). Triggers on: create S3 vector bucket, vector index, store embeddings, semantic search, RAG vector storage, similarity search, vector database, migrate from other vector databases. Do NOT use for: querying tabular data (use querying-data-lake), S3 object storage, or hundreds/thousands of sustained QPS (use OpenSearch).
description_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 Vectors 存储和查询向量嵌入，这是一项具有自身 API 命名空间（s3vectors）的经济高效的长期向量存储服务。触发条件：创建 S3 向量存储桶、向量索引、存储嵌入、语义搜索、RAG 向量存储、相似性搜索、向量数据库、从其他向量数据库迁移。禁止使用场景：查询表格数据（使用 querying-data-lake）、S3 对象存储，或数百/数千个持续 QPS（使用 OpenSearch）。

name: firecrawl-developer-index
description: Search an index of public repositories, GitHub issues, merged pull requests, repository READMEs, and curated documentation sites. Use when a programming question needs external documentation or upstream evidence.
description_zh: 搜索公共仓库索引、GitHub问题、已合并的拉取请求、仓库README文件以及精选的文档网站。当编程问题需要外部文档或上游证据时使用。

name: primitives
description: Builds and customizes assistant-ui chat UI from composable, unstyled @assistant-ui/react primitives: ThreadPrimitive, ComposerPrimitive (with Unstable_TriggerPopover for mentions and slash commands), MessagePrimitive and MessagePartPrimitive, ActionBarPrimitive, BranchPickerPrimitive, AttachmentPrimitive, ErrorPrimitive, AssistantModalPrimitive, ChainOfThoughtPrimitive, SelectionToolbarPrimitive, SuggestionPrimitive, QueueItemPrimitive, and the ThreadList primitives. Use when assembling or styling a custom Thread, Composer, message list, action bar, branch picker, or suggestion grid; wiring composer input, dictation, quoting, or attachments; or handling editing, branching, virtualization, scrolling, or chain of thought UI. Covers MessagePrimitive.Parts render functions per part type, groupPartByType, AuiIf in selector form, and the unstyled gotchas (AssistantRuntimeProvider, className). For prebuilt UI use setup, for the styled catalog use elements, for multi-thread sidebars use thread-list.
description_zh: 构建和定制 assistant-ui 聊天界面 UI，基于可组合、无样式的 @assistant-ui/react 基础组件：ThreadPrimitive、ComposerPrimitive（包含 Unstable_TriggerPopover 用于提及和斜杠命令）、MessagePrimitive 和 MessagePartPrimitive、ActionBarPrimitive、BranchPickerPrimitive、AttachmentPrimitive、ErrorPrimitive、AssistantModalPrimitive、ChainOfThoughtPrimitive、SelectionToolbarPrimitive、SuggestionPrimitive、QueueItemPrimitive，以及 ThreadList 基础组件。在组装或样式化自定义 Thread、Composer、消息列表、操作栏、分支选择器或建议网格时使用；连接 Composer 输入、语音输入、引用或附件；处理编辑、分支、虚拟化、滚动或思维链 UI。涵盖 MessagePrimitive.Parts 按部分类型渲染函数、groupPartByType、selector 形式的 AuiIf，以及无样式注意事项（AssistantRuntimeProvider、className）。预构建 UI 使用 setup，样式目录使用 elements，多线程侧边栏使用 thread-list。

name: winmd-api-search
description: Find and explore Windows desktop APIs. Use when building features that need platform capabilities — camera, file access, notifications, UI controls, AI/ML, sensors, networking, etc. Discovers the right API for a task and retrieves full type details (methods, properties, events, enumeration values).
description_zh: 查找并探索 Windows 桌面 API。在构建需要平台功能（如相机、文件访问、通知、UI 控件、人工智能/机器学习、传感器、网络等）的功能时使用。发现适合任务的正确 API，并检索完整的类型详细信息（方法、属性、事件、枚举值）。

name: google-analytics-data-api-basics
description: Manages Google Analytics reporting data, enables the Analytics Data API via the Cloud CLI, and creates reports using the Google Analytics Data API (v1beta). Use when you need to interact with Google Analytics properties, run customized analytics reports, query metrics (like activeUsers, screenPageViews) and dimensions (like city, date), check metrics and dimensions compatibility, or verify API enablement. Don't use for Google Analytics Admin API operations (e.g., creating properties, managing users) or for front-end tracking installation.
description_zh: 管理 Google Analytics 报告数据，通过 Cloud CLI 启用 Analytics Data API，并使用 Google Analytics Data API (v1beta) 创建报告。当您需要与 Google Analytics 属性交互、运行定制化分析报告、查询指标（如 activeUsers、screenPageViews）和维度（如 city、date）、检查指标和维度的兼容性，或验证 API 启用时使用。不应用于 Google Analytics Admin API 操作（例如创建属性、管理用户）或用于前端跟踪安装。

name: vercel-cli
description: Deploy, manage, inspect, and troubleshoot Vercel projects from the command line. Use for Vercel deployments, Vercel Toolbar comments, build failures, projects and teams, environment variables, domains and DNS, logs, metrics, Speed Insights, Core Web Vitals, request traces, usage, activity, alerts, firewall rules, cache, cron jobs, deploy hooks, Edge Config, feature flags (`vercel flags`), integrations, connectors, Blob storage, Container Registry (VCR), microfrontends, rolling releases, custom environments, Sandbox, agent/MCP setup, preview access, local development, or `vercel api` fallback.
description_zh: 从命令行部署、管理、检查和排错 Vercel 项目。用于 Vercel 部署、Vercel 工具栏评论、构建失败、项目与团队、环境变量、域名与 DNS、日志、指标、Speed Insights、核心网络指标、请求追踪、使用情况、活动、警报、防火墙规则、缓存、计划任务、部署钩子、边缘配置、功能标志 (`vercel flags`)、集成、连接器、Blob 存储、容器注册中心 (VCR)、微前端、滚动发布、自定义环境、沙盒、代理/MCP 设置、预览访问、本地开发或 `vercel api` 备用。

name: xlsx-manipulation
description: Create, edit, and manipulate Excel spreadsheets programmatically using openpyxl
description_zh: 使用 openpyxl 以编程方式创建、编辑和操作 Excel 电子表格

name: kakao-bar-nearby
description: Use when the user asks for nearby bars or 근처 술집. Ask for the user's location, search with the official Kakao Local API, then follow returned Kakao Map detail links for open-now, menu, and seating hints. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当用户询问附近酒吧或“근처 술집”时使用。请求用户的地理位置，使用官方Kakao Local API进行搜索，然后根据返回的Kakao地图详细链接获取营业中、菜单和座位信息。在Dolce中，将通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: improve-ui
description: Audit an existing product surface against its own design evidence, identify verified UI problems, and write self-contained implementation plans for another agent. Strictly read-only on product source. Use when asked to review, refine, improve, or clean up an interface without replacing its identity; investigate design-system drift; or prepare a design handoff.
description_zh: 对现有产品界面进行审计，对照其设计证据，识别已验证的UI问题，并为另一个代理编写独立的实施计划。产品源代码仅严格只读。在需要评审、优化、改进或清理界面而不改变其身份；调查设计系统漂移；或准备设计交接时使用。

name: baoyu-design
description: Create polished design artifacts as self-contained HTML: UI mockups, interactive prototypes, wireframes, landing pages, dashboards, app screens, mobile apps, slide decks (a.k.a. PPT / PowerPoint presentations), documents and résumés, animations, 3D objects, research reports, HTML email, diagrams, fliers, and visual explorations. Use whenever the user asks to design, mock up, prototype, wireframe, visualize, explore, or make a PPT/deck for an interface, product screen, user flow, content layout, visual artifact, or pitch/deck concept, even if they do not say "design". Also use to export a deck built with this skill to PowerPoint (PPT/PPTX) — but only decks authored here (deck-stage / this skill's slide-structured HTML), NOT arbitrary HTML, so confirm the target is such a deck first. Also use for setting up, importing, or authoring reusable design systems, UI kits, brand tokens, or component libraries. Harness-agnostic for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex Agent, and similar file-capable agents.
description_zh: 创建作为独立HTML的自带设计成果：UI原型图、交互原型、线框图、着陆页、仪表盘、应用界面、移动应用、幻灯片（又名PPT/PowerPoint演示文稿）、文档和简历、动画、3D对象、研究报告、HTML邮件、图表、传单和视觉探索。当用户要求设计、原型设计、线框图、可视化、探索，或为界面、产品屏幕、用户流程、内容布局、视觉成果或提案/演示概念制作PPT/演示文稿时，即使他们没有说“设计”，也使用此技能。此外，用于将使用此技能构建的演示文稿导出为PowerPoint（PPT/PPTX）——但仅限于在此处创建的演示文稿（演示文稿级/此技能的幻灯片结构HTML），而不是任意HTML，因此请先确认目标是此类演示文稿。还用于设置、导入或编写可复用的设计系统、UI套件、品牌标记或组件库。适用于Claude Code、Cursor、Codex Agent和类似文件功能的代理。

name: build-mcp-app
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to build an "MCP app", add "interactive UI" or "widgets" to an MCP server, "render components in chat", build "MCP UI resources", make a tool that shows a "form", "picker", "dashboard" or "confirmation dialog" inline in the conversation, or mentions "apps SDK" in the context of MCP. Use AFTER the build-mcp-server skill has settled the deployment model, or when the user already knows they want UI widgets.
description_zh: 当用户想要构建“MCP应用”、向“MCP服务器”添加“交互式UI”或“小部件”、在“聊天中渲染组件”、构建“MCP UI资源”、制作一个在对话中内联显示“表单”、“选择器”、“仪表板”或“确认对话框”的工具，或在MCP上下文中提及“应用SDK”时，应使用此技能。该技能应在“构建MCP服务器”技能确定部署模型之后使用，或者当用户已经知道他们需要UI小部件时使用。

name: seo-programmatic
description: Programmatic SEO planning and analysis for pages generated at scale from data sources. Covers template engines, URL patterns, internal linking automation, thin content safeguards, and index bloat prevention. Use when user says "programmatic SEO", "pages at scale", "dynamic pages", "template pages", "generated pages", or "data-driven SEO".
description_zh: 针对从数据源大规模生成的页面进行程序化SEO规划与分析。涵盖模板引擎、URL模式、内部链接自动化、薄内容防护以及索引膨胀预防。当用户说“程序化SEO”、“大规模页面”、“动态页面”、“模板页面”、“生成页面”或“数据驱动SEO”时使用。

name: workload-manager-basics
description: Use this skill to manage Google Cloud Workload Manager evaluations, rules, scanned resources, and validation results by using public client libraries and the REST API. Use when you need to inspect workload best-practice rules, create and run evaluations for Google Cloud general best practices, SAP, SQL Server, or custom organizational rules, review violations, export results to BigQuery, or automate Workload Manager through client libraries because no service-specific public CLI or MCP server is available. Don't use for general Google Compute Engine instance management, VPC configuration, or standard IAM auditing.
description_zh: 使用此技能通过公共客户端库和 REST API 管理Google Cloud Workload Manager的评估、规则、扫描资源和验证结果。当您需要检查工作负载最佳实践规则、为Google Cloud通用最佳实践、SAP、SQL Server或自定义组织规则创建和运行评估、审查违规行为、将结果导出到BigQuery，或通过客户端库自动化Workload Manager时使用，因为不存在特定于服务的公共CLI或MCP服务器。不应用于通用Google Compute Engine实例管理、VPC配置或标准IAM审计。

name: dashboarding
description: Build, modify, and ship Grafana dashboards as JSON via the HTTP API — panel types (timeseries / stat / gauge / table / heatmap / logs / traces / node-graph), `gridPos` 24-column layout, units, thresholds, template + datasource + chained variables, transformations (`organize` / `calculateField` / `filterByValue`), panel + dashboard links with `${__field.labels.x}` / `${__from}`, and Loki/Prometheus annotations. Use when scripting dashboard creation, writing the dashboard JSON for a new service, adding a `$job` dropdown variable, computing an "Error %" column with a transformation, overlaying deploys as annotations, or pushing a dashboard via `POST /api/dashboards/db` — even when the user says "create a dashboard for this metric", "add a service dropdown", "show errors as percentage", "overlay our deploys", or "export the dashboard JSON" without naming the API or schema. After every API push, verify with the returned `version` plus a GET on the dashboard UID.
description_zh: 通过 HTTP API 以 JSON 格式构建、修改和发布 Grafana 仪表板——支持各种面板类型（时序图 / 统计图 / 指针图 / 表格 / 热力图 / 日志 / 跟踪 / 节点图）、`gridPos` 24 列布局、单位、阈值、模板 + 数据源 + 链式变量、转换（`organize` / `calculateField` / `filterByValue`）、面板 + 仪表板链接（使用 `${__field.labels.x}` / `${__from}`）以及 Loki/Prometheus 注释。适用于以下场景：脚本化仪表板创建、为新增服务编写仪表板 JSON、添加 `$job` 下拉变量、通过转换计算 "错误 %" 列、将部署信息作为注释叠加、或通过 `POST /api/dashboards/db` 推送仪表板——即使用户说 "为这个指标创建仪表板"、"添加服务下拉"、"将错误显示为百分比"、"叠加我们的部署" 或 "导出仪表板 JSON" 而未提及 API 或架构。每次 API 推送后，请通过返回的 `version` 并对仪表板 UID 进行 GET 请求进行验证。

name: winui3-migration-guide
description: UWP-to-WinUI 3 migration reference. Maps legacy UWP APIs to correct Windows App SDK equivalents with before/after code snippets. Covers namespace changes, threading (CoreDispatcher to DispatcherQueue), windowing (CoreWindow to AppWindow), dialogs, pickers, sharing, printing, background tasks, and the most common Copilot code generation mistakes.
description_zh: UWP迁移至WinUI 3参考指南。将传统UWP API映射到Windows App SDK的正确等效API，并提供前后代码片段。涵盖命名空间变更、线程（CoreDispatcher到DispatcherQueue）、窗口（CoreWindow到AppWindow）、对话框、选择器、共享、打印、后台任务，以及最常见的Copilot代码生成错误。

name: experience-lwc-generate
description: Lightning Web Components with PICKLES methodology and 165-point scoring. Use this skill when the user creates or edits LWC components, builds wire service patterns, or writes Jest tests for LWC. TRIGGER when: user creates/edits LWC components, touches lwc/**/*.js, .html, .css, .js-meta.xml files, or asks about wire service, SLDS, or Jest LWC tests. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Apex classes (use platform-apex-generate), Aura components, or Visualforce.
description_zh: 使用PICKLES方法论和165分评分标准的Lightning Web Components。当用户创建或编辑LWC组件、构建线服务模式或为LWC编写Jest测试时，使用此技能。触发条件：用户创建/编辑LWC组件、触碰lwc/**/*.js、.html、.css、.js-meta.xml文件，或询问线服务、SLDS或Jest LWC测试。不触发条件：Apex类（使用platform-apex-generate）、Aura组件或Visualforce。

name: platform-metadata-api-context-get
description: REQUIRED companion for Salesforce metadata generation — load this schema/API-context skill in the SAME turn as ANY metadata generator (if you load a generator, you ALSO load this). Use whenever you create, generate, edit, or author metadata or a *-meta.xml file (custom object, field, flow, and 604 Metadata API types): it gives authoritative schema, required flags, and XML structure so files deploy cleanly. Trigger on *-meta.xml, metadata schema, api context. DO NOT use for SOQL, DML, runtime sObject access, or Tooling API records.
description_zh: 必需的 Salesforce 元数据生成辅助工具——在与任何元数据生成器（加载生成器时，您也必须加载此工具）在相同回合中加载此模式/API上下文技能。在创建、生成、编辑或编写 *-meta.xml 文件（自定义对象、字段、流程和 604 种元数据 API 类型）时使用：它提供权威模式、必需标志和 XML 结构，确保文件顺利部署。触发于 *-meta.xml、元数据模式、API 上下文。不应用于 SOQL、DML、运行时 sObject 访问或 Tooling API 记录。

name: mcp
description: MCP Apps integration for json-render. Use when building MCP servers that render interactive UIs in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or VS Code, or when integrating json-render with the Model Context Protocol.
description_zh: json-render 的 MCP 应用集成。在构建在 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 或 VS Code 中渲染交互式 UI 的 MCP 服务器时使用，或在将 json-render 与模型上下文协议集成时使用。

name: ingesting-into-data-lake
description: Import data into the AWS data lake from S3 files, local uploads, JDBC databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, RDS, Aurora), Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, DynamoDB, or existing Glue catalog tables (migration). Default target is S3 Tables; standard Iceberg on a general purpose bucket is supported where S3 Tables is not adopted. Handles one-time loads, recurring pipelines, migrations. Triggers on: import data, load data, ingest, sync database, migrate table, move data to AWS, set up pipeline, ETL, pull from Snowflake, query BigQuery into S3, export DynamoDB, CTAS, convert to Iceberg. Do NOT use for setting up or troubleshooting Glue connections (use connecting-to-data-source), creating empty tables (use creating-data-lake-table), running queries (use querying-data-lake), finding tables by fuzzy name (use finding-data-lake-assets), catalog audit (use exploring-data-catalog), or SaaS platforms like Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, MongoDB, Kafka.
description_zh: 将数据从 S3 文件、本地上传、JDBC 数据库（Oracle、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、RDS、Aurora）、Amazon Redshift、Snowflake、BigQuery、DynamoDB 或现有的 Glue 目录表（迁移）导入 AWS 数据湖。默认目标为 S3 表；在不采用 S3 表的情况下，支持在通用存储桶上使用标准 Iceberg。支持一次性加载、周期性管道和迁移。触发条件包括：导入数据、加载数据、摄取、同步数据库、迁移表、将数据移动到 AWS、设置管道、ETL、从 Snowflake 拉取、将 BigQuery 查询结果导入 S3、导出 DynamoDB、CTAS、转换为 Iceberg。**请勿**用于设置或排查 Glue 连接（请使用 connecting-to-data-source）、创建空表（请使用 creating-data-lake-table）、运行查询（请使用 querying-data-lake）、按模糊名称查找表（请使用 finding-data-lake-assets）、目录审计（请使用 exploring-data-catalog）或 Salesforce、ServiceNow、SAP、MongoDB、Kafka 等云服务。

name: asc-revenuecat-catalog-sync
description: Reconcile App Store Connect subscriptions and in-app purchases with RevenueCat products, entitlements, offerings, and packages using asc and RevenueCat MCP. Use when setting up or syncing subscription catalogs across ASC and RevenueCat.
description_zh: 使用 asc 和 RevenueCat MCP 将 App Store Connect 订阅和内购与 RevenueCat 产品、权限、产品线和套餐进行对账。在跨 App Store Connect 和 RevenueCat 设置或同步订阅目录时使用。

name: connecting-lambda-to-api-gateway
description: Connects an existing AWS Lambda function to Amazon API Gateway by creating a REST or HTTP API with resource/method setup, Lambda proxy integration, permissions, and deployment. Always use this skill when connecting Lambda to API Gateway — it handles CORS, throttling, access logging, and production security hardening that are easy to miss.
description_zh: 通过创建具有资源/方法设置、Lambda 代理集成、权限和部署的 REST 或 HTTP API，将现有的 AWS Lambda 函数连接到 Amazon API Gateway。在将 Lambda 连接到 API Gateway 时，始终使用此技能——它处理容易遗漏的 CORS、限流、访问日志记录和生产安全加固。

name: rust-engineer
description: Writes, reviews, and debugs idiomatic Rust code with memory safety and zero-cost abstractions. Implements ownership patterns, manages lifetimes, designs trait hierarchies, builds async applications with tokio, and structures error handling with Result/Option. Use when building Rust applications, solving ownership or borrowing issues, designing trait-based APIs, implementing async/await concurrency, creating FFI bindings, or optimizing for performance and memory safety. Invoke for Rust, Cargo, ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, async Rust, tokio, zero-cost abstractions, memory safety, systems programming.
description_zh: 编写、审查和调试具有内存安全性和零成本抽象的 Rust 代码。实现所有权模式、管理生命周期、设计特征层次结构、使用 tokio 构建 async 应用程序，并使用 Result/Option 结构化错误处理。适用于构建 Rust 应用程序、解决所有权或借用问题、设计基于特征的 API、实现 async/await 并发、创建 FFI 绑定，或优化性能和内存安全性。适用于 Rust、Cargo、所有权、借用、生命周期、async Rust、tokio、零成本抽象、内存安全性、系统编程。

name: creating-data-lake-table
description: Create managed Iceberg tables using Amazon S3 Tables (s3tables API namespace) with automatic compaction and snapshot management. Sets up table bucket, namespace, table, schema, Glue catalog registration, partitioning, IAM access control. Triggers on: create table, data lake table, analytics table, structured data storage, S3 Tables, Iceberg, Athena table, partitioning strategy, access permissions. Do NOT use  for: importing files (use ingesting-into-data-lake), vector storage (use storing-and-querying-vectors), querying existing tables (use querying-data-lake), or locating existing table (use finding-data-lake-assets).
description_zh: 使用 Amazon S3 Tables（s3tables API 命名空间）创建受管理的 Iceberg 表格，支持自动压缩和快照管理。配置表格存储桶、命名空间、表格、模式、Glue 目录注册、分区、IAM 访问控制。触发条件：创建表格、数据湖表格、分析表格、结构化数据存储、S3 Tables、Iceberg、Athena 表格、分区策略、访问权限。**禁止**用于：导入文件（请使用 ingesting-into-data-lake）、向量存储（请使用 storing-and-querying-vectors）、查询现有表格（请使用 querying-data-lake）或定位现有表格（请使用 finding-data-lake-assets）。

name: runtime
description: Guide to the assistant-ui runtime system, the state and action layer behind every chat surface. Use when creating a runtime (useLocalRuntime with a ChatModelAdapter, useExternalStoreRuntime for Redux or Zustand backed stores, useRemoteThreadListRuntime, useCloudThreadListRuntime, useAssistantTransportRuntime), wiring AssistantRuntimeProvider, or reading and mutating thread, message, composer, and attachment state. Covers useAui, useAuiState, and useAuiEvent with the stable selector rule, the scope accessors (aui.thread, aui.message, aui.composer, and siblings), the AuiConfig plus AuiProvider grammar, RuntimeCapabilities, and the attachment, speech, dictation, feedback, suggestion, and history adapters. Route here for a provider error ('Cannot read property of undefined'), a removed v0.12 hook import, an infinite re-render from an object literal selector, or state not updating. For multi-thread list UI use thread-list instead; for toolkit definitions and tool call UI use tools instead.
description_zh: 助手界面运行系统指南，即每个聊天界面的状态和动作层。在创建运行时（使用LocalRuntime配合ChatModelAdapter，使用Redux或Zustand支持的store使用useExternalStoreRuntime，使用useRemoteThreadListRuntime、useCloudThreadListRuntime、useAssistantTransportRuntime）、连接AssistantRuntimeProvider，或读取和修改线程、消息、composer和附件状态时使用。涵盖useAui、useAuiState和useAuiEvent，以及稳定的selector规则、作用域访问器（aui.thread、aui.message、aui.composer及其兄弟），AuiConfig与AuiProvider语法、RuntimeCapabilities，以及附件、语音、听写、反馈、建议和历史适配器。当遇到提供者错误（'Cannot read property of undefined'）、移除的v0.12钩子导入、对象字面量selector导致的无限重渲染，或状态未更新时，请在此处查找。多线程列表UI请使用thread-list；工具箱定义和工具调用UI请使用tools。

name: aws-amplify
description: Build and deploy full-stack web and mobile apps with AWS Amplify Gen2 (TypeScript code-first). Covers auth (Cognito), data (AppSync/DynamoDB), storage (S3), functions, APIs, and AI (Amplify AI Kit with Bedrock). Supports React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, React Native, Flutter, Swift, and Android. Always use this skill for Amplify Gen2 topics — even for questions you think you know — it contains validated, version-specific patterns that prevent common mistakes. TRIGGER when: user mentions Amplify Gen2; project has amplify/ directory or amplify_outputs; code imports @aws-amplify packages; user asks about defineBackend, defineAuth, defineData, defineStorage, defineFunction, or npx ampx. SKIP: Amplify Gen1 (amplify CLI v6), standalone SAM/CDK without Amplify (use aws-serverless), direct Bedrock without Amplify AI Kit (use bedrock).
description_zh:
使用 AWS Amplify Gen2（TypeScript 代码优先）构建和部署全栈 Web 和移动应用。涵盖认证（Cognito）、数据（AppSync/DynamoDB）、存储（S3）、函数、API 和 AI（使用 Amplify AI Kit 和 Bedrock）。支持 React、Next.js、Vue、Angular、React Native、Flutter、Swift 和 Android。始终使用此技能处理 Amplify Gen2 相关话题——即使你认为已经了解——它包含经过验证的、版本特定的模式，可防止常见错误。  
触发条件：  
- 用户提及 Amplify Gen2；  
- 项目包含 amplify/ 目录或 amplify_outputs；  
- 代码导入 @aws-amplify 包；  
- 用户询问 defineBackend、defineAuth、defineData、defineStorage、defineFunction 或 npx ampx。  

排除项：  
- Amplify Gen1（amplify CLI v6）；  
- 独立的 SAM/CDK（未使用 Amplify，可改用 aws-serverless）；  
- 直接使用 Bedrock（未使用 Amplify AI Kit，可改用 bedrock）。

name: platform-validation-rule-generate
description: Use this skill when users need to create, modify, or validate Salesforce Validation Rules. Trigger when users mention validation rules, field validation, data quality rules, formula validation, error messages, or validation logic. Also use when users encounter validation errors, need to update formulas, or want to enforce business rules at the data layer. Always use this skill for any validation rule work.
description_zh: 当用户需要创建、修改或验证 Salesforce 验证规则时，使用此技能。当用户提及验证规则、字段验证、数据质量规则、公式验证、错误消息或验证逻辑时触发。此外，当用户遇到验证错误、需要更新公式或希望在数据层强制执行业务规则时，也使用此技能。对于任何验证规则工作，始终使用此技能。

name: clean-code
description: Write readable, maintainable code through disciplined naming, small functions, and clean error handling. Use when the user mentions "clean up this code", "this function is too long", "code smells", "naming conventions", "boy scout rule", "single responsibility", or "unit test quality". Also trigger when reviewing a pull request for readability, untangling a messy function, debating comment styles, or improving error-handling patterns. Covers SRP, comment discipline, formatting, and unit testing. For refactoring techniques, see refactoring-patterns. For architecture and dependency rules, see clean-architecture.
description_zh: 通过规范的命名、小函数和清晰的错误处理来编写可读、可维护的代码。当用户提到“清理这段代码”、“这个函数太长”、“代码异味”、“命名规范”、“童子军规则”、“单一职责”或“单元测试质量”时使用。在审查拉取请求以提高可读性、梳理混乱的函数、讨论注释风格或改进错误处理模式时也会触发。涵盖SRP、注释规范、格式化和单元测试。关于重构技术，请参阅refactoring-patterns。关于架构和依赖规则，请参阅clean-architecture。

name: finding-data-lake-assets
description: Resolve data lake and lakehouse asset references across Glue Data Catalog, S3, S3 Tables, and Redshift. Triggers on: find the table, where is our data, which table has, locate dataset, find data for, search catalog, what tables match, Redshift table, lakehouse table, data lake table, warehouse table, reverse lookup S3 path. Do NOT use for: full catalog audits (use exploring-data-catalog), running queries (use querying-data-lake), creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table).
description_zh: 跨 Glue Data Catalog、S3、S3 Tables 和 Redshift 解决数据湖和湖屋资产引用。触发条件：查找包含我们数据的表、哪个表包含、定位数据集、查找数据、搜索目录、匹配哪些表、Redshift 表、湖屋表、数据湖表、仓库表、反向查找 S3 路径。不适用于：完整目录审计（使用 exploring-data-catalog）、运行查询（使用 querying-data-lake）、创建表（使用 creating-data-lake-table）。

name: mongodb-schema-design
description: MongoDB schema design patterns and anti-patterns. Use when designing data models, reviewing schemas, migrating from SQL, or troubleshooting performance issues caused by schema problems. Triggers on "design schema", "embed vs reference", "MongoDB data model", "schema review", "unbounded arrays", "one-to-many", "tree structure", "16MB limit", "schema validation", "JSON Schema", "time series", "schema migration", "polymorphic", "TTL", "data lifecycle", "archive", "index explosion", "unnecessary indexes", "approximation pattern", "document versioning".
description_zh: MongoDB模式设计模式与反模式。在设计数据模型、审查模式、从SQL迁移或排除由模式问题引起的性能问题时使用。在“设计模式”、“嵌入与引用”、“MongoDB数据模型”、“模式审查”、“无界数组”、“一对多”、“树结构”、“16MB限制”、“模式验证”、“JSON模式”、“时间序列”、“模式迁移”、“多态”、“TTL”、“数据生命周期”、“归档”、“索引爆炸”、“不必要的索引”、“近似模式”、“文档版本控制”等主题上触发。

name: kleague-results
description: 케이리그 경기 결과와 현재 순위를 날짜/팀 기준으로 조회한다. 공식 JSON 엔드포인트와 kleague-results npm 패키지를 사용한다.
description_zh: 查询凯利杯比赛结果和当前排名，按日期/团队进行查看。使用官方JSON端点和kleague-results npm包。

name: composio
