name: angular-ssr
description: DEPRECATED - this skill is unmaintained. Use the official Angular skills at https://github.com/angular/skills instead. Implement server-side rendering and hydration in Angular v20+ using @angular/ssr. Use for SSR setup, hydration strategies, prerendering static pages, and handling browser-only APIs. Triggers on SSR configuration, fixing hydration mismatches, prerendering routes, or making code SSR-compatible.
description_zh: 已弃用 - 此技能未得到维护。请使用官方的 Angular 技能，访问 https://github.com/angular/skills。在 Angular v20+ 中使用 @angular/ssr 实现服务器端渲染和预渲染。用于 SSR 配置、预渲染策略、静态页面预渲染以及处理浏览器端 API。在 SSR 配置、修复预渲染不匹配、预渲染路由或使代码 SSR 兼容时触发。

name: elasticsearch-onboarding
description: Help developers new to Elasticsearch get from zero to a working search experience. Guide them through understanding their intent, mapping their data, and building a search experience with best practices baked in. Use this when the user shows intent to build search-related functionality, asks about Elasticsearch-related concepts for their use case, or expresses the need for help getting started with Elasticsearch.
description_zh: 帮助新接触Elasticsearch的开发者从零开始构建一个可用的搜索体验。指导他们理解其需求、映射其数据，并构建一个内置最佳实践搜索体验。当用户表现出构建搜索相关功能的意图、询问与其用例相关的Elasticsearch概念，或表达需要帮助开始使用Elasticsearch时，使用此功能。

name: ljg-book
description: Explain a whole book to readers without specialist knowledge: what it follows, how its main threads connect, where it ends, and how its evidence or events change understanding. Keep the book's specific content; a general lesson alone is not enough. USE WHEN given a book title, PDF, EPUB, excerpt, or asked 拆书, 分析这本书, 这本书在讲什么, 压缩一本书, or book. Defaults to a saved Org note. NOT FOR chapter summaries, papers, formal reviews, or single-concept deep dives.
description_zh: 向读者解释整本书，无需专业知识：它将如何发展，主要脉络如何关联，最终将走向何方，以及其证据或事件如何改变理解。保留书中的具体内容；仅提供一般性教训是不够的。在给定书名、PDF、EPUB、摘录，或被问及“拆书”、“分析这本书”、“这本书在讲什么”、“压缩一本书”或“书”时使用。默认情况下，会保存为Org笔记。不适用于章节摘要、论文、正式评论或单一概念深入探讨。

name: figma-generate-library
description: Build or update a professional-grade design system in Figma from a codebase. Use when the user wants to create variables/tokens, build component libraries, create individual components with proper variant sets and variable bindings, set up theming (light/dark modes), document foundations, or reconcile gaps between code and Figma. Also use when the user asks to create or generate any component in Figma — even a single one — since components require proper variable foundations, variant states, and design token bindings to be production-quality. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.
description_zh: 从代码库中构建或更新 Figma 中的专业级设计系统。当用户希望创建变量/符号、构建组件库、创建具有正确变体集和变量绑定的单个组件、设置主题（亮色/暗色模式）、记录基础文档，或协调代码与 Figma 之间的差异时使用。也用于用户要求在 Figma 中创建或生成任何组件——即使是单个组件，因为组件需要适当的基础变量、变体状态和设计符号绑定才能达到生产级质量。这项技能教授“构建什么”以及“按什么顺序构建”——它补充了 `figma-use` 技能，后者教授“如何调用插件 API”。这两项技能应一起加载。

name: daangn-jobs-search
description: 당근알바 공개 웹 데이터로 공고를 검색하고, 돌쇠에서는 공식 계정 표면에서 지원서 작성·채팅·승인 기반 전송까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 使用胡萝卜兼职公开的网页数据搜索公告，而多乐岛则在其官方账号界面进行申请填写、聊天、以及基于批准的传输等流程。

name: donation-place-search
description: Use when the user asks where to donate, 기부처 조회, or donation place recommendations by Korean location and category. Recommend recipients with best-effort 1365 verification-assist links and never execute donations. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当用户询问捐赠地点、기부처 조회或通过韩国地理位置和类别推荐捐赠场所时使用。尽力推荐经过1365验证辅助链接确认的受赠对象，并永不执行实际捐赠。돌쇠将通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: procedural-gen
description: Generate game content procedurally — seeded deterministic RNG, value/Perlin/ Simplex noise for terrain and heightmaps, grid dungeon generation (rooms + corridors, BSP, random walk), and weighted loot/drop tables. Engine-neutral algorithms. Use when the user mentions procedural generation, perlin/simplex noise, random seed, dungeon generator, heightmap/terrain, or loot tables.
description_zh: 生成程序化游戏内容——基于种子确定性随机数生成器（RNG）、值/Perlin/ Simplex噪声用于地形和高度图、网格地牢生成（房间+走廊、BSP、随机游走），以及加权掉落表。采用与引擎无关的算法。当用户提及程序化生成、Perlin/ Simplex噪声、随机种子、地牢生成器、高度图/地形或掉落表时使用。

name: daangn-cars-search
description: 당근중고차 공개 웹 데이터로 차량을 검색하고, 돌쇠에서는 공식 계정 표면에서 문의·찜·거래 준비까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 使用胡萝卜二手车公开的网页数据搜索车辆，而돌쇠则在官方账号界面上进行咨询、收藏和交易准备。

name: slack-messaging
description: Guidance for composing well-formatted, effective Slack messages using mrkdwn syntax
description_zh: 使用 mrkdwn 语法编写格式良好、有效的 Slack 消息指南

name: scroll-world
description: Build an immersive scroll-scrubbed "fly through the world" landing page for any industry or brand using Higgsfield. As the visitor scrolls, a pre-rendered camera flies from outside each scene into its interior, then flows on to the next scene with NO cuts — one continuous connected flight (Emons-style isometric diorama world, or any art direction you pick). The skill interviews the user for the topic, the story beats/sections, and brand kit, then generates cohesive scenes + seamless camera clips with Higgsfield and wires a portable, framework-agnostic scroll-scrub engine. The video chain renders through Monid by default (Seedance 2.0, pay-per-clip USD — capability re-checked each build, see Step 4) with Higgsfield credits as the fallback biller. Use when the user wants a "3D world" / "browse-through-the-industry" hero, a scroll cinematic, a diorama landing, or to turn a business into a scrollable world.
description_zh: 使用 Higgsfield 为任何行业或品牌构建一个沉浸式、滚动浏览的“飞越世界”着陆页。当访客滚动时，预先渲染的摄像机从每个场景外部飞入其内部，然后无缝地流至下一个场景，全程无剪辑——一次连续的连接飞行（可以是 Emons 风格的等距立体场景世界，或您选择的任何艺术风格）。该技能会向用户询问主题、故事节点/部分以及品牌资料包，然后使用 Higgsfield 生成连贯的场景和无缝的摄像机剪辑，并连接一个可移植的、框架无关的滚动浏览引擎。视频链默认通过 Monid 渲染（Seedance 2.0，按剪辑付费美元——每次构建时重新确认能力，见步骤 4），Higgsfield 信用额度作为备用账单方。适用于用户需要“3D 世界”/“浏览行业”的封面、滚动式电影、立体场景着陆页，或将企业转化为可滚动的世界。

name: swift-expert
description: Builds iOS/macOS/watchOS/tvOS applications, implements SwiftUI views and state management, designs protocol-oriented architectures, handles async/await concurrency, implements actors for thread safety, and debugs Swift-specific issues. Use when building iOS/macOS applications with Swift 5.9+, SwiftUI, or async/await concurrency. Invoke for protocol-oriented programming, SwiftUI state management, actors, server-side Swift, UIKit integration, Combine, or Vapor.
description_zh: 构建 iOS/macOS/watchOS/tvOS 应用程序，实现 SwiftUI 视图和状态管理，设计面向协议的架构，处理异步/等待并发，实现线程安全的 actor，并调试 Swift 特定问题。适用于使用 Swift 5.9+、SwiftUI 或异步/等待并发构建 iOS/macOS 应用程序时。用于面向协议编程、SwiftUI 状态管理、actor、服务器端 Swift、UIKit 集成、Combine 或 Vapor。

name: gsap-framer-scroll-animation
description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to build scroll animations, scroll effects, parallax, scroll-triggered reveals, pinned sections, horizontal scroll, text animations, or any motion tied to scroll position — in vanilla JS, React, or Next.js. Covers GSAP ScrollTrigger (pinning, scrubbing, snapping, timelines, horizontal scroll, ScrollSmoother, matchMedia) and Framer Motion / Motion v12 (useScroll, useTransform, useSpring, whileInView, variants). Use this skill even if the user just says "animate on scroll", "fade in as I scroll", "make it scroll like Apple", "parallax effect", "sticky section", "scroll progress bar", or "entrance animation". Also triggers for Copilot prompt patterns for GSAP or Framer Motion code generation. Pairs with the premium-frontend-ui skill for creative philosophy and design-level polish.
description_zh: 使用此技能，无论用户想要创建滚动动画、滚动效果、视差效果、滚动触发的显示、固定区域、水平滚动、文本动画，或任何与滚动位置相关的动画效果——无论是使用原生 JavaScript、React 还是 Next.js。涵盖 GSAP ScrollTrigger（固定、滑动、吸附、时间线、水平滚动、ScrollSmoother、matchMedia）以及 Framer Motion / Motion v12（useScroll、useTransform、useSpring、whileInView、variants）。即使用户只是说“滚动时动画”、“随着滚动淡入”、“让它像苹果一样滚动”、“视差效果”、“粘性区域”、“滚动进度条”或“入场动画”，也可以使用此技能。同时，它还触发了用于 GSAP 或 Framer Motion 代码生成的 Copilot 提示模式。与“高级前端 UI”技能搭配使用，以实现创意理念和设计级别的完善。

name: rds-sqlserver
description: Provides connectivity, authentication, and troubleshooting guidance for Amazon RDS for SQL Server. Applicable when users ask about SSMS times out connecting from EC2, Cannot generate SSPI context with Windows auth, connect RDS SQL Server from Lambda with pymssql, auth_scheme shows NTLM instead of KERBEROS on ECS Fargate, SSM tunnel to RDS SQL Server from laptop, port 1433 security group, TrustServerCertificate=True for localhost tunnels, SPN MSSQLSvc, AWS Managed Microsoft AD, CNAME not RDS endpoint for Kerberos, tds_version='7.4', encryption='require', port-as-string for pymssql, Secrets Manager credential caching in Lambda, error 18456 login failed. Covers Python (pymssql, pyodbc), .NET (Microsoft.Data.SqlClient), Java (JDBC mssql-jdbc), Node.js (tedious), IAM auth via RDS Proxy, and VPC/ECS/EKS/Lambda deployment.
description_zh: 提供 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 的连接、身份验证和故障排除指南。适用于用户询问以下情况：从 EC2 连接 SSMS 超时、使用 Windows 身份验证无法生成 SSPI 上下文、从 Lambda 使用 pymssql 连接 RDS SQL Server、ECS Fargate 上的 auth_scheme 显示 NTLM 而不是 KERBEROS、从笔记本电脑通过 SSM 隧道连接 RDS SQL Server、端口 1433 的安全组、localhost 隧道的 TrustServerCertificate=True、SPN MSSQLSvc、AWS 管理的 Microsoft AD、CNAME 而不是 RDS 端点用于 Kerberos、tds_version='7.4'、encryption='require'、pymssql 的 port-as-string、Lambda 中的 Secrets Manager 凭据缓存、错误 18456 登录失败。涵盖 Python (pymssql, pyodbc)、.NET (Microsoft.Data.SqlClient)、Java (JDBC mssql-jdbc)、Node.js (tedious)、通过 RDS Proxy 的 IAM 身份验证，以及 VPC/ECS/EKS/Lambda 部署。

name: langgraph-python-quickstart
description: Scaffold a minimal local LangGraph agent in Python by following the official quickstart. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a LangGraph agent locally.
description_zh: 按照官方快速入门指南，用Python搭建一个最小的本地LangGraph代理。当用户希望快速在本地构建或尝试LangGraph代理时使用。

name: wp-abilities-api
description: Use when working with the WordPress Abilities API (wp_register_ability, wp_register_ability_category, /wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/*, @wordpress/abilities) including defining abilities, categories, meta, REST exposure, and permissions checks for clients.
description_zh: 在处理 WordPress 能力 API（wp_register_ability、wp_register_ability_category、/wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/*、@wordpress/abilities）时使用，包括定义能力、分类、元数据、REST 暴露以及客户端权限检查。

name: apple-reminders
description: List, add, edit, complete, or delete Apple Reminders and reminder lists via remindctl.
description_zh: 通过 remindctl 列出、添加、编辑、完成或删除 Apple Reminders 和提醒列表。

name: game-development
description: Game development orchestrator. Routes by platform, dimension, and engine fit (web 2D/3D, hybrid DOM+canvas, narrative tools). Use when starting or structuring a game project, choosing frameworks, or picking among Phaser, PixiJS, Kaplay, Canvas/WebGL, Three.js, Babylon.js, Godot, Unity, or Ink/Twine.
description_zh: 游戏开发协调器。根据平台、维度和引擎适配（Web 2D/3D、混合 DOM+canvas、叙事工具）。在启动或构建游戏项目、选择框架，或从 Phaser、PixiJS、Kaplay、Canvas/WebGL、Three.js、Babylon.js、Godot、Unity、Ink/Twine 中选择时使用。

name: launch-with-aws
description: Migrates vibe-coded web applications to AWS. Handles the full workflow from analysis through migration to deployment, producing deployable AWS Blocks infrastructure code. Supports full-stack apps built with vibe-coding platforms (Lovable, Bolt.new, Replit) and frontend web applications and websites: React, Vue, Angular, Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, SvelteKit, Gatsby, Vite, Svelte, Solid, Docusaurus, and others (static sites, SPAs, and SSR frameworks with static export). Triggers on: launch with AWS, launch on AWS, deploy to AWS, migrate to AWS, host my app on AWS, move my app to AWS, transfer my app to AWS. Activates when the user wants to migrate a vibe-coded app or frontend web app to AWS, even if they don't say 'migrate' explicitly.
description_zh: 将 vibe-coded 网络应用程序迁移至 AWS。处理从分析到迁移再到部署的完整工作流程，生成可部署的 AWS Blocks 基础设施代码。支持使用 vibe-coding 平台（Lovable、Bolt.new、Replit）构建的全栈应用程序，以及前端网络应用程序和网站：React、Vue、Angular、Next.js、Nuxt、Astro、SvelteKit、Gatsby、Vite、Svelte、Solid、Docusaurus 等（静态网站、SPAs 和具有静态导出的 SSR 框架）。触发条件：AWS 启动、AWS 上启动、部署至 AWS、迁移至 AWS、在 AWS 上托管我的应用程序、将我的应用程序迁移至 AWS、将我的应用程序转移至 AWS。当用户希望将 vibe-coded 应用程序或前端网络应用程序迁移至 AWS 时，即使他们没有明确说出“迁移”，该功能也会被激活。

name: agent-slack
description: Slack CLI for agents: read URLs/threads/history/unreads/later/canvases/workflows, create/edit canvases from Markdown, search messages/files, download attachments, lookup users, list/create/invite channels, open DMs, compose messages, manage Slack-native drafts, schedule sends, and explicit sends/edits/deletes/reactions/mark-read/uploads.
description_zh: 代理的 Slack CLI：读取 URL/线程/历史记录/未读消息/稍后处理/画布/工作流，从 Markdown 创建/编辑画布，搜索消息/文件，下载附件，查找用户，列出/创建/邀请频道，打开私信，撰写消息，管理 Slack 原生草稿，安排发送，以及显式发送/编辑/删除/反应/标记已读/上传。

name: internal-comms
description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).
description_zh: 一套资源，用于帮助我撰写各种内部沟通内容，使用我司偏好的格式。Claude 应在每次被要求撰写某种内部沟通内容时（如状态报告、领导更新、第三方更新、公司简报、常见问题解答、事件报告、项目更新等）使用此技能。

name: google-cloud-solution-agentic-analytics-spark-knowledge-catalog
description: Discovers requirements and designs an end-to-end governed agentic analytics solution using Knowledge Catalog and Managed Service for Apache Spark (Lightning Engine). Use when designing data science and analytics workflows across structured and unstructured distributed data (including in S3, Azure Blob, AlloyDB, and Iceberg), establishing metadata governance with Knowledge Catalog aspect types, or grounding agentic IDEs (VS Code, Antigravity) by using the Google Cloud Data Agent Kit. Don't use for provisioning borderless data lakehouse infrastructure (use google-cloud-solution-agentic-ai-borderless-data-lakehouse instead).
description_zh: 发现需求，并使用知识目录和Apache Spark（闪电引擎）的托管服务设计一个端到端受管理的代理式分析解决方案。在跨结构化和非结构化分布式数据（包括S3、Azure Blob、AlloyDB和Iceberg）设计数据科学和分析工作流时，在知识目录方面类型中建立元数据治理，或通过使用Google Cloud数据代理工具包为代理式IDE（VS Code、Antigravity）奠定基础时使用。不应用于提供无边界数据湖屋基础设施（请使用google-cloud-solution-agentic-ai-borderless-data-lakehouse）。

name: datalineage-summary
description: Summarizes Google Cloud Data Lineage graphs to help users debug data quality issues and understand data provenance for BQ/GCS. Use when summarizing upstream and downstream data flows, and presenting complex lineage data as an intuitive Markdown report. Don't use for generic BigQuery queries, editing lineage relationships, or downstream deprecation. Don't use for downstream blast-radius impact analysis (use datalineage-bigquery-asset-impact-analysis skill instead).
description_zh: 总结 Google Cloud Data Lineage 图，帮助用户调试数据质量问题并理解 BigQuery/GCS 的数据来源。在总结上游和下游数据流，以及将复杂的 Lineage 数据以直观的 Markdown 报告形式呈现时使用。不应用于通用 BigQuery 查询、编辑 Lineage 关系或下游弃用。不应用于下游爆炸半径影响分析（应使用 datalineage-bigquery-asset-impact-analysis 技能）。

name: design-audit
description: Premium UI/UX design audit and refinement skill. Conducts systematic visual audits of existing apps and produces phased, implementation-ready design plans. Use this skill whenever the user asks to audit a UI, improve an app's visual design, make an interface feel more polished or premium, review design consistency, fix visual hierarchy, or refine spacing/typography/color. Also trigger when the user says "design review", "make it look better", "UI polish", "visual refinement", "design pass", "audit the design", or references making an app feel more professional. This skill is purely visual — it does not touch functionality, logic, or features. It elevates what exists.
description_zh: 高级 UI/UX 设计审核与优化技能。对现有应用进行系统化的视觉审核，并产出分阶段、可实施的优化方案。当用户要求审核 UI、改进应用视觉设计、使界面更显精致或高端、审查设计一致性、调整视觉层级或优化间距/字体/颜色时，可使用此技能。同时，当用户说“设计审核”、“让它看起来更好”、“UI 精致化”、“视觉优化”、“设计通过”、“审核设计”，或提及让应用更显专业时，也可触发此技能。该技能纯粹关注视觉层面——不涉及功能、逻辑或特性。它提升现有设计。

name: swiftui-uikit-interop
description: Bridges UIKit and SwiftUI with UIViewRepresentable, UIViewControllerRepresentable, UIHostingController, UIHostingConfiguration, coordinator delegates, and UIKit automatic observation tracking for shared @Observable state. Use when wrapping UIKit-only or third-party UIKit views/controllers in SwiftUI, embedding SwiftUI in UIKit, integrating mail/share/document/PDF/text-view surfaces, or migrating UIKit apps to SwiftUI incrementally.
description_zh: 通过 `UIViewRepresentable`、`UIViewControllerRepresentable`、`UIHostingController`、`UIHostingConfiguration`、协调器代理以及 UIKit 自动观察跟踪共享的 `@Observable` 状态，实现 UIKit 和 SwiftUI 的桥接。适用于将 UIKit 唯一或第三方 UIKit 视图/控制器包装在 SwiftUI 中、将 SwiftUI 嵌入 UIKit、集成邮件/分享/文档/PDF/文本视图界面，或逐步将 UIKit 应用迁移到 SwiftUI。

name: myrealtrip-search
description: 마이리얼트립 공식 Streamable HTTP MCP 서버로 항공권, 숙소, 투어/티켓/액티비티를 검색하고 상세·가격·예약 링크를 확인한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过MyRealTrip官方Streamable HTTP MCP服务器，可以搜索机票、住宿、旅游/门票/活动，并确认详细信息、价格和预订链接。在Dolce中，则通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: spring-boot-security-jwt
description: Provides JWT authentication and authorization patterns for Spring Boot 3.5.x covering token generation with JJWT, Bearer/cookie authentication, database/OAuth2 integration, and RBAC/permission-based access control using Spring Security 6.x. Use when implementing authentication or authorization in Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 提供 JWT 认证和授权模式，适用于 Spring Boot 3.5.x 版本，涵盖使用 JJWT 生成令牌、Bearer/cookie 认证、数据库/OAuth2 集成，以及使用 Spring Security 6.x 实现基于 RBAC/权限的访问控制。在 Spring Boot 应用程序中实现认证或授权时使用。

name: google-cloud-solution-rag-enterprise-search-gke-sqldb
description: Discovers requirements, and generates architectural, design, and deployment guidance for a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-capable enterprise search system in Google Cloud. Use when users need a vector-enabled SQL database as the store and index for the embedding vectors, an open model and open-source inferencing framework, and Kubernetes containers to host all the application components. DON'T use this skill for fully-managed RAG, or SaaS search services, or when a non-SQL vector database is required.
description_zh: 发现需求，并为 Google Cloud 中的检索增强生成（RAG）功能的企业搜索系统生成架构、设计和部署指南。当用户需要一个支持向量的 SQL 数据库作为嵌入向量的存储和索引、一个开源模型和开源推理框架，以及使用 Kubernetes 容器来托管所有应用程序组件时，请使用此技能。不要使用此技能用于完全管理的 RAG，或 SaaS 搜索服务，或者在需要非 SQL 向量数据库时。

name: kibana-dashboards
description: Create and manage Kibana Dashboards and Lens visualizations. Use when you need to define dashboards and visualizations declaratively, version control them, or automate their deployment.
description_zh: 创建和管理 Kibana 仪表板和 Lens 可视化。当您需要以声明方式定义仪表板和可视化、进行版本控制或自动化其部署时使用。

name: platform-custom-report-type-generate
description: Use to create, generate, or validate Salesforce Custom Report Type metadata. Trigger on custom report types, CRTs, cross-object reports, report builder data sources, exposing fields for reporting across related objects, inner vs outer joins in reports, report type categories, or deployment errors for .reportType-meta.xml files. Do NOT trigger for running, editing, or filtering existing reports; creating report folders, dashboards, or list views; or non-authoring reporting questions.
description_zh: 用于创建、生成或验证 Salesforce 自定义报表类型元数据。在自定义报表类型（CRT）、跨对象报表、报表构建器数据源上触发，以跨相关对象暴露报表字段、报表中的内连接与外连接、报表类型类别，或 .reportType-meta.xml 文件的部署错误。不应用于运行、编辑或筛选现有报表；创建报表文件夹、仪表板或列表视图；或非作者报表问题。

name: copywriting
description: When the user wants to write or optimize short-form marketing copy—headlines, CTAs, ad copy, landing page copy, email copy. Also use when the user mentions "copywriting," "headline," "CTA copy," "ad copy," "landing page copy," "sales copy," "conversion copy," "PAS," "AIDA," "BAB," "copy formula," or "differentiation." For long-form article bodies (blog posts, guides), use article-content.
description_zh: 当用户想要撰写或优化短文案时——标题、行动号召、广告文案、落地页文案、邮件文案。也适用于用户提到“文案写作”、“标题”、“行动号召文案”、“广告文案”、“落地页文案”、“销售文案”、“转化文案”、“ PAS”、“AIDA”、“BAB”、“文案公式”或“差异化”时。对于长文案（如博客文章、指南），请使用 article-content。

name: content-rewrite
description: Adapt and rewrite content for different platforms (LinkedIn, X, Reddit, English blog, WeChat). Each platform has its own tone, format, and length requirements.
description_zh: 为不同平台（领英、推特、Reddit、英文博客、微信）调整和改写内容。每个平台都有其独特的语气、格式和长度要求。

name: input-systems
description: Architect game input — action mapping (abstracting keys into named actions), rebinding with conflict detection and persistence, multi-device support (keyboard, gamepad, touch), analog deadzones, and feel features like input buffering and coyote time, plus accessibility. Engine-neutral. Use when the user mentions input mapping, rebind controls, gamepad support, deadzone, input buffering, coyote time, or accessible controls.
description_zh: 设计游戏输入——动作映射（将按键抽象为命名动作）、带冲突检测和持久化的重新绑定、多设备支持（键盘、手柄、触摸屏）、模拟死区以及输入缓冲和猫头鹰时间等体验特性，并支持无障碍功能。与引擎无关。当用户提及输入映射、重新绑定控制、手柄支持、死区、输入缓冲、猫头鹰时间或无障碍控制时使用。

name: minimax-pdf
description: Use this skill when visual quality and design identity matter for a PDF. CREATE (generate from scratch): "make a PDF", "generate a report", "write a proposal", "create a resume", "beautiful PDF", "professional document", "cover page", "polished PDF", "client-ready document". FILL (complete form fields): "fill in the form", "fill out this PDF", "complete the form fields", "write values into PDF", "what fields does this PDF have". REFORMAT (apply design to an existing doc): "reformat this document", "apply our style", "convert this Markdown/text to PDF", "make this doc look good", "re-style this PDF". This skill uses a token-based design system: color, typography, and spacing are derived from the document type and flow through every page. The output is print-ready. Prefer this skill when appearance matters, not just when any PDF output is needed.
description_zh:
在视觉质量和设计身份对 PDF 至关重要的场合使用此技能。  
CREATE（从零生成）："制作 PDF"、"生成报告"、"撰写提案"、"创建简历"、"精美 PDF"、"专业文档"、"封面页"、"精炼 PDF"、"客户适用文档"。  
FILL（填写表单字段）："填写表单"、"填写此 PDF"、"完成表单字段"、"将值写入 PDF"、"此 PDF 包含哪些字段"。  
REFORMAT（将设计应用于现有文档）："重新格式化此文档"、"应用我们的风格"、"将 Markdown/文本转换为 PDF"、"让此文档看起来美观"、"重新设计此 PDF"。  
此技能采用基于令牌的设计系统：颜色、字体和间距根据文档类型确定，并贯穿每一页。输出结果适用于印刷。当外观至关重要时，而非仅仅是需要任何 PDF 输出时，优先选择此技能。

name: research-synthesis
description: Synthesize user research into themes, insights, and recommendations. Use when you have interview transcripts, survey results, usability test notes, support tickets, or NPS responses that need to be distilled into patterns, user segments, and prioritized next steps.
description_zh: 将用户研究综合成主题、洞察和建议。当您有访谈记录、调查结果、可用性测试笔记、支持工单或NPS反馈，需要提炼成模式、用户细分和优先后续步骤时使用。

name: chrome-automation
description: Automate Chrome browser tasks using agent-browser CLI. Navigate pages, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, extract data, and replay Chrome DevTools Recorder exports.
description_zh: 使用 agent-browser CLI 自动化 Chrome 浏览器任务。导航页面、填写表单、点击按钮、截取屏幕截图、提取数据，以及重放 Chrome DevTools Recorder 导出的内容。

name: coding-agent
description: Delegate coding work to Codex, Claude Code, or OpenCode as background workers; not simple edits or read-only code lookup.
description_zh: 将编码工作委托给 Codex、Claude Code 或 OpenCode 作为后台工作；不涉及简单的编辑或只读代码查询。

name: obsidian
description: Work with Obsidian vaults using the official obsidian CLI: read/search/create/edit notes, tasks, links, properties, plugins.
description_zh: 使用官方的 Obsidian CLI 操作 Obsidian 档案库：读取/搜索/创建/编辑笔记、任务、链接、属性、插件。

name: claude-to-deerflow
description: Interact with DeerFlow AI agent platform via its HTTP API. Use this skill when the user wants to send messages or questions to DeerFlow for research/analysis, start a DeerFlow conversation thread, check DeerFlow status or health, list available models/skills/agents in DeerFlow, manage DeerFlow memory, upload files to DeerFlow threads, or delegate complex research tasks to DeerFlow. Also use when the user mentions deerflow, deer flow, or wants to run a deep research task that DeerFlow can handle.
description_zh: 通过其 HTTP API 与 DeerFlow AI 代理平台进行交互。当用户想要向 DeerFlow 发送消息或提问以进行研究/分析、启动 DeerFlow 对话线程、检查 DeerFlow 状态或健康状况、列出 DeerFlow 中可用的模型/技能/代理、管理 DeerFlow 内存、向 DeerFlow 对话线程上传文件，或将复杂的科研任务委托给 DeerFlow 时，使用此技能。此外，当用户提及 deerflow、deer flow，或想要运行 DeerFlow 可以处理的深度研究任务时，也使用此技能。

name: image-generation
description: Generate illustration images for articles and documentation with a Codex-first workflow, OpenAI API fallback, and Gemini fallback.
description_zh: 使用Codex优先工作流程、OpenAI API备用方案和Gemini备用方案为文章和文档生成插图图像。

name: mermaid-to-image
description: Convert Mermaid code blocks in Markdown files to PNG images using the mermaid.ink API.
description_zh: 使用 mermaid.ink API 将 Markdown 文件中的 Mermaid 代码块转换为 PNG 图片。

name: raffle-winner-picker
description: Picks random winners from lists, spreadsheets, or Google Sheets for giveaways, raffles, and contests. Ensures fair, unbiased selection with transparency.
description_zh: 从列表、电子表格或 Google Sheets 中随机抽取赠品、抽奖和竞赛的获奖者。确保公平、无偏见的选取，并具有透明度。

name: himalaya
description: Himalaya CLI for IMAP/SMTP mail: list, read, search, compose, reply, forward, copy, move, delete.
description_zh: Himalaya CLI用于IMAP/SMTP邮件：列出、阅读、搜索、撰写、回复、转发、复制、移动、删除。

name: ads-tiktok
description: Audit TikTok Ads measurement, Pixel and Events API, mobile-first creative, audiences, Smart+, Shop and commerce campaigns, bidding, budgets, pacing, attribution, and policy. Use for TikTok Ads, TikTok Pixel, Events API, Smart+, TikTok Shop Ads, GMV Max, Spark Ads, or TikTok campaign optimization.
description_zh: 审计抖音广告测量、像素和事件API、移动优先创意、受众、智能+、购物和商业广告活动、竞价、预算、节奏、归因和政策。适用于抖音广告、抖音像素、事件API、智能+、抖音购物广告、GMV Max、Spark广告或抖音广告活动优化。

name: debugging-instruments
description: Debug iOS apps and profile performance using LLDB, the interactive Memory Graph Debugger, and Instruments. Use for crashes, retain-cycle inspection, hangs, build failures, and generic CPU, memory, energy, or network profiling. Use ios-memgraph-analysis for .memgraph capture, leaks CLI ownership paths, or persistent heap growth; use ios-ettrace-performance for ETTrace capture and JSON.
description_zh: 使用LLDB、交互式内存图调试器以及Instruments来调试iOS应用程序并分析性能。用于崩溃、保留循环检查、卡顿、构建失败以及通用的CPU、内存、能耗或网络分析。使用ios-memgraph-analysis进行.memgraph捕获、泄漏CLI所有权路径或持久堆增长；使用ios-ettrace-performance进行ETTrace捕获和JSON。

name: gke-platform-security
description: Plans, configures, and hardens platform-level Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster security. Covers cluster add-ons (Secret Manager enablement), RBAC hardening (disabling insecure bindings, audit tools), Binary Authorization, Secrets Encryption (--database-encryption-key), Security Posture (--security-posture), enabling Shielded Nodes, GKE Sandbox cluster enablement, GKE IAM roles, and cross-service authentication IAM patterns. Use when securing cluster control planes, hardening GKE RBAC, enabling Shielded Nodes, enabling GKE Sandbox runtime, enabling cluster-wide security add-ons, or managing GKE IAM roles. Don't use for Workload Identity (use gke-workload-identity) or workload-level security (SecretProviderClass, PSS, NetPol, gVisor pod runtimeClassName; use gke-workload-security).
description_zh: 制定、配置和加固平台级 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 集群安全。涵盖集群附加组件（启用密钥管理器）、RBAC 加固（禁用不安全绑定、审计工具）、二进制授权、启用受保护节点、GKE 沙盒集群启用、GKE IAM 角色，以及跨服务认证 IAM 模式。在以下情况下使用：保护集群控制平面、加固 GKE RBAC、启用受保护节点、启用 GKE 沙盒运行时、启用集群级安全附加组件或管理 GKE IAM 角色。不适用于工作负载级安全（工作负载身份、SecretProviderClass、PSS、NetPol、gVisor pod runtimeClassName；请使用 gke-workload-security）。

name: react-code-review
description: Provides comprehensive code review capability for React applications, validates component architecture, hooks usage, React 19 patterns, state management, performance optimization, accessibility compliance, and TypeScript integration. Use when reviewing React code changes, before merging pull requests, after implementing new features, or for component architecture validation. Triggers on "review React code", "React code review", "check my React components".
description_zh: 为 React 应用提供全面的代码审查能力，验证组件架构、钩子（hooks）使用、React 19 模式、状态管理、性能优化、无障碍合规性以及 TypeScript 集成。在审查 React 代码变更、合并 pull 请求前、实现新功能后或进行组件架构验证时使用。当触发“审查 React 代码”、“React 代码审查”、“检查我的 React 组件”时激活。

name: rds-oracle
description: Diagnoses and resolves Amazon RDS for Oracle connectivity, authentication, networking, and driver troubleshooting. Applicable to any RDS-for-Oracle question including connecting a Python Lambda to RDS Oracle in a VPC with pooling and cold-start optimization, EKS pods to RDS Oracle via the Secrets Manager CSI driver with IRSA and SecretProviderClass, ORA-12170 cross-VPC timeouts from EC2, DPI-1047 cannot-locate-64-bit-Oracle-Client errors, and Oracle Connection Manager (CMAN) on EC2 as a proxy with HA across two AZs. Covers python-oracledb thin vs thick mode, init_oracle_client, RDS Proxy does NOT support RDS Oracle, port 1521, VPC peering, Transit Gateway, Kerberos with AWS Managed Microsoft AD, SSL/TLS/NNE, SSM port forwarding, EC2/ECS Fargate/EKS/Lambda, SQL Developer/DBeaver/Toad/SQLcl, and Secrets Manager.
description_zh: 诊断和解决 Amazon RDS for Oracle 连接、认证、网络和驱动程序问题。适用于任何 RDS-for-Oracle 问题，包括在 VPC 中通过连接池和冷启动优化将 Python Lambda 连接到 RDS Oracle，通过 Secrets Manager CSI 驱动程序和 IRSA 将 EKS Pod 连接到 RDS Oracle，来自 EC2 的 ORA-12170 跨 VPC 超时，DPI-1047 无法定位 64 位 Oracle 客户端错误，以及作为跨两个 AZ 实现高可用性的代理的 EC2 上的 Oracle 连接管理器（CMAN）。涵盖 python-oracledb 薄模式与厚模式、init_oracle_client、RDS Proxy 不支持 RDS Oracle、端口 1521、VPC 对等连接、传输网关、Kerberos 与 AWS 管理的 Microsoft AD、SSL/TLS/NNE、SSM 端口转发、EC2/ECS Fargate/EKS/Lambda、SQL Developer/DBeaver/Toad/SQLcl 以及 Secrets Manager。

name: storekit
description: Implement, review, or improve in-app purchases and subscriptions using StoreKit 2. Use when building paywalls with SubscriptionStoreView or ProductView, processing transactions with Product and Transaction APIs, verifying entitlements, handling purchase flows (consumable, non-consumable, auto-renewable), implementing offer codes or promotional/win-back/introductory offers, managing subscription status and renewal state, setting up StoreKit testing with configuration files, or integrating Family Sharing, Ask to Buy, refund handling, and billing retry logic.
description_zh: 使用 StoreKit 2 实现或改进应用内购买和订阅。在构建使用 SubscriptionStoreView 或 ProductView 的付费墙、使用 Product 和 Transaction API 处理交易、验证权限、处理购买流程（消耗型、非消耗型、自动续订型）、实现优惠码或促销/召回/入门优惠、管理订阅状态和续订状态、使用配置文件设置 StoreKit 测试、集成家庭共享、请求购买、退款处理和计费重试逻辑时使用。

name: pp-espn
description: Use this skill whenever the user asks about live sports scores, standings, team stats, game summaries (with box score, leaders, scoring plays, odds, and win probability), NFL / NBA / MLB / NHL / NCAA / MLS / EPL / WNBA games, team schedules, polls, or rankings. ESPN sports CLI with live scores across 10 leagues, offline search, head-to-head comparisons, and rich per-game summary payloads. No API key required. Triggers on natural phrasings like 'what's the score of the Lakers game', 'Patriots schedule this week', 'NFL standings', 'box score for tonight's Mavs game', 'Chiefs vs Eagles head to head', 'who's on top of the AP poll'.

name: diagramming-code
description: Generates Mermaid diagrams from Trailmark code graphs. Produces call graphs, class hierarchies, module dependency maps, containment diagrams, complexity heatmaps, and attack surface data flow visualizations. Use when visualizing code architecture, drawing call graphs, generating class diagrams, creating dependency maps, producing complexity heatmaps, or visualizing data flow and attack surface paths as Mermaid diagrams.
description_zh: 从 Trailmark 代码图中生成 Mermaid 图表。生成调用图、类层次结构、模块依赖关系图、包含关系图、复杂度热力图以及攻击面数据流可视化。在可视化代码架构、绘制调用图、生成类图、创建依赖关系图、生成复杂度热力图或以 Mermaid 图表形式可视化数据流和攻击面路径时使用。

name: dimensional-analysis
description: Annotates codebases with dimensional analysis comments documenting units, dimensions, and decimal scaling. Use when someone asks to annotate units in a codebase, perform a dimensional analysis, or find vulnerabilities in a DeFi protocol, offchain code, or other blockchain-related codebase with arithmetic. Prevents dimensional mismatches and catches formula bugs early.
description_zh: 为代码库添加维度分析注释，记录单位、维度和十进制缩放。当有人要求在代码库中标注单位、执行维度分析，或查找与DeFi协议、链下代码或其他与区块链相关的代码库中的算术漏洞时使用。可防止维度不匹配，并及早捕获公式错误。

name: google-cloud-solution-n-tier-serverless-web-app
description: Assists in designing and implementing secure n-tier serverless web applications and microservices on Google Cloud. Use when users need architecture designs, security checklists, Terraform code, or deployment guidance for multi-tier serverless apps, regional data residency / European sovereignty compliance, zero-trust private VPC networking, or Private Service Connect. Don't use for VM, GKE, or non-Google Cloud architectures.
description_zh: 协助在 Google Cloud 上设计和实施安全的 n 层无服务器 Web 应用程序和微服务。当用户需要多层无服务器应用程序的架构设计、安全检查清单、Terraform 代码或部署指南，以及区域数据驻留/欧洲主权合规性、零信任私有 VPC 网络或私有服务连接时使用。不适用于 VM、GKE 或非 Google Cloud 架构。

name: seoul-density
description: 서울 주요 121개 핫스팟 장소의 실시간 혼잡도와 인구 현황을 조회한다. 지금 강남역이 얼마나 붐비는지, 홍대 인파가 얼마나 되는지 물어볼 때 사용한다.
description_zh: 查询首尔主要121个热门地点的实时拥堵程度和人口状况。当您想了解现在江南站有多繁忙、弘大的人潮有多大时使用。

name: spring-data-jpa
description: Provides patterns to implement persistence layers with Spring Data JPA. Use when creating repositories, configuring entity relationships, writing queries (derived and `@Query`), setting up pagination, database auditing, transactions, UUID primary keys, multiple databases, and database indexing.
description_zh: 提供模式以使用 Spring Data JPA 实现持久化层。在创建仓库、配置实体关系、编写查询（派生查询和 `@Query`）、设置分页、数据库审计、事务、UUID 主键、多个数据库和数据库索引时使用。

name: korean-marathon-schedule
description: 고러닝과 대한철인3종협회 공개 표면으로 한국 마라톤·철인3종 경기 일정, 장소, 신청 마감일, 종목을 조회한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过学习和韩国铁人三项协会公开的表面，可以查询韩国马拉松·铁人三项比赛的日程、地点、报名截止日期和项目。在多乐士，将通过官方表面进行后续行动。

name: apple-on-device-ai
description: Build private, on-device AI features on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with Foundation Models, Core ML, MLX Swift, or llama.cpp. Use when choosing an Apple-local model runtime, building an Apple Intelligence chatbot or tool-calling feature, running an LLM on Apple Silicon, converting or compressing a Python model for Core ML, or comparing on-device inference backends. For Swift Core ML loading and prediction code, use the coreml skill.
description_zh: 使用 Foundation Models、Core ML、MLX Swift 或 llama.cpp 在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上构建私有的设备端 AI 功能。适用于选择 Apple 本地模型运行时、构建 Apple 智能聊天机器人或工具调用功能、在 Apple Silicon 上运行 LLM、将 Python 模型转换为或压缩为 Core ML 格式，或比较设备端推理后端。对于 Swift Core ML 加载和预测代码，请使用 coreml 技能。

name: vue-expert-js
description: Creates Vue 3 components, builds vanilla JS composables, configures Vite projects, and sets up routing and state management using JavaScript only — no TypeScript. Generates JSDoc-typed code with @typedef, @param, and @returns annotations for full type coverage without a TS compiler. Use when building Vue 3 applications with JavaScript only (no TypeScript), when projects require JSDoc-based type hints, when migrating from Vue 2 Options API to Composition API in JS, or when teams prefer vanilla JavaScript, .mjs modules, or need quick prototypes without TypeScript setup.
description_zh: 创建 Vue 3 组件，构建原生 JavaScript 可复用模块，配置 Vite 项目，并使用 JavaScript 仅设置路由和状态管理——无需 TypeScript。生成 JSDoc 类型化代码，包含 @typedef、@param 和 @returns 注释，以实现完全的类型覆盖，无需 TS 编译器。适用于仅使用 JavaScript 构建 Vue 3 应用（不使用 TypeScript）的场景，适用于项目需要基于 JSDoc 的类型提示的场景，适用于从 Vue 2 Options API 迁移到 Composition API（JavaScript 版本），或适用于团队偏好原生 JavaScript、.mjs 模块，或需要快速原型开发且无需 TypeScript 设置的情况。

name: sitetositevpn
description: Configures AWS Site-to-Site VPN: creating an IPsec VPN connection between an on-premises network and a VPC, choosing the target gateway (virtual private gateway, transit gateway, or AWS Cloud WAN), choosing static or dynamic (BGP) routing, sizing tunnel bandwidth (Standard 1.25 Gbps or Large 5 Gbps), connecting many sites through a VPN Concentrator, applying the customer gateway device configuration, making a connection highly available, and monitoring tunnels with CloudWatch. Applicable when the user wants to connect a data center or branch office to AWS over an encrypted tunnel, choose how routes are exchanged, scale throughput, consolidate sites, or diagnose a down tunnel. Routes to the right per-task procedure in references. Not for AWS Direct Connect (its own service), Client VPN for individual remote users, the transit gateway side of a VPN attachment (transitgateway skill), or Route 53 DNS work.
description_zh: 配置 AWS 站点到站点 VPN：在本地网络和 VPC 之间创建 IPsec VPN 连接，选择目标网关（虚拟私有网关、传输网关或 AWS 云 WAN），选择静态或动态（BGP）路由，调整隧道带宽（标准 1.25 Gbps 或大型 5 Gbps），通过 VPN 集中器连接多个站点，应用客户网关设备配置，使连接高度可用，并使用 CloudWatch 监控隧道。适用于用户希望通过加密隧道连接数据中心或分支机构到 AWS、选择路由交换方式、扩展吞吐量、整合站点或诊断故障隧道的情况。根据任务需求，参考正确的每项操作步骤。不适用于 AWS Direct Connect（其独立服务）、为单个远程用户提供的客户端 VPN、VPN 附加的传输网关端（传输网关技能）或 Route 53 DNS 工作场景。

name: why
description: Use for 'why does X work this way', 'why we picked Y', design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds. Discovers available MCPs and queries each evidence category (source control, issue tracker, long-form docs, real-time chat, infrastructure observability, error tracking, product analytics warehouse) in parallel, then returns a cited read on decisions and tradeoffs. Use how for runtime behavior.
description_zh: 用于解释“为什么X会这样工作”、“为什么我们选择了Y”，设计原理、回归测试、事后分析或数据驱动的阈值。它并行发现可用的MCPs，并查询每个证据类别（源代码控制、问题追踪器、长文档、实时聊天、基础设施可观测性、错误追踪、产品分析仓库），然后返回关于决策和权衡的引用性阅读。使用“如何”来解释运行时行为。

name: minimax-xlsx
description: Open, create, read, analyze, edit, or validate Excel/spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv). Use when the user asks to create, build, modify, analyze, read, validate, or format any Excel spreadsheet, financial model, pivot table, or tabular data file. Covers: creating new xlsx from scratch, reading and analyzing existing files, editing existing xlsx with zero format loss, formula recalculation and validation, and applying professional financial formatting standards. Triggers on 'spreadsheet', 'Excel', '.xlsx', '.csv', 'pivot table', 'financial model', 'formula', or any request to produce tabular data in Excel format.
description_zh: 打开、创建、读取、分析、编辑或验证 Excel/电子表格文件（.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv）。当用户要求创建、构建、修改、分析、读取、验证或格式化任何 Excel 电子表格、财务模型、数据透视表或表格数据文件时使用。涵盖：从零开始创建新的 xlsx 文件、读取和分析现有文件、编辑现有 xlsx 并保持零格式损失、公式重新计算和验证，以及应用专业的财务格式标准。在输入“电子表格”、“Excel”、“.xlsx”、“.csv”、“数据透视表”、“财务模型”、“公式”，或任何要求以 Excel 格式生成表格数据时触发。

name: template-skill
description: Replace with description of the skill and when Claude should use it.
description_zh: 替换为技能的描述以及Claude何时应使用它。

name: test-guard
description: Review generated or changed test code against universal testing rules before it ships. Best used reactively after an agent writes, edits, generates, or refactors tests, before presenting, committing, or merging them. Use for pytest (test_*.py, *_test.py), PHPUnit/Pest (*Test.php), Jest/Vitest (*.test.ts, *.spec.js), Go (*_test.go), files under tests/, __tests__/, or spec/, and review requests like 'write tests for X', 'add tests', 'test this', 'review these tests', or PR diffs containing tests. Can also guide test writing when explicitly invoked before the work. This skill is the quality gate that prevents AI-generated test bloat. DO NOT USE for production or implementation code review (use clean-code-guard), CI or test-runner configuration, running or debugging tests, or general architecture discussion.
description_zh: 在代码发布前，请对照通用测试规则审查生成的或修改的测试代码。最佳使用场景是代理（agent）编写、编辑、生成或重构测试后，在提交、提交或合并之前进行。适用于pytest（test_*.py、*_test.py）、PHPUnit/Pest（*Test.php）、Jest/Vitest（*.test.ts、*.spec.js）、Go（*_test.go）、tests/、__tests__/或spec/目录下的文件，以及类似“为X编写测试”、“添加测试”、“测试这个”、“审查这些测试”或包含测试的PR差异的审查请求。在明确调用前，也可用于指导测试编写。这项技能是防止AI生成测试冗余的质量关卡。**禁止**用于生产或实现代码审查（请使用clean-code-guard）、CI或测试运行器配置、运行或调试测试，或一般架构讨论。

name: accessibility-review
description: Run a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit on a design or page. Trigger with "audit accessibility", "check a11y", "is this accessible?", or when reviewing a design for color contrast, keyboard navigation, touch target size, or screen reader behavior before handoff.
description_zh: 对设计或页面进行 WCAG 2.1 AA 级无障碍性审核。可通过输入“audit accessibility”、“check a11y”、“is this accessible?”等指令触发，或在转交设计前，针对色度对比、键盘导航、触摸目标尺寸或屏幕阅读器行为进行审核。

name: video-spec-builder
description: 当用户说想做一个视频、宣传片、产品演示、动画短片、抖音/YouTube 内容，或者说要改分镜、调节奏、换镜头、调字幕、加配音、改转场时使用。通过苏格拉底式追问收集视频需求，主动激发渲染层的全部能力（TTS / 字幕 / 3D / shader / 音频反应等），输出标准化的 video-spec.md 用于渲染。

name: mutation-testing
description: Configures mewt or muton campaigns, analyzes surviving mutants, and investigates bugs exposed by testing gaps. Use when setting up mutation testing, reviewing campaign results, identifying equivalent mutants, or finding bugs from surviving mutations.
description_zh: 配置mewt或muton测试战役，分析存活变异体，并调查测试间隙暴露的缺陷。在设置变异测试、审查战役结果、识别等价变异体或从存活变异中查找缺陷时使用。

name: gpt-image-2-style-library
description: Choose GPT-Image2 / gpt-image-2 visual styles and industrial prompt templates from the awesome-gpt-image-2 style library. Use when an agent needs to create, rewrite, classify, or improve image-generation prompts with repository-backed templates, categories, style tags, scene tags, pitfalls, and example cases.
description_zh: 从 awesome-gpt-image-2 风格库中选择 GPT-Image2 / gpt-image-2 视觉风格和工业提示模板。当代理需要使用基于仓库的模板、分类、风格标签、场景标签、陷阱和示例案例来创建、重写、分类或改进图像生成提示时使用。

name: gke-workload-security
description: Audits, configures, and hardens workload-level security controls for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) applications and namespaces. Covers running security audits (`audit_cluster.sh`), enforcing Network Policies (default-deny and Dataplane V2 logging), isolating high-risk pods inside GKE Sandbox (`gVisor`), enforcing Pod Security Standards (`restricted` labeling) and pod securityContext, and mounting Secret Manager secrets via CSI (`SecretProviderClass`). Use when auditing workload security posture, isolating namespaces, applying pod security standards, or configuring network policies and secret volume mounts. Don't use for Workload Identity (use gke-workload-identity), cluster-wide control plane security, RBAC hardening, Binary Authorization, Shielded Nodes, or enabling platform-level GKE add-ons (use gke-platform-security instead).
description_zh: 审计、配置并加固 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 应用和命名空间的作业级安全控制。涵盖运行集群安全审计（`audit_cluster.sh`）、配置作业身份联合（模拟、KSA/GSA 绑定和 Pod 设置）、强制执行网络策略（默认拒绝和 Dataplane V2 日志记录）、在 GKE Sandbox（`gVisor`）中隔离高风险 Pod、强制执行 Pod 安全标准（`restricted` 标签）以及通过 CSI（`SecretProviderClass`）挂载 Secret Manager 秘密。在审计集群安全态势、隔离命名空间、应用 Pod 安全标准、设置作业身份或配置网络策略和秘密卷挂载时使用。不应用于集群范围的控制平面安全、RBAC 加固、二进制授权、受保护节点或启用平台级 GKE 插件（请使用 gke-platform-security）。

name: tanstack-pacer
description: Framework-agnostic debouncing, throttling, rate limiting, queuing, and batching utilities.
description_zh: 与框架无关的防抖、节流、速率限制、排队和批处理工具。

name: blast-radius
description: Find what a change could break somewhere else before it ships, beyond the diff, and prove the one fact it's safe because of by running real code instead of writing it up. Use for 'blast radius of X', 'what could this break', or reviewing a small diff you don't trust.
description_zh: 在软件发布前，通过代码审查等方式找出可能因变更而破坏其他部分的问题，并通过实际运行代码来验证变更的安全性，而不是仅仅通过代码差异分析。适用于评估“X的影响范围”、“这可能破坏什么”或审查你不信任的小代码差异。

name: ticket-availability
description: YES24 / 인터파크 공연의 공개 일정 + 등급별 잔여석을 단일 HTTP 호출로 조회 (조회 전용, 예매·결제 없음). 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.

name: 37signals-way
description: Build lean, opinionated products using the 37signals philosophy from "Getting Real", "Rework", and "Shape Up". Use when the user mentions "Getting Real", "Rework", "Shape Up", "37signals", "Basecamp method", "six-week cycles", "fixed time variable scope", "appetite vs estimates", "betting table", "breadboarding", "fat marker sketch", "build less", "underdo the competition", "opinionated software", "we have too many meetings", "how do we ship faster", or "stop overbuilding". Also trigger when cutting scope to ship sooner, running a small team, or avoiding long-term roadmaps. Covers shaping, betting, building, and the art of saying no. For MVP validation, see lean-startup. For design sprints, see design-sprint.
description_zh: 使用“真实获取”、“重新工作”和“快速成型”中的37signals哲学来构建精简、有主见的优质产品。当用户提到“真实获取”、“重新工作”、“快速成型”、“37signals”、“Basecamp方法”、“六周周期”、“固定时间可变范围”、“需求与估算”、“赌桌”、“快速原型设计”、“粗略草图”、“少做”、“超越竞争对手”、“有主见的软件”、“我们会议太多”、“如何更快地发布”或“停止过度建设”时，应触发此功能。此外，在缩减范围以更快发布、组建小团队或避免长期路线图时也会触发。涵盖塑造、赌注、构建以及拒绝的艺术。MVP验证请参考lean-startup，设计冲刺请参考design-sprint。

name: ads-creative
description: Audit paid-ad copy, images, video, hooks, concepts, format coverage, platform-native fit, message match, creative fatigue, accessibility, and policy across supported platforms. Use for creative audit, ad creative, creative fatigue, creative diversity, ad copy review, video review, image review, or production priorities.
description_zh: 审核付费广告文案、图片、视频、钩子、概念、格式覆盖、平台原生适配性、信息匹配度、创意疲劳度、可访问性以及支持平台上的政策。用于创意审核、广告创意、创意疲劳度、创意多样性、广告文案审查、视频审查、图片审查或生产优先级。

description:
Technical analysis frameworks — candlestick patterns, Ichimoku cloud, technical indicators (RSI/MACD/EMA/Bollinger), harmonic patterns (Gartley/Bat/Butterfly/Crab), Elliott Wave, Chan Theory (缠论 bi/zhongshu/buy-sell points), Smart Money Concepts (BOS/FVG/Order Block), and Turtle Trading signals with ATR/Unit position sizing.

description_zh:
技术分析框架——K线形态、一目均衡表、技术指标（RSI/MACD/EMA/布林带）、谐波形态（加特莱/蝙蝠/蝴蝶/蟹）、艾略特波浪、缠论（分型/笔/中枢/买卖点）、Smart Money概念（BOS/FVG/订单块）以及结合ATR/单位进行头寸规模的海龟交易信号。

name: market-news-analyst
description: This skill should be used when analyzing recent market-moving news events and their impact on equity markets and commodities. Use this skill when the user requests analysis of major financial news from the past 10 days, wants to understand market reactions to monetary policy decisions (FOMC, ECB, BOJ), needs assessment of geopolitical events' impact on commodities, or requires comprehensive review of earnings announcements from mega-cap stocks. The skill automatically collects news using WebSearch/WebFetch tools and produces impact-ranked analysis reports. All analysis thinking and output are conducted in English.
description_zh: 这项技能应在分析近期影响市场的新闻事件及其对股票市场和商品的影响时使用。当用户请求分析过去10天内的重大财经新闻、需要了解市场对货币政策决定（FOMC、ECB、BOJ）的反应、需要评估地缘政治事件对商品的影响，或需要全面回顾大型股票的盈利公告时，应使用此技能。该技能会自动使用WebSearch/WebFetch工具收集新闻，并生成影响排名的分析报告。所有分析思考和输出均以英语进行。

name: tavily-search
description: Tavily AI search API - Optimized search for AI agents. Use when searching the web for current information, news, facts, or any task requiring real-time data.

name: swiftui-gestures
description: Implement, review, or improve SwiftUI gesture handling. Use when adding tap, long press, drag, magnify, or rotate gestures, composing gestures with simultaneously/sequenced/exclusively, managing transient state with @GestureState, resolving parent/child gesture conflicts with highPriorityGesture or simultaneousGesture, building custom Gesture protocol conformances, or migrating from deprecated MagnificationGesture to MagnifyGesture or using the newer RotateGesture.
description_zh: 实现、审查或改进 SwiftUI 手势处理。在添加点击、长按、拖动、放大或旋转手势时使用，组合同时/顺序/互斥手势，使用 @GestureState 管理瞬时状态，使用 highPriorityGesture 或 simultaneousGesture 解决父/子手势冲突，构建自定义 Gesture 协议遵循，或从已弃用的 MagnificationGesture 迁移到 MagnifyGesture，或使用更新的 RotateGesture。

name: unit-test-boundary-conditions
description: Provides edge case, corner case, boundary condition, and limit testing patterns for Java unit tests. Validates minimum/maximum values, null cases, empty collections, numeric overflow/underflow, floating-point precision, and off-by-one scenarios using JUnit 5 and AssertJ. Use when writing .java test files to ensure code handles limits, corner cases, and special inputs correctly.
description_zh: 为 Java 单元测试提供边界情况、极端情况、边界条件和极限测试模式。使用 JUnit 5 和 AssertJ 验证最小/最大值、空值情况、空集合、数值溢出/下溢、浮点精度以及偏差为 1 的场景。在编写 .java 测试文件时使用，以确保代码正确处理极限、极端情况和特殊输入。

name: widgetkit
description: Implement, review, or improve WidgetKit widgets and controls. Use when building Home Screen, Lock Screen, StandBy, or CarPlay widgets with timeline providers; configurable widgets with AppIntentTimelineProvider; interactive widgets or Control Center controls with Button/Toggle wiring; WidgetKit push reloads, refresh budgets, deep links, Smart Stack relevance, Liquid Glass/accented rendering, widget extension setup, WidgetBundle, App Groups, and entitlements.
description_zh: 实现、审查或改进 WidgetKit 组件和控件。在构建带有时间线提供者的主屏幕、锁屏、待机或 CarPlay 组件时使用；配置带有 AppIntentTimelineProvider 的可配置组件；使用 Button/Toggle 连接实现交互式组件或控制中心控件；WidgetKit 推送重新加载、刷新预算、深度链接、智能堆栈相关性、Liquid Glass/强调渲染、组件扩展设置、WidgetBundle、App Groups 和权限。

name: ui-design
description: Use this to design a nice UI in single html as inspiration & UI exploration.
description_zh: 使用此方法在单个HTML文件中设计一个美观的UI，作为灵感和UI探索的参考。

name: turborepo-monorepo
description: Provides comprehensive Turborepo monorepo management guidance for TypeScript/JavaScript projects. Use when creating Turborepo workspaces, configuring turbo.json tasks, setting up Next.js/NestJS apps, managing test pipelines (Vitest/Jest), configuring CI/CD, implementing remote caching, or optimizing build performance in monorepos
description_zh: 为 TypeScript/JavaScript 项目提供全面的 Turborepo 单体仓库管理指南。在创建 Turborepo 工作区、配置 turbo.json 任务、设置 Next.js/NestJS 应用、管理测试流程（Vitest/Jest）、配置 CI/CD、实现远程缓存或优化单体仓库的构建性能时使用。

name: ads-competitor

Use for competitor ads, ad libraries, ad spy, competitive PPC analysis, competitor creative, Google Ads Transparency, Meta Ad Library, or paid-media competitor research.

name: find-skills
description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
description_zh: 帮助用户在询问“如何做X”、“寻找一个用于X的技能”、“有没有一个技能可以...”或表达对扩展功能的兴趣时，发现并安装代理技能。当用户正在寻找可能以可安装技能形式存在的功能时，应使用此技能。

name: frost-sequence-camera-orbit
description: An orbiting camera follows an ice logo as it breaks apart, reforms into two text moments, and fades. HyperFrames block, 1920×1080, 22.5s, 216 variables.
description_zh: 一个环绕的摄像机跟随一个冰晶标志，它分解、重新组合成两个文字时刻，然后逐渐淡出。HyperFrames画面，1920×1080，22.5秒，216个变量。

name: oh-my-issues
description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.
description_zh: 将 GitHub 问题积压按根本原因进行聚类，形成少量计划主问题，用标准化的评论重定向子问题，并将架构修复的 PR 原子化地关闭聚类。适用于以下情况：当问题追踪器积累了数十个共享底层缺陷的报告时；当被要求进行问题筛选/合并/聚类/去重时；当被要求从开放问题中构建计划系列或路线图时；或当将新接收的 Bug 分流到现有计划中时。

name: weekly-digests
description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.
description_zh: 生成项目完整 claude-mem 时间线的每周连续叙事摘要。将时间线按 ISO 周分割成单独文件，然后每周运行一个连续的子代理——每个子代理接收前一周的延续数据块——以生成每周的数据章节。在要求“每周摘要”、“每周故事”、“连续时间线”或“叙事章节”的项目历史时使用。

name: app-observability
description: Get RED metrics + service maps + frontend RUM + AI/LLM monitoring out of Grafana Cloud — Application Observability (`traces_spanmetrics_*` from OTel traces, p50/p95/p99 latency, exemplar-to-trace, traces-to-logs / profiles), Frontend Observability with the Faro Web SDK (Core Web Vitals, session replay, `pushError`, React + router integration, `TracingInstrumentation` for browser → backend trace correlation), and AI Observability via OpenLIT (token / cost / latency, GPU, hallucination + toxicity evals). Use when standing up APM for a service, wiring an Alloy OTLP receiver + forwarding to Cloud, instrumenting a React frontend for RUM, debugging why service-map edges are missing, monitoring LLM cost drift, or correlating a frontend error to its backend trace — even when the user says "set up APM", "show service map", "monitor browser perf", "session replay", "RUM SDK", or "watch our OpenAI bill" without naming App / Frontend / AI Observability.
description_zh: 从 Grafana Cloud 中获取 RED 指标、服务地图、前端 RUM 和 AI/LLM 监控——应用可观测性（来自 OpenTelemetry 跟踪的 `traces_spanmetrics_*`、p50/p95/p99 延迟、示例到跟踪、跟踪到日志/配置文件）、使用 Faro Web SDK 的前端可观测性（核心网络指标、会话回放、`pushError`、React + 路由集成、`TracingInstrumentation` 用于浏览器到后端跟踪关联），以及通过 OpenLIT 的 AI 可观测性（令牌/成本/延迟、GPU、幻觉和毒性评估）。在以下情况下使用：为服务部署 APM、将 Alloy OTLP 接收器连接并转发到云端、为 RUM 仪器化 React 前端、调试服务地图边缘缺失问题、监控 LLM 成本漂移，或关联前端错误与其后端跟踪——即使用户说“设置 APM”、“显示服务地图”、“监控浏览器性能”、“会话回放”、“RUM SDK”或“关注我们的 OpenAI 账单”而没有提及应用/前端/AI 可观测性。

name: avoid-ai-writing
description: Audit and rewrite content to remove AI writing patterns ("AI-isms"). Use this skill when asked to "remove AI-isms," "clean up AI writing," "edit writing for AI patterns," "audit writing for AI tells," or "make this sound less like AI." Supports a detect-only mode, an edit-in-place mode for files, an optional voice profile (casual / professional / technical / warm / blunt), and an iterate-to-convergence pass.
description_zh: 审计并重写内容以消除AI写作模式（“AI-isms”）。当被要求“消除AI-isms”、“清理AI写作”、“编辑针对AI模式的写作”、“审计针对AI特征的写作”或“让内容听起来不那么像AI”时，使用此技能。支持仅检测模式、文件就地编辑模式、可选的语音配置文件（休闲/专业/技术/温暖/直率）以及迭代收敛过程。

name: physics-tuning
description: Tune game physics for stable, good-feeling motion — fixed vs variable timestep, render interpolation, mass/gravity/drag, continuous collision detection (CCD) to stop tunneling, fixing jitter, and collision layers/masks. Engine-neutral. Use when the user mentions physics feel, jitter, tunneling, fixed timestep, FixedUpdate, CCD, bouncing/unstable physics, or collision layers.
description_zh: 为游戏物理调优，以实现稳定且流畅的运动效果——固定步长与可变步长、渲染插值、质量/重力/阻力、连续碰撞检测（CCD）以防止隧道效应、消除抖动，以及碰撞层/掩码。引擎无关。当用户提及物理感觉、抖动、隧道效应、固定步长、FixedUpdate、CCD、弹跳/不稳定物理或碰撞层时使用。

name: swift-charts
description: Implement, review, or improve data visualizations using Swift Charts. Use when building bar, line, area, point, pie, donut, or iOS 26 3D charts; when adding chart selection, scrolling, annotations, axes, scales, legends, or foregroundStyle grouping; when plotting functions with BarPlot, LinePlot, AreaPlot, PointPlot, Chart3D, or SurfacePlot; or when creating heat maps, Gantt charts, grouped bars, sparklines, threshold lines, or spatial visualizations.
description_zh: 使用 Swift Charts 实现、审查或改进数据可视化。适用于构建条形图、折线图、面积图、点图、饼图、环形图或 iOS 26 3D 图表；在添加图表选择、滚动、注释、坐标轴、刻度、图例或前景样式分组时使用；在用 BarPlot、LinePlot、AreaPlot、PointPlot、Chart3D 或 SurfacePlot 绘制函数时使用；或在创建热力图、甘特图、分组条形图、火花线图、阈值线或空间可视化时使用。

name: initialize-ai-navigation
description: Sets up and configures Unity AI Navigation, including NavMesh surfaces, agents, obstacles, and links. Use when the user asks about navigation meshes, pathfinding, patrol routes, or obstacle avoidance.
description_zh: 设置和配置 Unity AI 导航，包括 NavMesh 表面、智能体、障碍物和路径链接。当用户询问关于导航网格、路径查找、巡逻路线或障碍物避让时使用。

name: swift-language
description: Apply modern Swift language patterns and idioms for non-concurrency, non-SwiftUI code. Covers if/switch expressions (Swift 5.9+), typed throws (Swift 6+), result builders, property wrappers, opaque and existential types (some vs any), guard patterns, Never type, Regex builders (Swift 5.7+), basic Codable shaping (CodingKeys, custom decoding, nested containers), modern collection APIs (count(where:), contains(where:), replacing()), basic FormatStyle usage, and string interpolation patterns. Use when writing core Swift code involving generics, protocols, enums, closures, or modern language features; route deep Codable to swift-codable, detailed formatting/localization to swift-formatstyle, and API naming to swift-api-design-guidelines.
description_zh: 使用现代 Swift 语言模式和惯用法来编写非并发、非 SwiftUI 代码。涵盖 if/switch 表达式（Swift 5.9+）、带类型错误的 throws（Swift 6+）、结果构建器、属性包装器、模糊类型和存在类型（some vs any）、guard 模式、Never 类型、正则表达式构建器（Swift 5.7+）、基本 Codable 结构（CodingKeys、自定义解码、嵌套容器）、现代集合 API（count(where:)、contains(where:)、replacing()）、基本 FormatStyle 使用以及字符串插值模式。适用于编写涉及泛型、协议、枚举、闭包或现代语言特性的核心 Swift 代码；将深度 Codable 路由到 swift-codable，详细格式化/本地化路由到 swift-formatstyle，API 命名路由到 swift-api-design-guidelines。

name: html-diagram
description: Direct-invocation specialist for self-contained HTML diagrams whose layout, notation, and interaction clarify relationships, sequence, topology, state, hierarchy, or quantitative structure. Use when the user explicitly invokes html-diagram or the broad html skill routes a diagram request here. Do not activate independently from a general request.
description_zh: 直接调用专家，用于自包含的HTML图表，其布局、符号和交互能够清晰展示关系、顺序、拓扑、状态、层次或定量结构。当用户明确调用html-diagram，或广泛的html技能将图表请求导向此处时使用。不要从一般请求中独立激活。

name: cloud-logging-configuration-basics
description: Configure single-project Google Cloud Logging: regional log buckets, log sinks, log views, restricting or hiding sensitive logs in the default view (_Default) filter, IAM permissions for views (Logs View Accessor, IAM conditions), logs-based metrics, log exclusions, and sampling. Don't use for cross-project logging or multi-project setups.
description_zh: 配置单个项目的 Google Cloud Logging：区域日志桶、日志接收器、日志视图、在默认视图 (_Default) 过滤器中限制或隐藏敏感日志、视图的 IAM 权限（日志视图访问者、IAM 条件）、基于日志的指标、日志排除和采样。不适用于跨项目日志记录或多项目设置。

name: optimize-web
description: Optimizes Unity WebGL and WebGPU builds for smaller downloads and faster load. Use when a web build is too large or stutters, or the user asks about compression, stripping, shader variants, or web profiling.
description_zh: 优化 Unity WebGL 和 WebGPU 构建的下载体积和加载速度。当 Web 构建文件过大或出现卡顿时，或用户询问关于压缩、剥离、着色器变体或 Web 性能分析时使用。

name: domain-modeling
description: 构建并打磨项目的领域模型。适用于讨论 codebase 术语、编写或编辑 CONTEXT.md，或记录或编辑 ADR。
description_zh: 构建并完善项目的领域模型。适用于讨论代码库术语、编写或编辑 CONTEXT.md，或记录或编辑 ADR。

name: clawhub
description: Search ClawHub for skills when a requested capability is not already available; install, verify, update, uninstall, publish, or sync skills.
description_zh: 当所需功能尚未可用时，在ClawHub中搜索技能；安装、验证、更新、卸载、发布或同步技能。

name: web-design-guidelines
description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance by the Vercel engineering team. Covers layout, typography, color, motion, and accessibility for product UI.
description_zh: 请Vercel工程团队审查Web界面指南的UI代码合规性。涵盖布局、排版、颜色、动效和产品UI的可访问性。

name: ask-matt
description: 询问当前情境适合哪个技能或流程；它是本仓库所有 skills 的路由器。
description_zh: 询问当前情境适合哪个技能或流程；它是本仓库所有技能的路由器。

name: raw-video-processing
description: Post-process raw screen recordings by removing silent segments and applying speed adjustments. Uses FFmpeg-based Python scripts to optimize video pacing automatically.
description_zh: 对原始屏幕录制视频进行后处理，通过移除静音片段和应用速度调整来优化。使用基于FFmpeg的Python脚本自动优化视频节奏。

name: graphql-architect
description: Use when designing GraphQL schemas, implementing Apollo Federation, or building real-time subscriptions. Invoke for schema design, resolvers with DataLoader, query optimization, federation directives.
description_zh: 在设计 GraphQL 模式、实现 Apollo Federation 或构建实时订阅时使用。用于模式设计、带有 DataLoader 的解析器、查询优化、联邦指令。

name: code-review
description: 从固定点（commit、branch、tag 或 merge-base）开始，按 Standards（代码是否符合本仓库记录的编码标准？）和 Spec（代码是否符合来源 issue/spec 的要求？）两个轴线审查变更。两个审查会在并行子代理中运行，并并排报告。适用于用户想审查 branch、PR、进行中的变更，或要求“review since X”时。
description_zh: 从固定点（commit、branch、tag 或 merge-base）开始，沿 Standards（代码是否符合本仓库记录的编码标准？）和 Spec（代码是否符合来源 issue/spec 的要求？）两个维度审查变更。两个审查将在并行子代理中并行运行，并同步报告结果。适用于用户需要审查 branch、PR、进行中的变更，或要求“自 X 时间以来的审查”时。

name: ce-brainstorm
description: Explore vague or ambitious ideas into a right-sized requirements-only unified plan. Use when the user wants to brainstorm or scope what to build. Not for executing already-specified work. Use ce-pov for a verdict on adopting a named external technology.
description_zh: 将模糊或雄心勃勃的想法探索成一个规模适中的、仅包含需求的统一计划。当用户想要进行头脑风暴或确定要构建的内容范围时使用。不适用于执行已明确指定的工作。对于对采用命名的外部技术做出裁决，请使用ce-pov。

name: langchain-python-quickstart
description: Scaffold a minimal local LangChain agent in Python by following the official quickstart. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a LangChain agent locally.
description_zh: 通过遵循官方快速入门指南，用Python搭建一个最小的本地LangChain代理。当用户希望快速在本地构建或尝试LangChain代理时使用。

name: ontology
description: Typed knowledge graph for structured agent memory and composable skills. Use when creating/querying entities (Person, Project, Task, Event, Document), linking related objects, enforcing constraints, planning multi-step actions as graph transformations, or when skills need to share state. Trigger on "remember", "what do I know about", "link X to Y", "show dependencies", entity CRUD, or cross-skill data access.
description_zh: 用于结构化代理记忆和可组合技能的文本知识图谱。在创建/查询实体（Person、Project、Task、Event、Document）、链接相关对象、执行约束、规划多步行动作为图转换，或技能需要共享状态时使用。在“记住”、“我了解什么”、“将X链接到Y”、“显示依赖关系”、“实体CRUD”或跨技能数据访问时触发。

name: video-to-gif
description: Convert a video to multiple GIF variants with different quality/size tradeoffs. Generates a comparison set so the user can visually pick the best result.
description_zh: 将视频转换为多个具有不同质量/尺寸权衡的GIF变体。生成一个比较集，以便用户可以直观地选择最佳结果。

name: pwa-development
description: Progressive Web Apps - service workers, caching strategies, offline, Workbox
description_zh: 渐进式 Web 应用 - Service Workers、缓存策略、离线、Workbox

name: spring-boot-openapi-documentation
description: Provides patterns to generate comprehensive REST API documentation using SpringDoc OpenAPI 3.0 and Swagger UI in Spring Boot 3.x applications. Use when setting up API documentation, configuring Swagger UI, adding OpenAPI annotations, implementing security documentation, or enhancing REST endpoints with examples and schemas.
description_zh: 提供模式，用于在 Spring Boot 3.x 应用程序中使用 SpringDoc OpenAPI 3.0 和 Swagger UI 生成全面的 REST API 文档。在设置 API 文档、配置 Swagger UI、添加 OpenAPI 注解、实现安全文档或使用示例和模式增强 REST 端点时使用。

name: provider-actions
description: Implement Terraform Provider actions using the Plugin Framework. Use when developing imperative operations that execute at lifecycle events (before/after create, update, destroy).
description_zh: 使用插件框架实现 Terraform 提供者操作。在开发需要在生命周期事件（创建前/后、更新前/后、销毁前/后）执行的命令式操作时使用。

name: ads-audit
description: Run a source-grounded paid-advertising audit for one or more of Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, and X. Use for full ad checks, account health reviews, paid-media diagnostics, partial audits after authentication or worker failure, missing-platform weighting, beta-feature eligibility and scoring, spend audits, tracking audits, or prioritized opportunities and risks.
description_zh: 对 Google、Meta、YouTube、LinkedIn、TikTok、Microsoft、Apple、Amazon、Reddit、Pinterest、Snapchat 和 X 中的一个或多个进行基于来源的广告审计。用于全面广告检查、账户健康状况评估、付费媒体诊断、认证或工作失败后的部分审计、缺失平台权重、Beta 功能资格和评分、支出审计、跟踪审计，或优先级机会和风险。

name: maishou
description: 商品价格全网对比技能，获取商品在淘宝(Taobao)、天猫(TMall)、京东(JD.com)、拼多多(PinDuoDuo)、抖音(Douyin)、快手(KaiShou)的最优价格、优惠券，当用户想购物或者获取优惠信息时使用。Get the best price, coupons for goods on Chinese e-commerce platforms, compare product prices, and use when users want to shop or get discount information.
description_zh: 全网比价商品技能，获取商品在淘宝（Taobao）、天猫（TMall）、京东（JD.com）、拼多多（PinDuoDuo）、抖音（Douyin）、快手（KaiShou）的最优价格、优惠券，当用户想购物或获取优惠信息时使用。获取中国电商平台上商品的最佳价格、优惠券，比较商品价格，并在用户想购物或获取折扣信息时使用。

name: jupyter-notebook-writing
description: Write Milvus application-level Jupyter notebook examples using a Markdown-first workflow with jupyter-switch for format conversion.
description_zh: 使用 Markdown 优先的工作流程和 jupyter-switch 进行格式转换，编写 Milvus 应用级别的 Jupyter 笔记本示例。

name: diagnosing-bugs
description: 面向棘手缺陷和性能回退的诊断循环。适用于用户说 “diagnose” / “debug this”，或报告某些东西 broken、throwing、failing、slow 时。
description_zh: 针对棘手缺陷和性能回退的诊断循环。适用于用户说“诊断”/“调试这个”，或报告某些东西损坏、抛出异常、失败、缓慢时。

name: new-terraform-provider
description: Use this when scaffolding a new Terraform provider with the Plugin Framework: workspace layout, go module setup, provider server main.go, and a provider.go with schema and Configure. Also use when a user wants to start building a provider for a new API or asks how to begin a terraform-provider-* project.
description_zh: 在使用插件框架搭建新的 Terraform 提供者时使用：工作区布局、Go 模块设置、提供者服务器 main.go，以及包含 schema 和 Configure 的 provider.go。当用户想要开始为新的 API 构建 provider 或询问如何开始 terraform-provider-* 项目时，也使用。

name: app-intents
description: Implement App Intents for Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, widgets, Control Center, and Apple Intelligence on iOS. Covers AppIntent actions, AppEntity and EntityQuery models, AppShortcutsProvider phrases, IndexedEntity Spotlight indexing, WidgetConfigurationIntent, SnippetIntent, and assistant schemas. Use when exposing app actions or entities to system surfaces.
description_zh: 在 iOS 上为 Siri、快捷指令、Spotlight、小组件、控制中心和 Apple 智能实现 App Intents。涵盖 AppIntent 动作、AppEntity 和 EntityQuery 模型、AppShortcutsProvider 短语、IndexedEntity Spotlight 索引、WidgetConfigurationIntent、SnippetIntent 和助手架构。在将应用动作或实体暴露给系统界面时使用。

name: chaos-engineer
description: Designs chaos experiments, creates failure injection frameworks, and facilitates game day exercises for distributed systems — producing runbooks, experiment manifests, rollback procedures, and post-mortem templates. Use when designing chaos experiments, implementing failure injection frameworks, or conducting game day exercises. Invoke for chaos experiments, resilience testing, blast radius control, game days, antifragile systems, fault injection, Chaos Monkey, Litmus Chaos.
description_zh: 设计混沌实验，创建故障注入框架，并促进分布式系统的游戏日演练——生成运行手册、实验清单、回滚程序和事后分析模板。在设计混沌实验、实施故障注入框架或进行游戏日演练时使用。用于混沌实验、弹性测试、影响范围控制、游戏日、反脆弱系统、故障注入、混沌猴、Litmus Chaos。

name: shader-programming
description: Write game shaders from cross-engine fundamentals — the vertex→fragment pipeline, coordinate spaces, UV math, and common 2D/3D effects (tint, UV scroll, dissolve, outline, fresnel rim, vignette) in GLSL with HLSL equivalents. Use when the user mentions shaders, fragment/pixel shader, vertex shader, UV, GLSL, HLSL, or effects like dissolve, outline, or rim light.
description_zh: 从跨引擎基础编写游戏着色器——顶点→片元管线、坐标系、UV数学以及常见的2D/3D效果（染色、UV滚动、溶解、轮廓、菲涅尔边缘、暗角），使用GLSL编写并附带HLSL等价代码。当用户提及着色器、片元/像素着色器、顶点着色器、UV、GLSL、HLSL，或溶解、轮廓、边缘光等效果时使用。

name: deepagents-python-quickstart
description: Scaffold a minimal local Deep Agent in Python by following the official quickstart, using provider-native web search instead of Tavily. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a Deep Agent locally.
description_zh: 通过遵循官方快速入门指南，使用本地原生网络搜索代替Tavily，在Python中搭建一个最小的本地深度代理。当用户希望快速在本地构建或尝试深度代理时使用。

name: korean-cinema-search
description: CGV, 메가박스, 롯데시네마 영화관 검색, 상영작, 시간표, 잔여석 조회가 필요할 때 사용한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当需要搜索CGV、메가박스、롯데시네마电影院、上映作品、时间表、剩余座位时使用。在돌쇠中，通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: software-architecture

name: gmgn-token-buy
description: Turn a token name into a vetted, sized buy order. Two things here are exclusive to this skill: resolving a NAME or symbol to the one right contract among its copycats, and sizing an order — amount, slippage, gas, position. No sibling does either. USE THIS SKILL WHEN a buy is being prepared, which shows up as a NAME or symbol, or an AMOUNT, or both — including the plainest possible ask with no mention of checking: 我想买 200u 的 PENGU, 帮我买 500 刀的 BONK, 买 1 个 SOL 的 WIF, 帮我买点 dogwifhat, 想梭 100u 的 XX, PENGU 现在能买吗, PENGU 能不能买, 能不能冲, 值不值得进, 确认是正主不是仿盘再买, buy me $500 of PENGU — and including a bare contract address once an amount arrives with it. DO NOT USE THIS SKILL for a bare contract address with no name to resolve and no amount to size (「这个地址能不能买」, 打个分, 尽调, 有没有貔貅, rug check, is this token safe): that one belongs to gmgn-contract-dd, which is the skill that returns the 0-100 safety verdict. This skill never computes a second verdict of its own — it CALLS gmgn-contract-dd and defers to it — so there is nothing to gain by taking that ask, and the user gets an order card they never asked for. Come back here the moment they name an amount. A buy question about a LAUNCHER rather than about a token — 「这个 dev 的新盘能不能买」, 「他下一个盘值不值得冲」, "should I buy his next launch", "will this dev rug at open" — is gmgn-dev-score: it scores the creator's own record, and there is no token name to resolve or amount to size yet. Come back here once they name the coin. Naming a token with no buy intent at all is gmgn-market search. gmgn-swap is where this skill ENDS, not a rival for it: gmgn-swap signs and submits, and this skill never touches a private key and never places an order, so a plain buy request starts HERE and reaches gmgn-swap only after the user confirms the order card. Note that gmgn-swap cannot start from a name either — its --output-token is a contract address and the only names it resolves are the currencies SOL/BNB/ETH/USDC — so 帮我买点 dogwifhat has to come here regardless of who is asked. Go straight to gmgn-swap only when the user says the pre-buy check is unwanted (skip the checks, 直接买, 不用尽调, 我很急), or for what this skill does not do at all: selling, percentage sells, limit orders, stop loss, take profit, trailing orders, multi-wallet batch trading, order status, gas-price lookups. The split is by what the ask still needs done, not by who executes: a name needs resolving and an amount needs sizing, so both start here; a bare address needs only a verdict, so it is gmgn-contract-dd's; a signed transaction is always gmgn-swap's.
description_zh: 将代币名称转换为经过审核、确定规模的买入订单。这里有两点是此技能独有的：将名称或符号解析为正确的合约，以及确定订单规模——金额、滑点、燃料费、仓位。没有其他技能能做这两件事。当准备买入时使用此技能，这时会以名称或符号、金额或两者都出现——包括最简单的询价，无需提及审核：我想买200u的PENGU，帮我买500刀的BONK，买1个SOL的WIF，帮我买点dogwifhat，想梭100u的XX，PENGU现在能买吗，PENGU能不能买，能不能冲，值不值得进，确认是正主不是仿盘再买，buy me $500 of PENGU——以及当金额出现时，会附带一个裸合约地址。不要使用此技能来处理没有名称解析需求且没有金额确定需求的裸合约地址（「这个地址能不能买」，打个分，尽调，有没有貔貅，rug check，这个代币安全吗）：那属于gmgn-contract-dd技能，它是返回0-100安全评级的技能。此技能从不自行计算第二个评级——它调用gmgn-contract-dd并委派给它——所以接受这个询价没有好处，用户会得到他们从未要求的订单卡。一旦他们指定金额，立刻回到这里。关于启动器（LAUNCHER）而非代币的买入问题——「这个dev的新盘能不能买」，「他下一个盘值不值得冲」，"should I buy his next launch"，"will this dev rug at open"——属于gmgn-dev-score：它评分创作者的自身记录，目前还没有代币名称需要解析或金额需要确定。一旦他们指定代币，关于完全没有买入意向的代币命名属于gmgn-market search。gmgn-swap是此技能的终点，而非它的竞争对手：gmgn-swap签名并提交，而此技能从不接触私钥也从不下单，所以普通的买入请求从这里开始，只有用户确认订单卡后才会到达gmgn-swap。注意gmgn-swap也不能从名称开始——它的--output-token是合约地址，它唯一解析的名称是货币SOL/BNB/ETH/USDC——所以「帮我买点dogwifhat」无论询问对象是谁都必须先到这里。只有当用户表示不想进行预购检查（跳过检查，直接买，不用尽调，我很急），或此技能完全不做的事情：卖出、百分比卖出、限价单、止损、止盈、跟踪单、多钱包批量交易、订单状态、燃料费查询时，才直接跳转到gmgn-swap。划分依据是询价仍需完成的工作，而非执行者：名称需要解析，金额需要确定，所以两者从这里开始；裸地址只需要评级，所以属于gmgn-contract-dd；已签名的交易始终属于gmgn-swap。

name: code-obfuscation-deobfuscation
description: Code obfuscation analysis and deobfuscation playbook. Use when reversing binaries protected by junk code, opaque predicates, self-modifying code, control flow flattening, VM protection, or string encryption.
description_zh: 代码混淆分析与反混淆手册。在逆向分析受垃圾代码、不透明谓词、自修改代码、控制流扁平化、虚拟机保护或字符串加密保护的二进制文件时使用。

name: dialogue-systems
description: Build branching dialogue and narrative — a node/choice graph with conditions, variables, and localization hooks — and choose between authoring tools Ink and Yarn Spinner or a custom data-driven runner. Engine-neutral. Use when the user mentions dialogue system, branching dialogue, conversation tree, choices, Ink (.ink), Yarn Spinner (.yarn), or NPC dialogue.
description_zh: 构建分支对话和叙事——一个带有条件、变量和本地化钩子的节点/选择图——并选择使用Ink或Yarn Spinner等创作工具，或自定义数据驱动运行器。引擎无关。当用户提到对话系统、分支对话、对话树、选择、Ink (.ink)、Yarn Spinner (.yarn) 或NPC对话时使用。

name: langchain-typescript-quickstart
description: Scaffold a minimal local LangChain agent in TypeScript by following the official quickstart. Use when the user wants to quickly build or try a LangChain agent locally.
description_zh: 通过遵循官方的快速入门指南，用TypeScript搭建一个最小的本地LangChain代理。当用户希望快速在本地构建或尝试LangChain代理时使用。

name: ads-budget
description: Plan and review paid-media budgets, bidding, pacing, marginal return, forecasts, CPA, ROAS, MER, LTV:CAC, constraints, and allocation across supported platforms. Use for ad budget allocation, media budget, bidding strategy, scaling, spend pacing, budget forecast, ROAS target, or investment tradeoffs.
description_zh: 制定和审核付费媒体预算、竞价、节奏、边际回报、预测、CPA、ROAS、MER、LTV:CAC、限制条件以及跨支持平台的分配。用于广告预算分配、媒体预算、竞价策略、扩展、支出节奏、预算预测、ROAS目标或投资权衡。

name: database-observability
description: Set up Grafana Cloud Database Observability for MySQL and PostgreSQL — enables `pg_stat_statements` / Performance Schema, creates a least-privilege monitoring user, configures the `database_observability.postgres` / `database_observability.mysql` Alloy components, ships query samples + visual explain plans + RED metrics + schema details to Grafana Cloud, and correlates slow queries with application traces via `db.statement` / `db.system` OTel attributes. Use when monitoring database performance, diagnosing slow queries, setting up DB observability for RDS / Aurora / Cloud SQL / Azure Database / self-managed instances, correlating DB metrics with APM, or alerting on query latency — even when the user says "my database is slow", "find the slow queries", or "monitor RDS" without saying "observability".
description_zh: 设置 Grafana Cloud 数据库可观测性功能以用于 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL — 启用 `pg_stat_statements` / 性能模式，创建最小权限监控用户，配置 `database_observability.postgres` / `database_observability.mysql` Alloy 组件，将查询示例 + 可视化执行计划 + RED 指标 + 模式详情发送至 Grafana Cloud，并通过 `db.statement` / `db.system` OTel 属性将慢查询与应用程序追踪关联。适用于监控数据库性能、诊断慢查询、为 RDS / Aurora / Cloud SQL / Azure Database / 自管实例设置数据库可观测性、将数据库指标与 APM 关联，或在查询延迟时触发告警 — 即使用户说“我的数据库慢了”、“找出慢查询”或“监控 RDS”，而未提及“可观测性”。

name: computer-vision-opencv
description: Expert guidance for computer vision development using OpenCV, PyTorch, and modern deep learning techniques for image and video processing.
description_zh: 使用OpenCV、PyTorch以及现代深度学习技术进行图像和视频处理的计算机视觉开发专家指导。

name: codebase-design
description: 用于设计深模块的共享词汇。适用于用户想设计或改进模块接口、寻找深化机会、决定 seam 放在哪里、让代码更容易测试或更适合 AI 导航，或其他技能需要深模块词汇时。
description_zh: 用于设计深模块的共享词汇。适用于用户想设计或改进模块接口、寻找深化机会、决定 seam 放在哪里、让代码更容易测试或更适合 AI 导航，或其他技能需要深模块词汇时。

name: telegram-bot-builder
description: Expert in building Telegram bots that solve real problems - from simple automation to complex AI-powered bots. Covers bot architecture, the Telegram Bot API, user experience, monetization strategies, and scaling bots to thousands of users.
description_zh: 精通构建解决实际问题的Telegram机器人——从简单的自动化到复杂的AI驱动型机器人。涵盖机器人架构、Telegram Bot API、用户体验、盈利策略以及扩展机器人至数千用户。

name: ads-plan
description: Create a professional paid-advertising strategy covering objectives, economics, platform selection, campaign architecture, audiences, budget, creative, measurement, experiments, governance, rollout, and reporting. Use for ad plan, media plan, PPC strategy, paid-social strategy, campaign architecture, advertising roadmap, or channel planning.
description_zh: 制定一个专业的付费广告策略，涵盖目标、经济性、平台选择、活动架构、受众、预算、创意、衡量、实验、治理、上线和报告。适用于广告计划、媒体计划、PPC策略、付费社交策略、活动架构、广告路线图或渠道规划。

name: ui-designer
description: Craft one-of-a-kind, ship-ready frontend interfaces with elevated design quality. Apply this skill whenever the user wants to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (for example, websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or any task that involves styling or beautifying a web UI). Produces inventive, refined code and UI design that sidesteps cookie-cutter AI aesthetics.

name: transcribe
description: Transcribe audio files to text with optional diarization and known-speaker hints. Use when a user asks to transcribe speech from audio/video, extract text from recordings, or label speakers in interviews or meetings.
description_zh: 将音频文件转录为文本，可选择进行说话人分割并提供已知说话人提示。当用户要求从音频/视频中转录语音、从录音中提取文本，或在访谈或会议中标注说话人时使用。

name: github-traffic
description: Fetch, store, and visualize GitHub repository traffic data (views, clones, referrers, stars) with trend charts. Requires repo push access.
description_zh: 获取、存储和可视化 GitHub 仓库流量数据（浏览量、克隆量、来源、星标），并附带趋势图表。需要仓库推送访问权限。

name: inngest-durable-functions
description: Use when building functions that must survive process crashes, retry automatically on failure, run on a schedule, react to events, or maintain state across infrastructure failures — e.g., webhook handlers that drop events, flaky cron jobs, background jobs that fail mid-execution, or workflows that need to resume where they left off. Covers Inngest function configuration, triggers (events, cron, invoke), step execution and memoization, idempotency, cancellation, error handling, retries, logging, and observability.
description_zh: 在构建必须能够承受进程崩溃、在失败时自动重试、按计划运行、响应事件或在基础设施故障时保持状态的功能时使用——例如，丢弃事件的 webhook 处理程序、不可靠的 cron 作业、执行中途失败的后台作业，或需要从上次中断处继续的工作流。涵盖 Inngest 函数配置、触发器（事件、cron、调用）、步骤执行和缓存、幂等性、取消、错误处理、重试、日志记录和可观察性。

name: sqli-sql-injection
description: SQL injection playbook. Use when input reaches SQL queries, authentication logic, sorting, filtering, reporting, or DB-specific blind and out-of-band execution paths.
description_zh: SQL注入演练手册。当输入到达SQL查询、认证逻辑、排序、过滤、报告或特定数据库的盲注和带外执行路径时使用。

name: drawio-logical-diagrams
description: Creates professional logical flow diagrams and logical system architecture diagrams using draw.io XML format (.drawio files). Use when creating: (1) logical flow diagrams showing data/process flow between system components, (2) logical architecture diagrams representing system structure without cloud provider specifics, (3) BPMN process diagrams, (4) UML diagrams (class, sequence, activity), (5) data flow diagrams (DFD), (6) decision flowcharts, or (7) system interaction diagrams. This skill focuses on generic/abstract representations, not AWS/Azure-specific architectures (use aws-drawio-architecture-diagrams for cloud diagrams).
description_zh: 使用 draw.io XML 格式（.drawio 文件）创建专业的逻辑流程图和逻辑系统架构图。适用于以下场景： (1) 显示系统组件之间数据/流程流的逻辑流程图， (2) 不涉及云服务提供商具体信息的系统结构逻辑架构图， (3) BPMN 流程图， (4) UML 图（类、时序、活动）， (5) 数据流图（DFD）， (6) 决策流程图，或 (7) 系统交互图。此技能侧重于通用/抽象表示，而非 AWS/Azure 特定的架构（云架构图请使用 aws-drawio-architecture-diagrams）。

name: authentication
description: Implement iOS authentication flows with AuthenticationServices and LocalAuthentication. Use when building Sign in with Apple, passkey/WebAuthn registration or sign-in with ASAuthorizationPlatformPublicKeyCredentialProvider, ASAuthorizationController credential state and revocation handling, ASWebAuthenticationSession OAuth or third-party login, Password AutoFill, identity-token server validation, or local biometric re-authentication with LAContext.
description_zh: 使用AuthenticationServices和LocalAuthentication实现iOS身份验证流程。在构建“使用Apple登录”、密钥/WebAuthn注册或登录、ASAuthorizationPlatformPublicKeyCredentialProvider的ASAuthorizationController凭证状态和撤销处理、ASWebAuthenticationSession OAuth或第三方登录、密码自动填充、身份令牌服务器验证，或使用LAContext进行本地生物识别重新验证时使用。

name: workflow-init
description: Install and configure Vercel Workflow SDK before it exists in node_modules. Use when the user asks to "install workflow", "set up workflow", "add durable workflows", "configure workflow sdk", or "init workflow" for Next.js, Express, Hono, Fastify, NestJS, Nitro, Nuxt, Astro, SvelteKit, or Vite.
description_zh: 在 `node_modules` 中不存在 Vercel Workflow SDK 之前，进行安装和配置。当用户要求为 Next.js、Express、Hono、Fastify、NestJS、Nitro、Nuxt、Astro、SvelteKit 或 Vite "安装工作流"、"设置工作流"、"添加持久化工作流"、"配置工作流 SDK" 或 "初始化工作流" 时使用。

name: coding-guidelines
description: Use when asking about Rust code style or best practices. Keywords: naming, formatting, comment, clippy, rustfmt, lint, code style, best practice, P.NAM, G.FMT, code review, naming convention, variable naming, function naming, type naming, 命名规范, 代码风格, 格式化, 最佳实践, 代码审查, 怎么命名
description_zh: 在询问 Rust 代码风格或最佳实践时使用。关键词：命名、格式化、注释、clippy、rustfmt、lint、代码风格、最佳实践、P.NAM、G.FMT、代码审查、命名规范、变量命名、函数命名、类型命名、命名规范、代码风格、格式化、最佳实践、代码审查、怎么命名

name: ohou-today-deal
description: 오늘의집 공개 오늘의딜 페이지에서 로그인 없이 특가 상품을 조회하고 할인율, 가격, 리뷰, 링크를 정리하는 읽기 전용 스킬. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: "오늘의집" 공개 "오늘의딜" 페이지에서 로그인 없이 특가 상품을 조회하고 할인율, 가격, 리뷰, 링크를 정리하는 읽기 전용 스킬입니다. "돌쇠"에서는 공식 표면을 통해 후속 액션까지 진행합니다.

name: inngest-events
description: Use when designing event-driven workflows, decoupling services, implementing fan-out patterns (one trigger, many downstream handlers), implementing idempotent event handling with IDs (24-hour dedupe window), or handling at-least-once delivery from external sources like Stripe webhooks. Covers Inngest event schema, payload format, naming conventions, IDs for idempotency, the ts param, fan-out patterns, and system events like inngest/function.failed.
description_zh: 在设计事件驱动工作流、解耦服务、实现扇出模式（一个触发器、多个下游处理器）、使用ID实现幂等事件处理（24小时去重窗口），或处理来自Stripe webhook等外部来源的至少一次交付时使用。涵盖Inngest事件模式、负载格式、命名规范、幂等ID、ts参数、扇出模式以及系统事件（如inngest/function.failed）。

name: clean-architecture
