description: Diagnoses GKE workload failures (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff, Pending, etc.) via logs and events. Use when pods fail to start or crash repeatedly. Don't use for GKE cluster infrastructure provisioning, node pool creation, or non-Kubernetes Google Cloud services.
description_zh: 通过日志和事件诊断 GKE 工作负载故障（如 CrashLoopBackOff、OOMKilled、ImagePullBackOff、Pending 等）。当 Pod 无法启动或反复崩溃时使用。不应用于 GKE 集群基础设施配置、节点池创建或非 Kubernetes 的 Google Cloud 服务。

name: auth-sec
description: Entry P1 category router for authentication and authorization. Use when testing login flows, sessions, object authorization, JWT, OAuth, CORS, CSRF, and enterprise SSO weaknesses before any deeper auth topic skill.
description_zh: P1类认证授权路由器。在测试登录流程、会话、对象授权、JWT、OAuth、CORS、CSRF以及企业SSO漏洞之前使用，以便在深入学习更复杂的认证主题之前掌握基本技能。

name: app-clips
description: Build iOS App Clips with invocation URLs, App Clip Codes, NFC, QR codes, Safari banners, Maps, Messages, target setup, App Store Connect experiences, size/capability constraints, NSUserActivity routing, SKOverlay promotion, App Group/keychain handoff, ephemeral notifications, location confirmation, and full-app migration. Use when creating App Clips or wiring App Clip invocation, experience configuration, or full-app handoff.
description_zh: 使用调用URL、App Clip码、NFC、二维码、Safari横幅、地图、信息、目标设置、App Store Connect体验、大小/功能限制、NSUserActivity路由、SKOverlay推广、App组/密钥串传递、临时通知、位置确认和完整应用迁移来构建iOS App Clips。在创建App Clips或配置App Clip调用、体验设置或完整应用传递时使用。

name: firecrawl-download
description: Save a site or section as local files (markdown, screenshots). Use for "download the site", offline docs, or a local copy for reference.
description_zh: 将网站或部分保存为本地文件（Markdown、截图）。用于“下载网站”、离线文档或参考的本地副本。

name: api-authorization-and-bola
description: API authorization and BOLA testing playbook. Use when APIs expose object identifiers, nested resources, hidden writable fields, or weak function-level authorization.
description_zh: API授权和BOLA测试手册。当API暴露对象标识符、嵌套资源、隐藏的可写字段或弱函数级授权时使用。

name: reddit
description: Search and retrieve content from Reddit. Get posts, comments, subreddit info, and user profiles via the public JSON API. Use when user mentions Reddit, a subreddit, or r/ links.
description_zh: 从Reddit搜索和检索内容。通过公共JSON API获取帖子、评论、子版块信息以及用户资料。当用户提及Reddit、子版块或r/链接时使用。

name: xcode-compilation-analyzer
description: Analyze Swift and mixed-language compile hotspots using build timing summaries and Swift frontend diagnostics, then produce a recommend-first source-level optimization plan. Use when a developer reports slow compilation, type-checking warnings, expensive clean-build compile phases, long CompileSwiftSources tasks, warn-long-function-bodies output, or wants to speed up Swift type checking.
description_zh: 使用构建时间摘要和Swift前端诊断分析Swift和混合语言编译热点，然后生成以推荐为主的源级优化计划。当开发人员报告编译缓慢、类型检查警告、昂贵的清理构建编译阶段、耗时的CompileSwiftSources任务、warn-long-function-bodies输出，或希望加快Swift类型检查时使用。

name: fullstack-dev
description:
Full-stack backend architecture and frontend-backend integration guide.
TRIGGER when: building a full-stack app, creating REST API with frontend, scaffolding backend service,
building todo app, building CRUD app, building real-time app, building chat app,
Express + React, Next.js API, Node.js backend, Python backend, Go backend,
designing service layers, implementing error handling, managing config/auth,
setting up API clients, implementing auth flows, handling file uploads,
adding real-time features (SSE/WebSocket), hardening for production.
DO NOT TRIGGER when: pure frontend UI work, pure CSS/styling, database schema only.
description_zh:
全栈后端架构与前后端集成指南。
触发条件：构建全栈应用、创建带前端的后端REST API、搭建后端服务、构建待办事项应用、构建CRUD应用、构建实时应用、构建聊天应用、Express + React、Next.js API、Node.js后端、Python后端、Go后端、设计服务层、实现错误处理、管理配置/认证、设置API客户端、实现认证流程、处理文件上传、添加实时功能（SSE/WebSocket）、为生产环境加固。
不触发条件：纯前端UI工作、纯CSS/样式、仅数据库模式。

name: aws-sdk-java-v2-bedrock
description: Provides Amazon Bedrock patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Invokes foundation models (Claude, Llama, Titan), generates text and images, creates embeddings for RAG, streams real-time responses, and configures Spring Boot integration. Use when asking about Bedrock integration, Java SDK for AI models, AWS generative AI, Claude/Llama invocation, embeddings for RAG, or Spring Boot AI setup.
description_zh: 使用 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 提供 Amazon Bedrock 模式。调用基础模型（Claude、Llama、Titan），生成文本和图像，为 RAG 创建嵌入，流式传输实时响应，并配置 Spring Boot 集成。在询问 Bedrock 集成、AI 模型的 Java SDK、AWS 生成式 AI、Claude/Llama 调用、RAG 嵌入或 Spring Boot AI 设置时使用。

name: aws-sdk-java-v2-core
description: Provides AWS SDK for Java 2.x client configuration, credential resolution, HTTP client tuning, timeout, retry, and testing patterns. Use when creating or hardening AWS service clients, wiring Spring Boot beans, debugging auth or region issues, or choosing sync vs async SDK usage.
description_zh: 提供 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 客户端配置、凭证解析、HTTP 客户端调优、超时、重试和测试模式。在创建或加固 AWS 服务客户端、配置 Spring Boot 组件、调试身份验证或区域问题时，或选择同步与异步 SDK 使用方式时使用。

name: injection-checking
description: Entry P1 category router for injection testing. Use when routing between XSS, SQLi, SSRF, XXE, SSTI, command injection, and NoSQL injection workflows based on how attacker-controlled input is consumed.
description_zh: 用于注入测试的P1类别路由器。在基于攻击者控制输入的消耗方式，在XSS、SQLi、SSRF、XXE、SSTI、命令注入和NoSQL注入工作流之间进行路由时使用。

name: wayfinder
description: 把单个 agent session 装不下的一大块工作规划成 issue tracker 上的 decision tickets shared map，并逐一解决，直到通往 destination 的路清晰。
description_zh: 将单个 agent session 无法承载的大量工作规划为 issue tracker 上的决策票证共享地图，并逐一解决，直至通往目的地之路清晰。

name: kubernetes-pentesting
description: Kubernetes penetration testing playbook. Use when targeting Kubernetes clusters via API server, RBAC enumeration, service account abuse, etcd access, Kubelet API, pod escape, cloud-specific metadata, admission webhook bypass, and registry secrets.
description_zh: Kubernetes渗透测试手册。在通过API服务器、RBAC枚举、服务账户滥用、etcd访问、Kubelet API、Pod逃逸、特定云元数据、准入webhook绕过和镜像仓库密钥等目标Kubernetes集群时使用。

name: openspec-explore
description: Enter OpenSpec explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements in a project that uses OpenSpec. Use when the user wants to think through something before or during an OpenSpec change. Also use when the user says "openspec explore" or "opsx explore".
description_zh: 进入 OpenSpec 探索模式——一个用于探索想法、调查问题、明确项目需求的 OpenSpec 思考伙伴。当用户在 OpenSpec 变更之前或期间想要思考某些内容时使用。也适用于用户输入“openspec explore”或“opsx explore”时。

name: openspec-propose
description: Propose a new OpenSpec change with all artifacts generated in one step. Use when the user wants to quickly describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks ready for implementation. Also use when the user says "openspec propose" or "opsx propose".
description_zh: 建议一个新的 OpenSpec 变更，所有工件在一个步骤中生成。当用户想要快速描述他们想要构建的内容，并获得一份包含设计、规范和任务、准备就绪的实施方案时使用。也适用于当用户输入 "openspec propose" 或 "opsx propose" 时。

name: aws-sdk-java-v2-secrets-manager
description: Provides AWS Secrets Manager patterns for AWS SDK for Java 2.x, including secret retrieval, caching, rotation-aware access, and Spring Boot integration. Use when storing or reading secrets in Java services, replacing hardcoded credentials, or wiring secret-backed configuration into applications.
description_zh: 为 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 提供了 AWS Secrets Manager 模式，包括密钥获取、缓存、旋转感知访问以及 Spring Boot 集成。适用于在 Java 服务中存储或读取密钥，替换硬编码的凭证，或将基于密钥的配置连接到应用程序中。

name: longbridge-research
description:
Institution ratings, consensus price targets, EPS/revenue forecasts, finance calendar, shareholder data, fund holders, insider trades (SEC Form 4), short interest, industry rankings, peer group analysis via Longbridge. Frameworks: investment proposals, coverage initiation, stock research, competitive analysis, financial planning, and DeFi/on-chain analysis.
Triggers: "机构评级", "目标价", "一致预期", "EPS预测", "内部人交易", "空头", "行业排名", "投资提案", "首次覆盖", "竞争格局", "财务规划", "DeFi收益", "链上数据", "機構評級", "目標價", "一致預期", "內部人交易", "空頭", "投資提案", "首次覆蓋", "競爭格局", "鏈上數據", "analyst rating", "price target", "consensus", "insider trades", "short interest", "coverage initiation", "DeFi yield", "on-chain", "earnings calendar", "finance calendar", "财报日历", "下周谁财报", "下周财报", "下周有哪些财报", "哪些财报", "谁财报", "FOMC", "非农", "股东", "谁持有", "股東", "基金持仓", "基金持倉", "機構評級", "目標價", "財務規劃"
description_zh:
机构评级、一致预期价格目标、EPS/营收预测、财务日历、股东数据、基金持有人、内部人交易（SEC Form 4）、空头、行业排名、同业分析（通过Longbridge）。框架：投资提案、首次覆盖、股票研究、竞争格局分析、财务规划、以及DeFi/链上数据分析。  
触发词："机构评级"、"目标价"、"一致预期"、"EPS预测"、"内部人交易"、"空头"、"行业排名"、"投资提案"、"首次覆盖"、"竞争格局"、"财务规划"、"DeFi收益"、"链上数据"、"分析师评级"、"目标价"、"一致预期"、"内部人交易"、"空头"、"投资提案"、"首次覆盖"、"竞争格局"、"链上数据"、"财报日历"、"财务日历"、"下周谁财报"、"下周财报"、"下周有哪些财报"、"哪些财报"、"谁财报"、"FOMC"、"非农"、"股东"、"谁持有"、"股東"、"基金持仓"、"基金持倉"、"机构评级"、"目标价"、"财务规划"。

name: aws-sdk-java-v2-kms
description: Provides AWS Key Management Service (KMS) patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Use when creating/managing encryption keys, encrypting/decrypting data, generating data keys, digital signing, key rotation, or integrating encryption into Spring Boot applications.
description_zh: 提供使用 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 的 AWS 密钥管理服务 (KMS) 模式。在创建/管理加密密钥、加密/解密数据、生成数据密钥、数字签名、密钥轮换或将加密集成到 Spring Boot 应用程序时使用。

name: copywriting-hooks
description: Writes opening hooks and post titles for long-form articles in EN or FR — blog posts, Substack/Medium/dev.to, LinkedIn long-form, newsletters, essays. Trigger whenever the user asks for a hook, opening, lede, intro, first sentence/paragraph, opener, accroche, attaque, phrase d'accroche, or première phrase — including punching up a flat intro or draft opening — or for a post title, titre d'article, or headline. Do NOT trigger for social posts (LinkedIn feed, Twitter/X, TikTok, Bluesky), READMEs, taglines, email subjects, ad copy, landing-page headlines, press releases, SEO meta, or body rewrites. Do NOT use for end-of-article CTAs — use samber/cc-skills@copywriting-cta instead.
description_zh: 为长篇英文或法语文章撰写开篇钩子及标题——博客文章、Substack/Medium/dev.to、LinkedIn长篇内容、简报、散文等。当用户要求钩子、开篇、导语、引言、第一句/段落、开场白、accroche、attaque、phrase d'accroche 或 première phrase 时触发，包括提升平淡引言或草稿开篇——或用于文章标题、titre d'article 或标题。禁止触发社交帖子（LinkedIn动态、Twitter/X、TikTok、Bluesky）、README、标语、邮件主题、广告文案、落地页标题、新闻稿、SEO元数据或正文重写。禁止用于文章末尾的CTA——请使用 samber/cc-skills@copywriting-cta。

name: aws-sdk-java-v2-messaging
description: Provides AWS messaging patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x for SQS queues and SNS topics. Handles sending/receiving messages, FIFO queues, DLQ, subscriptions, and pub/sub patterns. Use when implementing messaging with SQS or SNS.
description_zh: 使用 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 为 SQS 队列和 SNS 主题提供 AWS 消息模式。处理发送/接收消息、FIFO 队列、DLQ、订阅以及发布/订阅模式。在实现 SQS 或 SNS 消息时使用。

name: github
description: GitHub CLI for issues, PRs, CI/check logs, comments, reviews, releases, repos, and gh api queries.
description_zh: GitHub CLI 用于问题、拉取请求、CI/检查日志、评论、评审、发布、仓库以及 gh api 查询。

name: typescript-best-practices
description: Use when reading or writing TypeScript or JavaScript files (.ts, .tsx, .js, tsconfig.json).
description_zh: 在阅读或编写TypeScript或JavaScript文件（.ts、.tsx、.js、tsconfig.json）时使用。

name: godot-nodes-scenes
description: Structure a Godot 4.7 project with the scene tree and node composition: build reusable scenes, instance PackedScenes at runtime, navigate the tree safely, and register autoload singletons. Use when designing .tscn scenes, deciding how to split nodes, spawning instances with instantiate(), wiring autoloads, or fixing "node not found"/freed-node errors in a Godot project.
description_zh: 使用场景树和节点组合结构化 Godot 4.7 项目：构建可重用场景、在运行时实例化 PackedScenes、安全地导航树，并注册自动加载单例。在设计 .tscn 场景时使用，决定如何拆分节点、使用 instantiate() 生成实例、连接自动加载，或修复 Godot 项目中的 "找不到节点"/已释放节点错误。

name: notion-research-documentation
description: Research across Notion and synthesize into structured documentation; use when gathering info from multiple Notion sources to produce briefs, comparisons, or reports with citations.
description_zh: 在 Notion 上进行跨研究，并整合成结构化文档；在从多个 Notion 源收集信息以生成简报、比较或带引用的报告时使用。

name: math-olympiad
description: Solve competition math problems (IMO, Putnam, USAMO, AIME) with adversarial verification that catches the errors self-verification misses. Activates when asked to 'solve this IMO problem', 'prove this olympiad inequality', 'verify this competition proof', 'find a counterexample', 'is this proof correct', or for any problem with 'IMO', 'Putnam', 'USAMO', 'olympiad', or 'competition math' in it. Uses pure reasoning (no tools) — then a fresh-context adversarial verifier attacks the proof using specific failure patterns, not generic 'check logic'. Outputs calibrated confidence — will say 'no confident solution' rather than bluff. If LaTeX is available, produces a clean PDF after verification passes.
description_zh: 用对抗性验证来解决竞赛数学问题（IMO、Putnam、USAMO、AIME），捕捉自我验证所遗漏的错误。当被要求“解决这个IMO问题”、“证明这个奥林匹克不等式”、“验证这个竞赛证明”、“找一个反例”、“这个证明正确吗”，或包含“IMO”、“Putnam”、“USAMO”、“奥林匹克”、“竞赛数学”等关键词时自动激活。使用纯推理（无需工具）——然后一个全新上下文的对抗性验证器用特定的失败模式攻击证明，而不是通用的“检查逻辑”。输出校准的置信度——如果不确定有解，会明确说“没有自信的解决方案”。如果LaTeX可用，验证通过后生成一份干净的PDF文档。

name: wiki-update
description: Sync the current project's knowledge into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill from any project when the user says "update wiki", "sync to wiki", "save this to my wiki", "update obsidian", or wants to distill what they've been working on into their knowledge base. This is the cross-project skill that lets you push knowledge from wherever you are into the vault. Accepts inline named-vault routing like "@work update wiki" via the shared Config Resolution Protocol.
description_zh: 将当前项目的知识同步到Obsidian维基中。当用户说“更新维基”、“同步到维基”、“保存到我的维基”或想要将他们所做的工作提炼到知识库中时，可以使用此技能。这是跨项目的技能，允许你将知识从任何地方推送到保险库中。通过共享的配置解析协议，接受内联命名保险库路由，例如“@work update wiki”。

name: aws-sdk-java-v2-rds
description: Provides AWS RDS (Relational Database Service) management patterns using AWS SDK for Java 2.x. Use when creating, modifying, monitoring, or managing Amazon RDS database instances, snapshots, parameter groups, and configurations.
description_zh: 提供使用 AWS SDK for Java 2.x 的 AWS RDS（关系数据库服务）管理模式。在创建、修改、监控或管理 Amazon RDS 数据库实例、快照、参数组和配置时使用。

name: php-best-practices
description: PHP 8.x modern patterns, PSR standards, and SOLID principles. Use when reviewing PHP code, checking type safety, auditing code quality, or ensuring PHP best practices. Triggers on "review PHP", "check PHP code", "audit PHP", or "PHP best practices".
description_zh: PHP 8.x 现代模式、PSR 标准、SOLID 原则。在审查 PHP 代码、检查类型安全、审计代码质量或确保 PHP 最佳实践时使用。在“审查 PHP”、“检查 PHP 代码”、“审计 PHP”或“PHP 最佳实践”时触发。

name: cors-cross-origin-misconfiguration
description: CORS misconfiguration testing playbook. Use when analyzing cross-origin trust, credentialed browser reads, origin reflection, preflight policy bugs, and browser-based access to authenticated APIs.
description_zh: CORS 配置错误测试手册。用于分析跨域信任、凭据浏览器读取、源反射、预检策略错误以及基于浏览器的认证 API 访问。

name: energykit
description: Query grid electricity forecasts and submit load events using EnergyKit to help users optimize home electricity usage. Use when building smart home apps, EV charger controls, HVAC scheduling, or energy management dashboards that guide users to use power during cleaner or cheaper grid periods.
description_zh: 查询电网电力预测，并使用EnergyKit提交负载事件，以帮助用户优化家庭电力使用。在构建智能家居应用程序、电动汽车充电器控制、暖通空调调度或能源管理仪表板时使用，这些仪表板指导用户在电网更清洁或更经济的时段使用电力。

name: firecrawl-parse
description: Convert a local file (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, …) to markdown, or answer questions about its content. Use whenever the input is a file path, not a URL.
description_zh: 将本地文件（PDF、DOCX、XLSX、HTML、…）转换为 Markdown，或回答关于其内容的问题。当输入是文件路径而不是 URL 时使用。

name: game-ui-design
description: World-class game UI design expertise combining the clarity of Nintendo's UI philosophy, the immersive diegetic interfaces of Dead Space and Metroid Prime, and the competitive readability principles from esports titles. Game UI is the invisible bridge between player intent and game response.  Great game UI serves the player without breaking immersion. It communicates critical information at a glance during intense action, guides new players without patronizing veterans, and adapts gracefully from 4K monitors to handheld screens and from keyboard to touch to controller. The best game UI designers understand that every pixel of screen space is sacred - borrowed from the game world itself. Use when "game ui, game interface, hud design, heads up display, game menu, inventory ui, health bar, stamina bar, game hud, minimap, crosshair, reticle, button prompt, controller ui, gamepad navigation, diegetic interface, in-world ui, quest tracker, damage numbers, cooldown indicator, radial menu, game tooltip, game-ui, hud, game-interface, game-menu, controller-ui, diegetic, game-design, accessibility, console, mobile-games" mentioned.
description_zh: 世界一流的游戲界面设计专长，融合了任天堂界面哲学的清晰性、死空间（Dead Space）和银河战士：普罗米修斯（Metroid Prime）的沉浸式拟真界面，以及电子竞技游戏标题中的竞争性可读性原则。游戲界面是玩家意图与游戏响应之间的无形桥梁。优秀的游戲界面在服务玩家的同时不破坏沉浸感。它在激烈动作中能瞬间传达关键信息，引导新玩家而不冒犯老玩家，并能优雅地从4K显示器适应手持屏幕，从键盘适应触摸到控制器。最好的游戲界面设计师明白，屏幕上的每一个像素都是神圣的——它们来自游戏世界本身。当提及“游戲界面、游戲界面、HUD设计、抬头显示、游戲菜单、物品栏界面、生命值条、耐力条、游戲HUD、小地图、准星、瞄准器、按钮提示、控制器界面、手柄导航、拟真界面、世界内界面、任务追踪器、伤害数字、冷却指示器、环形菜单、游戲提示、游戲-ui、HUD、游戲界面、游戲菜单、控制器-ui、拟真、游戲设计、无障碍、主机、手机游戏”时使用。

name: openspec-archive-change
description: Archive a completed OpenSpec change in the experimental workflow. Use when the user wants to finalize and archive a change after implementation is complete. Also use when the user says "openspec archive" or "opsx archive".
description_zh: 在实验工作流程中归档一个已完成的 OpenSpec 更改。当用户希望在实施完成后最终确定并归档更改时使用。也用于当用户输入“openspec archive”或“opsx archive”时。

name: lfg
description: Take a request all the way to done, hands-off, through the right Compound Engineering skills. A code change ends as an open pull request, pushed without stopping. Use only when the user explicitly asks for autonomous end-to-end work or invokes lfg directly. Use ce-plan, ce-work, ce-debug, or ce-commit-push-pr for work the user reviews step by step.
description_zh: 将请求全程处理完毕，无需人工干预，通过正确的复合工程技能。代码变更以打开的拉取请求结束，无间断地推送。仅在用户明确要求自主端到端工作或直接调用lfg时使用。对于用户需要逐步审查的工作，使用ce-plan、ce-work、ce-debug或ce-commit-push-pr。

name: ios-pentesting-tricks
description: iOS pentesting playbook. Use when testing iOS applications for keychain extraction, URL scheme hijacking, Universal Links exploitation, runtime manipulation, binary protection analysis, data storage issues, and transport security bypass during authorized mobile security assessments.
description_zh: iOS渗透测试手册。在授权的移动安全评估期间，用于测试iOS应用程序的关键链路提取、URL方案劫持、通用链接利用、运行时操作、二进制保护分析、数据存储问题以及传输安全绕过。

name: recon-for-sec
description: Entry P1 category router for reconnaissance and methodology. Use when mapping scope, drawing an attack surface from one application, discovering assets, fingerprinting technology, building endpoint inventory, and choosing the first high-value security testing path.
description_zh: P1类别侦察路由器，用于侦察和方法论。在绘制范围、从一个应用程序绘制攻击面、发现资产、指纹技术、构建端点清单以及选择首个高价值安全测试路径时使用。

name: nextjs-deployment
description: Provides comprehensive patterns for deploying Next.js applications to production. Use when configuring Docker containers, setting up GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, managing environment variables, implementing preview deployments, or setting up monitoring and logging for Next.js applications. Covers standalone output, multi-stage Docker builds, health checks, OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and production best practices.
description_zh: 提供全面的方法，用于将 Next.js 应用部署到生产环境。在配置 Docker 容器、设置 GitHub Actions CI/CD 管道、管理环境变量、实现预览部署或为 Next.js 应用设置监控和日志记录时使用。涵盖独立输出、多阶段 Docker 构建、健康检查、OpenTelemetry 仪器化以及生产最佳实践。

name: neat-freak
description: Knowledge and governance closeout: reconcile project docs, rule files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), authorized agent memory, and workspace residue with what the code and runtime actually do, so the next session or the next person starts from one current answer. Trigger when the user names "neat-freak", "洁癖", or "/neat" — and also on clear knowledge-closeout intent without the name: syncing or tidying project docs/rules/memory after development ("把文档和记忆整理一下", "收尾时把文档同步掉", "docs 和代码对不上了"), stale or conflicting CLAUDE.md/memory, a clean handoff to a teammate or a fresh session, or auditing whether workspace rules are actually followed. Do not trigger for pure coding/refactoring/debugging tasks, tidying data or prose (JSON, 周报, changelog announcements), or a bare "整理" with no project-knowledge context.
description_zh: 知识与管理收尾：将项目文档、规则文件（CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md）、授权代理记忆和工位残留与代码及运行时的实际操作进行核对，确保下一次会话或下一位使用者能从当前状态继续。在用户输入“neat-freak”、“洁癖”或“/neat”时触发——或在无明确名称但意图为知识收尾时触发：开发后同步或整理项目文档/规则/记忆（“把文档和记忆整理一下”、“收尾时把文档同步掉”、“docs 和代码对不上了”）、陈旧或冲突的CLAUDE.md/记忆、向队友清晰交接或开启新会话、审计工位规则是否被遵守。不触发于纯代码/重构/调试任务、整理数据或文本（JSON、周报、changelog公告），或无项目知识背景的单纯“整理”。

name: ads-math
description: Calculate and model paid-media CPA, CPL, CPC, CPM, ROAS, MER, break-even targets, contribution margin, LTV:CAC, impression-share opportunity, budgets, forecasts, and experiment economics. Use for PPC math, ad calculator, break-even analysis, ROAS calculator, CPA calculator, budget forecast, LTV CAC, or MER.
description_zh: 计算并建模付费媒体的CPA、CPL、CPC、CPM、ROAS、MER、盈亏平衡目标、贡献边际、LTV:CAC、展示份额机会、预算、预测和实验经济学。用于PPC数学、广告计算器、盈亏平衡分析、ROAS计算器、CPA计算器、预算预测、LTV CAC或MER。

name: xcode-build-benchmark
description: Benchmark Xcode clean and incremental builds with repeatable inputs, timing summaries, and timestamped `.build-benchmark/` artifacts. Use when a developer wants a baseline, wants to compare before and after changes, asks to measure build performance, mentions build times, build duration, how long builds take, or wants to know if builds got faster or slower.
description_zh: 使用可重复的输入、计时摘要和带时间戳的 `.build-benchmark/` 资产来基准测试 Xcode 的清理和增量构建。当开发者需要基准数据、想要比较更改前后的差异、要求测量构建性能、提及构建时间、构建持续时间、构建所需时间，或想知道构建速度是否变快或变慢时使用。

name: html-plan
description: Direct-invocation specialist for clear, self-contained HTML plans that preserve source material while improving hierarchy, sequence, ownership, dependencies, and reviewability. Use when the user explicitly invokes html-plan or the broad html skill routes a plan request here. Do not activate independently from a general request.
description_zh: 直接调用专家，用于生成清晰、自包含的HTML计划，在保留源材料的同时优化层级、顺序、所有权、依赖关系和可审查性。当用户明确调用html-plan或广泛的HTML技能将计划请求路由至此处时使用。不要从一般请求中独立激活。

name: open-source
description: Documentation reference for writing Python code using the browser-use open-source library. Use this skill whenever the user needs help with Agent, Browser, or Tools configuration, is writing code that imports from browser_use, asks about @sandbox deployment, supported LLM models, Actor API, custom tools, lifecycle hooks, MCP server setup, or monitoring/observability with Laminar or OpenLIT. Also trigger for questions about browser-use installation, prompting strategies, or sensitive data handling. Do NOT use this for Cloud API/SDK usage or pricing — use the cloud skill instead. Do NOT use this for directly automating a browser via CLI commands — use the browser-use skill instead.
description_zh: 使用浏览器-use开源库编写Python代码的文档参考。当用户需要帮助配置Agent、Browser或Tools，编写导入自browser-use的代码，询问@sandbox部署、支持的LLM模型、Actor API、自定义工具、生命周期钩子、MCP服务器设置，或使用Laminar或OpenLIT进行监控/可观察性时，请使用此技能。也用于触发关于browser-use安装、提示策略或敏感数据处理的问题。请勿使用此技能用于Cloud API/SDK使用或定价——请使用云技能。请勿使用此技能用于通过CLI命令直接自动化浏览器——请使用browser-use技能。

name: openspec-apply-change
description: Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change. Use when the user wants to start implementing, continue implementation, or work through tasks. Also use when the user says "openspec apply", "opsx apply", or "openspec implement".
description_zh: 从OpenSpec变更中实施任务。当用户想要开始实施、继续实施或处理任务时使用。也用于当用户说“openspec apply”、“opsx apply”或“openspec implement”时。

name: spm-build-analysis
description: Analyze Swift Package Manager dependencies, package plugins, module variants, and CI-oriented build overhead that slow Xcode builds. Use when a developer suspects packages, plugins, or dependency graph shape are hurting clean or incremental build performance, mentions SPM slowness, package resolution time, build plugin overhead, duplicate module builds from configuration drift, circular dependencies between modules, oversized modules needing splitting, or modularization best practices.
description_zh: 分析 Swift Package Manager 依赖关系、包插件、模块变体以及面向 CI 的构建开销，这些因素导致 Xcode 构建变慢。当开发者怀疑包、插件或依赖图结构损害了清理或增量构建性能，提及 SPM 缓慢、包解析时间、构建插件开销、因配置漂移导致的重复模块构建、模块间的循环依赖、需要拆分的过大型模块，或模块化最佳实践时，应使用此分析。

name: llm-prompt-injection
description: LLM prompt injection playbook. Use when testing AI/LLM applications for direct injection, indirect injection via RAG/browsing, tool abuse, data exfiltration, MCP security risks, and defense bypass techniques.
description_zh: LLM提示注入演练手册。在测试AI/LLM应用程序时使用，用于直接注入、通过RAG/浏览进行间接注入、工具滥用、数据窃取、MCP安全风险以及防御绕过技术。

name: paper-fetch
description: Use whenever the user wants to obtain, download, or fetch a paper's PDF — given a DOI, an arXiv id, a paper title, a citation, or a list of DOIs. Trigger on phrases like "download this paper", "find the PDF for [DOI]", "grab me the [Nature/bioRxiv/arXiv] paper on X", "get the open-access version", "I need this article", or any bulk/batch paper download request, even when the user doesn't explicitly say "PDF" or "DOI". Resolves via Unpaywall → Semantic Scholar → arXiv → PubMed Central → bioRxiv/medRxiv → publisher direct (institutional opt-in) → Sci-Hub mirrors as last-resort fallback.
description_zh: 在用户希望获取、下载或获取论文的PDF时使用——根据DOI、arXiv ID、论文标题、引用信息或DOI列表。在类似“下载这篇论文”、“查找[DOI]的PDF”、“获取关于X的[Nature/bioRxiv/arXiv]论文”、“获取开放获取版本”、“我需要这篇文章”或任何批量/批量论文下载请求时触发，即使用户没有明确说“PDF”或“DOI”。通过Unpaywall → Semantic Scholar → arXiv → PubMed Central → bioRxiv/medRxiv → 出版社直接（机构选择加入）→ Sci-Hub镜像作为最后的备用方案解决。

name: semanticscholar-skill
description: Use when searching academic papers, looking up citations, finding authors, or getting paper recommendations using the Semantic Scholar API. Triggers on queries about research papers, academic search, citation analysis, or literature discovery.
description_zh: 用于搜索学术论文、查找引用、查找作者或使用Semantic Scholar API获取论文推荐。当查询涉及研究论文、学术搜索、引用分析或文献发现时触发。

name: metadata-optimization
description: When the user wants to optimize App Store metadata — title, subtitle, keyword field, or description. Also use when the user mentions "optimize my title", "ASO metadata", "keyword field", "character limits", "app description", or "write my subtitle". For keyword discovery, see keyword-research. For full ASO audits, see aso-audit.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化App Store元数据（如标题、副标题、关键词字段或描述）时，也适用于用户提及“优化我的标题”、“ASO元数据”、“关键词字段”、“字符限制”、“应用描述”或“撰写我的副标题”的情况。关于关键词发现，请参阅keyword-research。关于完整的ASO审核，请参阅aso-audit。

name: csrf-cross-site-request-forgery
description: CSRF testing playbook. Use when reviewing state-changing web flows, anti-CSRF defenses, SameSite behavior, JSON CSRF, login CSRF, and OAuth state handling.
description_zh: CSRF测试手册。在审查状态变更的Web流程、反CSRF防御、SameSite行为、JSON CSRF、登录CSRF以及OAuth状态处理时使用。

name: heap-exploitation
description: Heap exploitation playbook. Use when targeting ptmalloc2/glibc heap vulnerabilities including UAF, double free, overflow, off-by-one/null, and leveraging tcache/fastbin/unsortedbin attacks for arbitrary write or code execution.
description_zh: 堆利用手册。在针对ptmalloc2/glibc堆漏洞时使用，包括使用UAF、双重释放、溢出、偏移/空指针，以及利用tcache/fastbin/unsortedbin攻击进行任意写或代码执行。

name: cline-sdk
description: Comprehensive Cline SDK skill for building AI agents. Covers the direct Agent runtime, ClineCore sessions, custom tools, plugins, events, LLM providers, scheduling, multi-agent teams, and production deployment. Use for any task involving @cline/sdk or its sub-packages.
description_zh: 用于构建AI代理的全面Cline SDK技能。涵盖直接代理运行时、ClineCore会话、自定义工具、插件、事件、LLM提供者、调度、多代理团队和生产部署。适用于任何涉及@cline/sdk或其子包的任务。

name: swift-codable
description: Implement Swift Codable models for JSON and property-list encoding and decoding with JSONDecoder, JSONEncoder, CodingKeys, and custom init(from:) or encode(to:). Use when parsing API responses, remapping keys, flattening nested JSON, handling date or data decoding strategies, decoding heterogeneous arrays, or integrating Codable with URLSession, SwiftData, or UserDefaults.
description_zh: 实现 Swift Codable 模型，用于 JSON 和属性列表的编码和解码，使用 JSONDecoder、JSONEncoder、CodingKeys 以及自定义 init(from:) 或 encode(to:)。适用于解析 API 响应、重映射键、展平嵌套 JSON、处理日期或数据解码策略、解码异构数组，或集成 Codable 与 URLSession、SwiftData 或 UserDefaults。

name: spanner-basics
description: Assists in provisioning instances and databases, designing performant schemas, and querying data in Spanner. Use when designing primary keys, writing SQL queries or client library code, or diagnosing performance issues.
description_zh: 帮助配置实例和数据库，设计高性能模式，以及在 Spanner 中查询数据。在设计主键、编写 SQL 查询或客户端库代码，或诊断性能问题时使用。

name: business-logic-vuln
description: Entry P1 category router for business logic testing. Use when workflow abuse, race conditions, pricing flaws, or multi-step state attacks matter more than parser-level input injection.
description_zh: 用于业务逻辑测试的 P1 类入口路由器。当工作流滥用、竞态条件、定价缺陷或多步骤状态攻击比解析器级别的输入注入更重要时使用。

name: value-dividend-screener
description: Screen US stocks for high-quality dividend opportunities combining value characteristics (P/E ratio under 20, P/B ratio under 2), attractive yields (3% or higher), and consistent growth (dividend/revenue/EPS trending up over 3 years). Supports two-stage screening using FINVIZ Elite API for efficient pre-filtering followed by FMP API for detailed analysis. Use when user requests dividend stock screening, income portfolio ideas, or quality value stocks with strong fundamentals.
description_zh: 筛选美国股市的高质量股息机会，结合价值特征（市盈率低于20，市净率低于2）、有吸引力的收益率（3%或更高）以及持续增长（股息/营收/每股收益在过去3年内呈上升趋势）。支持使用FINVIZ Elite API进行两阶段筛选，先进行高效预筛选，再使用FMP API进行详细分析。当用户请求股息股票筛选、收入投资组合建议或基本面强劲的高质量价值股票时使用。

name: traffic-analysis-pcap
description: Traffic analysis and PCAP forensics playbook. Use when analyzing network captures including Wireshark filters, protocol analysis (HTTP/DNS/FTP/SMTP/USB/WiFi), data extraction, covert channel detection, PCAP repair, TLS decryption, and tshark command-line analysis.
description_zh: 流量分析和PCAP取证手册。在分析网络捕获数据时使用，包括使用Wireshark过滤器、协议分析（HTTP/DNS/FTP/SMTP/USB/WiFi）、数据提取、隐蔽通道检测、PCAP修复、TLS解密以及tshark命令行分析。

name: oauth-oidc-misconfiguration
description: OAuth and OIDC misconfiguration testing playbook. Use when reviewing redirect URI handling, state and nonce validation, PKCE, token audience, callback binding, and identity-provider trust flaws.
description_zh: OAuth和OIDC配置错误测试剧本。在审查重定向URI处理、状态和nonce验证、PKCE、令牌受众、回调绑定以及身份提供者信任缺陷时使用。

name: security-generate-security-sample-data
description: Generate sample security events, attack scenarios, and synthetic alerts for Elastic Security. Use when demoing, populating dashboards, testing detection rules, or setting up a POC.

name: redis-core
description: Core Redis modeling guidance — choose the right data structure (String, Hash, List, Set, Sorted Set, JSON, Stream, Vector Set) and use consistent colon-separated key names. Use when designing a Redis data model, caching objects, deciding between Hash and JSON, building counters, leaderboards, membership sets, or session stores, or when reviewing/cleaning up Redis key naming.
description_zh: 核心 Redis 建模指南 — 选择合适的数据结构（String、Hash、List、Set、Sorted Set、JSON、Stream、Vector Set）并使用一致的冒号分隔的键名。在设计 Redis 数据模型、缓存对象、在 Hash 和 JSON 之间进行选择、构建计数器、排行榜、成员集合或会话存储时使用，或在审查/清理 Redis 键命名时使用。

name: shareplay-activities
description: Build shared real-time experiences using GroupActivities and SharePlay. Use when implementing shared media playback, collaborative app features, synchronized game state, or any FaceTime, Messages, AirDrop, or nearby visionOS group activity on iOS, macOS, tvOS, or visionOS.
description_zh: 使用 GroupActivities 和 SharePlay 构建共享实时体验。在实现共享媒体播放、协作应用功能、同步游戏状态，或任何在 iOS、macOS、tvOS 或 visionOS 上的 FaceTime、消息、AirDrop 或附近 visionOS 组活动时使用。

name: vm-and-bytecode-reverse
description: Custom VM and bytecode reverse engineering playbook. Use when CTF challenges or protected software implement custom virtual machines with proprietary bytecode, dispatcher loops, or maze-style challenges.
description_zh: 自定义虚拟机与字节码逆向工程手册。在CTF挑战或受保护软件中实现自定义虚拟机、专有字节码、调度器循环或迷宫式挑战时使用。

name: graphql-operations
description: Guide for writing GraphQL operations (queries, mutations, fragments) following best practices. Use this skill when: (1) writing GraphQL queries or mutations, (2) organizing operations with fragments, (3) optimizing data fetching patterns, (4) setting up type generation or linting, (5) reviewing operations for efficiency.
description_zh: 编写 GraphQL 操作（查询、变更、片段）的最佳实践指南。在以下情况使用此技能：(1) 编写 GraphQL 查询或变更，(2) 使用片段组织操作，(3) 优化数据获取模式，(4) 设置类型生成或代码检查，(5) 审查操作的效率。

name: godot-physics
description: Use Godot 4.7 physics bodies and detection in 2D and 3D: RigidBody, StaticBody, Area, and CharacterBody; collision layers vs masks; contact/overlap signals; and raycasts (RayCast nodes and direct space-state queries). Use when configuring collision layers/masks, detecting overlaps with Area2D/Area3D, applying forces to a RigidBody, or casting rays in a Godot project (.tscn with physics bodies), including 3D projects running Jolt Physics, the default 3D engine for projects created in 4.6+.
description_zh: 使用 Godot 4.7 的 2D 和 3D 物理体及检测：RigidBody、StaticBody、Area 和 CharacterBody；碰撞层与掩码；接触/重叠信号；以及射线（RayCast 节点和直接空间状态查询）。在配置碰撞层/掩码、检测 Area2D/Area3D 的重叠、对 RigidBody 施加力或在 Godot 项目（包含物理体的 .tscn）中投射射线时使用，包括运行 Jolt Physics 的 3D 项目（4.6+ 创建项目的默认 3D 引擎）。

name: playwright-testing
description: E2E testing with Playwright - Page Objects, cross-browser, CI/CD
description_zh: 使用 Playwright 进行端到端测试 - 页面对象、跨浏览器、CI/CD

name: anywidget-generator
description: Generate anywidget components for marimo notebooks.

name: reconciliation
description: Reconcile accounts by comparing GL balances to subledgers, bank statements, or third-party data. Use when performing bank reconciliations, GL-to-subledger recs, intercompany reconciliations, or identifying and categorizing reconciling items.
description_zh: 通过比较总账余额与明细账、银行对账单或第三方数据来核对账目。在进行银行对账、总账至明细账核对、公司间核对或识别和分类对账差异项时使用。

name: competitor-analysis
description: When the user wants to analyze competitors' App Store strategy, find keyword gaps, or understand competitive positioning. Also use when the user mentions "competitor analysis", "competitive research", "keyword gap", "what are my competitors doing", or "compare my app to". For keyword-specific research, see keyword-research. For metadata writing, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户希望分析竞争对手的App Store策略、寻找关键词差距或了解竞争定位时，也可使用。当用户提及“竞争对手分析”、“竞争研究”、“关键词差距”、“我的竞争对手在做什么”或“将我的应用与...进行比较”时，也可使用。针对特定关键词的研究，请参阅keyword-research。针对元数据编写，请参阅metadata-optimization。

name: aws-auth
description: Adds user authentication to web and mobile apps with Amazon Cognito (user pools and identity pools) and the AWS Amplify client auth libraries. Covers sign-up/sign-in flows and the login page (Cognito-hosted UI / managed login), MFA, password policies, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows (auth-code + PKCE, client credentials), social/SAML federation, tokens (ID/access/refresh, rotation, revocation, storage), Cognito Lambda triggers, identity pools (temp AWS creds), and gating API Gateway (or ALB) routes to signed-in users via Cognito/JWT authorizers. Applies when adding a login or sign-up page, configuring a user pool or app client, choosing user pool vs identity pool, wiring social/SAML, refreshing tokens, requiring sign-in on an API Gateway or ALB, or debugging redirect_uri/token/MFA/CORS/federation errors. Does NOT cover Amplify Gen2 backend definitions (defineAuth, npx ampx → aws-amplify), IAM/STS/Identity Center (→ aws-iam), or API Gateway/Lambda resource config beyond the authorizer (→ aws-serverless).
description_zh: 使用 Amazon Cognito（用户池和身份池）以及 AWS Amplify 客户端认证库为 Web 和移动应用添加用户认证。涵盖注册/登录流程和登录页面（Cognito 托管的 UI / 管理式登录）、多因素认证 (MFA)、密码策略、OAuth 2.0 / OIDC 流程（授权码 + PKCE、客户端凭证）、社交/SAML 联邦、令牌（ID/访问/刷新、轮换、吊销、存储）、Cognito Lambda 触发器、身份池（临时 AWS 凭证），以及通过 Cognito/JWT 认证器将 API Gateway（或 ALB）路由门控到已登录用户。适用于添加登录或注册页面、配置用户池或应用客户端、选择用户池与身份池、配置社交/SAML、刷新令牌、要求 API Gateway 或 ALB 登录，或调试 redirect_uri/令牌/MFA/CORS/联邦错误的情况。**不包括** Amplify Gen2 后端定义（defineAuth、npx ampx → aws-amplify）、IAM/STS/身份中心（→ aws-iam），或 API Gateway/Lambda 资源配置（超出认证器部分）（→ aws-serverless）。

name: blogwatcher
description: Monitor blogs and RSS/Atom feeds for updates using the blogwatcher CLI.
description_zh: 使用 blogwatcher CLI 监控博客和 RSS/Atom 提供更新。

name: prototype-fast
description: Build a playable prototype in about an hour to answer one question — is it fun? — with greybox primitives, a hard timebox, and explicit keep/kill criteria. Use when prototyping a mechanic, making a vertical slice or MVP, greyboxing/blockout, or judging throwaway vs keep.
description_zh: 在约一个小时内构建一个可玩的原型，以回答一个问题——它是否有趣？——使用灰盒原语、严格的时间限制和明确的保留/删除标准。在原型设计机制、制作垂直切片或最小可行产品（MVP）、灰盒设计或判断可丢弃与保留时使用。

name: sonoscli
description: Control Sonos speakers (discover/status/play/volume/group).
description_zh: 控制Sonos音箱（发现/状态/播放/音量/分组）。

name: ads-test
description: Design and evaluate paid-ad experiments with hypotheses, randomization units, sample-size and duration assumptions, guardrails, platform experiment tools, analysis, and decision rules. Use for A/B test, split test, experiment design, hypothesis, statistical significance, sample size, test duration, or experiment readout.
description_zh: 设计和评估具有假设、随机化单元、样本量和持续时间假设、护栏、平台实验工具、分析以及决策规则的付费广告实验。用于 A/B 测试、分割测试、实验设计、假设、统计显著性、样本量、测试持续时间或实验结果分析。

name: model-usage
description: Summarize CodexBar local cost logs by model for Codex or Claude, including current or full breakdowns.
description_zh: 按模型对CodexBar的本地成本日志进行汇总，包括当前或完整明细。

name: anti-debugging-techniques
description: Anti-debugging detection and bypass playbook. Use when reversing protected binaries that detect debuggers via ptrace, PEB flags, timing checks, or signal/exception handlers on Linux and Windows.
description_zh: 反调试检测与绕过手册。在逆向分析检测调试器的受保护二进制文件时使用，这些二进制文件通过ptrace、PEB标志、时间检查或Linux和Windows上的信号/异常处理程序来检测调试器。

name: speech
description: Use when the user asks for text-to-speech narration or voiceover, accessibility reads, audio prompts, or batch speech generation via the OpenAI Audio API; run the bundled CLI (`scripts/text_to_speech.py`) with built-in voices and require `OPENAI_API_KEY` for live calls. Custom voice creation is out of scope.
description_zh: 在用户请求文本转语音旁白、配音、无障碍阅读、音频提示或通过 OpenAI 音频 API 批量生成语音时使用；使用捆绑的 CLI (`scripts/text_to_speech.py`) 并内置语音，实时调用时需要 `OPENAI_API_KEY`。自定义语音创建不在范围内。

name: spotify-player
description: Terminal Spotify playback/search via spogo (preferred) or spotify_player.
description_zh: 通过 spogo（首选）或 spotify_player 在终端进行 Spotify 播放/搜索。

name: godot-resources
description: Design data-driven Godot 4.7 games with custom Resource classes: define typed data with class_name + @export, save/load .tres/.res files, instance and duplicate resources, and load on demand with ResourceLoader (incl. threaded loading). Use when modeling items/stats/configs as data in a Godot project, creating .tres resources, or working with custom Resource subclasses and ResourceLoader/ResourceSaver.
description_zh: 使用自定义 Resource 类设计数据驱动的 Godot 4.7 游戏：通过 class_name + @export 定义类型数据，保存/加载 .tres/.res 文件，实例化和复制资源，并使用 ResourceLoader 按需加载（包含线程加载）。适用于在 Godot 项目中将物品/属性/配置建模为数据、创建 .tres 资源，或处理自定义 Resource 子类和 ResourceLoader/ResourceSaver。

name: gke-ai-troubleshooting-jobset-interruption
description: Diagnoses GKE JobSet interruptions, restarts, and preemptions for AI/ML training workloads autonomously. Use when troubleshooting JobSet restart loops, spot VM preemptions, node readiness failures, host VM issues, or coordinator worker crashes. Don't use for general GKE cluster creation, basic workload deployment, or non-JobSet application issues.
description_zh: 自动诊断 GKE JobSet 的中断、重启和抢占，用于 AI/ML 训练工作负载。在排错 JobSet 重启循环、Spot VM 抢占、节点就绪失败、主机 VM 问题或协调工作进程崩溃时使用。不适用于一般 GKE 集群创建、基本工作负载部署或非 JobSet 应用问题。

name: notion-knowledge-capture
description: Capture conversations and decisions into structured Notion pages; use when turning chats/notes into wiki entries, how-tos, decisions, or FAQs with proper linking.
description_zh: 将对话和决策记录到结构化的Notion页面中；在将聊天记录/笔记转换为维基条目、操作指南、决策记录或常见问题解答时使用，并确保正确链接。

name: binary-protection-bypass
description: Binary protection bypass playbook. Use when identifying and bypassing ASLR, PIE, NX/DEP, stack canary, RELRO, FORTIFY_SOURCE, CET, and MTE protections in ELF binaries to enable exploitation.
description_zh: 二进制保护绕过手册。用于识别和绕过ELF二进制中的ASLR、PIE、NX/DEP、栈金丝雀、RELRO、FORTIFY_SOURCE、CET和MTE保护，以实现利用。

name: path-traversal-lfi
description: Path traversal and LFI playbook. Use when file paths, download endpoints, include operations, archive extraction, or wrapper behavior may expose filesystem control.
description_zh: 路径遍历和本地文件包含（LFI）用例。在文件路径、下载端点、包含操作、归档提取或包装器行为可能暴露文件系统控制时使用。

name: aws-lambda-python-integration
description: Provides AWS Lambda integration patterns for Python with cold start optimization. Use when deploying Python functions to AWS Lambda, choosing between AWS Chalice and raw Python approaches, optimizing cold starts, configuring API Gateway or ALB integration, or implementing serverless Python applications. Triggers include "create lambda python", "deploy python lambda", "chalice lambda aws", "python lambda cold start", "aws lambda python performance", "python serverless framework".
description_zh: 提供针对 Python 的 AWS Lambda 集成模式，并支持冷启动优化。在将 Python 函数部署到 AWS Lambda 时使用，可选择 AWS Chalice 或原始 Python 方法，优化冷启动，配置 API Gateway 或 ALB 集成，或实现无服务器 Python 应用。触发词包括 "create lambda python"、"deploy python lambda"、"chalice lambda aws"、"python lambda cold start"、"aws lambda python performance"、"python serverless framework"。

name: platform-sharing-owd-configure
description: Use when the user wants to retrieve or update Organization-Wide Default (OWD) sharing settings for Salesforce objects. TRIGGER on org-wide defaults, checking/viewing sharing defaults, changing default access levels (Private, Public Read Only, Public Read/Write, Controlled by Parent), internal/external access for standard or custom objects, making records private, or sharingModel in .object-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER for sharing rules, criteria-based sharing, role hierarchy, or manual sharing — delegate to platform-sharing-rules-generate.
description_zh: 当用户需要检索或更新 Salesforce 对象的全组织默认（OWD）共享设置时使用。在 OWD 上触发，检查/查看共享默认设置、更改默认访问级别（私有、公共只读、公共读写、由父级控制）、标准或自定义对象的内/外部访问、将记录设为私有，或在 .object-meta.xml 文件中的 sharingModel。不应用于共享规则、基于条件的共享、角色层次结构或手动共享——将这些委托给 platform-sharing-rules-generate。

name: nestjs-drizzle-crud-generator
description: Generates complete CRUD modules for NestJS applications with Drizzle ORM. Use when building server-side features in NestJS that require database operations, including creating new entities with full CRUD endpoints, services with Drizzle queries, Zod-validated DTOs, and unit tests. Triggered by requests like "generate a user module", "create a product CRUD", "add a new entity with endpoints", or when setting up database-backed features in NestJS.
description_zh: 为 NestJS 应用生成完整的 CRUD 模块，使用 Drizzle ORM。在构建需要数据库操作的 NestJS 服务器端功能时使用，包括创建具有完整 CRUD 端点的实体、使用 Drizzle 查询的服务、Zod 验证的 DTO 以及单元测试。可通过请求如“生成用户模块”、“创建产品 CRUD”、“添加具有端点的实体”或设置 NestJS 中的数据库支持功能时触发。

name: contacts
description: Add, enrich, and manage contacts in Joel's Vault. Fire the Inngest enrichment pipeline for full multi-source dossiers, or create quick contacts manually. Use when: 'add a contact', 'enrich this person', 'who is X', 'VIP contact', 'update contact', or any task involving the Vault/Contacts directory.
description_zh: 在 Joel 的 Vault 中添加、丰富和管理联系人。触发 Inngest 丰富流程以获取完整的多源档案，或手动快速创建联系人。使用场景：'添加联系人'、'丰富此人'、'X 是谁'、'VIP 联系人'、'更新联系人'，或任何涉及 Vault/联系人目录的任务。

name: cmdi-command-injection
description: Command injection playbook. Use when user input may reach shell commands, process execution, converters, import pipelines, or blind out-of-band command sinks.
description_zh: 命令注入剧本。当用户输入可能到达 shell 命令、进程执行、转换器、导入管道或盲外带命令接收器时使用。

name: cursor-delegate
description: Delegate a coding task to the Cursor Agent CLI (`cursor-agent`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Cursor — phrasings like "have Cursor implement X", "delegate this to Cursor", "run it through Cursor Agent", or "use Cursor to implement/fix/refactor" — or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Cursor while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Cursor Agent CLI (`cursor-agent`) 作为后台实现者，然后自行审查其差异并合并。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Cursor 时使用此方法——例如“让 Cursor 实现 X”、“将此委托给 Cursor”、“通过 Cursor Agent 运行”或“使用 Cursor 实现/修复/重构”——或者希望在保持审查者身份的情况下，通过 Cursor 运行编码任务队列。对于足够小可以直接内联完成的任务，或用户希望直接编写代码而不进行委托的情况，请勿使用。

name: skill-creator
description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
description_zh: 创建有效技能的指南。当用户希望创建一项新技能（或更新现有技能），以通过专业知识、工作流程或工具集成扩展Claude的功能时，应使用此技能。

name: roguelike
description: Build a roguelike: turn-based grid movement, procedural dungeons, permadeath, field-of-view, and loot tables. Use for a roguelike/roguelite or turn-based grid dungeon crawler with procedural levels.
description_zh: 构建一个roguelike游戏：回合制网格移动、程序化地牢、永久死亡、视野范围和掉落表。用于roguelike/roguelite或回合制网格地牢爬行者，具有程序化关卡。

name: document-skills
description: Professional document creation, editing, and analysis for Office formats (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx). Use when working with Word documents, PDFs, PowerPoint presentations, or Excel spreadsheets.
description_zh: 专业文档创建、编辑和分析，适用于Office格式（docx、pdf、pptx、xlsx）。在处理Word文档、PDF文件、PowerPoint演示文稿或Excel电子表格时使用。

name: aws-lambda-typescript-integration
description: Provides AWS Lambda integration patterns for TypeScript with cold start optimization. Use when creating or deploying TypeScript Lambda functions, choosing between NestJS framework and raw TypeScript approaches, optimizing cold starts, configuring API Gateway or ALB integration, or implementing serverless TypeScript applications. Triggers include "create lambda typescript", "deploy typescript lambda", "nestjs lambda aws", "raw typescript lambda", "aws lambda typescript performance".
description_zh: 提供具有冷启动优化的 TypeScript AWS Lambda 集成模式。在创建或部署 TypeScript Lambda 函数时使用，可选择 NestJS 框架或原生 TypeScript 方法，优化冷启动，配置 API Gateway 或 ALB 集成，或实现无服务器 TypeScript 应用。触发词包括 "create lambda typescript"、"deploy typescript lambda"、"nestjs lambda aws"、"raw typescript lambda"、"aws lambda typescript performance"。

name: antislop-copywriting
description: Copy and text skill for antislop. Use when writing or editing prose: headlines, tone, CTAs, and anti-AI-writing patterns. Load with the core.
description_zh: 复制和文本技巧用于防抄袭。在撰写或编辑散文时使用：标题、语气、行动号召和反AI写作模式。与核心一起加载。

name: develop
description: Run /develop to build a feature, UI or backend, from an approved design, a page, component, API, service, or data slice. If something load bearing is undecided and no spec records it, it stops and routes you to /architect; otherwise it reads the spec plus AGENTS.md, builds, and advances the scope.
description_zh: 运行 /develop 以基于已批准的设计来构建功能、界面或后端，该设计可能涉及页面、组件、API、服务或数据切片。若有关键依赖尚未确定且无规格说明予以记录，流程将中止并引导至 /architect；否则，它将读取规格说明及 AGENTS.md，完成构建并推进开发范围。

name: notion
description: Notion CLI/API for pages, Markdown content, data sources, files, comments, search, Workers, and raw API calls.
description_zh: Notion 命令行界面（CLI）/API 用于页面、Markdown 内容、数据源、文件、评论、搜索、工作程序（Workers）以及原始 API 调用。

name: format-string-exploitation
description: Format string exploitation playbook. Use when printf-family functions receive user-controlled format strings, enabling arbitrary stack reads (%p/%s), arbitrary memory writes (%n/%hn/%hhn), GOT/hook overwrites, and canary/libc/PIE leaks.
description_zh: 格式化字符串利用手册。当 printf 家族函数接收到用户控制的格式字符串时使用，可启用任意栈读取（%p/%s）、任意内存写入（%n/%hn/%hhn）、GOT/hook 覆盖，以及 canary/libc/PIE 泄露。

name: graphql-and-hidden-parameters
description: GraphQL and hidden parameter testing playbook. Use when exploring introspection, batching, undocumented fields, hidden parameters, schema abuse, and GraphQL authorization gaps.
description_zh: GraphQL 和隐藏参数测试剧本。在探索内省、批量请求、未公开的字段、隐藏参数、模式滥用以及 GraphQL 授权漏洞时使用。

name: ssti-server-side-template-injection
description: SSTI playbook. Use when template expressions, server-side rendering, preview features, or templating engines may evaluate attacker-controlled content.
description_zh: SSTI playbook。当模板表达式、服务器端渲染、预览功能或模板引擎可能评估攻击者控制的内容时使用。

name: xxe-xml-external-entity
description: XXE playbook. Use when XML, SVG, OOXML, SOAP, or parser-driven imports may resolve external entities, files, or internal network resources.
description_zh: XXE playbook。当 XML、SVG、OOXML、SOAP 或解析器驱动的导入可能解析外部实体、文件或内部网络资源时使用。

name: openspec-update-change
description: Update an OpenSpec change by revising its existing planning artifacts and keeping them coherent with one another. Use when the user wants to revise a change's plan, fold new decisions into it, or reconcile its artifacts after an edit. Also use when the user says "openspec update change" or "opsx update". If the user means the openspec update CLI command, which refreshes generated files, run that command instead. Never edits code.
description_zh: 更新 OpenSpec 变更，通过修订其现有的规划文档并确保它们彼此一致。当用户想要修订变更的计划、将新决策整合到其中，或在编辑后协调其文档时使用。也用于用户输入“openspec update change”或“opsx update”时。如果用户指的是刷新生成文件的 OpenSpec 更新 CLI 命令，请运行该命令。切勿编辑代码。

name: kernel-exploitation
description: Linux kernel exploitation playbook. Use when exploiting kernel vulnerabilities (UAF, OOB, race condition, type confusion) for privilege escalation via commit_creds, modprobe_path overwrite, or kernel ROP chains in CTF and real-world scenarios.
description_zh: Linux 内核利用手册。在利用内核漏洞（使用-after-free、越界读取、竞态条件、类型混淆）以通过 commit_creds、modprobe_path 重写或内核 ROP 链在 CTF 和实际场景中提升权限时使用。

name: weatherkit
description: Fetch WeatherKit current, minute, hourly, and daily forecasts; weather alerts; iOS 18+ changes, historical comparisons, summaries, and statistics; and required Apple Weather attribution. Use when integrating weather data, showing forecasts or alerts, caching WeatherKit responses, displaying attribution, or reviewing WeatherKit query limits in iOS apps.
description_zh: 获取 WeatherKit 的当前、分钟、小时和每日预报；天气警报；iOS 18+ 的变更、历史比较、摘要和统计数据；以及所需的 Apple Weather 归因。在集成天气数据、显示预报或警报、缓存 WeatherKit 响应、显示归因或在 iOS 应用中检查 WeatherKit 查询限制时使用。

name: file-access-vuln
description: Entry P1 category router for file access and upload workflows. Use when testing download endpoints, file paths, local file inclusion, upload flows, preview pipelines, archive extraction, or storage and sharing boundaries.
description_zh: P1类文件访问和上传工作流的入口路由器。在测试下载端点、文件路径、本地文件包含、上传流程、预览管道、归档提取或存储和共享边界时使用。

name: openai-whisper-api
description: OpenAI Audio Transcriptions API via curl; gpt-4o-transcribe, mini, diarize, or whisper-1.
description_zh: 通过 curl 使用 OpenAI 音频转写 API；gpt-4o-transcribe、mini、diarize 或 whisper-1。

name: sentry
description: Use when the user asks to inspect Sentry issues or events, summarize recent production errors, or pull basic Sentry health data via the Sentry CLI; perform read-only queries using the `sentry` command.
description_zh: 当用户要求检查Sentry问题或事件、总结近期生产错误，或通过Sentry CLI拉取基本Sentry健康数据时使用；使用 `sentry` 命令执行只读查询。

name: architect
description: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before code, then stay in the loop while implementation fills in. Use for /architect, 'architect this', 'design this', or non-trivial work where jumping to code would lock in the wrong shape.
description_zh: 在编写代码之前，先勾勒出草图类型、签名和模块结构，然后在实现过程中持续跟进。适用于架构师（for /architect），使用“架构这个”、“设计这个”，或对于跳转到代码会锁定错误形态的非平凡工作。

name: understand-dashboard
description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph
description_zh: 启动交互式网络仪表板，以可视化代码库的知识图谱

name: godot-signals-groups
description: Build event-driven, decoupled Godot 4.7 gameplay with signals and node groups: declare and emit custom signals, connect with Callables (incl. bind/one-shot), and broadcast to many nodes via groups and call_group. Use when wiring node communication in a Godot project, replacing tight references with signals, emitting/connecting events, or porting 3.x connect("sig", self, "method") code.
description_zh: 构建基于信号和节点组的 Godot 4.7 解耦事件驱动游戏玩法：声明和发射自定义信号，通过可调用对象（包括绑定/一次性）进行连接，并通过节点组及 call_group 函数向多个节点广播。适用于 Godot 项目中节点通信的线路连接，可替代紧密引用信号、发射/连接事件，或迁移 3.x 版本的 connect("sig", self, "method") 代码。

name: developer-device-platform-basics
description: Provides guidance and instructions on managing remote devices on Developer Device Platform (DDP). Use when reserving remote Android devices, establishing connection tunnels, checking session status, or extending/cancelling leases. Don't use for iOS or local device/hardware inquiries.
description_zh: 提供关于在开发者设备平台（DDP）上管理远程设备的指导和说明。当需要预留远程 Android 设备、建立连接隧道、检查会话状态，或延长/取消租约时，请使用此功能。请勿将其用于 iOS 或本地设备/硬件相关咨询。

name: godot-audio
description: Play and mix audio in Godot 4.7: AudioStreamPlayer (2D/3D variants), audio buses with volume/mute and effects, music vs SFX routing, db/linear volume, and precise sync-to-beat playback timing. Use when playing sounds or music in a Godot project, routing AudioStreamPlayer nodes to buses, adjusting bus volume via AudioServer, or syncing gameplay to the beat.
description_zh: 在 Godot 4.7 中播放和混合音频：AudioStreamPlayer（2D/3D 变体）、带音量/静音和效果的音频总线、音乐与音效路由、分贝/线性音量以及精确的同步到节拍播放时机。用于在 Godot 项目中播放声音或音乐、将 AudioStreamPlayer 节点路由到总线、通过 AudioServer 调整总线音量，或同步游戏到节拍。

name: options-strategy-advisor
description: Options trading strategy analysis and simulation tool. Provides theoretical pricing using Black-Scholes model, Greeks calculation, strategy P/L simulation, and risk management guidance. Use when user requests options strategy analysis, covered calls, protective puts, spreads, iron condors, earnings plays, or options risk management. Includes volatility analysis, position sizing, and earnings-based strategy recommendations. Educational focus with practical trade simulation.
description_zh: 期权交易策略分析与模拟工具。提供基于 Black-Scholes 模型的定价计算、Greeks 指标计算、策略盈亏模拟以及风险管理指导。当用户请求期权策略分析、备兑开仓（covered calls）、保护性认沽（protective puts）、价差策略、铁蝶式策略（iron condors）、财报行情交易策略或期权风险管理时，调用此工具。包含波动率分析、仓位规模管理，以及基于财报的策略建议。侧重于结合实用交易模拟的教育性内容。

name: http-parameter-pollution
description: HTTP Parameter Pollution (HPP): duplicate query/body keys parsed differently by servers, proxies, WAFs, and app frameworks. Use when filters and application layers disagree on which value wins, enabling bypass, SSRF second URL, logic abuse, or CSRF token confusion.
description_zh: HTTP参数污染（HPP）：服务器、代理、WAF和应用程序框架对重复的查询/请求体键进行不同解析。当过滤器与应用程序层对哪个值生效存在分歧时使用，可导致绕过、SSRF二级URL、逻辑滥用或CSRF令牌混淆。

name: deserialization-insecure
description: Insecure deserialization playbook. Use when Java, PHP, or Python applications deserialize untrusted data via ObjectInputStream, unserialize, pickle, or similar mechanisms that may lead to RCE, file access, or privilege escalation.
description_zh: 不安全的反序列化剧本。当 Java、PHP 或 Python 应用程序通过 ObjectInputStream、unserialize、pickle 或类似的机制反序列化不受信任的数据时使用，这些机制可能导致远程代码执行（RCE）、文件访问或权限提升。

name: legal-response
description: Generate a response to a common legal inquiry using configured templates, with built-in escalation checks for situations that shouldn't use a templated reply. Use when responding to data subject requests, litigation hold notices, vendor legal questions, NDA requests from business teams, or subpoenas.
description_zh: 使用配置好的模板生成对常见法律咨询的回复，并内置升级检查机制，以避免在不应使用模板回复的情况下使用。适用于回复数据主体请求、诉讼证据保全通知、供应商法律咨询、业务团队的非公开协议（NDA）请求或传票。

name: chakra-ui-builder
description: Build responsive, accessible UI components and layouts using Chakra UI v3, install or configure Chakra UI in new and existing projects, and design scalable themes using tokens, semantic tokens, recipes, and slot recipes. Use this skill whenever a user asks to build, create, or generate any UI component, page, form, dashboard, navbar, card, landing section, pricing table, or layout using Chakra UI; wants to add Chakra UI to a project, set up ChakraProvider, run CLI snippets, configure color mode, or fix provider wrapping; or asks about theming — defining brand colors, design tokens, semantic tokens, dark mode values, component recipes, slot recipes, typegen, or ejecting the default theme. Trigger on any Chakra UI building, setup, or theming or charts request, however casually phrased — "add my brand colors", "make a reusable card style", "build a bar chart", "show me a line chart", "make me a login form", "build a sidebar", "add Chakra to my app".
description_zh: 使用 Chakra UI v3 构建响应式、可访问的 UI 组件和布局，在新项目和现有项目中安装或配置 Chakra UI，并使用 token、语义 token、配方和插槽配方设计可扩展的主题。每当用户要求使用 Chakra UI 构建、创建或生成任何 UI 组件、页面、表单、仪表板、导航栏、卡片、着陆区域、定价表或布局时；想要将 Chakra UI 添加到项目中、设置 ChakraProvider、运行 CLI 片段、配置颜色模式或修复提供者包装；或询问关于主题——定义品牌颜色、设计 token、语义 token、暗黑模式值、组件配方、插槽配方、typegen 或移除默认主题时，使用此技能。在任何涉及 Chakra UI 构建、设置或主题或图表的请求中触发，无论表达方式多么随意——"添加我的品牌颜色"、"制作可复用的卡片样式"、"构建条形图"、"展示我一条线图"、"制作登录表单"、"构建侧边栏"、"将 Chakra 添加到我的应用"。

name: valyu-best-practices
description: Complete Valyu API toolkit for AI agents. Use this skill when asked to perform real-time search across web, academic, medical, transportation, financial sources, content extraction from URLs, AI-powered answers with citations, or comprehensive deep research reports.
description_zh: 完成用于AI代理的Valyu API工具包。当被要求在网页、学术、医疗、交通、金融来源中进行实时搜索，从URL中提取内容，提供带引用的AI驱动答案，或撰写全面的深度研究报告时，请使用此技能。

name: browser-exploitation-v8
description: Browser and V8 exploitation playbook. Use when exploiting JavaScript engine vulnerabilities including JIT type confusion, incorrect bounds elimination, and V8 sandbox bypass to achieve renderer RCE and sandbox escape in Chrome/Chromium.
description_zh: 浏览器和V8利用手册。在利用JavaScript引擎漏洞时使用，包括JIT类型混淆、错误边界消除和V8沙盒绕过，以在Chrome/Chromium中实现渲染器RCE和沙盒逃逸。

name: research-paper-writer
description: Creates formal academic research papers following IEEE/ACM formatting standards with proper structure, citations, and scholarly writing style. Use when the user asks to write a research paper, academic paper, or conference paper on any topic.
description_zh: 创建符合IEEE/ACM格式标准的正式学术论文，具有正确的结构、引用和学术写作风格。当用户要求撰写任何主题的研究论文、学术论文或会议论文时使用。

name: request-smuggling
description: HTTP request smuggling and desynchronization testing. Use when front proxies, CDNs, or load balancers disagree with the origin on message framing (Content-Length vs Transfer-Encoding), on HTTP/2→HTTP/1 translation, or when exploring client-side desync via browser fetch pipelines.
description_zh: HTTP请求走私和不同步测试。当前代理、CDN或负载均衡器与源端在消息帧（Content-Length与Transfer-Encoding）上存在分歧，或在HTTP/2→HTTP/1转换时，或探索通过浏览器获取管道实现客户端不同步时使用。

name: netlify-deploy
description: Deploy web projects to Netlify using the Netlify CLI (`npx netlify`). Use when the user asks to deploy, host, publish, or link a site/repo on Netlify, including preview and production deploys.
description_zh: 使用 Netlify CLI (`npx netlify`) 将 Web 项目部署到 Netlify。当用户要求在 Netlify 上部署、托管、发布或链接站点/仓库时使用，包括预览和生产部署。

name: race-condition
description: Race condition and TOCTOU testing for web apps. Use when testing one-time operations, concurrent HTTP abuse, rate-limit bypass, Turbo Intruder gates, HTTP/2 single-packet attacks, and CWE-362-style synchronization gaps.
description_zh: 并发条件与TOCTOU测试用于Web应用程序。在测试一次性操作、并发HTTP滥用、速率限制绕过、Turbo Intruder门禁、HTTP/2单包攻击以及CWE-362风格同步间隙时使用。

name: ce-debug
description: Diagnosis loop for bugs and failing behavior. Use when asked to debug or fix failing or slow behavior.
description_zh: 用于诊断错误和失败行为的循环。在被告知需要调试或修复失败或缓慢行为时使用。

name: csp-bypass-advanced
description: Advanced Content Security Policy bypass techniques. Use when XSS or data exfiltration is blocked by CSP and you need to find policy weaknesses, trusted endpoint abuse, nonce leakage, or exfiltration channels that CSP cannot block.
description_zh: 高级内容安全策略绕过技术。当XSS或数据窃取被CSP阻止，且你需要寻找策略弱点、受信任端点的滥用、随机数泄漏或CSP无法阻止的数据窃取通道时使用。

name: nodejs-express-server
description: Build production-ready Express.js servers with middleware, authentication, routing, and database integration. Use when creating REST APIs, managing requests/responses, implementing middleware chains, and handling server logic.
description_zh: 使用中间件、身份验证、路由和数据库集成来构建可投入生产的 Express.js 服务器。适用于创建 REST API、管理请求/响应、实现中间件链以及处理服务器逻辑。

name: c-review
description: Performs comprehensive C/C++ security review for memory corruption, integer overflows, race conditions, and platform-specific vulnerabilities. Use when auditing native C/C++ applications, reviewing daemons or services for memory safety, or hunting integer overflow / use-after-free / race conditions in userspace code.
description_zh: 执行全面的 C/C++ 安全审查，涵盖内存损坏、整数溢出、竞态条件以及平台特定漏洞。适用于审计原生 C/C++ 应用程序、审查守护进程或服务以保障内存安全，或在用户空间代码中查找整数溢出/使用后释放/竞态条件。

name: vueuse-functions
description: Apply VueUse composables where appropriate to build concise, maintainable Vue.js / Nuxt features.
description_zh: 在适当的地方使用 VueUse 组合式函数来构建简洁、可维护的 Vue.js / Nuxt 功能。

name: nx-run-tasks
description: Helps with running tasks in an Nx workspace. USE WHEN the user wants to execute build, test, lint, serve, or run any other tasks defined in the workspace.
description_zh: 帮助在 Nx 工作区中执行任务。在用户想要执行工作区中定义的构建、测试、校验、服务或运行任何其他任务时使用。

name: symbolic-execution-tools
description: Symbolic execution and constraint solving playbook. Use when solving CTF reversing challenges, recovering keys, bypassing checks, or automating binary analysis with angr, Z3, or Unicorn Engine.
description_zh: 符号执行与约束求解手册。在解决CTF逆向挑战、恢复密钥、绕过检查或使用angr、Z3或Unicorn Engine自动化二进制分析时使用。

name: understand-explain
description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase
description_zh: 当您需要深入了解代码库中特定文件、函数或模块的详细解释时使用。

name: blueprint
description: Use when the deliverable is WordPress Playground Blueprint JSON or a Blueprint bundle, including creating, editing, reviewing, validating schema keys, choosing steps/resources, and debugging Blueprint files. For only running or sharing a Playground environment, use wp-playground.
description_zh: 当交付成果是 WordPress Playground Blueprint JSON 或 Blueprint 套件时使用，包括创建、编辑、审阅、验证模式键、选择步骤/资源以及调试 Blueprint 文件。仅用于运行或共享 Playground 环境，请使用 wp-playground。

name: mobile-ssl-pinning-bypass
description: Mobile SSL pinning bypass playbook. Use when intercepting HTTPS traffic from mobile applications that implement certificate pinning, public key pinning, or SPKI hash pinning on Android and iOS, including React Native, Flutter, and Xamarin frameworks.
description_zh: 移动端SSL锁定绕过攻略。在拦截实施证书锁定、公钥锁定或SPKI哈希锁定的Android和iOS移动应用程序的HTTPS流量时使用，包括React Native、Flutter和Xamarin框架。

name: open-redirect
description: Open redirect playbook. Use when URL parameters, form actions, or JavaScript sinks control navigation targets and may redirect users to attacker-controlled destinations.
description_zh: 打开重定向操作手册。在URL参数、表单操作或JavaScript接收端点控制导航目标，并可能将用户重定向到攻击者控制的目的地时使用。

name: better-auth
description: Provides Better Auth integration patterns for NestJS backend and Next.js frontend with Drizzle ORM and PostgreSQL. Use when setting up Better Auth with NestJS backend, integrating Next.js App Router frontend, configuring Drizzle ORM schema, implementing social login (GitHub, Google), adding plugins (2FA, Organization, SSO, Magic Link, Passkey), implementing email/password authentication with session management, or creating protected routes and middleware.
description_zh: 为 NestJS 后端和 Next.js 前端提供更好的 Auth 集成模式，结合 Drizzle ORM 和 PostgreSQL。适用于以下场景：使用 NestJS 后端设置 Better Auth，集成 Next.js App Router 前端，配置 Drizzle ORM 模式，实现社交登录（GitHub、Google），添加插件（2FA、组织、SSO、魔法链接、Passkey），实现带会话管理的邮箱/密码认证，或创建受保护的路由和中间件。

name: sonarqube-mcp
description: Provides SonarQube and SonarCloud integration patterns via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Enables quality gate monitoring, issue discovery and triaging, pre-push code analysis, and rule education directly in the agent workflow. Use when the user wants to check quality gates, search for Sonar issues, analyze code snippets before committing, or understand SonarQube rules. Triggers on "sonarqube", "sonarcloud", "quality gate", "sonar issues", "analyze with sonar", "check sonar", "sonar rule", "pre-push analysis".
description_zh: 通过模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器提供 SonarQube 和 SonarCloud 集成模式。支持在代理工作流中直接进行质量门禁监控、问题发现与分派、提交前代码分析以及规则教育。当用户需要检查质量门禁、搜索 Sonar 问题、在提交前分析代码片段或理解 SonarQube 规则时使用。触发条件包括："sonarqube"、"sonarcloud"、"质量门禁"、"sonar 问题"、"使用 sonar 分析"、"检查 sonar"、"sonar 规则"、"提交前分析"。

name: insecure-source-code-management
description: Source control and artifact exposure (.git, .svn, .hg, backups, .env). Use when recon finds VCS paths, 403 on hidden dirs, or backup/config leaks during authorized testing.
description_zh: 版本控制与工件暴露（.git、.svn、.hg、备份、.env）。在侦察发现版本控制系统路径、隐藏目录的403错误或授权测试期间的备份/配置泄露时使用。

name: godot-export
description: Export and build a Godot 4.7 project for distribution: install export templates, define export presets (Windows/macOS/Linux/Web/Android), run headless command-line exports for CI, and handle web (HTML5) COOP/COEP and dedicated-server/headless builds. Use when exporting a Godot game, configuring export_presets.cfg, building for web/desktop/mobile, or automating builds from the command line.
description_zh: 为分发而导出并构建 Godot 4.7 项目：安装导出模板，定义导出预设（Windows/macOS/Linux/Web/Android），在 CI 中运行无头（headless）命令行导出，并处理 Web（HTML5）的 COOP/COEP 设置以及专用服务器/无头构建。在导出 Godot 游戏、配置 export_presets.cfg、为 Web/桌面/移动端构建，或从命令行自动化构建时使用本工具。

name: writing-shape
description: Writing, exploit：把原始素材塑造成文章，一段一段地推进。
description_zh: 写作，利用：将原始素材塑造成文章，逐段推进。

name: crlf-injection
description: CRLF injection playbook. Use when user input reaches HTTP response headers, Location redirects, Set-Cookie values, or log files where carriage-return/line-feed characters can split or inject content.
description_zh: CRLF注入剧本。当用户输入到达HTTP响应头、Location重定向、Set-Cookie值或日志文件时使用，其中回车/换行字符可以分割或注入内容。

name: design-handoff
description: Generate developer handoff specs from a design. Use when a design is ready for engineering and needs a spec sheet covering layout, design tokens, component props, interaction states, responsive breakpoints, edge cases, and animation details.
description_zh: 从设计生成开发者交接规范。当设计准备就绪，需要一份涵盖布局、设计符号、组件属性、交互状态、响应式断点、边缘案例和动画细节的规范表时使用。

name: http-host-header-attacks
description: HTTP Host header injection and routing abuse playbook. Use when the application trusts the Host header for generating URLs, routing requests, or access control — enabling password reset poisoning, web cache poisoning, SSRF via routing, and virtual host bypass.
description_zh: HTTP 主机头注入和路由滥用剧本。当应用程序信任主机头生成 URL、路由请求或访问控制时使用——可导致密码重置中毒、Web 缓存中毒、通过路由实现服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）以及虚拟主机绕过。

name: web-cache-deception
description: Web cache deception and poisoning playbook. Use when CDN, reverse proxy, or application caching may serve sensitive authenticated content to other users due to path confusion or cache key manipulation.
description_zh: 网络缓存欺骗与污染手册。当CDN、反向代理或应用程序缓存可能因路径混淆或缓存键操纵而向其他用户提供敏感的认证内容时使用。

name: pp-recipe-goat
description: Find the best version of any recipe across 37 trusted sites — with offline cookbook, pantry match, substitution lookup, meal planning, and USDA-backed nutrition. Trigger phrases: `find the best recipe for`, `what can I make with`, `substitute for <ingredient>`, `nutrition for <recipe>`, `use recipe-goat`.
description_zh: 在 37 个值得信赖的网站上找到任何食谱的最佳版本——配备离线食谱簿、储藏室匹配、替代品查询、餐食计划和由美国农业部支持的营养信息。触发短语：`查找最佳食谱`，`我能做什么`，`替代<食材>`，`<食谱>的营养`，`使用recipe-goat`。

name: dependency-confusion
description: Supply-chain testing via package-manager dependency confusion: when internal package names resolve to attacker-controlled public registries, leading to malicious install and script execution. Use for npm/pip/gem/Maven/Composer/Docker manifest review and authorized red-team supply-chain exercises.
description_zh: 通过包管理器依赖混淆进行供应链测试：当内部包名解析到攻击者控制的公共注册中心时，会导致恶意安装和脚本执行。用于npm/pip/gem/Maven/Composer/Docker清单审查和授权的红队供应链演练。

name: git-create-repo
description: Create a new GitHub repository and clone it locally
description_zh: 创建一个新的 GitHub 仓库并将其本地克隆。

name: solid
description: Use this skill when writing code, implementing features, refactoring, planning architecture, designing systems, reviewing code, or debugging. This skill transforms junior-level code into senior-engineer quality software through SOLID principles, TDD, clean code practices, and professional software design.
description_zh: 在编写代码、实现功能、重构、规划架构、设计系统、代码审查或调试时使用这项技能。这项技能通过SOLID原则、TDD（测试驱动开发）、干净代码实践和专业级软件设计，将初级代码转化为高级工程师质量的软件。

name: principle-fix-root-causes
description: Apply when debugging. Trace each symptom to its root cause and fix it there; reproduce first, ask why until you reach it, resist nil-check guards that silence crashes.
description_zh: 在调试时使用。追溯每个症状到其根本原因并就地修复；先复现问题，再问为什么直到找到原因，抵制那些会静音崩溃的空检查守卫。

name: writing-fragments
description: Writing, explore：挖掘原始 fragments，暂不施加任何结构。
description_zh: 写作，探索：挖掘原始碎片，暂不施加任何结构。

name: expression-language-injection
description: Expression Language injection playbook. Use when Java EL, SpEL, OGNL, or MVEL expressions may evaluate attacker-controlled input in Spring, Struts2, Confluence, or similar frameworks.
description_zh: 表达式语言注入演练手册。在Java EL、SpEL、OGNL或MVEL表达式可能在Spring、Struts2、Confluence或类似框架中评估攻击者控制输入时使用。

name: check-understanding
description: Phase quiz for AI Engineering from Scratch. Trigger with "quiz me", "test phase", "check my understanding", "do I know phase 3", or `/check-understanding <phase>`.
description_zh: 从零开始的人工智能工程阶段测验。使用“测验我”、“测试阶段”、“检查我的理解”或“我知道阶段3吗”，或`/check-understanding <阶段>`来触发。

name: aws-resilience-lifecycle
description: Guides the end-to-end AWS resilience lifecycle integrating Resilience Hub v2, Fault Injection Service, and Application Recovery Controller. Covers the Define → Test → Operate workflow: from policy creation through failure mode assessment, to FIS experiment validation, to ARC operational controls. Applicable when the user wants a complete resilience strategy, needs to connect findings to experiments to controls, or is planning a resilience program. Also applicable for the meta question of whether marking NGRH findings as resolved is enough, whether they are "done" after resolving findings, or how to validate findings before resolving them. Not applicable for resolving or remediating a specific individual finding (see resilience-hub-failure-mode-assessment), or when a single service is explicitly named (e.g. "what FIS experiment should I run").
description_zh: 指导端到端的 AWS 弹性生命周期，整合了 Resilience Hub v2、故障注入服务和应用恢复控制器。涵盖定义 → 测试 → 运行的工作流程：从策略创建、故障模式评估，到 FIS 实验验证，再到 ARC 运行控制。适用于用户需要完整弹性策略、需要将发现结果与实验和控制连接，或正在规划弹性计划的情况。也适用于关于是否将 NGRH 发现标记为已解决、解决后发现现是否“完成”，或如何在解决前验证发现等元问题。不适用于解决或修复特定单个发现（参见 resilience-hub-failure-mode-assessment），或在明确指定单个服务时（例如“我应该运行什么 FIS 实验”）。

name: principle-prove-it-works
description: Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff), not a proxy, self-report, or 'it compiles.'
description_zh: 完成任务后立即应用，在声明完成之前。需对照实际产出物进行验证（运行功能、读取实际值、检查差异），而非依赖代理、自报或“能编译”的情况。

name: subdomain-takeover
description: Subdomain takeover detection and exploitation playbook. Use when targets have dangling CNAME/NS/MX records pointing to deprovisioned cloud resources, expired third-party services, or unclaimed SaaS tenants that an attacker can register to serve content under the victim's domain.
description_zh: 子域名接管检测与利用手册。当目标存在指向已停用云资源、过期第三方服务或攻击者可注册以在受害者域名下提供内容的未认领SaaS租户的悬空CNAME/NS/MX记录时使用。

name: start-learning
description: One-time onboarding for the AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum (523 lessons, 20 phases). Interviews the learner, runs the placement quiz, and writes LEARNING.md, a persistent study plan the learn skill drives. Trigger phrases: "start learning", "set up the course", "begin the curriculum", "onboard me", "create my learning plan"
description_zh: AI工程从零开始的入门课程一次性配置（523课时，20阶段）。对学习者进行面试，运行定位测试，并编写LEARNING.md，这是一个由学习技能驱动的持久学习计划。触发短语："开始学习"、"设置课程"、"开始课程"、"让我入门"、"创建我的学习计划"

name: transitgateway
description: Configures AWS Transit Gateway: creating a hub and attaching VPCs, segmenting traffic with route tables, centralizing egress and inspection through a hub (appliances or a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint), forcing east-west traffic between VPCs through AWS Network Firewall, connecting on-premises networks over the transit-gateway side of a Site-to-Site VPN or Direct Connect attachment (including ECMP to aggregate bandwidth across multiple VPN tunnels), peering transit gateways across Regions, migrating from a VPC peering mesh, and routing IP multicast. Applicable when connecting many VPCs through one router, isolating environments, forcing VPC-to-VPC traffic through a central Network Firewall, reaching on-premises over the hub, linking Regions, or moving off a peering mesh. Not applicable for single-VPC routing, VPC peering between two VPCs (vpcpeering skill), Direct Connect gateway or virtual interface setup (directconnect skill), or Route 53 DNS work.
description_zh: 配置 AWS Transit Gateway：创建中心节点并附加 VPC，通过路由表进行流量分段，通过中心节点（设备或网关负载均衡器端点）集中出站流量和检查，通过 AWS 网络防火墙强制 VPC 之间的东西向流量，通过 Transit Gateway 端口连接本地网络（包括通过多个 VPN 隧道聚合带宽的 ECMP），跨区域对等 Transit Gateway，从 VPC 对等网络迁移，以及路由 IP 组播。适用于通过单个路由器连接多个 VPC、隔离环境、通过中心网络防火墙强制 VPC 之间的流量、通过中心节点连接本地网络、连接区域或从对等网络迁移。不适用于单 VPC 路由、两个 VPC 之间的 VPC 对等（vpcpeering 技能）、Direct Connect 网关或虚拟接口设置（directconnect 技能），或 Route 53 DNS 工作。

name: csv-formula-injection
description: CSV/spreadsheet formula injection (DDE, Excel/LibreOffice, Google Sheets IMPORT*). Use when exports, imports, or user fields feed spreadsheets or reporting tools.
description_zh: CSV/电子表格公式注入（DDE、Excel/LibreOffice、Google Sheets IMPORT*）。在导出、导入或用户字段向电子表格或报告工具提供数据时使用。

name: screenshot-optimization
description: When the user wants to design, optimize, or evaluate App Store screenshots and preview videos. Also use when the user mentions "screenshots", "app preview", "product page design", "screenshot design", "creative assets", or "what should my screenshots show". For A/B testing screenshots, see ab-test-store-listing. For full ASO audit, see aso-audit.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计、优化或评估 App Store 截图和预览视频时使用。同时，当用户提到“截图”、“应用预览”、“产品页面设计”、“截图设计”、“创意素材”或“我的截图应该展示什么”时也使用。进行 A/B 测试截图时，请参阅 ab-test-store-listing。进行完整的 ASO 审计时，请参阅 aso-audit。

name: cross-linker
description: Scan the Obsidian wiki and automatically discover missing cross-references between pages. Use this skill when the user says "link my pages", "find missing links", "cross-reference", "connect my wiki", "add wikilinks", "what pages should be linked", or after any large ingestion to ensure new pages are woven into the existing knowledge graph. Also trigger when the user mentions "orphan pages" in the context of wanting to connect them, or says things like "my wiki feels disconnected" or "pages aren't linked well". This is a write-heavy skill — it actually modifies pages to add links, unlike wiki-lint which just reports issues.
description_zh: 扫描 Obsidian 维基并自动发现页面之间的缺失交叉引用。当用户说“链接我的页面”、“查找缺失的链接”、“交叉引用”、“连接我的维基”、“添加维基链接”、“哪些页面应该被链接”，或在任何大型内容导入后使用此技能，以确保新页面融入现有的知识图谱。此外，当用户在希望连接它们的情况下提到“孤儿页面”，或说“我的维基感觉不连贯”或“页面链接不好”时也会触发。这是一个写操作密集型技能——它实际上会修改页面以添加链接，而不同于仅报告问题的 wiki-lint。

name: fps-shooter
description: Build a first-person shooter: move+mouse-look controller, hitscan or projectile shooting, weapons, health, and enemy AI. Use for an FPS, or tuning aim feel, time-to-kill, recoil, or spread.
description_zh: 构建第一人称射击游戏：移动+鼠标视角控制器、命中扫描或抛射物射击、武器、生命值和敌人AI。可用于FPS游戏，或调整瞄准手感、击杀时间、后坐力或散布。

name: godot-2d-movement
description: Implement 2D kinematic character movement in Godot 4.7 with CharacterBody2D and move_and_slide(): platformer run/jump with gravity, top-down 8-direction motion, slope handling, and reading collisions. Use when coding a 2D player or enemy controller, a platformer or top-down character, or fixing move_and_slide()/ is_on_floor() behavior in a .tscn with a CharacterBody2D.
description_zh: 在 Godot 4.7 中使用 CharacterBody2D 和 move_and_slide() 实现 2D 动态角色移动：平台跳跃跑动、重力效果、俯视 8 向移动、斜坡处理及碰撞检测。适用于编写 2D 玩家或敌人控制器、平台跳跃或俯视角色，或在 .tscn 文件中使用 CharacterBody2D 修复 move_and_slide()/is_on_floor() 行为。

name: jndi-injection
description: JNDI injection playbook. Use when Java applications perform JNDI lookups with attacker-controlled names, especially via Log4j2, Spring, or any code path reaching InitialContext.lookup().
description_zh: JNDI注入演练手册。当Java应用程序使用攻击者控制的名称执行JNDI查找时使用，特别是通过Log4j2、Spring或任何到达InitialContext.lookup()的代码路径。

name: access
description: Manage Discord channel access — approve pairings, edit allowlists, set DM/group policy. Use when the user asks to pair, approve someone, check who's allowed, or change policy for the Discord channel.
description_zh: 管理 Discord 通道访问权限——批准配对、编辑白名单、设置 DM/群组策略。当用户请求配对、批准某人、查看谁被允许访问或更改 Discord 通道策略时使用。

name: writing-beats
description: Writing, exploit——把原始素材组装成一段节拍旅程，在某个 beat 依赖一个术语之前先把它 grounded。
description_zh: 写作，利用——将原始素材组装成一段节奏旅程，在依赖某个术语之前先将其 grounded。

name: configure
description: Set up the Discord channel — save the bot token and review access policy. Use when the user pastes a Discord bot token, asks to configure Discord, asks "how do I set this up" or "who can reach me," or wants to check channel status.
description_zh: 设置 Discord 通道——保存机器人令牌并审查访问策略。当用户粘贴 Discord 机器人令牌、请求配置 Discord、询问“如何设置这个”或“谁可以联系我”，或想要检查通道状态时使用。

name: privacy-policy
description: Draft a detailed privacy policy covering data types, jurisdiction, GDPR and compliance considerations, and clauses needing legal review. Use when creating a privacy policy, updating data protection documentation, or preparing for compliance.
description_zh: 起草一份详细的隐私政策，涵盖数据类型、司法管辖权、GDPR合规性考虑以及需要法律审核的条款。在创建隐私政策、更新数据保护文件或准备合规性工作时使用。

name: active-directory-acl-abuse
description: Active Directory ACL abuse playbook. Use when exploiting misconfigured AD permissions including GenericAll, WriteDACL, DCSync rights, shadow credentials, LAPS reading, GPO abuse, and BloodHound-guided attack paths.
description_zh: Active Directory ACL滥用剧本。在利用配置错误的AD权限（包括通用完全控制、写入DACL、DCSync权限、影子凭证、LAPS读取、GPO滥用以及BloodHound引导的攻击路径时使用。

name: clickjacking
description: Clickjacking playbook. Use when testing whether target pages can be framed, whether X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors are properly configured, and whether UI redress attacks can trigger sensitive actions.
description_zh: 点击劫持操作手册。用于测试目标页面是否可被嵌入框架，X-Frame-Options或CSP frame-ancestors是否配置正确，以及UI补偿攻击是否可触发敏感操作。

name: openspec-sync-specs
description: Sync delta specs from an OpenSpec change to main specs. Use when the user wants to update main specs with changes from a delta spec, without archiving the change. Also use when the user says "openspec sync" or "opsx sync".
description_zh: 从OpenSpec变更中同步差异规范到主规范。当用户希望使用差异规范中的变更来更新主规范，且不存档变更时使用。也用于用户输入"openspec sync"或"opsx sync"时。

name: debug
description: Run /debug to find and fix a bug's root cause: a test failing for an unclear reason, /check verify finding a failure, or behavior being wrong. Runs a reproduce, localize, hypothesize, test, fix, verify loop, makes the minimal fix, and hands a regression test to /test. No features, no extra refactors.
description_zh: 运行 `/debug` 来查找并修复一个 bug 的根本原因：一个测试因不明原因失败，`/check` 验证找到的失败情况，或行为不正确。它运行一个“复现、定位、假设、测试、修复、验证”的循环，做出最小化修复，并将回归测试交给 `/test`。不包含新功能，也不进行额外的重构。

name: book-study
description: Reading coach: guides users through books systematically with knowledge compilation, mastery testing, spaced repetition, and knowledge querying. Use when user says 'read this book with me', 'book study', 'start studying X', 'reading plan', 'ingest this chapter', 'review what I read', 'quiz me on the book', 'what did the book say about X', or invokes /book-study. Supports sub-commands: ingest, query, review, compare, status. Triggers: book, study, read, chapter, ingest, review, quiz, reading plan, book notes.
description_zh: 阅读教练：通过知识汇编、掌握测试、间隔重复和知识查询，系统地指导用户阅读书籍。当用户说“和我一起读这本书”、“书籍学习”、“开始学习X”、“阅读计划”、“吸收这一章”、“复习我读的内容”、“给我出书题”、“这本书关于X说了什么”，或调用/book-study时使用。支持子命令：吸收、查询、复习、比较、状态。触发词：书籍、学习、阅读、章节、吸收、复习、测验、阅读计划、书籍笔记。

name: card-game
