description: Build a card game: card data, deck/hand/discard zones, draw/shuffle/reshuffle, a turn structure, costs, and effect resolution. Use for a deckbuilder, TCG/CCG, or roguelike deckbuilder.
description_zh: 构建一张卡牌游戏：卡牌数据、牌组/手牌/弃牌区、抽牌/洗牌/重新洗牌、回合结构、费用和效果结算。用于卡组构筑游戏、TCG/CCG或roguelike卡组构筑游戏。

name: github-trending
description: Fetch and display GitHub trending repositories and developers. Use when building dashboards showing trending repos, discovering popular projects, or tracking GitHub trends. Triggers on GitHub trending, trending repos, popular repositories, GitHub discover.
description_zh: 获取并展示 GitHub 热门仓库和开发者。在构建展示热门仓库的仪表盘、发现热门项目或追踪 GitHub 趋势时使用。在 GitHub 热门、热门仓库、热门仓库、GitHub 发现时触发。

name: android-kotlin
description: Android Kotlin development with Coroutines, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, and MockK testing
description_zh: 使用协程、Jetpack Compose、Hilt 和 MockK 进行 Android Kotlin 开发和测试

name: dart-use-doc-examples
description: How to inject external code examples into Dartdoc using the {@example} directive, and how to filter those files using #hide, #region, and #endregion tags.
description_zh: 如何使用 {@example} 指令将外部代码示例注入 Dartdoc，以及如何使用 #hide、#region 和 #endregion 标签过滤这些文件。

name: animate
description: Animation patterns and best practices for Next.js/React applications. Use this skill when implementing animations, transitions, hover effects, page transitions, modals, or any motion in React components. Based on Emil Kowalski's "Animations on the Web" course.

name: sentry-node-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Node.js, Bun, and Deno. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Node.js", "add Sentry to Bun", "add Sentry to Deno", "install @sentry/node", "@sentry/bun", or "@sentry/deno", or configure error monitoring, tracing, logging, profiling, metrics, crons, or AI monitoring for server-side JavaScript/TypeScript runtimes.
description_zh: Node.js、Bun 和 Deno 的完整 Sentry SDK 配置。当被要求“为 Node.js 添加 Sentry”、“为 Bun 添加 Sentry”、“为 Deno 添加 Sentry”、“安装 @sentry/node”、“@sentry/bun”或“@sentry/deno”时使用，或为服务器端 JavaScript/TypeScript 运行时配置错误监控、追踪、日志记录、性能分析、指标、定时任务或 AI 监控。

name: godot-3d-essentials
description: Set up a Godot 4.7 3D scene: Node3D transforms, Camera3D, lighting (DirectionalLight3D/OmniLight3D), WorldEnvironment for sky/ambient/tonemap/post, MeshInstance3D materials, and GridMap for tile-based 3D levels. Use when building a 3D scene in a Godot project, placing cameras/lights, configuring environment and post-processing, or working with Node3D/.tscn 3D content and GridMap.
description_zh: 设置一个 Godot 4.7 的 3D 场景：Node3D 变换、Camera3D、光照（DirectionalLight3D/OmniLight3D）、WorldEnvironment 用于天空/环境光/色调映射/后期处理、MeshInstance3D 材质，以及 GridMap 用于基于瓦片的 3D 关卡。在 Godot 项目中构建 3D 场景时使用，放置相机/灯光，配置环境和后期处理，或处理 Node3D/.tscn 3D 内容和 GridMap。

name: http2-specific-attacks
description: HTTP/2 protocol-specific attack playbook. Use when the target supports HTTP/2 and you need to exploit binary framing, HPACK compression, h2c upgrade smuggling, pseudo-header injection, stream multiplexing abuse, or H2→H1 downgrade translation flaws.
description_zh: HTTP/2 协议特定攻击手册。当目标支持 HTTP/2 且您需要利用二进制帧、HPACK 压缩、h2c 升级走私、伪头部注入、流复用滥用或 H2→H1 降级转换漏洞时使用。

name: saml-sso-assertion-attacks
description: SAML SSO assertion attack playbook. Use when testing signature validation, assertion wrapping, audience restrictions, ACS handling, XML trust boundaries, and enterprise SSO flaws.
description_zh: SAML SSO断言攻击演练手册。用于测试签名验证、断言封装、观众限制、ACS处理、XML信任边界和企业SSO漏洞。

name: test-anti-patterns
description: Audit a test file or suite; produce a severity-ranked diagnostic report. ALWAYS USE for tests that verify nothing, missing/tautological assertions, swallowed/broad exceptions, flaky/order-dependent tests, duplication, or magic values. Polyglot. DO NOT USE for direct edits: writing-mstest-tests owns supplied MSTest assertions/attributes/lifecycle; code-testing-agent owns new tests. Exclude running tests, migration, assertion metrics (assertion-quality), raw .NET coverage collection (run-tests), non-.NET coverage collection/analysis (native tooling), project-wide .NET coverage/CRAP (coverage-analysis), named-target .NET CRAP (crap-score), behavioral/pseudo-mutation gaps (test-gap-analysis), test-mix/ happy-vs-error classification and trait distributions (test-tagging), or the testsmells.org catalog (test-smell-detection).
description_zh: 审计测试文件或测试套件；生成按严重程度排序的诊断报告。始终用于验证无内容、缺失/冗余断言、被吞没/宽泛异常、不稳定/依赖顺序的测试、重复或魔法值。多语言支持。不应用于直接编辑：writing-mstest-tests 拥有提供的 MSTest 断言/属性/生命周期；code-testing-agent 拥有新的测试。排除运行测试、迁移、断言指标（断言质量）、原始 .NET 覆盖率收集（run-tests）、非 .NET 覆盖率收集/分析（原生工具）、项目级 .NET 覆盖率/CRAP（覆盖率分析）、命名目标 .NET CRAP（crap-score）、行为/伪变异差距（test-gap-analysis）、测试混合/成功与错误分类和特征分布（test-tagging），或 testsmells.org 目录（test-smell-detection）。

name: hash-attack-techniques
description: Hash attack playbook. Use when exploiting length extension, MD5/SHA1 collisions, HMAC timing leaks, birthday attacks, or hash-based proof of work in CTF and authorized testing scenarios.
description_zh: 哈希攻击手册。在利用长度扩展、MD5/SHA1 碰撞、HMAC 时间泄露、生日攻击或基于哈希的工作量证明等 CTF 和授权测试场景中使用。

name: sentry-cocoa-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Apple platforms (iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS). Use when asked to "add Sentry to iOS", "add Sentry to Swift", "install sentry-cocoa", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, session replay, logging, or metrics for Apple applications. Supports SwiftUI and UIKit.
description_zh: 苹果平台（iOS、macOS、tvOS、watchOS、visionOS）的完整Sentry SDK设置。当被要求“将Sentry添加到iOS”、“将Sentry添加到Swift”、“安装sentry-cocoa”，或为苹果应用程序配置错误监控、跟踪、分析、会话回放、日志记录或指标时使用。支持SwiftUI和UIKit。

name: find-your-level
description: Interactive quiz that maps your AI/ML knowledge to a starting point in the 523-lesson, 20-phase AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum. Trigger phrases: "where should I start", "find my level", "what do I know", "which phase", "assess my knowledge", "placement test", "skip ahead"
description_zh: 互动式测试，将您的AI/ML知识映射到“从零开始”的20阶段、523课时的AI工程课程的起点。触发短语：“我应该从哪里开始”、“找到我的水平”、“我了解什么”、“哪个阶段”、“评估我的知识”、“水平测试”、“跳过前进”

name: active-directory-kerberos-attacks
description: Kerberos attack playbook for Active Directory. Use when targeting AD authentication via AS-REP roasting, Kerberoasting, golden/silver/diamond tickets, delegation abuse, or pass-the-ticket attacks.
description_zh: Active Directory 的 Kerberos 攻击剧本。在针对通过 AS-REP 炸烤、Kerberoasting、黄金/白银/钻石票据、委派滥用或票据传递攻击的 AD 身份验证时使用。

name: stock-correlation
description: Analyze how stocks move together using Yahoo Finance price history (yfinance): find correlated peers for a ticker, measure correlation, beta, and spread between specific tickers, cluster a group into a correlation matrix, and track rolling or regime-dependent correlation. Use this skill whenever the user asks what moves with a stock, what else drops when it drops, related tickers or sympathy plays, sector or supply-chain peers, pair trading or hedging pairs, beta or relative performance, correlation matrices, co-movement, or rolling/realized correlation — including well-known pairs like AMD/NVDA, GOOGL/AVGO, or LITE/COHR. With a single ticker, assume the user wants its correlated peers.
description_zh: 使用Yahoo Finance价格历史（yfinance）分析股票的联动情况：为某个股票代码找到相关的同行股票，测量相关性、贝塔系数和特定股票之间的价差，将一组股票聚类到相关性矩阵中，并跟踪滚动或状态依赖的相关性。每当用户询问什么与股票联动、什么在它下跌时也会下跌、相关股票或同情性交易、行业或供应链同行、配对交易或对冲配对、贝塔系数或相对表现、相关性矩阵、共同运动或滚动/已实现相关性时，都可以使用这项技能——包括像AMD/NVDA、GOOGL/AVGO或LITE/COHR这样著名的配对。对于单个股票代码，假设用户想要的是它的相关同行股票。

name: tiptap
description: Helps coding agents integrate and work with the Tiptap rich text editor. Use when building or modifying a rich text editor with Tiptap, installing Tiptap extensions, or implementing features like collaboration, comments, AI, or document conversion.
description_zh: 帮助代码智能体集成并使用 Tiptap 富文本编辑器。在构建或修改基于 Tiptap 的富文本编辑器、安装 Tiptap 扩展，或实现协作、评论、AI 或文档转换等功能时使用。

name: design-brief
description:
Parse a structured design brief written in I-Lang protocol format into a
concrete design spec. Eliminates ambiguity from vague requests like
"make it professional" by requiring explicit dimensions: palette, typography,
layout, mood, density, and constraints.
Trigger keywords: "design brief", "create a design brief", "ilang brief", "structured brief".
description_zh:
将使用I-Lang协议格式编写的结构化设计简报解析为具体的设计规范。通过要求明确尺寸（如调色板、字体、布局、氛围、密度和约束条件），消除诸如“使其专业”等模糊请求中的歧义。
触发关键词：“设计简报”、“创建设计简报”、“ilang简报”、“结构化简报”。

name: linux-privilege-escalation
description: Linux privilege escalation playbook. Use when you have low-privilege shell access and need to escalate to root via SUID/SGID binaries, capabilities, cron abuse, kernel exploits, misconfigurations, or credential harvesting on Linux systems.
description_zh: Linux 权限提升剧本。在您拥有低权限 shell 访问权限且需要通过 SUID/SGID 二进制程序、功能、cron 滥用、内核漏洞、配置错误或 Linux 系统凭证收集来提升至 root 权限时使用。

name: git-commit-push
description: Commit changes and push to origin without creating a PR
description_zh: 提交更改并推送到origin，无需创建PR

name: backtest
description: Quick backtest a strategy on a symbol. Creates a complete .py script with data fetch, signals, backtest, stats, and plots.
description_zh: 快速在某个股票代码上回测策略。生成一个完整的 .py 脚本，包含数据获取、信号生成、回测、统计分析和图表绘制。

name: active-directory-certificate-services
description: AD Certificate Services attack playbook. Use when targeting misconfigured AD CS for privilege escalation via ESC1-ESC13 template abuse, NTLM relay to enrollment, CA officer abuse, and certificate-based persistence.
description_zh: AD证书服务攻击剧本。在针对配置错误的AD CS以通过ESC1-ESC13模板滥用实现权限提升、NTLM中继到注册、CA官员滥用以及基于证书的持久化时使用。

name: aws-lambda-java-integration
description: Provides AWS Lambda integration patterns for Java with cold start optimization. Use when deploying Java functions to AWS Lambda, choosing between Micronaut and Raw Java approaches, optimizing cold starts below 1 second, configuring API Gateway or ALB integration, or implementing serverless Java applications. Triggers include "create lambda java", "deploy java lambda", "micronaut lambda aws", "java lambda cold start", "aws lambda java performance", "java serverless framework".
description_zh: 提供针对 Java 的 AWS Lambda 集成模式，并支持冷启动优化。在将 Java 函数部署到 AWS Lambda 时使用，可选择 Micronaut 或原始 Java 方法，优化冷启动至 1 秒以下，配置 API Gateway 或 ALB 集成，或实现无服务器 Java 应用。触发词包括 "create lambda java"、"deploy java lambda"、"micronaut lambda aws"、"java lambda cold start"、"aws lambda java performance"、"java serverless framework"。

name: directconnect
description: Configures AWS Direct Connect: choosing a connection model (dedicated, hosted, or a link aggregation group) and completing the cross connect; creating private, public, and transit virtual interfaces and bringing up BGP; reaching many VPCs through a Direct Connect gateway including cross-account transit gateway associations; encrypting traffic with MACsec or a private IP Site-to-Site VPN; making the connection resilient and tuning failover; managing link aggregation groups; SiteLink; and migrating from a virtual private gateway to a transit gateway. Use when the user wants a private, consistent network link between a data center and AWS, or operates an existing Direct Connect setup and needs to extend, encrypt, or harden it. Routes to the right per-task procedure in references. Do NOT use for transit gateway route tables and attachments (transitgateway skill), Site-to-Site VPN without Direct Connect (sitetositevpn skill), or Route 53 DNS routing (route53 skill).
description_zh: 配置 AWS Direct Connect：选择连接模式（专用、托管或链路聚合组）并完成跨连接；创建私有、公共和传输虚拟接口并启动 BGP；通过 Direct Connect 网关连接到多个 VPC，包括跨账户传输网关关联；使用 MACsec 或私有 IP 站点到站点 VPN 加密流量；使连接具有弹性并调整故障转移；管理链路聚合组；SiteLink；以及从虚拟私有网关迁移到传输网关。当用户需要在数据中心和 AWS 之间建立私有、一致的网络安全连接，或操作现有的 Direct Connect 设置并需要扩展、加密或加固时使用。参考中会根据任务类型引导至正确的操作步骤。**不适用于**传输网关路由表和附件（transitgateway 技能）、无 Direct Connect 的站点到站点 VPN（sitetositevpn 技能）或 Route 53 DNS 路由（route53 技能）。

name: sherpa-onnx-tts
description: Local text-to-speech via sherpa-onnx (offline, no cloud)
description_zh: 本地通过sherpa-onnx的文本转语音（离线，无需云服务）

name: arbitrary-write-to-rce
description: Arbitrary write to RCE playbook. Use when you have an arbitrary write primitive (from heap exploitation, format string, or OOB write) and need to convert it into code execution by targeting GOT, hooks, _IO_FILE vtable, exit_funcs, TLS_dtor_list, modprobe_path, .fini_array, or C++ vtables.
description_zh:
**任意写入到 RCE 攻击手册**  
适用于已具备任意写入原语（如堆利用、格式化字符串漏洞或越界写入）并需要将其转化为代码执行的情形。可针对 GOT、钩子、_IO_FILE 虚函数表、exit_funcs、TLS_dtor_list、modprobe_path、.fini_array 或 C++ 虚函数表等目标实施攻击。

name: prototype-pollution
description: Prototype pollution testing for JavaScript stacks. Use when user input is merged into objects (query parsers, JSON bodies, deep assign), when configuring libraries via untrusted keys, or when hunting RCE gadgets via polluted Object.prototype in Node or the browser.
description_zh: JavaScript 技术栈的原型污染测试。适用于以下场景：当用户输入被合并到对象中时（如查询解析器、JSON 请求体、深度赋值操作）；当使用不可信键配置第三方库时；或在 Node.js 或浏览器环境中，通过被污染的 Object.prototype 挖掘远程代码执行（RCE）利用链时。

name: m10-performance
description: CRITICAL: Use for performance optimization. Triggers: performance, optimization, benchmark, profiling, flamegraph, criterion, slow, fast, allocation, cache, SIMD, make it faster, 性能优化, 基准测试
description_zh: 关键：用于性能优化。触发词：性能、优化、基准测试、性能分析、火焰图、标准、慢、快、内存分配、缓存、SIMD、使其更快、性能优化、基准测试

name: ios-simulator
description: Verify and debug native, React Native, Expo, or Flutter apps on an iOS Simulator with agent-device. Use when an agent needs to launch an app, inspect its live UI, tap, type, scroll, validate a code change, collect failure evidence, or reproduce a workflow on an iPhone or iPad Simulator.
description_zh: 使用 agent-device 在 iOS 模拟器上验证和调试原生、React Native、Expo 或 Flutter 应用。当代理需要启动应用、检查其实时 UI、点击、输入、滚动、验证代码更改、收集错误证据或在 iPhone 或 iPad 模拟器上重现工作流程时使用。

name: ai-ml-security
description: AI/ML security playbook. Use when assessing model supply chain attacks (pickle RCE, poisoned weights), adversarial examples, model poisoning, model stealing, data privacy attacks (membership inference, model inversion), and autonomous agent security risks.
description_zh: AI/ML 安全操作手册。在评估模型供应链攻击（如 pickle 远程代码执行、投毒权重）、对抗性样本、模型投毒、模型窃取、数据隐私攻击（如成员推断、模型逆向）以及自主智能体安全风险时使用。

name: dns-rebinding-attacks
description: DNS rebinding attack playbook. Use when testing applications that trust DNS resolution for origin checks, interact with internal services from browser context, or when SSRF is not possible server-side but the target has client-side fetch/XHR to attacker-controlled domains.
description_zh: DNS 重绑定攻击操作手册。在测试依赖 DNS 解析进行源站校验的应用程序、在浏览器环境中与内部服务交互，或无法在服务端利用 SSRF（服务器端请求伪造）但目标存在由攻击者控制的域名发起的客户端 fetch/XHR 请求时，可使用本手册。

name: senior-data-scientist
description: World-class data science skill for statistical modeling, experimentation, causal inference, and advanced analytics. Expertise in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn), R, SQL, statistical methods, A/B testing, time series, and business intelligence. Includes experiment design, feature engineering, model evaluation, and stakeholder communication. Use when designing experiments, building predictive models, performing causal analysis, or driving data-driven decisions.
description_zh: 世界级的数据科学技能，适用于统计建模、实验设计、因果推断和高级分析。精通 Python（NumPy、Pandas、Scikit-learn）、R、SQL、统计方法、A/B 测试、时间序列和商业智能。涵盖实验设计、特征工程、模型评估和利益相关者沟通。适用于设计实验、构建预测模型、进行因果分析或推动数据驱动决策。

name: spring-boot-project-creator
description: Creates and scaffolds a new Spring Boot project (3.x or 4.x) by downloading from Spring Initializr, generating package structure (DDD or Layered architecture), configuring JPA, SpringDoc OpenAPI, and Docker Compose services (PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB). Use when creating a new Java Spring Boot project from scratch, bootstrapping a microservice, or initializing a backend application.
description_zh: 通过从 Spring Initializr 下载创建并搭建一个新的 Spring Boot 项目（3.x 或 4.x），生成包结构（领域驱动设计或分层架构），配置 JPA、SpringDoc OpenAPI 和 Docker Compose 服务（PostgreSQL、Redis、MongoDB）。适用于从零开始创建新的 Java Spring Boot 项目、启动微服务或初始化后端应用程序。

name: filter-syntax
description: Reference-only filter syntax for VSTest and MTP with MSTest, NUnit, xUnit v3, and TUnit. Load only after the platform/framework is known and a consumer needs to create or translate a filter. Do not load for unfiltered runs or platform detection. Used by run-tests and mtp-hot-reload; never invoke directly.
description_zh: 仅用于参考的 VSTest 和 MTP 的 MSTest、NUnit、xUnit v3 和 TUnit 过滤器语法。仅在平台/框架确定且消费者需要创建或转换过滤器时加载。未过滤运行或平台检测时无需加载。由 run-tests 和 mtp-hot-reload 使用；切勿直接调用。

name: defi-attack-patterns
description: DeFi attack pattern playbook. Use when analyzing flash loan attacks, price oracle manipulation, MEV sandwich attacks, governance exploits, bridge vulnerabilities, and token standard edge cases in decentralized finance protocols.
description_zh: DeFi攻击模式手册。在分析去中心化金融协议中的闪电贷攻击、预言机价格操纵、MEV三明治攻击、治理漏洞、跨链桥安全风险以及代币标准边缘用例时，请使用本手册。

name: account-research
description: Research a company using Common Room data. Triggers on 'research [company]', 'tell me about [domain]', 'pull up signals for [account]', 'what's going on with [company]', or any account-level question.
description_zh: 使用 Common Room 数据调研公司。当用户输入“研究[公司]”、“告诉我[域名]的相关信息”、“调取[客户]的信号”、“[公司]发生了什么”，或提出任何针对具体客户的问题时，将触发此功能。

name: notebooklm
description: Enables interaction with Google NotebookLM for advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) capabilities via the notebooklm-mcp-cli tool. Use when querying project documentation stored in NotebookLM, managing research notebooks and sources, retrieving AI-synthesized information, generating audio podcasts or reports from notebooks, or performing contextual queries against curated knowledge bases. Triggers on "notebooklm", "nlm", "notebook query", "research notebook", "query documentation in notebooklm".
description_zh: 通过 notebooklm-mcp-cli 工具，启用与 Google NotebookLM 的交互，以实现高级 RAG（检索增强生成）功能。在以下情况下使用：查询存储在 NotebookLM 中的项目文档、管理研究笔记本和来源、检索 AI 合成信息、从笔记本生成音频播客或报告，或对精选知识库执行上下文查询。在输入 "notebooklm"、"nlm"、"notebook query"、"research notebook"、"query documentation in notebooklm" 时触发。

name: dangling-markup-injection
description: Dangling markup injection playbook. Use when HTML injection is possible but JavaScript execution is blocked (CSP, sanitizer strips event handlers, WAF blocks script tags) — exfiltrate CSRF tokens, session data, and page content by injecting unclosed HTML tags that capture subsequent page content.
description_zh: 悬挂式标记注入操作手册。当 HTML 注入可行但 JavaScript 执行被阻断时（例如 CSP 限制、净化器剥离事件处理器、WAF 拦截 script 标签），使用此策略。通过注入未闭合的 HTML 标签以捕获后续页面内容，从而窃取 CSRF 令牌、会话数据及页面内容。

name: ce-commit
description: Create a git commit with a clear, value-communicating message. Use when the user asks to commit/save staged or unstaged changes with a repo-appropriate message.
description_zh: 创建一个具有清晰、传达价值的提交信息。当用户要求使用与仓库相关的适当信息提交/保存暂存或未暂存的更改时使用。

name: docs-updater
description: Provides automated documentation updates by analyzing git changes between the current branch and the last release tag. Performs git diff analysis to identify modifications, then updates README.md, CHANGELOG.md following Keep a Changelog standard, and discovers documentation folders for contextual updates. Use when preparing a release, maintaining documentation sync, or before creating a pull request. Triggers on "update docs", "update changelog", "sync documentation", "update readme", "prepare release documentation".
description_zh: 通过分析当前分支与最后一个发布标签之间的git变更，提供自动化的文档更新。执行git diff分析以识别修改，然后按照Keep a Changelog标准更新README.md和CHANGELOG.md，并发现文档文件夹以进行上下文相关的更新。在准备发布、维护文档同步或创建pull request之前使用。在"update docs"、"update changelog"、"sync documentation"、"update readme"、"prepare release documentation"等操作时触发。

name: things-mac
description: Add, update, list, search, or inspect Things 3 todos, inbox, today, projects, areas, and tags on macOS.
description_zh: 在 macOS 上添加、更新、列出、搜索或检查 Things 3 的待办事项、收件箱、今天、项目、区域和标签。

name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
description: Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.
description_zh: 当你发现自己第二次写出相同的指示，或注意到反复出现的更正时，就应用此方法。将规则编码为代码检查（lint）、元数据标记、运行时校验或脚本，而非依赖更多文字说明。

name: check
description: Confirm a change before merge. `/check verify` drives the real app to prove behavior against the spec (every acceptance criterion met, every surface built). `/check review` runs a senior code review on a fresh model, one that did not write the code. Verify after /develop, review before a PR. Writes to docs/reviews/, never edits code.
description_zh: 在合并前确认变更。`/check verify` 驱动真实应用来验证行为是否符合规范（所有验收标准都满足，所有界面都已构建）。`/check review` 在一个未编写代码的新模型上运行高级代码审查。在 `/develop` 后进行验证，在 PR 前进行审查。文档写入到 `docs/reviews/`，从不编辑代码。

name: network-protocol-attacks
description: Network protocol attack playbook. Use when exploiting layer 2/3 protocols including ARP spoofing, LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS poisoning, WPAD abuse, DHCPv6 attacks, VLAN hopping, STP manipulation, DNS spoofing, IPv6 attacks, and IDS/IPS evasion.
description_zh: 网络协议攻击手册。在对二层/三层协议进行利用时使用，包括 ARP 欺骗、LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS 投毒、WPAD 滥用、DHCPv6 攻击、VLAN 跳跃、STP 操纵、DNS 欺骗、IPv6 攻击以及 IDS/IPS 规避。

name: windows-av-evasion
description: AV/EDR evasion playbook for Windows. Use when bypassing AMSI, ETW, .NET assembly detection, shellcode execution, process injection, API hooking, and signature-based detection on Windows endpoints.
description_zh: Windows 环境下 AV/EDR 规避操作手册。适用于绕过端点上的 AMSI、ETW、.NET 程序集检测、Shellcode 执行、进程注入、API Hooking 以及基于签名的检测等场景。

name: aws-lambda-php-integration
description: Provides AWS Lambda integration patterns for PHP with Symfony using the Bref framework. Creates Lambda handler classes, configures runtime layers, sets up SQS/SNS event triggers, implements warm-up strategies, and optimizes cold starts. Use when deploying PHP/Symfony applications to AWS Lambda, configuring API Gateway integration, implementing serverless PHP applications, or optimizing Lambda performance with Bref. Triggers include "create lambda php", "deploy symfony lambda", "bref lambda aws", "php lambda cold start", "aws lambda php performance", "symfony serverless", "php serverless framework".
description_zh: 提供使用 Bref 框架在 PHP 和 Symfony 中集成的 AWS Lambda 模式。创建 Lambda 处理器类、配置运行时层、设置 SQS/SNS 事件触发器、实现预热策略并优化冷启动。在将 PHP/Symfony 应用部署到 AWS Lambda、配置 API Gateway 集成、实现无服务器 PHP 应用或使用 Bref 优化 Lambda 性能时使用。触发器包括 "create lambda php"、"deploy symfony lambda"、"bref lambda aws"、"php lambda 冷启动"、"aws lambda php 性能"、"symfony 无服务器"、"php 无服务器框架"。

name: langsmith-online-eval-engineering
description: Iteratively inspect traces, interview the user, and create LangSmith online evaluators one at a time. Use specifically for creating online evaluators for use within LangSmith -- use "eval-engineering" for Harbor-style online evaluations.
description_zh: 逐一生成LangSmith在线评估器。专门用于在LangSmith中创建在线评估器——使用"eval-engineering"创建Harbor风格的在线评估。

name: nx-generate
description: Generate code using nx generators. INVOKE IMMEDIATELY when user mentions scaffolding, setup, structure, creating apps/libs, or setting up project structure. Trigger words - scaffold, setup, create a new app, create a new lib, project structure, generate, add a new project. ALWAYS use this BEFORE calling nx_docs or exploring - this skill handles discovery internally.
description_zh: 使用 nx 生成器生成代码。当用户提到 scaffolding、setup、structure、创建应用/库或设置项目结构时，立即调用。触发词：scaffold、setup、创建新应用、创建新库、项目结构、生成、添加新项目。调用 nx_docs 或探索之前，务必使用此技能——该技能内部处理发现过程。

name: xslt-injection
description: XSLT injection testing: processor fingerprinting, XXE and document() SSRF, EXSLT write primitives, PHP/Java/.NET extension RCE surfaces. Use when user-controlled XSLT/stylesheet input or transform endpoints are in scope.
description_zh: XSLT 注入测试：处理器指纹识别、XXE 及 document() 引发的 SSRF、EXSLT 写入原语、PHP/Java/.NET 扩展中的 RCE 攻击面。当用户可控的 XSLT/样式表输入或转换端点在测试范围内时使用此方法。

name: understand-chat
description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph
description_zh: 当您需要就代码库提问或通过知识图谱理解代码时使用

name: github-issue-workflow
description: Provides a structured 8-phase workflow for resolving GitHub issues in Claude Code. Covers fetching issue details, analyzing requirements, implementing solutions, verifying correctness, performing code review, committing changes, and creating pull requests. Use when user asks to resolve, implement, work on, fix, or close a GitHub issue, or references an issue URL or number for implementation.
description_zh: 为解决 Claude Code 中的 GitHub 问题提供结构化的 8 步工作流程。涵盖获取问题详情、分析需求、实施解决方案、验证正确性、执行代码审查、提交更改以及创建拉取请求。当用户要求解决、实施、处理、修复或关闭 GitHub 问题，或引用问题 URL 或编号进行实施时使用。

name: create-design-md
description: Create or update a DESIGN.md from an existing product repository or public website. Use when asked to document an interface's design language, reconstruct its visual system, extract design tokens and guidance from current evidence, or give coding agents persistent UI context. Do not modify product source or promote accidental implementation patterns into design decisions.
description_zh: 从现有的产品仓库或公共网站创建或更新 DESIGN.md 文件。在需要记录界面设计语言、重建其视觉系统、从现有证据中提取设计令牌和指导，或为编码代理提供持久 UI 上下文时使用。不要修改产品源代码，也不要将偶然的实现模式推广为设计决策。

name: email-header-injection
description: Email header injection and spoofing playbook. Use when testing contact forms, email APIs, password reset flows, or any feature that constructs SMTP messages with user-controlled fields. Covers CRLF injection in headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC bypass, and phishing amplification.
description_zh: 邮件头注入和欺骗剧本。在测试联系表单、邮件API、密码重置流程或任何使用用户控制字段构建SMTP消息的功能时使用。涵盖邮件头中的CRLF注入、SPF/DKIM/DMARC绕过以及钓鱼放大。

name: type-juggling
description: PHP type juggling and weak comparison (`==`) bypass. Use when authentication, HMAC/signature checks, or token validation uses loose equality, numeric coercion, or hash comparisons without strict types — common in legacy PHP and CTF-style code paths.
description_zh: PHP类型转换和弱比较（`==`）绕过。在身份验证、HMAC/签名检查或令牌验证使用松散相等性、数字强制转换或哈希比较而不严格类型时使用——这在旧版PHP和CTF风格的代码路径中很常见。

name: infra-clickhouse
description: Sets up and manages ClickHouse using the clickhousectl CLI — installs and runs a local ClickHouse server for development, and creates managed ClickHouse Cloud services for production (authentication, service creation, schema migration, application connection). Use when the user wants to build an application with ClickHouse, set up a local ClickHouse dev environment, create tables and start querying, deploy ClickHouse to production or ClickHouse Cloud, or migrate from a local setup to the cloud.
description_zh: 使用 clickhousectl CLI 配置和管理 ClickHouse——为开发安装并运行本地 ClickHouse 服务器，并为生产创建托管 ClickHouse Cloud 服务（认证、服务创建、模式迁移、应用程序连接）。当用户希望使用 ClickHouse 构建应用程序、设置本地 ClickHouse 开发环境、创建表并开始查询、将 ClickHouse 部署到生产环境或 ClickHouse Cloud，或从本地设置迁移到云端时使用。

name: ce-simplify-code
description: Simplify settled, recently changed code for clarity, reuse, quality, and efficiency while preserving behavior. Use after implementation and before review; use ce-debug for bugs.
description_zh: 简化已定代码，最近更改代码以提高清晰度、可重用性、质量和效率，同时保持行为。在实施后和审查前使用；使用 ce-debug 来报告错误。

name: scope
description: Run /scope to turn a product idea into a living, coarse scope in docs/scope/ and keep it current: plan a new product, plan the next slice, enroll one named feature, or run with no argument to reconcile after shipping and queue what is next. Seeds WHAT to build; /architect designs, /develop builds.
description_zh: 运行 /scope 将产品构想转化为文档/scope/中的实际、粗略范围，并保持其更新：规划新产品、规划下一部分、加入一个命名的功能，或无参数运行以在发布后进行协调并排定下一步工作。种子 WHAT 要构建；/architect 设计，/develop 构建。

name: linux-lateral-movement
description: Linux lateral movement playbook. Use after gaining initial access to pivot across Linux hosts via SSH hijacking, credential harvesting, internal pivoting, D-Bus exploitation, sudo token reuse, and shared filesystem abuse.
description_zh: Linux横向移动剧本。在通过SSH劫持、凭证收集、内部跳板、D-Bus利用、sudo令牌重用和共享文件系统滥用获得初始访问权限后使用。

name: windows-privilege-escalation
description: Windows local privilege escalation playbook. Use when you have low-privilege shell access on Windows and need to escalate via token abuse, Potato exploits, service misconfigurations, DLL hijacking, UAC bypass, or registry autoruns.
description_zh: Windows本地权限提升剧本。当您在Windows上拥有低权限shell访问权限，并需要通过凭证滥用、Potato漏洞、服务配置错误、DLL劫持、UAC绕过或注册表自动运行等方式提升权限时使用。

name: audit
description: Run /audit on a greenfield project, an existing codebase with missing docs, or one area (/audit src/auth) to bootstrap the project's AI context, the AGENTS.md files every later skill reads. Writes tool agnostic AGENTS.md plus thin CLAUDE.md pointers, adding only what is missing; never overwrites curated content.
description_zh: 在绿野项目中、现有代码库（缺少文档）或某个区域（例如 `/audit src/auth`）上运行 `/audit`，以启动项目的 AI 上下文，即每个后续技能都会读取的 AGENTS.md 文件。它会生成与工具无关的 AGENTS.md 和薄的 CLAUDE.md 指针，仅添加缺失的内容；永远不会覆盖精选内容。

name: yeet
description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to stage, commit, push, and open a GitHub pull request in one flow using the GitHub CLI (`gh`).
description_zh: 仅在用户明确要求使用 GitHub CLI (`gh`) 一次性完成暂存、提交、推送和打开 GitHub 拉取请求时使用。

name: memory-forensics-volatility
description: Memory forensics playbook using Volatility 2/3. Use when analyzing memory dumps for malware analysis, credential extraction, process investigation, code injection detection, and incident response timeline reconstruction.
description_zh: 使用 Volatility 2/3 的内存取证手册。用于分析内存转储文件，进行恶意软件分析、凭证提取、进程调查、代码注入检测和事件响应时间线重建。

name: document
description: Run /document `pr` | `changelog` | `release-note` | `postmortem` (or let it ask) to write the human facing prose about a change. Drafts from the real commits and diff, writing to the right place. Does not write code, tests, or specs.
description_zh: 运行 `/document pr`、`changelog`、`release-note` 或 `postmortem`（或让它询问）来编写关于变更的人类可读的文本。根据实际提交和差异，将草稿写入正确的位置。不会编写代码、测试或规范。

name: to-spec
description: 把当前对话转成 spec 并发布到项目 issue tracker——不做访谈，只综合已经讨论的内容。
description_zh: 将当前对话转为 spec 并发布到项目 issue tracker——不进行访谈，仅综合已讨论的内容。

name: container-escape-techniques
description: Container escape playbook. Use when operating inside a Docker container, LXC, or Kubernetes pod and need to escape to the host via privileged mode, capabilities, Docker socket, cgroup abuse, namespace tricks, or runtime vulnerabilities.
description_zh: 容器逃逸手册。在操作Docker容器、LXC或Kubernetes Pod时使用，需要通过特权模式、能力、Docker套接字、cgroup滥用、命名空间技巧或运行时漏洞逃逸到宿主机。

name: paper-audit
description: Reviewer-style audit and submission gate for academic papers in .tex, .typ, or .pdf. Use for peer-review critique, readiness/gate decisions, blocker triage, revision roadmaps, journal-style reports, re-audits, and under-claim / self-weakening prose signals. Do not use for source editing, sentence polishing, bibliography search, or compile repair.
description_zh: 用于 .tex、.typ 或 .pdf 格式学术论文的审稿风格审计和提交门禁。用于同行评审评论、准备/门禁决策、障碍筛选、修订路线图、期刊风格报告、复审以及低声/自我削弱性文字信号。不应用于源代码编辑、句子润色、参考文献搜索或编译修复。

name: prometheus-label-strategy
description: Expert evaluator for Prometheus label strategy on Grafana Cloud. Audits, designs, and improves label schemas using cardinality scoring, access-pattern alignment, static vs. dynamic label rules, histogram bucket discipline, and instrumentation hygiene. Prevents high cardinality at the source — in application code and scrape target labels — without dropping labels that make series unique (which breaks the data). For reducing the cost of series already in Grafana Cloud, routes to the adaptive-metrics skill. Use when the user asks to evaluate, audit, design, or improve Prometheus labels — or asks how to prevent high cardinality at the source. For "why is my Prometheus slow / expensive right now" triage, see prometheus-cardinality-troubleshooter.
description_zh: Grafana Cloud上的Prometheus标签策略专家评估员。通过基数评分、访问模式对齐、静态与动态标签规则、直方图桶规范以及仪器卫生等手段，审计、设计和优化标签模式。从源头上防止高基数——在应用程序代码和抓取目标标签中——同时不丢弃使时间序列唯一的标签（这会破坏数据）。为降低已存在于Grafana Cloud中的时间序列成本，将路由至自适应指标技能。当用户要求评估、审计、设计或优化Prometheus标签，或询问如何从源头上防止高基数时使用。对于“为什么我的Prometheus现在变慢/变贵了”的紧急处理，请参考prometheus-cardinality-troubleshooter。

name: wiki-rebuild
description: Archive existing wiki knowledge and rebuild from scratch, or restore from a previous archive. Use this skill when the user wants to start fresh, rebuild the wiki from all sources, archive current knowledge before a major change, or restore an older version. Triggers on "rebuild the wiki", "start over", "archive and rebuild", "restore from archive", "nuke and repave", "clean rebuild". Also use when the wiki has drifted too far from sources and incremental fixes won't cut it.
description_zh: 归档现有 Wiki 知识并从头重建，或从之前的归档中恢复。当用户希望重新开始、从所有来源重建 Wiki、在重大变更前归档当前知识，或恢复旧版本时，请使用此技能。当出现“重建 Wiki”、“重新开始”、“归档并重建”、“从归档恢复”、“彻底清除并重新构建”、“干净重建”等触发词时，也应使用此技能。此外，当 Wiki 内容与来源信息偏离过远、增量修复已无法奏效时，也请启用此技能。

name: your-skill-name
description: Clear description of what this skill does and when to use it. Use when the user asks about X or wants to work with Y. Include specific trigger phrases so agents auto-load it correctly. Max 1024 characters.

name: classical-cipher-analysis
description: Classical cipher analysis playbook. Use when encountering substitution ciphers, Vigenere, transposition, XOR, or encoded text in CTF challenges that requires frequency analysis, Kasiski examination, or known-plaintext cryptanalysis.
description_zh: 经典密码分析手册。在遇到替换密码、维吉尼亚密码、置换密码、异或或CTF挑战中需要频率分析、卡西斯基检验或已知明文密码分析时使用。

name: understand-onboard
description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project
description_zh: 当您需要为加入项目的团队成员生成入职指南时使用

name: godot-tilemap
description: Build and edit tile-based 2D levels in Godot 4.7 with TileMapLayer and TileSet: paint layers, set up collision/navigation/custom-data on tiles, autotile with terrain sets, and read/write cells from code (set_cell, get_cell_tile_data, local_to_map). Use when working with TileMapLayer nodes, .tres TileSets, autotiling, or migrating a deprecated TileMap node to TileMapLayer.
description_zh: 使用 TileMapLayer 和 TileSet 在 Godot 4.7 中构建和编辑基于瓦片的 2D 关卡：绘制图层、为瓦片设置碰撞/导航/自定义数据、使用地形集自动瓦片，以及从代码中读取/写入瓦片单元（set_cell、get_cell_tile_data、local_to_map）。适用于使用 TileMapLayer 节点、.tres TileSets、自动瓦片或从已弃用的 TileMap 节点迁移到 TileMapLayer 的情况。

name: git-commit-pr
description: Commit changes and create a pull request to the official upstream repo
description_zh: 提交更改并创建一个拉取请求到官方上游仓库

name: tunneling-and-pivoting
description: Tunneling and pivoting playbook. Use when establishing network tunnels through compromised hosts including SSH tunneling, Chisel, Ligolo-ng, socat, DNS/ICMP/HTTP tunneling, ProxyChains, and multi-layer pivoting strategies.
description_zh: 隧道和转向剧本。在通过受感染主机建立网络隧道时使用，包括SSH隧道、Chisel、Ligolo-ng、socat、DNS/ICMP/HTTP隧道、ProxyChains和多层转向策略。

name: crypto-report
description: Get cryptocurrency market data. Get Binance AI analysis report. Get blockchain news updates.
description_zh: 获取加密货币市场数据。获取币安AI分析报告。获取区块链新闻更新。

name: linux-security-bypass
description: Linux security mechanism bypass playbook. Use when facing restricted bash/rbash, read-only or noexec filesystems, AppArmor, SELinux, seccomp filters, or audit logging that must be evaded during post-exploitation.
description_zh: Linux安全机制绕过剧本。在面临受限的bash/rbash、只读或noexec文件系统、AppArmor、SELinux、seccomp过滤器，或必须绕过以进行后渗透审计日志时使用。

name: openhue
description: Control Philips Hue lights and scenes via the OpenHue CLI.
description_zh: 通过 OpenHue CLI 控制飞利浦 Hue 灯光和场景。

name: creative-director
description: AI creative director with recursive self-assessment: 20+ methodologies (SIT, TRIZ, Bisociation, SCAMPER, Synectics), 3-axis evaluation calibrated against Cannes/D&AD/HumanKind, 5-phase process from brief to presentation.
description_zh: 具有递归自我评估能力的AI创意总监：掌握20余种方法论（如SIT、TRIZ、联想思维、SCAMPER、综合思维法），采用针对戛纳/英德府/人类关怀进行校准的三轴评估体系，从简报到提案的5阶段流程。

name: goplaces
description: Query Google Places for text search, place details, resolve, reviews, or scriptable JSON via goplaces.
description_zh: 使用goplaces查询Google Places，进行文本搜索、地点详情、解析、评论或可脚本化的JSON。

name: ui-design-system
description: React UI component systems with TailwindCSS + Radix + shadcn/ui. Stack: TailwindCSS (styling), Radix UI (primitives), shadcn/ui (components), React/Next.js. Capabilities: design system architecture, accessible components, responsive layouts, theming, dark mode, component composition. Actions: review, design, build, improve, refactor UI components. Keywords: TailwindCSS, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, design system, component library, accessibility, ARIA, responsive, dark mode, theming, CSS variables, component architecture, atomic design, design tokens, variant, slot, composition. Use when: building component libraries, implementing shadcn/ui, creating accessible UIs, setting up design systems, adding dark mode/theming, reviewing UI component architecture.
description_zh: 使用 TailwindCSS + Radix + shadcn/ui 的 React UI 组件系统。技术栈：TailwindCSS（样式）、Radix UI（基础组件）、shadcn/ui（组件）、React/Next.js。功能：设计系统架构、可访问性组件、响应式布局、主题定制、暗黑模式、组件组合。操作：审查、设计、构建、优化、重构 UI 组件。关键词：TailwindCSS、Radix UI、shadcn/ui、设计系统、组件库、可访问性、ARIA、响应式、暗黑模式、主题定制、CSS 变量、组件架构、原子设计、设计令牌、变体、插槽、组合。适用场景：构建组件库、实施 shadcn/ui、创建可访问 UI、建立设计系统、添加暗黑模式/主题定制、审查 UI 组件架构。

name: ce-commit-push-pr
description: Commit, push, and open a PR. Use when asked to ship/open a PR, or for PR-description-only flows like writing, rewriting, or describing a PR body.
description_zh: 提交、推送并打开一个PR。在被告知需要发布/打开PR时使用，或用于仅涉及PR描述流程（如撰写、重写或描述PR正文）的场景。

name: puzzle
description: Build a puzzle game: grid/board state, move input, rule-based resolution (match-3 cascades, sokoban pushes, tile logic), scoring, and undo. Use for a match-3, sokoban, or grid-logic puzzle.
description_zh:
**构建一款益智游戏：**

*   **网格/棋盘状态**：定义游戏的底层数据结构，记录所有方块的位置、状态及属性。
*   **移动输入**：处理玩家的交互操作，如点击、拖拽或按键，将输入转换为具体的移动指令。
*   **基于规则的结算**：实现游戏核心逻辑的自动计算，例如：
    *   **三消（Match-3）连锁**：检测连线、消除并触发级联下落。
    *   **推箱子（Sokoban）推动**：校验目标位置是否可推、是否被阻挡。
    *   **方块逻辑**：执行旋转、翻转或形状匹配等规则。
*   **计分系统**：根据游戏表现（如消除数量、步数效率、特殊方块等）实时计算并更新分数。
*   **撤销功能**：允许玩家回退上一步操作，通常通过记录状态历史栈（State History Stack）实现。

**适用场景：**
可复用此架构用于开发**三消类**、**推箱子类**或**通用网格逻辑**益智游戏。

name: convex-functions
description: Writes Convex queries, mutations, actions, and internal functions in the object form with args and returns validators, correct ctx usage, runtime boundaries, and error handling. Use when adding or changing anything in convex/*.ts that exports a function, or when deciding between query, mutation, and action.
description_zh: 以对象形式编写凸查询、变异、操作和内部函数，包含参数和返回验证器、正确的 ctx 使用、运行时边界和错误处理。在添加或修改 convex/*.ts 中导出函数的任何内容时使用，或在决定使用查询、变异还是操作时使用。

name: prototype-pollution-advanced
description: Advanced prototype pollution playbook — server-side RCE, client-side gadgets, filter bypasses, and detection techniques. Companion to ../prototype-pollution/ for basics. Use when you've confirmed pollution and need to escalate to code execution or find framework-specific gadgets.
description_zh: 高级原型污染战术手册——服务器端远程代码执行、客户端小工具、过滤器绕过和检测技术。作为 ../prototype-pollution/ 的补充，用于基础知识。当您确认存在污染并需要升级到代码执行或寻找框架特定小工具时使用。

name: stack-overflow-and-rop
description: Stack overflow and ROP playbook. Use when exploiting buffer overflows to hijack control flow via return address overwrite, ROP chains, ret2libc, ret2csu, ret2dlresolve, or SROP on Linux userland binaries.
description_zh: 栈溢出和ROP（返回导向编程）操作手册。在利用缓冲区溢出通过覆盖返回地址、ROP链、ret2libc、ret2csu、ret2dlresolve或Linux用户态二进制中的SROP（栈溢出返回导向编程）劫持控制流时使用。

name: platformer
description: Build a 2D platformer: run/jump control with coyote time, jump buffering, and variable jump height, plus tiled levels and hazards. Use for a platformer or Mario/Celeste-like, or tuning jump feel.
description_zh: 构建一个2D平台跳跃游戏：实现带有“郊狼时间”（coyote time）、跳跃缓冲（jump buffering）和可变跳跃高度的移动/跳跃控制，并集成瓦片关卡和危险区域。适用于打造平台跳跃游戏（如《超级马里奥》或《蔚蓝》（Celeste）风格游戏），或用于调优跳跃手感。

name: smart-contract-vulnerabilities
description: Smart contract vulnerability playbook. Use when auditing Solidity/EVM contracts for reentrancy, integer overflow, access control, delegatecall, flash loan, signature replay, and MEV-related attack patterns.
description_zh: 智能合约漏洞演练手册。在审计 Solidity/EVM 合约以查找重入、整数溢出、访问控制、delegatecall、闪电贷、签名重放以及与 MEV 相关的攻击模式时使用。

name: git-fork-clone
description: Fork a GitHub repo and clone it locally with proper remote setup
description_zh: 从 GitHub 仓库中 fork 并在本地克隆，同时正确设置远程仓库

name: wiki-export
description: Export the Obsidian wiki's knowledge graph to structured formats for use in external tools. Use this skill when the user says "export wiki", "export graph", "export to JSON", "export to Gephi", "export to Neo4j", "export to Postgres", "export to SQL", "graphml", "visualize wiki", "knowledge graph export", "export to OKF", "OKF bundle", "open knowledge format", "export as markdown bundle", or wants to use their wiki data in another tool. Outputs graph.json, graph.graphml, cypher.txt (Neo4j), postgres.sql (Postgres), and graph.html (interactive browser visualization) into a wiki-export/ directory at the vault root, plus an optional OKF (Open Knowledge Format) markdown bundle under wiki-export/okf/.
description_zh: 将 Obsidian 知识库的知识图谱导出为结构化格式，以便在外部工具中使用。当用户说“导出知识库”、“导出图谱”、“导出到 JSON”、“导出到 Gephi”、“导出到 Neo4j”、“导出到 Postgres”、“导出到 SQL”、“graphml”、“可视化知识库”、“知识图谱导出”、“导出到 OKF”、“OKF 套件”、“开放知识格式”、“导出为 Markdown 套件”，或希望将他们的知识库数据用于其他工具时，使用此功能。输出 graph.json、graph.graphml、cypher.txt（Neo4j）、postgres.sql（Postgres）和 graph.html（交互式浏览器可视化）到仓库根目录下的 wiki-export/ 目录，并可选择在 wiki-export/okf/ 目录下生成 OKF（开放知识格式）Markdown 套件。

name: shieldadvanced
description: Configures AWS Shield Advanced for enhanced Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) protection: subscribing accounts and adding resource protections, enabling automatic application layer (layer 7) mitigation through AWS WAF, configuring health-based detection with Route 53 health checks, setting up Shield Response Team (SRT) access and proactive engagement, reviewing DDoS events and requesting cost protection credits, and aggregating resources into protection groups. Applicable when the user wants stronger DDoS protection for internet-facing resources (CloudFront, Application or Network Load Balancers, Elastic IP addresses, Global Accelerator, or Route 53 hosted zones), wants expert help during an attack, or wants to recover attack-driven scaling charges. Routes to the right per-task procedure in references. Not applicable for authoring AWS WAF rules (waf skill), creating Route 53 health checks (route53 skill), or org-wide Shield Advanced rollout with Firewall Manager (firewallmanager skill).
description_zh: 配置 AWS Shield Advanced 以增强分布式拒绝服务 (DDoS) 保护：订阅账户并添加资源保护，通过 AWS WAF 启用自动应用层（第 7 层）缓解，使用 Route 53 健康检查配置基于健康的检测，设置 Shield 响应团队 (SRT) 访问和主动参与，审核 DDoS 事件并申请成本保护信用额度，并将资源聚合到保护组中。适用于用户希望为面向互联网的资源（CloudFront、应用或网络负载均衡器、弹性 IP 地址、全球加速器或 Route 53 托管区域）提供更强的 DDoS 保护，希望在攻击期间获得专家帮助，或希望恢复攻击驱动的扩展费用的情况。引导至每项任务的正确操作步骤参考。不适用于编写 AWS WAF 规则（waf 技能）、创建 Route 53 健康检查（route53 技能），或使用 Firewall Manager 在整个组织中推广 Shield Advanced（firewallmanager 技能）。

name: ce-compound-refresh
description: Refresh the repo's captured learnings against the current codebase. Use when auditing stale, overlapping, superseded, or drifted learnings; avoid general refactor, debugging, or code review unless the learnings store is explicit.
description_zh: 对照当前代码库刷新仓库中捕获的学习成果。在审计过时、重叠、被取代或偏离的学习成果时使用；除非明确说明，否则避免用于常规重构、调试或代码审查。

name: sync
description: Run /sync as the last step after a change is complete, around merge, to keep durable knowledge current. Updates root and nested AGENTS.md, reconciles the scope from repo evidence, and flags specs the change made stale. Surgical edits only: it adds lines, and rewrites single lines it owns. Never a whole section, never curated prose.
description_zh: 在变更完成后，以 /sync 作为最后一步，在合并附近执行，以保持持久性知识更新。更新根目录和嵌套的 AGENTS.md，根据仓库证据协调范围，并将变更导致过时的规范标记出来。仅进行手术式编辑：它添加行，并重写它拥有的单行。绝不修改整个章节，绝不编辑编辑过的散文。

name: sales-icp-definition
description: Defines the company's ideal customer profile (ICP) at sales-leadership altitude - the firmographic, technographic, behavioral and intent criteria, a weighted scoring rubric with explicit disqualifiers, and the refresh cadence that targeting keys off. Works from closed-won/lost deal data, or from founder-led discovery when deal data is thin. Covers B2B account ICPs and the equivalent B2C demographic/psychographic profile. Use whenever the user mentions the ideal or target customer, buyer profile, "who should we sell to", or targeting that is too broad, even without the letters ICP. Do NOT use for TAM/SAM/SOM sizing (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-market-sizing) or account fit scoring (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-segmentation).
description_zh: 定义了公司在销售领导层高度的理想客户画像（ICP）——包括公司特征、技术特征、行为特征和意向标准，一个具有明确淘汰标准的加权评分标准，以及目标关键字的刷新频率。当交易数据不足时，可从创始人主导的发现过程中获取。涵盖B2B账户ICP和相应的B2C人口统计/心理统计画像。每当用户提及理想客户、目标客户、购买者画像、“我们应该向谁销售”或过于宽泛的目标定位时，即使没有ICP字母，也请使用。禁止用于TAM/SAM/SOM规模评估（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-market-sizing）或账户匹配评分（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-segmentation）。

name: ce-ideate
description: Generate and evaluate grounded ideas. Use when the user wants ideas, improvements, or surprising directions before choosing one to develop. Not for refining an idea they already have (ce-brainstorm) or judging one already on the table (ce-pov).
description_zh: 生成并评估有根据的想法。当用户在选择要开发的想法之前需要想法、改进或意想不到的方向时使用。不适用于完善他们已经拥有的想法（ce-brainstorm）或评判已经摆在桌上的想法（ce-pov）。

name: gke-ai-troubleshooting-tpu-vbar-oom
description: Diagnoses and prevents vbar_control_agent segfaults, out-of-memory (OOM) errors, and TPU device initialization failures on TPU v6e nodes in GKE caused by race conditions during TPU device resets or high-frequency metrics polling. Use when troubleshooting vbar_control_agent crashes, memory cgroup OOMs in serial console logs, tpu-device-plugin metrics checksum corruption errors, or custom TPU metrics collection conflicts on GKE TPU v6e nodes. Don't use for general non-TPU container OOM troubleshooting or standard GKE node lifecycle operations.
description_zh: 诊断并预防 GKE 中 TPU v6e 节点上由 TPU 设备重置期间竞态条件或高频指标轮询引起 vbar_control_agent 段错误、内存不足 (OOM) 错误以及 TPU 设备初始化失败。在排查 vbar_control_agent 崩溃、串行控制台日志中的内存 cgroup OOM、tpu-device-plugin 指标校验和损坏错误或 GKE TPU v6e 节点上自定义 TPU 指标收集冲突时使用。不适用于一般非 TPU 容器 OOM 排查或标准 GKE 节点生命周期操作。

name: nano-banana-pro
description: Generate and edit images using Google's Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) API. Use when the user asks to generate, create, edit, modify, change, alter, or update images. Also use when user references an existing image file and asks to modify it in any way (e.g., "modify this image", "change the background", "replace X with Y"). Supports both text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing with configurable resolution (1K default, 2K, or 4K for high resolution). DO NOT read the image file first - use this skill directly with the --input-image parameter.
description_zh: 使用 Google 的 Nano Banana Pro（Gemini 3 Pro 图像）API 生成和编辑图像。当用户要求生成、创建、编辑、修改、更改、更改或更新图像时使用。同时，当用户引用现有图像文件并要求以任何方式修改它时（例如，“修改此图像”、“更改背景”、“用 X 替换 Y”）也使用。支持文本到图像生成和图像到图像编辑，具有可配置的分辨率（默认为 1K，2K 或 4K 用于高分辨率）。请勿先读取图像文件——直接使用 --input-image 参数调用此技能。

name: add-uint-support
description: Add unsigned integer (uint) type support to PyTorch operators by updating AT_DISPATCH macros. Use when adding support for uint16, uint32, uint64 types to operators, kernels, or when user mentions enabling unsigned types, barebones unsigned types, or uint support.
description_zh: 通过更新 AT_DISPATCH 宏为 PyTorch 操作符添加无符号整数（uint）类型支持。在为操作符、内核添加 uint16、uint32、uint64 类型支持，或用户提及启用无符号类型、精简无符号类型、uint 支持时使用。

name: git-summarize-weekly
description: Summarize weekly GitHub contributions for writing weekly reports
description_zh: 总结每周 GitHub 贡献，用于撰写每周报告

name: oracle
description: Oracle CLI second-model review/debug/refactor/design with selected files, dry-run token checks, API or browser engine.
description_zh: 使用选定文件对 Oracle CLI 的第二模型进行审查、调试、重构和设计，包括 dry-run 令牌检查以及 API 或浏览器引擎。

name: ui
description: Routes Unity UI requests to the right framework skill (UI Toolkit, uGUI, or IMGUI) and answers UI comparison questions. Use for menus, HUDs, panels, or editor UI when the request doesn't name a framework. Consult before writing any UI code.
description_zh: 将Unity UI请求路由到正确的框架技能（UI Toolkit、uGUI或IMGUI），并回答UI比较问题。当请求未指定框架时，用于菜单、HUD、面板或编辑器UI。在编写任何UI代码前请咨询。

name: hackernews
description: Hacker News API for stories and comments. Use when user mentions "Hacker News", "HN", "Y Combinator", or asks about tech news.
description_zh: Hacker News API用于获取故事和评论。当用户提及“Hacker News”、“HN”、“Y Combinator”或询问科技新闻时使用。

name: docstring
description: Write docstrings for PyTorch functions and methods following PyTorch conventions. Use when writing or updating docstrings in PyTorch code.
description_zh: 遵循 PyTorch 规范为 PyTorch 函数和方法编写文档字符串。在编写或更新 PyTorch 代码中的文档字符串时使用。

name: arize-instrumentation
description: Adds Arize AX tracing to an LLM application for the first time. Detects the stack, routes to the single matching integration doc, wires auto-instrumentation after user confirmation, and verifies traces land. Use when the user wants to instrument their app, add tracing from scratch, set up LLM observability, integrate OpenTelemetry or openinference, or get started with Arize tracing.
description_zh: 首次为LLM应用程序添加Arize AX追踪。检测堆栈，路由到匹配的单一集成文档，在用户确认后连接自动追踪，并验证追踪是否成功。当用户希望为其应用程序进行追踪、从头开始添加追踪、设置LLM可观察性、集成OpenTelemetry或openinference，或开始使用Arize追踪时使用。

name: git-get-notification
description: Check GitHub notifications and recent Issues/PRs for monitored repos
description_zh: 检查监控仓库的 GitHub 通知和最近的 Issues/PRs

name: sales-career
description: Coach one person through landing and growing a sales career - SDR/BDR entry, SDR-to-AE promotion, and beyond - across B2B SaaS and commission-heavy B2C (real estate, insurance, solar, auto). Covers sales interview prep (mock cold call, sell-me-this-pen, candidate-authored 30-60-90 plan), quantified track-record evidence, sales skill-gap roadmaps, employer diligence, and sales offer evaluation from the candidate's seat, anchored to dated benchmarks (Bridge Group, RepVue, NAR). Use for "sales career", "break into tech sales", "sdr interview prep", "sdr to ae path", "evaluate this sales offer". Does not cover the hiring side (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-hiring), job searching or auto-applying, resume file generation, or deal execution tactics.
description_zh: 指导一个人完成销售职业生涯的落地与成长——从SDR/BDR入门，到SDR晋升为AE，以及更高阶的职位——涵盖B2B SaaS和佣金密集型B2C（房地产、保险、太阳能、汽车）领域。内容涵盖销售面试准备（模拟冷启动电话、推销这支笔、候选人撰写的30-60-90计划）、量化业绩证据、销售技能差距路线图、雇主尽职调查，以及从候选人角度评估销售职位，以Bridge Group、RepVue、NAR等日期基准为依据。适用于“销售职业生涯”、“进入技术销售”、“SDR面试准备”、“SDR晋升为AE的路径”、“评估这个销售职位”。不涵盖招聘方（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-hiring）、求职或自动申请、简历文件生成，或交易执行策略。

name: lattice-crypto-attacks
description: Lattice-based cryptanalysis playbook. Use when attacking RSA via Coppersmith small roots, recovering DSA/ECDSA nonces from bias, solving knapsack problems, or applying LLL/BKZ reduction to cryptographic constructions.
description_zh: 基于格的密码分析手册。在通过Coppersmith小根攻击RSA、从偏差中恢复DSA/ECDSA非ces、解决背包问题或对密码构造应用LLL/BKZ约简时使用。

name: sandbox-escape-techniques
description: Sandbox escape playbook. Use when breaking out of Python sandbox, Lua sandbox, seccomp filter, chroot jail, container/Docker, browser sandbox, or namespace isolation to achieve unrestricted code execution or file access.
description_zh: 沙盒逃逸手册。在从 Python 沙盒、Lua 沙盒、seccomp 过滤器、chroot 监狱、容器/Docker、浏览器沙盒或命名空间隔离中逃逸时使用，以实现无限制的代码执行或文件访问。

name: git-sync-main
description: Sync local main branch with the latest code from official upstream or origin remote
description_zh: 与官方上游或origin远程的最新代码同步本地主分支

name: unity-csharp-scripting
description: Write Unity 6.3 LTS C# gameplay scripts: the MonoBehaviour lifecycle (Awake/OnEnable/Start/Update/FixedUpdate/LateUpdate), GameObject and component access, coroutines, and Inspector serialization. Use when creating or editing .cs scripts in a Unity project, or when the user mentions MonoBehaviour, Start/Update, GetComponent, SerializeField, coroutines, or "Unity script".
description_zh: 编写 Unity 6.3 LTS C# 游戏脚本：MonoBehaviour 生命周期（Awake/OnEnable/Start/Update/FixedUpdate/LateUpdate）、GameObject 和组件访问、协程以及 Inspector 序列化。在创建或编辑 Unity 项目中的 .cs 脚本时使用，或在用户提及 MonoBehaviour、Start/Update、GetComponent、SerializeField、协程或“Unity 脚本”时使用。

name: gifgrep
description: Search GIF providers with CLI/TUI, download results, and extract stills/sheets.
description_zh: 使用 CLI/TUI 搜索 GIF 提供商，下载结果，并提取静态图像/图像集。

name: rsa-attack-techniques
description: RSA attack playbook for CTF and real-world cryptanalysis. Use when given RSA parameters (n, e, c) and need to recover plaintext by exploiting weak keys, small exponents, shared factors, or padding oracles.
description_zh: RSA 攻击手册，适用于 CTF 和实际密码分析。当给定 RSA 参数（n，e，c）并需要通过利用弱密钥、小指数、共享因子或填充或然来恢复明文时使用。

name: launchdarkly-metric-choose
description: Choose the right metrics for a LaunchDarkly experiment, guarded rollout, or release policy. Use when the user wants to know which metrics to use, which is the primary metric for an experiment, what guardrails to add, or which events to monitor in a rollout. Surfaces what will auto-attach from existing release policies before making additional recommendations.
description_zh: 为LaunchDarkly实验、受控发布或发布策略选择合适的指标。当用户需要了解应使用哪些指标、实验的主要指标是什么、应添加哪些安全限制，或发布过程中应监控哪些事件时使用。在提供额外建议之前，会展示现有发布策略中会自动附加的内容。

name: steganography-techniques
description: Steganography detection and extraction playbook. Use when analyzing images (LSB, PNG chunks, JPEG DCT, EXIF), audio (spectrogram, DTMF), files (polyglots, appended data, ADS), and text (whitespace, zero-width, homoglyphs) for hidden data.
description_zh: 隐写术检测与提取手册。在分析图像（最低有效位、PNG块、JPEG DCT、EXIF）、音频（频谱图、DTMF）、文件（多语言文本、附加数据、ADS）和文本（空白字符、零宽字符、同形字）以查找隐藏数据时使用。

name: symmetric-cipher-attacks
description: Symmetric cipher attack playbook. Use when exploiting block cipher mode weaknesses (CBC padding oracle, ECB cut-and-paste, bit flipping), stream cipher key reuse, or meet-in-the-middle attacks.
description_zh: 对称密码攻击手册。在利用分组密码模式弱点（CBC填充漏洞、ECB剪切粘贴、位翻转）、流密码密钥重用或中间相遇攻击时使用。

name: windows-lateral-movement
description: Windows lateral movement playbook. Use when pivoting between Windows hosts via PsExec, WMI, WinRM, DCOM, RDP, pass-the-hash, overpass-the-hash, or pass-the-ticket techniques.
description_zh: Windows横向移动剧本。在通过PsExec、WMI、WinRM、DCOM、RDP、传递哈希、跨过哈希或传递票据等技术在不同Windows主机之间进行转换时使用。

name: memory-md-management
description: Provides comprehensive memory file management capabilities including auditing, quality assessment, and targeted improvements for files such as CLAUDE.md. Use when user asks to check, audit, update, improve, fix, maintain, or validate project memory files. Also triggers for "project memory optimization", "CLAUDE.md quality check", "documentation review", or when a project memory file needs to be created from scratch. This skill scans memory files, evaluates quality against standardized criteria, outputs detailed quality reports with scores and recommendations, then makes targeted updates with user approval.
description_zh: 提供全面的内存文件管理功能，包括审计、质量评估以及针对CLAUDE.md等文件的重点改进。当用户要求检查、审计、更新、改进、修复、维护或验证项目内存文件时使用。同时，在触发"项目内存优化"、"CLAUDE.md质量检查"、"文档审查"或需要从零创建项目内存文件时也会触发。该技能扫描内存文件，根据标准化标准评估质量，输出包含分数和建议的详细质量报告，然后经用户批准后进行针对性更新。

name: pr-review
description: Review PyTorch pull requests for code quality, test coverage, security, and backward compatibility. Use when reviewing PRs, when asked to review code changes, or when the user mentions "review PR", "code review", or "check this PR".
description_zh: 审查 PyTorch 的拉取请求，检查代码质量、测试覆盖率、安全性和向后兼容性。在审查 PR 时、被要求审查代码更改时，或用户提到“审查 PR”、“代码审查”或“检查这个 PR”时使用。

name: sales-market-sizing
description: Estimates TAM, SAM, and SOM for a market or sub-segment to ground sales capacity, territory, and quota planning - top-down, bottom-up on named accounts or population math, value theory, triangulation, a capacity-based SOM ceiling, and a per-layer refresh cadence. A macro planning exercise for sales leadership and RevOps, covering B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions TAM, SAM, SOM, market size, addressable market, "how big is this market", or the number behind next year's quota, even without those acronyms. Sizes for planning, not pitching. Do NOT use for defining the ICP (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-icp-definition) or turning SOM into quotas (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting).
description_zh: 为市场或子细分市场估算TAM、SAM和SOM，以支撑销售能力、区域和配额规划——采用自上而下、自下而上的方法，结合指定客户或人口统计、价值理论、三角测量法、基于能力的SOM上限，以及各层级更新频率。这是一项面向销售领导层和RevOps的宏观规划活动，涵盖B2B和B2C。每当用户提及TAM、SAM、SOM、市场规模、可触及市场、市场有多大，或明年配额背后的数字时（即使不使用这些缩写），也需使用。用于规划而非销售提案。禁止用于定义ICP（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-icp-definition）或将SOM转化为配额（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting）。

name: macro-regime-detector
description: Detect structural macro regime transitions (1-2 year horizon) using cross-asset ratio analysis. Analyze RSP/SPY concentration, yield curve, credit conditions, size factor, equity-bond relationship, and sector rotation to identify regime shifts between Concentration, Broadening, Contraction, Inflationary, and Transitional states. Run when user asks about macro regime, market regime change, structural rotation, or long-term market positioning.
description_zh: 使用跨资产比率分析来检测结构宏观状态转换（1-2年展望期）。分析RSP/SPY集中度、收益率曲线、信贷状况、规模因子、股债关系和行业轮动，以识别集中、扩散、收缩、通胀和过渡状态之间的状态转换。当用户询问宏观状态、市场状态变化、结构轮动或长期市场定位时运行。

name: goframe-v2
description: GoFrame v2 development skill. Use only when the target Go project uses or is explicitly adopting GoFrame v2: the nearest go.mod requires github.com/gogf/gf/v2, existing Go files import github.com/gogf/gf/v2 or any github.com/gogf/gf/v2/... component package, or the user asks to scaffold, migrate, or build with GoFrame. Trigger for GoFrame-backed Go work such as APIs/controllers/services, middleware, routing/config, ORM/DAO/DO/entity/database operations, gf CLI/codegen, HTTP/gRPC services, and microservice conventions. Do not trigger for generic Go projects without GoFrame evidence, frontend-only work, shell scripts, or unrelated infrastructure tasks.
description_zh: GoFrame v2 开发技能。仅在目标 Go 项目使用或明确采用 GoFrame v2 时使用：最近的 go.mod 文件需要 github.com/gogf/gf/v2，现有的 Go 文件导入 github.com/gogf/gf/v2 或任何 github.com/gogf/gf/v2/... 组件包，或用户要求使用 GoFrame 进行脚手架搭建、迁移或构建。适用于基于 GoFrame 的 Go 工作类型，如 API/控制器/服务、中间件、路由/配置、ORM/DAO/DO 实体/数据库操作、gf CLI/代码生成、HTTP/gRPC 服务以及微服务规范。不适用于无 GoFrame 证据的通用 Go 项目、仅前端工作、Shell 脚本或不相关的基础设施任务。

name: skill-creator
description: Author or review AgentSkills: create, repair, validate, or restructure SKILL.md files and bundled resources.
description_zh: 作者或审阅代理技能：创建、修复、验证或重构 SKILL.md 文件和捆绑资源。

name: risk-assessment
description: Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks. Trigger with "what are the risks", "risk assessment", "risk register", "what could go wrong", or when the user is evaluating risks associated with a project, vendor, process, or decision.
description_zh: 识别、评估和减轻运营风险。当用户输入“有哪些风险”、“风险评估”、“风险登记册”、“可能出什么问题”，或当用户正在评估项目、供应商、流程或决策相关的风险时触发。

name: sales-account-tiering
description: Designs the tier layer downstream of an existing account fit score - where the cutoffs sit, tier names, rep-to-account capacity caps, the coverage model per tier (touch cadence, channel mix, QBR frequency, executive involvement), coverage-ratio health metrics, and the recalibration cadence. Covers B2B account tiering and B2C key-account tiering through retail/distribution channels. Use whenever the user mentions tiers, strategic/key/growth/long-tail accounts, accounts-per-rep ratios, 1:1 or 1:few or 1:many ABM coverage, or "everything drifted into Tier 1", even without the word tiering. Takes the fit score as input. Do NOT use for building that score (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-segmentation).
description_zh: 设计现有账户匹配分数下游的层级层——包括截止点位置、层级名称、代表对账户容量上限、每个层级的覆盖模型（接触频率、渠道组合、QBR频率、高管参与度）、覆盖率健康指标以及重新校准频率。涵盖通过零售/分销渠道的B2B账户层级和关键B2C账户层级。在用户提及层级、战略/关键/增长/长尾账户、每代表账户比率、1:1或1:少数或1:多数ABM覆盖，或“一切都滑入了Tier 1”，即使没有提及层级时，也使用该设计。将匹配分数作为输入。请勿用于构建该分数（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-segmentation）。

name: gh-issues
description: Fetch GitHub issues, select candidates, spawn background fix agents, open PRs, and optionally process PR review comments.
description_zh: 获取 GitHub 问题，选择候选问题，启动后台修复代理，创建拉取请求，并可选择处理拉取请求的评审评论。

name: color-palette
description: Generate complete, accessible colour palettes from a single brand hex. Produces 11-shade scale (50-950), semantic tokens, dark mode variants, Tailwind v4 CSS output, WCAG contrast checks. Use whenever the user supplies a brand hex and asks for a palette, mentions setting up a design system, wants Tailwind theme colours from a brand colour, or asks to check colour accessibility / contrast.
description_zh: 从单一品牌十六进制代码生成完整、可访问的调色板。生成11色阶（50-950）、语义标记、暗黑模式变体、Tailwind v4 CSS输出、WCAG对比度检查。当用户提供品牌十六进制代码并要求调色板、提及设置设计系统、需要从品牌颜色获取Tailwind主题颜色，或要求检查颜色可访问性/对比度时使用。

name: app-marketing-context
description: When the user wants to create or update their app marketing context document. Also use when the user mentions "app context", "marketing brief", "app positioning", or when starting any ASO or app marketing project. This is the foundation skill — all other skills check for this context first.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建或更新他们的应用营销背景文件时使用。同样适用于用户提到“应用背景”、“营销简报”、“应用定位”或开始任何ASO或应用营销项目时。这是基础技能——所有其他技能都会首先检查这个背景。

name: xurl
description: xurl CLI for authenticated X posts, replies, reads/search, DMs, media upload, followers, auth status, or raw v2 API calls.
description_zh: 用于认证的X帖子、回复、阅读/搜索、私信、媒体上传、关注者、认证状态或原始v2 API调用的xurl CLI。

name: ce-setup
description: Check Compound Engineering health and repo-local config, or scaffold a Compound Pack with `pack:<id>`.
description_zh: 检查 Compound Engineering 的健康状态和 repo-local 配置，或者使用 `pack:<id>` 来构建一个 Compound Pack。

name: options-payoff
description: Render an interactive options payoff chart — expiry P&L plus Black-Scholes theoretical value — with sliders for strikes, premium, IV, DTE, and spot. Use this skill whenever the user describes or shares an options position or strategy and wants to see how it makes or loses money: vertical, calendar, diagonal, or ratio spreads, butterflies, condors and iron condors, straddles, strangles, covered calls, protective or naked puts, or any multi-leg structure. This includes pasted strikes, premiums, and expiries, requests like "show me the payoff" or "draw the P&L curve", and broker screenshots (IBKR, TastyTrade, Robinhood). Use it even when details are partial — defaults fill the gaps.
description_zh: 渲染一个交互式期权收益图——包含到期损益和Black-Scholes理论价值——并使用滑块调整执行价、期权费、隐含波动率、剩余期限和现货价格。当用户描述或分享期权头寸或策略，并希望了解其盈利或亏损情况时，请使用此功能：垂直价差、日历价差、对角价差、比例价差、蝶式价差、宽跨式价差和铁蝶式价差、跨式期权、宽跨式期权、保护性看跌期权或裸看跌期权，或任何多腿结构。这包括粘贴的执行价、期权费和到期日，类似“展示收益情况”或“绘制损益曲线”的请求，以及经纪商截图（如Interactive Brokers、TastyTrade、Robinhood）。即使细节不完整，也可以使用此功能——默认值将填补空白。

name: tailwind-theme-builder
description: Set up Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui themed UI with dark mode. Install deps, configure CSS variables via @theme inline, wire dark mode toggle, verify. Use whenever the user mentions Tailwind v4, setting up Tailwind theming, shadcn/ui colours, dark mode, or troubleshooting colours not working, tw-animate-css errors, @theme inline conflicts, @apply breaking after upgrade, or v3 → v4 migration issues.
description_zh: 配置 Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui 主题 UI 并支持暗黑模式。安装依赖项，通过 @theme 内联配置 CSS 变量，连接暗黑模式切换开关，并进行验证。每当用户提及 Tailwind v4、配置 Tailwind 主题、shadcn/ui 颜色、暗黑模式，或遇到颜色无效、tw-animate-css 错误、@theme 内联冲突、升级后 @apply 失效，或 v3 → v4 迁移问题时，均使用此方法。

name: antislop-human
description: Human and accessibility skill for antislop. Contrast, keyboard, focus, and states for real people. Includes the contrast checker.
description_zh: 人类和可访问性技能用于防滑。对比度、键盘、焦点和状态，为真实的人设计。包含对比度检查器。

name: launchdarkly-metric-create
description: Create a LaunchDarkly metric that measures what matters for an experiment or rollout. Use when the user wants to create a metric, track an event, measure page views, button clicks, conversion, latency, error rate, or any custom numeric or binary outcome. Instruments the event first when needed (including SDK setup and .env), then creates and verifies the metric.
description_zh: 创建一个 LaunchDarkly 指标，用于衡量实验或发布过程中重要的指标。当用户需要创建指标、跟踪事件、测量页面浏览量、按钮点击次数、转化率、延迟、错误率或任何自定义的数值或二元结果时使用。首先在需要时对事件进行仪器化（包括 SDK 设置和 .env），然后创建并验证该指标。

name: react-best-practices
description: Use when reading or writing React components (.tsx, .jsx files with React imports).
description_zh: 在阅读或编写 React 组件（.tsx、.jsx 文件，包含 React 导入）时使用。

name: graalvm-native-image
description: Provides expert guidance for building GraalVM Native Image executables from Java applications. Use when converting JVM applications to native binaries, optimizing cold start times, reducing memory footprint, configuring native build tools for Maven or Gradle, resolving reflection and resource issues in native builds, or implementing framework-specific native support for Spring Boot, Quarkus, and Micronaut. Triggers include "graalvm native image", "native executable java", "java cold start optimization", "native build tools", "ahead of time compilation java", "reflection config graalvm", "native image build failure".
description_zh: 为从 Java 应用程序构建 GraalVM Native Image 可执行文件提供专家指导。在将 JVM 应用程序转换为原生二进制文件、优化冷启动时间、减少内存占用、为 Maven 或 Gradle 配置原生构建工具、解决原生构建中的反射和资源问题，或为 Spring Boot、Quarkus 和 Micronaut 实现框架特定的原生支持时使用。触发词包括 "graalvm native image"、"native executable java"、"java cold start optimization"、"native build tools"、"ahead of time compilation java"、"reflection config graalvm" 和 "native image build failure"。

name: launchdarkly-metric-instrument
description: Instrument a LaunchDarkly metric event in a codebase by adding a track() call. Use when the user wants to wire up an event, instrument an action for a metric, add tracking to a feature, or confirm that an event is flowing to LaunchDarkly.
description_zh: 在代码库中通过添加一个 track() 调用来配置 LaunchDarkly 指标事件。当用户需要连接事件、为指标配置操作、为功能添加跟踪或确认事件正在流向 LaunchDarkly 时使用。

name: sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling
description: Models how much pipeline a team needs relative to quota - coverage ratios derived from win rates (raw multiplier, stage-weighted, conversion-inversion), segment-level coverage targets, in-quarter timing and the point of no return, seasonality indexing, and pipeline-gap math that turns a ratio into new-pipeline-required. A macro modeling exercise for sales leadership and RevOps, covering B2B and high-velocity/B2C motions. Use whenever the user mentions pipeline coverage, 3x pipeline, a pipeline gap, forecast shortfall, or "we missed quota with 4x coverage", even without the word coverage. Do NOT use for deriving the quota itself (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting) or inspecting one deal (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags).
description_zh: 模型展示团队相对于配额所需的管道量——基于胜率（原始倍数、阶段加权、转化反转）、细分级别覆盖率目标、季度时间节点和无法挽回点、季节性指数以及将比率转化为所需新管道量的管道差距计算。这是一项宏观建模练习，适用于销售领导层和RevOps，涵盖B2B和高速度/B2C业务模式。当用户提及管道覆盖率、3倍管道、管道差距、预测不足或“以4倍覆盖率未达配额”，即使未使用“覆盖率”一词时，均可使用。禁止用于推导配额本身（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting）或检查单个交易（mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags）。

name: frontend-dev
description:
Full-stack frontend development combining premium UI design, cinematic animations,
AI-generated media assets, persuasive copywriting, and visual art. Builds complete,
visually striking web pages with real media, advanced motion, and compelling copy.
Use when: building landing pages, marketing sites, product pages, dashboards,
generating media assets (image/video/audio/music), writing conversion copy,
creating generative art, or implementing cinematic scroll animations.
description_zh: 全栈前端开发，融合高端UI设计、电影级动画、AI生成媒体资源、有说服力的文案和视觉艺术。构建完整且视觉冲击力强的网页，包含真实媒体、高级动效和引人入胜的文案。使用场景：构建落地页、营销网站、产品页面、仪表盘、生成媒体资源（图像/视频/音频/音乐）、撰写转化文案、创建生成式艺术或实现电影级滚动动画。

name: sag
description: ElevenLabs text-to-speech with mac-style say UX.
description_zh: 使用 ElevenLabs 文本转语音功能，搭配 macOS 风格的语音交互体验。

name: macos-security-bypass
description: macOS security bypass playbook. Use when targeting macOS endpoints and need to bypass TCC, Gatekeeper, SIP, sandbox, code signing, or entitlement-based protections during authorized red team or pentest engagements.
description_zh: macOS安全绕过手册。在针对macOS端点并需要绕过TCC、Gatekeeper、SIP、沙盒、代码签名或基于权限的保护时，用于授权的红队或渗透测试活动。

name: threejs
description: Three.js skills for creating 3D elements and interactive experiences in the browser — scenes, materials, controls, and post-processing.
description_zh: 用于在浏览器中创建3D元素和交互式体验的Three.js技能——场景、材质、控件和后期处理。

name: tailwindcss
description: Tailwind CSS utility-first CSS framework. Use when styling web applications with utility classes, building responsive designs, or customizing design systems with theme variables.
description_zh: Tailwind CSS 是一种以工具优先的 CSS 框架。当您使用工具类来样式化 Web 应用、构建响应式设计或使用主题变量来自定义设计系统时使用。

name: vercel-deploy
description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".
description_zh: 将应用程序和网站部署到 Vercel。当用户请求部署操作，例如“部署我的应用”、“部署并给我链接”、“发布上线”或“创建预览部署”时使用。

name: platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate
description: Orchestrate Apex-backed Lightning Type + HXL widget generation. TRIGGER only when the prompt EXPLICITLY invokes Lightning Types: user says 'Lightning Type', 'CLT', 'Custom Lightning Type', 'Apex-backed type', references '@apexClassType/...', asks to build a widget or card for a named Lightning Type, asks to create a new Lightning Type and widget together, or grounds a widget in a specific Apex class as its schema. DO NOT TRIGGER when the prompt names only a subject, domain, feature, or entity noun. Also DO NOT TRIGGER when: authoring only a Custom Lightning Type (use platform-custom-lightning-type-generate), only an Apex class (use platform-apex-generate), editing an existing widget without any Lightning Type change, or grounding a widget on an object/JSON-based Lightning Type (lightning__objectType with primitives).
description_zh: 编排 Apex 支持的 Lightning 类型 + HXL 组件生成。仅在以下情况下触发：提示明确调用 Lightning 类型：用户说“Lightning 类型”、“CLT”、“自定义 Lightning 类型”、“Apex 支持的类型”、引用“@apexClassType/...”、要求为命名 Lightning 类型构建组件或卡片、要求同时创建新的 Lightning 类型及组件，或以特定 Apex 类作为其架构来构建组件。以下情况不触发：提示仅命名主题、领域、功能或实体名词。此外，以下情况也不触发：仅编写自定义 Lightning 类型（使用 platform-custom-lightning-type-generate）、仅编写 Apex 类（使用 platform-apex-generate）、编辑现有组件且未更改 Lightning 类型，或基于对象/JSON 的 Lightning 类型（lightning__objectType 使用基本类型）构建组件。

name: skill-authoring
description: Author, audit, and improve Grafana SKILL.md files against Anthropic's published Agent Skills guidance and the four-dimension rubric the grafana/skills CI gate uses (conciseness, actionability, workflow clarity, progressive disclosure). Applies the canonical SKILL.md structure (YAML frontmatter + body + references/ + scripts/ + assets/), the "pushy description" trigger pattern, the three-level progressive-disclosure model, and the validate-fix-rerun feedback loop. Use when creating a new skill in this repo, when reviewing a skill PR, when a skill's Tessl review score is below 75 (the merge gate), when a skill's description isn't getting picked up by agents, when restructuring a long SKILL.md into a bundle, or when the user asks how to write, improve, optimize, audit, or fix a skill - even if they don't say "skill" explicitly (e.g. "this isn't triggering", "Tessl scored this 72", "split this doc").
description_zh: 根据Anthropic发布的代理技能指导以及grafana/skills CI门禁使用的四维评估标准（简洁性、可操作性、工作流清晰度、渐进式披露），对Grafana的SKILL.md文件进行撰写、审核和改进。应用标准的SKILL.md结构（YAML前端元数据+主体内容+引用/脚本/资源/），"推式描述"触发模式，三级渐进式披露模型，以及验证-修复-重试的反馈循环。在以下情况下使用：在创建此存储库中的新技能时、在审核技能PR时、当技能的Tessl评审分数低于75（合并门禁）时、当技能的描述未被代理捕获时、当将长SKILL.md重构为包时，或当用户询问如何撰写、改进、优化、审核或修复技能——即使他们没有明确提及"技能"（例如："这个没有触发"、"Tessl给这个打了72分"、"把这个文档拆分"）。

name: trading-analysis
description: Generate professional investment reports for stocks and ETFs. Use when user requests market analysis, investment reports, stock analysis, or trading recommendations for financial instruments (SPY, AAPL, TSLA, etc.). Creates institutional-grade reports with technical indicators, AI-powered insights, charts, and investment recommendations.
description_zh: 生成股票和ETF的专业投资报告。当用户请求市场分析、投资报告、股票分析或金融工具（如SPY、AAPL、TSLA等）的交易建议时使用。创建具有技术指标、AI驱动的洞察、图表和投资建议的机构级报告。

name: survival-crafting
description: Build a survival-crafting game: resource gathering, inventory, crafting and a tech tree, needs (hunger/thirst/temperature), and base building. Use for a survival or crafting/base-building game.
description_zh: 构建一款生存制作游戏：资源采集、背包、制作和科技树，需要（饥饿/口渴/温度），以及基地建设。用于生存或制作/基地建设游戏。

name: wiki-history-ingest
description: Unified wiki-history-ingest entrypoint for conversation/session sources. Use this when the user says "/wiki-history-ingest claude", "/wiki-history-ingest copilot", "/wiki-history-ingest codex", "/wiki-history-ingest pi", or asks to ingest agent history without naming the underlying skill. This router dispatches to the specialized history skill.
description_zh: 统一对话/会话源 wiki-history-ingest 入口。当用户输入 "/wiki-history-ingest claude"、"wiki-history-ingest copilot"、"wiki-history-ingest codex"、"wiki-history-ingest pi" 或请求摄入代理历史但未指定底层技能时，使用此路由。该路由将分发至专门的历史技能。

name: prometheus-cardinality-troubleshooter
description: Diagnostic guide for active Prometheus cardinality problems — slow queries, OOMing Prometheus, high Grafana Cloud Active Series or DPM bills, "too many samples" ingest errors, series churn, or rapid memory growth. Walks through tsdb status endpoints, per-metric and per-label drill-downs, common-culprit galleries, and remediation paths. Use when the user is *currently experiencing* a cardinality fire. For preventing cardinality issues at the source, route to prometheus-label-strategy. For post-ingest aggregation, route to adaptive-metrics. For DPM-specific analysis, route to dpm-finder.
description_zh: 活动 Prometheus 基数问题诊断指南——慢查询、OOMing Prometheus、高 Grafana Cloud 活跃序列或 DPM 账单、"样本过多"摄取错误、序列漂移或快速内存增长。通过 tsdb 状态端点、按指标和按标签的深入分析、常见问题排查库以及修复路径进行说明。适用于用户*当前正在经历*基数问题。若需从源头上预防基数问题，请路由至 prometheus-label-strategy。若需摄取后聚合，请路由至 adaptive-metrics。若需 DPM 特定分析，请路由至 dpm-finder。

name: principle-guard-the-context-window
description: Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main thread, not raw payloads.
description_zh: 在上下文即将填满时使用：大量输出、长文件、重复读取、分叉规划。将大量数据路由到子代理；在主线程中保留摘要，而不是原始有效载荷。

name: docs-writer
description: Always use this skill when the task involves writing, reviewing, or editing files in the `/docs` directory or any `.md` files in the repository.
description_zh: 始终在处理 `/docs` 目录中的文件或存储库中的任何 `.md` 文件进行编写、审阅或编辑的任务时使用此技能。

name: writing-prds
description: Help users transform abstract ideas into actionable project specs that align engineering and design teams on the problem and success metrics.
description_zh: 帮助用户将抽象概念转化为可执行的项目规范，使工程和设计团队在问题及成功指标上达成一致。

name: longbridge-value-investing
description:
Value investing analysis using Graham (NCAV/net-net/defensive-investor) and Buffett (economic moat/ROE/FCF) methodologies. Covers single-stock diagnostics and batch screening for both Graham cigar-butt and Buffett quality-compounder criteria. Runs cross-statement reconciliation before scoring. Data from Longbridge CLI first, MCP fallback, WebSearch only for genuine gaps.
Triggers: "格雷厄姆", "巴菲特", "捡烟蒂", "烟蒂股", "NCAV", "净流动资产", "护城河", "价值投资", "安全边际", "深度价值", "撿煙蒂", "煙蒂股", "淨流動資產", "護城河", "安全邊際", "Graham", "Buffett", "cigar butt", "net-net", "NCAV screen", "moat", "value investing", "margin of safety", "deep value", "quality compounder", "價值投資", "深度價值", "防御型投资者", "防禦型投資者"
description_zh:
使用格雷厄姆（NCAV/净净值/防御型投资者）和巴菲特（经济护城河/ROE/自由现金流）方法的价值投资分析。涵盖格雷厄姆烟蒂股和巴菲特优质复利股的个股诊断和批量筛选。在评分前进行跨报表核对。数据优先从Longbridge CLI获取，MCP为备选，WebSearch仅用于真实数据缺口。

触发词："格雷厄姆", "巴菲特", "捡烟蒂", "烟蒂股", "NCAV", "净流动资产", "护城河", "价值投资", "安全边际", "深度价值", "捡烟蒂", "烟蒂股", "净流动资产", "护城河", "安全边际", "Graham", "Buffett", "cigar butt", "net-net", "NCAV筛选", "moat", "value investing", "margin of safety", "deep value", "quality compounder", "价值投资", "深度价值", "防御型投资者", "防御型投资者"

name: ntlm-relay-coercion
description: NTLM relay and authentication coercion playbook. Use when capturing and relaying NTLM authentication to escalate privileges via SMB, LDAP, HTTP, or MSSQL relay targets, combined with PetitPotam, PrinterBug, and other coercion methods.
description_zh: NTLM 中继与认证强制（Authentication Coercion）操作手册。适用于捕获并中继 NTLM 认证，从而通过 SMB、LDAP、HTTP 或 MSSQL 中继目标实现权限提升，并结合 PetitPotam、PrinterBug 及其他强制手段进行利用。

name: m07-concurrency
description: CRITICAL: Use for concurrency/async. Triggers: E0277 Send Sync, cannot be sent between threads, thread, spawn, channel, mpsc, Mutex, RwLock, Atomic, async, await, Future, tokio, deadlock, race condition, 并发, 线程, 异步, 死锁
description_zh: 关键：用于并发/异步。触发器：E0277 发送同步，不能在线程间发送，线程、spawn、channel、mpsc、Mutex、RwLock、Atomic、async、await、Future、tokio、死锁、竞态条件、并发、线程、异步、死锁

name: longbridge-fundamentals
description:
Financial statements, business segments, dividends, valuation multiples (PE/PB/PS), industry comparison, operating data, corporate actions, company and executive profiles, cross-stock comparison, and valuation ranking via Longbridge. Also: DCF models, value investing screens (low PE/PB, margin of safety), and behavioral finance analysis frameworks.

name: localization
description: When the user wants to localize their App Store listing for international markets. Also use when the user mentions "localization", "translate my app", "international markets", "expand to new countries", "localize metadata", or "which countries should I target". For keyword research in specific markets, see keyword-research. For metadata writing, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户希望将其 App Store 应用商店列表进行本地化，以适配国际市场时。当用户提及“本地化”、“翻译我的应用”、“国际市场”、“拓展至新国家”、“本地化元数据”或“我应该针对哪些国家”时，也适用本指南。关于特定市场的关键词研究，请参阅关键词研究指南。关于元数据撰写，请参阅元数据优化指南。

name: tower-defense
description: Build a tower defense: enemies pathing along lanes, wave spawning, towers that auto-target and fire, an economy, and lives. Use for a tower-defense/wave-defense game, or balancing waves and economy.
description_zh: 构建一个塔防游戏：敌人沿路线移动，波次生成，自动瞄准并发射的塔，经济系统和生命值。可用于塔防/波次防御游戏，或平衡波次与经济。

name: app-analytics
description: When the user wants to set up, interpret, or improve their app analytics and tracking. Also use when the user mentions "analytics", "tracking", "metrics", "KPIs", "App Store Connect analytics", "install tracking", "funnel", "attribution", or "how is my app performing". For A/B testing, see ab-test-store-listing. For retention metrics, see retention-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户想要设置、解释或改进他们的应用分析及跟踪功能时，也适用于用户提及“分析”、“跟踪”、“指标”、“关键绩效指标（KPIs）”、“App Store Connect分析”、“安装跟踪”、“漏斗”、“归因”或“我的应用表现如何”等术语。对于A/B测试，请参阅ab-test-store-listing。对于留存指标，请参阅retention-optimization。

name: performance-review
description: Structure a performance review with self-assessment, manager template, and calibration prep. Use when review season kicks off and you need a self-assessment template, writing a manager review for a direct report, prepping rating distributions and promotion cases for calibration, or turning vague feedback into specific behavioral examples.
description_zh: 构建包含自我评估、经理模板和校准准备的综合绩效评估。在评估季开始时使用，当您需要自我评估模板、撰写直接下属的经理评估、准备评分分布和晋升案例的校准，或将有模糊的反馈转化为具体的可行为示例时使用。

name: test
description: Run /test to write a test suite for code you just built or changed, after implementing a feature, route, or fix. Targets uncommitted changes automatically, reads test preferences.json for your framework (asks and saves it if absent), and picks the right strategy per file: happy path, edge cases, error states, accessibility.
description_zh: 运行 /test 来为刚刚构建或修改的代码编写测试套件，在实现功能、路由或修复后。它自动针对未提交的更改，读取适用于您框架的 test_preferences.json（如果不存在则会询问并保存），并根据文件选择正确的策略：常规路径、边界情况、错误状态、可访问性。

name: sales-kickoff
description: Before starting any sales project, and before answering a sales request that spans more than one sales topic or names no skill at all, run this router first. It routes the task to exactly one skill in the sales-skills collection, or says plainly that none fits, and bootstraps or resumes the project's shared sales-context.md artifact, producing a short-list plus an ordered skill chain. Fires on the state of the conversation rather than the subject matter, at a sales project start, at a periodic sales check-in or recurring sales review, on a mid-project re-route, or on any broad or ambiguous sales request such as "which sales skill do I need" or "where do I start with sales".
