Covers both altitudes, CRO-altitude planning (motion, ICP, market sizing, segmentation, tiering, org structure, quota, coverage, comp) and execution (outbound, cold calling, discovery, objections, MEDDPICC, recaps, call review, hiring, career). Run it even when sibling skills are already in daily use elsewhere.
description_zh: 在启动任何销售项目之前，以及在任何跨越多个销售主题或未提及任何技能的销售请求中，首先运行此路由器。它将任务精确路由至“销售技能”集合中的且仅且一个技能，或者明确说明没有适用的技能；它会引导创建或恢复项目的共享 sales-context.md 工件，并生成一份简短列表以及一条有序的“技能链”。该路由器的触发依据是对话所处状态而非主题内容，具体包括：销售项目启动时、定期销售检查或例行销售回顾时、项目中途重新路由时，或任何广泛或模糊的销售请求（例如“我需要哪些销售技能”或“销售从哪里入手”）。它覆盖两个层级：CRO 层级的规划（销售模式、理想客户画像、市场规模估算、细分、分层、组织架构、配额、覆盖范围、薪酬结构）与执行层面（外联、冷呼、需求发掘、异议处理、MEDDPICC、复盘、通话评审、招聘、职业发展）。即使相关姊妹技能已在其他场景日常使用，仍需运行本路由器。

name: sales-radar
description: Builds and maintains a personalized watch list of sales information sources - podcasts, newsletters, communities, benchmark reports, and sales people to follow - matched to the user's role, market, and time budget, shipped as a dated verified-source snapshot with per-source status and a freshness check that catches rebranded or dead sources. Covers B2B SaaS and B2C high-ticket as separate ecosystems. Use whenever the user mentions sales newsletters, sales podcasts, who to follow in sales, sales communities, staying current in sales, or refreshing a reading list, even without the word radar. Do NOT use for career or interview prep (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-career).
description_zh: 构建并维护一份个性化的销售信息源关注列表——涵盖播客、通讯、社区、基准报告以及值得关注的销售人员——并依据用户的角色、市场和时间预算进行匹配。该列表以带有日期的已验证来源快照形式交付，包含各来源的状态信息及新鲜度检查功能，以识别已重新品牌化或已失效的来源。该工具将B2B SaaS和B2C高客单价领域视为两个独立的生态系统分别处理。当用户提及销售通讯、销售播客、销售领域值得关注的人物、销售社区、在销售领域保持前沿了解，或更新阅读清单时，均使用此工具，即使用户未使用“雷达”一词。切勿用于职业或面试准备（参见 mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-career）。

name: arc-region-switch
description: Answers questions about Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) Region switch including architecture, plans, execution blocks, workflows, triggers, active/active vs active/passive, cross-account support, recovery time, dashboards, and customer positioning. Applicable when users ask about ARC Region switch adoption, design, or troubleshooting.
description_zh: 回答有关亚马逊应用程序恢复控制器（ARC）区域切换的问题，包括架构、计划、执行块、工作流、触发器、主动/主动与主动/被动、跨账户支持、恢复时间、仪表板和客户定位。适用于用户询问ARC区域切换采用、设计或故障排除时。

name: sales-hiring
description: Employer-side hiring workflow for SDR/BDR and AE roles, producing an outcome-based scorecard, a structured interview loop with question bank, a scored mock-call work sample, and a 30-60-90 ramp plan with certification gates. Recommends SDR vs AE vs full-cycle from ACV, cycle length and inbound volume, and rests on selection-validity evidence - structured interviews, independent scoring, no brainteasers. Use whenever the user mentions hiring a rep, sales interview questions, a hiring scorecard, a mock call interview, rep onboarding, or a ramp plan, even without the word hiring. Do NOT use for candidate-side prep (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-career) or comp plan design (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-comp-design).
description_zh: 雇主端的SDR/BDR和AE角色招聘流程，产出基于结果的评分卡、结构化面试流程（含题库）、评分式模拟通话工作样本，以及30-60-90分阶段入职计划（含认证关卡）。根据ACV（平均合同价值）、周期长度和入站量，推荐SDR、AE或全周期销售代表，并基于选拔效度证据——结构化面试、独立评分、无脑筋急转弯。在用户提及招聘代表、销售面试问题、招聘评分卡、模拟通话面试、代表入职或分阶段入职计划时使用，即使未提及“招聘”二字。禁止用于候选人端准备（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-career）或薪酬计划设计（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-comp-design）。

name: draft-outreach
description: Draft a personalized outreach email or multi-touch sequence to a prospect, create it as an email draft for review, and add the contact to a sequence in your sales engagement tool when asked. Use when the user asks to "draft outreach to [person/company]", "write a cold email to [prospect]", "re-engage [prospect]", "draft a 3-touch sequence", or "reach out to [person]".
description_zh: 为潜在客户撰写个性化的外联邮件或多触点序列，将其创建为邮件草稿以供审阅，并在被要求时将联系人添加到您的销售参与工具中的序列中。当用户要求“为[人/公司]起草外联”、“给[潜在客户]写一封冷启动邮件”、“重新激活[潜在客户]”、“起草一个3触点序列”或“联系[人]”时使用。

name: canslim-screener
description: Screen US stocks using William O'Neil's CANSLIM growth stock methodology. Use when user requests CANSLIM stock screening, growth stock analysis, momentum stock identification, or wants to find stocks with strong earnings and price momentum following O'Neil's investment system.
description_zh: 使用威廉·奥尼尔的CANSLIM成长股方法对美股进行筛选。当用户请求CANSLIM股票筛选、成长股分析、动量股识别，或希望依据奥尼尔的投资体系寻找盈利强劲且价格动量显著的股票时，使用此功能。

name: visual-novel
description: Build a visual novel: a branching script, character and background display, a text box with choices, save/load, backlog, and skip/auto. Use for a VN, dating sim, or branching story game.
description_zh: 构建一款视觉小说：支持分支剧情脚本、角色与背景展示、带选项的文本框、存档/读档功能、待办列表以及跳过/自动播放功能。适用于视觉小说、恋爱模拟或分支剧情游戏。

name: dynamodb-toolbox-patterns
description: Provides TypeScript patterns for DynamoDB-Toolbox v2 including schema/table/entity modeling, .build() command workflow, query/scan access patterns, batch and transaction operations, and single-table design with computed keys. Use when implementing type-safe DynamoDB access layers with DynamoDB-Toolbox v2 in TypeScript services or serverless applications.
description_zh: 为 DynamoDB-Toolbox v2 提供 TypeScript 模式，包括模式/表/实体建模、.build() 命令工作流、查询/扫描访问模式、批处理和事务操作，以及使用计算键的单表设计。在 TypeScript 服务或无服务器应用程序中使用 DynamoDB-Toolbox v2 实现类型安全的 DynamoDB 访问层时使用。

name: ios-device-automation
description:
Vision-driven iOS device automation using Midscene CLI. Operates entirely from screenshots — no DOM or accessibility labels required. Can interact with all visible elements on screen regardless of technology stack.
Control iOS devices with natural language commands via WebDriverAgent.

Triggers: ios, iphone, ipad, ios app, tap on iphone, swipe, mobile app ios,
ios device, ios testing, iphone automation, ipad automation, ios screen, ios navigate,
test ios app, verify on iphone, QA on ipad, check the app on ios, test on ios device,
see if the app works on iphone, end-to-end test on ios, visual verification on ios

Powered by Midscene.js (https://midscenejs.com)

name: adr-drafting
description: Creates new Architecture Decision Record (ADR) documents for significant architectural changes using a consistent template and repository-aware naming and storage guidance. Use when a user or agent decides on an architectural change, needs to document technical rationale, or wants to add a new ADR to the project history.
description_zh: 创建新的架构决策记录（ADR）文档，用于记录重要的架构变更，并使用统一的模板以及与代码库相关的命名和存储指导。当用户或代理决定进行架构变更、需要记录技术理由，或希望向项目历史中添加新的ADR时使用。

name: tag-taxonomy
description: Enforce consistent tagging across the Obsidian wiki using a controlled vocabulary. Use this skill when the user says "fix my tags", "normalize tags", "clean up tags", "tag audit", "what tags should I use", "tag taxonomy", or whenever you're creating or updating wiki pages and need to choose the right tags. Also trigger when the user asks about tag conventions, wants to add a new tag to the taxonomy, or says "my tags are a mess". Always consult this skill's taxonomy file before assigning tags to any wiki page.
description_zh: 通过受控词汇表在 Obsidian wiki 中实施一致的标签规范。当用户说“修复我的标签”、“规范化标签”、“清理标签”、“标签审计”、“我该用哪些标签”、“标签分类体系”，或者你在创建或更新 wiki 页面需要选择合适的标签时，使用此功能。当用户询问标签约定、希望向分类体系添加新标签，或说“我的标签太乱了”时，也应触发此功能。在给任何 wiki 页面分配标签之前，务必先查阅此功能的分类体系文件。

name: brainstorm-ideas-new
description: Brainstorm feature ideas for a new product in initial discovery from PM, Designer, and Engineer perspectives. Use when starting product discovery for a new product, exploring features for a startup idea, or doing initial ideation.
description_zh: 从产品经理、设计师和工程师的角度出发，为新产品的初步探索阶段构思功能点子。在开始新产品的探索阶段、探索创业想法的功能，或进行初步构思时使用。

name: gemini
description: Provides Gemini CLI delegation workflows for large-context analysis and complex reasoning using Gemini 3.0 Flash and Gemini 3.0 Pro models, including English prompt formulation, execution flags, and safe result handling. Use when the user explicitly asks to use Gemini for tasks such as broad codebase analysis, fast iterations with Gemini 3 Flash, or deep architectural reasoning with Gemini 3 Pro. Triggers on "use gemini", "delegate to gemini", "run gemini cli", "ask gemini", "use gemini for this task", "use gemini 3 flash", "use gemini 3 pro".
description_zh: 为大型上下文分析和复杂推理提供 Gemini CLI 委托工作流程，使用 Gemini 3.0 Flash 和 Gemini 3.0 Pro 模型，包括英文提示词的制定、执行标志以及安全结果处理。当用户明确要求使用 Gemini 执行任务时使用，例如广泛代码库分析、使用 Gemini 3 Flash 快速迭代或使用 Gemini 3 Pro 进行深度架构推理。在以下情况下触发："使用 gemini"、"委托给 gemini"、"运行 gemini cli"、"询问 gemini"、"为这个任务使用 gemini"、"使用 gemini 3 flash"、"使用 gemini 3 pro"。

name: to-tickets
description: 把 plan、spec 或当前对话拆成一组 tracer-bullet tickets，每个 ticket 声明 blocking edges，并发布到已配置的 tracker；本地用每 ticket 一个文件中的文本 edge，真实 tracker 用 native blocking links。
description_zh: 将 plan、spec 或当前对话拆分为一组 tracer-bullet tickets，每个 ticket 声明 blocking edges，并发布到已配置的 tracker；本地使用每个 ticket 一个文件中的文本 edge，真实 tracker 使用 native blocking links。

name: macos-process-injection
description: macOS process injection playbook. Use when you need to inject code into running or launching macOS processes via dylib hijacking, DYLD environment variables, XPC exploitation, Mach port manipulation, or Electron/Chromium abuse.
description_zh: macOS 进程注入手册。在需要通过 dylib 劫持、DYLD 环境变量、XPC 利用、Mach 端口操作或滥用 Electron/Chromium 将代码注入正在运行或启动的 macOS 进程时使用。

name: memory-leak-audit
description: Audit code for memory leaks and disposable issues. Use when reviewing event listeners, DOM handlers, lifecycle callbacks, or fixing leak reports. Covers addDisposableListener, Event.once, MutableDisposable, DisposableStore, and onWillDispose patterns.
description_zh: 审计代码以检测内存泄漏和可丢弃问题。在审查事件监听器、DOM 处理器、生命周期回调或修复泄漏报告时使用。涵盖 addDisposableListener、Event.once、MutableDisposable、DisposableStore 和 onWillDispose 模式。

name: gemini
description: Gemini CLI one-shot prompts, summaries, generation, skills, hooks, MCP, or Gemma routing.
description_zh: Gemini CLI 一次性提示、摘要、生成、技能、钩子、MCP 或 Gemma 路由。

name: cc-use
description: 把较长的编码、排查、测试或交互式 CLI 工作交给 tmux 中的内层命令行编码 Agent， 由当前外层 Agent 负责拆解任务、读取稳定屏幕快照、纠正方向、执行最终验收，并在本次 任务结束后销毁内层 session。适用于用户明确要求使用 cc-use、希望把长时间实现工作 交给内层 Agent、需要在真实 Codex CLI 或 Claude Code TUI 中完成受监督工作，或需要 评估如何由 cron、launchd、systemd 等外部调度器触发 cc-use。
description_zh: 将较长的编码、排查、测试或交互式 CLI 工作交给 tmux 中的内层命令行编码 Agent，由当前外层 Agent 负责拆解任务、读取稳定屏幕快照、纠正方向、执行最终验收，并在本次任务结束后销毁内层 session。适用于用户明确要求使用 cc-use、希望将长时间实现工作交给内层 Agent、需要在真实 Codex CLI 或 Claude Code TUI 中完成受监督工作，或需要评估如何由 cron、launchd、systemd 等外部调度器触发 cc-use。

name: azure-verified-modules
description: Azure Verified Modules (AVM) requirements and best practices for developing certified Azure Terraform modules. Use when creating or reviewing Azure modules that need AVM certification.
description_zh: Azure 验证模块（AVM）在开发认证的 Azure Terraform 模块时的要求和最佳实践。在创建或审查需要 AVM 认证的 Azure 模块时使用。

name: position-sizer
description: Calculate risk-based position sizes for long stock trades. Use when user asks about position sizing, how many shares to buy, risk per trade, Kelly criterion, ATR-based sizing, fractional-share sizing, or portfolio risk allocation. Supports stop-loss distance calculation, volatility scaling, and sector concentration checks.
description_zh: 计算股票多头交易的基于风险的头寸规模。当用户询问头寸规模、应购买多少股、每笔交易的风险、凯利准则、基于ATR的规模、分数股规模或投资组合风险分配时使用。支持止损距离计算、波动率缩放和行业集中度检查。

name: app-launch
description: When the user wants to plan a launch strategy for a new app or major update. Also use when the user mentions "app launch", "launch plan", "launch checklist", "pre-launch", "launch day", or "how to launch my app". For ongoing ASO after launch, see aso-audit. For paid acquisition during launch, see ua-campaign.
description_zh: 当用户想要为新应用或重大更新制定发布策略时使用。此外，当用户提及“应用发布”、“发布计划”、“发布清单”、“发布前”、“发布日”或“如何发布我的应用”时也使用。发布后的持续ASO，请参考aso-audit。发布期间的付费获取，请参考ua-campaign。

name: institutional-flow-tracker
description: Use this skill to track institutional investor ownership changes and portfolio flows using 13F filings data. Analyzes hedge funds, mutual funds, and other institutional holders to identify stocks with significant smart money accumulation or distribution. Helps discover stocks before major moves by following where sophisticated investors are deploying capital.
description_zh: 使用此技能，通过13F申报数据追踪机构投资者持股变化和投资组合流动。分析对冲基金、共同基金和其他机构持有人，以识别具有显著聪明资金积累或派发的股票。通过追踪复杂投资者资本配置的方向，帮助在重大行情发生前发现股票。

name: otel-instrumentation
description: Provides guidance on OpenTelemetry SDK setup, custom instrumentation, and sending data to Honeycomb. Trigger phrases: "instrument my app", "add tracing", "set up OpenTelemetry", "configure OTel", "add custom spans", "add attributes to spans", "send traces to Honeycomb", "set up OTLP", "configure sampling", "add span events", "add span links", "set up tracing for [any language]", "configure the OTel Collector", or any request about OpenTelemetry SDK setup, custom instrumentation, or sending data to Honeycomb.
description_zh: 提供关于 OpenTelemetry SDK 配置、自定义埋点以及向 Honeycomb 发送数据的指导。触发短语包括：“为我的应用添加埋点”、“添加链路追踪”、“配置 OpenTelemetry”、“配置 OTel”、“添加自定义 Span”、“为 Span 添加属性”、“将链路追踪数据发送至 Honeycomb”、“配置 OTLP”、“配置采样”、“添加 Span 事件”、“添加 Span 链接”、“为[任意编程语言]配置链路追踪”、“配置 OTel Collector”，或任何关于 OpenTelemetry SDK 配置、自定义埋点或向 Honeycomb 发送数据的请求。

name: roblox-luau
description: Script a Roblox experience in Luau: get services, create and parent Instances, connect events, run server Scripts vs client LocalScripts, and communicate across the client/server boundary with RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions (server-authoritative). Use when building or debugging Roblox Studio scripts — when the user mentions Roblox, Luau, services, RemoteEvent, Instance.new, PlayerAdded, or client vs server. For saving player data use roblox-datastores.
description_zh: 用Luau编写Roblox体验脚本：获取服务、创建和附加实例、连接事件、运行服务器脚本与客户端LocalScript，并通过RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions（服务器权威）在客户端/服务器边界间通信。适用于构建或调试Roblox Studio脚本——当用户提及Roblox、Luau、服务、RemoteEvent、Instance.new、PlayerAdded或客户端与服务器时。保存玩家数据请使用roblox-datastores。

name: lark-mcp
description: 飞书/Lark 官方 MCP 集成。支持发送消息、创建群组、操作多维表格（Bitable）、导入/搜索文档、知识库查询。触发词：飞书、Feishu、Lark、多维表格、bitable、飞书文档、飞书群。
description_zh: 飞书/Lark 官方 MCP 集成。支持发送消息、创建群组、操作多维表格（Bitable）、导入/搜索文档、知识库查询。触发词：飞书、Feishu、Lark、多维表格、bitable、飞书文档、飞书群。

name: nosql-injection
description: NoSQL injection playbook. Use when MongoDB-style operators, JSON query objects, flexible search filters, or backend query DSLs may allow data or logic abuse.
description_zh: NoSQL注入手册。当MongoDB风格的操作符、JSON查询对象、灵活的搜索过滤器或后端查询DSL可能允许数据或逻辑滥用时使用。

name: humanizer
description: AI가 생성한 한국어 텍스트의 특징적인 패턴을 감지하고 자연스러운 인간의 글쓰기로 변환합니다. 과학적 언어학 연구(KatFishNet 논문, 94.88% AUC 정확도)에 기반합니다. 쉼표 과다, 띄어쓰기 경직성, 품사 다양성, AI 어휘 과용, 번역투(에 대해/통해/되어진다), 대명사 과다, 복수형 과다, 구조적 단조로움 등 40가지 패턴을 S1/S2/S3 심각도로 분석합니다. ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini가 생성한 한국어 텍스트를 자연스럽게 만들거나 LLM 출력에서 AI 흔적을 제거할 때 사용하세요.
description_zh: AI能够检测韩语文本的特征性模式，并将其转换为自然的人类写作风格。该技术基于科学语言学研究成果（KatFishNet论文，AUC准确度达94.88%）。它分析40种典型模式，包括逗号过度使用、标点僵化、词性多样性不足、AI词汇滥用、翻译腔（如“关于/通过/被...”等）、代词过度使用、复数形式过度使用、结构单调等，并按S1/S2/S3严重程度进行分类。适用于将ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini生成的韩语文本改写得更自然，或从LLM输出中去除AI痕迹。

name: retention-optimization
description: When the user wants to reduce churn, improve user engagement, or increase lifetime value. Also use when the user mentions "retention", "churn", "users leaving", "engagement", "DAU/MAU", "user activation", or "why are users uninstalling". For onboarding-specific issues, see app-launch. For monetization, see monetization-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户希望降低用户流失率、提升用户参与度或增加用户终身价值时，也可使用。此外，当用户提及“留存”、“流失”、“用户流失”、“参与度”、“DAU/MAU”、“用户激活”或“用户为何卸载”时，也可使用。针对新用户引导特定问题，请参阅app-launch。针对变现问题，请参阅monetization-strategy。

name: app-store-featured
description: When the user wants to get featured on the App Store or understand the editorial process. Also use when the user mentions "get featured", "App Store editorial", "App of the Day", "Today tab", "Apple featuring", or "how to get Apple to feature my app". For launch strategy, see app-launch. For ASO optimization, see aso-audit.
description_zh: 当用户希望获得App Store推荐或了解编辑流程时，也适用于用户提及“获得推荐”、“App Store编辑”、“每日应用”、“今日标签”、“苹果推荐”或“如何让苹果推荐我的应用”。关于发布策略，请参阅app-launch。关于ASO优化，请参阅aso-audit。

name: agentforce-bot-upgrade
description: Use this skill to Upgrade Einstein Bots into Agentforce agents end-to-end in a single pass, orchestrating per-bot Agent Spec generation, planner reconciliation across bots, agentforce-generate authoring, and post-conversion .agent enhancements. TRIGGER when: user asks to migrate, upgrade, or convert one or more Einstein Bots to Agentforce; runs a multi-bot bot-to-agent upgrade; needs Einstein Bot metadata turned into Agent Spec handoffs and generated .agent agents; convert bots to agents; upgrade my service bots; move bots to Agentforce. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user already has an approved Agent Spec and only wants direct .agent authoring, deploy, test, or observe flows; the request is unrelated to Einstein Bot migration.
description_zh: 使用此技能将 Einstein Bots 一次性升级为 Agentforce 代理，全程协调每个代理的 Agent Spec 生成、跨代理的规划器协调、agentforce-generate 编写以及转换后的 .agent 增强功能。触发条件：当用户要求迁移、升级或转换一个或多个 Einstein Bots 至 Agentforce；执行多代理的 bot-to-agent 升级；需要将 Einstein Bot 元数据转换为 Agent Spec 交接并生成 .agent 代理；将 bot 转换为代理；升级我的服务 bot；将 bot 移至 Agentforce。不触发条件：当用户已有批准的 Agent Spec 且仅希望直接进行 .agent 编写、部署、测试或观察流程；请求与 Einstein Bot 迁移无关。

name: copilot-cli
description: Provides GitHub Copilot CLI task delegation in non-interactive mode with multi-model support (Claude, GPT, Gemini), permission controls, output sharing, and session resume. Use when users ask to hand work to Copilot, compare models, or run Copilot programmatically from Claude Code.
description_zh: 提供非交互模式下的 GitHub Copilot CLI 任务委托，支持多模型（Claude、GPT、Gemini），具备权限控制、输出共享和会话恢复功能。当用户要求将工作交给 Copilot、比较模型或从 Claude Code 中以编程方式运行 Copilot 时使用。

name: daily-briefing
description: Morning rundown - today's meetings with account context, opps closing soon with stale flags, waiting customer emails, and the day's top actions. Use when the user says "daily briefing", "daily brief", "morning briefing", "what's my day", "what's on my plate today", "prep my day", "start my day", "morning rundown", or on a schedule.
description_zh: 早上总结 - 今天与客户相关的会议，即将关闭的过时机会，等待的客户邮件，以及当天最重要的行动事项。当用户说“每日简报”、“每日摘要”、“早晨简报”、“我今天的日程是什么”、“我今天要做什么”、“准备我的日程”、“开始我的日程”或“早上总结”，或在日程安排中时使用。

name: jupyter-to-marimo
description: Convert a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb) to a marimo notebook (.py).
description_zh: 将一个 Jupyter 笔记本 (.ipynb) 转换为一个 marimo 笔记本 (.py)。

name: bear-notes
description: Create, search, and manage Bear notes via grizzly CLI.
description_zh: 通过 grizzly CLI 创建、搜索和管理 Bear 笔记。

name: khazix-writer
description: 数字生命卡兹克（Khazix）的公众号长文写作skill。当用户需要撰写公众号文章、写稿子、续写文章、根据素材产出长文时使用。触发词包括但不限于：写文章、写稿子、帮我写、续写、扩写、公众号文章、长文、出稿、按我的风格写。即使用户只是说"帮我把这个写成文章"或"用我的风格写一下"，只要上下文涉及内容创作和公众号输出，都应该触发。也适用于用户丢过来一个PDF、brief、新闻链接、语音转文字或任何素材说"帮我写篇文章"的场景。不要用于短内容（小红书帖子、推特、朋友圈）或纯标题摘要生成（那个用wechat-title skill）。
description_zh: 数字生命卡兹克（Khazix）的公众号长文写作技能。当用户需要撰写公众号文章、写稿子、续写文章、根据素材产出长文时使用。触发词包括但不限于：写文章、写稿子、帮我写、续写、扩写、公众号文章、长文、出稿、按我的风格写。即使用户只是说"帮我把这个写成文章"或"用我的风格写一下"，只要上下文涉及内容创作和公众号输出，都应该触发。也适用于用户丢过来一个PDF、brief、新闻链接、语音转文字或任何素材说"帮我写篇文章"的场景。不要用于短内容（小红书帖子、推特、朋友圈）或纯标题摘要生成（那个用wechat-title技能）。

name: azure-pipelines
description: Use when validating Azure DevOps pipeline changes for the VS Code build. Covers queueing builds, checking build status, viewing logs, and iterating on pipeline YAML changes without waiting for full CI runs.
description_zh: 用于验证 VS Code 构建的 Azure DevOps 管道更改。涵盖排队构建、检查构建状态、查看日志以及在无需等待完整 CI 运行的情况下迭代管道 YAML 更改。

name: upload-insecure-files
description: Insecure file upload playbook. Use when testing upload validation, storage paths, processing pipelines, preview behavior, overwrite risks, and upload-to-RCE chains.
description_zh: 不安全的文件上传剧本。在测试上传验证、存储路径、处理管道、预览行为、覆盖风险以及上传至RCE链时使用。

name: m06-error-handling
description: CRITICAL: Use for error handling. Triggers: Result, Option, Error, ?, unwrap, expect, panic, anyhow, thiserror, when to panic vs return Result, custom error, error propagation, 错误处理, Result 用法, 什么时候用 panic
description_zh: 关键：用于错误处理。触发：Result、Option、Error、?、unwrap、expect、panic、anyhow、thiserror、何时使用 panic 而不是返回 Result、自定义错误、错误传播、错误处理、Result 用法、何时使用 panic

name: prompt-master
description: Generates optimized prompts for AI tools. Activates only when the user explicitly asks to write, fix, improve, or adapt a prompt for a specific AI tool (LLM, Cursor, Midjourney, image AI, video AI, coding agents, etc.). Does not activate for general conversation, coding tasks, document writing, or other non-prompt-engineering work.

name: biz-health-check
description: 사업자등록번호 하나로 "이 사업자, 실제 문제 없나"를 확인한다 — 국세청 사업자등록 상태·국민연금 가입 사업장·국세 체납 명단·금융위 법인개요·조달청 부정당제재·지방행정 인허가 영업상태를 무료 공공 데이터로 교차 조회해 사실만 병렬하는 실사 리포트(점수·등급·위험 판정 없음).
description_zh: 通过一个企业注册号，即可确认“这家企业是否存在实际问题”——国税厅通过免费公开数据交叉查询企业注册状态、国民年金参保企业、国税欠税名单、金融监管院法人概要、采购厅不当得利制裁、地方行政许可营业状态，生成不包含分数、等级、风险评定的实况调查报告。

name: ce-optimize
description: Optimize a named target with a measured loop: attribute a workload's cost, or score variants and keep winners. Use when a working system's metric should move and the winning change is not already known. Use ce-debug when the job is diagnosis; use ce-work when the change is already known.
description_zh: 使用测量循环优化命名目标：为工作负载分配成本，或评分变体并保留优胜者。当工作系统的指标需要变化且获胜变化尚未知晓时使用。当工作为诊断时使用ce-debug；当变化已知时使用ce-work。

name: camsnap
description: Capture frames or clips from RTSP/ONVIF cameras and local webcams, including USB pan/tilt/zoom control.
description_zh: 从RTSP/ONVIF摄像机和本地网络摄像头捕获帧或片段，包括USB云台控制。

name: openclaw-backup
description:
Encrypted backup and restore for OpenClaw Agent workspace files
(SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, IDENTITY.md, AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md). Uses
tar + openssl (AES-256-CBC) encryption and soul-upload.com API.
Auto-generates a new random password for each backup (DO NOT reuse
passwords). Use when the user needs to: (1) Back up or upload agent
workspace files, (2) Restore or download a previous backup, (3) Delete
a backup from remote storage, or (4) Manage encrypted agent persistence.
description_zh: OpenClaw Agent 工作区文件加密备份与恢复（SOUL.md、MEMORY.md、IDENTITY.md、AGENTS.md、TOOLS.md）。使用 tar + openssl (AES-256-CBC) 加密和 soul-upload.com API。每次备份自动生成一个新的随机密码（请勿重复使用密码）。当用户需要时使用：（1）备份或上传代理工作区文件，（2）恢复或下载之前的备份，（3）从远程存储删除备份，或（4）管理加密代理持久化。

name: competitive-brief
description: Research competitors and generate a positioning and messaging comparison with content gaps, opportunities, and threats. Use when building sales battlecards, when finding positioning gaps and messaging angles competitors haven't claimed, or when a competitor makes a move and you need to assess the impact.
description_zh: 研究竞争对手，并生成定位和信息的对比，包括内容差距、机会和威胁。在构建销售战卡、寻找竞争对手尚未占据的定位差距和信息角度，或竞争对手采取行动需要评估影响时使用。

name: earnings-analysis
description: Create professional equity research earnings update reports (8-12 pages, 3,000-5,000 words) analyzing quarterly results for companies already under coverage. Fast-turnaround format focusing on beat/miss analysis, key metrics, updated estimates, and revised thesis. Includes 1-3 summary tables and 8-12 charts. Use when user requests "earnings update", "quarterly update", "earnings analysis", "Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 results", or post-earnings report.
description_zh: 创建专业的股票研究报告（8-12页，3,000-5,000字），分析已覆盖公司的季度业绩。快速交付格式，重点关注业绩超预期/不及预期分析、关键指标、更新预测和修正投资逻辑。包含1-3个总结表格和8-12个图表。在用户请求“业绩更新”、“季度更新”、“业绩分析”、“Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4业绩”或发布业绩报告后使用。

name: interrogate
description: Use for "interrogate", "adversarial review", "multi-model review", "challenge this", "stress test this code", "find blind spots", or "tear this apart". Multiple LLM reviewers challenge changes from independent angles.
description_zh: 用于“审问”、“对抗性审查”、“多模型审查”、“挑战此内容”、“对这段代码进行压力测试”、“找出盲点”或“彻底分析此内容”。多个大型语言模型（LLM）从独立的角度挑战变更。

name: songsee
description: Generate spectrograms and feature-panel visualizations from audio with the songsee CLI.
description_zh: 使用 songsee CLI 从音频生成频谱图和特征面板可视化。

name: resilience-program-design
description: Designs a resilience program: how to structure and standardize resilience policies across an organization, team, or portfolio (tiered policy model with availability/RTO/RPO targets and DR approach selection), and how often to run resilience activities (operational cadence). Applies when the user asks how to structure policies org-wide, what tiers/targets to set, which DR approach fits a tier, or how frequently to run assessments, FIS experiments, GameDays, or autoshift practice. Does not apply to creating or configuring a specific policy or resource for a single workload (use resilience-hub-getting-started), to step-by-step lifecycle execution (see aws-resilience-lifecycle), or to service-specific setup.
description_zh: 设计韧性计划：阐述如何在整个组织、团队或项目组合中构建并标准化韧性策略（采用分层策略模型，明确可用性/RTO/RPO 目标并选择灾难恢复（DR）方案），以及如何设定韧性活动的执行频率（运营节奏）。当用户询问如何在全组织范围内规划策略架构、应设置哪些层级与目标、某一层级适合采用哪种灾难恢复方案，或应多频繁地执行评估、故障注入（FIS）实验、演练（GameDays）或自动切换（autoshift）实践时适用。本项不适用于为单一工作负载创建或配置特定策略或资源（请使用 resilience-hub-getting-started），不适用于逐步执行生命周期（参见 aws-resilience-lifecycle），也不适用于特定服务的配置。

name: migrating-to-amazon-redshift
description: Guides an end-to-end data-warehouse migration to Amazon Redshift — discovery, schema/SQL/stored-procedure/macro/script conversion, data migration, validation, performance comparison, and reporting. Source-routed via `references/<source>/`; Teradata (Vantage) is the supported source; additional sources are added as their own `references/<source>/` sets. Text-only knowledge (no executable code) — the AI generates all execution at runtime. Applies when a user wants to migrate Teradata to Amazon Redshift, convert Teradata DDL/SQL/stored procedures/macros/BTEQ to Redshift/RSQL, or assess Teradata-to-Redshift migration complexity. Applies only to migrations targeting Amazon Redshift; migrations to other platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, etc.) are out of scope regardless of source. Does not cover general Redshift administration, performance tuning, or troubleshooting of existing Redshift clusters (no migration involved), or sources not listed under references/.
description_zh: 指导端到端的数据仓库迁移至 Amazon Redshift——涵盖发现、架构/SQL/存储过程/宏/脚本转换、数据迁移、验证、性能对比及报告。源系统通过 `references/<source>/` 路由；支持 Teradata（Vantage）作为源；其他源将以独立的 `references/<source>/` 集添加。仅为纯文本知识（无可执行代码）——所有执行均由 AI 在运行时生成。当用户希望将 Teradata 迁移至 Amazon Redshift、将 Teradata DDL/SQL/存储过程/宏/BTEQ 转换为 Redshift/RSQL，或评估 Teradata 到 Redshift 的迁移复杂度时适用。仅适用于以 Amazon Redshift 为目标的迁移；无论源系统为何，针对其他平台（如 Snowflake、BigQuery、Databricks 等）的迁移均不在范围内。不涵盖一般性的 Redshift 管理、性能调优或现有 Redshift 集群的故障排查（不涉及迁移），也不涵盖 references/ 目录下未列出的源系统。

name: update-skills-from-changelog
description: Update ElevenLabs agent skills from a merged weekly changelog in elevenlabs-dx, then open a pull request in elevenlabs/skills. Trigger after a changelog merges to main on elevenlabs-dx, or when asked to update skills from changelog YYYY-MM-DD.
description_zh: 更新 ElevenLabs 代理技能，使用 elevenlabs-dx 中的合并周变更日志，然后在 elevenlabs/skills 中打开一个拉取请求。在变更日志合并到 elevenlabs-dx 的主分支后触发，或者当被要求根据变更日志 YYYY-MM-DD 更新技能时触发。

name: google-cloud-slo-alert-configuration
description: Configures PromQL-based Service Level Objective (SLO) alerting policies for Google Cloud resources registered in App Hub or individually specified. Generates Terraform output. Use when the user asks to configure an SLO or Service Level Objective. Don't use for standard alerting policies.
description_zh: 配置基于PromQL的服务等级目标（SLO）警报策略，用于在App Hub中注册的Google Cloud资源或单独指定的资源。生成Terraform输出。当用户要求配置SLO或服务等级目标时使用。不要用于标准警报策略。

name: sales-discovery-questions
description: Builds a sequenced sales discovery question set - pain, root cause, impact, urgency - for a specific deal or persona, sized to the call length, with follow-up ladders, branch triggers, and a do-not-ask list. Covers B2B (SDR qualification through multi-stakeholder AE discovery) and high-ticket B2C consultations. Use whenever the user mentions discovery call prep, qualification questions, SPIN or pain-funnel questions, a first-meeting agenda, or "what should I ask this prospect", even without the word discovery. Do NOT use for rebuttals (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling), the cold-call opening (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener), or grading a finished call (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review).
description_zh: 构建针对特定交易或客户画像的有序销售发现问题集——包括痛点、根本原因、影响和紧迫性——问题数量根据通话时长调整，并包含后续问题阶梯、分支触发器和禁止提问清单。涵盖B2B（通过多方利益相关者AE发现进行SDR资格认证）和高价值B2C咨询。无论用户何时提及发现通话准备、资格问题、SPIN或痛点漏斗问题、首次会议议程，或“我应该向潜在客户问什么”，即使没有使用“发现”一词，也适用。**禁止**用于反驳（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling）、冷呼开场（mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener），或评估已完成通话（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review）。

name: superwall-editor
description: Build and edit live Superwall paywalls from the CLI. Attach to a running browser editor session using a pairing code, list the tools the browser exposes right now, and invoke them. Covers native sw-* elements, editing workflow, design standards, and the attach/call/release lifecycle. Use whenever the user wants to design, build, modify, or review a Superwall paywall, onboarding, or web2app flow.
description_zh: 从命令行构建和编辑实时 Superwall 订阅墙。使用配对码连接到正在运行的浏览器编辑器会话，列出浏览器当前暴露的工具，并调用它们。涵盖原生 sw-* 元素、编辑工作流、设计标准以及连接/调用/释放生命周期。每当用户想要设计、构建、修改或审查 Superwall 订阅墙、引导流程或 Web2App 流程时，均可使用。

name: learning-medusa
description: Load automatically when user asks to learn Medusa development (e.g., "teach me how to build with medusa", "guide me through medusa", "I want to learn medusa"). Interactive guided tutorial where Claude acts as a coding bootcamp instructor, teaching step-by-step with checkpoints and verification.
description_zh: 当用户要求学习 Medusa 开发时自动加载（例如："教我如何使用 Medusa 构建"、"引导我学习 Medusa"、"我想学习 Medusa"）。交互式引导教程，Claude 扮演编程训练营讲师的角色，通过分步教学、检查点和验证进行指导。

name: 3d-animation-short-generator
description: Create complete stylized 3D animated shorts from a story idea through an ordered production workflow covering project brief, story outline, character and environment cards, standardized shot planning, text or optional pencil storyboards, video-model selection, single-shot generation, assembly, BGM matching, and final review. Use when the user wants an end-to-end narrative animation workflow with strong character consistency, scene continuity, timing, camera, performance, and audio control. Not for single images, simple edits, photorealistic live action, or one standalone clip.
description_zh: 从故事创意开始，通过有序的生产流程，创建完整的风格化3D动画短片。该流程涵盖项目简报、故事大纲、角色与环境卡片、标准化镜头规划、文字或可选铅笔故事板、视频模型选择、单镜头生成、组装、背景音乐匹配及最终审阅。适用于用户需要端到端的叙事动画工作流程，并要求角色一致性、场景连贯性、时间控制、摄像机、表演和音频控制。不适用于单张图像、简单编辑、照片级真实感实拍或单个独立片段。

name: metal-kernel
description: Write Metal/MPS kernels for PyTorch operators. Use when adding MPS device support to operators, implementing Metal shaders, or porting CUDA kernels to Apple Silicon. Covers native_functions.yaml dispatch, host-side operators, and Metal kernel implementation.
description_zh: 编写适用于 PyTorch 操作符的 Metal/MPS 内核。在为操作符添加 MPS 设备支持、实现 Metal 着色器或从 CUDA 内核移植到 Apple Silicon 时使用。涵盖 native_functions.yaml 分发、主机端操作符和 Metal 内核实现。

name: db-migrate
description: Run database migrations in Medusa
description_zh: 在 Medusa 中运行数据库迁移

name: cass
description: Coding Agent Session Search - unified CLI/TUI to index and search local coding agent history from Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Aider, ChatGPT, Pi-Agent, Factory, and more. Purpose-built for AI agent consumption with robot mode.

name: steam-publish
description: Publish or update a game on Steam with Steamworks and SteamPipe: configure depots and packages, upload builds with steamcmd, set a build live on a branch, and run the release checklists. Use for Steam publishing, app_build.vdf/steamcmd uploads, depots, beta branches, or a store page release.
description_zh: 使用 Steamworks 和 SteamPipe 在 Steam 上发布或更新游戏：配置 depot 和 package，通过 steamcmd 上传构建版本，在指定分支上将某构建设为正式版，并执行发布前的检查清单。适用于 Steam 游戏发布、app_build.vdf/steamcmd 上传、depot 管理、Beta 分支设置，以及商店页面发布。

name: codex
description: Provides Codex CLI delegation workflows for complex code generation and development tasks using OpenAI's GPT-5.3-codex models, including English prompt formulation, execution flags, sandbox modes, and safe result handling. Use when the user explicitly asks to use Codex for complex programming tasks such as code generation, refactoring, or architectural analysis. Triggers on "use codex", "delegate to codex", "run codex cli", "ask codex", "codex exec", "codex review".
description_zh: 为使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.3-codex 模型进行复杂的代码生成和开发任务提供 Codex CLI 委托工作流程，包括英文提示词的制定、执行标志、沙盒模式和安全结果处理。当用户明确要求使用 Codex 进行代码生成、重构或架构分析等复杂编程任务时使用。在“使用 Codex”、“委托给 Codex”、“运行 Codex CLI”、“询问 Codex”、“Codex 执行”和“Codex 审核”时触发。

name: at-dispatch-v2
description: Convert PyTorch AT_DISPATCH macros to AT_DISPATCH_V2 format in ATen C++ code. Use when porting AT_DISPATCH_ALL_TYPES_AND*, AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES*, or other dispatch macros to the new v2 API. For ATen kernel files, CUDA kernels, and native operator implementations.
description_zh: 将 ATen C++ 代码中的 PyTorch AT_DISPATCH 宏转换为 AT_DISPATCH_V2 格式。在将 AT_DISPATCH_ALL_TYPES_AND*、AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES* 或其他调度宏移植到新的 v2 API 时使用。适用于 ATen 内核文件、CUDA 内核和本地算子实现。

name: asta-skill
description: Domain expertise for Ai2 Asta MCP tools (Semantic Scholar corpus). Intent-to-tool routing, safe defaults, workflow patterns, and pitfall warnings for academic paper search, citation traversal, and author discovery.
description_zh: 为Ai2 Asta MCP工具（语义学者语料库）提供领域专业知识。用于学术论文搜索、引文遍历和作者发现的意图到工具路由、安全默认设置、工作流模式以及陷阱警告。

name: blucli
description: BluOS CLI (blu) for discovery, playback, grouping, and volume.
description_zh: 用于发现、播放、分组和音量的BluOS CLI（blu）

name: human-architect-mindset
description: Systematic architectural thinking for irreplaceable human capabilities - domain modeling, systems thinking, constraint navigation, and AI-aware problem decomposition. Use proactively when detecting architectural decisions, system design discussions, or multi-component planning.
description_zh: 为不可替代的人类能力进行系统性的架构思考——领域建模、系统思维、约束导航和AI感知问题分解。在检测架构决策、系统设计讨论或多组件规划时主动使用。

name: platform-widget-generate
description: Use this skill to author a complete HXL WidgetBundle (UEM body + schema.json + -meta.xml). TRIGGER when: user asks for a widget, mosaic, fragment, card, or rich UI surface for any subject, domain, feature, or entity noun; the prompt names only an entity or data shape without invoking Lightning Types, CLTs, or Apex-backed types. DO NOT TRIGGER when: the prompt explicitly says 'Lightning Type', 'CLT', 'Custom Lightning Type', 'Apex-backed type', or references '@apexClassType/...' (use platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate); authoring a custom-LWC renderer for a Custom Lightning Type (use platform-custom-lightning-type-generate); or editing only an LWC component.
description_zh: 使用此技能来创建一个完整的 HXL WidgetBundle（UEM 主体 + schema.json + -meta.xml）。触发条件为：当用户请求任何主题、领域、功能或实体名词的组件、马赛克、片段、卡片或富 UI 界面时；提示仅命名实体或数据形状，而未调用 Lightning 类型、CLT 或 Apex 支持的类型。不触发条件为：提示明确说明“Lightning 类型”、“CLT”、“自定义 Lightning 类型”、“Apex 支持的类型”，或引用“@apexClassType/...”（请使用 platform-lightning-type-widget-coordinate）；为自定义 Lightning 类型创建自定义-LWC 渲染器（请使用 platform-custom-lightning-type-generate）；或仅编辑 LWC 组件。

name: sales-call-review
description: Scores one sales call transcript against an anchored rubric - opener, discovery, objection handling, close - quoting the transcript for every judgement and naming one focus behaviour. Handles messy ASR transcripts, missing speaker labels, and partial calls, covering B2B deal calls and B2C/inside-sales QA, rep self-review and manager tape review. Use whenever the user mentions a call recording, transcript, Gong or Chorus review, tape review, call scoring, or "how did this call go", even without the word review. Do NOT use for writing the follow-up email (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-meeting-recap) or scoring the deal itself (mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard).
description_zh: 对一份销售通话记录进行评分，依据一个固定的评分标准——开场白、发现、异议处理、收尾——并引用通话记录原文来支持每一个评分，同时指出一个重点行为。能够处理混乱的语音转文字记录、缺失的发言人标签以及部分通话记录，涵盖B2B交易通话和B2C/内部销售质量评估、销售代表自我评估以及经理录音评估。当用户提到通话录音、通话记录、Gong或Chorus评估、录音评估、通话评分，甚至没有使用“评估”一词时，都可以使用。禁止用于撰写后续邮件（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-meeting-recap）或对交易本身进行评分（mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard）。

name: resilience-hub-getting-started
description: Sets up AWS Resilience Hub v2 from scratch: creates resilience policies with SLO targets, registers systems and user journeys, onboards services with input sources, and runs a first failure mode assessment. Applies when the user wants to get started with Resilience Hub v2, create a policy, onboard a service, or run an assessment — including creating one concrete policy with specific availability/RTO/RPO targets and a DR approach for a single service (even a tier-1 one). Does not apply to FIS experiments or ARC routing controls.
description_zh: 从零开始设置 AWS Resilience Hub v2：创建具有 SLO 目标的弹性策略，注册系统和用户旅程，使用输入源将服务上线，并运行首次故障模式评估。适用于用户希望开始使用 Resilience Hub v2、创建策略、上线服务或运行评估的情况——包括为单个服务（即使是第一层服务）创建一个具体的策略，并设定特定的可用性/RTO/RPO 目标和灾难恢复方法。不适用于 FIS 实验或 ARC 路由控制。

name: blog-writing-guide
description: Write, review, and improve blog posts for the Sentry engineering blog following Sentry's specific writing standards, voice, and quality bar. Use this skill whenever someone asks to write a blog post, draft a technical article, review blog content, improve a draft, write a product announcement, create an engineering deep-dive, or produce any written content destined for the Sentry blog or developer audience. Also trigger when the user mentions "blog post," "blog draft," "write-up," "announcement post," "engineering post," "deep dive," "postmortem," or asks for help with technical writing for Sentry. Even if the user just says "help me write about [feature/topic]" — if it sounds like it could become a Sentry blog post, use this skill.
description_zh: 为Sentry工程博客撰写、审阅和改进博文，需遵循Sentry特定的写作标准、风格和质量要求。每当有人要求撰写博文、起草技术文章、审阅博客内容、改进草稿、撰写产品公告、创建工程深度解析，或产出任何面向Sentry博客或开发者群体的书面内容时，均需使用此技能。此外，当用户提及“博文”、“博客草稿”、“撰写”、“公告”、“工程文章”、“深度解析”、“事后分析”，或询问Sentry技术写作帮助时，也需触发此技能。即便用户只是说“帮我写关于[功能/主题]的内容”——如果听起来可能成为Sentry博客文章，也应使用此技能。

name: sales-outbound-sequence
description: Plans a touch-by-touch outbound cadence - which channel on which day, touch count, spacing, channel mix, multi-threading, exit and stop rules, recycle and re-entry, and the capacity math behind it, with pre-committed metric thresholds. Use whenever the user mentions a sequence, cadence, follow-up timing, Outreach or Salesloft steps, a drip, "how many touches", inbound-lead or event follow-up, closed-lost re-engagement, or B2C lifecycle and SMS flows, even without the word cadence. Do NOT use for message copy, subject lines (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester), call scripts (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener), or inbox placement (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-deliverability).
description_zh: 制定逐点触达的外出节奏计划——包括每日哪个渠道触达、触达次数、间隔时间、渠道组合、多线程操作、退出和停止规则、循环和重新进入，以及其背后的容量计算，并设定预先承诺的指标阈值。在用户提及序列、节奏、后续时间、Outreach或Salesloft步骤、滴灌营销、"多少次触达"、"入站线索或事件跟进"、"已关闭丢单的再激活"，或B2C生命周期和短信流程时使用，即使没有提及"节奏"这个词。不适用于消息文案、主题行（mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester）、电话脚本（mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener），或收件箱送达率（mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-deliverability）。

name: resilience-hub-failure-mode-assessment
description: Runs and interprets AWS Resilience Hub v2 failure mode assessments. Covers starting assessments, understanding findings (severity, categories, recommendations), triaging by achievability, working with AI-generated service functions, and resolving findings. Applies when the user wants to run an assessment, review findings, or understand failure modes, or has a specific finding and asks how to resolve, remediate, or fix it. Does not apply to initial setup (use resilience-hub-getting-started) or FIS experiments.
description_zh: 运行并解释 AWS Resilience Hub v2 的故障模式评估。涵盖启动评估、理解发现（严重程度、类别、建议）、按可实现性进行分派、与 AI 生成的服务函数协作以及解决发现。适用于用户想要运行评估、审查发现或了解故障模式，或具有特定发现并询问如何解决、补救或修复的情况。不适用于初始设置（请使用 resilience-hub-getting-started）或 FIS 实验。

name: earnings-calendar
description: This skill retrieves upcoming earnings announcements for US stocks using the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API. Use this when the user requests earnings calendar data, wants to know which companies are reporting earnings in the upcoming week, or needs a weekly earnings review. The skill focuses on mid-cap and above companies (over $2B market cap) that have significant market impact, organizing the data by date and timing in a clean markdown table format. Supports multiple environments (CLI, Desktop, Web) with flexible API key management.
description_zh: 此技能通过Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API获取美国股票的即将发布的盈利公告。当用户请求盈利日历数据、想知道哪些公司在未来一周发布盈利，或需要每周盈利回顾时，请使用此技能。该技能专注于市值超过20亿美元的中小型企业（中大型企业），这些企业具有显著的市场影响力，并将数据按日期和时间以清晰的Markdown表格格式组织。支持多种环境（CLI、桌面、网页），并提供灵活的API密钥管理。

name: sales-quota-setting
description: Designs how sales quotas are derived for a team or company - top-down vs bottom-up reconciliation, ramp-adjusted capacity modeling (Ramped Rep Equivalents), over-assignment cushion, territory-weighted fair-share allocation, ramp relief policy, and validation against current attainment benchmarks. A macro planning exercise for VP Sales, CRO, and sales ops, covering B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions quotas, targets, attainment, ramping new hires, annual planning, or "how much quota should an AE carry", even without the word quota. Do NOT use for pipeline coverage math (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling) or the comp plan that pays against it (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-comp-design).
description_zh: 设计团队或公司销售配额的制定方式——自上而下与自下而上的对账、调整后的产能建模（逐步增加的等效人员）、超额分配缓冲、区域加权公平分配、逐步增加新员工的缓解政策，以及与当前达成基准的验证。这是面向销售副总裁、首席营收官和销售运营团队的战略规划练习，涵盖B2B和B2C业务。每当用户提及配额、目标、达成率、逐步增加新员工、年度规划或“AE应承担多少配额”时（即使未使用“配额”一词），均可使用。**不适用于**销售管道覆盖率计算（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling）或与之挂钩的薪酬计划（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-comp-design）。

name: bencium-aeo
description: Generate AEO-optimized content (Answer Engine Optimization) for AI search visibility - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, AI Overviews. Use when optimizing websites for AI citations, creating FAQ schemas, evidence panels, or analyzing content for LLM extraction readiness.
description_zh: 生成 AEO 优化内容（答案引擎优化）以提升 AI 搜索可见性 - ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、AI 概览。在优化网站以供 AI 引用、创建 FAQ 结构化数据、证据面板或分析内容以供 LLM 提取准备时使用。

name: technical-writing
description: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis structure, Google developer style sentences, STE instruction rules, Global English syntax. Use for /technical-writing or when writing or reviewing docs, RFCs, readmes, PR descriptions, or commit messages.
description_zh: 分层技术规范标准：采用 Diátaxis 结构，遵循 Google 开发者风格句式、STE 指令规则以及全球英语（Global English）句法。适用于使用 /technical-writing，或在撰写、审阅文档、RFC、README、PR 描述或提交信息时使用。

name: resilience-hub-multi-account
description: Configures AWS Resilience Hub v2 for multi-account resilience management across an AWS Organization. Covers the per-service cross-account permission model, cross-account IAM roles, and centralized assessment from a single account. Applies when the user wants to set up org-wide resilience or assess workloads that span multiple AWS accounts.
description_zh: 配置 AWS Resilience Hub v2 以实现跨 AWS 组织的多账户弹性管理。涵盖跨账户的服务权限模型、跨账户 IAM 角色以及从单个账户进行集中评估。适用于用户希望设置组织范围的弹性或评估跨越多个 AWS 账户的工作负载的场景。

name: spec
description: Designs and develops specs following the spec-driven method. Asks clarifying questions before proposing structure, and builds the spec section by section. Use it when starting a large feature, before writing code.
description_zh: 遵循规范驱动方法设计和开发规范。在提出结构之前提出澄清问题，并逐段构建规范部分。在开始大型功能、编写代码之前使用。

name: accessibility
description: Primary accessibility skill for VS Code. REQUIRED for new feature and contribution work, and also applies to updates of existing UI. Covers accessibility help dialogs, accessible views, verbosity settings, signals, ARIA announcements, keyboard navigation, and ARIA labels/roles.
description_zh: VS Code 的主要可访问性技能。新功能和贡献工作必需，也适用于现有 UI 的更新。涵盖可访问性帮助对话框、可访问视图、详细程度设置、信号、ARIA 通知、键盘导航以及 ARIA 标签/角色。

name: antislop-layoutmobile
description: Mobile layout skill for antislop. Use for layouts that reflow across screen sizes, phone to desktop: grids, overflow, tap targets. Load with the core.
description_zh: 移动布局技能，用于防滑动。适用于跨屏幕尺寸（从手机到桌面）的重新布局，如网格、溢出、点击目标。随核心加载。

name: wiremock-standalone-docker
description: Provides patterns and configurations for running WireMock as a standalone Docker container. Generates mock HTTP endpoints, creates stub mappings for testing, validates integration scenarios, and simulates error conditions. Use when you need to mock APIs, create a mock server, stub external services, simulate third-party APIs, or fake API responses for integration testing.
description_zh: 提供用于以独立 Docker 容器方式运行 WireMock 的模式与配置。可生成模拟 HTTP 端点，为测试创建桩映射（stub mappings），验证集成场景，并模拟错误状况。当你需要模拟 API、创建模拟服务器、对外部服务进行桩替（stubbing）、模拟第三方 API，或为集成测试伪造 API 响应时，请使用本内容。

name: eightctl
description: Control Eight Sleep pods (status, temperature, alarms, schedules).
description_zh: 控制八个睡眠舱（状态、温度、警报、日程）。

name: provider-test-patterns
description: Terraform provider acceptance test patterns using terraform-plugin-testing with the Plugin Framework. Covers test structure, TestCase/TestStep fields, ConfigStateChecks with custom statecheck.StateCheck implementations, plan checks, CompareValue for cross-step assertions, config helpers, import testing with ImportStateKind, sweepers, and scenario patterns (basic, update, disappears, validation, regression), and ephemeral resource testing with the echoprovider package. Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging provider acceptance tests, including questions about statecheck, plancheck, TestCheckFunc, CheckDestroy, ExpectError, import state verification, ephemeral resources, or how to structure test files.
description_zh: 使用 Terraform 插件测试框架（Plugin Framework）的 Terraform provider 接受测试模式。涵盖测试结构、TestCase/TestStep 字段、使用自定义 statecheck.StateCheck 实现的 ConfigStateChecks、计划检查、跨步骤断言的 CompareValue、配置辅助工具、使用 ImportStateKind 的导入测试、清理工具（sweepers）以及场景模式（基础、更新、消失、验证、回归），以及使用 echoprovider 包进行临时资源测试。在编写、审查或调试 provider 接受测试时使用，包括关于 statecheck、plancheck、TestCheckFunc、CheckDestroy、ExpectError、导入状态验证、临时资源或如何组织测试文件的问题。

name: longbridge-market-data
description:
Real-time quotes, K-line charts, order book, trade ticks, intraday capital flow, market sentiment temperature, trading session schedule, security lists, exchange rates, and IPO calendar for HK/US/A-share/SG via Longbridge. Also covers ADR premium and FX carry frameworks.
Triggers: "股价", "行情", "K线", "走势", "盘口", "资金流", "市场温度", "汇率", "IPO", "打新", "隔夜股", "ADR溢价", "外汇套息", "K線", "盤口", "資金流", "市場溫度", "匯率", "ADR溢價", "外匯套息", "现在多少钱", "多少钱", "stock price", "quote", "kline", "chart", "depth", "orderbook", "capital flow", "market sentiment", "exchange rate", "IPO calendar", "security list", "ADR premium", "fx carry", "market open", "trading hours", "开市", "溢价", "NVDA.US", "700.HK", "600519.SH", "股價", "走勢", "開盤", "今天開市"
description_zh:
提供港股/美股/A股/新交所的实时报价、K线图、盘口深度、逐笔成交、日内资金流向、市场情绪温度、交易时段安排、证券列表、汇率及IPO日历（经由长桥平台）。同时涵盖ADR溢价与外汇套息框架。

触发词："股价"、"行情"、"K线"、"走势"、"盘口"、"资金流"、"市场温度"、"汇率"、"IPO"、"打新"、"隔夜股"、"ADR溢价"、"外汇套息"、"K線"、"盤口"、"資金流"、"市場溫度"、"匯率"、"ADR溢價"、"外匯套息"、"现在多少钱"、"多少钱"、"stock price"、"quote"、"kline"、"chart"、"depth"、"orderbook"、"capital flow"、"market sentiment"、"exchange rate"、"IPO calendar"、"security list"、"ADR premium"、"fx carry"、"market open"、"trading hours"、"开市"、"溢价"、"NVDA.US"、"700.HK"、"600519.SH"、"股價"、"走勢"、"開盤"、"今天開市"

name: arena
description: Spawn N parallel candidates at the same task, pick a base, graft the strongest parts of the losers into it. Use for /arena, 'arena this', 'throw it in the arena', or when one attempt at a non-trivial artifact would lock in the wrong shape.
description_zh: 在同一任务中并行生成N个候选者，选择一个基础，将失败者的最强部分嫁接到它上面。用于/arena、'arena this'、'throw it in the arena'，或在尝试制作一个非平凡物品时，避免锁定错误的形状。

name: godot-csharp
description: Use C#/.NET in Godot 4.7: partial classes extending nodes, the PascalCase lifecycle (_Ready/_Process/_PhysicsProcess), [Export] fields, [Signal] delegates as C# events, type-safe node lookup, and calling between C# and GDScript. Use when writing Godot game code in C# (.cs files, .csproj), needing the Godot .NET build, converting GDScript patterns to C#, or wiring Godot signals as C# events.
description_zh: 在 Godot 4.7 中使用 C#/.NET：支持部分类扩展节点、PascalCase 生命周期（_Ready/_Process/_PhysicsProcess）、[Export] 字段、[Signal] 委托作为 C# 事件、类型安全的节点查找，以及 C# 和 GDScript 之间的调用。适用于在 C#（.cs 文件、.csproj）中编写 Godot 游戏代码、需要 Godot .NET 构建、将 GDScript 模式转换为 C# 或将 Godot 信号连接为 C# 事件的情况。

name: godot-multiplayer
description: Build networked games with Godot 4.7 high-level multiplayer: set up an ENetMultiplayerPeer server/client, define RPCs with the @rpc annotation (call via rpc()/rpc_id()), set per-node multiplayer authority, and replicate state with MultiplayerSpawner and MultiplayerSynchronizer. Use when adding multiplayer/networking to a Godot project, writing @rpc functions, or syncing player/world state across peers.
description_zh: 使用 Godot 4.7 的高级多人游戏功能构建网络游戏：设置 ENetMultiplayerPeer 服务器/客户端，通过 @rpc 注释定义 RPC（通过 rpc()/rpc_id() 调用），为每个节点设置多人游戏权限，并使用 MultiplayerSpawner 和 MultiplayerSynchronizer 复制状态。适用于向 Godot 项目添加多人/网络功能、编写 @rpc 函数或跨节点同步玩家/世界状态。

name: sales-outreach-personalization
description: Turns prospect signals into 2-3 ranked personalization angles for outreach, each pairing a dated, sourced signal with the problem it implies, a one-line hook, the ask it justifies, and a confidence/recency label. Covers B2B and B2C signals and 1:1 vs 1:few vs 1:many effort tiers, and never invents a signal. Use whenever the user mentions personalization, a trigger event, a funding round, a new hire or job change, a product launch, review mining, or "find a reason to reach out", even without the word personalize. Do NOT use for drafting the message - subject lines (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester), openers (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener), and cadence (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence) live elsewhere.
description_zh: 将潜在信号转化为2-3个用于外联的个性化角度，每个角度将一个有日期来源的信号与其暗示的问题配对，附上一句钩子语、一个合理的请求，以及一个置信度/时效性标签。涵盖B2B和B2C信号，以及1:1、1:少数和1:多数的努力层级，且永不凭空捏造信号。每当用户提及个性化、触发事件、融资轮次、新员工入职或职位变动、产品发布、评论挖掘，或“寻找联系理由”时（即使没有“个性化”一词），均可使用。请勿用于撰写消息——主题行（mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester）、开场白（mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-call-opener）和节奏（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence）另有安排。

name: developing-with-streamlit
description: Use for ALL Streamlit tasks: creating, editing, debugging, beautifying, styling, theming, optimizing, or deploying Streamlit apps. Also custom components, st.components.v2, HTML/JS/CSS work. Discovers and loads version-matched reference docs from the user's installed Streamlit (>=1.57). Triggers: streamlit, st., dashboard, app.py, beautify, style, CSS, color, background, theme, button, widget styling, custom component, st.components, CCv2, session state, performance, cache, fragment, slow rerun, deploy.
description_zh: 用于所有 Streamlit 任务：创建、编辑、调试、美化、样式设置、主题化、优化或部署 Streamlit 应用。还包括自定义组件、st.components.v2、HTML/JS/CSS 工作。从用户已安装的 Streamlit（>=1.57）中发现并加载版本匹配的参考文档。触发器：streamlit、st.、dashboard、app.py、beautify、style、CSS、颜色、背景、主题、按钮、组件样式、自定义组件、st.components、CCv2、会话状态、性能、缓存、片段、慢速重跑、部署。

name: unauthorized-access-common-services
description: Unauthorized access playbook for common exposed services. Use when Redis, Rsync, PHP-FPM, AJP/Ghostcat, Hadoop YARN, H2 Console, or similar management interfaces are exposed without authentication.
description_zh: 未经授权访问剧本，用于常见暴露服务。当 Redis、Rsync、PHP-FPM、AJP/Ghostcat、Hadoop YARN、H2 Console 或类似的管理接口未进行身份验证时使用。

name: sales-comp-design
description: Designs the sales compensation plan structure - pay mix (base/variable split) set by role influence, performance measures under the rule of three, accelerator and decelerator curves, SPIF overlays, draws, and role plans for SDR, AE, manager, overlay, and CSM seats. A macro annual exercise for sales leadership, RevOps, and finance, covering B2B SaaS and commission-heavy B2C. Use whenever the user mentions commission plans, OTE, accelerators, clawbacks, SPIFs, capping commissions, or "how should we pay our reps", even without the words comp design. Do NOT use for deriving the quota the plan pays against (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting) or structuring the org (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-org-structure).
description_zh: 负责设计销售薪酬计划的结构，包括薪酬构成（固定/浮动比例，按角色影响力设定）、基于“三原则”的绩效指标、加速与减速曲线、短期激励计划（SPIF）叠加、预付款（draw）以及面向 SDR、AE、经理、叠加角色和 CSM 职位的角色计划。这是一项面向销售领导层、收入运营（RevOps）和财务部门的年度宏观任务，适用于 B2B SaaS 以及以佣金为主的大众 B2C 场景。只要用户提到佣金计划、OTE（目标总收入）、加速条款、追回机制、SPIF、佣金封顶或“我们该如何向销售代表支付薪酬”，即使未明确提及“薪酬设计”，也应使用本功能。但不得用于推导该计划所对应的销售配额（参见 mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting）或组织结构设计（参见 mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-org-structure）。

name: sales-motion
description: Chooses and designs the company-level sales motion at VP Sales / CRO altitude - product-led growth (PLG), sales-led, hybrid product-led sales, developer-led/open-source, or channel/partner-led - plus the transitions between them (exiting founder-led sales, layering sales onto self-serve, moving upmarket, adding channel), mapped to ACV, time-to-value, buyer-vs-user separation, TAM shape and procurement friction. Covers B2B SaaS and consumer self-serve motions. Use whenever the user mentions PLG vs sales-led, hiring the first salesperson, going upmarket, self-serve vs demo, or adding partners, even without the word motion. Do NOT use for org topology (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-org-structure) or quotas (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting).
description_zh: 选择并设计公司层面的销售策略，在销售副总裁/CRO的高度进行规划——包括产品驱动增长（PLG）、销售驱动、混合产品驱动销售、开发者驱动/开源或渠道/合作伙伴驱动——以及它们之间的过渡（例如退出创始人驱动销售、在自助服务上叠加销售、向上市场拓展、增加渠道），并与ACV、价值实现时间、买方与用户分离、TAM形态及采购摩擦进行映射。涵盖B2B SaaS和消费者自助服务策略。在用户提及PLG与销售驱动、首次招聘销售人员、向上市场拓展、自助服务与演示、增加合作伙伴等情况时使用，即使没有“策略”一词。不适用于组织结构（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-org-structure）或配额（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting）。

name: squirrelscan
description: squirrelscan audits websites for SEO, performance, security, accessibility, content, and structured data issues (260+ rules) and scores site health, via the squirrel CLI. Use when the user wants to check, audit, or improve a website's SEO, ranking, speed, or health, and for anything squirrelscan itself, installing or updating the CLI, login and API keys, running audits, publishing and sharing reports, cloud credits, MCP server setup, configuration, or troubleshooting. Also covers the entity map: the site-wide graph of the entities a site declares in its JSON-LD, and fixing structured data identity problems such as an organization declared separately on every page.
description_zh: 松鼠扫描（squirrelscan）可对网站进行SEO、性能、安全、可访问性、内容和结构化数据问题的审计（260多项规则），并通过松鼠命令行界面（CLI）对网站健康状况进行评分。当用户需要检查、审计或提升网站的SEO、排名、速度或健康状况时，以及需要进行松鼠扫描本身、安装或更新CLI、登录和API密钥、运行审计、发布和共享报告、云信用额度、MCP服务器设置、配置或故障排除时，均可使用。此外，它还涵盖实体映射：即网站在JSON-LD中声明的全局实体图谱，以及修复结构化数据身份问题，例如组织信息在每个页面中单独声明的情况。

name: rag-blueprint
description: NVIDIA RAG Blueprint — deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and manage. Handles any RAG action: deploy, install, start, enable, disable, toggle, change, configure, troubleshoot, debug, fix, shutdown, stop, or tear down any RAG feature or service (Agentic RAG, VLM, guardrails, query rewriting, models, search, ingestion, observability, summarization, reasoning, and more).
description_zh: NVIDIA RAG 蓝图 — 部署、配置、排错和管理。支持任何 RAG 操作：部署、安装、启动、启用、禁用、切换、更改、配置、排错、调试、修复、关闭、停止或拆除任何 RAG 功能或服务（包括自主式 RAG、视觉语言模型、安全防护机制、查询重写、模型、搜索、数据摄取、可观测性、摘要生成、推理等）。

name: slack-search
description: Guidance for effectively searching Slack to find messages, files, channels, and people
description_zh: 有效搜索 Slack 以查找消息、文件、频道和人员的指南

name: drawio
description: Always use when user asks to create, generate, draw, or design a diagram, flowchart, architecture diagram, ER diagram, sequence diagram, class diagram, network diagram, mockup, wireframe, or UI sketch, or mentions draw.io, drawio, drawoi, .drawio files, or diagram export to PNG/SVG/PDF.
description_zh: 始终在用户要求创建、生成、绘制或设计图表、流程图、架构图、ER图、时序图、类图、网络图、模型图、线框图或UI草图时使用，或者提及draw.io、drawio、drawoi或.drawio文件，或提到将图表导出为PNG/SVG/PDF。

name: sales-org-structure
description: Designs a sales organization's structure for its current stage - role mix (SDR, AE, AM/CS), topology (island, assembly line, pod, hybrid), SDR-to-AE ratio, hunter/farmer split, span of control, and specialization by segment. A macro org-design exercise for a VP Sales, CRO, or founder scaling past founder-led selling, covering B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions restructuring the sales team, pods vs assembly line, reps per manager, splitting SDRs from AEs, or hunters vs farmers, even without the words org structure. Do NOT use for hiring into the seats (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-hiring), choosing the motion (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-motion), or setting quotas (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting).
description_zh: 根据当前阶段设计销售组织架构——包括角色组合（SDR、AE、AM/CS）、拓扑结构（孤岛、流水线、小组、混合模式）、SDR 与 AE 的比例、开拓型/维护型比例、管理幅度，以及按细分市场的专业化分工。这是面向销售副总裁、首席营收官或正在实现从创始人主导销售向规模化扩张过渡的创始人的宏观组织架构设计任务，涵盖 B2B 和 B2C。只要用户提及重新组织销售团队、小组与流水线模式、每位经理管理的人员数量、将 SDR 与 AE 分离，或开拓型与维护型销售，即使未使用“组织架构”一词，也应使用此描述。请勿将其用于以下场景：填补岗位招聘（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-hiring）、选择销售模式（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-motion）或设定销售配额（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-quota-setting）。

name: claude-brainrot
description: Always-on autonomous meme dropper. A UserPromptSubmit hook fires every user message and tells Claude to drop multiple memes per response — 1-3 image+sound combos plus 1-5 sound-only fires, scaled to response length. Every answer carries brainrot. No invocation needed; loads and stays active automatically. The roast lands through the meme itself, never words. Self-contained skill — catalogue and assets live in this skill folder.

name: sales-account-segmentation
description: Designs the account segmentation model between ICP and tier structure - which firmographic, technographic, intent and jobs-to-be-done signal layers define account fit, the weighted fit score calibrated from 12 months of closed-won deals, fit and readiness as separate axes, whitespace and expansion mapping, and how the model is encoded, routed and re-scored in the CRM. Covers B2B account segmentation and B2C value-based customer segmentation. Use whenever the user mentions account scoring, fit score, whitespace, book-of-business carve-up, or reps picking accounts on gut feel, even without the word segmentation. Do NOT use for tier cutoffs and coverage (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-tiering) or ICP criteria (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-icp-definition).
description_zh: 设计ICP与层级结构之间的客户细分模型——哪些企业特征、技术特征、意向和待完成工作信号层定义了客户匹配度，从12个月已成交交易中校准的加权匹配分数，匹配度和准备度作为独立的维度，空白区域和扩展映射，以及该模型如何在CRM中编码、路由和重新评分。涵盖B2B客户细分和B2C基于价值的客户细分。每当用户提及客户评分、匹配分数、空白区域、业务组合划分或代表凭直觉选择客户时，即使没有提及“细分”一词，也使用该内容。不适用于层级划分和覆盖范围（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-account-tiering）或ICP标准（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-icp-definition）。

name: beautiful-article
description: 把用户提供的素材（网页 URL / PDF / DOCX / Markdown / 纯文本 / 截图 / 粘贴材料）编辑、设计成一篇美丽的、可离线打开和分享的**单文件 HTML 网页文章**。基于 reacticle 组件协议：不手写裸 HTML/CSS，而用语义组件 + 受主题约束的 Raw 自由层；按 source→规划→双确认→生成→终审→修复的小型 harness 流程推进，默认 100% 信息保留的长文。触发场景：把 URL/PDF/DOCX/文章做成网页文章 / 长文 / briefing / 解释文 / 视觉文章 / 教程 / 审阅复盘 / 方案分析，'render this as a beautiful web article / 把这篇做成网页文章 / 生成一篇可分享的 HTML 长文 / reacticle 文章'。只生成文章，不生成后台、表单、dashboard、产品原型或通用 Web App。
description_zh: 将用户提供的素材（网页 URL / PDF / DOCX / Markdown / 纯文本 / 截图 / 粘贴内容）编辑并设计成一篇精美、可离线打开和分享的**单文件 HTML 网页文章**。基于 reacticle 组件协议：不手写裸 HTML/CSS，而是使用语义化组件 + 受主题约束的 Raw 自由层；按 source→规划→双确认→生成→终审→修复的小型 harness 流程推进，默认生成 100% 信息保留的长文。触发场景：将 URL/PDF/DOCX/文章制作成网页文章 / 长文 / 简报 / 解释文 / 视觉文章 / 教程 / 审阅复盘 / 方案分析，例如“render this as a beautiful web article / 把这篇做成网页文章 / 生成一篇可分享的 HTML 长文 / reacticle 文章”。仅生成文章，不生成后台、表单、仪表盘、产品原型或通用 Web 应用。

name: unity-animation
description: Drive Unity 6.3 LTS character animation with Animator Controllers: states, transitions, parameters, blend trees, animation layers, and humanoid Avatar IK. Use when wiring an Animator, setting parameters from script (SetFloat/SetBool/SetTrigger), building blend trees, or when the user mentions Animator, Mecanim, state machine, blend tree, or .controller.
description_zh: 使用Animator控制器驱动Unity 6.3 LTS角色动画：状态、过渡、参数、混合树、动画层和类人Avatar IK。在连接Animator、从脚本设置参数（SetFloat/SetBool/SetTrigger）、构建混合树，或用户提及Animator、Mecanim、状态机、混合树或.controller时使用。

name: fsc-corporate-info
description: 금융위원회 기업기본정보(법인 개요)를 공공데이터포털 API(k-skill-proxy 경유)로 조회한다. 법인명으로 대표자·설립일·업종 등 법인 개요를 확인하고, 응답에 사업자번호가 있으면 입력 번호와 교차검증한다.
description_zh: 通过公共数据门户网站API（经由k-skill-proxy）查询金融委员会的企业基本信息（法人概况）。根据法人名称确认代表理事、成立日期、行业等法人概况，并在响应中包含营业者登记号时，对输入编号进行交叉验证。

name: pyrefly-type-coverage
description: Migrate a file to use stricter Pyrefly type checking with annotations required for all functions, classes, and attributes.
description_zh: 将文件迁移至使用更严格的 Pyrefly 类型检查，要求所有函数、类和属性都必须使用注解。

name: recovery-controller-setup
description: Configures AWS Application Recovery Controller (ARC) for operational resilience: routing controls with safety rules for cross-Region failover, and zonal shift / zonal autoshift for AZ-impairment recovery. Applies when setting up failover routing, configuring safety rules, enabling zonal shift, or configuring zonal autoshift with practice runs. Also applies when shifting traffic out of a specific Availability Zone (AZ) for an ALB/NLB or other resource. For a broader "an AZ is impaired, what is my response across services" question, see aws-resilience-lifecycle. Does not apply to Resilience Hub setup or FIS experiments.
description_zh: 配置 AWS 应用恢复控制器 (ARC) 以实现操作弹性：通过安全规则进行跨区域故障转移的路由控制，以及用于 AZ 损坏恢复的区域转换/区域自动转换。在设置故障转移路由、配置安全规则、启用区域转换或配置带演练的区域自动转换时适用。也适用于将流量从特定可用区 (AZ) 转移到 ALB/NLB 或其他资源的情况。对于更广泛的“一个 AZ 受损，我的跨服务响应是什么”的问题，请参阅 aws-resilience-lifecycle。不适用于 Resilience Hub 设置或 FIS 实验。

name: figma-create-new-file
description: Always use this skill when the user wants to create a new Figma Design, FigJam, or Slides file. You MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `create_new_file` tool call.
description_zh: 每当用户希望创建新的 Figma 设计、FigJam 或幻灯片文件时，请务必使用此技能。在每次调用 `create_new_file` 工具之前，都必须先调用此技能。

name: mantine-custom-components
description: Build custom components that integrate with Mantine's theming, Styles API, and core features. Use this skill when: (1) creating a new component using factory(), polymorphicFactory(), or genericFactory(), (2) adding Styles API support (classNames, styles, vars, unstyled), (3) implementing CSS variables via createVarsResolver, (4) building compound components with sub-components and shared context, (5) registering a component with MantineProvider via Component.extend(), or (6) any task involving Factory, useProps, useStyles, BoxProps, StylesApiProps, or ElementProps in @mantine/core.
description_zh: 构建与 Mantine 主题、样式 API 和核心功能集成的自定义组件。在以下情况下使用此技能：(1) 使用 factory()、polymorphicFactory() 或 genericFactory() 创建新组件时，(2) 添加样式 API 支持（classNames、styles、vars、unstyled），(3) 通过 createVarsResolver 实现 CSS 变量，(4) 构建具有子组件和共享上下文的复合组件，(5) 通过 Component.extend() 在 MantineProvider 中注册组件，或 (6) 任何涉及 @mantine/core 中的 Factory、useProps、useStyles、BoxProps、StylesApiProps 或 ElementProps 的任务。

name: antislop-code
description: Code comment hygiene for AI coding agents: remove generic AI-slop comments, keep the valuable ones, never touch the code.
description_zh: 为AI编程代理维护代码注释卫生：移除通用的AI杂乱注释，保留有价值的注释，绝不触碰代码。

name: g2b-sanctioned-supplier
description: 조달청 나라장터 부정당제재업체정보를 공공데이터포털 API(k-skill-proxy 경유)로 조회한다. 사업자등록번호 정확 일치로 조회시점 현재 유효한 입찰참가자격 제한(부정당제재)의 기간·제재기관·근거법률을 확인한다.
description_zh: 通过公共数据门户API（经k-skill-proxy中转）查询政府采购网不正当竞争处罚企业信息。以营业执照注册号精确匹配进行查询时，确认查询时点当前有效的投标参与资格限制（不正当竞争处罚）的期限、处罚机构及依据法律。

name: chatgpt-apps
description: Build, scaffold, refactor, and troubleshoot ChatGPT Apps SDK applications that combine an MCP server and widget UI. Use when Codex needs to design tools, register UI resources, wire the MCP Apps bridge or ChatGPT compatibility APIs, apply Apps SDK metadata or CSP or domain settings, or produce a docs-aligned project scaffold. Prefer a docs-first workflow by invoking the openai-docs skill or OpenAI developer docs MCP tools before generating code.
description_zh: 构建、搭建脚手架、重构和排错结合MCP服务器和组件UI的ChatGPT应用SDK。当Codex需要设计工具、注册UI资源、连接MCP应用桥或ChatGPT兼容API、应用应用SDK元数据或CSP或域设置，或生成与文档一致的工程脚手架时使用。优先通过调用openai-docs技能或OpenAI开发者文档MCP工具在生成代码前采用文档优先的工作流程。

name: reverse-shell-techniques
description: Reverse shell techniques playbook. Use when establishing remote shells including language one-liners, encrypted shells (OpenSSL/socat/ncat), web shells, PTY upgrades, file transfer methods, PowerShell shells, and Windows payload generation.
description_zh: 反向shell技术手册。用于建立远程shell，包括语言单行命令、加密shell（OpenSSL/socat/ncat）、web shell、PTY升级、文件传输方法、PowerShell shell以及Windows有效载荷生成。

name: observe-whatsapp
description: Observe and troubleshoot WhatsApp in Kapso: search Logs across API, Meta webhook, workflow, and webhook-delivery events; debug message delivery; inspect webhook retries; triage API errors; and run health checks. Use when investigating production issues, message failures, workflow behavior, or webhook delivery problems.
description_zh: 在 Kapso 中观察并排查 WhatsApp 相关问题：在 API、Meta webhook、工作流以及 webhook 投递事件等多个维度的日志中进行检索；调试消息投递流程；检查 webhook 重试情况；对 API 错误进行分类处理（分诊）；并执行健康检查。此功能适用于排查生产环境中的问题、消息发送失败、工作流行为异常或 webhook 投递故障。

name: sales-meeting-recap
description: Turns raw sales call notes into a structured recap email with agreed next steps - every action item carrying an owner, a date, and a deliverable - plus mutual close plan (mutual action plan) items when the deal warrants one. Restates the buyer's pain in their own words and never invents a commitment the notes don't contain. Covers complex B2B committee deals and transactional or B2C motions. Use whenever the user mentions a recap email, follow-up after a sales call, next steps email, post-call summary, or a mutual action plan, even without the word recap. Do NOT use for judging how the call went (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review).
description_zh: 将原始销售通话笔记转化为结构化的总结邮件，包含双方商定的后续步骤——每个行动项都明确负责人、截止日期和交付成果——并在交易需要时添加互惠关闭计划（互惠行动计划）项目。用买方自己的话重述其痛点，并确保不捏造笔记中未包含的承诺。涵盖复杂的B2B委员会交易和交易性或B2C动议。每当用户提及总结邮件、销售通话后的跟进、后续步骤邮件、通话后总结或互惠行动计划时，即使没有“总结”一词，也使用该功能。禁止用于评判通话情况（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review）。

name: compliance-check
description: Run a compliance check on a proposed action, product feature, or business initiative, surfacing applicable regulations, required approvals, and risk areas. Use when launching a feature that touches personal data, when marketing or product proposes something with regulatory implications, or when you need to know which approvals and jurisdictional requirements apply before proceeding.
description_zh: 对拟采取的行动、产品功能或业务举措执行合规性检查，识别适用的法规、所需审批及风险领域。在推出涉及个人数据的功能、营销或产品团队提出具有法规影响的事项，或在推进前需明确所需审批及司法辖区要求时，请使用此功能。

name: youtube-seo
description: When the user wants to optimize YouTube videos for search, create video descriptions, or improve channel visibility. Also use when the user mentions "YouTube SEO," "YouTube description," "YouTube tags," "YouTube thumbnail," "YouTube title," "YouTube channel," or "video SEO." For YouTube ads, use youtube-ads.

name: sales-objection-handling
description: Diagnoses what a sales objection really means and writes rebuttal scripts a rep can say out loud, or calls the deal dead when the objection is a real constraint. Covers price/budget, timing, competitor/incumbent, authority, status-quo, and trust objections for B2B and B2C, with price-specific guidance on value gap vs genuine budget limit and trading instead of discounting. Use whenever the user mentions a price objection, "too expensive", "not interested", "send me some info", "we already use a competitor", stalling, or an objection library, even without the word objection. Do NOT use for discount trade planning (mbfinotti/sales-skills@negotiation-concession-planner) or ROI math (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-value-calc).
description_zh: 诊断销售异议的真正含义，并撰写销售代表可以大声说出的反驳脚本，或在异议是真实限制时叫停交易。涵盖B2B和B2C的价格/预算、时间、竞争对手/现有供应商、权限、现状和信任异议，并提供针对价值差距与真实预算限制以及交易而非折扣的价格特定指导。每当用户提到价格异议，如“太贵了”、“不感兴趣”、“发我些资料”、“我们已经在用竞争对手”、“拖延”或异议库时（即使没有“异议”一词），均可使用。禁止用于折扣交易规划（mbfinotti/sales-skills@negotiation-concession-planner）或ROI计算（mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-value-calc）。

name: vibe-security
description: Audits codebases for common security vulnerabilities that AI coding assistants introduce in "vibe-coded" applications. Checks for exposed API keys, broken access control (Supabase RLS, Firebase rules), missing auth validation, client-side trust issues, insecure payment flows, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks about security, wants a code review, mentions "vibe coding", or when you're writing or reviewing code that handles authentication, payments, database access, API keys, secrets, or user data — even if they don't explicitly mention security. Also trigger when the user says things like "is this safe?", "check my code", "audit this", "review for vulnerabilities", or "can someone hack this?".
description_zh: 对代码库进行审计，以检测由AI编程助手在“氛围编码”应用程序中引入的常见安全漏洞。检查暴露的API密钥、损坏的访问控制（Supabase RLS、Firebase规则）、缺失的身份验证验证、客户端信任问题、不安全的支付流程等。每当用户询问关于安全、要求代码审查、提及“氛围编码”，或在编写或审查涉及身份验证、支付、数据库访问、API密钥、密钥或用户数据的代码时，请使用此技能——即使他们没有明确提及安全。此外，当用户说“这是安全的吗？”、“检查我的代码”、“审计这个”、“审查漏洞”或“有人能破解这个吗？”时也会触发。

name: twitter-reader
description: Fetches Twitter/X post and Article content — text, author, engagement metrics and embedded media — downloading images locally and generating complete Markdown with image references. Use when retrieving a tweet's text or an X Article with images, or pulling post metadata for a Markdown/PKM record. Preferred over Jina alone for X Articles with images.
description_zh: 获取 Twitter/X 帖子和文章的内容——包括文本、作者、互动指标以及嵌入的媒体——将图片下载到本地，并生成带有图片引用的完整 Markdown。当需要获取包含图片的推文文本或 X 文章，或为 Markdown/PKM 记录拉取帖子元数据时，请使用此功能。对于包含图片的 X 文章，优先于仅使用 Jina。

name: sentry-react-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for React. Use when asked to "add Sentry to React", "install @sentry/react", or configure error monitoring, tracing, session replay, profiling, or logging for React applications. Supports React 16+, React Router v5-v7 non-framework mode, TanStack Router, Redux, Vite, and webpack.
description_zh: React 的完整 Sentry SDK 配置。当被要求“为 React 添加 Sentry”、“安装 @sentry/react”或为 React 应用配置错误监控、跟踪、会话回放、性能分析或日志记录时使用。支持 React 16+、React Router v5-v7 非框架模式、TanStack Router、Redux、Vite 和 webpack。

name: negotiation-concession-planner
description: Builds a pre-negotiation concession plan for a pricing or contract conversation - every tradeable lever priced by cost-to-us vs value-to-them, tiered, each give paired with a required reciprocal get and its approval level, plus a BATNA-based walk-away. Covers B2B (terms, scope, service, risk, price protection) and B2C (bundles, financing, trade allowance). Use whenever the user mentions a discount request, procurement, redlines, give-get trades, walk-away point, or "the buyer wants 20% off", even without the word negotiation. Do NOT use for quantifying the value (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-value-calc) or scripting price rebuttals (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling).
description_zh: 构建针对定价或合同谈判的预协商让步方案——每个可交易杠杆均按成本对己方与价值对对方定价，分层级，每项给予均需配以必要的互惠获取及其批准级别，并附基于BATNA的退出策略。涵盖B2B（条款、范围、服务、风险、价格保护）和B2C（捆绑销售、融资、交易让步）。每当用户提及折扣请求、采购、红线条款、给取交易、退出点，或“买方要求20%折扣”，即使未提及“谈判”字样时，均需使用。禁止用于量化价值（mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-value-calc）或编写价格反驳脚本（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling）。

name: effect-ts
description: Use for nontrivial Effect 3 work including services/layers, typed errors, Schema/JSONSchema, Config, runtime/concurrency, @effect/vitest, @effect/ai, @effect/sql, Effect Atom, or @prb/effect-next.
description_zh: 用于非平凡的 Effect 3 工作，包括服务/层、类型错误、Schema/JSONSchema、配置、运行时/并发、@effect/vitest、@effect/ai、@effect/sql、Effect 原子或 @prb/effect-next。

name: cold-email-deliverability
description: Reviews a cold email draft and its sending setup for deliverability - SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment, sender reputation and complaint risk, body mechanics (length, links, images, tracking pixels, HTML vs plain text, opt-out), and legal compliance by region. Covers B2B cold outbound and B2C bulk/lifecycle mail. Use whenever the user mentions the spam folder, blacklisting, domain warmup, inbox placement, bounce rates, DMARC, or "why are my emails not landing", even without the word deliverability. Do NOT use for subject lines (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester) or cadence (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence). Hygiene and compliance only, never spam-filter evasion.
description_zh: 审查冷邮件草稿及其发送设置，以确保可投递性——包括SPF/DKIM/DMARC一致性、发件人声誉和投诉风险、邮件内容结构（长度、链接、图片、追踪像素、HTML与纯文本、退订选项），以及各地区的法律合规性。涵盖B2B冷外发和B2C批量/生命周期邮件。当用户提及垃圾邮件文件夹、被列入黑名单、域名预热、收件箱送达率、DMARC，或“我的邮件为何无法送达”时，即使未提及“可投递性”，也适用此功能。请勿用于主题行（mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-subject-line-tester）或发送频率（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence）。仅进行卫生检查和合规性审核，绝不用于规避垃圾邮件过滤器。

name: triaging-issues
description: Triages GitHub issues by routing to oncall teams, applying labels, and closing questions. Use when processing new PyTorch issues or when asked to triage an issue.
description_zh: 按路由至值班团队、应用标签和关闭问题来分诊 GitHub 问题。在处理新的 PyTorch 问题或被要求分诊问题时使用。

name: sector-analyst
description: This skill should be used when analyzing sector and industry performance charts to assess market positioning and rotation patterns. Use this skill when the user provides performance chart images (1-week or 1-month timeframes) for sectors or industries and requests market cycle assessment, sector rotation analysis, or strategic positioning recommendations based on performance data. All analysis and output are conducted in English.
description_zh: 此技能应在分析行业和产业表现图表时使用，以评估市场定位和轮动模式。当用户提供行业或产业的性能图表图像（1周或1个月的时间范围）并请求基于性能数据的市场周期评估、行业轮动分析或战略定位建议时，应使用此技能。所有分析和输出均以英语进行。

name: hatch-pet
description: Create, repair, validate, visually QA, and package Codex-compatible animated pets and pet spritesheets from character art, generated images, company or prospect brand cues, or visual references. Use when a user wants a lightweight-worker Codex pet workflow, a non-pixel custom pet style, a prospect or company mascot pet, or a full 8x9 animated pet atlas with transparent unused cells, QA contact sheets, and pet.json packaging. This skill composes the installed $imagegen system skill for visual generation and uses bundled scripts for deterministic spritesheet assembly.
description_zh: 创建、修复、验证、可视化质量保证（QA）和打包与Codex兼容的动画宠物及宠物精灵图集，可从角色艺术、生成图像、公司或潜在品牌提示或视觉参考中获取。当用户需要轻量级工作流程的Codex宠物、非像素自定义宠物风格、潜在公司吉祥物宠物，或包含透明未使用单元格、QA接触图和宠物.json打包的完整8x9动画宠物图集时使用。此技能组合了安装的$imagegen系统技能用于视觉生成，并使用捆绑脚本进行确定性精灵图集组装。

name: web-content-fetcher
description: Extract article content from any URL as clean Markdown. Uses Scrapling script as primary method (with auto fast→stealth fallback), Jina Reader as alternative for simple pages. Preserves headings, links, images, lists, and code blocks. Use this skill whenever the user wants to fetch, read, extract, scrape, or summarize content from a URL — including blog posts, news articles, WeChat articles (微信公众号), documentation pages, or any web page. Also trigger when the user says things like "帮我读一下这篇文章", "抓取这个网页", "提取正文", or "read this page for me".

name: aoti-debug
description: Debug AOTInductor (AOTI) errors and crashes. Use when encountering AOTI segfaults, device mismatch errors, constant loading failures, or runtime errors from aot_compile, aot_load, aoti_compile_and_package, or aoti_load_package.
description_zh: 调试 AOTInductor (AOTI) 错误和崩溃。在遇到 AOTI 段错误、设备不匹配错误、常量加载失败，或来自 aot_compile、aot_load、aoti_compile_and_package 或 aoti_load_package 的运行时错误时使用。

name: understand-diff
description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks
description_zh: 当您需要分析 git 差异或拉取请求，以了解发生了什么更改、受影响的组件以及风险时使用。

name: stanley-druckenmiller-investment
description: スタンレー・ドラッケンミラーの投資哲学と戦略に基づいた投資アドバイスを提供。30年間無敗、年率30%近いリターンを達成した伝説的投資家の思考法を活用し、マクロ経済分析、リスク管理、ポジション構築、市場サイクルの読み方などについて実践的な指導を行う。投資判断、市場分析、リスク管理、ポートフォリオ構築などの相談時に使用。
description_zh: 基于斯坦利·德拉肯米勒的投资哲学和策略，提供投资建议。运用这位30年不败、实现年化30%高回报的传奇投资家的思维方法，进行宏观经济分析、风险管理、头寸构建、市场周期解读等方面的实用指导。适用于投资决策、市场分析、风险管理、投资组合构建等方面的咨询。

name: cold-call-opener
description: Writes the opening 5-30 seconds of a live outbound cold call - a tailored opener for a named persona and pain point, with 2-3 testable variants, delivery notes, and a measurement plan. Covers B2B and B2C phone outreach, including do-not-call scrubbing. Use whenever the user mentions a cold call opener, cold call script, phone opener, dialer talk track, "what do I say when they pick up", or opening a call for a persona, even if they don't say "opener" explicitly. Do NOT use for rebuttals later in the call (use mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling), grading a recorded call (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review), or cadence planning (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence).
description_zh: 撰写一个电话外呼冷启动的前5-30秒内容——针对特定角色和痛点量身定制的开场白，包含2-3个可测试的变体、交付说明和衡量计划。涵盖B2B和B2C电话外联，包括“不拨打”名单清理。当用户提及冷启动开场白、冷启动脚本、电话开场白、拨号器语音脚本、“他们接听时我该说什么”或为特定角色开启通话时，即使他们没有明确说“开场白”，也请使用。不应用于通话后期的反驳（使用mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling）、录制通话的评分（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review）或节奏规划（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence）。

name: social-publishing
description: Schedule and publish social media posts across 13 platforms (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook Pages, TikTok, Discord, Telegram, YouTube, Reddit, WordPress, Pinterest) via the SocialClaw API. Use when the user wants to publish, schedule, or manage social media content programmatically. Requires SOCIALCLAW_API_KEY.
description_zh: 通过 SocialClaw API 在 13 个平台（X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook Pages、TikTok、Discord、Telegram、YouTube、Reddit、WordPress、Pinterest）上安排和发布社交媒体帖子。当用户希望以编程方式发布、安排或管理社交媒体内容时使用。需要 SOCIALCLAW_API_KEY。

name: principle-boundary-discipline
description: Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs); trust internal types and keep business logic in pure functions.
description_zh: 在布线验证、错误处理或框架适配器时使用。将守卫集中在系统边界（CLI、配置、网络、外部API）；信任内部类型，并将业务逻辑保留在纯函数中。

name: activitykit
description: Implement, review, or improve Live Activities and Dynamic Island experiences in iOS apps using ActivityKit. Use when building real-time updating widgets for the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island — delivery tracking, sports scores, ride-sharing status, workout timers, media playback, or any time-sensitive information that updates in real time. Also use when working with ActivityKit, ActivityAttributes, Activity lifecycle (request/update/end), Dynamic Island layouts (compact/minimal/expanded), push-to-update Live Activities, or Lock Screen live widgets.
description_zh: 使用 ActivityKit 在 iOS 应用中实现、审查或改进 Live Activities 和 Dynamic Island 体验。适用于构建用于主屏幕和 Dynamic Island 的实时更新小部件，例如物流跟踪、体育比分、拼车状态、锻炼计时器、媒体播放或任何实时更新的时间敏感信息。也适用于使用 ActivityKit、ActivityAttributes、Activity 生命周期（请求/更新/结束）、Dynamic Island 布局（紧凑型/极简型/扩展型）、推送更新 Live Activities 或主屏幕实时小部件。

name: deal-red-flags
description: Reviews one deal's free-text notes - call notes, opportunity fields, CRM activity log, email threads - for qualification red flags such as single-threaded deal, no champion, no compelling event, unverified budget, no agreed next step, or fading engagement, each graded on severity and confidence with the quoted note fragment behind it. Covers B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user mentions deal risk, a stalled or slipping deal, ghosting, forecast inspection, or "is this deal real", even without the words red flag. Reviews one deal, not a pipeline export. Do NOT use for structured qualification scoring (mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard) or stakeholder mapping (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-champion-mapping).
description_zh: 审查单个交易的自由文本笔记——电话记录、机会领域、CRM活动日志、电子邮件线程——以识别资格问题红旗，例如单线程交易、无关键人物、无重大事件、未验证的预算、无约定的下一步行动或参与度下降，每个问题都根据严重程度和置信度进行评分，并在引用的笔记片段后显示。涵盖B2B和B2C。当用户提及交易风险、停滞不前或下滑的交易、幽灵客户、预测检查或“这笔交易是否真实”，即使没有“红旗”字眼，也请使用。审查单个交易，而不是管道导出。不要用于结构化的资格评分（mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard）或利益相关者映射（mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-champion-mapping）。

name: logo-creator
description: Create logos using AI image generation. Discuss style/ratio, generate variations, iterate with user feedback, crop, remove background, and export as SVG. Use when user wants to create a logo, icon, favicon, brand mark, mascot, emblem, or design a logo.
