description_zh: 使用 AI 图像生成技术创建标志。讨论风格和比例，生成多种变体，并根据用户反馈进行迭代，然后进行裁剪、去除背景，并以 SVG 格式导出。当用户希望创建标志、图标、浏览器图标（favicon）、品牌标识、吉祥物、徽章，或设计标志时，使用此流程。

name: m01-ownership
description: CRITICAL: Use for ownership/borrow/lifetime issues. Triggers: E0382, E0597, E0506, E0507, E0515, E0716, E0106, value moved, borrowed value does not live long enough, cannot move out of, use of moved value, ownership, borrow, lifetime, 'a, 'static, move, clone, Copy, 所有权, 借用, 生命周期
description_zh: 关键：用于所有权/借用/生命周期问题。触发：E0382、E0597、E0506、E0507、E0515、E0716、E0106、值已移动、借用值生命周期不足、无法移动、移动值的引用、所有权、借用、生命周期、'a、'static、移动、克隆、Copy、所有权、借用、生命周期。

name: react-three-fiber
description: Build declarative 3D scenes with React Three Fiber (R3F) - a React renderer for Three.js. Use when building interactive 3D experiences in React applications with component-based architecture, state management, and reusable abstractions. Ideal for product configurators, portfolios, games, data visualization, and immersive web experiences.
description_zh: 使用 React Three Fiber (R3F) 构建声明式 3D 场景——这是一个用于 Three.js 的 React 渲染器。适用于在具有组件化架构、状态管理和可重用抽象的 React 应用程序中构建交互式 3D 体验。非常适合产品配置器、作品集、游戏、数据可视化和沉浸式网络体验。

name: streamdown
description: Implement, configure, and customize Streamdown — a streaming-optimized React Markdown renderer with syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, math rendering, and CJK support. Use when working with Streamdown setup, configuration, plugins, styling, security, or integration with AI streaming (e.g., Vercel AI SDK). Triggers on: (1) Installing or setting up Streamdown, (2) Configuring plugins (code, mermaid, math, cjk), (3) Styling or theming Streamdown output, (4) Integrating with AI chat/streaming, (5) Configuring security, link safety, or custom HTML tags, (6) Using carets, static mode, or custom components, (7) Troubleshooting Tailwind, Shiki, or Vite issues.
description_zh: 实现、配置和定制 Streamdown——一个针对流媒体优化的 React Markdown 渲染器，支持语法高亮、Mermaid 图表、数学公式渲染以及 CJK 语言支持。适用于处理 Streamdown 的设置、配置、插件、样式、安全或与 AI 流媒体（例如 Vercel AI SDK）集成。触发条件： (1) 安装或设置 Streamdown，(2) 配置插件（代码、Mermaid、数学、CJK），(3) 样式化或主题化 Streamdown 输出，(4) 与 AI 聊天/流媒体集成，(5) 配置安全、链接安全或自定义 HTML 标签，(6) 使用下划线、静态模式或自定义组件，(7) 排查 Tailwind、Shiki 或 Vite 问题。

name: bencium-code-conventions
description: Bence's code style, tech stack, and workflow conventions
description_zh: Bence的代码风格、技术栈和工作流规范

name: db-generate
description: Generate database migrations for a Medusa module
description_zh: 为 Medusa 模块生成数据库迁移

name: managed-airflow-migrations
description: Provides guidance for migrating Apache Airflow DAGs in Managed Service for Apache Airflow (MSAA; formerly Cloud Composer). Covers migration to Airflow 2.11.1 (MSAA Gen 2 and 3) and Airflow 3 (MSAA Gen 3), including environment inspection, GCS download/upload and scanning patterns for breaking changes. Use when migrating the DAG code to newer Airflow version. Don't use when checking DAG run failures unrelated to code migration.
description_zh: 为迁移 Apache Airflow DAGs 到 Managed Service for Apache Airflow (MSAA；曾用名 Cloud Composer) 提供指导。涵盖迁移至 Airflow 2.11.1 (MSAA 第 2 代和第 3 代) 以及 Airflow 3 (MSAA 第 3 代) 的内容，包括环境检查、GCS 下载/上传以及破坏性变更的扫描模式。在将 DAG 代码迁移到较新版本的 Airflow 时使用。在检查与代码迁移无关的 DAG 运行失败时不要使用。

name: earnings-preview
description: Build a pre-earnings briefing for a stock from Yahoo Finance data (yfinance): the upcoming report date and timing, consensus EPS and revenue estimates with their range, the beat/miss track record, analyst ratings and price targets, and what to watch in the print. Use this skill whenever the user is preparing for an upcoming earnings report or asks what the street expects — consensus or whisper numbers, EPS expectations, whether a company will beat, an earnings setup, or an earnings-season preview — and whenever a ticker comes up in the context of upcoming earnings, even without the word "preview". For results that are already out, use earnings-recap.
description_zh: 构建一份来自Yahoo Finance数据（yfinance）的股票盈利前简报：即将发布的报告日期和时间、市场一致预期的每股收益和收入预估及其范围、超越/未达预期的历史记录、分析师评级和目标价，以及印刷版中需要关注的要点。当用户准备即将到来的盈利报告或询问市场预期——市场一致预期或小道消息、每股收益预期、公司是否会超越预期、盈利格局或盈利季前瞻——时，以及每当在即将到来的盈利背景下出现股票代码，即使没有“前瞻”一词，也使用此技能。对于已经公布的结果，使用盈利回顾。

name: deal-champion-mapping
description: Builds an evidence-graded stakeholder map for one active deal from titles, call notes, email and meeting activity, and CRM contact roles, naming the likely champion, economic buyer, and blockers, each with a confidence level tied to observed behaviour rather than title. Covers B2B buying committees and high-consideration B2C households. Use whenever the user mentions a champion, economic buyer, power map, deal org chart, multi-threading, single-threaded risk, or "who actually decides", even without the word stakeholder. Do NOT use for qualification scoring (mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard) or scanning notes for general risk (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags).
description_zh: 构建一个基于证据评估的利益相关者地图，针对一个活跃交易，从标题、通话记录、电子邮件和会议活动以及CRM联系人角色中构建，并命名可能的倡导者、经济购买者和阻碍者，每个都有与观察到的行为相关的信心水平，而不是基于头衔。涵盖B2B购买委员会和高考虑B2C家庭。每当用户提到倡导者、经济购买者、权力地图、交易组织结构图、多线程、单线程风险或“谁实际决定”，即使没有“利益相关者”这个词，也使用。不要用于资格评分（mbfinotti/sales-skills@meddpicc-scorecard）或扫描笔记以进行一般风险扫描（mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags）。

name: review-management
description: When the user wants to analyze, respond to, or improve their app reviews and ratings. Also use when the user mentions "reviews", "ratings", "negative reviews", "how to get more reviews", "review response", or "my rating is dropping". For broader ASO audit, see aso-audit. For retention issues causing bad reviews, see retention-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户想要分析、回应或改进他们的应用评论和评分时使用。也用于用户提到“评论”、“评分”、“负面评论”、“如何获得更多评论”、“评论回应”或“我的评分正在下降”时。进行更广泛的ASO审核，请参考aso-audit。因留存问题导致差评，请参考retention-optimization。

name: adaptive-communication
description: Use when detecting ambiguous user intent, hedging language, open-ended framing, personal context before requests, or when unsure whether user wants exploration vs direct answer. Applies to all conversations.
description_zh: 在检测到用户意图模糊、使用委婉语言、开放式措辞、请求前的个人背景信息，或不确定用户是想探索还是直接获取答案时使用。适用于所有对话。

name: figma-code-connect
description: Creates and maintains Figma Code Connect template files that map Figma components to code snippets. Use when the user mentions Code Connect, Figma component mapping, design-to-code translation, or asks to create/update .figma.ts or .figma.js files.
description_zh: 创建和维护 Figma Code Connect 模板文件，用于将 Figma 组件映射到代码片段。当用户提及 Code Connect、Figma 组件映射、设计到代码的转换，或要求创建/更新 .figma.ts 或 .figma.js 文件时使用。

name: phaser-core
description: Set up and debug a Phaser 4 game: the Game config, the Scene lifecycle (init/preload/create/update), the asset loader, cameras, and cross-scene communication. Use when building or debugging a Phaser game — when the user mentions Phaser, Phaser.Game, Phaser.Scene, preload/create/update, this.load, this.add, or scene transitions. For Arcade Physics movement/collisions use phaser-arcade-physics.
description_zh: 设置和调试 Phaser 4 游戏：游戏配置、场景生命周期（初始化/预加载/创建/更新）、资源加载器、摄像机和跨场景通信。在构建或调试 Phaser 游戏时使用——当用户提到 Phaser、Phaser.Game、Phaser.Scene、预加载/创建/更新、this.load、this.add 或场景转换时。对于 Arcade 物理运动/碰撞，请使用 phaser-arcade-physics。

name: aws-step-functions
description: Authors and edits AWS Step Functions state machines: writes Amazon States Language (ASL) in JSONata, and chooses and structures state types (Task, Choice, Map, Parallel, Pass, Wait, Succeed, Fail). Covers ASL syntax, JSONata data transformation and variables, Retry/Catch error handling, service integrations (.sync, waitForTaskToken callbacks), Distributed Map for large-scale S3/CSV processing, saga/compensation patterns, Standard vs Express workflow choice, TestState API unit testing, and migrating state machines from JSONPath to JSONata. Use when the user is building, authoring, debugging, or migrating a Step Functions state machine or ASL definition, or orchestrating multi-step workflows with branching, retries, or human-approval callbacks, even if they don't say 'Step Functions.' Do NOT use for general Lambda function code, API Gateway, EventBridge wiring, or SAM/CDK application packaging.
description_zh: 作者和编辑 AWS Step Functions 状态机：使用 JSONata 编写 Amazon States Language (ASL)，并选择和结构化状态类型（任务、选择、映射、并行、传递、等待、成功、失败）。涵盖 ASL 语法、JSONata 数据转换和变量、重试/捕获错误处理、服务集成（.sync、waitForTaskToken 回调）、分布式映射用于大规模 S3/CSV 处理、Saga/补偿模式、标准与快速工作流选择、TestState API 单元测试，以及从 JSONPath 迁移状态机到 JSONata。当用户正在构建、编写、调试或迁移 Step Functions 状态机或 ASL 定义，或编排具有分支、重试或人工审批回调的多步骤工作流时使用，即使他们没有提及“Step Functions”。不适用于一般 Lambda 函数代码、API Gateway、EventBridge 接线或 SAM/CDK 应用程序打包。

name: ui-ux-designer
description: Create interface designs, wireframes, and design systems. Masters user research, accessibility standards, and modern design tools.
description_zh: 创建界面设计、线框图和设计系统。精通用户研究、无障碍标准以及现代设计工具。

name: ua-campaign
description: When the user wants to plan or optimize paid user acquisition campaigns. Also use when the user mentions "Apple Search Ads", "user acquisition", "paid ads", "UA", "ad campaign", "install campaign", "Facebook ads for apps", "TikTok ads", or "cost per install". For organic growth, see aso-audit. For launch-specific UA, see app-launch.
description_zh: 当用户想要规划或优化付费用户获取活动时使用。同时，当用户提到“Apple Search Ads”、“用户获取”、“付费广告”、“UA”、“广告活动”、“安装活动”、“Facebook应用广告”、“TikTok广告”或“每安装成本”时也使用。对于自然增长，请参考aso-audit。对于特定于发布的UA，请参考app-launch。

name: cloudkit
description: Implement, review, or improve CloudKit and iCloud sync in iOS/macOS apps. Use when working with CKContainer, CKRecord, CKQuery, CKSubscription, CKSyncEngine, CKShare, NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore, or iCloud Drive file coordination; when syncing SwiftData models via ModelConfiguration with cloudKitDatabase; when handling CKError codes for conflict resolution, network failures, or quota limits; or when checking iCloud account status before performing sync operations.
description_zh: 实现、审查或改进 iOS/macOS 应用中的 CloudKit 和 iCloud 同步。在以下情况下使用：与 CKContainer、CKRecord、CKQuery、CKSubscription、CKSyncEngine、CKShare、NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore 或 iCloud Drive 文件协调配合使用；通过 ModelConfiguration 使用 cloudKitDatabase 同步 SwiftData 模型；处理冲突解决、网络故障或配额限制的 CKError 代码；或在执行同步操作前检查 iCloud 账户状态。

name: ads-attribution
description: Audit cross-platform attribution, conversion definitions, reporting windows, GA4, AdServices and AdAttributionKit, MMPs, browser and server events, offline conversions, and platform reconciliation. Use for attribution audit, attribution models, conversion windows, requests to add or total Meta and Google conversions, incompatible reporting-window aggregation, GA4 attribution, MMP review, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Singular, or cross-platform discrepancies.
description_zh: 审计跨平台归因、转化定义、报告窗口、GA4、AdServices和AdAttributionKit、MMPs、浏览器和服务器事件、离线转化以及平台对账。用于归因审计、归因模型、转化窗口、添加或总计Meta和Google转化请求、不兼容报告窗口聚合、GA4归因、MMP审核、AppsFlyer、Adjust、Branch、Singular或跨平台差异。

name: meddpicc-scorecard
description: Scores one deal against the eight MEDDPICC elements on an evidence ladder - unknown, assumed, stated, validated - with a scorecard, a verdict band, and the single next action that closes the biggest gap. Full MEDDPICC for complex deals, a lightweight subset for small ones, covering B2B and considered high-ticket B2C. Use whenever the user mentions MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, BANT, deal qualification, "score this opportunity", "is this deal real", or deal-review prep, even without naming a framework. Do NOT use for stakeholder mapping (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-champion-mapping), note-level risk scanning (mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags), or transcript grading (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review).
description_zh: 针对八个MEDDPICC要素在证据阶梯上进行评分 - 未知、假设、陈述、验证 - 使用评分卡、裁决区间，并确定单个后续行动以弥补最大差距。适用于复杂交易的完整MEDDPICC，小型交易则采用轻量级子集，涵盖B2B和高端B2C业务。在用户提及MEDDPICC、MEDDIC、BANT、交易资格认定、"评估此机会"、"此交易是否真实"或交易复盘准备时使用，即使未明确提及框架。禁止用于利益相关者映射（mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-champion-mapping）、笔记级风险扫描（mbfinotti/sales-skills@deal-red-flags）或通话记录评分（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-call-review）。

name: cold-email-subject-line-tester
description: Generates, scores, and split-tests email subject lines, producing angle-distinct variants, a numeric scorecard, and a test plan with sample size and decision metric. Covers B2B cold outbound and B2C lifecycle/promotional email, and flags spam-trigger words inside the subject line only. Use whenever the user mentions a subject line, open rates, email A/B test, preview text, or "nobody opens my emails", even if they don't say "subject line" explicitly. Do NOT use for body copy or inbox-placement audits (mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-deliverability), personalization angles (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outreach-personalization), or cadence design (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence).
description_zh: 生成、评分和拆分测试电子邮件主题行，生成角度差异化的变体、数值评分卡以及包含样本量和决策指标的测试计划。涵盖B2B冷呼和B2C生命周期/促销电子邮件，并仅标记主题行中的垃圾邮件触发词。每当用户提及主题行、打开率、电子邮件A/B测试、预览文本或“没人打开我的邮件”时，即使他们没有明确说“主题行”，也请使用。禁止用于正文文案或收件箱放置审核（mbfinotti/sales-skills@cold-email-deliverability）、个性化角度（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outreach-personalization）或节奏设计（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-outbound-sequence）。

name: apple-hig
description: Apple Human Interface Guidelines as 14 agent skills covering platforms, foundations, components, patterns, inputs, and technologies for iOS, macOS, visionOS, watchOS, and tvOS.
description_zh: 苹果人机界面指南涵盖14项代理技能，涉及平台、基础、组件、模式、输入和技术，适用于iOS、macOS、visionOS、watchOS和tvOS。

name: create-react-native-library
description: Scaffolds React Native libraries with create-react-native-library for standalone libraries or local native modules and views. Use when creating or working on React Native libraries or adding native functionality in an existing app.
description_zh: 使用 create-react-native-library 为独立库或本地原生模块和视图搭建脚手架。在创建或处理 React Native 库，或在现有应用中添加原生功能时使用。

name: deal-value-calc
description: Builds the ROI and business case for one deal - value drivers, full investment, ROI, payback, three cases conservative-first, and a one-page case the champion can forward. The buyer supplies every assumption, each number labeled buyer-supplied, benchmark, or rep-assumed, and none invented. Covers B2B and high-ticket B2C. Use whenever the user mentions ROI, business case, payback period, TCO, cost of doing nothing, "justify the price", or CFO sign-off, even without the word value. Do NOT use for price rebuttals (mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling) or discount trade planning (mbfinotti/sales-skills@negotiation-concession-planner).
description_zh: 构建单个交易的ROI和商业案例——价值驱动因素、总投资额、ROI、回收期，包含三种保守优先案例，以及一份一页纸的案例供主要推动者转发。买方提供所有假设，每个数字均标注为买方提供、基准或代表假设，且不凭空捏造。涵盖B2B和高价B2C业务。每当用户提及ROI、商业案例、回收期、TCO、不采取行动的成本、“证明价格合理性”或CFO批准，即使未出现“价值”一词时，均可使用。禁止用于价格反驳（mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-objection-handling）或折扣交易规划（mbfinotti/sales-skills@negotiation-concession-planner）。

name: national-pension-workplace
description: 국민연금공단 국민연금 가입 사업장 내역을 공공데이터포털 API(k-skill-proxy 경유)로 조회한다. 사업장명으로 가입자수·당월 고지금액·월별 취득/상실 추이를 확인해 그 회사의 직원 규모와 변화를 본다.
description_zh: 通过国民年金公团国民年金加入企业信息，利用公共数据门户API（经k-skill-proxy中转）进行查询。根据企业名称，确认参保人数、当月应缴金额以及月度获得/丧失趋势，以此分析该企业的员工规模和变化情况。

name: feynman-perspective
description:
理查德·费曼的思维框架与表达方式。基于40+个一手来源的深度调研，
提炼5个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用费曼的视角分析问题、审视决策、提供反馈。
当用户提到「用费曼的视角」「费曼会怎么看」「费曼模式」「feynman perspective」「费曼学习法」时使用。
即使用户只是说「这是不是cargo cult」「命名不等于理解」「能不能做个演示替代论证」「我真的理解了还是只记住了名字」也可触发。
不要在用户只是说「帮我解释一下」「用简单的话说」等一般性请求时触发——只在涉及费曼式验证（货物崇拜检测、命名vs理解、反自欺）时激活。

name: m04-zero-cost
description: CRITICAL: Use for generics, traits, zero-cost abstraction. Triggers: E0277, E0308, E0599, generic, trait, impl, dyn, where, monomorphization, static dispatch, dynamic dispatch, impl Trait, trait bound not satisfied, 泛型, 特征, 零成本抽象, 单态化
description_zh: 关键：用于泛型、特征、零成本抽象。触发条件：E0277、E0308、E0599、泛型、特征、impl、dyn、where、单态化、静态分发、动态分发、impl Trait、特征约束不满足

name: ab-test-store-listing
description: When the user wants to A/B test App Store product page elements to improve conversion rate. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test", "product page optimization", "test my screenshots", "test my icon", "conversion rate optimization", "CPP", or "custom product pages". For screenshot design, see screenshot-optimization. For metadata optimization, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户想要对 App Store 产品页面元素进行 A/B 测试以提高转化率时，也适用于用户提到“A/B 测试”、“产品页面优化”、“测试我的截图”、“测试我的图标”、“转化率优化”、“CPP”或“自定义产品页面”。关于截图设计，请参阅 screenshot-optimization。关于元数据优化，请参阅 metadata-optimization。

name: earnings-recap
description: Analyze a company's most recent (or a specified past) earnings report from Yahoo Finance data (yfinance): actual vs estimated EPS, surprise size, revenue and margin trends, and the stock's price reaction. Use this skill whenever the user asks how earnings went — beat or miss, earnings surprise, quarterly results, the post-earnings move, or an earnings call recap — including casual references to a past report such as "AMZN reported last night" or "how did they do". For an upcoming report, use earnings-preview.
description_zh: 分析公司最新的（或指定的过去）盈利报告，使用Yahoo Finance数据（yfinance）：实际与预估的每股收益（EPS）对比、盈利惊喜幅度、营收和利润率趋势，以及股票价格反应。当用户询问盈利情况时——无论是超出预期还是未达预期、盈利惊喜、季度结果、盈利发布后的股价变动，还是盈利电话会议回顾——包括对过去报告的随意提及，如“AMZN昨晚发布了报告”或“他们表现如何”，都可以使用这项技能。对于即将发布的报告，使用盈利预览（earnings-preview）。

name: ce-resolve-pr-feedback
description: Resolve PR review feedback. Use when addressing feedback already left on a PR. Not for reviewing the code before feedback exists; that is ce-code-review.
description_zh: 处理 PR 评审反馈。适用于响应已提交至 PR 的评审意见。不用于在反馈产生前对代码进行评审；该任务应由 ce-code-review 负责。

name: campaign-plan
description: Generate a full campaign brief with objectives, audience, messaging, channel strategy, content calendar, and success metrics. Use when planning a product launch, lead-gen push, or awareness campaign, when you need a week-by-week content calendar with dependencies, or when translating a marketing goal into a structured, executable plan.
description_zh: 生成一份完整的活动简报，包括目标、受众、信息传递、渠道策略、内容日历和成功指标。在规划产品发布、潜在客户生成推广或意识活动时使用，当你需要一个按周划分、包含依赖关系的内容日历时使用，或当你需要将营销目标转化为结构化、可执行的计划时使用。

name: renaissance-architecture
description: Software architecture and UI/UX principles for building genuinely new solutions, not derivative work. Use when designing features, architecting software, brainstorming apps, reviewing designs, or during strategy discussions. Focuses on first-principles thinking, simplicity where it matters, and creating rather than commenting.
description_zh: 构建真正新颖的解决方案的软件架构和 UI/UX 原则，而非衍生作品。在设计功能、架构软件、构思应用、评审设计或进行战略讨论时使用。强调基于第一性原理的思考、在关键处追求简洁，以及重在创造而非评论。

name: localdata-business-status
description: 지방행정 인허가데이터(LOCALDATA)로 동네 사업장(식당·카페·숙박·약국·미용실·학원 등 인허가 업종 208종)의 영업/휴업/폐업 상태, 인허가일자(업력), 폐업일자, 업태, 주소를 조회한다. 상호+시군구로 검색하며 인증키 불필요.
description_zh: 使用地方行政许可数据（LOCALDATA），查询社区内各类型经营场所（包括餐馆、咖啡馆、住宿、药店、美容院、学校等208种许可行业）的营业/停业/歇业状态、许可日期（营业年限）、歇业日期、行业类型、地址。可通过商户名称+市辖区查询，无需认证密钥。

name: xiaohongshu-note-analyzer
description: 全面分析小红书笔记的内容质量、关键词优化、标题吸引力、敏感内容风险、商业化程度、互动潜力等。适用于发布前审核、内容优化建议、提升笔记曝光率。触发词包括"分析小红书笔记"、"小红书内容审核"、"笔记优化"、"XHS分析"，或上传小红书笔记内容请求分析。
description_zh: 全面分析小红书笔记的内容质量、关键词优化、标题吸引力、敏感内容风险、商业化程度、互动潜力等。适用于发布前审核、内容优化建议、提升笔记曝光率。触发词包括"分析小红书笔记"、"小红书内容审核"、"笔记优化"、"XHS分析"，或上传小红书笔记内容请求分析。

name: generative-ui
description: Design system and templates for Claude's built-in generative UI — the show_widget tool that renders interactive HTML/SVG widgets inline in claude.ai conversations. Use this skill whenever the user wants visual or interactive output rather than plain text or markdown: charts and dashboards, diagrams, flowcharts and architecture drawings, mockups, comparison grids, illustrations, interactive explainers ("explain how X works" with a visual), or tools with sliders, toggles, and live-updating displays — including financial data shown visually and requests phrased as "show me", "visualize", "draw", or "chart this".
description_zh: 为Claude的内置生成式UI设计系统和模板——即show_widget工具，该工具可在claude.ai对话中内联渲染交互式HTML/SVG组件。当用户希望获得视觉或交互式输出而非纯文本或Markdown时，请使用此技能：图表和仪表盘、图表、流程图和架构图、模型图、对比网格、插图、交互式解释器（“用视觉解释X如何工作”）或带有滑块、切换开关和实时更新显示的工具——包括视觉化展示的金融数据，以及以“展示给我”、“可视化”、“绘制”或“图表化这个”等方式提出的需求。

name: principle-type-system-discipline
description: Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand semantic primitives, parse external data at boundaries, refuse to lie to the compiler, exhaust variants, derive from authoritative schemas.
description_zh: 在设计类型、审查函数签名或编写任何静态类型语言的代码时使用。使非法状态无法表示，标记语义原语，在边界处解析外部数据，拒绝向编译器撒谎，穷尽变体，从权威模式中派生。

name: gen-paylink-govilo
description: Upload files to Govilo and generate unlock links via Bot API. Use when: (1) Creating a Govilo unlock link from a ZIP, folder, or individual files, (2) Automating file upload to Govilo R2 storage with presigned URLs, (3) Managing Govilo Bot API interactions (presign → upload → create item). Requires GOVILO_API_KEY and SELLER_ADDRESS env vars. If missing, guides user to register at https://govilo.xyz/.
description_zh: 将文件上传至 Govilo 并通过 Bot API 生成解锁链接。使用场景包括：(1) 从 ZIP 文件、文件夹或单个文件创建 Govilo 解锁链接，(2) 使用预签名 URL 自动化上传文件至 Govilo R2 存储空间，(3) 管理Govilo Bot API 交互（预签名 → 上传 → 创建项目）。需要 GOVILO_API_KEY 和 SELLER_ADDRESS 环境变量。若缺失，将引导用户在 https://govilo.xyz/ 注册。

name: standup
description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.
description_zh: 在git工作树、分支或PR之间进行只读的站立会议，以比较更改并生成一个整合计划。

name: m05-type-driven
description: CRITICAL: Use for type-driven design. Triggers: type state, PhantomData, newtype, marker trait, builder pattern, make invalid states unrepresentable, compile-time validation, sealed trait, ZST, 类型状态, 新类型模式, 类型驱动设计
description_zh: 关键：用于类型驱动设计。触发器：类型状态、PhantomData、新类型、标记特征、构建模式、使无效状态不可表示、编译时验证、密封特征、ZST、类型状态、新类型模式、类型驱动设计

name: council
description: Compare model perspectives for brainstorming, planning, validation, idea duels or interviews. Use when: independent proposals or judgments need optional bounded debate.
description_zh: 比较模型视角用于头脑风暴、规划、验证、想法对决或访谈。使用场景：当需要可选的有限范围辩论时，独立提案或判断。

name: aws-cdk
description: Provides AWS CDK TypeScript patterns for defining, validating, and deploying AWS infrastructure as code. Use when creating CDK apps, stacks, and reusable constructs, modeling serverless or VPC-based architectures, applying IAM and encryption defaults, or testing and reviewing `cdk synth`, `cdk diff`, and `cdk deploy` changes. Triggers include "aws cdk typescript", "create cdk app", "cdk stack", "cdk construct", "cdk deploy", and "cdk test".
description_zh: 提供 AWS CDK TypeScript 模式，用于定义、验证和部署 AWS 基础设施即代码（Infrastructure as Code）。在创建 CDK 应用、堆栈（stacks）和可复用结构（constructs）、构建无服务器或基于 VPC 的架构、应用 IAM 和加密默认设置，或测试与审查 `cdk synth`、`cdk diff` 和 `cdk deploy` 变更时使用。触发词包括 “aws cdk typescript”、“create cdk app”、“cdk stack”、“cdk construct”、“cdk deploy” 和 “cdk test”。

name: nts-tax-delinquency
description: 국세청 고액·상습체납자 명단공개를 nts.go.kr 공개 검색으로 조회한다. 상호·법인명으로 법인 명단과 개인 명단을 대조해 공개된 체납 사실(총 체납액·세목·체납요지 등)을 나열한다. 인증키 불필요. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过nts.go.kr的公开搜索查询国税厅高额·惯犯欠税者名单公开。对照公司名称·法人名称，列出公开的欠税事实（总欠税金额·税种·欠税原因等）。无需认证密钥。在Dolce中，通过官方表面进行后续行动。

name: pptx-html-fidelity-audit
description: Audit a python-pptx export against its source HTML deck, identify layout/content drift (footer overflow, cropped content, missing italic/em, lost styling, off-rhythm spacing), and re-export with strict footer-rail + cursor-flow layout discipline. Use this skill whenever the user has a .pptx that was generated from an HTML slide deck and asks to compare/audit/verify/fix the export — including phrases like "compare ppt with html", "fidelity audit", "fix the pptx", "ppt is cut off", "footer overlap", "italic missing in pptx", "re-export the deck", "pptx-html-fidelity-audit", or any case where a python-pptx → HTML round-trip needs verification or repair. Also trigger when the user shows you a deck.html and a deck.pptx side by side and is debugging visual differences.
description_zh: 对 python-pptx 导出的内容进行审计，并与源 HTML 幻灯片进行对比，识别布局/内容差异（页脚溢出、内容被裁剪、斜体/强调格式丢失、样式丢失、间距错乱），并使用严格的页脚轨道 + 光标流布局规范重新导出。当用户有从 HTML 幻灯片生成的 .pptx 文件并要求对比/审计/验证/修复导出内容时，使用此技能——包括类似“比较 PPT 与 HTML”、“保真度审计”、“修复 PPTX”、“PPT 被裁剪”、“页脚重叠”、“PPTX 中缺少斜体”、“重新导出套件”、“PPTX-HTML-保真度审计”等请求，或任何需要验证或修复 python-pptx → HTML 轮换的场景。此外，当用户同时展示 deck.html 和 deck.pptx 并调试视觉差异时，也触发该技能。

name: convex-schema-validator
description: Designs convex/schema.ts tables, validators, indexes, and relationships, and keeps the schema honest as data evolves. Use when creating tables, adding fields, choosing index fields, modeling relationships, or when a validator error appears at deploy time.
description_zh: 设计凸面/模式.ts表、验证器、索引和关系，并在数据演变时保持模式的一致性。在创建表、添加字段、选择索引字段、建模关系或部署时出现验证器错误时使用。

name: user-stories
description: Create user stories following the 3 C's (Card, Conversation, Confirmation) and INVEST criteria with descriptions, design links, and acceptance criteria. Use when writing user stories, breaking down features into backlog items, or defining acceptance criteria.
description_zh: 根据3C（卡片、对话、确认）原则和INVEST标准，创建用户故事，包含描述、设计链接和验收标准。在编写用户故事、将功能拆分为待办事项或定义验收标准时使用。

name: wp-plugin-directory-guidelines
description: Use when reviewing WordPress plugins for GPL compliance, checking license headers or compatibility, evaluating upsell/freemium/trialware patterns, validating plugin naming or trademark rules, checking plugin slugs, understanding why a plugin was rejected from WordPress.org, or answering any question about the 18 WordPress.org Plugin Directory guidelines — even if the user doesn't mention 'guidelines' explicitly.
description_zh: 在审查 WordPress 插件是否符合 GPL 规范、检查许可证头或兼容性、评估增值/免费增值/试用软件模式、验证插件命名或商标规则、检查插件别名、了解插件为何被拒绝出 WordPress.org 目录，或回答任何关于 18 条 WordPress.org 插件目录指南的问题时使用——即使用户没有明确提及“指南”。

name: m02-resource
description: CRITICAL: Use for smart pointers and resource management. Triggers: Box, Rc, Arc, Weak, RefCell, Cell, smart pointer, heap allocation, reference counting, RAII, Drop, should I use Box or Rc, when to use Arc vs Rc, 智能指针, 引用计数, 堆分配
description_zh: 关键：用于智能指针和资源管理。触发：Box、Rc、Arc、Weak、RefCell、Cell、智能指针、堆分配、引用计数、RAII、Drop、我应该使用Box还是Rc、何时使用Arc与Rc、智能指针、引用计数、堆分配

name: audit-support
description: Support SOX 404 compliance with control testing methodology, sample selection, and documentation standards. Use when generating testing workpapers, selecting audit samples, classifying control deficiencies, or preparing for internal or external audits.
description_zh: 支持 SOX 404 合规性，包括控制测试方法、样本选择和文档标准。在生成测试工作底稿、选择审计样本、分类控制缺陷或准备内部或外部审计时使用。

name: notion-spec-to-implementation
description: Turn Notion specs into implementation plans, tasks, and progress tracking; use when implementing PRDs/feature specs and creating Notion plans + tasks from them.
description_zh: 将 Notion 的规格转化为实施计划、任务和进度跟踪；在实施 PRDs/功能规格以及从它们创建 Notion 计划和任务时使用。

name: process-optimization
description: Analyze and improve business processes. Trigger with "this process is slow", "how can we improve", "streamline this workflow", "too many steps", "bottleneck", or when the user describes an inefficient process they want to fix.
description_zh: 分析和优化业务流程。当用户提到“这个流程太慢”、“如何改进”、“简化此工作流程”、“步骤太多”、“瓶颈”，或描述希望修正的低效流程时，触发此功能。

name: unity-scriptableobjects
description: Architect Unity 6.3 LTS data and decoupling with ScriptableObjects: config/data assets, shared runtime variables, event channels, and runtime sets/registries. Use when designing data-driven systems, replacing singletons/managers, creating .asset data with CreateAssetMenu, or when the user mentions ScriptableObject, SO architecture, or data assets.
description_zh: 使用 ScriptableObjects 构建和解耦 Unity 6.3 LTS 的数据：配置/数据资源、共享运行时变量、事件通道以及运行时集合/注册表。在设计数据驱动系统、替换单例/管理器、使用 CreateAssetMenu 创建 .asset 数据，或用户提及 ScriptableObject、SO 架构或数据资源时使用。

name: ads-amazon
description: Audit Amazon Ads profiles, regions, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, DSP, portfolios, targeting, search terms, retail readiness, creative, budgets, ACOS, TACOS, reporting, and policy. Use for Amazon Ads, sponsored ads, Amazon PPC, ACOS, TACOS, ASIN advertising, Amazon DSP, or retail-media optimization.
description_zh: 审计亚马逊广告资料库、区域、推广商品、品牌推广、展示型推广、DSP（数字媒体广告平台）、投资组合、目标定位、搜索词、零售准备度、创意素材、预算、ACOS（广告支出回报率）、TACOS（总广告支出回报率）、报告以及政策。适用于亚马逊广告、推广广告、亚马逊PPC（按点击付费广告）、ACOS、TACOS、ASIN广告、亚马逊DSP（数字媒体广告平台）或零售媒体优化。

name: understand-domain
description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.
description_zh: 从代码库中提取业务领域知识，并生成交互式领域流程图。可独立运行（轻量级扫描），或从现有的 /understand 知识图谱中派生。

name: spec-impl
description: Implements an approved spec. Validates that the state means "Approved" (in any language), creates a git branch named after the spec, switches to it, and starts the implementation step by step with pauses to review diffs.
description_zh: 实现已批准的规范。验证状态表示“已批准”（任何语言），创建以规范命名的git分支，切换到该分支，并逐步开始实现，每一步之间暂停以审查差异。

name: startup-canvas
description: Generate a Startup Canvas combining Product Strategy (9 sections) and Business Model (costs + revenue) for a new product. An alternative to BMC and Lean Canvas that separates strategy from business model. Use when launching a new product or evaluating a startup concept.
description_zh: 为新产品生成一个包含产品战略（9个部分）和商业模式（成本+收入）的创业画布。作为商业模型画布（BMC）和精益画布（Lean Canvas）的替代方案，将战略与商业模式分离。在推出新产品或评估创业概念时使用。

name: arize-prompt-optimization
description: Optimizes, improves, and debugs LLM prompts using production trace data, evaluations, and annotations. Extracts prompts from spans, gathers performance signal, and runs a data-driven optimization loop using the ax CLI. Use when the user mentions optimize prompt, improve prompt, make AI respond better, improve output quality, prompt engineering, prompt tuning, or system prompt improvement.
description_zh: 使用生产跟踪数据、评估和注释来优化、改进和调试大型语言模型（LLM）提示。从片段中提取提示，收集性能信号，并使用ax CLI运行数据驱动的优化循环。当用户提到优化提示、改进提示、使AI响应更好、提高输出质量、提示工程、提示调整或系统提示改进时使用。

name: ads-server-side-tracking
description: Audit server-side paid-media measurement including server-side tag management, platform conversion APIs, event taxonomy, browser/server deduplication, consent, hashing, data quality, observability, and privacy. Use for server-side tracking, sGTM, server-side tagging, CAPI, Events API, event_id, pixel debugging, first-party measurement, or conversion data loss.
description_zh: 审计服务器端付费媒体测量，包括服务器端标签管理、平台转换API、事件分类、浏览器/服务器去重、同意、哈希、数据质量、可观察性和隐私。用于服务器端跟踪、sGTM、服务器端标签、CAPI、事件API、event_id、像素调试、第一方测量或转换数据丢失。

name: variance-analysis
description: Decompose financial variances into drivers with narrative explanations and waterfall analysis. Use when analyzing budget vs. actual, period-over-period changes, revenue or expense variances, or preparing variance commentary for leadership.
description_zh: 将财务差异分解为驱动因素，并辅以叙述性解释及瀑布分析。适用于分析预算与实际对比、环比变动、收入或支出差异，或为管理层准备差异分析说明。

name: unity-input-system
description: Wire player input in Unity 6.3 LTS with the Input System package: Input Actions, action maps, the PlayerInput component, and reading values via callbacks or polling. Use when the project has a .inputactions asset or com.unity.inputsystem, or when the user mentions the Unity Input System, InputAction, action maps, PlayerInput, control schemes, or rebinding.
description_zh: 在 Unity 6.3 LTS 中使用 Input System 包配置线缆玩家输入：Input Actions、动作映射、PlayerInput 组件，以及通过回调或轮询读取值。当项目具有 .inputactions 资产或 com.unity.inputsystem，或用户提及 Unity Input System、InputAction、动作映射、PlayerInput、控制方案或重新绑定时使用。

name: economic-calendar-fetcher
description: Fetch upcoming economic events and data releases using FMP API. Retrieve scheduled central bank decisions, employment reports, inflation data, GDP releases, and other market-moving economic indicators for specified date ranges (default: next 7 days). The script outputs raw JSON or text; the assistant filters, assesses impact, and generates the Markdown report.
description_zh: 使用 FMP API 获取即将到来的经济事件和数据发布。检索指定日期范围内（默认为未来7天）的中央银行决策、就业报告、通胀数据、GDP发布以及其他影响市场的经济指标。该脚本输出原始 JSON 或文本；助手将进行筛选、评估影响并生成 Markdown 报告。

name: brand-promo-video-generator
description: For marketers and creators producing promotional content for brands, products, websites, apps, shops, or personal projects. Users provide logos, product images, interface screenshots, official links, or other verifiable assets and confirm duration, aspect ratio, audience, and campaign focus. The Skill organizes brand facts and asset provenance, selects a narrative direction, plans precise beats and shots, generates needed imagery, video, voiceover, or music, and completes assembly and pre-delivery review. It outputs a promotional short that highlights product capabilities, use cases, and a call to action. Best for launches, website showcases, and social promotion; not for imitating real brand marks without authorized assets, inventing product claims, or producing long-form narrative films.
description_zh: 对于为品牌、产品、网站、应用程序、商店或个人项目制作推广内容的营销人员和创作者。用户提供标志、产品图片、界面截图、官方链接或其他可验证的资产，并确认时长、宽高比、受众和活动重点。该技能整理品牌信息和资产来源，选择叙事方向，规划精确的节奏和镜头，生成所需的图像、视频、旁白或音乐，并完成组装和预交付审核。输出一个突出产品功能、应用场景和行动号召的推广短片。最适合用于发布、网站展示和社交推广；不适用于未经授权资产模仿真实品牌标志、虚构产品声明或制作长篇叙事电影。

name: aws-security
description: Covers AWS security services and workflows — Security Hub V2 (OCSF) findings, connectors, aggregators, automation rules, and security posture summaries; Security Hub CSPM (V1/ASFF) controls and compliance standards; GuardDuty threat findings; Inspector vulnerability findings; Macie sensitive data findings; Detective investigation; and Security Lake configuration and data aggregation. Applicable when questions involve security posture, Exposure findings, CSPM failed controls, threat findings, vulnerability findings, sensitive data findings, automation rules, or cross-service security configuration across AWS environments. Procedures use standard AWS CLI syntax and work with or without the AWS MCP server.
description_zh: 涵盖 AWS 安全服务和工作流程——安全中心 V2（OCSF）发现项、连接器、聚合器、自动化规则和安全态势摘要；安全中心 CSPM（V1/ASFF）控制项和合规标准；GuardDuty 威胁发现项；Inspector 漏洞发现项；Macie 敏感数据发现项；Detective 调查；以及安全湖的配置和数据聚合。适用于涉及安全态势、暴露发现项、CSPM 失败控制项、威胁发现项、漏洞发现项、敏感数据发现项、自动化规则或跨 AWS 环境的服务间安全配置的问题。流程使用标准的 AWS CLI 语法，可配合或独立于 AWS MCP 服务器使用。

name: learn
description: Provides autonomous project pattern learning by analyzing the codebase to discover development conventions, architectural patterns, and coding standards, then generates project rule files in .claude/rules/. Use when user asks to "learn from project", "extract project rules", "analyze codebase conventions", "discover project patterns", or wants to auto-generate Claude Code rules for the current project.
description_zh: 通过分析代码库来提供自主的项目模式学习功能，以发现开发规范、架构模式和编码标准，然后生成 .claude/rules/ 中的项目规则文件。当用户要求“学习项目”、“提取项目规则”、“分析代码库规范”、“发现项目模式”，或希望为当前项目自动生成 Claude Code 规则时使用。

name: m03-mutability
description: CRITICAL: Use for mutability issues. Triggers: E0596, E0499, E0502, cannot borrow as mutable, already borrowed as immutable, mut, &mut, interior mutability, Cell, RefCell, Mutex, RwLock, 可变性, 内部可变性, 借用冲突
description_zh: 关键：用于可变性问题。触发：E0596、E0499、E0502，不能可变借用，已不可变借用，mut、&mut、内部可变性、Cell、RefCell、Mutex、RwLock，可变性、内部可变性、借用冲突

name: rust-refactor-helper
description: Safe Rust refactoring with LSP analysis. Triggers on: /refactor, rename symbol, move function, extract, 重构, 重命名, 提取函数, 安全重构
description_zh: 使用LSP分析进行Safe Rust重构。触发条件：/refactor、重命名符号、移动函数、提取、重构、重命名、提取函数、安全重构

name: swiftui-webkit
description: Embeds and controls web content in SwiftUI with WebKit for SwiftUI, including WebView, WebPage, navigation policies, JavaScript execution, observable page state, link interception, local HTML or data loading, and custom URL schemes. Use when building iOS 26+ article/detail views, help centers, in-app documentation, or other embedded web experiences backed by HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
description_zh: 通过 WebKit for SwiftUI 在 SwiftUI 中嵌入并控制 Web 内容，涵盖 WebView、WebPage、导航策略、JavaScript 执行、可观察的页面状态、链接拦截、本地 HTML 或数据加载以及自定义 URL 方案。适用于构建 iOS 26 及以上版本的文章/详情视图、帮助中心、应用内文档或其他基于 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 的嵌入式 Web 体验。

name: rams
description: Run accessibility and visual design review on components. Use when reviewing UI code for WCAG compliance and design issues.
description_zh: 对组件进行无障碍性和视觉设计审查。在审查 UI 代码以符合 WCAG 标准和设计问题时使用。

name: andrej-karpathy-perspective
description:
Andrej Karpathy的思维框架与表达方式。基于20+篇博文、16段深度访谈、100+条X帖子的系统蒸馏，
提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式、完整的中文输出适配和经典句式速查。
用途：作为思维顾问，用Karpathy的视角分析AI技术可靠性、学习方法、行业趋势、产品设计。
当用户提到「用Karpathy的视角」「Karpathy会怎么看」「卡帕西」「karpathy模式」时使用。
也适用于：Software 2.0/3.0讨论、vibe coding话题、神经网络训练、AI炒作判断、LLM能力边界。
即使用户只是说「从工程现实主义角度」「march of nines」「构建即理解」「锯齿状智能」也可触发。
不在用户只是普通问AI相关问题时触发——只在明确想要Karpathy式思维框架时激活。

name: game-jam
description: Plan and ship a game under a jam deadline: lock scope to the clock, schedule the hours, cut features, and submit on time. Use for a game jam (Ludum Dare, GMTK Jam, Global Game Jam), a 48-hour or weekend build, or scoping and submitting a jam entry.
description_zh: 在限定时间内规划并发布一款游戏：锁定范围于时间，安排时间表，删减功能，并按时提交。适用于游戏马拉松（如Ludum Dare、GMTK Jam、Global Game Jam）、48小时或周末开发，或用于范围规划并提交游戏马拉松作品。

name: freee-api-skill
description: freee-mcp / freee-sign-mcp と連携するスキル。会計・人事労務・請求書・工数管理・販売・IT管理・固定資産・業務委託管理・サーベイ・開業・人事評価・申告・サイン（電子契約）の詳細APIリファレンスと使い方ガイドを提供。freee の経費申請・取引登録・勤怠打刻・給与明細・見積書・試算表・仕訳・従業員管理・工数登録・売上管理・SaaSアカウント管理・備品管理・固定資産管理・業務委託先の企業ユーザー/部門管理・サーベイ企画/実施回の取得・開業申請用データの参照/更新・人事評価結果の取得・法人税申告データや帳票の参照・電子契約の文書管理などの操作やAPI仕様を調べたいときに使う。ユーザーが freee のデータ操作、会計処理、人事労務管理、請求・見積、プロジェクト工数管理、販売管理、IT管理、固定資産管理、業務委託管理、サーベイ、開業、人事評価、申告、電子契約について質問や操作を依頼してきた場合は、明示的に freee と言及していなくても、このスキルの利用を検討すること。サインは別途 freee-sign-mcp の設定が必要。
description_zh:
该技能用于与 freee-mcp / freee-sign-mcp 进行集成。提供关于会计、人事与劳务、发票、工时管理、销售、IT 管理、固定资产、业务委托管理、调查、开业申请、绩效考核、报税以及签名（电子合同）等模块的详细 API 参考和使用指南。

当用户希望查询 freee 的相关操作或 API 规范时可使用此技能，包括但不限于：费用申请、交易登记、考勤打卡、薪资单、报价单、试算表、记账分录、员工管理、工时登记、销售管理、SaaS 账号管理、设备管理、固定资产管理、业务委托方的企业用户/部门管理、调查的计划与执行轮次获取、开业申请数据的查询与更新、绩效考核结果获取、法人税报税数据及报表查询，以及电子合同的文档管理等。

如果用户就 freee 的数据操作、会计处理、人事与劳务管理、发票与报价、项目工时管理、销售管理、IT 管理、固定资产管理、业务委托管理、调查、开业、绩效考核、报税或电子合同提出疑问或操作请求，即使未明确提及“freee”，也应考虑使用此技能。注意：签名功能需另外配置 freee-sign-mcp。

name: cargo-mailbox-management
description: Send mail from inboxes Cargo owns — provision mailboxes on a sending domain, run provider warm-up and the 5→40/day send ramp, deliver with the `sendEmail` action, and read back threads, replies, delivery events, and the workspace suppression list. Triggers: "set up a sending mailbox", "provision inboxes for outbound", "warm up this mailbox", "how many sends do I have left today", "send this from Cargo", "did they reply", "who unsubscribed", "suppress this recipient", "take me off your list", "never email them again", "what do mailboxes cost", "my mailbox is stuck pending". A mailbox is a recurring monthly credit charge, and every send is gated on basis, suppression, and relevance. Skip when: writing the copy or building the audience — use cargo-gtm; the mailbox belongs in git — use cargo-project.
description_zh: 从 Cargo 拥有的收件箱发送邮件——为发送域配置邮箱，运行提供者预热并执行每日5→40的发送增量，使用 `sendEmail` 动作发送，并读取回邮件线程、回复、送达事件和工作区屏蔽列表。触发条件： "设置发送邮箱"、"为外发配置收件箱"、"预热此邮箱"、"我今天还能发送多少"、"从 Cargo 发送此邮件"、"他们回复了吗"、"谁退订了"、"屏蔽此收件人"、"把我从列表中移除"、"再也不要给他们发邮件"、"邮箱费用是多少"、"我的邮箱卡在待处理状态"。邮箱是按月计费的周期性信用额度，每次发送都基于基础、屏蔽和相关性进行限制。跳过时：编写文案或构建受众时——使用 cargo-gtm；邮箱属于 git 仓库——使用 cargo-project。

name: user-onboarding
description:
Onboarding script for first-time Starchild users: positioning, quick wins, discovery.

Use when the user is new or vague (e.g. "what can you do", "I don't know where to start", first session with no context, generic hello).
description_zh:
新用户 StarChild 欢迎脚本：定位、快速成功、探索。

适用于新用户或模糊不清的情况（例如：“你能做什么”、“我不知道从哪里开始”、“首次无上下文会话”、“通用问候语”）。

name: office-automation
description: 自动化处理 Word 和 Excel 文件。使用 Python 脚本读取、写入、格式化文档和表格。支持批量处理、模板填充、数据提取和格式转换。

name: negentropy-lens
description: A decision-support framework that evaluates systems, architectures, and strategies through the entropy (decay) vs negentropy (growth) lens, while surfacing tacit knowledge gaps. Use this skill whenever the user is making architecture decisions, evaluating system designs, reviewing technical approaches, choosing between options, auditing existing systems, or planning strategies. Also trigger when the user explicitly asks to "apply the negentropy lens", mentions "entropy", "negentropy", "tacit knowledge", "knowledge engine", or "flip the switch". Nudge activation when you detect the user is at a decision point — even if they haven't asked for this lens — by briefly noting the entropic/negentropic dimension before proceeding.
description_zh: 这是一个决策支持框架，通过熵（衰变）与负熵（增长）的视角来评估系统、架构和策略，同时揭示隐性知识的缺口。每当用户进行架构决策、评估系统设计、审查技术方案、在选项之间做出选择、审计现有系统或规划策略时，都应使用此技能。此外，当用户明确要求“应用负熵视角”，或提及“熵”、“负熵”、“隐性知识”、“知识引擎”或“切换视角”时，也应触发此技能。即使用户未主动请求此视角，只要你检测到用户正处于决策节点，就应主动提示激活该框架——在继续之前，简要说明其中的熵/负熵维度。

name: aws-ami-builder
description: Build Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) with Packer using the amazon-ebs builder. Use when creating custom AMIs for EC2 instances.
description_zh: 使用amazon-ebs构建器通过Packer构建Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)。在为EC2实例创建自定义AMIs时使用。

name: loopy
description: Discover, find, compare, audit, repair, adapt, craft, run, debrief, save, and prepare repeatable AI-agent loops for publication. Use when a user asks to analyze code or coding threads for recurring work, find a published loop, interview them to turn a goal into a bounded loop, review a loop for weak checks or unsafe authority, execute a loop with an evidence receipt, learn from completed runs, save or reuse a project loop, or validate and submit a loop to Loop Library.
description_zh: 发现、寻找、比较、审计、修复、调整、构建、运行、复盘、保存，并为发布准备可重复的AI代理循环。当用户要求分析代码或编码线程以进行重复性工作时使用，查找已发布的循环，通过访谈将目标转化为有界循环，审查循环中的弱检查或非安全权限，使用证据收据执行循环，从完成的运行中学习，保存或重用项目循环，或验证并提交循环到循环库。

name: sentry-sdk-upgrade
description: Upgrade the Sentry JavaScript SDK across major versions. Use when asked to upgrade Sentry, migrate to a newer version, fix deprecated Sentry APIs, or resolve breaking changes after a Sentry version bump.
description_zh: 升级 Sentry JavaScript SDK 以跨越主要版本。当被要求升级 Sentry、迁移到新版本、修复已弃用的 Sentry API，或解决 Sentry 版本升级后的破坏性变更时，使用此功能。

name: provider-docs
description: Create, update, and review Terraform provider documentation for Terraform Registry using HashiCorp-recommended patterns, tfplugindocs templates, and schema descriptions. Use when adding or changing provider configuration, resources, data sources, ephemeral resources, list resources, functions, actions, or guides; when validating generated docs; and when troubleshooting missing or incorrect Registry documentation.
description_zh: 使用 HashiCorp 推荐的模式、tfplugindocs 模板和模式描述创建、更新和审查 Terraform 提供商文档，用于 Terraform Registry。在添加或更改提供程序配置、资源、数据源、临时资源、列表资源、函数、操作或指南时使用；在验证生成的文档时使用；以及在解决缺少或不正确的 Registry 文档问题时使用。

name: longbridge-intel
description:
Market intelligence: strategy screener, popularity rankings, top movers with news correlation, quote anomalies, index/ETF constituent stocks, morning briefings, catalyst monitoring for watchlist, event-driven strategies, ETF fund flows, sector rotation, market microstructure, supply chain analysis, industry overviews, and ARK-style disruptive innovation analysis.

description_zh:
市场情报：策略筛选器、热度排行、与新闻关联的强势股、报价异常、指数/ETF成分股、晨间简报、监控观察列表的催化剂、事件驱动策略、ETF资金流、板块轮动、市场微观结构、供应链分析、行业概览以及ARK风格的颠覆式创新分析。

name: gtm-strategy
description: Create a go-to-market strategy covering marketing channels, messaging, success metrics, and launch timeline. Use when planning a product launch, creating a GTM plan from scratch, or defining a launch strategy for a new market.
description_zh: 制定一个涵盖营销渠道、信息传递、成功指标和发布时间表的上市策略。在规划产品发布、从零开始创建GTM计划或为新产品市场定义发布策略时使用。

name: photokit
description: Implement, review, or improve photo picking, camera capture, and media handling in iOS apps using PhotoKit and AVFoundation. Use when working with PhotosPicker, PHPickerViewController, camera capture sessions (AVCaptureSession), photo library access, image loading and display, video recording, or media permissions. Also use when selecting photos from the library, taking pictures, recording video, processing images, or handling photo/camera privacy permissions in Swift apps.
description_zh: 使用 PhotoKit 和 AVFoundation 在 iOS 应用中实现、审查或改进照片选择、相机捕获和媒体处理。在处理 PhotosPicker、PHPickerViewController、相机捕获会话（AVCaptureSession）、照片库访问、图像加载和显示、视频录制或媒体权限时使用。同时，在 Swift 应用中选择库中的照片、拍照、录制视频、处理图像或处理照片/相机隐私权限时也使用。

name: itch-publish
description: Publish and update a game on itch.io: create the project page and upload builds with the butler CLI (butler push) to named channels. Use for itch.io publishing, butler push, channel naming for Windows/macOS/Linux/HTML5, versioning uploads, or shipping a jam or release build to itch.io.
description_zh: 在 itch.io 上发布和更新游戏：创建项目页面，并使用 butler CLI（butler push）上传构建版本到命名频道。用于 itch.io 发布、butler push、频道命名，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux/HTML5，版本上传，或将 jam 或发布构建版本上传到 itch.io。

name: session-report
description: Generate an explorable HTML report of Claude Code session usage (tokens, cache, subagents, skills, expensive prompts) from ~/.claude/projects transcripts.
description_zh: 生成一个可探索的HTML报告，展示Claude Code会话的使用情况（包括token、缓存、子代理、技能和昂贵提示），数据来源于~/.claude/projects transcripts。

name: equity-research
description: Generate comprehensive equity research snapshots combining analyst consensus estimates, company fundamentals, historical prices, and macroeconomic context. Use when researching stocks, comparing estimates to actuals, analyzing company financials, assessing equity valuations, or building investment cases.
description_zh: 生成包含分析师共识预测、公司基本面、历史价格和宏观经济背景的全面股票研究快照。在研究股票、比较预测与实际值、分析公司财务、评估股票估值或构建投资案例时使用。

name: render-deploy
description: Deploy applications to Render by analyzing codebases, generating render.yaml Blueprints, and providing Dashboard deeplinks. Use when the user wants to deploy, host, publish, or set up their application on Render's cloud platform.
description_zh: 将应用程序部署到 Render，通过分析代码库、生成 render.yaml 蓝图，并提供 Dashboard 深链接。当用户希望将应用程序部署、托管、发布或设置在 Render 的云平台上时使用。

name: minimalist-product-ad-generator
description: Turn product images and ad requirements into minimalist product ad shorts for e-commerce promotion and product launches. The Skill confirms format and product variants, extracts selling points, writes concise English ad copy, builds product anchors, plans beat-synced typography/storyboards, and generates a clean product film with premium camera language. Not for KOC talking-head ads, general editing, or complex screen demos.
description_zh: 将产品图片和广告需求转化为极简风格的产品广告短片，用于电商推广和产品发布。该技能确认格式和产品变体，提取卖点，撰写简洁的英文广告文案，构建产品锚点，规划与节奏同步的字体/故事板，并生成采用高端摄影语言的产品短片。不适用于KOC口播广告、常规剪辑或复杂屏幕演示。

name: literature-search-arxiv
description: Search for scientific papers, preprints, and publications on arXiv. Extract metadata, abstracts, and download full-text PDFs or HTML versions of papers. Use when the user asks to find research papers, literature, or specific arXiv IDs.

name: owasp-security
description: Implement secure coding practices following OWASP Top 10. Use when preventing security vulnerabilities, implementing authentication, securing APIs, or conducting security reviews. Triggers on OWASP, security, XSS, SQL injection, CSRF, authentication security, secure coding, vulnerability.
description_zh: 遵循 OWASP Top 10 实施安全编码实践。当需要防范安全漏洞、实现身份认证、保护 API 或开展安全评审时，请使用此实践。触发词包括：OWASP、安全、XSS、SQL 注入、CSRF、身份认证安全、安全编码、漏洞。

name: paperclip-create-plugin
description: Create and develop external Paperclip plugins with the CLI-first workflow. Use when scaffolding a plugin, iterating on a local plugin, installing it into Paperclip, or updating plugin authoring docs.
description_zh: 使用 CLI 优先的工作流程创建和开发外部 Paperclip 插件。在搭建插件、迭代本地插件、将其安装到 Paperclip 或更新插件编写文档时使用。

name: ima-sdk-client-side
description: Supports Interactive Media Ads (IMA) SDK. Use this skill for client-side ad insertion when you are requesting video ads for websites, apps, TVs or other platforms using VAST or VMAP. Do not use for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), SSAI, or SGAI.
description_zh: 支持交互式媒体广告 (IMA) SDK。在您使用 VAST 或 VMAP 为网站、应用程序、电视或其他平台请求视频广告时，请使用此技能进行客户端广告插入。不应用于动态广告插入 (DAI)、SSAI 或 SGAI。

name: dx-org-trial-expiration-check
description: Check when Salesforce orgs expire (or already expired) and what to do about it, for one org, the default org, or across all authenticated orgs, using the Salesforce CLI (sf). Use when the user asks about org or trial expiration, "when does my trial expire", "is my trial org still active", "how many days are left", "which orgs are expiring soon", wants to filter orgs expiring within N days, needs machine-readable (JSON/CSV) output for cron or alerting, wants to back up an at-risk org before it lapses, or asks how to extend or renew an expiring trial or Developer Edition org. Covers trial editions, Developer Edition orgs (anything with a TrialExpirationDate), and scratch orgs (via sf org list). DO NOT TRIGGER for sandbox refresh timing, for creating, deleting, or switching the active org, or for non-Salesforce trials such as AWS, Netflix, or other vendors — this skill reads expiration and prints guidance, it does not modify orgs.
description_zh: 检查 Salesforce 组织何时到期（或已过期）以及应如何处理，可以针对单个组织、默认组织或所有已认证组织，使用 Salesforce CLI（sf）。当用户询问组织或试用版到期问题时，例如“我的试用版何时到期”、“我的试用版组织是否仍然活跃”、“还剩多少天”、“哪些组织即将到期”，需要筛选 N 天内到期的组织，需要机器可读（JSON/CSV）输出以用于 cron 或告警，需要在组织到期前备份有风险的组织，或询问如何延长或续订即将到期的试用版或开发者版组织时使用。涵盖试用版、开发者版组织（任何具有 TrialExpirationDate 的组织）以及通过 sf org list 查询的沙盒组织。禁止用于沙盒刷新时间、创建、删除或切换活动组织，或用于非 Salesforce 试用版（如 AWS、Netflix 或其他供应商）——此技能仅读取到期信息并打印指导，不会修改组织。

name: vcp-screener
description: Screen S&P 500 stocks for Mark Minervini's Volatility Contraction Pattern (VCP) and detect historical VCPs in a single ticker's price path. Identifies Stage 2 uptrend stocks forming tight bases with contracting volatility near breakout pivot points; in historical single-ticker mode walks a multi-year history and emits every VCP that formed with forward-outcome stats (breakout / stop-hit / timeout). Use when user requests VCP screening, Minervini-style setups, tight base patterns, volatility contraction breakout candidates, Stage 2 momentum stock scanning, or historical VCP pattern study on a specific ticker (e.g. FIX, TSLA).
description_zh: 筛选满足马克·明内维尼（Mark Minervini）波动收缩模式（VCP）的标普500成分股，并在单个股票的价格走势中检测历史VCP模式。识别形成紧密基底的阶段2上升趋势股票，这些股票在突破枢轴点附近出现波动收缩；在历史单只股票模式下，回溯多年历史并输出所有形成并带有前瞻性结果统计（突破/止损/超时）的VCP。当用户请求VCP筛选、明内维尼风格设置、紧密基底模式、波动收缩突破候选股、阶段2动量股扫描，或对特定股票（例如FIX、TSLA）进行历史VCP模式研究时使用。

name: threejs-gltf-loading
description: Load glTF/GLB models in three.js with GLTFLoader and play their skinned animations with AnimationMixer, including DRACO/Meshopt-compressed meshes and KTX2 textures. Use when importing 3D models into three.js — when the user mentions glTF, GLB, GLTFLoader, AnimationMixer, animation clips, DRACOLoader, or "load a 3D model". For scene/camera/renderer setup use threejs-scene-setup; for materials and lights use threejs-materials-lighting.
description_zh: 使用GLTFLoader在three.js中加载glTF/GLB模型，并使用AnimationMixer播放其骨骼动画，支持DRACO/Meshopt压缩的网格和KTX2纹理。在将3D模型导入three.js时使用——当用户提到glTF、GLB、GLTFLoader、AnimationMixer、动画片段、DRACOLoader或“加载3D模型”时。场景/相机/渲染器设置请使用threejs-scene-setup；材质和灯光请使用threejs-materials-lighting。

name: hormuz-strait
description: Check the live status of the Strait of Hormuz from the Hormuz Strait Monitor dashboard: open, restricted, or closed status, tanker transits vs normal, stranded vessels, Brent price impact, war-risk insurance levels, cargo throughput, tanker freight rates, diplomatic developments, and global trade impact. Use this skill whenever the user asks about the Strait of Hormuz or the Persian Gulf in the context of oil, shipping, or geopolitical risk — whether Hormuz is open, chokepoint or transit disruption, Gulf tanker traffic, war-risk premiums, Middle East shipping routes, or energy supply-chain risk.
description_zh: 从霍尔木兹海峡监控面板检查霍尔木兹海峡的实时状态：开放、限制或关闭状态，油轮通行与正常通行对比，搁浅船只，布伦特油价影响，战争风险保险水平，货物吞吐量，油轮运费率，外交发展动态以及全球贸易影响。当用户询问关于霍尔木兹海峡或波斯湾在石油、航运或地缘政治风险背景下的情况时，无论霍尔木兹海峡是否开放、咽喉要道或通行中断、海湾油轮交通、战争风险溢价、中东航运路线或能源供应链风险，均使用此技能。

name: mantine-combobox
description: Build custom dropdown/select/autocomplete/multiselect components using Mantine's Combobox primitives. Use this skill when: (1) creating a new custom select-like component with Combobox primitives, (2) building a searchable dropdown, (3) implementing a multi-select or tags input variant, (4) customizing option rendering, (5) adding custom filtering logic, or (6) any task involving useCombobox, Combobox.Target, Combobox.Option, or Combobox.Dropdown.
description_zh: 使用 Mantine 的 Combobox 基础组件构建自定义的下拉/选择/自动完成/多选组件。在以下情况下使用此技巧：(1) 使用 Combobox 基础组件创建新的自定义选择类组件，(2) 构建可搜索的下拉菜单，(3) 实现多选或标签输入变体，(4) 自定义选项渲染，(5) 添加自定义过滤逻辑，或 (6) 任何涉及 useCombobox、Combobox.Target、Combobox.Option 或 Combobox.Dropdown 的任务。

name: cloud
description: Documentation reference for using Browser Use Cloud — the hosted API and SDK for browser automation. Use this skill whenever the user needs help with the Cloud REST API (v2, v3, or v4), browser-use-sdk (Python or TypeScript), X-Browser-Use-API-Key authentication, cloud sessions, browser profiles, profile sync, CDP WebSocket connections, stealth browsers, residential proxies, CAPTCHA handling, webhooks, workspaces, skills marketplace, liveUrl streaming, pricing, or integration patterns (chat UI, subagent, adding browser tools to existing agents). Also trigger for questions about n8n/Make/Zapier integration, Playwright/ Puppeteer/Selenium on cloud infrastructure, or 1Password vault integration. Do NOT use this for the open-source Python library (Agent, Browser, Tools config) — use the open-source skill instead.
description_zh: 使用 Browser Use Cloud 的文档参考——browser automation 的托管 API 和 SDK。当用户需要有关 Cloud REST API（v2、v3 或 v4）、browser-use-sdk（Python 或 TypeScript）、X-Browser-Use-API-Key 认证、云会话、浏览器配置文件、配置文件同步、CDP WebSocket 连接、隐身浏览器、住宅代理、验证码处理、webhooks、工作区、技能市场、liveUrl 流式传输、定价或集成模式（聊天 UI、子代理、向现有代理添加浏览器工具）的帮助时，请使用此技能。也用于有关 n8n/Make/Zapier 集成、Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium 在云基础设施上的使用或 1Password 库集成的提问。**请勿**使用此技能用于开源 Python 库（Agent、Browser、Tools 配置）——请使用开源技能。

name: mapkit
description: Implement, review, or improve maps and location features in iOS/macOS apps using MapKit and CoreLocation. Use when working with Map views, annotations, markers, polylines, user location tracking, geocoding, reverse geocoding, search/autocomplete, directions and routes, geofencing, region monitoring, CLLocationUpdate async streams, or location authorization flows. Also use when working with maps, coordinates, addresses, places, directions, distance calculations, or location-based features in Swift apps.
description_zh: 使用 MapKit 和 CoreLocation 在 iOS/macOS 应用中实现、审查或改进地图和位置功能。适用于处理地图视图、注释、标记、折线、用户位置跟踪、地理编码、反向地理编码、搜索/自动完成、路线和导航、地理围栏、区域监控、CLLocationUpdate 异步流或位置授权流程。也适用于在 Swift 应用中处理地图、坐标、地址、地点、路线、距离计算或基于位置的功能。

name: music-video-subtitle-generator
description: For musicians, video creators, and social-media editors producing AI music videos or emotional short films with lyric typography. Users provide music, lyrics, references, characters, typography direction, mood, or target platform. The Skill analyzes beat and vocal timing, separates character, scene, and text references, designs beat-reactive spatial typography, decomposes long works into connected shots, audits prompts, and routes generation for H3 or other video tools. It outputs MV concepts, shot prompts, lyric text plans, and stitching guidance. Best for stylized MVs and subtitle-driven music visuals, not ordinary caption cleanup, licensed IP copying, or fully manual post-production editing.
description_zh: 对于音乐人、视频创作者和社交媒体编辑，用于制作AI音乐视频或情感短剧，并带有歌词排版特效。用户提供音乐、歌词、参考素材、角色、排版方向、情绪氛围或目标平台。该技能会分析节拍和演唱节奏，分离角色、场景和文本参考，设计随节拍变化的立体排版，将长作品分解为连续镜头，审核提示词，并为H3或其他视频工具生成路径。输出内容包括MV概念、镜头提示、歌词文本计划以及拼接指导。最适合风格化MV和字幕驱动的音乐视觉，不适用于普通字幕清理、版权素材复制或完全手动后期剪辑。

name: unity-physics
description: Set up 3D physics in Unity 6.3 LTS: Rigidbody movement and forces, colliders, triggers vs collisions, layer-based collision, raycasts, and joints. Use when adding a Rigidbody, handling OnCollisionEnter/OnTriggerEnter, tuning collision layers, casting rays, or when the user mentions Unity physics, AddForce, isKinematic, or linearVelocity.
description_zh: 在 Unity 6.3 LTS 中设置 3D 物理效果：Rigidbody 运动和力、碰撞体、触发器与碰撞、基于层的碰撞、射线投射和关节。在添加 Rigidbody、处理 OnCollisionEnter/OnTriggerEnter、调整碰撞层、投射射线或用户提及 Unity 物理、AddForce、isKinematic 或 linearVelocity 时使用。

name: skill-creator
description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
description_zh: 创建新技能、修改和改进现有技能，并衡量技能性能。当用户希望从零开始创建技能、编辑或优化现有技能、运行评估测试技能、通过方差分析基准测试技能性能，或优化技能描述以提高触发准确度时使用。

name: monetization-strategy
description: Brainstorm 3-5 monetization strategies with audience fit, risks, and validation experiments. Use when exploring revenue models, evaluating pricing strategies, or deciding how to monetize a product.
description_zh: 构思3-5种与受众匹配的变现策略，包括风险和验证实验。在探索收入模式、评估定价策略或决定如何变现产品时使用。

name: pair-trade-screener
description: Statistical arbitrage tool for identifying and analyzing pair trading opportunities. Detects cointegrated stock pairs within sectors, analyzes spread behavior, calculates z-scores, and provides entry/exit recommendations for market-neutral strategies. Use when user requests pair trading opportunities, statistical arbitrage screening, mean-reversion strategies, or market-neutral portfolio construction. Supports correlation analysis, cointegration testing, and spread backtesting.
description_zh: 用于识别和分析配对交易机会的统计套利工具。可在行业内部检测协整股票对，分析价差行为，计算z分数，并为市场中性策略提供入场/出场建议。当用户请求配对交易机会、统计套利筛选、均值回归策略或市场中性投资组合构建时使用。支持相关性分析、协整检验和价差回测。

name: sessions
description: Core principles and workflow router for changes to the Agents Window under src/vs/sessions.
description_zh: 核心原则和用于更改 src/vs/sessions 下的 Agents 窗口的流程路由器。

name: realitykit
description: Build iOS augmented reality and 3D experiences with RealityKit and ARKit. Use when adding RealityView content, loading entities or USDZ models, anchoring objects to planes or world positions, distinguishing entity hit tests from ARKit real-world raycasts, handling AR camera availability, world tracking, scene updates, or RealityKit entity gestures and interactions.
description_zh: 使用 RealityKit 和 ARKit 构建 iOS 增强现实和 3D 体验。在添加 RealityView 内容、加载实体或 USDZ 模型、将对象锚定到平面或世界位置、区分实体命中测试与 ARKit 真实世界射线投射、处理 AR 摄像头可用性、世界跟踪、场景更新或 RealityKit 实体手势和交互时使用。

name: web-performance-optimization
description: Optimize website and web application performance including loading speed, Core Web Vitals, bundle size, caching strategies, and runtime performance
description_zh: 优化网站和 Web 应用性能，包括加载速度、核心 Web 指标、包大小、缓存策略和运行时性能

name: m12-lifecycle
description: Use when designing resource lifecycles. Keywords: RAII, Drop, resource lifecycle, connection pool, lazy initialization, connection pool design, resource cleanup patterns, cleanup, scope, OnceCell, Lazy, once_cell, OnceLock, transaction, session management, when is Drop called, cleanup on error, guard pattern, scope guard, 资源生命周期, 连接池, 惰性初始化, 资源清理, RAII 模式
description_zh: 在设计资源生命周期时使用。关键词：RAII、Drop、资源生命周期、连接池、惰性初始化、连接池设计、资源清理模式、清理、作用域、OnceCell、Lazy、once_cell、OnceLock、事务、会话管理、Drop何时被调用、错误清理、守卫模式、作用域守卫、资源生命周期、连接池、惰性初始化、资源清理、RAII模式

name: company-valuation
description: Estimate a public company's intrinsic value with DCF, relative (peer multiple), and sum-of-the-parts (SOTP) methods, then blend them into an implied share price with upside/downside vs the market price, a WACC and terminal-growth sensitivity grid, and bull/base/bear scenarios. Use this skill whenever the user asks what a company or ticker is worth: fair value, intrinsic value, implied share price, a price target from fundamentals, whether it is overvalued or undervalued, building a DCF (WACC, terminal value, discounted cash flow), EV/EBITDA or P/E based targets, peer comparison valuation, or SOTP and conglomerate discounts. Run the model rather than answering valuation questions from memory.
description_zh: 使用DCF、相对估值（同行市盈率）和分部估值（SOTP）方法估算一家上市公司的内在价值，并将这些估值结果融合，以隐含股价与市场价格对比，结合WACC和终值增长率敏感性矩阵，以及牛市/基准/熊市情景分析。每当用户询问一家公司或股票的价值时，包括公允价值、内在价值、隐含股价、基于基本面的目标价、是否高估或低估、构建DCF（WACC、终值、折现现金流）、EV/EBITDA或P/E目标估值、同行比较估值、分部估值和集团折价等，都应运用此技能。运行模型进行估值分析，而不是凭记忆回答估值问题。

name: papercraft-stop-motion-explainer
description: For creators explaining science, education, or general knowledge through tactile handmade papercraft visuals. Users provide a topic, core knowledge points, or source material and may specify audience, duration, aspect ratio, and deliverable type. The Skill extracts the learning goal and visual metaphor, proposes creative directions, designs paper characters, layered diorama sets, and props, creates preview concepts plus image and video prompts, and plans storyboards, camera movement, transitions, and sound with staged approvals and review checklists. It outputs a production-ready papercraft stop-motion explainer package, or selected assets such as still prompts, image-series prompts, short-video prompts, or storyboards. Best for cut-paper, pop-up-book, layered diorama, and miniature stop-motion explainers; not for standard 2D cartoons, line doodles, live action, or explainers without a paper-art look.
description_zh: 用于创作者通过触感手工纸艺视觉来解释科学、教育或一般知识。用户提供主题、核心知识点或源材料，并可以指定受众、时长、宽高比和交付类型。该技能提取学习目标和视觉隐喻，提出创意方向，设计纸艺角色、分层场景组和道具，创建预览概念及图像和视频提示，并规划故事板、摄像机运动、转场和音效，需经舞台审批和审查清单确认。输出可生产的纸艺定格动画解释包，或选定资源如静态提示、图像序列提示、短视频提示或故事板。最适合剪纸、立体书、分层场景和微型定格动画解释；不适用于标准2D动画、线条涂鸦、实拍或无纸艺风格的解释。

name: market-breadth-analyzer
description: Quantifies market breadth health using TraderMonty's public CSV data. Generates a 0-100 composite score across 6 components (100 = healthy). No API key required. Use when user asks about market breadth, participation rate, advance-decline health, whether the rally is broad-based, or general market health assessment.
description_zh: 使用 TraderMonty 的公开 CSV 数据量化市场广度健康状况。在 6 个组成部分上生成 0-100 的综合评分（100 表示健康）。无需 API 密钥。当用户询问市场广度、参与率、涨跌健康度、反弹是否广泛，或一般市场健康状况时使用。

name: m09-domain
description: CRITICAL: Use for domain modeling. Triggers: domain model, DDD, domain-driven design, entity, value object, aggregate, repository pattern, business rules, validation, invariant, 领域模型, 领域驱动设计, 业务规则
description_zh: 关键：用于领域建模。触发器：领域模型、DDD、领域驱动设计、实体、值对象、聚合、仓库模式、业务规则、不变量、领域模型、领域驱动设计、业务规则

name: infra-postgres
description: Sets up and manages Postgres using the clickhousectl CLI — runs a local Docker-backed Postgres for development, and creates and operates managed ClickHouse Cloud Postgres services (connections, TLS, runtime config, read replicas, failover, point-in-time restore). Use when the user wants a Postgres or PostgreSQL database for their application, a local Postgres dev environment, psql access, or a managed/production Postgres in ClickHouse Cloud, or mentions moving a local Postgres to production. Also use when migrating an existing Postgres database (Neon, Supabase, RDS, Aurora, Cloud SQL, self-hosted) into ClickHouse Cloud Postgres.
description_zh: 使用 clickhousectl CLI 设置和管理 Postgres——为开发运行本地 Docker 支持的 Postgres，并创建和操作 ClickHouse Cloud 上的托管 Postgres 服务（连接、TLS、运行时配置、读副本、故障转移、时间点恢复）。当用户需要为应用程序使用 Postgres 或 PostgreSQL 数据库、本地 Postgres 开发环境、psql 访问，或 ClickHouse Cloud 上的托管/生产 Postgres，或提及将本地 Postgres 迁移到生产环境时使用。也用于将现有 Postgres 数据库（Neon、Supabase、RDS、Aurora、Cloud SQL、自托管）迁移到 ClickHouse Cloud Postgres。

name: payment-assistant
description: Binance Pay Assistant - Send and Receive crypto payments. Send: QR code payment from Funding Wallet (C2C + PIX). Use when user wants to buy/purchase/pay/transfer/send, confirm/cancel payment, or query order status. Requires QR code data. PIX QR codes (pix, br.gov.bcb.pix) are auto-detected. Receive: Generate QR codes and payment links to collect crypto. Use when user wants to receive/collect payment (generate receive link, receive QR). Do NOT use for earning, buying/selling crypto, or digital goods.

name: mcp-duckgo
description: Skills for web search and content scraping via DuckDuckGo MCP Server. Used when users need online searching and web scraping.
description_zh: 通过DuckDuckGo MCP服务器进行网络搜索和内容抓取的技能。当用户需要在线搜索和网页抓取时使用。

name: 10x-cli-setup
description: Set up or troubleshoot @przeprogramowani/10x-cli for a 10xDevs learner: reuse or install a compatible CLI, check authentication and course access, choose the project and AI tool, and hand off to 10x-cli-guide. Use for installation, updates, npm permissions and onboarding. Excludes CLI source development and everyday download/use/sync guidance once setup is ready.
description_zh: 为 10xDevs 学习者设置或排错 @przeprogramowani/10x-cli：重用或安装兼容的 CLI，检查认证和课程访问权限，选择项目和 AI 工具，然后转交给 10x-cli-guide。用于安装、更新、npm 权限和入职。不包括 CLI 源代码开发以及设置完成后日常下载/使用/同步的指导。

name: authsome
description: Use this to access external services/CLIs/APIs: Gmail/gh/Github/Stripe etc. or when running any bash command, script, or curl/wget that makes outbound HTTP calls. Make HTTP requests directly and the gateway injects credentials automatically.
description_zh: 使用此功能访问外部服务/CLI/API：Gmail/gh/Github/Stripe等，或在执行任何bash命令、脚本或进行curl/wget等出站HTTP调用时使用。直接发起HTTP请求，网关将自动注入凭证。

name: finviz-screener
description: Build and open FinViz screener URLs from natural language requests. Use when user wants to screen stocks, find stocks matching criteria, filter by fundamentals or technicals, or asks to open FinViz with specific conditions. Supports both Japanese and English input (e.g., "高配当で成長している小型株を探したい", "Find oversold large caps with high ROE").
description_zh: 从自然语言请求中构建并打开FinViz筛选器URL。当用户想要筛选股票、查找符合标准的股票、按基本面或技术面进行筛选，或要求以特定条件打开FinViz时使用。支持日语和英语输入（例如："想找高股息且成长的小型股"、"Find oversold large caps with high ROE"）。

name: arize-trace
description: Downloads, exports, and inspects existing Arize traces and spans to understand what an LLM app is doing or debug runtime issues. Covers exporting traces by ID, spans by ID, sessions by ID, and root-cause investigation using the ax CLI. Use when the user wants to look at existing trace data, see what their LLM app is doing, export traces, download spans, investigate errors, or analyze behavior regressions.
description_zh: 下载、导出和检查现有的 Arize 跟踪和跨度，以了解 LLM 应用程序正在做什么或调试运行时问题。涵盖通过 ID 导出跟踪、通过 ID 导出跨度、通过 ID 导出会话，以及使用 ax CLI 进行根本原因调查。当用户想要查看现有的跟踪数据、了解他们的 LLM 应用程序正在做什么、导出跟踪、下载跨度、调查错误或分析行为回归时使用。

name: karpathy-guidelines
description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.
description_zh: 减少常见大型语言模型（LLM）编码错误的指导方针。在编写、审查或重构代码时使用，以避免过度复杂化、进行精准修改、揭示假设，并定义可验证的成功标准。

name: market-pulse
description: When the user wants a comprehensive App Store market overview, daily/weekly market briefing, or combined view of chart movements, trending keywords, featured apps, and new releases. Also use when the user mentions "market overview", "what's happening on the App Store", "market briefing", "weekly report", "market trends", or "state of the market". For chart-specific rank changes only, see market-movers. For keyword trends only, see keyword-research.
description_zh: 当用户需要全面的应用商店市场概览、每日/每周市场简报，或图表趋势、热门关键词、特色应用和新发布的综合视图时，也适用于用户提及“市场概览”、“应用商店动态”、“市场简报”、“每周报告”、“市场趋势”或“市场状态”。仅针对图表特定排名变化，请参阅market-movers。仅针对关键词趋势，请参阅keyword-research。

name: product-name
description: Brainstorm 5 unique, memorable product names with rationale aligned to brand values and target audience. Use when naming a new product, rebranding, or exploring product name ideas.
description_zh: 构思5个独特且令人难忘的产品名称，其理由需与品牌价值观和目标受众相一致。适用于新产品命名、品牌重塑或探索产品名称创意。

name: appllama-usage
description: Use the Appllama MCP (mcp.appllama.io) well — research real top-grossing mobile apps, their screens, flows, and UI elements, then build from what you learn. Load when the Appllama MCP is connected and the task involves building a mobile app or screen, researching app design patterns, studying onboarding/paywall/feature flows, improving an existing screen, or whenever an appllama_* / search_apps / list_app_screens tool is available. Covers the tool map, pagination, expiring media, and the full build-from-research playbooks.
description_zh: 请充分利用Appllama MCP（mcp.appllama.io）——研究真实收入排名靠前的移动应用，了解它们的界面、流程和UI元素，然后根据所学进行构建。当Appllama MCP连接且任务涉及构建移动应用或界面、研究应用设计模式、学习引导/付费墙/功能流程、改进现有界面，或当可用appllama_* / search_apps / list_app_screens工具时，即可使用。涵盖工具地图、分页、过期媒体以及基于研究构建的完整流程。

name: estimate-analysis
description: Analyze sell-side analyst estimates and how they are changing, using Yahoo Finance data (yfinance): EPS and revenue consensus by period, estimate ranges and dispersion, revision trends over 7/30/60/90 days and up/down revision breadth, growth estimates vs industry, sector, and the S&P 500, and historical estimate accuracy. Use this skill when the user wants more than a single estimate lookup: estimate revisions or momentum, EPS trend, consensus changes, forward or next-quarter and annual estimates, the bull vs bear estimate spread, or growth projections across periods.
description_zh: 分析卖方分析师的预测及其变化情况，使用Yahoo Finance数据（yfinance）：按期间划分的每股收益（EPS）和收入共识、预测范围和离散度、7/30/60/90天的修订趋势以及上调/下调修订的广度、增长预测与行业、板块和标普500的对比，以及历史预测准确性。当用户需要查询多个预测或预测修订、动量、EPS趋势、共识变化、前瞻或下一季度及年度预测、牛市与熊市预测差距，或跨时期的增长预测时，使用此技能。

name: oauth
description: Configure OAuth providers (Google, Apple, Microsoft, Facebook, GitHub, etc.) to work with portless local dev URLs. Use when setting up OAuth redirect URIs, fixing "redirect_uri_mismatch" or "invalid redirect" errors, configuring sign-in providers for local development, or when a provider rejects .localhost subdomains. Triggers include "OAuth not working with portless", "redirect URI mismatch", "Google/Apple/Microsoft sign-in fails locally", "configure OAuth for local dev", or any task involving OAuth callback URLs with portless domains.
description_zh: 配置 OAuth 提供商（如 Google、Apple、Microsoft、Facebook、GitHub 等）以与无端口本地开发 URL 配合使用。在设置 OAuth 重定向 URI、修复 "redirect_uri_mismatch" 或 "invalid redirect" 错误、为本地开发配置登录提供商，或当提供商拒绝 .localhost 子域时使用。触发条件包括 "OAuth 无端口无法工作"、"重定向 URI 不匹配"、"Google/Apple/Microsoft 本地登录失败"、"为本地开发配置 OAuth"，或任何涉及无端口域的 OAuth 回调 URL 的任务。

name: fetch
description: Use this skill when the user wants to retrieve a URL without a full browser session: fetch HTML or JSON from static pages, inspect status codes or headers, follow redirects, or get page source for simple scraping. Prefer it over a browser when JavaScript rendering and page interaction are not needed. Supports proxies and redirect control.
description_zh: 当用户需要在不启动完整浏览器会话的情况下获取 URL 时，请使用此技能：从静态页面获取 HTML 或 JSON，检查状态码或请求头，跟随重定向，或获取页面源代码以进行简单的抓取。当不需要 JavaScript 渲染和页面交互时，优先使用它代替浏览器。支持代理和重定向控制。

name: muapi-cinema-director
description: Direct high-fidelity cinematic video with AI — translates creative intent into technical cinematographic directives for Veo3, Kling, and Luma video models via muapi.ai

name: data-context-extractor
description:
Generate or improve a company-specific data analysis skill by extracting tribal knowledge from analysts.
BOOTSTRAP MODE - Triggers: "Create a data context skill", "Set up data analysis for our warehouse", "Help me create a skill for our database", "Generate a data skill for [company]" → Discovers schemas, asks key questions, generates initial skill with reference files
ITERATION MODE - Triggers: "Add context about [domain]", "The skill needs more info about [topic]", "Update the data skill with [metrics/tables/terminology]", "Improve the [domain] reference" → Loads existing skill, asks targeted questions, appends/updates reference files
Use when data analysts want Claude to understand their company's specific data warehouse, terminology, metrics definitions, and common query patterns.
description_zh:
通过从分析师处提取部落知识来生成或改进公司特定的数据分析技能。  
**自举模式** - 触发条件："创建数据上下文技能"、"为我们的仓库设置数据分析"、"帮我为我们的数据库创建技能"、"为[公司]生成数据技能" → 发现模式，提出关键问题，参考文件生成初始技能  
**迭代模式** - 触发条件："关于[领域]添加上下文"、"技能需要更多关于[主题]的信息"、"使用[指标/表格/术语]更新数据技能"、"改进[领域]参考" → 加载现有技能，提出针对性问题，追加/更新参考文件  
当数据分析师希望Claude理解他们公司特定的数据仓库、术语、指标定义和常见查询模式时使用。

name: m14-mental-model
description: Use when learning Rust concepts. Keywords: mental model, how to think about ownership, understanding borrow checker, visualizing memory layout, analogy, misconception, explaining ownership, why does Rust, help me understand, confused about, learning Rust, explain like I'm, ELI5, intuition for, coming from Java, coming from Python, 心智模型, 如何理解所有权, 学习 Rust, Rust 入门, 为什么 Rust
description_zh: 在学习 Rust 概念时使用。关键词：心智模型、如何理解所有权、理解借用检查器、可视化内存布局、类比、误解、解释所有权、为什么 Rust、帮助我理解、感到困惑、学习 Rust、像我对...解释、ELI5、直觉、来自 Java、来自 Python、心智模型、如何理解所有权、学习 Rust、Rust 入门、为什么 Rust

name: qwen-coder
description: Provides Qwen Coder CLI delegation workflows for coding tasks using Qwen2.5-Coder and QwQ models, including English prompt formulation, execution flags, and safe result handling. Use when the user explicitly asks to use Qwen for tasks such as code generation, refactoring, debugging, or architectural analysis. Triggers on "use qwen", "use qwen coder", "delegate to qwen", "ask qwen", "second opinion from qwen", "qwen opinion", "continue with qwen", "qwen session".
description_zh: 提供使用Qwen2.5-Coder和QwQ模型进行编码任务的Qwen Coder CLI委托工作流程，包括英文提示词的制定、执行标志以及安全结果处理。当用户明确要求使用Qwen执行代码生成、重构、调试或架构分析等任务时使用。在"使用qwen"、"使用qwen coder"、"委托给qwen"、"询问qwen"、"qwen的第二意见"、"qwen的意见"、"继续使用qwen"、"qwen会话"等情况下触发。

name: browser-trace
description: Capture a full DevTools-protocol trace of any browser automation — CDP firehose, screenshots, and DOM dumps — then bisect the stream into per-page searchable buckets. Use when the user wants to debug a failed run, audit network/console/DOM activity, attach a trace to an in-progress session, or feed structured per-page summaries back into an agent loop so its next iteration learns from the last one.
description_zh: 捕获任何浏览器自动化操作的完整 DevTools-protocol 跟踪记录——包括 CDP 数据流、屏幕截图和 DOM 快照——然后将数据流按页面分割成可搜索的独立桶。当用户需要调试失败的操作、审计网络/控制台/DOM 活动时使用，或者将跟踪记录附加到正在进行的会话中，或者将按页面的结构化摘要反馈回代理循环，以便其下一次迭代能从上一次中学习。

name: dx-devops-work-item-manage
description: Use this skill to manage the full lifecycle of DevOps Center work items — list, create, update, commit changes, perform status transitions, and create pull requests. Update fields like subject, description, and status. Commit and push code changes to work item branches. Create pull requests for work item branches via DevOps Center API. Invoke when the user wants to track, find, create, or update a work item, commit changes to a work item branch, advance a work item's status through the pipeline, or create a pull request for code review. Consolidates sf devops work-item and review operations. DO NOT TRIGGER for promotion or deployment operations, or conflict detection.
description_zh: 使用此技能来管理 DevOps Center 工作项的完整生命周期——列出、创建、更新、提交更改、执行状态转换以及创建拉取请求。更新主题、描述和状态等字段。将代码更改提交并推送到工作项分支。通过 DevOps Center API 为工作项分支创建拉取请求。当用户想要跟踪、查找、创建或更新工作项、向工作项分支提交更改、通过管道推进工作项状态或为代码审查创建拉取请求时触发。整合 sf devops 工作项和审查操作。禁止在晋升或部署操作，或冲突检测时触发。

name: experience-ui-bundle-project-generate
description: Generates a minimal, ready-to-develop SFDX starter project from template instead of hand-scaffolding files. Use this skill when starting a brand-new Salesforce UI bundle app (React or Angular) and the initial project must be scaffolded — trigger phrases include create, start, or scaffold a new UI bundle app, generate a starter project, or use a prebuilt/starter template. DO NOT TRIGGER when: editing, styling, or adding pages or components to an EXISTING app (use experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate); configuring ui-bundle.json or metadata files (use experience-ui-bundle-metadata-generate); deploying to an org (use experience-ui-bundle-deploy); when the user explicitly says they want to hand-scaffold from scratch; or when creating a brand-new standalone Salesforce project that also needs full setup — relocating the session, connecting an org, setting the default, and enabling source tracking (use dx-project-create in the salesforce-development plugin).
description_zh: 从模板生成一个最小化、可直接用于开发的SFDX启动项目，而不是手动创建脚手架文件。在开始一个全新的Salesforce UI组件应用（React或Angular）且初始项目必须进行脚手架操作时使用此技能——触发短语包括“创建”、“开始”或“脚手架一个新的UI组件应用”、“生成启动项目”，或使用预构建/启动模板。以下情况不触发：编辑、样式化或向现有应用添加页面或组件（使用experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate）；配置ui-bundle.json或元数据文件（使用experience-ui-bundle-metadata-generate）；部署到组织（使用experience-ui-bundle-deploy）；当用户明确表示他们想从零开始手动创建脚手架；或当创建一个全新的独立Salesforce项目且也需要完整设置时——迁移会话、连接组织、设置默认值和启用源跟踪（使用salesforce-development插件中的dx-project-create）。

name: local-seo
description: Audit a Google Business Profile, compare it to local competitors, and map Maps visibility around a location.
description_zh: 审查谷歌商家资料，将其与本地竞争对手进行比较，并绘制该地点在地图上的可见性。

name: ip-as-logo
description: Generate extremely simple, cute, personified square character images with rounded heavy forms, two purposeful character colors, one solid background color, and a dominant lower-corner composition. Use when creating an animal, creature, robot, ghost, plant, object, or other character image, including when the agent should infer three product-relevant directions and propose six independent candidates for approval.

name: paseo-advisor
description: Spin up a single agent as an advisor — second opinion on the current task. Use when the user says "advisor", "second opinion", "what does X think", or wants an outside take without delegating the work itself.
description_zh: 启动单个代理作为顾问——对当前任务的第二意见。当用户说“顾问”、“第二意见”、“X会怎么想”，或想获得外部看法而不想亲自分配工作时使用。

name: design-review
description: Designer Who Codes: visual audit then fixes with atomic commits and before/after screenshots. Useful for tightening shipped UI before launch.
description_zh: 代码设计师：先进行视觉审核，然后通过原子提交和前后截图进行修复。适用于发布前优化已发布的UI。

name: breadth-chart-analyst
description: This skill should be used when analyzing market breadth charts, specifically the S&P 500 Breadth Index (200-Day MA based) and the US Stock Market Uptrend Stock Ratio charts. Use this skill when the user provides breadth chart images for analysis, requests market breadth assessment, positioning strategy recommendations, or wants to understand medium-term strategic and short-term tactical market outlook based on breadth indicators. All analysis and output are conducted in English.
description_zh: 此技能应在分析市场广度图表时使用，特别是基于200日移动平均线的标普500广度指数（S&P 500 Breadth Index）和美国股市上升趋势股票比率（U.S. Stock Market Uptrend Stock Ratio）图表。当用户提供用于分析的广度图表图像、请求市场广度评估、定位策略建议，或希望基于广度指标了解中短期战略和短期战术市场展望时，应使用此技能。所有分析和输出均以英文进行。

name: excalidraw-diagram
description: Generate Excalidraw diagrams from text content. Supports three output modes - Obsidian (.md), Standard (.excalidraw), and Animated (.excalidraw with animation order). Triggers on "Excalidraw", "画图", "流程图", "思维导图", "可视化", "diagram", "标准Excalidraw", "standard excalidraw", "Excalidraw动画", "动画图", "animate".
description_zh: 从文本内容生成 Excalidraw 图表。支持三种输出模式 - Obsidian (.md)、标准 (.excalidraw) 和动画 (.excalidraw 带动画顺序)。在以下关键词触发时启动："Excalidraw"、"画图"、"流程图"、"思维导图"、"可视化"、"diagram"、"标准Excalidraw"、"standard excalidraw"、"Excalidraw动画"、"动画图"、"animate"。

name: create-game-assets
description: Plan, generate, source, normalize, and validate cohesive visual game assets. Use for art direction, style bibles, sprites, tilesets, backgrounds, UI art, icons, textures, concept art, or 3D asset briefs.
description_zh: 规划、生成、获取、标准化和验证连贯的视觉游戏资源。用于艺术指导、风格手册、精灵、瓦片集、背景、UI 艺术图标、纹理、概念艺术或 3D 资源简报。

name: learn
description: Interactive lesson tutor for the AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum. Reads LEARNING.md, fetches the next lesson, teaches it section by section in the terminal, quizzes at the end, and records progress. Works cloned or entirely over raw.githubusercontent.com — no setup required. Trigger phrases: "next lesson", "teach me", "continue the course", "let's learn", "resume learning"
description_zh: AI工程从零开始的互动式课程导师。读取LEARNING.md文件，获取下一课内容，在终端中分章节进行教学，课后进行测验，并记录学习进度。支持从克隆的仓库或直接从raw.githubusercontent.com获取内容——无需设置。触发短语："下一课"、"教我"、"继续课程"、"让我们学习"、"恢复学习"

name: runbook
description: Create or update an operational runbook for a recurring task or procedure. Use when documenting a task that on-call or ops needs to run repeatably, turning tribal knowledge into exact step-by-step commands, adding troubleshooting and rollback steps to an existing procedure, or writing escalation paths for when things go wrong.
