不要用于简单的名词解释（用户只是问"XX是什么"）、不要用于公众号写作（那个用khazix-writer）、不要用于纯标题摘要生成（用wechat-title）。

name: ui-test
description: AI-powered adversarial UI testing via the browse CLI. Analyzes git diffs to test only what changed, or explores the full app to find bugs. Tests functional correctness, accessibility, responsive layout, and UX heuristics. Use when the user asks to test UI changes, QA a pull request, audit accessibility, or run exploratory testing. Supports local browser (localhost) and remote Browserbase (deployed sites).
description_zh: 通过浏览器的 CLI 实现人工智能驱动的对抗式 UI 测试。分析 git 差异，仅测试变更内容，或探索完整应用程序以发现错误。测试功能正确性、可访问性、响应式布局和用户体验启发式规则。当用户要求测试 UI 变更、审核拉取请求、审计可访问性或运行探索性测试时使用。支持本地浏览器（localhost）和远程 Browserbase（已部署站点）。

name: sales-agentforce-pipeline-management-configure
description: Use to configure, set up, or repair the Sales Management agent and Agentforce Pipeline Management in a Salesforce org. Automates metadata creation for flows, prompt templates, permission sets, and data source configuration. TRIGGER when: user wants to enable Pipeline Management, configure Sales pipeline features, set up the Sales Management agent for opportunity field updates (including autonomous updates), connect enabled data sources like Einstein Conversation Insights or Einstein Activity Capture, customize opportunity stage descriptions, configure post-meeting suggestions, verify or audit configuration status, fix partially configured orgs, or troubleshoot Pipeline Management metadata issues. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to build a custom agent (use agentforce-generate), configure general Agentforce tracing (use platform-tracing-agentforce-configure), work with non-Sales agents, or enable Einstein Conversation Insights or Einstein Activity Capture from scratch (provisioning is out of scope).
description_zh: 用于配置、设置或修复 Salesforce 组织中的销售管理代理和 Agentforce 流程管理。自动化流程、提示模板、权限集和数据源配置的元数据创建。触发条件：当用户需要启用流程管理、配置销售流程功能、为机会字段更新设置销售管理代理（包括自主更新）、连接已启用数据源（如 Einstein Conversation Insights 或 Einstein Activity Capture）、自定义机会阶段描述、配置会议后建议、验证或审计配置状态、修复部分配置的组织或解决流程管理元数据问题时。不触发条件：当用户需要构建自定义代理（使用 agentforce-generate）、配置通用 Agentforce 追踪（使用 platform-tracing-agentforce-configure）、与非销售代理合作，或从零启用 Einstein Conversation Insights 或 Einstein Activity Capture（配置范围之外）时。

name: stock-liquidity
description: Analyze how liquid a stock is using Yahoo Finance data (yfinance): bid-ask spreads, volume and dollar volume (ADTV), top-of-book and options depth, square-root market impact and slippage estimates, turnover ratio, and Amihud illiquidity, rolled into a liquidity grade. Use this skill whenever the user asks about liquidity or trading costs — how easily a position can be entered or exited, what a large order would do to the price, spread or execution-cost estimates, order book depth, volume patterns, or liquidity comparisons — especially for small caps, penny stocks, and thinly traded names.
description_zh: 使用Yahoo Finance数据（yfinance）分析股票的流动性：包括买卖价差、成交量、美元成交量（ADTV）、买卖盘深度、平方根市场冲击和滑点估计、换手率以及Amihud流动性指标，并将其整合为流动性等级。当用户询问流动性或交易成本时，请使用此技能——包括进入或退出头寸的便利性、大额订单对价格、价差或执行成本估计的影响、订单簿深度、成交量模式或流动性比较——尤其适用于小盘股、分时股和交易不活跃的股票。

name: roblox-datastores
description: Persist player data in Roblox with DataStoreService: GetDataStore, GetAsync/ SetAsync/UpdateAsync/IncrementAsync wrapped in pcall, load-on-join and save-on-leave plus BindToClose, retries, and OrderedDataStore leaderboards. Use when saving or loading persistent data in a Roblox experience — when the user mentions DataStore, DataStoreService, GetAsync, SetAsync, UpdateAsync, save player data, or leaderboards. For general Luau scripting use roblox-luau.
description_zh: 使用 DataStoreService 在 Roblox 中持久化玩家数据：使用 pcall 包裹 GetDataStore、GetAsync/ SetAsync/UpdateAsync/IncrementAsync，结合加入时加载（load-on-join）和离开时保存（save-on-leave），以及 BindToClose、重试机制和 OrderedDataStore 排行榜。在 Roblox 体验中保存或加载持久化数据时使用——当用户提及 DataStore、DataStoreService、GetAsync、SetAsync、UpdateAsync、保存玩家数据或排行榜时。一般 Luau 脚本编写请使用 roblox-luau。

name: jobkorea-talent-search
description: 잡코리아 기업회원 로그인 세션으로 유료 열람 전 마스킹된 인재 이력서를 검색·비교해 채용 검토용 shortlist를 만듭니다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 使用 잡코리아 企业会员登录会话，在付费阅览前对已屏蔽的人才简历进行搜索和比较，以创建用于招聘审核的 shortlist。在 돌쇠 上，将通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: close-management
description: Manage the month-end close process with task sequencing, dependencies, and status tracking. Use when planning the close calendar, tracking close progress, identifying blockers, or sequencing close activities by day.
description_zh: 使用任务排序、依赖关系和状态跟踪来管理月末结账流程。在规划结账日历、跟踪结账进度、识别阻碍因素或按天排序结账活动时使用。

name: openspec-ff-change
description: Fast-forward through OpenSpec artifact creation. Use when the user wants to quickly create all artifacts needed for implementation without stepping through each one individually. Also use when the user says "openspec ff" or "opsx ff".
description_zh: 快速跳过OpenSpec工件创建过程。当用户希望快速创建所有实施所需的工件，而无需逐个步骤操作时使用。同样适用于用户输入"openspec ff"或"opsx ff"的情况。

name: product-strategy-session
description: Run an end-to-end product strategy session across positioning, discovery, and roadmap planning. Use when a team needs validated direction before committing to execution.
description_zh: 运行端到端的产品策略会议，涵盖定位、发现和路线图规划。在团队在执行前需要验证方向时使用。

name: rust-trait-explorer
description: Explore Rust trait implementations using LSP. Triggers on: /trait-impl, find implementations, who implements, trait 实现, 谁实现了, 实现了哪些trait
description_zh: 使用 LSP 探索 Rust 特性实现。触发条件：/trait-impl、查找实现、谁实现了、特性实现、谁实现了、实现了哪些特性

name: msbuild-antipatterns
description: Detect and fix MSBuild anti-patterns in project and build files. USE WHEN asked to review, audit, lint, clean up, or code-review a .csproj/.vbproj/.fsproj/.props/.targets/.proj (or Directory.Build.props/.targets) file, when asked 'is this project file correct?' or 'what's wrong with my build file?', or when hunting subtle build bugs caused by how a project is authored. Each anti-pattern has a symptom and a concrete BAD→GOOD fix. DO NOT USE FOR: non-MSBuild build systems (npm, Maven, CMake), or migrating a project to SDK-style (use msbuild-modernization).
description_zh: 检测并修复项目及构建文件中的 MSBuild 反模式。在以下情况下使用：被要求评审、审计、格式化、清理或代码审查 .csproj/.vbproj/.fsproj/.props/.targets/.proj（或 Directory.Build.props/.targets）文件，当被问及“这个项目文件是否正确？”或“我的构建文件有什么问题？”时，或当追踪由项目编写方式引起的微妙构建错误时。每个反模式都包含一个症状和一个具体的 BAD→GOOD 修复方案。不适用于：非 MSBuild 构建系统（npm、Maven、CMake），或迁移项目到 SDK 风格（请使用 msbuild-modernization）。

name: shopify-shopifyql
description: Answer a merchant's **analytics and reporting** questions with **ShopifyQL** — Shopify's query language for aggregated store metrics that the Admin GraphQL API cannot compute. Choose this (not `admin`) whenever the ask is for **numbers, totals, trends, or breakdowns** rather than fetching or mutating individual records: including but not limited to total/gross/net sales and revenue, order counts, average order value, refunds, quantity sold, sessions, conversion rate, and traffic — sliced by product, channel, region, or customer, trended over time, or compared period-over-period. Examples: "total sales last 7 days", "orders by sales channel this month", "top products by revenue", "conversion rate this week", "sales this year vs last year". This topic covers writing the ShopifyQL query; if the merchant wants to run it against their store, execution is handed off to `use-shopify-cli`. Not for general Admin GraphQL record operations — fetching or mutating individual resources (use `admin`).
description_zh: 用 **ShopifyQL** 回答商家的 **分析和报告** 问题——Shopify 的聚合商店指标查询语言，Admin GraphQL API 无法计算。当询问的是 **数字、总额、趋势或细分** 而不是获取或修改单个记录时，请选择此选项（而不是 `admin`）：包括但不限于总销售额/毛利/净利润、订单数量、平均订单价值、退款、销售数量、会话数、转化率、流量——按产品、渠道、地区或客户进行细分，随时间趋势变化，或进行同期比较。例如："过去7天的总销售额"、"本月按销售渠道的订单"、"按收入排名的前端产品"、"本周的转化率"、"今年与去年的销售额"。本主题涵盖编写 ShopifyQL 查询；如果商家想将其应用于自己的商店，执行将交由 `use-shopify-cli` 处理。不适用于一般 Admin GraphQL 记录操作——获取或修改单个资源（请使用 `admin`）。

name: show-me-your-work
description: Keep a reviewable decision trail for long-running or unattended work: a TSV log with one row per decision (what, why, evidence, result). Local by default; commit it when a reviewer needs the trail to trust the result. Use for /show-me-your-work, autonomous or multi-phase runs, or work a human reviews after stepping away.
description_zh: 为长时间运行或无人值守的工作保留可审查的决策记录：使用TSV日志，每行记录一个决策（决策内容、原因、依据、结果）。默认本地保存；当审查者需要记录以信任结果时提交。适用于“展示你的工作成果”、自主运行或多阶段运行，或人类在离开后审查的工作。

name: customer-journey-map
description: Create an end-to-end customer journey map with stages, touchpoints, emotions, pain points, and opportunities. Use when mapping the customer experience, identifying friction points, improving onboarding, or visualizing the user journey.
description_zh: 创建一个包含阶段、触点、情绪、痛点和发展机会的端到端客户旅程图。在绘制客户体验、识别摩擦点、改进引导流程或可视化用户旅程时使用。

name: course-guide
description: Topic router for the AI Engineering from Scratch curriculum. Give it a topic, a question, or a bug you are fighting, and it points at the exact lessons that teach it, plus the right next command. Trigger phrases: "where do I learn", "which lesson covers", "course guide", "I'm stuck on", "what should I do next", "teach me MCP", "teach me Agent Skills", "where do I prepare for a Claude certification"
description_zh: AI工程从零开始的课程主题路由器。输入一个主题、问题或你正在解决的bug，它将指向相关的具体课程，并提供正确的下一步指令。触发短语："我在哪里学习"、"哪个课程涵盖"、"课程指南"、"我卡住了"、"我应该做什么"、"教我MCP"、"教我代理技能"、"我在哪里准备Claude认证"。

name: framer-motion
description: Expert guidelines for building performant animations with Framer Motion/Motion library in React applications
description_zh: 使用 Framer Motion/Motion 库在 React 应用中构建高性能动画的专业指南

name: kanchi-dividend-us-tax-accounting
description: Provide US dividend tax and account-location workflow for Kanchi-style income portfolios. Use when users ask about qualified vs ordinary dividends, 1099-DIV interpretation, REIT/BDC distribution treatment, holding-period checks, or taxable-vs-IRA account placement decisions for dividend assets.
description_zh: 为 Kanchi 风格的收益型投资组合提供美国股息税收及账户配置的工作流程。当用户询问合格股息与普通股息、1099-DIV 表格的解读、REIT/BDC 分配税处理、持有期检查，或关于股息资产在应税账户与 IRA 账户之间的配置决策时，请调用此流程。

name: code-review-skill
description:
Provides comprehensive code review guidance for React 19, Vue 3, Angular 17+, Svelte 5,
Rust, TypeScript, Java, Java 8, PHP, Ruby, Rails, Python, Django, FastAPI, Go, C#/.NET, Kotlin, Swift,
Dart, Flutter, NestJS, C/C++, Zig, CSS/Less/Sass, Qt, and more.
Covers architecture review, performance review, security audit, code quality anti-patterns,
and common bugs across all ecosystems.
Use when: reviewing pull requests, conducting PR reviews, code review, reviewing code changes,
establishing review standards, mentoring developers, architecture reviews, security audits,
performance reviews, checking code quality, finding bugs, giving feedback on code.

name: openspec-onboard
description: Guided onboarding for OpenSpec - walk through a complete workflow cycle with narration and real codebase work. Also use when the user says "openspec onboard" or "opsx onboard".
description_zh: OpenSpec 的引导入职 - 通过语音解说和实际代码库操作，带您完成整个工作流程循环。当用户输入“openspec onboard”或“opsx onboard”时，也可使用此功能。

name: pencilkit
description: Add Apple Pencil drawing with PKCanvasView, PKToolPicker, PKDrawing serialization/export, stroke inspection, and PencilKit/PaperKit handoffs. Use when building drawing apps, annotation features, handwriting capture, signature fields, content-version-safe ink workflows, or Apple Pencil-powered experiences on iOS/iPadOS/visionOS.
description_zh: 添加 Apple Pencil 绘图功能，支持 PKCanvasView、PKToolPicker、PKDrawing 的序列化/导出、笔触检查，以及 PencilKit/PaperKit 的无缝切换。适用于构建绘图应用、标注功能、手写捕捉、签名字段、内容版本安全的墨迹工作流，或在 iOS/iPadOS/visionOS 上提供 Apple Pencil 驱动的体验。

name: academic-writing
description: Scholarly writing and research compliance. Use for CRediT, preregistration, Plan S, Nelson Memo, preprints, ORCID, LLM disclosure.
description_zh: 学术写作与研究合规性。适用于CRediT、预注册、Plan S、Nelson备忘录、预印本、ORCID、LLM披露。

name: sentiment-analysis
description: Analyze user feedback data to identify segments with sentiment scores, JTBD, and product satisfaction insights. Use when analyzing user feedback at scale, running sentiment analysis on reviews or surveys, or identifying satisfaction patterns.
description_zh: 分析用户反馈数据，以识别具有情感分数、JTBD（用户任务完成情况）和产品满意度洞察的细分群体。适用于大规模分析用户反馈、对评论或调查进行情感分析，或识别满意度模式。

name: data-quality-checker
description: Validate data quality in market analysis documents and blog articles before publication. Use when checking for price scale inconsistencies (ETF vs futures), instrument notation errors, date/day-of-week mismatches, allocation total errors, and unit mismatches. Supports English and Japanese content. Advisory mode -- flags issues as warnings for human review, not as blockers.
description_zh: 在发布前，验证市场分析文档和博客文章中的数据质量。用于检查价格尺度不一致（ETF与期货）、指标符号错误、日期/星期几不匹配、分配总额错误以及单位不匹配等问题。支持英语和日语内容。建议模式——将问题标记为警告供人工审核，而非阻断。

name: ftd-detector
description: Detects Follow-Through Day (FTD) signals for market bottom confirmation using William O'Neil's methodology. Dual-index tracking (S&P 500 + NASDAQ) with state machine for rally attempt, FTD qualification, and post-FTD health monitoring. Use when user asks about market bottom signals, follow-through days, rally attempts, re-entry timing after corrections, or whether it's safe to increase equity exposure. Complementary to market-top-detector (defensive) - this skill is offensive (bottom confirmation).
description_zh: 使用威廉·欧奈尔的方法检测跟进日（FTD）信号以确认市场底部。采用双指数跟踪（标普500 + 纳斯达克）并结合状态机，用于反弹尝试、FTD资格认证以及FTD后的健康状况监测。当用户询问市场底部信号、跟进日、反弹尝试、修正后的重新入场时机，或增加股票仓位是否安全时使用。与市场顶部检测器（防御性）互补——此技能为进攻性（底部确认）。

name: forecast
description: Generate the commit / best-case / pipeline narrative for a forecast call or a 1:1 with your manager - what's closing, what's at risk, what changed since last time. Use when the user asks "write my forecast", "forecast narrative", "prep for forecast call", "prep for my quarterly forecast call", "which deals should I commit vs. call upside", "forecast from this pipeline export", or "prep for my 1:1 with my manager".
description_zh: 为预测通话或与经理的一对一会议生成提交/最佳情况/流程说明——哪些即将完成，哪些存在风险，自上次以来有哪些变化。当用户询问“写我的预测”、“预测说明”、“准备预测通话”、“准备我的季度预测通话”、“哪些交易我应该提交而不是呼叫上行”、“从此管道导出的预测”或“准备我与经理的一对一会议”时使用。

name: openspec-new-change
description: Start a new OpenSpec change using the experimental artifact workflow. Use when the user wants to create a new feature, fix, or modification with a structured step-by-step approach. Also use when the user says "openspec new change" or "opsx new".
description_zh: 使用实验性工件工作流启动一个新的 OpenSpec 变更。当用户希望以结构化的分步方式创建新功能、修复或修改时使用。也适用于用户输入“openspec new change”或“opsx new”时。

name: unity-navmesh
description: Add AI navigation in Unity 6.3 LTS: bake a NavMesh with the AI Navigation package (NavMeshSurface), move agents with NavMeshAgent.SetDestination, and handle dynamic obstacles. Use when setting up pathfinding, making an enemy chase the player, baking navigation, or when the user mentions NavMesh, NavMeshAgent, NavMeshSurface, NavMeshObstacle, or Unity pathfinding.
description_zh: 在 Unity 6.3 LTS 中添加 AI 导航：使用 AI 导航包（NavMeshSurface）烘焙一个 NavMesh，通过 NavMeshAgent.SetDestination 移动智能体，并处理动态障碍物。在设置路径规划、让敌人追击玩家、烘焙导航，或用户提及 NavMesh、NavMeshAgent、NavMeshSurface、NavMeshObstacle 或 Unity 路径规划时使用。

name: frontend-skill
description: Create visually strong landing pages, websites, and app UIs with restrained composition. OpenAI's production frontend playbook.
description_zh: 使用简洁的构图创建视觉冲击力强的着陆页、网站和应用程序界面。OpenAI 的前端生产手册。

name: pi-delegate
description: Delegate a coding task to the Pi coding agent CLI (`pi`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to delegate implementation work to Pi - phrasings like "have Pi implement X", "delegate this to pi", "run it through Pi", or "use pi to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Pi while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委派给 Pi 编码代理命令行工具（`pi`），以作为后台实现者执行；随后审查其生成的代码差异（diff）并自行完成合并落地。当用户希望将实现工作委派给 Pi 时（例如表述为“让 Pi 实现 X”、“将此任务委派给 pi”、“通过 Pi 执行”或“使用 pi 来实现/修复/重构”），或希望将一组编码任务队列通过 Pi 运行，同时自己担任审查者时，请使用此方法。若任务足够小、可内联完成，或用户希望直接编写代码而无需委派，则不要使用此方法。

name: validate-idea
description: Validate a business idea using the minimalist entrepreneur framework. Use when someone has a business idea and wants to test if it's worth pursuing before building anything.
description_zh: 使用极简创业者框架验证商业想法。适用于有人拥有商业想法，但在构建任何东西之前想要测试其是否值得追求的情况。

name: principle-experience-first
description: Apply when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up. Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer polished features over more rough ones.
description_zh: 当出现产品、用户体验或功能范围权衡时，请应用。选择用户满意度而非实现便利性；选择较少的精良功能而非更多的粗糙功能。

name: ce-strategy
description: Create or update STRATEGY.md. Use when starting a product, adding a strategy doc, or changing direction or roadmap.
description_zh: 创建或更新 STRATEGY.md。在启动产品、添加策略文档或改变方向或路线图时使用。

name: shannon
description: Autonomous AI pentester for web apps and APIs. Run white-box security assessments with Shannon — analyzes source code, identifies attack vectors, and executes real exploits to prove vulnerabilities. Triggered by 'shannon', 'pentest', 'security audit', 'vuln scan'.

name: ima-dai-sdk
description: Integrates the Google Interactive Media Ads (IMA) Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) SDK into websites, web apps, mobile apps, or TV apps. Use when: - A video player needs to load and play HLS or DASH streams in web apps, Android apps, iOS apps, tvOS apps, Cast (CAF) receivers, or Roku channels. - The app needs to make use of a Google DAI livestream event asset key, or content source CMS ID, video ID for video on demand. Don't use this skill to load and play a VAST or VMAP URL.
description_zh: 将 Google 互动媒体广告 (IMA) 动态广告插入 (DAI) SDK 集成到网站、网络应用、移动应用或电视应用中。使用场景：- 视频播放器需要在网络应用、Android 应用、iOS 应用、tvOS 应用、Cast (CAF) 接收器或 Roku 频道中加载并播放 HLS 或 DASH 流。- 应用需要使用 Google DAI 直播流事件资产密钥，或内容源 CMS ID，或点播视频的视频 ID。不要使用此功能来加载和播放 VAST 或 VMAP URL。

name: kill-ai-slop
description: Find and remove AI slop — the generic, machine-default visual and copy tics of vibe-coded products — from a web project. Use when the user asks to "kill AI slop", "de-slop", "remove the AI look", "make this not look AI-generated", or clean up a landing page / UI / docs that feels templated. Detects and fixes the catalogue of tells: indigo→violet gradients, gradient-clip headlines, the default semantic palette, one-hue status boxes, atmospheric gradients, serif-italic emphasis, highlighted keywords, AI copywriting voice ("not just X — it's Y"), emoji everywhere, glowing status dots, wobbling spinners, colored-left-border callouts, pastel icon tiles, glassmorphism, over-rounding, oversized shadows, borders that die at corners, badge & pill spam, AI-drawn SVG icons, kickers over every heading, flat type hierarchies, invented stat rows, 01/02/03 section markers, cards nested in cards, the default Inter/Space Grotesk look, and more. Works on HTML/CSS, React/Vue/Svelte/Astro, Tailwind, PHP, and Markdown copy.
description_zh: 从网络项目中查找并移除AI冗余——即那些具有氛围感产品的通用机器默认视觉和文本特征——使用场景包括：当用户要求“清除AI冗余”、“去除冗余感”、“去除AI风格”、“让这个看起来不是AI生成的”，或清理感觉像模板化的着陆页/UI/文档时。检测并修复一系列特征：靛蓝转紫渐变、渐变裁剪标题、默认语义调色板、单色状态框、氛围渐变、衬线斜体强调、高亮关键词、AI文案风格（“不只是X——而是Y”）、满屏表情符号、发光状态点、晃动加载器、彩色左边界标注、粉彩图标瓦片、玻璃态效果、过度圆润、超大阴影、边角消失的边框、徽章与药丸泛滥、AI绘制的SVG图标、每个标题上的装饰文字、扁平化层级、虚构的统计行、01/02/03章节标记、卡片嵌套卡片、默认的Inter/Space Grotesk外观，以及更多。支持HTML/CSS、React/Vue/Svelte/Astro、Tailwind、PHP和Markdown文案。

name: google-cloud-filestore-autoscale
description: Inspects Google Cloud Filestore capacity and utilization, evaluates storage scaling rules, and performs capacity autoscaling (scale UP for low free space or scale DOWN for cost optimization). Use when monitoring Filestore instance headroom, resizing instance shares, configuring automated growth/shrink thresholds (custom thresholds apply globally across projects in session memory), or preventing out-of-space outages. Don't use for Cloud Storage (GCS) buckets, Persistent Disk block storage, or NetApp Volumes.
description_zh: 检查 Google Cloud Filestore 的容量和利用率，评估存储扩展规则，并执行容量自动扩展（低可用空间时扩展，为成本优化而缩减）。在监控 Filestore 实例的剩余空间、调整实例份额、配置自动增长/缩减阈值（自定义阈值在会话内存中全局应用于所有项目）或防止因空间不足导致的停机时使用。不适用于 Cloud Storage (GCS) 存储桶、持久磁盘块存储或 NetApp Volumes。

name: bun-development
description: Fast, modern JavaScript/TypeScript development with the Bun runtime, inspired by [oven-sh/bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun).
description_zh: 使用 Bun 运行时进行快速、现代的 JavaScript/TypeScript 开发，灵感来源于 [oven-sh/bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun)。

name: strategy-pivot-designer
description: Detect backtest iteration stagnation and generate structurally different strategy pivot proposals when parameter tuning reaches a local optimum.
description_zh: 检测回测迭代停滞，并在参数调优达到局部最优时生成结构不同的策略转向建议。

name: pixijs-rendering
description: Build a PixiJS v8 render layer: create the async Application, load textures with Assets, compose the scene graph with Container and Sprite, drive the ticker loop, wire pointer events, and group draws with render groups. Use when building or debugging PixiJS v8 — when the user mentions PixiJS, Pixi, Application, app.stage, Container, Sprite, Assets.load, app.ticker, or eventMode. Pins the v8 async init() API.
description_zh: 构建 PixiJS v8 渲染层：创建异步 Application，使用 Assets 加载纹理，通过 Container 和 Sprite 组合场景图，驱动 ticker 循环，连接指针事件，并使用渲染组分组绘制。在构建或调试 PixiJS v8 时使用——当用户提及 PixiJS、Pixi、Application、app.stage、Container、Sprite、Assets.load、app.ticker 或 eventMode 时。固定 v8 异步 init() API。

name: saju-fortune
description: 사주팔자 정보를 인터뷰로 확인한 뒤 saju-fortune npm package를 사용해 연애운, 재물운, 직업운, 건강운, 한해 운세, 궁합을 대화형으로 풀이한다.
description_zh: 在通过访谈确认了八字信息之后，将使用sa ju-fortune npm包，以对话形式解析爱情运、财运、事业运、健康运、全年运势以及匹配度。

name: arize-experiment
description: Creates, runs, and analyzes Arize experiments for evaluating and comparing model performance. Covers experiment CRUD, exporting runs, comparing results, and evaluation workflows using the ax CLI. Use when the user mentions create experiment, run experiment, compare models, model performance, evaluate AI, experiment results, benchmark, A/B test models, or measure accuracy.
description_zh: 创建、运行和分析 Arize 实验以评估和比较模型性能。涵盖实验的创建、读取、更新、删除（CRUD）、导出运行记录、比较结果以及使用 ax CLI 进行评估的工作流程。当用户提到创建实验、运行实验、比较模型、模型性能、评估 AI、实验结果、基准测试、A/B 测试模型或测量准确度时使用。

name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
description: Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design. Redesign as if the requirement had been a foundational assumption from day one, instead of bolting it on.
description_zh: 在将新需求整合到现有设计时应用此原则。不应简单地将新需求“附加”上去，而应重新设计整个系统，仿佛该需求从一开始就是基础假设之一。

name: saramin-talent-search
description: 사람인 기업회원 인재풀 로그인 세션에서 마스킹된 후보 정보를 검색·비교해 유료 열람 전 shortlist를 만듭니다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 在“企业会员人才库”登录会话中，搜索并比对已屏蔽的候选人信息，创建付费阅览前的shortlist。在Dolce中，则通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: copywriting-tone-of-voice-creator
description: Builds a brand tone of voice guide (TONE.md) — voice attributes with do's/don'ts, NN/g positioning, tone modulation matrix, lexicon, channel rules — for downstream content skills to consume. Also ports an existing TONE.md to a new channel (blog → LinkedIn, web → Twitter/X, in-product UI). Covers B2B SaaS, B2C/D2C, NGO, public sector, consulting, industrial, product-led, personal, and volunteering brands. Apply when the user wants to define or refresh a brand voice, port it to a new channel, or set up a content factory. Not for writing individual posts, articles, emails, or UI strings — use the dedicated writing skills. Not for SOUL.md, PROSE.md (samber/cc-skills@copywriting-prose-creator), or DESIGN.md.
description_zh: 构建品牌语气指南（TONE.md）——包含语气属性（应做/不应做）、NN/g定位、语气调节矩阵、词汇表、渠道规则——供下游内容技能使用。同时将现有的TONE.md迁移到新渠道（博客→领英，网站→推特/X，产品内UI）。涵盖B2B SaaS、B2C/D2C、NGO、公共部门、咨询、工业、产品驱动、个人和志愿服务品牌。当用户需要定义或更新品牌语气、将其迁移到新渠道或建立内容工厂时适用。不用于撰写单个帖子、文章、邮件或UI字符串——请使用专门的写作技能。不适用于SOUL.md、PROSE.md（samber/cc-skills@copywriting-prose-creator）或DESIGN.md。

name: openclaw-config
description: Manage OpenClaw bot configuration - channels, agents, security, and autopilot settings
description_zh: 管理 OpenClaw 机器人配置 - 频道、代理、安全和自动驾驶设置

name: call-prep
description: Prepare for a customer or prospect call using Common Room signals. Triggers on 'prep me for my call with [company]', 'prepare for a meeting with [company]', 'what should I know before talking to [company]', or any call preparation request.
description_zh: 使用 Common Room 信号准备与客户或潜在客户的通话。当触发“为我的与[公司]的通话做准备”、“为与[公司]的会议做准备”、“在与[公司]交谈之前我应该了解什么”或任何通话准备请求时，将触发该功能。

name: arize-dataset
description: Creates, manages, and queries Arize datasets and examples. Covers dataset CRUD, appending examples, exporting data, and file-based dataset creation using the ax CLI. Use when the user needs test data, evaluation examples, or mentions create dataset, list datasets, export dataset, append examples, dataset version, golden dataset, or test set.
description_zh: 创建、管理和查询 Arize 数据集和示例。涵盖数据集的 CRUD 操作、追加示例、导出数据以及使用 ax CLI 基于文件创建数据集。当用户需要测试数据、评估示例，或提及创建数据集、列出数据集、导出数据集、追加示例、数据集版本、黄金数据集或测试集时使用。

name: homekit
description: Control smart-home accessories and commission Matter devices using HomeKit and MatterSupport. Use when managing homes/rooms/accessories, creating action sets or triggers, reading accessory characteristics, onboarding Matter devices, or building a third-party smart-home ecosystem app.
description_zh: 使用 HomeKit 和 MatterSupport 控制智能家居配件并部署 Matter 设备。在管理家庭/房间/配件、创建操作集或触发器、读取配件特征、部署 Matter 设备或构建第三方智能家居生态系统应用时使用。

name: g2b-order-plan-search
description: 조달청 나라장터 발주계획현황서비스로 물품·공사·용역·외자 발주계획 목록을 검색한다. 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.
description_zh: 通过政府采购청的国家市场采购订单计划现状服务，可以搜索物品、工程、服务、外协的采购计划清单。在Dolseo，将尽可能地准备最接近合法正式阶段的条件。

name: finance-news
description: Market news briefings with AI summaries. Use when asked about stock news, market updates, portfolio performance, morning/evening briefings, financial headlines, or price alerts. Supports US/Europe/Japan markets, WhatsApp delivery, and English/German output.
description_zh: 使用AI摘要的市场新闻简报。当您询问股票新闻、市场更新、投资组合表现、晨间/晚间简报、财经头条或价格提醒时使用。支持美国/欧洲/日本市场、WhatsApp发送以及英文/德文输出。

name: carplay
description: Build CarPlay-enabled apps using the CarPlay framework. Use when creating navigation, audio, communication, EV charging, parking, or food ordering apps for the car display, working with CPTemplateApplicationScene, CPInterfaceController template hierarchies, CPListTemplate, CPMapTemplate, CPNowPlayingTemplate, configuring CarPlay entitlements, or integrating with CarPlay Simulator for testing.
description_zh: 使用 CarPlay 框架构建支持 CarPlay 的应用。适用于为车载显示屏创建导航、音频、通信、电动汽车充电、停车或点餐应用；使用 CPTemplateApplicationScene、CPInterfaceController 模板层级、CPListTemplate、CPMapTemplate、CPNowPlayingTemplate；配置 CarPlay 权限；或集成 CarPlay 模拟器进行测试。

name: openspec-bulk-archive-change
description: Archive multiple completed OpenSpec changes at once. Use when archiving several parallel changes. Also use for a plural archive request - "openspec bulk-archive", "opsx bulk-archive", "openspec archive all", or "openspec archive these changes".
description_zh: 一次性归档多个已完成的OpenSpec变更。适用于归档多个并行变更。也适用于复数归档请求 - "openspec bulk-archive"、"opsx bulk-archive"、"openspec archive all"或"openspec archive these changes"。

name: job-posting-match
description: 한국 구직자의 이력서·경력요약과 희망조건을 바탕으로 잡코리아·사람인 공개 채용공고를 검색하고 적합도와 지원 전략을 정리합니다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 根据韩国求职者的简历·经历总结和期望条件，搜索并整理出Jobkorea·Shinhappin公开招聘公告的匹配度和申请策略。在Dolce中，将通过官方渠道进行后续行动。

name: edge-candidate-agent
description: Generate and prioritize US equity long-side edge research tickets from EOD observations, then export pipeline-ready candidate specs for trade-strategy-pipeline Phase I. Use when users ask to turn hypotheses/anomalies into reproducible research tickets, convert validated ideas into `strategy.yaml` + `metadata.json`, or preflight-check interface compatibility (`edge-finder-candidate/v1`) before running pipeline backtests.
description_zh: 根据每日收盘观察结果生成并优先排序美国股票多头策略研究工单，然后导出适用于交易策略流水线第一阶段（Phase I）的候选规格。当用户需要将假设/异常转化为可复现的研究工单、将验证后的想法转换为`strategy.yaml` + `metadata.json`，或在运行流水线回测前进行接口兼容性预检（`edge-finder-candidate/v1`）时使用。

name: rust-call-graph
description: Visualize Rust function call graphs using LSP. Triggers on: /call-graph, call hierarchy, who calls, what calls, 调用图, 调用关系, 谁调用了, 调用了谁
description_zh: 使用LSP可视化Rust函数调用图。触发条件：/call-graph、调用层次结构、谁调用了、谁调用了、调用图、调用关系、谁调用了、调用了谁。

name: write-query
description: Write optimized SQL for your dialect with best practices. Use when translating a natural-language data need into SQL, building a multi-CTE query with joins and aggregations, optimizing a query against a large partitioned table, or getting dialect-specific syntax for Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, etc.
description_zh: 为您的方言编写优化的 SQL，并遵循最佳实践。在将自然语言数据需求翻译成 SQL、构建包含连接和聚合的多 CTE 查询、针对大型分区表优化查询，或获取 Snowflake、BigQuery、Postgres 等方言特定语法时使用。

name: financekit
description: Access eligible Wallet financial data using FinanceKit and FinanceKitUI. Use when querying transactions or balances, reading Apple Card, Apple Cash, Savings, or U.K. connected-account data, requesting financial-data authorization, using TransactionPicker, enabling iOS 26 background delivery, or saving and checking Wallet orders.
description_zh: 使用 FinanceKit 和 FinanceKitUI 访问符合条件的 Wallet 金融数据。适用于以下场景：查询交易或余额，读取 Apple Card、Apple Cash、储蓄或英国关联账户数据，请求金融数据授权，使用 TransactionPicker，启用 iOS 26 后台推送，以及保存和检查 Wallet 订单。

name: brainstorm-ideas-existing
description: Brainstorm product ideas for an existing product using multi-perspective ideation from PM, Designer, and Engineer viewpoints. Use when generating new feature ideas, brainstorming solutions for an identified opportunity, or ideating with a product trio.
description_zh: 从产品经理、设计师和工程师的多重视角进行头脑风暴，为现有产品构思新产品创意。当需要生成新的功能点子、针对已识别的机遇构思解决方案，或以产品三人组（Product Trio）形式开展创意构思时，可使用此方法。

name: pead-screener
description: Screen post-earnings gap-up stocks for PEAD (Post-Earnings Announcement Drift) patterns. Analyzes weekly candle formation to detect red candle pullbacks and breakout signals. Supports two input modes - FMP earnings calendar (Mode A) or earnings-trade-analyzer JSON output (Mode B). Use when user asks about PEAD screening, post-earnings drift, earnings gap follow-through, red candle breakout patterns, or weekly earnings momentum setups.
description_zh: 用于筛选PEAD（盈利公告后漂移）模式的屏幕后盈利价差上涨股票。分析每周K线形态，以检测红色K线回调和突破信号。支持两种输入模式 - FMP盈利日历（模式A）或盈利交易分析器JSON输出（模式B）。当用户询问关于PEAD筛选、后盈利漂移、盈利价差持续、红色K线突破模式或每周盈利动能设置时使用。

name: domain-cli
description: Use when building CLI tools. Keywords: CLI, command line, terminal, clap, structopt, argument parsing, subcommand, interactive, TUI, ratatui, crossterm, indicatif, progress bar, colored output, shell completion, config file, environment variable, 命令行, 终端应用, 参数解析
description_zh: 在构建命令行工具时使用。关键词：命令行界面（CLI）、命令行、终端、clap、structopt、参数解析、子命令、交互式、文本用户界面（TUI）、ratatui、crossterm、indicatif、进度条、彩色输出、shell自动补全、配置文件、环境变量、命令行、终端应用、参数解析

name: journal-entry-prep
description: Prepare journal entries with proper debits, credits, and supporting documentation for month-end close. Use when booking accruals, prepaid amortization, fixed asset depreciation, payroll entries, revenue recognition, or any manual journal entry.
description_zh: 在为月末结账编制记账凭证时，请确保借方、贷方金额准确，并附上完整的支撑文件。此场景适用于计提应计项目、摊销预付款项、计提固定资产折旧、记录工资分录、确认收入，或编制任何其他手工记账凭证。

name: code-testing-agent
description: ALWAYS USE whenever asked to write, add, or generate unit tests for existing code in xUnit, MSTest, NUnit, pytest, Vitest/Jest, Go, or another framework, including "tests only for" one helper, function, class, or missing regression case as well as project-wide suites. Also use for "cover this untested method", scaffolding tests where none exist, sparse workspaces, classic packages.config MSTest, and extending healthy suites. Focused requests use a proportional direct workflow; broad requests use the full pipeline. DO NOT USE for only running/diagnosing tests, coverage/audits, a test blocked on a missing production seam (testability-obstacle), or correcting supplied MSTest assertions, attributes, lifecycle, or configuration without designing new cases (writing-mstest-tests).
description_zh: 每次被要求为现有代码编写、添加或生成单元测试时，无论使用 xUnit、MSTest、NUnit、pytest、Vitest/Jest、Go 或其他框架，都应使用。这包括为单个辅助函数、类或遗漏的回归用例编写“仅测试”的用例，以及为整个项目编写测试套件。此外，在需要“覆盖这个未测试的方法”、搭建测试环境（在没有测试的情况下）、稀疏工作空间、经典 packages.config MSTest 以及扩展健康的测试套件时，也应使用。针对具体请求，采用与需求规模成比例的直接工作流程；针对广泛请求，则使用完整的工作流程。以下情况不应使用：仅用于运行/诊断测试、覆盖率/审计、被生产端缺失接口（可测试性障碍）阻塞的测试，或在不设计新用例的情况下修正提供的 MSTest 断言、属性、生命周期或配置。

name: edge-concept-synthesizer
description: Abstract detector tickets and hints into reusable edge concepts with thesis, invalidation signals, and strategy playbooks before strategy design/export.
description_zh: 在策略设计/导出之前，将抽象检测器票据和提示转化为具有论文、无效信号和策略手册的可重用边缘概念。

name: scenekit
description: Maintain and extend existing SceneKit 3D scenes and visualizations. Use when working with SCNView, SCNScene, SCNNode scene graphs, SceneKit geometry/materials/lights/cameras, SCNAction animation, SCNPhysicsBody physics, SCNParticleSystem effects, .scn/.dae/.abc SceneKit assets, shader modifiers, or SwiftUI SceneView. SceneKit is soft-deprecated and in maintenance mode; route new apps, significant updates, USD/USDZ pipelines, and migration planning toward RealityKit.
description_zh: 维护和扩展现有的 SceneKit 3D 场景和可视化效果。在处理 SCNView、SCNScene、SCNNode 场景图、SceneKit 几何体/材质/灯光/相机、SCNAction 动画、SCNPhysicsBody 物理效果、SCNParticleSystem 特效、.scn/.dae/.abc SceneKit 资产、着色器修饰符或 SwiftUI SceneView 时使用。SceneKit 已软弃用并进入维护模式；将新应用、重大更新、USD/USDZ 管道和迁移规划转向 RealityKit。

name: managed-airflow-dag-authoring
description: Provides guidance for authoring Apache Airflow DAGs in Managed Service for Apache Airflow (MSAA; formerly Cloud Composer). Covers environment context discovery, Airflow 2 vs 3 compatibility, authoring best practices, and local/remote validation processes. Use when creating or extending an Airflow DAG. Don't use when authoring Python code unrelated to Airflow DAGs.
description_zh: 为在 Apache Airflow 管理服务 (MSAA；以前称为 Cloud Composer) 中编写 Apache Airflow DAG 提供指导。涵盖环境上下文发现、Airflow 2 与 3 的兼容性、编写最佳实践以及本地/远程验证流程。在创建或扩展 Airflow DAG 时使用。在编写与 Airflow DAG 无关的 Python 代码时不使用。

name: cryptotokenkit
description: Access security tokens and smart cards using CryptoTokenKit. Use when building TKTokenDriver or TKSmartCardTokenDriver extensions, communicating with smart cards via TKSmartCard/TKSmartCardSlotManager, using iOS 26+ NFC smart-card sessions, registering smart cards, querying token-backed keychain items with kSecAttrTokenID, monitoring TKTokenWatcher, or configuring certificate-based smart-card authentication.
description_zh: 使用 CryptoTokenKit 访问安全令牌和智能卡。在构建 TKTokenDriver 或 TKSmartCardTokenDriver 扩展、通过 TKSmartCard/TKSmartCardSlotManager 与智能卡通信、使用 iOS 26+ NFC 智能卡会话、注册智能卡、使用 kSecAttrTokenID 查询令牌支持的钥匙串项、监控 TKTokenWatcher 或配置基于证书的智能卡认证时使用。

name: ticket-triage
description: Triage and prioritize a support ticket or customer issue. Use when a new ticket comes in and needs categorization, assigning P1-P4 priority, deciding which team should handle it, or checking whether it's a duplicate or known issue before routing.
description_zh: 对支持工单或客户问题进行初步评估并确定优先级。适用于新工单到达时需要分类、指定 P1 至 P4 优先级、决定由哪个团队处理，或在分派前检查该工单是否为重复或已知问题的场景。

name: accessorysetupkit
description: Discover and configure Bluetooth and Wi-Fi accessories using AccessorySetupKit. Use when presenting a privacy-preserving accessory picker, defining discovery descriptors for BLE or Wi-Fi devices, handling accessory session events, migrating from CoreBluetooth permission-based scanning, or setting up accessories without requiring broad Bluetooth permissions.
description_zh: 使用AccessorySetupKit发现和配置蓝牙和Wi-Fi配件。在展示隐私保护配件选择器、为BLE或Wi-Fi设备定义发现描述符、处理配件会话事件、从基于权限的CoreBluetooth扫描迁移，或设置不需要广泛蓝牙权限的配件时使用。

name: test-tui
description: Guide for testing Codex TUI interactively
description_zh: 测试 Codex TUI 的交互式指南

name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
description: Apply when sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead code, redundant validators, and stub references first, then build on the simpler base.
description_zh: 在进行添加、重构或重写时应用。首先移除死代码、冗余验证器和桩引用，然后基于更简单的基座进行构建。

name: callkit
description: Implement VoIP calling with CallKit and PushKit. Use when building incoming/outgoing call flows, registering for VoIP push notifications, configuring CXProvider and CXCallController, handling call actions, coordinating audio sessions, or creating Call Directory extensions for caller ID and call blocking.
description_zh: 使用 CallKit 和 PushKit 实现VoIP通话。在构建来电/去电流程、注册VoIP推送通知、配置 CXProvider 和 CXCallController、处理通话操作、协调音频会话或为来电显示和通话拦截创建通话目录扩展时使用。

name: edge-hint-extractor
description: Extract edge hints from daily market observations and news reactions, with optional LLM ideation, and output canonical hints.yaml for downstream concept synthesis and auto detection.
description_zh: 从日常市场观察和新闻反应中提取边缘提示，可选择使用LLM进行构思，并输出规范的hints.yaml文件，用于下游概念合成和自动检测。

name: image-generation
description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, imagine, or visualize images including characters, scenes, products, or any visual content. Supports structured prompts and reference images for guided generation.
description_zh: 当用户请求生成、创建、想象或可视化图像时，请使用此技能，包括角色、场景、产品或任何视觉内容。支持使用结构化提示词和参考图像进行引导式生成。

name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
description: Apply when facing a novel UI interaction or architectural decision with no precedent in the codebase. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare side by side before committing.
description_zh: 当面临代码库中前所未有的新UI交互或架构决策时，请应用此方法。在做出最终决定之前，构建2-3个竞争性原型并进行并排比较。

name: push-to-registry
description: Push Packer build metadata to HCP Packer registry for tracking and managing image lifecycle. Use when integrating Packer builds with HCP Packer for version control and governance.
description_zh: 将 Packer 构建元数据推送到 HCP Packer 注册中心，用于跟踪和管理镜像生命周期。在将 Packer 构建与 HCP Packer 集成以进行版本控制和治理时使用。

name: copywriting
description: Write and rewrite marketing copy for landing pages, homepages, and ads. Useful as a copy chief partner during launches.
description_zh: 撰写和修改用于落地页、主页和广告的营销文案。在产品发布期间，可作为文案主管的合作伙伴。

name: paperkit
description: Add drawings, shapes, and a consistent markup experience using PaperKit. Use when integrating PaperMarkupViewController for markup editing, adding shape recognition, working with PaperMarkup data models, embedding markup tools in document editors, or building annotation features that need the system-standard markup toolbar. New in iOS 26.
description_zh: 使用 PaperKit 添加绘图、形状，并享受一致的标记体验。在集成 PaperMarkupViewController 进行标记编辑、添加形状识别、处理 PaperMarkup 数据模型、将标记工具嵌入文档编辑器或构建需要系统标准标记工具栏的注释功能时使用。iOS 26 新增。

name: passkit
description: Integrate Apple Pay payments and Wallet passes using PassKit. Use when adding Apple Pay buttons, creating payment requests, handling payment authorization, adding passes to Wallet, configuring merchant capabilities, managing shipping/contact fields, or working with PKPaymentRequest, PKPaymentAuthorizationController, PKPaymentButton, AddPassToWalletButton, PKPass, PKAddPassesViewController, PKPassLibrary, Wallet pass distribution, or Apple Pay checkout flows for physical goods, real-world services, donations, and eligible recurring payments.
description_zh: 使用 PassKit 集成 Apple Pay 支付和 Wallet 通行证。在添加 Apple Pay 按钮、创建支付请求、处理支付授权、向 Wallet 添加通行证、配置商户功能、管理运输/联系字段，或使用 PKPaymentRequest、PKPaymentAuthorizationController、PKPaymentButton、AddPassToWalletButton、PKPass、PKAddPassesViewController、PKPassLibrary、Wallet 通行证分发，或用于实体商品、现实世界服务、捐赠和符合条件的周期性支付的 Apple Pay 结账流程时使用。

name: video-shotcraft
description: Create cinematic product videos from shot recipe cards, a validated template, and code/audio assets (Remotion + real page screenshots + 2.5D camera moves + beat-synced cuts + sound design). Use when the user asks to turn a frontend project or webpage into a product video, says "use video-shotcraft to make a video/promo", names the Ink Press template or asks to reproduce its effect, or wants a single shot card's motion. 用镜头配方卡 + 已验收模板 + 代码/音频资产制作电影感产品视频（Remotion + 真实页面截图 + 2.5D 运镜 + 节奏卡点 + 声音设计）。当用户要求"用 video-shotcraft 做视频/宣传片"、把前端项目/网页做成产品视频、点名 Ink Press 模板或要求复刻模板片效果，或要用镜头卡做单个动效镜头时使用。

name: meeting-briefing
description: Prepare structured briefings for meetings with legal relevance and track resulting action items. Use when preparing for contract negotiations, board meetings, compliance reviews, or any meeting where legal context, background research, or action tracking is needed.
description_zh: 准备具有法律相关性的结构化会议简报，并跟踪结果行动项。在准备合同谈判、董事会会议、合规审查或任何需要法律背景、背景研究或行动跟踪的会议时使用。

name: exa-web-search-free
description: Free AI search via Exa MCP. Web search for news/info, code search for docs/examples from GitHub/StackOverflow, company research for business intel. No API key needed.
description_zh: 通过 Exa MCP 提供免费 AI 搜索。支持网页搜索获取新闻和信息，代码搜索检索 GitHub 和 StackOverflow 上的文档与示例，以及企业调研获取商业情报。无需 API 密钥。

name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, including navigating pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data, testing web apps, or automating any browser task. Triggers include requests to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data from a page", "test this web app", "login to a site", "automate browser actions", or any task requiring programmatic web interaction.
description_zh: 用于 AI 代理的浏览器自动化命令行工具。当用户需要与网站交互时使用，包括浏览页面、填写表单、点击按钮、截屏、提取数据、测试 Web 应用或自动化任何浏览器任务。触发条件包括“打开网站”、“填写表单”、“点击按钮”、“截屏”、“从页面抓取数据”、“测试这个 Web 应用”、“登录网站”、“自动化浏览器操作”或任何需要程序化 Web 交互的任务。

name: adattributionkit
description: Measure ad effectiveness with privacy-preserving attribution using AdAttributionKit. Use when registering ad impressions, handling attribution postbacks, updating conversion values, implementing re-engagement attribution, configuring publisher or advertiser apps, or replacing SKAdNetwork with AdAttributionKit for ad measurement.
description_zh: 使用 AdAttributionKit 进行隐私保护下的归因分析，以衡量广告效果。在注册广告展示、处理归因回传、更新转化值、实施再触达归因、配置出版商或广告商应用，或使用 AdAttributionKit 替代 SKAdNetwork 进行广告测量时使用。

name: blender-web-pipeline
description: Blender to web export workflows for 3D models and animations. Use this skill when exporting Blender models to glTF for web, optimizing 3D assets for Three.js or Babylon.js, batch processing models with Python scripts, automating Blender workflows, or creating web-ready 3D pipelines. Triggers on tasks involving Blender glTF export, bpy scripting, 3D asset optimization, model compression, texture baking, or Blender automation. Exports models for threejs-webgl, react-three-fiber, and babylonjs-engine skills.
description_zh: 用于3D模型和动画的Blender到Web导出工作流程。在将Blender模型导出为glTF用于Web、优化Three.js或Babylon.js的3D资源、使用Python脚本批量处理模型、自动化Blender工作流程或创建适用于Web的3D工作流时，使用这项技能。在涉及Blender glTF导出、bpy脚本、3D资源优化、模型压缩、纹理烘焙或Blender自动化等任务时触发。导出适用于threejs-webgl、react-three-fiber和babylonjs-engine技能的模型。

name: google-flights
description: Search Google Flights for flight prices and schedules using browser automation. Use when user asks to search flights, find airfare, compare prices, check flight availability, or look up routes. Triggers include "search flights", "find flights", "how much is a flight", "flights from X to Y", "cheapest flight", "flight prices", "airfare", "flight schedule", "nonstop flights", "when should I fly".

name: dual-axis-skill-reviewer
description: Review skills in any project using a dual-axis method: (1) deterministic code-based checks (structure, scripts, tests, execution safety) and (2) LLM deep review findings. Use when you need reproducible quality scoring for `skills/*/SKILL.md`, want to gate merges with a score threshold (for example 90+), or need concrete improvement items for low-scoring skills. Works across projects via --project-root.
description_zh: 使用双轴方法评估任何项目中的技能：(1) 基于代码的确定性检查（结构、脚本、测试、执行安全性）和 (2) LLM 深度审查发现。当您需要为 `skills/*/SKILL.md` 提供可复现的质量评分、希望以分数阈值（例如 90+）来控制合并，或需要为低分技能提供具体改进项时使用。通过 `--project-root` 可跨项目工作。

name: rust-symbol-analyzer
description: Analyze Rust project structure using LSP symbols. Triggers on: /symbols, project structure, list structs, list traits, list functions, 符号分析, 项目结构, 列出所有, 有哪些struct
description_zh: 使用LSP符号分析Rust项目结构。触发条件：/symbols、项目结构、列出所有struct、列出所有traits、列出所有functions、符号分析、项目结构、列出所有、有哪些struct。

name: swot-analysis
description: Perform a detailed SWOT analysis — strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats with actionable recommendations. Use when doing strategic assessment, competitive analysis, or evaluating a product or business position.
description_zh: 进行详细的SWOT分析——包括优势、劣势、机会和威胁，并提出可操作的推荐建议。在进行战略评估、竞争分析或评估产品或商业定位时使用。

name: memory-discipline
description: The session loop that makes agentmemory pay off, recall before starting work, save at decision points, learn from corrections. Use when starting a nontrivial task, after settling a decision or debugging a gotcha, or whenever deciding if something belongs in memory.
description_zh: 使agentmemory发挥作用的工作流程：在开始工作前进行回忆，在决策点进行保存，从纠正中学习。在开始一项非平凡的任务、解决一个决策或调试一个意外情况之后，或者每当决定某事是否应保存在记忆中时使用。

name: muapi-seedance-2
description: Expert Cinema Director skill for Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance) — high-fidelity video generation across Chinese, Global, and VIP tiers. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first-last-frame, omni reference, character training, omni-reference training, video editing, and watermark removal.
description_zh: Seedance 2.0（字节跳动）专业电影导演技能——支持中、全球及VIP等级的高保真视频生成。支持文本转视频、图像转视频、首尾帧、全参考、角色训练、全参考训练、视频编辑和去水印功能。

name: audioaccessorykit
description: Support automatic audio switching for paired third-party Bluetooth headphones or earbuds with AudioAccessoryKit. Use when a companion app registers an audio accessory, an app extension reports worn/removed placement or connected source-device changes, or AccessoryControlDevice capabilities and errors need handling. Do not use for general AVAudioSession routing, Bluetooth transport, or initial accessory pairing.
description_zh: 支持通过AudioAccessoryKit自动切换配对的第三方蓝牙耳机或耳塞。在以下情况使用：当伴侣应用注册音频配件、应用扩展报告佩戴/移除位置或连接源设备变化，或需要处理配件控制设备功能与错误时。不应用于一般AVAudioSession路由、蓝牙传输或初始配件配对。

name: dockkit
description: Control motorized camera docks and enable intelligent subject tracking using DockKit. Use when discovering DockKit-compatible accessories, implementing camera subject tracking for faces or bodies, controlling dock motors for pan and tilt, configuring framing behavior, setting regions of interest, or building video apps with automatic camera tracking.
description_zh: 使用 DockKit 控制电动相机底座，并启用智能主体跟踪功能。在发现兼容 DockKit 的配件、实现人脸或身体的相机主体跟踪、控制底座电机进行水平/垂直转动、配置构图行为、设置兴趣区域，或构建具有自动相机跟踪功能的视频应用时使用。

name: draw-io-diagram-generator
description: Use when creating, editing, or generating draw.io diagram files (.drawio, .drawio.svg, .drawio.png). Covers mxGraph XML authoring, shape libraries, style strings, flowcharts, system architecture, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, UML class diagrams, network topology, layout strategy, the hediet.vscode-drawio VS Code extension, and the full agent workflow from request to a ready-to-open file.
description_zh: 在创建、编辑或生成 draw.io 图表文件（.drawio、.drawio.svg、.drawio.png）时使用。涵盖 mxGraph XML 编写、形状库、样式字符串、流程图、系统架构、时序图、ER 图、UML 类图、网络拓扑、布局策略、hediet.vscode-drawio VS Code 扩展，以及从请求到可打开文件的完整代理工作流程。

name: sentry-browser-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for browser JavaScript. Use when asked to "add Sentry to a website", "install @sentry/browser", or configure error monitoring, tracing, session replay, or logging for vanilla JavaScript, jQuery, static sites, or WordPress.
description_zh: 浏览器 JavaScript 的完整 Sentry SDK 设置。当被要求“将 Sentry 添加到网站”、“安装 @sentry/browser”或为原生 JavaScript、jQuery、静态网站或 WordPress 配置错误监控、跟踪、会话回放或日志记录时使用。

name: arize-evaluator
description: Handles LLM-as-judge and code evaluator workflows on Arize including creating/updating evaluators, running evaluations on spans or experiments, managing tasks, trigger-run operations, column mapping, and continuous monitoring. Use when the user mentions create evaluator, LLM judge, code evaluator, hallucination, faithfulness, correctness, relevance, run eval, score spans, score experiment, trigger-run, column mapping, continuous monitoring, or improve evaluator prompt.
description_zh: 处理 Arize 上的 LLM 作为裁判和代码评估工作流程，包括创建/更新评估器、在跨度或实验上运行评估、管理任务、触发运行操作、列映射和持续监控。当用户提到创建评估器、LLM 裁判、代码评估器、幻觉、忠实度、正确性、相关性、运行评估、评分跨度、评分实验、触发运行、列映射、持续监控或改进评估器提示时使用。

name: guideline-generation
description: This skill generates, creates, or builds brand voice guidelines from source materials. It should be used when the user asks to "generate brand guidelines", "create a style guide", "extract brand voice", "create guidelines from calls", "consolidate brand materials", "analyze my sales calls for brand voice", "build a brand playbook from documents", "synthesize a voice and tone guide", or uploads brand documents, transcripts, or meeting recordings for brand analysis. Also triggers when the user has a discovery report and wants to convert it into actionable guidelines.
description_zh: 这项技能能够根据源材料生成、创建或构建品牌声音指南。当用户要求“生成品牌指南”、“创建风格指南”、“提取品牌声音”、“从通话中创建指南”、“整合品牌材料”、“分析我的销售通话以确定品牌声音”、“从文档中构建品牌手册”、“综合声音和语气指南”，或上传品牌文档、转录文本或会议录音以进行品牌分析时，应使用该技能。此外，当用户拥有一份发现报告并希望将其转换为可操作的指南时，也会触发该技能。

name: lesson
description: Save a correction or hard-won rule as a confidence-weighted lesson that resurfaces before similar work. Use when the user corrects your approach, says "learn this", "always" or "never do X", or you notice yourself repeating a past mistake.
description_zh: 将一次修正或来之不易的规则保存为带有置信权重的经验教训，以便在类似的工作中再次出现。当用户纠正你的方法、说“学这个”、“永远”或“永远不要做X”，或者你意识到自己重复了过去的错误时使用。

name: dbs-theory-grounding
description: 理论溯源与案例重释。审查 PPT、课程、文案或方法论中的经验判断，先判断命题是否成立，再匹配并核实可信理论，用该理论重释案例并标明边界。适用于给自创理论找依据、给 PPT 补理论来源、判断一句话能否上升为理论、检查是否硬套名人；聚焦单次理论锚定，不默认展开历史同构研究。
description_zh: 理论溯源与案例重释。审查 PPT、课程、文案或方法论中的经验判断，应先判断命题是否成立，再匹配并核实可信理论，用该理论重释案例并标明边界。适用于为自创理论寻找依据、为 PPT 补充理论来源、判断一句话能否上升为理论、检查是否硬套名人；聚焦单次理论锚定，不默认展开历史同构研究。

name: r3f-interaction
description: Implement React Three Fiber pointer events, picking, dragging, keyboard input, and camera controls. Use for scene interaction and event propagation, rather than animation or physics simulation itself.
description_zh: 实现 React Three Fiber 的指针事件、拾取、拖拽、键盘输入和相机控制。用于场景交互和事件传播，而非动画或物理模拟本身。

name: csharp-scripts
description: Run file-based C# apps with the .NET CLI when the user explicitly wants C#/.NET code without creating a project. Use for C# language/API experiments, one-file C# apps, small multi-file C# apps composed with `#:include`/`#:exclude`, or C# file-based apps linked with `#:ref`. Do not use for language-agnostic throwaway scripts, generic computations, Python/PowerShell-style automation, full projects, or existing app integration.
description_zh: 使用 .NET CLI 运行基于文件的 C# 应用程序，当用户明确希望使用 C#/.NET 代码而不创建项目时。适用于 C# 语言/API 实验场景、单文件 C# 应用程序、使用 `#:include`/`#:exclude` 组合的简单多文件 C# 应用程序，或使用 `#:ref` 链接的基于文件的 C# 应用程序。不适用于语言无关的临时脚本、通用计算、Python/PowerShell 风格的自动化、完整项目或现有应用程序集成。

name: ce-test-xcode
description: Test iOS apps in a simulator with XcodeBuildMCP. Use when iOS changes need simulator evidence before handoff.
description_zh: 使用 XcodeBuildMCP 在模拟器中测试 iOS 应用。当 iOS 变更需要在转交之前提供模拟器证据时使用。

name: compliance-tracking
description: Track compliance requirements and audit readiness. Trigger with "compliance", "audit prep", "SOC 2", "ISO 27001", "GDPR", "regulatory requirement", or when the user needs help tracking, preparing for, or documenting compliance activities.
description_zh: 跟踪合规要求及审计准备情况。当输入“合规”、“审计准备”、“SOC 2”、“ISO 27001”、“GDPR”、“监管要求”，或用户需要帮助跟踪、准备或记录合规活动时触发。

name: platform-data-and-tooling-api-context-get
description: Authoritative field/schema reference for 2130 STANDARD Salesforce objects — sObject and Tooling field API names, types, properties (filterable/sortable/groupable/updateable), and relationships for Account, Contact, Opportunity, Lead, Case, ApexClass, and more. Load alongside a SOQL/Apex skill when fields/types/capabilities are unverified — not for query syntax or optimization alone. TRIGGER when verifying/debugging fields in a SOQL/SOSL query or DML against a standard object. Custom __c objects/fields are NOT covered — describe the live org (sf sobject describe). DO NOT TRIGGER for authoring/deploying *-meta.xml or sfdx source (use the Metadata API skill).
description_zh: 2130 标准Salesforce对象（如Account、Contact、Opportunity、Lead、Case、ApexClass等）的权威字段/模式参考——包括sObject和Tooling字段API名称、类型、属性（可筛选/可排序/可分组/可更新）以及关系。当字段/类型/功能未验证时，与SOQL/Apex技能一同加载——仅用于查询语法或优化。在SOQL/SOSL查询或针对标准对象执行的DML中验证/调试字段时触发。自定义__c对象/字段不在此范围内——请使用实时组织的sobject描述（sf sobject describe）。禁止用于编写/部署*-meta.xml或sfdx源（使用元数据API技能）。

name: grammar-check
description: Identify grammar, logical, and flow errors in text and suggest targeted fixes without rewriting the entire text. Use when proofreading content, checking writing quality, or reviewing a draft.
description_zh: 在文本中识别语法、逻辑和行文流畅性问题，并提供针对性修正建议，避免整体重写。适用于校对内容、检查写作质量或审阅初稿时使用。

name: data-report
description: Turns CSV, Excel, or JSON data into a polished visual report page.
description_zh: 将CSV、Excel或JSON数据转换为精美的可视化报告页面。

name: nuxt-seo
description: Nuxt SEO meta-module with robots, sitemap, og-image, schema-org. Use when configuring SEO, generating sitemaps, creating OG images, or adding structured data.
description_zh: Nuxt 的 SEO 元模块，包含 robots、sitemap、og-image 和 schema-org。在配置 SEO、生成站点地图、创建 OG 图片或添加结构化数据时使用。

name: agentmail
description: Build with the AgentMail TypeScript or Python SDK for inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, domain, allow/block list, pod, webhook, and WebSocket workflows, including programmatic agent sign-up, domain/DNS administration, and deliverability triage (bounces, spam, blocked mail). Use when implementing or reviewing AgentMail API code; do not use for direct mailbox operations, CLI usage, MCP setup, or framework-toolkit integration.
description_zh: 使用 AgentMail 的 TypeScript 或 Python SDK 构建，支持收件箱、消息、线程、草稿、附件、域名、允许/阻止列表、Pod、Webhook 和 WebSocket 工作流，包括程序化代理注册、域名/DNS 管理，以及可投递性问题处理（退回邮件、垃圾邮件、被阻止邮件）。在实现或审查 AgentMail API 代码时使用；不应用于直接邮箱操作、CLI 使用、MCP 设置或框架工具包集成。

name: discover-brand
description: This skill orchestrates autonomous discovery of brand materials across enterprise platforms (Notion, Confluence, Google Drive, Box, SharePoint, Figma, Gong, Granola, Slack). It should be used when the user asks to "discover brand materials", "find brand documents", "search for brand guidelines", "audit brand content", "what brand materials do we have", "find our style guide", "where are our brand docs", "do we have a style guide", "discover brand voice", "brand content audit", or "find brand assets".
description_zh: 这项技能能够自主地在企业平台（Notion、Confluence、Google Drive、Box、SharePoint、Figma、Gong、Granola、Slack）中搜索品牌资料。当用户提出以下请求时，应使用该技能："发现品牌资料"、"查找品牌文档"、"搜索品牌规范"、"审核品牌内容"、"我们有哪些品牌资料"、"查找我们的风格指南"、"我们的品牌文档在哪里"、"我们是否有风格指南"、"发现品牌语调"、"品牌内容审核"或"查找品牌资产"。

name: earn-hunter
description: Automatically monitors OKX Flash Earn, Fixed Earn and Flexible Earn opportunities, sends push notifications, and guides subscription. 自动监控 OKX 闪赚、定期和活期赚币机会，推送通知并引导申购。Use when user says: 有闪赚通知我, 监控赚币, monitor earn, notify me about earn, 定时检查理财, 执行 earn-hunter 扫描, earn-hunter scan, 活期年化高了通知我, 监控活期.
description_zh: 当用户说以下内容时使用：有闪赚通知我，监控赚币，监控赚，赚币通知我，定时检查理财，执行 earn-hunter 扫描，earn-hunter scan，活期年化高了通知我，监控活期。

name: metrics-dashboard
description: Define and design a product metrics dashboard with key metrics, data sources, visualization types, and alert thresholds. Use when creating a metrics dashboard, defining KPIs, setting up product analytics, or building a data monitoring plan.
description_zh: 定义并设计一个产品指标仪表板，包含关键指标、数据源、可视化类型和警报阈值。在创建指标仪表板、定义关键绩效指标（KPI）、设置产品分析或构建数据监控计划时使用。

name: company-research
description: Create a company research brief with executive quotes, product strategy, and org context. Use when preparing for interviews, competitive analysis, partnerships, or market-entry work.
description_zh: 创建一份公司研究简报，包含高管引言、产品策略和组织背景。在准备面试、竞争分析、合作或市场进入工作时使用。

name: netlify-deploy
description: Create, configure, and manage Netlify deploys from code — reach for this when setting up Git continuous deployment, running netlify deploy or netlify deploy --prod from the CLI, writing netlify.toml deploy contexts, adding a Deploy to Netlify button, wiring build hooks, configuring Deploy Previews or branch deploys, locking or skipping deploys, fixing a failed or secrets-scanning deploy, or when someone asks to "deploy my site", "set up preview deploys", "add per-branch build config", or "add a deploy button to my README".
description_zh: 从代码中创建、配置和管理 Netlify 部署——在设置 Git 持续部署、从命令行运行 netlify deploy 或 netlify deploy --prod、编写 netlify.toml 部署上下文、添加部署到 Netlify 按钮、连接构建钩子、配置部署预览或分支部署、锁定或跳过部署、修复失败的或涉及密钥扫描的部署，或当有人要求“部署我的网站”、“设置预览部署”、“添加分支级构建配置”或“在我的 README 中添加部署按钮”时，请使用此功能。

name: cli-gh
description: Use for GitHub CLI automation: repository reads, workflow runs, search, codespaces, releases, configuration, or gh command syntax. Use yeet for contribution writes to PRs, issues, comments, or discussions.
description_zh: 用于 GitHub CLI 自动化：仓库读取、工作流运行、搜索、代码空间、发布、配置或 gh 命令语法。使用 yeet 进行对 PR、问题、评论或讨论的贡献写入。

name: recruiting-pipeline
description: Track and manage recruiting pipeline stages. Trigger with "recruiting update", "candidate pipeline", "how many candidates", "hiring status", or when the user discusses sourcing, screening, interviewing, or extending offers.
description_zh: 跟踪和管理招聘流程阶段。可通过“招聘更新”、“候选人流程”、“有多少候选人”、“招聘状态”触发，或在用户讨论人才寻访、筛选、面试或发放录用通知时触发。

name: a11y-debugging
description: Uses Chrome DevTools MCP for accessibility (a11y) debugging and auditing based on web.dev guidelines. Use when testing semantic HTML, ARIA labels, focus states, keyboard navigation, tap targets, and color contrast.
description_zh: 使用 Chrome DevTools MCP 进行基于 web.dev 指导方针的可访问性 (a11y) 调试和审核。在测试语义 HTML、ARIA 标签、焦点状态、键盘导航、点击目标以及颜色对比时使用。

name: browserenginekit
description: Build alternative browser engines using BrowserEngineKit. Use when developing a non-WebKit browser engine for iOS/iPadOS in supported regions, managing web content/rendering/networking extension processes, configuring GPU and networking process capabilities, checking alternative-engine device eligibility, or reviewing BrowserEngineKit entitlements and Info.plist setup.
description_zh: 使用 BrowserEngineKit 构建替代浏览器引擎。在支持的区域为 iOS/iPadOS 开发非 WebKit 浏览器引擎、管理网页内容/渲染/网络扩展进程、配置 GPU 和网络进程功能、检查替代引擎设备资格，或审核 BrowserEngineKit 授权和 Info.plist 设置时使用。

name: create-skill
description: Guide for creating effective skills following best practices. Use when creating or updating skills that extend agent capabilities.
description_zh: 创建高效技能的最佳实践指南。在创建或更新扩展代理能力的技能时使用。

name: agentx
description:
AgentX forum: create posts, comments, likes, reposts, follows, attachments.

Use when posting to the Starchild AgentX forum, not Twitter (e.g. share a project on AgentX, comment on a post, follow an agent, upload image).
description_zh:
AgentX论坛：创建帖子、评论、点赞、转发、关注、附件。

在发布到Starchild AgentX论坛时使用，而不是Twitter（例如：在AgentX上分享项目、评论帖子、关注代理、上传图片）。

name: appmigrationkit
description: Transfer app data to or from other platforms using AppMigrationKit. Use when implementing system-orchestrated one-time migration between iOS and Android or another platform, building an AppMigrationExtension, packaging transportable resources with ResourcesArchiver, importing resources on the destination device, reporting import progress, handling migration errors and app group cleanup, checking MigrationStatus, or testing migration code with AppMigrationTester.
description_zh: 使用 AppMigrationKit 将应用数据迁移到或从其他平台。在实施系统协调的 iOS 和 Android 或其他平台之间的单次迁移、构建 AppMigrationExtension、使用 ResourcesArchiver 打包可传输资源、在目标设备上导入资源、报告导入进度、处理迁移错误和应用组清理、检查 MigrationStatus 或使用 AppMigrationTester 测试迁移代码时使用。

name: sensorkit
description: Access research-grade sensor data using SensorKit for approved studies. Use when an app needs SensorKit entitlement setup, Research Sensor & Usage Data authorization, ambient light, recorded motion, device usage, keyboard metrics, visits, speech, face, wrist temperature, ECG, PPG, acoustic settings, or sleep-session data. Route ordinary motion to CoreMotion and health records/workouts to HealthKit.
description_zh: 使用 SensorKit 访问研究级传感器数据，适用于经批准的研究。当应用程序需要 SensorKit 授权设置、研究传感器与使用数据授权、环境光、记录的运动、设备使用情况、键盘指标、访问记录、语音、面部、手腕温度、心电图、脉搏波、声学设置或睡眠会话数据时使用。将普通运动路由至 CoreMotion，健康记录/锻炼则路由至 HealthKit。

name: favicon
description: Generate a complete set of favicons from a source image and update HTML. Use when setting up favicons for a web project.
description_zh: 从源图像生成一套完整的 favicons 并更新 HTML。用于为 Web 项目设置 favicons 时。

name: principle-minimize-reader-load
description: Apply when reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers between question and answer, and hidden state in the reader's head; collapse one-caller wrappers and shrink mutable scope.
description_zh: 在审查或重构难以追踪的代码时使用。计算问题与答案之间的层级，以及读者头脑中的隐藏状态；折叠单调用包装器并缩小可变作用域。

name: create-an-asset
description: Build a customer deck, one-pager or leave-behind from your account data, call notes and approved materials, with no made-up numbers. Use when the user asks for a sales asset, one-pager, deck, leave-behind, "create an asset for [prospect]", or "make something for [account]".
description_zh: 基于您的客户数据、通话记录及已批准材料，为客户制作演示文稿、单页介绍或留置资料，严禁编造数据。当用户要求销售材料、单页简介、演示文稿、留置资料，或提出“为[潜在客户]创建资产”或“为[客户]制作内容”等请求时，启用此功能。

name: relevancekit
description: Increase widget visibility on Apple Watch using RelevanceKit. Use when providing contextual relevance signals for watchOS widgets, declaring time-based or location-based relevance, combining multiple relevance providers, helping the system surface the right widget at the right time on watchOS 26, or routing mixed RelevanceKit/WidgetKit/HealthKit/MapKit Smart Stack scope.
description_zh: 使用 RelevanceKit 提高Apple Watch上的小部件可见性。在为watchOS小部件提供上下文相关性信号、声明基于时间或位置的相关性、组合多个相关性提供者、帮助系统在watchOS 26上在正确的时间显示正确的小部件，或路由混合RelevanceKit/WidgetKit/HealthKit/MapKit智能堆栈范围时使用。

name: trader-memory-core
description: Track investment theses across their lifecycle — from screening idea to closed position with postmortem. Register theses from screener outputs, manage state transitions, attach position sizing, review due dates, and generate postmortem reports with P&L and MAE/MFE analysis. Trigger when user says "register thesis", "track this idea", "thesis status", "review due", "close position", "postmortem", or "trading journal".
description_zh: 跟踪投资策略在其生命周期中的进展——从筛选想法到关闭仓位并进行事后分析。从筛选器输出中注册策略，管理状态转换，附加仓位规模，审查截止日期，并生成包含盈亏（P&L）和平均绝对误差（MAE）/平均方向误差（MFE）分析的事后分析报告。当用户说“注册策略”、“跟踪这个想法”、“策略状态”、“审查截止日期”、“关闭仓位”、“事后分析”或“交易日记”时触发。

name: target-prioritization
description: Prioritize drug targets from a ranked gene list (e.g., scRNA-seq DE output) by orchestrating parallel API queries against UniProt, OpenTargets (with integrated DepMap CRISPR essentiality + gnomAD constraint), PubMed, the Human Protein Atlas (HPA), and ChEMBL tool compounds, then re-ranking by a composite score combining protein localization, druggability, disease genetics, tissue specificity (safety), focus-cell-type expression, CRISPR essentiality, LoF safety constraint, and research maturity. Use whenever the user wants to filter, triage, prioritize, or "do due diligence" on a list of candidate genes for drug discovery, especially after a DE / DEG analysis when they say things like "which of these should I follow up on", "filter for druggable targets", "make a target dossier", "rank these for tractability", "annotate these genes for druggability", or "build a target report". Trigger even when the user says just "filter these candidate genes" or hands over a CSV from a DE pipeline.
description_zh: 从排序的基因列表（例如scRNA-seq差异表达输出）中优先筛选药物靶点，通过并行API查询UniProt、OpenTargets（整合DepMap CRISPR必需性+gnomAD约束）、PubMed、人类蛋白质图谱（HPA）和ChEMBL工具化合物，然后根据综合评分重新排序。该评分结合了蛋白质定位、成药性、疾病遗传性、组织特异性（安全性）、焦点细胞类型表达、CRISPR必需性、LoF安全性约束和研究成熟度。用户在筛选、分诊、优先排序或对药物发现候选基因列表进行“尽职调查”时均可使用，尤其是在DE/DEG分析后，当用户提出“我应该关注哪些基因”、“筛选成药性靶点”、“制作靶点档案”、“按可操作性排序”、“标注基因成药性”或“构建靶点报告”等需求时。即使用户仅说“筛选这些候选基因”或从DE流程中提供CSV文件，也会触发该功能。

name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
description: Apply when designing commands, lifecycle steps, or processing loops that run amid crashes, restarts, and retries. Converge to the same end state regardless of partial prior runs.
description_zh: 在设计命令、生命周期步骤或处理循环时使用，这些循环在崩溃、重启和重试的背景下运行。无论之前的部分运行情况如何，最终都会收敛到相同的状态。

name: nx-plugins
description: Find and add Nx plugins. USE WHEN user wants to discover available plugins, install a new plugin, or add support for a specific framework or technology to the workspace.
description_zh: 查找并添加 Nx 插件。当用户想要发现可用插件、安装新插件或向工作区添加特定框架或技术的支持时使用。

name: docx
description: Create, edit, and analyze Word documents with tracked changes, comments, and formatting. Useful for design briefs, copy docs, and review-ready deliverables.
description_zh: 创建、编辑和分析带修订跟踪、批注和格式的 Word 文档。适用于设计简报、文案文档以及准备审查的交付成果。

name: adspower-browser
description: AdsPower profile operation via adspower-browser CLI. open/launch/start browser or profile, environment, config profile, AdsPower; create/update/delete/list profiles; groups, tags, proxies; kernel download/list; client patch; API check-status. User phrases like open environment or map to commands such as open-browser.
description_zh: 通过 adspower-browser CLI 进行 AdsPower 配置文件操作。打开/启动/启动浏览器或配置文件、环境、配置配置文件、AdsPower；创建/更新/删除/列出配置文件；组、标签、代理；内核下载/列出；客户端补丁；API 检查状态。用户可以使用诸如打开环境之类的短语映射到 open-browser 等命令。

name: performance-report
description: Build a marketing performance report with key metrics, trend analysis, wins and misses, and prioritized optimization recommendations. Use when wrapping a campaign, when preparing weekly, monthly, or quarterly channel summaries for stakeholders, or when you need data translated into an executive summary with next-period priorities.
description_zh: 构建一份包含关键指标、趋势分析、成功与失误以及优先级优化建议的市场绩效报告。在结束活动、为利益相关者准备每周、每月或每季度的渠道总结，或需要将数据转化为执行摘要并确定下一阶段优先事项时使用。

name: ideal-customer-profile
description: Identify the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) from research data with demographics, behaviors, JTBD, and needs. Use when defining your ICP, analyzing PMF survey data, or understanding who your best customers are.
description_zh: 从研究数据中识别理想客户画像（ICP），包括人口统计特征、行为、主要任务和需求。在定义ICP、分析PMF调查数据或了解您的最佳客户时使用。

name: arize-link
description: Generates deep links to the Arize UI for projects, traces, spans, sessions, datasets, labeling queues, evaluators, and annotation configs. Discovers organization and project IDs with the ax CLI and produces clickable URLs for sharing Arize resources with team members. Use when the user wants to link to or open a project, trace, span, session, dataset, evaluator, or annotation config in the Arize UI.
description_zh: 为项目、追踪、跨度、会话、数据集、标注队列、评估器和标注配置生成指向 Arize UI 的深度链接。使用 ax CLI 发现组织和项目 ID，并为与团队成员共享 Arize 资源生成可点击的 URL。当用户希望链接到或打开 Arize UI 中的项目、追踪、跨度、会话、数据集、评估器或标注配置时使用。

Use when asked to create, generate, format, or build ListTimeSeries requests, JSON payloads, filter expressions, or aligner/reducer aggregations for Cloud Monitoring metrics and charts. Don't use for metric discovery or metric selection.
description_zh: 从指标描述符和资源参数生成有效的 Cloud Monitoring ListTimeSeries 请求和聚合规范。当被要求创建、生成、格式化或构建 Cloud Monitoring 指标的 ListTimeSeries 请求、JSON 负载、过滤表达式或对齐器/缩减器聚合时使用。不应用于指标发现或指标选择。

name: github-deep-research
description: Conduct multi-round deep research on any GitHub Repo. Use when users request comprehensive analysis, timeline reconstruction, competitive analysis, or in-depth investigation of GitHub. Produces structured markdown reports with executive summaries, chronological timelines, metrics analysis, and Mermaid diagrams. Triggers on Github repository URL or open source projects.
description_zh: 对任何 GitHub 仓库进行多轮深度研究。当用户请求全面分析、时间线重建、竞争分析或 GitHub 深入调查时使用。生成结构化的 Markdown 报告，包含执行摘要、时间线、指标分析和 Mermaid 图表。通过 GitHub 仓库 URL 或开源项目触发。

name: pdf
description: Extract text, create PDFs, and handle forms. Useful for press releases, branded one-pagers, and printable design deliverables.
description_zh: 提取文本，创建PDF文件，并处理表单。适用于新闻稿、品牌单页宣传册以及可打印的设计交付物。

name: trigger-tasks
description: Covers writing backend Trigger.dev tasks with @trigger.dev/sdk: defining task() and schemaTask(), the run function and its ctx, retries, waits, queues and concurrency, idempotency keys, run metadata, logging, triggering other tasks (and the Result shape), scheduled/cron tasks, and the essentials of trigger.config.ts. Load this whenever you are authoring or editing code inside a /trigger directory, defining a task, or writing backend code that triggers tasks. Realtime/React hooks and AI chat are covered by separate skills.
description_zh: 涵盖使用 @trigger.dev/sdk 编写 backend Trigger.dev 任务的写作：定义 task() 和 schemaTask()、运行函数及其 ctx、重试、等待、队列和并发、幂等性键、运行元数据、日志记录、触发其他任务（及其 Result 形状）、计划任务/cron 任务以及 trigger.config.ts 的基础知识。在 /trigger 目录内编写或编辑代码、定义任务或编写触发任务的后端代码时，请随时加载此内容。实时/React 钩子和 AI 聊天由单独的技能覆盖。

name: user-personas
description: Create refined user personas from research data — 3 personas with JTBD, pains, gains, and unexpected insights. Use when building personas from survey data, creating user profiles from research, or segmenting users for product decisions.
description_zh: 根据研究数据创建精细的用户画像——3个具有任务目标、痛点、收益和意外洞察的用户画像。在从调查数据构建用户画像、根据研究创建用户资料或为产品决策细分用户时使用。

name: wiki-capture
description: Save the current conversation as a permanent, structured wiki note. Use this skill when the user says "save this", "/wiki-capture", "capture this", "file this conversation", "preserve this", "add this to my wiki", or wants to turn what was just discussed into lasting knowledge. The skill classifies the content, rewrites it as declarative knowledge (not a chat transcript), and places it in the correct vault category. Also supports a fast QUICK MODE (`/wiki-capture --quick`, "quick capture", "capture this finding", "save this bug fix", "save this gotcha", "drop this to raw", "quick save to wiki") that drops findings to the `_raw/` staging area in under 60 seconds with no manifest or index writes — used by the session-end Stop hook to auto-preserve findings. Accepts inline named-vault routing like "@research save this" via the shared Config Resolution Protocol.
description_zh: 将当前对话保存为永久、结构化的维基笔记。当用户说“保存这个”、“/wiki-capture”、“捕捉这个”、“归档此对话”、“保留这个”、“将这个添加到我的维基”或希望将刚刚讨论的内容转化为持久知识时，使用此技能。该技能对内容进行分类，将其改写为陈述性知识（而非聊天记录），并将其放置在正确的保险库类别中。此外，还支持快速QUICK模式（`/wiki-capture --quick`、“快速捕捉”、“捕捉这个发现”、“保存这个bug修复”、“保存这个gotcha”、“丢弃到原始数据”、“快速保存到维基”），该模式在60秒内将发现内容丢弃到`_raw/`暂存区，无需写入清单或索引——由会话结束的Stop钩子自动保留发现内容。支持通过共享的配置解析协议进行内联命名保险库路由，例如“@research 保存这个”。

name: unreal-blueprints
description: Build Unreal Engine 5 gameplay with Blueprint visual scripting: Blueprint Classes, the Event Graph and Construction Script, variables/functions/macros, and Blueprint communication (Cast, Interfaces, Event Dispatchers). Use when working in Blueprints, wiring an event graph, deciding how Blueprints talk to each other, or when the user mentions Blueprint, BP, event graph, construction script, or a Blueprint .uasset.
description_zh: 使用蓝图可视化脚本构建虚幻引擎5的游戏玩法：蓝图类、事件图和构造脚本、变量/函数/宏，以及蓝图通信（类型转换、接口、事件派发器）。适用于在蓝图中工作、连接事件图、决定蓝图之间如何通信，或当用户提到蓝图、BP、事件图、构造脚本或蓝图.uasset文件时。

name: sepa-strategy
description: Analyze stocks with Mark Minervini's SEPA (Specific Entry Point Analysis) methodology: stage analysis, the 8-condition trend template, fundamentals, VCP and other base patterns, pivot-point entries, market environment, and risk-based position sizing. Use this skill whenever the user mentions SEPA, Minervini, superperformance, the trend template, VCP (volatility contraction pattern), Stage 2, pivot or breakout entries, moving-average stacking (price above the 50/150/200-day MAs), breakout volume, position sizing from risk percentage, growth-stock screening or swing-trade entry criteria, or bases such as cup-with-handle, flat base, bull flag, or high tight flag. Also use it when the user asks "should I buy this stock" or "is this a good setup" about a growth or momentum name, or shares a chart for pattern analysis.
description_zh: 使用马克·明维尼的SEPA（特定入场点分析）方法论分析股票：阶段分析、8条件趋势模板、基本面、VCP和其他基础形态、枢轴点入场、市场环境以及基于风险的仓位规模。每当用户提及SEPA、明维尼、超常表现、趋势模板、VCP（波动率收缩形态）、阶段2、枢轴或突破入场、移动平均线叠加（价格在50/150/200日均线之上）、突破量、基于风险百分比的仓位规模、成长股筛选或波段交易入场标准，或诸如杯柄形态、平底形态、牛市旗形或高紧旗形等基础形态时，均使用此技能。当用户询问“我应该买入这只股票吗”或“这是一个好的入场设置吗”关于成长股或动量股，或分享图表进行形态分析时，也使用此技能。

name: review-resume
description: Comprehensive PM resume review and tailoring against 10 best practices including XYZ+S formula, keyword optimization, job-specific tailoring, and structure. Use when reviewing a PM resume, preparing for job applications, or improving resume impact.
description_zh: 针对10项最佳实践（包括XYZ+S公式、关键词优化、职位特定定制和结构）进行全面的PM简历审阅和定制。在审阅PM简历、准备求职申请或提升简历影响力时使用。

name: pricing-strategy
description: Analyze and design pricing strategies including pricing models, competitive pricing analysis, willingness-to-pay estimation, and price elasticity. Use when setting prices, evaluating pricing models, preparing for a pricing change, or comparing freemium vs paid approaches.
description_zh: 分析和设计定价策略，包括定价模型、竞争性定价分析、支付意愿估计和价格弹性。在设定价格、评估定价模型、准备进行定价变更或比较免费增值与付费模式时使用。

name: react-hook-form
description: React Hook Form performance optimization for client-side form validation using useForm, useWatch, useController, useFieldArray, the subscribe() API, and the Watch / FormStateSubscribe / FieldArray render-prop components. Covers RHF 7.82 additions including resetDefaultValues() and the disabled field-array option. This skill should be used when building client-side controlled forms with React Hook Form library. This skill does NOT cover React 19 Server Actions, useActionState, or server-side form handling (use react-19 skill for those).
description_zh: 使用 `useForm`、`useWatch`、`useController`、`useFieldArray`、`subscribe()` API 以及 `Watch` / `FormStateSubscribe` / `FieldArray` render-prop 组件进行 React Hook Form 客户端表单验证的性能优化。涵盖 RHF 7.82 的新增功能，包括 `resetDefaultValues()` 和禁用 field-array 选项。在构建使用 React Hook Form 库的客户端受控表单时，应使用此技能。此技能不涵盖 React 19 Server Actions、`useActionState` 或服务器端表单处理（请使用 `react-19` 技能处理这些内容）。

name: email-sequence
description: Design and draft multi-email sequences with full copy, timing, branching logic, exit conditions, and performance benchmarks. Use when building onboarding, lead nurture, re-engagement, win-back, or product launch flows, when you need a complete drip campaign with A/B test suggestions, or when mapping a sequence end-to-end with a flow diagram.
description_zh: 设计并草拟包含完整文案、时间安排、分支逻辑、退出条件和性能基准的多封邮件序列。适用于构建新用户引导、潜在客户培育、重新激活、赢回客户或产品发布流程时，当您需要一个完整的滴灌营销活动并需要A/B测试建议，或需要使用流程图端到端映射序列时。

name: reclaude
description: Refactor CLAUDE.md files to follow progressive disclosure principles. Use when CLAUDE.md is too long or disorganized.
description_zh: 重构 CLAUDE.md 文件以遵循渐进式披露原则。当 CLAUDE.md 过长或结构混乱时使用。

name: functions
description: Deploy serverless browser automation as cloud functions using Browserbase. Use when the user wants to deploy browser automation to run on a schedule or cron, create a webhook endpoint for browser tasks, run automation in the cloud instead of locally, or asks about Browserbase Functions.
description_zh: 使用 Browserbase 将无服务器浏览器自动化部署为云函数。当用户希望将浏览器自动化部署为按计划或 cron 运行、为浏览器任务创建 webhook 端点、在云端而非本地运行自动化，或询问 Browserbase Functions 时使用。

name: startup-analysis
description: Analyze a startup from three perspectives — VC investor, job applicant, and CEO/founder — covering market, traction, unit economics, team, defensibility, runway, equity value, culture, and competitive position, with a verdict for each. Use this skill whenever the user wants to evaluate a startup or private tech company: due diligence, whether to invest in it or join it, weighing a startup job offer, company health, outlook, or competitive position, or open-ended asks such as "what do you think of [company]" or "research [company] for me".
description_zh: 从三个角度分析一家初创公司——风险投资家、求职者和CEO/创始人——涵盖市场、进展、单位经济、团队、防御性、运营时间、股权价值、文化以及竞争地位，并为每个角度给出结论。每当用户想要评估一家初创公司或私营科技公司时，都可以使用这项技能：尽职调查、是否要投资或加入该公司、权衡初创公司的工作机会、公司健康状况、前景或竞争地位，或开放式问题，如“你对[公司]的看法是什么”或“帮我研究一下[公司]”。

name: aiconfig-projects
description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to projects. Do not use this skill; invoke projects instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-projects still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向 — 此功能已更名为“项目”。请勿使用此功能；应调用“项目”功能。保留此功能仅是为了让旧引用的aiconfig-projects仍然指向新名称。

name: aiconfig-create
description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to configs-create. Do not use this skill; invoke configs-create instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-create still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向 — 此技能已重命名为 configs-create。请勿使用此技能；应调用 configs-create。保留此功能仅是为了让旧引用的 aiconfig-create 仍然指向新名称。

name: aiconfig-update
description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to configs-update. Do not use this skill; invoke configs-update instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-update still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向 — 此技能已重命名为 configs-update。请勿使用此技能；应调用 configs-update。保留此技能仅是为了让旧引用的 aiconfig-update 仍然指向新名称。

name: stakeholder-update
description: Generate a stakeholder update tailored to audience and cadence. Use when writing a weekly or monthly status for leadership, announcing a launch, escalating a risk or blocker, or translating the same progress into exec-brief, engineering-detail, or customer-facing versions.
description_zh: 生成一份针对受众和节奏的干系人更新。在撰写每周或每月状态报告给领导、宣布发布、升级风险或障碍，或将相同进展转化为高管简报、工程细节或面向客户的版本时使用。

name: enrich-lead
description: Instant lead enrichment. Drop a name, company, LinkedIn URL, or email and get the full contact card with email, phone, title, company intel, and next actions.
description_zh: 即时获取联系人信息。只需输入姓名、公司名称、LinkedIn链接或电子邮件，即可获取完整的联系人名片，包含电子邮件、电话、职位、公司信息以及下一步行动方案。

name: process-doc
description: Document a business process — flowcharts, RACI, and SOPs. Use when formalizing a process that lives in someone's head, building a RACI to clarify who owns what, writing an SOP for a handoff or audit, or capturing the exceptions and edge cases of how work actually gets done.
description_zh: 记录业务流程——流程图、RACI 和标准操作程序（SOP）。在将存在于某人脑海中的流程正式化时使用，构建 RACI 以明确谁负责什么，编写 SOP 以进行交接或审计，或捕获实际工作中出现的例外情况和边缘案例。

name: debug-optimize-lcp
description: Guides debugging and optimizing Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) using Chrome DevTools MCP tools. Use this skill whenever the user asks about LCP performance, slow page loads, Core Web Vitals optimization, or wants to understand why their page's main content takes too long to appear. Also use when the user mentions "largest contentful paint", "page load speed", "CWV", or wants to improve how fast their hero image or main content renders.
description_zh: 使用 Chrome DevTools 的 MCP 工具指导用户调试和优化 Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)。当用户询问 LCP 性能、页面加载缓慢、核心网页指标 (Core Web Vitals) 优化，或想知道为何页面主要内容加载过慢时，可使用此技能。同样适用于用户提及“最大内容绘制 (largest contentful paint)”、“页面加载速度”、“CWV”，或希望提升其英雄图片或主要内容渲染速度的情况。

name: metrics-review
description: Review and analyze product metrics with trend analysis and actionable insights. Use when running a weekly, monthly, or quarterly metrics review, investigating a sudden spike or drop, comparing performance against targets, or turning raw numbers into a scorecard with recommended actions.
description_zh: 对产品指标进行审查和分析，结合趋势分析和可操作的洞察。在执行每周、每月或每季度的指标审查、调查突然的峰值或下降、对比目标性能或把原始数据转化为包含推荐行动的评分卡时使用。

name: react-doctor
description: Diagnose and fix React codebase health issues. Use when reviewing React code, fixing performance problems, auditing security, or improving code quality.
description_zh: 诊断和修复 React 代码库的健康问题。在审查 React 代码、解决性能问题、进行安全审计或提高代码质量时使用。

name: caveman
description:
Caveman encoding for SPEC.md and spec-adjacent writes. Loaded by /spec, /build,
/check. Cuts tokens ~75% vs prose while staying precise. Triggers on any write
to SPEC.md or when user says "caveman", "compress this", "be brief".
description_zh: 针对SPEC.md和与SPEC相关的写入的原始人编码。由/spec、/build、/check加载。与散文相比，该编码将标记减少约75%同时保持精确性。当对SPEC.md进行任何写入或用户说“原始人”、“压缩这个”、“简洁些”时触发。

name: read-arxiv-paper
description: Use this skill when asked to read an arxiv paper given an arxiv URL
description_zh: 在要求您根据arxiv URL阅读arxiv论文时使用此技能。

name: unreal-cpp-gameplay
description: Write Unreal Engine 5 C++ gameplay code: the UCLASS/UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION reflection macros, the Gameplay Framework (GameMode, Pawn, Character, PlayerController, Actor components), and the module Build.cs.
