Use when the user mentions "legacy code", "no tests", "untested codebase", "how do I test this", "seams", "characterization tests", "golden master", "sprout method", "afraid to change this code", "monster method", "dependency breaking", or "inherited a messy codebase". Also trigger when changing code without tests safely, getting a class under test when constructors, statics, or singletons block it, adding features to tangled modules, or planning incremental test coverage for an old codebase. Covers the legacy-code change algorithm, seams, characterization tests, sprout/wrap, and dependency-breaking techniques. For refactoring code that already has tests, see refactoring-patterns. For day-to-day code quality, see clean-code.
description_zh: 使用Feathers的“有效处理遗留代码”安全地更改和测试未经测试的代码库。当用户提到“遗留代码”、“没有测试”、“未经测试的代码库”、“如何测试这个”、“接口”、“特性测试”、“黄金版本”、“萌芽方法”、“害怕更改这段代码”、“怪物方法”、“依赖破坏”或“继承了一个混乱的代码库”时使用。此外，在安全地更改没有测试的代码时也会触发，当构造函数、静态方法或单例阻止测试类时获取测试类，向纠缠的模块添加功能，或为旧代码库规划增量测试覆盖率。涵盖遗留代码更改算法、接口、特性测试、萌芽/包装和依赖破坏技术。对于已有测试的代码重构，请参阅refactoring-patterns。对于日常代码质量，请参阅clean-code。

name: draft-offer
description: Draft an offer letter with comp details and terms. Use when a candidate is ready for an offer, assembling a total comp package (base, equity, signing bonus), writing the offer letter text itself, or prepping negotiation guidance for the hiring manager.
description_zh: 起草一份包含薪酬细节和条款的录用通知书。当候选人准备接受录用、组装完整的薪酬包（基本工资、股权、签字奖金）、撰写录用通知书文本本身，或为招聘经理准备谈判指导时使用。

name: dry-refactoring
description: Guided workflow to eliminate copy-paste duplication detected by jscpd. Refactor exact, renamed and near-miss clones using extract function, parameterize, module, constant, or base class strategies, starting from the hotspots the summary ranks.
description_zh: 基于jscpd检测到的复制粘贴重复项的引导式工作流程。使用提取函数、参数化、模块、常量或基类策略重构精确、重命名和近似重复的克隆，从摘要排名的热点开始。

name: fal-tryon
description: Virtual try-on — see how clothes look on a person via fal.ai's hosted try-on models. Useful for ecommerce, lookbooks, and styling experiments.
description_zh: 虚拟试穿——通过fal.ai提供的托管试穿模型查看衣物上身效果。适用于电子商务、时尚画册和造型实验。

name: deep-research
description: Deep research on any topic — broad parallel web searches, multi-source validation, confidence tracking, and a cited Markdown report. Use whenever the deliverable is a thorough sourced report rather than a quick answer: 'research <topic>', 'deep dive on X', 'analyze the landscape', 'competitive analysis', 'compare these options', 'who are the players in Z', 'literature review', 'background on Y', 'what papers exist on X', 'product teardown', 'regulatory overview', 'funding landscape', 'what trends are emerging in X', 'patent landscape', 'community health', or any request requiring scanning many sources and producing a cited written analysis. Covers 11 research types: market (TAM/SAM, segments, pricing, trends), domain (industry structure, ecosystem, regulatory overview), technical (architecture, tooling, benchmarks, technology evaluation), competitive (competitor teardown, positioning, win/loss), product (feature analysis, reviews, teardowns, roadmap signals), academic (literature survey, citation networks, key authors), person/org (due diligence on a company or public figure), financial (funding landscape, valuation multiples, revenue signals), legal (IP, patent landscape, litigation, compliance), trend (emerging signals, foresight, scenario mapping), community (ecosystem health, key voices, governance, fragmentation). Trigger even when phrased casually: 'look into X', 'what's the deal with Y', 'dig into Z', 'I need to understand the space', 'catch me up on X'. Do NOT use for single-fact lookups or one-off web questions.
description_zh: 针对任何主题的深入研究——包括广泛的并行网络搜索、多源验证、置信度追踪，以及带有引用的Markdown报告。当交付成果是详尽且有据的报告而非快速回答时，请使用：'研究 <主题>'、'深入探讨X'、'分析现状'、'竞争分析'、'比较这些选项'、'Z领域有哪些参与者'、'文献综述'、'Y的背景'、'X领域有哪些论文'、'产品拆解'、'监管概览'、'资金格局'、'X领域有哪些新兴趋势'、'专利格局'、'社区健康'，或任何需要扫描多个来源并产出带引用的书面分析的要求。涵盖11种研究类型：市场（TAM/SAM、细分市场、定价、趋势）、领域（产业结构、生态系统、监管概览）、技术（架构、工具、基准、技术评估）、竞争（竞争对手拆解、定位、胜负分析）、产品（功能分析、评测、拆解、路线图信号）、学术（文献综述、引用网络、关键作者）、个人/组织（公司或公众人物的尽职调查）、金融（资金格局、估值倍数、收入信号）、法律（知识产权、专利格局、诉讼、合规）、趋势（新兴信号、前瞻、情景映射）、社区（生态系统健康、关键声音、治理、碎片化）。即使表述随意时也可触发：'调查X'、'Y是怎么回事'、'深入挖掘Z'、'我需要了解这个领域'、'让我了解一下X'。不适用于单事实查询或一次性网络问题。

name: ralph-plan
description: Interactive planning assistant that helps create focused, well-structured ralph-loop commands through collaborative conversation
description_zh: 交互式规划助手，通过协作对话帮助创建专注、结构良好的ralph-loop命令

name: netlify-identity
description: Add user authentication to a Netlify site with @netlify/identity — signup/login/logout, Google/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket OAuth, server-side getUser() checks, role-based access control, and Identity event functions. Use it when a task involves adding a login or signup form, gating content to members or roles, "auth middleware" or verifying users in Netlify Functions or Edge Functions, handling OAuth or email-confirmation callbacks, assigning roles at signup, or customizing Identity emails. For locking a whole site to your company or employees-only access, use netlify-access-control instead.
description_zh: 使用 @netlify/identity 为 Netlify 网站添加用户身份验证功能，包括注册/登录/登出、Google/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket OAuth、服务器端 getUser() 检查、基于角色的访问控制以及 Identity 事件函数。当任务涉及添加登录或注册表单、将内容限制为成员或角色访问、"身份验证中间件"或在 Netlify Functions 或 Edge Functions 中验证用户、处理 OAuth 或电子邮件确认回调、在注册时分配角色或自定义 Identity 邮件时，请使用它。若需将整个网站锁定为仅限公司或员工访问，请使用 netlify-access-control。

name: popbill
description: 팝빌 전자세금계산서·전자명세서·현금영수증·문자·카카오톡·팩스·휴폐업/기업정보·계좌조회·홈택스 수집을 테스트/운영 환경에서 안전하게 호출한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 将 Popbill 电子发票、电子明细单、现金收据、短信、KakaoTalk、传真、休业/开业/企业信息、账户查询、HomeTax 的收集在测试/运营环境中安全地调用。在돌쇠中，通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: sentry-fix-issues
description: Find and fix issues from Sentry using MCP. Use when asked to fix Sentry errors, debug production issues, investigate exceptions, or resolve bugs reported in Sentry. Methodically analyzes stack traces, breadcrumbs, traces, and context to identify root causes.
description_zh: 使用MCP从Sentry中查找并修复问题。在需要修复Sentry错误、调试生产问题、调查异常或解决Sentry中报告的bug时使用。系统性地分析堆栈跟踪、面包屑、跟踪和上下文，以确定根本原因。

name: venice-image-edit
description: Image edits, upscaling, and background removal via the Venice.ai API.
description_zh: 通过 Venice.ai API 进行图像编辑、放大和背景移除。

name: aiq-deploy
description: Use when asked to install, deploy, run, validate, troubleshoot, or stop NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint infrastructure.
description_zh: 在要求安装、部署、运行、验证、排错或停止NVIDIA AI-Q Blueprint基础设施时使用。

name: wwas
description: Create product backlog items in Why-What-Acceptance format — independent, valuable, testable items with strategic context. Use when writing structured backlog items, breaking features into work items, or using the WWA format.
description_zh: 以“原因-目的-验收标准”格式创建产品待办事项——独立、有价值、可测试且具有战略背景的待办事项。在编写结构化的待办事项、将功能拆分为工作项或使用WWA格式时使用。

name: iam-helper-for-policy-simulator
description: Safely simulates and applies Google Cloud IAM v1 (Allow) policy changes. Uses the Policy Simulator to replay historical access logs against proposed policies to prevent breaking active workloads before applying the changes. Use when simulating or applying IAM v1 allow policies across Projects, Folders, or Organizations. Don't use for analyzing IAM v2 deny policies, VPC Service Controls, or performing general policy troubleshooting.
description_zh: 安全地模拟并应用 Google Cloud IAM v1（允许）策略变更。使用策略模拟器将历史访问日志重放至拟议的策略，以在应用变更前防止破坏现有工作负载。适用于跨项目、文件夹或组织模拟或应用 IAM v1 允许策略。不适用于分析 IAM v2 拒绝策略、VPC 服务控制或执行一般策略故障排除。

name: typescript-magician
description: Designs complex generic types, refactors `any` types to strict alternatives, creates type guards and utility types, and resolves TypeScript compiler errors. Use when the user asks about TypeScript (TS) types, generics, type inference, type guards, removing `any` types, strict typing, type errors, `infer`, `extends`, conditional types, mapped types, template literal types, branded/opaque types, or utility types like `Partial`, `Record`, `ReturnType`, and `Awaited`.
description_zh: 设计复杂的泛型，将 `any` 类型重构为严格替代类型，创建类型守卫和工具类型，并解决 TypeScript 编译器错误。当用户询问关于 TypeScript (TS) 类型、泛型、类型推断、类型守卫、移除 `any` 类型、严格类型、类型错误、`infer`、`extends`、条件类型、映射类型、模板字面量类型、标记/不透明类型或工具类型（如 `Partial`、`Record`、`ReturnType` 和 `Awaited`）时使用。

name: paywall-upgrade-cro
description: Design and optimize upgrade screens, paywalls, and upsell modals. Useful for SaaS conversion design and pricing-page experiments.
description_zh: 设计并优化升级界面、付费墙和追加销售模态框。适用于SaaS转化设计及定价页面的实验。

name: sora
description: Generate, remix, and manage short video clips via OpenAI's Sora API. Useful for cinematic shots, b-roll, and rapid concept video iteration.
description_zh: 通过 OpenAI 的 Sora API 生成、混音和管理短视频片段。适用于电影镜头、B-roll 以及快速概念视频迭代。

name: s2b-notice-search
description: S2B 학교장터 공개 고객 공고/견적요청 목록을 브라우저 우선으로 조회하고 fixture HTML을 파싱해 공고 메타데이터를 정리한다. 돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다.
description_zh: S2B 학교장터 공개 고객 공고/견적요청 목록을 브라우저 우선으로 조회하고 fixture HTML을 파싱해 공고 메타데이터를 정리한다。돌쇠에서는 가능한 가장 가까운 합법적 공식 단계까지 준비한다。

name: yeet
description: Use for GitHub PR/issue/discussion workflows: create/update PRs, issues, or discussions and post issue or discussion comments; triggers include yeet.
description_zh: 用于 GitHub PR/问题/讨论工作流：创建/更新 PR、问题或讨论，并发布问题或讨论评论；触发器包括 yeet。

name: experience-lds-data-requirements-generate
description: Use when a Lightning Web Component data need is described in ambiguous natural language — turn "get contact info" or "show account data" into a clear, PRD-ready data-requirements spec. TRIGGER when the user says "define data requirements for this LWC", "turn this PRD data section into validated object/field names", "recommend GraphQL vs UIAPI for this data need", "validate these Salesforce API names", or "spec out the LDS adapter for this component", or references LWC bundle files (`.js`, `.js-meta.xml`) whose data layer is not yet specified. DO NOT TRIGGER when the data layer is already fully specified, when authoring the actual query or adapter code from a known spec, or when implementing an LWC end-to-end (use experience-lwc-generate).
description_zh:
在自然语言中描述 Lightning Web Component 数据需求模糊不清时使用——将“获取联系人信息”或“显示账户数据”转化为清晰、符合产品需求文档（PRD）的数据需求规格。  
触发条件：当用户说“为这个 LWC 定义数据需求”、“将这个 PRD 数据部分转化为验证后的对象/字段名”、“为这个数据需求推荐 GraphQL 与 UIAPI”、“验证这些 Salesforce API 名称”，或“为这个组件定义 LDS 适配器”，或引用 LWC 包文件（`.js`、`.js-meta.xml`）且其数据层尚未定义时。  
不触发条件：当数据层已完全定义、从已知规格编写实际查询或适配器代码，或实现 LWC 端到端（使用 `experience-lwc-generate`）时。

name: domain-embedded
description: Use when developing embedded/no_std Rust. Keywords: embedded, no_std, microcontroller, MCU, ARM, RISC-V, bare metal, firmware, HAL, PAC, RTIC, embassy, interrupt, DMA, peripheral, GPIO, SPI, I2C, UART, embedded-hal, cortex-m, esp32, stm32, nrf, 嵌入式, 单片机, 固件, 裸机
description_zh: 在开发嵌入式/no_std Rust时使用。关键词：嵌入式，no_std，微控制器，MCU，ARM，RISC-V，裸机，固件，HAL，PAC，RTIC，embassy，中断，DMA，外设，GPIO，SPI，I2C，UART，embedded-hal，cortex-m，esp32，stm32，nrf，嵌入式，单片机，固件，裸机

name: sales-pipeline-hygiene
description: Run a periodic, checklist-based hygiene audit over an active pipeline snapshot - stale deals (no stage, close date, or amount change, not logged touches) flagged against segment-specific stage medians, close-date push-count anomalies, and missing forecast-critical fields - producing an exception list with a disposition per flagged deal, a remediation plan, and a pass threshold. Use whenever the user mentions pipeline hygiene, a stale deal audit, pipeline cleanup before a QBR, deals that keep pushing, a close date that keeps slipping, missing fields on deals, or "our pipeline is full of junk" - even if they never say "hygiene". Covers B2B and B2C/high-velocity/PLG. Do NOT use for rewriting stage definitions - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@pipeline-stage-definition-audit instead.
description_zh: 对活跃的管道快照进行周期性、基于清单的卫生审计——识别过时交易（无阶段、关闭日期或金额变更、未记录接触记录），并与特定阶段中位数、关闭日期推送次数异常以及缺失预测关键字段进行标记，生成包含每个被标记交易的处置方案、整改计划以及通过阈值的异常列表。在用户提及管道卫生、过时交易审计、QBR前的管道清理、持续推进的交易、不断滑动的关闭日期、交易中缺失字段或“我们的管道充斥着垃圾”时使用——即使他们从未提及“卫生”。涵盖B2B、B2C/高速/PLG。禁止用于重写阶段定义——请使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@pipeline-stage-definition-audit。

name: design-cleanup
description: Sweep the current branch for leftovers of an abandoned design after a significant mid-work decision change, and rewrite the affected code, comments, tests, and docs so the result reads as if it had been designed this way from the beginning. Use when the user says "design cleanup", "clean up the old approach", "erase the journey", says a design decision changed and asks to clean up after it, or after a pivot in approach mid-branch. This is a rewrite pass over the code touched by the decision only — not a general refactoring or bug-hunting pass.
description_zh: 清理当前分支中因重大中途决策变更而遗留的废弃设计残留，并重写受影响的代码、注释、测试和文档，使最终结果看起来像是从一开始就按这种方式设计的。在用户说“设计清理”、“清理旧方法”、“抹去历程”，提到设计决策变更并要求清理后续，或在中途分支中进行方法转向后使用。这是针对决策所触及代码的重写过程——不是通用的重构或排错过程。

name: fal-restore
description: Restore and fix image quality — deblur, denoise, fix faces, and restore old documents using fal.ai's hosted restoration models.
description_zh: 修复并提升图像质量——去模糊、去噪点、修复人像，以及使用 fal.ai 的托管修复模型恢复旧文档。

name: figma-generate-library
description: Build or update a professional-grade design system library in Figma from a codebase. Useful for keeping the Figma source of truth in sync with shipped components.
description_zh: 从代码库中构建或更新 Figma 中的专业级设计系统库。适用于保持 Figma 源代码与已发布组件同步。

name: elicit
description: Run a structured discovery session to build an Allium specification through conversation. Use when the user wants to create a new spec from scratch, elicit or gather requirements, capture domain behaviour, specify a feature or system, define what a system should do, or is describing functionality and needs help shaping it into a specification.
description_zh: 运行一个结构化的发现会议，通过对话构建一个Allium规范。当用户想要从零开始创建一个新的规范、获取或收集需求、捕获领域行为、指定一个功能或系统、定义系统应该做什么，或者正在描述功能并需要帮助将其塑造成规范时使用。

name: modern-web-design
description: Modern web design trends, principles, and implementation patterns for 2024-2025. Use this skill when designing websites, creating interactive experiences, implementing design systems, ensuring accessibility, or building performance-first interfaces. Triggers on tasks involving modern design trends, micro-interactions, scrollytelling, bold minimalism, cursor UX, glassmorphism, accessibility compliance, performance optimization, or design system architecture. References animation skills (GSAP, Framer Motion, React Spring), 3D skills (Three.js, R3F, Babylon.js), and component libraries for implementation guidance.
description_zh: 2024-2025年现代网页设计趋势、原则及实现模式。在设计网站、创建交互体验、实施设计系统、确保可访问性或构建性能优先界面时使用此技能。在涉及现代设计趋势、微交互、滚动叙事、大胆极简主义、光标UX、玻璃态设计、可访问性合规、性能优化或设计系统架构的任务上触发。参考动画技能（GSAP、Framer Motion、React Spring）、3D技能（Three.js、R3F、Babylon.js）及组件库以获取实现指导。

name: sentry-cloudflare-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Cloudflare Workers and Pages. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Cloudflare Workers", "install @sentry/cloudflare", or configure error monitoring, tracing, logging, crons, or AI monitoring for Cloudflare Workers, Pages, Durable Objects, Queues, Workflows, or Hono on Cloudflare.
description_zh: 为 Cloudflare Workers 和 Pages 完整设置 Sentry SDK。当被要求“将 Sentry 添加到 Cloudflare Workers”、“安装 @sentry/cloudflare”或为 Cloudflare Workers、Pages、Durable Objects、Queues、Workflows 或 Cloudflare 上的 Hono 配置错误监控、跟踪、日志记录、计划任务或 AI 监控时使用。

name: deck-guizang-editorial
description: OpenDesign's FY26 marketing plan: brand-to-pipeline — audience, offer, channel mix, and the launch calendar that ties creative to growth. Built as a decision-grade marketing & GTM deck for CMO, growth lead, founder.
description_zh: OpenDesign的2026财年营销计划：从品牌到管道——受众、产品、渠道组合，以及将创意与增长联系起来的发布日历。专为CMO、增长负责人和创始人打造的高阶营销与GTM演示文稿。

name: stitch-loop
description: Iterative design-to-code feedback loop. Critique → adjust → ship cycle for tightening visual fidelity between brief and built UI.
description_zh: 迭代设计到编码的反馈循环。评论 → 调整 → 发布周期，用于提高简报与构建UI之间的视觉保真度。

name: apollo-server
description: Guide for building GraphQL servers with Apollo Server 5.x. Use this skill when: (1) setting up a new Apollo Server project, (2) writing resolvers or defining GraphQL schemas, (3) implementing authentication or authorization, (4) creating plugins or custom data sources, (5) troubleshooting Apollo Server errors or performance issues.
description_zh: 使用 Apollo Server 5.x 构建 GraphQL 服务器的指南。在以下情况下使用此技能：(1) 设置新的 Apollo Server 项目，(2) 编写解析器或定义 GraphQL 模式，(3) 实现身份验证或授权，(4) 创建插件或自定义数据源，(5) 解决 Apollo Server 错误或性能问题。

name: fal-video-edit
description: Edit existing videos using AI — remix style, upscale, remove background, and add audio via fal.ai's hosted video models.
description_zh: 使用 AI 编辑现有视频——采用混剪风格、提升分辨率、移除背景，并通过 fal.ai 的托管视频模型添加音频。

name: figma-code-connect-components
description: Connect Figma design components to code components using Code Connect so design-system updates flow into the codebase automatically.
description_zh: 使用 Code Connect 将 Figma 设计组件连接到代码组件，以便设计系统更新可以自动流入代码库。

name: venice-audio-speech
description: Text-to-speech models, voices, formats, and streaming via Venice.ai. Useful for narration, voiceover, and conversational agent voices.
description_zh: 通过 Venice.ai 提供的文本转语音模型、声音、格式和流媒体服务。适用于旁白、配音和对话式代理声音。

name: platform-quick-deploy
description: Deploy validated metadata to a Production Salesforce org without re-running tests. TRIGGER when the user wants to deploy to production, says 'quick deploy', 'promote', 'ship to prod', or has just validated and wants to push the change live. REQUIRES a recent `sf project deploy validate` job ID (≤10 days old, ≤3 days for --use-most-recent). DO NOT TRIGGER for sandbox/scratch deploys (use platform-metadata-deploy) or unvalidated deploys (use platform-deploy-validate first).
description_zh: 将验证后的元数据部署到生产环境的 Salesforce 组织，无需重新运行测试。当用户想要部署到生产环境时触发，例如输入“快速部署”、“推广”、“部署到生产”或刚刚验证后想要将更改上线。需要最近执行的 `sf project deploy validate` 任务 ID（≤10天旧，≤3天为 --use-most-recent）。不要触发沙盒/草稿部署（使用 platform-metadata-deploy）或未验证部署（先使用 platform-deploy-validate）。

name: sox-testing
description: Generate SOX sample selections, testing workpapers, and control assessments. Use when planning quarterly or annual SOX 404 testing, pulling a sample for a control (revenue, P2P, ITGC, close), building a testing workpaper template, or evaluating and classifying a control deficiency.
description_zh: 生成 SOX 示例选择、测试工作底稿和控制评估。在规划季度或年度 SOX 404 测试、为控制（收入、P2P、ITGC、结账）抽取样本、构建测试工作底稿模板或评估和分类控制缺陷时使用。

name: first-customers
description: Create a strategy for selling to your first 100 customers using the minimalist entrepreneur playbook. Use when someone has a product and needs to find customers, or is struggling with early sales.
description_zh: 使用极简创业者手册制定向首批100名客户销售的战略。适用于拥有产品但需要寻找客户，或早期销售遇到困难的人。

name: gif-sticker-maker
description: Convert photos into animated GIF stickers in Funko Pop / Pop Mart style via the MiniMax API. Useful for personalized chat stickers and avatar packs.
description_zh: 通过MiniMax API将照片转换为Funko Pop / Pop Mart风格的动画GIF贴纸。适用于个性化聊天贴纸和头像包。

name: cx-cost-optimization
description: Use this skill when the user asks to "check data usage", "list TCO policies", "reduce Coralogix costs", "optimize observability spend", "lower our logging bill", "data budget exceeded", "TCO policy", "retention tier", "archive storage", "ingestion costs", "frequent search vs archive", "why is our bill so high", "spending too much on logs", "data retention settings", "cost analysis", "usage breakdown", "optimize log volume", "control data ingestion", "archive cold data", "billing units", "plan consumption", "daily plan", "overage", "PAYG", "usage anomaly", "usage trend", "cx_data_usage_units", or wants to investigate, analyze, or reduce Coralogix data costs.
description_zh: 当用户要求“检查数据使用情况”、“列出TCO策略”、“降低Coralogix成本”、“优化可观察性支出”、“降低我们的日志费用”、“数据预算超支”、“TCO策略”、“保留层级”、“归档存储”、“摄取成本”、“频繁搜索与归档”、“为什么我们的账单这么高”、“在日志上花费过多”、“数据保留设置”、“成本分析”、“使用情况明细”、“优化日志量”、“控制数据摄取”、“归档冷数据”、“计费单位”、“计划消耗”、“每日计划”、“超额”、“按量付费”、“使用异常”、“使用趋势”、“cx_data_usage_units”或希望调查、分析或降低Coralogix数据成本时，请使用此功能。

name: code-review-pro
description: Performs a deep code review of files, modules, a diff, or a branch - finding security vulnerabilities (mapped to OWASP Top 10:2025), correctness bugs, performance problems, and maintainability issues - and returns severity-ranked findings with evidence and concrete fixes. Use when the user asks to review, audit, or sanity-check code, asks "is this safe", "what's wrong with this", "find bugs", or wants a security or performance pass before shipping. For posting line comments on a GitHub pull request, use git-pr-reviewer.
description_zh: 对文件、模块、差异或分支进行深度代码审查，发现安全漏洞（映射至 OWASP Top 10:2025）、正确性错误、性能问题和可维护性问题，并返回按严重程度排序的发现结果，附带证据和具体修复方案。当用户要求审查、审计或检查代码，询问“这个安全吗”、“这里有什么问题”、“查找错误”，或在发布前需要安全或性能检查时使用。若需在 GitHub 拉取请求中添加行级评论，请使用 git-pr-reviewer。

name: actionbook
description: Activate when the user needs to interact with any website — browser automation, web scraping, screenshots, form filling, UI testing, monitoring, or building AI agents. Provides pre-verified page actions with step-by-step instructions and tested selectors.
description_zh: 当用户需要与任何网站进行交互时（例如浏览器自动化、网页抓取、截图、表单填写、UI 测试、监控或构建 AI 代理）即可激活。提供经过预先验证的页面操作，包含分步说明和经过测试的选择器。

name: chart-visualization
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to visualize data. It intelligently selects the most suitable chart type from 26 available options, extracts parameters based on detailed specifications, and generates a chart image using a JavaScript script.
description_zh: 当用户想要可视化数据时，应使用此技能。它智能地从26种可用选项中选择最合适的图表类型，根据详细规范提取参数，并使用JavaScript脚本生成图表图像。

name: memory-leak-debugging
description: Diagnoses and resolves memory leaks in JavaScript/Node.js applications. Use when a user reports high memory usage, OOM errors, or wants to capture, compare, or inspect heap snapshots with Chrome DevTools MCP memory tools.
description_zh: 诊断和解决 JavaScript/Node.js 应用中的内存泄漏。当用户报告高内存使用、OOM 错误，或希望使用 Chrome DevTools MCP 内存工具捕获、比较或检查堆快照时使用。

name: revops-kickoff
description: Before starting any RevOps or Sales Ops task, and at the start of every session on an ongoing RevOps project, run this first - it routes the task to exactly one skill of the revops-skills collection or says plainly that none fits, and bootstraps or resumes the project's shared, versioned context artifact so the next session starts warm instead of cold, ending in a short-list plus an ordered skill chain. Run it even when the collection's other skills are already used daily - a new project is a new context. Also use whenever the user mentions a revops kickoff, a new RevOps project, a revops project start, revops or crm skill routing, a periodic RevOps check-in, a recurring RevOps review, "which revops skill do I need", or "where do I start with RevOps" - even if they never name a skill, and even if the request looks like it already belongs to one specific skill. Do NOT use for routing quota-carrying sales tasks - use mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-kickoff instead.
description_zh: 在开始任何 RevOps 或 Sales Ops 任务之前，以及在持续进行的 RevOps 项目的每个会话开始时，首先运行这个——它会将任务路由到 revops-skills 集合中的确切一个技能，或者直接说明没有匹配的技能，并启动或恢复项目的共享、版本化的上下文工件，以便下一个会话能够以热启动而非冷启动开始，最终以一个简短列表和一个有序技能链结束。即使集合中的其他技能已经每天使用——新项目就是新上下文。此外，每当用户提到 revops 启动、新的 RevOps 项目、revops 项目开始、revops 或 crm 技能路由、定期的 RevOps 检查、周期性的 RevOps 回顾、“我需要哪个 revops 技能”或“我该如何开始 RevOps”时——即使他们从未提及具体技能，并且即使请求看起来已经属于某个特定技能——也请使用。**不要**用于路由携带配额的销售任务——请使用 mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-kickoff。

name: figma-create-new-file
description: Create a new blank Figma Design or FigJam file. Useful as the first step in scripted design-system or workshop workflows.
description_zh: 创建一个新的空白 Figma 设计或 FigJam 文件。可作为脚本化设计系统或工作坊工作流程的第一步。

name: replicate
description: Discover, compare, and run AI models using Replicate's API. Strong fit for image, audio, and video generation pipelines that swap models frequently.
description_zh: 使用 Replicate 的 API 发现、比较和运行 AI 模型。非常适合频繁切换模型的图像、音频和视频生成流程。

name: figma-code-connect-components
description: Connects Figma design components to code components using Code Connect mapping tools. Use when user says "code connect", "connect this component to code", "map this component", "link component to code", "create code connect mapping", or wants to establish mappings between Figma designs and code implementations. For canvas writes via `use_figma`, use `figma-use`.
description_zh: 使用 Code Connect 映射工具将 Figma 设计组件连接到代码组件。当用户说“代码连接”、“将此组件连接到代码”、“映射此组件”、“将组件链接到代码”或希望建立 Figma 设计与代码实现之间的映射关系时使用。通过 `use_figma` 进行的画布写入，请使用 `figma-use`。

name: rsbuild-best-practices
description: Configure, review, or troubleshoot Rsbuild applications, including build/dev commands, assets, type checking, and bundle optimization.
description_zh: 配置、审查或排错 Rsbuild 应用程序，包括构建/开发命令、资源、类型检查和捆绑包优化。

name: cx-olly
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "chat with AI", "ask Olly", "ask the agent", "send message to AI", "continue a chat", "follow up on chat", "get artifact", "download artifact", "list artifacts", "retrieve generated content", "AI-generated charts", "AI analysis", "conversational observability", "natural language query", or wants to interact with the Coralogix Observability Agent (Olly) using the cx CLI.
description_zh: 当用户要求“与AI聊天”、“询问Olly”、“询问代理”、“向AI发送消息”、“继续聊天”、“跟进聊天”、“获取工件”、“下载工件”、“列出工件”、“检索生成内容”、“AI生成的图表”、“AI分析”、“对话可观察性”、“自然语言查询”，或使用cx CLI与Coralogix可观察性代理（Olly）交互时，应使用此技能。

name: platform-environment-validate
description: Validate and configure the local Salesforce development environment. Runs a prerequisite scan across required tools with per-tool status and offers to install or update missing items. Use when the user asks to 'check my setup', 'validate tools', 'verify prerequisites', 'am I set up correctly', or reports a tool is missing or not working. DO NOT TRIGGER for org auth (/salesforce-development:login), deployment problems (platform-metadata-deploy), or status checks (/salesforce-development:status).
description_zh: 验证并配置本地 Salesforce 开发环境。对所需工具运行前提条件扫描，并提供安装或更新缺失项的选项。当用户要求“检查我的设置”、“验证工具”、“验证前提条件”、“我设置正确吗”，或报告工具缺失或无法工作时使用。禁止触发组织认证（/salesforce-development:login）、部署问题（platform-metadata-deploy）或状态检查（/salesforce-development:status）。

name: propagate
description: Generate tests from Allium specifications. Use when the user wants to propagate tests, generate test files from a spec, write tests for a specification, create property-based tests, produce state machine tests, check test coverage against spec obligations, or understand what tests a specification requires.
description_zh: 从Allium规范中生成测试。当用户希望传播测试、从规范生成测试文件、为规范编写测试、创建基于属性的测试、生成状态机测试、检查测试覆盖率与规范义务的符合性，或了解规范需要哪些测试时使用。

name: threejs-game-ui-designer
description: Design premium Three.js game UI: HUDs, menus, overlays, pause/win/lose screens, settings, icon controls, touch UI, typography, responsive layout, safe areas, text fit, and UI/world cohesion.
description_zh: 设计高端 Three.js 游戏界面：HUD、菜单、覆盖层、暂停/胜利/失败界面、设置、图标控制、触控界面、字体排版、响应式布局、安全区域、文本适配以及 UI 与世界的协调性。

name: pipeline-stage-definition-audit
description: Audit existing sales pipeline stage definitions against buyer-verifiable milestones and flag the ones built on rep activity instead. Core test - does each stage exit criterion name something the buyer did, said, or agreed to, checkable by two managers independently? Adds stage aging, conversion decay, stage-skip rate, and close-date push diagnostics. Use whenever the user mentions stage definitions, stage exit criteria, stage inflation, stages named after rep activity ("demo scheduled", "proposal sent"), "our stages don't mean anything", or "why is everything stuck in one stage" - even if they never say "audit". Covers enterprise and high-velocity pipelines, B2B and B2C. Do NOT use for designing a funnel stage set from scratch - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-funnel instead.
description_zh: 对照买方可验证的里程碑审计现有销售管道阶段定义，并标记那些基于销售代表活动构建的阶段。核心测试——每个阶段的退出标准名称是否指买方所做、所说或同意的事项，且可由两位经理独立核查？增加阶段老化、转化衰减、阶段跳过率和截止日期推送诊断功能。每当用户提及阶段定义、阶段退出标准、阶段膨胀、以销售代表活动命名的阶段（如“安排演示”、“发送提案”）、“我们的阶段毫无意义”或“为什么所有事情都卡在同一个阶段”时使用——即使他们从未提及“审计”。涵盖企业级和高周转率管道、B2B和B2C。切勿用于从零设计漏斗阶段集——请使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-funnel。

name: revenue-funnel
description: Design a company's revenue funnel model from scratch, at the macro level - the stage set, the unit of analysis (lead, buying group, account), the model purpose (process vs planning vs forecast), the cohort-based conversion assumptions behind the plan, and the ownership handoffs between marketing, sales, and CS. Use whenever the user mentions funnel design, funnel stages, a funnel model, conversion rate assumptions, a bowtie model, a demand waterfall, MQL to SQL to opportunity definitions, or marketing-sales handoff design - even if they never say "funnel". Covers B2B and high-consideration B2C. Do NOT use for auditing an existing pipeline's stage definitions - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@pipeline-stage-definition-audit instead.
description_zh: 从零开始设计一家公司的收入漏斗模型，在宏观层面——包括阶段设置、分析单位（潜在客户、购买群体、客户账户）、模型目的（流程型、规划型、预测型）、计划背后的基于群体的转化假设，以及市场、销售和客户服务之间的所有权交接。当用户提到漏斗设计、漏斗阶段、漏斗模型、转化率假设、蝴蝶结模型、需求瀑布模型、MQL到SQL到机会定义，或市场-销售交接设计时使用——即使他们从未提及“漏斗”。涵盖B2B和高考虑度B2C。不适用于审计现有管道的阶段定义——请使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@pipeline-stage-definition-audit。

name: fal-kling-o3
description: Generate images and videos with Kling O3 — Kling's most powerful model family — via fal.ai.
description_zh: 通过 fal.ai 生成图像和视频，使用 Kling O3——Kling 最强大的模型家族。

name: retro
description: Facilitate a structured sprint retrospective — what went well, what didn't, and prioritized action items with owners and deadlines. Use when running a retrospective, reflecting on a sprint, creating action items from team feedback, or learning how to run effective retros.
description_zh: 促进结构化的冲刺回顾——哪些方面做得好，哪些方面做得不好，以及与负责人和截止日期优先排序的行动项。在执行回顾、反思冲刺、根据团队反馈创建行动项或学习如何进行有效回顾时使用。

name: sales-forecast-diagnostic
description: Diagnose why an existing sales forecast is unreliable and recommend fixes - stage inflation and happy ears, sandbagging, deals without verifiable buyer evidence, stale or mass-pushed close dates, wrong forecast-category assignment, zombie and duplicate opportunities, late-created deals, manager roll-up overrides, and comp incentives that reward bias - separating data-quality from behavioral from genuine demand problems. Use whenever the user mentions forecast accuracy, a forecast miss, reps sandbagging, deals that keep slipping, "why did we miss the number", or "our commit is never right" - even if they never say "forecast". Covers B2B deal-based and B2C/high-volume. Do NOT use for pipeline coverage modeling - use mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling instead.
description_zh: 诊断现有销售预测为何不可靠并建议解决方案——包括阶段膨胀和“快乐耳朵”现象、沙袋策略、缺乏可验证买家证据的交易、过时或批量推送的关闭日期、错误的预测类别分配、僵尸和重复机会、后期创建的交易、经理汇总覆盖的覆盖、以及奖励偏见的绩效激励——需将数据质量问题与行为问题及真实需求问题区分开来。当用户提及预测准确性、预测失误、销售代表沙袋策略、交易持续滑落、“我们为何未达目标”或“我们的承诺永远不对”时使用——即使他们从未提及“预测”。涵盖B2B交易型和B2C/高容量模式。禁止用于管道覆盖率建模——请使用mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-pipeline-coverage-modeling。

name: venice-image-generate
description: Image generation endpoints and available styles via the Venice.ai API.
description_zh: 通过Venice.ai API提供的图像生成端点和可用风格。

name: what-the
description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.
description_zh: 怎么了？当用户想要了解某个技术问题的简单英文解释时使用——包括人物、事件、地点、原因和时机。

name: fal-train
description: Train custom AI models (LoRA) on fal.ai for personalized image generation tailored to a brand, character, or style.
description_zh: 在fal.ai上训练定制AI模型（LoRA），以生成符合品牌、角色或风格的个性化图像。

name: muapi-youtube-shorts
description: Auto-generate viral 9:16 YouTube Shorts (or TikTok / Reels clips) from a long-form video. Thin platform-aware wrapper around the AI Clipping skill — picks sensible defaults for short-form social platforms (9:16, 30–60s sweet spot) and delegates the actual highlight extraction + crop to muapi.ai's `/ai-clipping` endpoint.
description_zh: 自动从长视频生成病毒式传播的 9:16 YouTube Shorts（或 TikTok/Reels 短片）。这是一个围绕 AI 剪辑技能的轻量级平台感知包装器——为短视频社交平台（9:16 比例，30-60 秒黄金时长）选择合理的默认设置，并将实际的高亮提取和裁剪工作委托给 muapi.ai 的 `/ai-clipping` 端点。

name: platform-destructive-deploy
description: Execute the destructiveChanges.xml delete-and-deploy workflow against a Salesforce org. TRIGGER when the user asks to delete/remove a custom object, field, Apex class, flow, or any metadata component FROM an org, or to perform a 'destructive deploy' / removal as part of a release. Validates first and gates production with explicit confirmation. DO NOT TRIGGER for local file deletion (use Bash), or for net-new deploys (use platform-metadata-deploy).
description_zh: 对Salesforce组织执行destructiveChanges.xml删除并部署工作流。当用户请求删除/移除自定义对象、字段、Apex类、流程或任何元数据组件时触发，或在发布中执行“破坏性部署”/移除操作时触发。首先进行验证，并通过明确确认来控制生产环境的触发。禁止用于本地文件删除（使用Bash），或用于全新的部署（使用platform-metadata-deploy）。

name: aiconfig-ai-metrics
description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to built-in-metrics. Do not use this skill; invoke built-in-metrics instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-ai-metrics still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向 — 此技能已被重命名为 built-in-metrics。请勿使用此技能；应调用 built-in-metrics。保留此技能仅是为了让旧引用的 aiconfig-ai-metrics 仍然指向新名称。

name: microsoft-outlook
description: Microsoft Outlook integration. Manage communication data, records, and workflows. Use when the user wants to interact with Microsoft Outlook data.
description_zh: Microsoft Outlook 集成。管理通信数据、记录和工作流程。当用户希望与 Microsoft Outlook 数据交互时使用。

name: cc-best-practices
description: Guidance on how to use Claude Code effectively — covering context management, verification strategies, the explore-plan-implement workflow, prompting techniques, session management, parallel sessions, and common failure patterns. Use this skill whenever the user asks how to get the most out of Claude Code, how to write better prompts, how to manage context, when to use plan mode, how to automate tasks, or when they describe a frustrating pattern like Claude repeating mistakes or losing track of instructions.
description_zh: 如何有效使用Claude Code的指南——涵盖上下文管理、验证策略、探索-计划-实施工作流、提示技巧、会话管理、并行会话和常见错误模式。当用户询问如何充分利用Claude Code、如何编写更好的提示、如何管理上下文、何时使用计划模式、如何自动化任务，或描述类似Claude重复错误或忘记指令的令人沮丧的模式时，请使用此技能。

name: tanstack-start
description: Build a full-stack TanStack Start app on Cloudflare Workers from scratch — SSR, file-based routing, server functions, D1+Drizzle, better-auth, Tailwind v4+shadcn/ui. Use whenever the user mentions TanStack Start, asks to scaffold a full-stack Cloudflare app with SSR, wants an SSR dashboard, or asks for a React 19 + Cloudflare Workers app with file-based routing and server functions — even if they don't name TanStack Start specifically. No template repo — Claude generates every file fresh per project.
description_zh: 从零开始在 Cloudflare Workers 上构建一个完整的 TanStack Start 应用程序——SSR、基于文件的路由、服务器函数、D1+Drizzle、better-auth、Tailwind v4+shadcn/ui。每当用户提到 TanStack Start、要求使用 SSR 搭建全栈 Cloudflare 应用、需要 SSR 仪表板，或要求使用 React 19 + Cloudflare Workers 应用（具有基于文件的路由和服务器函数）时——即使他们没有明确提到 TanStack Start。无需模板仓库——Claude 为每个项目实时生成所有文件。

name: distill
description: Extract an Allium specification from an existing codebase. Use when the user has existing code and wants to distil behaviour into a spec, reverse engineer a specification from implementation, generate a spec from code, turn implementation into a behavioural specification, or document what a codebase does in Allium terms.
description_zh: 从现有代码库中提取一个 Allium 规范。当用户已有代码并希望将行为提炼为规范、从实现中逆向工程规范、从代码生成规范、将实现转换为行为规范，或以 Allium 术语记录代码库所做之事时使用。

name: revops-career
description: Build and advance a RevOps or Sales Ops career from the candidate's side - place the candidate on the ladder by scope rather than title, close competency gaps, build defensible evidence of structurally invisible work, and prepare the four exercises RevOps interview loops actually run. Produces a career plan with a gap roadmap, an evidence ledger, interview readiness, and a compensation ask. Use whenever the user mentions a RevOps career, a sales ops career path, RevOps interview prep, RevOps certifications, "how do I break into RevOps", "am I ready for a RevOps manager role", or proving impact when nobody notices ops working - even if they never say "career". Candidate side only - for the hiring manager's side, use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revops-hiring instead.
description_zh: 从候选人的角度构建和推进 RevOps 或销售运营 (Sales Ops) 职业发展——根据职责范围而非职位头衔将候选人置于职业阶梯上，弥补能力差距，构建结构化无形工作的可辩护证据，并准备 RevOps 面试环节实际执行的四个练习。生成包含差距路线图、证据账本、面试准备和薪酬要求的职业规划。每当用户提及 RevOps 职业发展、销售运营职业路径、RevOps 面试准备、RevOps 认证、"如何进入 RevOps"、"我是否准备好担任 RevOps 经理职位"，或在无人注意运营工作时证明影响——即使他们从未提及"职业"——均可使用。仅限候选人使用——对于招聘经理的角度，请使用 mbfinotti/revops-skills@revops-hiring。

name: fal-realtime
description: Real-time and streaming AI image generation via fal.ai. Suited for moodboard exploration, draft variations, and rapid creative iteration.
description_zh: 通过fal.ai实现实时和流式AI图像生成。适用于情绪板探索、草稿变体和快速创意迭代。

name: skill-creator
description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch for Claude Code or Cursor, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
description_zh: 创建新技能、修改和改进现有技能，并衡量技能性能。当用户希望为 Claude Code 或 Cursor 从零开始创建技能、更新或优化现有技能、运行评估以测试技能、通过方差分析基准测试技能性能，或优化技能描述以提高触发准确性时使用。

name: skill-best-practices
description: Guide for creating, structuring, and improving Claude skills (SKILL.md). Use when building a new skill, reviewing an existing skill, writing SKILL.md frontmatter, defining trigger conditions, troubleshooting skill problems (not triggering, over-triggering, instructions not followed), or planning skill distribution. When working on any skill in this repository: also load the cc-best-practices skill, and always update both CLAUDE.md and README.md skill tables after any skill change. Do NOT use for general Claude Code configuration or hook setup.
description_zh: 创建、构建和改进Claude技能（SKILL.md）指南。在构建新技能、审查现有技能、编写SKILL.md前置内容、定义触发条件、解决技能问题（未触发、过度触发、指令未遵循）或规划技能分发时使用。在处理此存储库中的任何技能时：同时加载cc-best-practices技能，并在任何技能更改后始终更新CLAUDE.md和README.md技能表。不应用于一般Claude代码配置或钩子设置。

name: aiconfig-migrate
description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to migrate. Do not use this skill; invoke migrate instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-migrate still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向——此技能已更名为迁移。请勿使用此技能；应调用迁移。仅保留此功能，以便旧引用中的aiconfig-migrate仍能指向新名称。

name: revenue-kpi-framework
description: Design the org-wide revenue KPI framework at the macro level - which metrics matter at each org level from board to IC, how they roll up through a reconciling metric tree with explicit math, who owns each branch, which guardrail counter-metrics ride alongside each owned number, and how the set is gated by company stage and business model. Use whenever the user mentions a revenue KPI framework, a metric hierarchy, a KPI tree, a North Star metric, driver metrics, guardrail counter-metrics, NRR, or which revenue metrics each org level should track - even if they never say "framework". Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use for writing the board report itself - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-reporting instead.
description_zh: 在宏观层面设计全组织的收入KPI框架——从董事会到一线员工，每个组织层级应关注哪些指标，这些指标如何通过明确的数学公式在平衡计分树中汇总，每个分支由谁负责，哪些保护性反指标与每个负责的指标并行，以及该指标集如何根据公司发展阶段和商业模式进行限制。每当用户提及收入KPI框架、指标层级、KPI树、北极星指标、驱动指标、保护性反指标、NRR或各组织层级应追踪的收入指标时，均需使用——即使他们从未明确说“框架”。涵盖B2B和B2C业务。不应用于撰写董事会报告本身——应使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-reporting。

name: xlsx
description: Comprehensive spreadsheet creation, editing, and analysis with support for formulas, formatting, data analysis, and visualization. When Claude needs to work with spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv, etc) for: (1) Creating new spreadsheets with formulas and formatting, (2) Reading or analyzing data, (3) Modify existing spreadsheets while preserving formulas, (4) Data analysis and visualization in spreadsheets, or (5) Recalculating formulas
description_zh: 全面支持公式、格式设置、数据分析及可视化的电子表格创建、编辑和分析。当Claude需要处理电子表格（.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv等）时，包括：(1) 创建带有公式和格式的电子表格，(2) 读取或分析数据，(3) 修改现有电子表格并保留公式，(4) 电子表格中的数据分析和可视化，或(5) 重新计算公式。

name: create-verification-skill
description: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does — any language, framework, or platform. Use for /create-verification-skill, "make a control skill for this repo", or when a project has no scripted way to prove UI/CLI/service behavior.
description_zh: 生成一个项目本地验证技能，以用户使用的方式驱动您的应用程序——任何语言、框架或平台。用于 /create-verification-skill、“为这个存储库创建一个控制技能”，或当项目没有脚本方式来证明 UI/CLI/服务行为时使用。

name: revenue-leakage
description: Trace where deals and revenue silently exit one specific funnel and size the loss in recoverable (never gross) dollars - untracked steps, unworked leads, manual handoffs, mid-funnel stalls, paper-process drops, billing and renewal misses - separating real leaks from healthy disqualification and data-capture gaps. Use whenever the user mentions revenue leakage, funnel drop-off, a leaky funnel, deals disappearing, unworked leads, handoff gaps, "where are we losing deals", or "why did pipeline vanish" - even if they never say "leakage". Covers B2B sales-led and B2C/self-serve/PLG, one funnel instance at a time. Takes stage definitions as given - to audit those, use mbfinotti/revops-skills@pipeline-stage-definition-audit instead.
description_zh: 追踪交易和收入在特定漏斗中如何悄无声息地流失，并以可收回（非毛额）美元计算损失——未追踪的步骤、未处理的潜在客户、手动交接、漏斗中途停滞、纸质流程遗漏、计费和续约疏漏——将真正的漏洞与健康淘汰及数据捕获缺口区分开来。当用户提及收入流失、漏斗流失、漏斗渗漏、交易消失、未处理的潜在客户、交接缺口，或询问“我们在哪里丢失交易”或“为什么我们的漏斗消失了”——即使他们从未明确说“流失”——时，均可使用。涵盖B2B销售主导、B2C/自助服务/PLG模式，每次针对一个漏斗实例。接受阶段定义作为既定前提——若需审计这些定义，请使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@pipeline-stage-definition-audit。

name: video-report
description: Generate a report about a video
description_zh: 生成一份关于视频的报告

name: camel-matrix
description: Generates a Markdown compatibility matrix for Apache Camel Spring Boot, Spring Boot, and Apache CXF versions by running the camel-springboot-matrix.sh script. Use when the user asks to generate or update the Camel compatibility matrix, check Camel Spring Boot version compatibility, or run the camel-springboot-matrix script. Supports optional version range arguments (min max).
description_zh: 通过运行 camel-springboot-matrix.sh 脚本，生成 Apache Camel Spring Boot、Spring Boot 和 Apache CXF 版本的 Markdown 兼容性矩阵。当用户要求生成或更新 Camel 兼容性矩阵、检查 Camel Spring Boot 版本兼容性或运行 camel-springboot-matrix 脚本时使用。支持可选的版本范围参数（最小值 最大值）。

name: grill-me
description: Calibrated grilling session for stress-testing a plan, design, idea, or decision. First assesses the user's topic knowledge, confidence, and desired pressure level, then asks one question at a time with recommended answers. Use when user says "grill me", "stress-test this", "challenge my plan", "interview me", or wants a plan probed without being overwhelmed.
description_zh: 针对计划、设计、想法或决策进行压力测试的校准式烧烤会话。首先评估用户对主题的知识、信心和期望的压力水平，然后逐一提出问题并提供推荐答案。当用户说“让我经受烧烤”、“对这进行压力测试”、“挑战我的计划”、“面试我”，或希望在不感到不知所措的情况下进行计划探究时使用。

name: analyzing-user-feedback
description: Help users convert massive volumes of qualitative and quantitative feedback into high-confidence product decisions through rigorous synthesis and internal immersion.
description_zh: 帮助用户通过严谨的综合分析和内部深入理解，将大量的定性和定量反馈转化为高置信度的产品决策。

name: lottie-animations
description: After Effects animation rendering for web and React applications. Use this skill when implementing Lottie animations, JSON vector animations, interactive animated icons, micro-interactions, or loading animations. Triggers on tasks involving Lottie, lottie-web, lottie-react, dotLottie, After Effects JSON export, bodymovin, animated SVG alternatives, or designer-created animations. Complements GSAP ScrollTrigger and Framer Motion for scroll-driven and interactive animations.
description_zh: 用于网页和React应用程序的After Effects动画渲染。在实现Lottie动画、JSON矢量动画、交互式动画图标、微交互或加载动画时使用此技能。适用于涉及Lottie、lottie-web、lottie-react、dotLottie、After Effects JSON导出、bodymovin、动画SVG替代方案或设计师创建的动画的任务。与GSAP ScrollTrigger和Framer Motion结合，用于滚动驱动和交互式动画。

name: crm-data-governance
description: Design and operate CRM field-level governance - who owns each CRM field, which system is authoritative for it, how often it must be refreshed, and how the rules are enforced. Produces a field dictionary, per-field ownership, a system-of-record map with write-precedence and conflict rules, freshness SLAs, an enforcement plan, a field lifecycle, and a governance cadence. Use whenever the user mentions field ownership, single source of truth, system of record per field, data dictionary, stale CRM data, custom field sprawl, "which system wins", or "our CRM fields contradict each other" - even if they never say "governance". Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use for org-wide, object-level source-of-truth policy - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-data-governance-strategy instead.
description_zh: 设计和运营CRM字段级治理——明确每个CRM字段的所有者、哪个系统具有权威性、需要多久刷新一次以及如何执行规则。产出字段字典、按字段的所有权划分、具有写入优先级和冲突规则的记录系统映射、数据新鲜度服务水平协议（SLA）、执行计划、字段生命周期以及治理节奏。每当用户提及字段所有权、单一事实来源、每个字段的记录系统、数据字典、过时的CRM数据、自定义字段蔓延、“哪个系统获胜”或“我们的CRM字段相互矛盾”时使用——即使他们从未提及“治理”。涵盖B2B和B2C场景。请勿用于组织范围的、对象级别的真相来源政策——应使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-data-governance-strategy。

name: marketing-plan
description: Create a minimalist marketing plan focused on building an audience through content, not ads. Use when someone has product-market fit (~100 customers) and wants to scale with marketing, or needs a content strategy.
description_zh: 创建一个以内容而非广告来吸引受众的极简营销计划。适用于拥有产品市场契合度（约100名客户）并希望借助营销实现规模扩张，或需要内容策略的情况。

name: revops-radar
description: Build a personalised, time-budgeted watch list of RevOps / Sales Ops information sources - revops podcasts, revops newsletters, revops communities, industry events, and revops people to follow - every source verified still active, with a periodic refresh routine that keeps the list fresh. Use whenever the user mentions a revops radar, staying current in revenue operations, which revops newsletters or podcasts to subscribe to, which revops communities or conferences deserve their time, or who to follow in the field - even if they never say "radar". Tool-agnostic; B2B-SaaS-centric with explicit B2C guidance. Do NOT use for sales-specific sources - use mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-radar instead.
description_zh: 构建一个个性化的、按时间预算的RevOps/Sales Ops信息源清单——包括RevOps播客、RevOps简报、RevOps社区、行业活动以及值得关注的RevOps人士——确保每个信息源都经过验证且仍然活跃，并配备定期刷新机制以保持清单的时效性。每当用户提及RevOps雷达时，即可使用该工具，以保持收入运营领域的最新动态，了解应订阅哪些RevOps简报或播客、哪些RevOps社区或会议值得投入时间，以及在领域内应关注哪些人士——即使他们从未明确提及“雷达”。工具无关性；以B2B-SaaS为中心，并明确提供B2C指导。请勿用于销售特定信息源——应使用mbfinotti/sales-skills@sales-radar。

name: tend
description: Tend the Allium garden. Use when the user wants to write, edit, update, add to, improve, clarify, refine, restructure, fix or migrate Allium specs. Covers adding entities, rules, triggers, surfaces and contracts, fixing syntax or validation errors, renaming or refactoring within specs, migrating specs to a new language version, and translating requirements into well-formed specifications. Pushes back on vague requirements.
description_zh: 管理Allium花园。当用户想要撰写、编辑、更新、添加、改进、澄清、精炼、重构、修复或迁移Allium规范时使用。涵盖添加实体、规则、触发器、界面和合约，修复语法或验证错误，在规范内重命名或重构，将规范迁移到新的语言版本，以及将需求转化为结构良好的规范。对模糊的需求提出异议。

name: chatgpt-codex-onboarding
description:
Connect a ChatGPT or Codex subscription via OAuth device-code login.

Use when the user wants to sign in with their ChatGPT Plus, Pro, or Team account (e.g. "use my Codex subscription", "log in with ChatGPT").
description_zh:
通过 OAuth 设备码登录连接 ChatGPT 或 Codex 订阅。

当用户希望使用他们的 ChatGPT Plus、Pro 或 Team 账户登录时使用（例如：“使用我的 Codex 订阅”、“使用 ChatGPT 登录”）。

name: figma-generate-library
description: Build or update a professional-grade design system in Figma from a codebase. Use when the user wants to create variables/tokens, build component libraries, set up theming (light/dark modes), document foundations, or reconcile gaps between code and Figma. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.
description_zh: 根据代码库构建或更新一个专业级 Figma 设计系统。当用户希望创建变量/令牌（variables/tokens）、构建组件库、配置主题（浅色/深色模式）、记录基础规范，或弥合代码与 Figma 之间的差异时使用。本技能指导**需要构建什么内容**以及**按什么顺序构建**，它与 `figma-use` 技能互补，后者讲解如何调用 Plugin API。两个技能应同时加载使用。

name: card-xiaohongshu
description: Xiaohongshu-style knowledge cards, arranged as a swipeable multi-card carousel.
description_zh: 小红书风格的知識卡片，排列成可滑动的多卡片轮播。

name: revops-hiring
description: Build the complete hiring packet for a RevOps or Sales Ops role - archetype and level decision, outcome scorecard, interview stage map with a competency question bank and anchored rating scales, a work-sample exercise with rubric and debrief, and a 30-60-90 ramp plan branched on seniority and archetype. For the hiring manager or founder recruiting the hire. Use whenever the user mentions hiring a RevOps manager, sales ops interview questions, a RevOps take-home exercise, a scorecard for a first ops hire, or a 30-60-90 for a new ops hire - even if they never say "hiring packet". Does not source candidates or post jobs. Do NOT use for a candidate's own interview prep - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revops-career instead.
description_zh: 为 RevOps 或销售运营 (Sales Ops) 职位构建完整的招聘材料包——包括原型和级别决策、结果评分卡、包含能力问题库和锚定评分标准的面试阶段地图、带有评分标准和复盘的工作样本练习，以及基于资历和原型的 30-60-90 适应计划。适用于招聘经理或创始人进行招聘。当用户提及招聘 RevOps 经理、销售运营面试问题、RevOps 带回家练习、首次运营招聘的评分卡，或新运营招聘的 30-60-90 计划时，无论是否明确提及“招聘材料包”，均适用。不负责候选人来源或发布职位。请勿用于候选人的个人面试准备——应使用 mbfinotti/revops-skills@revops-career。

name: draft-nda
description: Draft a detailed Non-Disclosure Agreement between two parties covering information types, jurisdiction, and clauses needing legal review. Use when creating confidentiality agreements or preparing an NDA for a partnership.
description_zh: 起草一份详细的保密协议，涵盖信息类型、司法管辖权以及需要法律审核的条款。在创建保密协议或为合作准备NDA时使用。

name: ibd-distribution-day-monitor
description: Detect IBD-style Distribution Days for QQQ/SPY (close down at least 0.2% on higher volume), track 25-session expiration and 5% invalidation, count d5/d15/d25 clusters, classify market risk (NORMAL/CAUTION/HIGH/SEVERE), and emit TQQQ/QQQ exposure recommendations. Use after market close, before TQQQ exposure changes, or as input to FTD/market-state frameworks. Does not execute trades.
description_zh: 检测 QQQ/SPY 的 IBD 风格分布日（收盘下跌至少 0.2%，成交量放大），跟踪 25 个交易日到期和 5% 作废率，统计 d5/d15/d25 集群，分类市场风险（正常/谨慎/高/严重），并发出 TQQQ/QQQ 投资组合建议。可在收盘后、TQQQ 投资组合调整前或作为 FTD/市场状态框架的输入使用。不执行交易。

name: domain-ml
description: Use when building ML/AI apps in Rust. Keywords: machine learning, ML, AI, tensor, model, inference, neural network, deep learning, training, prediction, ndarray, tch-rs, burn, candle, 机器学习, 人工智能, 模型推理
description_zh: 用于在 Rust 中构建机器学习/人工智能应用程序。关键词：机器学习、ML、AI、张量、模型、推理、神经网络、深度学习、训练、预测、ndarray、tch-rs、burn、candle、机器学习、人工智能、模型推理

name: academic-paper-review
description: Use this skill when the user requests to review, analyze, critique, or summarize academic papers, research articles, preprints, or scientific publications. Supports comprehensive structured reviews covering methodology assessment, contribution evaluation, literature positioning, and constructive feedback generation. Trigger on queries involving paper URLs, uploaded PDFs, arXiv links, or requests like "review this paper", "analyze this research", "summarize this study", or "write a peer review".
description_zh: 在用户请求审阅、分析、评论或总结学术论文、研究文章、预印本或科学出版物时使用此技能。支持全面的结构化审阅，涵盖方法评估、贡献评价、文献定位和建设性反馈生成。在涉及论文URL、上传的PDF、arXiv链接或类似“审阅这篇论文”、“分析这项研究”、“总结这项研究”或“撰写同行评审”的请求时触发。

name: pixelbin-media
description: Generate and edit images and videos with an 85+ API portfolio and build visually appealing website pages via Pixelbin.
description_zh: 使用 Pixelbin，通过 85+ 的 API 组合生成和编辑图像和视频，并构建视觉吸引力强的网站页面。

name: define-goal
description: Help the user define a concrete, measurable goal before starting work, especially when they ask to use the goal tool, create a goal, set an objective, clarify success criteria, or turn a fuzzy intention into a quantitative outcome. Use this skill for goal creation and goal refinement only; it does not manage durable snapshots, decision logs, or long-running execution artifacts.
description_zh: 在开始工作之前，帮助用户设定一个具体、可衡量的目标，尤其是在他们要求使用目标工具、创建目标、设定目标、明确成功标准或将模糊的意图转化为量化结果时。仅使用此技能进行目标创建和目标优化；它不管理持久快照、决策日志或长期运行的可执行工件。

name: cloud-build-basics
description: Teaches the fundamentals of Google Cloud Build (GCB). Covers core concepts, API enablement, console navigation to the Build History page, and the end-to-end workflow for creating and manually running a basic build trigger. Do not use for managing private pools or complex pipeline architectures.
description_zh: 教授 Google Cloud Build (GCB) 的基础知识。涵盖核心概念、API 启用、控制台导航至构建历史页面，以及创建和手动运行基本构建触发器的端到端工作流程。不适用于管理私有池或复杂管道架构。

name: aiconfig-custom-metrics
description: DEPRECATED redirect — this skill was renamed to custom-metrics. Do not use this skill; invoke custom-metrics instead. Kept only so old references to aiconfig-custom-metrics still point users to the new name.
description_zh: 已弃用的重定向 — 此技能已更名为 custom-metrics。请勿使用此技能；应调用 custom-metrics。保留此技能仅是为了让旧引用（如 aiconfig-custom-metrics）仍然指向新名称。

name: revenue-data-governance-strategy
description: Set org-wide revenue data governance policy - which system is source of truth per object class (account, contact, opportunity, subscription, usage event, revenue metrics), how cross-team data contracts bind producers to consumers, where revenue metric definitions live, and who arbitrates disputes. Produces a per-object SOR/SOT designation table, an identity-resolution spine, a data-contract register, and a federated ownership model. Use whenever the user mentions source of truth, "two ARR numbers", GTM data contracts, revenue data governance, metric definition ownership, or "finance and sales report different numbers" - even if they never say "governance". Covers B2B, PLG/B2C, hybrid. Do NOT use for CRM field-level rules - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@crm-data-governance instead.
description_zh: 设定全组织的收入数据治理政策——每个对象类别（账户、联系人、机会、订阅、使用事件、收入指标）的“单一事实来源”系统是什么，跨团队数据合同如何将生产者与消费者绑定，收入指标定义的存放位置，以及争议的仲裁者是谁。生成每个对象的“单一事实来源”/“系统间数据传递”指定表、身份解析骨干、数据合同注册表和联邦所有权模型。每当用户提到“单一事实来源”、“两个ARR数字”、GTM数据合同、收入数据治理、指标定义所有权或“财务和销售报告数字不同”——即使他们从未提及“治理”，也请使用。涵盖B2B、PLG/B2C、混合模式。请勿用于CRM字段级规则——应使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@crm-data-governance。

name: slack-gif-creator
description: Create animated GIFs optimized for Slack with validators for size constraints and composable animation primitives.
description_zh: 为 Slack 创建经过优化的动画 GIF，包含用于尺寸限制的验证器和可组合的动画基础元素。

name: wpds
description: WordPress Design System. Apply WordPress's official design tokens, typography, and component patterns to themes and sites.
description_zh: WordPress 设计系统。将 WordPress 官方的设计令牌、排版和组件模式应用于主题和网站。

name: venice-video
description: Video generation and transcription workflows via the Venice.ai API.
description_zh: 通过Venice.ai API进行视频生成和转录工作流程。

name: resume-modern
description: Modern minimal resume, single A4 page, ready for print or PDF export.
description_zh: 现代简约简历，单页A4纸，可用于打印或PDF导出。

name: binlog-failure-analysis
description: Analyze MSBuild binary logs to diagnose build failures. USE FOR: build errors that are unclear from console output, diagnosing cascading failures across multi-project builds, tracing MSBuild target execution order, and generally any MSBuild build issues. Requires an existing .binlog file. DO NOT USE FOR: generating binlogs (use binlog-generation), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 分析 MSBuild 二进制日志以诊断构建失败。适用场景：从控制台输出中无法明确了解的构建错误、诊断跨多项目构建的级联失败、追踪 MSBuild 目标执行顺序，以及任何 MSBuild 构建问题。需要现有的 .binlog 文件。不适用场景：生成 binlogs（请使用 binlog-generation）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: trading-skills-navigator
description: Recommend the right trading workflow, skillset, API profile, and setup path from a natural-language goal. Use this as the on-ramp when a user expresses a trading or investing goal and needs to know which skill/workflow to use, where to start, or whether something works without paid API keys — e.g. "where do I start", "which skill should I use", "I want to swing trade only when the market is favorable", "what works without API keys", "どれを使えばいい", "API キー無しで 使えるものは". Routes and explains only; it never executes trades or auto-runs other skills, and it is honest when no workflow has shipped yet.
description_zh: 根据自然语言目标，推荐合适的交易流程、技能集、API配置文件和设置路径。当用户表达交易或投资目标，需要了解应使用哪个技能/流程、从何处开始，或是否可在未支付API密钥的情况下使用时，以此作为入口。例如："我从哪里开始"、"我应该使用哪个技能"、"我只想在市场有利时进行波段交易"、"哪些功能可在没有API密钥的情况下使用"、"どれを使えばいい"、"API キー無しで 使えるものは"。仅提供路线指引和解释；它从不执行交易或自动运行其他技能，并且在尚未发布工作流程时保持诚实。

name: migrate-to-parallel
description: Migrate Exa, Tavily, Perplexity, or Firecrawl web-data integrations completely to the appropriate Parallel products while preserving application behavior. Use when replacing these providers' SDKs or REST calls, dependencies, environment variables, request parameters, response parsing, model tools, search-plus-scrape paths, full-content or answer-synthesis paths, tests, and documentation; separating unsupported research-index, crawl, browser, file-parse, monitor, or other non-search capabilities; auditing for leftover provider usage; or finishing and verifying an in-progress provider migration.
description_zh: 将 Exa、Tavily、Perplexity 或 Firecrawl 的网络数据集成完全迁移到相应的 Parallel 产品，同时保留应用程序行为。在替换这些提供商的 SDK 或 REST 调用、依赖项、环境变量、请求参数、响应解析、模型工具、搜索加抓取路径、全文或答案合成路径、测试和文档时使用；分离不支持的科研索引、抓取、浏览器、文件解析、监控或其他非搜索功能；审计剩余的提供商使用情况；或完成并验证正在进行中的提供商迁移。

name: mockup-device-3d
description: Static iPhone and MacBook 3D-style showcase with real HTML embedded on screens, glass-lens refraction, and 360-degree turntable composition.
description_zh: 静态iPhone和MacBook 3D风格展示，屏幕上嵌入真实HTML，玻璃镜头折射效果，360度旋转台构图。

name: parabolic-short-trade-planner
description: Screen US equities for parabolic exhaustion patterns and generate conditional pre-market short plans, then evaluate intraday trigger fires from live 5-min bars. Phase 1 daily 5-factor scorer (MA extension / acceleration / volume climax / range expansion / liquidity), Phase 2 per-candidate plans for ORL break / first-red 5-min / VWAP fail with explicit borrow / SSR / manual-confirmation gating, Phase 3 one-shot intraday FSM that detects trigger fires and resolves concrete share counts. Covers Phase 1 + Phase 2 + Phase 3.
description_zh: 筛选美国股票的抛物线衰竭模式，并生成条件性开盘前做空计划，然后评估实时5分钟K线图的日内触发信号。第一阶段每日5因子评分器（均线延伸/加速/量能巅峰/区间扩张/流动性），第二阶段针对每个候选标的制定ORL突破/首红5分钟/VWAP失效的计划，并明确融券/SSR/手动确认的触发条件，第三阶段一次性日内有限状态机，用于检测触发信号并确定具体股数。涵盖第一阶段+第二阶段+第三阶段。

name: db
description: Oracle Database guidance for SQL, PL/SQL, SQLcl, ORDS, Oracle Vector SDK, administration, app development, performance, security, migrations, and agent-safe database workflows. Use when the user asks to write, edit, rewrite, review, format, debug, tune, or explain SQL; create or refactor PL/SQL; use Oracle VecDB through the Python SDK, REST API, or DBMS_VECTOR_DATABASE package; use SQLcl, Liquibase, ORDS, JDBC, node-oracledb, Python, Java, .NET, or database frameworks; troubleshoot vector tables, embeddings, vector search, reranking, queries, sessions, locks, waits, indexes, optimizer plans, AWR, ASH, migrations, schemas, users, roles, privileges, backup, recovery, Data Guard, RAC, multitenant, containers, monitoring, auditing, encryption, VPD, or safe agent database operations.
description_zh: SQL、PL/SQL、SQLcl、ORDS、Oracle Vector SDK、管理、应用程序开发、性能、安全、迁移和代理安全数据库工作流的Oracle数据库指南。当用户要求编写、编辑、重写、审查、格式化、调试、调整或解释SQL；创建或重构PL/SQL；通过Python SDK、REST API或DBMS_VECTOR_DATABASE包使用Oracle VecDB；使用SQLcl、Liquibase、ORDS、JDBC、node-oracledb、Python、Java、.NET或数据库框架；排除向量表、嵌入、向量搜索、重新排序、查询、会话、锁、等待、索引、优化器计划、AWR、ASH、迁移、模式、用户、角色、权限、备份、恢复、Data Guard、RAC、多租户、容器、监控、审计、加密、VPD或安全代理数据库操作时使用。

name: domain-fintech
description: Use when building fintech apps. Keywords: fintech, trading, decimal, currency, financial, money, transaction, ledger, payment, exchange rate, precision, rounding, accounting, 金融, 交易系统, 货币, 支付
description_zh: 在构建金融科技应用程序时使用。关键词：金融科技，交易，小数，货币，金融，金钱，交易，账簿，支付，汇率，精度，四舍五入，会计，金融，交易系统，货币，支付

name: dt-dql-essentials
description: Core DQL syntax, pitfalls, query patterns, and query optimization. Load to write, build, fix, or OPTIMIZE a DQL query — prevents syntax errors and makes queries faster, more efficient, and cheaper (less data scanned = lower query consumption/cost per run). Covers fetch commands, data models, field namespaces, time alignment, entity/smartscape patterns, metric discovery, and performance/cost optimization (filter early, bucket filters, short time ranges, field selection, sampling, cardinality). Trigger: "write/build/fix a DQL query", "DQL syntax", "query logs/spans/metrics", "create a timeseries", "optimize my DQL", "make my query faster/cheaper", "reduce DQL cost/consumption/scanned data", "keep DQL cost under control". Do NOT use to explain an existing query or answer product questions. For MONITORING a tenant's ACTUAL query consumption/billing (how much queries cost, who scanned most, cost trends) use dt-platform-costs — this tunes the query text, not billing data.
description_zh: 核心DQL语法、常见陷阱、查询模式及查询优化。用于编写、构建、修复或OPTIMIZE DQL查询——防止语法错误，并使查询更快、更高效、成本更低（扫描数据量减少 = 每次查询的消耗/成本降低）。涵盖获取命令、数据模型、字段命名空间、时间对齐、实体/Smartscape模式、指标发现以及性能/成本优化（早期过滤、分桶过滤、短时间范围、字段选择、采样、基数）。触发条件："编写/构建/修复DQL查询"、"DQL语法"、"查询日志/跨度/指标"、"创建时间序列"、"优化我的DQL"、"使我的查询更快/更便宜"、"减少DQL成本/消耗/扫描数据"、"控制DQL成本"。**不用于解释现有查询或回答产品问题**。若需监控租户的**实际查询消耗/计费**（查询成本、谁扫描最多、成本趋势），请使用`dt-platform-costs`——该工具调整查询文本，而非计费数据。

name: animated-component-libraries
description: Pre-built animated React component collections combining Magic UI (150+ TypeScript/Tailwind/Motion components) and React Bits (90+ minimal-dependency animated components). Use this skill when building landing pages, marketing sites, dashboards, or interactive UIs requiring pre-made animated components instead of hand-crafting animations. Triggers on tasks involving animated UI components, Magic UI, React Bits, shadcn/ui integration, Tailwind CSS components, or component library selection. Alternative to manually implementing animations with Framer Motion or GSAP.
description_zh: 预构建的动画 React 组件集合，结合了 Magic UI（150 多个 TypeScript/Tailwind/Motion 组件）和 React Bits（90 多个轻量级依赖动画组件）。在构建落地页、营销网站、仪表盘或需要预置动画组件而非手工制作动画的交互式 UI 时使用此技能。触发于涉及动画 UI 组件、Magic UI、React Bits、shadcn/ui 集成、Tailwind CSS 组件或组件库选择的任务。替代使用 Framer Motion 或 GSAP 手动实现动画的方法。

name: weed
description: Weed the Allium garden. Find where Allium specifications and implementation code have diverged, and help resolve the divergences. Use when the user wants to check spec-code alignment, compare specs against implementation, audit for spec drift or violations, sync specs with code or code with specs, or verify whether the implementation matches what the spec says.
description_zh: 清理Allium花园。找出Allium规范和实现代码之间的差异，并协助解决这些差异。当用户需要检查规范-代码的一致性、比较规范与实现、审计规范漂移或违规、同步规范与代码或代码与规范，或验证实现是否与规范所述相符时使用。

name: conventional-git
description: Conventional Commits v1.0.0 branch naming, worktree naming, and commit message standards for GitHub and GitLab projects. Use when creating branches, naming worktrees, writing commits, generating commit messages, reviewing branch conventions, or setting up changelog automation. Apply when your project needs consistent git history, SemVer-driven releases, parseable changelog generation, or automatic issue closing. Trigger when the user asks how to name a worktree, create a git worktree, or organize worktrees alongside branches.
description_zh: 常规提交 v1.0.0 分支命名、工作区命名和提交信息标准，适用于 GitHub 和 GitLab 项目。在创建分支、命名工作区、编写提交信息、生成提交信息、审查分支规范或设置变更日志自动化时使用。当您的项目需要一致的 git 历史记录、基于 SemVer 的发布、可解析的变更日志生成或自动关闭问题时适用。当用户询问如何命名工作区、创建 git 工作区或在分支旁边组织工作区时触发。

name: agentwallet
description: Wallets for AI agents with x402 and MPP payment signing, referral rewards, and policy-controlled actions.
description_zh: 用于AI代理的钱包，支持x402和MPP支付签名、推荐奖励以及策略控制操作。

name: retrieving-developer-knowledge
description: Searches, retrieves, and synthesizes official Google developer documentation across Google Cloud, AI/Gemini, Android, Chrome, Web, Flutter, Go, Firebase, and other Google developer platforms. Integrates with the Developer Knowledge MCP server (search_documents, get_documents, answer_query) or the Developer Knowledge REST API fallback. Use when searching for gcloud CLI commands, API syntax, IAM permissions, official documentation, architectural comparisons, or product choice overviews. Don't use for local filesystem lookups or non-Google documentation.
description_zh: 搜索、检索和整合来自 Google Cloud、AI/Gemini、Android、Chrome、Web、Flutter、Go、Firebase 以及其他 Google 开发者平台的官方 Google 开发者文档。与开发者知识 MCP 服务器（search_documents、get_documents、answer_query）或开发者知识 REST API 备用方案集成。在搜索 gcloud CLI 命令、API 语法、IAM 权限、官方文档、架构比较或产品选择概览时使用。不用于本地文件系统查找或非 Google 文档。

name: before-you-build
description: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.
description_zh: 为创始人、产品经理和AI辅助构建者提供预构建产品和功能风险审查。当用户即将构建落地页、MVP、SaaS产品、内部工具、代理工作流或主要功能，并在实施开始前需要检查需求、定位、变现、留存、信任、分发和采用风险时，使用此技能。

name: rank-local
description: Build a local SEO strategy covering Google Business Profile, local citations, reviews, and NAP consistency. Use when the user asks about local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Maps ranking, local pack, NAP consistency, local citations, review strategy, or ranking for "[service] near me" searches.
description_zh: 制定一个本地SEO策略，涵盖Google商家资料、本地引用、评价和NAP一致性。当用户询问关于本地SEO、Google商家资料、Google地图排名、本地包、NAP一致性、本地引用、评价策略或"[服务]附近"搜索排名时使用。

name: pricing
description: Help figure out pricing for a product or service using minimalist entrepreneur principles. Use when someone is setting prices, considering price changes, or struggling with what to charge.
description_zh: 使用极简主义创业原则来帮助确定产品或服务的定价。适用于在设定价格、考虑价格变动或对如何收费感到困惑时使用。

name: ios-debugger-agent
description: Use XcodeBuildMCP to build, run, launch, and debug the current iOS project on a booted simulator. Trigger when asked to run an iOS app, interact with the simulator UI, inspect on-screen state, capture logs/console output, or diagnose runtime behavior using XcodeBuildMCP tools.
description_zh: 使用 XcodeBuildMCP 在启动的模拟器上构建、运行、启动和调试当前的 iOS 项目。当要求运行 iOS 应用、与模拟器 UI 交互、检查屏幕状态、捕获日志/控制台输出或使用 XcodeBuildMCP 工具诊断运行时行为时触发。

name: imsg
description: Use the imsg CLI from OpenClaw agents for iMessage/SMS DMs, groups, replies, reactions, polls, watching, and private-API actions.
description_zh: 使用 OpenClaw 代理的 imsg CLI 进行 iMessage/SMS 群聊、回复、反应、投票、监控以及私有 API 操作。

name: article-magazine
description: Huashu / huashu-md-html-inspired magazine article layout for turning Markdown or notes into a polished long-form HTML essay.
description_zh: 华树 / 华树-md-html-inspired杂志文章布局，用于将Markdown或笔记转换为精致的长期HTML文章。

name: deck-swiss-international
description: OpenDesign's FY26 board pre-read: the open-core bet, growth vs burn, and the one decision the board must approve. Built as a decision-grade corporate strategy deck for board, CEO, CFO.
description_zh: OpenDesign的2026财年董事会预读：开源核心的赌注、增长与消耗的博弈，以及董事会必须批准的一项决策。专为董事会、CEO、CFO打造的战略决策级企业演示文稿。

name: video-hyperframes
description: Hyperframes / Remotion-compatible continuous frame animation with autoplay support.
description_zh: 超帧 / 兼容 Remotion 的连续帧动画，支持自动播放。

name: threejs-aaa-graphics-builder
description: Upgrade Three.js games from prototype visuals to premium browser graphics: art-direction critique, procedural model building, material and texture libraries, world prop kits, shaders, VFX, lighting and render pipeline, LOD and instancing, render budgets, and a 10-category visual scorecard. Use when screenshots still look basic or the user asks for premium, AAA, high-fidelity, showcase, or less-basic graphics.
description_zh: 将 Three.js 游戏从原型视觉效果升级至高端浏览器图形：艺术指导批评、程序化模型构建、材质和纹理库、世界道具套件、着色器、视觉特效（VFX）、光照和渲染管线、细节层次（LOD）和实例化、渲染预算，以及一个包含10个类别的视觉评分卡。当截图仍显基础，或用户要求高端、AAA级、高保真、展示性或更非基础的图形时使用。

name: portable-text-conversion
description: Convert HTML and Markdown content into Portable Text blocks for Sanity. Use when migrating content from legacy CMSs, importing HTML or Markdown into Sanity, building content pipelines that ingest external content, converting rich text between formats, or programmatically creating Portable Text documents. Covers @portabletext/markdown (markdownToPortableText), @portabletext/block-tools (htmlToBlocks), custom deserializers, and the Portable Text specification for manual block construction.
description_zh: 将 HTML 和 Markdown 内容转换为 Sanity 的 Portable Text 块。适用于从旧版 CMS 迁移内容、将 HTML 或 Markdown 导入 Sanity、构建摄取外部内容的 内容管道、在不同格式之间转换富文本，或通过编程方式创建 Portable Text 文档。涵盖 @portabletext/markdown（markdownToPortableText）、@portabletext/block-tools（htmlToBlocks）、自定义反序列化器，以及用于手动构建块的 Portable Text 规范。

name: implement-paper
description: Implement a research paper as an interactive marimo notebook together with the user. Start by understanding what the user wants to explore, fetch the paper via alphaxiv, then build a focused notebook.
description_zh: 将一篇研究论文实现为一个与用户交互的Marimo笔记本。首先，了解用户想要探索的内容，通过alphaxiv获取论文，然后构建一个专注的笔记本。

name: substack-ghostwriting
description: Write, optimize, and grow Substack content — newsletter issues (email-first) and web posts (web-first essays). Covers voice matching, Substack algorithm and Notes strategy, email formatting, SEO, growth tactics, and paid-subscriber monetization. Use when the user mentions Substack, a newsletter issue, a Substack post or article, evergreen content, newsletter growth, Notes, paid subscribers, 'ghostwrite for', or 'write in the style of' — and for newsletter or essay writing even when Substack is not named, or when adapting a blog post, talk, or thread into newsletter format. Do NOT use for generic blog post writing without a newsletter context — use samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer instead.
description_zh: 撰写、优化和扩展 Substack 内容——订阅邮件（以邮件优先）和网页文章（以网页优先的随笔）。涵盖语音匹配、Substack 算法与笔记策略、邮件格式化、SEO、增长策略以及付费订阅者变现。当用户提及 Substack、订阅邮件、Substack 文章或随笔、长青内容、订阅增长、笔记、付费订阅者、'代笔'或'模仿写作风格'时使用——即使未提及 Substack，或需将博客文章、演讲或讨论串转换为订阅邮件格式时同样适用。不适用于无订阅邮件背景的通用博客文章撰写——此时请使用 samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer。

name: customer-health-score
description: Design, validate, and govern a composite customer health score - product usage and engagement signals combined into one weighted, normalized, decayed, banded account score that flags both churn risk and expansion readiness, backtested against real churn outcomes and recalibrated. Use whenever the user mentions a customer health score, health scoring model, account health, signal weighting, score bands, at-risk account flagging, churn risk score, expansion risk, or says "green accounts keep churning" - even if they never say "health score". Covers B2B account-level rollup and B2C/PLG continuous scoring. Do NOT use for discovering which indicators actually predict churn - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-churn-signals instead.
description_zh: 设计、验证和管理一个复合型客户健康评分——将产品使用和参与信号结合为一个加权、归一化、衰减、分段的账户评分，该评分可同时标记客户流失风险和业务拓展准备度，并经过真实流失结果的回测和重新校准。在用户提及客户健康评分、健康评分模型、账户健康、信号加权、评分分段、风险账户标记、流失风险评分、业务拓展风险，或说“绿色账户仍在流失”时使用——即使他们从未明确说“健康评分”。涵盖B2B账户级别的汇总和B2C/PLG持续评分。请勿使用此功能来发现哪些指标实际上能预测流失——应使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-churn-signals。

name: deck-open-slide-canvas
description: OpenDesign's architecture review: the local daemon + agent-runtime design, the tradeoffs, and the decision to lock. Built as a decision-grade product management deck for staff eng, tech leads, security.
description_zh: OpenDesign 架构评审：本地守护进程 + 代理运行时设计、权衡取舍以及锁定决策。作为决策级产品管理演示文稿构建，面向员工工程师、技术负责人和安全团队。

name: press-release-writer
description: Write professional press releases for any occasion, media type, and region. Use when the user wants to write, draft, or improve a press release, communiqué de presse, media announcement, or news release — including product launches, funding rounds, partnerships, crisis communications, executive hires, events, M&A, and open source milestones. Covers media targets (print, digital/wire, broadcast, social/SMPR, trade press) and region-specific conventions worldwide. Also trigger on 'I need to announce something' or 'how do I tell the press about X'. Do NOT use for blog posts or technical articles — use samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer instead; for newsletter issues, use samber/cc-skills@substack-ghostwriting.
description_zh: 为任何场合、任何媒体类型和任何地区撰写专业的新闻稿。当用户需要撰写、起草或优化新闻稿、媒体声明、媒体公告或新闻通稿时，应使用此功能——涵盖产品发布、融资轮次、合作伙伴关系、危机沟通、高管任命、活动、并购（M&A）以及开源里程碑等场景。支持各类媒体渠道（印刷媒体、数字/通讯社、广播、社交媒体/SMPR、行业媒体）以及全球各地的地区性惯例。同时，当用户表达“我需要宣布某事”或“我该如何向媒体介绍 X”等需求时也应触发。请勿用于博客文章或技术文章——请改用 samber/cc-skills@technical-article-writer；如需撰写通讯（newsletter）内容，请改用 samber/cc-skills@substack-ghostwriting。

name: trigger-setup
description: Bootstrap Trigger.dev into an existing project from scratch: authenticate the CLI, install @trigger.dev/sdk and @trigger.dev/build, write trigger.config.ts with the project ref and task dirs, scaffold a /trigger directory with a first task, wire tsconfig and .gitignore, set TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY, and run the dev server. Load this when a project has no trigger.config.ts yet and the user asks to "add Trigger.dev", "set up Trigger.dev", "initialize Trigger.dev", or get a first task running, including in a monorepo. Once the project is set up and you are writing task code, switch to the trigger-tasks skill.
description_zh: 从零开始将 Trigger.dev 集成到现有项目中：验证 CLI、安装 @trigger.dev/sdk 和 @trigger.dev/build、编写 trigger.config.ts 并包含项目引用和任务目录、搭建带有首个任务的 /trigger 目录、配置 tsconfig 和 .gitignore、设置 TRIGGER_SECRET_KEY，然后运行开发服务器。当项目尚未存在 trigger.config.ts 且用户请求“添加 Trigger.dev”、“设置 Trigger.dev”、“初始化 Trigger.dev”或启动首个任务时（包括在单体仓库中），加载此流程。项目配置完成后，在编写任务代码时切换到 trigger-tasks 技能。

name: dev-browser
description: Browser automation with persistent named pages via the dev-browser CLI. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, log into sites, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", "open the browser", or any browser interaction request.
description_zh: 使用 dev-browser CLI 实现持久化命名页面的浏览器自动化。当用户需要导航网站、填写表单、截取屏幕截图、提取网页数据、测试网页应用、登录网站或自动化浏览器工作流程时使用。触发短语包括“访问 [url]”、“点击”、“填写表单”、“截取屏幕截图”、“抓取”、“自动化”、“测试网站”、“登录”、“打开浏览器”或任何浏览器交互请求。

name: naver-ad-performance
description: 네이버 검색광고(키워드광고)의 노출수·클릭수·광고비·CTR·CPC·전환수를 조회한다. 캠페인/광고그룹/키워드 목록, 기간별 성과, 연관키워드·월간 조회수 도구 포함. 읽기 전용, 로컬 실행 전용. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 查询 Naver 搜索广告（关键词广告）的展示量、点击量、广告费、CTR、CPC 和转换数。包括活动/广告组/关键词列表、按期间的绩效，以及关联关键词和月度浏览量工具。只读，仅限本地运行。在 Dolesso 中，还可通过官方界面执行后续操作。

name: find-community
description: Help identify and evaluate communities to build a minimalist business around. Use when someone is looking for a business idea, trying to find their community, or wondering where to start as an entrepreneur.
description_zh: 帮助识别和评估社区，以便围绕其构建简约型业务。适用于以下场景：当某人正在寻找商业创意、试图找到自己的社区，或作为创业者不确定从哪里开始时。

name: registry
description: Pay-per-call API gateway for AI agents. 10 services available via x402 — no API keys, no subscriptions.
description_zh: 按调用付费的API网关，适用于AI代理。通过x402即可使用10项服务——无需API密钥，无需订阅。

name: assembly-bill-vote-search
description: 열린국회정보 Open API를 k-skill-proxy 경유로 호출해 의안 검색·상세와 국회의원 본회의 표결정보를 조회한다. 조회 전용.
description_zh: 通过 k-skill-proxy 中转调用 열린국회정보 Open API，进行议案搜索、详情查看以及国会代表会议表决信息查询。仅限查询功能。

name: mcp-lark
description: Based on FeiShu(飞书) / Lark's OpenAPI MCP server, manage user information, chats, emails, cloud documents, multidimensional tables, tasks, calendars, etc.
description_zh: 基于飞书/Lark 开放平台 MCP 服务器，管理用户信息、群聊、邮件、云文档、多维表格、任务、日程等功能。

name: swiftlint
description: Configures and enforces SwiftLint in Swift projects using build tool plugins, run scripts, and CI. Covers .swiftlint.yml configuration, disabled_rules, opt_in_rules, only_rules, analyzer_rules, baselines, autocorrect, swiftlint:disable suppressions, reporter formats (sarif, json, checkstyle), strict and lenient modes, SwiftLintBuildToolPlugin via SimplyDanny/SwiftLintPlugins, swift package plugin swiftlint, Xcode run script phases, CI integration, multiple configuration files, and rollout strategies for existing codebases. Use when setting up SwiftLint, configuring lint rules, suppressing warnings, creating baselines, choosing between build tool plugin and run script, or integrating SwiftLint into CI.
description_zh: 使用构建工具插件、运行脚本和持续集成（CI）配置并强制执行 SwiftLint 在 Swift 项目中。涵盖 .swiftlint.yml 配置、禁用规则、选择加入规则、仅限规则、分析器规则、基线、自动更正、swiftlint:disable 抑制、报告器格式（sarif、json、checkstyle）、严格和宽松模式、SimplyDanny/SwiftLintPlugins 的 SwiftLintBuildToolPlugin、swift package 插件 swiftlint、Xcode 运行脚本阶段、CI 集成、多个配置文件以及现有代码库的发布策略。在设置 SwiftLint、配置检查规则、抑制警告、创建基线、选择构建工具插件和运行脚本之间、或将 SwiftLint 集成到 CI 时使用。

name: frontend-design
description: Design and implement a distinctive frontend within the product’s existing brand, accessibility, performance and framework constraints.
description_zh: 在产品现有的品牌、可访问性、性能和框架限制内设计和实现一个独特的用户界面。

name: korean-holiday-calendar
description: 한국천문연구원 특일 정보 API를 k-skill-proxy 경유로 호출해 공휴일·국경일·기념일·24절기·잡절을 조회한다. 조회 전용.
description_zh: 通过 k-skill-proxy 中转调用韩国天文研究所特日信息 API，查询公休日、国庆日、纪念日、二十四节气及杂节。仅用于查询。

name: chrome-extension
description: Build Chrome extensions with Manifest V3. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Chrome extension, browser extension, manifest.json, content script, service worker (in extension context), popup, side panel, chrome.runtime, chrome.tabs, chrome.storage, chrome.scripting, or any Chrome extension API. Also trigger when the user wants to inject scripts into web pages, communicate between page and background, bypass CSP from a content script, build an RPC layer over chrome messaging, or publish to the Chrome Web Store. Covers both new extension projects and adding features to existing ones. Do NOT use for CRXJS/Vite-based builds with HMR — use samber/cc-skills@crxjs instead.
description_zh: 使用 Manifest V3 构建 Chrome 扩展。当用户提及 Chrome 扩展、浏览器扩展、manifest.json、内容脚本、服务工作者（在扩展上下文中）、弹出窗口、侧边栏、chrome.runtime、chrome.tabs、chrome.storage、chrome.scripting 或任何 Chrome 扩展 API 时，请使用此技能。此外，当用户希望将脚本注入网页、在页面和后台之间进行通信、从内容脚本绕过内容安全策略（CSP）、在 chrome 消息传递上构建 RPC 层，或发布到 Chrome 网上应用店时，也会触发该技能。涵盖新扩展项目以及为现有扩展添加功能。不适用于基于 CRXJS/Vite 的 HMR 构建——请使用 samber/cc-skills@crxjs。

name: customer-churn-signals
description: Assemble, define, validate, and rank leading indicators of customer churn from account activity, product usage, and support data into a ranked churn signal register - each signal carrying event, threshold, window, baseline, lift over base rate, lead time, and coverage. Use whenever the user mentions churn signals, churn indicators, leading indicators of churn, an early warning system for at-risk accounts, champion departure, seat utilisation drops, payment failure, or says "our health score misses churn" - even if they never say "signal". Covers B2B and B2C subscription. Do NOT use for combining signals into one composite score, weights, bands, or tiers - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-health-score instead.
description_zh: 从账户活动、产品使用和支持数据中，组装、定义、验证并排序客户流失的关键指标，将其整合到一个排序的客户流失信号注册表中——每个信号都包含事件、阈值、窗口、基线、基准率提升、提前期和覆盖范围。在用户提及客户流失信号、流失指标、流失先兆指标、高风险账户的预警系统、关键用户流失、座位利用率下降、支付失败，或表示“我们的健康评分未能识别流失”时使用——即使他们从未提及“信号”。涵盖B2B和B2C订阅。禁止用于将信号合并为一个综合评分、权重、区间或等级——应使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-health-score。

name: muapi-ai-clipping
description: Turn a long video into N viral-ready short clips with a single managed API call. Wraps muapi.ai's `/ai-clipping` endpoint, which handles transcription, highlight ranking through a virality framework (hook / emotional peak / opinion bomb / revelation / conflict / quotable / story peak / practical value), overlap dedupe, and vertical face-tracking auto-crop server-side. No local Whisper, no local LLM, no GPU.

name: sales-to-cs-handoff
description: Design the sales-to-CS handoff process after a deal closes - what data transfers, when, in what artifact, and who is accountable - producing a handoff spec with a gated closed-won trigger, a required handoff packet, timing SLAs, a kickoff meeting pattern, and a CS acceptance/rejection step. For RevOps and Sales Ops designing and enforcing the process, not a CSM running one handoff.
