Use whenever the user mentions sales to CS handoff, post-close transition, closed-won to kickoff, handoff accountability, "the CSM starts from zero", or "customers repeat themselves after signing" - even if they never say "handoff". Covers B2B high-touch through PLG/self-serve and B2C subscription. Do NOT use for account health scoring - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-health-score instead.
description_zh: 设计交易完成后销售到客户成功团队的交接流程——包括哪些数据需要交接、何时交接、通过什么载体交接以及由谁负责——产出一份交接规范，该规范需包含受控的“已成功关闭”触发器、必填的交接包、时间服务等级协议、启动会议模板以及客户成功团队的接受/拒绝步骤。该流程由RevOps和销售运营团队设计和执行，而非由客户成功经理单独负责。当用户提及销售到客户成功团队的交接、交易后过渡、已成功关闭到启动会议、交接责任、"客户成功经理从零开始"或"客户签约后重复提及"等情况时，即使他们没有明确说“交接”，也应使用此流程——涵盖B2B高触达至PLG/自助服务以及B2C订阅场景。请勿用于账户健康评分——应使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@customer-health-score。

name: junior-to-senior
description: Adversarial senior-engineer review for agent-generated plans, designs, and architectures. Treats the current output as junior work, constructs a senior reviewer whose domain expertise comes from live codebase research plus web research of current best practices, diagnoses altitude failures (too vague or too granular), then rewrites the plan into a scoped, state-of-the-art version. Use when the user says "junior to senior", "senior review", "review this like a staff engineer", when a plan feels hand-wavy or lost in details, or before committing to any agent-written plan.
description_zh: 针对代理生成的计划、设计和架构进行对抗性资深工程师评审。将当前输出视为初级工作，构建一位资深评审者，其领域专业知识来源于实际代码库研究加上对当前最佳实践的网页研究，诊断高度模糊或过于细粒度的缺陷，然后将计划重写为具有范围界定、最前沿的版本。在用户说“初级到资深”、“资深评审”、“像资深工程师一样评审这个”时使用，当计划感觉过于模糊或陷入细节，或提交任何代理生成的计划前使用。

name: literature-search
description: Search academic literature using Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and OpenAlex APIs. Returns structured JSONL with title, authors, year, venue, abstract, citations, and BibTeX. Use when the user needs to find papers, check related work, or build a bibliography.
description_zh: 使用Semantic Scholar、arXiv和OpenAlex API搜索学术文献。返回结构化的JSONL，包含标题、作者、年份、会议/期刊、摘要、引用次数和BibTeX。当用户需要查找论文、检查相关工作或构建参考文献列表时使用。

name: animate-text
description: Curated text animation catalog with exact JSON specs for headings, labels, counters, and text swaps. Use when an agent needs to pick or translate named effects like soft blur in, typewriter, shared axis, line reveal, stagger, crossfade, or kinetic builds into WAAPI, Motion, Framer Motion, GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Rive, or similar stacks.
description_zh: 带有精确 JSON 规范的精选文本动画目录，适用于标题、标签、计数器及文本替换。当代理需要将命名效果（如柔和模糊进入、打字机效果、共享轴、线条揭示、错落、交叉淡入淡出或动态构建）转换为 WAAPI、Motion、Framer Motion、GSAP、CSS、Lottie、Rive 或类似技术栈时使用。

name: fix-merge-conflicts
description: Resolve merge conflicts non-interactively, validate build and tests, and finalize conflict resolution
description_zh: 非交互式解决合并冲突，验证构建和测试，并最终确定冲突解决方案

name: lead-scoring
description: Design, validate, and recalibrate a lead scoring model - fit and engagement signals, weighting, negative scoring and exclusions, decay, MQL/PQL threshold and tier setting, backtesting against closed-won/closed-lost outcomes, and governance; also diagnoses an existing broken model. Use whenever the user mentions lead scoring, an MQL threshold, fit vs engagement scoring, product-qualified leads, score decay, "score my leads", "our lead scores are wrong", "sales rejects our MQLs", or "too many junk MQLs" - even if they never say "scoring model". Covers B2B sales-led and B2C/PLG, rules-based design and predictive readiness. Do NOT use for assigning scored leads to reps - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@lead-routing instead.
description_zh: 设计、验证和重新校准一个潜在客户评分模型——适配度与参与度信号、权重分配、负面评分和排除项、衰减机制、MQL/PQL阈值和层级设置、与已成交/已流失结果的回测验证，以及治理机制；同时诊断现有失效模型。在用户提及潜在客户评分、MQL阈值、适配度评分与参与度评分、产品认证潜在客户、评分衰减、"为我评分潜在客户"、"我们的评分有误"、"销售拒绝我们的MQL"或"过多无效MQL"等情况下使用——即使他们从未提及"评分模型"。涵盖B2B销售主导和B2C/PLG模式，基于规则的模型设计与预测性准备。禁止用于将评分后的潜在客户分配给销售代表——请使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@lead-routing。

name: experience-ui-bundle-mfa-configure
description: Configure Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for Salesforce Experience Site users. TRIGGER when: user wants to enable MFA on a community, enforce two-factor authentication for portal users, add MFA to a React Experience Site / Web App, configure ForceTwoFactor permission, create MFA permission sets for external users, or troubleshoot MFA not appearing on login. Also triggers on: MFA community, two-factor portal, ForceTwoFactor permission set, MFA Experience Cloud, MFA React site, identity verification community, MFA experience site, ForceTwoFactor permissionset-meta.xml, MFA permissionset-meta.xml. DO NOT TRIGGER when: configuring org-wide MFA for internal users (that's Setup > Identity Verification), building custom login UI components (use experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate), or generating generic permission sets without MFA context (use platform-permission-set-generate).
description_zh: 为 Salesforce 体验站点用户配置多因素认证 (MFA)。触发条件如下：用户希望在社区上启用 MFA、为门户用户强制执行双因素认证、为 React 体验站点/网络应用添加 MFA、配置 ForceTwoFactor 权限、为外部用户创建 MFA 权限集，或解决登录时 MFA 未显示的问题。此外，在以下情况下也会触发：MFA 社区、双因素门户、ForceTwoFactor 权限集、MFA 体验云、MFA React 站点、身份验证社区、MFA 体验站点、ForceTwoFactor 权限set-meta.xml、MFA 权限set-meta.xml。不触发的情况包括：为内部用户配置全局 MFA（路径为 Setup > Identity Verification）、构建自定义登录 UI 组件（使用 experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate）、生成不含 MFA 上下文的通用权限集（使用 platform-permission-set-generate）。

name: gmgn-heat-rank
description: Produce THE list of tokens that are hot RIGHT NOW and safe enough to look at, across every chain GMGN supports, scored 0-100 and capped at ten names. This is a screening skill: it starts from no address, sweeps all seven chains, gates every candidate on liquidity / real volume / concentration / rug-and-dev risk, scores the survivors on one cross-chain scale, and returns however many clear the score floor — fewer than ten in a weak market, never padded to fill the quota. USE THIS SKILL WHEN the user wants a curated hot list rather than raw rankings: "热榜", "热门代币", "近期热门", "帮我抓一轮热榜", "现在有什么值得关注的热币", "全链热门币", "生成热榜", "有没有新的热门盘", "what is hot right now", "give me the hot list", "which trending tokens are actually worth looking at", "screen the trending list for me". The same questions in any other language route here too - match on meaning, not wording. DO NOT USE THIS SKILL for a raw ranking dump ("show me the top 20 by volume on sol", "1h trending", "hot search list") - that is `gmgn-market trending` / `hot-searches`, which returns the exchange's own ordering untouched; nor for freshly launched bonding-curve tokens ("just launched", "pump.fun new", "新盘") - that is `gmgn-market trenches`; nor for one address the user already has ("is this token safe", "打个分", "尽调") - that is `gmgn-contract-dd`; nor for a chart read ("走势怎么样", "什么形态") - that is `gmgn-kline-pattern`; nor for early-stage hunting below this skill's own floor ("值得埋伏吗", "新币筛选", "早期机会", "discover early-stage opportunities") - that is `gmgn-market trenches`, because the candidate pool here starts at 500k market cap and 100k liquidity and never contains a bonding-curve token; nor for the wallet-side view of the same market ("聪明钱在买什么", "KOL 在买什么", "on-chain alpha", "copy-trade signals") - that is `gmgn-track smartmoney` / `kol`, which answers who is buying rather than what is worth looking at. The split is by who chooses the tokens: if the user names the token, it is not this skill; if the user is asking the skill to choose, it is. When nobody names a token and the wording alone collides with `gmgn-market` - "hot coins", "what's pumping", "trending tokens", "热门币", "什么币在涨" - the deciding test is the shape of the answer being asked for: an untouched ranking of N rows in the exchange's own order is `gmgn-market trending`; a short list that survived risk gates, carries a score and can be acted on is this skill. A bare ambiguous ask with no other signal defaults here, because this skill can point at the raw ranking while the raw ranking cannot screen itself. Nothing has to be supplied to run it - the trigger phrase alone is enough, and no address, chain or amount is ever required. Four things can be narrowed when the user asks for it: which chains are swept, the age ceiling, how many names come back, and the score floor; any value changed that way is named in the report.
description_zh: 生成当前热门且足够安全的代币列表，涵盖GMGN支持的每条链，按0-100分制评分，最多返回十个名称。这是一个筛选功能：从无地址开始，扫描所有七条链，对每个候选代币进行流动性/真实交易量/集中度/跑路风险筛选，在跨链评分体系中对幸存者进行评分，并返回达到评分标准的代币数量——弱市时少于十个，从不为凑数而填充名额。当用户希望获得精选的热门列表而非原始排名时使用此功能："热榜"、"热门代币"、"近期热门"、"帮我抓一轮热榜"、"现在有什么值得关注的热币"、"全链热门币"、"生成热榜"、"有没有新的热门盘"、"what is hot right now"、"give me the hot list"、"which trending tokens are actually worth looking at"、"screen the trending list for me"。其他语言中的相同问题也路由至此——匹配意义而非措辞。不要使用此功能进行原始排名倾倒（"show me the top 20 by volume on sol"、"1h trending"、"hot search list"）——那是`gmgn-market trending`/`hot-searches`，它返回交易所的原始排序；也不要用于新推出的债券曲线代币（"just launched"、"pump.fun new"、"新盘"）——那是`gmgn-market trenches`；也不要用于用户已持有的单个地址（"is this token safe"、"打个分"、"尽调"）——那是`gmgn-contract-dd`；也不要用于图表解读（"走势怎么样"、"什么形态"）——那是`gmgn-kline-pattern`；也不要用于此功能自身评分标准以下的早期挖掘（"值得埋伏吗"、"新币筛选"、"早期机会"、"discover early-stage opportunities"）——那是`gmgn-market trenches`，因为这里的候选池起始于500万市值和10万流动性，且从不包含债券曲线代币；也不要用于同一市场的钱包端视角（"聪明钱在买什么"、"KOL 在买什么"、"on-chain alpha"、"copy-trade signals"）——那是`gmgn-track smartmoney`/`kol`，它回答的是谁在购买而非什么值得关注。划分依据是代币的选择者：如果用户指定代币，则不是此功能；如果用户请求功能选择，则是。当无人指定代币且措辞仅与`gmgn-market`冲突时（"hot coins"、"what's pumping"、"trending tokens"、"热门币"、"什么币在涨"），决定性测试是所请求答案的形态：交易所原始排序的N行未触碰排名是`gmgn-market trending`；而通过风险筛选、附带评分且可操作的短列表则是此功能。无其他信号的单向模糊提问默认归为此功能，因为此功能可指向原始排名，而原始排名无法自我筛选。运行此功能无需提供任何信息——仅触发短语即可，且永远无需地址、链或金额。用户请求时可缩小四个方面：扫描的链、年龄上限、返回名称数量、评分下限；任何通过这种方式修改的值都会在报告中注明。

name: i18n-expert
description: This skill should be used when setting up, auditing, or enforcing internationalization/localization in UI codebases (React/TS, i18next or similar, JSON locales), including installing/configuring the i18n framework, replacing hard-coded strings, ensuring en-US/zh-CN coverage, mapping error codes to localized messages, and validating key parity, pluralization, and formatting.
description_zh: 此技能应在设置、审计或执行 UI 代码库（React/TS、i18next 或类似工具、JSON 地区设置）中的国际化/本地化时使用，包括安装/配置国际化框架、替换硬编码字符串、确保 en-US/zh-CN 覆盖、将错误代码映射到本地化消息以及验证键的对应关系、复数形式和格式。

name: figma-create-new-file
description: Create a new blank Figma file. Use when the user wants to create a new Figma design or FigJam file, or when you need a new file before calling use_figma. Handles plan resolution via whoami if needed. Usage — /figma-create-new-file [editorType] [fileName] (e.g. /figma-create-new-file figjam My Whiteboard)
description_zh: 创建一个新的空白 Figma 文件。当用户想要创建一个新的 Figma 设计或 FigJam 文件时使用，或者在你需要在使用 `use_figma` 之前创建一个新文件时使用。如果需要，通过 `whoami` 处理计划分辨率。用法 — `/figma-create-new-file [编辑器类型] [文件名]`（例如：`/figma-create-new-file figjam 我的白板`）

name: crap-score
description: Calculates CRAP (Change Risk Anti-Patterns) for a named .NET method, class, or file. USE FOR: explicit CRAP calculation or coverage-and-complexity risk within that named target, including which tests to prioritize. DO NOT USE FOR: project-wide coverage/CRAP, plateaus, or project-wide blockers/priorities (coverage-analysis); behavioral/pseudo-mutation gaps (test-gap-analysis); writing tests; test runs without CRAP context.
description_zh: 计算指定 .NET 方法、类或文件的 CRAP（变更风险反模式）。用途：显式计算 CRAP 或在指定目标范围内的覆盖率和复杂度风险，包括优先测试哪些。不适用：项目范围的覆盖率/CRAP、平台期或项目范围的障碍/优先级（覆盖率分析）、行为/伪变异差距（测试差距分析）、编写测试、无 CRAP 上下文的测试运行。

name: automate-me
description: Use for "automate me", "create/update/refresh my -mode skill", "turn/capture my preferences or working style into a skill", or wanting agents to follow how the user works. Drafts or revises a personal -mode skill via create-skill + unslop, optionally pulling fresh evidence from recent transcripts.
description_zh: 用于“自动化我”、“创建/更新/刷新我的-模式技能”、“将我的偏好或工作方式转化为技能”，或希望代理按照用户的工作方式行事。通过 create-skill + unslop 起草或修订个人-模式技能，并可选地从最近的文本记录中提取最新证据。

name: md2wechat
description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces. Also use for unpublished Zhihu, CSDN, Toutiao, or Tencent Cloud Developer Community drafts through a browser. Use for product introductions, encyclopedia articles or entry drafts, and writing tailored to platforms or search targets.
description_zh: 将 Markdown 转换为微信公众号 HTML，检查支持的提供商/主题/提示，生成文章图片，创建草稿，使用创作者风格撰写，准备标题建议，并去除 AI 写作痕迹。也可通过浏览器用于未发布的知乎、CSDN、头条或腾讯云开发者社区草稿。适用于产品介绍、百科文章或入门草稿，以及针对平台或搜索目标的定制化写作。

name: ad-creative-brief
description: Turn a campaign goal and an audience insight into a structured creative brief a designer, video editor, or UGC creator can execute - messaging angle, hook directions, art direction, specs, testing intent, and the handoff and revision loop. Covers B2B and B2C, with variants for static image, short-form video/UGC, and search/responsive text ads. Use whenever the user needs to brief a designer or creator, asks what an ad should say, or mentions messaging pillars, creative direction, or a design handoff - even if they never say 'brief'. Writes direction, never the finished asset: the ad copy itself is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants and shot-by-shot creator scripts are mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts.
description_zh: 将一个活动目标和受众洞察转化为设计师、视频编辑或UGC创作者可以执行的结构化创意简报——包括信息角度、钩子方向、艺术指导、规格、测试意图以及交接和修改流程。涵盖B2B和B2C，并提供静态图像、短视频/UGC和搜索/响应式文本广告的变体。无论用户何时需要向设计师或创作者提供简报、询问广告应如何表述，或提及信息支柱、创意方向或设计交接——即使他们从未说出“简报”这个词——都可以使用。提供指导方向，而非最终成品：广告文案本身位于mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants，分镜头创作者脚本位于mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts。

name: user-story-mapping
description: Create a user story map that lays out activities, steps, tasks, and release slices. Use when planning a workflow, backlog, or MVP around the user journey.
description_zh: 创建一个用户故事地图，列出活动、步骤、任务和发布切片。在规划工作流程、待办事项列表或最小可行产品（MVP）围绕用户旅程时使用。

name: dotnet-pinvoke
description: Correctly call native (C/C++) libraries from .NET using P/Invoke and LibraryImport. Covers function signatures, string marshalling, memory lifetime, SafeHandle, and cross-platform patterns. USE FOR: writing new P/Invoke or LibraryImport declarations, reviewing or debugging existing native interop code, wrapping a C or C++ library for use in .NET, diagnosing crashes, memory leaks, or corruption at the managed/native boundary. DO NOT USE FOR: COM interop, C++/CLI mixed-mode assemblies, or pure managed code with no native dependencies.
description_zh: 使用 P/Invoke 和 LibraryImport 从 .NET 正确调用原生（C/C++）库。涵盖函数签名、字符串封送处理、内存生命周期、SafeHandle 以及跨平台模式。适用场景：编写新的 P/Invoke 或 LibraryImport 声明、审查或调试现有的原生互操作代码、将 C 或 C++ 库封装用于 .NET、诊断托管/原生边界处的崩溃、内存泄漏或损坏。不适用场景：COM 互操作、C++/CLI 混合模式程序集或无原生依赖的纯托管代码。

name: discovery-interview-prep
description: Plan customer discovery interviews with the right goal, segment, constraints, and method. Use when preparing interviews for problem validation, churn research, or new product ideas.
description_zh: 制定具有明确目标、细分市场、约束条件和方法的客户发现访谈计划。在准备问题验证、客户流失研究或新产品创意的访谈时使用。

name: revenue-reporting
description: Define the metric set and narrative structure for an executive or board revenue report so it tells one coherent story - a small stable metric spine, locked definitions, an answer-first narrative around plan vs actual vs forecast, presenting a miss without surprising the board, the reconciliation and sign-off chain, and weekly vs monthly vs quarterly cadences. Use whenever the user mentions a board revenue report, exec deck metrics, the QBR revenue section, a monthly revenue review, an investor update, or a board deck that reads as a data dump - even if they never say "reporting". Covers B2B subscription, B2C, transactional, usage-based, and PLG. Do NOT use for designing the org-level KPI hierarchy - use mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-kpi-framework instead.
description_zh: 定义高管或董事会收入报告的指标集和叙事结构，使其讲述一个连贯的故事——一个小的稳定指标骨架、固定的定义、围绕计划与实际与预测的“先回答”式叙事、在不过分惊动董事会的情况下呈现偏差、对账和签字链，以及每周、每月和每季度的节奏。在用户提到董事会收入报告、高管演示文稿指标、QBR收入部分、月度收入回顾、投资者更新，或看起来像数据堆砌的董事会演示文稿时使用——即使他们从未说“报告”。涵盖B2B订阅、B2C、交易型、使用量基础型和PLG。不应用于设计组织级KPI层级——请使用mbfinotti/revops-skills@revenue-kpi-framework。

name: influence-and-negotiation
description: Influence and negotiation toolkit for any interaction needing another person's agreement, even when the user never says 'negotiation'. Covers B2B sales, salary reviews and raise asks, collective bargaining and unions, hard 1:1s, recruitment closes, cross-cultural deals, mediation, and diplomatic messages — declining, pushing back on scope, justifying a delay, raising a concern, getting alignment. Use when the user says 'they just said X, what do I say' or 'draft a reply', or mentions a buyer, champion, procurement, RFP, sponsor, HR, union, or candidate, or a pushback, refusal, ghosting, no-decision, escalation, fixed budget, counter-offer, comp band, strike, BATNA, anchor, or concession.

name: connector-weatherapi
description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that reads weather data from a canister. The supported path is the `weatherapi-client` mops package (WeatherAPI.com) over outbound HTTPS, authenticated with a query-string API key. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `api.weatherapi.com` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses the non-replicated-outcall safeguard (WeatherAPI bodies carry per-request clocks and fail consensus), the generated JSON decoding, and the API-key handling. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions weather, forecast, temperature, humidity, wind, rain, snow, conditions, sunrise, sunset, moon phase, astronomy, timezone, IP geolocation, marine or tide forecasts, or location autocomplete — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a weather endpoint.
description_zh: 必须为每个 Caffeine 构建添加的配方，用于从容器中读取天气数据。支持路径是 `weatherapi-client` mops 包（WeatherAPI.com），通过出站 HTTPS 进行认证，使用查询字符串 API 密钥。手动编写 `ic.http_request` 调用至 `api.weatherapi.com` 是一种禁止的反模式——它绕过了非复制出站调用保护（WeatherAPI 的响应体包含请求时钟并会失败共识）、生成的 JSON 解码以及 API 密钥处理。当用户、规范或任何先前的任务提及天气、预报、温度、湿度、风、雨、雪、状况、日出、日落、月相、天文学、时区、IP 地理位置或海洋/潮汐预报、位置自动补全时，请加载此技能——并在编写任何与天气端点交互的代码之前。

Load when wiring a frontend (React/Next.js/Remix) or backend-for-frontend to show live run progress, status badges, token streams, trigger buttons, or wait-token approval UIs. NOT for writing the backend task itself (streams.define / metadata.set is trigger-tasks territory); this is the consumer side.
description_zh: Trigger.dev 客户端/前端界面：实时订阅运行（runs.subscribeToRun 和 @trigger.dev/react-hooks hook useRealtimeRun），在 React 中消费元数据和 AI/文本流（useRealtimeStream），从浏览器触发任务（useTaskTrigger, useRealtimeTaskTrigger），并使用 auth.createPublicToken / auth.createTriggerPublicToken 创建作用域前端凭证。在连接前端（React/Next.js/Remix）或后端-前端时加载，以显示实时运行进度、状态徽章、令牌流、触发按钮或等待令牌审批 UI。不用于编写后端任务本身（streams.define / metadata.set 属于 trigger-tasks 范围）；这是消费者端。

name: ad-swipe-file
description: Build and maintain a competitor swipe file - competitors' currently-running ads collected into a categorised, queryable library classified by format, hook type, offer/angle, awareness stage, and funnel stage, then converted into ranked creative test hypotheses. Accepts pasted ad text, described ads, screenshots, export files, or public ad transparency libraries. Use whenever the user asks what ads competitors are running, wants a competitor ad teardown, creative inspiration, or to know what is working in their category - even if they never say 'swipe file'. Covers B2B and B2C on any paid channel. Stops at ranked hypotheses: briefing is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief and test design is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-test-plan.
description_zh: 构建和维护一个竞争对手广告库——将当前正在运行的竞争对手广告收集到一个分类、可查询的库中，按格式、钩子类型、优惠/角度、认知阶段和漏斗阶段进行分类，然后将其转化为排名靠前的创意测试假设。支持粘贴广告文本、描述广告、截图、导出文件或公开广告透明度库。每当用户询问竞争对手正在运行哪些广告、需要竞争对手广告拆解、创意灵感，或想了解其所在类别中哪些广告有效时——即使他们从未提及“广告库”——都可以使用。涵盖B2B和B2C在任何付费渠道。停留在排名靠前的假设阶段：简报是mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief，测试设计是mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-test-plan。

name: binlog-generation
description: Generate MSBuild binary logs (binlogs) for build diagnostics and analysis. USE FOR: adding /bl:{} to any dotnet build, test, pack, publish, or restore command to capture a full build execution trace, prerequisite for binlog-failure-analysis and build-perf-diagnostics skills, enabling post-build investigation of errors or performance. Requires MSBuild 17.8+ / .NET 8 SDK+ for {} placeholder; PowerShell needs -bl:{{}}. DO NOT USE FOR: non-MSBuild build systems (npm, Maven, CMake), analyzing an existing binlog (use binlog-failure-analysis instead).
description_zh: 为构建诊断和分析生成 MSBuild 二进制日志（binlogs）。使用方法：将 /bl:{} 添加到任何 dotnet 构建命令、测试、打包、发布或还原命令中，以捕获完整的构建执行跟踪。这是 binlog-failure-analysis 和 build-perf-diagnostics 技能的前提条件，可对构建后的错误或性能进行事后调查。{} 占位符需要 MSBuild 17.8+ / .NET 8 SDK+；PowerShell 需要 -bl:{{}}。不适用情况：非 MSBuild 构建系统（npm、Maven、CMake），分析现有的 binlog（请使用 binlog-failure-analysis）。

name: build-perf-diagnostics
description: Diagnose MSBuild build performance bottlenecks using binary log analysis. USE FOR: identifying why builds are slow by analyzing binlog performance summaries, detecting ResolveAssemblyReference (RAR) taking >5s, Roslyn analyzers consuming >30% of Csc time, single targets dominating >50% of build time, node utilization below 80%, excessive Copy tasks, NuGet restore running every build. Covers timeline analysis, Target/Task Performance Summary interpretation, and 7 common bottleneck categories. Use after build-perf-baseline has established measurements. DO NOT USE FOR: establishing initial baselines (use build-perf-baseline first), fixing incremental build issues (use incremental-build), parallelism tuning (use build-parallelism), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 使用二进制日志分析来诊断MSBuild构建性能瓶颈。适用场景：通过分析binlog性能摘要识别构建缓慢的原因，检测ResolveAssemblyReference（RAR）耗时超过5秒、Roslyn分析器占用Csc时间超过30%、单个目标占用构建时间超过50%、节点利用率低于80%、复制任务过多、NuGet还原在每次构建中运行。涵盖时间线分析、目标/任务性能摘要解读以及7种常见瓶颈类别。在建立构建性能基线（build-perf-baseline）后使用。不适用场景：建立初始基线（请先使用build-perf-baseline）、解决增量构建问题（请使用incremental-build）、并行性调优（请使用build-parallelism）、非MSBuild构建系统。

name: ad-creative-fatigue
description: Decide whether a running ad creative is genuinely wearing out, or whether a confounder - budget change, learning-phase reset, audience saturation, auction CPM inflation, seasonality, tracking breakage - explains the decline, and return a verdict with confidence plus the highest-return remedy per unit of effort. Use whenever the user mentions creative or ad fatigue, wear-out, climbing frequency, dropping CTR, a rising CPA on an older ad, when to refresh creative, or whether to kill an ad - even if they never say 'fatigue'. Covers B2B and B2C across search, social, video, and native. Ends at the verdict: replacement creative belongs to mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants and mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts.
description_zh: 决定一个正在运行的广告创意是否确实出现了疲劳，或者是否存在混淆因素——预算变化、学习阶段重置、受众饱和、拍卖CPM通货膨胀、季节性、追踪中断——导致其下降，并带着自信和最高回报的解决方案（每单位努力）给出裁决。在用户提及创意或广告疲劳、磨损、频率上升、CTR下降、旧广告CPA上升、何时刷新创意或是否停止广告时使用——即使他们从未说“疲劳”。涵盖B2B和B2C，覆盖搜索、社交、视频和原生广告。裁决结束时：替换创意属于mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants和mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts。

name: advertising-kickoff
description: Before starting any paid advertising work, before each recurring advertising review, and whenever routing is unclear, route the task to the right skill of the advertising-skills collection - or say plainly that none fits - and bootstrap or resume the project's shared context artifact. Use at every advertising project start, on later sessions of the same project to re-route without re-interviewing, and whenever the user mentions a new ad campaign or paid media project, asks which advertising skill they need, or wants a periodic advertising check-in - even if they name no skill at all. Prefer this whenever several skills could apply, since the collection has three colliding clusters - the hirer-vs-candidate pair, the budget cluster, the creative cluster - and it returns a short-list plus an ordered skill chain rather than a single guess. Do NOT use when the task already maps cleanly to one skill, such as a pure account audit - that is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic.
description_zh: 在开始任何付费广告工作之前、在每次周期性广告审核之前，以及每当路由不明确时，将任务路由到广告技能集合中的正确技能——或者简单地说没有合适的技能——并启动或恢复项目的共享上下文工件。在每次广告项目开始时、在同一个项目的后续会话中以重新路由而不需要重新面试时，以及每当用户提到新的广告活动或付费媒体项目、询问需要哪种广告技能，或者想要定期进行广告检查时——即使他们没有指定任何技能——都优先使用此方法。因为集合中有三个冲突的集群——雇主与候选人配对、预算集群、创意集群——并且它返回一个短名单和一个有序的技能链，而不是一个单一的猜测。当任务已经清晰地映射到一项技能时，不要使用此方法，例如纯粹的账户审核——那就是 mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic。

name: gsap-scrolltrigger
description: Comprehensive skill for GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) and ScrollTrigger plugin. Use this skill when creating web animations, scroll-driven experiences, timelines, tweens, scroll-triggered animations, pinning, scrubbing, parallax effects, or animating DOM elements, SVG, Canvas, WebGL, or Three.js. Triggers on tasks involving GSAP, ScrollTrigger, smooth animations, scroll effects, or animation sequencing.
description_zh: GSAP（GreenSock动画平台）和ScrollTrigger插件的全面技能。在创建网页动画、滚动驱动体验、时间轴、缓动动画、滚动触发的动画、固定定位、滚动缓动、视差效果或动画化DOM元素、SVG、Canvas、WebGL或Three.js时使用此技能。适用于涉及GSAP、ScrollTrigger、平滑动画、滚动效果或动画序列的任务。

name: ad-audience-targeting
description: Turn a business's ICP and buying signals into a layered ad audience targeting plan - cold/broad prospecting, interest and in-market behavioural segments, lookalike/similar, first-party lists, and retargeting pools - each sized against platform audience floors, budgeted to the learning threshold, and kept from overlapping by exclusion rules. Use whenever the user mentions ad targeting, who to target with ads, audience tiers or layers, broad vs. layered targeting, audience overlap between campaigns, or mapping an ICP onto ad audiences - even if they never say 'audience'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to pick the seed customers behind a lookalike (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@lookalike-audience-seeds) or to sequence retargeting messages (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@retargeting-funnel).
description_zh: 将企业的ICP（目标客户画像）和购买信号转化为分层的广告受众定位计划——包括冷启动/广泛潜在客户、兴趣和市场行为细分、相似受众/类似受众、第一方名单和再营销池——每个定位规模需参考平台受众基准，预算需控制在学习阈值内，并通过排除规则避免重叠。在用户提及广告定位、广告目标受众、受众层级或分层、广泛定位与分层定位、活动间受众重叠，或需将ICP映射到广告受众时使用——即使他们从未提及“受众”。涵盖B2B和B2C场景。请勿用于选择相似受众背后的种子客户（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@lookalike-audience-seeds）或用于排序再营销信息（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@retargeting-funnel）。

name: create-skill
description: Scaffolds new agent skills for the dotnet/skills repository. Use when creating a new skill, generating SKILL.md files, writing a skill description that the runtime will actually route to, or setting up skill directory structures. Handles frontmatter generation, section templates, and validation guidance. Do not use for fixing a skill that already fails its evaluation (use improve-skill-quality) or for writing eval.yaml (use create-skill-test).
description_zh: 为新技能创建 dotnet/skills 存储库的脚手架。在创建新技能、生成 SKILL.md 文件、编写实际由运行时路由的技能描述或设置技能目录结构时使用。处理前文生成、部分模板和验证指南。不要用于修复已失败评估的技能（请使用 improve-skill-quality）或编写 eval.yaml（请使用 create-skill-test）。

name: gke-ai-troubleshooting-tpu-dynamic-slices-monitoring
description: Monitors, troubleshoots, and manages GKE TPU Dynamic Slices custom resources. Use when checking TPU slice lifecycle states, troubleshooting slice provisioning failures, validating single-slice or multi-slice (JobSet) workload manifests, or safely patching stuck finalizers and disabling the slice controller. Don't use for generic GKE cluster node pool creation or standard non-TPU workload management (use gke-basics or gke-cluster-creation instead).
description_zh: 监控、排错和管理 GKE TPU 动态切片自定义资源。在检查 TPU 切片生命周期状态、排错切片配置失败、验证单切片或多切片（JobSet）工作负载清单，或安全地修补卡住的最终化器并禁用切片控制器时使用。不应用于通用 GKE 集群节点池创建或标准非 TPU 工作负载管理（请使用 gke-basics 或 gke-cluster-creation）。

name: ad-account-diagnostic
description: Diagnose the root cause of an underperforming paid ad account - why the ads stopped working, why CPA went up, why ROAS dropped - instead of defaulting to 'increase the budget'. Weighs tracking, account structure, targeting, creative, bidding and budget, offer, and external forces, and returns a prioritised verdict with evidence and confidence. Covers B2B and B2C on search, paid social, video, and native. Use whenever the user mentions an ad account audit, a campaign structure review, wasted ad spend, rising cost per lead, or says their ads used to work - even if they never say 'diagnostic'. Diagnosis only, and it stops at the click: post-click page problems are mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-landing-page-audit and creative decay is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-fatigue.
description_zh: 诊断表现不佳的付费广告账户的根本原因——广告为何失效、CPA为何上升、ROAS为何下降——而不是默认选择“增加预算”。该工具评估追踪、账户结构、定向、创意、竞价和预算、产品供应以及外部因素，并基于证据和信心给出优先排序的结论。涵盖B2B和B2C在搜索、付费社交、视频和原生广告上的情况。每当用户提及广告账户审计、活动结构审查、浪费的广告支出、获客成本上升，或表示他们的广告曾经有效——即使他们从未提及“诊断”——都可以使用。仅提供诊断服务，且分析止于点击：点击后的页面问题请参考mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-landing-page-audit，创意衰减问题请参考mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-fatigue。

name: cac-roas-benchmark
description: Compute a business's CAC and ROAS family metrics from real spend and outcome data, then judge whether the spend is healthy against three references - the business's own break-even, its own trailing history, and provenance-labelled external benchmarks - returning healthy, watch, unhealthy, or insufficient evidence. Use whenever the user asks whether their CAC is too high, whether a ROAS is good, what ROAS to aim for, whether ads are profitable, or mentions MER, blended CAC, payback period, or a spend health check - even if they never say 'benchmark'. Covers B2B/SaaS (cost per SQL, cost per closed-won, cohort lag) and B2C/ecommerce. Do NOT use to set those thresholds as policy - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-guardrails instead.
description_zh: 根据实际支出和成果数据计算企业的CAC（客户获取成本）和ROAS（广告支出回报率）家族指标，然后与三个参考标准进行对比判断支出是否健康——包括企业自身的盈亏平衡点、自身的历史数据以及经过验证的外部基准数据——输出结果为“健康”、“关注”、“不健康”或“证据不足”。当用户询问CAC是否过高、ROAS是否良好、应追求何种ROAS、广告是否盈利，或提及MER（营销效率比）、混合CAC（加权平均CAC）、回报期，或进行支出健康检查时，均可使用此功能——即使他们从未提及“基准”。涵盖B2B/SaaS（SQL成本、成交成本、队列滞后）和B2C/电商领域。请勿使用此功能来设定政策阈值——应使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-guardrails。

name: spectrum
description: Build or review messaging agents with Photon Spectrum (`spectrum-ts`). Use for Spectrum setup, messages and content, spaces and users, provider capabilities, iMessage/WhatsApp/Terminal integrations, custom platforms, lifecycle, or production message-processing architecture.
description_zh: 使用 Photon Spectrum (`spectrum-ts`) 构建或审查消息代理。用于 Spectrum 设置、消息和内容、空间和用户、提供商功能、iMessage/WhatsApp/Terminal 集成、自定义平台、生命周期或生产消息处理架构。

name: emilkowal-animations
description: Emil Kowalski's animation best practices for web interfaces. Use when writing, reviewing, or implementing animations in React, CSS, or Framer Motion. Triggers on tasks involving transitions, easing, gestures, toasts, drawers, or motion.
description_zh: 埃米尔·科瓦尔斯基的网页界面动画最佳实践。在编写、审查或实现 React、CSS 或 Framer Motion 中的动画时使用。适用于涉及过渡、缓动、手势、吐司、抽屉或运动的任务。

name: dx-project-create
description: Scaffold a new Salesforce DX project of any template — standard, empty, analytics, agent, or a React/Angular UI-bundle app — and set it up end-to-end: relocate the session, connect an org, set the default, enable source tracking. Use when the user asks to create or scaffold a new Salesforce/SFDX project, start a new React/Angular Salesforce app, or run 'sf template generate project'. DO NOT TRIGGER for: building/editing/styling an EXISTING UI-bundle app (experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate); scaffolding only a UI bundle as a step of building one out (experience-ui-bundle-project-generate, experience-ui-bundle-app-coordinate); tool validation (platform-environment-validate); org auth (login); project stats; scratch orgs (dx-org-manage).
description_zh: 为任何模板（标准、空、分析、代理或 React/Angular UI-bundle 应用）搭建一个新的 Salesforce DX 项目，并端到端配置：迁移会话、连接组织、设置默认值、启用源跟踪。当用户要求创建或搭建新的 Salesforce/SFDX 项目、启动新的 React/Angular Salesforce 应用，或运行 'sf template generate project' 时使用。**禁止触发**以下场景：构建/编辑/样式化现有的 UI-bundle 应用（experience-ui-bundle-frontend-generate）；仅作为构建步骤搭建 UI bundle（experience-ui-bundle-project-generate, experience-ui-bundle-app-coordinate）；工具验证（platform-environment-validate）；组织认证（login）；项目统计；沙盒组织（dx-org-manage）。

name: ad-budget-pacing
description: Track daily and weekly spend against a single campaign or account budget and flag under-pacing or over-pacing before it hurts results, reporting the pacing ratio, projected period spend, and the corrective daily spend behind every alert. Use whenever the user mentions budget pacing, spend tracking, burn rate, spend vs budget, projected month-end spend, underspending or overspending, or asks whether a campaign is on pace - even if they never say 'pacing'. Covers any ad platform, B2B and B2C, calendar-month or fixed-date flights. It flags and recommends; it never changes budgets or bids. Do NOT use to plan a scale-up (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-media-scaling) or to set CAC/ROAS thresholds (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-guardrails).
description_zh: 跟踪每日和每周支出与单个活动或账户预算的对比，并在造成结果损害之前标记支出不足或超额支出，报告支出配速率、预计周期支出以及每个警报背后的纠正每日支出。当用户提及预算配速、支出跟踪、消耗率、支出与预算对比、预计月末支出、支出不足或超额支出，或询问活动是否按配速进行时（即使他们从未说“配速”）均可使用。涵盖任何广告平台、B2B和B2C、按日历月或固定日期飞行的活动。它进行标记和推荐；它永远不会更改预算或出价。请勿使用它来规划规模扩大（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-media-scaling）或设置CAC/ROAS阈值（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-guardrails）。

name: lookalike-audience-seeds
description: Select and size the seed customer list behind a lookalike, similar, or value-based audience - which customers to upload, how many, and whether the matched count (not the row count) clears the platform floor - with RFM and value-based selection, a negative-selection pass, a privacy and consent gate before any customer list upload, and a fallback ladder when the floor cannot be cleared. Use whenever the user mentions a lookalike or similar audience, a seed list, a customer list upload, match rate, an audience that is too small, or says their lookalike isn't working - even if they never say 'seed'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to design the whole targeting tier structure - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting instead.
description_zh: 选择并确定与相似、类似或基于价值的受众相对应的种子客户清单的规模——哪些客户需要上传、数量多少，以及匹配数量（而非行数）是否达到平台最低标准——结合RFM和基于价值的筛选、负向筛选、任何客户清单上传前的隐私与同意验证，以及当最低标准无法达到时的备用方案。在用户提及相似受众、种子清单、客户清单上传、匹配率、受众规模过小，或表示相似受众效果不佳时使用——即使他们从未提及“种子”。涵盖B2B和B2C场景。请勿使用此功能设计整个目标层级结构——应使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting。

name: paid-media-scaling
description: Decide when a proven paid campaign has earned a budget increase, how large each step should be, how the ramp sequences over weeks and months, and how to avoid performance collapse on the way up - including readiness gates, vertical vs horizontal scaling, and rollback triggers. Use whenever the user asks whether to scale a campaign, how fast ad spend can rise, mentions a budget ramp, a scaling ceiling, or says performance collapsed after the budget was raised - even if they never say 'scaling'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to split a fixed total across campaigns (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation) or to track daily spend against a set budget (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing).
description_zh: 确定一个经过验证的付费广告活动何时应增加预算，每个步骤应如何调整，如何在数周和数月内逐步扩大规模，以及如何避免在预算提升过程中出现性能崩溃——包括准备就绪关卡、垂直扩展与水平扩展、回滚触发器。当用户询问是否扩展广告活动、广告支出增长速度、提及预算逐步增加、扩展上限，或表示在预算提高后性能崩溃时使用（即使他们从未提及“扩展”）。涵盖B2B和B2C业务。请勿用于将固定总额分配到多个广告活动中（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation），或用于跟踪每日支出与设定预算的匹配情况（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing）。

name: frame-liquid-bg-hero
description: WebGL-style fluid displacement background with a quote overlay, suited to video intros, landing heroes, or posters.
description_zh: WebGL风格的流体置换背景，带有文字叠加，适用于视频开场、着陆页横幅或海报。

name: migrate-dotnet9-to-dotnet10
description: Migrate a .NET 9 project or solution to .NET 10 and resolve all breaking changes. USE FOR: upgrading TargetFramework from net9.0 to net10.0, fixing build errors after updating the .NET 10 SDK, resolving source and behavioral changes in .NET 10 / C# 14 / ASP.NET Core 10 / EF Core 10, updating Dockerfiles for Debian-to-Ubuntu base images, resolving obsoletion warnings (SYSLIB0058-SYSLIB0062), adapting to SDK/NuGet changes (NU1510, PrunePackageReference), migrating System.Linq.Async to built-in AsyncEnumerable, fixing OpenApi v2 API changes, cryptography renames, and C# 14 compiler changes (field keyword, extension keyword, span overloads). DO NOT USE FOR: .NET Framework migrations, upgrading from .NET 8 or earlier (use migrate-dotnet8-to-dotnet9 first), greenfield .NET 10 projects, or cosmetic modernization. LOADS REFERENCES: csharp-compiler, core-libraries, sdk-msbuild (always); aspnet-core, efcore, cryptography, extensions-hosting, serialization-networking, winforms-wpf, containers-interop (selective).
description_zh: 将 .NET 9 项目或解决方案迁移到 .NET 10 并解决所有破坏性变更。用途：从 net9.0 升级 TargetFramework 到 net10.0，更新 .NET 10 SDK 后修复构建错误，解决 .NET 10 / C# 14 / ASP.NET Core 10 / EF Core 10 中的源代码和行为变更，更新 Debian 到 Ubuntu 基础镜像的 Dockerfile，解决弃用警告（SYSLIB0058-SYSLIB0062），适应 SDK/NuGet 变更（NU1510, PrunePackageReference），将 System.Linq.Async 迁移到内置的 AsyncEnumerable，修复 OpenApi v2 API 变更，加密重命名，以及 C# 14 编译器变更（字段关键字、扩展关键字、span 重载）。不适用于：.NET Framework 迁移，从 .NET 8 或更早版本升级（请先使用 migrate-dotnet8-to-dotnet9），全新的 .NET 10 项目，或仅用于美化现代化的场景。依赖项：csharp-compiler, core-libraries, sdk-msbuild（始终）；aspnet-core, efcore, cryptography, extensions-hosting, serialization-networking, winforms-wpf, containers-interop（选择性）。

name: gke-ai-troubleshooting-tpu-metrics-monitoring
description: Monitors and troubleshoots GKE TPU workloads, nodes, and node pools using GKE system metrics and PromQL. Use when monitoring TensorCore duty cycle, TPU memory, node readiness, multi-host TPU node pool availability, host maintenance or preemption interruptions, and calculating MTTR or MTBI metrics for GKE TPUs. Don't use for general non-TPU GKE workload monitoring or non-metric TPU debugging.
description_zh: 使用 GKE 系统指标和 PromQL 监控并排查 GKE TPU 工作负载、节点及节点池。当需要监控 TensorCore 占空比、TPU 内存、节点就绪状态、多主机 TPU 节点池可用性、主机维护或抢占中断，以及计算 GKE TPU 的 MTTR 或 MTBI 指标时，请使用此功能。请勿用于通用的非 TPU GKE 工作负载监控或非基于指标的 TPU 故障排查。

name: design-taste-frontend
description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns. The agent reads the brief, infers the right design direction, and ships interfaces that do not look templated. Real design systems when applicable, audit-first on redesigns, strict pre-flight check.
description_zh: 用于落地页、作品集和重新设计的防模板化前端技能。该代理会阅读需求简报，推断出正确的设计方向，并交付不显模板化的界面。在适用情况下采用真实设计系统，重新设计时先进行审计，严格进行预发布检查。

name: kr-whois-lookup
description: 공공데이터포털 WHOIS 도메인/IP 정보 API를 k-skill-proxy 경유로 호출해 .kr/.한국 도메인, IP 주소, AS 번호의 공개 등록정보를 조회한다. 조회 전용. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 通过 k-skill-proxy 中转调用公共数据门户 WHOIS 域名/IP 信息 API，查询 .kr/.韩国 域名、IP 地址、AS 号码的公开注册信息。仅支持查询功能。在돌쇠中，将通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: customer-journey-map
description: Create a customer journey map across stages, touchpoints, actions, emotions, and metrics. Use when diagnosing a broken experience or aligning a team on the full customer flow.
description_zh: 创建涵盖阶段、触点、行为、情感和指标的客户旅程图。在诊断体验问题或使团队对完整客户流程达成一致时使用。

name: ad-creative-test-plan
description: Design a pre-launch ad creative test plan - falsifiable hypothesis, isolation level, test cells with per-cell budgets, required sample, spend and duration, and kill/scale rules pre-registered before any money moves. Every cell carries an explicit read standard, so an underpowered screen is never dressed up as an A/B test. Use whenever the user wants to test ads, mentions an A/B or split test on creative, asks how much budget or how long a test needs, or mentions sample size, statistical significance, single-variable vs big-swing testing, or test cell structure - even if they never say 'test plan'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to read results from a test already running - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-fatigue instead.
description_zh: 设计一个广告发布前创意测试计划——包含可证伪的假设、隔离级别、带每单元预算的测试单元、所需样本量、花费和持续时间，以及在进行任何资金调动前预先注册的终止/扩展规则。每个单元都需携带明确的读取标准，因此不会用未充分配额的屏幕伪装成A/B测试。在用户想要测试广告、提及创意上的A/B或分割测试、询问预算或测试时长、提及样本量、统计显著性、单变量与大幅波动测试，或测试单元结构时使用——即使他们从未说“测试计划”。涵盖B2B和B2C。请勿用于读取已运行测试的结果——应使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-fatigue。

name: ad-spend-guardrails
description: Set the organisation's top-level paid-media spend guardrails as written policy - maximum allowable CAC, minimum ROAS/MER floor, kill-switch thresholds, counter-metrics, who owns them and who may override them - each derived from contribution margin, payback, and cash runway rather than inherited from a dashboard. Use whenever the user asks what CAC they can afford, mentions a ROAS floor, spend guardrails, a kill switch, when to stop spending, or who approves a budget increase - even if they never say 'guardrails'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to judge whether current CAC/ROAS is actually good (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@cac-roas-benchmark) or to monitor daily pacing (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing).
description_zh: 将组织的顶级付费媒体支出警戒线作为书面政策设定——包括最大可接受CAC（客户获取成本）、最低ROAS/MER（广告支出回报率/媒体效率比）下限、关闭开关阈值、反指标、谁拥有它们以及谁可以覆盖它们——所有这些均应基于贡献边际、投资回报和现金跑道来推导，而非从仪表盘继承。当用户询问他们可以承受的CAC、提及ROAS下限、支出警戒线、关闭开关、何时停止支出或谁批准预算增加时（即使他们从未说“警戒线”），也请使用。涵盖B2B和B2C业务。请勿使用此方法来判断当前的CAC/ROAS是否实际良好（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@cac-roas-benchmark）或用于监控每日进度（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing）。

name: frame-flowchart-sticky
description: SVG curve connectors, sticky-note nodes, and cursor interaction with a whiteboard-brainstorm feel.
description_zh: SVG曲线连接器、便利贴节点，以及与白板头脑风暴感觉的鼠标交互。

name: ad-attribution-gap
description: Quantify and explain the discrepancy between ad platform reporting, an analytics tool, and the source of truth (CRM or order system), classifying every unit of the gap as timing, definitional, or unexplained residual. Use whenever the user says the numbers don't match, that the platform reports more conversions or revenue than the CRM or order system, or mentions cross-platform reconciliation, double-counted conversions, an attribution discrepancy, or asks whether a reporting gap is normal - even if they never say 'attribution'. Covers B2B (CRM-anchored) and B2C/ecommerce (order-system-anchored). Do NOT use to fix broken or missing tracking - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-conversion-tracking instead.
description_zh: 量化并解释广告平台报告、分析工具与真实来源（CRM或订单系统）之间的差异，将每个差距单位归类为时间差异、定义差异或未解释的残差。当用户表示数字不匹配、平台报告的转化量或收入高于CRM或订单系统、提及跨平台对账、重复计数的转化、归因差异，或询问报告差异是否正常时（即使他们从未提及“归因”），均适用——涵盖B2B（以CRM为基础）和B2C/电商（以订单系统为基础）。不用于修复损坏或缺失的跟踪——请使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-conversion-tracking。

name: ad-spend-allocation
description: Split a fixed total paid-media budget across campaigns, platforms, funnel stages, and audiences based on expected marginal return - the monthly or quarterly reallocation decision, for B2B and B2C. Use whenever the user asks how to split an ad budget, which channel or campaign should get more money, how to reallocate spend, how much to put behind prospecting vs retargeting, or mentions a portfolio split, marginal return, or diminishing returns - even if they never say 'allocation'. Do NOT use to raise the total budget on a proven campaign (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-media-scaling), to track daily spend against a set budget (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing), or to pick channels at setup (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-platform-selection).
description_zh:
根据预期边际回报，将固定的付费媒体预算分配到各个活动、平台、漏斗阶段和受众群体——这是针对B2B和B2C的月度或季度再分配决策。当用户询问如何分配广告预算、哪个渠道或活动应获得更多资金、如何进行支出再分配、应将多少资金用于潜在客户开发与再营销，或提及投资组合分配、边际回报或边际收益递减时，均可使用——即使他们从未提及“分配”。  
**不应用于**：  
- 提高已验证活动的总预算（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@paid-media-scaling）  
- 根据设定预算跟踪每日支出（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing）  
- 在设置阶段选择渠道（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-platform-selection）

name: mini-browser
description: Browser automation skill for AI agents using the mb CLI. Use when the agent needs to browse the web, take screenshots, scrape text, fill forms, click elements, record screencasts, run JS in pages, or audit designs. Triggers on: "browse", "open a page", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "fill form", "click button", "web automation", "record screen", "design audit", "accessibility check".
description_zh: 使用 mb CLI 为 AI 代理提供的浏览器自动化技能。当代理需要浏览网页、截图、抓取文本、填写表单、点击元素、录制屏幕录像、在页面中运行 JS 或审核设计时使用。触发条件包括："浏览"、"打开页面"、"截图"、"抓取"、"填写表单"、"点击按钮"、"网页自动化"、"录制屏幕"、"设计审核"、"无障碍检查"。

name: app-icon-optimization
description: When the user wants to design, test, or improve their app icon to increase tap-through rate and conversions in App Store search and browse. Use when the user mentions "app icon", "icon design", "icon A/B test", "icon variants", "tap-through rate", "icon conversion", "icon refresh", or wants to know what makes a good app icon. For screenshot optimization, see screenshot-optimization. For full listing A/B tests, see ab-test-store-listing.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计、测试或改进他们的应用图标以提高在App Store搜索和浏览中的点击率和转化率时使用。当用户提到“应用图标”、“图标设计”、“图标A/B测试”、“图标变体”、“点击率”、“图标转化”、“图标刷新”，或想知道什么构成一个优秀的应用图标时使用。有关屏幕截图优化，请参阅screenshot-optimization。有关完整列表A/B测试，请参阅ab-test-store-listing。

name: swift-formatstyle
description: Formats and parses locale-aware numbers, decimals, currencies, percentages, dates, durations, measurements, names, lists, byte counts, and URLs with Foundation FormatStyle and ParseableFormatStyle. Use when replacing legacy Formatter subclasses, designing reusable format APIs, using SwiftUI Text(_:format:), correcting availability, or testing user-facing formatted output across locales.
description_zh: 使用 Foundation 的 FormatStyle 和 ParseableFormatStyle 格式化和解析本地化敏感的数字、小数、货币、百分比、日期、持续时间、度量单位、名称、列表、字节计数和 URL。在替换旧式 Formatter 子类、设计可重用的格式 API、使用 SwiftUI 的 Text(_:format:)、修正可用性或测试跨不同地区的用户界面格式化输出时使用。

name: ad-platform-selection
description: Decide which paid channel families fit a business's economics, audience, funnel stage, and budget at campaign setup - paid search, paid social, short-form video, connected TV, native/discovery, retail media, programmatic display, podcast/audio, paid review listings, B2B professional networks - including whether each is affordable against allowable CAC and payback. Use whenever the user asks where to spend a new ad budget, which platform to advertise on, how to build a paid channel mix, whether a channel is worth trying, or compares two ad channels - even if they never say 'channel selection'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to split an ongoing budget across existing campaigns - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation instead.
description_zh: 在创建活动时，确定哪些付费渠道组合适合企业的经济状况、受众、漏斗阶段和预算——包括付费搜索、付费社交、短视频、连接电视、原生/发现、零售媒体、程序化展示、播客/音频、付费评论列表、B2B专业网络——并评估每个渠道是否在可接受的客户获取成本（CAC）和回报周期内具有可行性。当用户询问如何分配新的广告预算、选择哪个平台进行广告投放、如何构建付费渠道组合、某个渠道是否值得尝试，或比较两个广告渠道时（即使他们从未提及“渠道选择”），均可使用。涵盖B2B和B2C场景。请勿使用此功能来分配现有预算至正在进行的活动——应使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation。

name: frame-data-chart-nyt
description: NYT-newsroom typography, staggered reveal animation, and editorial-grade charts (line, bar, or range band).
description_zh: 纽约时报新闻室的排版、错落有致的揭示动画，以及编辑级别的图表（线形、柱状或范围带）。

name: flags-sdk
description: Set up and use feature flags and A/B tests with the Flags SDK (`flags` npm package) and Vercel Flags. Use when installing or configuring the SDK, adding a new or existing flag, wiring `vercelAdapter` (OIDC or SDK keys), declaring flags with `flag()`, using the `vercel flags` CLI (create, inspect, list, enable, disable, set, update, split, rollout, rules, segments, use-targeting, evaluations, versions, open, archive, unarchive, rm, sdk-keys, override, prepare), setting up providers/adapters (Vercel, Statsig, LaunchDarkly, PostHog, GrowthBook, Global Config, OpenFeature, Split, Flagsmith, Reflag, Optimizely, or custom), precompute, `identify`/`dedupe`, Flags Explorer/Toolbar, Next.js or SvelteKit, or encrypting flag values. Triggers: feature flags, feature gates, A/B testing, experimentation, gradual rollout, traffic split, targeting rules, flag overrides, precompute, Flags Explorer, Vercel Flags, vercel flags CLI, `flags/next`, `flags/sveltekit`, `flags/react`, `@flags-sdk/*`.
description_zh: 使用 Flags SDK（`flags` npm 包）和 Vercel Flags 设置和使用功能标志及 A/B 测试。在以下场景中使用：安装或配置 SDK、添加新标志或现有标志、连接 `vercelAdapter`（OIDC 或 SDK 密钥）、使用 `flag()` 声明标志、使用 `vercel flags` 命令行工具（创建、检查、列出、启用、禁用、设置、更新、拆分、发布、规则、细分、使用目标、评估、版本、打开、归档、解归档、删除、SDK 密钥、覆盖、准备）、设置提供程序/适配器（Vercel、Statsig、LaunchDarkly、PostHog、GrowthBook、全局配置、OpenFeature、Split、Flagsmith、Reflag、Optimizely 或自定义）、预计算、`identify`/`dedupe`、标志探索器/工具栏、Next.js 或 SvelteKit、或加密标志值。触发器：功能标志、功能门、A/B 测试、实验、渐进式发布、流量拆分、目标规则、标志覆盖、预计算、标志探索器、Vercel Flags、vercel flags 命令行工具、`flags/next`、`flags/sveltekit`、`flags/react`、`@flags-sdk/*`。

name: build-perf-baseline
description: Establish build performance baselines and apply systematic optimization techniques. USE FOR: diagnosing slow builds, establishing before/after measurements (cold, warm, no-op scenarios), applying optimization strategies like static graph builds, artifacts output, and dependency graph trimming. Start here before diving into build-perf-diagnostics, incremental-build, or build-parallelism. DO NOT USE FOR: non-MSBuild build systems, detailed bottleneck analysis (use build-perf-diagnostics after baselining).
description_zh: 建立构建性能基线并应用系统优化技术。用途：诊断缓慢构建、建立前后测量（冷启动、热启动、无操作场景）、应用静态图构建、工件输出和依赖图修剪等优化策略。在深入研究构建性能诊断、增量构建或构建并行性之前，请从这里开始。不适用：非MSBuild构建系统、详细瓶颈分析（基线建立后使用构建性能诊断）。

name: django-access-review
description: Django access control and IDOR security review. Use when reviewing Django views, DRF viewsets, ORM queries, or any Python/Django code handling user authorization. Trigger keywords: "IDOR", "access control", "authorization", "Django permissions", "object permissions", "tenant isolation", "broken access".
description_zh: Django 访问控制和 IDOR 安全审查。在审查 Django 视图、DRF 视图集、ORM 查询或任何处理用户授权的 Python/Django 代码时使用。触发关键词："IDOR"、"访问控制"、"授权"、"Django 权限"、"对象权限"、"租户隔离"、"访问失效"。

name: paid-landing-page-audit
description: Audit a landing page receiving paid traffic against post-click conversion best practice and return a prioritised fix list - message match to the ad, above-the-fold clarity, form friction, trust, speed, mobile, policy risk - with every finding labelled by evidence class and no statistical claims on thin data. Use whenever the user says their ads get clicks but no conversions, asks why a landing page isn't converting, or mentions post-click experience, message match, conversion friction, form friction, or CPA rising after the click - even if they never say 'landing page audit'. Covers B2B and B2C on any platform. Audit only. Do NOT use for pre-click account problems - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic instead.
description_zh: 对接受付费流量的着陆页进行审计，对照点击后转化最佳实践，并返回优先级修复清单——包括与广告信息匹配度、首屏清晰度、表单摩擦、信任度、速度、移动端适配、政策风险等方面——每个发现项需标注证据类别，且不得基于薄弱数据做出统计性声明。在用户表示广告有点击但无转化、询问着陆页为何不转化、提及点击后体验、信息匹配度、转化摩擦、表单摩擦或点击后CPA上升等情况时使用——即使他们从未提及“着陆页审计”。涵盖B2B和B2C，适用于任何平台。仅限审计。禁止用于点击前账户问题——请使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic。

name: access-protected-vercel-deployment
description: Access and test Vercel deployments protected by Vercel Authentication, SSO, or Deployment Protection. Use when curl, agent-browser, Playwright, or another automated request reaches a Vercel login or protection page; when a protected preview or production URL returns 401 or 403; when TRUSTED_SOURCES_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH appears; or when choosing between `vercel curl` and the `x-vercel-trusted-oidc-idp-token` header.
description_zh: 访问和测试受 Vercel 身份验证、SSO 或部署保护保护的 Vercel 部署。当 curl、agent-browser、Playwright 或其他自动化请求到达 Vercel 登录或保护页面时使用；当受保护的预览或生产 URL 返回 401 或 403 时使用；当出现 TRUSTED_SOURCES_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH 时使用；或在 `vercel curl` 和 `x-vercel-trusted-oidc-idp-token` 头之间进行选择时使用。

name: frame-light-leak-cinema
description: Film light leaks, grain, 16:9 letterbox, and large serif type for cinematic openings or chapter cards.
description_zh: 胶片光晕、颗粒感、16:9宽银幕黑边以及大号衬线字体，适用于电影开场或章节卡片。

name: android-aso
description: When the user wants to optimize their Google Play Store listing — title, short description, full description, keywords, ratings, or Play Store-specific features. Use when the user mentions "Google Play", "Android", "Play Store", "Play Console", "short description", "full description indexed", "Google Play ASO", or wants Google Play-specific keyword, creative, or ratings strategy. For iOS App Store optimization, see aso-audit and metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化他们的 Google Play 商店列表时——标题、简短描述、完整描述、关键词、评分或 Google Play 特定功能。在用户提到“Google Play”、“Android”、“Play Store”、“Play Console”、“简短描述”、“完整描述索引”、“Google Play ASO”，或希望获得 Google Play 特定关键词、创意或评分策略时使用。对于 iOS App Store 优化，请参考 aso-audit 和 metadata-optimization。

name: spline-interactive
description: Browser-based 3D design tool with visual editor, animation, and web export. Use this skill when creating 3D scenes without code, designing interactive web experiences, prototyping 3D UI, exporting to React/web, or building designer-friendly 3D content. Triggers on tasks involving Spline, no-code 3D, visual 3D editor, 3D animation, state-based interactions, React Spline integration, or scene export. Alternative to Three.js for designers who prefer visual tools over code.
description_zh: 基于浏览器的3D设计工具，具备可视化编辑器、动画制作和网页导出功能。在无需编写代码即可创建3D场景、设计交互式网页体验、原型化3D界面、导出到React/网页或构建设计师友好的3D内容时，请使用此技能。当任务涉及Spline、无代码3D、可视化3D编辑器、3D动画、基于状态交互、React Spline集成或场景导出时，将触发该技能。对于更倾向于可视化工具而非代码的设计师，它是Three.js的替代方案。

name: advertising-career
description: Plan and advance a paid-advertising career from the candidate side - media buyer, performance marketer, PPC specialist, creative strategist, growth marketer - covering the junior to lead ladder, the five real interview formats (live account audit, mental-maths case, metric diagnosis, take-home, behavioural), an NDA-safe results portfolio, platform certifications, in-house vs agency vs freelance, and promotion and pay conversations. Use whenever the user asks how to get into paid media or PPC, preps a media-buyer or growth interview, wants an ad portfolio, or weighs an agency vs in-house move - even if they never say 'career'. Do NOT use for the employer side of hiring - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-hiring instead.
description_zh: 从候选人角度规划并推进付费广告职业生涯——媒体购买商、绩效营销人员、PPC专家、创意策略师、增长营销人员——涵盖从初级到高级职位的晋升阶梯，包括五种真实的面试形式（账户现场审核、心算案例、指标诊断、居家作业、行为评估）、保密协议安全的成果作品集、平台认证、内部与代理机构与自由职业者的区别，以及晋升与薪酬谈判。每当用户询问如何进入付费媒体或PPC领域、准备媒体购买商或增长面试、需要广告作品集，或权衡代理机构与内部职位选择时——即使他们从未提及“职业生涯”——均可使用。不适用于雇主招聘方面——请使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-hiring。

name: advertising-radar
description: Build a personalised, time-budgeted watch list of paid-advertising information sources - PPC and paid-social podcasts, newsletters, ad-platform release notes, communities, industry events, and media buyers worth following - with a verification method that keeps it fresh and a disclosure of what each source is selling. Use whenever a media buyer, PPC specialist, or growth marketer asks how to stay current on Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, or Microsoft Ads changes, which PPC newsletters or paid-social podcasts to follow, which communities or conferences deserve their time, or who to follow in performance marketing - even if they never say 'radar'. Do NOT use for career planning - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-career instead.
description_zh: 构建一个个性化的、按时间预算的广告信息资源清单——包括PPC和付费社交播客、简报、广告平台发布说明、社区、行业活动以及值得关注的媒体购买者——并采用验证方法使其保持更新，同时披露每个资源所推广的内容。每当媒体购买者、PPC专家或增长营销人员询问如何紧跟Google Ads、Meta、LinkedIn、TikTok或Microsoft Ads的变化，应该关注哪些PPC简报或付费社交播客，哪些社区或会议值得投入时间，或在绩效营销领域应该关注谁时（即使他们从未提及“雷达”），都可以使用此清单。禁止用于职业规划——请使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-career。

name: frame-glitch-title
description: Digital glitch, chromatic offset, and data-corruption title frame for video transitions or cyberpunk heroes.
description_zh: 数字故障、色偏和数据损坏的视频过渡或赛博朋克英雄标题帧。

name: frame-logo-outro
description: Segmented logo assembly, glow bloom, and tagline reveal for video outros or brand closing frames.
description_zh: 分段式标志组合、发光绽放和标语揭示，适用于视频结尾或品牌结束画面。

name: ethskills
description: Ethereum development knowledge for AI agents — from idea to deployed dApp. Fetch real-time docs on gas costs, Solidity patterns, Scaffold-ETH 2, Layer 2s, DeFi composability, security, testing, and production deployment. Use when: (1) building any Ethereum or EVM dApp, (2) writing or reviewing Solidity contracts, (3) deploying to mainnet or L2s, (4) the user asks about gas, tokens, wallets, or smart contracts, (5) any web3/blockchain/onchain development task. NOT for: trading, price checking, or portfolio management — use a trading skill for those.
description_zh: 为AI代理提供的以太坊开发知识——从构思到部署dApp。获取关于gas成本、Solidity模式、Scaffold-ETH 2、Layer 2、DeFi可组合性、安全性、测试和生产部署的实时文档。使用场景： (1) 构建任何以太坊或EVM dApp， (2) 编写或审查Solidity合约， (3) 部署到主网或L2， (4) 用户询问关于gas、代币、钱包或智能合约的问题， (5) 任何web3/区块链/链上开发任务。不适用于：交易、价格查询或投资组合管理——这些情况请使用交易技能。

name: ad-buyer-group-mapper
description: Map the likely buying committee for an offer, deal size, and industry, and give each role a messaging angle plus the ad-targeting proxy - job function and seniority, account list, account-level intent - that actually reaches them, sequenced by buying stage. Use whenever the user mentions a buying committee or buying group, decision makers, influencers or blockers, who signs off, targeting the economic buyer or a champion, per-role ad messaging, or whether one broad message beats per-role targeting - even if they never say 'buying committee'. Covers B2B committees and multi-decider household purchases. Do NOT use to size or build the audiences themselves - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting instead.
description_zh: 为报价、交易规模和行业映射可能的采购委员会，并为每个角色提供一个沟通角度，以及能够实际触达他们的广告定位代理——包括职位职能和资历、客户名单、客户层面的意向——按采购阶段排序。每当用户提到采购委员会或采购小组、决策者、影响者或阻碍者、谁最终签字、针对经济买家或倡导者、按角色进行广告信息传递，或一个广泛的信息是否胜过按角色定位——即使他们从未说“采购委员会”。涵盖B2B委员会和多决策者家庭购买。请勿用于规模或构建受众本身——应使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting。

name: advertising-hiring
description: Build the complete hiring packet for a paid-advertising role - the rung decision (media buyer vs performance marketer vs growth marketer; creative strategist is its own role), an outcome scorecard, a 2-3 round interview loop with a judgment-first question bank, a time-boxed in-interview work sample, and a 30-60-90 ramp with staged spend authority. For the marketing leader or founder recruiting. Use for "hire a media buyer", "interview questions for a performance marketer", "paid media work sample", "scorecard for our first ad hire", or "30-60-90 for a new paid media hire". Does not source candidates, post jobs, run applicant tracking, or write offers, and does not cover the candidate side - that is the sibling mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-career.
description_zh: 构建一个完整的付费广告岗位招聘包——包括决策层级（媒体购买者 vs. 效果营销者 vs. 增长营销者；创意策略师为独立岗位）、结果评分卡、2-3轮面试流程（以判断性问题库为先）、限时面试工作样本，以及30-60-90天的入职适应期和分阶段预算授权。适用于营销负责人或创始人招聘。可用于“招聘媒体购买者”、“效果营销者面试问题”、“付费媒体工作样本”、“首任广告员评分卡”或“新付费媒体招聘30-60-90计划”。本工具不负责候选人搜寻、职位发布、申请人追踪或录用通知撰写，且不涉及候选人端——这部分由兄弟项目mbfinotti/advertising-skills@advertising-career负责。

name: code-review-analysis
description: Perform comprehensive code reviews with best practices, security checks, and constructive feedback. Use when reviewing pull requests, analyzing code quality, checking for security vulnerabilities, or providing code improvement suggestions.
description_zh: 执行全面代码审查，包括最佳实践、安全检查和建设性反馈。在审查拉取请求、分析代码质量、检查安全漏洞或提供代码改进建议时使用。

name: retargeting-funnel
description: Design a multi-stage retargeting sequence from a site's own funnel data - recency windows and behavioural-depth tiers per stage, a message and offer ladder for each stage, mutually exclusive audiences with exclusion logic, and per-stage frequency caps. Use whenever the user mentions retargeting or remarketing, cart or form abandonment, how long a retargeting window should be, frequency caps, a retargeting audience that is too small, or ads still showing to people who already bought - even if they never say 'funnel'. Covers B2B and B2C, and produces a stage-by-stage plan rather than campaigns built inside an ad platform. Do NOT use to design cold prospecting audience tiers - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting instead.
description_zh: 根据网站自身的漏斗数据设计多阶段再营销序列——每个阶段的近期窗口和行为深度层级、每阶段的文案和优惠阶梯、相互排斥的受众及排除逻辑，以及每阶段的频率限制。在用户提及再营销、购物车或表单放弃、再营销窗口时长、频率限制、再营销受众规模过小，或广告仍向已购买用户展示时使用——即使他们从未提及“漏斗”。涵盖B2B和B2C，并生成分阶段计划，而非在广告平台内构建的营销活动。**不用于设计冷启动潜在客户受众层级**——请使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-audience-targeting。

name: smoke-test
description: Create a Mastra project using create-mastra and smoke test the studio in Chrome using Chrome MCP server
description_zh: 使用 create-mastra 创建一个 Mastra 项目，并通过 Chrome MCP 服务器在 Chrome 中对 Studio 进行冒烟测试

name: aihot
description: 查询 AIHOT 的中文 AI 资讯、精选、当前热点和日报。用户询问今天或最近的 AI 新闻、AI 圈动态、大模型或产品发布、OpenAI／Anthropic／Google 最新消息、AI 论文、AI 日报、AIHOT 精选、当前最热事件，或需要同步当前全部精选时使用。必须通过 aihot.news 的匿名只读 API 获取当前数据，不凭训练记忆回答新闻；不需要 API Key 或 MCP server。
description_zh: 查询 AIHOT 的中文 AI 资讯、精选、当前热点和日报。用户询问今天或最近的 AI 新闻、AI 圈动态、大模型或产品发布、OpenAI／Anthropic／Google 最新消息、AI 论文、AI 日报、AIHOT 精选、当前最热事件，或需要同步当前全部精选时使用。必须通过 aihot.news 的匿名只读 API 获取当前数据，不凭训练记忆回答新闻；不需要 API Key 或 MCP server。

name: second-brain-ingest
description: Process raw source documents into wiki pages. Use when the user adds files to raw/ and wants them ingested, says "process this source", "ingest this article", "I added something to raw/", or wants to incorporate new material into their knowledge base.
description_zh: 将原始源文档处理成维基页面。当用户向 raw/ 目录添加文件并希望将其纳入时，可以使用，例如说“处理这个源”、“摄入这篇文章”、“我添加了 raw/ 里的内容”，或希望将新材料整合到他们的知识库中。

name: build-parallelism
description: Diagnose and fix under-parallelized MSBuild builds. USE WHEN a multi-project solution build is slower than expected, doesn't speed up when you add cores, pegs a single core while others idle, or you want to know why `-m` isn't helping. Note: `/maxcpucount` default is 1 (sequential) — always pass `-m` for parallel builds. Covers finding the critical path (longest serial ProjectReference chain), graph build (`/graph`), BuildInParallel, and solution filters (`.slnf`). DO NOT USE FOR: single-project builds, incremental issues (use incremental-build), compilation slowness inside one project (use build-perf-diagnostics), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 诊断和修复并行度不足的MSBuild构建。在以下情况时使用：多项目解决方案构建速度慢于预期、增加核心数时无法提速、占用单个核心而其他核心空闲，或想知道为什么`-m`无效。注意：`/maxcpucount`默认值为1（顺序执行）——并行构建时始终传递`-m`。涵盖关键路径查找（最长串行ProjectReference链）、图构建（`/graph`）、并行构建（BuildInParallel）和解决方案过滤器（`.slnf`）。不适用于：单项目构建、增量问题（使用incremental-build）、单个项目中编译缓慢（使用build-perf-diagnostics）、非MSBuild构建系统。

name: core-data
description: Build, review, or improve Core Data persistence in apps that have not adopted SwiftData. Use when working with NSManagedObject subclasses, NSFetchedResultsController for list-driven UI, NSBatchInsertRequest / NSBatchDeleteRequest / NSBatchUpdateRequest for bulk operations, NSPersistentHistoryChangeRequest for persistent history tracking and multi-target sync, NSStagedMigrationManager for staged schema migrations (iOS 17+), NSCompositeAttributeDescription for composite attributes (iOS 17+), or when integrating Core Data threading with Swift Concurrency. For Core Data + SwiftData coexistence or migration, see the swiftdata skill instead.
description_zh: 构建、审查或改进未采用 SwiftData 应用的 Core Data 持久化。适用于使用 NSManagedObject 子类、NSFetchedResultsController 实现列表驱动 UI、NSBatchInsertRequest / NSBatchDeleteRequest / NSBatchUpdateRequest 执行批量操作、NSPersistentHistoryChangeRequest 跟踪持久化历史记录和多目标同步、NSStagedMigrationManager 执行分阶段模式迁移（iOS 17+）、NSCompositeAttributeDescription 处理复合属性（iOS 17+），或需将 Core Data 线程与 Swift Concurrency 集成时使用。若需了解 Core Data 与 SwiftData 共存或迁移方案，请参考 swiftdata 技能。

name: card-twitter
description: Twitter quote or data card designed to pair with a post.
description_zh: 用于与帖子配对的推特引言或数据卡片设计。

name: understand-anything-knowledge-graph
description: Turn any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph using Claude Code skills — explore, search, and ask questions about any project visually.
description_zh: 将任何代码库转换为交互式知识图谱，使用 Claude 代码技能——可直观地探索、搜索和针对任何项目提问。

name: company-values
description: Help define company values and culture for a minimalist business. Use when someone is setting up their company culture, preparing to hire, or wanting to codify what their company stands for.
description_zh: 帮助定义简约型企业的价值观和企业文化。适用于有人正在建立其企业文化、准备招聘，或希望将公司的宗旨规范化时使用。

name: loop-me
description: 在这个工作区中，就我想构建的工作流规格访谈我。
description_zh: 在这个工作区中，请就我打算构建的工作流规范对我进行访谈。

name: dotnet-maui-doctor
description: Diagnoses and fixes .NET MAUI development environment issues. Validates .NET SDK, workloads, Java JDK, Android SDK, Xcode, and Windows SDK. All version requirements discovered dynamically from NuGet WorkloadDependencies.json — never hardcoded. Use when: setting up MAUI development, build errors mentioning SDK/workload/JDK/Android, "Android SDK not found", "Java version" errors, "Xcode not found", environment verification after updates, or any MAUI toolchain issues. Do not use for: non-MAUI .NET projects, Xamarin.Forms apps, runtime app crashes unrelated to environment setup, or app store publishing issues. Works on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
description_zh: 诊断和修复 .NET MAUI 开发环境问题。验证 .NET SDK、工作负载、Java JDK、Android SDK、Xcode 和 Windows SDK。所有版本要求均从 NuGet WorkloadDependencies.json 动态获取——绝不硬编码。使用场景：设置 MAUI 开发环境、构建错误提示 SDK/工作负载/JDK/Android、"未找到 Android SDK"、"Java 版本错误"、"未找到 Xcode"、更新后的环境验证或任何 MAUI 工具链问题。不适用场景：非 MAUI 的 .NET 项目、Xamarin.Forms 应用、与环境设置无关的运行时应用崩溃或应用商店发布问题。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。

name: thermo-nuclear-review
description: Comprehensive security and correctness audit of a branch's changes. Use for thermo nuclear, thermonuclear, or deep review requests, or branch/PR diff audits focused on bugs, breaking changes, security issues, devex regressions, and feature-gate leaks.
description_zh: 对一个分支的变更进行全面的安全性和正确性审计。适用于热核、热核或深度审查请求，或专注于错误、破坏性变更、安全问题、开发异常回归和功能门泄露的分支/PR差异审计。

name: finance-manager
description: Comprehensive personal finance management system for analyzing transaction data, generating insights, creating visualizations, and providing actionable financial recommendations. Use when users need to analyze spending patterns, track budgets, visualize financial data, extract transactions from PDFs, calculate savings rates, identify spending trends, generate financial reports, or receive personalized budget recommendations. Triggers include requests like "analyze my finances", "track my spending", "create a financial report", "extract transactions from PDF", "visualize my budget", "where is my money going", "financial insights", "spending breakdown", or any finance-related analysis tasks.
description_zh: 全面的个人财务管理系统，用于分析交易数据、生成洞察、创建可视化图表，并提供可操作的财务建议。当用户需要分析消费模式、追踪预算、可视化财务数据、从PDF中提取交易、计算储蓄率、识别消费趋势、生成财务报告或获取个性化预算建议时使用。触发条件包括类似“分析我的财务状况”、“追踪我的消费”、“创建财务报告”、“从PDF中提取交易”、“可视化我的预算”、“我的钱花在哪里”、“财务洞察”、“消费明细”或任何与财务相关的分析任务。

name: dump-collect
description: Configure and collect crash dumps for modern .NET applications. USE FOR: enabling automatic crash dumps for CoreCLR or NativeAOT, capturing dumps from running .NET processes, setting up dump collection in Docker or Kubernetes, using dotnet-dump collect or createdump. DO NOT USE FOR: analyzing or debugging dumps, post-mortem investigation with lldb/windbg/dotnet-dump analyze, profiling or tracing, or for .NET Framework processes.
description_zh: 配置和收集现代 .NET 应用的崩溃转储文件。用途：启用 CoreCLR 或 NativeAOT 的自动崩溃转储、捕获正在运行的 .NET 进程的转储文件、在 Docker 或 Kubernetes 中设置转储收集、使用 dotnet-dump collect 或 createdump。不适用：分析或调试转储文件、使用 lldb/windbg/dotnet-dump analyze 进行事后调查、性能分析或跟踪，或用于 .NET Framework 进程。

name: promql-cli
description: CLI for querying Prometheus and PromQL-compatible engines (Thanos, Cortex, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana Mimir, Grafana Tempo...) — instant queries, range queries, metric discovery (metrics/labels/meta subcommands), output formats (table/csv/json/graph). Apply when executing PromQL queries, troubleshooting performance issues on a software having observability, investigating latency/error rates/saturation, or analyzing time series data.
description_zh: 用于查询 Prometheus 及 PromQL 兼容引擎（Thanos、Cortex、VictoriaMetrics、Grafana Mimir、Grafana Tempo 等）的命令行工具——即时查询、范围查询、指标发现（指标/标签/元数据子命令）、输出格式（表格/CSV/JSON/图形）。适用于执行 PromQL 查询、排查具有可观测性的软件性能问题、调查延迟/错误率/饱和度，或分析时间序列数据。

name: monetizing-innovation
description: Design products and pricing around validated willingness to pay, from Ramanujam & Tacke's "Monetizing Innovation". Use when the user mentions "pricing", "how much should we charge", "willingness to pay", "pricing page", "packaging", "freemium vs free trial", "are we leaving money on the table", "nobody buys at this price", "price increase", or "good-better-best". Also trigger when designing or auditing pricing and packaging, validating willingness to pay before building, segmenting customers by value, or choosing between subscription, usage-based, and freemium models. Covers price-before-product, willingness-to-pay talks, the four failures (feature shock, minivation, hidden gem, undead), leader/filler/killer packaging, and behavioral pricing. For offers and guarantees, see hundred-million-offers. For what customers value, see jobs-to-be-done.
description_zh: 围绕经验证的支付意愿设计产品与定价，参考拉马努金与塔克的《创新变现》。当用户提及“定价”、“我们应该收多少”、“支付意愿”、“定价页面”、“包装”、“免费增值与免费试用”、“我们是否错失了收入”、“这个价格没人买”、“价格上调”或“好-更好-最好”时触发。设计或审核定价与包装、在构建前验证支付意愿、按价值细分客户、或选择订阅、按使用量付费与免费增值模式时也会触发。涵盖“先定价后产品”、支付意愿讨论、四大失败（功能冲击、最小化、隐藏宝石、不死）、领导者/填充者/杀手包装和行为定价。关于优惠与保证，请参阅“百万级优惠”。关于客户重视什么，请参阅“用户要完成的任务”。

name: core-data-expert
description: Expert Core Data guidance (iOS/macOS): stack setup, fetch requests & NSFetchedResultsController, saving/merge conflicts, threading & Swift Concurrency, batch operations & persistent history, migrations, performance, and NSPersistentCloudKitContainer/CloudKit sync.
description_zh: 专家级 Core Data 指南（iOS/macOS）：栈配置、数据请求与 NSFetchedResultsController、保存与合并冲突处理、线程管理及 Swift 并发、批处理与持久历史记录、数据迁移、性能优化，以及 NSPersistentCloudKitContainer/CloudKit 同步。

name: assertion-quality
description: Analyze assertion quality, depth, variety, and false confidence in existing tests. ALWAYS USE when asked about weak, shallow, trivial, always-true, self-referential, assertion-free, presence/truthiness-only, or insufficiently diverse assertions, including MSTest, Jest, pytest, and Go. DO NOT USE for direct fixes: writing-mstest-tests owns supplied MSTest assertions; code-testing-agent owns new cases. Use test-gap-analysis when asked whether tests would catch a production change, and test-anti-patterns for general severity-ranked audits.
description_zh: 分析现有测试中的断言质量、深度、多样性以及虚假自信。当被问及关于薄弱、浅显、琐碎、始终为真、自我引用、无断言、仅检查存在/真值或多样性不足的断言时，必须使用，包括 MSTest、Jest、pytest 和 Go。不应用于直接修复：编写 MSTest 测试负责提供的 MSTest 断言；代码测试代理负责新案例。当被问及测试是否会捕获生产环境变更时，使用 test-gap-analysis，使用 test-anti-patterns 进行一般严重性排序的审计。

name: storytelling
description: Discipline for giving design work narrative structure that makes people care. Provides four canonical patterns — protagonist-arc, choreography, situation/complication/resolution, what-is/what-could-be — each with a goal, shape, and named pathology. Use when design work needs narrative structure, when stakeholders need to see the user's experience as a story, when presenting design rationale to non-design audiences, or when a journey, blueprint, brief, or deck feels lifeless. Trigger phrases: "what's the story here?", "tell the story", "story mode", "narrative mode". Restated inline in journey, blueprint, strategize, evaluate (and presentation when that skill ships). Refuses to smooth user data into clean arcs, manufacture strategic tension, substitute emotional appeal for evidence, assume conflict arcs are universal, or engineer stakeholder assent by shortcut.
description_zh: 赋予设计工作叙事结构，使其引人入胜。提供四种规范模式——主角弧、编排、情境/冲突/解决、现状/应有状态——每种模式都包含目标、形态和命名的病理。在以下情况使用：设计工作需要叙事结构、利益相关者需要将用户体验视为故事、向非设计受众阐述设计理念，或当旅程图、蓝图、简报或演示文稿显得缺乏活力时。触发短语：“这里的故事是什么？”、“讲述故事”、“故事模式”、“叙事模式”。在旅程图、蓝图、策略制定、评估（以及演示文稿）中内嵌重述（当该技能交付时）。拒绝将用户数据平滑成完美弧线、制造战略紧张感、用情感诉求替代证据、假设冲突弧线具有普适性，或通过捷径获取利益相关者的认同。

name: payload
description: Use when working with Payload projects (payload.config.ts, collections, fields, hooks, access control, Payload API). Use when debugging validation errors, security issues, relationship queries, transactions, or hook behavior.
description_zh: 在处理 Payload 项目（payload.config.ts、集合、字段、钩子、访问控制、Payload API）时使用。在调试验证错误、安全问题、关系查询、事务或钩子行为时使用。

name: autoresearch
description: Autonomous iteration loop: modify, verify, keep/discard against any metric
description_zh: 自主迭代循环：修改、验证、根据任何指标保留/舍弃

name: vfx-text-cursor
description: Cursor light trail, chromatic rays, and directional flares for word-by-word quote reveals in video intros.
description_zh: Cursor light trail, chromatic rays, and directional flares for word-by-word quote reveals in video intros.

name: convert-to-cpm
description: Convert .NET projects and solutions (.sln, .slnx) to NuGet Central Package Management (CPM) using Directory.Packages.props. USE FOR: converting to CPM, centralizing or aligning NuGet package versions across multiple projects, inlining MSBuild version properties from Directory.Build.props into Directory.Packages.props, resolving version conflicts or mismatches across a solution or repository, updating or bumping or syncing package versions across projects. Also activate when packages are out of sync, drifting, or inconsistent -- even without the user mentioning CPM. Provides baseline build capture, version conflict resolution, build validation with binlog comparison, and a structured post-conversion report. DO NOT USE FOR: packages.config projects (must migrate to PackageReference first) or repositories that already have CPM fully enabled.
description_zh:
使用 Directory.Packages.props 将 .NET 项目和解决方案（.sln、.slnx）转换为 NuGet Central Package Management (CPM)。用途：  
- 转换为 CPM  
- 在多个项目中集中或统一 NuGet 包版本  
- 将 Directory.Build.props 中的 MSBuild 版本属性内联到 Directory.Packages.props  
- 解决解决方案或存储库中的版本冲突或版本不匹配  
- 在项目中更新或提升或同步包版本  
- 当包版本不同步、漂移或不一致时自动激活——即使用户未提及 CPM。  
提供基础构建捕获、版本冲突解决、通过 binlog 比较的构建验证，以及结构化的转换后报告。  

**不适用场景**：  
- 包含 packages.config 的项目（必须先迁移到 PackageReference）  
- 已完全启用 CPM 的存储库。

name: microbenchmarking
description: Activate this skill when BenchmarkDotNet (BDN) is involved in the task — creating, running, configuring, or reviewing BDN benchmarks. Also activate when microbenchmarking .NET code would be useful and BenchmarkDotNet is the likely tool. Consider activating when answering a .NET performance question requires measurement and BenchmarkDotNet may be needed. Covers microbenchmark design, BDN configuration and project setup, how to run BDN microbenchmarks efficiently and effectively, and using BDN for side-by-side performance comparisons. Do NOT use for profiling/tracing .NET code (dotnet-trace, PerfView), production telemetry, or load/stress testing (Crank, k6).
description_zh: 当任务涉及 BenchmarkDotNet（BDN）时启用此技能，例如创建、运行、配置或评审 BDN 基准测试。在微基准测试 .NET 代码会受益且 BenchmarkDotNet 可能是合适工具时，同样启用此技能。在回答 .NET 性能问题时需要测量且可能需要使用 BenchmarkDotNet 时，考虑启用此技能。本技能涵盖微基准测试的设计、BDN 配置与项目设置、如何高效且有效地运行 BDN 微基准测试，以及使用 BDN 进行并排性能对比。请勿用于 .NET 代码的剖析/跟踪（dotnet-trace、PerfView）、生产遥测，或负载/压力测试（Crank、k6）。

name: skill-lookup
description: Search, retrieve, and install Agent Skills from the prompts.chat registry using MCP tools. Use when the user asks to find skills, browse skill catalogs, install a skill for Claude, or extend Claude's capabilities with reusable AI agent components.
description_zh: 使用MCP工具从prompts.chat注册中心搜索、检索和安装代理技能。当用户要求查找技能、浏览技能目录、为Claude安装技能或使用可重用的AI代理组件扩展Claude的功能时使用。

name: technology-selection
description: Guides technology selection and implementation of AI and ML features in .NET 8+ applications using ML.NET, Microsoft.Extensions.AI (MEAI), Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), GitHub Copilot SDK, ONNX Runtime, and OllamaSharp. Covers the full spectrum from classic ML through modern LLM orchestration to local inference. Use when adding classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, recommendation, LLM integration (text generation, summarization, reasoning), RAG pipelines with vector search, agentic workflows with tool calling, Copilot extensions, or custom model inference via ONNX Runtime to a .NET project. DO NOT USE FOR projects targeting .NET Framework (requires .NET 8+), the task is pure data engineering or ETL with no ML/AI component, or the project needs a custom deep learning training loop (use Python with PyTorch/TensorFlow, then export to ONNX for .NET inference).
description_zh: 指导在 .NET 8+ 应用中使用 ML.NET、Microsoft.Extensions.AI (MEAI)、Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF)、GitHub Copilot SDK、ONNX Runtime 和 OllamaSharp 选择和实现 AI 和 ML 功能。涵盖从经典 ML 到现代 LLM 协调再到本地推理的完整范围。在向 .NET 项目添加分类、回归、聚类、异常检测、推荐、LLM 集成（文本生成、摘要、推理）、使用向量搜索的 RAG 管道、带有工具调用的智能体工作流、Copilot 扩展或通过 ONNX Runtime 进行自定义模型推理时使用。**不适用于**目标为 .NET Framework 的项目（需要 .NET 8+）、任务为纯数据工程或 ETL 且无 ML/AI 组件的项目，或项目需要自定义深度学习训练循环（请使用 Python 配合 PyTorch/TensorFlow，然后导出为 ONNX 以用于 .NET 推理）。

name: capacitor-best-practices
description: Best practices for Capacitor app development including project structure, plugin usage, performance optimization, security, and deployment. Use this skill when reviewing Capacitor code, setting up new projects, or optimizing existing apps.
description_zh: 电容应用开发的最佳实践，包括项目结构、插件使用、性能优化、安全性和部署。在审查电容代码、设置新项目或优化现有应用时使用这项技能。

name: loop-library
description: Compatibility alias for Loopy. Use only when an existing installation or older instruction explicitly invokes loop-library; use Loopy for new installations and requests. Provides the same discovery, recommendation, audit, repair, adaptation, guided crafting, bounded execution, run debrief, project loop saving, and publication-preparation workflows.
description_zh: Loopy 的兼容别名。仅当现有安装或较旧的说明明确调用 loop-library 时使用；对于新安装和请求，请使用 Loopy。提供与 Loopy 相同的发现、推荐、审计、修复、适配、引导式制作、受限执行、运行回顾、项目循环保存以及发布准备工作流程。

name: frame-macos-notification
description: Realistic macOS notification banner with app icon, title, and body, suited to video overlays or product teasers.
description_zh: 一个具有应用程序图标、标题和正文的逼真 macOS 通知横幅，适用于视频叠加或产品预告。

name: nx-import
description: Import, merge, or combine repositories into an Nx workspace using nx import. USE WHEN the user asks to adopt Nx across repos, move projects into a monorepo, or bring code/history from another repository.
description_zh: 使用 nx import 将存储库导入、合并或组合到 Nx 工作区中。在以下情况下使用：用户要求跨多个存储库采用 Nx、将项目迁移到单一代码库，或从另一个存储库引入代码/历史记录。

name: before-and-after
description: Add existing screenshots or screen recordings to a GitHub pull request as a before/after or preview block. Use when a PR needs visual media attached to its description. Browser navigation and capture belong to agent-browser.
description_zh: 将现有的截图或屏幕录制添加到 GitHub 拉取请求中，作为“之前/之后”或“预览”模块。当 PR 需要附加视觉媒体到其描述时使用。浏览器导航和捕获属于 agent-browser。

name: eval-performance
description: Guide for diagnosing and improving MSBuild project evaluation performance. USE FOR: builds slow before any compilation starts, high evaluation time in binlog analysis, expensive glob patterns walking large directories (node_modules, .git, bin/obj), deep import chains (>20 levels), preprocessed output >10K lines indicating heavy evaluation, property functions with file I/O ($([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(...))), multiple evaluations per project. Covers the 5 MSBuild evaluation phases, glob optimization via DefaultItemExcludes, import chain analysis with /pp preprocessing. DO NOT USE FOR: compilation-time slowness (use build-perf-diagnostics), incremental build issues (use incremental-build), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 用于诊断和提升 MSBuild 项目评估性能的指南。适用场景：编译开始前构建缓慢、binlog 分析中评估时间过长、在大型目录（如 node_modules、.git、bin/obj）中遍历昂贵的 glob 模式、导入链过深（>20 层）、预处理输出超过 10K 行表明评估负担重、涉及文件 I/O 的属性函数（如 $([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(...))）、每个项目多次评估。涵盖 MSBuild 的 5 个评估阶段、通过 DefaultItemExcludes 进行 glob 优化、使用 /pp 预处理进行导入链分析。不适用场景：编译时缓慢（使用 build-perf-diagnostics）、增量构建问题（使用 incremental-build）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: ad-hook-analyzer
description: Score and force-rank the openings of candidate video ads - from a script, transcript, storyboard, shot list, or a description of a finished cut - to decide which hooks deserve test budget, returning a ranked shortlist within the batch rather than an absolute performance prediction.
