Use whenever the user mentions a hook, the first 3 seconds, an ad opening, hook rate, thumbstop, attention scoring, or asks which hook to test or whether a hook works - even if they never say 'hook analyzer'. Covers B2B and B2C on any platform. Ends at the ranking: writing the scripts themselves is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts and static copy is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants.
description_zh: 对候选视频广告的开头进行评分和强制排名——根据脚本、字幕稿、故事板、镜头清单或成品剪辑的描述——以确定哪些钩点值得测试预算，并在批次内返回一个排名短名单，而不是绝对的性能预测。每当用户提到钩点、前3秒、广告开头、钩点率、拇指停留、注意力评分，或询问要测试哪个钩点或钩点是否有效时，即使他们从未说“钩点分析器”，也使用此功能。涵盖B2B和B2C，适用于任何平台。在排名结束时：编写脚本本身是mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts，静态文案是mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants。

name: site-launch-checklist
description: Pre-launch checklist for shipping a new website or web app. Scope: analytics (GA4, PostHog, Google Search Console, Ahrefs), DNS, TLS and backups, legal and CNIL/GDPR compliance, security headers, SEO and GEO (robots.txt, sitemaps, llms.txt, hreflang, schema markup, keyword research), copywriting voice via TONE.md and a humanizer pass, OpenGraph and social previews, favicons and web manifest, Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals and WCAG quality gates, directory submissions, Product Hunt, G2/Capterra reviews, post-launch monitoring. Use when the user says 'checklist for the site', 'ready to ship', 'before I go live', 'ready for prod', 'audit before launch', or asks for a site review, pre-launch audit, or help launching a site or app, deploying a domain to production, or shipping a marketing, docs, SaaS, or lead-magnet site.
description_zh: 新网站或网络应用上线前的检查清单。范围：分析（GA4、PostHog、Google Search Console、Ahrefs）、DNS、TLS和备份、法律和CNIL/GDPR合规性、安全头信息、SEO和GEO（robots.txt、站点地图、llms.txt、hreflang、schema标记、关键词研究）、通过TONE.md进行文案风格调整和人性化处理、OpenGraph和社交预览、图标和网页清单、Lighthouse、核心网络健康指标和WCAG质量门、目录提交、Product Hunt、G2/Capterra评价、上线后监控。当用户说“检查清单”、“准备上线”、“上线前”、“准备生产环境”、“上线前审计”，或询问网站评审、上线前审计、帮助上线网站或应用、部署域名到生产环境，或发布营销、文档、SaaS或潜在客户吸引网站时使用。

name: dx-apexguru-scan
description: Run an ApexGuru performance scan on a Salesforce Apex project via the ApexGuru SFAP Scan API. Zips the project's Apex (any layout), submits it, polls to completion, decodes the base64 report, and presents performance antipattern violations (SOQL in loop, DML in loop, Schema.getGlobalDescribe(), SOQL without WHERE/LIMIT, unused SOQL fields) grouped by rule with severity, file:line, and suggested fixes — clearly attributed as 'Static only' or 'Production insights'. TRIGGER when the user says 'run ApexGuru', 'ApexGuru scan', 'check Apex performance', 'find governor-limit / performance antipatterns', 'SOQL in loop', 'scan my Apex for performance', or 'ApexGuru performance insights'. DO NOT TRIGGER for general static analysis or security scans (use dx-code-analyzer-run), for fixing code without scanning, or for onboarding an org to ApexGuru.
description_zh: 通过 ApexGuru SFAP 扫描 API 对 Salesforce Apex 项目运行 ApexGuru 性能扫描。压缩项目的 Apex（任何布局），提交它，轮询完成，解码 base64 报告，并按规则分组展示性能反模式违规（循环中的 SOQL、循环中的 DML、Schema.getGlobalDescribe()、无 WHERE/LIMIT 的 SOQL、未使用的 SOQL 字段），包含严重程度、文件:行号和建议修复方案——明确标注为“仅静态分析”或“生产洞察”。当用户说“运行 ApexGuru”、“ApexGuru 扫描”、“检查 Apex 性能”、“查找治理限制/性能反模式”、“循环中的 SOQL”、“扫描我的 Apex 以进行性能分析”或“ApexGuru 性能洞察”时触发。禁止用于一般静态分析或安全扫描（请使用 dx-code-analyzer-run），禁止在未扫描的情况下修复代码，或用于将组织引入 ApexGuru。

name: social-x-post-card
description: Realistic X post card with engagement metrics (likes, reposts, views), suited to video overlays or shareable image cards.
description_zh: 包含互动指标（点赞、转发、浏览量）的逼真 X 平台帖子卡片，适用于视频叠加效果或可分享的图像卡片。

name: focus-engine
description: Implements keyboard, directional, and scene-level focus behavior across SwiftUI and UIKit. Use when managing @FocusState, defaultFocus, focused values, focusable interactions, focus sections, tvOS geometric focus and Siri Remote navigation, watchOS Digital Crown input, visionOS connected-device focus versus gaze hover/input targets, macOS key view loop and Full Keyboard Access, focus restoration after presentation changes, custom focus routing with UIFocusGuide, or debugging focus with UIFocusDebugger.
description_zh: 实现 SwiftUI 和 UIKit 中的键盘、方向和场景级焦点行为。在管理 @FocusState、默认焦点、焦点值、可焦点交互、焦点区域、tvOS 几何焦点和 Siri Remote 导航、watchOS 数字旋钮输入、visionOS 连接设备焦点与注视悬停/输入目标、macOS 键视图循环和全键盘访问、焦点变化后的焦点恢复、使用 UIFocusGuide 的自定义焦点路由或使用 UIFocusDebugger 的焦点调试时使用。

name: ad-bidding-strategy
description: Choose the bidding policy per platform and goal - manual vs automated, cost-goal vs value/return-goal, when to switch, and how to set and move the target - written up as a policy with an evaluation window, change discipline, and a rollback trigger. Use whenever the user mentions a bid strategy, target CPA or target ROAS, smart or automated bidding, bid cap vs cost cap, portfolio bid strategies, seasonal bid adjustments, value-based bidding readiness, or delivery collapsing after a target change - even if they never say 'bidding'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use to split budgets across campaigns (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation) or to track spend against a budget (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing).
description_zh: 根据平台和目标选择竞价策略——手动与自动、成本目标与价值/回报目标、何时切换、如何设置和调整目标——以政策形式编写，包含评估窗口、变更规范和回滚触发条件。在用户提及竞价策略、目标CPA或目标ROAS、智能或自动竞价、出价上限与成本上限、投资组合竞价策略、季节性竞价调整、基于价值的竞价准备或目标变更后的交付合并时使用——即使他们从未提及“竞价”。涵盖B2B和B2C。请勿用于跨活动分配预算（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-spend-allocation）或追踪预算支出（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-budget-pacing）。

name: pubmed-database
description: Search PubMed for scientific literature, including published clinical trials. Fetch abstracts and full text. Link published research to biological databases (gene, protein, nucleotide, PubChem) to discover associations between papers and specific compounds or genes. Verify medical spelling, match raw citations, and cache result sets for bulk processing. Interfaces NCBI E-utilities and PMC BioC APIs.

name: local-seo
description: When the user wants to optimize for local search, set up Google Business Profile, or build local citations. Also use when the user mentions "local SEO," "Google Business Profile," "Google Maps," "NAP," "citations," "local search," "local business," or "service area." For location pages, use programmatic-seo.

name: lean-analytics
description: Choose and audit startup metrics using Croll and Yoskovitz's "Lean Analytics". Use when the user mentions "what metrics should we track", "KPIs", "north star metric", "One Metric That Matters (OMTM)", "vanity metrics", "analytics dashboard", "DAU/MAU", "churn benchmark", or "measure product-market fit". Also trigger when choosing metrics for a startup or feature, auditing a dashboard for vanity metrics, setting metric targets and baselines, or instrumenting a product by business model and stage. Covers good-vs-vanity metrics, the One Metric That Matters, metrics by business model, the five startup stages, and benchmarks. For the build-measure-learn loop, see lean-startup. For fixing activation and retention, see improve-retention.
description_zh: 使用 Croll 和 Yoskovitz 的《精益分析》（Lean Analytics）选择并审核初创企业指标。当用户提到“我们应该追踪哪些指标”、“关键绩效指标（KPIs）”、“北极星指标”、“关键指标（OMTM）”、“虚荣指标”、“分析仪表盘”、“日活跃用户（DAU）/月活跃用户（MAU）”、“用户流失基准”或“衡量产品市场契合度”时触发。此外，在为初创企业或功能选择指标、审核仪表盘中的虚荣指标、设置指标目标和基准，或按商业模式和阶段对产品进行业务建模时也会触发。涵盖优质指标与虚荣指标、关键指标、按商业模式划分的指标、初创企业五个阶段以及基准。关于“构建-衡量-学习”循环，请参阅 lean-startup。关于改进激活和留存，请参阅 improve-retention。

name: cx-platform-admin
description: Use this skill when the user asks "who has access", "audit permissions", "check user roles", "list API keys", "review access controls", "rotate API keys", "create API key", "delete expired keys", "send data keys", "IP allowlist", "IP access restrictions", "check IP whitelist", "add user", "deactivate user", "manage team groups", "user permissions", "role-based access", "manage scopes", "system roles", "API key admin", "team member keys", "group membership", or wants to audit, manage, or configure access controls for a Coralogix account.
description_zh: 当用户询问“谁有权访问”、“审计权限”、“检查用户角色”、“列出 API 密钥”、“审查访问控制”、“轮换 API 密钥”、“创建 API 密钥”、“删除过期密钥”、“发送数据密钥”、“IP 白名单”、“IP 访问限制”、“检查 IP 白名单”、“添加用户”、“停用用户”、“管理团队组”、“用户权限”、“基于角色的访问”、“管理作用域”、“系统角色”、“API 密钥管理员”、“团队成员密钥”、“组成员资格”，或需要审计、管理或配置 Coralogix 账户的访问控制时，请使用此功能。

name: processize
description: Turn a product idea into a manual-first process you can start delivering today. Use when you have an idea and want to figure out how to deliver value by hand before writing any code.
description_zh: 将一个产品想法转变为一个您可以立即开始交付的手册优先流程。当您有想法并希望在使用任何代码之前通过手工方式来交付价值时使用。

name: migrate-dotnet10-to-dotnet11
description: Migrate a .NET 10 project or solution to .NET 11 and resolve all breaking changes. This is a MIGRATION skill — use it when upgrading from .NET 10 to .NET 11, NOT for writing new programs. USE FOR: upgrading TargetFramework from net10.0 to net11.0, fixing build errors after updating the .NET 11 SDK, resolving source-breaking and behavioral changes in .NET 11 runtime, C# 15 compiler, and EF Core 11, adapting to updated minimum hardware requirements (x86-64-v2, Arm64 LSE), and updating CI/CD pipelines and Dockerfiles for .NET 11. DO NOT USE FOR: .NET Framework migrations, upgrading from .NET 9 or earlier, greenfield .NET 11 projects, or cosmetic modernization unrelated to the upgrade. NOTE: .NET 11 is in preview. Covers breaking changes through Preview 3.
description_zh: 将 .NET 10 项目或解决方案迁移到 .NET 11 并解决所有破坏性变更。这是一个迁移技能——在从 .NET 10 升级到 .NET 11 时使用它，而不是用于编写新程序。用于：将 TargetFramework 从 net10.0 更新为 net11.0，更新 .NET 11 SDK 后修复构建错误，解决 .NET 11 运行时、C# 15 编译器和 EF Core 11 中的源代码破坏性行为变更，适应更新的最低硬件要求（x86-64-v2、Arm64 LSE），以及更新用于 .NET 11 的 CI/CD 管道和 Dockerfile。不用于：.NET Framework 迁移、从 .NET 9 或更早版本升级、绿色字段 .NET 11 项目或与升级无关的纯美化现代化。注意：.NET 11 处于预览阶段。涵盖预览版 3 的破坏性变更。

name: writing-mstest-tests
description: ALWAYS USE when asked to fix, rewrite, update, improve, modernize, show corrected code for, or explain existing MSTest tests or MSTest-specific configuration. Use for "review" when corrected code or edits are wanted, even for one pasted assertion or passing tests with bad failure output. Covers expected/actual labels; generic Boolean, collection, string, numeric, null, identity, exception, hard-cast, and object[] checks; TestContext/lifecycle; timeout/cancellation; OS/CI conditions, retry, cleanup, parallelization, MSTest.Sdk project setup, and MSTESTxxxx. Honor the installed MSTest version. DO NOT USE to design new test cases (code-testing-agent), perform report-only audits, create project files rather than explain MSTest setup, run tests, migrate frameworks, or handle non-MSTest/non-.NET code.
description_zh: 始终在以下情况下使用：当被要求修复、重写、更新、改进、现代化、展示修正后的代码或解释现有的 MSTest 测试或 MSTest 特定配置时。对于需要修正代码或编辑的情况（即使只是粘贴一个断言或通过测试但失败输出有误），也使用“review”。涵盖预期/实际标签；通用布尔值、集合、字符串、数值、空值、标识、异常、强制类型转换和对象[]检查；TestContext/生命周期；超时/取消；操作系统/持续集成条件、重试、清理、并行化、MSTest.Sdk 项目设置以及 MSTESTxxxx。尊重已安装的 MSTest 版本。不要用于设计新的测试用例（代码测试代理）、执行仅报告的审计、创建项目文件而非解释 MSTest 设置、运行测试、迁移框架或处理非 MSTest/非-.NET 代码。

name: blog-factcheck
description: Verify statistics and claims in blog posts by fetching cited source URLs and checking if the claimed data actually appears on the page. Extracts all load-bearing claims (statistics, product or policy claims, ranking and comparative claims, named sources), validates cited URLs before fetching, and scores match confidence (exact match 1.0, paraphrase 0.7-0.9, not found 0.0). Flags uncited claims as UNVERIFIED. Use when user says "fact check", "verify statistics", "check sources", "validate claims", "factcheck", "source verification".
description_zh: 验证博客文章中的统计数据和声明，通过获取引用的源URL并检查所声称的数据是否实际出现在页面上。提取所有承重声明（统计数据、产品或政策声明、排名和比较声明、有名称的来源），在获取前验证引用的URL，并根据匹配置信度打分（完全匹配1.0，释义0.7-0.9，未找到0.0）。将未引用的声明标记为UNVERIFIED。当用户说“事实核查”、“验证统计数据”、“检查来源”、“验证声明”、“factcheck”、“source verification”时使用。

name: social-reddit-card
description: Realistic Reddit post card with vote rail and comment count, suited to video overlays or story sharing.
description_zh: 一个逼真的 Reddit 帖子卡片，带有投票栏和评论计数，适合视频叠加或故事分享。

name: second-brain-query
description: Answer questions against the knowledge base wiki. Use when the user asks a question about their collected knowledge, wants to explore connections between topics, says "what do I know about X", or wants to search their wiki.
description_zh: 针对知识库维基回答问题。当用户询问关于其收集的知识的问题、想要探索主题之间的联系、说“我知道X是什么”或想要搜索其维基时使用。

name: incremental-build
description: Guide for optimizing MSBuild incremental builds. USE FOR: builds slower than expected on subsequent runs, 'nothing changed but it rebuilds anyway', diagnosing why targets re-execute unnecessarily, fixing broken no-op builds. Covers 8 common causes: missing Inputs/Outputs on custom targets, volatile properties in output paths (timestamps/GUIDs), file writes outside tracked Outputs, missing FileWrites registration, glob changes, Visual Studio Fast Up-to-Date Check (FUTDC) issues. Key diagnostic: look for 'Building target completely' vs 'Skipping target' in binlog. DO NOT USE FOR: first-time build slowness (use build-perf-baseline), parallelism issues (use build-parallelism), evaluation-phase slowness (use eval-performance), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 优化 MSBuild 增量构建的指南。适用场景：后续运行时构建速度慢于预期、'未做任何更改却仍然重新构建'、诊断目标为何不必要地重新执行、修复无效构建。涵盖 8 个常见原因：自定义目标中缺失输入/输出、输出路径中的易变属性（时间戳/GUID）、未跟踪的输出路径文件写入、缺失 FileWrites 注册、glob 变化、Visual Studio 快速更新检查（FUTDC）问题。关键诊断方法：在 binlog 中查找 '完全构建目标' 与 '跳过目标' 的差异。不适用场景：首次构建速度慢（使用 build-perf-baseline）、并行性问题（使用 build-parallelism）、评估阶段速度慢（使用 eval-performance）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: contract-review
description: Lightweight NDA, MSA, and vendor contract review for SMBs without legal on staff. Reads contracts from local files, mail attachments (Gmail or M365), a connected file store (Google Drive or M365), or DocuSign envelopes; flags non-standard terms; explains risks in plain English; and outputs a marked-up redline as a separate DOCX. Use when the user says "review this contract," "what am I signing," "red flags," "flag any concerns," "check the payment terms," or uploads/forwards a contract or legal agreement.
description_zh: 为没有法律专员的中小企业提供轻量级NDA、MSA和供应商合同审查服务。支持从本地文件、邮件附件（Gmail或M365）、连接的文件存储（Google Drive或M365）或DocuSign信封中读取合同；标记非标准条款；用通俗易懂的语言解释风险；并将标注的红线版本作为单独的DOCX文件输出。当用户说“审查这份合同”、“我在签署什么”、“风险警示”、“标记任何问题”、“检查付款条款”，或上传/转发合同或法律协议时使用。

name: ugc-ad-scripts
description: Turn a product brief and target audience into UGC-style short-form video ad scripts a creator can film - hook, body, CTA - with 3-5 hook variants per concept written as spoken line plus on-screen text plus opening visual, with delivery notes and disclosure lines. Use whenever the user asks for a UGC ad or creator script, a short-form vertical video ad script, a founder-led video, employee-generated content, or a customer testimonial video script - even if they never say 'UGC'. Covers B2C creator scripts and B2B formats. Do NOT use to score existing hooks (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-hook-analyzer), to write static ad copy (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants), or to brief a designer (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief).
description_zh: 将产品简介和目标受众转化为创作者可拍摄的UGC风格短形式视频广告脚本——包括钩子、正文、行动号召——每个概念提供3-5种钩子变体，以口语化台词加屏幕文字加开场视觉的形式呈现，并附有交付说明和披露条款。每当用户要求UGC广告、创作者脚本、短形式竖屏视频广告脚本、创始人主导视频、员工生成内容或客户证言视频脚本时使用——即使他们从未提及“UGC”。涵盖B2C创作者脚本和B2B格式。请勿用于评分现有钩子（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-hook-analyzer）、撰写静态广告文案（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants）或为设计师撰写广告创意简报（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief）。

name: audit-speed
description: Deep Core Web Vitals and page speed audit. Use when the user asks about page speed, Core Web Vitals, LCP, CLS, INP, FCP, TTFB, Lighthouse scores, why a page is slow, performance optimization, or resource size analysis. For broader technical SEO issues, see diagnose-seo.
description_zh: 深度核心网页性能和页面速度审核。当用户询问页面速度、核心网页性能、LCP、CLS、INP、FCP、TTFB、Lighthouse评分、页面为何缓慢、性能优化或资源大小分析时使用。对于更广泛的技术SEO问题，请参阅diagnose-seo。

name: migrate-nullable-references
description: Enable nullable reference types in a C# project and systematically resolve all warnings. USE FOR: adopting NRTs in existing codebases, file-by-file or project-wide migration, fixing CS8602/CS8618/CS86xx warnings, annotating APIs for nullability, cleaning up null-forgiving operators, upgrading dependencies with new nullable annotations. DO NOT USE FOR: projects already fully migrated with zero warnings (unless auditing suppressions), fixing a handful of nullable warnings in code that already has NRTs enabled, suppressing warnings without fixing them, C# 7.3 or earlier projects. INVOKES: Get-NullableReadiness.ps1 scanner script.
description_zh: 在 C# 项目中启用可空引用类型并系统性地解决所有警告。用途：在现有代码库中采用 NRTs、逐文件或全局迁移、修复 CS8602/CS8618/CS86xx 警告、为 API 标注可空性、清理可空省略操作符、升级依赖项以使用新的可空注解。不适用：已完全迁移且无任何警告的项目（除非用于审计抑制）、在已启用 NRTs 的代码中修复少量可空警告、抑制警告但不修复、C# 7.3 或更早版本的项目。触发：Get-NullableReadiness.ps1 扫描脚本。

name: arize-compliance-audit
description: INVOKE THIS SKILL when auditing an AI agent or LLM app for regulatory compliance. Covers EU AI Act, GPAI Code of Practice, GDPR, NIST AI RMF, Colorado AI Act, HIPAA, and ISO 42001. Scans the codebase for compliance gaps, cross-references Arize instrumentation for audit trail coverage, and produces an actionable remediation checklist tailored to the selected frameworks.
description_zh: 在审核 AI 代理或 LLM 应用程序以进行合规性检查时，请调用此技能。涵盖欧盟 AI 法、GPAI 实践准则、GDPR、NIST AI RMF、科罗拉多州 AI 法、HIPAA 和 ISO 42001。扫描代码库以查找合规性差距，对照 Arize 仪器化结果以确认审计追踪覆盖范围，并生成针对所选框架的实用化整改清单。

name: migrate-to-codex
description: Migrate supported instruction files, skills, agents, and MCP config into Codex project and global files.
description_zh: 将支持的指令文件、技能、代理以及MCP配置迁移到Codex项目和全局文件中。

name: crxjs
description: CRXJS Chrome extension development — true HMR for popup, options, content scripts, side panels, manifest-driven builds, dynamic content script imports (`?script`, `?script&module`), and `defineManifest` for type-safe manifests. Uses Vite as its build tool. Use when the user mentions CRXJS, crxjs, @crxjs/vite-plugin, 'extension with hot reload', 'HMR for chrome extension', or wants to set up a CRXJS-based Chrome extension project with any framework (React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Vanilla). Also trigger when the user has an existing CRXJS project and wants to add features, fix HMR issues, or configure content scripts with CRXJS. For general Chrome extension architecture (messaging, CSP, storage, permissions) -> See `samber/cc-skills@chrome-extension` skill.
description_zh: CRXJS Chrome扩展开发——为弹窗、选项页面、内容脚本、侧边栏、清单驱动构建、动态内容脚本导入（`?script`、`?script&module`）以及类型安全的清单文件`defineManifest`提供真正的热重载。使用Vite作为其构建工具。当用户提及CRXJS、crxjs、@crxjs/vite-plugin、'带热重载的扩展'、'Chrome扩展的热重载'，或希望使用任何框架（React、Vue、Svelte、Solid、原生JavaScript）搭建基于CRXJS的Chrome扩展项目时使用。此外，当用户已有CRXJS项目并希望添加功能、修复热重载问题或使用CRXJS配置内容脚本时也会触发。对于通用的Chrome扩展架构（消息传递、CSP、存储、权限）-> 请参考`samber/cc-skills@chrome-extension`技能。

name: data-designer
description: Use when the user wants to create a dataset, generate synthetic data, or build a data generation pipeline.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建数据集、生成合成数据或构建数据生成管道时使用。

name: engineering-skills
description: Index of the engineering-team skills bundle for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw, and 6 more tools. Architecture, frontend, backend, QA, DevOps, security, AI/ML, data engineering, Playwright, Stripe, AWS, MS365 (stdlib-only Python tools). Use when browsing or choosing among engineering-team role skills — load only the one specialist SKILL.md you need, never bulk-load the bundle.
description_zh: Claude 代码、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、OpenClaw 及其他 6 项工具的工程团队技能包索引。涵盖架构、前端、后端、QA、DevOps、安全、AI/ML、数据工程、Playwright、Stripe、AWS、MS365（仅限 stdlib 的 Python 工具）。在浏览或选择工程团队角色技能时使用——仅加载所需的单一专家 SKILL.md 文件，切勿批量加载整个技能包。

name: hermes-history-ingest
description: Ingest Hermes agent history into the Obsidian wiki. Use this skill when the user wants to mine their past Hermes sessions for knowledge, import their ~/.hermes folder, extract insights from previous Hermes conversations, or says things like "process my Hermes history", "add my Hermes memories to the wiki", "ingest ~/.hermes", or "what have I worked on in Hermes". Also triggers when the user mentions Hermes memories, Hermes sessions, ~/.hermes/memories, or Hermes skill logs.
description_zh: 将赫耳墨斯代理的历史记录导入Obsidian维基。当用户希望挖掘其过去的赫耳墨斯会话以获取知识、导入其 ~/.hermes 文件夹、从之前的赫耳墨斯对话中提取见解，或说出类似“处理我的赫耳墨斯历史”、“将我的赫耳墨斯记忆添加到维基”、“导入 ~/.hermes”或“我在赫耳墨斯中做了什么”等语句时，可使用此技能。此外，当用户提及赫耳墨斯记忆、赫耳墨斯会话、~/.hermes/memories 或赫耳墨斯技能日志时也会触发。

name: opportunity-solution-tree
description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree from outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and tests. Use when a stakeholder request needs problem framing before you decide what to build.
description_zh: 构建一个从成果到机会、解决方案和测试的机会解决方案树。当利益相关者的请求需要在决定要构建什么之前进行问题框架时使用。

name: platform-detection
description: Identify a .NET project's test platform, framework, command mode, and SDK-style vs classic project system. Use only for "which test platform/framework?", "VSTest or MTP?", or "what runner does this project use?", including bridge settings, UseVSTest opt-outs, and incompatible or conflicting VSTest/MTP configuration. Resolves global.json, project, packages.config, Directory.Build.props, and Directory.Packages.props precedence for MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit. DO NOT USE when the user asks to run/filter tests or for commands, flags, TRX/dumps, or test-command/filter errors; use run-tests directly. Do not route hot-reload or migration requests here as the entry skill; mtp-hot-reload may use this skill internally for platform detection.
description_zh: 识别 .NET 项目的测试平台、框架、命令模式以及 SDK 风格与经典项目系统的差异。仅用于回答“哪个测试平台/框架？”、“VSTest 或 MTP？”或“该项目使用哪个运行器？”等问题，包括桥接设置、UseVSTest 排除选项以及不兼容或冲突的 VSTest/MTP 配置。解决 global.json、项目文件、packages.config、Directory.Build.props 和 Directory.Packages.props 的 MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit 优先级问题。在用户询问运行/筛选测试或命令、标志、TRX/转储或测试命令/筛选错误时，请勿使用；直接使用 run-tests。不要将热重载或迁移请求作为此技能的入口，因为 mtp-hot-reload 可能会在此技能内部用于平台检测。

name: skill-progressive-disclosure-design
description: Decide how to split skill content between SKILL.md and reference files for context efficiency and reliable triggering. Use this whenever creating a new Claude skill, refactoring an existing one, or when a SKILL.md is growing past 300-400 lines. Also trigger when the user mentions "progressive disclosure", "reference files", "splitting skills", "skill bundling", "context window for skills", "SKILL.md too long", "what goes in references/", "skill structure", or expresses any uncertainty about where to put content within a skill. Use this even if the user phrases the question as a triggering problem ("how do I make my skill trigger better"), because that question is often confused with the splitting question and needs to be disentangled first.
description_zh: 决定如何将技能内容在 SKILL.md 和参考文件之间进行拆分，以提高上下文效率并确保可靠触发。在创建新的 Claude 技能、重构现有技能，或当 SKILL.md 超过 300-400 行时，请使用此功能。此外，当用户提及“渐进式披露”、“参考文件”、“技能拆分”、“技能捆绑”、“技能的上下文窗口”、“SKILL.md 太长”、“参考资料/中应包含哪些内容”、“技能结构”，或对技能内容存放位置表示任何不确定时，也请触发。即使用户将问题表述为触发问题（“如何让我的技能触发得更好”），也应使用此功能，因为这类问题通常与拆分问题混淆，需要先进行分离。

name: test-gap-analysis
description: Pseudo-mutation analysis ONLY: answer whether tests would catch a bug if production code changed, which meaningful changes would still pass, or which caller-visible mutations existing assertions would miss; verify candidates when requested, then optionally close verified gaps. Activate for behavioral blind spots or missing edge cases tied to production behavior. Polyglot. DO NOT USE FOR: suite organization, taxonomy, metadata, or distribution reports (test-tagging); .NET line-vs-branch or Cobertura interpretation, arithmetic, plateaus, project-wide coverage gaps, or coverage-backed test/CRAP priorities (coverage-analysis; use native coverage tooling outside .NET); named-target CRAP (crap-score); new suites (code-testing-agent); assertion/smell audits; or mutation tools.
description_zh: 伪突变分析仅限：回答如果生产代码变更，测试能否捕获错误；哪些有意义的变更仍能通过；现有断言会遗漏哪些可见于调用者的突变；在请求时验证候选项，然后可选择关闭已验证的差距。用于行为盲点或与生产行为相关的缺失边界情况。多语言。不应用于：套件组织、分类、元数据或分发报告（测试标签）；.NET行级分支或Cobertura解释、算术、平台、项目级覆盖率差距，或基于覆盖率的测试/CRAP优先级（覆盖率分析；在.NET外部使用原生覆盖率工具）；命名目标CRAP（CRAP分数）；新套件（代码测试代理）；断言/异味审计；或突变工具。

name: social-spotify-card
description: Spotify Now Playing-style card with album art, progress bar, and playback controls, suited to video overlays or personal homepages.
description_zh: Spotify Now Playing 风格卡片，包含专辑封面、进度条和播放控制，适用于视频叠加或个人主页。

name: frontend-design-ui-ux
description:
Produce a distinctive, LOCKED design language plus an implementation-ready UX/UI spec, written to
`.ulpi/design/`: a per-brief visual identity (palette, type, signature), the design system to build
on, user flows and states, component briefs, and accessibility constraints. Commits to a bold
aesthetic direction, bans AI-slop by name, and locks the identity so every screen and future session
stays consistent. Can visit inspiration links with the browse skill to extract real design DNA. Ends
with a build handoff that a delegated engineering agent implements — a DESIGN-SPEC skill that produces
the spec, never production UI code. Use for new features, redesigns, or design-system work where the
build should follow a locked spec.
description_zh: 产出独特的、锁定式的设计语言，并生成一份可立即实施的用户体验/界面规范，写入 `.ulpi/design/` 目录：包括针对每个简报的视觉识别（调色板、字体、签名）、可构建的设计系统、用户流程与状态、组件简报以及无障碍性约束。坚定地遵循大胆的审美方向，明确禁止特定名称的 AI 低劣设计，并锁定身份以确保每个屏幕和未来会话保持一致性。可使用浏览技能访问灵感链接，提取真实的设计基因。最终通过设计规范交接给指定的工程代理实施——这是一个生成规范而非生产级 UI 代码的“设计规范”技能。适用于新功能开发、重新设计或设计系统工作，其中构建过程需遵循锁定规范。

name: blog-analyze
description: Audit and score blog posts on a 5-category 100-point scoring system covering content quality, SEO optimization, E-E-A-T signals, technical elements, and AI citation readiness. Includes AI content detection (burstiness, phrase flagging, vocabulary diversity). Supports export formats (markdown, JSON, table) and batch analysis with sorting. Generates prioritized recommendations (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with specific fixes. Works with any format (MDX, markdown, HTML, URL). Use when user says "analyze blog", "audit blog", "blog score", "check blog quality", "blog review", "rate this blog", "blog health check".
description_zh: 对博客文章进行审计和评分，采用包含内容质量、SEO优化、E-E-A-T信号、技术要素和AI引用准备度五个类别的100分评分系统。包括AI内容检测（爆发性、短语标记、词汇多样性）。支持导出格式（Markdown、JSON、表格）和批量分析排序。生成优先级建议（关键/高/中/低）并提供具体修复方案。适用于任何格式（MDX、Markdown、HTML、URL）。当用户说“分析博客”、“审计博客”、“博客评分”、“检查博客质量”、“博客评审”、“评价这个博客”、“博客健康检查”时使用。

name: cline-delegate
description: Delegate a coding task to the Cline coding agent CLI (`cline`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to delegate implementation work to Cline - phrasings like "have Cline implement X", "delegate this to cline", "run it through Cline", or "use cline to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through Cline while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Cline 编码代理 CLI (`cline`) 作为后台实现者，然后自行审查其差异并合并。每当用户希望将实现工作委托给 Cline 时（例如“让 Cline 实现 X”、“将此委托给 cline”、“通过 Cline 运行”或“使用 cline 实现/修复/重构”）——或者希望在保持审查者身份的同时，通过 Cline 运行编码任务队列——请使用此方法。对于足够小可以直接内联完成的任务，或用户希望直接编写代码而不进行委托的情况，请勿使用。

name: presentation-design
description: Design and evaluate presentations that communicate effectively. Use when designing a presentation, creating slides, getting presentation feedback, structuring a talk, or reviewing slides. Keywords: presentation, slides, talk, PowerPoint, Keynote, reveal.js.
description_zh: 设计并评估能够有效传达信息的演示文稿。在设计演示文稿、创建幻灯片、获取演示反馈、组织演讲或审阅幻灯片时使用。关键词：演示文稿、幻灯片、演讲、PowerPoint、Keynote、reveal.js。

name: team-topologies
description: Organize business and technology teams for fast flow using Skelton & Pais's "Team Topologies". Use when the user mentions "team topologies", "Conway's law", "platform team", "stream-aligned team", "team boundaries", "cognitive load", "how should we split teams", "who owns this service", "team dependencies", or "reorg". Also trigger when reorganizing engineering teams, aligning team and service boundaries, splitting a monolith and deciding ownership, reducing cross-team handoffs, or designing an internal platform. Covers the four team types, three interaction modes, the inverse Conway maneuver, and fracture planes. For bounded contexts, see domain-driven-design. For dependency direction in code, see clean-architecture.
description_zh: 使用Skelton & Pais的《团队拓扑结构》（Team Topologies）来组织业务和技术团队，实现快速流动。当用户提到“团队拓扑结构”、“康威定律”、“平台团队”、“流程对齐团队”、“团队边界”、“认知负荷”、“我们应该如何拆分团队”、“谁拥有此服务”、“团队依赖关系”或“重组”时，即可触发。同时，在重组工程团队、对齐团队和服务边界、拆分单体并确定所有权、减少跨团队交接或设计内部平台时也会触发。涵盖四种团队类型、三种交互模式、逆康威操作和断裂平面。对于限界上下文，请参考领域驱动设计（domain-driven-design）。对于代码中的依赖方向，请参考干净架构（clean-architecture）。

name: threejs-game-director
description: Entrypoint for building, upgrading, and finishing Three.js browser games. Routes work across the sibling threejs-* skills for gameplay, graphics, UI, 3D/image/audio asset generation, debugging, and release. Use for any request to build, upgrade, polish, or ship a Three.js game as a whole, at any scope from a small arcade prototype to a premium release.
description_zh: 构建、升级和完成 Three.js 浏览器游戏的入口点。路由在兄弟 threejs-* 技能中有效，用于游戏玩法、图形、UI、3D/图像/音频资源生成、调试和发布。用于任何构建、升级、完善或发布整个 Three.js 游戏的请求，范围可从一个小型街机原型到高端发布。

name: e2e-tests-studio
description: REQUIRED when modifying any file in packages/playground-ui or packages/playground. Triggers on: React component creation/modification/refactoring, UI changes, new playground features, bug fixes affecting studio UI. Generates Playwright E2E tests that validate PRODUCT BEHAVIOR, not just UI states.
description_zh: 当修改 `packages/playground-ui` 或 `packages/playground` 中的任何文件时均为必需。触发条件：创建/修改/重构 React 组件、界面变更、新增 playground 功能，以及影响 studio 界面的 Bug 修复。生成 Playwright E2E 测试，用于验证产品行为，而不仅仅是 UI 状态。

name: muapi-youtube-thumbnail
description: Design a high-CTR YouTube thumbnail — striking imagery, bold text placement, and emotional face/subject if needed.
description_zh: 设计一个高点击率的YouTube缩略图——使用引人注目的图像、大胆的文字布局，并在必要时加入富有情感的面部/主题。

name: tianqi
description: 查询中国地区的天气预报，支持15天及逐小时预报、各种生活指数
description_zh: 查询中国地区的天气预报，支持15天及逐小时预报、各种生活指数

name: jscpd
description: Copy-paste detector for 220+ languages. Detect exact, renamed and near-miss duplicated code, measure duplication percentages, and find refactoring hotspots with the codebase summary.
description_zh: 支持220多种语言的代码重复检测工具。可检测精确重复、重命名重复及近似重复代码，测量重复比例，并通过代码库概览查找重构热点。

name: asd-ste100
description: Use when English text must be parsed without a human to resolve ambiguity — tool descriptions, error messages, inter-agent instructions, system prompts, status reports — and misreading has a real cost, or when text reads as dense, hedged, or easy to misparse. Triggers: disambiguate, STE100 rewrite, apply Simplified Technical English, plain-language rewrite, controlled-language rewrite, rewrite so an agent cannot misread this. Not for creative or marketing copy.

name: mem
description: Store and retrieve memories (notes, facts, decisions, snippets, images) using a local SQLite database with full-text search. Use when you need to remember information across sessions, recall previous decisions, store code snippets, or search your knowledge base.
description_zh: 使用本地 SQLite 数据库存储和检索记忆（笔记、事实、决策、片段、图像），并支持全文搜索。适用于需要跨会话记忆信息、回忆之前的决策、存储代码片段或搜索知识库的场景。

name: animejs
description: Versatile JavaScript animation engine for DOM, CSS, SVG, and JavaScript objects. Use when creating timeline-based animations, stagger effects, SVG morphing, keyframe sequences, or complex choreographed animations. Triggers on tasks involving Anime.js, timeline animations, staggered sequences, SVG path animations, morphing, or multi-step animation choreography. Alternative to GSAP for SVG-heavy animations and React-independent projects.
description_zh: 适用于 DOM、CSS、SVG 和 JavaScript 对象的通用 JavaScript 动画引擎。在创建基于时间轴的动画、错落效果、SVG 变形、关键帧序列或复杂编排动画时使用。触发于涉及 Anime.js、时间轴动画、错落序列、SVG 路径动画、变形或多步骤动画编排的任务。适用于 SVG 密集型动画和独立于 React 的项目，作为 GSAP 的替代方案。

name: automate-this
description: Analyze a screen recording of a manual process and produce targeted, working automation scripts. Extracts frames and audio narration from video files, reconstructs the step-by-step workflow, and proposes automation at multiple complexity levels using tools already installed on the user machine.
description_zh: 分析手动流程的屏幕录制，并生成有针对性、可运行的自动化脚本。从视频文件中提取帧和音频旁白，重建分步工作流程，并利用用户计算机上已安装的工具，在多个复杂度级别上提出自动化方案。

name: second-brain-lint
description: Health-check the wiki for contradictions, orphan pages, stale claims, and missing cross-references. Use when the user says "audit", "health check", "lint", "find problems", or wants to improve wiki quality.
description_zh: 对维基进行健康检查，查找矛盾之处、孤立页面、过时声明和缺失的交叉引用。当用户说“审计”、“健康检查”、“代码检查”、“发现问题”或希望提升维基质量时使用。

name: cx-cli
description: This skill should be used whenever the user runs any cx command, uses the cx CLI, Coralogix CLI, or mentions cx in the context of Coralogix observability. This skill provides cross-cutting concerns like update notifications that apply to all cx commands.
description_zh: 此技能应在用户运行任何 cx 命令、使用 cx CLI、Coralogix CLI 或在 Coralogix 可观测性上下文中提及 cx 时使用。该技能提供适用于所有 cx 命令的跨领域关注点，例如更新通知。

name: elite-longterm-memory
description: Ultimate AI agent memory system. Combines bulletproof WAL protocol, vector search, git-based knowledge graphs, cloud backup, and maintenance hygiene. Never lose context again. For Clawdbot, Moltbot, Claude, GPT agents.

name: snyk-agent-scan-compliance
description: Compliance expert for snyk-agent-scan — the agent skill file scanner — NOT for other Snyk CLI tools (snyk test, snyk code SAST, snyk iac, snyk container). Fixes alerts through content restructuring, never by suppressing or deleting information. Covers every file in a skill directory: SKILL.md, references/, assets/, and any secondary markdown. Apply when authoring a new skill, editing an existing one, triaging a failed snyk-agent-scan run locally or in CI, or unblocking a PR held by agent scanner failures. Not applicable to dependency vulnerabilities, code security findings, or infrastructure misconfigurations — those are out of scope.
description_zh: snyk-agent-scan 的合规专家——即代理技能文件扫描器——不适用于其他 Snyk CLI 工具（如 snyk test、snyk code SAST、snyk iac、snyk container）。通过内容结构调整来修复警报，而非通过抑制或删除信息。涵盖技能目录中的所有文件：SKILL.md、references/、assets/ 以及任何其他 Markdown 文件。在以下情况适用：编写新技能、编辑现有技能、本地或 CI 中对失败的 snyk-agent-scan 进行分诊处理，或解决由代理扫描器失败导致的 PR 阻塞。不适用于依赖漏洞、代码安全发现或基础设施配置错误——这些超出了适用范围。

name: service-digital-engagement-channel-configure
description: Configures and deploys enhanced chat Messaging Channels for Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW). Use when the user needs to create, deploy, and activate a messaging channel configured with Omni-Channel Flow, Omni-Channel Queue, User, or Agentforce Service Agent routing. Generates MessagingChannel metadata, deploys it to the target org, and activates the channel with User Verification, pre-chat forms, automated responses, consent settings, and all customizable channel options via Metadata API. TRIGGER when the user mentions messaging channel, MIAW, enhanced chat, in-app messaging, web messaging setup, or references a .messagingChannel-meta.xml file. DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is configuring legacy Live Agent chat, Embedded Service deployments without messaging, or standard Omni-Channel routing rules without a messaging channel.
description_zh: 配置和部署增强型聊天消息通道，用于应用内和网页消息（MIAW）。当用户需要创建、部署并激活一个通过全渠道流程（Omni-Channel Flow）、全渠道队列（Omni-Channel Queue）、用户或代理服务（Agentforce Service Agent）路由配置的消息通道时使用。通过元数据API生成消息通道元数据，将其部署到目标组织，并通过用户验证、预聊天表单、自动回复、同意设置以及所有可自定义的通道选项来激活通道。当用户提及消息通道、MIAW、增强型聊天、应用内消息、网页消息设置或引用.messagingChannel-meta.xml文件时触发。当用户正在配置传统Live Agent聊天、无消息功能的嵌入式服务部署或无消息通道的标准全渠道路由规则时不触发。

name: ad-format-fit
description: Flag ad formats that are a poor fit or commonly misused for a given objective and platform - formats the objective does not even expose, formats built for a different funnel stage, formats the team cannot produce - then, post-launch, separate a format problem from a creative or targeting problem. Use whenever the user asks which ad format to use, mentions carousel, Stories, in-feed vs in-stream video, a funnel-stage mismatch, a pre-launch format check, or says a format 'isn't working' - even if they never say 'format fit'. Covers B2B and B2C, with explicit launch blockers. Do NOT use to choose the channel itself (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-platform-selection) or to brief the creative (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief).
description_zh: 标记与特定目标和平台不匹配或普遍误用的广告格式——包括该目标未公开的格式、为不同漏斗阶段构建的格式、团队无法制作的格式——然后，在上线后，将格式问题与创意或定向问题区分开来。在用户询问应使用哪种广告格式、提及轮播图、故事、内容内视频与流内视频、漏斗阶段不匹配、进行预发布格式检查，或表示某个格式“不起作用”时使用——即使他们从未提及“格式适配”。涵盖B2B和B2C，并包含明确的上线阻碍。**不应用于选择渠道本身（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-platform-selection）或用于创意简报（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief）。**

name: claude-handoff
description: 把当前对话交接给一个全新的 background agent，让它立即接手工作。
description_zh: 将当前对话转交给全新的后台代理，让其立即接手工作。

name: blog-audit
description: Full-site blog health assessment scanning all blog files for quality scores, orphan pages, topic cannibalization, stale content, and AI citation readiness. Runs canonical batch analysis before site-wide checks. Produces per-post scores and a prioritized action queue. Use when user says "audit blog", "blog audit", "site audit", "blog health", "audit all posts", "check all blogs".
description_zh: 全站博客健康评估扫描所有博客文件，以评估质量分数、孤立页面、主题重复、过时内容和AI引用准备情况。在全局检查之前执行规范批量分析。生成每篇帖子的分数和优先级行动队列。当用户说“审计博客”、“博客审计”、“站点审计”、“博客健康”、“审计所有帖子”、“检查所有博客”时使用。

name: code-testing-extensions
description: Provides file paths to language-specific extension files for the code-testing pipeline. Call this skill to discover available extension guidance files (e.g., dotnet.md for .NET, cpp.md for C++). Do not use directly — invoked by code-testing agents and skills that need language-specific references.
description_zh: 为代码测试流程提供特定语言的扩展文件路径。调用此技能以发现可用的扩展指导文件（例如，.NET 对应的 dotnet.md，C++ 对应的 cpp.md）。不要直接使用——由需要特定语言参考的代码测试代理和技能调用。

name: pr-creator
description: Use this skill when asked to create a pull request (PR). It ensures all PRs follow the repository's established templates and standards.
description_zh: 在要求创建拉取请求（PR）时使用此技能。它确保所有PR都遵循存储库设定的模板和标准。

name: mojo-gpu-fundamentals
description: The basics of how to program GPUs using Mojo. Use this skill in addition to mojo-syntax when writing Mojo code that targets GPUs or other accelerators. Use targeting code to NVIDIA, AMD, Apple silicon GPUs, or others. Use this skill to overcome misconceptions about how Mojo GPU code is written.
description_zh: 使用Mojo编程GPU的基础知识。在编写针对GPU或其他加速器的Mojo代码时，除了mojo语法之外，请使用这项技能。使用目标代码来针对NVIDIA、AMD、Apple硅GPU或其他设备。使用这项技能来克服对Mojo GPU代码编写方式产生的误解。

name: cloud-monitoring-promql-query
description: Generates valid PromQL queries from Cloud Monitoring metric descriptors and resource parameters. Use when asked to create, generate, write, or format PromQL queries, PromQL strings, or PromQL aggregations for Cloud Monitoring metrics and resources. Don't use for raw metric discovery or metric selection.
description_zh: 从 Cloud Monitoring 指标描述符和资源参数生成有效的 PromQL 查询。在要求为 Cloud Monitoring 指标和资源创建、生成、编写或格式化 PromQL 查询、PromQL 字符串或 PromQL 聚合时使用。不应用于原始指标发现或指标选择。

name: check-bin-obj-clash
description: Detects MSBuild projects with conflicting OutputPath or IntermediateOutputPath. USE FOR: builds failing with 'Cannot create a file when that file already exists', 'The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process', intermittent build failures that succeed on retry, or missing/overwritten outputs in multi-project or multi-targeting builds where bin/obj (or project.assets.json) collide. Common causes: shared OutputPath, missing AppendTargetFrameworkToOutputPath, extra global properties (e.g. PublishReadyToRun), or SetTargetFramework on a ProjectReference to a single-targeting project. DO NOT USE FOR: file access errors unrelated to MSBuild (OS-level locking), single-project single-TFM builds, non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 检测存在冲突的 OutputPath 或 IntermediateOutputPath 的 MSBuild 项目。适用于：构建失败时出现“无法创建已存在的文件”、“进程无法访问正在被另一个进程使用的文件”、重试后成功的间歇性构建失败，或在多项目或多目标构建中 bin/obj（或 project.assets.json）冲突导致输出缺失或被覆盖的情况。常见原因：共享的 OutputPath、缺少 AppendTargetFrameworkToOutputPath、额外的全局属性（例如 PublishReadyToRun），或对单目标项目设置 ProjectReference 时的 SetTargetFramework。不适用于：与 MSBuild 无关的文件访问错误（如操作系统级锁定）、单项目单-TFM 构建、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: nuxt-modules
description: Use when creating Nuxt modules: (1) Published npm modules (@nuxtjs/, nuxt-), (2) Local project modules (modules/ directory), (3) Runtime extensions (components, composables, plugins), (4) Server extensions (API routes, middleware), (5) Releasing/publishing modules to npm, (6) Setting up CI/CD workflows for modules. Provides defineNuxtModule patterns, Kit utilities, hooks, E2E testing, and release automation.
description_zh: 在创建 Nuxt 模块时使用：(1) 发布的 npm 模块 (@nuxtjs/、nuxt-)，(2) 本地项目模块 (modules/ 目录)，(3) 运行时扩展 (组件、可组合模块、插件)，(4) 服务器扩展 (API 路由、中间件)，(5) 将模块发布到 npm，(6) 为模块设置 CI/CD 工作流。提供 defineNuxtModule 模板、Kit 工具、钩子、端到端测试和发布自动化功能。

name: blog-brief
description: Generate detailed content briefs for blog posts with target keywords, content outlines, competitive analysis, recommended statistics, image and chart suggestions, word count targets, internal linking architecture, template recommendations (12 types), TL;DR drafts, citation capsule planning, information gain prompts, and multi-channel distribution plans. Briefs are optimized for Google rankings and AI citation visibility as part of SEO. Use when user says "content brief", "blog brief", "write brief", "SEO brief", "article brief", or "content requirements".
description_zh: 为博客文章生成详细内容概要，包括目标关键词、内容大纲、竞争分析、推荐统计数据、图片和图表建议、字数目标、内部链接架构、模板推荐（12种）、TL;DR草稿、引文胶囊规划、信息获取提示以及多渠道分发计划。概要旨在优化谷歌排名和AI引文可见性，作为SEO的一部分。当用户说“内容概要”、“博客概要”、“撰写概要”、“SEO概要”、“文章概要”或“内容需求”时使用。

name: blog-geo
description: AI citation readiness audit as part of SEO, covering classic Google search and AI search surfaces together. Use whenever the user wants their content to rank or be cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, You.com, Google AI Overviews, or Google AI Mode. AI citation optimization audit scoring blog posts for major answer surfaces. Evaluates passage-level citability, Q&A formatting, entity clarity, structured data, and AI crawler accessibility. Generates citation capsules and a 0-100 AI Citation Readiness score. Use when user says "geo", "ai citation", "ai optimization", "citation audit", "aeo", "perplexity optimization", "chatgpt citation".
description_zh: 作为SEO的一部分，进行AI引用准备度审核，涵盖经典谷歌搜索和AI搜索界面。当用户希望其内容在ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Gemini、Copilot、You.com、谷歌AI概览或谷歌AI模式中排名或被引用时使用。对主要答案界面中的博客文章进行AI引用优化审核评分。评估段落级别的可引用性、问答格式、实体清晰度、结构化数据以及AI爬虫的可访问性。生成引用胶囊和0-100分的AI引用准备度评分。当用户输入“geo”、“ai引用”、“ai优化”、“引用审核”、“aeo”、“perplexity优化”、“chatgpt引用”时使用。

name: training-report
description: Produce a professional training/workshop report as a .docx file. Use this skill whenever the user mentions "training report", "workshop report", "compte rendu", "compte rendu de formation", "formation report", "debriefing a workshop", "write up a training session", "résumé de formation", or any request to document a training session, workshop, or onboarding event with individual participant feedback and recommendations. Also trigger when the user says things like "I just ran a workshop and need to write it up", "help me summarize what happened in my training session", or "I need to report back to management about a session I ran". Always use this skill — for short or long sessions, across any discipline (technical, soft skills, creative, compliance, onboarding, etc.) — whenever a structured written deliverable about a training event is needed.
description_zh: 生成一份专业的培训/研讨会报告，并以.docx文件格式提交。当用户提到“培训报告”、“研讨会报告”、“compte rendu”、“compte rendu de formation”、“formation report”、“debriefing a workshop”、“write up a training session”、“résumé de formation”，或任何要求记录培训、研讨会或入职活动（包括个人参与者反馈和建议）的请求时，请使用此技能。此外，当用户说类似“我刚举办了一场研讨会，需要整理报告”、“帮我总结一下我的培训内容”、“我需要向管理层汇报我组织的活动”等话时，也请使用此技能。无论培训时长是短是长，无论涉及哪个领域（技术、软技能、创意、合规、入职等），只要需要关于培训活动的结构化书面成果，就始终使用此技能。

name: amazon-ses
description: Guides Amazon SES onboarding for domain-based email sending. Covers identity configuration, production access, an optional first test send, and troubleshooting setup, authentication, or sending failures. Use when setting up SES, resuming incomplete onboarding, or leaving the sandbox. Does not cover inbound email or Mail Manager, SMS/voice, WhatsApp, SNS, Pinpoint, or WorkMail.
description_zh: 指导 Amazon SES 的基于域的电子邮件发送设置流程。涵盖身份配置、生产环境访问、可选的首发测试发送以及故障排除设置、身份验证或发送失败问题。在设置 SES、恢复未完成的设置流程或退出沙盒环境时使用。不涵盖入站电子邮件、邮件管理器、SMS/语音、WhatsApp、SNS、Pinpoint 或 WorkMail。

name: service-helpagent-coordinate
description: Use to set up, configure, ground, or go live with a Salesforce Help Agent (an Agentforce Service Agent in Service Cloud) via a guided four-checkpoint flow. Use whenever a user says any of: set up / create / build / add a help agent, service agent, or support chat agent; add or embed a chat widget on a website or Experience Cloud / LWR site; put a help agent on a channel (web chat, voice, phone, help portal); ground a help agent on Salesforce Knowledge; or wants an AI to answer customer questions, manage support cases, and escalate to a human. The right skill even when the request names only one part or references help-agent-spec.md or the Agentforce Quick Setup wizard. DO NOT TRIGGER when authoring a brand-new agent with no Help Agent lineage (use agentforce-adlc:agentforce-generate), configuring OAuth/ECAs (use integration-connectivity-connected-app-configure), or only deploying metadata (use platform-metadata-deploy).
description_zh: 用于通过引导式四步流程设置、配置、接地或启用 Salesforce 帮助代理（在服务云中为 Agentforce 服务代理）。在用户说出以下任何指令时使用：设置/创建/构建/添加帮助代理、服务代理或支持聊天代理；在网站或 Experience Cloud/LWR 站点上添加或嵌入聊天小部件；将帮助代理放置到渠道（网页聊天、语音、电话、帮助门户）；将帮助代理接地到 Salesforce 知识库；或希望 AI 回答客户问题、管理支持案例并升级至人工。即使请求名称仅包含一部分或引用 help-agent-spec.md 或 Agentforce 快速设置向导，此技能也适用。在以下情况下不触发：创建全新的、无帮助代理谱系的代理（使用 agentforce-adlc:agentforce-generate）、配置 OAuth/ECAs（使用 integration-connectivity-connected-app-configure）或仅部署元数据（使用 platform-metadata-deploy）。

name: service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure
description: Configures Embedded Messaging Deployments for Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW). Use when the user needs to create a new embedded messaging deployment from scratch using Connect API with defaults, or update an existing deployment's settings using Metadata API. Produces Connect API request payloads for new deployments and EmbeddedServiceConfig metadata XML for updates. TRIGGER when the user mentions embedded messaging deployment, embedded service deployment, MIAW deployment, messaging widget setup, chat widget configuration, embedded chat deployment, or references a .EmbeddedServiceConfig-meta.xml file. DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is creating a messaging channel (use service-digital-engagement-channel-configure), configuring legacy Live Agent embedded service, or generating the JavaScript code snippet for website embedding.
description_zh: 配置嵌入式消息部署，用于应用内和网页消息服务（MIAW）。当用户需要使用Connect API从默认设置创建新的嵌入式消息部署，或使用Metadata API更新现有部署的设置时使用。为新部署生成Connect API请求负载，为更新生成EmbeddedServiceConfig元数据XML。当用户提及嵌入式消息部署、嵌入式服务部署、MIAW部署、消息小部件设置、聊天小部件配置、嵌入式聊天部署，或引用.EmentedServiceConfig-meta.xml文件时触发。不触发场景：用户创建消息频道（使用service-digital-engagement-channel-configure）、配置传统Live Agent嵌入式服务，或为网站嵌入生成JavaScript代码片段。

name: qodo-get-rules
description: Retrieve and apply Qodo coding rules relevant to implementation, planning, refactoring, or code review. Use on "get rules", "load qodo rules", or "relevant standards" and when starting a concrete coding task. Reuse rules already retrieved for the same workspace, repository, and task scope; refresh when that scope changes.
description_zh: 获取并应用与实现、规划、重构或代码评审相关的Qodo编码规则。在执行"获取规则"、"加载qodo规则"或"相关标准"操作，以及开始具体编码任务时使用。对于同一工作区、存储库和任务范围，可复用已获取的规则；当该范围发生变化时，则刷新规则。

name: gov-overseas-trip-report
description: 선관위·권익위·정보공개포털·주요 지방의회 등 검증된 공개 표면에서 공무국외출장/국외훈련 보고서·현황을 조회하고, 첨부 원문이 있으면 kordoc으로 사실·공개성·검토 신호만 구조화한다. 부정부패 판정 도구가 아니다.
description_zh: 在선관위·권익위·정보공개포털·主要地方议会等经核实的公开平台查询公务国外出差/国外培训报告·现状，如有附件原文，则仅以kordoc结构化事实·公开性·审查信号。这不是反腐败判定工具。

name: experience-lwc-base-components-integrate
description: Pick the right Lightning Base Component (`lightning-*`) for a given UI task, retrieve its full API (props, methods, events, slots) from the bundled per-component reference, and wire it into an LWC (LWC `.html`, `.js`, and `.css` files) without breaking SLDS. Use this skill when users say "I need a Lightning modal / datatable / combobox / record form", ask which `lightning-*` component fits a use case, want a shortlist of LBC candidates, are about to hand-roll a UI that a base component already provides, or are editing an LWC bundle's `.html` / `.js` / `.css` and need to select or wire a base component. Also triggers on "Lightning base component", "LBC", "lightning-combobox", "lightning-datatable", "use `lightning-` tag". DO NOT TRIGGER for applying SLDS design tokens, blueprints, or styling guidance in general — that is `design-systems-slds-apply`; this skill only selects and wires `lightning-*` base components.
description_zh: 为给定的 UI 任务选择合适的 Lightning Base Component (`lightning-*`), 从组件的捆绑参考中获取其完整 API（属性、方法、事件、插槽），并将其连接到 LWC（LWC 的 `.html`、`.js` 和 `.css` 文件）中，同时不破坏 SLDS。当用户说“我需要一个 Lightning 弹窗 / 数据表格 / 下拉框 / 记录表单”时，询问哪个 `lightning-*` 组件适合该用例，需要 LBC 候选组件的简短列表，即将要手动编写一个基础组件已经提供的 UI，或正在编辑 LWC 捆绑的 `.html` / `.js` / `.css` 并需要选择或连接基础组件时，使用此技能。此外，在“Lightning 基础组件”、“LBC”、“lightning-combobox”、“lightning-datatable”、“使用 `lightning-` 标签”时也会触发。一般不用于应用 SLDS 设计令牌、蓝图或样式指南——那是 `design-systems-slds-apply`；此技能仅用于选择和连接 `lightning-*` 基础组件。

name: service-digital-engagement-messaging-site-integrate
description: Integrates a Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW) Embedded Messaging chat widget into an Experience Cloud site by patching the site's LWR or Aura page bundle, deploying, publishing, and verifying guest access. Use when the user wants to embed messaging on an Experience site, add a chat widget to a community, place the Embedded Messaging component on an LWR or Aura page, wire an embedded service deployment to a site, references the retrieved bundle artifacts (`content.json`, `homeGuestLayout.json`, or a `*.site-meta.xml` file), or automates the retrieve/patch-JSON/deploy/publish flow instead of clicking through Experience Builder. DO NOT TRIGGER when creating the messaging channel (use service-digital-engagement-channel-configure), when creating or updating the EmbeddedServiceConfig deployment (use service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure), or when generating a standalone JavaScript snippet for a non-Experience website.
description_zh: 将 Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW) 内嵌消息聊天小部件集成到 Experience Cloud 网站中，通过修补网站的 LWR 或 Aura 页面包，进行部署、发布和验证访客访问权限。当用户希望在 Experience 网站上嵌入消息、向社区添加聊天小部件、将内嵌消息组件放置在 LWR 或 Aura 页面上、将内嵌服务部署连接到网站、引用检索到的包资源（`content.json`、`homeGuestLayout.json` 或一个 `*.site-meta.xml` 文件），或自动化检索/修补 JSON/部署/发布流程（而不是通过 Experience Builder 点击操作）时使用。在创建消息通道时（请使用 service-digital-engagement-channel-configure）、在创建或更新 EmbeddedServiceConfig 部署时（请使用 service-digital-engagement-deployment-configure），或在为非 Experience 网站生成独立的 JavaScript 代码片段时，请勿触发。

name: thought-leadership-ads
description: Plan a campaign that promotes an executive's or founder's existing organic posts as paid person-fronted ads - post selection, sequencing, audience and exclusions, permission and governance, budget, and measurement. Use whenever the user mentions thought leader ads, promoting a founder's or CEO's post, sponsoring an employee's or a creator's post, executive content amplification, running ads from a personal profile, or B2B trust ads - even if they never say 'thought leadership'. Covers B2B trust-layer campaigns on professional networks with pipeline-lens measurement, and B2C founder-led brands with direct-response measurement. Plans the campaign only, never the featured person's content: ad copy is mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants.
description_zh: 制定一项推广高管或创始人的现有原创帖子的活动计划，将其作为付费的个人代言广告——包括帖子选择、排序、受众和排除项、权限和治理、预算和衡量指标。在用户提及思想领袖广告、推广创始人或CEO的帖子、赞助员工或创作者的帖子、高管内容放大、从个人资料运行广告或B2B信任广告时使用——即使他们从未提到“思想领导力”。涵盖专业网络上的B2B信任层活动，采用管道视角衡量，以及采用直接响应衡量的创始人主导的B2C品牌。仅规划活动本身，不包括被代言人的内容：广告文案为mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants。

name: storyboard
description: Create a six-frame storyboard that shows a user's journey from problem to solution. Use when you need a fast narrative for alignment, concept reviews, or demos.
description_zh: 创建一个包含六个画面的故事板，展示用户从问题到解决方案的旅程。在需要快速叙述以进行对齐、概念评审或演示时使用。

name: detect-static-dependencies
description: ACTIVATION PREREQUISITE: the request or discovered target must explicitly identify C#, .NET, `.cs`, or `.csproj`; otherwise stay dormant without invoking this skill. USE FOR: locating System.DateTime.Now/UtcNow, System.IO.File/Directory, System.Environment, HttpClient, Console, or Process usage in C#; auditing C# code for hard-to-test framework dependencies; or verifying those C# calls are already abstracted. DO NOT USE FOR: any target lacking the activation prerequisite; generating wrappers (use generate-testability-wrappers); migrating code (use migrate-static-to-wrapper); or general code review.
description_zh:
激活前提：请求或发现的目标必须明确标识 C#、.NET、`.cs` 或 `.csproj`；否则保持休眠状态，不调用此技能。  
用途：用于定位 C# 中的 System.DateTime.Now/UtcNow、System.IO.File/Directory、System.Environment、HttpClient、Console 或 Process 的使用；审计 C# 代码中难以测试的框架依赖；或验证这些 C# 调用是否已抽象化。  
不适用情况：任何缺乏激活前提的目标；生成包装器（使用 generate-testability-wrappers）；迁移代码（使用 migrate-static-to-wrapper）；或一般代码审查。

name: site-md
description: Analyze a project description or site requirements and synthesize a project constitution into SITE.md for the Stitch Build Loop
description_zh: 分析项目描述或场地需求，并将项目章程综合到SITE.md中，用于Stitch Build Loop

name: mantine-form
description: Build forms using @mantine/form in the mantine-9 repository. Use this skill when: (1) setting up a form with useForm, (2) adding validation rules or async validation, (3) working with nested object or array fields, (4) sharing form state across components with createFormContext, (5) using uncontrolled mode for performance, (6) using the standalone useField hook, or (7) any task involving useForm, getInputProps, onSubmit, insertListItem, or form validation.
description_zh: 使用 `@mantine/form` 在 `mantine-9` 存储库中构建表单。在以下情况时使用此技能：(1) 使用 `useForm` 设置表单，(2) 添加验证规则或异步验证，(3) 处理嵌套对象或数组字段，(4) 使用 `createFormContext` 在组件间共享表单状态，(5) 使用非受控模式以提升性能，(6) 使用独立的 `useField` 钩子，或 (7) 任何涉及 `useForm`、`getInputProps`、`onSubmit`、`insertListItem` 或表单验证的任务。

name: sentry-nestjs-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for NestJS. Use when asked to "add Sentry to NestJS", "install @sentry/nestjs", "setup Sentry in NestJS", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, logging, metrics, crons, or AI monitoring for NestJS applications. Supports Express and Fastify adapters, GraphQL, microservices, WebSockets, and background jobs.
description_zh: NestJS 完整的 Sentry SDK 配置。当被要求“将 Sentry 添加到 NestJS”、“安装 @sentry/nestjs”、“在 NestJS 中配置 Sentry”，或为 NestJS 应用配置错误监控、追踪、性能分析、日志记录、指标、定时任务或 AI 监控时使用。支持 Express 和 Fastify 适配器、GraphQL、微服务、WebSocket 和后台任务。

name: cloud-databases-onboarding
description: Guides users through discovering their database requirements, recommends a Google Cloud database based on a recommendation matrix, and assists in database creation. Use when a user asks 'What database service should I use?', 'Help me pick a database', or when a user wants to create a new database on Google Cloud. Don't use for general Google Cloud maintenance, managing existing databases, or database migrations.
description_zh: 引导用户发现其数据库需求，根据推荐矩阵推荐 Google Cloud 数据库，并协助创建数据库。当用户询问“我应该使用哪个数据库服务？”、“帮我选个数据库”，或用户希望在 Google Cloud 上创建新数据库时使用。不适用于一般 Google Cloud 维护、管理现有数据库或数据库迁移。

name: muapi-instagram-post
description: Create a polished, on-brand Instagram post — square or portrait hero image with matching caption and hashtags.

name: dt-obs-logs
description: Log querying, filtering, pattern analysis, and error rate calculation. Use when searching application or infrastructure logs, analyzing error patterns, or correlating log data. Trigger: "show error logs", "search logs for keyword", "log error rate", "recent errors", "logs from last hour", "find log entries", "top error messages", "log patterns", "parse JSON logs", "logs by process group", "log trends over time", "log entry counts per minute". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation questions, distributed tracing or span analysis (use dt-obs-tracing).
description_zh: 日志查询、过滤、模式分析和错误率计算。用于搜索应用程序或基础设施日志、分析错误模式或关联日志数据。触发条件："显示错误日志"、"搜索关键字日志"、"日志错误率"、"最近错误"、"过去一小时的日志"、"查找日志条目"、"顶级错误消息"、"日志模式"、"解析JSON日志"、"按进程组日志"、"日志随时间趋势"、"每分钟日志条目计数"。不适用于解释现有查询、产品文档问题、分布式追踪或跨度分析（请使用dt-obs-tracing）。

name: dt-obs-problems
description: DAVIS problem analysis including root cause identification, impact assessment, and correlation with other telemetry. Use when querying or investigating detected problems. Trigger: "active problems", "root cause analysis", "problem impact", "affected users", "list problems", "P-12345 details", "recurring problems", "problem history", "problem trending", "blast radius", "which entity caused the problem", "problems affecting Kubernetes", "problems by service". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation questions, generic log searching, distributed tracing, or host-level resource monitoring.
description_zh: DAVIS问题分析，包括根本原因识别、影响评估以及与其他遥测数据的关联。在查询或调查检测到的问题时使用。触发条件："活跃问题"、"根本原因分析"、"问题影响"、"受影响用户"、"列出问题"、"P-12345详情"、"重复问题"、"问题历史"、"问题趋势"、"影响范围"、"哪个实体导致了问题"、"影响Kubernetes的问题"、"按服务分类的问题"。不适用于解释现有查询、产品文档问题、通用日志搜索、分布式追踪或主机级资源监控。

name: threejs-debug-profiler
description: Debug and profile Three.js browser games: blank canvases, render and runtime bugs, asset and audio loading, animation, resize, mobile input, plus performance profiling of draw calls, triangles, textures, memory, shader and post-processing cost, and bundle size.
description_zh: 调试和剖析 Three.js 浏览器游戏：空白画布、渲染和运行时错误、资源及音频加载、动画、缩放、移动端输入，以及绘制调用、三角形、纹理、内存、着色器和后期处理的性能剖析，以及打包文件大小。

name: p-video
description: Generate videos with Pruna P-Video and WAN models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Video, WAN-T2V, WAN-I2V. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, audio support, 720p/1080p, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna video, p-video, pruna ai video, fast video generation, optimized video, wan t2v, wan i2v, economic video generation, cheap video generation, pruna text to video, pruna image to video
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh 命令行界面使用 Pruna P-Video 和 WAN 模型生成视频。模型：P-Video、WAN-T2V、WAN-I2V。功能：文本转视频、图像转视频、音频支持、720p/1080p、快速推理。Pruna 在不损失质量的情况下优化模型速度。触发词：pruna video、p-video、pruna ai video、快速视频生成、优化视频、wan t2v、wan i2v、经济视频生成、廉价视频生成、pruna 文本转视频、pruna 图像转视频。

name: clr-activation-debugging
description: Diagnoses .NET Framework CLR activation issues using CLR activation logs (CLRLoad logs) produced by mscoree.dll. Use when: the shim picks the wrong runtime, fails to load any runtime, shows unexpected .NET 3.5 Feature-on-Demand (FOD) dialogs, unexpectedly does NOT show FOD dialogs, loads both v2 and v4 into the same process causing failures, or any time someone is wondering "what is happening with .NET Framework activation?"
description_zh: 使用由mscoree.dll生成的CLR激活日志（CLRLoad日志）诊断.NET Framework CLR激活问题。在以下情况使用：shim选择错误运行时、无法加载任何运行时、显示意外的.NET 3.5按需功能（FOD）对话框、意外不显示FOD对话框、将v2和v4同时加载到同一进程导致失败，或任何有人想知道“.NET Framework激活发生了什么？”的时候。

name: muapi-product-video-ad-maker
description: Create a high-end cinematic product video advertisement starting from a simple product photo.
description_zh: 从一张简单的产品照片开始，制作一部高端电影感的产品视频广告。

name: ad-copy-variants
description: Turn one core value proposition into genuinely distinct ad copy variants - headline, primary text, description, and CTA combinations - each labelled with angle, awareness stage, formula, and version so test results stay attributable. A real variant is a new angle, never a reworded line. Use whenever the user asks to write ad copy, needs headline or CTA variations, wants copy to A/B test, has ads that all sound the same, or needs a search ad headline set or an ML asset pool - even if they never say 'variants'. Covers B2B and B2C. Do NOT use for video or creator scripts (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts), a designer brief (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief), or test design (mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-test-plan).
description_zh: 将一个核心价值主张转化为真正不同的广告文案变体——包括标题、主要文本、描述和CTA组合——每个变体都需标注角度、认知阶段、公式和版本，以便测试结果可追溯。真正的变体是新角度，而非改写过的句子。当用户要求撰写广告文案、需要标题或CTA变体、希望进行A/B测试、广告听起来都一样、需要搜索广告标题设置或ML资产库时，均可使用——即使他们从未提及“变体”。涵盖B2B和B2C场景。禁止用于视频或创作者脚本（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ugc-ad-scripts）、设计师简报（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-brief）或测试设计（mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-creative-test-plan）。

name: redis-connections
description: Redis client and connection guidance covering connection pooling, multiplexing, pipelining, client-side caching with RESP3, avoiding slow commands (KEYS, SMEMBERS, HGETALL), and tuning socket timeouts. Use when configuring a Redis client (redis-py, Jedis, Lettuce, NRedisStack), batching commands for throughput, eliminating per-request connection creation, iterating large keyspaces with SCAN, enabling client-side caching for read-heavy workloads, or setting connect and read timeouts.
description_zh: Redis 客户端和连接指南，涵盖连接池、多路复用、管道化、使用 RESP3 的客户端缓存、避免慢速命令（KEYS、SMEMBERS、HGETALL）以及调整套接字超时。在配置 Redis 客户端（redis-py、Jedis、Lettuce、NRedisStack）时使用，用于批量命令以提高吞吐量、消除每次请求的连接创建、使用 SCAN 迭代大型键空间、为读密集型工作负载启用客户端缓存，或设置连接和读取超时。

name: nuget-trusted-publishing
description: Set up NuGet trusted publishing (OIDC) on a GitHub Actions repo — replaces long-lived API keys with short-lived tokens. USE FOR: trusted publishing, NuGet OIDC, keyless NuGet publish, migrate from NuGet API key, NuGet/login, secure NuGet publishing. DO NOT USE FOR: publishing to private feeds or Azure Artifacts (OIDC is nuget.org only). INVOKES: shell (powershell or bash), edit, create, ask_user for guided repo setup.
description_zh: 在 GitHub Actions 仓库中设置 NuGet 受信任发布（OIDC）——用短期令牌替换长期 API 密钥。用途：受信任发布、NuGet OIDC、无密钥 NuGet 发布、从 NuGet API 密钥迁移、NuGet/登录、安全 NuGet 发布。不适用：发布到私有源或 Azure Artifacts（OIDC 仅限 nuget.org）。触发：shell（powershell 或 bash）、编辑、创建、ask_user 用于引导仓库设置。

name: tailwindcss-animations
description:
Tailwind CSS animations and transitions including built-in utilities and custom keyframes.
PROACTIVELY activate for: (1) animate-* utilities (spin, ping, pulse, bounce), (2) custom @keyframes via @theme animate, (3) transition utilities (transition, duration, ease), (4) transforms (scale, rotate, translate) with transition, (5) prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, (6) Framer Motion / Motion One integration with Tailwind, (7) CSS scroll-driven animations (animation-timeline), (8) view transitions API with Tailwind, (9) hover, focus, group-hover transitions, (10) staggered list animations.
Provides: animation utility reference, custom keyframe examples, reduced-motion pattern, Framer Motion integration, and scroll-driven animation recipes.
description_zh:
Tailwind CSS 动画和过渡效果，包括内置工具和自定义关键帧。
主动激活以下功能： (1) animate-* 工具（旋转、弹跳、脉冲、弹跳），(2) 通过 @theme animate 定义的 @keyframes，(3) 过渡工具（过渡、持续时间、缓动），(4) 带有过渡效果的变换（缩放、旋转、平移），(5) prefers-reduced-motion: 减少，(6) 与 Tailwind 集成的 Framer Motion / Motion One，(7) CSS 滚动驱动动画（animation-timeline），(8) 与 Tailwind 集成的视图过渡 API，(9) 悬停、焦点、组悬停过渡效果，(10) 交错列表动画。
提供：动画工具参考、自定义关键帧示例、减少运动模式、Framer Motion 集成以及滚动驱动动画配方。

name: discord
description: Discord messaging workflows through OpenClaw's message tool.
description_zh: 通过OpenClaw的消息工具进行Discord消息工作流程。

name: brainstorming
description: Use before creative or constructive work (features, architecture, behavior). Transforms vague ideas into validated designs through disciplined reasoning and collaboration.
description_zh: 在进行创意或建设性工作（如功能、架构、行为）之前使用。通过严谨的推理和协作，将模糊的想法转化为经过验证的设计。

name: migrate-dotnet8-to-dotnet9
description: Migrate a .NET 8 project to .NET 9 and resolve all breaking changes. USE FOR: upgrading TargetFramework from net8.0 to net9.0, fixing build errors after updating the .NET 9 SDK, resolving behavioral changes in .NET 9 / C# 13 / ASP.NET Core 9 / EF Core 9, replacing BinaryFormatter (now always throws), resolving SYSLIB0054-SYSLIB0057, adapting to params span overload resolution, fixing C# 13 compiler changes, updating HttpClientFactory for SocketsHttpHandler, and resolving EF Core 9 migration/Cosmos DB changes. DO NOT USE FOR: .NET Framework migrations, upgrading from .NET 7 or earlier, greenfield .NET 9 projects, or cosmetic modernization unrelated to the upgrade.
description_zh: 将 .NET 8 项目迁移到 .NET 9 并解决所有破坏性变更。适用场景：将 TargetFramework 从 net8.0 升级到 net9.0，更新 .NET 9 SDK 后修复构建错误，解决 .NET 9 / C# 13 / ASP.NET Core 9 / EF Core 9 中的行为变化，替换 BinaryFormatter（现始终抛出异常），解决 SYSLIB0054-SYSLIB0057 问题，适配 params span 重载解析，修复 C# 13 编译器变更，更新 HttpClientFactory 以支持 SocketsHttpHandler，解决 EF Core 9 迁移/Cosmos DB 变更。不适用场景：.NET Framework 迁移、从 .NET 7 或更早版本升级、全新的 .NET 9 项目，或与升级无关的纯外观现代化改造。

name: mtp-hot-reload
description: Set up or recover MTP hot reload for a long-lived console-host edit/re-run loop in a Microsoft Testing Platform project. Use for explicit MTP console requests such as "enable hot reload", "dotnet run to rerun on edit", or unsupported/rude edits. Covers setup, run/watch, restarts, filters, and the VSTest no-mutation fallback. For one-time runs, exact commands, filter errors, TRX/dumps, or merely a failing test, use run-tests. Do not use when Test Explorer or an IDE should rerun tests without an MTP console host. Excludes editor integration, CI, and writing/debugging tests.
description_zh: 为 Microsoft Testing Platform 项目中的长期存在的控制台主机编辑/重新运行循环设置或恢复 MTP 热重载。用于显式的 MTP 控制台请求，例如“启用热重载”、“dotnet run 以编辑后重新运行”，或不受支持/粗鲁的编辑。涵盖设置、运行/监视、重启、过滤器以及 VSTest 无变更回退。对于一次性运行、精确命令、过滤器错误、TRX/转储，或仅仅是失败的测试，请使用 run-tests。当 Test Explorer 或 IDE 应在不使用 MTP 控制台主机的情况下重新运行测试时，请勿使用。不包括编辑器集成、持续集成以及测试的编写/调试。

name: ad-campaign-consolidation
description: Evaluate a fragmented paid-ads account and recommend which campaigns and ad sets to merge, which splits to preserve, and how to migrate without resetting learning across the account - it plans the consolidation, it never executes it. Use whenever the user mentions too many campaigns or ad sets, merging or restructuring an ad account, ad sets stuck in learning or learning limited, budget spread too thin, account simplification, or campaigns competing with each other - even if they never say 'consolidation'. Covers B2B and B2C on search, paid social, video, and professional-network platforms. Do NOT use to find out why the account underperforms in the first place - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic instead.
description_zh: 评估一个碎片化的付费广告账户，并推荐哪些推广活动和广告组可以合并，哪些拆分需要保留，以及如何迁移而不重置账户的学习过程——它规划整合，但从不执行。当用户提到推广活动或广告组过多、合并或重构广告账户、广告组卡在学习状态或学习受限、预算过于分散、账户简化或推广活动相互竞争时，均可使用——即使他们从未提及“整合”。涵盖搜索、付费社交、视频和专业网络平台上的B2B和B2C业务。请勿使用此工具来找出账户最初表现不佳的原因——应使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-account-diagnostic。

name: conversational-ad-copy
description: Adapt ad messaging for conversational and AI-answer ad surfaces - the one-shot, context-aware ad occupying a single response slot inside an AI assistant reply or answer-engine result, where the copy is either rendered verbatim or rewritten by a model from the landing page and feed. Covers recommendation register, self-contained slot copy, situation-description targeting, grounding and disclosure discipline, and reading performance without creative-level reporting. Use whenever the user mentions ads inside ChatGPT or another AI assistant, sponsored answers, in-assistant ads, response-slot ads, or one-shot ad copy - even if they never say 'conversational ads'. Do NOT use for feed or search ad copy - use mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants instead.
description_zh: 为对话式和AI回答广告界面调整广告信息 - 这种一次性、上下文感知的广告占据AI助手回复或答案引擎结果中的单个响应槽位，其文案要么直接渲染，要么由模型从着陆页和内容流中重写。涵盖推荐注册、自包含槽位文案、情境描述定向、基础与披露规范，以及阅读性能，但不包含创意级报告。每当用户在ChatGPT或其他AI助手中提及广告、赞助答案、助手内广告、响应槽位广告或一次性广告文案时（即使他们从未提及“对话式广告”），均需使用。禁止用于内容流或搜索广告文案——请使用mbfinotti/advertising-skills@ad-copy-variants。

name: shader-dev
description: Comprehensive GLSL shader techniques for creating stunning visual effects — ray marching, SDF modeling, fluid simulation, particle systems, procedural generation, lighting, post-processing, and more.
description_zh: 用于创建惊艳视觉效果的全面GLSL着色器技术——光线步进、SDF建模、流体模拟、粒子系统、程序化生成、光照、后期处理等。

name: blog-calendar
description: Generate editorial calendars for blogs with topic clusters, publishing schedules, content decay detection, freshness update plans, seasonal opportunities, content mix formula, template integration, and distribution scheduling. Plans monthly or quarterly calendars optimized for SEO topic authority and freshness signals based on content priority. Use when user says "editorial calendar", "content calendar", "blog calendar", "publishing schedule", "blog plan", "content plan", "what should I write".
description_zh: 为博客生成编辑日历，包含主题群组、发布计划、内容衰减检测、新鲜度更新计划、季节性机会、内容组合公式、模板集成和分发计划。根据内容优先级，制定每月或每季的日历，优化SEO主题权威性和新鲜度信号。当用户说“编辑日历”、“内容日历”、“博客日历”、“发布计划”、“博客计划”、“内容计划”或“我应该写什么”时使用。

name: dt-app-notebooks
description: Work with Dynatrace notebooks - create, modify, query, and analyze notebook JSON including sections, DQL queries, and visualizations.
description_zh: 与 Dynatrace 笔记本合作 - 创建、修改、查询和分析笔记本 JSON，包括章节、DQL 查询和可视化。

name: cold-start-problem
description: Start and scale networked products using Andrew Chen's "The Cold Start Problem" framework for network effects. Use when the user mentions "network effects", "chicken and egg", "cold start", "two-sided marketplace", "atomic network", "hard side", "liquidity", "critical mass", "invite-only launch", "how do I get my first users", or "the marketplace has no buyers or sellers". Also trigger when launching a marketplace, social, or collaboration product that is worthless without other users, deciding launch sequencing and seeding tactics, or diagnosing stalled network growth at scale. Covers the five stages: cold start, tipping point, escape velocity, hitting the ceiling, and the moat. For word-of-mouth virality, see contagious. For habit-driven retention, see hooked-ux.
description_zh: 使用Andrew Chen的“冷启动问题”框架来启动和扩展具有网络效应的网络产品。当用户提到“网络效应”、“鸡生蛋还是蛋生鸡”、“冷启动”、“双边市场”、“原子网络”、“硬边”、“流动性”、“临界规模”、“邀请制启动”、“我如何获取第一批用户”或“市场没有买家或卖家”时使用。在推出市场、社交或协作产品时触发，这些产品在没有其他用户的情况下毫无价值，用于决定启动顺序和种子策略，或诊断大规模网络增长停滞。涵盖五个阶段：冷启动、临界点、逃逸速度、触及天花板和护城河。对于口碑病毒传播，请参阅contagious。对于习惯驱动的留存，请参阅hooked-ux。

name: blog-write
description: Write new blog articles from scratch optimized for Google rankings and AI citations. Generates full articles with template selection, answer-first formatting, Key Takeaways summary box, information gain markers, citation capsules, sourced statistics, Pixabay/Unsplash images, built-in SVG chart generation, optional FAQ sections, internal linking zones, and proper heading hierarchy. Supports MDX, markdown, and HTML output. Use when user says "write blog", "new blog post", "create article", "write about", "draft blog", "generate blog post".
description_zh: 从零开始撰写针对谷歌排名和人工智能引用优化的新博客文章。可生成完整文章，支持模板选择、先回答后格式化、关键要点摘要框、信息获取标记、引用胶囊、来源统计数据、Pixabay/Unsplash图片、内置SVG图表生成、可选FAQ部分、内部链接区域以及规范的标题层级。支持MDX、markdown和HTML输出。当用户说"写博客"、"新博客文章"、"创建文章"、"写关于"、"博客草稿"、"生成博客文章"时使用。

name: sentry-sdk-skill-creator
description: Create a complete Sentry SDK skill bundle for any platform. Use when asked to "create an SDK skill", "add a new platform skill", "write a Sentry skill for X", or build a new sentry-<platform>-sdk skill bundle with wizard flow and feature reference files.
description_zh: 为任何平台创建一个完整的Sentry SDK技能包。当被要求“创建一个SDK技能”、“添加一个新的平台技能”、“为X编写一个Sentry技能”或使用向导流程和功能参考文件构建一个新的sentry-<platform>-sdk技能包时使用。

name: resolve-project-references
description: Guide for interpreting ResolveProjectReferences time in MSBuild performance summaries. Activate when ResolveProjectReferences appears as the most expensive target and developers are trying to optimize it directly. Explains that the reported time includes wait time for dependent project builds and is misleading. Guides users to focus on task self-time instead. Do not activate for general build performance -- use build-perf-diagnostics instead.
description_zh: 解释 ResolveProjectReferences 时间在 MSBuild 性能摘要中的指南。当 ResolveProjectReferences 出现为最昂贵的目标，并且开发人员直接尝试优化它时激活。解释报告的时间包括对依赖项目构建的等待时间，这是具有误导性的。指导用户关注任务自时间。不要用于一般构建性能——请使用 build-perf-diagnostics。

name: epic-breakdown-advisor
description: Break down epics into user stories with Humanizing Work split patterns. Use when a backlog item is too large to estimate, sequence, or deliver safely.
description_zh: 使用 Humanizing Work 分割模式将史诗拆分为用户故事。当待办事项列表中的项目过大，无法安全地估算、排序或交付时使用。

name: google-cloud-scc-query
description: Queries and retrieves active security findings, external exposures, toxic combinations, vulnerabilities, threats, and sensitive data risks from Google Cloud Security Command Center. Use when retrieving details for a security finding by its name, validating finding scope (e.g., verifying findingClass is TOXIC_COMBINATION, VULNERABILITY, EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE, or THREAT), or fetching finding details for triage. Don't use to draft remediations, apply patches, or execute configurations.
description_zh: 从 Google Cloud Security Command Center 查询并检索活动安全发现、外部暴露、有害组合、漏洞、威胁和敏感数据风险。在通过名称检索安全发现详情、验证发现范围（例如，验证 findingClass 是否为 TOXIC_COMBINATION、VULNERABILITY、EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE 或 THREAT）或为故障排除获取发现详情时使用。不要使用它来起草修复方案、应用补丁或执行配置。

name: deepstream-dev
description: NVIDIA DeepStream SDK development with Python pyservicemaker API. Use when building video analytics pipelines, GStreamer-based video processing, TensorRT inference integration, object detection/tracking, or Kafka/message broker integration.
description_zh: 使用 Python pyservicemaker API 进行 NVIDIA DeepStream SDK 开发。适用于构建视频分析流水线、基于 GStreamer 的视频处理、TensorRT 推理集成、目标检测/跟踪，或与 Kafka/消息代理的集成。

name: tanstack-virtual
description: Headless UI for virtualizing large element lists at 60FPS in TS/JS, React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, Lit & Angular.
description_zh: Headless UI：在 TS/JS、React、Vue、Solid、Svelte、Lit 和 Angular 中实现 60FPS 大型元素列表虚拟化的无头用户界面。

name: blog-chart
description: Generate dark-mode-compatible inline SVG data visualization charts for blog posts. Supports horizontal bar, grouped bar, donut, line, lollipop, area, and radar charts with automatic platform detection (HTML vs JSX/MDX). Enforces chart type diversity, accessible markup (role=img, aria-labelledby), source attribution, and transparent backgrounds. Use whenever the user mentions data visualization, charts, graphs, comparison tables that need to be visualized, or wants to embed inline SVG visualizations in a blog post, even if not invoking blog-write. Use when user says "blog chart", "generate chart", "data visualization", "svg chart", "blog graph", "visualize data", or when the blog-write workflow identifies chart-worthy data points (3+ comparable metrics, trends, before/after data).
description_zh: 为博客文章生成兼容暗黑模式的内联 SVG 数据可视化图表。支持水平条形图、分组条形图、环形图、折线图、糖葫芦图、面积图和雷达图，并自动检测平台（HTML vs JSX/MDX）。强制执行图表类型多样性、可访问性标记（role=img, aria-labelledby）、来源归因和透明背景。在用户提及数据可视化、图表、图形、需要可视化的比较表格，或希望在博客文章中嵌入内联 SVG 可视化时使用，即使未调用 blog-write 功能。在用户说“博客图表”、“生成图表”、“数据可视化”、“SVG 图表”、“博客图形”、“可视化数据”，或当 blog-write 工作流程识别出值得绘制图表的数据点（3个以上可比较指标、趋势、前后数据）时使用。

name: podcast-generation
description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, or produce podcasts from text content. Converts written content into a two-host conversational podcast audio format with natural dialogue.
description_zh: 当用户请求从文本内容生成、创建或制作播客时，使用此技能。将书面内容转换为两人主持的对话式播客音频格式，对话自然。

name: blog-image
description: AI image generation and editing for blog content powered by Gemini via MCP. Claude acts as Creative Director - interpreting intent, selecting domain expertise, constructing optimized 6-component prompts (Subject + Action + Context + Composition + Lighting + Style), and orchestrating Gemini for blog-quality results. Generates hero images, inline illustrations, social preview cards, and OG images. Edits existing blog images. Supports 6 blog-optimized domain modes (Editorial, Product, Landscape, UI/Web, Infographic, Abstract). Works standalone via /blog image or internally from blog-write and blog-rewrite workflows. Falls back gracefully when MCP is not configured. Use when user says "blog image", "generate hero image", "blog illustration", "social card", "generate blog image", "edit blog image", "image generate", "blog cover image", "inline image", "OG image".
description_zh: 由MCP驱动的Gemini博客内容AI图像生成与编辑。Claude担任创意总监——解读意图、选择领域专长、构建优化的6组件提示（主题+动作+背景+构图+光照+风格），并统筹Gemini以生成博客级质量结果。生成主视觉图像、内联插图、社交预览卡片及OG图像。编辑现有博客图像。支持6种博客优化领域模式（编辑、产品、风景、UI/网页、信息图表、抽象）。可独立使用（通过/blog image命令）或从博客撰写与重写工作流中内部调用。当MCP未配置时优雅降级。当用户说“博客图像”、“生成主视觉图像”、“博客插图”、“社交卡片”、“生成博客图像”、“编辑博客图像”、“图像生成”、“博客封面图像”、“内联图像”、“OG图像”时使用。

name: including-generated-files
description: Fix MSBuild targets that generate files during the build but those files are missing from compilation or output. USE FOR: generated source files not compiling (CS0246 for a type that should exist), custom build tasks that create files but they are invisible to subsequent targets, globs not capturing build-generated files because they expand at evaluation time before execution creates them, ensuring generated files are cleaned by the Clean target. Covers correct BeforeTargets timing (CoreCompile, BeforeBuild, AssignTargetPaths), adding to Compile/FileWrites item groups, using $(IntermediateOutputPath) instead of hardcoded obj/ paths. DO NOT USE FOR: C# source generators that already work via the Roslyn pipeline, T4 design-time generation that runs in Visual Studio, non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 修复 MSBuild 目标：在构建过程中生成文件，但这些文件在编译或输出中缺失。适用场景：生成的源文件无法编译（例如 CS0246 错误，表示某个类型应该存在），自定义构建任务创建的文件对后续目标不可见，通配符（globs）未能捕获构建生成的文件（因为它们在执行前就展开），确保生成的文件能被 Clean 目标清理。涵盖正确的 BeforeTargets 时间点（CoreCompile、BeforeBuild、AssignTargetPaths），将文件添加到 Compile/FileWrites 项目组，使用 $(IntermediateOutputPath) 而非硬编码的 obj/ 路径。不适用场景：已通过 Roslyn 管道正常工作的 C# 源文件生成器，在 Visual Studio 中运行的 T4 设计时生成，非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: blog-outline
description: SERP-informed outline generation with H2/H3 heading hierarchy, competitive content gap analysis, section-by-section word count targets, chart and image placement markers, optional FAQ question planning, and internal linking zones. Skeleton only: structure, H2/H3 hierarchy, word counts, optional FAQ slots. Use blog-brief instead if you need full competitive analysis, statistics research, and image suggestions. Lighter than a full content brief, generates article skeleton and structure only, ready for /blog write to consume. Use when user says "outline", "blog outline", "content outline", "structure blog", "plan sections", "article skeleton", "heading structure", "SERP analysis", "competitive outline", "plan article".
description_zh: 基于SERP的提纲生成，采用H2/H3标题层级，竞争内容差距分析，分节段字数目标，图表和图片位置标记，可选FAQ问题规划，以及内部链接区域。仅提供框架：结构、H2/H3层级、字数、可选FAQ位置。如需全面的竞争分析、数据研究和图片建议，请使用blog-brief。比完整内容简报更轻量，仅生成文章框架和结构，准备好供/blog write使用。当用户说"提纲"、"博客提纲"、"内容提纲"、"结构博客"、"规划章节"、"文章框架"、"标题结构"、"SERP分析"、"竞争提纲"、"规划文章"时使用。

name: token-efficiency
description: Token optimization best practices for cost-effective Claude Code usage. Automatically applies efficient file reading, command execution, and output handling strategies. Includes model selection guidance (Opus for learning, Sonnet for development/debugging). Prefers bash commands over reading files.
description_zh: 针对成本效益的Claude Code使用，优化Token的最佳实践。自动应用高效的文件读取、命令执行和输出处理策略。包含模型选择指导（学习使用Opus，开发/调试使用Sonnet）。优先使用bash命令而非读取文件。

name: developing-genkit-python
description: Develop AI-powered applications using Genkit in Python. Use when the user asks about Genkit, AI agents, flows, or tools in Python, or when encountering Genkit errors, import issues, or API problems.
description_zh: 使用 Genkit 在 Python 中开发 AI 应用。当用户询问有关 Genkit、AI 代理、流程或 Python 工具时，或遇到 Genkit 错误、导入问题或 API 问题时应使用。

name: om-apply-upgrade-notes
description: Apply the skills collection's UPGRADE_NOTES.md after an upgrade. Re-syncs installed tracker and browser-provider descriptors while preserving local edits, reports custom-provider gaps, checks pipeline config and installed artifacts, and summarizes exactly what changed.
