This skill should be used when users need (1) data integration and batch correction with scVI/scANVI, (2) ATAC-seq analysis with PeakVI, (3) CITE-seq multi-modal analysis with totalVI, (4) multiome RNA+ATAC analysis with MultiVI, (5) spatial transcriptomics deconvolution with DestVI, (6) label transfer and reference mapping with scANVI/scArches, (7) RNA velocity with veloVI, or (8) any deep learning-based single-cell method. Triggers include mentions of scVI, scANVI, totalVI, PeakVI, MultiVI, DestVI, veloVI, sysVI, scArches, variational autoencoder, VAE, batch correction, data integration, multi-modal, CITE-seq, multiome, reference mapping, latent space.
description_zh: 使用 scvi-tools 进行单细胞分析深度学习。当用户需要以下功能时应使用此技能：(1) 使用 scVI/scANVI 进行数据整合和批次校正，(2) 使用 PeakVI 进行 ATAC-seq 分析，(3) 使用 totalVI 进行 CITE-seq 多模态分析，(4) 使用 MultiVI 进行多组学 RNA+ATAC 分析，(5) 使用 DestVI 进行空间转录组学解卷积，(6) 使用 scANVI/scArches 进行标签迁移和参考映射，(7) 使用 veloVI 进行 RNA 速度分析，或 (8) 任何基于深度学习的单细胞方法。触发条件包括提及 scVI、scANVI、totalVI、PeakVI、MultiVI、DestVI、 veloVI、sysVI、scArches、变分自编码器、VAE、批次校正、数据整合、多模态、CITE-seq、多组学、参考映射、潜在空间。

name: lightweight-3d-effects
description: Lightweight 3D effects for decorative elements and micro-interactions using Zdog, Vanta.js, and Vanilla-Tilt.js. Use this skill when adding pseudo-3D illustrations, animated backgrounds, parallax tilt effects, decorative 3D elements, or subtle depth effects without heavy frameworks. Triggers on tasks involving Zdog pseudo-3D, Vanta.js backgrounds, Vanilla-Tilt parallax, card tilt effects, hero section animations, or lightweight landing page visuals. Ideal for performance-focused designs.
description_zh: 使用Zdog、Vanta.js和Vanilla-Tilt.js为装饰元素和微交互添加轻量级3D效果。在添加伪3D插图、动画背景、视差倾斜效果、装饰性3D元素或微妙深度效果时，无需使用重型框架即可使用此技能。适用于涉及Zdog伪3D、Vanta.js背景、Vanilla-Tilt视差、卡片倾斜效果、英雄区域动画或轻量级着陆页视觉的任务。非常适合性能优先的设计。

name: web-design-guidelines
description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".
description_zh: 检查 Web 界面指南的 UI 代码。当被要求“检查我的 UI”、“检查可访问性”、“审核设计”、“检查 UX”或“对照最佳实践检查我的网站”时使用。

name: vite
description: Vite build tool configuration, plugin API, SSR, and Vite 8 Rolldown migration. Use when working with Vite projects, vite.config.ts, Vite plugins, or building libraries/SSR apps with Vite.
description_zh: Vite 构建工具配置、插件 API、SSR 以及 Vite 8 的 Rolldown 迁移。在与 Vite 项目、vite.config.ts、Vite 插件或使用 Vite 构建库/SSR 应用时使用。

name: voice-call
description: Start voice calls via the OpenClaw voice-call plugin.
description_zh: 通过 OpenClaw 语音通话插件开始语音通话。

name: svg-animations
description: Create beautiful, performant SVG animations and illustrations. Use this skill when the user asks to create SVG graphics, icons, illustrations, animated logos, path animations, morphing shapes, loading spinners, or any animated SVG content. Covers SMIL animations, CSS-driven SVG animation, path drawing effects, shape morphing, motion paths, gradients, masks, and filters.
description_zh: 创建美观且性能优越的SVG动画和插图。当用户要求创建SVG图形、图标、插图、动画标志、路径动画、变形形状、加载旋转器或任何动画SVG内容时，使用这项技能。涵盖SMIL动画、CSS驱动的SVG动画、路径绘制效果、形状变形、运动路径、渐变、蒙版和滤镜。

name: senior-architect
description: Complete toolkit for senior architect with modern tools and best practices.
description_zh: 高级架构师完整工具包，包含现代工具和最佳实践。

name: blog-multilingual
description: One-command multilingual blog creation. Writes a blog post, translates it into user-specified languages, applies cultural adaptation, and emits hreflang tags, sitemap entries, and a CMS-ready language map. The complete write-to-publish pipeline for international content. Orchestrates blog-write, blog-translate, blog-localize, and (optionally) seo-hreflang. Use when user says "multilingual blog", "blog multilingual", "write in multiple languages", "international blog", "mehrsprachiger Blog", "blog multilingue", "blog multilingue", "create blog in German and French".
description_zh: 一键创建多语言博客。撰写博客文章，将其翻译成用户指定的语言，进行文化适配，并生成hreflang标签、站点地图条目以及CMS兼容的语言映射。国际内容的完整撰写至发布流程。统筹博客撰写、博客翻译、博客本地化以及（可选）SEO-hreflang。当用户说“多语言博客”、“博客多语言”、“用多种语言撰写”、“国际博客”、“mehrsprachiger Blog”、“blog multilingue”、“blog multilingue”、“用德语和法语创建博客”时使用。

name: experience-lwc-rtl-validate
description: Use this skill to review a Lightning Web Component (.html, .js, .css files) for right-to-left (RTL) internationalization correctness, producing a finding list with code-level fixes covering CSS logical properties, bidirectional text handling, keyboard semantics, and RTL-aware SLDS class usage. TRIGGER when the user says "review this LWC for RTL", "audit i18n compliance", "fix bidirectional text rendering", "replace left/right CSS with logical properties", "check RTL layout issues", "verify SLDS RTL classes", "review my component for Arabic/Hebrew layout", "ensure this LWC works in RTL locales", or "check bidi text handling". DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is building a new LWC (use experience-lwc-generate), refactoring SLDS classes themselves (use design-systems-slds-apply or design-systems-slds2-migrate), or performing accessibility/security review.
description_zh: 使用此技能来检查 Lightning Web Component（.html、.js、.css 文件）的从右到左（RTL）国际化正确性，生成一个包含代码级修复建议的发现列表，涵盖 CSS 逻辑属性、双向文本处理、键盘语义以及 RTL 兼容的 SLDS 类使用。当用户说“检查这个 LWC 的 RTL”、“审计国际化合规性”、“修复双向文本渲染”、“用逻辑属性替换左右 CSS”、“检查 RTL 布局问题”、“验证 SLDS RTL 类”、“检查我的组件的阿拉伯语/希伯来语布局”、“确保这个 LWC 在 RTL 地区可用”或“检查双向文本处理”时触发。当用户正在创建新的 LWC（使用 experience-lwc-generate）、重构 SLDS 类本身（使用 design-systems-slds-apply 或 design-systems-slds2-migrate），或进行无障碍性/安全性审查时，不要触发。

name: pr
description: Create a PR for the current branch (targets `canary` by default), including splitting one cross-layer branch into ordered stacked PRs so a lower layer (db / shared package / server TRPC) merges before its callers (desktop / CLI / UI). Use when the user asks to create / submit a PR, or to split a branch because clients call a server contract that isn't on the trunk yet. Triggers on 'pr', 'create pr', 'submit pr', 'open a PR', 'pull request', 'split this PR', 'stacked PR', 'backend should merge first', '提 PR', '提个 PR', '新建 PR', '拆 PR', '后端先合', '分层合并'.
description_zh: 为当前分支创建一个 PR（默认目标为 `canary`），包括将一个跨层分支拆分为有序堆叠的 PR，以便较低层（数据库 / 共享包 / 服务器 TRPC）在它们的调用者（桌面端 / 命令行 / UI）之前合并。在用户请求创建/提交 PR，或因客户端调用尚未在主干上的服务器合约而拆分分支时使用。触发条件包括 'pr', 'create pr', 'submit pr', 'open a PR', 'pull request', 'split this PR', 'stacked PR', 'backend should merge first', '提 PR', '提个 PR', '新建 PR', '拆 PR', '后端先合', '分层合并'。

name: rating-prompt-strategy
description: When the user wants to improve their app's star rating, increase ratings volume, optimize when and how they prompt users for a review, or recover from a bad rating period. Use when the user mentions "app rating", "star rating", "review prompt", "SKStoreReviewRequest", "In-App Review API", "ask for review", "low rating", "rating drop", "get more reviews", or "recover from 1-star". For responding to reviews, see review-management. For overall ASO health, see aso-audit.
description_zh: 当用户希望提升其应用的星级评分、增加评分数量、优化何时以及如何提示用户进行评价，或从不良评分期中恢复时，使用。当用户提及“应用评分”、“星级评分”、“评价提示”、“SKStoreReviewRequest”、“应用内评价API”、“请求评价”、“低评分”、“评分下降”、“获取更多评价”或“从1星恢复”。对于回复评价，请参阅review-management。对于整体ASO健康状况，请参阅aso-audit。

name: review-team
description: Use when the user asks for a code review by a fleet of specialized reviewer agents, wants multiple independent reviewer perspectives, or asks to run reviewers in single-pass or iterative fix-until-clean mode. Launches focused subagents for correctness, security, architecture, conventions, simplicity, UX, reliability, telemetry, testing, compatibility, and documentation review.
description_zh: 当用户请求由一组专业评审代理进行代码评审、希望获得多个独立的评审视角，或要求以单次通过或迭代修复直至干净的模式运行评审器时使用。该功能会启动专注于正确性、安全性、架构、规范、简洁性、用户体验、可靠性、遥测、测试、兼容性和文档评审的子代理。

name: rive-interactive
description: State machine-based vector animation with runtime interactivity and web integration. Use this skill when creating interactive animations, state-driven UI, animated components with logic, or designer-created animations with runtime control. Triggers on tasks involving Rive, state machines, interactive vector animations, animation with input handling, ViewModel data binding, or React Rive integration. Alternative to Lottie for animations requiring state machines and two-way interactivity.
description_zh: 基于状态机的矢量动画，支持运行时交互和网页集成。在创建交互式动画、状态驱动UI、带逻辑的动画组件或设计师创建的带运行时控制的动画时使用此技能。适用于涉及Rive、状态机、交互式矢量动画、带输入处理的动画、ViewModel数据绑定或React Rive集成的任务。适用于需要状态机和双向交互的动画，作为Lottie的替代方案。

name: odoo-development
description: Expert guidance for Odoo ERP development including Python ORM, XML views, and module architecture
description_zh: Odoo ERP 开发专家指导，包括 Python ORM、XML 视图和模块架构

name: pulumi-best-practices
description: Load when the user is writing, reviewing, or debugging Pulumi TypeScript/Python programs; asks about Output<T> or apply() usage; wants to create ComponentResource classes; needs to refactor resources without destroying them (aliases); is setting up secrets or config; or is configuring a pulumi preview/up CI workflow. Also load for questions about resource dependency order, parent/child resource relationships, or pulumi.interpolate.
description_zh: 在用户编写、审查或调试 Pulumi TypeScript/Python 程序时加载；询问 Output<T> 或 apply() 的使用方法；想要创建 ComponentResource 类；需要在不销毁资源的情况下重构资源（别名）；正在设置密钥或配置；或正在配置 pulumi 预览/上 CI 工作流。此外，对于有关资源依赖顺序、父子资源关系或 pulumi.interpolate 的问题，也会加载。

name: saas-revenue-growth-metrics
description: Calculate SaaS revenue, retention, and growth metrics. Use when diagnosing momentum, churn, expansion, or product-market-fit signals.
description_zh: 计算 SaaS 收入、留存率和增长指标。在诊断势头、流失率、扩张或产品市场契合度信号时使用。

name: building-register-search
description: Use when the user asks to look up a Korean building-register title record by address, PNU, legal-dong code, or parcel number.
description_zh: 当用户通过地址、PNU、法定洞代码或地块编号查询韩国建筑登记标题记录时使用。

name: instrument-data-to-allotrope
description: Convert laboratory instrument output files (PDF, CSV, Excel, TXT) to Allotrope Simple Model (ASM) JSON format or flattened 2D CSV. Use this skill when scientists need to standardize instrument data for LIMS systems, data lakes, or downstream analysis. Supports auto-detection of instrument types. Outputs include full ASM JSON, flattened CSV for easy import, and exportable Python code for data engineers. Common triggers include converting instrument files, standardizing lab data, preparing data for upload to LIMS/ELN systems, or generating parser code for production pipelines.
description_zh: 将实验室仪器输出文件（PDF、CSV、Excel、TXT）转换为Allotrope简单模型（ASM）JSON格式或扁平化2D CSV。当科学家需要为LIMS系统、数据湖或下游分析标准化仪器数据时，请使用此技能。支持自动检测仪器类型。输出包括完整的ASM JSON、易于导入的扁平化CSV，以及可导出的Python代码供数据工程师使用。常见触发场景包括转换仪器文件、标准化实验室数据、准备上传至LIMS/ELN系统的数据，或为生产流程生成解析代码。

name: improve-react
description: Survey a whole React codebase as a senior React engineer, using React Doctor's scan as evidence, then produce a prioritized audit and self-contained implementation plans for other agents (or cheaper models) to execute. Read-only on source code — it plans improvements, it does not apply them. Use when the user asks to "improve the React code", "audit this codebase", "make this app faster / more robust", or wants a roadmap of fixes rather than a review of a single diff. For a regression check or a fix-it-now pass, use the `react-doctor` skill instead.
description_zh: 以资深 React 工程师的身份，对整个 React 代码库进行调研，并以 React Doctor 的扫描结果为依据，然后为其他代理（或更便宜的模型）生成优先级排序的审计报告和独立的实施计划。仅对源代码进行只读访问——它计划改进，但不应用这些改进。当用户要求“改进 React 代码”、“审计此代码库”、“使此应用更快/更健壮”，或希望获得修复路线图而非单个 diff 的评审时使用。对于回归检查或立即修复的检查，请使用 `react-doctor` 技能。

name: domain-context
description: Progressive Domain Crystallization (PDC) — a skill for building and maintaining a living domain knowledge base for any custom business application. Use this skill whenever the user is developing a business application and wants the AI to accumulate understanding of internal terminology, entities, relationships, and business rules over time — especially when that knowledge is not fully defined upfront and grows across sessions. Trigger on any of: "remember how our system works", "learn our domain", "track business entities", "build domain knowledge", "understand our terminology", "grow AI context over time", "domain model", "business rules documentation", or whenever a user says the AI doesn't understand their business-specific language or data model. Also use at the start of any session where a .tasks/domain.md file exists in the project — always read it before doing any work.
description_zh: 渐进式领域结晶化（PDC）——一种用于构建和维护适用于任何定制业务应用程序的活体领域知识库的技能。当用户正在开发业务应用程序，并希望AI随着时间的推移积累对内部术语、实体、关系和业务规则的理解时，请使用此技能——尤其是在知识尚未完全定义 upfront 并在会话间增长时。在以下任何一种情况下触发： "记住我们的系统如何运作"、"学习我们的领域"、"跟踪业务实体"、"构建领域知识"、"理解我们的术语"、"随着时间的推移增长AI上下文"、"领域模型"、"业务规则文档"，或每当用户表示AI不理解其特定业务语言或数据模型时。此外，在项目中有 .tasks/domain.md 文件存在时，也应在任何会话开始时使用——始终在执行任何工作之前读取它。

name: migrate-xunit-to-xunit-v3
description: Migrate .NET test projects from xUnit.net v2 to xunit.v3 and fix v3 breaks. Use for package/CPM conversion, OutputType=Exe, preserving the VSTest or MTP runner (including projects currently using YTest.MTP.XUnit2), incompatible TFMs, async void tests, string-to-Type attributes, custom Fact/Theory/BeforeAfterTest attributes, Xunit.SkippableFact, xunit.abstractions/extensibility consolidation, and Xunit.Combinatorial/StaFact compatibility. Do not use for framework conversion or a runner-only migration. For xUnit v3 MTP filter syntax, also use migrate-vstest-to-mtp.
description_zh: 将 .NET 测试项目从 xUnit.net v2 迁移到 xunit.v3 并修复 v3 引入的问题。用于包/CPM 转换，OutputType=Exe，保留 VSTest 或 MTP 运行器（包括当前使用 YTest.MTP.XUnit2 的项目），不兼容的 TFMs，异步 void 测试，字符串到类型的属性，自定义 Fact/Theory/BeforeAfterTest 属性，Xunit.SkippableFact，xunit.abstractions/extensibility 整合，以及 Xunit.Combinatorial/StaFact 兼容性。不应用于框架转换或仅运行器迁移。对于 xUnit v3 MTP 过滤语法，也使用 migrate-vstest-to-mtp。

name: upstash-workflow
description: Use for Upstash Workflow/QStash handlers, triggers, durable steps and async fan-out.
description_zh: 适用于 Upstash Workflow/QStash 的处理器、触发器、持久化步骤以及异步扇出。

name: feature-investment-advisor
description: Evaluate feature investments using revenue impact, cost structure, ROI, and strategy. Use when deciding whether a feature deserves investment.
description_zh: 使用收入影响、成本结构、投资回报率和战略来评估功能投资。在决定一个功能是否值得投资时使用。

name: migrate-mstest-v1v2-to-v3
description: Use this skill before answering or editing whenever an MSTest v1/v2 project is being upgraded or repaired for v3. Triggers include QualityTools assembly references; MSTest.TestFramework/TestAdapter 1.x-2.x; "upgrade to MSTest v3"; comparing v1 and v2 migration paths; choosing MSTest or MSTest.Sdk; CS0411/CS1503 after a v3 package bump; DataRow type mismatch, MSTEST0014, or "Test data doesn't match method parameters"; .testsettings/LegacySettings to .runsettings; timeout changes; and net5.0 or other dropped v3 TFMs. Still use it when packages say 3.x but migration source errors or legacy settings remain. Preserve VSTest/MTP. Do not use for a clean v3 project, v3-to-v4, framework conversion, or runner-only migration.
description_zh: 在使用此技能回答或编辑之前，每当升级或修复 MSTest v1/v2 项目以适配 v3 时，请使用该技能。触发条件包括：QualityTools 程序集引用；MSTest.TestFramework/TestAdapter 1.x-2.x；"升级至 MSTest v3"；比较 v1 和 v2 迁移路径；选择 MSTest 或 MSTest.Sdk；v3 包更新后的 CS0411/CS1503 错误；DataRow 类型不匹配、MSTEST0014 或 "测试数据与方法参数不匹配"；.testsettings/LegacySettings 转换为 .runsettings；超时设置变更；以及 net5.0 或其他已弃用的 v3 TFMs。即使包标示为 3.x 但迁移源错误或遗留设置仍然存在时，仍需使用该技能。保留 VSTest/MTP。不要在干净的 v3 项目、v3 至 v4 框架转换或仅运行器迁移时使用。

name: heygen-avatar
description:
Create a persistent HeyGen avatar — a reusable face + voice identity for the agent,
the user, or any named character — powered by HeyGen Avatar V technology.
Prompt-based creation by default (description → HeyGen builds it); photo upload is
optional for real-person digital twins.
Use when: (1) giving the agent a face + voice so it can present videos
("bring yourself to life", "create your avatar", "give yourself an avatar",
"design a presenter", "set up an avatar", "let's make an avatar"),
(2) the user wants to appear in videos as themselves ("create my avatar",
"I want my face in a video", "digital twin of me", "build me an avatar"),
(3) building a named character presenter ("create an avatar called Cleo",
"design a character named X"), (4) establishing HeyGen identity before making videos —
the correct FIRST step when no avatar exists yet.
Chain signal: when the user says both an identity/avatar action AND a video action in the same
request ("create an avatar AND make a video", "set up identity THEN create a video",
"design a presenter AND immediately record"), run heygen-avatar first, then heygen-video.
Returns avatar_id + voice_id — pass directly to heygen-video to create HeyGen videos.
NOT for: generating videos (use heygen-video), translating videos, or TTS-only tasks.
description_zh: 创建一个持久的HeyGen头像——一个可重复使用的面部+声音身份，适用于代理、用户或任何命名角色，由HeyGen头像V技术驱动。默认基于提示创建（描述→HeyGen构建）；真人数字孪生可选择上传照片。使用场景： (1) 给代理赋予面部+声音，使其能够展示视频（“让自己活过来”、“创建你的头像”、“赋予自己头像”、“设计一个主讲人”、“设置头像”、“让我们制作头像”）； (2) 用户希望在视频中以真实身份出现（“创建我的头像”、“我想在我的视频中出镜”、“我的数字孪生”、“为我构建头像”）； (3) 构建命名角色主讲人（“创建一个名为Cleo的头像”、“设计一个名为X的角色”）； (4) 在制作视频前建立HeyGen身份——当不存在头像时，这是正确的第一步。链信号：当用户在同一个请求中同时说出身份/头像动作和视频动作时（“创建头像并制作视频”、“设置身份然后创建视频”、“设计主讲人并立即录制”），首先运行heygen-avatar，然后运行heygen-video。返回头像ID + 声音ID——直接将其传递给heygen-video以创建HeyGen视频。不适用于生成视频（使用heygen-video）、翻译视频或仅TTS任务。

name: blog-flow
description: FLOW framework integration for bloggers. Evidence-led content workflow using the Find, Optimize, Win loop with stage-specific AI prompts from the FLOW knowledge base (30 blog-applicable prompts, CC BY 4.0). Use when user says "FLOW", "FLOW framework", "blog flow", "evidence-led blogging", "find optimize win", or wants stage-specific blog prompts.
description_zh: 博客作者的FLOW框架集成。采用基于证据的内容工作流，使用Find、Optimize、Win循环，并结合FLOW知识库的特定阶段AI提示（包含30个适用于博客的提示，CC BY 4.0）。当用户说“FLOW”、“FLOW框架”、“博客流程”、“基于证据的博客”或“寻找优化赢得”时，或需要特定阶段的博客提示时使用。

name: blog-taxonomy
description: Extract, suggest, and sync tags and categories for blog posts across all major CMS platforms. Supports WordPress REST API, Shopify GraphQL, Ghost Content API, Strapi REST/GraphQL, and Sanity GROQ. Generates tag suggestions from content analysis (keyword frequency, heading extraction, semantic grouping), enforces minimum post-count thresholds to prevent thin tag archives, and syncs taxonomy via authenticated API calls. Use when user says "tags", "categories", "taxonomy", "tag suggestions", "sync tags", "WordPress tags", "Shopify tags".
description_zh: 提取、建议和同步所有主要 CMS 平台上的博客文章的标签和分类。支持 WordPress REST API、Shopify GraphQL、Ghost 内容 API、Strapi REST/GraphQL 以及 Sanity GROQ。通过内容分析（关键词频率、标题提取、语义分组）生成标签建议，执行最小文章数量阈值以防止标签存档过薄，并通过认证 API 调用同步分类体系。当用户说“标签”、“分类”、“分类体系”、“标签建议”、“同步标签”、“WordPress 标签”或“Shopify 标签”时使用。

name: update-swiftui-apis
description: Scan Apple's SwiftUI documentation for deprecated APIs and update the SwiftUI Expert Skill with modern replacements. Use when asked to "update latest APIs", "refresh deprecated SwiftUI APIs", "check for new SwiftUI deprecations", "scan for API changes", or after a new iOS/Xcode release. Requires the Sosumi MCP to be available.
description_zh: 扫描 Apple 的 SwiftUI 文档以查找已弃用的 API，并使用现代替代方案更新 SwiftUI 专家技能。在收到“更新最新 API”、“刷新已弃用的 SwiftUI API”、“检查新的 SwiftUI 弃用情况”、“扫描 API 变更”的请求时，或在新 iOS/Xcode 版本发布后使用。需要 Sosumi MCP 可用。

name: migrate-mstest-v3-to-v4
description: Use this skill before answering, planning, or editing any MSTest 3.x-to-4.x upgrade or post-upgrade failure. Triggers include "MSTest v4 breaking changes"; CS0507/CS0103/CS1061/CS1615; ExecuteAsync, CallerInfo, DisplayName, or custom TestMethodAttribute; ClassCleanupBehavior; ContainsKey; ThrowsExactly or ExpectedException; IsInstanceOfType out parameters; TestTimeout.Infinite; ManagedType; net6/net7 compatibility; TestCase.Id history; TestName in ClassInitialize; TreatDiscoveryWarningsAsErrors; discovery errors after a clean build; and MSTest.Sdk/MTP or vstest.console discovery changes. Do not use for v1/v2-to-v3 leftovers, framework conversion, runner-only migration, or a general .NET upgrade.
description_zh: 在使用此技能回答、规划或编辑任何 MSTest 3.x 到 4.x 升级或升级后故障之前，请使用该技能。触发条件包括“MSTest v4 的破坏性变更”；CS0507/CS0103/CS1061/CS1615；ExecuteAsync、CallerInfo、DisplayName 或自定义TestMethodAttribute；ClassCleanupBehavior；ContainsKey；ThrowsExactly 或 ExpectedException；IsInstanceOfType 输出参数；TestTimeout.Infinite；ManagedType；net6/net7 兼容性；TestCase.Id 历史；ClassInitialize 中的 TestName；TreatDiscoveryWarningsAsErrors；干净构建后的发现错误；以及 MSTest.Sdk/MTP 或 vstest.console 发现更改。不适用于 v1/v2 到 v3 的遗留问题、框架转换、仅运行器迁移或一般的 .NET 升级。

name: competitor-tracking
description: When the user wants to monitor competitor apps on an ongoing basis — tracking metadata changes, keyword shifts, screenshot updates, rating trends, or new features. Use when the user mentions "competitor monitoring", "track competitors", "competitor alert", "competitor changed their title", "watch a competitor app", "competitor weekly report", "competitive intelligence", or "what changed in competitor's listing". For a one-time deep competitive analysis, see competitor-analysis. For market-wide chart movements, see market-movers.
description_zh: 当用户希望持续监控竞争对手应用——跟踪元数据变化、关键词变动、截图更新、评分趋势或新功能发布时，应使用此功能。当用户提及“竞争对手监控”、“跟踪竞争对手”、“竞争对手警报”、“竞争对手修改了应用名称”、“监控某竞争应用”、“竞争对手周报”、“竞争情报”或“竞争对手应用列表有何变化”时，请使用本功能。若需进行一次性的深入竞争分析，请参见 competitor-analysis。若需了解市场整体的排名变动，请参见 market-movers。

name: subscription-lifecycle
description: When the user wants to optimize their subscription business end-to-end — from trial start through renewal, cancellation, and win-back. Use when the user mentions "subscription lifecycle", "trial conversion", "churn", "cancellation", "win-back", "lapsed subscribers", "dunning", "billing retry", "grace period", "renewal rate", "subscriber LTV", or "resubscribe". For paywall design and pricing strategy, see monetization-strategy. For subscription analytics dashboards, see app-analytics.
description_zh: 当用户希望端到端地优化其订阅业务——从试用开始到续订、取消及召回——时使用本项。若用户提及“订阅生命周期”、“试用转化”、“流失”、“取消订阅”、“召回（win-back）”、“已流失订户”、“催缴（dunning）”、“账单重试”、“宽限期”、“续订率”、“订户生命周期价值（LTV）”或“重新订阅”，则适用本项。关于付费墙设计与定价策略，请参阅“变现策略（monetization-strategy）”。关于订阅分析仪表板，请参阅“应用分析（app-analytics）”。

name: migrate-static-to-wrapper
description: ALWAYS USE when asked to migrate, replace, or make testable existing C# static calls with a named wrapper or built-in abstraction: DateTime.UtcNow/Now or DateTimeOffset.UtcNow to TimeProvider/IClock, File.* to IFileSystem or an existing store such as ITextFileStore, and Environment.* to an existing reader such as IEnvironmentReader. Covers scoped files/projects, constructor injection, replacing temp-file or process-environment tests with fakes, "already registered" abstractions, and static classes whose callers/signatures must stay unchanged. Preserves DateTimeKind and call count. DO NOT USE for finding statics (detect-static-dependencies), choosing/designing a new wrapper (generate-testability-wrappers), behavior tests with no chosen seam (testability-obstacle), or test-framework migration.
description_zh: 在要求迁移、替换或使现有 C# 静态调用可测试时，始终使用命名的包装器或内置抽象：使用 DateTime.UtcNow/Now 或 DateTimeOffset.UtcNow 替换 TimeProvider/IClock，使用 File.* 替换 IFileSystem 或现有存储（如 ITextFileStore），以及使用 Environment.* 替换现有读取器（如 IEnvironmentReader）。涵盖作用域文件/项目、构造函数注入、用假体替换临时文件或进程环境测试、"已注册"的抽象，以及调用者/签名必须保持不变的静态类。保留 DateTimeKind 和调用次数。不应用于查找静态（检测静态依赖）、选择/设计新包装器（生成可测试包装器）、无选定接口的行为测试（可测试障碍），或测试框架迁移。

name: p-image
description: Generate images with Pruna P-Image models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Image, P-Image-LoRA, P-Image-Edit, P-Image-Edit-LoRA. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, LoRA styles, multi-image compositing, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna, p-image, pruna image, fast image generation, optimized flux, pruna ai, p image, fast ai image, economic image generation, cheap image generation
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh 命令行界面使用 Pruna P-Image 模型生成图像。模型：P-Image、P-Image-LoRA、P-Image-Edit、P-Image-Edit-LoRA。功能：文本到图像、图像编辑、LoRA 风格、多图像合成、快速推理。Pruna 在不损失质量的前提下优化模型速度。触发词：pruna、p-image、pruna image、快速图像生成、优化 flux、pruna ai、p image、快速 ai 图像、经济图像生成、廉价图像生成。

name: weread-year-in-review-video-template
description:
WeRead-inspired HyperFrames video template for vertical annual reading reports,
personal reading dashboards, book-note recaps, and shareable year-in-review
stories. Use when users want a 9:16 HTML-to-MP4 reading report with warm paper
texture, editorial Chinese typography, book-page metaphors, data highlights,
and deterministic motion.
description_zh: 灵感源自微信读书的 HyperFrames 视频模板，适用于竖版年度阅读报告、个人阅读仪表盘、读书笔记回顾以及可分享的年度回顾故事。当用户希望生成 9:16 比例的 HTML 转 MP4 阅读报告，并采用暖色纸张质感、编辑风格的中文字体、书页隐喻、数据亮点展示及确定性动效时，可使用此模板。

name: woo-guard
description: Review generated or changed WooCommerce code — extensions, payment and shipping integrations, checkout customizations, and order/product logic — before it ships. Best used reactively after an agent writes, edits, or reviews code touching WooCommerce APIs: wc_get_order, wc_get_orders, wc_get_product, WC() cart or session, woocommerce_* hooks, Store API endpoints, payment gateways, order or product meta, HPOS, subscriptions, or bookings. Use on 'review this Woo plugin', 'is this HPOS compatible', or after tasks like 'write a WooCommerce extension', 'add a checkout field', 'hook into the order flow', or 'update stock'. Enforces HPOS-safe order access, CRUD over direct meta, feature-compatibility declarations, server-side checkout validation, money-handling discipline, and hooks over template overrides. DO NOT USE for WordPress code without WooCommerce APIs (use wp-guard), generic code review (use clean-code-guard), test review (use test-guard), or store configuration and admin-screen questions.
description_zh: 审查在发布前生成的或更改的 WooCommerce 代码——扩展、支付和运输集成、结账自定义以及订单/产品逻辑。最佳使用场景是在代理编写、编辑或审查涉及 WooCommerce API 的代码后进行：wc_get_order、wc_get_orders、wc_get_product、WC() 购物车或会话、woocommerce_* 钩子、商店 API 端点、支付网关、订单或产品元数据、HPOS、订阅或预订。适用于“审查这个 WooCommerce 插件”、“这个 HPOS 兼容吗”等场景，或在“编写 WooCommerce 扩展”、“添加结账字段”、“钩入订单流程”或“更新库存”等任务之后使用。强制执行 HPOS 安全的订单访问、直接元数据的 CRUD 操作、功能兼容性声明、服务器端结账验证、资金处理规范以及模板覆盖的钩子。**禁止**用于没有 WooCommerce API 的 WordPress 代码（请使用 wp-guard）、通用代码审查（请使用 clean-code-guard）、测试审查（请使用 test-guard）或商店配置和管理屏幕问题。

name: omniverse-usd-performance-tuning
description: Top-level workflow skill for USD performance diagnosis and optimization. Handles slow loading, high memory, low FPS, and broad scene-optimization requests; delegates auth/runtime setup to Phase 0 owners.
description_zh: 用于 USD 性能诊断与优化的顶层工作流技能。处理加载缓慢、内存占用高、帧率低（低 FPS）以及广泛的场景优化需求；认证与运行时配置工作委派给第 0 阶段负责人。

name: experience-lwc-typescript-migrate
description: Use when converting an existing JavaScript Lightning Web Component (.js, .html, .css) to TypeScript with full type annotations and a matching `.d.ts` file that exposes only the component's `@api` surface. TRIGGER when the user says "convert LWC to TypeScript", "migrate LWC to TS", "rename .js to .ts for this component", "add types to my LWC", "generate .d.ts for this LWC", "type-annotate @api properties", or "produce declare module 'c/componentName' definitions". DO NOT TRIGGER when the user is authoring a brand-new LWC from scratch (use experience-lwc-generate), generating Jest tests for an existing LWC (use experience-lwc-generate), or migrating an Aura component to LWC.
description_zh: 在将现有的 JavaScript Lightning Web Component（.js、.html、.css）转换为带有完整类型注解的 TypeScript，并生成仅公开该组件 `@api` 接口的对应 `.d.ts` 文件时，使用此工具。当用户说出“将 LWC 转换为 TypeScript”、“将 LWC 迁移到 TS”、“将此组件的 .js 重命名为 .ts”、“为我的 LWC 添加类型”、“为此 LWC 生成 .d.ts”、“为 @api 属性添加类型注解”或“生成 declare module 'c/componentName' 定义”时，触发此工具。当用户正在从头创建全新的 LWC（应使用 experience-lwc-generate）、为现有 LWC 生成 Jest 测试（应使用 experience-lwc-generate），或正在将 Aura 组件迁移到 LWC 时，不触发此工具。

name: wp-abilities-audit
description: Audit a WordPress plugin's REST surface and produce a standardized audit document proposing Abilities API registrations. Produces a markdown doc with a YAML schema and prose sections that humans and agents can both consume when planning a registration rollout. Works on any WP plugin.
description_zh: 审计一个 WordPress 插件的 REST 接口，并生成一份标准化的审计文档，其中包含建议的 Abilities API 注册。生成一份 Markdown 文档，其中包含 YAML 模式和供人类及代理在规划注册部署时参考的文本部分。适用于任何 WP 插件。

name: blog-localize
description: Cultural adaptation for translated content. Run AFTER blog-translate completes. Adjusts brand examples, CTAs, legal references, and formality for the target market (German, French, Japanese, Spanish, etc.). Deep cultural adaptation of translated blog posts. Goes beyond translation to swap brand examples, adapt CTAs, substitute legal references, localize statistic sources where possible, and adjust formality (Sie/du, tu/vous, formal/informal). Built-in profiles for DACH, Francophone, Hispanic, and Japanese markets, plus a custom-locale template. Makes content feel locally authored, not translated. Use when user says "localize blog", "blog localize", "cultural adaptation", "adapt for Germany", "adapt for France", "lokalisieren", "localiser", "adaptar".
description_zh: 翻译内容的本地化调整。在“博客翻译”完成后运行。调整品牌示例、行动号召（CTA）、法律引用以及目标市场的正式程度（德语、法语、日语、西班牙语等）。对翻译后的博客文章进行深度文化调整。超越简单翻译，替换品牌示例、调整行动号召、替换法律引用、尽可能本地化统计数据来源，并调整正式程度（Sie/du, tu/vous, 正式/非正式）。内置DACH、法语区、西班牙语和日语市场的配置文件，以及自定义区域模板。使内容感觉像是本地创作，而非翻译。当用户输入“本地化博客”、“博客本地化”、“文化调整”、“为德国调整”、“为法国调整”、“lokalisieren”、“localiser”、“adaptar”时使用。

name: ux-writing
description: Create user-centered, accessible interface copy (microcopy) for digital products including buttons, labels, error messages, notifications, forms, onboarding, empty states, success messages, and help text. Use when writing or editing any text that appears in apps, websites, or software interfaces, designing conversational flows, establishing voice and tone guidelines, auditing product content for consistency and usability, reviewing UI strings, or improving existing interface copy. Applies UX writing best practices based on four quality standards — purposeful, concise, conversational, and clear. Includes accessibility guidelines, research-backed benchmarks (sentence length, comprehension rates, reading levels), expanded error patterns, tone adaptation frameworks, and comprehensive reference materials.

name: dt-obs-frontends
description: Real User Monitoring (RUM) on Dynatrace — web and mobile frontends. Core Web Vitals, user sessions, page performance, mobile crashes, frontend errors, and frontend-backend linking. Query via `user.events`, `user.sessions`, and `dt.frontend.*` metrics. Does NOT cover synthetic monitoring (HTTP/browser/network checks) — that's a separate domain.
description_zh: Dynatrace上的真实用户监控（RUM）——适用于网页和移动前端。核心网络指标、用户会话、页面性能、移动崩溃、前端错误以及前端与后端的关联。可通过`user.events`、`user.sessions`和`dt.frontend.*`指标进行查询。不包含合成监控（HTTP/浏览器/网络检查）——那是另一个领域。

name: visual-content
description: When the user wants to plan, create, or repurpose visual content (images, infographics, social post images) across channels. Also use when the user mentions "content images," "social media images," "infographic," "visual content," "post image," "image specs," "visual repurposing," "content visuals," or "image for social post." For Pinterest, use pinterest-posts.
description_zh: 当用户希望规划、创建或改造跨渠道的视觉内容（图片、信息图表、社交媒体帖子图片）时，应使用此功能。此外，当用户提及“内容图片”、“社交媒体图片”、“信息图表”、“视觉内容”、“帖子图片”、“图片规格”、“视觉内容再利用”、“内容视觉素材”或“用于社交媒体帖子的图片”时，也应使用此功能。针对 Pinterest 平台，请使用 pinterest-posts。

name: qwen-agent
description: Delegate menial, well-scoped coding tasks to a cheap Qwen-backed subagent via the `claude-9arm` command instead of burning Claude tokens/quota. Use when the work is mechanical and low-risk — bulk renames, formatting, boilerplate, find-replace, grep-style search & summarization, reading/condensing logs or files, test/docstring/comment scaffolding, or running builds/linters/tests and reporting pass-fail. Also use when the user says "use qwen", "delegate this", "send it to 9arm/qwen", or "do this cheaply". Do NOT use for architecture, design, debugging judgment, security-sensitive edits, or anything needing this conversation's context.
description_zh: 将琐碎、范围明确的编码任务委托给一个基于Qwen的廉价子代理（通过`claude-9arm`命令），而不是消耗Claude的token/配额。当工作具有机械性和低风险时使用——批量重命名、格式化、模板代码、查找替换、grep式搜索与摘要、读取/压缩日志或文件、测试/文档字符串/注释脚手架，或运行构建/检查器/测试并报告通过/失败。当用户说“使用qwen”、“委托这个”、“发送到9arm/qwen”或“廉价完成这个”时也使用。**禁止**用于架构、设计、调试判断、安全敏感的编辑，或需要此对话上下文的内容。

name: asc-metrics
description: When the user wants to analyze their own app's actual performance data from App Store Connect — real downloads, revenue, IAP, subscriptions, trials, or country breakdowns synced via Appeeky Connect. Use when the user asks about "my downloads", "my revenue", "how is my app performing", "ASC data", "sales and trends", "my subscription numbers", "App Store Connect metrics", or wants to compare periods or top markets. For third-party app estimates, see app-analytics. For subscription analytics depth, see monetization-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户希望从 App Store Connect 分析其应用的实际性能数据时——真实的下载量、收入、应用内购买、订阅、试用或按国家/地区细分的数据，这些数据通过 Appeeky Connect 同步。适用于用户询问“我的下载量”、“我的收入”、“我的应用表现如何”、“ASC 数据”、“销售和趋势”、“我的订阅数量”、“App Store Connect 指标”，或希望比较不同时期或顶级市场的情况。对于第三方应用估算，请参阅 app-analytics。对于订阅分析深度，请参阅 monetization-strategy。

name: blog-locale-audit
description: Audit a directory of multilingual blog content for completeness, consistency, hreflang correctness, meta-tag parity, and freshness. Builds a translation coverage matrix, flags stale translations, validates hreflang and schema, and emits a prioritized report with runnable fix commands. Use when user says "locale audit", "blog locale-audit", "check translations", "multilingual audit", "translation check", "hreflang check", "Uebersetzungen pruefen".
description_zh: 对多语言博客内容目录进行审计，检查其完整性、一致性、hreflang正确性、meta标签匹配性以及内容新鲜度。构建翻译覆盖矩阵，标记过时的翻译，验证hreflang和schema，并生成包含可执行修复命令的优先级报告。当用户说“locale audit”、“blog locale-audit”、“check translations”、“multilingual audit”、“translation check”、“hreflang check”、“Uebersetzungen pruefen”时使用。

name: blog-post
description: Writes and structures long-form blog posts, creates tutorial outlines, and optimizes content for SEO with cover image generation. Use when the user asks to write a blog post, article, how-to guide, tutorial, technical writeup, thought leadership piece, or long-form content.
description_zh: 撰写并结构化长篇幅博客文章，创建教程大纲，并结合封面图生成功能优化内容以提升搜索引擎排名（SEO）。当用户请求撰写博客文章、新闻稿、操作指南、教程、技术文档、思想领导力文章或长篇幅内容时使用。

name: typography-scale
description: Create a modular type scale with size, weight, and line-height relationships. Use when establishing typographic structure. For line length only use `readable-measure`; for judging type on an existing screen use `critique-typography` (visual-critique).
description_zh: 创建一个模块化的类型比例尺，包含大小、粗细和行高关系。在建立排版结构时使用。仅针对行长度使用 `readable-measure`；在评估现有屏幕上的类型时使用 `critique-typography`（视觉评估）。

name: bro
description: Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon.
description_zh: 用普通人的语言重新表述最后一条消息，不要使用专业术语。

name: swiftui-view-refactor
description: Refactor and review SwiftUI view files with strong defaults for small dedicated subviews, MV-over-MVVM data flow, stable view trees, explicit dependency injection, and correct Observation usage. Use when cleaning up a SwiftUI view, splitting long bodies, removing inline actions or side effects, reducing computed `some View` helpers, or standardizing `@Observable` and view model initialization patterns.
description_zh: 重构并审查 SwiftUI 视图文件，要求小型专用子视图具有强默认值、MV-over-MVVM 数据流、稳定的视图树、显式的依赖注入以及正确的 Observation 使用。在清理 SwiftUI 视图、拆分长体、移除内联操作或副作用、减少计算 `some View` 辅助函数或标准化 `@Observable` 和视图模型初始化模式时使用。

name: reddit-posts
description: When the user wants to create Reddit post copy, comments, or optimize for Reddit. Also use when the user mentions "Reddit post," "subreddit," "r/," "Reddit marketing," "post to Reddit," "Reddit thread," "Reddit comment," "Reddit copy," "Reddit content," or "Reddit engagement." For Reddit ads, use reddit-ads.

name: blog-brand
description: Establish durable brand and voice context for cross-skill consumption. Generates BRAND.md (audience, positioning, do/don't editorial rules, taboo phrases, competitor differentiation) and VOICE.md (existing persona JSON re-expressed as readable prose), both written to the project root. When present, the blog orchestrator auto-loads these files for write, rewrite, brief, outline, calendar, and strategy workflows. Pairs with blog-persona, which manages the structured persona JSON. Use when user says "blog brand", "create brand context", "brand voice doc", "BRAND.md", "VOICE.md", "establish editorial brand", "brand guidelines for blog".
description_zh: 建立跨技能消费的持久品牌和声音语境。生成 BRAND.md（受众、定位、执行/不执行编辑规则、禁忌短语、竞争对手差异化）和 VOICE.md（现有的角色 JSON 以可读的散文形式重新表达），两者均写入项目根目录。当存在时，博客协调器会自动加载这些文件用于撰写、重写、简报、大纲、日历和策略工作流程。与 blog-persona 配合使用，后者管理结构化的角色 JSON。当用户说“blog brand”、“create brand context”、“brand voice doc”、“BRAND.md”、“VOICE.md”、“establish editorial brand”、“brand guidelines for blog”时使用。

name: macro-rates-monitor
description: Build macroeconomic and rates dashboards combining macro indicators, yield curves, inflation breakevens, and swap rates. Use when monitoring macro conditions, analyzing yield curve shape, decomposing real vs nominal rates, assessing policy rate expectations, or evaluating financial conditions.
description_zh: 构建包含宏观经济指标、收益率曲线、通胀利差和掉期利率的宏观经济及利率仪表盘。适用于监测宏观经济状况、分析收益率曲线形态、分解实际与名义利率、评估政策利率预期或评估金融状况。

name: weekly-performance-digest
description: Generate a weekly performance summary from closed trader-memory-core theses — win rate, expectancy, profit factor, R-multiple, MAE/MFE, and win/loss pattern analysis by source skill, exit reason, thesis type, sector, and mechanism. No API required; pure local calculation.
description_zh: 从已关闭的交易者-记忆-核心策略中生成每周绩效摘要——胜率、期望值、盈亏比率、R倍数、最大回撤/最佳回撤，以及按来源技能、退出原因、策略类型、行业和机制进行的盈亏模式分析。无需API；纯本地计算。

name: spl-to-apl
description: Translates Splunk SPL queries to Axiom APL. Provides command mappings, function equivalents, and syntax transformations. Use when migrating from Splunk, converting SPL queries, or learning APL equivalents of SPL patterns.
description_zh: 将Splunk SPL查询转换为Axiom APL。提供命令映射、函数等价物和语法转换。在从Splunk迁移、转换SPL查询或学习SPL模式对应的APL等价物时使用。

name: pr-review-canvas
description: Generate an interactive PR review walkthrough as an HTML page. Fetches PR data via gh API, categorizes files into core vs mechanical changes, adds reviewer annotations, and renders diffs with moved-code detection. Use when the user pastes a GitHub PR URL and asks for a review, walkthrough, or summary, or says "review this PR".
description_zh: 生成一个交互式 PR 审查演示文稿，作为 HTML 页面。通过 gh API 获取 PR 数据，将文件分类为核心变更与机械变更，添加审查者注释，并渲染带移动代码检测的差异。当用户粘贴 GitHub PR 链接并要求审查、演示或摘要，或说“审查这个 PR”时使用。

name: mapbox-web-performance-patterns
description: Performance optimization patterns for Mapbox GL JS web applications. Covers initialization waterfalls, bundle size, rendering performance, memory management, and web optimization. Prioritized by impact on user experience.
description_zh: Mapbox GL JS Web应用程序的性能优化模式。涵盖初始化瀑布流、包体大小、渲染性能、内存管理和Web优化。按其对用户体验的影响优先排序。

name: optimize
description: Optimize strategy parameters using VectorBT. Tests parameter combinations and generates heatmaps.
description_zh: 使用VectorBT优化策略参数。测试参数组合并生成热力图。

name: skill-card-generator
description: Use only to generate or update a governance skill card for a specified existing agent skill directory. Do not use for explaining, listing, comparing, or discussing skill capabilities.
description_zh: 仅用于生成或更新指定现有代理技能目录的治理技能卡。不应用于解释、列举、比较或讨论技能能力。

name: business-analytics-reporter
description: This skill should be used when analyzing business sales and revenue data from CSV files to identify weak areas, generate statistical insights, and provide strategic improvement recommendations. Use when the user requests a business performance report, asks to analyze sales data, wants to identify areas of weakness, or needs recommendations on business improvement strategies.
description_zh: 此技能应在分析来自CSV文件的业务销售和收入数据时使用，以识别薄弱环节、生成统计洞察，并提供战略改进建议。当用户请求业务绩效报告、要求分析销售数据、希望识别薄弱环节，或需要业务改进战略建议时使用。

name: locomotive-scroll
description: Comprehensive skill for Locomotive Scroll smooth scrolling library with parallax effects, viewport detection, and scroll-driven animations. Use this skill when implementing smooth scrolling experiences, creating parallax effects, building scroll-triggered animations, or developing immersive scrolling websites. Triggers on tasks involving Locomotive Scroll, smooth scrolling, parallax, scroll detection, scroll events, sticky elements, horizontal scrolling, or GSAP ScrollTrigger integration. Integrates with GSAP for advanced scroll-driven animations.
description_zh: Locomotive Scroll 完整技能库，支持平滑滚动、视差效果、视口检测和滚动驱动的动画。在实现平滑滚动体验、创建视差效果、构建滚动触发的动画或开发沉浸式滚动网站时使用此技能。在涉及 Locomotive Scroll、平滑滚动、视差、滚动检测、滚动事件、粘性元素、水平滚动或 GSAP ScrollTrigger 集成等任务时触发。与 GSAP 集成，以实现高级滚动驱动的动画。

name: football-data
description:
Football (soccer) data across the world's major leagues — standings, schedules, match stats, xG, transfers, player profiles, head-to-head history, team strength (Elo), and match forecasts. Zero config, no API keys. Covers Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, MLS, Champions League, World Cup, Championship, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Serie A Brazil, Russian Premier League, Scottish/Belgian/Turkish top flights, European Championship, and more (call get_competitions for the live list).

Use when: user asks about football/soccer standings, fixtures, match stats, xG, lineups, player values, transfers, injury news, league tables, daily fixtures, player profiles, head-to-head records, team strength/Elo ratings, or match odds/forecasts.
Don't use when: user asks about American football/NFL (use nfl-data), college football (use cfb-data), NBA (use nba-data), WNBA (use wnba-data), college basketball (use cbb-data), NHL (use nhl-data), MLB (use mlb-data), tennis (use tennis-data), golf (use golf-data), cricket (use cricket-data), Formula 1 (use fastf1), or betting odds (use polymarket or kalshi). Don't use for live/real-time scores — data updates post-match. Don't use get_season_leaders or get_missing_players for non-Premier League leagues (they return empty). Don't use get_event_xg for leagues outside the top 5 (EPL, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1).
description_zh:
全球主要联赛的足球（足球）数据——赛程表、积分榜、比赛统计数据、预期进球数（xG）、转会信息、球员资料、历史交锋记录、球队实力（Elo）和比赛预测。无需配置，无需API密钥。覆盖英超、西甲、德甲、意甲、法甲、美职联、欧冠、世界杯、英冠、荷甲、葡超、巴西意甲、俄超、苏格兰/比利时/土耳其顶级联赛、欧洲杯等（调用get_competitions获取最新联赛列表）。

使用场景：当用户询问足球/足球积分榜、赛程、比赛统计数据、预期进球数（xG）、阵容、球员身价、转会信息、伤病新闻、联赛排名、每日赛程、球员资料、历史交锋记录、球队实力/Elo评分或比赛赔率/预测时。

不适用场景：当用户询问美式足球/NFL（使用nfl-data）、大学足球（使用cfb-data）、NBA（使用nba-data）、WNBA（使用wnba-data）、大学篮球（使用cbb-data）、NHL（使用nhl-data）、MLB（使用mlb-data）、网球（使用tennis-data）、高尔夫（使用golf-data）、板球（使用cricket-data）、一级方程式（使用fastf1）或博彩赔率（使用polymarket或kalshi）时。不用于实时比分——比赛后更新数据。对于非英超联赛，不使用get_season_leaders或get_missing_players（将返回空结果）。对于非五大联赛（英超、西甲、德甲、意甲、法甲）的联赛，不使用get_event_xg。

name: greploop
description: Iteratively improves a PR (GitHub), MR (GitLab), or shelved changelist (Perforce) until Greptile gives it a 5/5 confidence score with zero unresolved comments. Triggers Greptile review, fixes all actionable comments, pushes/re-shelves, re-triggers review, and repeats. Use when the user wants to fully optimize a PR/MR/CL against Greptile's code review standards.
description_zh: 逐步优化一个PR（GitHub）、MR（GitLab）或搁置的变更列表（Perforce），直到Greptile给出5/5的置信度评分且无未解决的评论。触发Greptile审查，修复所有可操作的评论，推送/重新搁置，重新触发审查，并重复此过程。当用户希望完全按照Greptile的代码审查标准优化PR/MR/CL时使用。

name: template-validation
description: Validates custom dotnet new templates for correctness before publishing. Catches missing fields, parameter bugs, shortName conflicts, constraint issues, and common authoring mistakes that cause templates to fail silently. USE FOR: checking template.json files for errors before publishing or testing, diagnosing why a template doesn't appear after installation, reviewing template parameter definitions for type mismatches and missing defaults, finding shortName conflicts with dotnet CLI commands, validating post-action and constraint configuration. DO NOT USE FOR: finding or using existing templates (use template-discovery), creating projects from templates (use template-instantiation), creating templates from existing projects (use template-authoring).
description_zh: 在发布前验证自定义 dotnet 新模板的正确性。捕获缺失字段、参数错误、短名称冲突、约束问题以及导致模板静默失败的常见编写错误。用途：在发布或测试前检查 template.json 文件中的错误，诊断模板安装后未出现的原因，检查模板参数定义的类型不匹配和缺失默认值，查找与 dotnet CLI 命令的短名称冲突，验证后操作和约束配置。不适用：查找或使用现有模板（使用 template-discovery），从模板创建项目（使用 template-instantiation），从现有项目创建模板（使用 template-authoring）。

name: slack
description: Slack messaging workflows through OpenClaw's message tool.
description_zh: 通过 OpenClaw 的消息工具实现 Slack 消息工作流程。

name: maui-data-binding
description: Guidance for .NET MAUI XAML and C# data bindings — compiled bindings, INotifyPropertyChanged / ObservableObject, value converters, binding modes, multi-binding, relative bindings, fallbacks, and MVVM best practices. USE FOR: setting up compiled bindings with x:DataType, implementing INotifyPropertyChanged or CommunityToolkit ObservableObject, creating IValueConverter / IMultiValueConverter, choosing binding modes, configuring BindingContext, relative bindings, binding fallbacks, StringFormat, code-behind SetBinding with lambdas, and enforcing XC0022/XC0025 warnings. DO NOT USE FOR: CollectionView item templates and layouts (use maui-collectionview), Shell navigation data passing (use maui-shell-navigation), dependency injection (use maui-dependency-injection), or animations triggered by property changes (use .NET MAUI animation APIs).
description_zh: .NET MAUI XAML 和 C# 数据绑定指南——编译绑定、INotifyPropertyChanged / ObservableObject、值转换器、绑定模式、多绑定、相对绑定、后备选项以及 MVVM 最佳实践。用途：使用 x:DataType 设置编译绑定，实现 INotifyPropertyChanged 或 CommunityToolkit ObservableObject，创建 IValueConverter / IMultiValueConverter，选择绑定模式，配置 BindingContext，相对绑定，绑定后备选项，StringFormat，代码隐藏 SetBinding 使用 lambda，以及强制 XC0022/XC0025 警告。不适用：CollectionView 项目模板和布局（使用 maui-collectionview）、Shell 导航数据传递（使用 maui-shell-navigation）、依赖注入（使用 maui-dependency-injection）或由属性更改触发的动画（使用 .NET MAUI 动画 API）。

name: backend-development
description: Build robust backend systems with modern technologies (Node.js, Python, Go, Rust), frameworks (NestJS, FastAPI, Django), databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis), APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), authentication (OAuth 2.1, JWT), testing strategies, security best practices (OWASP Top 10), performance optimization, scalability patterns (microservices, caching, sharding), DevOps practices (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD), and monitoring. Use when designing APIs, implementing authentication, optimizing database queries, setting up CI/CD pipelines, handling security vulnerabilities, building microservices, or developing production-ready backend systems.
description_zh: 使用现代技术（Node.js、Python、Go、Rust）、框架（NestJS、FastAPI、Django）、数据库（PostgreSQL、MongoDB、Redis）、API（REST、GraphQL、gRPC）、认证（OAuth 2.1、JWT）、测试策略、安全最佳实践（OWASP Top 10）、性能优化、可扩展性模式（微服务、缓存、分片）、DevOps实践（Docker、Kubernetes、CI/CD）以及监控来构建健壮的后端系统。在设计API、实现认证、优化数据库查询、设置CI/CD流水线、处理安全漏洞、构建微服务或开发生产就绪的后端系统时使用。

name: cuopt-routing-api-python
description: Vehicle routing (VRP, TSP, PDP) with cuOpt — Python API only. Use when the user is building or solving routing in Python.
description_zh: 使用 cuOpt 进行车辆路径规划（VRP、TSP、PDP）—— 仅限 Python API。当用户在 Python 中构建或解决路径规划问题时使用。

name: tdd
description: Use only when the user explicitly asks for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test, OR when the bug has an obvious cheap local test target. Skip when the test path is unclear, expensive, integration-heavy, or not requested.
description_zh: 仅在用户明确要求TDD、失败的测试或回归测试，或者当缺陷具有明显的廉价本地测试目标时使用。当测试路径不明确、昂贵、高度集成或未被请求时跳过。

name: finance-based-pricing-advisor
description: Evaluate pricing changes using ARPU, conversion, churn risk, NRR, and payback. Use when deciding whether a pricing move should ship.
description_zh: 使用 ARPU、转化率、流失风险、NRR 和投资回报期来评估价格变动。在决定是否应实施价格调整时使用。

name: auth-wechat-miniprogram
description: CloudBase WeChat Mini Program native authentication guide. This skill should be used when users need mini program identity handling, OPENID/UNIONID access, or `wx.cloud` auth behavior in projects where login is native and automatic.
description_zh: 云开发微信小程序原生认证指南。当用户需要处理小程序身份、访问OPENID/UNIONID或项目登录为原生自动时，应使用此技能。

name: code-review
description: PRやコード変更の汎用コードレビューを実施します。コードの品質、セキュリティ、設計を共通基準で評価し、approve/rejectを判断します。「このPRをレビュー」「コードレビューして」「マージ前チェック」などの依頼や、gh pr viewコマンドの実行時に使用してください。
description_zh: 我们将执行通用代码评审，对代码质量、安全性和设计进行基于共同标准的评估，并据此做出批准/拒绝的判断。请用于“评审此PR”、“进行代码评审”、“合并前检查”等请求，或在执行`gh pr view`命令时使用。

name: automation-sandbox-post-copy-config-generate
description: Generate the JSON config file that the Salesforce sandbox post-copy automation tool consumes, from a customer SOP in any format (PDF, xlsx, csv, JSON, docx, Markdown, plain text, or a screenshot of an endpoint table). Use when the user asks to create, build, generate, produce, or convert a post-copy or post-refresh automation config — turning a sandbox-refresh SOP into a JSON array of OutboundMessages and RemoteSiteSettings entries with ConfigurationName, Label, Fields, IsActive, and ExecutionOrder. Also trigger for phrasings like "post-copy config", "post-refresh automation JSON", "update the outbound message (OBM) endpoints after refresh", "convert this SOP to config", "remote site settings JSON", "refresh planner to JSON", or "sandbox refresh config". DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to deploy the generated config to an org (use platform-metadata-deploy), or apply/execute/run/dry-run the post-copy automation JSON against a sandbox (use automation-sandbox-post-copy-configure).
description_zh: 从客户的标准操作程序（SOP）中生成 Salesforce 沙盒复制后自动化工具所需的 JSON 配置文件，支持任何格式（PDF、xlsx、csv、JSON、docx、Markdown、纯文本或端点表的截图）。在用户要求创建、构建、生成、生产或转换复制后或刷新后自动化配置时使用——将沙盒刷新 SOP 转换为包含 OutboundMessages 和 RemoteSiteSettings 条目的 JSON 数组，其中包含 ConfigurationName、Label、Fields、IsActive 和 ExecutionOrder。同时适用于以下表述："复制后配置"、"刷新后自动化 JSON"、"刷新后更新外发消息（OBM）端点"、"将此 SOP 转换为配置"、"远程站点设置 JSON"、"刷新计划器转换为 JSON" 或 "沙盒刷新配置"。**不触发**以下情况：用户希望将生成的配置部署到组织（使用 platform-metadata-deploy），或在沙盒上应用/执行/运行/干运行复制后自动化 JSON（使用 automation-sandbox-post-copy-configure）。

name: keris-academic-search
description: Use when the user asks to search Korean theses, academic articles, research reports, journals, or university-library catalog metadata through KERIS RISS. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当用户通过KERIS RISS搜索韩国论文、学术论文、研究报告、期刊或大学图书馆目录元数据时使用。돌쇠将进行通过官方界面进行的后续操作。

name: maui-theming
description: Guide for theming .NET MAUI apps — light/dark mode via AppThemeBinding, ResourceDictionary theme switching, DynamicResource bindings, system theme detection, and user theme preferences. Use when: "dark mode", "light mode", "theming", "AppThemeBinding", "theme switching", "ResourceDictionary theme", "dynamic resources", "system theme detection", "color scheme", "app theme", "DynamicResource". Do not use for: localization or language switching (see .NET MAUI localization documentation), accessibility visual adjustments (see .NET MAUI accessibility documentation), app icons or splash screens (see .NET MAUI app icons documentation), or Bootstrap-style class theming (see Plugin.Maui.BootstrapTheme NuGet package).
description_zh: 主题化 .NET MAUI 应用的指南——通过 AppThemeBinding 实现亮/暗模式、ResourceDictionary 主题切换、DynamicResource 绑定、系统主题检测以及用户主题偏好设置。使用场景：当需要“暗模式”、“亮模式”、“主题化”、“AppThemeBinding”、“主题切换”、“ResourceDictionary 主题”、“动态资源”、“系统主题检测”、“配色方案”、“应用主题”、“DynamicResource”时。不适用场景：本地化或语言切换（请参阅 .NET MAUI 本地化文档）、无障碍视觉调整（请参阅 .NET MAUI 无障碍文档）、应用图标或启动画面（请参阅 .NET MAUI 应用图标文档），或 Bootstrap 风格的类主题化（请参阅 Plugin.Maui.BootstrapTheme NuGet 包）。

name: dt-obs-aws
description: AWS cloud resource monitoring including EC2, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS, VPC networking, load balancers, S3, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, and cost optimization. Use when analyzing AWS infrastructure, resource inventory, security compliance, capacity planning, or cost savings. Trigger: "show EC2 instances", "find RDS databases", "VPC resources", "AWS cost optimization", "Lambda functions", "ECS services", "security groups", "unattached EBS volumes", "AWS load balancer topology", "publicly accessible databases", "AWS dashboards". Do NOT use for explaining existing queries, product documentation questions, generic host CPU/memory metrics (use dt-obs-hosts), application-level tracing (use dt-obs-tracing), or log analysis (use dt-obs-logs).
description_zh: AWS 云资源监控，包括 EC2、RDS、Lambda、ECS/EKS、VPC 网络连接、负载均衡器、S3、DynamoDB、SQS/SNS 以及成本优化。用于分析 AWS 基础设施、资源清单、安全合规、容量规划或成本节约。触发条件："显示 EC2 实例"、"查找 RDS 数据库"、"VPC 资源"、"AWS 成本优化"、"Lambda 函数"、"ECS 服务"、"安全组"、"未附加的 EBS 卷"、"AWS 负载均衡器拓扑"、"公开可访问的数据库"、"AWS 仪表盘"。不应用于解释现有查询、产品文档问题、通用主机 CPU/内存指标（使用 dt-obs-hosts）、应用级追踪（使用 dt-obs-tracing）或日志分析（使用 dt-obs-logs）。

name: business-growth-skills
description: Router/index for the 4 business & growth skills bundled in this plugin: customer-success-manager (health scoring, churn risk, expansion), sales-engineer (RFP analysis, competitive matrices, PoC planning), revenue-operations (pipeline, forecast accuracy, GTM efficiency), and contract-and-proposal-writer. Use when a growth/revenue request doesn't obviously match one skill and you need to pick the right one (e.g., 'which accounts are at risk', 'should we bid on this RFP').
description_zh: 此插件中捆绑的4项业务与成长技能的Router/index：客户成功经理（健康评分、流失风险、拓展）、销售工程师（RFP分析、竞争矩阵、PoC规划）、收入运营（管道、预测准确率、GTM效率）以及合同与提案撰写者。当成长/收入请求不明显匹配某项技能，且需要选择正确技能时使用（例如，“哪些账户存在风险”、“是否应该竞标此RFP”）。

name: maui-dependency-injection
description: Guidance for configuring dependency injection in .NET MAUI apps — service registration in MauiProgram.cs, lifetime selection (Singleton / Transient / Scoped), constructor injection, Shell navigation auto-resolution, platform-specific registrations, and testability patterns. USE FOR: "dependency injection", "DI setup", "AddSingleton", "AddTransient", "AddScoped", "service registration", "constructor injection", "IServiceProvider", "MauiProgram DI", "register services", "BindingContext injection". DO NOT USE FOR: data binding (use maui-data-binding), Shell route configuration (use maui-shell-navigation), unit-test mocking frameworks (use standard xUnit and NSubstitute patterns).
description_zh: 配置 .NET MAUI 应用中的依赖注入指南 — MauiProgram.cs 中的服务注册、生命周期选择（单例/瞬态/作用域）、构造函数注入、Shell 导航自动解析、平台特定注册以及可测试性模式。适用范围："依赖注入"、"DI 设置"、"AddSingleton"、"AddTransient"、"AddScoped"、"服务注册"、"构造函数注入"、"IServiceProvider"、"MauiProgram DI"、"注册服务"、"BindingContext 注入"。不适用范围：数据绑定（请使用 maui-data-binding）、Shell 路由配置（请使用 maui-shell-navigation）、单元测试模拟框架（请使用标准的 xUnit 和 NSubstitute 模式）。

name: blog-discourse
description: Research what people are actually saying about a topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X / Twitter, YouTube, Hacker News, dev.to, Medium, and other public discourse platforms. API-free; uses WebSearch with platform-targeted site operators plus recency filters. Produces DISCOURSE.md (a structured brief) and JSON output the writer can consume. Complements blog-researcher (which focuses on authority sources) with a recency-and-engagement lens. Use when user says "blog discourse", "discourse research", "what are people saying about", "research what people are saying", "voice of customer", "social listening", "30-day research", "trend research", "what's the discussion on", "real-time research", "practitioner discourse", "/blog discourse".
description_zh: 研究过去30天内人们在Reddit、X / Twitter、YouTube、Hacker News、dev.to、Medium和其他公共讨论平台上实际讨论某个话题的情况。无需API；使用WebSearch并结合平台定向站点操作符及时效性筛选。生成DISCOURSE.md（结构化简报）和JSON输出供作者使用。与专注于权威来源的blog-researcher互补，提供时效性和互动性视角。当用户说“blog discourse”、“discourse research”、“人们在谈论什么”、“研究人们在谈论什么”、“客户声音”、“社会聆听”、“30天研究”、“趋势研究”、“讨论焦点是什么”、“实时研究”、“从业者讨论”、“/blog discourse”时使用。

name: nitro
description: Nitro is the framework-agnostic server toolkit (powering Nuxt) for building and deploying web servers anywhere. Use when working with nitro.config, server routes/event handlers, route rules, caching, storage, tasks, websockets, or deploying to Node/Bun/Deno/Cloudflare/Vercel.
description_zh: Nitro 是一个与框架无关的服务器工具包（为 Nuxt 提供支持），用于在任何地方构建和部署 Web 服务器。当您使用 `nitro.config`、服务器路由/事件处理程序、路由规则、缓存、存储、任务、WebSocket 或部署到 Node/Bun/Deno/Cloudflare/Vercel 时，请使用它。

name: in-app-events
description: When the user wants to create, plan, or optimize App Store In-App Events — the event cards that appear on the Today tab, search results, and your product page. Use when the user mentions "in-app event", "App Store event", "event card", "Today tab", "live event", "challenge", "game event", "seasonal event card", or wants visibility beyond organic search. For general ASO, see aso-audit. For seasonal keyword strategy, see seasonal-aso.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建、规划或优化 App Store 应用内活动时——这些活动卡片会出现在今日标签页、搜索结果和您的产品页面上。当用户提到“应用内活动”、“App Store 活动”、“活动卡片”、“今日标签页”、“直播活动”、“挑战赛”、“游戏活动”、“季节性活动卡片”，或希望获得超越自然搜索的可见性时使用。对于一般的应用商店优化（ASO），请参阅 aso-audit。对于季节性关键词策略，请参阅 seasonal-aso。

name: test-tagging
description: Classifies existing tests by standard traits and reports their distribution. USE FOR: tagging all tests with category attributes, categorizing/tagging/ labeling each test, compare happy vs error paths, audit the test mix, describe coverage shape by test type, or tag then verify the project builds. Read bodies when names mislead. Apply canonical attributes; otherwise report only. DO NOT USE FOR: requests owned by test-anti-patterns, coverage-analysis, crap-score, test-gap-analysis, code-testing-agent, or migration skills.
description_zh: 根据标准特征对现有测试进行分类，并报告其分布情况。用途：为所有测试添加类别属性标签、对每个测试进行分类/标记/命名、比较成功路径与错误路径、审核测试组合、通过测试类型描述覆盖率形状，或标记后验证项目构建。当名称具有误导性时，读取测试内容。应用规范属性；否则仅报告。不适用于：由 test-anti-patterns、coverage-analysis、crap-score、test-gap-analysis、code-testing-agent 或迁移技能拥有的请求。

name: new-modular-project
description: Creates a new Mojo or MAX project. Use when wanting to start a new Mojo or MAX project, initializing the `pixi` or `uv` environment to use Mojo or MAX, or when the user wants to begin a new Mojo or MAX project from scratch.
description_zh: 创建一个新的Mojo或MAX项目。当您想要开始一个新的Mojo或MAX项目、初始化`pixi`或`uv`环境以使用Mojo或MAX，或当用户想要从零开始创建一个新的Mojo或MAX项目时使用。

name: ev-charger-nearby
description: Use when the user asks for Korean EV charging-station locations, charger types, or current charger status by region, station, or location text. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 当用户询问韩国电动汽车充电站位置、充电器类型或按区域、站点、位置文本查询的当前充电器状态时使用。在多库斯中，通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: ev-subsidy-status
description: 한국 지자체별 전기차 구매보조금 민간공고·접수·출고·출고잔여 대수와 공고 상태를 환경부 무공해차 통합누리집에서 조회한다. 사용자가 사는 지역의 전기승용·전기화물·전기승합 보조금 잔여 현황, 접수 가능 여부, 마감·소진·추경 예정, 특정 모델 기준 보조금 환산치를 물을 때 사용한다. 돌쇠에서는 공식 표면을 통한 후속 액션까지 진행한다.
description_zh: 韩国各地方政府电动汽车购置补贴的民间公告、受理、出货、剩余数量及公告状态，可在环境部的无污染车统一网站查询。用户查询居住地区的电动乘用车、电动货车、电动特种车补贴剩余情况、受理是否可能、截止/用尽/追加计划，以及特定车型标准补贴换算值时使用。在Dolseo中，通过官方界面进行后续操作。

name: surprise-me
description: Create a delightful, unexpected "wow" experience for the user by dynamically discovering and creatively combining other enabled skills. Triggers when the user says "surprise me" or any request expressing a desire for an unexpected creative showcase. Also triggers when the user is bored, wants inspiration, or asks for "something interesting".
description_zh: 通过动态发现并创意组合其他已启用技能，为用户创造一个令人愉悦、意想不到的“哇”体验。当用户说“给我个惊喜”或任何表达对意外创意展示的请求时，都会触发。此外，当用户感到无聊、想要灵感或询问“来点有趣的”时，也会触发。

name: nextjs-app-router-fundamentals
description: Guide for working with Next.js App Router (Next.js 13+). Use when migrating from Pages Router to App Router, creating layouts, implementing routing, handling metadata, or building Next.js 13+ applications. Activates for App Router migration, layout creation, routing patterns, or Next.js 13+ development tasks.
description_zh: Next.js 应用路由器（Next.js 13+）使用指南。在从页面路由器迁移到应用路由器、创建布局、实现路由、处理元数据或构建 Next.js 13+ 应用时使用。适用于应用路由器迁移、布局创建、路由模式或 Next.js 13+ 开发任务。

name: pixijs-2d
description: Fast, lightweight 2D rendering engine for creating interactive graphics, particle effects, and canvas-based applications using WebGL/WebGPU. Use this skill when building 2D games, particle systems, interactive canvases, sprite animations, or UI overlays on 3D scenes. Triggers on tasks involving PixiJS, 2D rendering, sprite sheets, particle effects, filters, or high-performance canvas graphics. Alternative to Canvas2D with WebGL acceleration for rendering thousands of sprites at 60 FPS.
description_zh: 快速、轻量级的2D渲染引擎，用于创建交互式图形、粒子效果和基于WebGL/WebGPU的canvas应用程序。在构建2D游戏、粒子系统、交互式canvas、精灵动画或3D场景上的UI叠加层时使用此技能。在涉及PixiJS、2D渲染、精灵表、粒子效果、滤镜或高性能canvas图形的任务上触发。作为Canvas2D的替代方案，支持WebGL加速渲染数千个精灵，实现60 FPS。

name: manim-composer
description:
Trigger when: (1) User wants to create an educational/explainer video, (2) User has a vague concept they want visualized, (3) User mentions "3b1b style" or "explain like 3Blue1Brown", (4) User wants to plan a Manim video or animation sequence, (5) User asks to "compose" or "plan" a math/science visualization.

Transforms vague video ideas into detailed scene-by-scene plans (scenes.md). Conducts research, asks clarifying questions about audience/scope/focus, and outputs comprehensive scene specifications ready for implementation with ManimCE or ManimGL.

Use this BEFORE writing any Manim code. This skill plans the video; use manimce-best-practices or manimgl-best-practices for implementation.
description_zh:
触发条件： (1) 用户希望创建教育/解释类视频， (2) 用户有一个模糊的概念需要可视化， (3) 用户提到“3b1b风格”或“像3Blue1Brown那样解释”， (4) 用户希望规划Manim视频或动画序列， (5) 用户要求“创作”或“规划”数学/科学可视化。

将模糊的视频想法转化为详细的分场景计划（场景.md）。进行调研，询问关于受众范围/重点的澄清问题，并输出可用于ManimCE或ManimGL实施的全面场景规格。

在编写任何Manim代码之前使用此功能。该技能用于规划视频；实施时请参考manimce-best-practices或manimgl-best-practices。

name: translation
description: When the user wants to translate content, create translation workflows, manage terminology, or optimize translation quality. Also use when the user mentions "translate," "translation," "localization copy," "glossary," "terminology," "style guide translation," "machine translation," "human translation," "TMS," or "multilingual content." For strategy, use localization-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户需要翻译内容、创建翻译工作流程、管理术语或优化翻译质量时，也使用。此外，当用户提到“翻译”、“翻译”、“本地化文案”、“术语表”、“术语”、“风格指南翻译”、“机器翻译”、“人工翻译”、“TMS”或“多语言内容”时，也使用。对于策略，使用 localization-strategy。

name: bangumi-frames
description: Extract and organize frames from a Bilibili video (bangumi episode, UP upload, or a local file) into scenery shots and per-character image groups, using anime-specific person detection + CCIP character-identity embeddings. Two modes — cluster everyone, or pull out one (or several) named characters via reference folders. Use when the user wants to collect, extract, or organize anime frames/screenshots by character or by scenery from a Bilibili video. Read-only download for personal viewing/analysis; uploads nothing.
description_zh: 从Bilibili视频（番剧集数、UP主上传或本地文件）中提取和组织帧，将其分为场景镜头和按角色分组的图像，使用针对动漫的特定人物检测+CCIP角色身份嵌入。两种模式——将所有人聚类，或通过参考文件夹提取一个（或多个）命名角色。当用户希望从Bilibili视频中按角色或场景收集、提取或组织动漫帧/截图时使用。仅限个人查看/分析的只读下载，不上传任何内容。

name: bok-ecos-stats
description: 한국은행 ECOS Open API로 기준금리, 환율, 소비자물가지수, 통화량 등 중앙은행 경제통계 시계열과 100대 핵심지표를 조회한다. Use when the user asks 기준금리, 환율 추이, 물가지수, M2, 국고채 금리, 거시경제 통계. Not for 주식 시세(korean-stock-search) or KOSIS 일반 통계(kosis-stats).
description_zh: 韩国银行ECOS开放API用于查询基准利率、汇率、消费者物价指数、货币量等中央银行经济统计时间序列和100大核心指标。在用户询问基准利率、汇率走势、物价指数、M2、国债利率、宏观经济统计时使用。不适用于股票价格（korean-stock-search）或KOSIS一般统计（kosis-stats）。

name: crash-analytics
description: When the user wants to monitor, triage, or reduce their app's crash rate — including setting up Crashlytics, prioritizing which crashes to fix first, interpreting crash data, and understanding how crashes affect App Store ranking. Use when the user mentions "crash", "crashlytics", "crash rate", "ANR", "app not responding", "crash-free sessions", "crash-free users", "symbolication", "stability", "firebase crashes", "app crashing", or "crash report". For overall analytics setup, see app-analytics.

Run BEFORE blog-localize: this handles language conversion; localize handles cultural adaptation after translation completes. Use when user says "translate blog", "blog translate", "uebersetzen", "traduire", "traducir", "translate post", "blog auf Deutsch", "blog en espanol".
description_zh: 将现有的博客文章翻译成一种或多种目标语言，并进行SEO优化的本地化。生成具有原生质量的翻译，保留Markdown结构、前文、Schema JSON-LD、图片和图表嵌入以及引文胶囊。根据地区本地化关键词、元标签、数字、日期、货币和引用格式。标记机器翻译的痕迹以供审核。在运行"blog-localize"之前执行；此步骤处理语言转换，而"localize"在翻译完成后处理文化适应。当用户说"translate blog"、"blog translate"、"uebersetzen"、"traduire"、"traducir"、"translate post"、"blog auf Deutsch"、"blog en espanol"时使用。

name: visual-hierarchy
description: Establish hierarchy through size, weight, colour, spacing, and position so the eye lands in the intended order. Use when composing new work. For judging an existing screen, use `critique-visual-hierarchy` (visual-critique).
description_zh: 通过大小、重量、颜色、间距和位置建立层次结构，使视线按照预期顺序落定。在创作新作品时使用。对于评判现有界面，请使用 `critique-visual-hierarchy`（视觉评判）。

name: zhang-yiming-perspective
description:
张一鸣（字节跳动/TikTok创始人）的思维框架与表达方式。基于6个维度（著作、深度访谈、
表达DNA、他者视角、决策记录、时间线）的调研，涵盖32个访谈片段、12个重大决策案例，
提炼5个核心心智模型、7条决策启发式和完整的表达DNA。
用途：作为思维顾问，用张一鸣的视角分析产品、组织、全球化、人才和个人成长问题。
当用户提到「用张一鸣的视角」「张一鸣会怎么看」「一鸣的思路」「zhang yiming perspective」时使用。
即使用户只是说「帮我用张一鸣的角度想想」「如果是字节会怎么做」「切换到张一鸣」也应触发。
即使用户说「字节怎么看」「头条的逻辑」「一鸣怎么选择」「一鸣」也应触发。

name: google-maps-scraper
description: Find businesses, leads, emails, reviews, ratings, and contact details from Google Maps. Use for requests such as "find dentists in Berlin", "scrape Google Maps", "get local business leads", or "collect Google Maps reviews". Runs the open-source scraper locally with Docker and guides nontechnical users through setup, monitoring, and results.
description_zh: 从 Google 地图中查找企业、潜在客户、电子邮件、评论、评分和联系方式。适用于“在柏林查找牙医”、“抓取 Google 地图”、“获取本地企业潜在客户”或“收集 Google 地图评论”等请求。使用 Docker 在本地运行开源抓取器，并指导非技术人员完成设置、监控和结果。

name: housing-official-price
description:
Korean apartment and individual-house official price lookup through the public
realtyprice.kr web data surface. Use when the user asks for 공동주택가격,
개별주택가격, 아파트 공시가격, 단독주택 공시가격, or housing official price
history. This is not land official price, transaction price, or building
register metadata.
description_zh: 通过公共的 realtyprice.kr 网站数据接口，查询韩国公寓和独立房屋的官方价格。当用户询问 공동주택가격（公寓价格）、개별주택가격（独立房屋价格）、아파트 공시가격（公寓公示价格）、단독주택 공시가격（独立房屋公示价格）或住房官方价格历史时使用。这不是土地官方价格、交易价格或建筑登记元数据。

name: p-video-avatar
description: Generate talking head avatar videos with Pruna P-Video-Avatar via inference.sh CLI. Turn a portrait image into a realistic speaking video with built-in TTS. 18x faster and 6x cheaper than competitors. Models: P-Video-Avatar, P-Image (for portrait generation). Capabilities: text-to-avatar, audio-driven avatars, 30 voices, 10 languages, 720p/1080p, built-in TTS, dynamic backgrounds, full-body control. Use for: AI presenters, product demos, explainer videos, virtual influencers, marketing, education, multilingual content, UGC, gaming avatars. Triggers: avatar video, talking head, ai avatar, p-video-avatar, pruna avatar, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human, virtual presenter, lipsync, talking avatar, ai spokesperson, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, veed alternative, fabric alternative, omnihuman alternative
description_zh: 通过 Pruna P-Video-Avatar 的 inference.sh 命令行工具生成真人头像视频。将肖像图像转换为内置 TTS 的逼真讲话视频。比竞争对手快 18 倍，便宜 6 倍。模型：P-Video-Avatar、P-Image（用于肖像生成）。功能：文本生成头像、音频驱动头像、30 种声音、10 种语言、720p/1080p、内置 TTS、动态背景、全身控制。用途：AI 员工、产品演示、解释视频、虚拟网红、营销、教育、多语言内容、UGC、游戏头像。触发词：头像视频、真人头像、AI 头像、P-Video-Avatar、Pruna 头像、视频头像、AI 员工、数字人、虚拟员工、口型同步、讲话头像、AI 发言人、Heygen 替代品、Synthesia 替代品、Veed 替代品、Fabric 替代品、Omnihuman 替代品。

name: tanstack-devtools
description: Centralized, extensible devtools panel for TanStack libraries with a plugin architecture.
description_zh: TanStack 库的集中式、可扩展的开发工具面板，具有插件架构。

name: react-pdf
description: React PDF renderer for json-render. Use when generating PDF documents from JSON specs, working with @json-render/react-pdf, or rendering specs to PDF buffers/streams/files.
description_zh: React PDF 渲染器，用于 json-render。在从 JSON 规范生成 PDF 文档、与 @json-render/react-pdf 一起使用或将规范渲染到 PDF 缓冲区/流/文件时使用。

name: react-three-fiber
description: React Three Fiber 3D renderer for json-render. Use when working with @json-render/react-three-fiber, building 3D scenes from JSON specs, rendering meshes/lights/models/environments, or integrating Three.js with json-render catalogs.
description_zh: React Three Fiber 的 3D 渲染器，用于 json-render。在与 @json-render/react-three-fiber 一起使用时，用于从 JSON 规范构建 3D 场景、渲染网格/灯光/模型/环境，或集成 Three.js 与 json-render 目录。

name: twitter-x-posts
description: When the user wants to create X (Twitter) post copy, threads, or optimize for X platform. Also use when the user mentions "X post," "X thread," "Twitter post," "Twitter thread," "tweet," "tweet copy," "thread," "X marketing," "X content," "post to X," "create X post," or "X post copy." For long-form source, use article-content.
description_zh: 当用户想要创建 X（推特）的帖子文案、串行帖子或针对 X 平台进行优化时，也适用于用户提及“X 帖子”、“X 串行帖子”、“推特帖子”、“推特串行帖子”、“推文”、“推文文案”、“串行帖子”、“X 营销”、“X 内容”、“发布到 X”、“创建 X 帖子”或“X 帖子文案”。对于长格式源，使用 article-content。

name: aws-social-messaging
description: Manages WhatsApp messaging through AWS End User Messaging Social. Covers managing templates (create, update, delete, library), sending messages (utility/marketing/auth templates and freeform), uploading and managing media, configuring event destinations for delivery tracking, and troubleshooting delivery failures. Applicable when a user needs to send WhatsApp messages, create or manage templates, upload media, configure delivery notifications, or diagnose messaging issues.
description_zh: 通过 AWS End User Messaging Social 管理 WhatsApp 消息。涵盖模板管理（创建、更新、删除、库）、消息发送（工具/营销/认证模板和自由格式）、媒体上传与管理、配置交付跟踪的事件目标，以及解决交付失败问题。适用于用户需要发送 WhatsApp 消息、创建或管理模板、上传媒体、配置交付通知或诊断消息问题时。

name: alibabacloud-find-skills
description: Use this skill when users want to search, discover, browse, or find Alibaba Cloud (阿里云) agent skills. Triggers include: "find a skill for X", "search alicloud skills", "阿里云有什么 skill","阿里云", "搜索阿里云技能", "有没有管理 ECS/RDS/OSS 的 skill", "阿里云 skills 有哪些类目", "帮我找一个 skill", "browse alicloud skills", "list alicloud skill categories", "is there an alicloud skill that can...", "what alicloud skills are available", "XX Skill 的内容是什么", "我想了解阿里云 XX Skill 具体做什么","帮我安装阿里云 Skill","使用阿里云相关的skill", "阿里云 agent skill 市场", "搜一下阿里云的 skill", "建一个数据分析项目有没有相关 skill".
description_zh:
当用户想要搜索、发现、浏览或查找阿里云（Alibaba Cloud）代理技能时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：  
"为X找一个技能"、"搜索阿里云技能"、"阿里云有什么技能"、"阿里云"、"搜索阿里云技能"、"有没有管理 ECS/RDS/OSS 的技能"、"阿里云技能有哪些类目"、"帮我找一个技能"、"浏览阿里云技能"、"列出阿里云技能类目"、"有没有阿里云技能能..."、"有哪些阿里云技能可用"、"XX技能的内容是什么"、"我想了解阿里云XX技能具体做什么"、"帮我安装阿里云技能"、"使用阿里云相关技能"、"阿里云代理技能市场"、"搜一下阿里云的技能"、"建一个数据分析项目有没有相关技能"。

name: nextjs-seo
description: Next.js App Router SEO implementation and audits. Use for metadata and social images, sitemap/robots, canonicals and localization, structured data, Core Web Vitals evidence, AI crawler policy or search-indexing diagnosis. Not for general Next.js feature work unrelated to SEO.
description_zh: Next.js 应用路由器 SEO 优化和审核。在 Next.js 应用中实现或修复 SEO 时使用——元数据与 generateMetadata、视口/主题色、Open Graph 和 og/twitter 图片（文件规范 + ImageResponse）、网页应用清单、图标/favicons、sitemap.xml、robots.txt、规范 URL、hreflang/i18n 替代、JSON-LD 结构化数据与丰富结果、核心网页性能（LCP/INP/CLS）、AI 搜索/GEO 和 AI 爬虫规则（GPTBot、OAI-SearchBot），或诊断 Google 索引问题（搜索控制台，“已发现/爬取 - 目前未索引”）。也用于运行 SEO 审核清单。不适用于与 SEO 无关的通用 Next.js 功能工作。

name: seasonal-aso
description: When the user wants to optimize their App Store listing for seasonal events, holidays, or trending moments — including keyword opportunities, metadata updates, screenshot theming, and timing strategy. Use when the user mentions "seasonal", "holiday", "Christmas", "New Year", "Valentine's Day", "summer", "back to school", "seasonal keywords", "trending now", "limited time", or wants to capitalize on a calendar event. For general keyword research, see keyword-research. For full metadata rewrites, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化其App Store列表以适应季节性活动、节假日或热门时刻时——包括关键词机会、元数据更新、截图主题和时机策略。使用此功能时，用户会提及“季节性”、“节假日”、“圣诞节”、“新年”、“情人节”、“夏季”、“返校季”、“季节性关键词”、“正在流行”、“限时”或希望利用日历事件。对于一般关键词研究，请参阅keyword-research。对于完整的元数据重写，请参阅metadata-optimization。

name: verify-this
description: Verify a claim with fresh local evidence: restate it falsifiably, capture baseline and treatment, compare artifacts, and return VERIFIED, NOT VERIFIED, or INCONCLUSIVE.
description_zh: 验证一项声明，使用最新的本地证据：重新陈述其可证伪性，捕捉基线和治疗情况，比较人工制品，并返回“已验证”、“未验证”或“未定论”。

name: favicon-gen
description: Generate custom favicons from logos, text, or brand colours. Produces favicon.svg, favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon.png, icon-192/512.png, and web manifest. Use whenever the user wants a favicon, mentions replacing a CMS default favicon, converting a logo into a favicon, creating branded initials icons, or troubleshooting favicon not displaying / iOS black square / missing manifest.
description_zh: 从标志、文本或品牌颜色生成自定义的 favicons。生成 favicon.svg、favicon.ico、apple-touch-icon.png、icon-192/512.png 和 web manifest。每当用户需要 favicons、提到替换 CMS 默认 favicons、将标志转换为 favicons、创建品牌首字母图标，或解决 favicons 不显示 / iOS 黑色方块 / 缺失 manifest 问题时，均可使用。

name: wechat-binding
description:
WeChat binding: QR scan, bind, unbind, reconnect, status check.

Use when setting up or repairing WeChat delivery (e.g. connect WeChat, scan QR, why isn't WeChat pushing, disconnect WeChat).
description_zh:
微信绑定：扫码、绑定、解绑、重连、状态检查。

用于设置或修复微信发送（例如：连接微信、扫码、为何微信不推送、断开微信连接）。

name: stockbee-episodic-pivot-analyzer
description: Analyze Stockbee-style Day 1 Episodic Pivot candidates from earnings, guidance raises, M&A, FDA/regulatory approvals, analyst actions, major contracts, product launches, short-squeeze catalysts, or theme/story events. Scores catalyst quality together with gap/range expansion, volume shock, neglect/revaluation context, liquidity, and risk to the EP-day low. Use when the user asks for EP candidates, episodic pivots, Day 1 catalyst trades, game-changing news reactions, delayed EP watchlists, or handoffs into PEAD monitoring.
description_zh: 分析来自盈利、指引上调、并购、FDA/监管批准、分析师行动、重大合同、产品发布、短期逼空催化剂或主题/事件驱动等因素的Stockbee风格第一天剧情性转折候选股。将催化剂质量与缺口/区间扩张、成交量冲击、忽视/再评估背景、流动性及对EP日低点的风险进行评分。当用户询问EP候选股、剧情性转折、第一天催化剂交易、颠覆性新闻反应、延迟EP观察名单或转入PEAD监控时使用。

name: visual-edit-precision
description: Use when making UI/frontend changes guided by visual context, when the user selects elements visually, draws annotations, or provides screenshots alongside change requests. Also use when editing components where spatial context (element identity, DOM references, layout data) supplements text instructions.
description_zh: 在以下情况下使用：当进行基于视觉上下文的 UI/前端更改时，当用户通过视觉方式选择元素、绘制注释或随变更请求提供截图时。此外，在编辑组件时，当空间上下文（元素身份、DOM 引用、布局数据）补充文本说明时。

name: prompt-images
description: Prompting techniques for AI image generation and editing models on Replicate. Use when writing prompts for image models or building image generation features.
description_zh: Replicate上AI图像生成和编辑模型的提示技术。在编写图像模型的提示或构建图像生成功能时使用。

name: entity-seo
description: When the user wants to optimize for entity recognition, Knowledge Graph, or entity-based SEO. Also use when the user mentions "entity SEO," "entity optimization," "Knowledge Graph," "Knowledge Panel," "entity signals," "brand entity," "entity linking," "entity relationships," or "entity-first content." For structured data, use schema-markup.
description_zh: 当用户希望优化实体识别、知识图谱或基于实体的SEO时，也使用。当用户提到“实体SEO”、“实体优化”、“知识图谱”、“知识面板”、“实体信号”、“品牌实体”、“实体链接”、“实体关系”或“实体优先内容”时，也使用。对于结构化数据，使用schema标记。

name: om-auto-review-pr
description: Review or re-review a PR by number in an isolated worktree. Runs the `om-code-review` skill — or, for spec-only design PRs, a specification review — submits approve/request-changes, manages pipeline labels. On changes-requested, the autofix loop (fix/test/validate/re-review until merge-ready) runs on the automation's own PRs or with --autofix; other authors' PRs get review + handoff only. Usage - /om-auto-review-pr <PR-number> [--autofix]
description_zh: 在隔离的工作树中通过编号审查或重新审查一个PR。运行`om-code-review`技能——或者，对于仅涉及规范的PR，运行规范审查——提交批准/请求修改，管理管道标签。在请求修改时，自动修复循环（修复/测试/验证/重新审查直到可以合并）将在自动化自己的PR上运行或使用`--autofix`；其他作者的PR仅进行审查和交接。使用方法 - `/om-auto-review-pr <PR编号> [--autofix]`

name: stockbee-setup-fluency-trainer
description: Build a Stockbee-style setup model book from momentum-burst screener candidates, then update 3-day and 5-day forward outcomes with MFE/MAE, stop-hit status, outcome tags, and cohort statistics. Use when the user wants to study Stockbee Momentum Burst examples, track failed candidates, build setup fluency, review A/B setup quality, or convert screener outputs into a learning loop rather than immediate trade signals.
description_zh: 构建一个Stockbee风格的设置模型手册，从动量爆发筛选器候选者开始，然后使用MFE/MAE更新3天和5天未来结果，包括止损状态、结果标签和队列统计数据。当用户希望研究Stockbee动量爆发示例、追踪失败候选者、建立设置熟练度、审查A/B设置质量，或把筛选器输出转化为学习循环而非即时交易信号时使用。

name: wp-abilities-verify
description: Verify a WordPress plugin's Abilities API registrations: enumerate abilities, check that callback behavior matches each annotation's claim (the adversarial readonly-but-writes detection), validate permissions and schemas, and validate audit documents produced by wp-abilities-audit.
description_zh: 验证 WordPress 插件的能力 API 注册：枚举能力，检查回调行为是否与每个注解的声明相匹配（对抗性只读但写入检测），验证权限和模式，并验证 wp-abilities-audit 生成的审计文档。

name: control-ui
description: Build or adapt a local browser/CDP harness to drive and inspect a web, IDE, or Electron UI. Use for local UI verification, screenshots, accessibility snapshots, perf profiles, visual diffs, or reproducing UI bugs.
description_zh: 构建或适配本地浏览器/CDP 托架，用于驱动和检查网页、IDE 或 Electron UI。用于本地 UI 验证、截图、可访问性快照、性能分析、视觉差异或复现 UI 错误。

name: check-compiler-errors
description: Run compile and type-check commands and report failures
description_zh: 运行编译和类型检查命令，并报告失败

name: pricing-strategy
description: Help users validate willingness-to-pay, select the right value metrics, and continuously optimize pricing and packaging to drive growth.
description_zh: 帮助用户验证支付意愿，选择合适的价值指标，并持续优化定价和包装以推动增长。

name: weekly-review
description: Produce a weekly synthesis of authored commits with highlights by bugfix, tech debt, and net-new work
description_zh: 生成每周撰写的提交摘要，并突出显示错误修复、技术债务和全新工作。

name: uv
description: Checks whether the uv Python package manager is installed and installs it if missing. Ensures uv is on PATH. Use when another skill requires uv as a prerequisite.
description_zh: 检查uv Python包管理器是否已安装，如果缺失则进行安装。确保uv在PATH路径中。当其他技能需要uv作为先决条件时使用。

name: stockbee-exhaustion-hammer-screener
description: Screen US stocks for Stockbee-style selling-exhaustion hammer setups using prior momentum, pullback depth, undercut/reclaim, long lower-wick geometry, close-location, volume confirmation, quality/liquidity gates, and risk-distance scoring. Use when the user asks for Stockbee, Pradeep Bonde, exhaustion setup, selling exhaustion, hammer reversal, undercut reclaim, near-close reversal candidates, or pullback entries in high-quality funds-owned stocks.
description_zh: 为Stockbee风格的卖出竭尽锤形形态筛选美国股市，需结合前期动能、回调深度、下探/回补、长下影线几何形态、收盘位置、成交量确认、质/流动性门槛以及风险距离评分。当用户要求Stockbee、Pradeep Bonde、竭尽形态、卖出竭尽、锤形反转、下探回补、近收盘反转候选或高质量基金控股股票的回调入场时使用。

name: antfu-design
description: antfu-style design conventions, broadened. UnoCSS-first, class-based semantic tokens with dual light/dark for tooling and devtools UIs, plus design-read, anti-slop, and micro-interaction polish for landing pages and product surfaces. Use when building or refactoring any interface with UnoCSS.
description_zh: antfu 风格的设计规范，已扩展。以 UnoCSS 优先，采用基于类的语义化 token，支持双光/暗模式以适应工具和开发工具界面，并为落地页和产品界面提供设计可读性、防滑移和微交互的优化。在构建或重构任何使用 UnoCSS 的界面时使用。

name: writing-evals
description: Scaffolds evaluation suites for the Axiom AI SDK. Generates eval files, scorers, flag schemas, and config from natural-language descriptions. Use when creating evals, writing scorers, setting up flag schemas, or configuring axiom.config.ts.
description_zh: 为Axiom AI SDK评估套件创建脚手架。根据自然语言描述生成评估文件、评分器、标志模式以及配置文件。在创建评估、编写评分器、设置标志模式或配置 axiom.config.ts 文件时使用。

name: workflow-skill-creator
description: Distills a completed user workflow or interaction into a reusable agent skill. Use when the user asks to turn their workflow, interaction, or multi-step process into a skill, or when they say "make this a skill", "create a skill from what we just did", "package this workflow" or similar. Do not use for creating skills from scratch without an existing workflow (use a generic skill-creator for that).

name: press-and-pr
