description_zh: 在准备或验证用于Moshi远程编码的主机时使用。为Easy Pair主机设置、SSH或更优选的Mosh就绪、非交互式shell PATH问题、推荐使用Herdr（首选）或tmux作为代理复用器、创建以选定目录为根的项目会话、通过`MOSHI_CLIENT`环境信号调整shell或复用器行为、为Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Grok Build和其他支持代理安装Moshi代理钩子，或使用打包的`moshi DIR`启动器时，请触发此功能。

name: new-branch-and-pr
description: Create a fresh branch, complete work, and open a pull request
description_zh: 创建一个新分支，完成工作，并打开一个拉取请求

name: firecrawl-dashboard-reporting
description: Pull metrics from analytics dashboards and internal web tools with Firecrawl browser. Use when the user needs dashboard reporting, cross-platform metric summaries, authenticated analytics extraction, date-range reports, or structured metrics from web dashboards.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器从分析仪表板和内部网络工具中提取指标。当用户需要仪表板报告、跨平台指标摘要、认证分析提取、日期范围报告或来自网络仪表板的结构化指标时使用。

name: spring-boot-testing
description: Expert Spring Boot 4 testing specialist that selects the best Spring Boot testing techniques for your situation with Junit 6 and AssertJ.
description_zh: 精通 Spring Boot 4 测试的专业人士，能够根据您的具体情况选择最佳的 Spring Boot 测试技术，并结合 Junit 6 和 AssertJ。

name: scientific-visualization
description: Create and audit truthful, accessible, publication-ready scientific figures with Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly. Use for figure design, multi-panel layouts, uncertainty and missing-data displays, color/contrast review, image metadata validation, and journal export planning.
description_zh: 使用 Matplotlib、Seaborn 或 Plotly 创建和审核真实、易访问、适合发表的科技图表。用于图表设计、多面板布局、不确定性及缺失数据展示、色彩/对比度审查、图像元数据验证以及期刊导出规划。

name: youtube-summarizer
description: Extract transcripts from YouTube videos and generate comprehensive, detailed summaries using intelligent analysis frameworks
description_zh: 从 YouTube 视频中提取文本记录，并使用智能分析框架生成全面、详细的摘要

name: pol-probe
description: Define a Proof of Life probe to test a risky hypothesis cheaply. Use when you need harsh truth before building real product.
description_zh: 定义一个“生命证明”（Proof of Life）探测，以低成本测试一个高风险假设。在构建实际产品之前，当你需要残酷的真相时使用。

name: firecrawl-knowledge-ingest
description: Ingest public or authenticated knowledge bases and docs portals with Firecrawl browser. Use for JS-heavy docs, login-gated portals, paginated help centers, support knowledge bases, or structured JSON/markdown extraction from documentation sites.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器摄取公共或经过身份验证的知识库和文档门户。适用于 JS 重的文档、需要登录的门户、分页的帮助中心、支持知识库，或从文档网站提取结构化的 JSON/Markdown。

name: firecrawl-market-research
description: Extract market, financial, earnings, industry, and company metrics with Firecrawl. Use when the user asks for market research, industry trends, public company data, financial comparisons, earnings research, or structured market reports.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 提取市场、金融、盈利、行业和公司指标。当用户询问市场研究、行业趋势、上市公司数据、金融比较、盈利研究或结构化市场报告时使用。

name: latex-formatting
description: Handle LaTeX formatting, templates, and styling for academic papers. Set up conference templates (ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS, AAAI, ACL), fix formatting issues, manage packages, and ensure venue-specific compliance. Use when the user needs to set up a paper template, fix LaTeX formatting, or prepare for submission.
description_zh: 处理学术论文的LaTeX格式、模板和样式。设置会议模板（ICML、ICLR、NeurIPS、AAAI、ACL），修复格式问题，管理软件包，并确保符合特定会议要求。当用户需要设置论文模板、修复LaTeX格式或准备投稿时使用。

name: hermes-tweet
description: Install and operate Hermes Tweet, a Hermes Agent plugin for X/Twitter research, timeline reading, tweet analysis, and approval-gated private or state-changing operations. Use this skill when installing Hermes Tweet, researching X/Twitter accounts, monitoring launch signals, investigating mentions, auditing giveaways, or preparing gated X operations. Use proactively when a Hermes Agent workflow needs current X/Twitter context. Requires XQUIK_API_KEY for read and action tools.
description_zh: 安装并操作Hermes Tweet，这是一个用于X/Twitter研究的Hermes Agent插件，可用于时间线阅读、推文分析以及需要审批的私密操作或状态变更操作。在安装Hermes Tweet、研究X/Twitter账号、监测发布信号、调查提及、审核赠品或准备需要审批的X操作时，请使用此技能。当Hermes Agent工作流程需要当前的X/Twitter上下文时，请主动使用。读取和操作工具需要XQUIK_API_KEY。

name: fetch-and-send-data
description: Call APIs, load data into components, and handle the async lifecycle in Blazor. USE FOR fetching data from a backend, submitting data to an API, displaying loading/error states, registering HttpClient, building service abstractions for Auto/WebAssembly render modes. DO NOT USE for form validation (see collect-user-input), prerendering persistence (see support-prerendering), or project scaffolding (see create-blazor-project).
description_zh: 调用 API，将数据加载到组件中，并处理 Blazor 中的异步生命周期。用于从后端获取数据、向 API 提交数据、显示加载/错误状态、注册 HttpClient、为 Auto/WebAssembly 渲染模式构建服务抽象。不应用于表单验证（请参阅 collect-user-input）、预渲染持久化（请参阅 support-prerendering）或项目脚手架（请参阅 create-blazor-project）。

name: agent-email-cli
description: Operate the agent-email CLI to create disposable inboxes, poll for new mail, retrieve full message details, and manage local mailbox profiles. Use when the user needs terminal-based email inbox access for LLM or agent automation workflows.
description_zh: 使用 agent-email CLI 创建一次性邮箱、轮询新邮件、获取完整消息详情以及管理本地邮箱配置。当用户需要基于终端的邮箱访问以用于 LLM 或代理自动化工作流时使用。

name: laravel-best-practices
description: Laravel 13 conventions and best practices. Use when creating controllers, models, migrations, validation, services, or structuring Laravel applications. Triggers on tasks involving Laravel architecture, Eloquent, database, API development, or PHP patterns.
description_zh: Laravel 13 的约定和最佳实践。在创建控制器、模型、迁移、验证、服务或构建 Laravel 应用程序时使用。涉及 Laravel 架构、Eloquent、数据库、API 开发或 PHP 模式的任务触发。

name: build-clusters
description: Build a topical authority cluster from a seed keyword or topic. Use when the user asks about topic clusters, content silos, pillar pages, topical authority, content architecture, or how to structure content around a theme. For finding the right keywords, see find-keywords. For writing individual pieces, see brief.
description_zh: 从种子关键词或主题构建一个主题权威集群。当用户询问主题集群、内容隔间、支柱页面、主题权威、内容架构或如何围绕主题构建内容时使用。要查找合适的关键词，请参阅 find-keywords。要撰写单个文章，请参阅 brief。

name: cot-contrarian-detector
description: Detect crowded speculative positioning in CFTC futures markets (COT report analysis) to find contrarian setups using Jason Shapiro's methodology. Screens large-speculator ("non-commercial") net positioning across 65 futures markets (indices, rates, FX, metals, energy, crypto) via the FMP Commitment of Traders API, computes a 3-year and 26-week COT Index per market, and classifies extremes as CROWDED_LONG / CROWDED_SHORT. Use when the user asks about COT report analysis, crowded positioning, "who is trapped", speculative positioning extremes, contrarian futures setups, or wants to run Jason Shapiro-style analysis. This skill automates crowding DETECTION only (step 1 of 5) — it does not generate trade signals by itself.
description_zh: 检测CFTC期货市场中的拥挤投机性头寸（COT报告分析），使用Jason Shapiro的方法寻找逆势交易机会。通过FMP交易商持仓报告API，对65个期货市场（指数、利率、外汇、金属、能源、加密货币）的大型投机者（“非商业”）净头寸进行筛选，计算每个市场的3年及26周COT指数，并将极端情况分类为CROWDED_LONG / CROWDED_SHORT。当用户询问COT报告分析、拥挤头寸、谁被套牢、投机头寸极端情况、逆势期货交易机会，或希望运行Jason Shapiro风格分析时使用。此技能仅自动化拥挤检测（第1步，共5步）——它本身不生成交易信号。

name: poster-design-generation
description: Generate professional poster designs using each::sense AI. Create movie posters, event posters, motivational posters, product launch visuals, vintage designs, travel posters, and more with AI-powered creative generation.
description_zh: 使用 each::sense AI 生成专业的海报设计。利用 AI 驱动的创意生成功能，您可以制作电影海报、活动海报、励志海报、产品发布视觉设计、复古设计、旅行海报等。

name: firecrawl-demo-walkthrough
description: Walk through a product's key flows with Firecrawl browser and produce a structured UX/product walkthrough. Use for signup, onboarding, pricing, docs, dashboard, product demo prep, UX teardown, and first-run experience analysis.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器逐步浏览产品的关键流程，并生成结构化的用户体验/产品演示。适用于注册、引导、定价、文档、仪表盘、产品演示准备、用户体验拆解和首次运行体验分析。

name: serenity-skill
description: Research technology and advanced-manufacturing investments using Serenity-inspired supply-chain bottleneck analysis. Use for theme scans, company thesis challenges, candidate comparisons, or learning this method. Prioritize A-shares unless another market is requested. Return research priorities, dated evidence, profit implications, and conditions that would change the judgment.

name: netlify-mcp-servers
description: Build, deploy, and secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers on Netlify. Use whenever the task involves creating an MCP server, exposing an app or API to AI agents as MCP tools, letting Claude / Cursor / Claude Code call a custom remote server, or adding MCP tools to an existing Netlify site. Covers the MCP SDK + Streamable HTTP transport on a Netlify Function, authentication (single shared secret vs per-user API keys with Netlify Identity), read/write safety, file uploads, and connecting clients. Use even when the user just says "MCP", "tool server for an agent", or "let an AI use my API".
description_zh: 在 Netlify 上构建、部署和保障 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器。每当任务涉及创建 MCP 服务器、将应用程序或 API 作为 MCP 工具暴露给 AI 代理、让 Claude / Cursor / Claude Code 调用自定义远程服务器，或向现有 Netlify 网站添加 MCP 工具时，均可使用。涵盖 MCP SDK + Streamable HTTP 传输在 Netlify Function 上的实现、认证（共享密钥与 Netlify Identity 的用户级 API 密钥）、读写安全、文件上传以及客户端连接。即使用户仅说“MCP”、“为代理创建工具服务器”或“让 AI 使用我的 API”时，也可使用。

name: futures-position-sizer
description: Calculate contract-based futures position sizes from a direction, entry, and stop-loss, using verified per-symbol contract specs (multiplier, tick size, tick value). Use when the user asks how many futures contracts to trade, wants to size a futures position (ES, NQ, ZB, GC, CL, 6E/E6, VX, BT, ...), or is handing off a contrarian-setup-gate READY_FOR_PLAN direction/invalidation_level for sizing. Pure, offline calculation -- no API keys, no network.
description_zh: 根据方向、入场点和止损点，计算基于合约的期货仓位大小，使用经过验证的每个合约的规格（乘数、最小变动价位、最小变动价值）。在用户询问要交易多少份期货合约、想要调整期货仓位大小（ES、NQ、ZB、GC、CL、6E/E6、VX、BT、...）或传递反手套利设置（READY_FOR_PLAN方向/无效化水平）以调整仓位大小时使用。纯离线计算——无需API密钥，无需网络。

name: user-story-mapping-workshop
description: Run a user story mapping workshop with adaptive questions and a structured map output. Use when you need backbone activities, tasks, and release slices for a workflow.
description_zh: 运行一个用户故事映射工作坊，使用自适应问题并生成结构化的映射输出。当你需要为工作流程制定骨干活动、任务和发布切片时使用。

name: sentry-flutter-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Flutter and Dart. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Flutter", "install sentry_flutter", "setup Sentry in Dart", or configure error monitoring, tracing, profiling, session replay, or logging for Flutter applications. Supports Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and Web.
description_zh: Flutter和Dart的完整Sentry SDK设置。当被要求“将Sentry添加到Flutter”、“安装sentry_flutter”、“在Dart中设置Sentry”或为Flutter应用程序配置错误监控、跟踪、分析、会话回放或日志记录时使用。支持Android、iOS、macOS、Linux、Windows和Web。

name: pol-probe-advisor
description: Select the right Proof of Life (PoL) probe based on hypothesis, risk, and resources. Use this to match the validation method to the real learning goal, not tooling comfort.
description_zh: 根据假设、风险和资源，选择合适的生命体征证明（PoL）探针。利用此方法将验证方法与实际学习目标相匹配，而不是工具的舒适度。

name: firecrawl-lead-research
description: Produce pre-meeting lead intelligence briefs with Firecrawl. Use when the user needs company research, person research, recent news, talking points, pain points, or outreach preparation before a sales call, partnership meeting, investor conversation, or customer interview.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 生成会议前的预调研情报简报。当用户需要在销售电话、合作会议、投资者对话或客户访谈前进行公司研究、人员研究、近期新闻、讨论要点、痛点分析或外联准备时使用。

name: prisma-orm-setup
description: Set up Prisma ORM in an application, connect its database, or troubleshoot the connection of an existing Prisma 6, 7, or 8 app. Defaults new applications to Prisma ORM 8 and loads the package-owned prisma-8 skill; keeps existing Prisma 6/7 apps on their version with provider references for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, CockroachDB, MongoDB, and Prisma Postgres.

name: recover-content
description: Diagnose and reverse traffic loss on existing pages. Use when the user asks about content decay, pages losing traffic, declining rankings, traffic drops, why a page stopped ranking, content refresh strategy, or when to consolidate vs redirect old content. For creating new content, see brief.
description_zh: 诊断并逆转现有页面的流量损失。当用户询问内容衰减、页面流量流失、排名下降、流量骤降、页面为何停止排名、内容更新策略，或何时整合而非重定向旧内容时使用。创建新内容请参考简报。

name: dali-dynamic-mode
description: DALI imperative dynamic mode (`nvidia.dali.experimental.dynamic`, ndd): use when working on ndd code or migrating pipelines; skip pipeline-only tasks.
description_zh: DALI 命令式动态模式 (`nvidia.dali.experimental.dynamic`, ndd)：在处理 ndd 代码或迁移管道时使用；跳过仅针对管道的任务。

name: news-reaction-failure-analyzer
description: Judge whether a market FAILED to react to news favorable to a crowded speculative position — step 2 of Jason Shapiro's COT contrarian process. Consumes a cot-contrarian-detector report (or an explicit direction) plus a Claude-curated events JSON, fetches the underlying price series with a documented fallback chain, and produces a fail-closed CONFIRMED / NOT_CONFIRMED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict using a statistically validated drift-significance test (not a naive failure-ratio, which false-confirms on pure noise). Generic beyond COT — reusable for PEAD and macro-crowding news-failure checks. Use when the user asks to check news-failure confirmation, whether a crowded market "shrugged off" good/bad news, or wants to run Shapiro step 2 on a CROWDED_LONG/CROWDED_SHORT market.
description_zh: 判断市场是否未能对利好消息作出反应——这是杰森·沙皮罗COT逆势检测流程的第2步。该流程消耗cot-contrarian-detector报告（或明确的指示）以及Claude整理的事件JSON，通过记录在案的备用链获取底层价格序列，并使用经过统计验证的漂移显著性测试（而非简单的失败率，后者会在纯噪声上产生误报）生成fail-closed的CONFIRMED / NOT_CONFIRMED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE判定结果。其通用性超越COT——可用于PEAD和宏观拥挤新闻失效检测。当用户要求检查新闻失效确认、判断拥挤市场是否“无视”利好/利空消息，或希望对CROWDED_LONG/CROWDED_SHORT市场运行沙皮罗第2步时使用。

name: rest-api-design
description: Design RESTful APIs following best practices for resource modeling, HTTP methods, status codes, versioning, and documentation. Use when creating new APIs, designing endpoints, or improving existing API architecture.
description_zh: 遵循资源建模、HTTP方法、状态码、版本控制和文档的最佳实践来设计RESTful API。在创建新API、设计端点或改进现有API架构时使用。

name: firecrawl-lead-gen
description: Generate structured lead lists from prospect databases and web directories with Firecrawl browser. Use for finding prospects by role, company type, industry, stage, location, technologies, or other criteria and exporting CRM-ready JSON or CSV.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 浏览器从潜在客户数据库和网络目录中生成结构化的潜在客户名单。可用于按角色、公司类型、行业、阶段、地理位置、技术或其他标准查找潜在客户，并导出 CRM 兼容的 JSON 或 CSV 文件。

name: bullmq-specialist
description: BullMQ expert for Redis-backed job queues, background processing, and reliable async execution in Node.js/TypeScript applications.
description_zh: BullMQ专家，用于Redis后端任务队列、后台处理以及Node.js/TypeScript应用程序中的可靠异步执行。

name: astro-framework
description: Astro framework specialist for building fast, content-driven websites with islands architecture. Use when creating Astro components, configuring hydration (client:load/idle/visible/media), using server:defer (server islands), Content Layer API (glob/file loaders, live loaders), sessions, astro:env, i18n routing, actions, SSR adapters, view transitions, or integrating React/Vue/Svelte/Solid. Not for full-SPA frameworks (Next.js, Remix, SvelteKit).
description_zh: 构建基于岛屿架构的快速、内容驱动型网站的 Astro 框架专家。在创建 Astro 组件、配置水合（客户端：加载/空闲/可见/媒体）、使用服务器延迟（服务器岛屿）、内容层 API（glob/文件加载器、实时加载器）、会话、astro:env、国际化路由、操作、SSR 适配器、视图过渡或集成 React/Vue/Svelte/Solid 时使用。不适用于全 SPA 框架（Next.js、Remix、SvelteKit）。

name: acquire-codebase-knowledge
description: Use this skill when the user explicitly asks to map, document, or onboard into an existing codebase. Trigger for prompts like "map this codebase", "document this architecture", "onboard me to this repo", or "create codebase docs". Do not trigger for routine feature implementation, bug fixes, or narrow code edits unless the user asks for repository-level discovery.
description_zh: 在用户明确要求映射、文档化或接入现有代码库时使用此技能。对于类似“映射这个代码库”、“文档化这个架构”、“让我接入这个仓库”或“创建代码库文档”的提示应触发。除非用户要求仓库级别的发现，否则不应用于常规功能实现、错误修复或狭窄的代码编辑。

name: substance-3d-texturing
description: Comprehensive skill for Adobe Substance 3D Painter texturing and material creation workflow. Use this skill when creating PBR materials, exporting textures for web/game engines, optimizing 3D assets for real-time rendering, or automating texture workflows. Triggers on tasks involving Substance 3D Painter, PBR texturing, material creation, texture export for Three.js, Babylon.js, Unity, Unreal, glTF optimization, or Python API automation. Creates optimized textures for threejs-webgl, react-three-fiber, and babylonjs-engine materials.
description_zh:
```text
适用于 Adobe Substance 3D Painter 材质绘制与材质创建工作流的综合性技能。在创建 PBR 材质、为 Web/游戏引擎导出贴图、优化 3D 资产以适配实时渲染，或自动化贴图工作流时使用该技能。当任务涉及 Substance 3D Painter、PBR 贴图制作、材质创建、面向 Three.js、Babylon.js、Unity、Unreal 的贴图导出、glTF 优化或 Python API 自动化时触发。为 threejs-webgl、react-three-fiber 及 babylonjs-engine 的材质创建经过优化的贴图。
```

name: confluence
description: Confluence integration. Manage document management data, records, and workflows. Use when the user wants to interact with Confluence data.
description_zh: Confluence 集成。管理文档管理数据、记录和工作流。当用户想要与 Confluence 数据交互时使用。

name: architecture-diagram
description: Create polished dark-themed architecture diagrams as self-contained HTML+SVG files. Use when the user asks for system, infrastructure, cloud, security, or network topology diagrams.
description_zh: 创建精致的暗色主题架构图，以自包含的HTML+SVG文件形式呈现。当用户要求系统、基础设施、云、安全或网络拓扑图时使用。

name: run-smoke-tests
description: Run Playwright smoke tests, debug failures, and verify fixes
description_zh: 运行 Playwright 测试，调试失败，并验证修复

name: fundraising
description: Help users navigate the end-to-end lifecycle of funding a startup, from choosing between bootstrapping and VC to closing a Series A or managing a strategic exit.
description_zh: 帮助用户了解初创企业融资的端到端生命周期，从选择自筹资金和风险投资之间进行抉择，到完成A轮融资或管理战略性退出。

name: wiki-digest
description: Generate a periodic knowledge digest — a human-readable newsletter-style summary of what was learned, updated, and connected in your wiki over a specified period (day/week/month). Use when the user says "what did I learn this week", "give me a digest", "weekly summary", "knowledge report", "what's new in my wiki", "/wiki-digest [period]", "summarize my recent learning", or wants a readable overview of recent wiki activity. Distinct from wiki-status (which reports ingestion delta of sources) — wiki-digest summarizes *knowledge*, not sources.
description_zh: 生成周期性知识摘要——一种人类可读的简报式总结，概述在指定时间段（日/周/月）内你在维基中学到的、更新的和连接的内容。当用户说“这周我学到了什么”、“给我一份摘要”、“周度总结”、“知识报告”、“我的维基有什么新内容”、“/wiki-digest [时间段]”、“总结我最近的学习”或需要维基近期活动的可读概览时使用。与维基状态（报告来源的摄入增量）不同——维基摘要总结的是*知识*，而不是来源。

name: firecrawl-qa
description: QA test a live website with Firecrawl browser and scrape evidence. Use when the user wants exploratory QA, form testing, navigation/link checks, responsive checks, performance observations, bug reports, or a pre-launch quality review.
description_zh: 使用Firecrawl浏览器对实时网站进行QA测试并抓取证据。当用户需要进行探索性QA、表单测试、导航/链接检查、响应式检查、性能观察、错误报告或发布前质量审查时使用。

name: doc-coauthoring
description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.
description_zh: 引导用户通过结构化的工作流程共同撰写文档。当用户想要撰写文档、提案、技术规格、决策文档或类似结构化内容时使用。此工作流程帮助用户高效地传递背景信息，通过迭代优化内容，并验证文档对读者的适用性。当用户提及撰写文档、创建提案、起草规格或类似文档任务时触发。

name: computer-automation
description:
Vision-driven desktop automation using Midscene. Control your local desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) or a remote Windows desktop over RDP with natural language commands.
Operates entirely from screenshots — no DOM or accessibility labels required. Can interact with all visible elements on screen regardless of technology stack.

⚠️ In local mode this takes over the user's real mouse and keyboard. For web apps, prefer "Browser Automation" instead.
Only use this for desktop-native apps (Electron, Qt, native macOS/Windows/Linux) that cannot run in a browser, or for driving a remote Windows host via RDP.

Triggers: open app, press key, desktop, computer, click on screen, type text, screenshot desktop,
launch application, switch window, desktop automation, control computer, mouse click, keyboard shortcut,
screen capture, find on screen, read screen, verify window, close app, test Electron app,
rdp, remote desktop, windows server, connect via rdp

Powered by Midscene.js (https://midscenejs.com)
description_zh:
使用 Midscene 实现视觉驱动的桌面自动化。通过自然语言命令控制本地桌面（macOS、Windows、Linux）或经由 RDP 连接远程 Windows 桌面。

完全基于屏幕截图运行——无需 DOM 或无障碍标签。可交互屏幕上所有可见元素，无论其底层技术栈为何。

⚠️ 在本地模式下，此工具将接管用户真实的鼠标和键盘。对于 Web 应用，请优先使用“浏览器自动化”。
仅将此工具用于无法在浏览器中运行的桌面原生应用（Electron、Qt、原生 macOS/Windows/Linux 应用），或用于通过 RDP 控制远程 Windows 主机。

触发词：打开应用，按键，桌面，电脑，点击屏幕，输入文本，截取桌面屏幕，启动应用程序，切换窗口，桌面自动化，控制电脑，鼠标点击，键盘快捷键，屏幕截图，在屏幕上查找，读取屏幕，验证窗口，关闭应用，测试 Electron 应用，rdp，远程桌面，Windows 服务器，通过 rdp 连接

由 Midscene.js 提供技术支持（https://midscenejs.com）

name: blender-mcp
description: Blender MCP expert for scene inspection, Python scripting, GLTF export, and material/animation extraction. Activate when: (1) using Blender MCP tools (get_scene_info, execute_python, screenshot, etc.), (2) writing Blender Python scripts for extraction or manipulation, (3) exporting scenes to GLTF/GLB for web (Three.js, R3F), (4) debugging material or texture export losses, (5) optimizing GLB files with gltf-transform, (6) using asset integrations (PolyHaven, Sketchfab, Hyper3D Rodin, Hunyuan3D). Covers critical export gotchas, material mapping survival, texture optimization pipeline, headless CLI patterns, and known failure modes.
description_zh: Blender MCP场景检查、Python脚本编写、GLTF导出及材质/动画提取专家。在以下情况时激活：(1) 使用Blender MCP工具（如get_scene_info、execute_python、screenshot等），(2) 编写用于提取或操作的Blender Python脚本，(3) 将场景导出为GLTF/GLB用于网页（Three.js、R3F），(4) 调试材质或纹理导出丢失问题，(5) 使用gltf-transform优化GLB文件，(6) 使用资源集成（PolyHaven、Sketchfab、Hyper3D Rodin、 Hunyuan3D）。涵盖关键导出注意事项、材质映射生存技巧、纹理优化流程、无头CLI模式及已知故障模式。

name: workflow-from-chats
description: Extract durable working preferences from recent Cursor chats and convert them into skills, rules, or workflow docs. Use when asked to learn preferences, mine feedback, personalize workflows, or generate team/person-specific agent guidance.
description_zh: 从最近的Cursor聊天中提取耐用的工作偏好，并将其转换为技能、规则或工作流文档。在需要学习偏好、挖掘反馈、个性化工作流或生成团队/个人特定代理指导时使用。

name: godot-best-practices
description: Guide AI agents through Godot 4.x GDScript coding best practices including scene organization, signals, resources, state machines, and performance optimization. This skill should be used when generating GDScript code, creating Godot scenes, designing game architecture, implementing state machines, object pooling, save/load systems, or when the user asks about Godot patterns, node structure, or GDScript standards. Keywords: godot, gdscript, game development, signals, resources, scenes, nodes, state machine, object pooling, save system, autoload, export, type hints.
description_zh: 指导 AI 代理遵循 Godot 4.x 的 GDScript 编码最佳实践，包括场景组织、信号、资源、状态机以及性能优化。这项技能应在生成 GDScript 代码、创建 Godot 场景、设计游戏架构、实现状态机、对象池、存档/加载系统，或用户询问 Godot 模式、节点结构或 GDScript 标准时使用。关键词：godot、gdscript、游戏开发、信号、资源、场景、节点、状态机、对象池、存档系统、autoload、导出、类型提示。

name: pinterest-posts
description: When the user wants to create Pinterest Pins, optimize Pin descriptions, or grow Pinterest presence. Also use when the user mentions "Pinterest," "Pin," "Pinterest SEO," "Pinterest description," "Pinterest board," or "Pinterest marketing." For asset specs, use visual-content.

name: user-flow-diagram
description: Diagram screen-level paths, decision points, and branch logic. Use when specifying how a feature is traversed. For the emotional end-to-end arc, use `journey-map` (design-research).
description_zh: 绘制屏幕级别的路径、决策点和分支逻辑。在指定功能如何被遍历时使用。对于情感端到端弧线，使用 `journey-map`（设计研究）。

name: firecrawl-seo-audit
description: Audit a website's SEO with Firecrawl. Use when the user asks for an SEO audit, metadata and heading review, sitemap/site-structure analysis, keyword opportunities, competitor SERP comparison, or prioritized search optimization recommendations.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 对网站进行 SEO 审计。当用户要求进行 SEO 审计、元数据和标题审查、站点地图/站点结构分析、关键词机会、竞争对手搜索结果页面比较或优先级搜索优化建议时使用。

name: docs-write
description: Write documentation following Metabase's conversational, clear, and user-focused style. Use when creating or editing documentation files (markdown, MDX, etc.).
description_zh: 遵循 Metabase 的对话式、清晰且以用户为中心的风格编写文档。在创建或编辑文档文件（如 markdown、MDX 等）时使用。

name: contrarian-setup-gate
description: Synthesize the three Jason Shapiro contrarian-pipeline verdicts (COT crowding, news-reaction failure, weekly price-action confirmation) into one actionable setup_status via a fail-closed precedence state machine. Pure, offline synthesis -- no network, no API keys, no computation beyond validation and precedence.
description_zh: 将Jason Shapiro的三种逆势管道判断标准（COT拥挤、新闻反应失效、周线价格行为确认）整合为一个可操作的setup_status，通过一个故障关闭的优先级状态机实现。纯粹、离线的合成——无需网络，无需API密钥，计算仅限于验证和优先级。

name: firecrawl-research-papers
description: Find and synthesize research papers, whitepapers, PDFs, technical reports, and academic sources with Firecrawl Research, using semantic paper search, related-paper expansion, and in-body verification over Firecrawl's paper index — largely biomedical and life-science literature from PubMed, bioRxiv, and medRxiv, plus arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math. Use when the user wants a literature review, systematic review, survey of studies, paper summary, research landscape, or sourced synthesis from scholarly and industry publications, including clinical, drug, gene, disease, epidemiology, and public-health topics. Prefer this over a general web-research workflow whenever the evidence base is published papers rather than web pages.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl Research 查找并整合研究论文、白皮书、PDF 文件、技术报告和学术资源，通过语义论文搜索、相关论文扩展以及在 Firecrawl 论文索引中的体内验证——主要涵盖 PubMed、bioRxiv 和 medRxiv 的生物医学和生命科学文献，以及 CS、物理和数学领域的 arXiv 预印本。当用户需要文献综述、系统综述、研究调查、论文摘要、研究格局或来自学术和行业出版物（包括临床、药物、基因、疾病、流行病学和公共卫生主题）的资料综合时，请使用此功能。在证据基础为已发表论文而非网页时，优先选择此功能，而非通用的网络研究工作流程。

name: eol-message
description: Write a right-sized EOL announcement — brief notice through full phased comms — with rationale, customer impact, and next steps. Use when retiring a product, feature, or plan.
description_zh: 撰写一个规模适中的EOL公告——通过简短通知到分阶段沟通——需包含理由、客户影响和后续步骤。在退役产品、功能或计划时使用。

name: data-visualization
description: Select chart types and design data encodings — marks, axes, labels, and accessible chart styling. Use when presenting data graphically. Owns chart selection and encoding only; the categorical colour ramp itself belongs to `color-system`.
description_zh: 选择图表类型并设计数据编码——标记、坐标轴、标签和可访问的图表样式。用于图形化展示数据。仅拥有图表选择和编码；类别色彩渐变本身属于 `color-system`。

name: engineering-advanced-skills
description: Index of 37 advanced engineering agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenClaw. Use when browsing or choosing among the POWERFUL-tier engineering skills: agent design, RAG, MCP servers, CI/CD, database design, observability, security auditing, changelog/release automation, reliability (SLO/chaos/flags/operators), platform ops.
description_zh: 37项高级工程智能体技能索引，适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 和 OpenClaw。在浏览或从“强力”（POWERFUL）级别的工程技能中进行选择时使用：包括智能体设计、RAG、MCP 服务器、CI/CD、数据库设计、可观测性、安全审计、变更日志/发布自动化、可靠性（SLO/混沌工程/特性开关/Operator）以及平台运维。

name: audit-xls
description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
description_zh: 对电子表格进行公式准确性、错误和常见错误的审核。可针对选定范围、单个工作表或整个模型进行审核（包括财务模型完整性检查，如资产负债表平衡、现金核对和逻辑合理性）。在以下触发条件下启动审核：“审核此工作表”、“检查我的公式”、“查找公式错误”、“审核此电子表格”、“进行合理性检查”、“调试模型”、“模型检查”、“模型无法平衡”、“我的模型有问题”、“模型评审”。

name: altitude-horizon-framework
description: Understand the PM-to-Director transition through altitude and horizon thinking. Use when diagnosing scope, time-horizon, or leadership-level gaps.
description_zh: 通过高度和视野思维理解从项目经理到总监的转型。在诊断范围、时间视野或领导力层面差距时使用。

name: sentry-svelte-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Svelte and SvelteKit. Use when asked to "add Sentry to Svelte", "add Sentry to SvelteKit", "install @sentry/sveltekit", or configure error monitoring, tracing, session replay, or logging for Svelte or SvelteKit applications.
description_zh: Svelte 和 SvelteKit 的完整 Sentry SDK 设置。当被要求“为 Svelte 添加 Sentry”、“为 SvelteKit 添加 Sentry”、“安装 @sentry/sveltekit”或为 Svelte 或 SvelteKit 应用配置错误监控、跟踪、会话回放或日志记录时使用。

name: openrouter-typescript-sdk
description: Complete reference for integrating with 300+ AI models through the OpenRouter TypeScript SDK using the callModel pattern
description_zh: 通过 OpenRouter TypeScript SDK 使用 callModel 模式集成 300 多个 AI 模型的完整参考

name: redis-security
description: Redis security guidance covering authentication (requirepass and ACL users), TLS, ACL-based least-privilege access control, restricting network exposure via bind and protected-mode, firewall rules, and disabling dangerous commands. Use when deploying Redis to production, defining ACL users for an application, configuring TLS connections, locking down a Redis instance behind a firewall, or auditing a Redis deployment for security hardening.
description_zh: Redis 安全指南涵盖认证（requirepass 和 ACL 用户）、TLS、基于 ACL 的最小权限访问控制、通过 bind 和保护模式限制网络暴露、防火墙规则以及禁用危险命令。在将 Redis 部署到生产环境、为应用程序定义 ACL 用户、配置 TLS 连接、在防火墙后锁定 Redis 实例，或审计 Redis 部署以进行安全加固时使用。

name: wiki-switch
description: Switch between multiple Obsidian wiki vault profiles. Use this skill when the user says "/wiki-switch NAME", "switch to my work wiki", "switch vault", "change wiki", "which wiki am I on", "list my wikis", "show my vaults", "create a new vault config", or "add a new wiki profile". The skill manages named config files at <global config dir>/config.NAME and activates one by symlinking it to <global config dir>/config.
description_zh: 在多个 Obsidian 知识库档案之间切换。当用户说 "/wiki-switch NAME"、"切换到我的工作知识库"、"切换档案"、"更改知识库"、"我在哪个知识库上"、"列出我的知识库"、"显示我的档案"、"创建新的档案配置" 或 "添加新的知识库配置" 时，使用此技能。该技能管理名为 config.NAME 的配置文件，并通过将其符号链接到 <全局配置目录>/config 来激活其中一个。

name: google-search
description: A Google Search API alternative and SERP API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no API key application. Use when the user wants programmatic Google search results as clean JSON, including Google's own operators — site:, filetype:, intitle:, and quoted exact phrases — plus pagination, language (hl), and country/region scoping. Also covers rank tracking input, competitive research, and search-result monitoring without Google's own Custom Search API quota and billing.
description_zh: fetcher.sh 上的一款 Google 搜索 API 替代方案和 SERP API 替代方案 — 按调用付费，使用 USDC 通过 x402 支付，或使用 Bearer 密钥预付费积分，无需申请 API 密钥。当用户需要将 Google 搜索结果以干净的 JSON 格式进行程序化获取时使用，包括 Google 自身的操作符 — site:、filetype:、intitle: 以及引号精确短语 — 还支持分页、语言（hl）和国家/地区范围限制。此外，它还涵盖排名跟踪输入、竞争研究和搜索结果监控，而无需 Google 自家的 Custom Search API 配额和计费。

name: barba-js
description: Page transitions library for creating fluid, smooth transitions between website pages. Use this skill when implementing page transitions, creating SPA-like experiences, adding animated route changes, or building websites with smooth navigation. Triggers on tasks involving Barba.js, page transitions, routing, view management, transition hooks, GSAP integration, or smooth page navigation. Works with gsap-scrolltrigger for transition animations.
description_zh: 页面过渡库，用于在网站页面之间创建流畅、平滑的过渡效果。在实现页面过渡、创建类似SPA的体验、添加动画路由变化或构建具有平滑导航的网站时使用此技能。在涉及Barba.js、页面过渡、路由、视图管理、过渡钩子、GSAP集成或平滑页面导航的任务中触发。可与gsap-scrolltrigger配合使用，实现过渡动画效果。

name: codeql
description: Comprehensive guide for setting up and configuring CodeQL code scanning via GitHub Actions workflows and the CodeQL CLI. This skill should be used when users need help with code scanning configuration, CodeQL workflow files, CodeQL CLI commands, SARIF output, security analysis setup, or troubleshooting CodeQL analysis.
description_zh: 通过 GitHub Actions 工作流和 CodeQL CLI 设置和配置 CodeQL 代码扫描的全面指南。当用户需要帮助进行代码扫描配置、CodeQL 工作流文件、CodeQL CLI 命令、SARIF 输出、安全分析设置或排查 CodeQL 分析问题时，应使用此技能。

name: commandcode-delegate
description: Delegate a coding task to the Command Code CLI (`cmd`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to hand implementation work to Command Code — phrasings like "have Command Code do X", "delegate this to commandcode", "run it through cmd", or "use Command Code to implement/fix/refactor" — or to run a queue of coding tasks through Command Code while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, or when the user wants the code written directly without delegating.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Command Code CLI (`cmd`) 作为后台实现者，然后自行审查其差异并合并。当用户希望将实现工作交给 Command Code 时（例如“让 Command Code 执行 X”、“将此委托给 commandcode”、“通过 cmd 运行”或“使用 Command Code 实现/修复/重构”等说法），或者需要通过 Command Code 运行编码任务队列时，同时保持审查者的角色。不适用于可以直接内联完成的小任务，或用户希望直接编写代码而不进行委托的情况。

name: bmod-core-tools
description: Required bmod metadata. Never invoke this skill.
description_zh: 需要bmod元数据。永远不要调用这个技能。

name: ast-grep-outline
description: Use when exploring or modifying a codebase and you need a cheap structural map of files, directories, imports, exports, or direct members before reading full source.
description_zh: 在探索或修改代码库时使用，您需要在不阅读完整源代码之前，快速获取文件、目录、导入、导出或直接成员的结构性概览。

name: scientific-critical-thinking
description: Evaluate scientific claims and evidence quality. Use for assessing experimental design validity, identifying biases and confounders, applying evidence grading frameworks (GRADE, Cochrane Risk of Bias), or teaching critical analysis. Best for understanding evidence quality, identifying flaws. For formal peer review writing use peer-review.
description_zh: 评估科学声明和证据质量。用于评估实验设计的有效性、识别偏差和混杂因素、应用证据分级框架（GRADE、Cochrane偏倚风险）、或进行批判性分析教学。最适合理解证据质量、识别缺陷。正式同行评审写作请使用peer-review。

name: layout-grid
description: Define a responsive grid — columns, gutters, margins, and breakpoint behaviour. Use when establishing page structure. For the spacing scale inside components use `spacing-system`; for cross-device behaviour use `responsive-design`.
description_zh: 定义响应式网格——列、间隙、边距和断点行为。在建立页面结构时使用。组件内部的间距使用 `spacing-system`；跨设备行为使用 `responsive-design`。

name: design-mcp-workflow
description: Design a Zoom MCP workflow for Claude. Use when deciding whether Zoom MCP fits a task, when planning tool-based AI workflows, or when separating MCP responsibilities from REST API responsibilities.
description_zh: 为Claude设计一个Zoom MCP工作流程。在决定Zoom MCP是否适用于某项任务、规划基于工具的AI工作流程，或从REST API职责中分离MCP职责时使用。

name: openseo-release-notes
description: Cut an OpenSEO release — bump the version, draft user-facing release notes from commits since the last tag, run a review + subagent-verification pass, and open a "release: vX.X.X" PR. Use when the user asks to prepare a release, bump the version, or write release notes.
description_zh: 发布一个 OpenSEO 版本——更新版本号，根据自上次标签以来的提交草拟面向用户的发布说明，运行审核和子代理验证流程，并打开一个“release: vX.X.X”的 Pull Request。当用户要求准备发布、更新版本号或编写发布说明时使用。

name: firecrawl-website-design-clone
description: Extract any website's design system into an agent-ready DESIGN.md using Firecrawl scrape evidence. Use when the user wants colors, fonts, spacing, components, layout patterns, or brand/UI guidance from a website so AI agents can create new websites, clone a look, or build pages inspired by that design.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 抓取证据，将任何网站的 设计系统 提取到适用于代理的 DESIGN.md 文件中。当用户需要从网站获取颜色、字体、间距、组件、布局模式或品牌/UI指导，以便AI代理可以创建新网站、复制外观或构建受该设计启发的页面时使用。

name: evaluating-trade-offs
description: Help users navigate complex product decisions by weighing competing priorities and calculating long-term value. This skill covers build-vs-buy logic, technical debt evaluation, and communicating tradeoffs to senior leadership.
description_zh: 通过权衡竞争性优先事项和计算长期价值，帮助用户应对复杂的产品决策。这项技能涵盖构建与购买逻辑、技术债务评估，以及向高层领导沟通权衡取舍。

name: setup-ts-deep-modules
description: 在 TypeScript repo 中接入 dependency-cruiser，让每个 package 成为 deep module：implementation 隐藏在 subfolders 中，只能通过 entry-point files 访问。User-invoked。
description_zh: 在 TypeScript 仓库中集成 dependency-cruiser，使每个包成为深度模块：implementation 隐藏在子文件夹中，只能通过入口文件访问。由用户触发。

name: arize-prompts
description: INVOKE THIS SKILL for Arize Prompt Hub and `ax prompts` workflows: author or import templates and save (Workflows A–B), label/promote (C), or list/get/edit/delete/duplicate (D). Use when the user mentions ax prompts, Prompt Hub, creating/editing/saving a prompt, `{variable}` placeholders, or production/staging labels. For improving prompt text using traces or eval scores, use arize-prompt-optimization. For running experiments, use arize-experiment.
description_zh: 为 Arize Prompt Hub 和 `ax prompts` 工作流调用此技能：创建或导入模板并保存（工作流 A–B）、标记/提升（C），或列出/获取/编辑/删除/复制（D）。当用户提及 ax prompts、Prompt Hub、创建/编辑/保存提示、`{variable}` 占位符，或生产/预发布标签时使用。若需使用跟踪记录或评估分数改进提示文本，请使用 arize-prompt-optimization。若需运行实验，请使用 arize-experiment。

name: add-molab-badge
description: Add "Open in molab" badge(s) linking to marimo notebooks. Works with READMEs, docs, websites, or any markdown/HTML target.
description_zh: 添加“在molab中打开”徽章，链接到marimo笔记本。适用于README、文档、网站或任何Markdown/HTML目标。

name: fix-linking
description: Design or audit internal link structure for a website. Use when the user asks about internal linking, link architecture, orphan pages, PageRank flow, anchor text, site structure, silo architecture, or why pages aren't ranking despite good content. For external link building, see build-links.
description_zh: 为网站设计或审核内部链接结构。当用户询问内部链接、链接架构、孤儿页面、PageRank 流量、锚文本、网站结构、隔间架构，或为何内容良好但页面无法排名时使用。外部链接建设请参考 build-links。

name: grammar-checker
description: 표준 한국어 규칙에 기반한 문법, 맞춤법, 띄어쓰기, 구두점 검사기. 맞춤법 오류(되/돼, -ㄴ지/-는지), 띄어쓰기 오류(의존명사, 보조용언), 문법 오류(조사 사용, 시제), 구두점 문제를 감지하고 교정합니다. 다음 상황에 사용하세요. (1) 한국어 문서 작성 후 검토 (2) 작성 중 실시간 교정 (3) 코드의 한국어 주석이나 문서 검사 (4) 설명과 함께 한국어 문법 학습 (5) 공식 문서 품질 보장
description_zh: 基于标准韩语规则的语法、拼写、标点符号检查器。检测并纠正拼写错误（되/돼、-ㄴ지/-는지）、标点符号错误（依存名词、补助动词）、语法错误（助词使用、时态）以及标点符号问题。适用于以下场景：（1）韩语文档撰写后的检查（2）撰写中的实时校正（3）代码中的韩语注释或文档检查（4）附带说明的韩语语法学习（5）正式文档质量保证。

name: emilkowalski-motion
description: Motion-design follow-up skill inspired by Emil Kowalski's animation guidance. Use after an interface exists to add tasteful micro-interactions, state transitions, and page motion with product-grade restraint.
description_zh: 基于埃米尔·科瓦尔斯基（Emil Kowalski）动画指导的动效设计进阶技巧。在界面存在后使用，以产品级克制感增添雅致的微交互、状态过渡和页面动效。

name: maintain-greptile-rules
description: Evaluate verified findings from merge-ready, Greptile, pull-request, CI, security, billing, and other code reviews, then promote durable review gaps into the version-controlled .greptile configuration. Use when a review uncovers a recurring or high-risk repository invariant that Greptile does not capture, when Greptile repeatedly produces a false positive, or when asked to audit or update OpenSEO's Greptile rules and context.
description_zh: 评估来自可合并、Greptile、拉取请求、CI、安全、计费和其他代码审查的已验证发现，然后将持久的审查差距推进到版本控制的 .greptile 配置中。当审查发现重复出现或高风险的存储库不变量，而 Greptile 无法捕获时；当 Greptile 反复产生误报时；或当被要求审计或更新 OpenSEO 的 Greptile 规则和上下文时使用。

name: bmod-method
description: Required bmod metadata. Never invoke this skill.
description_zh: 需要bmod元数据。永远不要调用这个技能。

name: video-translation
description: Translate and dub videos from one language to another, replacing the original audio with TTS while keeping the video intact.
description_zh: 将视频从一种语言翻译成另一种语言，用TTS替换原始音频，同时保留视频完整。

name: typescript-write
description: Write TypeScript and JavaScript code following Metabase coding standards and best practices. Use when developing or refactoring TypeScript/JavaScript code.
description_zh: 遵循Metabase编码规范和最佳实践编写TypeScript和JavaScript代码。在开发或重构TypeScript/JavaScript代码时使用。

name: author-component
description: Create or review Blazor components (.razor files) with correct architecture. USE FOR: writing new Blazor components that do NOT involve JavaScript interop, implementing parameters and EventCallback, RenderFragment slots, component lifecycle (OnInitializedAsync, OnParametersSet), async patterns, IAsyncDisposable, CancellationToken, CSS isolation, code-behind. DO NOT USE FOR: creating new projects (use create-blazor-project), JavaScript interop or calling browser APIs from Blazor (use use-js-interop), forms and validation (use collect-user-input), prerendering issues (use support-prerendering), HTTP data fetching patterns (use fetch-and-send-data), coordinating state between unrelated components (use coordinate-components).
description_zh: 创建或审查具有正确架构的Blazor组件（.razor文件）。适用范围：编写不涉及JavaScript互操作的Blazor组件、实现参数和EventCallback、RenderFragment插槽、组件生命周期（OnInitializedAsync、OnParametersSet）、异步模式、IAsyncDisposable、CancellationToken、CSS隔离、代码隐藏。不适用范围：创建新项目（使用create-blazor-project）、JavaScript互操作或从Blazor调用浏览器API（使用use-js-interop）、表单和验证（使用collect-user-input）、预渲染问题（使用support-prerendering）、HTTP数据获取模式（使用fetch-and-send-data）、协调无关组件之间的状态（使用coordinate-components）。

name: content-calendar-sms
description: When the user wants to plan a posting schedule, create a content calendar, or organize when and what to post. Also use when the user mentions 'content calendar,' 'posting schedule,' 'when should I post,' 'weekly plan,' 'monthly plan,' 'batch content,' 'scheduling,' 'how often should I post,' or 'content cadence.' For deciding what topics to cover, see content-strategy-sms. For writing the actual posts, see post-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要制定发布计划、创建内容日历或安排何时发布什么内容时，也使用以下情况：用户提到“内容日历”、“发布计划”、“我应该何时发布”、“周计划”、“月计划”、“批量内容”、“排期”、“我应该多久发布一次”或“内容节奏”。关于决定要涵盖的主题，请参阅content-strategy-sms。关于撰写实际帖子，请参阅post-writer-sms。

name: property-patterns
description: MSBuild property definition patterns: conditional defaults, composition/concatenation, path normalization, trailing-slash handling, TFM detection helpers, and evaluation order. USE FOR: diagnosing and fixing property definition issues and shared-property anti-patterns in .props/.csproj; DefineConstants or NoWarn overwritten instead of appended; unconditional assignments that block project-level overrides; unquoted conditions that fail on empty properties; hardcoded paths that break cross-platform builds; setting overridable defaults; property evaluation order and last-write-wins semantics. DO NOT USE FOR: props vs targets placement (use directory-build-organization), item operations (use item-management), target structure (use target-authoring), general anti-patterns (use msbuild-antipatterns), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: MSBuild 属性定义模式：条件默认值、组合/连接、路径规范化、尾随斜杠处理、TFM 检测辅助工具以及求值顺序。用途：用于诊断和修复 .props/.csproj 中的属性定义问题及共享属性反模式；定义 Constants 或 NoWarn 被覆盖而非追加；无条件赋值阻塞项目级覆盖；未加引号的条件在空属性上失败；硬编码路径导致跨平台构建失败；设置可覆盖默认值；属性求值顺序及最后写入者胜出语义。不适用：属性与目标文件放置（使用目录构建组织）、项操作（使用项管理）、目标结构（使用目标编写）、通用反模式（使用 msbuild-antipatterns）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: gif-sticker-maker
description:
Convert photos (people, pets, objects, logos) into 4 animated GIF stickers with captions.
Use when: user wants to create cartoon stickers, GIF expressions, emoji packs, animated avatars,
or convert photos to Funko Pop / Pop Mart blind box style animations.
Triggers: sticker, GIF, cartoon, emoji, expression pack, avatar animation.
description_zh:
将照片（人物、宠物、物品、标志）转换为4个带标题的动画GIF贴纸。
使用场景：当用户想要创建卡通贴纸、GIF表情、表情包、动画头像，或将照片转换为Funko Pop/泡泡玛特盲盒风格动画时。
触发条件：贴纸、GIF、卡通、表情、表情包、头像动画。

name: firecrawl-shop
description: Research products across the web with Firecrawl and produce a shopping recommendation or cart-ready summary. Use when the user wants to compare products, find the best option, evaluate reviews, respect budget/preferences, or shop with a saved browser session.
description_zh: 使用 Firecrawl 在全网搜索产品，并生成购物推荐或可直接加入购物清单的摘要。适用于用户想要对比产品、寻找最佳选项、评估用户评论、遵循预算和偏好设置，或使用已保存的浏览器会话进行购物时。

name: saleor-storefront
description: Saleor e-commerce API patterns for building storefronts. Use when working with Saleor's GraphQL API, products, variants, checkout, channels, permissions, or debugging API behavior. Framework-agnostic — applies to any Saleor storefront.
description_zh: Saleor 电子商务 API 模式用于构建店面。在与 Saleor 的 GraphQL API、产品、变体、结账、渠道、权限或调试 API 行为时使用。框架无关——适用于任何 Saleor 店面。

name: director-readiness-advisor
description: Guide the PM-to-Director transition across preparing, interviewing, landing, and recalibrating. Use when leadership scope is changing and you need practical coaching.
description_zh: 指导项目经理到总监的过渡，涵盖准备、面试、入职和重新校准等阶段。适用于领导力范围发生变化且需要实际指导的情况。

name: create-blazor-project
description: Create a new ASP.NET Core web application or web site using Blazor. USE FOR: creating a new Blazor web app, scaffolding a new web project, starting a new web site, choosing render modes (Static SSR, Interactive Server, Interactive WebAssembly, Auto), running dotnet new blazor with the right options, setting up initial project structure. DO NOT USE FOR: adding features to existing projects, changing how an existing app renders, or component authoring (use author-component).
description_zh: 使用Blazor创建一个新的ASP.NET Core Web应用程序或网站。用途：创建新的Blazor Web应用、搭建新的Web项目、启动新的网站、选择渲染模式（静态SSR、交互式服务器、交互式WebAssembly、自动）、使用正确的选项运行`dotnet new blazor`、设置初始项目结构。不适用：为现有项目添加功能、更改现有应用的渲染方式或组件开发（请使用`author-component`）。

name: executive-onboarding-playbook
description: Plan a VP or CPO 30-60-90 day diagnostic onboarding path. Use when entering a new executive product role and avoiding premature change.
description_zh: 制定一位副总裁（VP）或首席产品官（CPO）的30-60-90天诊断入职计划。在进入新的高管产品职位时使用，以避免过早改变。

name: nemo-rl-session-memory
description: Manage durable working-session memory for coding agents. Use when a user asks to preserve or recover agent context across disconnects, VS Code restarts, long-running work, handoffs, or any session where important state should be written periodically under the repo's session directory. Do NOT use for: simple questions, short tasks, one-off commands, linting, or code review.
description_zh: 管理编码代理的持久工作会话内存。当用户要求在断开连接、VS Code 重启、长时间运行的工作、任务交接或任何需要在仓库会话目录下定期写入重要状态的会话中保留或恢复代理上下文时使用。不应用于：简单问题、短任务、一次性命令、代码检查或代码审查。

name: eval-harness-first
description: Build the evaluation harness that gates every fine-tuning run — golden sets, per-failure-mode graders, judge calibration, and base-model baselines. Use when starting a fine-tuning effort, when converting traces into an eval set, or when calibrating a judge against human labels.
description_zh: 构建用于控制每次微调运行的评估框架——包括黄金数据集、按故障模式划分的评分器、裁判校准和基础模型基线。在开始微调工作、将追踪数据转换为评估集，或校准裁判与人工标签时使用。

name: zoom-mcp
description: Guidance for the bundled Zoom MCP connectors. Use after routing to an MCP workflow when planning or troubleshooting tool-based access to meetings, recordings, meeting assets, or transcripts. Route Zoom Docs requests to the dedicated Docs MCP server and Whiteboard-specific requests to `zoom-mcp/whiteboard`.
description_zh: 捆绑 Zoom MCP 连接器的使用指南。在规划或排错基于工具的会议、录制、会议资产或字幕访问时，使用此指南在 MCP 工作流中路由。将 Zoom Docs 请求路由至专用的 Docs MCP 服务器，并将白板特定请求路由至 `zoom-mcp/whiteboard`。

name: test-analysis-extensions
description: Provides file paths to language-specific reference files for the test ANALYSIS skills (assertion-quality, test-anti-patterns, test-gap-analysis, test-smell-detection, test-tagging). Call this skill to discover available extension files (e.g., dotnet.md for .NET/MSTest/xUnit/NUnit/TUnit, python.md for pytest/unittest, typescript.md for Jest/Vitest/Mocha, java.md for JUnit/TestNG, etc.). Do not use directly — invoked by the test-quality-auditor agent and polyglot analysis skills that need framework-specific lookup tables (test markers, assertion APIs, skip annotations, sleep patterns, mystery guest indicators, integration markers, setup/teardown, tag-support capability).
description_zh: 为测试分析技能（断言质量、测试反模式、测试差距分析、测试异味检测、测试标记）提供特定语言的参考文件路径。调用此技能以发现可用的扩展文件（例如，dotnet.md 用于 .NET/MSTest/xUnit/NUnit，python.md 用于 pytest/unittest，typescript.md 用于 Jest/Vitest/Mocha，java.md 用于 JUnit/TestNG 等）。不要直接使用——由测试质量审计代理和多语言分析技能调用，这些技能需要特定框架的查找表（测试标记、断言 API、跳过注解、睡眠模式、神秘访客指标、集成标记、设置/清理、标签支持能力）。

name: video-motion-graphics
description: Use when creating After Effects compositions, Premiere Pro motion, video titles, explainer videos, or broadcast motion graphics.
description_zh: 在创建 After Effects 合成、Premiere Pro 动画、视频标题、解说视频或广播动态图形时使用。

name: icon-system
description: Specify an icon system — grid, sizing, stroke weight, naming, categories, and implementation. Use when standardising iconography. For broader illustration, use `illustration-style` (ui-design).
description_zh: 指定一个图标系统——网格、尺寸、描边粗细、命名、分类和实现。在标准化图标时使用。对于更广泛的插画，使用 `illustration-style` (ui-design)。

name: dataset-curation
description: Prepare, format, and validate datasets for supervised fine-tuning and preference training. Use when converting raw data into training format, applying chat templates, configuring sequence packing, generating synthetic training data, or writing a dataset card before a run.
description_zh: 准备、格式化并验证数据集以用于监督微调和偏好训练。在将原始数据转换为训练格式、应用聊天模板、配置序列打包、生成合成训练数据或运行前编写数据集卡片时使用。

name: claude-design
description: Produce thoughtful, high-fidelity design artifacts in HTML — landing pages, slide decks, interactive prototypes, animated videos, posters, wireframes, and visual explorations. Use whenever the user asks to design, mock up, prototype, visualize, storyboard, or explore UI options — including phrases like "make a deck", "design a landing page", "prototype this flow", "animate this concept", "build a pitch deck", "create a poster", "visualize this idea", or "design something for a brand". Enforces fact verification (WebSearch before assuming a product exists or its version), the Core Asset Protocol for branded work (logo, product shots, and UI screenshots are first-class, not just colors and fonts), a Design Direction Advisor fallback that offers 3 differentiated directions from 10 design philosophies when the brief is too vague, commits to a visual system up front, presents multiple variations, and avoids AI-design tropes (aggressive gradients, emoji bullets, generic templates).

name: machine-learning
description: Machine learning development with JAX, functional programming patterns, and high-performance computing.
description_zh: 使用JAX进行机器学习开发，结合函数式编程模式和高性能计算。

name: clean-architecture
description: Clean Architecture principles and best practices from Robert C. Martin's book. This skill should be used when designing software systems, reviewing code structure, or refactoring applications to achieve better separation of concerns. Triggers on tasks involving layers, boundaries, dependency direction, entities, use cases, or system architecture.
description_zh: 罗伯特·C·马丁（Robert C. Martin）在其著作中阐述的清洁架构（Clean Architecture）原则和最佳实践。这项技能应在设计软件系统、审查代码结构或重构应用程序以实现更好的关注点分离时使用。它适用于涉及层、边界、依赖方向、实体、用例或系统架构的任务。

name: hot-topics
description: 获取微博、知乎、百度、抖音、今日头条、B站等主流中文平台的实时热搜榜单和热门话题。Use when users want to know trending topics, hot searches, or popular content on Chinese social media platforms.
description_zh: 获取微博、知乎、百度、抖音、今日头条、B站等主流中文平台的实时热搜榜单和热门话题。适用于用户想了解中文社交媒体平台上的热门话题、热搜或流行内容。

name: authoring-github-workflows
description: Author and review GitHub Actions workflow YAML safely so syntactically-valid YAML can't ship a workflow that GitHub Actions refuses to run. USE FOR: editing, adding, or reviewing any file under .github/workflows/, writing run-name/name/if/env/run values that contain ${{ }} expressions, diagnosing a run that fails with 'This run likely failed because of a workflow file issue' and no jobs starting, deciding when a workflow scalar must be quoted, validating workflows with actionlint. DO NOT USE FOR: authoring application YAML unrelated to GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, GitLab CI, or non-workflow YAML. SCOPE: this skill covers *syntactic/structural* correctness of workflow YAML (quoting, parsing, actionlint); for *semantic and functional* workflow design (what a workflow should do, agentic-workflow behavior), see .github/agents/agentic-workflows.agent.md — the two are complementary. INVOKES: actionlint (downloaded pinned binary) plus git/grep for inspection.
description_zh: 安全地编写和审查 GitHub Actions 工作流 YAML，以确保语法有效的 YAML 不会提交一个 GitHub Actions 拒绝执行的工作流。用途：编辑、添加或审查 .github/workflows/ 下任何文件，编写包含 ${{ }} 表达式的 run-name/name/if/env/run 值，诊断因“此运行可能因工作流文件问题而失败”且无作业启动的运行，决定何时必须给工作流标量加引号，使用 actionlint 验证工作流。不适用：编写与应用程序 YAML 无关的 GitHub Actions、Azure Pipelines、GitLab CI 或非工作流 YAML。范围：此技能涵盖工作流 YAML 的 *语法/结构* 正确性（引号、解析、actionlint）；对于 *语义和功能* 工作流设计（工作流应做什么、agentic-workflow 行为），请参阅 .github/agents/agentic-workflows.agent.md——两者互补。触发：actionlint（下载的固定二进制文件）以及用于检查的 git/grep。

name: edgeone
description: Deploy HTML content to EdgeOne Pages, return the public URL.
description_zh: 将HTML内容部署到EdgeOne Pages，返回公共URL。

name: powerpoint-automation
description: Create and edit professional PowerPoint presentations from web articles, blog posts, existing PPTX files, or templates. Use when creating PPTX, converting articles to slides, translating presentations, editing open PowerPoint files, or doing COM Automation / RefURL / overflow review work. Triggers on PowerPoint, PPTX, パワポ, スライド作成, 記事をスライド化, COM自動化, RefURL.
description_zh: 从网络文章、博客文章、现有的PPTX文件或模板创建和编辑专业的PowerPoint演示文稿。在创建PPTX、将文章转换为幻灯片、翻译演示文稿、编辑打开的PowerPoint文件或进行COM自动化/RefURL/溢出审查工作时使用。在PowerPoint、PPTX、パワポ、スライド作成、記事をスライド化、COM自動化、RefURL时触发。

name: find-untested-sources
description: MANDATORY for static source-to-test pairing: find or list source files/modules without corresponding tests, or suggest test locations from repository structure. Invoke even for a tiny package; do not substitute manual globbing. Uses Roslyn for C#/.NET and tree-sitter for Python, TS/JS, Go, Java, Rust, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift, PowerShell, and C++. DO NOT USE FOR: real line/branch/Cobertura data, coverage-backed test priorities, CRAP risk, or grading existing tests.
description_zh: 静态源代码到测试代码的配对是强制性的：查找或列出没有相应测试的源文件/模块，或从仓库结构中建议测试位置。即使是微小的包也要调用；不要用手动通配符替代。使用Roslyn用于C#/.NET，使用tree-sitter用于Python、TS/JS、Go、Java、Rust、Ruby、Kotlin、Swift、PowerShell和C++。不应用于：真实行/分支/Cobertura数据、基于覆盖率的测试优先级、CRAP风险或评估现有测试。

name: agent-memory-systems
description: Memory is the cornerstone of intelligent agents. Without it, every interaction starts from zero. This skill covers the architecture of agent memory: short-term (context window), long-term (vector stores), and the cognitive architectures that organize them.
description_zh: 记忆是智能体的基石。没有它，每一次交互都将从零开始。这项技能涵盖了智能体记忆的架构：短期（上下文窗口）、长期（向量存储）以及组织它们的认知架构。

name: migrate-xml-views-to-jetpack-compose
description: Provides a structured workflow for migrating an Android XML View to Jetpack Compose. This skill details the step-by-step process, from planning and dependency setup, to theming and layout migration, validation and XML cleanup. Use this skill when you need to migrate an XML View to Jetpack Compose in an Android project. It solves the problem of converting the UI of a legacy XML View into modern, declarative Compose components while maintaining interoperability.
description_zh: 提供了一种将 Android XML 视图迁移到 Jetpack Compose 的结构化工作流程。该技能详细介绍了从规划、依赖设置到主题和布局迁移、验证和 XML 清理的逐步过程。当您需要在 Android 项目中将 XML 视图迁移到 Jetpack Compose 时，请使用此技能。它解决了将传统 XML 视图的 UI 转换为现代、声明式 Compose 组件，同时保持互操作性的问题。

name: physical-ai-infrastructure-setup-and-resilient-scaling
description: Use when the user wants to set up, scale, validate, or harden NVIDIA physical AI infrastructure for synthetic data generation workflows across local MicroK8s or Azure AKS, including Kubernetes clusters, inference endpoint deployment, OSMO deployment, workload submission readiness, and infrastructure failure recovery. Trigger keywords: physical ai infrastructure, resilient scaling, SDG infrastructure, microk8s, azure aks, NVCF deployment, NIM Operator, OSMO deploy, workflow scaling. Don't trigger for: OSMO log summarization or workload-only operations unless infrastructure setup, scaling, validation, or recovery is requested.
description_zh: 当用户需要为本地 MicroK8s 或 Azure AKS 的合成数据生成工作流程设置、扩展、验证或加固 NVIDIA 物理AI基础设施时使用，包括 Kubernetes 集群、推理端点部署、OSMO 部署、工作负载提交准备和基础设施故障恢复。触发关键词：物理AI基础设施、弹性扩展、SDG基础设施、microk8s、azure aks、NVCF部署、NIM Operator、OSMO部署、工作流程扩展。不触发：OSMO日志汇总或仅工作负载操作，除非请求了基础设施设置、扩展、验证或恢复。

name: event-prospecting
description:
Event prospecting skill. Takes a conference / event speakers URL,
extracts the people, filters their companies against the user's
ICP, then deep-researches only the speakers at ICP-fit companies.
Outputs a person-first HTML report where each card answers "why
should the AE talk to this person?" with all public links and a
one-click DM opener.
Use when the user wants to: (1) find leads at a specific
conference, (2) prep for an event, (3) research event speakers,
(4) build a target list from a sponsor/exhibitor page,
(5) scrape conference speakers and rank by ICP fit.
Triggers: "find leads at {event}", "research speakers at",
"prospect this conference", "stripe sessions leads",
"ai engineer summit prospects", "event prospecting",
"scrape conference speakers", "who should I meet at".
description_zh:
事件开发技能。输入一个会议/活动演讲者URL，提取人员信息，根据用户的ICP（行业分类）筛选其公司，然后深入调研ICP匹配公司的演讲者。输出以人为中心的HTML报告，每张卡片回答“为什么AE（客户经理）应该与这个人交谈？”并提供所有公开链接和一键私信开启器。

使用场景：
(1) 在特定会议上寻找潜在客户；
(2) 为活动做准备；
(3) 调研活动演讲者；
(4) 从赞助商/参展商页面构建目标名单；
(5) 抓取会议演讲者并按ICP匹配度排序。

触发词：
"在{会议}中寻找潜在客户"、"调研{会议}演讲者"、"开发这个会议"、"stripe会议潜在客户"、"AI工程师峰会潜在客户"、"事件开发"、"抓取会议演讲者"、"我应该与谁会面"。

name: flowstudio-power-automate-build
description: Build, scaffold, and deploy Power Automate cloud flows using the FlowStudio MCP server. Your agent constructs flow definitions, wires connections, deploys, and tests — all via MCP without opening the portal. Load this skill when asked to: create a flow, build a new flow, deploy a flow definition, scaffold a Power Automate workflow, construct a flow JSON, update an existing flow's actions, patch a flow definition, add actions to a flow, wire up connections, or generate a workflow definition from scratch. Requires a FlowStudio MCP subscription — see https://mcp.flowstudio.app
description_zh: 使用 FlowStudio MCP 服务器构建、搭建和部署 Power Automate 云流程。您的代理将构建流程定义、连接线路、部署和测试——所有操作均通过 MCP 完成，无需打开门户。当被要求创建流程、构建新流程、部署流程定义、搭建 Power Automate 工作流、构建流程 JSON、更新现有流程的操作、修补流程定义、向流程添加操作、连接线路或从零生成工作流定义时，请加载此技能。需要 FlowStudio MCP 订阅——请访问 https://mcp.flowstudio.app。

name: microsoft-agent-framework
description: Create, update, refactor, explain, or review Microsoft Agent Framework solutions using shared guidance plus language-specific references for .NET and Python.
description_zh: 使用共享指导以及针对 .NET 和 Python 的语言特定参考来创建、更新、重构、解释或审查 Microsoft Agent Framework 解决方案。

name: implement-paper-auto
description: Implement a research paper in a marimo notebook fully automatically without extra user input.
description_zh: 在Marimo笔记本中全自动地实现研究论文，无需额外用户输入。

name: posthog-instrumentation
description: Automatically add PostHog analytics instrumentation to code. Triggers when user asks to add tracking, instrument events, add analytics, or implement feature flags in their codebase.
description_zh: 自动将 PostHog 分析工具集成到代码中。当用户要求添加跟踪、集成事件、添加分析或在其代码库中实现功能标志时触发。

name: firecrawl-workflows
description: Run outcome-focused Firecrawl workflows that produce deliverables such as research reports, literature reviews over published papers, SEO audits, QA reports, lead lists, knowledge bases, website design systems, and other structured web-data artifacts. Use when the user wants Firecrawl to complete a business, marketing, product, or creative workflow rather than merely scrape a page or integrate API calls into code.
description_zh: 运行以结果为导向的 Firecrawl 工作流，可生成研究报告、已发表论文的文献综述、SEO 审计、QA 报告、潜在客户列表、知识库、网站设计系统以及其他结构化网络数据工件。当用户希望 Firecrawl 完成商业、营销、产品或创意工作流，而不仅仅是抓取页面或将 API 调用集成到代码中时使用。

name: adk
description: a set of guidelines to build with Botpress's Agent Development Kit (ADK) - use these whenever you're tasked with building a feature using the ADK
description_zh: 一套使用 Botpress 智能体开发工具包（ADK）构建功能的指南——在您被分配使用 ADK 构建功能任务时，请随时使用这些指南。

name: ai-evals
description: Help users build robust infrastructure for measuring, monitoring, and iterating on AI product performance using human, code-based, and LLM-as-a-judge methodologies.
description_zh: 帮助用户构建用于衡量、监控和迭代 AI 产品性能的稳健基础设施，采用人类、基于代码和 LLM 作为裁判的方法论。

name: math-reasoning
description: Formal mathematical reasoning for research papers — derive equations, write proofs, formalize problem settings, select statistical tests, and generate LaTeX math notation. Use when the user needs mathematical derivations, theorem proofs, notation tables, or statistical analysis formalization.
description_zh: 用于研究论文的正式数学推理——推导方程、撰写证明、形式化问题设定、选择统计检验，以及生成LaTeX数学符号。当用户需要数学推导、定理证明、符号表或统计分析形式化时使用。

name: lora-qlora-recipes
description: Configure LoRA and QLoRA supervised fine-tuning with current best-practice hyperparameters. Use when writing or reviewing a LoRA/QLoRA training configuration, choosing rank/alpha/target modules, or deciding between LoRA, QLoRA, and full fine-tuning.
description_zh: 配置当前最佳实践超参数的 LoRA 和 QLoRA 监督微调。在编写或审查 LoRA/QLoRA 训练配置、选择秩/alpha/目标模块，或决定在 LoRA、QLoRA 和全量微调之间选择时使用。

name: nuxthub
description: Use when building NuxtHub v0.10.6 applications - provides database (Drizzle ORM with sqlite/postgresql/mysql), KV storage, blob storage, and cache APIs. Covers configuration, schema definition, migrations, multi-cloud deployment (Cloudflare, Vercel), and the new hub:db, hub:kv, hub:blob virtual module imports.
description_zh: 在构建 NuxtHub v0.10.6 应用时使用 - 提供数据库（Drizzle ORM 配合 sqlite/postgresql/mysql）、KV 存储空间、对象存储空间和缓存 API。涵盖配置、模式定义、迁移、多云部署（Cloudflare、Vercel）以及新的 hub:db、hub:kv、hub:blob 虚拟模块导入。

name: stakeholder-alignment
description: Help users master the art of leading without formal authority by identifying stakeholder incentives, neutralizing conflict through connection, and using co-creation to build shared ownership.
description_zh: 帮助用户掌握在无正式权力的情况下领导的艺术，通过识别利益相关者的激励措施、通过建立联系来化解冲突，并利用共创来建立共同所有权。

name: aframe-webxr
description: Declarative web framework for building browser-based 3D, VR, and AR experiences using HTML and entity-component architecture. Use this skill when creating WebXR applications, VR experiences, AR experiences, 360-degree media viewers, or immersive web content with minimal JavaScript. Triggers on tasks involving A-Frame, WebXR, VR development, AR development, entity-component-system, declarative 3D, or HTML-based 3D scenes. Built on Three.js with accessible HTML-first approach.
description_zh: 声明式Web框架，用于使用HTML和实体-组件架构构建基于浏览器的3D、VR和AR体验。在创建WebXR应用程序、VR体验、AR体验、360度媒体查看器或使用最少JavaScript的沉浸式网页内容时使用此技能。在涉及A-Frame、WebXR、VR开发、AR开发、实体-组件系统、声明式3D或基于HTML的3D场景的任务中触发。基于Three.js构建，采用以HTML优先的方式。

name: fxmacrodata-calendar
description: Fetch official FXMacroData macro release-calendar events for trade planning, macro regime checks, and event-risk filters. Use before CPI, NFP, GDP, PCE, retail sales, PMI, and central-bank decision windows.
description_zh: 获取官方FXMacroData宏观经济日历事件，用于交易规划、宏观经济政策检查和事件风险过滤器。在CPI、NFP、GDP、PCE、零售销售、PMI和央行决策窗口之前使用。

name: coordinate-components
description: Share state between components that don't have a direct parent-child parameter relationship, using cascading values, scoped services with change events, or CascadingValueSource via DI. USE WHEN the user needs a CascadingParameter or CascadingValue that works across render mode boundaries, a shopping cart or notification count accessible from multiple pages, a theme or user preference cascaded app-wide, or when components in different parts of the tree must react when shared data changes. Also USE WHEN cascading values aren't reaching interactive children in per-page interactivity mode, or when the user needs to understand scoped vs singleton service lifetime for state on Blazor Server. DO NOT USE for direct parent-child parameter passing or EventCallback (see author-component), for persisting state across prerender-to-interactive transitions (see support-prerendering), or for service abstractions for data fetching in Auto/WebAssembly (see fetch-and-send-data).
description_zh: 在组件之间共享状态，这些组件没有直接的父子参数关系，可以使用级联值、带变更事件的范围服务或通过依赖注入的CascadingValueSource。在以下情况时使用：用户需要跨渲染模式边界工作的CascadingParameter或CascadingValue；需要从多个页面访问的购物车或通知计数；全局级联的主题或用户偏好；树形结构不同部分的组件需要响应共享数据变化时。此外，在级联值在每页交互模式下无法到达交互式子组件时，或用户需要理解Blazor Server上范围服务与单例服务生命周期差异时，也使用。不应用于直接的父子参数传递或EventCallback（参见author-component），不应用于在预渲染到交互式过渡期间持久化状态（参见support-prerendering），也不应用于Auto/WebAssembly中数据获取的服务抽象（参见fetch-and-send-data）。

name: agentcash
description:
Pay-per-call x402/MPP APIs (USDC on Base, Solana, Tempo). No API keys—wallet pays per request.
If the task matches a SERVICES origin below, SKIP search and go straight to discover → fetch.
Only search when NO listed origin fits.

SERVICES: stableenrich (people/company, web search, scraping, Maps, LinkedIn, email verify, news), stablesocial (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, GitHub), stablestudio (AI image/video), stableupload (file/site hosting), stableemail (email, inboxes, subdomains), stablephone (AI calls, phone numbers), stablejobs (jobs), stabletravel (travel), stablebrowser (browser automation).
TRIGGERS: research, enrich, scrape, search the web, generate image, video, social media, send email, phone call, travel, jobs, find contact, find API, x402, mpp, agentcash
description_zh:
按调用付费 x402/MPP API（Base、Solana、Tempo 上使用 USDC）。无需 API 密钥——钱包按请求付费。
如果任务匹配下方列出的 SERVICES 来源，则跳过搜索，直接进入发现 → 获取。
仅在没有任何列出的来源适用时才进行搜索。

SERVICES：stableenrich（人员/公司、网络搜索、抓取、地图、领英、邮箱验证、新闻），stablesocial（抖音、Instagram、YouTube、Facebook、Reddit、领英、GitHub），stablestudio（AI 图像/视频），stableupload（文件/网站托管），stableemail（邮箱、收件箱、子域名），stablephone（AI 通话、电话号码），stablejobs（工作），stabletravel（旅行），stablebrowser（浏览器自动化）。
TRIGGERS：研究、丰富、抓取、网络搜索、生成图像、视频、社交媒体、发送邮件、电话呼叫、旅行、工作、查找联系人、查找 API、x402、mpp、agentcash

name: collect-user-input
description: Build forms, validate data, and react to user input in Blazor. USE FOR adding forms, search boxes, filter panels, inline editing, data-entry UI, file uploads, validation (annotations or custom), handling form submissions, and binding input controls. Covers EditForm, built-in input components, DataAnnotationsValidator, custom validation, SSR form patterns (SupplyParameterFromForm, FormName, AntiforgeryToken, Enhance), and @bind for simple interactive controls. DO NOT USE for project scaffolding (see create-blazor-project) or prerendering issues (see support-prerendering).
description_zh: 在Blazor中构建表单、验证数据并响应用户输入。用于添加表单、搜索框、筛选面板、内联编辑、数据输入UI、文件上传、验证（注解或自定义）、处理表单提交以及绑定输入控件。涵盖EditForm、内置输入组件、DataAnnotationsValidator、自定义验证、SSR表单模式（SupplyParameterFromForm、FormName、AntiforgeryToken、Enhance）以及@bind用于简单的交互控件。不应用于项目脚手架（参见create-blazor-project）或预渲染问题（参见support-prerendering）。

name: product-skills
description: Use when coordinating product work across the 12 bundled product sub-skills (RICE, OKRs, UX research, design tokens, competitive teardown, analytics, experiments, discovery, roadmaps, spec-to-repo, landing pages, SaaS scaffolding) or the 4 standalone product-team plugins (user stories, Apple HIG, code-to-PRD, research summarizer). Triggers on 'help me prioritize', 'plan a product experiment', 'we ship features nobody uses', 'run the discovery loop', 'is our OST sound'. Forks context to route to one sub-skill via a deterministic signal router and returns a digest; can also drive a continuous-discovery loop (Torres cadence tracker + OST linter as machine gates) or a full goal→plan→execute→verify→close run through the repo-wide agent-harness. Distinct from project-management (how to deliver vs what to build), marketing/landing (from-scratch pages), and engineering/agent-harness (the generic loop engine this orchestrator plugs into).
description_zh: 在协调12个捆绑产品子技能（RICE、OKRs、用户体验研究、设计令牌、竞争拆解、分析、实验、发现、路线图、规范到仓库、落地页、SaaS脚手架）或4个独立产品团队插件（用户故事、Apple HIG、代码到PRD、研究摘要器）的工作时使用。触发于“帮我优先级排序”、“计划一个产品实验”、“我们发布无人使用的功能”、“运行发现循环”、“我们的OST是否合理”。通过确定性信号路由器将上下文分支路由到其中一个子技能，并返回摘要；也可以驱动连续发现循环（Torres节奏追踪器+OST校验器作为机器门禁）或通过仓库级代理框架运行完整的目标→计划→执行→验证→关闭流程。与项目管理（如何交付与要构建什么）、营销/落地页（从零开始的页面）以及工程/代理框架（此协调器接入的通用循环引擎）有所区别。

name: prompt-lookup
description: Activates when the user asks about AI prompts, needs prompt templates, wants to search for prompts, or mentions prompts.chat. Use for discovering, retrieving, and improving prompts.
description_zh: 当用户询问AI提示、需要提示模板、想要搜索提示或提及 prompts.chat 时激活。用于发现、检索和改进提示。

name: literature-review
description: Conduct comprehensive, systematic literature reviews using multiple academic databases (PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv, Semantic Scholar, etc.). This skill should be used when conducting systematic literature reviews, meta-analyses, research synthesis, or comprehensive literature searches across biomedical, scientific, and technical domains. Creates professionally formatted markdown documents and PDFs with verified citations in multiple citation styles (APA, Nature, Vancouver, etc.).
description_zh: 使用多个学术数据库（PubMed、arXiv、bioRxiv、Semantic Scholar等）进行全面的、系统的文献综述。这项技能应在进行系统文献综述、元分析、研究综合或跨生物医学、科学和技术领域的全面文献检索时使用。创建格式规范的Markdown文档和PDF文件，并包含多种引用格式的验证引用（APA、Nature、Vancouver等）。

name: om-auto-fix-pr
description: Drive an open PR to merge-ready from its number — merges the latest base, then loops review-autofix (om-auto-review-pr), built-in CI stabilization, and UI verification (om-auto-qa-pr) until approvable, green, and QA-evidenced. A --ci-only mode drives just CI green on a PR or a plain branch. Files follow-up issues for nits, normalizes labels, hands off to om-approve-merge-pr — never merges itself. Use for "get PR 123 merge-ready".
description_zh: 从其编号发起一个开放的PR，使其达到可合并状态——合并最新的基础版本，然后循环进行自动修复（om-auto-review-pr）、内置CI稳定性检查和UI验证（om-auto-qa-pr），直到达到可批准、绿色且经过QA验证的状态。使用`--ci-only`模式时，仅在PR或普通分支上驱动CI变为绿色。文件会跟进小问题（nits），标准化标签，然后转交给`om-approve-merge-pr`——它自身不会进行合并。用于“将PR 123变为可合并状态”。

name: finetuning-method-selection
description: Decide whether to fine-tune at all, and route to the right method (SFT, DPO/ORPO/KTO, GRPO/RLVR, continued pretraining) and base model. Use when starting any fine-tuning effort, when unsure whether RAG or prompting would suffice, or when choosing between preference-optimization and reinforcement methods.
description_zh: 决定是否进行微调，并选择合适的方法（SFT、DPO/ORPO/KTO、GRPO/RLVR、持续预训练）和基础模型。在开始任何微调工作、不确定是否只需使用RAG或提示，或是在偏好优化与强化方法之间进行选择时使用。

name: k6-test-maintenance
description: Maintain and improve existing k6 test scripts. Covers threshold tightening based on trend data, version migration between k6 releases, auto-fixing tests when the underlying service changes, refactoring for cleanliness, and auditing scripts against current best practices from docs. Use when the user asks to fix a failing k6 test, tighten thresholds, migrate a script to a new k6 version, refactor a test, update a script after a service change, or improve a script with best practices. Trigger on phrases like "fix my k6 test", "tighten my thresholds", "migrate to k6 v2", "update my test script", "refactor this k6 test", "my test is failing after a deploy", "apply best practices to my script", "modernize my k6 test", or "the service changed and my test broke". Also trigger when another skill (k6-trend-analysis or k6-cloud-investigate-test) hands off with a recommendation to edit a script.
description_zh: 维护和改进现有的k6测试脚本。包括基于趋势数据的阈值收紧、k6版本之间的迁移、在底层服务变更时自动修复测试、为简洁性进行重构，以及根据文档中的最佳实践审计脚本。当用户要求修复失败的k6测试、收紧阈值、将脚本迁移到新的k6版本、重构测试、在服务变更后更新脚本，或使用最佳实践改进脚本时使用。在以下短语触发：如"修复我的k6测试"、"收紧我的阈值"、"迁移到k6 v2"、"更新我的测试脚本"、"重构这个k6测试"、"部署后我的测试失败了"、"将最佳实践应用于我的脚本"、"使我的k6测试现代化"、"服务变更导致我的测试失效"。此外，当其他技能（k6-trend-analysis或k6-cloud-investigate-test）推荐编辑脚本时也会触发。

name: scientific-brainstorming
description: Facilitates evidence-aware scientific ideation with independent generation, structured discussion, explicit assumptions, transparent evaluation, adversarial review, and decision logs. Use for early-stage research brainstorming or prioritizing candidate directions; hand off empirical validation, study design, ethics or regulatory review, and clinical questions to appropriate experts or skills.
description_zh: 支持证据驱动的科学构思，包括独立生成、结构化讨论、明确假设、透明评估、对抗性评审和决策日志。适用于早期研究阶段的头脑风暴或筛选候选方向；将实证验证、研究设计、伦理或监管审查以及临床问题移交给相应的专家或技能。

name: mapbox-geospatial-operations
description: Expert guidance on choosing the right geospatial tool based on problem type, accuracy requirements, and performance needs
description_zh: 根据问题类型、精度要求和性能需求，选择合适的地理空间工具的专业指导

name: nemotron-speech
description: Routes NVIDIA Nemotron Speech (Formerly Riva) NIM tasks — deploys, runs, and tests ASR, TTS, and NMT NIMs on build.nvidia.com or self-hosted.
description_zh: NVIDIA Nemotron Speech（原Riva）NIM任务路由——在build.nvidia.com或自托管环境中部署、运行和测试ASR、TTS和NMT NIM。

name: to-questionnaire
description: 把你无法完整回答的 decision 转成一份交给他人填写的 questionnaire。
description_zh: 将你无法完整回答的 decision 转换成一份交给他人填写的 questionnaire。

name: plan-ui-change
description: Plan complex Blazor UI features by decomposing them into focused components. USE FOR: building a complex Blazor page with multiple sections, planning component decomposition, designing a multi-section dashboard or layout, breaking down a large UI feature into composable components, pages with sidebars and content panels, any page with 3+ distinct visual sections or multiple interacting sub-features, identifying parent-child relationships and data flow. DO NOT USE FOR: creating new Blazor projects or apps from scratch (use create-blazor-project), implementing a single individual component (use author-component), writing component code with parameters and EventCallback (use author-component), or simple single-component pages.
description_zh: 通过将复杂的 Blazor UI 功能分解为专注的组件来规划。适用于：构建具有多个部分的复杂 Blazor 页面、规划组件分解、设计多部分仪表板或布局、将大型 UI 功能分解为可组合的组件、带有侧边栏和内容面板的页面、任何具有 3 个以上不同视觉部分的页面或多个交互子功能、识别父子关系和数据流。不适用于：从零创建新的 Blazor 项目或应用程序（请使用 create-blazor-project）、实现单个独立组件（请使用 author-component）、编写带参数和 EventCallback 的组件代码（请使用 author-component），或简单的单组件页面。

name: fusion-dependency-review
description: Review dependency PRs with structured research, existing-PR-discussion capture, multi-lens analysis (security, code quality, impact), and a repeatable verdict template. USE FOR: dependency update PRs, Renovate/Dependabot PRs, library upgrade reviews, "review this dependency PR", "should we merge this update". DO NOT USE FOR: feature PRs, application code reviews, dependency automation/bot configuration, or unattended merge without confirmation.
description_zh:
请使用结构化研究、现有PR讨论记录、多维度分析（安全性、代码质量、影响）以及可重复的结论模板来审查依赖关系PR。  
适用场景：依赖关系更新PR、Renovate/Dependabot PR、库升级审查、"请审查此依赖关系PR"、"是否应合并此更新"。  
不适用场景：功能PR、应用程序代码审查、依赖关系自动化/机器人配置，或在未经确认的情况下进行无人值守合并。

name: prompt-optimizer
description: Creates, optimizes, and iteratively refines agent prompts, system prompts, developer prompts, and reusable prompt templates. Use when asked to improve a prompt, optimize a system prompt, rewrite an agent prompt, tune prompt wording, make a prompt more reliable, port prompts between OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini, or build prompt evals.
description_zh: 创建、优化和迭代改进代理提示、系统提示、开发者提示和可重用提示模板。当被要求改进提示、优化系统提示、重写代理提示、调整提示措辞、提高提示可靠性、在 OpenAI、Claude 或 Gemini 之间移植提示，或构建提示评估时使用。

name: risk-management
description: Risk management rules learned from competition outcomes. Use when sizing positions or setting stop-losses.
description_zh: 从比赛结果中学习风险管理规则。在确定仓位大小或设置止损时使用。

name: playcanvas-engine
description: Lightweight WebGL/WebGPU game engine with entity-component architecture and visual editor integration. Use this skill when building browser-based games, interactive 3D applications, or performance-critical web experiences. Triggers on tasks involving PlayCanvas, entity-component systems, game engine development, WebGL games, 3D browser applications, editor-first workflows, or real-time 3D rendering. Alternative to Three.js with game-specific features and integrated development environment.
description_zh: 轻量级 WebGL/WebGPU 游戏引擎，采用实体-组件架构并集成可视化编辑器。在构建基于浏览器的游戏、交互式 3D 应用或性能关键型 Web 体验时使用此技能。适用于涉及 PlayCanvas、实体-组件系统、游戏引擎开发、WebGL 游戏、3D 浏览器应用、编辑器优先工作流或实时 3D 渲染的任务。作为 Three.js 的替代方案，具备游戏特定功能并集成开发环境。

name: hankookilbo-news
description: 한국일보 공식 원격 MCP 서버(mcp.hankookilbo.com)를 인증 없이 직접 호출해 편집 헤드라인·많이 본·꼼꼼히 본·최신 기사·섹션별 편집 추천·주제 검색·오늘의 운세를 기사 메타데이터(제목·발행시각·원문 링크) 중심으로 조회한다.
description_zh: 韩国日报官方远程MCP服务器(mcp.hankookilbo.com)无需认证即可直接调用，以稿件元数据（标题、发布时间、原文链接）为中心，查询编辑头条、热门、仔细阅读、最新稿件、各版块编辑推荐、主题搜索、今日运势。

name: edit-spec
description: Edit a vigiles .spec.ts to change a compiled instruction file (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) — add, modify, or remove a rule, section, command, or key file. Use whenever you need to change a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md that carries a vigiles hash (edit the spec, never the artifact), including adding a new enforce()/check()/guidance() rule.
description_zh: 编辑一个 vigiles.spec.ts 文件以更改一个编译指令文件（CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md）——添加、修改或删除规则、章节、命令或键文件。在需要更改包含 vigiles hash 的 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 文件时使用（编辑规范，而不是工件），包括添加新的 enforce()/check()/guidance() 规则。

name: 3-statement-model
description: Complete, populate and fill out 3-statement financial model templates (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement) . Use when asked to fill out model templates, complete existing model frameworks, populate financial models with data, complete a partially filled IS/BS/CF framework, or link integrated financial statements within an existing template structure. Triggers include requests to fill in, complete, or populate a 3-statement model template
description_zh: 完成、填充并填写三报表财务模型模板（利润表、资产负债表、现金流量表）。在需要填写模型模板、完成现有模型框架、用数据填充财务模型、完成部分填写的IS/BS/CF框架，或链接现有模板结构中的集成财务报表时使用。触发条件包括要求填写、完成或填充三报表模型模板的请求。

name: recommendation-canvas
description: Evaluate an AI product idea across outcomes, hypotheses, risks, and positioning. Use when deciding whether an AI solution deserves investment or recommendation.
description_zh: 评估一项人工智能产品创意，涵盖成果、假设、风险和定位。在决定是否值得投资或推荐人工智能解决方案时使用。

name: nemotron-retrieval-recipes
description: Use when planning, debugging, tuning, evaluating, exporting, or deploying public Nemotron `embed`/`rerank` retrieval recipes.
description_zh: 在规划、调试、调优、评估、导出或部署公共 Nemotron `embed`/`rerank` 检索配方时使用。

name: x-ray-a-company
description: Corporate due-diligence workflow — resolve a brand or website to its registered legal entity, map group structure and beneficial ownership, profile officers and directors, enumerate the digital estate, and screen litigation, insolvency, procurement, sanctions, PEP and adverse media. Use when asked to check out, vet or research a company, verify a supplier or counterparty before signing or paying, or assess whether a business is real. Applies to vendor and third-party risk, KYC and KYB onboarding, M&A and investor diligence, procurement integrity, and shell-company assessment. Reference at useosint.com/skills/x-ray-a-company.
description_zh: 企业尽职调查流程——将品牌或网站解析为其注册法律实体，绘制集团结构和实际所有权，分析高管和董事，列举数字资产，并筛查诉讼、破产、采购、制裁、PEP（政治公众人物）和负面媒体。在需要调查、审核或研究公司，签署合同或付款前验证供应商或交易对手，或评估业务是否真实时使用。适用于供应商和第三方风险、KYC（了解你的客户）和KYB（了解你的业务伙伴）开户、并购和投资者尽职调查、采购诚信以及空壳公司评估。使用时参考 useosint.com/skills/x-ray-a-company。

name: grade-tests
description: Grade specified test methods individually and produce a concise PR-ready table with each fully qualified test name, an A-F grade, score band, and one-line note. USE FOR per-test feedback on a curated list such as new or modified tests in a pull request, not a suite-wide audit. Polyglot: .NET, Python, TS/JS, Java, Go, Ruby, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, PowerShell, C++. Inputs may be test methods, method bodies, or file-and-line spans. DO NOT USE FOR: full suite audits (use test-quality-auditor agent or test-anti-patterns), writing new tests (use code-testing-generator agent or writing-mstest-tests), fixing failures, or measuring code coverage.
description_zh: 逐个对指定的测试方法进行评分，并生成一份简洁的、适用于 PR 的表格，其中包含每个测试的完整名称、A-F 评分、分数范围和一句话备注。用于针对精选列表（如 PR 中的新增或修改测试）进行逐个测试的反馈，而不是对整个测试套件进行审核。多语言支持：.NET、Python、TS/JS、Java、Go、Ruby、Rust、Swift、Kotlin、PowerShell、C++。输入可以是测试方法、方法体或文件和行范围。不应用于：完整的套件审核（使用 test-quality-auditor 代理或 test-anti-patterns）、编写新测试（使用 code-testing-generator 代理或 writing-mstest-tests）、修复失败或测量代码覆盖率。

name: item-management
