description: Patterns for managing MSBuild item groups: Include/Remove/Update semantics, item metadata, batching with %(Metadata), transforms, per-item filtering, and cross-product batching pitfalls. USE FOR: diagnosing and fixing item group anti-patterns in .csproj files, reviewing item management for correctness, fixing CS2002 duplicate file warnings from SDK globbing, fixing targets that run more times than expected due to cross-product batching, fixing Include vs Update misuse on SDK-globbed items, fixing FileWrites registration for generated file clean support, moving generated files to IntermediateOutputPath. DO NOT USE FOR: target chain architecture (use target-authoring), property patterns (use property-patterns), incrementality (use incremental-build), general anti-patterns (use msbuild-antipatterns), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 管理 MSBuild 项目组的模式：包含/移除/更新语义、项目元数据、使用 %(Metadata) 进行批处理、转换、逐项过滤以及跨产品批处理的陷阱。用途：诊断和修复 .csproj 文件中的项目组反模式、审查项目管理的正确性、修复 SDK 通配符导致的 CS2002 重复文件警告、修复因跨产品批处理而运行次数超出预期的目标、修复 SDK 通配符项目上 Include 与 Update 的误用、修复为生成文件清理支持而进行的 FileWrites 注册、将生成文件移动到 IntermediateOutputPath。不适用：目标链架构（使用 target-authoring）、属性模式（使用 property-patterns）、增量性（使用 incremental-build）、一般反模式（使用 msbuild-antipatterns）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: strengthen
description: Upgrade a vigiles spec's guidance() rules to enforce() — scan the guidance rules in a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md spec and find existing linter rules (ESLint, Ruff, Clippy, Pylint, RuboCop, Stylelint) that back them. Use when asked to strengthen, harden, or make vigiles rules enforceable; NOT for general linting or fixing lint errors.
description_zh: 将 vigiles 规范的 guidance() 规则升级为 enforce() — 在 CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 规范中扫描 guidance 规则，并查找支持这些规则的现有代码风格检查规则（ESLint、Ruff、Clippy、Pylint、RuboCop、Stylelint）。仅在要求加强、加固或使 vigiles 规则可强制执行时使用；不用于常规代码风格检查或修复代码风格错误。

name: axiom-alerting
description: Create and manage Axiom monitors and notifiers via the v2 public API. Use when building alerting, routing notifications, validating monitor behavior, and maintaining alert configurations end-to-end.
description_zh: 通过 v2 公共 API 创建和管理 Axiom 监控器和通知器。在构建告警、路由通知、验证监控行为以及维护端到端的告警配置时使用。

name: heuristic-evaluation
description: Run an expert review against Nielsen's heuristics and domain criteria, with severity ratings. Use when you need findings without recruiting participants. For a facilitated team feedback session, use `design-critique` (design-ops).
description_zh: 对尼尔森的启发式方法和领域标准进行专家评审，并附带严重程度评级。当您需要结果而不需要招募参与者时使用。对于引导的团队反馈会议，使用 `design-critique`（design-ops）。

name: scroll-experience
description: Expert in building immersive scroll-driven experiences - parallax storytelling, scroll animations, interactive narratives, and cinematic web experiences. Like NY Times interactives, Apple product pages, and award-winning web experiences.
description_zh: 精通构建沉浸式滚动体验——视差叙事、滚动动画、互动叙事和电影级网页体验。例如《纽约时报》互动内容、苹果产品页面以及获奖网页体验。

name: beads
description: Use when working in a repository that uses bd or Beads for durable project task tracking, issue dependencies, blocker management, multi-session handoff, or shared work memory. Trigger when the user asks to find ready work, claim or close tasks, create follow-up work, inspect blockers, recover project context, or choose between local planning and persistent project tracking.
description_zh: 在以下情况下使用：当您在采用 bd 或 Beads 进行持久性项目任务跟踪、问题依赖关系、阻塞管理、多会话交接或共享工作内存的代码库中工作时。在用户请求查找可处理的工作、认领或关闭任务、创建后续工作、检查阻塞项、恢复项目上下文，或选择本地规划与持久性项目跟踪之间进行选择时触发。

name: target-serp
description: Identify and capture SERP features for target keywords — featured snippets, People Also Ask boxes, knowledge panels, and rich results. Use when the user asks about featured snippets, position zero, PAA optimization, rich results, schema markup for SERP features, or how to get more SERP real estate.
description_zh: 识别并捕获目标关键词的SERP功能——特色摘要、人们还问框、知识面板和丰富结果。在用户询问特色摘要、位置零、PAA优化、丰富结果、SERP功能的结构化标记或如何获取更多SERP展示空间时使用。

name: preference-optimization
description: Align a fine-tuned model with preference data using DPO, ORPO, KTO, or SimPO. Use when preference pairs or thumbs-up/down feedback exist, when choosing between preference-optimization methods, or when a DPO run needs hyperparameters or debugging.
description_zh: 使用 DPO、ORPO、KTO 或 SimPO 将微调模型与偏好数据对齐。当存在偏好数据对或点赞/点踩反馈时使用，或在选择偏好优化方法时使用，或当 DPO 运行需要超参数或调试时使用。

name: build-zoom-rest-api-app
description: Reference skill for Zoom REST API. Use after choosing an API-based workflow when you need endpoint selection, resource-management patterns, OAuth requirements, rate-limit awareness, or API error debugging.
description_zh: Zoom REST API的参考技能。在您选择基于API的工作流程，并需要端点选择、资源管理模式、OAuth要求、速率限制意识或API错误调试时使用。

name: apollo-connectors
description: Guide for integrating REST APIs into GraphQL supergraphs using Apollo Connectors with @source and @connect directives. Use this skill when the user: (1) mentions "connectors", "Apollo Connectors", or "REST Connector", (2) wants to integrate a REST API into GraphQL, (3) references @source or @connect directives, (4) works with files containing "# Note to AI Friends: This is an Apollo Connectors schema".
description_zh: 将 REST API 集成到 GraphQL 超图中的 Apollo Connectors 指南，使用 @source 和 @connect 指令。当用户：(1) 提及“连接器”、“Apollo Connectors”或“REST 连接器”；(2) 想要将 REST API 集成到 GraphQL 中；(3) 引用 @source 或 @connect 指令；(4) 处理包含“# Note to AI Friends: This is an Apollo Connectors schema”注释的文件时，请使用此技能。

name: extension-points
description: Guide for MSBuild extensibility: CustomBefore/CustomAfter hooks, wildcard imports with alphabetic ordering, import gating with control properties, NuGet package build extension layout (build/buildTransitive), and the MicrosoftCommonPropsHasBeenImported guard. USE FOR: diagnosing and fixing MSBuild import and hook patterns, reviewing and fixing extension point anti-patterns in Directory.Build files, fixing missing Exists() guards on imports that break fresh clones, fixing NuGet package hooks being silently dropped instead of appended, making build targets extensible for other projects, injecting custom logic into the build pipeline, creating NuGet packages that extend the build, conditionally disabling imports. DO NOT USE FOR: target authoring patterns (use target-authoring), props vs targets placement (use directory-build-organization), general anti-patterns (use msbuild-antipatterns), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: MSBuild 扩展指南：CustomBefore/CustomAfter 钩子、字母顺序通配符导入、控制属性导入门控、NuGet 包构建扩展布局（build/buildTransitive）以及 MicrosoftCommonPropsHasBeenImported 保护机制。用途：诊断和修复 MSBuild 导入和钩子模式、审查和修复 Directory.Build 文件中的扩展点反模式、修复导致全新克隆失败的缺失 Exists() 保护、修复 NuGet 包钩子被静默丢弃而非追加、使构建目标对其他项目可扩展、向构建管道注入自定义逻辑、创建扩展构建的 NuGet 包、条件禁用导入。不适用：目标编写模式（使用 target-authoring）、属性与目标放置（使用 directory-build-organization）、通用反模式（使用 msbuild-antipatterns）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: k6-trend-analysis
description: Analyze Grafana Cloud k6 test run trends over time. Detects slow metric drift (e.g., P95 latency creeping up while still passing thresholds), computes headroom to thresholds, flags anomalies, and recommends threshold tightening. Use when the user asks about test performance trends, wants to know if metrics are degrading, asks whether thresholds should be tightened, or wants a health check across recent runs for a specific test. Trigger on phrases like "how is my test trending", "is P95 getting worse", "check for performance regression", "should I tighten thresholds", "are my tests degrading", "show me trends for test X", "analyze my k6 test runs", or "is my test getting slower". Also trigger when a user asks to check all tests in a project -- run this skill once per test and synthesize.
description_zh: 分析 Grafana Cloud k6 测试运行随时间变化的趋势。检测指标缓慢漂移（例如，P95 延迟逐渐上升但仍通过阈值），计算与阈值的裕度，标记异常，并建议收紧阈值。当用户询问测试性能趋势、想知道指标是否在退化、询问是否应收紧阈值，或希望对特定测试的最近运行进行健康检查时使用。在以下短语触发： "我的测试趋势如何"、"P95 是否在变差"、"检查性能回归"、"我是否应收紧阈值"、"我的测试是否在退化"、"显示测试 X 的趋势"、"分析我的 k6 测试运行" 或 "我的测试是否在变慢"。此外，当用户要求检查项目中的所有测试时也会触发——对每个测试运行此技能一次，并综合分析。

name: scientific-writing
description: Core skill for the deep research and writing tool. Write scientific manuscripts in full paragraphs (never bullet points). Use two-stage process: (1) create section outlines with key points using research-lookup, (2) convert to flowing prose. IMRAD structure, citations (APA/AMA/Vancouver), figures/tables, reporting guidelines (CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA), for research papers and journal submissions.
description_zh: 核心技能：用于深度研究和写作的工具。以完整段落（绝不使用项目符号）撰写科学文稿。采用两阶段流程：（1）使用研究检索功能创建包含关键点的章节提纲，（2）转换为流畅的散文。IMRAD结构、引文（APA/AMA/Vancouver）、图表、报告指南（CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA），适用于研究论文和期刊投稿。

name: convert-blazor-server-to-webapp
description: Guides conversion of a pre-.NET 8 Blazor Server app into a .NET 8+ Blazor Web App. USE FOR: migrating apps that use AddServerSideBlazor and MapBlazorHub to the AddRazorComponents/MapRazorComponents model, converting _Host.cshtml to an App.razor root component, replacing blazor.server.js with blazor.web.js, migrating CascadingAuthenticationState to a service, adopting new Blazor Web App features like enhanced navigation and streaming rendering. DO NOT USE FOR: apps that are already Blazor Web Apps (already use AddRazorComponents and MapRazorComponents), Blazor WebAssembly or hosted Blazor WebAssembly apps (different migration path), apps that should stay on the Blazor Server hosting model without converting, or apps still targeting .NET Framework.
description_zh: 将预.NET 8的Blazor Server应用程序转换为.NET 8+的Blazor Web应用程序。适用场景：将使用AddServerSideBlazor和MapBlazorHub的应用迁移到AddRazorComponents/MapRazorComponents模型，将_Host.cshtml转换为App.razor根组件，将blazor.server.js替换为blazor.web.js，将CascadingAuthenticationState迁移为服务，采用新的Blazor Web应用程序功能（如增强导航和流式渲染）。不适用场景：已使用AddRazorComponents和MapRazorComponents的Blazor Web应用程序，Blazor WebAssembly或托管Blazor WebAssembly应用程序（具有不同的迁移路径），应保持Blazor Server托管模型而不进行转换的应用程序，或仍针对.NET Framework的应用程序。

name: ui-ux-pro-max-skill
description: AI design intelligence skill for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms with 161 reasoning rules, 67 styles, and automated design system generation
description_zh: AI设计智能技能，用于跨平台构建专业UI/UX，包含161条推理规则、67种风格，以及自动化设计系统生成

name: literature-review
description: Conduct comprehensive, systematic literature reviews using multiple academic databases (PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv, Semantic Scholar, etc.). This skill should be used when conducting systematic literature reviews, meta-analyses, research synthesis, or comprehensive literature searches across biomedical, scientific, and technical domains. Creates professionally formatted markdown documents and PDFs with verified citations in multiple citation styles (APA, Nature, Vancouver, etc.).
description_zh: 使用多个学术数据库（PubMed、arXiv、bioRxiv、Semantic Scholar等）进行全面的系统性文献综述。这项技能应在进行系统性文献综述、元分析、研究综合或跨生物医学、科学和技术领域的全面文献检索时使用。创建具有专业格式化、包含经过验证引用的markdown文档和PDF文件，支持多种引用格式（APA、Nature、Vancouver等）。

name: prisma-next
description: Route a vague Prisma Next prompt to the right specific skill. Use for "help me with Prisma Next", "what is Prisma Next", "explain Prisma Next", "I'm new to PN", "where do I start", "what can I do with Prisma Next", "what can I do next with Prisma", "just ran createprisma", "tour of Prisma Next", "Prisma Next overview", and comparison questions like "Prisma Next vs Prisma 7", "PN vs Drizzle", "PN vs Kysely", "PN vs TypeORM". Do NOT use when the prompt clearly matches a workflow skill — adoption / quickstart / first-touch orientation / brownfield introspection, schema / contract editing, migration authoring (db update / migration plan / migrate), migration review on deploy / concurrent migrations, queries / db.orm / db.sql / TypedSQL, Supabase / RLS / role binding, runtime / db.ts / middleware wiring, build / Vite plugin / Next.js plugin, debug / structured error envelopes / PN-* error codes, or feedback / bug report / feature request — load that sibling skill directly.
description_zh: 将模糊的 Prisma Next 提示路由到正确的特定技能。适用于以下情况："帮我使用 Prisma Next"、"Prisma Next 是什么"、"解释 Prisma Next"、"我是 PN 新手"、"我该从哪里开始"、"我可以用 Prisma Next 做什么"、"我接下来可以用 Prisma 做什么"、"刚运行了 createprisma"、"Prisma Next 漫游指南"、"Prisma Next 概述"，以及比较性问题如 "Prisma Next vs Prisma 7"、"PN vs Drizzle"、"PN vs Kysely"、"PN vs TypeORM"。当提示明显匹配工作流技能时（如采用/快速入门/初次接触引导/遗留系统探索、模式/合约编辑、迁移编写（db 更新/迁移计划/迁移）、部署时的迁移审查/并发迁移、查询/db.orm/db.sql/TypedSQL、Supabase/RLS/角色绑定、运行时/db.ts/中间件配置、构建/Vite 插件/Next.js 插件、调试/结构化错误封装/PN-* 错误代码，或反馈/错误报告/功能请求）时，请勿使用，直接加载该同级技能。

name: fetcher
description: Shared payment and setup skill for fetcher.sh, a pay-per-call web-data API covering Twitter/X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Google Search, Google Maps, Google News, Google Play, the App Store, and Yelp. Use this skill whenever a task needs a fetcher.sh API key, a credit top-up, an x402 micropayment, MCP server configuration, or an explanation of the { status, message, data } response envelope and error codes — before or alongside any of the per-service skills (twitter-api, x-api, tiktok-api, instagram-api, youtube-api, reddit-api, google-search, google-maps, google-news, google-play, app-store, yelp). Also use it when the user asks how to pay with USDC, fund an agent wallet, set up credits, mint or rotate an API key, or connect an MCP client to fetcher.sh.
description_zh: fetcher.sh的共享支付和设置技能，是一个按调用付费的网页数据API，涵盖Twitter/X、TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、Reddit、Google搜索、Google地图、Google新闻、Google Play、App Store和Yelp。每当任务需要fetcher.sh API密钥、充值信用额度、x402微支付、MCP服务器配置，或解释{状态、消息、数据}响应包和错误代码时，都可以使用此技能——在任意一项按服务技能（twitter-api、x-api、tiktok-api、instagram-api、youtube-api、reddit-api、google-search、google-maps、google-news、google-play、app-store、yelp）之前或同时使用。此外，当用户询问如何使用USDC支付、为代理钱包充值、设置信用额度、铸造或轮换API密钥，或连接MCP客户端到fetcher.sh时，也使用此技能。

name: alphafold-database-fetch-and-analyze
description: Retrieve and analyze AlphaFold predicted structures for a protein. Use when the user provides a specific UniProt Accession ID and wants structural confidence metrics (pLDDT), domain boundary analysis, or disorder assessment. Do not use if the user only has a protein name, gene name, or amino acid sequence — ask for a UniProt ID first.

name: pm-skills
description: Use when coordinating project-delivery work across the 8 project-management sub-skills — sprint/velocity analytics, portfolio health, Jira/JQL, Confluence, Atlassian admin, templates, meeting analysis, team comms. Triggers on 'our sprints feel off', 'project health report', 'audit our Jira permissions', 'when will it be done', 'run the delivery loop'. Forks context to route to one sub-skill via a deterministic signal router and returns a digest; can also drive a full goal→plan→execute→verify→close delivery loop through the repo-wide agent-harness with Jira MCP data bridged into the domain's analytics tools. Distinct from product-team (what to build vs how to deliver it), business-operations (internal ops), and engineering/agent-harness (the generic loop engine this orchestrator plugs into).
description_zh: 在协调跨8个项目管理子技能的项目交付工作时使用——包括Sprint/速度分析、项目组合健康状况、Jira/JQL、Confluence、Atlassian管理、模板、会议分析、团队沟通。触发条件为“我们的Sprint感觉不对”、“项目健康状况报告”、“审计我们的Jira权限”、“何时完成”、“运行交付循环”。通过确定性信号路由器将上下文分支路由到其中一个子技能，并返回摘要；还可以通过包含Jira MCP数据的仓库级代理框架，驱动从目标→计划→执行→验证→关闭的完整交付循环，并将数据桥接至该领域的分析工具。与产品团队（要构建什么与如何交付）、业务运营（内部运营）以及工程/代理框架（此编排器接入的通用循环引擎）有所区别。

name: flowstudio-power-automate-debug
description: Debug failing Power Automate cloud flows using the FlowStudio MCP server. The Graph API only shows top-level status codes. This skill gives your agent action-level inputs and outputs to find the actual root cause. Load this skill when asked to: debug a flow, investigate a failed run, why is this flow failing, inspect action outputs, find the root cause of a flow error, fix a broken Power Automate flow, diagnose a timeout, trace a DynamicOperationRequestFailure, check connector auth errors, read error details from a run, or troubleshoot expression failures. Requires a FlowStudio MCP subscription — see https://mcp.flowstudio.app
description_zh: 使用 FlowStudio MCP 服务器调试失败的 Power Automate 云流程。Graph API 仅显示顶层状态代码。此技能为您提供操作级别的输入和输出，以找到实际的根本原因。当被要求：调试流程、调查失败运行、此流程为何失败、检查操作输出、找到流程错误的根本原因、修复损坏的 Power Automate 流程、诊断超时、追踪 DynamicOperationRequestFailure、检查连接器认证错误、从运行中读取错误详情或排查表达式失败时，请加载此技能。需要 FlowStudio MCP 订阅 — 请参阅 https://mcp.flowstudio.app

name: xiaohongshu-images
description: Transform markdown/HTML into styled 3:4 ratio images for Xiaohongshu 新手引导：输入 `/小红书配图 新手`、「这个怎么用」「第一次用」「能干嘛」时，走 SKILL.md 的〈新手上路〉，不要直接开始干活。

name: semgrep
description: Run Semgrep static analysis scans and create custom detection rules. Use when asked to scan code with Semgrep, find security vulnerabilities, write custom YAML rules, or detect specific bug patterns. IMPORTANT: Also use this skill when users ask to 'scan for bugs', 'check code quality', 'find vulnerabilities', 'static analysis', 'lint for security', 'audit this code', or want to enforce coding standards — even if they don't mention Semgrep by name. Semgrep is the right tool for pattern-based code scanning across 30+ languages.
description_zh: 运行 Semgrep 静态分析扫描并创建自定义检测规则。当被要求使用 Semgrep 扫描代码、查找安全漏洞、编写自定义 YAML 规则或检测特定 Bug 模式时使用。重要提示：当用户要求“扫描 Bug”、“检查代码质量”、“查找漏洞”、“静态分析”、“安全 Lint”、“审计代码”或希望强制执行编码规范时——即使他们没有提及 Semgrep 的名称——也应使用此技能。Semgrep 是用于跨 30 多种语言进行基于模式的代码扫描的正确工具。

name: checkpoint-promotion
description: Gate fine-tuned checkpoints with drift budgets, paired comparison, and forgetting checks before promotion. Use after a training run produces a checkpoint, when deciding whether a tuned model ships, or when a promoted model needs re-gating against updated goldens.
description_zh: 在模型晋级前，使用漂移预算、配对比较和遗忘检查对门控微调检查点进行优化。在训练运行后生成检查点时，在决定是否发布调优模型时，或在已发布的模型需要针对更新后的黄金标准进行重新门控时使用。

name: quantized-export
description: Export a promoted fine-tuned model in the right deployment format — merged safetensors, LoRA-only, GGUF with imatrix, or FP8. Use after a checkpoint passes promotion, when choosing a quantization format for a target device, or when an exported model fails its smoke test.
description_zh: 导出在正确部署格式下的优化微调模型——合并的safetensors、仅LoRA、带imatrix的GGUF或FP8。在检查点通过优化后、选择目标设备的量化格式时，或导出的模型未通过冒烟测试时使用。

name: write-openspec-docs
description: Switches into OpenSpec docs-writing mode; loads the house style guide and drafts or revises pages in its voice (action-first, no preamble, scannable). Use when writing or editing pages in the OpenSpec docs tree.
description_zh: 切换到 OpenSpec 文档编写模式；加载房屋风格指南，并以其口吻撰写或修订页面（行动优先，无开场白，可扫描）。在编写或编辑 OpenSpec 文档树中的页面时使用。

name: experience-lwc-security-validate
description: Use this skill as THE specialized Lightning Web Security (LWS) validator for a Lightning Web Component bundle (`.js`, `.ts`, `.html`, `.css`, `.js-meta.xml`) — the canonical LWS/Product-Security review for LWCs, NOT a generic code-security pass. It produces either a severity-ranked finding list with code-level remediations or a SARIF 2.1.0 JSON score report keyed by the `lws-001`…`lws-023b` rule catalog. TRIGGER when the user asks to review, audit, or check an LWC component for LWS compliance issues and recommend fixes, score a component's LWS/security compliance, find dangerous DOM APIs or blocked sinks (`eval`, `Function`, `document.write`, `innerHTML`, `document.createElement('script')`, global-scope assignment to `window`/`globalThis`, unsafe URL schemes), or emit a SARIF security report. DO NOT TRIGGER for generic non-LWC security review, for building a new LWC (use experience-lwc-generate), accessibility (WCAG 2.2), RTL/i18n, or Apex/Aura/server-side review.
description_zh: 使用此技能作为专门的闪电网页安全（LWS）验证器，用于闪电网页组件包（`.js`、`.ts`、`.html`、`.css`、`.js-meta.xml`）——这是闪电网页组件（LWC）的规范LWS/产品安全审查，而不是通用的代码安全检查。它将生成一个按严重程度排序的问题列表，并提供代码级别的修复建议，或者生成一个以 `lws-001`…`lws-023b` 规则目录为键的SARIF 2.1.0 JSON评分报告。当用户要求审查、审计或检查LWC组件的LWS合规性问题并建议修复方案、评分组件的LWS/安全合规性、查找危险的DOM API或被阻止的接收器（`eval`、`Function`、`document.write`、`innerHTML`、`document.createElement('script')`、全局作用域赋值给 `window`/`globalThis`、不安全的URL方案），或发出SARIF安全报告时触发。不应用于通用的非LWC安全审查、构建新的LWC（使用 `experience-lwc-generate`）、无障碍性（WCAG 2.2）、RTL/i18n，或Apex/Aura/服务器端审查。

name: cli-anything
description: Use when the user wants Codex to build, refine, test, validate, or list CLI-Anything harnesses for GUI applications or source repositories. Adapts the full CLI-Anything methodology to Codex without changing the generated Python harness format.
description_zh: 当用户希望Codex为GUI应用程序或源代码库构建、完善、测试、验证或列出CLI-Anything工具架时使用。该功能将完整的CLI-Anything方法论适配到Codex，同时不改变生成的Python工具架格式。

name: clone-website
description: Reverse-engineer and clone one or more websites in one shot — extracts assets, CSS, and content section-by-section and proactively dispatches parallel builder agents in worktrees as it goes. Use this whenever the user wants to clone, replicate, rebuild, reverse-engineer, or copy any website. Also triggers on phrases like "make a copy of this site", "rebuild this page", "pixel-perfect clone". Provide one or more target URLs as arguments.
description_zh: 一次性逆向工程并克隆一个或多个网站——逐段提取资源、CSS和内容，并在过程中主动在工作树中派遣并行构建代理。用户在任何时候想要克隆、复制、重建、逆向工程或复制任何网站时都可以使用此功能。同时，在类似“复制此网站”、“重建此页面”、“像素级克隆”的短语触发下也会执行。请提供一个或多个目标URL作为参数。

name: verify-openspec-docs
description: Fact-checks OpenSpec user documentation with a fresh-context subagent that re-runs commands and checks claims against source. Manually triggered; not part of the drafting loop. Use when the user asks to verify, fact-check, or accuracy-check a docs page, section, or set of changed claims.
description_zh: 使用 fresh-context 子代理对 OpenSpec 用户文档进行事实核查，该子代理会重新运行命令并对照源材料检查声明。手动触发；不属于起草流程的一部分。当用户要求验证、事实核查或准确性核查文档页面、章节或一组变更声明时使用。

name: citation-management
description: Manage BibTeX citations for LaTeX papers. Harvest missing citations from a draft using Semantic Scholar, validate cite keys against .bib files, deduplicate entries, and format bibliography. Use when working with references, BibTeX, or citations.
description_zh: 管理 LaTeX 论文的 BibTeX 引用。使用 Semantic Scholar 从草稿中收集缺失的引用，验证引用键与 .bib 文件是否匹配，去重条目，并格式化参考文献。在处理参考文献、BibTeX 或引用时使用。

name: flutter-adaptive-ui
description: Build, fix, review, and validate adaptive or responsive Flutter UIs for mobile, tablet, desktop, web, large screens, foldables, and mixed input devices. Use when creating breakpoint-driven layouts, responsive navigation, adaptive dialogs/lists/grids, keyboard/mouse/touch behavior, window-size decisions with MediaQuery or LayoutBuilder, or Capability and Policy patterns for platform-specific behavior.
description_zh: 构建、修复、审查和验证适用于移动设备、平板电脑、桌面、网络、大屏幕、折叠屏以及混合输入设备的自适应或响应式 Flutter UI。在创建基于断点的布局、响应式导航、自适应对话框/列表/网格、键盘/鼠标/触摸行为、使用 MediaQuery 或 LayoutBuilder 进行窗口大小决策，或使用 Capability 和 Policy 模式实现平台特定行为时使用。

name: alibabacloud-dms-skill
description:
Alibaba Cloud DMS Database Read/Write Skill. Use this skill to search for target databases in DMS and execute SQL queries and data modifications.
Triggers: "DMS query", "database query", "execute SQL", "search database", "DMS SQL", "insert data", "update data".
description_zh:
阿里云 DMS 数据库读写技能。使用此技能可在 DMS 中搜索目标数据库，并执行 SQL 查询和数据修改。
触发词："DMS 查询"、"数据库查询"、"执行 SQL"、"搜索数据库"、"DMS SQL"、"插入数据"、"更新数据"。

name: clean-architecture
description: Clean Architecture for .NET applications. Covers the 4-project layout (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Api), dependency inversion, use case handlers, domain entities with behavior, and infrastructure as a plugin. Load this skill when building a project with Clean Architecture, discussing layered architecture, dependency inversion, use cases, or when the architecture-advisor recommends Clean Architecture.
description_zh: .NET应用程序的整洁架构。涵盖4项目布局（领域、应用、基础设施、API）、依赖反转、用例处理器、带行为的领域实体以及基础设施作为插件。在构建采用整洁架构的项目、讨论分层架构、依赖反转、用例或当架构顾问推荐整洁架构时加载此技能。

name: draft-openspec-docs
description: Collaborative page-drafting mode for the OpenSpec docs. Builds a scratch plan inside the target page (purpose, structure, numbered draft steps), iterates on it with the user, then drafts one section per approved step and cleans up after itself. Use when a page needs a from-scratch rewrite or a new page is being shaped with the user in the loop.
description_zh: OpenSpec 文档的协作页面草稿模式。在目标页面内构建一个草稿计划（目的、结构、编号的草稿步骤），与用户迭代该计划，然后根据批准的步骤逐节草稿，并在完成后清理。当页面需要从头开始重写或与用户共同构建新页面时使用。

name: daily-stock-analysis
description: LLM-powered A/H/US stock intelligent analysis system with multi-source data, real-time news, AI decision dashboards, and multi-channel push notifications via GitHub Actions.
description_zh: 基于LLM的A/H/US股票智能分析系统，整合多源数据、实时新闻、AI决策仪表盘，并通过GitHub Actions实现多渠道推送通知。

name: scribe
description: Reference skill for Zoom AI Services Scribe. Use after routing to a transcription workflow when handling uploaded or stored media, Build-platform JWT auth, fast mode transcription, batch jobs, or transcript pipeline design.
description_zh: Zoom AI服务Scribe的参考技能。在处理上传或存储的媒体时，用于路由到转录工作流后，构建平台JWT认证、快速模式转录、批量作业或转录管道设计。

name: migrate-nativewind-to-uniwind
description: Migrate a React Native project from NativeWind to Uniwind. Use when the user wants to replace NativeWind with Uniwind, upgrade from NativeWind, switch to Uniwind, or mentions NativeWind-to-Uniwind migration. Handles package removal, config migration, Tailwind 4 upgrade, cssInterop removal, theme conversion, and all breaking changes.
description_zh: 将 React Native 项目从 NativeWind 迁移到 Uniwind。当用户希望用 Uniwind 替换 NativeWind、从 NativeWind 升级、切换到 Uniwind，或提及 NativeWind 到 Uniwind 的迁移时使用。处理包移除、配置迁移、Tailwind 4 升级、cssInterop 移除、主题转换以及所有破坏性变更。

name: vitest-midscene-e2e
description: Enhances Vitest with Midscene for AI-powered UI testing across Web (Playwright), Android (ADB), and iOS (WDA). Scaffolds new projects, converts existing projects, and creates/updates/debugs/runs E2E tests using natural-language UI interactions. Triggers: write test, add test, create test, update test, fix test, debug test, run test, e2e test, midscene test, new project, convert project, init project, 写测试, 加测试, 创建测试, 更新测试, 修复测试, 调试测试, 运行测试, 新建工程, 转化工程.
description_zh: 增强 Vitest，通过 Midscene 实现基于人工智能的跨平台 UI 测试，支持 Web（Playwright）、Android（ADB）和 iOS（WDA）。搭建新项目、转换现有项目，并使用自然语言 UI 交互创建/更新/调试/运行 E2E 测试。触发：写测试、加测试、创建测试、更新测试、修复测试、调试测试、运行测试、E2E 测试、Midscene 测试、新建工程、转化工程。

name: grpo-rlvr-training
description: Train reasoning and verifiable-task behavior with GRPO and reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). Use when task success is algorithmically checkable (math, code, tool calls, structured output), when designing GRPO reward functions, or when a GRPO run diverges or reward-hacks.
description_zh: 使用可验证奖励（RLVR）进行GRPO和强化学习，以训练推理和可验证任务行为。当任务成功可以通过算法进行验证（数学、代码、工具调用、结构化输出）时，在设计GRPO奖励函数时，或当GRPO运行出现偏离或奖励绕过时使用。

name: helmor-cli
description: Use the Helmor CLI to remote-control Helmor from the terminal. Use when the user asks to inspect Helmor data/settings, manage repositories/workspaces/sessions/files, send prompts to agents, list models, use GitHub integration, inspect scripts, run Helmor as an MCP server, generate shell completions, quit a running app, check/install/update the Helmor CLI beta, install/update Helmor skills through the beta app flow, or needs the Helmor command reference. Also plan and build a large change as a stack of dependent PRs (`/helmor-cli stack`), split a change you've already written into a stack (`/helmor-cli break`), and re-sync a stack after lower layers change or merge (`/helmor-cli restack`).
description_zh: 使用 Helmor CLI 从终端远程控制 Helmor。当用户需要检查 Helmor 数据/设置、管理仓库/工作区/会话/文件、向代理发送提示、列出模型、使用 GitHub 集成、检查脚本、以 MCP 服务器方式运行 Helmor、生成 shell 补全、退出正在运行的应用、检查/安装/更新 Helmor CLI Beta、通过 Beta 应用流程安装/更新 Helmor 技能，或需要 Helmor 命令参考时使用。此外，还可以规划和构建一个大型变更，将其作为一系列依赖的 PR 堆栈 (`/helmor-cli stack`)，将已编写好的变更拆分为堆栈 (`/helmor-cli break`)，以及在较低层变更或合并后重新同步堆栈 (`/helmor-cli restack`)。

name: target-authoring
description: Canonical patterns for writing custom MSBuild targets. USE FOR: diagnosing and fixing custom target authoring anti-patterns; broken SDK target chains across files (e.g., Directory.Build.targets silently redefining SDK targets); targets that replace CompileDependsOn instead of extending it with $(CompileDependsOn); query targets returning stale results from Outputs vs Returns misuse; missing Inputs/Outputs causing unnecessary rebuilds; missing FileWrites registration. Covers DependsOnTargets vs BeforeTargets vs AfterTargets, the Build→CoreBuild three-level pattern, and the $(XxxDependsOn) chain-extension pattern. DO NOT USE FOR: incremental build tuning (use incremental-build), parallelization (use build-parallelism), general anti-patterns (use msbuild-antipatterns), non-MSBuild build systems.
description_zh: 编写自定义 MSBuild 目标的规范模式。用途：诊断和修复自定义目标编写反模式；跨文件损坏的 SDK 目标链（例如，Directory.Build.targets 悄然重定义 SDK 目标）；替换 CompileDependsOn 而不是用 $(CompileDependsOn) 扩展的目标；查询目标因 Outputs 与 Returns 误用而返回陈旧结果；缺失的 Inputs/Outputs 导致不必要的重新构建；缺失的 FileWrites 注册。涵盖 DependsOnTargets 与 BeforeTargets 与 AfterTargets、Build→CoreBuild 三级模式，以及 $(XxxDependsOn) 链式扩展模式。不适用：增量构建调优（使用 incremental-build）、并行化（使用 build-parallelism）、通用反模式（使用 msbuild-antipatterns）、非 MSBuild 构建系统。

name: pdb-database
description: Use when you want to search for or download experimentally-determined 3D structures for biomolecules (proteins, nucleic acids, bound ligands). Supports searching by sequence similarity, structure similarity, chemical and other attributes. Also use to get metadata about biomolecular structure experiments.

name: docs-review
description: Review documentation changes for compliance with the Metabase writing style guide. Use when reviewing pull requests, files, or diffs containing documentation markdown files.
description_zh: 审查文档更改是否符合Metabase写作风格指南。在审查pull请求、文件或包含文档markdown文件的diff时使用。

name: research-decision-room
description:
Turn messy user research notes, interviews, support tickets, surveys, and product
context into an evidence-backed decision room: a single HTML artifact with an
evidence ledger, theme map, confidence heatmap, opportunity matrix, decision
memo, and experiment queue. Use when teams need to move from qualitative
signals to product or design decisions without fabricating certainty.
description_zh: 将杂乱的用户研究笔记、访谈记录、支持工单、调查问卷和产品背景资料转化为一个有据可依的决策空间：一个包含证据账本、主题地图、信心热力图、机会矩阵、决策备忘录和实验队列的单一HTML文件。当团队需要从定性信号转向产品或设计决策，且不伪造确定性时使用。

name: qianwen-find-skills
description: Discover, compare, and optionally install published Agent Skills from QianWen SkillHubs. TRIGGER when: user asks to find or recommend a skill, compare candidates, install a discovered skill, or explicitly invokes this skill by name. DO NOT TRIGGER when: user already selected an installed skill and only wants to run it, or the request is unrelated to skill discovery or installation.
description_zh: 发现、比较并可选地安装来自千问技能中心的已发布技能。在以下情况下触发：用户要求查找或推荐技能、比较候选技能、安装发现的技能，或通过名称显式调用此技能。在以下情况下不触发：用户已选择一个已安装的技能并且只想运行它，或请求与技能发现或安装无关。

name: test-harness
description: Install vigiles and test a Claude Code harness — hooks, skills, agents, settings, CLAUDE.md — by picking the right tier (unit / deterministic / eval) and writing a test that passes. Use to check that a hook fires or blocks, that a skill triggers, that injected context lands; or to observe a run — which tools it called, whether it stayed inside its declared allowed-tools, what files and side effects it produced, how to intercept a call without executing it.
description_zh: 安装 vigiles 并测试 Claude 代码套件——钩子、技能、代理、设置、CLAUDE.md——通过选择正确的层级（单元/确定性/评估）并编写一个通过的测试。用于检查钩子是否触发或阻止，技能是否触发，注入的上下文是否到达；或者用于观察运行情况——它调用了哪些工具，是否保持在声明的允许工具范围内，它产生了哪些文件和副作用，如何在不执行的情况下拦截调用。

name: style-guide
description: 문서 내부 또는 프로젝트 전체에서 일관된 작성 스타일을 유지하도록 돕는 검사기. 어조(경어체/반말), 용어(사용자/유저), 숫자 형식, 목록 스타일, 따옴표, 날짜/시간 형식의 불일치를 감지합니다. 다중 작성자 문서 검토 시, 프로젝트 전체 용어 표준 유지 시, 공식 문서 준비 시, 브랜드 일관성을 위한 문서 작업 시 사용하세요.
description_zh:
**一致性检查器**：帮助在文档内部或整个项目中保持统一的写作风格。该检查器可检测语气（敬语体/平语体）、术语（“用户”/“用户”）、数字格式、列表样式、引号、日期/时间格式等方面的不一致问题。

**适用场景**：  
- 审查由多位作者撰写的文档  
- 维护整个项目的术语标准  
- 准备正式文档  
- 为确保品牌一致性而进行的文档编写

name: use-js-interop
description: Add, review, or fix JavaScript interop in Blazor components. USE FOR: calling JavaScript from Blazor, calling .NET from JavaScript, collocated .razor.js modules, IJSRuntime, IJSObjectReference lifecycle, DotNetObjectReference, ElementReference, timing rules for when JS is available, IAsyncDisposable disposal of JS references, server-side JS interop safety. DO NOT USE FOR: general Blazor component authoring without JS interop needs (use author-component), forms (use collect-user-input).
description_zh: 在 Blazor 组件中添加、审查或修复 JavaScript 互操作。用途：从 Blazor 调用 JavaScript、从 JavaScript 调用 .NET、同位的 .razor.js 模块、IJSRuntime、IJSObjectReference 生命周期、DotNetObjectReference、ElementReference、JS 可用性时间规则、IAsyncDisposable 的 JS 引用清理、服务器端 JS 互操作安全性。不适用：无 JS 互操作需求的通用 Blazor 组件编写（使用 author-component）、表单（使用 collect-user-input）。

name: plan-zoom-product
description: Choose the right Zoom building surface for a use case and explain the tradeoffs clearly. Use when deciding between REST API, Webhooks, WebSockets, Meeting SDK, Video SDK, Zoom Apps SDK, Phone, Contact Center, or MCP for a specific product idea or integration goal.
description_zh: 选择适合特定用例的 Zoom 构建表面，并清晰说明权衡因素。在决定使用 REST API、Webhooks、WebSockets、会议 SDK、视频 SDK、Zoom 应用程序 SDK、电话、联络中心或 MCP 为特定产品理念或集成目标时使用。

name: k6-cloud-investigate-test
description: Investigate a Grafana Cloud k6 test — describe the script, list run history, identify pass/fail status, pull raw metric time-series and log lines for one or more runs, and (if asked) safely edit the test script. Use when the user asks about a specific k6 cloud test or run, gives a `/a/k6-app/tests/<id>` or `/a/k6-app/runs/<id>` URL, asks "is this test passing", "why are my k6 tests failing", "show me metrics for run X", "show me logs for run X", or wants to add thresholds / fix a failing test. Trigger this skill even when the user doesn't explicitly say "investigate" — pasted `/a/k6-app/...` URLs, "why did run X fail", "what happened with my test", "is my test healthy", "the latest run looks weird", "checks are failing but the run says passed", or any request to diagnose a Grafana Cloud k6 run all qualify.
description_zh: 调查 Grafana Cloud k6 测试——描述脚本、列出运行历史、识别通过/失败状态、为单个或多个运行拉取原始指标时间序列和日志行，以及在（被要求时）安全地编辑测试脚本。当用户询问特定的 k6 云测试或运行、提供 `/a/k6-app/tests/<id>` 或 `/a/k6-app/runs/<id>` URL、询问“这个测试是否通过”、“我的 k6 测试为什么失败”、“显示运行 X 的指标”、“显示运行 X 的日志”，或希望添加阈值/修复失败的测试时使用。即使用户没有明确说“调查”，也可以触发此技能——粘贴 `/a/k6-app/...` URL、“运行 X 为什么失败”、“我的测试发生了什么”、“我的测试是否健康”、“最新的运行看起来很奇怪”、“检查失败但运行显示通过”，或任何诊断 Grafana Cloud k6 运行的请求都符合条件。

name: clojure-write
description: Guide Clojure and ClojureScript development using REPL-driven workflow, coding conventions, and best practices. Use when writing, developing, or refactoring Clojure/ClojureScript code.
description_zh: 使用 REPL 驱动的开发流程、编码规范和最佳实践来指导 Clojure 和 ClojureScript 开发。在编写、开发或重构 Clojure/ClojureScript 代码时使用。

name: qianwen-payment
description: QianWenAI cash balance query and fixed-amount Alipay recharge orchestration. Owns the outer recharge lifecycle while delegating the payment-side step to `alipay-payment-skill` when selected. Covers balance, recharge orders, order results, recharge history, missing current-order QR recovery, Token Plan redirects, and recharge page guidance. TRIGGER when: explicit QianWenAI balance query, confirmed recharge request with amount, model-call error explicitly reporting insufficient QianWenAI balance or account overdue, recharge result/history query, the user reports that the current QianWenAI recharge QR was not displayed, Token Plan purchase redirect, user wants guidance for the QianWenAI recharge page, or user explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qianwen-payment). DO NOT TRIGGER when: usage/billing/subscription queries (use qianwen-usage), incoming Alipay payment links or unrelated merchant orders (use alipay-payment-skill), refunds, non-QianWenAI products.
description_zh: 千文AI余额查询与固定金额支付宝充值编排。拥有外部充值生命周期，并在选定时将支付环节委托给`alipay-payment-skill`。涵盖余额、充值订单、订单结果、充值历史、当前订单二维码缺失恢复、Token计划重定向以及充值页面引导。触发条件：明确千文AI余额查询、确认金额的充值请求、模型调用明确报告千文AI余额不足或账户过期、充值结果/历史查询、用户报告当前千文AI充值二维码未显示、Token计划购买重定向、用户需要千文AI充值页面引导，或用户通过名称明确调用此技能（例如使用qianwen-payment）。不触发条件：使用/计费/订阅查询（使用qianwen-usage）、入站的支付宝支付链接或不相关的商户订单（使用alipay-payment-skill）、退款、非千文AI产品。

name: fiction-workshop
description: Use when writing or editing novels, short stories, or any fiction manuscript. Trigger on: 'write fiction', 'edit my novel', 'developmental edit', 'line edit', 'character voice', 'plot hole', 'brainstorm', or fiction writing tasks.
description_zh: 在撰写或编辑小说、短篇故事或任何虚构稿件时使用。触发条件：'写小说'、'编辑我的小说'、'发展性编辑'、'行文编辑'、'人物声音'、'情节漏洞'、'头脑风暴'或虚构写作任务。

name: app-icon
description: Generate app icons for your React Native Expo app with iOS 26 support
description_zh: 为您的 React Native Expo 应用生成支持 iOS 26 的应用图标

name: prompt-optimizer
description: Transforms vague prompts or feature requests into precise, testable specifications using EARS (Easy Approach to Requirements Syntax) grounded in relevant domain theories (GTD, BJ Fogg, Gestalt). Use when requirements lack triggers or measurable outcomes, or the user asks to "optimize my prompt" / "improve this requirement" / "make this more specific".
description_zh: 利用基于相关领域理论（GTD、BJ Fogg、格式塔心理学）的 EARS（简易需求语法）方法，将模糊的提示词或功能请求转化为精确、可测试的规格说明。当需求缺少触发条件或可衡量的结果，或者用户请求“优化我的提示词”/“改进此需求”/“使此需求更具体”时，使用此方法。

name: pubchem-database
description: Query PubChem, search by name/CID/SMILES, retrieve properties, similarity/substructure searches, bioactivity, for cheminformatics. Use when a user asks about a specific chemical, drug, or molecule.

name: rev-frida
description: Generate Frida hook scripts using modern Frida API. Activate when the user wants to write Frida scripts, hook functions at runtime, trace calls or arguments or return values, intercept native or ObjC or Java methods, dump memory or exports, or handle native module load timing for Android and other targets.
description_zh: 使用现代 Frida API 生成 Frida hook 脚本。当用户想要编写 Frida 脚本、在运行时钩子函数、跟踪调用或参数或返回值、拦截原生或 ObjC 或 Java 方法、转储内存或导出，或处理 Android 和其他目标的原生模块加载时机时激活。

name: prisma-next-migrations
description: Author Prisma Next migrations — choose db update vs migration plan, edit the framework-rendered migration.ts (replace placeholder sentinels with dataTransform closures), recover from MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH or PN-MIG-2001 unfilled placeholder. Use for prisma migrate dev, prisma migrate deploy, prisma db push, db update, db update --dry-run, migration plan, migrate, migration new, migration show, db verify, db sign, data migration, this.dataTransform, dataTransform, placeholder, generated migration.ts, edit migration.ts, MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH, schema drift.
description_zh: 作者 Prisma Next 迁移——选择数据库更新或迁移计划，编辑框架生成的 migration.ts（将占位符哨兵替换为 dataTransform 闭包），从 MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH 或 PN-MIG-2001 未填写的占位符中恢复。用于 prisma migrate dev、prisma migrate deploy、prisma db push、数据库更新、数据库更新 --dry-run、迁移计划、migrate、migration new、migration show、数据库验证、数据库签名、数据迁移、this.dataTransform、dataTransform、占位符、生成的 migration.ts、编辑 migration.ts、MIGRATION.HASH_MISMATCH、模式漂移。

name: autocli
description: Use autocli CLI to interact with 55+ social/content websites (HackerNews, Reddit, Twitter/X, Bilibili, Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, YouTube, Medium, Substack, Douban, WeRead, Linux-do, V2EX, Bloomberg, Google, Arxiv, Wikipedia, StackOverflow, Steam, Hugging Face, Apple Podcasts, Xiaoyuzhou, BBC, SinaFinance, DevTo, Lobsters, Xueqiu, BOSS直聘, Jike, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reuters, SMZDM, Ctrip, Coupang, Yahoo Finance, Barchart, Grok, Jimeng, Yollomi, Chaoxing, Weixin, Doubao, Cursor, Codex, ChatWise, ChatGPT, Notion, Discord, Antigravity etc.) via the user's Chrome login session. ALWAYS prefer autocli over playwright/browser automation for supported sites. Triggers when user asks to browse, search, fetch hot/trending content, post, or read messages on any website; also use 'autocli read <url>' to extract main article content as Markdown (prefer over WebFetch for JS-rendered or login-gated pages).

name: spacing-system
description: Create a spacing scale from a base unit with rules for when each step applies. Use when standardising padding and margins. For page-level columns and gutters, use `layout-grid`.
description_zh: 从基本单位创建间距比例，并规定每个步骤适用的规则。用于标准化填充和边距。对于页面级别的列和间隙，请使用 `layout-grid`。

name: physical-ai-video-data-augmentation
description: Use when running video data augmentation and auto-labeling workflows on OSMO: flow selection, preflight, submit-time interpolation, monitoring, and output retrieval. Trigger keywords: video data augmentation, data enrichment, auto labeling, VDA demo, OSMO workflow, pseudo labeling.
description_zh: 在OSMO上运行视频数据增强和自动标注工作流时使用：流程选择、预检、提交时间插值、监控和输出检索。触发关键词：视频数据增强、数据丰富、自动标注、VDA演示、OSMO工作流、伪标注。

name: om-auto-implement-spec
description: Implement an existing spec and ship a verified, reviewed, ready PR. Resolves the spec by path, name, issue, or spec-PR number (clean stop with candidates when not found). A spec PR stays design-only — implementation ships on its own PR referencing it. Delegates to om-auto-create-pr (om-auto-continue-pr for an existing implementation PR), then runs the review loop and UI verification with screenshots. Use for "implement the spec X", "build spec from issue 123".
description_zh: 实现现有规范并提交一个经过验证、审核且准备好的PR。通过路径、名称、问题或规范PR编号解决规范（未找到时提供干净的停止和候选方案）。规范PR保持设计专一性——实现部分将在其自己的PR中引用它。委托给om-auto-create-pr（对于现有的实现PR使用om-auto-continue-pr），然后运行审核循环和带截图的UI验证。用于“实现规范X”、“从问题123构建规范”。

name: trace-to-training-data
description: Convert evaluation traces and production logs into SFT examples and preference pairs. Use when graded traces or failure examples exist and need to become training data, when applying rejection sampling to model outputs, or when building DPO pairs from passing and failing runs.
description_zh: 将评估跟踪和产品日志转换为SFT示例和偏好对。当存在需要成为训练数据的评分跟踪或失败示例时使用，当对模型输出应用拒绝采样时使用，或当从通过和失败的运行中构建DPO对时使用。

name: issue-fields-migration
description: Bulk-migrate metadata to GitHub issue fields from two sources: repo labels (e.g. priority labels to a Priority field) and Project V2 fields. Use when users say "migrate my labels to issue fields", "migrate project fields to issue fields", "convert labels to issue fields", "copy project field values to issue fields", or ask about adopting issue fields. Issue fields are org-level typed metadata (single select, text, number, date) that replace label-based workarounds with structured, searchable, cross-repo fields.
description_zh: 批量将元数据从两个来源迁移到 GitHub 问题字段：仓库标签（例如将优先级标签迁移到优先级字段）和项目 V2 字段。当用户说“将我的标签迁移到问题字段”、“将项目字段迁移到问题字段”、“将标签转换为问题字段”、“将项目字段值复制到问题字段”，或询问采用问题字段时使用。问题字段是组织级别的类型元数据（单选、文本、数字、日期），用于用结构化、可搜索、跨仓库的字段替代基于标签的解决方案。

name: pudl
description: Explore and understand PUDL energy data: discover which tables exist, look up column meanings and usage warnings, and load Parquet files from S3 or a local directory. No PUDL Python package required. Use this skill whenever a user asks what PUDL data contains, wants to understand a specific table or column, asks about data quality or limitations, needs help loading data into a notebook or script, or wants to know which table covers a topic like electricity generation, utility financials, fuel costs, power plant locations, emissions, capacity factors, FERC financial data, or EIA survey data. Also use when the user mentions PUDL, Catalyst Cooperative energy data, or any of the specific data sources PUDL ingests (EIA-860, EIA-861, EIA-923, FERC Form 1, FERC Form 714, FERC EQR, EPA CEMS, EPA CAMD, etc.).
description_zh: 探索和理解PUDL能源数据：发现哪些表格存在，查询列的含义和使用警告，以及从S3或本地目录加载Parquet文件。无需PUDL Python包。当用户询问PUDL数据包含哪些内容、想了解特定表格或列、询问数据质量或限制、需要帮助将数据加载到笔记本或脚本中，或想知道哪些表格涵盖电力生产、公用事业财务、燃料成本、发电厂位置、排放、容量因子、FERC财务数据或EIA调查数据等主题时，使用此技能。同样适用于用户提到PUDL、Catalyst Cooperative能源数据，或PUDL整合的任何具体数据源（如EIA-860、EIA-861、EIA-923、FERC Form 1、FERC Form 714、FERC EQR、EPA CEMS、EPA CAMD等）。

name: om-auto-manage-issues
description: Bring existing tracker issues up to standard without implementing anything — applies missing SDLC labels, clarifies laconic issues (analyzing attached screenshots), posts a read-only implementation-prep analysis, checks each issue against SDLC.md's Definition of Ready (READY_STATUS, not-ready comment), and flags feature issues lacking a covering spec (optionally authoring one with --write-missing-specs). Single issue or a batch (last ~25 open, worst-described first). Idempotent, claim-aware.
description_zh: 在不实施任何改动的情况下，将现有追踪问题提升至标准要求——应用缺失的SDLC标签，澄清简洁问题（分析附加的截图），发布只读的实施准备分析，检查每个问题是否符合SDLC.md中的就绪定义（READY_STATUS，未就绪的评论），并标记缺少覆盖性规范的特性问题（可选使用--write-missing-specs生成一个）。单个问题或批量处理（最后约25个开放的，描述最差的优先）。幂等，注意声明。

name: prompt-videos
description: Prompting techniques for AI video generation models on Replicate. Use when writing prompts for video models or building video generation features.
description_zh: Replicate上AI视频生成模型的提示技巧。在为视频模型编写提示或构建视频生成功能时使用。

name: omp-delegate
description: Delegate a coding task to Oh My Pi (`omp`) as a background implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use this whenever the user wants to delegate implementation work to Oh My Pi / omp - phrasings like "have omp implement X", "delegate this to oh my pi", "run it through omp", "use oh-my-pi to implement/fix/refactor" - or wants to run a queue of coding tasks through omp while staying the reviewer. DO NOT USE for tasks small enough to do inline, when the user wants the code written directly without delegating, or when they mean the original Pi CLI (`pi`) — that is pi-delegate.
description_zh: 将编码任务委托给 Oh My Pi (`omp`) 作为后台实现者，然后自行审查其代码差异并合并。当用户希望将实现工作委托给 Oh My Pi / omp 时，请使用此方法——例如“让 omp 实现 X”、“将此委托给 oh my pi”、“通过 omp 运行”、“使用 oh-my-pi 实现/修复/重构”等表述，或者当用户希望通过 omp 运行编码任务队列时仍作为审查者。不适用于可以直接内联完成的小任务、用户希望直接编写代码而不委托的情况，或当他们指的是原始 Pi CLI (`pi`)（即 pi-delegate）时。

name: skill-authoring-workflow
description: Turn raw PM content into a compliant, publish-ready skill. Use when creating or updating a repo skill without breaking standards.
description_zh: 将原始的 PM 内容转换为合规的、可发布的技能。在创建或更新存储库技能时使用，且不会破坏标准。

name: fusion-mcp
description: Explain what Fusion MCP is and guide users through setting it up when they need Fusion-aware MCP capabilities in Copilot workflows.
description_zh: 解释 Fusion MCP 是什么，并在用户需要在 Copilot 工作流程中具备 Fusion 感知 MCP 功能时，指导他们进行设置。

name: dynamo-recipe-runner
description: Select, validate, patch, and deploy existing NVIDIA Dynamo Kubernetes recipes. Use for model/backend/GPU/deployment-mode recipe bring-up; use router-starter for router-only mode work and troubleshoot for broken deployments.
description_zh: 选择、验证、修补和部署现有的NVIDIA Dynamo Kubernetes配方。用于模型/后端/GPU/部署模式配方的启动；使用router-starter用于仅路由器模式的工作，并使用troubleshoot用于故障部署。

name: app-store
description: An Apple App Store API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no Apple Developer Program membership. Use when the user wants to search iOS apps by keyword in any country's storefront, fetch an app's or app bundle's full details, reviews sorted by recent/helpful, apps similar to a given app, search or fetch app bundles, or fetch a developer's app catalog. Also covers iOS app store optimization (ASO) research, competitor app monitoring, localized storefront comparison, and app discovery without Apple Developer Program access.
description_zh: fetcher.sh上的一个Apple App Store API替代方案——按调用付费（使用USDC，通过x402），或使用Bearer密钥预付费积分，无需Apple Developer Program会员资格。当用户需要在任何国家的商店中通过关键词搜索iOS应用、获取应用或应用包的完整详细信息、按最近/有用排序的评论、与给定应用相似的应用、搜索或获取应用包，或获取开发者应用目录时使用。此外，还涵盖iOS应用商店优化（ASO）研究、竞争对手应用监控、本地化商店比较，以及无需Apple Developer Program访问权限的应用发现。

name: backtesting-trading-strategies
description:
Backtest crypto and traditional trading strategies against historical data.
Calculates performance metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown), generates equity curves,
and optimizes strategy parameters. Use when user wants to test a trading strategy,
validate signals, or compare approaches.
Trigger with phrases like "backtest strategy", "test trading strategy", "historical performance",
"simulate trades", "optimize parameters", or "validate signals".
description_zh:
对加密货币和传统交易策略进行历史数据回测。
计算绩效指标（夏普比率、索提诺比率、最大回撤），生成权益曲线，并优化策略参数。当用户想要测试交易策略、验证信号或比较方法时使用。
可通过短语如“回测策略”、“测试交易策略”、“历史表现”、“模拟交易”、“优化参数”或“验证信号”触发。

name: statistical-analysis
description: Guided statistical analysis for research data - test selection, assumption checking, effect sizes, power analysis, Bayesian alternatives, and APA-formatted reporting. Use whenever a user wants to compare groups, test a hypothesis, analyze experimental or survey data, check statistical assumptions, compute required sample sizes, or write up results - even if they never name a specific test. Covers t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square, correlation, regression, non-parametric and Bayesian methods. For low-level model APIs, see the statsmodels and pymc skills.
description_zh: 针对研究数据的引导式统计分析 - 包括测试选择、假设检验、效应量、功效分析、贝叶斯方法替代方案以及APA格式报告。用户在任何需要比较组别、检验假设、分析实验或调查数据、检查统计假设、计算所需样本量或撰写结果时均可使用 - 即使他们从未指定具体的测试。涵盖t检验、方差分析（ANOVA）、卡方检验、相关性、回归、非参数方法和贝叶斯方法。有关低级模型API，请参阅statsmodels和pymc技能。

name: nemo-automodel-distributed-training
description: Guide for selecting and configuring distributed training strategies in NeMo AutoModel, including FSDP2, Megatron FSDP, DDP, and parallelism settings.
description_zh: NeMo AutoModel 中选择和配置分布式训练策略的指南，包括 FSDP2、Megatron FSDP、DDP 和并行设置。

name: vision-sft
description: Fine-tune vision-language models (VLMs) with supervised learning on image+text data. Use when adapting a VLM to a visual domain or task, configuring frozen-vision-tower LoRA, or debugging a VLM fine-tune that trains without learning.
description_zh: 使用图像+文本数据进行监督学习来微调视觉语言模型（VLM）。在将VLM应用于视觉领域或任务、配置冻结的视觉塔LoRA，或调试训练过程中未学习的VLM微调时使用。

name: aws-storage
description: Selects, investigates, and compares AWS object, file, and block storage services, and answers cost, performance, configuration, security, and troubleshooting questions about storage services. Applies when a user asks where to store or archive data based on their usage patterns; which storage service to choose or how two compare; how to migrate data from on-premises or between AWS services; how to protect, replicate, or recover data; how to optimize storage costs; where to deploy shared NFS, SMB, or POSIX file systems; where to store vector embeddings or tabular data; what storage backs enterprise file shares, self-managed databases on EC2, VMware, or stateful containers; or asks what an AWS storage service can do or how it works. Relevant for storage needs for workloads such as AI/ML, analytics, EDA, HPC, media, genomics, or financial trading. Not applicable for SQL query engines (Athena, Spark, Redshift, EMR), ETL (Glue), streaming (Kafka, MSK, Kinesis), or managed database services (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB).
description_zh: 选择、调查和比较 AWS 对象存储、文件存储和块存储服务，并回答有关存储服务的成本、性能、配置、安全和故障排除问题。适用于用户根据其使用模式询问数据存储或归档位置；选择哪个存储服务或如何比较两个服务；如何从本地环境或 AWS 服务之间迁移数据；如何保护、复制或恢复数据；如何优化存储成本；在哪里部署共享 NFS、SMB 或 POSIX 文件系统；在哪里存储向量嵌入或表格数据；哪个存储支持企业文件共享、EC2、VMware 或有状态容器上的自管理数据库；或询问 AWS 存储服务能做什么或如何工作。适用于 AI/ML、分析、EDA、HPC、媒体、基因组学或金融交易等工作负载的存储需求。不适用于 SQL 查询引擎（Athena、Spark、Redshift、EMR）、ETL（Glue）、流处理（Kafka、MSK、Kinesis）或托管数据库服务（RDS、Aurora、DynamoDB）。

name: no-comments
description: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.
description_zh: 生成评论Sicko，修复已接受的发现，并为所声明的约束提供编码。

name: support-prerendering
description: Make interactive Blazor components work correctly with prerendering. USE FOR fixing duplicate data loads, UI flicker during prerender-to-interactive handoff, null references during prerender, persisting state across prerender, disabling prerendering, excluding pages from interactive routing, or detecting whether a component is currently prerendering. DO NOT USE for choosing which render mode to use (see create-blazor-project) or general component authoring (see author-component).
description_zh: 使交互式 Blazor 组件能够正确地与预渲染配合工作。用于修复重复数据加载、预渲染到交互式转换过程中的 UI 闪烁、预渲染期间的空引用、跨预渲染持久化状态、禁用预渲染、将页面排除在交互式路由之外，或检测组件是否当前正在预渲染。不应用于选择使用哪种渲染模式（请参阅 create-blazor-project）或一般组件开发（请参阅 author-component）。

name: ncbi-sequence-fetch
description: Retrieve protein and nucleotide sequences from NCBI databases using E-utilities. Supports direct accession lookup, CDS translation, gene+organism search, locus lookup, PubMed-linked sequences, patent protein extraction, and organism+length fallback search. Use when you need to fetch biological sequences by accession, gene name, locus tag, PubMed ID, or patent number.

name: openfda-database
description: Query, search, and download data from the openFDA API for drugs, devices, foods, tobacco, cosmetics, animal and veterinary products, substances, and transparency data. Use for FDA adverse events, recalls, labeling, approvals, shortages, 510(k) clearances, NDC lookups, and any FDA safety or regulatory data query across all 28 API endpoints.

name: physical-ai-defect-image-generation
description:
Use when the user wants to orchestrate defect image generation with NVIDIA Cosmos AnomalyGen (Cosmos-Predict2-derived) on OSMO for PCBA, metal surface, and glass inspection. The Day 0 path handles cold-start with USD-to-ROI, image-edit augmentation, and AnomalyGen to create initial PCBA datasets. The Day 1 path performs inference and labeling on real images. This skill helps with first-time asset setup, creation of finetuning checkpoints, and configuring deployment.
Trigger keywords: defect image generation, dig workflow, dig pipeline, defect image detection workflow, aoi pipeline, aoi anomalygen, usd2roi anomalygen, day 0 pcba, day 1 pcba, day 1 real-photo alignment, day 1 manual roi, metal surface anomaly, glass defect, anomalygen finetune, setup_pcb, setup_metal, setup_glass, setup_pretrained, dig setup, dig datasets, dig pretrained checkpoint, dig image-edit endpoint, cosmos defect generation, cosmos-predict2 defect, cosmos-anomalygen, cosmos predict2 finetune.
description_zh:
当用户希望在OSMO上使用NVIDIA Cosmos AnomalyGen（源自Cosmos-Predict2）对PCBA、金属表面和玻璃进行缺陷图像生成时使用。Day 0路径处理冷启动，包括USD到ROI的转换、图像编辑增强以及AnomalyGen创建初始PCBA数据集。Day 1路径对真实图像进行推理和标注。此技能有助于首次资产设置、微调检查点创建以及部署配置。

触发关键词：缺陷图像生成、dig工作流、dig管道、缺陷图像检测工作流、aoi管道、aoi异常生成、usd2roi异常生成、day 0 pcba、day 1 pcba、day 1真实图像对齐、day 1手动ROI、金属表面异常、玻璃缺陷、异常生成微调、setup_pcb、setup_metal、setup_glass、setup_pretrained、dig设置、dig数据集、dig预训练检查点、dig图像编辑端点、cosmos缺陷生成、cosmos-predict2缺陷、cosmos-anomalygen、cosmos predict2微调。

name: netlify-agent-runner
description: Run AI agent tasks remotely on Netlify using Claude, Codex, or Gemini. Use when the user wants to run an AI agent on their site, get a second opinion from another model, or delegate development tasks to run remotely against their repo.
description_zh: 在 Netlify 上使用 Claude、Codex 或 Gemini 远程运行 AI 代理任务。当用户希望在他们的网站上运行 AI 代理、从另一个模型获取第二意见，或将开发任务委托给远程运行其代码库时使用。

name: turso-cloud
description: Turso Cloud — fully managed SQLite-compatible database platform, accessed over the network. Use when connecting an application to a Turso Cloud database, creating or scoping auth tokens (JWT, fine-grained permissions, JWKS/external auth providers), or provisioning and managing cloud databases. Covers per-language SDKs (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust), authentication & authorization, and marketplace integrations (Vercel).
description_zh: Turso Cloud — 完全托管的 SQLite 兼容数据库平台，通过网络访问。在将应用程序连接到 Turso Cloud 数据库、创建或配置认证令牌（JWT、细粒度权限、JWKS/外部认证提供者）或配置和管理云数据库时使用。涵盖多语言 SDK（JavaScript/TypeScript、Python、Go、Rust）、认证与授权，以及市场集成（Vercel）。

name: clojure-review
description: Review Clojure and ClojureScript code changes for compliance with Metabase coding standards, style violations, and code quality issues. Use when reviewing pull requests or diffs containing Clojure/ClojureScript code.
description_zh: 审查 Clojure 和 ClojureScript 代码更改是否符合 Metabase 编码规范、风格违规和代码质量问题。在审查包含 Clojure/ClojureScript 代码的拉取请求或差异时使用。

name: read-deleted-pages
description: Recover deleted, edited or historical web content using the Wayback Machine and its CDX API, archive.today, Common Crawl and Memento/Timetravel. Use when a page is deleted, changed or 404s, checking what a site used to say, finding old team or staff pages, prior pricing, removed posts, pre-redaction wording or old contact details, enumerating every archived URL for a domain, or preserving evidence before it disappears. Applies to litigation and evidence preservation, regulatory and disclosure review, due diligence on a company's history, and journalism. Reference at useosint.com/skills/read-deleted-pages.
description_zh: 利用 Wayback Machine 及其 CDX API、archive.today、Common Crawl 和 Memento/TimeTravel，恢复已被删除、编辑或具有历史版本的网页内容。适用场景包括：页面被删除、更改或返回 404 错误；核查网站曾发布的内容；查找旧版团队或员工页面、过往定价、已删除的文章、删除前的措辞或旧联系方式；枚举某域名的所有已归档 URL；或在证据消失前进行保全。适用于诉讼与证据保全、监管与合规审查、公司历史背景尽职调查以及新闻调查。使用时请参考 readosint.com/skills/read-deleted-pages。

name: notion-cli
description: Work with Notion from the terminal using the `notion` CLI. Use when the user needs to read, create, update, query, or manage Notion pages, databases, blocks, comments, users, or files programmatically. Covers the entire Notion API with 50+ commands. Triggers: Notion workspace automation, database queries, page creation, block manipulation, comment threads, file uploads, relation management, database export, multi-workspace management, or any Notion API interaction from the command line.
description_zh: 使用 `notion` CLI 从终端与 Notion 进行交互。当用户需要以编程方式读取、创建、更新、查询或管理 Notion 页面、数据库、块、评论、用户或文件时使用。涵盖整个 Notion API，包含 50 多个命令。触发器：Notion 工作区自动化、数据库查询、页面创建、块操作、评论线程、文件上传、关系管理、数据库导出、多工作区管理，或从命令行进行的任何 Notion API 交互。

name: probe-sdk
description: Reference skill for Zoom Probe SDK. Use after routing to a preflight workflow when testing browser compatibility, media permissions, audio or video diagnostics, and network readiness before users join.
description_zh: Zoom Probe SDK 的参考技能。在测试浏览器兼容性、媒体权限、音频或视频诊断以及网络准备情况之前，用户加入前使用，用于路由到预检工作流。

name: code-quality
description: MUST be used whenever reviewing a Flows app for code quality, maintainability, or clean code issues — before a PR review, after a feature is complete, or when the user asks for a code review. Do NOT skip linting steps. Triggers: code quality, code review, clean code, refactor, maintainability, technical debt, any type, naming, dead code, duplication, DRY, single responsibility, component size, lint, linting, TypeScript strict, dependency injection, file structure.
description_zh: 在审查 Flows 应用程序以检查代码质量、可维护性或代码整洁性问题时，必须使用——在 PR 审查之前、功能完成后，或当用户请求代码审查时。不要跳过代码风格检查步骤。触发条件：代码质量、代码审查、代码整洁、重构、可维护性、技术债务、任何类型、命名、死代码、重复、DRY、单一职责、组件大小、代码风格检查、代码风格检查、TypeScript 严格模式、依赖注入、文件结构。

name: youtube-api
description: A YouTube API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no OAuth and no daily quota. Use when the user wants to search YouTube videos with filters for upload date, duration, or sort order, search channels or playlists, look up a channel by ID, @handle, or custom URL path, list a channel's videos, shorts, or live streams, fetch a video's or short's details and comments, list a playlist's videos, pull posts under a hashtag, or check trending videos by region. Also covers YouTube data pipelines, channel monitoring, video analytics input, and trend tracking without the official YouTube Data API's daily quota limits.
description_zh: fetcher.sh上的YouTube API替代方案——按调用付费（USDC，通过x402支付），或使用Bearer密钥预付费积分，无需OAuth且无每日配额限制。当用户需要使用筛选条件（如上传日期、时长或排序方式）搜索YouTube视频、搜索频道或播放列表、通过ID、@用户名或自定义URL路径查找频道、列出频道视频、短片或直播、获取视频或短片的详情和评论、列出播放列表视频、获取话题下的帖子，或按地区检查热门视频时使用。此外，还涵盖YouTube数据管道、频道监控、视频分析输入和趋势追踪，且不受官方YouTube Data API的每日配额限制。

name: build-zoom-phone-integration
description: Reference skill for Zoom Phone. Use after routing to a phone workflow when implementing OAuth, Phone APIs, webhooks, Smart Embed events, URI schemes, CRM or CTI dialers, or call handling automation.
description_zh: Zoom Phone参考技能。在实现OAuth、电话API、Webhooks、智能嵌入事件、URI方案、CRM或CTI拨号器，或呼叫处理自动化时，在路由到电话工作流后使用。

name: prisma-next-queries
description: Write Prisma Next queries for Postgres, SQLite, or Mongo — pick a lane (Postgres/SQLite `db.orm.<Model>` + `db.sql.<table>`; Mongo `db.orm.<root>` + `db.query.from(...)` pipeline builder), filter / project / sort / paginate, eager-load with `.include(...)`, Postgres/SQLite `db.transaction(...)`, Postgres/SQLite ORM `.aggregate(...)`, Mongo aggregations via query builder, namespace-aware accessors (`db.orm.<ns>.<Model>`, `db.sql.<ns>.<table>`). Triggers: query, where, match, select, project, orderBy, take, skip, include, lookup, first, all, count, aggregate, group, create, update, delete, upsert, returning, transaction, db.close, script teardown, variant, polymorphism, drizzle-style, kysely-style. Notes: `.all()` is a Thenable (just `await` it), iterators are single-use (`RUNTIME.ITERATOR_CONSUMED`), Postgres `count` is `number` while sum/avg/min/max are `number | null`, ranges use chained `.where()` or `and(...)` (no `.between(...)`).
description_zh: 为 Postgres、SQLite 或 Mongo 编写 Prisma Next 查询——选择一条路径（Postgres/SQLite `db.orm.<Model>` + `db.sql.<table>`；Mongo `db.orm.<root>` + `db.query.from(...)` 管道构建器），进行过滤/投影/排序/分页，使用 `.include(...)` 进行即时加载，Postgres/SQLite `db.transaction(...)`，Postgres/SQLite ORM `.aggregate(...)`，通过查询构建器进行 Mongo 聚合，命名空间感知访问器（`db.orm.<ns>.<Model>`，`db.sql.<ns>.<table>`）。触发器：查询、where、match、select、project、orderBy、take、skip、include、lookup、first、all、count、aggregate、group、create、update、delete、upsert、returning、transaction、db.close、脚本清理、variant、polymorphism、drizzle-style、kysely-style。备注：`.all()` 是一个 Thenable（只需 `await` 它），迭代器是单次使用的（`RUNTIME.ITERATOR_CONSUMED`），Postgres 的 `count` 是 `number`，而 sum/avg/min/max 是 `number | null`，范围使用链式 `.where()` 或 `and(...)`（没有 `.between(...)`）。

name: clean-data-xls
description: Clean up messy spreadsheet data — trim whitespace, fix inconsistent casing, convert numbers-stored-as-text, standardize dates, remove duplicates, and flag mixed-type columns. Use when data is messy, inconsistent, or needs prep before analysis. Triggers on "clean this data", "clean up this sheet", "normalize this data", "fix formatting", "dedupe", "standardize this column", "this data is messy".
description_zh: 清理杂乱的电子表格数据——去除空格、修正不一致的大小写、转换存储为文本的数字、标准化日期、删除重复项，以及标记混合类型列。当数据杂乱、不一致或需要分析前准备时使用。在以下情况下触发："清理这些数据"、"整理这张表格"、"规范化这些数据"、"修复格式"、"去重"、"标准化这一列"、"这些数据很杂乱"。

name: datapackage
description: Explore and query any dataset annotated with a Frictionless Data Package descriptor (datapackage.json). Use this skill whenever a user wants to discover what tables or resources a dataset contains, look up column names and descriptions, surface usage warnings embedded in metadata, or understand how to load data from Parquet files, DuckDB or SQLite databases, or CSV files described by a datapackage.json. Also use when the user has a datapackage.json and wants to know what's in it, how to query it efficiently, or how to connect its metadata to actual data files. Pairs well with dataset-specific skills (like `pudl`) that layer domain knowledge on top.
description_zh: 探索并查询任何使用 Frictionless Data Package 描述符（datapackage.json）标注的数据集。当用户想要发现数据集包含哪些表格或资源、查询列名和描述、揭示元数据中嵌入的使用警告，或了解如何从 Parquet 文件、DuckDB 或 SQLite 数据库，或由 datapackage.json 描述的 CSV 文件加载数据时，请使用此技能。此外，当用户拥有 datapackage.json 并想知道其中包含的内容、如何高效地查询它，或如何将其元数据与实际数据文件连接时，也请使用此技能。它与特定数据集技能（如 `pudl`）配合良好，后者在顶层叠加领域知识。

name: sentry-ruby-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for Ruby. Use when asked to add Sentry to Ruby, install sentry-ruby, setup Sentry in Rails/Sinatra/Rack, or configure error monitoring, tracing, logging, metrics, profiling, or crons for Ruby applications. Also handles migration from AppSignal, Honeybadger, Bugsnag, Rollbar, or Airbrake. Supports Rails, Sinatra, Rack, Sidekiq, and Resque.
description_zh: Ruby 完整的 Sentry SDK 设置。当被要求将 Sentry 添加到 Ruby 中、安装 sentry-ruby、在 Rails/Sinatra/Rack 中设置 Sentry，或为 Ruby 应用配置错误监控、跟踪、日志记录、指标、性能分析或定时任务时使用。同时支持从 AppSignal、Honeybadger、Bugsnag、Rollbar 或 Airbrake 迁移。支持 Rails、Sinatra、Rack、Sidekiq 和 Resque。

name: responsive-design
description: Design layouts and interactions that adapt across screen sizes and input methods. Use when one design must serve many viewports. For the underlying column grid use `layout-grid`; for OS-specific patterns use `platform-conventions`.
description_zh: 设计能够适应不同屏幕尺寸和输入方式的布局和交互。当需要用单个设计来适配多个视口时使用。底层列网格使用 `layout-grid`；针对特定操作系统的模式使用 `platform-conventions`。

name: caveman
description: Terse chat that stays easy to parse. Drops filler, pleasantries and hedging while keeping full technical accuracy. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman.
description_zh: 简洁的聊天方式，易于解析。去除填充词、寒暄语和犹豫表达，同时保持完整的技术准确性。当用户说“原始人模式”、“像原始人一样说话”、“使用原始人模式”、“减少token”、“简洁”或输入/caveman时使用。

name: pymol
description: Visualize, analyze, and render protein and molecular structures using PyMOL. Use when the user wants to create images of protein structures, perform structural alignments or superposition, measure distances or contacts, highlight binding sites or active site residues, color by B-factor/pLDDT, or analyze protein-ligand interactions. Do not use for docking, molecular dynamics, or sequence-only analysis.
description_zh: 使用PyMOL可视化、分析和渲染蛋白质及分子结构。当用户需要创建蛋白质结构图像、进行结构比对或叠加、测量距离或接触、突出显示结合位点或活性位点残基、按B因子/pLDDT着色或分析蛋白质-配体相互作用时使用。不应用于对接、分子动力学或仅序列分析。

name: build-zoom-meeting-sdk-app
description: Reference skill for Zoom Meeting SDK. Use after routing to a meeting-embed workflow when implementing real Zoom meeting joins, platform-specific SDK behavior, auth and join flows, waiting room issues, or meeting bot patterns.
description_zh: Zoom Meeting SDK 的参考技能。在实现真实的 Zoom 会议加入、平台特定 SDK 行为、认证和加入流程、等候室问题或会议机器人模式时，在路由到会议嵌入工作流后使用。

name: rivet-sdk
description: Reference skill for Zoom Rivet SDK. Use after routing to a Rivet-based server workflow when implementing auth handling, webhook consumers, API wrappers, multi-module composition, or Lambda receiver patterns.
description_zh: Zoom Rivet SDK 的参考技能。在实现身份验证处理、webhook 消费者、API 封装、多模块组合或 Lambda 接收器模式时，在路由到基于 Rivet 的服务器工作流后使用。

name: flutter-dev
description:
Flutter cross-platform development guide covering widget patterns, Riverpod/Bloc state management, GoRouter navigation, performance optimization, and platform-specific implementations. Includes const optimization, responsive layouts, testing strategies, and DevTools profiling.
Use when: building Flutter apps, implementing state management (Riverpod/Bloc), setting up GoRouter navigation, creating custom widgets, optimizing performance, writing widget tests, cross-platform development.
description_zh:
Flutter跨平台开发指南，涵盖组件模式、Riverpod/Bloc状态管理、GoRouter导航、性能优化和平台特定实现。包括const优化、响应式布局、测试策略和DevTools性能分析。
使用场景：构建Flutter应用、实现状态管理（Riverpod/Bloc）、设置GoRouter导航、创建自定义组件、优化性能、编写组件测试、跨平台开发。

name: logfire-instrumentation
description: Add Pydantic Logfire observability to application code — traces, logs, metrics, and AI/agent spans. Use when the user asks to add or configure Logfire, observability, tracing, logging, or monitoring; maximize useful telemetry; or understand what an app is doing. Supports Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, and major AI agent frameworks including Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and Google ADK. For infrastructure-only monitoring (hosts, Docker, Kubernetes, databases, or cloud metrics with no app-code changes), use `logfire-infrastructure`. For evaluating AI/agent behavior against test datasets, use `logfire-evals`.
description_zh: 为应用程序代码添加 Pydantic Logfire 可观测性功能——包括追踪、日志、指标和 AI/代理跨度。当用户要求添加或配置 Logfire、可观测性、追踪、日志记录或监控；最大化有用的遥测数据；或了解应用程序正在执行什么操作时使用。支持 Python、JavaScript/TypeScript、Rust 以及主要的 AI 代理框架，包括 Pydantic AI、OpenAI Agents SDK、Claude Agent SDK、LangChain、LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen 和 Google ADK。对于仅针对基础设施的监控（主机、Docker、Kubernetes、数据库或无需更改应用代码的云指标），请使用 `logfire-infrastructure`。对于评估 AI/代理在测试数据集上的行为，请使用 `logfire-evals`。

name: uni-app
description: Comprehensive skill reference for uni-app cross-platform development framework
description_zh: uni-app跨平台开发框架的全面技能参考

name: architecture-diagrams
description: Create system architecture diagrams using Mermaid, PlantUML, C4 model, flowcharts, and sequence diagrams. Use when documenting architecture, system design, data flows, or technical workflows.
description_zh: 使用 Mermaid、PlantUML、C4 模型、流程图和时序图创建系统架构图。在记录架构、系统设计、数据流或技术工作流程时使用。

name: roblox-game-development
description: Use this skill for any Roblox related tasks

name: spark-training-gotchas
description: Preflight and diagnose the ten known failure modes for ML training on NVIDIA DGX Spark. Use when a training run on DGX Spark fails to start, OOMs below the 128GB limit, slows down mid-run, or before any multi-hour training job on GB10.
description_zh: 对NVIDIA DGX Spark上的机器学习训练进行预检和故障诊断。当DGX Spark上的训练任务无法启动、内存使用量低于128GB限制、运行过程中减速，或在进行任何GB10多小时的训练任务之前使用。

name: jianying-editor
description: 剪映 (JianYing) AI自动化剪辑的高级封装 API (JyWrapper)，提供开箱即用的 Python 接口，支持录屏、素材导入、字幕生成、Web 动效合成及项目导出。全面适配 MacOS (Apple Silicon/Intel) 与 Windows，支持 v5.9+ (draft_info.json) 架构、工程自修复、智能配音字幕及录屏变焦。

name: mastra-factory
description: Operate and supervise Mastra Factory through `mastra api factory`. Use for first-time Factory connection and login, status or queue summaries, project and work-item inspection, thread history and memory, metrics, health, decisions, attention, supervisor sessions, and user-authorized autonomous or interactive Factory operations on hosted, local, remote, or self-hosted servers.
description_zh: 通过 `mastra api factory` 操作和监督 Mastra 工厂。用于首次工厂连接和登录、状态或队列摘要、项目和工单检查、线程历史和内存、指标、健康、决策、关注、监督会话，以及在托管、本地、远程或自托管服务器上对用户授权的自主或交互式工厂操作。

name: spark-memory-thermal-ops
description: Manage unified memory and thermals during long-running ML jobs on NVIDIA DGX Spark. Use when planning memory headroom for a training run on GB10, when a job OOMs on unified memory, or when monitoring temperature and power during multi-hour training.
description_zh: 在NVIDIA DGX Spark上管理长时间运行的机器学习作业的统一内存和散热。在为GB10的培训运行规划内存余量时使用，当作业在统一内存中OOM时使用，或在多小时的培训期间监控温度和功耗时使用。

name: setup-zoom-oauth
description: Implement Zoom authentication correctly. Use when setting up app credentials, choosing an OAuth grant, requesting scopes, handling token refresh, or debugging auth failures.
description_zh: 正确实现 Zoom 身份验证。在设置应用凭证、选择 OAuth 授权、请求作用域、处理令牌刷新或调试身份验证失败时使用。

name: pptx-slide-specification
description: Use when authoring or repairing a coordinate-explicit JSON specification for an editable PPTX deck.
description_zh: 在编写或修复可编辑的PPTX演示文稿的坐标明确JSON规范时使用。

name: spark-environment-setup
description: Set up a working ML training/inference environment on NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, aarch64, CUDA 13). Use when installing PyTorch/Unsloth/TRL/vLLM on DGX Spark, hitting libcudart or wheel-ABI errors on aarch64, or choosing between NGC containers and bare pip installs.
description_zh: 在NVIDIA DGX Spark（GB10，aarch64，CUDA 13）上设置一个可用的ML训练/推理环境。在DGX Spark上安装PyTorch/Unsloth/TRL/vLLM时使用，遇到aarch64上的libcudart或wheel-ABI错误，或是在NGC容器和裸pip安装之间进行选择时使用。

name: huggingface-llm-trainer
description: Train or fine-tune language and vision models using TRL (Transformer Reinforcement Learning) or Unsloth with Hugging Face Jobs infrastructure. Covers SFT, DPO, GRPO and reward modeling training methods, plus GGUF conversion for local deployment. Includes guidance on the TRL Jobs package, UV scripts with PEP 723 format, dataset preparation and validation, hardware selection, cost estimation, Trackio monitoring, Hub authentication, model selection/leaderboards and model persistence. Use for tasks involving cloud GPU training, GGUF conversion, or when users mention training on Hugging Face Jobs without local GPU setup.
description_zh: 使用TRL（Transformer强化学习）或Unsloth，通过Hugging Face Jobs基础设施来训练或微调语言和视觉模型。涵盖SFT、DPO、GRPO和奖励模型训练方法，并提供GGUF转换以支持本地部署。包含关于TRL Jobs包、遵循PEP 723格式的UV脚本、数据集准备与验证、硬件选择、成本估算、Trackio监控、Hub认证、模型选择/排行榜以及模型持久化的指导。适用于涉及云GPU训练、GGUF转换，或用户提及在Hugging Face Jobs上训练但无本地GPU设置的任务。

name: react-nextjs-development
description: React and Next.js 14+ application development with App Router, Server Components, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and modern frontend patterns.
description_zh: 使用 App Router、服务器组件、TypeScript、Tailwind CSS 和现代前端模式进行 React 和 Next.js 14+ 应用开发。

name: residual-edge-analyzer
description: Separate a strategy return series into declared baseline exposure and residual edge with returns-based OLS attribution, HAC inference, rolling stability, alternate-baseline sensitivity, and regime breakdowns. Use when evaluating whether backtest, out-of-sample, or live returns contain independent alpha beyond market, equal-weight, momentum, sector, or user-supplied factor returns; when explaining whether a drawdown came from baseline exposure or strategy-specific behavior; or when a strategy needs an attribution quality gate after backtesting. Do not use for holdings-based Brinson attribution, feature-level Shapley explanations, or analysis from summary metrics without a dated return series.
description_zh: 将策略回报序列分解为已声明的基准敞口和残差边缘，使用基于回报的 OLS 归因、HAC 推断、滚动稳定性、替代基准敏感性以及状态分解。在评估回测、样本外或实际回报是否包含独立于市场、等权、动量、行业或用户提供的因子回报的 alpha 时使用；在解释回撤是否来自基准敞口或策略特定行为时使用；或在策略回测后需要归因质量门禁时使用。不应用于基于持仓的 Brinson 归因、特征级别的 Shapley 解释，或没有日期回报序列的汇总指标分析。

name: choose-zoom-approach
description: Choose the right Zoom architecture for a use case. Use when deciding between REST API, Webhooks, WebSockets, Meeting SDK, Video SDK, Zoom Apps SDK, Zoom MCP, Phone, Contact Center, or a hybrid approach.
description_zh: 为特定用例选择合适的 Zoom 架构。在决定使用 REST API、Webhooks、WebSockets、会议 SDK、视频 SDK、Zoom 应用程序 SDK、Zoom MCP、电话、联络中心或混合方法时使用。

name: paper-lookup
description: Search 18 scholarly APIs for papers, preprints, citations, open-access full text, repository records, and journal OA status, and return results with reproducible provenance. Covers PubMed, PMC, Europe PMC, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, CORE, Unpaywall, OpenCitations, PubTator3, Zenodo, Figshare, ROR, BioStudies, and DOAJ. Use when searching for papers, citations, DOI/PMID/arXiv lookups, abstracts, full text, open-access PDFs, preprints, citation graphs, author publications, biomedical entity annotations, deposited records (Zenodo, Figshare, BioStudies), institution ROR IDs, or any scholarly literature query. Triggers on mentions of any supported database or requests like "find papers on X", "look up this DOI", "who cites this paper", or "get me the PDF".
