name: exploratory-data-analysis
description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.
description_zh: 执行针对明确支持的科学文件的有界局部探索性分析。用于处理经过脱敏处理的 CSV/TSV/JSON 配置文件；可选的 NumPy、HDF5、FASTA/FASTQ 和基本图像元数据检查；缺失值/泄漏审计；异常值和转换敏感性分析；以及严格的 EDA 报告框架。其他领域格式仅作参考，未知格式将触发失败关闭机制。

name: vss-search-archive
description: Use this skill to run top-level VSS fusion search on archived video, or to ingest video files / RTSP streams for search. Do NOT use for ad-hoc visual Q&A (use vss-ask-video), live captioning (use vss-deploy-dense-captioning), or video summarization and reports (use vss-summarize-video).
description_zh: 使用此功能对存档视频进行顶层 VSS 融合搜索，或用于摄取视频文件/RTSP 流以进行搜索。请勿将其用于临时视觉问答（请使用 vss-ask-video）、实时字幕（请使用 vss-deploy-dense-captioning）或视频摘要和报告（请使用 vss-summarize-video）。

name: error-handling
description: Error handling strategy for .NET 10 applications. Covers the Result pattern, ProblemDetails (RFC 9457), global exception handling, FluentValidation, and structured error responses. Load this skill when implementing error handling, validation, or designing API error contracts, or when the user mentions "error handling", "Result pattern", "ProblemDetails", "exception", "validation", "FluentValidation", "error response", "global exception handler", or "RFC 9457".
description_zh: .NET 10应用程序的错误处理策略。涵盖Result模式、ProblemDetails（RFC 9457）、全局异常处理、FluentValidation以及结构化错误响应。在实现错误处理、验证或设计API错误契约时，或当用户提及“错误处理”、“Result模式”、“ProblemDetails”、“异常”、“验证”、“FluentValidation”、“错误响应”、“全局异常处理器”或“RFC 9457”时，加载此技能。

name: creating-oracle-to-postgres-migration-bug-report
description: Creates structured bug reports for defects found during Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration. Use when documenting behavioral differences between Oracle and PostgreSQL as actionable bug reports with severity, root cause, and remediation steps.
description_zh: 为 Oracle 到 PostgreSQL 迁移过程中发现的缺陷创建结构化错误报告。在记录 Oracle 和 PostgreSQL 之间的行为差异时使用，以生成具有严重程度、根本原因和修复步骤的可操作错误报告。

name: digital-health-clinical-asr-build
description: Stage 2 of the Clinical ASR Flywheel. Use when curating clinical terms, tagging IPA, and synthesizing a NeMo manifest. NOT for scoring (use /digital-health-clinical-asr-eval).
description_zh: 临床 ASR 飞轮的第二阶段。在整理临床术语、标记 IPA 和合成 NeMo 格式文件时使用。不用于评分（请使用 /digital-health-clinical-asr-eval）。

name: tdd
description: Test-driven development via red-green-refactor with an auditable commit protocol. Use when implementing any feature, bugfix, refactor, or behavior change before writing implementation code, or when the user mentions TDD, red-green-refactor, or test-first development.
description_zh: 使用红绿重构的测试驱动开发，并采用可审计的提交协议。在编写实现代码之前，当实现任何功能、修复错误、重构或行为变更时使用，或者当用户提到TDD、红绿重构或先写测试的开发时使用。

name: vercel-composition-patterns
description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.
description_zh: 可扩展的 React 组合模式。适用于重构具有布尔型属性泛滥的组件、构建灵活的组件库或设计可重用的 API。在涉及复合组件、render props、context 提供者或组件架构的任务中触发。包含 React 19 API 变更。

name: agents-build
description: Use to extend an existing agent project with memory, app integration, VPC, multi-agent, migration, model, browser, code interpreter, payments, or resource removal. Triggers: "add memory", "remember across sessions", "call agent from app", "invoke agent from code", "agent auth", "streaming", "VPC", "VPC connectivity", "can't reach from VPC", "multi-agent", "A2A", "A2A auth", "orchestrator not delegating", "specialist not called", "migrate Bedrock Agent", "migration issue", "change model", "browser tool", "code interpreter", "delete agent", "tear down", "agentcore remove", "cross-account memory", "add payments capability to my agent", "wire payments plugin", "integrate x402 payments with the agent I'm building", "add MPP payments", "Machine Payments Protocol". External APIs via Gateway: use agents-connect. New project: use agents-get-started. CLI/dev-server errors: use agents-debug. Runtime x402/MPP payments: use agents-pay. Migration-specific Strands vs LangGraph routes here.
description_zh: 用于扩展现有代理项目，增加内存、应用集成、VPC、多代理、迁移、模型、浏览器、代码解释器、支付或资源移除功能。触发器： "添加内存"、"跨会话记忆"、"从应用调用代理"、"从代码调用代理"、"代理认证"、"流式传输"、"VPC"、"VPC连接"、"VPC无法访问"、"多代理"、"A2A"、"A2A认证"、"编排器不授权"、"专家未被调用"、"迁移Bedrock Agent"、"迁移问题"、"更改模型"、"浏览器工具"、"代码解释器"、"删除代理"、"拆除"、"移除agentcore"、"跨账户内存"、"为我的代理添加支付功能"、"连接支付插件"、"将x402支付集成到正在构建的代理中"、"添加MPP支付"、"机器支付协议"。通过网关的External APIs：使用agents-connect。新项目：使用agents-get-started。CLI/开发服务器错误：使用agents-debug。运行时x402/MPP支付：使用agents-pay。此处为迁移特定的Strands与LangGraph路由。

name: ef-core
description: Entity Framework Core patterns for .NET 10. Covers DbContext configuration, migrations workflow, interceptors, compiled queries, ExecuteUpdateAsync, ExecuteDeleteAsync, value converters, and query optimization. Load this skill when working with databases, writing queries, managing schema changes, or when the user mentions "EF Core", "Entity Framework", "DbContext", "migration", "LINQ query", "database", "SQL", "N+1", "Include", "split query", "value converter", "interceptor", or "compiled query".
description_zh: Entity Framework Core .NET 10 的模式。涵盖 DbContext 配置、迁移工作流、拦截器、编译查询、ExecuteUpdateAsync、ExecuteDeleteAsync、值转换器以及查询优化。在处理数据库、编写查询、管理架构变更时，或当用户提及“EF Core”、“Entity Framework”、“DbContext”、“迁移”、“LINQ 查询”、“数据库”、“SQL”、“N+1”、“Include”、“拆分查询”、“值转换器”、“拦截器”或“编译查询”时，加载此技能。

name: testing
description: Testing strategy for .NET 10 applications. Covers xUnit v3, WebApplicationFactory for integration tests, Testcontainers for real database testing, Verify for snapshot testing, and the AAA pattern. Load this skill when writing tests, setting up test infrastructure, reviewing test coverage, or when the user mentions "test", "xUnit", "WebApplicationFactory", "Testcontainers", "integration test", "unit test", "bUnit", "snapshot test", "Verify", "test coverage", "AAA pattern", "WireMock", or "FakeTimeProvider".
description_zh: .NET 10应用程序的测试策略。涵盖xUnit v3、WebApplicationFactory用于集成测试、Testcontainers用于真实数据库测试、Verify用于快照测试以及AAA模式。在编写测试、设置测试基础设施、审查测试覆盖率时，或当用户提到“测试”、“xUnit”、“WebApplicationFactory”、“Testcontainers”、“集成测试”、“单元测试”、“bUnit”、“快照测试”、“Verify”、“测试覆盖率”、“AAA模式”、“WireMock”或“FakeTimeProvider”时，加载此技能。

name: agentic-workflows
description: Route gh-aw workflow design/create/debug/upgrade requests to the right prompts.
description_zh: 将 gh-aw 工作流的设计/创建/调试/升级请求路由到正确的提示。

name: layers-domain
description: Techniques for mapping a domain's concepts, terminology conflicts, and bounded contexts — the raw material the conceptual model is built from
description_zh: 映射一个领域的概念、术语冲突和边界上下文的技术——概念模型所构建的原始材料

name: digital-health-clinical-asr-finetune
description: Stage 4 of the Clinical ASR Flywheel. Use when priority KER is above 0.3 to run stock NeMo SFT on Parakeet TDT v2 and offline cycle N+1 re-eval. NOT for generic word boosting (use /finetune-asr).
description_zh: 临床 ASR 飞轮的第 4 阶段。当优先 KER 高于 0.3 时使用，在 Parakeet TDT v2 上运行标准 NeMo SFT，并进行离线 N+1 重新评估。不用于通用词提升（请使用 /finetune-asr）。

name: unibind-database
description: Queries the UniBind database for experimentally validated transcription factor (TF) binding sites. Use when retrieving direct TF-DNA interaction datasets, downloading binding site coordinates (BED/FASTA) for local analysis, or listing available datasets by species, cell line, or TF name. Don't use to query specific intervals, locations, genes, motif models or expression data.

name: transformers-js
description: Use Transformers.js to run state-of-the-art machine learning models directly in JavaScript/TypeScript. Supports NLP (text classification, translation, summarization), computer vision (image classification, object detection), audio (speech recognition, audio classification), and multimodal tasks. Works in browsers and server-side runtimes (Node.js, Bun, Deno) with WebGPU/WASM using pre-trained models from Hugging Face Hub.
description_zh: 使用 Transformers.js 直接在 JavaScript/TypeScript 中运行最先进的机器学习模型。支持 NLP（文本分类、翻译、摘要）、计算机视觉（图像分类、目标检测）、音频（语音识别、音频分类）和多模态任务。可在浏览器和服务器端运行时（Node.js、Bun、Deno）使用 WebGPU/WASM，并利用 Hugging Face Hub 的预训练模型。

name: layers-user-needs
description: Techniques for eliciting and prioritising user needs, pains, and desires — the opportunities that feed product strategy
description_zh: 获取和优先排序用户需求、痛点和期望的技术——为产品战略提供机会

name: launch-nemo-rl
description: Playbook for launching, monitoring, stopping, and debugging NeMo-RL recipes on a Kubernetes cluster via the nrl-k8s CLI. Covers ephemeral vs long-lived RayCluster modes, iterating on runs, and debugging hung or failed training jobs.
description_zh: 用于通过 nrl-k8s CLI 在 Kubernetes 集群上启动、监控、停止和调试 NeMo-RL 方案的手册。涵盖临时与持久 RayCluster 模式、迭代运行以及调试卡住或失败的训练作业。

name: digital-health-clinical-asr-eval
description: Stage 3 of Clinical ASR Flywheel. Score a NeMo manifest, produce the five-section KER leaderboard (by-ipa_source diagnostic). Not for ASR auth (/riva-asr).
description_zh: 临床 ASR 飞轮第 3 阶段。评分 NeMo 清单，生成五部分 KER 排行榜（按 ipa_source 诊断）。不适用于 ASR 认证（/riva-asr）。

name: docker
description: Docker containerization for .NET 10 applications. Covers multi-stage builds, .NET container images, non-root user configuration, health checks, and .dockerignore. Load this skill when containerizing an application with a Dockerfile, optimizing image size, setting up Docker Compose for local development, or when the user mentions "Docker", "Dockerfile", "container", "docker-compose", "image", "multi-stage", "non-root", ".dockerignore", or "container health check". For Dockerfile-less SDK publishing (`dotnet publish /t:PublishContainer`), load the container-publish skill instead.
description_zh: 为 .NET 10 应用程序提供 Docker 容器化支持。涵盖多阶段构建、.NET 容器镜像、非根用户配置、健康检查以及 .dockerignore。在以下场景加载此技能：使用 Dockerfile 容器化应用程序、优化镜像大小、为本地开发设置 Docker Compose，或当用户提及“Docker”、“Dockerfile”、“容器”、“docker-compose”、“镜像”、“多阶段”、“非根”、“.dockerignore”或“容器健康检查”时。对于无需 Dockerfile 的 SDK 发布（`dotnet publish /t:PublishContainer`），请加载“容器发布”技能。

name: exploratory-data-analysis
description: Perform comprehensive exploratory data analysis on scientific data files across 200+ file formats. This skill should be used when analyzing any scientific data file to understand its structure, content, quality, and characteristics. Automatically detects file type and generates detailed markdown reports with format-specific analysis, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations. Covers chemistry, bioinformatics, microscopy, spectroscopy, proteomics, metabolomics, and general scientific data formats.
description_zh: 对200多种文件格式的科学数据文件进行全面的探索性数据分析。该技能应在分析任何科学数据文件时使用，以了解其结构、内容、质量和特征。自动检测文件类型，并生成包含格式特定分析、质量指标和下游分析建议的详细Markdown报告。涵盖化学、生物信息学、显微镜学、光谱学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学以及通用的科学数据格式。

name: gtm-product-led-growth
description: Build self-serve acquisition and expansion motions. Use when deciding PLG vs sales-led, optimizing activation, driving freemium conversion, building growth equations, or recognizing when product complexity demands human touch. Includes the parallel test where sales-led won 10x on revenue.
description_zh: 构建自助式获取和扩展策略。在决定 PLG（产品领导增长）与销售主导模式、优化激活、推动免费增值转化、建立增长公式，或识别产品复杂性需要人工干预时使用。包含平行测试案例，其中销售主导模式在收入上赢了10倍。

name: beautiful-mermaid
description: Render Mermaid diagrams as SVG and PNG using the Beautiful Mermaid library. Use when the user asks to render a Mermaid diagram.
description_zh: 使用 Beautiful Mermaid 库将 Mermaid 图表渲染为 SVG 和 PNG 格式。当用户要求渲染 Mermaid 图表时使用。

name: data-analysis
description: Generate statistical analysis code with 4-round review. Select appropriate statistical tests, interpret results, and produce analysis reports with p-values, effect sizes, and confidence intervals. Use when analyzing experimental data for a paper.
description_zh: 生成具有4轮评审的统计分析代码。选择合适的统计检验方法，解释结果，并生成包含p值、效应量和置信区间的分析报告。用于分析论文中的实验数据。

name: nemo-mbridge-recipe-recommender
description: Recommend and customize Megatron Bridge library and benchmark recipes for a user's model, GPU count, hardware, sequence length, and pretrain/SFT/PEFT goal. Use when selecting a starting recipe, comparing library and benchmark configs, resizing parallelism for a GPU allocation, or distinguishing convergence changes, semantics-preserving execution tuning, and benchmark-only shortcuts.
description_zh: 推荐并定制Megatron Bridge库和基准食谱，以适应用户的模型、GPU数量、硬件、序列长度以及预训练/SFT/PEFT目标。在以下情况下使用：选择起始食谱、比较库和基准配置、调整GPU分配的并行规模，或区分收敛变化、语义保持执行调优和仅基准的快捷方式。

name: browser-to-api
description: Turn a website's observable HTTP traffic into a best-effort OpenAPI 3.1 spec by analyzing a `browser-trace` capture. Use when the user wants to discover/extract API endpoints from a browser session, build an OpenAPI doc from network traffic, or document a third-party site's XHR/fetch surface for client integration.
description_zh: 将网站的可见 HTTP 流量通过分析 `browser-trace` 捕获转换为最佳努力 OpenAPI 3.1 规范。适用于用户希望从浏览器会话中发现/提取 API 端点、从网络流量构建 OpenAPI 文档，或为客户端集成文档化第三方网站的 XHR/fetch 接口。

name: repomix-explorer
description:
Analyze or explore a codebase (remote or local repository) by packing it with the Repomix CLI, then reading and searching the generated output. Use when the user wants a high-level understanding of an unfamiliar or large repo, not a targeted edit.

Trigger for:
- Structure/overview: "analyze this repo", "what's the structure", "explain this codebase", "what's in vercel/next.js"
- Pattern discovery across many files: "find all auth code", "where are the API endpoints", "show me all React components"
- Metrics: "how many files/tokens", "largest files", "TypeScript vs JavaScript ratio"
- Remote repos: any github.com URL or "owner/repo" the user wants explored

DO NOT trigger for:
- Editing, refactoring, or writing code in the current project
- Reading or searching a known file/path in the local project (use Read or grep directly)
- Single-symbol lookups in the local project answerable with one grep
- Git operations, running tests, builds, or installs
description_zh:
通过使用 Repomix CLI 将代码库（远程或本地仓库）打包，然后读取和搜索生成的输出，来分析或探索代码库。当用户想要了解不熟悉或庞大的仓库的高级概览，而不是进行有针对性的编辑时使用。

触发条件：
- 结构/概览："分析这个仓库"、"这是什么结构"、"解释这个代码库"、"vercel/next.js 里有什么"
- 跨多个文件的模式发现："查找所有认证代码"、"API 端点在哪里"、"展示所有 React 组件"
- 指标："有多少文件/符号"、"最大的文件"、"TypeScript 与 JavaScript 的比例"
- 远程仓库：任何 github.com URL 或用户想要探索的 "owner/repo"

不触发条件：
- 在当前项目中编辑、重构或编写代码
- 在本地项目中读取或搜索已知的文件/路径（直接使用 Read 或 grep）
- 在本地项目中单符号查找，可以用一次 grep 解决
- Git 操作、运行测试、构建或安装

name: google-play
description: A Google Play Store API alternative on fetcher.sh — pay-per-call in USDC via x402, or prepaid credits with a Bearer key, no Google Play Console access. Use when the user wants to search Android apps by keyword with price (free/paid) and country storefront filters, fetch an app's full details, reviews sorted by newest/rating/helpfulness, permissions, or data safety disclosure, list apps similar to a given app, or fetch a developer's app catalog. Also covers Android app store optimization (ASO) research, competitor app monitoring, review sentiment input, and app discovery without Google Play Console developer access.
description_zh: fetcher.sh上的Google Play Store API替代方案——通过x402使用USDC按调用付费，或使用Bearer密钥预付费积分，无需Google Play Console访问权限。当用户想通过关键词搜索Android应用（免费/付费）并按国家商店进行筛选、获取应用的完整详情、按最新/评分/有用性排序的评论、权限或数据安全声明、列出与给定应用相似的应用，或获取开发者应用目录时使用。此外，还涵盖Android应用商店优化（ASO）研究、竞争对手应用监控、评论情感输入以及无需Google Play Console开发者访问权限的应用发现。

name: earth2studio-discover
description: Find Earth2Studio models, data sources, and examples for a weather/climate use case. Do NOT use for writing inference code, downloading data, or installation.
description_zh: 查找适用于天气/气候用例的 Earth2Studio 模型、数据源和示例。请勿用于编写推理代码、下载数据或安装。

name: vss-generate-video-report
description: Use this skill when producing a VSS analysis report — Mode A per-clip VLM, Mode B incident-range via video-analytics. Not for standalone video summarization, real-time alerts or ad-hoc Q&A.
description_zh: 在使用此功能生成VSS分析报告时——采用每段视频的Mode A VLM和Mode B视频分析事件范围。不适用于独立视频摘要、实时警报或临时问答。

name: bash-linux
description: Bash/Linux terminal patterns. Critical commands, piping, error handling, scripting. Use when working on macOS or Linux systems.
description_zh: Bash/Linux 终端模式。关键命令、管道、错误处理、脚本编写。在 macOS 或 Linux 系统上工作时使用。

name: odoo-19
description: Odoo 19 development knowledge base with 18 specialized guides covering Actions (ir.actions.*, cron jobs, server actions), Controllers (HTTP routing, endpoints, auth types), Data files (XML/CSV records, shortcuts, noupdate), API Decorators (@api.depends, @api.constrains, @api.ondelete, @api.onchange, @api.model, @api.private), SQL Constraints (models.Constraint replacing _sql_constraints), Database Indexes (models.Index), Module development (manifest, wizards, reports), Field types (Char, Text, Monetary, relational fields), Manifest configuration (__manifest__.py, dependencies, asset bundles), Mixins (mail.thread, mail.activity.mixin, mail.alias.mixin, utm.mixin), ORM Model methods (search, CRUD, domain filters, recordsets, CamelCase model naming), Migration scripts (pre/post/end hooks, data migration), OWL frontend components (hooks, services, lifecycle), Performance optimization (N+1 prevention, batch ops, _read_group), QWeb Reports (PDF/HTML, paper formats, barcodes, t-out), Security/ACL (record rules, field permissions, privilege-based groups, @api.private), Testing (TransactionCase, HttpCase, mocking, query count assertions), Transactions (savepoints, UniqueViolation, serialization failures), Translations (i18n, PO files, translatable fields), XML Views (list/form/search, kanban card templates, xpath inheritance, QWeb templates). Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging any Odoo 19 Python or XML code, creating or modifying modules, fixing performance issues, or looking up Odoo 19 API patterns and best practices. Includes CSS/SCSS asset authoring and review for Odoo addons.

Triggers: "show instincts", "what have you learned", "list instincts", "export instincts", "share instincts", "import instincts", "load instincts from", "learn this", "I think they always", "notice a pattern", "instinct", "hypothesis", "confidence", "learn from mistakes", "remember this", "don't do that again", "log this", "document this finding", "gotcha", "what did we learn", "learnings", "discoveries", or at session start (to load existing knowledge).
description_zh: 统一学习与记忆系统：基于置信度评分的本能（观察-假设-确认，存储于 .claude/instincts.md），用户修正被捕获为永久规则并记录在 MEMORY.md 中，有机发现则记录于 .claude/learning-log.md。包含状态、导出和导入模式。当您注意到重复模式、用户修正您的输出或发现非显而易见的事物时，请加载此技能。触发词： "显示本能"、"你学到了什么"、"列出本能"、"导出本能"、"分享本能"、"导入本能"、"从...加载本能"、"学习这个"、"我认为它们总是"、"注意到模式"、"本能"、"假设"、"置信度"、"从错误中学习"、"记住这个"、"不要再那样做"、"记录这个"、"记录这一发现"、"抓到你了"、"我们学到了什么"、"学习成果"、"发现"，或在会话开始时（以加载现有知识）。

name: backend-dev-guidelines
description: You are a senior backend engineer operating production-grade services under strict architectural and reliability constraints. Use when routes, controllers, services, repositories, express middleware, or prisma database access.
description_zh: 您是一位高级后端工程师，负责在严格的架构和可靠性约束下运行生产级服务。适用于路由、控制器、服务、仓库、Express 中间件或 Prisma 数据库访问。

name: seaborn
description: Statistical visualization with pandas integration. Use for quick exploration of distributions, relationships, and categorical comparisons with attractive defaults. Best for box plots, violin plots, pair plots, heatmaps. Built on matplotlib. For interactive plots use plotly; for publication styling use scientific-visualization.
description_zh: 使用 pandas 集成的统计可视化。用于快速探索分布、关系和分类比较，具有吸引人的默认设置。最适合箱线图、小提琴图、配对图和热力图。基于 matplotlib 构建。交互式图表请使用 plotly；用于出版风格请使用 scientific-visualization。

name: vss-query-analytics
description: Use this skill when reading video-analytics metrics, incidents, alerts, and sensor data via the VA-MCP server (port 9901). Not for live VLM or incident-range narrative reports.
description_zh: 在使用VA-MCP服务器（端口9901）读取视频分析指标、事件、警报和传感器数据时使用此功能。不适用于实时VLM或事件范围叙述报告。

name: extract
description: Extract structured data from websites and produce an executable Playwright script plus extracted data. Use when the user wants to scrape, extract, pull, collect, or harvest data from any website — product listings, tables, search results, feeds, profiles, or any repeating content.
description_zh: 从网站中提取结构化数据，并生成可执行的 Playwright 脚本以及提取的数据。当用户希望从任何网站（如产品列表、表格、搜索结果、信息流、个人资料或任何重复内容）进行数据抓取、提取、拉取或收集时使用。

name: container-publish
description: Dockerfile-less containerization using the .NET 10 SDK container publishing feature. Covers MSBuild properties, chiseled images, multi-arch builds, and registry publishing — all without writing a Dockerfile. Load this skill when the user wants to containerize without a Dockerfile, or mentions "dotnet publish container", "PublishContainer", "ContainerRepository", "ContainerFamily", "chiseled", "distroless", "container publish", "SDK container", "no Dockerfile", or "containerize without Docker".
description_zh: 使用 .NET 10 SDK 容器发布功能实现无需 Dockerfile 的容器化。涵盖 MSBuild 属性、精简镜像、多架构构建和注册表发布——所有这些都不需要编写 Dockerfile。当用户希望无需 Dockerfile 进行容器化，或提及“dotnet publish container”、“PublishContainer”、“ContainerRepository”、“ContainerFamily”、“精简镜像”、“distroless”、“container publish”、“SDK container”、“no Dockerfile”或“无需 Dockerfile 进行容器化”时，加载此技能。

name: context-canary
description: Install a per-turn canary signal (e.g. starting every reply with the user's name and a turn counter) so silent context degradation becomes visible the moment it happens, and run a recovery protocol when the canary trips. Use when the user mentions a "canary", "context canary", or "canary check", asks to detect context rot / compaction / drift, says "you stopped using my name" or "did you lose context", asks "how degraded is your context", or wants an early-warning system for long agent sessions.
description_zh: 安装一个每回合的示警信号（例如，在每个回复开头加上用户姓名和回合计数器），以便在沉默的上下文退化发生时立即变得可见，并在示警信号触发时运行恢复协议。在用户提到“示警信号”、“上下文示警信号”或“示警检查”、要求检测上下文腐烂/压缩/漂移、说“你不再使用我的名字”或“你是否丢失了上下文”、询问“你的上下文退化到什么程度”或需要长代理会话的早期预警系统时使用。

name: nemo-mbridge-perf-megatron-fsdp
description: Operational guide for enabling Megatron FSDP in Megatron-Bridge, including config knobs, code anchors, pitfalls, and verification.
description_zh: 启用 Megatron-Bridge 中的 Megatron FSDP 操作指南，包括配置开关、代码锚点、陷阱和验证。

name: agents-deploy
description: Use when deploying your agent to AWS, or when a deploy has failed. Handles pre-flight validation, CDK/IAM/quota error diagnosis, version management, rollback, and canary deployments. Triggers on: "deploy my agent", "agentcore deploy", "deploy failed", "CDK error", "rollback", "canary deploy", "pin version", "redeploy", "deploy stuck". Not for production hardening — use agents-harden. Not for adding capabilities before deploy — use agents-build or agents-connect. Not for VPC configuration errors — use agents-build.
description_zh: 在将代理部署到 AWS 或部署失败时使用。处理预检验证、CDK/IAM/配额错误诊断、版本管理、回滚和金丝雀部署。触发条件包括："部署我的代理"、"agentcore 部署"、"部署失败"、"CDK 错误"、"回滚"、"金丝雀部署"、"固定版本"、"重新部署"、"部署卡住"。不用于生产环境加固——请使用 agents-harden。不用于部署前的功能添加——请使用 agents-build 或 agents-connect。不用于 VPC 配置错误——请使用 agents-build。

name: ticket-resolution
description: Create, triage, advance, and close HubSpot support tickets — pipeline discovery, contact/company association, priority queues, bulk stage moves, resolution close-out.
description_zh: 创建、分派、推进和关闭 HubSpot 支持工单 — 流程发现、联系人/公司关联、优先级队列、批量阶段移动、解决方案关闭。

name: scaffolding-oracle-to-postgres-migration-test-project
description: Scaffolds an xUnit integration test project targeting Oracle in .NET solutions. Creates the test project, transaction-rollback base class, and seed data manager. Use only during Phase 3, before writing Oracle baseline integration tests. Do not invoke during Phase 6 — the PostgreSQL test project is produced by migrating this project, not by running this skill again.
description_zh: 为 Oracle 在 .NET 解决方案中搭建 xUnit 集成测试项目。创建测试项目、事务回滚基类和种子数据管理器。仅在阶段 3 使用，在编写 Oracle 基线集成测试之前使用。阶段 6 期间不得调用——PostgreSQL 测试项目是通过迁移此项目生成的，而不是再次运行此技能。

name: nemo-mbridge-perf-moe-dispatcher-selection
description: Choose the right MoE token dispatcher (`alltoall`, DeepEP, or HybridEP) for the hardware, EP degree, and optimization stage. Summarizes patterns from DSV3, Qwen3, Qwen3-Next, and VLM bring-up work.
description_zh: 为硬件、EP 等级和优化阶段选择合适的 MoE 令牌调度器（`alltoall`、DeepEP 或 HybridEP）。总结 DSV3、Qwen3、Qwen3-Next 和 VLM 引入工作中的模式。

name: baidu-search
description: 百度 AI 搜索。支持网页搜索、百度百科、秒懂百科、AI 智能生成四种模式。自动包含当前日期上下文。当用户要求搜索信息、查询百科、获取最新资讯、搜索新闻、查找资料时使用。
description_zh: 百度AI搜索。支持网页搜索、百度百科、秒懂百科、AI智能生成四种模式。自动包含当前日期上下文。当用户要求搜索信息、查询百科、获取最新资讯、搜索新闻、查找资料时使用。

name: oo-component-documentation
description: Create or update standardized object-oriented component documentation using a shared template plus mode-specific guidance for new and existing docs.
description_zh: 使用共享模板加上特定模式的指导，为新的和现有的文档创建或更新标准化的面向对象组件文档。

name: nemo-mbridge-perf-tp-dp-comm-overlap
description: Operational guide for enabling TP, DP, and PP communication overlap in Megatron-Bridge, including config knobs, code anchors, pitfalls, and verification.
description_zh: Megatron-Bridge中启用TP、DP和PP通信重叠的操作指南，包括配置开关、代码锚点、潜在问题和验证。

name: holoscan-setup
description: Guides Holoscan SDK installation: inspects the host, assesses platform compatibility, recommends an install method, and delegates to the matching install skill.
description_zh: 指导 Holoscan SDK 安装：检查主机，评估平台兼容性，推荐安装方法，并委托给匹配的安装技能。

name: vss-setup-behavior-analytics
description: Use to deploy the vss-behavior-analytics service standalone (entrypoint, config-source, optional calibration). Not for the full warehouse deploy.
description_zh: 用于独立部署 vss-behavior-analytics 服务（包含入口点、配置源和可选的校准）。不适用于完整仓库的部署。

name: generate-editor-search-query
description: Generates Unity Search queries and opens the Search window to find assets or scene objects. Use when the user asks to find, filter, or list assets, GameObjects, components, or references in the Editor, not on disk.
description_zh: 生成 Unity 搜索查询并打开搜索窗口以查找资源或场景对象。当用户在编辑器中要求查找、筛选或列出资源、GameObject、组件或引用时使用，而不是在磁盘上。

name: typst-author
description: Generate idiomatic Typst (.typ) code, edit and troubleshoot Typst documents and projects, and answer Typst syntax/reference questions. Use when working with .typ files or when the user explicitly asks for Typst document creation, editing, debugging, compilation, formatting, template work, or package usage.
description_zh: 生成具有惯用性的 Typst (.typ) 代码，编辑和排错 Typst 文档和项目，并解答 Typst 语法/参考问题。在处理 .typ 文件时使用，或在用户明确要求 Typst 文档创建、编辑、调试、编译、格式化、模板工作或包使用时使用。

name: prototype-strategy
description: Choose prototype fidelity and method to match the design question and the decision at stake. Use before building a prototype. For what to test once it exists, use `test-scenario`.
description_zh: 选择原型保真度和方法以匹配设计问题及关键决策。在构建原型之前使用。一旦原型存在，使用 `test-scenario` 来确定要测试的内容。

name: release-stable
description: Cut a stable release of Paseo (fresh patch or minor, or promote from beta). Use when the user says "release stable", "ship stable", "promote", "release:patch", "release:minor", "release:promote", or "/release-stable".
description_zh: 切割一个稳定的 Paseo 版本（新鲜补丁或小版本更新，或从测试版中提升）。当用户说“发布稳定版”、“发布稳定版”、“提升”、“release:patch”、“release:minor”、“release:promote”，或“/release-stable”时使用。

name: hypothesis-generation
description: Formulate evidence-bounded scientific questions, candidate hypotheses, rival explanations, causal or associational claims, discriminating predictions, measurements, and preregistration-ready analysis plans. Use when turning observations or preliminary findings into transparent, testable research plans without treating hypotheses as facts.
description_zh: 构建以证据为基础的科学问题、候选假设、竞争性解释、因果或关联性主张、区分性预测、测量方法以及已准备好的预注册分析计划。在将观察结果或初步发现转化为透明、可检验的研究计划时使用，同时不将假设视为既定事实。

name: douyin-video-summary
description: Summarize Douyin (TikTok China) videos by extracting audio, transcribing with whisper.cpp, and generating structured summaries. Use when a user shares a Douyin link and wants a text summary of the video content. Supports optional sync to Feishu (Lark) docs. Triggers on Douyin URLs (v.douyin.com, douyin.com/video/).

name: mcore-linting-and-formatting
description: Linting and formatting for Megatron-LM. Covers running autoformat.sh, tools (ruff, black, isort, pylint, mypy), and code style rules.
description_zh: 为 Megatron-LM 进行代码检查和格式化。包括运行 autoformat.sh 脚本、工具（ruff、black、isort、pylint、mypy）以及代码风格规则。

name: nemo-rl-docs
description: Documentation conventions for NeMo-RL. Covers docs/index.md updates and docstring format. Do NOT use for: bug fixes, test fixes, dependency bumps, refactoring, CI/CD changes, performance tuning, or any task that does not involve writing or updating documentation.
description_zh: NeMo-RL的文档规范。涵盖docs/index.md的更新和docstring格式。不应用于：修复bug、修复测试、依赖版本更新、重构、CI/CD变更、性能调优或任何不涉及编写或更新文档的任务。

name: theming-system
description: Design theming architecture — brand variants, dark mode, and high-contrast — mapped through token layers. Use when one system must serve multiple themes. For a single palette use `color-system` (ui-design); for dark mode craft use `dark-mode-design` (ui-design).
description_zh: 设计主题架构——品牌变体、暗黑模式和对比度模式——通过符号层映射。当一个系统需要服务于多个主题时使用。对于单色板使用 `color-system`（ui-design）；对于暗黑模式使用 `dark-mode-design`（ui-design）。

name: experience-aura-lwc-migrate
description: Use this skill to analyze a Salesforce Aura component bundle (.cmp, .app, .evt, .intf, Controller.js, Helper.js, Renderer.js) and produce a framework-agnostic migration blueprint (PRD.yaml / PRD.md / PRD.json) capturing public API, data requirements, slots, events, states, accessibility, styling, localization, and security posture. This is Phase 1 (analysis + PRD) only — it does NOT author or edit component code, wire adapters, or Jest tests, and does not write .html/.js/.css/.js-meta.xml. TRIGGER when the user says "analyze this Aura component", "migrate Aura", "convert .cmp", "produce a migration blueprint", "generate a PRD for this Aura component", or mentions aura:attribute, aura:handler, force:recordData, $Label, $Resource, component.get, cmp.find, or an input directory containing .cmp files. DO NOT TRIGGER when there is no Aura source (delegate downstream LWC authoring to experience-lwc-generate), for post-migration scoring, or for refactoring an existing modern component.
description_zh: 使用此技能来分析 Salesforce Aura 组件包（.cmp、.app、.evt、.intf、Controller.js、Helper.js、Renderer.js），并生成一个与框架无关的迁移蓝图（PRD.yaml / PRD.md / PRD.json），该蓝图应捕获公共 API、数据需求、插槽、事件、状态、无障碍性、样式、本地化和安全态势。这是第一阶段（分析 + PRD）——它不会编写或编辑组件代码、连接适配器或编写 Jest 测试，也不会编写 .html/.js/.css/.js-meta.xml 文件。当用户说“分析这个 Aura 组件”、“迁移 Aura”、“转换 .cmp”、“生成迁移蓝图”、“为这个 Aura 组件生成 PRD”，或提到 aura:attribute、aura:handler、force:recordData、$Label、$Resource、component.get、cmp.find，或提到包含 .cmp 文件的输入目录时，应触发该技能。当没有 Aura 源时（将下游 LWC 编写委托给 experience-lwc-generate），用于迁移后的评分，或用于重构现有的现代组件时，不应触发该技能。

name: experience-lds-graphql-generate
description: Use ALWAYS when a prompt mentions GraphQL, lightning/uiGraphQLApi, @wire(graphql, ...), or gql template tags in an LWC context — even if the surface ask is "build an LWC". Owns the ENTIRE flow: introspect the org's LDS GraphQL schema, identify entities/fields, construct the schema-validated gql query or mutation, wire it into the LWC via lightning/uiGraphQLApi, verify against a connected org. REQUIRED whenever a prompt asks to render, list, or edit Salesforce records (Account, Contact, Case, custom objects) via GraphQL — the .html and .js scaffolding IS in scope. DO NOT delegate to experience-lwc-generate: that skill has NO GraphQL schema introspection, NO create_lds_graphql_read_query binding, and defaults to getRecord/getRelatedListRecords wire adapters which will not satisfy a GraphQL prompt. DO NOT TRIGGER only if the prompt forbids GraphQL, chooses UIAPI/Apex (use experience-lds-best-practices-apply), or asks for data requirements (use experience-lds-data-requirements-generate).
description_zh: 在 LWC 上下文中，当提示中提到 GraphQL、lightning/uiGraphQLApi、@wire(graphql, ...) 或 gql 模板标签时，始终使用 ALWAYS —— 即使表面请求是“构建一个 LWC”。拥有整个流程：分析组织的 LDS GraphQL 模式，识别实体/字段，构建经过模式验证的 gql 查询或变更，通过 lightning/uiGraphQLApi 将其连接到 LWC，并在连接的组织中验证。每当提示要求通过 GraphQL 渲染、列出或编辑 Salesforce 记录（账户、联系人、案例、自定义对象）时，都必须使用 REQUIRED —— .html 和 .js 框架也在范围内。不要委托给 experience-lwc-generate：该技能没有 GraphQL 模式分析功能，没有 create_lds_graphql_read_query 绑定，并且默认使用 getRecord/getRelatedListRecords 线路适配器，这些都无法满足 GraphQL 提示。不要触发，除非提示禁止使用 GraphQL、选择 UIAPI/Apex（使用 experience-lds-best-practices-apply），或要求数据需求（使用 experience-lds-data-requirements-generate）。

name: n8n-workflow-lifecycle-official
description: Use when starting, designing, organizing, finishing, or shipping an n8n workflow. Covers visual layout (sticky notes), descriptions that capture the *why*, node names, validation, testing, folders/projects, and publishing. Triggers on create_workflow_from_code, update_workflow, validate_workflow, publish_workflow, archive_workflow, "design", "lay out", "organize", "structure", "sticky", "describe this workflow", "ship", "deploy", "publish", "name this workflow", or any folder/project organization request.
description_zh: 在启动、设计、组织、完成或交付 n8n 工作流时使用。涵盖可视化布局（便利贴）、捕捉 *原因* 的描述、节点名称、验证、测试、文件夹/项目以及发布。触发条件包括：create_workflow_from_code、update_workflow、validate_workflow、publish_workflow、archive_workflow、"设计"、"布局"、"组织"、"结构化"、"便利贴"、"描述此工作流"、"交付"、"部署"、"发布"、"命名此工作流" 或任何文件夹/项目组织请求。

name: audio-setup-mixers
description: Routes Audio Sources into existing Audio Mixer Groups, classifying each source by what it plays. Use when the user asks about cleaning up mixer assignments, routing audio through a mixer, or which group a sound belongs in.
description_zh: 将音频源分配到现有的音频混音组中，并根据其播放内容对每个源进行分类。当用户询问清理混音分配、通过混音器路由音频或声音属于哪个组时使用。

name: agents-debug
description: Use when your agent or environment is broken — wrong answers, errors, timeouts, tool failures, or CLI issues. Reads traces and logs to diagnose root causes. Also checks prerequisites when the CLI itself isn't working. Triggers on: "agent not working", "wrong answer", "agent error", "tool call failing", "debug agent", "check logs", "read traces", "broken", "500 error", "424 error", "model access denied", "command not found", "stuck in DELETING", "maxVms exceeded", "cold start diagnosis", "cold start slow", "agentcore create error", "create failed", "exit code 7", "connection refused local dev". Not for deploy failures — use agents-deploy. Not for performance tuning without errors — use agents-optimize. Not for VPC configuration — use agents-build. Not for observability setup or missing logs — use agents-optimize.
description_zh: 当您的代理或环境出现问题时使用——包括错误答案、错误、超时、工具失败或CLI问题。读取跟踪记录和日志以诊断根本原因。当CLI本身无法工作时，还会检查先决条件。触发条件包括："代理无法工作"、"错误答案"、"代理错误"、"工具调用失败"、"调试代理"、"检查日志"、"读取跟踪记录"、"损坏"、"500错误"、"424错误"、"模型访问被拒绝"、"命令未找到"、"卡在DELETING状态"、"maxVms超出限制"、"冷启动诊断"、"冷启动缓慢"、"agentcore创建错误"、"创建失败"、"退出码7"、"本地开发连接被拒绝"。不适用于部署失败——请使用agents-deploy。不适用于无错误时的性能调优——请使用agents-optimize。不适用于VPC配置——请使用agents-build。不适用于可观测性设置或缺失日志——请使用agents-optimize。

name: code-review
description: MCP-powered multi-dimensional code review for .NET projects. Uses Roslyn analysis tools for antipatterns, diagnostics, references, and dependency graphs combined with structured manual review. Prioritizes effort with blast-radius scoring — data access, security, concurrency, and integration boundaries before style — and produces severity-categorized findings with actionable fixes. Use when: "review", "code review", "PR review", "review this", "review my code", "check code quality", "review changes", "what should I review", "review priorities", "blast radius", "critical path".
description_zh: 基于MCP的.NET项目多维代码审查。使用Roslyn分析工具进行反模式、诊断、引用和依赖图分析，并结合结构化人工审查。通过爆炸半径评分优先级排序——优先处理数据访问、安全性、并发和集成边界，然后才是代码风格——并生成按严重程度分类的、可操作的修复建议。适用于以下场景："审查"、"代码审查"、"PR审查"、"审查这个"、"审查我的代码"、"检查代码质量"、"审查变更"、"我应该审查什么"、"审查优先级"、"爆炸半径"、"关键路径"。

name: everything-claude-code-harness
description: Agent harness performance system for Claude Code and other AI coding agents — skills, instincts, memory, hooks, commands, and security scanning
description_zh: Claude 代码和其他 AI 编码代理的代理利用性能系统——技能、本能、记忆、钩子、命令和安全扫描

name: ai-behavior-trees-utility-ai
description: Build a production behavior-tree runtime (Blackboard, action/condition leaves, sequence/selector/parallel composites, decorators) and a Utility AI system (response curves — linear, exponential, sigmoid, quadratic — considerations, and action evaluators), plus hybrid BT-drives-Utility agents. Use when implementing a reusable behavior-tree or utility-based decision system, or tuning enemy/NPC decisions beyond a simple FSM, or when the user mentions behavior tree, blackboard, decorator, selector, sequence, tick status, utility AI, response/scoring curve, or consideration. For choosing between FSM/BT/steering or for pathfinding, use game-ai; for Unreal's BehaviorTree/Blackboard assets, use unreal-behavior-trees.
description_zh: 构建一个生产行为树运行时（黑板、动作/条件叶节点、序列/选择器/并行组合节点、装饰器）以及一个效用AI系统（响应曲线——线性、指数、S型、二次——考虑因素和动作评估器），还包括混合BT驱动-效用代理。在实现可重用的行为树或基于效用的决策系统时使用，或在调整敌人/NPC决策超出简单有限状态机时使用，或当用户提到行为树、黑板、装饰器、选择器、序列、tick状态、效用AI、响应/评分曲线或考虑因素时使用。在FSM/BT/转向或路径查找之间进行选择时，使用game-ai；对于虚幻引擎的BehaviorTree/Blackboard资源，使用unreal-behavior-trees。

name: domain-modeling
description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.
description_zh: 构建和精炼项目的领域模型。当用户想要确定领域术语或通用语言、记录架构决策，或需要维护领域模型的另一项技能时使用。

name: find-models
description: Find AI models on Replicate using search and curated collections.
description_zh: 在 Replicate 上使用搜索和精选集合查找 AI 模型。

name: agents-connect
description: Use when connecting your agent to external APIs, tools, or services via Gateway, or restricting tool access with Cedar policies. Handles gateway setup, target types, outbound auth (OAuth, API key, IAM), credentials, and Cedar policy authoring. Triggers on: "connect to API", "add gateway", "connect to MCP server", "Lambda tools", "OpenAPI", "gateway target", "Cedar policy", "restrict tools", "policy engine", "gateway auth error", "store API key", "outbound credential", "env var API key", "API key None after deploy", "credential not available after deploy", "should this be a gateway target", "give my agent tools", "add tools to agent". Not for inbound auth (who can call your agent) — use agents-harden. Not for debugging agent behavior — use agents-debug. Not for VPC networking errors (agent can't reach APIs due to VPC) — use agents-build. Not for creating or hosting a new MCP server project — use agents-get-started.
description_zh: 在通过网关连接您的代理到外部API、工具或服务，或使用Cedar策略限制工具访问时使用。处理网关设置、目标类型、出站认证（OAuth、API密钥、IAM）、凭证以及Cedar策略编写。触发条件包括："连接到API"、"添加网关"、"连接到MCP服务器"、"Lambda工具"、"OpenAPI"、"网关目标"、"Cedar策略"、"限制工具"、"策略引擎"、"网关认证错误"、"存储API密钥"、"出站凭证"、"环境变量API密钥"、"部署后API密钥为空"、"部署后凭证不可用"、"是否应为网关目标"、"给我的代理工具"、"向代理添加工具"。不适用于入站认证（谁可以调用您的代理）——请使用agents-harden。不适用于调试代理行为——请使用agents-debug。不适用于VPC网络错误（代理因VPC无法访问API）——请使用agents-build。不适用于创建或托管新的MCP服务器项目——请使用agents-get-started。

name: insta
description: Operate InstaCloud infrastructure with the `insta` CLI: create projects, add postgres/storage/compute services, deploy apps, create disposable branch environments (isolated DB + storage + compute per branch), schedule recurring HTTP calls (cron jobs) against a service or an external URL, bind service credentials into compute env, wire user secrets into `.env`, run multiple agents each in their own branch, handle governance approvals, check metrics/logs/usage, and promote branches to main. Use this skill when working in an InstaCloud-managed project (a `.insta/` dir or the `insta` CLI), when the user mentions InstaCloud or insta, AND when they ask to deploy an app, need a database/backend/object storage, want a scheduled or recurring task, want preview or per-agent sandbox environments, want branchable infrastructure, want to migrate an existing app in from Heroku / Railway / Fly / Render, or mention agent setup or MCP — even if they don't say "InstaCloud" explicitly. Also covers the insta-cloud remote MCP server (insta_* tools) and the self-hosted insta-oss runtime (same CLI, local daemon).
description_zh: 使用 `insta` 命令行界面 (CLI) 操作 InstaCloud 基础设施：创建项目、添加 PostgreSQL/存储/计算服务、部署应用程序、创建可一次性使用的分支环境（每个分支拥有独立的数据库+存储+计算环境）、对服务或外部 URL 调度定期 HTTP 调用（cron 任务）、将服务凭证绑定到计算环境、将用户密钥连接到 `.env` 文件、在每个分支中运行多个代理、处理治理审批、检查指标/日志/使用情况，并将分支提升至主分支。在以下情况下使用此技能：在 InstaCloud 管理的项目中工作（`.insta/` 目录或 `insta` CLI）、用户提及 InstaCloud 或 insta，以及当用户请求部署应用程序、需要数据库/后端/对象存储、需要计划或定期任务、需要预览或每个代理的沙盒环境、需要可分支的基础设施、需要从 Heroku / Railway / Fly / Render 迁移现有应用程序，或提及代理设置或 MCP（即使他们没有明确提及 "InstaCloud"）。此外，还涵盖 insta-cloud 远程 MCP 服务器（insta_* 工具）和自托管的 insta-oss 运行时（相同 CLI，本地守护进程）。

name: typst
description: Typst document creation and package development. Use when: (1) Working with .typ files, (2) User mentions typst, typst.toml, or typst-cli, (3) Creating or using Typst packages, (4) Developing document templates, (5) Converting Markdown/LaTeX to Typst
description_zh: Typst 文档创建和包开发。使用场景包括：(1) 处理 .typ 文件，(2) 用户提及 typst、typst.toml 或 typst-cli，(3) 创建或使用 Typst 包，(4) 开发文档模板，(5) 将 Markdown/LaTeX 转换为 Typst。

name: meshy-3d-generation
description: Create or edit digital 3D assets with Meshy: models, textures, rigging, animation, and reference images. For physical printing, use meshy-3d-printing.
description_zh: 使用 Meshy 创建或编辑数字 3D 资产：模型、纹理、绑定、动画和参考图像。用于物理打印，请使用 meshy-3d-printing。

name: mt5-robot-tester
description: Select the best MetaTrader 5 trading robots (Expert Advisors) that have not been backtested yet, by running the MT5 Strategy Tester from the command line through a 3-round pipeline. Use when the user wants to batch-test MT5 bots/EAs, screen robots across all symbols, optimize EA parameters, or move candidate bots to finalists based on profit, drawdown, positive months/years and equity-curve criteria. Runs terminal64.exe headless; Windows + MetaTrader 5 required at run time.
description_zh: 通过从命令行运行 MT5 策略测试器，在 3 轮流水线中选取尚未进行回测的最佳 MetaTrader 5 交易机器人（专家顾问）。当用户需要批量测试 MT5 机器人/EAs、跨所有货币对筛选机器人、优化 EA 参数，或根据利润、回撤、盈利月份/年份和权益曲线标准将候选机器人筛选为最终候选时使用。运行时需使用 terminal64.exe 无头模式；需在 Windows 环境下配合 MetaTrader 5 使用。

name: compose-ui-testing-patterns
description: Use when writing or reviewing Jetpack Compose UI tests, screenshot tests or baseline-recording evidence, previews, semantics assertions, fake image loading, keyboard input, focus assertions, interaction state (hover/pressed/focused), or tests for plain state-driven UI composables.
description_zh: 在编写或审查 Jetpack Compose UI 测试、截图测试或基线录制证据、预览、语义断言、模拟图片加载、键盘输入、焦点断言、交互状态（悬停/按下/聚焦）或纯状态驱动 UI 可组合组件的测试时使用。

name: journey-map
description: Map one persona's end-to-end experience with stages, touchpoints, emotions, and pain points. Use when improving an existing experience. For the multi-channel ecosystem use `experience-map` (ux-strategy); for screen-level paths use `user-flow-diagram` (prototyping-testing).
description_zh: 将一个角色的端到端体验与阶段、触点、情绪和痛点进行映射。在改进现有体验时使用。对于多渠道生态系统，使用 `experience-map` (ux-strategy)；对于屏幕级别的路径，使用 `user-flow-diagram` (prototyping-testing)。

name: backward-traceability
description: Make every number in the final PDF traceable to the exact code line that produced it. Uses \hypertarget/\hyperlink LaTeX commands and \num{formula} evaluated at compile time. Use for reproducibility and data integrity verification.
description_zh: 确保最终PDF中的每个数字都能追溯到产生它的确切代码行。使用LaTeX命令\hypertarget/\hyperlink，以及编译时评估的\num{公式}。用于可重复性和数据完整性验证。

name: nodejs-core
description: Contributes to and debugs Node.js core, including nodejs/node commit and PR tone, contribution workflows, native crashes, V8 performance, node-gyp builds, N-API bindings, and libuv issues. Use when drafting or reviewing a Node.js core commit or pull request, working in nodejs/node, or diagnosing C++ addons, binding.gyp failures, segfaults, native leaks, V8 deoptimizations, and event-loop internals.
description_zh: 参与并调试 Node.js 核心，包括 nodejs/node 的提交和 PR 语气、贡献工作流程、原生崩溃、V8 性能、node-gyp 构建、N-API 绑定以及 libuv 问题。在起草或审查 Node.js 核心提交或拉取请求、在 nodejs/node 中工作或诊断 C++ 扩展、binding.gyp 失败、段错误、原生内存泄漏、V8 退化以及事件循环内部问题时使用。

name: pptx
description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.
description_zh: 在任何时候涉及 .pptx 或 .potx 文件（作为输入、输出或两者兼有），均可使用此技能。这包括：创建幻灯片演示文稿、提案演示文稿或演示文稿；读取、解析或从任何 .pptx 或 .potx 文件中提取文本（即使提取的内容将用于其他地方，如电子邮件或摘要）；编辑、修改或更新现有演示文稿；合并或拆分幻灯片文件；处理模板（.potx）、布局、演讲者笔记或评论。当用户提到“deck”、“slides”、“presentation”或引用 .pptx 或 .potx 文件名时，无论他们计划如何处理内容，均会触发此技能。如果需要打开、创建或操作 .pptx 或 .potx 文件，请使用此技能。

name: holoscan-install-container
description: Install Holoscan SDK via the NGC Docker container. Use for container-based installs; not for native apt/pip/Conda installs.
description_zh: 通过 NGC Docker 容器安装 Holoscan SDK。用于基于容器的安装；不适用于原生 apt/pip/Conda 安装。

name: sqlalchemy-alembic-expert-best-practices-code-review
description: SQLAlchemy ORM and Alembic migration best practices for building safe, performant database schemas. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring SQLAlchemy models, Alembic migrations, or database query patterns. Triggers on tasks involving SQLAlchemy ORM, Alembic migrations, database schema changes, or query optimization.
description_zh: SQLAlchemy ORM 和 Alembic 迁移的最佳实践，用于构建安全、高效的数据库模式。在编写、审查或重构 SQLAlchemy 模型、Alembic 迁移或数据库查询模式时，应使用此技能。涉及 SQLAlchemy ORM、Alembic 迁移、数据库模式变更或查询优化的任务中的触发器。

name: happyhorse
description: Generate and edit videos with Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: HappyHorse T2V, I2V, R2V, Video Edit. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing with natural language, character preservation, 720P/1080P, up to 15 seconds. Use for: physically realistic video, video editing, character-consistent content, product demos, social media. Triggers: happyhorse, happy horse, alibaba video, happyhorse 1.0, dashscope video, alibaba happyhorse, video editing ai, ai video editor
description_zh:
通过 inference.sh 命令行界面，使用阿里巴巴 HappyHorse 1.0 系列模型生成和编辑视频。

**模型：** HappyHorse 文生视频（T2V）、图生视频（I2V）、参考生视频（R2V）、视频编辑

**功能：**
- 文生视频
- 图生视频
- 参考生视频
- 使用自然语言进行视频编辑
- 角色一致性保留
- 支持 720P 和 1080P 分辨率
- 最长 15 秒

**适用场景：**
- 物理真实感视频
- 视频编辑
- 角色一致性内容生成
- 产品演示
- 社交媒体内容

**触发关键词：**
happyhorse、happy horse、alibaba video、happyhorse 1.0、dashscope video、alibaba happyhorse、video editing ai、ai video editor

name: verify
description: Run a comprehensive 7-phase verification pipeline for .NET projects: build, analyzers, antipattern detection, tests, security, formatting, and diff review. Each phase produces PASS/FAIL with actionable output and the pipeline short-circuits on critical failures. Also the authority on verification strategy: which phases to run for a given change, quality gates, and fix-and-retry loops. Use when: "verify", "check everything", "is this ready", "pre-PR check", "run all checks", "quality gate", "verification strategy", "which checks should run", or after completing a feature or refactor.
description_zh: 为 .NET 项目运行全面的 7 阶段验证流程：构建、分析器、反模式检测、测试、安全、格式化以及差异审查。每个阶段都会产生 PASS/FAIL 结果，并提供可操作的输出，并且在关键失败时流程会中断。同时，也是验证策略的权威：针对特定变更需要运行哪些阶段、质量门禁以及修复重试循环。在以下情况下使用："verify"、"检查所有内容"、"是否准备好了"、"预 PR 检查"、"运行所有检查"、"质量门禁"、"验证策略"、"应该运行哪些检查"，或在完成功能或重构后。

name: dx-org-devhub-configure
description: Enable Dev Hub on a Salesforce org and view its scratch org allocation, using the Salesforce CLI (sf). Use when someone wants to turn on or enable Dev Hub, set up an org to create scratch orgs or second-generation (2GP) and unlocked packages, check whether Dev Hub is already enabled, see how many scratch orgs they can create (Active and Daily scratch org limits, remaining allocation), configure Dev Hub preferences such as packaging, org shape export, or scratch org snapshots, or list the active scratch orgs created from a Dev Hub. Enabling deploys the enableScratchOrgManagementPref setting, is irreversible, needs a System Administrator (ModifyAllData or ModifyMetadata), and does not work in sandboxes. DO NOT TRIGGER for creating or deleting individual scratch orgs, for switching the default org (use dx-org-switch), or for trial or org expiration dates (use dx-org-trial-expiration-check).
description_zh: 在 Salesforce 组织中启用 Dev Hub 并使用 Salesforce CLI (sf) 查看其 Scratch Org 分配情况。当需要启用或激活 Dev Hub、设置组织以创建 Scratch Org 或第二代 (2GP) 以及未锁定包时使用。检查 Dev Hub 是否已启用、查看可创建多少 Scratch Org（活跃和每日 Scratch Org 限制、剩余分配）、配置 Dev Hub 首选项（如打包、组织结构导出或 Scratch Org 快照），或列出从 Dev Hub 创建的活跃 Scratch Org。启用时会部署 enableScratchOrgManagementPref 设置，此操作不可逆，需要系统管理员（ModifyAllData 或 ModifyMetadata）权限，且在沙盒中无效。**禁止**用于创建或删除单个 Scratch Org、切换默认组织（使用 dx-org-switch）或处理试用或组织过期日期（使用 dx-org-trial-expiration-check）。

name: cli-bridge
description:
Manage short-code bundles that authorize the local starchild CLI to talk to this agent, including the agent-shell local-exec channel and the local MCP proxy (stdio MCP servers on the user's machine).

Use when connecting or disconnecting the starchild CLI (e.g. mint a CLI bridge code, list my CLI bundles, revoke an old CLI session, let the agent run shell commands on the user's own machine, or drive a local app via a stdio MCP server — Blender, Figma, Godot, computer-use, etc.).
description_zh:
管理短码包，授权本地 starchild CLI 与此代理进行通信，包括代理-shell 本地执行通道和本地 MCP 代理（用户机器上的 stdio MCP 服务器）。

在连接或断开 starchild CLI 时使用（例如：生成 CLI 桥接码、列出我的 CLI 包、撤销旧的 CLI 会话、让代理在用户自己的机器上运行 shell 命令，或通过 stdio MCP 服务器驱动本地应用——Blender、Figma、Godot、电脑使用等）。

name: social-media-image-sizes
description: Check and resize images for social media platforms. Run scripts/check.js to validate any image against specs for Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Snapchat, and Threads — get a ranked match list with exact resize commands. Run scripts/resize.js to export a correctly-sized copy. Use when a user asks to validate image dimensions, resize an image for a platform, check if an image fits a spec, or prep assets for social media posting or ads.
description_zh: 检查并调整社交媒体平台的图片大小。运行脚本/check.js 来验证任何图片是否符合 Instagram、Facebook、X（推特）、LinkedIn、TikTok、YouTube、Pinterest、Snapchat 和 Threads 的规格——获取一个精确调整命令的匹配列表。运行脚本/resize.js 来导出正确大小的副本。当用户需要验证图片尺寸、为平台调整图片大小、检查图片是否符合规格，或为社交媒体发布或广告准备素材时使用。

name: agents-optimize
description: Use when measuring or improving agent quality and performance — set up evaluators, online monitoring, CI/CD quality gates, observability, or cost optimization. Triggers on: "evaluate my agent", "add evaluator", "measure quality", "quality gate", "run evals", "agent too slow", "why is it slow", "reduce latency", "set up observability", "CloudWatch dashboard", "how much does my agent cost", "cost optimization", "logs not showing up", "logs missing", "spans not found", "eval failing", "eval error", "dev traces", "local traces", "agentcore dev traces", "traces to CloudWatch". Not for debugging errors or crashes — use agents-debug. Slow but correct routes here; broken routes to debug.
description_zh: 用于测量或提升代理质量与性能时使用——设置评估器、在线监控、CI/CD质量门禁、可观测性或成本优化。触发条件包括："评估我的代理"、"添加评估器"、"测量质量"、"质量门禁"、"运行评估"、"代理太慢"、"为什么慢"、"降低延迟"、"设置可观测性"、"CloudWatch控制台"、"我的代理成本多少"、"成本优化"、"日志未显示"、"日志缺失"、"追踪未找到"、"评估失败"、"评估错误"、"开发追踪"、"本地追踪"、"agentcore开发追踪"、"追踪上传至CloudWatch"。不用于调试错误或崩溃——请使用agents-debug。此处保留缓慢但正确的路由；故障路由需调试。

name: docx
description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.
description_zh: 每当用户想要创建、读取、编辑或操作 Word 文档（.docx 文件）或 Word 模板（.dotx 文件）时，请使用此技能。触发条件包括：提及“Word doc”、“word document”、“.docx”或“.dotx”，或要求生成具有目录、标题、页码或信头等格式化要求的正式文档。此外，在从 .docx 或 .dotx 文件中提取或重新组织内容、在文档中插入或替换图片、在 Word 文件中执行查找替换、处理修订跟踪或评论，或将内容转换为精致的 Word 文档时，也请使用此技能。如果用户要求以 Word 或 .docx 文件形式提供“报告”、“备忘录”、“信函”、“模板”或类似交付成果，请使用此技能。**不适用于**PDF、电子表格、Google Docs 或与文档生成无关的通用编程任务。

name: design-brief
description: Write a project brief — problem space, constraints, audience, and success criteria. Use at kickoff for one specific project. For long-horizon aspiration use `north-star-vision`; for reusable decision rules use `design-principles`.
description_zh: 撰写项目简报——问题领域、约束条件、目标受众和成功标准。在启动特定项目时使用。对于长期愿景使用 `north-star-vision`；对于可重用的决策规则使用 `design-principles`。

name: dotnet-init
description: Interactive project initialization. Detects project type, asks architecture questions, and generates a customized CLAUDE.md — no manual template copying. Use when: "init project", "setup project", "initialize", "new project setup", "generate CLAUDE.md", "configure for dotnet-claude-kit", or starting Claude Code on a fresh or existing .NET codebase.
description_zh: 交互式项目初始化。检测项目类型，询问架构问题，并生成定制化的CLAUDE.md——无需手动复制模板。使用场景：执行"init project"、"setup project"、"initialize"、"new project setup"、"generate CLAUDE.md"、"configure for dotnet-claude-kit"，或在全新或现有的.NET代码库上启动Claude Code时。

name: tdd
description: Guided test-driven development workflow for .NET 10 using xUnit v3, WebApplicationFactory, Testcontainers, and Verify snapshots. Follows the strict red-green-refactor cycle. Use when: "TDD", "test-driven", "let's TDD this", "red green refactor", "write the test first", or when building a feature with clear acceptance criteria.
description_zh: 使用 xUnit v3、WebApplicationFactory、Testcontainers 和 Verify 快照的 .NET 10 引导式测试驱动开发工作流。遵循严格的红-绿-重构循环。在以下情况下使用："TDD"、"测试驱动"、"让我们进行 TDD"、"红绿重构"、"先写测试"或构建具有明确验收标准的特性。

name: wrap-up
description: Owns the session handoff lifecycle: the end-of-session ritual that captures completed work, pending tasks, and learnings into .claude/handoff.md, and the session-start protocol that loads it back. Triggers on: /wrap-up, "wrap up", "done for today", "that's all", "end session", "signing off", "handoff" — and at session start: "start session", "session start", "load handoff", "pick up where we left off", "what were we working on".
description_zh: 拥有会话交接生命周期：会话结束的仪式，将已完成的工作、待办任务和学习成果记录到 .claude/handoff.md 中，以及会话开始的协议，用于加载这些内容。触发条件包括：/wrap-up、"wrap up"、"done for today"、"that's all"、"end session"、"signing off"、"handoff" — 以及在会话开始时："start session"、"session start"、"load handoff"、"pick up where we left off"、"what were we working on"。

name: animation-designer
description: Expert in web animations, transitions, and motion design using Framer Motion and CSS
description_zh: 精通使用 Framer Motion 和 CSS 的网页动画、过渡和运动设计专家

name: gitnexus-exploring
description: Use when the user asks how code works, wants to understand architecture, trace execution flows, or explore unfamiliar parts of the codebase. Examples: "How does X work?", "What calls this function?", "Show me the auth flow"
description_zh: 当用户询问代码如何工作、想要理解架构、追踪执行流程或探索代码库中不熟悉的部分时使用。例如：“X是如何工作的？”，“什么调用了这个函数？”，“给我展示认证流程”。

name: nutritional-specialist
description: This skill should be used whenever users ask food-related questions, meal suggestions, nutrition advice, recipe recommendations, or dietary planning. On first use, the skill collects comprehensive user preferences (allergies, dietary restrictions, goals, likes/dislikes) and stores them in a persistent database. All subsequent food-related responses are personalized based on these stored preferences.
description_zh: 此技能应在用户询问与食物相关的问题、寻求餐点建议、获取营养建议、推荐食谱或进行饮食规划时使用。首次使用时，该技能会收集用户的全面偏好（包括过敏、饮食限制、目标、喜好/不喜好），并将其存储在持久化数据库中。所有后续与食物相关的回复都将根据这些存储的偏好进行个性化。

name: agents-get-started
description: Use when a developer wants to create a new agent project or get started with AgentCore. Handles framework selection, project scaffolding, first deploy, and first invocation. Triggers on: "build an agent", "create an agent", "get started", "new project", "agentcore create", "which framework", "Strands vs LangGraph", "hello world agent", "first agent", "create MCP server", "host MCP server", "agentcore dev", "dev server", "what port", "local development". Not for adding capabilities to existing projects — use agents-build or agents-connect. Strands vs LangGraph in a migration context routes to agents-build, not here. Connecting to an existing MCP server routes to agents-connect, not here.
description_zh: 当开发者想要创建新的代理项目或开始使用 AgentCore 时使用。它处理框架选择、项目脚手架搭建、首次部署和首次调用。触发条件包括："构建代理"、"创建代理"、"开始使用"、"新建项目"、"agentcore create"、"选择框架"、"Strands vs LangGraph"、"hello world 代理"、"第一个代理"、"创建 MCP 服务器"、"托管 MCP 服务器"、"agentcore dev"、"开发服务器"、"哪个端口"、"本地开发"。不适用于为现有项目添加功能——请使用 agents-build 或 agents-connect。在迁移上下文中，Strands vs LangGraph 会路由到 agents-build，而不是这里。连接到现有的 MCP 服务器会路由到 agents-connect，而不是这里。

name: code-simplifier
description: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality. Focuses on recently modified code unless instructed otherwise.
description_zh: 简化并优化代码，以提高清晰度、一致性和可维护性，同时保留所有功能。除非另有指示，否则主要关注最近修改的代码。

name: script-writer
description: This skill should be used whenever users need YouTube video scripts written. On first use, collects comprehensive preferences including script type, tone, target audience, style, video length, hook style, use of humor, personality, and storytelling approach. Generates complete, production-ready YouTube scripts tailored to user's specifications for any topic. Maintains database of preferences and past scripts for consistent style.
description_zh: 这项技能应在用户需要撰写YouTube视频脚本时使用。首次使用时，会收集全面的偏好设置，包括脚本类型、语气、目标受众、风格、视频时长、钩子风格、幽默运用、个性特点以及叙事方法。根据用户的特定要求，为任何主题生成完整、适用于制作的YouTube脚本。同时维护偏好设置和过往脚本的数据库，以确保风格的一致性。

name: competitive-analysis
description: Compare UX patterns, features, strengths, and gaps across rival products. Use when you need to know what others actually do. For deliberately adopting their conventions, use `jakobs-law` (interaction-design).
description_zh: 对比竞品在用户体验模式、功能、优势及不足方面的差异。当你需要了解其他产品实际做法时使用。若需刻意采用其惯例，请使用 `jakobs-law`（交互设计）。

name: agents-harden
description: Use when preparing your agent for production — IAM scoping, inbound auth (JWT, SigV4), secrets management, cold start optimization, session lifecycle, rate limiting, input validation, and quota guidance. Triggers on: "production checklist", "harden agent", "production ready", "secure agent", "inbound auth", "going live", "cold start optimization", "session lifecycle", "StopRuntimeSession", "quota", "throttling", "maxVms", "rate limit", "security audit of outbound API calls", "gateway target audit for production", "restrict who can call", "lock down endpoint", "only our app can call". Not for Cedar tool-restriction policies — use agents-connect. Not for quality measurement — use agents-optimize. Not for outbound credential storage or API key wiring — use agents-connect. Not for A2A agent-to-agent auth — use agents-build. Cold start observation and diagnosis (not optimization) routes to agents-debug.
description_zh: 在准备将您的代理部署到生产环境时使用——包括 IAM 权限范围、入站认证（JWT、SigV4）、密钥管理、冷启动优化、会话生命周期、速率限制、输入验证和配额指导。触发条件包括："生产清单"、"加固代理"、"生产就绪"、"安全代理"、"入站认证"、"正式上线"、"冷启动优化"、"会话生命周期"、"StopRuntimeSession"、"配额"、"速率限制"、"安全审计出站 API 调用"、"生产网关目标审计"、"限制谁可以调用"、"锁定端点"、"仅允许我们的应用调用"。不适用于 Cedar 工具限制策略——请使用 agents-connect。不适用于质量测量——请使用 agents-optimize。不适用于出站凭证存储或 API 密钥配置——请使用 agents-connect。不适用于 A2A 代理间认证——请使用 agents-build。冷启动观察和诊断（非优化）路由至 agents-debug。

name: code-documentation
description: Use this skill when the user requests to generate, create, or improve documentation for code, APIs, libraries, repositories, or software projects. Supports README generation, API reference documentation, inline code comments, architecture documentation, changelog generation, and developer guides. Trigger on requests like "document this code", "create a README", "generate API docs", "write developer guide", or when analyzing codebases for documentation purposes.
description_zh: 在用户请求为代码、API、库、存储库或软件项目生成、创建或改进文档时使用此技能。支持生成README、API参考文档、行内代码注释、架构文档、生成变更日志以及开发者指南。在用户提出类似“为这段代码生成文档”、“创建一个README”、“生成API文档”、“编写开发者指南”的请求，或为文档目的分析代码库时触发。

name: plan
description: Enter plan mode for .NET projects with architecture awareness. Analyzes tasks through the lens of supported architectures (VSA, Clean Architecture, DDD, Modular Monolith) and produces structured implementation plans before any code is written. Use when: "plan", "let's plan", "think through", "design this", "how should I implement", or any non-trivial task requiring 3+ steps.
description_zh: 为具有架构感知能力的 .NET 项目进入计划模式。通过支持架构（VSA、Clean Architecture、DDD、模块化单体）的视角分析任务，并在编写任何代码之前生成结构化的实施计划。在以下情况使用："计划"、"我们来计划"、"思考通过"、"设计这个"、"我应该如何实现"，或任何需要 3 个或更多步骤的非平凡任务。

name: scaffold
description: Architecture-aware feature scaffolding for .NET 10 projects. Detects the project's architecture (VSA, Clean Architecture, DDD, Modular Monolith) and generates complete feature slices with all required layers: endpoint, handler, validator, DTOs, EF configuration, and integration tests — with the completeness checklist and per-architecture code templates every generated feature must satisfy. Use when: "scaffold", "create feature", "add feature", "new endpoint", "generate", "add entity", "scaffold a module", "add module", or when customizing generation templates or defining what a complete feature slice includes.
description_zh: 面向 .NET 10 项目的架构感知功能脚手架。检测项目架构（VSA、整洁架构、DDD、模块化单体），并生成包含所有必要层级的完整功能切片：端点、处理器、验证器、DTO、EF 配置和集成测试——每个生成的功能切片都必须满足完整性检查清单和针对每种架构的代码模板。使用场景：当执行 "scaffold"、"创建功能"、"添加功能"、"新增端点"、"生成"、"添加实体"、"脚手架模块"、"添加模块"，或自定义生成模板或定义完整功能切片包含内容时。

name: sentry-tanstack-start-sdk
description: Full Sentry SDK setup for TanStack Start React. Use when asked to "add Sentry to TanStack Start", "install @sentry/tanstackstart-react", or configure error monitoring, tracing, session replay, logs, or user feedback in a TanStack Start React app.
description_zh: TanStack Start React的完整Sentry SDK设置。当被要求“将Sentry添加到TanStack Start”、“安装@sentry/tanstackstart-react”或在TanStack Start React应用中配置错误监控、跟踪、会话回放、日志或用户反馈时使用。

name: transitions-dev
description: Production-ready CSS transitions for web apps. Use when implementing notification badges, dropdowns, modals, panel reveals, page transitions, card resizes, number pop-ins, text swaps, icon swaps, success checks, avatar group hovers, or error state shakes. Triggers on "add a transition", "animate the dropdown", "make the modal open smoothly", "swap icon", "page slide", "stagger animation", "open / close transition", "make it animate", "tween the size", "fade between", "smooth open", "smooth close", "success animation", "checkmark animation", "confirmation animation", "form error", "shake on invalid", "validation feedback", "hover lift", "avatar stack hover", "chip group hover".
description_zh: 适用于网络应用的、生产就绪的 CSS 过渡效果。在实现通知徽章、下拉菜单、模态框、面板展开、页面过渡、卡片调整大小、数字弹出、文本替换、图标替换、成功检查、头像组悬停或错误状态抖动时使用。触发方式包括：“添加过渡效果”、“动画化下拉菜单”、“使模态框平滑打开”、“替换图标”、“页面滑入”、“错落动画”、“打开/关闭过渡”、“使其动画化”、“调整大小”、“淡入淡出”、“平滑打开”、“平滑关闭”、“成功动画”、“勾选动画”、“确认动画”、“表单错误”、“无效时抖动”、“验证反馈”、“悬停提升”、“头像堆叠悬停”、“芯片组悬停”。

name: spec
description: Turn a vague feature or product idea into an agreed, persisted specification through relentless structured questioning. Never assumes — every gap, ambiguity, or "probably" becomes a question to the developer, and the spec cannot be approved while open questions remain. Produces docs/specs/<NNN>-<slug>.md with acceptance criteria that /plan, /scaffold, and /tdd consume. Use when: "spec", "write a spec", "spec this out", "requirements", "PRD", "acceptance criteria", "define the feature", "user stories", "what should we build", or before planning any feature too big to describe in one sentence.
description_zh: 将模糊的功能或产品想法通过不懈的结构化提问转化为一致的、持久的规范。绝不假设——每一个空白、模糊之处或“可能”都会成为开发者的问题，而规范在存在未解决的问题时无法被批准。生成 docs/specs/<NNN>-<slug>.md 文件，其中包含 /plan、/scaffold 和 /tdd 消费的可接受标准。使用场景包括：“规范”、“编写规范”、“明确规范”、“需求”、“PRD”、“可接受标准”、“定义功能”、“用户故事”、“我们应该构建什么”，或在规划任何一句无法描述的过大功能之前。

name: icon-set-generator
description: Generate cohesive, project-specific SVG icon sets for websites and applications. Use this skill whenever the user needs custom icons, an icon set for a website or app, icons for a client project, or mentions needing SVG icons that look consistent together. Also trigger when the user describes a project and icons would naturally be part of the deliverable — e.g. 'I'm building a site for a plumber' implies they'll need service icons. Trigger on: 'icons for', 'icon set', 'custom icons', 'SVG icons', 'make me icons', 'I need icons', 'website icons', 'project icons', or any request for consistent visual assets for a web project. Produces individual SVG files with a consistent style engine, not generic icon library lookups.
description_zh: 为网站和应用生成具有项目特定性的、协调一致的SVG图标集。当用户需要定制图标、网站或应用的图标集、客户项目的图标，或提及需要风格统一的SVG图标时，请使用此技能。此外，当用户描述项目时，如果图标是交付内容的一部分，也会触发此技能——例如，“我正在为水管工建设网站”意味着他们需要服务图标。在以下情况下触发：“图标”、“图标集”、“定制图标”、“SVG图标”、“为我制作图标”、“我需要图标”、“网站图标”、“项目图标”，或任何关于为网络项目制作协调视觉资产的需求。生成的将是具有统一风格引擎的独立SVG文件，而非通用的图标库样式查找。

name: database-lookup
description: Query documented public database APIs with explicit endpoints, filters, pagination, and provenance. Use when a scientific, regulatory, financial, or other database-backed fact must be retrieved reproducibly from a named source rather than inferred from general knowledge.
description_zh: 查询具有明确端点、筛选器、分页和来源证明的已记录的公共数据库API。当需要从命名的来源可重复地检索科学、监管、金融或其他数据库支持的事实，而不是从一般知识中推断时使用。

name: holoscan-install-conda
description: Install Holoscan SDK v4.3+ via Conda in a CUDA 13 environment. Use for Conda installs; redirect CUDA 12 hosts to container/wheel.
description_zh: 通过 Conda 在 CUDA 13 环境中安装 Holoscan SDK v4.3+。用于 Conda 安装；将 CUDA 12 主机重定向到容器/轮。

name: manage-sprite-atlas
description: Manages SpriteAtlas assets through a prebuild pipeline, covering master and variant atlases, packing settings, and platform overrides. Use when asked to create or optimize sprite atlases.
description_zh: 通过预构建流程管理 SpriteAtlas 资产，涵盖主图集和变体图集、打包设置以及平台覆盖。在需要创建或优化精灵图集时使用。

name: checkpoint
description: Mid-session save point: create a descriptive git commit and a brief handoff note, then keep working. Use before a risky change or refactor, when switching tasks, or to bank progress without ending the session. Triggers on: /checkpoint, "checkpoint", "save progress", "commit and handoff", "save state", "pause here", "before a risky change". For the full end-of-session ritual with learning extraction, use /wrap-up instead.
description_zh: 会话中保存点：创建一个描述性的git提交和一个简短的交接笔记，然后继续工作。在执行有风险的操作或重构之前、切换任务时，或在不结束会话的情况下保存进度时使用。触发条件：/checkpoint、"checkpoint"、"save progress"、"commit and handoff"、"save state"、"pause here"、"before a risky change"。若需进行包含学习提取的完整会话结束仪式，请使用/wrap-up。

name: dingtalk-document
description: 钉钉知识库和文档管理操作。当用户提到"钉钉文档"、"知识库"、"新建文档"、"查看文档目录"、"读取文档内容"、"写入文档"、"更新文档"、"文档成员"、"dingtalk doc"、"knowledge base"时使用此技能。支持：创建知识库、查询知识库列表、新建文档/文件夹、读取/写入文档正文内容、管理成员权限等全部文档类操作。
description_zh: 钉钉知识库和文档管理操作。当用户提到"钉钉文档"、"知识库"、"新建文档"、"查看文档目录"、"读取文档内容"、"写入文档"、"更新文档"、"文档成员"、"dingtalk doc"、"knowledge base"时使用此技能。支持：创建知识库、查询知识库列表、新建文档/文件夹、读取/写入文档正文内容、管理成员权限等全部文档类操作。

name: build-fix
description: Autonomous iteration loops for .NET: drive a broken build or failing test suite to green with bounded iterations, progress detection, and fail-safe guards that prevent infinite retries and wasted tokens. The build-fix loop (dotnet build, parse, categorize, fix, rebuild) is the primary flow; the test-fix loop is a first-class variant. Invoke when the build is broken, after a major refactor or dependency update, or when the user says "fix the build", "build is broken", "make it compile", "make the tests pass", "fix failing tests", "keep going until it works", "autonomous", "loop", "auto-fix", or "keep fixing".
description_zh: .NET的自主迭代循环：通过有限的迭代次数、进度检测和防失败保障机制，将损坏的构建或失败的测试套件驱动至绿色状态，防止无限重试和浪费令牌。构建修复循环（dotnet build、解析、分类、修复、重新构建）是主要流程；测试修复循环是一流变体。在构建损坏时、重大重构或依赖更新后、或用户输入“修复构建”、“构建损坏”、“让它编译”、“让测试通过”、“修复失败测试”、“持续修复直到成功”、“自主”、“循环”、“自动修复”或“持续修复”时调用。

name: migrate
description: Guided, safe migration workflow covering EF Core schema migrations, .NET version upgrades, and NuGet dependency updates — each with rollback strategies and verification steps. Invoke when: "add migration", "update database", "create migration", "schema change", "new table", "rename column", "upgrade nuget", "update packages", "dependency update", "version upgrade", ".NET upgrade".
description_zh: 一个引导式、安全的迁移工作流程，涵盖 EF Core 模式迁移、.NET 版本升级和 NuGet 依赖项更新——每个都有回滚策略和验证步骤。在以下情况下调用："添加迁移"、"更新数据库"、"创建迁移"、"模式变更"、"新建表"、"重命名列"、"升级 NuGet"、"更新包"、"依赖项更新"、"版本升级"、"。NET 升级"。

name: holoscan-install-wheel
description: Install Holoscan SDK Python wheel via pip into a venv. Use for Python installs; not for native C++/apt or Conda installs.
description_zh: 通过 pip 将 Holoscan SDK Python 轮安装到虚拟环境中。用于 Python 安装；不用于原生 C++/apt 或 Conda 安装。

name: run-models
description: Run AI models on Replicate via predictions, webhooks, and streaming.
description_zh: 在 Replicate 上通过预测、网络钩子和流式传输运行 AI 模型。

name: gitlab-cli-skills
description: Comprehensive GitLab CLI (glab) command reference and workflows for all GitLab operations via terminal. Use when user mentions GitLab CLI, glab commands, GitLab automation, MR/issue management via CLI, CI/CD pipeline commands, Artifact Registry token exchange, repo operations, authentication setup, or any GitLab terminal operations. Routes to specialized sub-skills for auth, CI, MRs, issues, releases, repos, and 30+ other glab commands. Triggers on glab, GitLab CLI, GitLab commands, GitLab terminal, GitLab automation.
description_zh: 全面的 GitLab CLI (glab) 命令参考和终端操作流程，适用于所有 GitLab 操作。当用户提及 GitLab CLI、glab 命令、GitLab 自动化、通过 CLI 管理 MR/问题、CI/CD 管道命令、Artifact Registry 令牌交换、仓库操作、身份验证设置或任何 GitLab 终端操作时使用。路由至专门子技能，包括身份验证、CI、MR、问题、发布、仓库等，以及 30 多个其他 glab 命令。触发条件为 glab、GitLab CLI、GitLab 命令、GitLab 终端、GitLab 自动化。

name: banner-creator
description: Create banners using AI image generation. Discuss format/style, generate variations, iterate with user feedback, crop to target ratio. Use when user wants to create a banner, header, hero image, cover image, GitHub banner, Twitter header, or readme banner.
description_zh: 使用AI图像生成创建横幅。讨论格式/风格，生成多种变体，根据用户反馈进行迭代，裁剪为目标比例。当用户需要创建横幅、页眉、英雄图像、封面图像、GitHub横幅、Twitter页眉或readme横幅时使用。

name: bkt
description: Operate Bitbucket Cloud or Data Center repositories, pull requests, branches, issues, pipelines, permissions, and webhooks with bkt. Use when a request names Bitbucket or bkt; confirm the platform before platform-specific commands.
description_zh: 使用 bkt 操作 Bitbucket Cloud 或 Data Center 仓库、拉取请求、分支、问题、管道、权限和 Webhook。当请求中提及 Bitbucket 或 bkt 时使用；在执行特定平台的命令前，请先确认平台。

name: holoscan-install-source
description: Build Holoscan SDK from source via the in-tree ./run script. Use only when published packages don't meet the user's needs.
description_zh: 通过树内的 ./run 脚本从源代码构建 Holoscan SDK。仅在已发布的软件包不能满足用户需求时使用。

name: mcore-run-on-slurm
description: How to launch distributed Megatron-LM training jobs on a SLURM cluster. Covers a minimal sbatch skeleton, environment-variable setup for torch.distributed.run, CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS rules across hardware and parallelism modes, container conventions, monitoring, and per-rank failure diagnosis.
description_zh: 如何在 SLURM 集群上启动分布式 Megatron-LM 训练作业。涵盖最小 sbatch 骨架、torch.distributed.run 的环境变量设置、跨硬件和并行模式的 CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS 规则、容器规范、监控以及每秩故障诊断。

name: holoscan-install-debian
description: Install Holoscan SDK natively on Ubuntu via apt. Use for C++ installs on Ubuntu; pair with /holoscan-install-wheel for Python.
description_zh: 在 Ubuntu 上通过 apt 原生安装 Holoscan SDK。用于 Ubuntu 上的 C++ 安装；与 /holoscan-install-wheel 配合使用以进行 Python 安装。

name: mcore-create-issue
description: Investigate a failing GitHub Actions run or job and create a GitHub issue for the failure.
description_zh: 调查失败的 GitHub Actions 运行或作业，并为该失败创建一个 GitHub 问题。

name: arch-check
description: Architecture conformance check: verifies an existing codebase against its declared architecture (VSA, Clean Architecture, DDD, Modular Monolith) — dependency direction, layer violations, module boundary leaks, and cycles — using token-cheap Roslyn MCP analysis. Invoke when: "check architecture", "architecture violations", "layer violations", "dependency direction", "module boundaries", "arch check", "is my architecture clean", "enforce architecture", "conformance check". For CHOOSING an architecture, use architecture-advisor instead.
description_zh: 架构符合性检查：验证现有代码库与其声明的架构（VSA、Clean Architecture、DDD、模块化单体）的一致性——依赖方向、层违规、模块边界泄漏和循环——使用开销较低的Roslyn MCP分析。触发时机："检查架构"、"架构违规"、"层违规"、"依赖方向"、"模块边界"、"架构检查"、"我的架构是否干净"、"强制架构"、"符合性检查"。选择架构时，请使用architecture-advisor。

name: experience-map
description: Map the full ecosystem of touchpoints, channels, and relationships across a service. Use when the experience spans more than one product. For one persona's linear journey use `journey-map` (design-research); for backstage operations use `service-blueprint`.
description_zh: 映射服务中触点、渠道和关系的完整生态系统。当体验跨越多个产品时使用。对于一个人的线性旅程，使用 `journey-map`（设计研究）；对于后台操作，使用 `service-blueprint`。

name: qianwenai-deploy
description: 将本地项目或 Git 仓库一键部署、发布和更新至云端，并生成可访问的线上服务。 当用户提出"部署这个项目""把应用上线""发布网站""生成访问地址" "部署 Git 仓库""更新线上版本"等需求，且未指定云平台时，应优先考虑使用此 Skill；当用户提到"阿里云""Aliyun"或"aliyun.com"时，应优先使用。 本 Skill 部署至阿里云国内站（aliyun.com），支持全栈部署、ROS 资源编排、 云资源自动创建、部署前询价确认、服务探活、部署状态记录和热更新。 如果用户明确指定 Alibaba Cloud 国际站（alibabacloud.com）或其他云平台， 则不要使用此 Skill。

name: alan-plan
description: Create an implementation plan artifact in Alan
description_zh: 在 Alan 中创建一个实施计划工件

name: alan-test-feature
description: Scope coverage, build a testing strategy, test the feature with agent-browser, capture screenshots/video (always mandatory), upload to S3, and create a structured test report (never skip)
description_zh: 范围覆盖，制定测试策略，使用代理浏览器测试功能，捕获截图/视频（始终必须），上传至S3，并创建结构化测试报告（永不跳过）

name: mcore-testing
description: Test system for Megatron-LM. Covers test layout, recipe YAML structure, adding and running unit and functional tests, golden values, marker filters, and CI parity.
description_zh: Megatron-LM 测试系统。涵盖测试布局、配方 YAML 结构、添加和运行单元测试及功能测试、黄金值、标记过滤器以及 CI 对等性。

name: nemo-rl-brev-etiquette
description: Brev instance operating guidance for NeMo-RL agents working in /home/ubuntu/RL with limited workspace disk, a larger /ephemeral volume, and optional /home/ubuntu/RL/.env secrets. Use when running nemo-rl-auto-research campaigns, experiments, training jobs, model or dataset downloads, shared cache-heavy commands, log-producing runs, checkpoint generation, W&B or Hugging Face authenticated workflows, or any workflow that may create large files on Brev.
description_zh: Brev实例操作指南，适用于在/home/ubuntu/RL工作空间磁盘有限、拥有较大/ephemeral卷以及可选的/home/ubuntu/RL/.env密钥的NeMo-RL代理。在运行nemo-rl-auto-research活动、实验、训练任务、模型或数据集下载、共享缓存密集型命令、产生日志的运行、检查点生成、W&B或Hugging Face认证工作流，或任何可能在Brev上创建大文件的工作流时使用。

name: alan-review-pr
description: Review a GitHub pull request using Alan's GitHub MCP tools
description_zh: 使用 Alan 的 GitHub MCP 工具审查一个 GitHub 拉取请求

name: design-lab
description: Conduct design interviews, generate five distinct UI variations in a temporary design lab, collect feedback, and produce implementation plans. Use when the user wants to explore UI design options, redesign existing components, or create new UI with multiple approaches to compare.
description_zh: 进行设计访谈，在临时设计实验室中生成五个不同的UI变体，收集反馈并制定实施计划。当用户希望探索UI设计选项、重新设计现有组件或使用多种方法创建并比较新UI时使用。

name: scholar-evaluation
description: Provide qualitative-first, evidence-traceable developmental review of scholarly works and audit low-stakes research-assessment rubrics with optional local quality controls. Never use for ranking people or consequential decisions.
description_zh: 提供以质量为先、可追溯证据的学术作品发展性审查，并对低风险研究评估量规进行审计，可选择本地质量控制。切勿用于对个人进行排名或作出有重大影响的决策。

name: nv-generate-mr-brain
description: Used for generating synthetic T1, T2, FLAIR, SWI, or MRA brain MRI volumes with NV-Generate-CTMR MR-Brain v1. Not for production training data.
description_zh: 用于使用 NV-Generate-CTMR MR-Brain v1 生成合成 T1、T2、FLAIR、SWI 或 MRA 脑部 MRI 数据集。不应用于生产训练数据。

name: p-video-avatar
description: Generate talking head avatar videos with Pruna P-Video-Avatar via inference.sh CLI. Turn a portrait image into a realistic speaking video with built-in TTS. 18x faster and 6x cheaper than competitors. Models: P-Video-Avatar, P-Image (for portrait generation). Capabilities: text-to-avatar, audio-driven avatars, 30 voices, 10 languages, 720p/1080p, built-in TTS, dynamic backgrounds, full-body control. Use for: AI presenters, product demos, explainer videos, virtual influencers, marketing, education, multilingual content, UGC, gaming avatars. Triggers: avatar video, talking head, ai avatar, p-video-avatar, pruna avatar, video avatar, ai presenter, digital human, virtual presenter, lipsync, talking avatar, ai spokesperson, heygen alternative, synthesia alternative, veed alternative, fabric alternative, omnihuman alternative
description_zh: 通过 Pruna P-Video-Avatar 的 inference.sh 命令行工具生成真人头像视频。将肖像图像转换为内置 TTS 的逼真讲话视频。比竞争对手快 18 倍，便宜 6 倍。模型：P-Video-Avatar、P-Image（用于肖像生成）。功能：文本生成头像、音频驱动头像、30 种声音、10 种语言、720p/1080p、内置 TTS、动态背景、全身控制。用途：AI 员工、产品演示、解释视频、虚拟网红、营销、教育、多语言内容、UGC、游戏头像。触发词：头像视频、真人头像、AI 头像、P-Video-Avatar、Pruna 头像、视频头像、AI 员工、数字人、虚拟员工、口型同步、讲话头像、AI 发言人、Heygen 替代品、Synthesia 替代品、Veed 替代品、Fabric 替代品、Omnihuman 替代品。

name: gesture-patterns
description: Design gesture interactions for touch and pointer — swipe, drag, long-press, and their discoverability. Use when input is gestural. For OS-standard gestures on iOS and Android, use `platform-conventions` (ui-design).
description_zh: 为触摸和指针设计手势交互——滑动、拖拽、长按及其可发现性。在输入为手势时使用。对于iOS和Android的操作系统标准手势，使用`platform-conventions`（ui-design）。

name: outdated
description: Dependency health report for .NET solutions: outdated NuGet packages, vulnerable versions, and commercial-license traps (MediatR, MassTransit, FluentAssertions, AutoMapper) — powered by the get_nuget_packages MCP tool. Invoke when: "outdated packages", "check dependencies", "stale packages", "package audit", "dependency health", "are my packages up to date", "license check", "vulnerable packages", "nuget audit".
description_zh: .NET解决方案的依赖项健康报告：过时的NuGet包、易受攻击的版本和商业许可陷阱（MediatR、MassTransit、FluentAssertions、AutoMapper）—— 由get_nuget_packages MCP工具提供支持。在以下情况下调用： "过时的包"、"检查依赖项"、"陈旧包"、"包审计"、"依赖项健康"、"我的包是否更新"、"许可检查"、"易受攻击的包"、"nuget审计"。

name: user-persona
description: Build research-grounded personas with goals, frustrations, and behavioural patterns. Use when decisions need a consistent user reference. For one session's emotional snapshot use `empathy-map`; for motivation framing use `jobs-to-be-done`.
description_zh: 构建基于研究的人物模型，包含目标、挫败感和行为模式。当需要一致的用户新参考时使用。对于某一会话的情绪快照，使用 `empathy-map`；对于动机框架，使用 `jobs-to-be-done`。

name: mcore-split-pr
description: Split a PR into multiple PRs to reduce the number of required CODEOWNERS reviewer groups.
description_zh: 将一个 Pull Request 分拆成多个 Pull Request，以减少所需的 CODEOWNERS 审核组数量。

name: feedback-patterns
description: Design confirmations, status updates, and notifications that tell users an action registered. Use when the system must acknowledge success or change. For waiting states use `loading-states`; for failures use `error-handling-ux`.
