description_zh: 设计确认信息、状态更新和通知，告知用户已成功注册操作。当系统需要确认成功或状态变更时使用。等待状态时使用 `loading-states`；出现错误时使用 `error-handling-ux`。

name: canva-creator
description: Takes an approved content brief and executes a campaign end-to-end: builds the posting calendar, generates Canva designs for social posts, drafts caption and email copy, and stages social sends in HubSpot. Canva is used for social posts only (Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn) — email content is drafted as plain text and surfaced inline for the owner to send from their own tool. Every step requires explicit owner approval. This is the one-shot campaign executor: a finished brief goes in, a complete campaign comes out. Use when the owner hands off an approved brief or points at one — "run this brief," "execute the campaign," "turn this brief into posts," "build the campaign from the plan we approved." For day-to-day posting with no brief — "I need to post more," "what should we post" — use social-content-engine instead; it owns the standing calendar.
description_zh: 接收一份经批准的内容简报，并执行整个活动：制定发布日历、为社交媒体帖子生成Canva设计、起草标题和邮件文案，并在HubSpot中安排社交媒体发布。Canva仅用于社交媒体帖子（Instagram、Facebook、X、LinkedIn）——邮件内容以纯文本形式起草，并在正文中显示，供所有者使用自己的工具发送。每一步都需要所有者明确批准。这是一个一次性活动执行者：一份完成的简报输入，一个完整的活动输出。当所有者移交一份经批准的简报或指向其中一份时使用——"运行这份简报"、"执行活动"、"将这份简报转化为帖子"、"根据我们批准的计划构建活动"。对于日常发布且无需简报的情况——"我需要发布更多"、"我们应该发布什么"——请使用social-content-engine；它拥有常驻日历。

name: docx
description: Comprehensive document creation, editing, and analysis with support for tracked changes, comments, formatting preservation, and text extraction. When Claude needs to work with professional documents (.docx files) for: (1) Creating new documents, (2) Modifying or editing content, (3) Working with tracked changes, (4) Adding comments, or any other document tasks
description_zh: 全面的文档创建、编辑和分析功能，支持修订追踪、评论、格式保留和文本提取。当Claude需要处理专业文档（.docx文件）时，包括：(1) 创建新文档，(2) 修改或编辑内容，(3) 处理修订追踪，(4) 添加评论，或任何其他文档任务。

name: querying-aws-redshift
description: Enables Redshift system-table (SYS_*) log publishing to S3 Tables in Apache Iceberg format for both Provisioned clusters and Serverless namespaces, verifies publishing status, and queries the published logs via any Iceberg-compatible engine including Redshift and Athena. Covers system tables such as sys_query_history, sys_query_text, sys_connection_log, sys_query_detail, and sys_session_history. Applies when turning on S3 Tables log publishing for a cluster or namespace, confirming publishing status and locating the S3 Tables namespace, querying non-realtime data from Redshift system tables off-cluster at scale, or building dashboards for Redshift monitoring and auditing, especially for historical or high-volume system-table data beyond the in-cluster SYS_ view retention window. Trigger phrases: publish redshift system table log to s3 tables, enable-logging s3 tables, describe redshift logging status, query redshift system tables in athena or redshift, redshift log exports to iceberg.
description_zh: 启用将Redshift系统表（SYS_*）日志发布到Apache Iceberg格式的S3表，适用于Provisioned集群和Serverless命名空间，验证发布状态，并通过任何Iceberg兼容引擎（包括Redshift和Athena）查询已发布的日志。涵盖系统表，如sys_query_history、sys_query_text、sys_connection_log、sys_query_detail和sys_session_history。适用于开启集群或命名空间的S3表日志发布时，确认发布状态并定位S3表命名空间，大规模从集群外Redshift系统表查询非实时数据，或构建Redshift监控和审计仪表盘，特别是针对超出集群内SYS视图保留窗口的历史或高量级系统表数据。触发短语：发布Redshift系统表日志到S3表、启用S3表日志记录、描述Redshift日志状态、在Athena或Redshift中查询Redshift系统表、Redshift日志导出到Iceberg。

name: design-system
description:
Translates an image (or a set of image references — screenshots,
mockups, Figma URLs, live websites) into two mirrored design-system
artifacts: `docs/design.md` (YAML tokens + prose, following Google's open
[design.md](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md) format, for the
coding agent) and `docs/design.html` (a self-contained, token-driven style
guide rendering every token and component live, for the human to read).
Reads the imagery, asks targeted clarifying questions, derives the design
tokens (colors, typography, spacing, rounded, components), and writes both
files. Fully standalone — requires no other document or skill. Use when the
founder says "create a design system", "design from image",
"translate image to design", "create design.md", "image to design
system", "extract design tokens", or shares an image with no other
clear intent.
description_zh: 将图像（或一组图像引用——截图、模型图、Figma链接、在线网站）转换为两个镜像的设计系统工件：`docs/design.md`（YAML标记+文本，遵循Google开源的[design.md](https://github.com/google-labs-code/design.md)格式，供编程代理使用）和`docs/design.html`（一个自包含的、基于标记的样式指南，实时渲染每个标记和组件，供人类阅读）。读取图像，提出有针对性的澄清问题，推导出设计标记（颜色、排版、间距、圆角、组件），并写入这两个文件。完全独立——无需其他文档或技能。在创始人说“创建设计系统”、“从图像设计”、“将图像转换为设计”、“创建design.md”、“图像到设计系统”、“提取设计标记”，或分享图像且无其他明确意图时使用。

name: documentation-update
description: Regenerates documentation files (agents.md, agent-skills.md, plugins.md, usage.md) from marketplace data using Jinja templates. Use when plugins are added, updated, or removed to keep documentation in sync.
description_zh: 使用 Jinja 模板从市场数据中重新生成文档文件（agents.md、agent-skills.md、plugins.md、usage.md）。当插件被添加、更新或删除时使用，以保持文档同步。

name: om-code-review
description: Review a diff, branch, or PR against correctness, security, breaking-change, and quality standards — runs the validation gate, applies the built-in checklist plus any repo-local one, and produces severity-ranked findings with an approve/request-changes verdict. The review engine behind om-auto-review-pr and om-review-prs.
description_zh: 审查差异、分支或 PR，确保其符合正确性、安全性、破坏性变更和质量标准——运行验证门禁，应用内置清单及任何仓库本地清单，并生成按严重程度排序的发现结果，附带批准/请求变更的判定。这是 om-auto-review-pr 和 om-review-prs 背后的审查引擎。

name: gpt-image
description: Generate and edit images with OpenAI GPT-Image-2 via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, mask-based editing, multi-image reference, batch generation. Use for: product mockups, marketing visuals, image editing, concept art, inpainting, photo manipulation. Triggers: gpt image, gpt-image-2, openai image, chatgpt image, dall-e, dalle, openai image generation, gpt image edit, gpt inpainting, openai dall-e, gpt 4o image
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh 命令行界面使用 OpenAI GPT-Image-2 生成和编辑图像。模型：GPT-Image-2。功能：文本到图像、图像编辑、修复、基于蒙版的编辑、多图像参考、批量生成。用途：产品原型图、营销视觉、图像编辑、概念艺术、修复、照片处理。触发词：gpt image、gpt-image-2、openai image、chatgpt image、dall-e、dalle、openai image generation、gpt image edit、gpt inpainting、openai dall-e、gpt 4o image

name: p-image
description: Generate images with Pruna P-Image models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Image, P-Image-LoRA, P-Image-Edit, P-Image-Edit-LoRA. Capabilities: text-to-image, image editing, LoRA styles, multi-image compositing, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna, p-image, pruna image, fast image generation, optimized flux, pruna ai, p image, fast ai image, economic image generation, cheap image generation
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh 命令行接口使用 Pruna P-Image 模型生成图像。模型包括：P-Image、P-Image-LoRA、P-Image-Edit 和 P-Image-Edit-LoRA。功能特性：文本生成图像、图像编辑、LoRA 风格、多图像合成、快速推理。Pruna 在保持画质无损的前提下优化模型以提升生成速度。触发词：pruna、p-image、pruna image、快速图像生成、优化版 Flux、pruna ai、p image、快速 AI 图像、经济型图像生成、低成本图像生成

name: mobile-design
description: Mobile-first design thinking and decision-making for iOS and Android apps. Touch interaction, performance patterns, platform conventions. Teaches principles, not fixed values. Use when building React Native, Flutter, or native mobile apps.
description_zh: 移动优先的设计思维和决策，适用于iOS和Android应用。触摸交互、性能模式、平台惯例。教授原则而非固定值。在构建React Native、Flutter或原生移动应用时使用。

name: nv-generate-mr-brain-finetune
description: Used for finetuning NV-Generate-CTMR MR-Brain v1 for T1, T2, FLAIR, SWI, or MRA data from a NIfTI datalist. Not for clinical or production data approval.
description_zh: 用于微调 NV-Generate-CTMR MR-Brain v1，以处理来自 NIfTI 数据列表的 T1、T2、FLAIR、SWI 或 MRA 数据。不适用于临床或生产数据审批。

name: jobs-to-be-done
description: Map functional, emotional, and social jobs with outcome expectations. Use when reframing decisions around motivation rather than features. For who the user is, use `user-persona`.
description_zh: 将功能性、情感性和社交性工作与结果预期进行匹配。在围绕动机而非功能重新构建决策时使用。对于用户是谁，使用 `user-persona`。

name: stock-research-executor
description: 股票投资调研执行引擎，执行8阶段投资尽调流程。接收stock-question-refiner生成的结构化调研指令，部署多智能体并行研究，生成带引用的投资尽调报告。覆盖：公司事实底座、行业周期、业务拆解、财务质量、股权治理、市场分歧、估值护城河、综合报告。当用户需要进行股票投资研究、基本面分析、投资尽调时使用此技能。
description_zh: 股票投资调研执行引擎，执行8阶段投资尽调流程。接收stock-question-refiner生成的结构化调研指令，部署多智能体并行研究，生成带引用的投资尽调报告。覆盖：公司事实底座、行业周期、业务拆解、财务质量、股权治理、市场分歧、估值护城河、综合报告。当用户需要进行股票投资研究、基本面分析、投资尽调时使用此技能。

name: premium
description: Apple-inspired premium aesthetic with precise spacing, modern typography, and a refined, polished visual language.
description_zh: 以苹果为灵感的精致美学，具有精准的间距、现代的字体排版，以及精致、优雅的视觉语言。

name: improve-claude-md
description: improve a CLAUDE.md file using <important if> blocks to improve instruction adherence
description_zh: 使用 `<important if>` 块改进 CLAUDE.md 文件，以提高指令的遵循性

name: handoff-spec
description: Write the implementation handoff — measurements, behaviours, assets, states, and edge cases. Use when engineering picks up the work. For verifying the result afterwards use `design-qa-checklist`; for reusable library components use `component-spec` (design-systems).
description_zh: 编写实现交接文档——包括测量值、行为、资源、状态和边缘情况。当工程人员接手工作时使用。验证结果后使用 `design-qa-checklist`；对于可重用的库组件，使用 `component-spec`（design-systems）。

name: google-mobile-ads-validate
description: Validates a project's Google Mobile Ads (GMA) SDK integration for iOS, Android, or Unity projects. Use when conducting a full pre-launch audit of an app that integrates GMA SDK or when validating any individual GMA SDK integration checks, such as when validating ad unit IDs and ad formats, SKAdNetwork IDs, mediation adapter SDK version compatibility, or ad preloading.
description_zh: 验证项目在 iOS、Android 或 Unity 项目中的 Google Mobile Ads (GMA) SDK 集成。在执行集成 GMA SDK 的应用的完整发布前审计时使用，或在验证任何单个 GMA SDK 集成检查时使用，例如验证广告单元 ID 和广告格式、SKAdNetwork ID、中介适配器 SDK 版本兼容性或广告预加载。

name: documentation-template
description: Generate a reusable documentation scaffold for components, patterns, or guidelines. Use when standardising how the system is documented. For the content of one component's spec, use `component-spec`.
description_zh: 为组件、模式或指南生成可重用的文档框架。在标准化系统文档方式时使用。对于单个组件规范的文档内容，使用 `component-spec`。

name: cloud-sync
description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.
description_zh: 设置或检查 claude-mem 云同步与 cmem.ai Pro。当用户说“设置云同步”、“同步我的记忆”、“cmem pro”、“云备份”、“同步状态”，或希望他们的记忆数据库备份或同步到他们的 cmem.ai 账户时使用。

name: p-video
description: Generate videos with Pruna P-Video and WAN models via inference.sh CLI. Models: P-Video, WAN-T2V, WAN-I2V. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, audio support, 720p/1080p, fast inference. Pruna optimizes models for speed without quality loss. Triggers: pruna video, p-video, pruna ai video, fast video generation, optimized video, wan t2v, wan i2v, economic video generation, cheap video generation, pruna text to video, pruna image to video
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh 命令行界面使用 Pruna P-Video 和 WAN 模型生成视频。模型：P-Video、WAN-T2V、WAN-I2V。功能：文本转视频、图像转视频、音频支持、720p/1080p、快速推理。Pruna 在不损失质量的情况下优化模型速度。触发词：pruna video、p-video、pruna ai video、快速视频生成、优化视频、wan t2v、wan i2v、经济视频生成、廉价视频生成、pruna 文本转视频、pruna 图像转视频。

name: puppeteer-automation
description: Expert guidance for browser automation using Puppeteer with best practices for web scraping, testing, screenshot capture, and JavaScript execution in headless Chrome.
description_zh: 使用Puppeteer进行浏览器自动化操作的专业指导，涵盖网络抓取、测试、屏幕截图捕获以及在无头Chrome中执行JavaScript的最佳实践。

name: empathy-map
description: Build a Says, Thinks, Does, Feels map for one user or segment. Use when sharing user understanding quickly. For a composite archetype with goals and behaviours use `user-persona`; for cross-session themes use `affinity-diagram`.
description_zh: 为单个用户或用户群体创建一个“说、想、做、感”地图。在快速分享用户理解时使用。对于具有目标和行为特征的综合原型，请使用 `user-persona`；对于跨会话主题，请使用 `affinity-diagram`。

name: akshare
description: Chinese financial data access using AkShare library. Fetch real-time and historical data for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, futures, funds, and macroeconomic indicators. Use when user requests Chinese market data, stock prices, market analysis, or financial information from Chinese exchanges. Supports stock quotes, historical data, futures market data, fund information, macroeconomic indicators, and real-time market updates.

name: skill-creator
description: Guide for creating effective skills for Apollo GraphQL and GraphQL development. Use this skill when: (1) users want to create a new skill, (2) users want to update an existing skill, (3) users ask about skill structure or best practices, (4) users need help writing SKILL.md files.
description_zh: 创建 Apollo GraphQL 和 GraphQL 开发中有效技能的指南。在以下情况使用此技能：(1) 用户想要创建新技能，(2) 用户想要更新现有技能，(3) 用户询问技能结构或最佳实践，(4) 用户需要帮助编写 SKILL.md 文件。

name: nv-segment-ct
description: Used for running NV-Segment-CT VISTA3D on CT NIfTI volumes and recording label-map evidence.
description_zh: 用于在CT NIfTI体积上运行NV-Segment-CT VISTA3D并记录标签图证据。

name: gtm-0-to-1-launch
description: Launch new products from idea to first customers. Use when launching products, finding early adopters, building launch week playbooks, diagnosing why adoption stalls, or learning that press coverage does not equal growth. Includes the three-layer diagnosis, the 2-week experiment cycle, and the launch that got 50K impressions and 12 signups.
description_zh: 从想法到首批客户推出新产品。在推出产品、寻找早期采用者、制定发布周计划、诊断采用停滞的原因，或了解媒体报道并不等于增长时使用。包含三层诊断、两周实验周期，以及一次获得5万次印象和12个注册的发布。

name: effect
description: Opinionated guide for building production TypeScript applications with Effect v4. Use when implementing Effect workflows, services, layers, schemas, configuration, schedules, caches, streams, HTTP clients, or tests.
description_zh: 针对使用 Effect v4 构建 TypeScript 生产应用程序的意见性指南。在实现 Effect 工作流、服务、层、模式、配置、计划、缓存、流、HTTP 客户端或测试时使用。

name: naming-convention
description: Establish naming rules for components, tokens, and layers with patterns and worked examples. Use when names are inconsistent or being set. For what the tokens actually contain, use `design-token`.
description_zh: 为组件、符号和层建立命名规则，使用模式和实例说明。当名称不一致或需要设定时使用。关于符号实际包含的内容，使用 `design-token`。

name: bgpt-paper-search
description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.
description_zh: 通过BGPT MCP服务器搜索科学论文，并从全文研究中检索结构化的实验数据。每篇论文返回25个以上字段，包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分和结论。用于文献综述、证据综合以及查找仅从摘要中无法获得的实验细节。

name: pptx-posters
description: Create and audit editable scientific posters in macro-free PowerPoint (.pptx) from author-approved local content and assets. Use when the requested deliverable is a PowerPoint research/conference poster and exact physical, printer, accessibility, provenance, and package-security checks are required.
description_zh: 从作者批准的本地内容和资源创建和审核可编辑的科学海报，使用免宏PowerPoint (.pptx) 格式。当请求的交付成果是PowerPoint研究/会议海报，并且需要精确的物理、打印、无障碍、来源和包安全检查时使用。

name: google-search-console
description: When the user wants to analyze Google Search Console data, use the GSC API, or interpret search performance. Also use when the user mentions "GSC," "Search Console," "indexing report," "Core Web Vitals," "Enhancements," "Insights report," "search performance," "search queries," "search performance report," "URL inspection," "impressions," "CTR," "average position," "index coverage," "GSC data analysis," "Search Console API," or "searchanalytics.query." When the user wants to rewrite title tags (not only report on them), use title-tag. For meta description rewrites, use meta-description.
description_zh: 当用户想要分析Google Search Console数据、使用GSC API或解读搜索表现时，也使用这些情况。当用户提到“GSC”、“Search Console”、“索引报告”、“核心网页质量”、“增强功能”、“洞察报告”、“搜索表现”、“搜索查询”、“搜索表现报告”、“URL检查”、“展示次数”、“点击率”、“平均位置”、“索引覆盖率”、“GSC数据分析”、“Search Console API”或“searchanalytics.query”时，也使用这些情况。当用户想要重写标题标签（不仅报告它们）时，使用title-tag。对于元描述重写，使用meta-description。

name: nv-generate-mr
description: Used for generating synthetic body MRI volumes with NV-Generate-CTMR rflow-mr. Not for paired masks or production training data.
description_zh: 用于使用 NV-Generate-CTMR rflow-mr 生成合成人体 MRI 数据集。不适用于配对掩码或生产训练数据。

name: swarm
description: Fan out N parallel workers, drain them, and return one report. Use for /swarm, 'swarm this', or parallel coverage, races, gauntlets, and exploration.
description_zh: 并行启动 N 个工作进程，执行完毕后返回一份报告。适用于/swarm、'swarm this'、并行覆盖率测试、竞赛、决斗和探索任务。

name: senior-data-engineer
description: World-class data engineering skill for building scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT systems, and data infrastructure. Expertise in Python, SQL, Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, and modern data stack. Includes data modeling, pipeline orchestration, data quality, and DataOps. Use when designing data architectures, building data pipelines, optimizing data workflows, or implementing data governance.
description_zh: 世界级的数据工程技能，用于构建可扩展的数据管道、ETL/ELT系统以及数据基础设施。精通Python、SQL、Spark、Airflow、dbt、Kafka以及现代数据栈。涵盖数据建模、管道编排、数据质量以及DataOps。适用于设计数据架构、构建数据管道、优化数据工作流或实施数据治理时使用。

name: nv-generate-ct-rflow
description: Used for generating synthetic CT volumes and masks with NV-Generate-CTMR rflow-ct. Not for production training data without review.
description_zh: 用于使用 NV-Generate-CTMR rflow-ct 生成合成 CT 容积和掩码。未经审核，不应用于生产训练数据。

name: seo-audit
description: When the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose SEO issues on their site. Uses live web data via the Bright Data CLI for accurate detection of JS-injected schema, hreflang, canonicals, and live SERP-based ranking checks. Also use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "technical SEO," "why am I not ranking," "SEO issues," "on-page SEO," "meta tags review," "SEO health check," "my traffic dropped," "lost rankings," "not showing up in Google," "site isn't ranking," "Google update hit me," "page speed," "core web vitals," "crawl errors," or "indexing issues." Use this even if the user just says something vague like "my SEO is bad" or "help with SEO" — start with an audit. For building pages at scale to target keywords, see programmatic-seo. For implementing structured data, see schema-markup. For AI search optimization, see ai-seo.
description_zh: 当用户想要对其网站进行审核、审查或诊断SEO问题时。通过Bright Data CLI获取实时网络数据，以准确检测JS注入的schema、hreflang、规范链接，并进行基于实时SERP的排名检查。当用户提到“SEO审核”、“技术SEO”、“为什么我的排名不高”、“SEO问题”、“页面SEO”、“元标签审查”、“SEO健康检查”、“我的流量下降”、“排名丢失”、“未在Google中显示”、“网站未排名”、“Google更新影响了我的网站”、“页面速度”、“核心网络关键指标”、“爬取错误”或“索引问题”时，也使用此功能。即使用户只是模糊地说“我的SEO很差”或“需要SEO帮助”——也先从审核开始。要大规模构建目标关键词的页面，请参阅programmatic-seo。要实施结构化数据，请参阅schema-markup。要进行AI搜索优化，请参阅ai-seo。

name: polars
description: High-performance DataFrame library for Python ETL, analytics, and pandas migration. Use for expression-based data manipulation with lazy query optimization, parallel execution, streaming out-of-core processing, Arrow interoperability, and optional GPU execution.
description_zh: 高性能Python ETL、分析和pandas迁移的DataFrame库。用于基于表达式进行数据操作，支持懒查询优化、并行执行、流式内存外处理、Arrow互操作以及可选的GPU执行。

name: web-development
description: Use when users need to implement, integrate, debug, build, deploy, or validate a Web frontend after the product direction is already clear, especially for React, Vue, Vite, browser flows, or CloudBase Web integration.
description_zh: 当产品方向已经明确，用户需要实现、集成、调试、构建、部署或验证 Web 前端时使用，尤其适用于 React、Vue、Vite、浏览器流程或 CloudBase Web 集成。

name: sandbox-npm-install
description: Install npm packages in a Docker sandbox environment. Use this skill whenever you need to install, reinstall, or update node_modules inside a container where the workspace is mounted via virtiofs. Native binaries (esbuild, lightningcss, rollup) crash on virtiofs, so packages must be installed on the local ext4 filesystem and symlinked back.
description_zh: 在 Docker 沙盒环境中安装 npm 包。每当您需要在通过 virtiofs 挂载的工作区内部署容器中安装、重新安装或更新 node_modules 时，请使用此技巧。原生二进制文件（如 esbuild、lightningcss、rollup）在 virtiofs 上会崩溃，因此必须先在本地 ext4 文件系统上安装包，然后创建符号链接回容器中。

name: tools
description: Give your agents capabilities through tools (function calling). Helps you identify what your agent needs to do, create tool definitions, and attach them to config variations.
description_zh: 通过工具（函数调用）为您的代理赋予能力。这有助于您识别代理需要执行的任务，创建工具定义，并将它们附加到配置变体上。

name: nv-segment-ctmr
description: Used for running NV-Segment-CTMR on CT or MRI NIfTI volumes and recording label-map evidence. Not for clinical interpretation.
description_zh: 用于在CT或MRI NIfTI体积上运行NV-Segment-CTMR并记录标签图证据。不用于临床解释。

name: nv-reason-cxr
description: Used for command-shape or live NV-Reason-CXR chest X-ray reasoning smoke tests. Not for diagnosis or clinical reporting.
description_zh: 用于命令形态或实时 NV-Reason-CXR 胸部 X 光推理烟雾测试。不用于诊断或临床报告。

name: requesthunt
description: Generate user demand research reports from real user feedback. Scrape and analyze feature requests, complaints, and questions from Reddit, X, GitHub, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Amazon. Use when user wants to do demand research, find feature requests, analyze user demand, or run RequestHunt queries.
description_zh: 从真实用户反馈中生成用户需求研究报告。抓取并分析来自Reddit、X（原Twitter）、GitHub、YouTube、LinkedIn和Amazon的功能请求、投诉和问题。当用户需要进行需求研究、寻找功能请求、分析用户需求或运行RequestHunt查询时使用。

name: seedance
description: Generate videos with ByteDance Seedance 2.0 via inference.sh CLI. Unified model for text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video with synchronized audio, up to 1080p, 4-15s duration. Pro and Fast variants. Studio variants with private asset library for portrait consistency. Use for: social media videos, music videos, product demos, animated content, AI video with sound. Triggers: seedance, seedance 2, bytedance video, seedance t2v, seedance i2v, seedance r2v, video with audio, seedance 2.0, bytedance seedance, seedance studio
description_zh: 通过 inference.sh 命令行界面使用字节跳动 Seedance 2.0 生成视频。统一模型支持文本转视频、图像转视频和参考转视频，并具有同步音频，最高支持 1080p 分辨率，时长 4-15 秒。提供专业版和快速版。Studio 版本配备私有资产库，用于保持人像一致性。适用于：社交媒体视频、音乐视频、产品演示、动画内容、带声音的 AI 视频。触发词：seedance、seedance 2、字节跳动视频、seedance t2v、seedance i2v、seedance r2v、带音频的视频、seedance 2.0、字节跳动 Seedance、seedance Studio

name: build-with-exa
description: Build applications and agents with Exa's API: search, contents extraction, answer, Agent API, monitors, websets, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and exa-py/exa-js SDKs. Use when choosing Exa endpoints, writing Exa API calls, integrating semantic web search or research into products, or debugging Exa request shapes.
description_zh: 使用 Exa 的 API 构建应用程序和代理：搜索、内容提取、回答、代理 API、监控器、Websets、OpenAI 兼容端点以及 exa-py/exa-js SDK。在以下情况下使用：选择 Exa 端点、编写 Exa API 调用、将语义网络搜索或研究集成到产品中，或调试 Exa 请求格式。

name: accessibility-test-plan
description: Plan accessibility testing — assistive technologies, participant criteria, WCAG coverage, and session protocol. Use when scheduling testing with real AT users. Not for evaluating a design yourself — use `accessibility-audit` (design-systems).
description_zh: 制定可访问性测试计划——涵盖辅助技术、参与者标准、WCAG 覆盖范围以及测试会话流程。适用于安排与真实辅助技术（AT）用户进行的测试。不适用于自行评估设计——请使用 `accessibility-audit`（design-systems）。

name: card-sort-analysis
description: Analyse open or closed card sort results into a proposed grouping and label set. Use after running a sort study. For turning that evidence into a full structure, use `information-architecture` (ux-strategy).
description_zh: 分析开放式或封闭式卡片分类结果，形成建议的分组和标签集。在运行分类研究后使用。若需将证据转化为完整结构，请使用 `information-architecture` (ux-strategy)。

name: ui-design
description:
UI/UX quality gate and build guide for every visual output — landing pages, dashboards,
web apps, portfolios, and tools. ui-design remains the main entry point.

Integration model: ui-design main trunk + taste-skill overlay.
- ui-design owns engineering quality (track selection, component-library strategy,
  accessibility, responsiveness, theming, performance, preview delivery)
- taste-skill is invoked inside the ui-design workflow for style decisions
  (Brief Inference, Design Dials, Anti-slop hard rules)

MUST USE together with project-builder whenever a project produces visual HTML/CSS/JS.
description_zh:
每个视觉输出的UI/UX质量门禁和构建指南——包括着陆页、仪表盘、Web应用、作品集和工具。ui-design仍然是主要入口。

集成模型：ui-design主分支 + taste-skill覆盖层。
- ui-design负责工程质量（选择追踪、组件库策略、无障碍性、响应式、主题化、性能、预览交付）
- taste-skill在ui-design工作流程中调用，用于风格决策（简报推断、设计旋钮、抗滑硬性规则）

每当项目生成视觉HTML/CSS/JS时，必须与project-builder一起使用。

name: affinity-diagram
description: Cluster many qualitative data points into themes and insight statements. Use when synthesising across multiple sessions or sources. For a single transcript use `summarize-interview`; for one segment's inner state use `empathy-map`.
description_zh: 将多个定性数据点聚类成主题和洞察陈述。在跨多个会话或来源进行综合分析时使用。对于单个访谈记录，请使用 `summarize-interview`；对于单个片段的内部状态，请使用 `empathy-map`。

name: recon-a-domain-passively
description: End-to-end passive reconnaissance for a domain, website or IP — builds an asset inventory covering registration, DNS, subdomains, infrastructure, tech stack, history and ownership without sending a single packet to the target. Use when asked to research or profile a domain or website, map what an organisation runs, or investigate a suspicious site without alerting its operator. Applies to vendor and third-party risk assessment, attack-surface review, M&A technical diligence, phishing and fraud-site investigation, and pre-engagement scoping. Reference at useosint.com/skills/recon-a-domain-passively.
description_zh: 针对域名、网站或IP的端到端被动侦察——在不向目标发送任何数据包的情况下，构建涵盖注册信息、DNS、子域名、基础设施、技术栈、历史记录和所有权等信息的资产清单。在需要研究或分析域名或网站、映射组织运营情况，或调查可疑网站而不触发其运营商警报时使用。适用于供应商和第三方风险评估、攻击面审查、并购技术尽职调查、钓鱼和欺诈网站调查，以及合作前的范围界定。参考：useosint.com/skills/recon-a-domain-passively。

name: nv-segment-ct-finetune
description: Runs standard or fixed-channel softmax finetuning of NV-Segment-CT VISTA3D on CT NIfTI image/label datasets, with optional MONAI-native MLflow tracking and checkpoint evidence. Uses softmax for predefined, mutually exclusive classes; keeps the standard workflow when point prompts or runtime-variable classes are needed. Not for clinical validation.
description_zh: 运行标准或固定通道的 softmax 微调，针对 NV-Segment-CT VISTA3D 在 CT NIfTI 图像/标签数据集上，可选择 MONAI 原生的 MLflow 追踪和检查点证据。使用 softmax 处理预定义的互斥类别；当需要点提示或运行时变量类别时，保持标准工作流程。不适用于临床验证。

name: design-rationale
description: Write rationale connecting decisions to user needs, business goals, and principles. Use when a decision needs defending in writing. For a live conversation, use `design-negotiation`.
description_zh: 撰写决策依据，将决策与用户需求、业务目标及原则相联系。在需要书面论证决策时使用。对于现场讨论，使用 `design-negotiation`。

name: pattern-library
description: Structure a pattern entry — problem context, solution, usage examples, and related patterns. Use when documenting a recurring solution rather than a component. For a single component's API, use `component-spec`.
description_zh: 构建模式条目——问题背景、解决方案、使用示例和相关模式。用于记录重复出现的解决方案，而非组件。对于单个组件的API，请使用`component-spec`。

name: latex-posters
description: Create professional research posters in LaTeX using beamerposter, tikzposter, or baposter. Support for conference presentations, academic posters, and scientific communication. Includes layout design, color schemes, multi-column formats, figure integration, and poster-specific best practices for visual communication.
description_zh: 使用 beamerposter、tikzposter 或 baposter 在 LaTeX 中创建专业的调研海报。支持会议展示、学术海报和科学交流。包含版式设计、配色方案、多列格式、图形集成以及针对海报的视觉传达最佳实践。

name: a-b-test-design
description: Design an A/B experiment — hypothesis, variants, primary metric, and sample size. Use when a change can be measured quantitatively at scale. For observing behaviour qualitatively, use `test-scenario`.
description_zh: 设计一个 A/B 实验——假设、变体、主要指标和样本量。当变更可以大规模进行定量测量时使用。若需定性观察行为，请使用 `test-scenario`。

name: connector-spotify
description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that reads Spotify catalog data or drives a user's Spotify account from a canister. The supported path is the `spotify-client` mops package (Spotify Web API) over outbound HTTPS with an OAuth 2.0 bearer token minted off-chain. Hand-rolling `ic.http_request` calls to `api.spotify.com` is a FORBIDDEN anti-pattern — it bypasses the non-replicated-outcall safeguard (player state and `progress_ms` differ per node and fail consensus), the generated JSON decoding, and the bearer handling. Load this skill whenever the user, spec, or any prior task mentions Spotify, a song, track, artist, album, playlist, music search, new releases, genres, markets, "what's playing", recently played, the queue, player controls (play / pause / skip / shuffle / repeat), a saved library, podcasts (shows or episodes), chapters or audiobooks — and BEFORE writing any code that touches a Spotify endpoint.
description_zh: 每個 Caffeine 构建的必須配方，用於讀取 Spotify 目錄數據或從容器驅動用戶的 Spotify 账戶。支持的路徑是 `spotify-client` mops 套件（Spotify Web API），通過出站 HTTPS 使用鏈下生成的 OAuth 2.0 授權碼。手動編寫 `ic.http_request` 調用至 `api.spotify.com` 是一種禁止的反模式——它繞過了非複製出調用保護（每個節點的播放狀態和 `progress_ms` 不同且無法達成共識）、生成的 JSON 解碼以及授權碼處理。當用戶、規範或任何先前任務提及 Spotify、歌曲、曲目、藝術家、專輯、播放列表、音樂搜索、新發行、流派、市場、正在播放、最近播放、隊列、播放器控制（播放/暫停/跳過/隨機/重複）、已保存庫、播客（節目或集數）、章節或有聲書時，請載入此技能——並在編寫任何觸及 Spotify 端點的代碼之前。

name: nv-generate-vae-finetune
description: Used for finetuning the NV-Generate-CTMR MAISI VAE from CT/MRI NIfTI datalists. Not for clinical or production data approval.
description_zh: 用于微调 NV-Generate-CTMR MAISI VAE 模型，基于 CT/MRI NIfTI 数据列表。不适用于临床或生产数据审批。

name: configs-create
description: Create and configure configs in LaunchDarkly. Helps you choose between agent vs completion mode, create the config, add variations with models and prompts, and verify the setup.
description_zh: 在LaunchDarkly中创建和配置配置文件。帮助您在代理模式与完成模式之间进行选择，创建配置文件，使用模型和提示添加变体，并验证设置。

name: diffity-diff
description: Open the diffity diff viewer in the browser to see your changes
description_zh: 在浏览器中打开diffity diff查看器以查看您的更改

name: interview-script
description: Write a structured interview guide — warm-up, core exploration, and wrap-up. Use before running interviews. For analysing what comes back, use `summarize-interview`.
description_zh: 编写一个结构化的访谈指南——包括开场白、核心探索和总结。在开始访谈前使用。对于分析访谈结果，使用 `summarize-interview`。

name: code-quality
description: General Correctness rules, Rust patterns, comments, avoiding over-engineering. When writing code always take these into account
description_zh: 通用正确性规则、Rust 模式、注释、避免过度设计。编写代码时，始终考虑这些因素。

name: semantic-kernel
description: Create, update, refactor, explain, or review Semantic Kernel solutions using shared guidance plus language-specific references for .NET and Python.
description_zh: 使用通用指南及 .NET 和 Python 的特定语言参考，创建、更新、重构、解释或审查 Semantic Kernel 解决方案。

name: store-longevity-radar
description: 소상공인시장진흥공단 상가(상권)정보 공개파일(무인증)로 업종·상호 키워드에 맞는 전국 점포 전수를 뽑고, 과거 스냅샷과 상호+좌표 매칭해 'N년 전에도 존재했고 지금도 영업 중'인 장수 점포 리스트를 추출한다. 사업자등록번호 없이 상호 기준이며 개업일이 아닌 최초 관측 시점 하한을 제공한다.
description_zh: 通过小规模商业市场振兴公团商铺（商圈）信息公开文件（无认证），根据行业·店铺名称关键词进行全国店铺全面筛选，并与过去的快照进行商户+坐标匹配，提取出“N年前就已存在且目前仍在营业”的老字号店铺列表。以商户名称为基准，无需营业执照号码，并提供开业日期而非首次观测时间下限。

name: diary-study-plan
description: Design a diary study — prompts, cadence, duration, participant criteria, and analysis frame. Use when behaviour unfolds over days or weeks. For a single-session study, use `usability-test-plan`.
description_zh: 设计日记研究——提示、节奏、持续时间、参与者标准和分析框架。当行为在数天或数周内展开时使用。对于单次研究，使用 `usability-test-plan`。

name: grokipedia-recommendations
description: When the user wants to add recommendations, links, or content to Grokipedia. Also use when the user mentions "Grokipedia," "GEO wiki," "AI encyclopedia," "suggest Grokipedia article," "Grokipedia citation," "Grokipedia listing," "AI search citation," "GEO visibility," or "Grokipedia optimization." For multi-platform parasite SEO strategy, use parasite-seo. For broad AI search visibility, use generative-engine-optimization.

name: mapbox-style-quality
description: Expert guidance on validating, optimizing, and ensuring quality of Mapbox styles through validation, accessibility checks, and optimization. Use when preparing styles for production, debugging issues, or ensuring map quality standards.
description_zh: 提供专家级指导，用于通过校验、可访问性检查和优化，验证、优化并确保 Mapbox 样式的质量。在将样式投入生产环境、排查问题或确保地图质量标准时使用。

name: metrics-definition
description: Define UX metrics and KPIs that connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. Use when choosing what to measure. For presenting the results afterwards, use `design-impact-reporting` (design-ops).
description_zh: 定义与可衡量结果相连接的 UX 指标和 KPI，用于选择要衡量的内容。在后续展示结果时，使用 `design-impact-reporting`（design-ops）。

name: editorial
description: Magazine-inspired editorial layout with refined serif typography, structured grids, and elegant reading experiences.
description_zh: 杂志风格的编辑排版，采用精致的衬线字体、结构化的网格布局，以及优雅的阅读体验。

name: research-grants
description: Write competitive research proposals for NSF, NIH, DOE, DARPA, and Taiwan NSTC. Agency-specific formatting, review criteria, budget preparation, broader impacts, significance statements, innovation narratives, and compliance with submission requirements.
description_zh: 撰写适用于NSF、NIH、DOE、DARPA以及台湾NSTC的竞争性研究提案。需符合各机构的特定格式要求、评审标准、预算编制、更广泛的影响、重要性声明、创新叙述，并确保符合提交要求。

name: configs-targeting
description: Configure config targeting rules to control which variations serve to different users. Enable percentage rollouts, attribute-based rules, segment targeting, and guarded rollouts.
description_zh: 配置目标规则以控制哪些变体服务于不同用户。启用百分比发布、基于属性的规则、细分定位和受保护发布。

name: configs-variations
description: Experiment with configs by creating and managing variations. Helps you test different models, prompts, and parameters to find what works best through systematic experimentation.
description_zh: 通过创建和管理配置变体来尝试不同的配置。这有助于您通过系统性的实验测试不同的模型、提示和参数，以找到最佳方案。

name: video-analysis
description:
Video understanding for any model — native passthrough for small files,
frame extraction + audio transcription fallback for large files.

Use when the user asks to analyze, describe, or understand a video file
(e.g. "what's in this video", "summarize this clip", "transcribe this recording").
description_zh:
任何模型的视频理解——小文件直接传输，大文件则采用帧提取+音频转录的备用方案。

当用户要求分析、描述或理解视频文件时使用（例如："这个视频里有什么"，"总结这段剪辑"，"转录这段录音"）。

name: xlsx
description: Create, edit, analyze, or convert Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx) where the workbook file is the primary deliverable. Use for formulas, formatting, financial models, multi-sheet workbooks, and tabular cleanup exported to Excel. Also applies to .csv/.tsv when the user wants spreadsheet output. Do NOT use for Word documents, HTML reports, standalone Python scripts, database pipelines, or Google Sheets API work.
description_zh: 创建、编辑、分析或转换 Excel 电子表格（.xlsx、.xlsm、.xltx），其中工作簿文件是主要交付成果。用于公式、格式设置、财务模型、多工作表工作簿以及导出到 Excel 的表格清理。当用户需要电子表格输出时，也适用于 .csv/.tsv。**不适用于** Word 文档、HTML 报告、独立的 Python 脚本、数据库管道或 Google Sheets API 工作。

name: configs-update
description: Update, archive, and delete LaunchDarkly configs and their variations. Use when you need to modify config properties, change model parameters, update instructions or messages, archive unused configs, or permanently remove them.
description_zh: 更新、归档和删除 LaunchDarkly 配置及其变体。当您需要修改配置属性、更改模型参数、更新说明或消息、归档未使用的配置或永久删除它们时使用。

name: styles
description: Use this skill to integrate the Jetpack Compose Styles API into an Android project. This skill guides you through upgrading dependencies, setting up component themes, making custom components styleable, and migrating existing layout properties to use unified styles. Migrate custom design system components, replace hard coded parameters with Style attributes, and use Modifier.styleable for interaction states.
description_zh: 使用此功能将 Jetpack Compose Styles API 集成到 Android 项目中。此功能将指导您完成升级依赖项、设置组件主题、使自定义组件可样式化以及将现有布局属性迁移到使用统一样式的过程。迁移自定义设计系统组件，用 Style 属性替换硬编码参数，并使用 Modifier.styleable 处理交互状态。

name: seo-local-business
description: Generate complete SEO setup for local business websites — HTML head tags, JSON-LD LocalBusiness schema, robots.txt, sitemap.xml. Australian-optimised with +61 phone, ABN, suburb patterns. Use whenever the user wants SEO for a local business (tradesman, café, clinic, agency, retailer), needs JSON-LD structured data, asks for LocalBusiness schema, or wants meta tags / robots.txt / sitemap for a suburb-serving business.
description_zh: 为本地企业网站生成完整的SEO设置——HTML头部标签、JSON-LD LocalBusiness模式、robots.txt、sitemap.xml。澳大利亚优化，包含+61电话、ABN、郊区模式。在用户需要为本地企业（如技工、咖啡馆、诊所、代理机构、零售商）进行SEO、需要JSON-LD结构化数据、要求LocalBusiness模式，或希望为服务特定郊区的企业提供元标签/robots.txt/sitemap时使用。

name: stakeholder-alignment
description: Build alignment artifacts — responsibility matrices, decision rights, and communication plans. Use when unclear ownership stalls decisions. For persuading in the moment, use `design-negotiation` (designer-toolkit).
description_zh: 构建对齐工件——责任矩阵、决策权责和沟通计划。当不明确的归属阻碍决策时使用。为即时说服，使用 `design-negotiation` (designer-toolkit)。

name: difit-review
description: A skill for reviewing a specific diff and showing the findings as comments inside difit (the diff viewer). Use it to review branch diffs, commit diffs, or GitHub PRs, then preload findings or code explanations into difit with `--comment` before launching it for the user.
description_zh: 一种用于审查特定差异并作为 difit（差异查看器）中的注释显示发现结果的功能。使用它来审查分支差异、提交差异或 GitHub PR，然后在启动 difit 之前，通过 `--comment` 参数预加载发现结果或代码解释。

name: loop-factory
description: Run a spec-driven agent loop where coding tasks live as markdown specs that move through inbox → active → archive, get implemented by Claude Code or Codex, and pass a review gate before they count as done. Use when the user mentions "loop factory", a "spec-driven loop", an "agent factory", wants repeatable/reviewable agent work, or when a repo has a factory/specs/inbox or factory/specs/active directory. Also covers installing and scaffolding the loop-factory CLI into a project.
description_zh: 运行一个以规范驱动的代理循环，其中编码任务以 Markdown 规范的形式存在，并通过收件箱 → 活动状态 → 归档的流程移动，由 Claude Code 或 Codex 实现，并在通过评审门禁后才被视为完成。当用户提到“循环工厂”、“规范驱动循环”、“代理工厂”，需要可重复/可评审的代理工作，或当代码库包含 factory/specs/inbox 或 factory/specs/active 目录时使用。此外，还涵盖将 loop-factory CLI 框架安装到项目中的操作。

name: design-review-process
description: Establish review gates — criteria, checkpoints, and approval flow. Use when work ships without consistent review. For running one individual session, use `design-critique`.
description_zh: 建立评审关卡——标准、检查点和审批流程。当工作成果缺乏一致评审时使用。进行单个评审会时，使用 `design-critique`。

name: north-star-vision
description: Articulate a long-horizon product vision that aligns teams and anchors strategy. Use when direction is contested or absent. For near-term project scope, use `design-brief`.
description_zh: 阐述与团队目标一致、支撑战略的中长期产品愿景。在方向存在争议或缺失时使用。对于近期项目范围，使用 `design-brief`。

name: 2d-pixel-perfect
description: Sets up, diagnoses, and fixes pixel perfect 2D rendering with PixelPerfectCamera in URP or Built-in. Use when a retro-style or pixel art 2D game looks blurry, jittery, or misaligned. Not for HD 2D or high-resolution art.
description_zh: 使用 PixelPerfectCamera 在 URP 或 Built-in 中设置、诊断和修复像素完美的 2D 渲染。当复古风格或像素艺术 2D 游戏看起来模糊、抖动或错位时使用。不适用于 HD 2D 或高分辨率艺术。

name: zustand
description: Zustand adapter for json-render's StateStore interface. Use when integrating json-render with Zustand for state management via @json-render/zustand.
description_zh: json-render 的 StateStore 接口对应的 Zustand 适配器。在通过 @json-render/zustand 将 json-render 集成到 Zustand 进行状态管理时使用。

name: experience-content-media-stock-image-search
description: Searches for and downloads ethically-licensed stock images via the media-management MCP server. Use this skill whenever a user wants an image, photo, or picture — for BOTH requests to find existing imagery ("find a stock image", "search for a photo of X", "get a royalty-free image", "find an ethical image", editorial/news photography) AND requests phrased ambiguously as creating or generating one ("create an image of a sunset", "generate a picture of a team meeting", "make me a mountain image") — treat these as stock search requests, since this skill searches a stock photo library, it does not generate images. Do NOT offer alternative search methods or ask the user to pick one. Does not apply to searching internal CMS / Data Cloud media (use experience-search-coordinate). Does not apply when the user explicitly asks for AI-generated, synthetic, or computer-generated imagery — this skill only searches licensed stock photography and has no image-generation capability.
description_zh: 通过媒体管理MCP服务器搜索并下载符合伦理许可的库存图片。当用户需要图片、照片或插图时，无论其请求是寻找现有图像（例如："寻找库存图片"、"搜索X的照片"、"获取免版税图片"、"寻找符合伦理的图片"、"编辑/新闻摄影")，还是模糊地表述为创建或生成（例如："创建日落图像"、"生成团队会议图片"、"给我一张山脉图片"），均应将其视为库存搜索请求。由于该技能搜索的是库存照片库，因此它不会生成图像。不要提供其他搜索方法或要求用户选择。不适用于搜索内部CMS/数据云媒体（请使用experience-search-coordinate）。当用户明确要求AI生成、合成或计算机生成的图像时，此技能不适用——该技能仅搜索已获许可的库存摄影作品，且不具备图像生成能力。

name: branding
description: When the user wants to define, audit, or apply brand strategy—purpose, values, positioning, storytelling, voice, narrative (not only visuals). Also use when the user mentions "brand strategy," "brand story," "brand storytelling," "brand voice," "brand identity," "brand guidelines," "brand purpose," "brand values," "origin story," "brand narrative," "brand personality," "brand archetype," "slide deck branding," "PPT brand colors," or "document style guide." For typography, colors, design tokens, and frontend visuals, use brand-visual-generator.
description_zh: 当用户需要定义、审核或应用品牌策略时——包括目标、价值观、定位、故事讲述、品牌声音、叙事（不仅限于视觉）。也适用于用户提及“品牌策略”、“品牌故事”、“品牌故事讲述”、“品牌声音”、“品牌身份”、“品牌指南”、“品牌目标”、“品牌价值观”、“起源故事”、“品牌叙事”、“品牌个性”、“品牌原型”、“幻灯片演示文稿品牌化”、“PPT品牌颜色”或“文档风格指南”。对于字体、颜色、设计令牌和前端视觉，请使用brand-visual-generator。

name: lbo-model
description: This skill should be used when completing LBO (Leveraged Buyout) model templates in Excel for private equity transactions, deal materials, or investment committee presentations. The skill fills in formulas, validates calculations, and ensures professional formatting standards that adapt to any template structure.
description_zh: 在完成私募股权交易、交易材料或投资委员会演示的Excel LBO（杠杆收购）模型模板时，应使用此技能。该技能可自动填充公式、验证计算结果，并确保符合任何模板结构的专业格式标准。

name: projects
description: Guide for setting up LaunchDarkly projects in your codebase. Helps you assess your stack, choose the right approach, and integrate project management that makes sense for your architecture.
description_zh: 在您的代码库中设置 LaunchDarkly 项目的指南。帮助您评估您的技术栈，选择正确的方法，并集成适合您架构的项目管理。

name: adopt-spec
description: Adopt a typed .spec.ts for an existing hand-written CLAUDE.md — start from the file you already have, non-destructively
description_zh: 为现有的手工编写的 CLAUDE.md 采用一个带类型的 .spec.ts 文件——从您已有的文件开始，非破坏性地

name: agent-graphs
description: Create and manage agent graphs — directed graphs of configs connected by edges with handoff logic. Use when building multi-agent workflows where configs route to each other.
description_zh: 创建和管理代理图——由带有交接逻辑的边连接的配置有向图。在构建多代理工作流时使用，其中配置相互路由。

name: built-in-metrics
description: Instrument an existing codebase with LaunchDarkly config tracking. Walks the four-tier ladder (managed runner → provider package → custom extractor + trackMetricsOf → raw manual) and picks the lowest-ceremony option that still captures duration, tokens, and success/error.
description_zh: 使用 LaunchDarkly 配置跟踪功能对现有代码库进行监控。遍历四层阶梯（受管理运行器 → 提供者包 → 自定义提取器 + trackMetricsOf → 原始手动），并选择能够捕获持续时间、令牌和成功/失败信息的最低仪式选项。

name: online-evals
description: Attach judges to config variations for automatic LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Create custom judges, configure sampling rates, and monitor quality scores.
description_zh: 将裁判附加到配置变体上，以进行自动的“大语言模型作为裁判”评估。创建自定义裁判，配置采样率，并监控质量分数。

name: snippets
description: Create and manage prompt snippets — reusable text blocks referenced inside config variation prompts. Keeps common instructions, personas, and guardrails consistent across multiple configs.
description_zh: 创建和管理提示片段——在配置变体提示中引用的可重用文本块。确保在多个配置中保持常见的指令、角色和护栏的一致性。

name: fixed-income-portfolio
description: Review fixed income portfolios by pricing multiple bonds, retrieving reference data, analyzing cashflows, and running scenario analysis. Use when reviewing bond portfolios, computing portfolio duration and DV01, analyzing cashflow waterfalls, stress testing rate scenarios, or assessing portfolio composition.
description_zh: 通过定价多种债券、获取参考数据、分析现金流以及运行情景分析来审查固定收益投资组合。在审查债券投资组合、计算投资组合久期和DV01、分析现金流瀑布、进行利率情景压力测试或评估投资组合构成时使用。

name: postgresql-database-engineering
description: Comprehensive PostgreSQL database engineering skill covering indexing strategies, query optimization, performance tuning, partitioning, replication, backup and recovery, high availability, and production database management. Master advanced PostgreSQL features including MVCC, VACUUM operations, connection pooling, monitoring, and scalability patterns.
description_zh: 涵盖索引策略、查询优化、性能调优、分区、复制、备份与恢复、高可用性及生产数据库管理的全面PostgreSQL数据库工程技能。掌握PostgreSQL高级特性，包括MVCC、VACUUM操作、连接池、监控及可扩展性模式。

name: deep-learning-pytorch
description: Expert guidance for deep learning, transformers, diffusion models, and LLM development with PyTorch, Transformers, Diffusers, and Gradio.
description_zh: 针对深度学习、Transformer、扩散模型以及使用PyTorch、Transformers、Diffusers和Gradio进行LLM开发的专家指导。

name: high-end-visual-design
description: Teaches the AI to design like a high-end agency. Defines the exact fonts, spacing, shadows, card structures, and animations that make a website feel expensive. Blocks all the common defaults that make AI designs look cheap or generic.

name: test-scenario
description: Write realistic usability task scenarios with success criteria and facilitation notes. Use when you have a study and need the tasks. For the surrounding study design, use `usability-test-plan` (design-research).
description_zh: 编写具有成功标准和促进说明的现实可用性任务场景。当您进行研究并需要任务时使用。对于周围的研究设计，使用 `usability-test-plan`（设计研究）。

name: apollo-federation
description: Guide for authoring Apollo Federation subgraph schemas. Use this skill when: (1) creating new subgraph schemas for a federated supergraph, (2) defining or modifying entities with @key, (3) sharing types/fields across subgraphs with @shareable, (4) working with federation directives (@external, @requires, @provides, @override, @inaccessible), (5) troubleshooting composition errors, (6) any task involving federation schema design patterns.
description_zh: 编写 Apollo Federation 子图模式指南。在以下情况下使用此技能：(1) 为联邦超图创建新的子图模式，(2) 使用 @key 定义或修改实体，(3) 使用 @shareable 在子图间共享类型/字段，(4) 处理联邦指令 (@external, @requires, @provides, @override, @inaccessible)，(5) 排查组合错误，(6) 任何涉及联邦模式设计的任务。

name: experience-ui-bundle-2gp-deploy
description: MUST activate when the user wants to package, distribute, or install/upgrade/uninstall/promote a UI Bundle as a Salesforce second-generation (2GP) package (project may contain uiBundles/ or sfdx-project.json for packaging tasks; install/upgrade tasks may lack local bundle files). Handles making a bundle packageable, choosing managed/unlocked flavor, creating package/version with sf package, installing/upgrading in another org, and debugging failures. TRIGGER on packaging, 2GP, managed package, unlocked package, AppExchange, package version, sf package, sf package install, sf package upgrade, install a package, upgrade a package, cross-org distribution. DO NOT TRIGGER for plain source deploy to one org (use experience-ui-bundle-deploy) or scaffolding a new bundle (use experience-ui-bundle-project-generate). Apply piecemeal — do ONLY the part asked.
description_zh: 必须在用户想要打包、分发或安装/升级/卸载/提升 UI Bundle 作为 Salesforce 第二代（2GP）包时激活（项目可能包含用于打包任务的 uiBundles/ 或 sfdx-project.json；安装/升级任务可能缺少本地 Bundle 文件）。处理使 Bundle 可打包、选择受管/未锁定版本、使用 sf package 创建包/版本、在另一个组织中安装/升级，以及调试失败。在打包、2GP、受管包、未锁定包、AppExchange、包版本、sf package、sf package install、sf package upgrade、安装包、升级包、跨组织分发时触发。不要用于将纯源代码部署到一个组织（使用 experience-ui-bundle-deploy）或搭建新的 Bundle（使用 experience-ui-bundle-project-generate）。分步应用——仅执行所请求的部分。

name: figma-generate-diagram
description: MANDATORY prerequisite — load this skill BEFORE every `generate_diagram` tool call. NEVER call `generate_diagram` directly without loading this skill first. Trigger whenever the user asks to create, generate, draw, render, sketch, or build a diagram — flowchart, architecture diagram, sequence diagram, ERD or entity-relationship diagram, state diagram or state machine, gantt chart, or timeline. Also trigger when the user mentions Mermaid syntax or wants a system architecture, decision tree, dependency graph, API call flow, auth handshake, schema, or pipeline visualized in FigJam. Routes to type-specific guidance, sets universal Mermaid constraints, and tells you when to use a different diagram type or skip the tool entirely (mindmaps, pie charts, class diagrams, etc.).
description_zh: 必须前置条件——在使用 `generate_diagram` 工具之前必须先加载此技能。严禁在未加载此技能的情况下直接调用 `generate_diagram`。当用户要求创建、生成、绘制、渲染、绘制草图或构建图表时触发——流程图、架构图、时序图、ERD（实体关系图）或实体关系图、状态图或状态机、甘特图或时间轴。此外，当用户提及 Mermaid 语法或希望以 FigJam 可视化系统架构、决策树、依赖图、API 调用流程、认证握手、模式或流程图时也会触发。该技能会根据图表类型提供特定指导，设置通用的 Mermaid 限制，并在需要使用不同图表类型或完全跳过工具时（如思维导图、饼图、类图等）给出提示。

name: custom-metrics
description: Create, track, retrieve, update, and delete custom business metrics for configs. Covers full lifecycle: define metric kinds via API, emit events via SDK, and query results.
description_zh: 为配置创建、跟踪、检索、更新和删除自定义业务指标。涵盖完整生命周期：通过 API 定义指标类型，通过 SDK 发出事件，并查询结果。

name: dd-monitors
description: Monitor management - list, search, file-based create, and alerting best practices.
description_zh: 监控管理 - 列表、搜索、基于文件的创建和告警最佳实践。

name: deep-research
description: Conduct systematic academic literature reviews in 6 phases, producing structured notes, a curated paper database, and a synthesized final report. Output is organized by phase for clarity.
description_zh: 进行分六个阶段的系统性学术文献综述，产出结构化笔记、精选论文数据库和综合最终报告。输出按阶段组织，以示清晰。

name: insurgent-campaign
description: Grassroots-first campaign design for anyone being outspent — startups vs. incumbents, NGOs vs. corporate comms, movements vs. state-backed machines, solo brands vs. big-budget competitors. Ideates awareness, launch, fundraising, mobilization, community-build, counter-narrative, referral, founder-story, and coalition campaigns. Triggers on "campaign plan", "marketing strategy", "ad budget", "should I advertise", "paid vs organic", "launch plan", "grassroots", "low budget marketing", "NGO campaign", "outspent", "competitor has bigger budget", "how do I compete without money". Also trigger on any spend asymmetry, collapsing organic reach, rising CPAs, or a trust/credibility problem — even without the word "campaign". Nudge activation when the user debates buying ads, boosting posts, or hiring influencers; they are likely about to burn money on a channel that will not persuade.
description_zh: 面向预算不足者的草根优先型活动策划方案——适用于初创企业对抗行业巨头、非政府组织对抗企业公关、社会运动对抗国家背景机构、独立品牌对抗大预算竞争对手。涵盖意识提升、启动推广、融资筹款、动员组织、社群构建、反叙事、口碑推荐、创始人故事及联盟活动策划。当用户搜索“活动策划方案”、“营销策略”、“广告预算”、“是否投放广告”、“付费与自然流量”、“启动计划”、“草根营销”、“低成本营销”、“非政府组织活动”、“预算不足”、“竞争对手预算更大”、“没钱如何竞争”等关键词时触发。同时，在预算不对称、自然流量骤降、转化成本飙升或信任/信誉出现问题时触发，即使不提及“活动”一词。当用户在考虑投放广告、推广帖子或聘请网红时，系统将进行提示激活，因为他们可能即将在无法产生说服力的渠道上浪费资金。

name: ios-design-guidelines
description: Apple Human Interface Guidelines for iPhone. Use when building, reviewing, or refactoring SwiftUI/UIKit interfaces for iOS. Triggers on tasks involving iPhone UI, iOS components, accessibility, Dynamic Type, Dark Mode, or HIG compliance.

name: migrate
description: Migrate an application with hardcoded LLM prompts to a full LaunchDarkly AgentControl implementation in five stages: audit the code, wrap the call, move the tools, add tracking, attach evaluators. Use when the user wants to externalize model/prompt configuration, move from direct provider calls (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini, Strands) to a managed config, or stage a full hardcoded-to-LaunchDarkly migration.
description_zh: 将具有硬编码LLM提示的应用迁移到完整的LaunchDarkly AgentControl实现中，分为五个阶段：审计代码、封装调用、迁移工具、添加跟踪、附加评估器。适用于用户希望将模型/提示配置外部化、从直接提供者调用（OpenAI、Anthropic、Bedrock、Gemini、Strands）迁移到管理配置，或进行从硬编码到LaunchDarkly的完整迁移。

name: networkx
description: Create, analyze, and visualize complex networks and graphs in Python with NetworkX. Use when working with network/graph data structures, computing graph algorithms (shortest paths, centrality, clustering), detecting communities, generating synthetic networks (random, scale-free, small-world), reading/writing graph file formats, or drawing network topologies. Common applications include social, biological, transportation, and citation networks.
description_zh: 使用 NetworkX 在 Python 中创建、分析和可视化复杂网络和图。适用于处理网络/图数据结构、计算图算法（最短路径、中心性、聚类）、检测社区、生成合成网络（随机、无标度、小世界）、读取/写入图文件格式或绘制网络拓扑。常见应用包括社交、生物、交通和引文网络。

name: pytorch-lightning
description: Deep learning framework (PyTorch Lightning / lightning package). Organize PyTorch code into LightningModules, configure Trainers for multi-GPU/TPU, implement data pipelines, callbacks, logging (W&B, TensorBoard, MLflow), distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed), for scalable neural network training.
description_zh: 深度学习框架（PyTorch Lightning / lightning 包）。将 PyTorch 代码组织成 LightningModules，配置多 GPU/TPU 的 Trainers，实现数据管道、回调、日志记录（W&B、TensorBoard、MLflow），分布式训练（DDP、FSDP、DeepSpeed），以实现可扩展的神经网络训练。

name: opportunity-framework
description: Identify, score, and prioritise design opportunities against impact and effort. Use when there are more ideas than capacity. For framing the one you choose, use `design-brief`.
description_zh: 针对影响和努力程度，识别、评分和优先排序设计机会。当想法多于能力时使用。为确定你选择的设计，使用 `design-brief`。

name: team-workflow
description: Design the team's operating rhythm — task management, collaboration rituals, and tooling. Use when the day-to-day cadence needs structure. For a time-boxed sprint, use `design-sprint-plan`.
description_zh: 设计团队的运作节奏——任务管理、协作仪式和工具。当日常节奏需要结构时使用。对于有时间限制的冲刺，使用 `design-sprint-plan`。

name: aeon
description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.
description_zh: 此技能应用于时间序列机器学习任务，包括分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测、分割和相似性搜索。在处理时间序列数据、序列模式或需要标准机器学习方法之外的专业算法的时间索引观测值时使用。特别适用于使用与scikit-learn兼容的API进行单变量和多变量时间序列分析。

name: podcast-marketing
description: When the user wants to plan, create, or market a podcast. Also use when the user mentions "podcast," "podcast strategy," "podcast SEO," "show notes," "podcast distribution," "Spotify podcast," "Apple Podcasts," "podcast discoverability," "PodcastEpisode schema," or "podcast repurposing." For show notes, use article-content.

name: sympy
description: Use when you need exact symbolic math in Python — algebra, calculus, equation solving, symbolic linear algebra, or code generation via lambdify/LaTeX. Prefer NumPy or SciPy when floating-point approximations are sufficient.
description_zh: 在需要精确符号数学的 Python 中使用——包括代数、微积分、方程求解、符号线性代数或通过 lambdify/LaTeX 生成代码。当浮点数近似足够时，优先选择 NumPy 或 SciPy。

name: netlify-access-control
description: Picks the right Netlify site-protection layer and disambiguates the three unrelated "auth" concepts users conflate — app-user login (Netlify Identity), site-load gating (Password Protection / project visibility), and dashboard SAML SSO. Use it when asked to password-protect a site or Deploy Preview, make a project private/public, restrict a site to your team, require SSO to view a site, set up company-wide app SSO, or invite users to a private project. Also use it for SSO-session symptoms on protected sites: "logged out mid-session", 401s after about an hour, or token expiry/refresh questions. Not for wiring auth code — route app-login setup to netlify-identity.
description_zh: 选择合适的 Netlify 站点保护层，并澄清用户混淆的三个不相关的“auth”概念——应用用户登录（Netlify Identity）、站点加载门控（密码保护/项目可见性）和仪表板 SAML SSO。在以下情况下使用：被要求对站点进行密码保护或部署预览、将项目设为私有/公开、限制站点仅限您的团队访问、要求 SSO 才能查看站点、设置全公司应用 SSO 或邀请用户加入私有项目。也用于受保护站点的 SSO 会话问题：会话中途注销、大约一小时后出现 401 错误，或令牌过期/刷新问题。不用于连接认证代码——将应用登录设置路由到 netlify-identity。

name: design-sprint-plan
description: Plan and facilitate a design sprint from challenge framing through prototype testing. Use when compressing discovery into days. For ongoing team cadence, use `team-workflow`.
description_zh: 制定并促进设计冲刺，从挑战界定到原型测试。在将探索压缩为几天的场景下使用。对于持续团队节奏，请使用 `team-workflow`。

name: design-system-adoption
description: Create adoption strategy and enablement materials to drive design system usage. Use when the system exists but teams ignore it. For contribution and versioning rules, use `design-system-governance` (design-systems).
description_zh: 创建采用策略和赋能材料，以推动设计系统的使用。当系统存在但团队忽视它时使用。对于贡献和版本控制规则，使用 `design-system-governance` (design-systems)。

name: sprite-segment-3x3grid
description: Segments a Sprite texture into a 3x3 grid and outputs a pattern of cells matching the center cell's color. Use when the user asks to analyze or document a sprite's structure or color distribution.
description_zh: 将精灵纹理分割成3x3网格，并输出与中心单元格颜色相匹配的单元格图案。当用户要求分析或记录精灵结构或颜色分布时使用。

name: speckit-plan
description: Execute the implementation planning workflow using the plan template to generate design artifacts.
description_zh: 使用计划模板执行实施规划工作流，以生成设计工件。

name: pyzotero
description: Interact with Zotero reference management libraries using the pyzotero Python client. Retrieve, create, update, and delete items, collections, tags, and attachments via the Zotero Web API v3. Use this skill when working with Zotero libraries programmatically, managing bibliographic references, exporting citations, searching library contents, uploading PDF attachments, or building research automation workflows that integrate with Zotero.
description_zh: 使用 pyzotero Python 客户端与 Zotero 参考管理库进行交互。通过 Zotero Web API v3 获取、创建、更新和删除条目、集合、标签和附件。在以编程方式处理 Zotero 库、管理书目参考文献、导出引文、搜索库内容、上传 PDF 附件或构建与 Zotero 集成的自动化研究工作流时，使用此技能。

name: ugc-ads
description: Use when the user asks for ugc ads or a task matching the examples below. Multi-cut jump-cut UGC product ad — HOOK + 3 JUMP CUTs + OUTRO, 15s, 9:16 vertical (3:4 optional, seedance only), POV first-person talking-head selfie, every beat has spoken dialogue with native lip-sync, 5-act narrative arc (set → name → reveal → twist → punchline). Six category essences (HAUL / APP / FOOD / BEAUTY / FITNESS / TECH) auto-picked from the input URL. Creator-style raw UGC talking-head with multi-beat conversational dialogue. Use when the user asks to "make a UGC ad", "jump-cut product ad", "POV product reveal", "creator-style ad", "haul-style ad", "unboxing ad", "TikTok-style product video", or "talking-head ad about [URL]".
description_zh: 在用户要求ugc广告或任务与以下示例匹配时使用。多剪辑跳跃剪辑ugc产品广告——钩子+3跳跃剪辑+尾声，15秒，9:16竖屏（3:4可选，仅限seedance），第一人称视角自拍，每个节拍都有带有本地口型的对话，5幕叙事弧（设定→命名→揭示→转折→高潮）。六类精华（HAUL / APP / FOOD / BEAUTY / FITNESS / TECH）从输入URL自动选择。创作者风格原始ugc自拍，多节拍对话式对话。在用户要求“制作ugc广告”、“跳跃剪辑产品广告”、“第一人称产品展示”、“创作者风格广告”、“带货风格广告”、“开箱广告”、“抖音风格产品视频”或“关于[URL]的自拍广告”时使用。

name: generate-image
description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.
description_zh: 通过 OpenRouter 图像 API 使用 AI 模型生成或编辑图像（Gemini、Seedream、Recraft、GPT-Image、Riverflow）。适用于照片、插图、艺术作品、概念艺术、视觉资产、标志，以及从参考图像进行图像编辑或合成。对于流程图、电路图、路径图和其他技术图表，请使用 scientific-schematics 技能。

name: viral-hook-creator
description: Creates viral social media hooks using proven psychological patterns and trigger words. Use when user needs attention-grabbing openings for posts, threads, videos, or content.
description_zh: 利用经过验证的心理模式和使用触发词汇，创建具有病毒式传播潜力的社交媒体钩子。当用户需要为帖子、主题、视频或内容制作吸引注意力的开头时使用。

name: gtm-technical-product-pricing
description: Pricing strategy for technical products. Use when choosing usage-based vs seat-based, designing freemium thresholds, structuring enterprise pricing conversations, deciding when to raise prices, or using price as a positioning signal.
description_zh: 技术产品的定价策略。在以下情况使用：选择按使用量收费还是按座位收费、设计免费增值门槛、构建企业定价对话结构、决定何时提价，或使用价格作为定位信号。

name: sequential-thinking
description: Use when complex problems require systematic step-by-step reasoning with ability to revise thoughts, branch into alternative approaches, or dynamically adjust scope. Ideal for multi-stage analysis, design planning, problem decomposition, or tasks with initially unclear scope.
description_zh: 当复杂问题需要系统性的逐步推理，并具备修正思路、分支探索替代方案或动态调整范围的能力时使用。适用于多阶段分析、设计规划、问题分解或初始范围不明确的任务。

name: rev-struct
description: Reconstruct data structures by analyzing memory access patterns across functions
description_zh: 通过分析跨函数的内存访问模式来重建数据结构

name: game-designer
description: Game UI/UX designer that analyzes and improves the visual polish, atmosphere, and player experience of browser games. Use when a game needs visual improvements, better backgrounds, particles, animations, screen transitions, juice/feel, or overall aesthetic upgrades.
description_zh: 游戏UI/UX设计师，负责分析和提升网页游戏的视觉质感、氛围及玩家体验。适用于游戏需要视觉改进、更优的背景、粒子效果、动画、屏幕过渡、质感提升或整体美学升级的情况。

name: whose-number-is-this
description: Investigate a phone number — E.164 normalisation with libphonenumber, phoneinfoga scanning, carrier and line-type identification, VoIP and burner detection, messaging-app registration checks, and reverse-lookup and caller-ID sources. Use for phone OSINT and reverse phone lookup, "who owns this number", identifying a burner or VoIP number, or checking whether a number is registered on WhatsApp, Telegram or Signal. Applies to vishing and business email compromise investigation, verifying a counterparty before sending payment, recruitment and marketplace scam checks, and fraud triage. Reference at useosint.com/skills/whose-number-is-this.
description_zh: 调查一个电话号码——使用libphonenumber进行E.164标准化，通过phoneinfoga进行扫描，识别运营商和线路类型，检测VoIP和一次性号码，检查消息应用程序的注册情况，以及反向查找和来电显示来源。用于电话OSINT和反向电话查询，"这个号码是谁的"，识别一次性号码或VoIP号码，或检查号码是否在WhatsApp、Telegram或Signal上注册。适用于vishing和商业电子邮件欺诈调查，发送付款前验证对方身份，招聘和交易平台诈骗检查，以及欺诈分类。参考useosint.com/skills/whose-number-is-this。

name: summarize-interview
description: Turn one interview transcript into themes, supporting quotes, and action items. Use immediately after a session. For synthesising many sessions at once, use `affinity-diagram`.
description_zh: 将一份访谈记录转化为主题、支持性引言和行动项。会话结束后立即使用。若需同时整合多个会话，请使用 `affinity-diagram`。

name: secrets-in-file-metadata
description: Extract and interpret embedded file metadata with exiftool — EXIF GPS coordinates, camera make, model and serial, DateTimeOriginal and CreateDate timestamps, XMP and IPTC fields, and Office and PDF properties such as Author, Company, LastModifiedBy, template paths and revision counts. Use when reading EXIF from a photo, checking who really wrote a document, dating a file, fingerprinting a camera or phone, or investigating provenance in JPEG, HEIC, RAW, MP4, DOCX, XLSX or PDF. Applies to document-provenance disputes, insider-leak attribution, evidence handling, and pre-publication redaction checks. Reference at useosint.com/skills/secrets-in-file-metadata.
description_zh: 使用 exiftool 提取并解析嵌入文件元数据——EXIF GPS 坐标、相机品牌、型号和序列号、DateTimeOriginal 和 CreateDate 时间戳、XMP 和 IPTC 字段，以及 Office 和 PDF 属性（如作者、公司、最后修改者、模板路径和修订次数）。适用于从照片读取 EXIF 信息、确认文档的真正作者、确定文件日期、识别相机或手机型号、或调查 JPEG、HEIC、RAW、MP4、DOCX、XLSX 或 PDF 文件的来源。适用于文档来源纠纷、内部泄露归属、证据处理和出版前脱敏检查。参考 useosint.com/skills/secrets-in-file-metadata。

name: transformers
description: Hugging Face Transformers for loading Hub models, running pipeline inference, text generation, and Trainer fine-tuning on NLP, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks. Use when working with AutoModel, pipelines, tokenizers, or TrainingArguments—not for general ML outside the Transformers library.

name: pr-review

Run the validation script first for hard checks, then apply quality guidelines for content review. Triggers: PR review, pull request, validate skill, check skill.
description_zh: 请检查MiniMax Skills存储库的拉取请求。在审查PR时、验证新技能提交或检查现有技能的合规性时使用。首先运行验证脚本进行硬性检查，然后应用内容审查的质量指南。触发器：PR审查、拉取请求、验证技能、检查技能。

name: click-test-plan
description: Design first-click and click tests for findability and navigation. Use when testing whether people can locate something. For full task-based observation, use `test-scenario`.
description_zh: 设计首次点击和点击测试，用于评估可查找性和导航性。在测试人们能否找到特定内容时使用。对于基于完整任务的观察，请使用 `test-scenario`。

name: copy-to-output-directory

USE FOR: removing the per-build Always copy perf hit; resetting output files mutated between builds. DO NOT USE FOR: general incremental-build diagnosis (use incremental-build); non-MSBuild build systems.

description: Explain and audit machine-learning predictions with SHAP. Use for selecting SHAP explainers and maskers, computing and validating feature attributions, handling multi-output explanations, and producing local or global SHAP visualizations.

name: tilemap-palette-create
description: Creates a Tile Palette asset with a rectangular, hexagonal, or isometric Grid layout. Use when the user wants to organize tiles for 2D level design.

name: hunt-a-handle
description: Enumerate a username across hundreds of platforms with sherlock, maigret and WhatsMyName, then correlate and confirm which accounts genuinely belong to the same person. Use for username OSINT and handle enumeration, "find all accounts for this username", cross-platform account correlation, nickname and screen-name pivots, or turning a handle into a real name. Applies to fraud and synthetic-identity investigation, recruitment and marketplace scam checks, trust-and-safety enforcement, insider-threat work, and personal exposure audits. Reference at useosint.com/skills/hunt-a-handle.
description_zh: 使用sherlock、maigret和WhatsMyName在数百个平台上枚举用户名，然后关联并确认哪些账户确实属于同一个人。用于用户名OSINT和枚举处理，"查找此用户名的所有账户"，跨平台账户关联，昵称和屏幕名转换，或将用户名转换为真实姓名。适用于欺诈和合成身份调查、招聘和交易市场诈骗检查、信任与安全执行、内部威胁工作和个人曝光审计。使用时参考useosint.com/skills/hunt-a-handle。

name: get-available-resources
description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

name: infographics
description: Create professional infographics using Nano Banana Pro AI with smart iterative refinement. Uses Gemini 3.6 Flash for quality review. Integrates research-lookup and web search for accurate data. Supports 10 infographic types, 8 industry styles, and colorblind-safe palettes.
description_zh: 使用 Nano Banana Pro AI 创建专业信息图表，通过智能迭代优化。采用 Gemini 3.6 Flash 进行质量审核。整合研究查询和网页搜索以获取准确数据。支持 10 种信息图表类型、8 种行业风格，并提供对色盲友好的调色板。

name: tilemap-ruletile-createempty
description: Creates an empty RuleTile, HexagonalRuleTile, or IsometricRuleTile asset. Use only when the user wants a blank RuleTile and provides no sprites; with sprites or terrain art, use tilemap-ruletile-createfromsegment.
description_zh: 创建一个空的RuleTile、HexagonalRuleTile或IsometricRuleTile资源。仅在用户想要一个空白RuleTile且未提供精灵时使用；如有精灵或地形艺术，请使用tilemap-ruletile-createfromsegment。

name: ui-ux-pro-max
description: UI/UX design intelligence. 50 styles, 21 palettes, 50 font pairings, 20 charts, 9 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui). Actions: plan, build, create, design, implement, review, fix, improve, optimize, enhance, refactor, check UI/UX code. Projects: website, landing page, dashboard, admin panel, e-commerce, SaaS, portfolio, blog, mobile app, .html, .tsx, .vue, .svelte. Elements: button, modal, navbar, sidebar, card, table, form, chart. Styles: glassmorphism, claymorphism, minimalism, brutalism, neumorphism, bento grid, dark mode, responsive, skeuomorphism, flat design. Topics: color palette, accessibility, animation, layout, typography, font pairing, spacing, hover, shadow, gradient. Integrations: shadcn/ui MCP for component search and examples.
description_zh: UI/UX设计智能。50种风格，21种调色板，50种字体搭配，20种图表，9种堆叠（React、Next.js、Vue、Svelte、SwiftUI、React Native、Flutter、Tailwind、shadcn/ui）。操作：计划、构建、创建、设计、实施、评审、修复、改进、优化、增强、重构、检查UI/UX代码。项目：网站、着陆页、仪表盘、管理面板、电子商务、SaaS、作品集、博客、移动应用、.html、.tsx、.vue、.svelte。元素：按钮、模态框、导航栏、侧边栏、卡片、表格、表单、图表。风格：玻璃态、陶土态、极简主义、残酷主义、新中态、本多网格、暗黑模式、响应式、拟物化、扁平化设计。主题：调色板、无障碍性、动画、布局、排版、字体搭配、间距、悬停、阴影、渐变。集成：shadcn/ui组件搜索和示例的MCP。

name: market-research-reports
description: Build evidence-traceable market research reports and assumption-driven market sizing or forecast scenarios. Use for market definition, industry and customer evidence, competitive landscapes, TAM/SAM/SOM reconciliation, forecast sensitivity, and auditable report scaffolds.
description_zh: 构建可追溯证据的市场研究报告，以及基于假设的市场规模或预测场景。用于市场定义、行业和客户证据、竞争格局、TAM/SAM/SOM协调、预测敏感性以及可审计报告框架。

name: follow-the-crypto
description: Trace cryptocurrency addresses and transactions on public blockchains using block explorers including Etherscan, Blockchair, mempool.space and Blockscout. Covers common-input clustering, ENS resolution, exchange deposit addresses, mixers, CoinJoin, Tornado-style pools, cross-chain bridges, and OFAC sanctions screening. Use when following a Bitcoin or Ethereum wallet, investigating where a ransom or scam payment went, or checking an address against sanctions listings. Applies to ransomware incident response, AML and sanctions compliance, fraud recovery and asset tracing, and financial-crime investigation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/follow-the-crypto.
description_zh: 使用 Etherscan、Blockchair、mempool.space 和 Blockscout 等区块链浏览器追踪加密货币地址和交易。涵盖常见输入聚类、ENS 解析、交易所存款地址、混合器、CoinJoin、龙卷风式池、跨链桥接以及 OFAC 制裁筛查。适用于追踪比特币或以太坊钱包、调查勒索或诈骗款项去向，或检查地址是否在制裁名单上。适用于勒索软件事件响应、反洗钱和制裁合规、欺诈追偿和资产追踪，以及金融犯罪调查。参考 useosint.com/skills/follow-the-crypto。

Delivers a chat summary and a downloadable XLSX. Use when the user asks "forecast my cash flow," "will I make payroll," mentions "runway," or says "cash crunch." Falls back to CSV upload when no connector is live.
description_zh: 从总账（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero 或 Zoho Books）或 PayPal、Square、Stripe 或 CSV 上传中读取应收应付账款、历史现金时间以及已知固定成本，并生成 30/60/90 天的现金流预测，包含百分比差异置信区间和命名风险标志。提供聊天摘要和可下载的 XLSX 文件。当用户询问“预测我的现金流”、“我能否支付工资”、“提到‘续航期’”或说“现金紧张”时使用。当没有可用的连接器时，回退到 CSV 上传。

description: Build production-ready Bright Data integrations with best practices baked in. Reference documentation for developers using coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to implement web scraping, search, browser automation, and structured data extraction. Covers Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API, and Browser API (Scraping Browser).

Supports topic-based research, content curation from multiple sources, and professional formatting for email or web distribution. Trigger on requests like "create a newsletter about X", "write a weekly digest", "generate a tech roundup", or "curate news about Y".
