description: Scans the developer's machine for dead side projects, autopsies each one from its git history (died at the payments wall, killed by a newer project, finished but never shipped), surfaces their personal death patterns, and picks the corpse most worth resurrecting — then helps ship it. Use when the user mentions abandoned, unfinished, or old side projects, asks "what should I finish", wants to revive or resurrect a project, says "run the graveyard", wonders why they never finish anything, or is about to start a new project that sounds like one they already built. Runs entirely locally.
description_zh: 扫描开发者的机器，查找已废弃的副项目，从其git历史中逐一进行尸检（死于支付壁垒、被更新的项目取代、完成但从未发布），揭示其个人项目死亡模式，并挑选最值得复活的“尸体”——然后帮助其发布。当用户提到已废弃、未完成或老旧的副项目，询问“我应该完成哪个”，想要复活或重启一个项目，说“运行墓地”，疑惑为何从未完成任何项目，或即将开始一个听起来像他们已构建过的项目时使用。完全在本地运行。

name: affiliate-fraud-detection
description: Build the detection rule set an affiliate program manager uses to flag fraudulent affiliate activity, plus the investigation and escalation path behind it  -  cookie stuffing, fake lead and form-fill fraud, self-referral rings, traffic-quality baselines, commission holds and clawbacks, and separating real fraud from legitimate low-incrementality coupon or cashback partners. Covers B2B SaaS lead-gen and B2C ecommerce programs. Use whenever the user mentions affiliate fraud, suspicious affiliate traffic, invalid clicks or leads, bot traffic, or an affiliate whose numbers look too good, even if they never say fraud. Do NOT use for consumer refer-a-friend gaming  -  use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@referral-abuse-guardrails instead.
description_zh: 构建联盟计划经理用于标记欺诈性联盟活动的检测规则集，以及其背后的调查和升级路径——包括 Cookie 注入、虚假线索和表单填写欺诈、自我推荐环、流量质量基线、佣金冻结和追回，以及区分真实欺诈与合法的低增量性优惠券或返现合作伙伴。涵盖 B2B SaaS 线索生成和B2C 电商计划。每当用户提及联盟欺诈、可疑联盟流量、无效点击或线索、机器人流量，或联盟数据看起来过于完美时（即使他们从未明确提及欺诈）均可使用。禁止用于消费者推荐好友游戏——应使用 mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@referral-abuse-guardrails。

name: dt-obs-gcp
description: GCP cloud resources including Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, VPC networking, DNS, IAM, Secret Manager, and monitoring. Monitor GCP infrastructure, analyze resource usage, audit security posture, and manage organizational hierarchy across projects and folders.
description_zh: GCP 云资源包括 Compute Engine、GKE、Cloud Run、Pub/Sub、VPC 网络、DNS、IAM、Secret Manager 和监控。监控 GCP 基础设施，分析资源使用情况，审计安全态势，并在项目和文件夹之间管理组织架构。

name: dotnet-timezone
description: .NET timezone handling guidance for C# applications. Use when working with TimeZoneInfo, DateTimeOffset, NodaTime, UTC conversion, daylight saving time, scheduling across timezones, cross-platform Windows/IANA timezone IDs, or when a .NET user needs the timezone for a city, address, region, or country and copy-paste-ready C# code.
description_zh: .NET 时区处理指南适用于 C# 应用程序。在处理 TimeZoneInfo、DateTimeOffset、NodaTime、UTC 转换、夏令时、跨时区调度、跨平台 Windows/IANA 时区 ID，或当 .NET 用户需要城市、地址、区域或国家的时区并需要可直接复制粘贴的 C# 代码时使用。

name: anndata
description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.
description_zh: 单细胞分析中注释矩阵的数据结构。在处理 .h5ad 文件或集成 scverse 生态系统时使用。这是数据格式相关的技能；分析工作流请使用 scanpy；概率模型请使用 scvi-tools；人群尺度查询请使用 cellxgene-census。

name: bioservices
description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.
description_zh: 提供统一的 Python 接口以访问 40 多项生物信息学服务。当需要在单一工作流中以一致的 API 同时查询多个数据库（UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL、Reactome）时使用。最适合用于跨数据库分析和各服务间的 ID 映射。如需快速查询单个数据库，请使用 gget；如需处理序列或文件，请使用 biopython。

name: clinical-reports
description: Create safety-bounded draft structures and run local deterministic checks for clinical case, diagnostic, trial, safety, and aggregate research reports. Use only with synthetic, de-identified, or aggregate inputs and verified source-fact manifests; every output requires qualified review.
description_zh: 创建具有安全边界的草稿结构，并对临床病例、诊断、试验、安全性及汇总研究报告执行本地确定性检查。仅允许使用合成数据、去标识化数据或汇总数据作为输入，且必须附带已验证的来源事实清单；所有输出均需经过具备资质的专业人员审核。

name: kiss-cam
description: Use when the user asks for kiss cam or a task matching the examples below. Generate a viral fake "in-arena Kiss Cam moment" of any two subjects — a fan-filmed phone shot of the MSG Jumbotron with retro Kiss Cam graphic + scoreboard, plus a 15s Kling v3-omni clip with PA-announcer commentary and crowd reaction. Any subject styles (human, 3D toy, illustrated avatar). No names. Triggers: "make me a kiss cam moment", "kiss cam version of these two", "Jumbotron kiss cam trend", "fake NBA kiss cam". Requires the pika MCP.
description_zh: 在用户要求进行亲吻镜头或任务与以下示例匹配时使用。生成任何两个主体的病毒式假“赛场亲吻镜头”时刻——一个粉丝拍摄的手机镜头，显示MSG巨型屏幕上的复古亲吻镜头图形+记分牌，加上15秒的Kling v3-omni片段，包含PA解说员评论和观众反应。任何主体风格（人类、3D玩具、插画式头像）。不出现名字。触发词：“给我一个亲吻镜头时刻”、“这两个人的亲吻镜头版本”、“巨型屏幕亲吻镜头趋势”、“假NBA亲吻镜头”。需要pika MCP。

name: speckit-implement
description: Execute the implementation plan by processing and executing all tasks defined in tasks.md
description_zh: 执行实施计划，处理并执行 tasks.md 中定义的所有任务。

name: douyin-viral-content
description: 抖音爆款文案智能生成器。当用户说"生成新文案"、"创作抖音内容"、"写短视频文案"时自动触发。自动执行：(1) 读取历史数据分析 (2) 应用9大爆款要素优化 (3) 多维度打分评估 (4) 自动迭代优化直到达到5星标准 (5) 智能预估播放量 (6) 输出完整优化文案。完全自动化，无需手动指定任何分析或优化任务。
description_zh: 抖音爆款文案智能生成器。当用户说"生成新文案"、"创作抖音内容"、"写短视频文案"时自动触发。自动执行：(1) 读取历史数据分析 (2) 应用9大爆款要素优化 (3) 多维度打分评估 (4) 自动迭代优化直到达到5星标准 (5) 智能预估播放量 (6) 输出完整优化文案。完全自动化，无需手动指定任何分析或优化任务。

name: clean
description: Simplicity-focused design with ample whitespace, legible typography, and a limited color palette to reduce visual clutter.
description_zh: 以简洁为重点的设计，采用充足的留白、易读的字体和有限的调色板，以减少视觉杂乱。

name: ui-design-system
description: UI design system toolkit for Senior UI Designer including design token generation, component documentation, responsive design calculations, and developer handoff tools. Use for creating design systems, maintaining visual consistency, and facilitating design-dev collaboration.
description_zh: 面向高级UI设计师的UI设计系统工具包，包括设计令牌生成、组件文档、响应式设计计算和开发者交接工具。用于创建设计系统、维护视觉一致性以及促进设计-开发协作。

name: macos-cleaner
description: Diagnoses and safely reclaims macOS disk space: caches, logs, app remnants, large/duplicate files, Docker/OrbStack, Chromium code-sign clones, developer caches. Use when a Mac is low on storage, shows “Caching needs more space”, or before deleting anything to avoid data loss. Not for Windows/Linux or permission issues (use macos-permissions).
description_zh: 诊断并安全回收 macOS 磁盘空间：涵盖缓存、日志、应用残留、大文件/重复文件、Docker/OrbStack、Chromium 代码签名克隆以及开发者缓存。适用于 Mac 存储空间不足、提示“缓存需要更多空间”或在进行任何删除操作之前，以避免数据丢失。不适用于 Windows/Linux 或权限问题（请改用 macos-permissions）。

name: novelty-assessment
description: Assess research idea novelty through systematic literature search. Multi-round search-evaluate loops with harsh critic persona. Binary novel/not-novel decision with justification. Use before committing to a research direction.
description_zh: 通过系统性文献检索评估研究想法的新颖性。采用严厉批评者角色的多轮搜索评估循环。做出新颖/不新颖的二分决策并说明理由。在确定研究方向之前使用。

name: alliance-prioritization
description: Rank named candidate strategic alliances and technology partnerships by expected value, effort, and risk, to decide where partner-team capacity goes  - must-pass screens, a weighted alliance scorecard with sensitivity analysis, co-innovation and platform-dependency risk checks, a ranked shortlist, and a go/no-go recommendation memo. Covers B2B tech alliances and B2C brand and creator partnerships. Use whenever the user mentions alliance prioritization, partnership ranking, partner shortlisting, or asks which of several named partners deserves investment, even if they never say prioritization. Portfolio-level comparison only. Do NOT use for modeling one partner's P&L  - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-economics instead.
description_zh: 按预期价值、投入程度和风险对命名的候选战略联盟和技术伙伴关系进行排序，以确定合作伙伴团队的资源分配——必须通过筛选、加权联盟评分卡及敏感性分析、联合创新和平台依赖风险检查、排名靠前的短名单，以及批准/否决建议备忘录。涵盖B2B技术联盟和B2C品牌与创作者合作。每当用户提及联盟优先级、伙伴关系排序、伙伴短名单，或询问多个命名伙伴中哪一个值得投资时（即使他们从未明确提及优先级），均可使用。仅适用于组合层面的比较。——不得用于对单个伙伴的损益进行建模——应使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-economics。

name: tigris-image-optimization
description: Use when resizing images, generating thumbnails, serving responsive images, or optimizing image delivery with Tigris — covers Next.js, Remix, Rails, Django, Laravel, Express
description_zh: 在调整图像大小、生成缩略图、提供响应式图像或使用 Tigris 优化图像交付时使用——涵盖 Next.js、Remix、Rails、Django、Laravel、Express。

name: memory-setup
description: Enable and configure Moltbot/Clawdbot memory search for persistent context. Use when setting up memory, fixing "goldfish brain," or helping users configure memorySearch in their config. Covers MEMORY.md, daily logs, and vector search setup.
description_zh: 启用并配置 Moltbot/Clawdbot 持久化上下文记忆搜索功能。在设置记忆、解决“金鱼记忆”问题或协助用户在配置文件中设置 memorySearch 时使用。涵盖 MEMORY.md、日常日志和向量搜索设置。

name: improve-website
description: Guided journey from a live website that underperforms to a prioritized, evidence-backed backlog of conversion, usability, message, and speed fixes - each shipped as a testable experiment. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - cro-methodology, ux-heuristics, refactoring-ui, web-typography, storybrand-messaging, high-perf-browser, made-to-stick, design-everyday-things - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (WEBSITE.md, DESIGN.md, IMPROVE-WEBSITE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to fix a landing page that isn't converting, diagnose why visitors leave, audit for clarity and usability, or says 'the homepage feels off but a redesign didn't help'. No site yet, create-website; converts but needs traffic, grow-website; if the friction is in a product app, not the marketing site, improve-app; if one specific flow leaks, conversion-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从表现不佳的实时网站进行引导式改进，逐步构建一个以证据为基础、优先级明确的前端、可用性、信息传递和速度优化任务队列——每个任务都以可测试的实验形式交付。分阶段协调八项技能：cro方法学、ux启发式方法、重构ui、网页排版、故事品牌信息传递、高性能浏览器、让信息深入人心、日常设计事物——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹中（WEBSITE.md、DESIGN.md、IMPROVE-WEBSITE-PLAN.md），以便跨会话继续改进。适用于用户希望修复未产生转化的落地页、诊断访客流失原因、审核清晰度和可用性，或表示“首页感觉不对劲但重新设计并未改善”的情况。目前尚未创建网站，请使用create-website；网站已能转化但需要流量，请使用grow-website；如果摩擦点在于产品应用而非营销网站，请使用improve-app；如果特定流程存在泄漏，请使用conversion-optimization。对于单一框架，可直接调用相应技能。

name: brand-naming
description: Full brand naming workflow for founders, agencies, and businesses. Use this skill whenever the user says "help me name this brand", "brand naming", "I need a name for", "name ideas for", "what should I call my brand/company/product", "naming a startup", "brand name suggestions", "help with naming", or shares a brand brief and asks for name options. Also triggers when the user shares existing name options and asks for feedback, evaluation, ranking, or scoring of those names. Auto-detects whether to run the full generation workflow or the evaluation workflow based on what the user provides. Always use this skill for any brand or product naming task — even if the user just casually mentions needing a name.
description_zh: 面向创始人、代理机构和企业的完整品牌命名工作流。每当用户提到“帮我给这个品牌起个名”、“品牌命名”、“我需要为……起个名字”、“……的名称灵感”、“我的品牌/公司/产品该叫什么”、“为初创公司取名”、“品牌名称建议”、“命名求助”，或分享品牌需求简报并索取名称方案时，都应使用此技能。此外，当用户分享现有名称选项并寻求对这些名称的反馈、评估、排名或评分时，也应触发此技能。系统将根据用户提供的内容自动判断是执行完整的生成工作流还是评估工作流。任何品牌或产品命名任务都应使用此技能——即使用户只是随口提到需要一个名字。

name: beautiful-shadows
description: Apply exact Tailwind arbitrary shadow utilities for polished, layered neutral elevation. Use when compact cards, controls, panels, popovers, hero media, feature callouts, or modal-like containers need refined shadows without default Tailwind shadow scales or colored tinting.
description_zh: 使用精确的 Tailwind 随机阴影工具来实现精致、层次分明的中性高度效果。适用于需要精细阴影的紧凑型卡片、控件、面板、弹出层、英雄媒体、功能提示或模态容器，且无需默认的 Tailwind 阴影等级或彩色色调。

name: tao-finetune-huggingface-model
description: Fine-tune any HuggingFace CV / VLM / LLM model on local NVIDIA GPUs inside an NGC PyTorch container when no dedicated TAO model skill matches. Use when the user wants to fine-tune a HuggingFace model (full or LoRA), train a vision / VLM / LLM model end-to-end, generate a reproducible HF training pipeline, smoke-test a HuggingFace model locally before scale-up, push a fine-tuned model to the HF Hub with a model card, or emit a self-contained rerun skill for an existing HuggingFace finetune. Supports image classification, object detection, semantic / instance / panoptic segmentation, depth estimation, image-text-to-text VLM (SFT / LoRA), and LLM SFT / DPO / GRPO. Six-step workflow: inspect and qualify, hardware and NGC image, research, generate and smoke, train + eval + infer, push and emit rerun skill. Do not use for any Hugging Face model ID claimed by a dedicated `skills/models/*` skill; the model skill and its declared execution environment take precedence.
description_zh: 在专用 TAO 模型技能不匹配的情况下，可在 NGC PyTorch 容器中的本地 NVIDIA GPU 上微调 HuggingFace CV / VLM / LLM 模型。当用户需要微调 HuggingFace 模型（完整或 LoRA）、端到端训练视觉 / VLM / LLM 模型、生成可重复的 HF 训练流程、在扩展前本地测试 HuggingFace 模型、使用模型卡将微调后的模型推送到 HF Hub，或为现有 HuggingFace 微调生成自包含的 rerun 技能时使用。支持图像分类、目标检测、语义 / 实例 / 全景分割、深度估计、图像-文本到文本 VLM（SFT / LoRA）以及 LLM SFT / DPO / GRPO。六步工作流程：检查和验证、硬件和 NGC 镜像、研究、生成和测试、训练 + 评估 + 推理、推送和生成 rerun 技能。不要用于任何被专用 `skills/models/*` 技能声明的 Hugging Face 模型 ID；模型技能及其声明的执行环境优先。

name: critique-visual-hierarchy
description: Critique a rendered screen's hierarchy — entry point, eye flow, weight distribution, and emphasis. Use when attention lands in the wrong place. For establishing hierarchy in new work, use `visual-hierarchy` (ui-design).
description_zh: 评估渲染屏幕的层级——入口点、视线流、权重分布和强调。当注意力落在错误位置时使用。在新作品中建立层级时，使用 `visual-hierarchy` (ui-design)。

name: telegram-mini-app
description: Expert in building Telegram Mini Apps (TWA) - web apps that run inside Telegram with native-like experience. Covers the TON ecosystem, Telegram Web App API, payments, user authentication, and building viral mini apps that monetize.
description_zh: Telegram 小程序（TWA）开发专家 —— 能够在 Telegram 内部运行并带来类原生体验的 Web 应用。涵盖 TON 生态系统、Telegram Web App API、支付、用户身份验证，以及打造并实现盈利的病毒式传播小程序。

name: tanstack-store
description: Framework-agnostic, immutable reactive data store with framework adapters for React, Vue, Solid, Angular, and Svelte.
description_zh: 框架无关的不可变响应式数据存储，提供 React、Vue、Solid、Angular 和 Svelte 的框架适配器。

name: pitch-deck
description: Generate professional PowerPoint pitch decks for startups and businesses. Use this skill when users request help creating investor pitch decks, sales presentations, or business pitch presentations. The skill follows standard 10-slide pitch deck structure and includes best practices for content and design.
description_zh: 为初创企业和商业生成专业的PowerPoint提案演示文稿。当用户请求帮助创建投资者提案演示文稿、销售演示文稿或商业提案演示文稿时，使用此技能。该技能遵循标准的10页提案演示文稿结构，并包含内容和设计方面的最佳实践。

name: heygen-translate
description:
Translate and dub a video into another language with voice cloning and lip-sync,
powered by HeyGen Video Translation. The presenter keeps their face, their voice
is cloned into the target language, and lips re-sync to the new audio — viewers
see the same person speaking natively.
Use when: (1) localizing an existing video into one or more languages
("translate this video to Spanish", "make this in French and German",
"dub this into Japanese", "I need this in 10 languages for a launch"),
(2) the user has a finished video and wants the SAME presenter speaking another
language (not a new presenter — that's heygen-video),
(3) podcast / audio-only translation ("translate this podcast", "dub the audio
but keep my video"),
(4) high-stakes translations where the user wants to review/edit subtitles
before final render (the proofreads workflow),
(5) "translate my video", "dub this", "localize this clip", "make a multilingual
version", "subtitle and dub".
Returns the translated video URL (or audio file for audio-only mode), one per
target language.
Chain signal: if the user wants to CREATE a new video in another language (no
source video exists yet), route to heygen-video and write the script in the
target language — do not use heygen-translate. Use heygen-translate only when
there is an existing source video to localize.
NOT for: creating new videos from scratch (use heygen-video), avatar creation
(use heygen-avatar), TTS-only synthesis (use heygen-video with audio-only
output), or text-only translation.
description_zh:
将视频翻译并配音到另一种语言，结合语音克隆和口型同步，由HeyGen视频翻译提供支持。主讲人保留其面部，声音克隆到目标语言，嘴唇重新与新的音频同步——观众看到的是同一个人以母语进行演讲。

使用场景：
(1) 将现有视频本地化为一种或多种语言（“将此视频翻译成西班牙语”、“制作法语和德语版本”、“将此配音成日语”、“我需要一个用于发布的10种语言版本”），
(2) 用户已有完成视频，并希望同一位主讲人以另一种语言进行演讲（不是新主讲人——那是heygen-video），
(3) 音频播客/纯音频翻译（“翻译此播客”、“配音但保留我的视频”），
(4) 高风险翻译，用户希望在最终渲染前审阅/编辑字幕（校对工作流程），
(5) “翻译我的视频”、“配音”、“本地化此片段”、“制作多语言版本”、“字幕和配音”。

返回值：针对每种目标语言，返回翻译后的视频URL（或纯音频模式下的音频文件）。

信号链：如果用户希望创建另一种语言的新视频（目前尚无源视频），则路由到heygen-video并在目标语言中编写脚本——不要使用heygen-translate。仅在存在现有源视频需要本地化时使用heygen-translate。

不适用于：从零开始创建新视频（使用heygen-video）、头像创建（使用heygen-avatar）、仅TTS合成（使用heygen-video并选择纯音频输出），或纯文本翻译。

name: huggingface-trackio
description: Track and visualize ML training experiments with Trackio. Use when logging metrics during training (Python API), firing alerts for training diagnostics, or retrieving/analyzing logged metrics (CLI). Supports real-time dashboard visualization, alerts with webhooks, HF Space syncing, and JSON output for automation.
description_zh: 使用 Trackio 追踪并可视化机器学习训练实验。适用场景包括：在训练过程中记录指标（Python API）、为训练诊断触发告警，或检索/分析已记录的指标（CLI）。支持实时仪表盘可视化、带 Webhook 的告警、Hugging Face Space 同步，以及用于自动化的 JSON 输出。

name: gget
description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.
description_zh: 快速CLI/Python查询20多个生物信息学数据库。用于快速检索：基因信息、BLAST/BLAT、病毒序列下载、AlphaFold结构、富集分析、OpenTargets、COSMIC、CELLxGENE以及8cube小鼠特异性/表达数据。最适合交互式探索和简单查询。批量处理或高级BLAST使用biopython；多数据库Python工作流使用bioservices。

name: paper-writing-section
description: Write a specific section of an academic paper (Abstract, Introduction, Background, Related Work, Methods, Experiments, Results, Discussion/Conclusion) with section-specific guidance and two-pass refinement. Use when the user wants to write, draft, or improve a paper section.
description_zh: 撰写学术论文的特定部分（摘要、引言、背景、相关工作、方法、实验、结果、讨论/结论），提供部分特定的指导，并进行两遍润色。适用于用户希望撰写、草拟或改进论文部分的情况。

name: datapack-builder
description: Build professional financial services data packs from various sources including CIMs, offering memorandums, SEC filings, web search, or MCP servers. Extract, normalize, and standardize financial data into investment committee-ready Excel workbooks with consistent structure, proper formatting, and documented assumptions. Use for M&A due diligence, private equity analysis, investment committee materials, and standardizing financial reporting across portfolio companies. Do not use for simple financial calculations or working with already-completed data packs.
description_zh: 从CIMs、要约收购备忘录、SEC文件、网络搜索或MCP服务器等多种来源构建专业的金融服务数据包。提取、规范化和标准化金融数据，将其转换为投资委员会准备好的Excel工作簿，具有一致的结构、正确的格式和记录的假设。用于并购尽职调查、私募股权分析、投资委员会材料以及跨投资组合公司标准化财务报告。不应用于简单的财务计算或处理已完成的数

name: migrate-app-to-flows
description: MUST be used when migrating a legacy Dune app to the new Flows app hosting infrastructure. Orchestrates the full migration: audits current state, updates app.json to appsApi infra, delegates auth wiring to setup-flows-auth, creates or updates manifest.json network permissions, and updates deploy scripts to @cognite/cli. Use this whenever a user says 'migrate to Flows', 'migrate to new infra', 'move from dune to flows', 'migrate legacy app', or wants to move their existing app to the new Flows app hosting.
description_zh: 在将传统 Dune 应用迁移至新的 Flows 应用托管基础设施时必须使用。它协调整个迁移过程：审计当前状态，将 app.json 更新为 appsApi 基础设施，将认证线路委托给 setup-flows-auth，创建或更新 manifest.json 网络权限，并更新部署脚本至 @cognite/cli。当用户表示“迁移至 Flows”、“迁移至新基础设施”、“从 Dune 迁移至 Flows”、“迁移传统应用”，或希望将现有应用迁移至新的 Flows 应用托管时，请使用此命令。

name: paper-revision
description: Revise papers based on reviewer feedback. Map reviewer concerns to specific sections, apply targeted edits, run additional experiments if needed, and verify improvements. Use after receiving peer review with revision requests.
description_zh: 根据审稿人反馈修改论文。将审稿人关注点映射到具体章节，进行针对性修改，如有必要运行额外实验，并验证改进效果。在收到同行评审及修改请求后使用。

name: affiliate-recruitment-outreach
description: Draft the outreach copy and sequence plan used to recruit new affiliates into a commission-based affiliate program - prospect qualification and tiering, pitch angle, first-touch recruitment email, follow-up sequence with a breakup touch, channel mix, and outreach tracking. Covers B2B SaaS and B2C ecommerce/DTC programs. Use whenever the user mentions recruiting affiliates, affiliate sourcing, or pitching content and review sites, coupon and cashback partners, newsletter operators, communities, podcasters, or agencies to join a program, even if they never say recruitment. Do NOT use for pitching one individually vetted creator - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-outreach instead.
description_zh: 起草用于招募新合作伙伴加入佣金制合作伙伴计划的推广文案和流程计划——包括潜在客户资格评估与分层、推销角度、首次接触招募邮件、后续跟进流程（含关键节点触达）、渠道组合及推广追踪。涵盖B2B SaaS和B2C电商/DTC项目。在用户提及招募合作伙伴、合作伙伴资源获取、内容与评审网站推广、优惠券与返现合作方、订阅邮件运营方、社群、播客主或代理机构加入项目时使用，即使他们未明确提及招募。禁止用于针对单个经过单独筛选的内容创作者进行推销——应使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-outreach。

name: wiki-dedup
description: Scan the Obsidian wiki for page-level identity collisions — different pages covering the same concept under different names (e.g. "RSC" vs "React Server Components") — and merge them. Use this skill when the user says "dedup my wiki", "find duplicate pages", "merge duplicates", "identity resolution", "consolidate my wiki", "I have duplicate pages", or "my wiki has two pages for the same thing". Distinct from wiki-lint (which checks structure) and cross-linker (which adds links) — this skill makes destructive page-level merges and requires careful confirmation.
description_zh: 扫描 Obsidian 维基以查找页面级别的身份冲突——即不同页面以不同名称涵盖同一概念（例如“RSC”与“React Server Components”）——并将它们合并。当用户说“dedup my wiki”、“find duplicate pages”、“merge duplicates”、“identity resolution”、“consolidate my wiki”、“I have duplicate pages”或“my wiki has two pages for the same thing”时，使用此技能。与 wiki-lint（检查结构）和 cross-linker（添加链接）不同——此技能会进行破坏性的页面级别合并，并需要谨慎确认。

name: phoenix-cli
description: Debug LLM applications using the Phoenix CLI. Fetch traces, spans, and sessions, annotate them, analyze errors, inspect datasets, review experiments, query annotation configs, and use the GraphQL API. Use whenever the user works with a Phoenix instance from the terminal.
description_zh: 使用 Phoenix CLI 调试 LLM 应用。获取跟踪记录、跨度、会话，进行标注，分析错误，检查数据集，审查实验，查询标注配置，并使用 GraphQL API。用户从终端与 Phoenix 实例交互时，均可使用。

name: clinical-decision-support
description: Prepare and validate research-only clinical decision-support evaluation, evidence-profile, cohort, survival, biomarker/model, privacy, and governance artifacts. Use for aggregate or synthetic research documentation and traceability—not patient care or live clinical operation.
description_zh: 准备和验证仅用于研究目的的临床决策支持评估、证据档案、队列、生存、生物标志物/模型、隐私和治理工件。用于汇总或合成研究文档和可追溯性——而非患者护理或实际临床操作。

name: om-auto-write-spec
description: Autonomously turn a brief or FR issue into a spec landed on a ready PR — runs om-spec-writing --autonomous (defaults posted for override), attaches UI mockups and current-app screenshots as PR evidence when a browser provider exists, applies full SDLC labels, and emits PR/spec markers for chaining into om-auto-implement-spec. Use for "write a spec for X and open a PR", "spec this issue".
description_zh: 自主地将一个简报或FR问题转化为一个已合并到可用的PR中的规范——运行 om-spec-writing --autonomous（默认值可用于覆盖），当存在浏览器提供者时，将UI模型和当前应用的截图作为PR证据附加，应用完整的SDLC标签，并发出PR/规范标记以链接到 om-auto-implement-spec。用于“为X编写规范并打开PR”、“规范此问题”。

name: pufferlib
description: Version-aware guidance for PufferLib reinforcement-learning environments, vectorization, policies, PuffeRL training, evaluation, and safe checkpoint review. Use when adapting Gymnasium/PettingZoo environments to published PufferLib 3.0.0 or working with the redesigned native 4.0 source line.
description_zh: 针对 PufferLib 强化学习环境、向量化、策略、PuffeRL 训练、评估和安全检查点审查的版本感知指导。在将 Gymnasium/PettingZoo 环境适配至已发布的 PufferLib 3.0.0 版本，或与重新设计的原生 4.0 源代码线合作时使用。

name: integrate-fusion-agent
description: MUST be used when adding AI, Atlas, an agent, a chat UI, or LLM features to a Flows/Fusion app. Use the Atlas/EOS sidebar via @cognite/app-sdk — not useAtlasChat, vendored atlas-agent, or per-row chat completions. Triggers: atlas, EOS, PAIA, agent chat, chat UI, sendAgentMessage, sendAgentLayoutMode, registerAgentServer, connectToHostApp, useAtlasChat, LLM. In-app chat: integrate-atlas-chat only if the host sidebar cannot work.
description_zh: 在为Flows/Fusion应用添加AI、Atlas、代理、聊天UI或LLM功能时必须使用。通过@cognite/app-sdk使用Atlas/EOS侧边栏——不要使用atlasChat、封装的atlas-agent或每行聊天完成。触发器：atlas、EOS、PAIA、代理聊天、聊天UI、sendAgentMessage、sendAgentLayoutMode、registerAgentServer、connectToHostApp、useAtlasChat、LLM。应用内聊天：仅在主机侧边栏无法工作时才集成atlas-chat。

name: pydicom
description: Use pydicom to read, inspect, write, transform, and safely preflight local DICOM datasets and pixel data. Applies to DICOM metadata, transfer syntaxes, compression plugins, frames, private elements, JSON, and bounded de-identification review.
description_zh: 使用pydicom读取、检查、写入、转换以及安全地预检本地DICOM数据集和像素数据。适用于DICOM元数据、传输语法、压缩插件、帧、私有元素、JSON以及有界去识别化审查。

name: excel-mcp
description: Excel MCP Server skill for Windows workbook automation. Use when an assistant needs rich MCP tools to create, inspect, modify, format, or analyze Excel files. Supports Power Query (M), Data Model/DAX, PivotTables, Tables, Ranges, Charts, Slicers, formatting, screenshots, VBA macros, connections, and calculation mode. Triggers: Excel, spreadsheet, workbook, xlsx, xlsm, Power Query, DAX, PivotTable, chart, dashboard, VBA, MCP.
description_zh: Excel MCP服务器技能用于Windows工作簿自动化。当助手需要丰富的MCP工具来创建、检查、修改、格式化或分析Excel文件时使用。支持Power Query（M）、数据模型/DAX、数据透视表、表格、区域、图表、切片器、格式设置、截图、VBA宏、连接和计算模式。触发器：Excel、电子表格、工作簿、xlsx、xlsm、Power Query、DAX、数据透视表、图表、仪表板、VBA、MCP。

name: who-really-owns-it
description: Research companies, directors, shareholders and ultimate beneficial ownership in official corporate registries, filings and offshore datasets — OpenCorporates, UK Companies House and the PSC register, SEC EDGAR, US Secretary of State registries, EU business registers, GLEIF LEI records, OpenOwnership, OpenSanctions and the ICIJ Offshore Leaks database. Use when asked who owns or controls a company, to find a person's other directorships, or to unpick a group structure. Applies to KYB and UBO verification, AML and sanctions screening, nominee and shell-company detection, procurement integrity, and M&A diligence. Reference at useosint.com/skills/who-really-owns-it.
description_zh: 在官方企业注册信息、申报文件和离岸数据集中调查公司、董事、股东和最终受益所有人——OpenCorporates、英国公司注册处、PSC注册处、美国证券交易委员会EDGAR、美国州务卿注册处、欧盟企业注册处、GLEIF LEI记录、OpenOwnership、OpenSanctions以及ICIJ离岸信息数据库。在询问谁拥有或控制一家公司、查找某人的其他董事职位或揭示集团结构时使用。适用于KYB和UBO验证、反洗钱和制裁筛查、代理人公司和空壳公司识别、采购诚信以及并购尽职调查。更多信息请参考useosint.com/skills/who-really-owns-it。

name: apollo-router
description: Version-aware guide for configuring and running Apollo Router for federated GraphQL supergraphs. Generates correct YAML for both Router v1.x and v2.x. Use this skill when: (1) setting up Apollo Router to run a supergraph, (2) configuring routing, headers, or CORS, (3) implementing custom plugins (Rhai scripts or coprocessors), (4) configuring telemetry (tracing, metrics, logging), (5) troubleshooting Router performance or connectivity issues, (6) securing the graph with JWT, declarative field-level authorization directives, or persisted-query safelisting, (7) managing router.yaml as version-controlled config with CI/CD validation.
description_zh: 针对联邦 GraphQL 超图的 Apollo Router 配置和运行版本指南。为 Router v1.x 和 v2.x 生成正确的 YAML 文件。在以下情况下使用此技能：(1) 设置 Apollo Router 以运行超图，(2) 配置路由、标头或 CORS，(3) 实现自定义插件（Rhai 脚本或协处理器），(4) 配置遥测（跟踪、指标、日志记录），(5) 解决 Router 性能或连接问题，(6) 使用 JWT、声明式字段级授权指令或持久化查询安全白名单来保护图，(7) 将 router.yaml 作为受版本控制的配置文件，并使用 CI/CD 进行验证。

name: modal
description: Modal is a serverless cloud platform for running Python on demand, including on-demand GPUs. Use when deploying or serving AI/ML models, running GPU-accelerated workloads (training, fine-tuning, inference), serving web endpoints, scheduling batch jobs, or scaling Python code to cloud containers with the Modal SDK.
description_zh: Modal 是一个无服务器的云平台，用于按需运行 Python，包括按需 GPU。适用于部署或服务 AI/ML 模型、运行 GPU 加速的工作负载（训练、微调、推理）、服务 Web 端点、调度批处理任务，或使用 Modal SDK 将 Python 代码扩展到云容器。

name: vaex
description: Use this skill for processing and analyzing large tabular datasets (billions of rows) that exceed available RAM. Vaex excels at out-of-core DataFrame operations, lazy evaluation, fast aggregations, efficient visualization of big data, and machine learning on large datasets. Apply when users need to work with large CSV/HDF5/Arrow/Parquet files, perform fast statistics on massive datasets, create visualizations of big data, or build ML pipelines that do not fit in memory.
description_zh: 使用此技能来处理和分析超出可用RAM的大型表格数据集（数十亿行）。Vaex擅长内存外DataFrame操作、惰性求值、快速聚合、大数据的高效可视化以及在大数据集上进行机器学习。当用户需要处理大型CSV/HDF5/Arrow/Parquet文件、对海量数据执行快速统计、创建大数据可视化，或构建内存无法容纳的机器学习管道时，请使用。

name: coverage
description: Analyze test coverage gaps. Use when user says "test coverage", "what's not tested", "coverage gaps", "missing tests", "coverage report", or "what needs testing".
description_zh: 分析测试覆盖率差距。当用户说“测试覆盖率”、“什么没测试”、“覆盖率差距”、“缺失测试”、“覆盖率报告”或“什么需要测试”时使用。

name: report
description: Generate test report. Use when user says "test report", "results summary", "test status", "show results", "test dashboard", or "how did tests go".
description_zh: 生成测试报告。当用户说“测试报告”、“结果摘要”、“测试状态”、“显示结果”、“测试仪表盘”或“测试进行得怎么样”时使用。

name: crm-lookup
description: Find a specific CRM record by ID, email, domain, or name fragment, and traverse associations for the full account picture.
description_zh: 通过ID、电子邮件、域名或名称片段查找特定的CRM记录，并遍历关联以获取完整的账户信息。

name: markdown-converter
description: Convert documents and files to Markdown using markitdown. Use when converting PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx, .xls), HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, images (with EXIF/OCR), audio (with transcription), ZIP archives, YouTube URLs, or EPubs to Markdown format for LLM processing or text analysis.
description_zh: 使用 markitdown 将文档和文件转换为 Markdown 格式。适用于将 PDF、Word (.docx)、PowerPoint (.pptx)、Excel (.xlsx, .xls)、HTML、CSV、JSON、XML、图像（带 EXIF/OCR）、音频（带字幕）、ZIP 压缩文件、YouTube URL 或 EPubs 转换为 Markdown 格式，用于 LLM 处理或文本分析。

name: scanpy
description: Standard single-cell RNA-seq analysis pipeline. Use for QC, normalization, dimensionality reduction (PCA/UMAP/t-SNE), clustering, differential expression, visualization, and converting R-friendly single-cell formats such as Seurat or SingleCellExperiment RDS files into h5ad for Scanpy. Best for exploratory scRNA-seq analysis with established workflows. For deep learning models use scvi-tools; for data format questions use anndata.
description_zh: 标准单细胞RNA测序分析流程。用于质量控制（QC）、归一化、降维（PCA/UMAP/t-SNE）、聚类、差异表达分析、可视化，以及将R友好的单细胞格式（如Seurat或SingleCellExperiment RDS文件）转换为h5ad格式以供Scanpy使用。适用于具有成熟工作流的探索性scRNA-seq分析。深度学习模型请使用scvi-tools；数据格式问题请使用anndata。

name: safe-browser
description: Build local constrained-browser agents with a safe_browser tool that owns CDP, enforces a domain allowlist with Fetch interception, and lets a runtime Claude Agent SDK agent complete browsing tasks without raw browser, shell, or CDP access. Use when the user wants an agent to browse or scrape while staying on approved domains, demo blocked off-domain navigation, or generate a safe browser client.
description_zh: 使用 safe_browser 工具构建本地受限浏览器智能体，该工具独占管理 CDP，通过 Fetch 拦截强制执行域名白名单，使运行时的 Claude Agent SDK 智能体能够完成浏览任务，同时不授予其对原始浏览器、Shell 或 CDP 的访问权限。适用于以下场景：用户希望智能体在限定在已批准域名内进行浏览或爬取、演示被拦截的跨域导航，或生成安全浏览器客户端。

name: deeptools
description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.
description_zh: NGS分析工具包。BAM到bigWig的转换，质量控制（相关性、主成分分析、指纹），热图/轮廓图（转录起始位点、峰），用于ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq可视化。

name: paywall-optimization
description: When the user wants to design, test, or optimize their app's paywall — layout, copy, pricing display, trial offers, plan structure, hard vs soft paywall, paywall placement, or paywall A/B tests. Use when the user mentions "paywall", "paywall design", "paywall conversion", "trial-to-paid", "soft paywall", "hard paywall", "paywall A/B test", "paywall copy", "plan picker", "annual vs monthly display", "best paywall", "RevenueCat paywall", "Superwall", "Adapty", or "my paywall isn't converting". For overall pricing strategy and monetization model choice, see monetization-strategy. For trial nurture, dunning, and churn, see subscription-lifecycle. For where in the onboarding the paywall fires, see onboarding-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计、测试或优化其应用的付费墙时——包括布局、文案、价格展示、试用优惠、套餐结构、硬付费墙与软付费墙、付费墙位置或付费墙A/B测试。当用户提及“付费墙”、“付费墙设计”、“付费墙转化”、“试用转付费”、“软付费墙”、“硬付费墙”、“付费墙A/B测试”、“付费墙文案”、“套餐选择器”、“年付与月付展示”、“最佳付费墙”、“RevenueCat付费墙”、“Superwall”、“Adapty”或“我的付费墙转化率不高”时使用。关于整体定价策略和变现模式选择，请参阅monetization-strategy。关于试用培育、催款和流失，请参阅subscription-lifecycle。关于付费墙在引导流程中触发的位置，请参阅onboarding-optimization。

name: huggingface-community-evals
description: Run evaluations for Hugging Face Hub models using inspect-ai and lighteval on local hardware. Use for backend selection, local GPU evals, and choosing between vLLM / Transformers / accelerate. Not for HF Jobs orchestration, model-card PRs, .eval_results publication, or community-evals automation.
description_zh: 使用 inspect-ai 和 lighteval 在本地硬件上对 Hugging Face Hub 模型进行评估。用于后端选择、本地 GPU 评估，以及选择 vLLM / Transformers / accelerate。不用于 HF Jobs 协调、模型卡 PR、.eval_results 发布或社区评估自动化。

name: deepchem
description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.
description_zh: 具有多样化特征提取器和预构建数据集的分子机器学习。适用于使用传统机器学习或图神经网络进行性质预测（ADMET、毒性），当你需要广泛的特征提取选项和MoleculeNet基准时。最适合使用预训练模型和多样化分子表示进行快速实验。对于以图为主的PyTorch工作流程，请使用torchdrug；对于基准数据集，请使用pytdc。

name: rdkit
description: Cheminformatics toolkit for fine-grained molecular control. SMILES/SDF parsing, descriptors (MW, LogP, TPSA), fingerprints, substructure search, 2D/3D generation, similarity, reactions. For standard workflows with simpler interface, use datamol (wrapper around RDKit). Use rdkit for advanced control, custom sanitization, specialized algorithms.
description_zh: 用于细粒度分子控制的化学信息学工具包。支持SMILES/SDF解析、描述符（分子量、LogP、TPSA）、指纹、子结构搜索、2D/3D生成、相似性、反应。对于标准工作流程和更简单的界面，可以使用datamol（RDKit的封装）。使用rdkit进行高级控制、自定义清理和专用算法。

name: seoul-weather-risk
description: 서울 행정동 이름을 정식명 우선·허용된 결정적 표기 별칭만으로 정규 place_id로 해석해 ASK 서울의 장소별 기상 위험 예상 시간대(weather_place_risk_window) 단일 제품을 hosted k-skill proxy에서 읽기 전용 조회한다. 사용자 API Key와 place_id 입력은 필요하지 않다.
description_zh: 将首尔行政洞名称正式名称优先，仅使用允许的决定性标识别称来解释为标准 place_id，从 ASK 首尔的地点特定气象风险预测时段（weather_place_risk_window）单一产品中，通过托管 k-skill 代理进行只读查询。无需输入用户 API Key 和 place_id。

name: om-prepare-test-env
description: Prepare a reusable, technology-agnostic environment for local tests and QA. Compiles discovery into cross-platform launch scripts, provisions the configured browser provider autonomously, and writes the shared test-env descriptor consumed by UI and integration-test skills.
description_zh: 准备一个可重用、技术无关的环境，用于本地测试和QA。将发现过程编译为跨平台启动脚本，自主配置浏览器提供程序，并编写被UI和集成测试技能使用的共享测试环境描述符。

name: prompt-engineer
description: Transforms user prompts into optimized prompts using frameworks (RTF, RISEN, Chain of Thought, RODES, Chain of Density, RACE, RISE, STAR, SOAP, CLEAR, GROW)
description_zh: 将用户提示转换为使用框架（RTF、RISEN、思维链、RODES、密度链、RACE、RISE、STAR、SOAP、CLEAR、GROW）优化后的提示

name: gtm-enterprise-onboarding
description: Four-phase framework for onboarding enterprise customers from contract to value realization. Use when implementing new enterprise customers, preventing churn during onboarding, or solving the adoption cliff that kills deals post-go-live. Includes the Week 4 ghosting pattern.
description_zh: 面向企业客户从签约到价值实现的四阶段框架。在实施新企业客户、在客户入职期间防止流失或解决上线后导致交易失败的采用悬崖问题时使用。包含第4周的“幽灵模式”。

name: redesign-existing-projects
description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.
description_zh: 将现有网站和应用程序升级至高级品质。审核当前设计，识别通用人工智能模式，并应用高端设计标准，同时不破坏功能。可与任何CSS框架或纯CSS协同工作。

name: rev-unicorn-debug
description: Debug and emulate specific code fragments or functions using the Unicorn engine. Activate when the user wants to emulate a function with Unicorn, trace binary execution without running the full program, decrypt or decode data by emulating the algorithm, or bypass environment dependencies (JNI, syscalls, libc) during emulation.
description_zh: 使用Unicorn引擎调试和模拟特定的代码片段或函数。当用户希望使用Unicorn模拟函数、在不运行完整程序的情况下跟踪二进制执行、通过模拟算法解密或解码数据，或模拟期间绕过环境依赖（JNI、系统调用、libc）时，即可激活。

name: faster-whisper
description: Local speech-to-text using faster-whisper. 4-6x faster than OpenAI Whisper with identical accuracy; GPU acceleration enables ~20x realtime transcription. SRT/VTT/TTML/CSV subtitles, speaker diarization, URL/YouTube input, batch processing with ETA, transcript search, chapter detection, per-file language map.

name: benchling-integration
description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.
description_zh: Benchling Python SDK和REST API集成用于注册实体、库存、ELN条目、工作流、Benchling应用和数据仓库查询。在通过benchling-sdk或v2 API自动化实验室数据时使用。

name: github-research
description: Explore and analyze GitHub repositories related to a research topic. Reads deep-research output, discovers repos from multiple sources, deeply analyzes code, and produces integration blueprints.
description_zh: 探索和分析与研究主题相关的GitHub仓库。阅读深度研究输出，从多个来源发现仓库，深入分析代码，并生成集成蓝图。

name: tigris-s3-migration
description: Use when migrating from AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob to Tigris — shadow buckets via `tigris buckets set-migration`, active drain via `tigris buckets migrate`, bulk copy, SDK endpoint swap, zero-downtime migration
description_zh: 在从 AWS S3、Google Cloud Storage 或 Azure Blob 迁移到 Tigris 时使用 — 通过 `tigris buckets set-migration` 设置影子存储桶，通过 `tigris buckets migrate` 进行主动排空，批量复制，SDK 端点切换，零停机迁移

name: tigris-static-assets
description: Use when deploying static assets (CSS, JS, fonts, build artifacts) to Tigris — asset pipelines, cache headers, CDN delivery, covers Next.js, Remix, Rails, Django, Laravel, Express
description_zh: 用于将静态资源（CSS、JS、字体、构建产物）部署到 Tigris — 资源管道、缓存头、CDN 分发，涵盖 Next.js、Remix、Rails、Django、Laravel、Express。

name: clawhub-skill-vetting
description: Vet ClawHub skills before installation. Use when the user asks about evaluating, auditing, or safely installing OpenClaw/ClawHub skills, or when a skill’s trustworthiness is in question.

name: frontend-design
description: Frontend design skill that generates, restyles, and guides UI development in mager's actual design taste — concept-led interfaces that feel authored, tactile, expressive, and highly usable, spanning editorial warmth, bright modern product design, and high-contrast neon systems. Use this skill when building or reviewing any frontend UI.

name: mapbox-search-integration
description: Complete workflow for implementing Mapbox search in applications - from discovery questions to production-ready integration with best practices
description_zh: 实现应用程序中的Mapbox搜索的完整工作流程——从发现性问题到采用最佳实践的生产就绪集成

name: fix
description: Fix failing or flaky Playwright tests. Use when user says "fix test", "flaky test", "test failing", "debug test", "test broken", "test passes sometimes", or "intermittent failure".
description_zh: 修复失败或不稳定的 Playwright 测试。当用户说出“修复测试”、“测试不稳定”、“测试失败”、“调试测试”、“测试损坏”、“测试有时通过”或“间歇性失败”时，请应用此操作。

name: project-artifact
description: Generate and publish a project status artifact — an opinionated, tabbed status page for a project too big for one update (overview & success criteria, the workstream sequence, next steps, plus background, plan, risks & open questions, and decisions/FAQ when they earn a tab) — published with the built-in Artifact tool to a default-private claude.ai page the user can share with teammates. Use when a piece of work spans several workstreams and you want a shareable overview kept current. Each artifact is backed by a small per-project config in the plugin data dir, so refreshing it re-gathers live state, redeploys the same URL, and reports only the delta. For software projects whose workstreams are PRs, also read swe.md (the X.Y PR-numbering convention; pulling PR state with gh/git; a per-PR detail block). Needs the built-in Artifact tool (claude.ai login). Not for single-PR changes or public docs.
description_zh: 生成并发布一个项目状态工件——一个针对规模过大的项目（概述与成功标准、工作流顺序、下一步计划，以及背景、计划、风险与开放问题，当它们获得一个标签时还会包含决策/常见问题解答）的带有标签的状态页面——使用内置的工件工具发布到默认私有的 claude.ai 页面，用户可以与团队成员共享。当一项工作涉及多个工作流，并且您希望保持可共享的概览时使用。每个工件都由插件数据目录中每个项目的小型配置文件支持，因此刷新它会重新收集实时状态、重新部署相同的 URL，并仅报告差异。对于工作流为 PR 的软件项目，还需要读取 swe.md（X.Y PR编号约定；使用 gh/git 拉取 PR 状态；每个PR的详细块）。需要内置的工件工具（claude.ai 登录）。不适用于单个 PR 的变更或公开文档。

name: bond-relative-value
description: Perform relative value analysis on bonds by combining pricing, yield curve context, credit spreads, and scenario stress testing. Use when analyzing bond richness/cheapness, computing spread decomposition, comparing bonds, assessing bond value vs curves, or running rate shock scenarios.
description_zh: 通过结合定价、收益率曲线背景、信用利差和情景压力测试，对债券进行相对价值分析。在分析债券的估值高低、计算利差分解、比较债券、评估债券价值与曲线的对比，或进行利率冲击情景分析时使用。

name: product-planner
description:
Vision intake conversation followed by generation of three product
documents — `docs/product-vision.md` (strategy and brand),
`docs/prd.md` (technical spec for coding agents), and
`docs/product-roadmap.md` (phased build plan with task checkboxes).
Also captures the founder's answers as `docs/VISION.md`. Use when the
founder says "plan my product", "plan a product", "define my vision",
"generate a PRD", "create a roadmap", "spec out my idea", "help me
build something", or wants to convert an idea into shippable spec
documents.
description_zh: 进行愿景摄入对话，随后生成三个产品文档——`docs/product-vision.md`（战略和品牌）、`docs/prd.md`（编码代理的技术规格），以及`docs/product-roadmap.md`（分阶段建设计划与任务复选框）。同时捕获创始人的回答作为`docs/VISION.md`。在创始人说“规划我的产品”、“规划一个产品”、“定义我的愿景”、“生成PRD”、“创建路线图”、“明确我的想法”、“帮助我构建某物”，或希望将想法转化为可交付的规格文档时使用。

name: datamol
description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.
description_zh: RDKit 的 Pythonic 封装，提供简化的接口和合理的默认设置。优先用于标准药物发现流程，包括 SMILES 解析、标准化、描述符、指纹、聚类、3D 构象生成以及并行处理。返回原生的 rdkit.Chem.Mol 对象。如需高级控制或自定义参数，请直接使用 rdkit。

name: pyhealth
description: Build clinical/healthcare deep-learning pipelines with PyHealth — loading EHR/signal/imaging datasets (MIMIC-III/IV, eICU, OMOP, SleepEDF, ChestXray14, EHRShot), defining tasks (mortality, readmission, length-of-stay, drug recommendation, sleep staging, ICD coding, EEG events), instantiating models (Transformer, RETAIN, GAMENet, SafeDrug, MICRON, StageNet, AdaCare, CNN/RNN/MLP), training with the PyHealth Trainer, computing clinical metrics, and using medical code utilities (ICD/ATC/NDC/RxNorm lookup and cross-mapping). Use this skill whenever the user mentions PyHealth, MIMIC, eICU, OMOP, EHR modeling, clinical prediction, drug recommendation, sleep staging, medical code mapping, ICD/ATC codes, or any healthcare ML pipeline that fits the dataset → task → model → trainer → metrics pattern, even if "PyHealth" isn't named explicitly.
description_zh: 使用 PyHealth 构建 临床/医疗 深度学习流程——加载 EHR/信号/影像数据集（MIMIC-III/IV、eICU、OMOP、SleepEDF、ChestXray14、EHRShot），定义任务（死亡率、再入院、住院时长、药物推荐、睡眠分期、ICD 编码、脑电图事件），实例化模型（Transformer、RETAIN、GAMENet、SafeDrug、MICRON、StageNet、AdaCare、CNN/RNN/MLP），使用 PyHealth 训练器进行训练，计算临床指标，并使用医疗代码工具（ICD/ATC/NDC/RxNorm 查找和交叉映射）。每当用户提到 PyHealth、MIMIC、eICU、OMOP、EHR 建模、临床预测、药物推荐、睡眠分期、医疗代码映射、ICD/ATC 代码，或任何符合数据集→任务→模型→训练器→指标模式 的医疗 ML 流程时，即使未明确提及“PyHealth”，也请使用此技能。

name: astropy
description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.
description_zh: 用于天文学和天体物理学工作流的 Python 核心库，需要 Astropy API，包括单位/量、坐标、FITS I/O、表格、时间系统、WCS 和宇宙学。在用 Astropy 实现或调试天文数据分析代码时使用。

name: pydeseq2
description: Differential gene expression analysis for bulk RNA-seq with PyDESeq2, including formulaic designs, Wald tests, FDR correction, LFC shrinkage, and result visualization.
description_zh: 使用PyDESeq2对批量RNA-seq进行差异基因表达分析，包括公式化设计、Wald检验、FDR校正、LFC收缩以及结果可视化。

name: torchdrug
description: Build and troubleshoot TorchDrug 0.2.1 workflows for molecular graphs, property prediction, self-supervised pretraining, molecule generation, retrosynthesis, protein representation learning, and knowledge graph reasoning. Use when code imports torchdrug or needs its datasets, models, tasks, or Engine.
description_zh: 构建和排错 TorchDrug 0.2.1 工作流，用于分子图、性质预测、自监督预训练、分子生成、逆合成、蛋白质表征学习和知识图谱推理。当代码需要导入 torchdrug 或使用其数据集、模型、任务或 Engine 时使用。

name: landing-page-generator
description: Deprecated compatibility entry for Landing Page construction. This page is now maintained in Pagina; install and use page-builder to build a new Landing Page.

name: experiment-design
description: Design experiment plans with progressive stages — initial implementation, baseline tuning, creative research, and ablation studies. Plan baselines, datasets, hyperparameter sweeps, and evaluation metrics. Use when planning experiments for a research paper.
description_zh: 设计具有渐进式阶段的实验计划——初始实施、基线调优、创意研究和消融研究。规划基线、数据集、超参数扫描和评估指标。在为研究论文规划实验时使用。

name: shannon-ai-pentester
description: Autonomous white-box AI pentester for web applications and APIs using source code analysis and live exploit execution
description_zh: 用于Web应用程序和API的自主白盒AI渗透测试工具，通过源代码分析和实时漏洞利用执行

name: find-leaks-in-the-wild
description: Find leaked or mentioned selectors circulating in pastes, leak forums, Telegram channels and dump markets, and judge whether a claimed leak is genuine or a recycled combolist. Covers paste aggregators, site: searches over paste hosts, channel indexes and leak-search services. Use when checking whether a name, email, domain or credential is circulating, verifying a breach claim made against your organisation, or setting up ongoing leak monitoring. Applies to incident response and breach triage, threat intelligence, brand and executive protection, and extortion-claim validation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/find-leaks-in-the-wild.
description_zh: 查找在粘贴板、泄露论坛、Telegram 频道和倒卖市场中流传或被提及的选择器，并判断声称的泄露是否真实或只是重复使用的组合列表。涵盖粘贴板聚合器、对粘贴板主机的 site: 搜索、频道索引和泄露搜索服务。在检查姓名、电子邮件、域名或凭证是否在流传、验证针对您组织的漏洞声明，或设置持续泄露监控时使用。适用于事件响应和漏洞分诊、威胁情报、品牌和高管保护，以及勒索声明验证。参考 useosint.com/skills/find-leaks-in-the-wild。

name: pr-triage
description: PRの変更内容をトリアージし、変更カテゴリ分類・表層チェック・必要リファレンス判定を行います。結果を`.pr-triage.json`に出力し、後続のコードレビューフェーズで活用します。CI環境でのコスト最適化に使用してください。
description_zh: 对PR的变更内容进行分诊，进行变更类别分类、表层检查、必要参考判定。将结果输出到`.pr-triage.json`文件中，并在后续的代码审查阶段中使用。请用于CI环境中的成本优化。

name: aws-secrets-manager
description: Secret safety for AWS Secrets Manager, secret management, credentials, API keys, tokens, and passwords. Prevents AI agents from directly fetching secret values and teaches runtime dynamic references with asm-exec so plaintext never enters the LLM context window.
description_zh: AWS Secrets Manager 的安全秘密，秘密管理，凭证，API 密钥，令牌和密码。防止 AI 代理直接获取秘密值，并使用 asm-exec 教授运行时动态引用，确保明文永远不会进入 LLM 上下文窗口。

name: imaging-data-commons
description: Query and download public cancer imaging data from NCI Imaging Data Commons. Invoke for any question about IDC collections, cancer imaging datasets, DICOM data access, radiology (CT, MR, PET) or pathology AI training sets, metadata queries, visualization, or license checks — even when the user doesn't explicitly mention "IDC". No authentication required.
description_zh: 从NCI成像数据公共平台查询并下载公共癌症影像数据。针对任何关于IDC集合、癌症影像数据集、DICOM数据访问、放射科（CT、MR、PET）或病理AI训练集、元数据查询、可视化或许可证检查的问题，均可调用——即使用户未明确提及“IDC”。无需身份验证。

name: pymatgen
description: Analyze, validate, convert, and transform materials structures and computed materials data with current pymatgen APIs, including local phase diagrams, symmetry sensitivity, electronic-structure I/O, and explicitly bounded Materials Project queries.
description_zh: 使用当前的 pymatgen API 分析、验证、转换和转换材料结构和计算材料数据，包括局部相图、对称敏感性、电子结构输入输出以及明确界定的 Materials Project 查询。

name: n8n-debugging-official
description: Use when an n8n workflow isn't working, errors appear, results don't match what was expected, or the user says "this isn't working." Triggers on errors, unexpected output, "it's not working", "why is this happening", "the workflow stopped", failure investigation, or any debugging context.
description_zh: 当n8n工作流无法正常工作、出现错误、结果与预期不符，或用户表示“这不起作用”时使用。触发条件包括错误、意外输出、“这不起作用”、“为什么会这样”、“工作流停止了”、故障排查或任何调试场景。

name: cellxgene-census
description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.
description_zh: 以编程方式查询CZ CELLxGENE普查，获取版本化的公共单细胞和空间转录组数据。当您需要群体规模的细胞元数据、基因表达切片、普查汇总计数、源H5AD URI/下载、嵌入、空间普查数据，或跨物种、组织、疾病、检测和细胞类型的参考图谱比较时使用。分析您自己的本地单细胞数据时，请使用scanpy、anndata或scvi-tools。

name: guizang-material-illustration
description: Generate Guizang-style material illustrations, labeled explanatory visuals, material-styled chart illustrations, and data-first editorial images from articles, notes, product concepts, workplace reports, creator posts, tutorials, school materials, humanities topics, science explanations, screenshots, or chart data. Use when the user asks for 配图, 带字插图, 解释图, 图解插画, 概念拆解图, 图表美化, 数据图美化, 3D 图表, 汇报配图, 内容配图, 小学课文配图, 生物/化学/物理解释图, 人文类配图, process/loop/system diagrams, or wants GPT-Image / image generation to create supporting images that can sit inside social cards, docs, slides, PPTs, or posts.

name: ai-ui-patterns
description: Teaches design patterns for building AI-powered React interfaces. Use when creating chatbots, intelligent assistants, streaming UIs, or any AI-driven user experience in React.
description_zh: 教授用于构建人工智能驱动 React 界面的设计模式。在创建聊天机器人、智能助手、流式 UI 或任何 React 中的 AI 驱动用户体验时使用。

name: fx-carry-trade
description: Evaluate FX carry trade opportunities by combining spot rates, forward points, interest rate differentials, volatility surface analysis, and historical price trends. Use when analyzing carry trades, comparing FX forward curves, assessing carry-to-vol ratios, or evaluating currency pair opportunities.
description_zh: 通过结合即期汇率、远期点差、利率差异、波动率曲面分析和历史价格趋势，评估外汇套利交易机会。适用于分析套利交易、比较外汇远期曲线、评估套利-波动率比率或评估货币对交易机会。

name: arboreto
description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.
description_zh: 使用可扩展算法（GRNBoost2、GENIE3）从基因表达数据中推断基因调控网络（GRNs）。在分析转录组数据（批量RNA-seq、单细胞RNA-seq）时使用，以识别转录因子-靶基因关系和调控相互作用。支持分布式计算，适用于大规模数据集。

name: fluidsim
description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.
description_zh: 使用显式数值有效性和HPC安全检查，规划、配置、检查、重启和分析有界流体模拟计算流体动力学模拟。用于流体模拟求解器选择、参数审查、FFT/MPI设置、输出诊断或重启兼容性。

name: zarr-python
description: Chunked N-D arrays for cloud storage (Zarr-Python 3). Compressed arrays, parallel I/O, S3/GCS via fsspec, NumPy/Dask/Xarray compatible, for large-scale scientific computing pipelines.
description_zh: 用于云存储的块状N维数组（Zarr-Python 3）。支持压缩数组、并行I/O，通过fsspec访问S3/GCS，兼容NumPy/Dask/Xarray，适用于大规模科学计算流程。

name: okx
description:
OKX OnChainOS: on-chain trading, analytics, security, DeFi across 20+ chains.

Use when running OKX-routed on-chain ops (e.g. swap on Ethereum, scan token risk, track smart money, check wallet portfolio).

Wallet: default to the user's Agent Wallet (via the `wallet` skill). Only use the OnchainOS TEE wallet (`onchainos wallet login <email>`) when the user explicitly asks for it.
description_zh:
OKX OnChainOS：跨链的链上交易、分析、安全及DeFi解决方案。

适用于运行OKX路由的链上操作（例如：在以太坊上进行交换、扫描代币风险、追踪智能资金、检查钱包投资组合）。

钱包：默认使用用户的代理钱包（通过`wallet`技能）。仅在用户明确要求时使用OnChainOS TEE钱包（`onchainos wallet login <email>`）。

name: tax-prep
description: Prepares tax materials as a two-link chain — month-end-prep confirms the books are closed and reconciled first, then tax-season-organizer calculates the quarterly estimated payment or builds the year-end 1099-NEC list and accountant packet from those closed numbers. Requires a ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books); uses Gusto, PayPal, and Stripe when connected, else CSV upload. US federal tax math; a non-US business gets the closed-books packet. Prep material for a CPA, never tax advice, nothing filed. Trigger on "quarterly taxes," "estimated tax payment," "how much should I set aside," "1099s," "1099-NEC," "W-9s," "year-end tax prep," "get my books ready for my accountant," any phrasing that suggests a tax deadline is coming, or a question about net profit or YTD income that sounds like worry about a tax bill. An owner who says the period's books are already closed routes to tax-season-organizer directly.
description_zh: 准备税务材料作为两环链——月末准备确认账目已关闭和核对，然后税务季节组织者根据这些关闭的数字计算季度预估付款或构建年终1099-NEC清单和会计师文件包。需要账簿（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero或Zoho Books）；连接时使用Gusto、PayPal和Stripe，否则进行CSV上传。美国联邦税务计算；非美国企业获取关闭账目文件包。为注册会计师准备材料，非税务建议，不提交任何文件。触发条件为“季度税务”、“预估税款支付”、“我应该预留多少”、“1099”、“1099-NEC”、“W-9”、“年终税务准备”、“为我的会计师准备好账目”、“任何暗示税务截止日期临近的措辞”，或关于净利润或累计收入且听起来像担心税务账单的问题。如果所有者表示该期账目已关闭，则直接路由至税务季节组织者。

name: gdpr-compliant
description: Apply GDPR-compliant engineering practices across your codebase. Use this skill whenever you are designing APIs, writing data models, building authentication flows, implementing logging, handling user data, writing retention/deletion jobs, designing cloud infrastructure, or reviewing pull requests for privacy compliance. Trigger this skill for any task involving personal data, user accounts, cookies, analytics, emails, audit logs, encryption, pseudonymization, anonymization, data exports, breach response, CI/CD pipelines that process real data, or any question framed as "is this GDPR-compliant?". Inspired by CNIL developer guidance and GDPR Articles 5, 25, 32, 33, 35.
description_zh: 在您的代码库中应用符合GDPR规范的工程实践。在您设计API、编写数据模型、构建身份验证流程、实现日志记录、处理用户数据、编写保留/删除任务、设计云基础设施或审查隐私合规的拉取请求时，请使用此技能。针对涉及个人数据、用户账户、Cookie、分析、电子邮件、审计日志、加密、假名化、匿名化、数据导出、安全事件响应、处理真实数据的CI/CD流水线，或以“这是否符合GDPR规范？”为形式的任何问题，均可触发此技能。此技能灵感来源于CNIL开发者指南以及GDPR第5、25、32、33、35条。

name: adaptyv
description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.
description_zh: 如何使用Adaptyv Bio Foundry API和Python SDK进行蛋白质实验设计、提交和结果检索。当用户提到Adaptyv、Foundry API、蛋白质结合测定、蛋白质筛选实验、BLI/SPR测定、热稳定性测定，或希望提交蛋白质序列进行实验表征时，请使用此技能。此外，当代码导入`adaptyv`、`adaptyv_sdk`或`FoundryClient`，或引用`foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`时，也会触发。

name: molecular-dynamics
description: Run and analyze molecular dynamics simulations with OpenMM and MDAnalysis. Set up protein/small molecule systems, define force fields, run energy minimization and production MD, analyze trajectories (RMSD, RMSF, contact maps, free energy surfaces). For structural biology, drug binding, and biophysics.
description_zh: 使用 OpenMM 和 MDAnalysis 运行和分析分子动力学模拟。设置蛋白质/小分子系统，定义力场，运行能量最小化和生成MD，分析轨迹（RMSD、RMSF、接触图、自由能表面）。适用于结构生物学、药物结合和生物物理学。

name: om-root-cause
description: Read-only root-cause analysis for a tracker issue. Identifies the bug's location and the minimal change surface so the next agent can implement the fix without re-exploring the repo. Outputs a short summary, the files that need to change, and the proposed approach.
description_zh: 针对追踪器问题的只读根本原因分析。识别出错误的位置和最小变更范围，以便下一个代理无需重新探索代码库即可实施修复。输出简短摘要、需要修改的文件以及建议的方法。

name: desktop-commander-overview
description: Use for Desktop Commander MCP capabilities — persistent shells and REPLs, long-running processes, filesystem beyond the workspace, structured files (.xlsx, .docx, .pdf, images) and large local data files such as CSVs, ripgrep search at scale, SSH, or cross-turn state.
description_zh: 用于桌面命令器MCP功能——持久性Shell和REPL、长期运行进程、工作区之外的文件系统、结构化文件（.xlsx、.docx、.pdf、图片）以及大型本地数据文件（如CSV），大规模ripgrep搜索、SSH或跨回合状态。

name: github-actions-efficiency
description: Audit GitHub Actions workflow efficiency and recommend fixes to reduce CI minutes and costs.
description_zh: 审计 GitHub Actions 工作流效率，并推荐修复措施以减少 CI 分钟数和成本。

name: scvi-tools
description: Deep generative models for single-cell omics. Use when you need probabilistic batch correction (scVI), transfer learning, differential expression with uncertainty, or multi-modal integration (TOTALVI, MultiVI). Best for advanced modeling, batch effects, multimodal data. For standard analysis pipelines use scanpy.
description_zh: 单细胞组学深度生成模型。当您需要概率批次校正（scVI）、迁移学习、带不确定性的差异表达或多模态整合（TOTALVI、MultiVI）时使用。适用于高级建模、批次效应和多模态数据。标准分析流程请使用scanpy。

name: mongodb
description: Work with MongoDB databases using best practices. Use when designing schemas, writing queries, building aggregation pipelines, or optimizing performance. Triggers on MongoDB, Mongoose, NoSQL, aggregation pipeline, document database, MongoDB Atlas.
description_zh: 使用 MongoDB 数据库的最佳实践。在设计模式、编写查询、构建聚合管道或优化性能时使用。MongoDB、Mongoose、NoSQL、聚合管道、文档数据库、MongoDB Atlas。

name: neurokit2
description: Use NeuroKit2 to build or audit reproducible research workflows for physiological time-series preprocessing, event/interval analysis, multimodal alignment, variability, and complexity. Trigger when code imports neurokit2 or needs its current APIs, schemas, and method-aware validation—not for diagnosis or device validation.
description_zh: 使用 NeuroKit2 构建或审核可重复研究的生理时间序列预处理、事件/间隔分析、多模态对齐、变异性及复杂性工作流程。当代码导入 neurokit2 或需要其当前 API、模式和方法感知验证时触发——但不用于诊断或设备验证。

name: partner-channel-program
description: Design the overall structure of a B2B partner or channel program from scratch - a readiness gate that can conclude not yet, partner value proposition, which motions to run (referral, reseller, services, technology), tier count, benefit stack, program-wide economics envelope, governance, and success horizon. Covers B2C analogs (dealer, franchise, ambassador). Use whenever the user mentions building a partner program, channel program design, launching a channel, a partner ecosystem program, or asks whether they are ready for partners, even if they never say program. Do NOT use for reworking tiers inside a program that already exists - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-tiering instead.
description_zh: 从头开始设计 B2B 合作伙伴或渠道计划的整体结构——一个可以得出尚未结论的“准备就绪”门槛、合作伙伴价值主张、计划运行方向（如推荐、分销商、服务、技术）、层级数量、利益组合、计划整体经济框架、治理机制以及成功预期。涵盖 B2C 类似案例（如经销商、特许经营商、大使）。在用户提及构建合作伙伴计划、渠道计划设计、启动渠道、合作伙伴生态系统计划，或询问他们是否已准备好与合作伙伴合作时（即使他们从未提及“计划”一词）均可使用。不适用于已存在计划内部层级结构的调整——应使用 mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-tiering。

name: partner-ecosystem-expansion
description: Decide which partner categories to add next to a partner ecosystem and in what sequence  -  a staged partner-category expansion roadmap with readiness gates, capacity limits, and kill criteria. Covers B2B categories (tech/ISV, reseller/VAR, MSP, SI/GSI, agency, referral/affiliate, marketplace) and consumer-side equivalents (retail/wholesale, creator, licensing, co-branding). Use whenever the user mentions partner ecosystem expansion, partner category planning, a partner mix roadmap, or asks which partner type to launch next, even if they never say expansion. Category-level sequencing only. Do NOT use for ranking named candidate companies  -  use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@alliance-prioritization instead.
description_zh: 确定要在合作伙伴生态系统中添加哪些合作伙伴类别，以及添加的顺序——制定一个分阶段的合作伙伴类别扩展路线图，包含准备就绪关卡、容量限制和淘汰标准。涵盖 B2B 类别（技术/ISV、分销商/VAR、MSP、系统集成商/GSI、代理商、推荐/联盟、市场）以及消费者端的对应类别（零售/批发、创作者、许可、联合品牌）。在用户提及合作伙伴生态系统扩展、合作伙伴类别规划、合作伙伴组合路线图，或询问下一步应启动哪种合作伙伴类型时使用，即使他们从未明确提及扩展。仅限类别级别的排序。请勿用于对命名候选公司进行排名——应使用 mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@alliance-prioritization。

name: partnerships-kickoff
description: Before starting any partnerships work - and before routing to any other skill in the mbfinotti/partnerships-skills collection - run this router first. It matches the task (channel, alliance, co-sell, marketplace, affiliate, influencer, or referral) to exactly one sibling skill, says plainly when none fits, and bootstraps or resumes the project's shared partnerships-context.md artifact so the next session starts warm instead of cold. Use whenever the user opens a partnerships project, asks which partnerships skill they need, resumes partner work after a gap, runs a periodic partner, affiliate or influencer check-in, or describes a partner, creator or commission problem without naming a skill - even if they never say kickoff, routing or partnerships, and even when they name a downstream task directly. Routing and shared context only - it never does a sibling skill's work itself, and always emits the full owner/repo@skill target it routes to.
description_zh: 在开始任何合作伙伴关系工作之前——以及在路由到 `mbfinotti/partnerships-skills` 集合中的任何其他技能之前——请先运行此路由器。它将任务（渠道、联盟、联合销售、市场、联盟营销、影响者或推荐）匹配到恰好一个兄弟技能，在没有任何匹配项时明确说明，并启动或恢复项目的共享合作伙伴关系上下文文件 `partnerships-context.md`，以便下一次会话能够热启动而不是冷启动。在用户打开合作伙伴关系项目、询问需要哪个合作伙伴关系技能、在间隙后恢复合作伙伴工作、运行定期的合作伙伴、联盟营销或影响者检查、或描述一个合作伙伴、创作者或佣金问题但不指明技能时，都可以使用它——即使他们从未提及启动、路由或合作伙伴关系，即使他们直接指明下游任务。仅进行路由和共享上下文——它本身从不执行兄弟技能的工作，并且始终发出它路由到的完整所有者/仓库@技能目标。

name: idea-validator
description:
Pressure-tests a product idea before the founder invests in planning,
building, or launching. Surfaces fatal flaws, tests whether the problem
is real, maps real competition (including current behavior), plans first
10 customers, defines a 2-week MVP test, returns a strong/weak/pivot
verdict, then sharpens `docs/product-idea.md` based on the founder's
direction calls. Use when the founder says "validate my idea",
"pressure-test", "is this idea good", "find fatal flaws",
"stress test my idea", or otherwise wants to evaluate an idea before
committing.
description_zh: 在创始人投入规划、构建或发布产品之前，对产品构想进行压力测试。揭示致命缺陷，验证问题是否真实，分析真实竞争情况（包括当前行为），规划首批10位客户，定义为期2周的MVP测试，并给出强效/弱效/转向的判断结果，然后根据创始人的方向指引，修订`docs/product-idea.md`文档。当创始人表示“验证我的构想”、“进行压力测试”、“这个构想好吗”、“找出致命缺陷”、“对我的构想进行压力测试”，或以其他方式希望在投入前评估构想时使用。

name: esm
description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.
description_zh: 在直接使用 `esm` Python SDK、ESM3 或 ESMC 模型 ID、Forge/Biohub 推理客户端或 ESMFold2 折叠工作流程时使用。

name: pysam
description: Python/HTSlib workflows for genomic files. Use when reading, querying, filtering, or writing SAM/BAM/CRAM, VCF/BCF, FASTA/FASTQ, or tabix data with pysam, including pileup, coverage, indexing, and CRAM references.
description_zh: 用于基因组文件的 Python/HTSlib 工作流程。使用 pysam 读取、查询、过滤或写入 SAM/BAM/CRAM、VCF/BCF、FASTA/FASTQ 或 tabix 数据，包括 pileup、覆盖率、索引和 CRAM 参考信息。

name: partner-economics
description: Model the unit economics of one partner relationship - partner P&L, margin modeling, cost-to-serve, referral-fee and lifetime-value split, channel partner ROI, partner CAC vs direct CAC, ramp and payback - to decide whether to sign, scale, renegotiate, or exit that partner. Covers B2B channel and alliance partners plus B2C affiliate and creator economics. Use whenever the user mentions partnership unit economics, a single-partner business case, reseller, VAR, MSP, OEM or marketplace deal economics, revenue-share and margin-stack analysis, or asks whether a partner is worth pursuing, even if they never say economics. Do NOT use for ranking a portfolio of candidates - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@alliance-prioritization instead.
description_zh: 对单一合作伙伴关系的单位经济进行建模——包括合作伙伴损益表、利润率建模、服务成本、推荐费和终身价值分配、渠道合作伙伴投资回报率、合作伙伴客户获取成本与直接客户获取成本对比、增长和回收期——以决定是否签约、扩大规模、重新谈判或退出该合作伙伴。涵盖B2B渠道和联盟合作伙伴，以及B2C联盟和创作者经济模型。在用户提及合作伙伴单位经济、单一合作伙伴商业案例、分销商、增值经销商、托管服务提供商、原始设备制造商或市场平台交易经济、收入分成和利润率分析，或询问是否值得追求合作伙伴时（即使他们未明确提及经济）使用。不应用于对候选组合进行排名——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@alliance-prioritization。

name: compose-focus-navigation
description: Use when writing or reviewing Jetpack Compose UI for TV, keyboard, desktop, accessibility focus, D-pad navigation, FocusRequester, focusProperties, key events, or initial focus behavior.
description_zh: 在编写或审查适用于电视、键盘、桌面、可访问性焦点、方向键导航、FocusRequester、focusProperties、按键事件或初始焦点行为时的Jetpack Compose UI时使用。

name: quality-playbook
description: Run a complete quality engineering audit on any codebase. Derives behavioral requirements from the code, generates spec-traced functional tests, runs a three-pass code review with regression tests, executes a multi-model spec audit (Council of Three), and produces a consolidated bug report with TDD-verified patches. Finds the 35% of real defects that structural code review alone cannot catch. Works with any language. Trigger on 'quality playbook', 'spec audit', 'Council of Three', 'fitness-to-purpose', or 'coverage theater'.
description_zh: 对任何代码库进行完整的质量工程审计。从代码中提取行为需求，生成规范跟踪的功能测试，执行三遍代码审查并运行回归测试，进行多模型规范审计（三人议会），并生成包含TDD验证补丁的整合缺陷报告。能够发现仅通过结构化代码审查无法捕获的35%真实缺陷。支持任何编程语言。可通过“质量剧本”、“规范审计”、“三人议会”、“适用性测试”或“覆盖率剧场”触发。

name: dhdna-profiler
description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.
description_zh: 从任何文本中提取认知模式和思维指纹。当用户想要分析某人的思维方式、了解认知风格、分析写作或演讲模式、比较不同人的思维风格，或询问“我的思维风格是什么”、“分析这个人的推理方式”、“认知画像”、“思维模式”、“DHDNA”、“数字DNA”，以及想要了解任何文本背后的思维时，使用这项技能。此外，当用户提供文本并希望深入洞察作者的推理模式、决策风格或认知特征时，也会触发该技能。

name: gpt-taste
description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.
description_zh: 精英级UX/UI与高级GSAP动效工程师。坚持使用Python驱动的真正随机化布局差异，严格遵循AIDA页面结构，采用宽版编辑字体（禁止6行换行），无缝嵌套的便当格布局，严格规范的GSAP ScrollTriggers（固定、堆叠、滚动），内联微型图片，以及大间距的章节排版。

name: gstack-workflow-assistant
description: Team of specialist AI workflows for Claude Code with CEO review, engineering planning, code review, shipping, QA testing, and browser automation
description_zh: Claude Code的专业AI工作流程团队，包括CEO审核、工程规划、代码审查、发布、质量保证测试和浏览器自动化。

name: content-strategy
description: Analyzes sales data from PayPal and QuickBooks to find top performers and slow movers, layers in seasonality, and produces a prioritized 30-day content brief: what to push, what offers to run, what to hold. Strategic output only — no calendars or assets. Use when the user asks what to post, wants a content plan, asks what's selling, or what to promote this month.
description_zh: 分析 PayPal 和 QuickBooks 的销售数据，找出表现优异和滞销的产品，分析季节性因素，并生成一个优先级为30天的内容简报：要推广什么、要运行哪些促销活动、要暂缓哪些内容。仅输出战略性内容——不包含日历或资产。当用户询问要发布什么内容、需要内容计划、询问哪些产品在销售或本月要推广什么时使用。

name: mermaid-visualizer
description: Transform text content into professional Mermaid diagrams for presentations and documentation. Use when users ask to visualize concepts, create flowcharts, or make diagrams from text. Supports process flows, system architectures, comparisons, mindmaps, and more with built-in syntax error prevention.
description_zh: 将文本内容转换为专业的 Mermaid 图表，用于演示文稿和文档。当用户要求可视化概念、创建流程图或从文本制作图表时使用。支持流程图、系统架构、比较、思维导图等，并内置语法错误预防功能。

name: launch-checklist
description: Use when the user's product is built (or nearly built) and they want to get it live and accessible to customers. Triggers on phrases like "create my launch checklist", "how do I deploy this", "help me launch", "get this live", "put this in production", "ship it to customers", "what do I need to do to go live", or any request for a step-by-step path from working code to a product customers can use. Audits the current codebase — stack, services, environment variables, payments, deploy config — then writes a plain-English, step-by-step launch guide to `docs/launch-checklist.md`. Every step is marked as something the user must do themselves, something their coding agent can do, or both together, and all technical terms are explained for non-technical founders.
description_zh: 当用户的产品已构建（或接近完成）并希望将其上线供客户使用时使用。当用户输入类似“创建我的发布清单”、“如何部署这个”、“帮助我发布”、“让这个上线”、“将其投入生产”、“将它交付给客户”、“我需要做些什么才能上线”或任何从可运行代码到客户可使用产品的分步路径请求时，将触发该功能。该功能会审计当前代码库——包括技术栈、服务、环境变量、支付方式、部署配置等——然后生成一份简体中文的、分步骤的发布指南，并写入`docs/launch-checklist.md`文件。每个步骤都会标记为用户必须亲自完成、其编码代理可以完成，或两者共同完成，并且所有技术术语都会为非技术型创始人进行解释。

name: translate-book
description: Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.

name: e2e-testing
description: End-to-end testing patterns with Playwright for full-stack Python/React applications. Use when writing E2E tests for complete user workflows (login, CRUD, navigation), critical path regression tests, or cross-browser validation. Covers test structure, page object model, selector strategy (data-testid > role > label), wait strategies, auth state reuse, test data management, and CI integration. Does NOT cover unit tests or component tests (use pytest-patterns or react-testing-patterns).
description_zh: 使用 Playwright 对全栈 Python/React 应用进行端到端测试的模式。适用于编写完整用户工作流（登录、CRUD、导航）、关键路径回归测试或跨浏览器验证的 E2E 测试。涵盖测试结构、页面对象模型、选择器策略（data-testid > role > label）、等待策略、认证状态复用、测试数据管理以及 CI 集成。**不包括**单元测试或组件测试（请使用 pytest-patterns 或 react-testing-patterns）。

name: pathml
description: Use PathML for local, research-only computational pathology workflows: load and tile slides, build preprocessing and QC pipelines, manage h5path data, quantify multiplex images, construct spatial graphs, and plan bounded model inference.
description_zh: 使用 PathML 进行本地、仅供研究使用的计算病理工作流程：加载和瓦片切片、构建预处理和QC流程、管理h5path数据、量化多重图像、构建空间图，以及规划有界模型推理。

name: where-was-this-taken
description: End-to-end workflow to establish where and when a photo or video was captured and whether it is authentic — evidentiary handling, metadata extraction, reverse image search for provenance, visual geolocation, chronolocation from shadows, and manipulation checks, ending in a location finding with a stated confidence radius. Use when asked to verify where an image was taken, confirm or refute a claimed location or date, or authenticate media before relying on it. Applies to insurance claims, litigation evidence, disinformation analysis, and conflict and human-rights documentation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/where-was-this-taken.
description_zh: 端到端工作流程，用于确定照片或视频的拍摄地点和时间，并判断其真实性——证据处理、元数据提取、溯源反向图像搜索、视觉地理定位、阴影时间定位以及篡改检查，最终以带有置信半径的定位结果结束。在需要验证图像拍摄地点、确认或反驳声称的地点或日期，或在依赖媒体内容前进行认证时使用。适用于保险理赔、诉讼证据、虚假信息分析以及冲突和人权记录。使用时参考 useosint.com/skills/where-was-this-taken。

name: partner-channel-conflict
description: Write the channel conflict rules that govern contested deals between direct sales and channel partners or between partners - rules of engagement, account segmentation, named-account carve-outs, deal registration as a claim instrument (protection window, tie-break, rejection grounds), compensation neutrality for direct reps, escalation and adjudication ladders, and governance cadence. Also covers consumer brands (D2C vs retail conflict, MAP policy, channel-exclusive assortment). Use whenever the user mentions channel conflict, partner disputes, deal poaching, or two routes to market claiming the same account, even if they never say conflict. Do NOT use for designing the co-sell operating model - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@co-selling-strategy instead.
description_zh: 编写管理直接销售与渠道合作伙伴之间或合作伙伴之间的争议交易的渠道冲突规则——包括参与规则、账户划分、指定账户划分、交易注册作为权利主张工具（保护期、裁决机制、拒绝理由）、直接代表的补偿中立性、升级和裁决阶梯，以及治理节奏。此外还涵盖消费者品牌（D2C与零售冲突、MAP政策、渠道独家产品组合）。在用户提及渠道冲突、合作伙伴纠纷、交易窃取或两条市场路线主张同一账户时使用，即使他们从未明确提及冲突。不适用于设计联合销售运营模式——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@co-selling-strategy。

name: anthropic-cybersecurity-skills
description: Use 754 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, ATLAS, D3FEND, and NIST AI RMF for AI-driven security operations
description_zh: 使用754项结构化网络安全技能，与MITRE ATT&CK、NIST CSF、ATLAS、D3FEND和NIST AI RMF进行映射，以实现AI驱动的安全运营

name: enterprise
description: Dark-themed cloud-platform aesthetic with modular grids, glass-like panels, and strong data hierarchy for productivity dashboards.
description_zh: 深色主题云平台美学，采用模块化网格、玻璃状面板和清晰的数据层级，适用于生产力仪表盘。

name: idea-generator
description:
Guided discovery of a product idea by mining what the founder already knows
or already does — covers source selection (business vs. expertise),
context capture, pattern synthesis, candidate scorecard, and writes
`docs/product-idea.md`. Use when the founder says "generate an idea",
"help me find an idea", "what should I build", "product idea from my
business", "product idea from my expertise", or otherwise needs to discover
a product concept worth building.
description_zh: 通过挖掘创始人已知信息或已做之事来引导式发现产品创意——涵盖信息源选择（商业 vs. 专业知识）、情境捕捉、模式合成、候选方案评分卡，并生成 `docs/product-idea.md` 文件。适用于创始人提出“生成一个创意”、“帮我找一个创意”、“我应该构建什么”、“来自我业务的创意”、“来自我专业知识的创意”，或需要发现值得构建的产品概念的情况。

name: github-actions-hardening
description: Security hardening reviewer for GitHub Actions workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml). Reasons about the Actions threat model that pattern matchers and general code linters miss — untrusted-input script injection, privileged triggers running fork code, mutable action references, and over-scoped tokens. Use this skill when asked to review, audit, harden, or secure a GitHub Actions workflow, when writing a new workflow, or for any request like "is this workflow safe?", "review my CI for security issues", "why is pull_request_target dangerous here?", "pin my actions", or "lock down GITHUB_TOKEN permissions". Covers script injection via ${{ }} interpolation, pull_request_target / workflow_run privilege escalation, SHA-pinning of third-party actions, least-privilege permissions, GITHUB_ENV/GITHUB_OUTPUT injection, secret exposure, OIDC over long-lived credentials, and self-hosted runner exposure on public repositories.
description_zh: GitHub Actions 工作流文件（.github/workflows/*.yml）的安全加固审查者。关于 Actions 威胁模型中模式匹配器和通用代码静态分析器会遗漏的问题——不受信任的输入脚本注入、特权触发器运行 fork 代码、可变动作引用以及权限过宽的令牌。当被要求审查、审计、加固或保护 GitHub Actions 工作流时，编写新工作流时，或遇到类似“这个工作流是否安全？”、“审查我的 CI 以发现安全问题”、“为什么 pull_request_target 在此处危险？”、“固定我的 actions”或“锁定 GITHUB_TOKEN 权限”等请求时，请使用这项技能。涵盖通过 `${{ }}` 插值进行的脚本注入、pull_request_target / workflow_run 特权提升、第三方 actions 的 SHA 固定、最小权限权限、GITHUB_ENV/GITHUB_OUTPUT 注入、秘密泄露、OIDC 长期凭证、以及公共仓库中自托管运行器的暴露。

name: influencer-campaign-brief
description: Draft the creative campaign brief a brand hands to an already-signed influencer or creator for one campaign - deliverables with exact specs, key messages with proof points, brand guardrails, disclosure requirements, timeline, and bounded review rounds, split into non-negotiables vs preferences. Covers B2C brand collabs and B2B creator programs. Use whenever the user mentions a creator brief, campaign brief, content brief, creator deliverables, or briefing a creator they just signed, even if they never say brief. Starts after the deal is signed and reflects its terms exactly. Do NOT use for picking or vetting the creator - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-discovery-brief instead.
description_zh: 为品牌方与已签约的网红或创作者合作制定创意活动简报——包含具体规格、核心信息及证明点、品牌规范、披露要求、时间表和有限评审轮次，并区分不可协商项与偏好项。涵盖B2C品牌合作与B2B创作者项目。用户在提及创作者简报、活动简报、内容简报、创作者交付成果或向刚签约的创作者进行简报时，无论是否明确提及“简报”一词，均适用。该简报在协议签署后生效，并精确反映协议条款。请勿用于创作者选择或评估——应使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-discovery-brief。

name: influencer-discovery-brief
description: Define creator sourcing criteria and produce the discovery brief used to shortlist candidate influencers and creators - weighted criteria for audience fit, engagement quality, niche consistency and brand safety, knockout screens, and a ranked shortlist scoring template with evidence per score. Covers B2C brand campaigns and B2B creator and thought-leader programs. Use whenever the user mentions finding creators, vetting influencers, audience fit, creator shortlists, or deciding which creators to approach, even if they never say discovery. Runs before any contact. Do NOT use for writing the pitch message itself - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-outreach instead.
description_zh: 定义创作者筛选标准，并制作用于筛选候选影响者和创作者的发现简报——包含权重标准（受众匹配度、互动质量、细分领域一致性及品牌安全）、淘汰筛选标准，以及带有每项评分证据的排名短名单评分模板。涵盖B2C品牌活动和B2B创作者及思想领袖项目。在用户提及寻找创作者、筛选影响者、受众匹配度、创作者短名单或决定接触哪些创作者时使用，即使他们从未提及“发现”环节。在接触前执行。请勿用于撰写提案信息本身——应使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-outreach。

name: day2-create-context-sync-skill
description: AI Native Camp Day 2 Context Sync 스킬 만들기. 여러 외부 도구에서 컨텍스트를 수집하여 하나의 sync 문서로 만드는 나만의 스킬을 직접 구축한다. "2일차", "Day 2", "context sync", "컨텍스트 싱크", "sync 스킬", "스킬 만들기", "정보 수집 스킬" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI Native Camp Day 2 上下文同步技能制作。从多个外部工具中收集上下文，将其制作成一个同步文档，自己动手构建专属的同步技能。使用“2日”，“Day 2”，“上下文同步”，“context sync”，“同步技能”，“技能制作”，“信息收集技能”等请求。

name: create-website
description: Guided journey from a blank page to a live, high-converting website, built message-first, then design, then conversion. Orchestrates ten skills phase by phase - one-page-marketing, storybrand-messaging, made-to-stick, top-design, web-typography, refactoring-ui, ux-heuristics, cro-methodology, scorecard-marketing, steve-jobs-design-review - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (POSITIONING.md, WEBSITE.md, CREATE-WEBSITE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to build a new website or landing page from scratch, turn a validated idea into a page that converts, or says 'build me a landing page for my SaaS'. Site already exists: use improve-website site-wide, conversion-optimization for one flow, or grow-website for traffic; building a software product, not a marketing site: create-app; no positioning yet: create-business first, or the positioning phase here.
