For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从空白页到高转化率的网站，提供引导式旅程，以内容为先，再设计，最后优化转化。分阶段逐步掌握十项技能——单页营销、故事品牌传播、易于记忆、顶尖设计、网页排版、UI重构、用户体验启发法、转化率优化方法论、评分卡营销、乔布斯设计评审——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹中（POSITIONING.md、WEBSITE.md、CREATE-WEBSITE-PLAN.md），以便跨会话继续旅程。适用于用户想从零开始构建新网站或落地页、将验证过的想法转化为转化页面，或说“为我构建一个SaaS落地页”。网站已存在：使用improve-website进行全局优化，conversion-optimization针对单一流程，或grow-website提升流量；构建软件产品而非营销网站：使用create-app；尚未定位：先使用create-business，或在此进行定位阶段。若仅针对单一框架，可直接调用该技能。

name: generate
description: Generate Playwright tests. Use when user says "write tests", "generate tests", "add tests for", "test this component", "e2e test", "create test for", "test this page", or "test this feature".
description_zh: 生成 Playwright 测试用例。当用户说“写测试”、“生成测试”、“为...添加测试”、“测试这个组件”、“端到端测试”、“为...创建测试”、“测试这个页面”或“测试这个功能”时使用。

name: obsidian
description: Activate when the user mentions their Obsidian vault, notes, tags, frontmatter, daily notes, backup, or sync. Route operations across MCP, Obsidian CLI/app actions, and git sync with safe defaults.
description_zh: 当用户提及他们的 Obsidian 档案库、笔记、标签、元数据、每日笔记、备份或同步时激活。通过 MCP、Obsidian CLI/应用操作以及 git 同步进行路由操作，并采用安全默认设置。

name: depmap
description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.
description_zh: 查询癌症依赖图谱（DepMap）以获取癌细胞系基因依赖评分（CRISPR Chronos）、药物敏感性数据和基因效应特征。用于识别癌症特异性弱点、合成致死相互作用以及验证肿瘤药物靶点。

name: diffdock
description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.
description_zh: DiffDock和DiffDock-L分子对接。用于从PDB或序列加SMILES/SDF/MOL2进行蛋白质小分子构象预测、批量对接、虚拟筛选和构象置信度解释。不用于结合亲和力预测。

name: phylogenetics
description: Build and analyze phylogenetic trees using MAFFT (multiple alignment), IQ-TREE 2 (maximum likelihood), and FastTree (fast NJ/ML). Visualize with ETE3 or FigTree. For evolutionary analysis, microbial genomics, viral phylodynamics, protein family analysis, and molecular clock studies.
description_zh: 使用 MAFFT（多重序列比对）、IQ-TREE 2（最大似然）和 FastTree（快速 NJ/ML）构建和分析系统发育树。使用 ETE3 或 FigTree 进行可视化。用于进化分析、微生物基因组学、病毒系统发育动力学、蛋白质家族分析和分子钟研究。

name: od-contribute
description: One-click contribution flow for OpenDesign (nexu-io/open-design) — even for non-coders. Pick one of four cards (ship a Skill or Design System you made with OD; translate docs; fix a typo / write a blog; report a bug), the agent validates and opens a PR (or issue) for you. Trigger words contribute to open design, ship my OD skill, ship my OD design system, translate OD docs, report an OD bug, od-contribute.
description_zh: OpenDesign（nexu-io/open-design）的一键贡献流程——即使对于非程序员也是如此。从四个选项中选择一个卡片（使用OD开发的技能或设计系统进行发布；翻译文档；修正错别字/撰写博客；报告错误），代理将为您验证并打开PR（或问题）。触发词包括：贡献于开放设计、发布我的OD技能、发布我的OD设计系统、翻译OD文档、报告OD错误、od-contribute。

name: documentation-templates
description: Documentation templates and structure guidelines. README, API docs, code comments, and AI-friendly documentation.
description_zh: 文档模板和结构指南。README、API文档、代码注释和AI友好的文档。

name: tigris-agent-kit
description: Use when building AI agent storage workflows on Tigris — forks for isolated dataset copies, workspaces for per-agent buckets with TTL, checkpoints for snapshot/restore, and coordination for event-driven pipelines via bucket webhooks. Triggers on "@tigrisdata/agent-kit", "agent storage", "agent workspace", "agent fork", "isolated agent environment", "checkpoint and restore", "bucket webhook", "multi-agent pipeline"
description_zh: 在 Tigris 上构建 AI 代理存储工作流时使用——分支用于隔离数据集副本，工作区用于每个代理的带 TTL 的桶，检查点用于快照/恢复，以及通过桶 webhook 协调事件驱动管道。触发条件包括 "@tigrisdata/agent-kit"、"代理存储"、"代理工作区"、"代理分支"、"隔离代理环境"、"检查点与恢复"、"桶 webhook" 和 "多代理管道"。

name: day2-supplement-mcp
description: Day 2 보충 자료 - MCP 딥다이브. Claude Code에 외부 도구를 연결하는 MCP를 체계적으로 배운다. "MCP 배우기", "MCP 보충", "MCP 강의", "MCP 학습" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: 第2天补充资料 - MCP深度探索。系统学习如何将外部工具连接到Claude Code中的MCP。用于“学习MCP”、“MCP补充”、“MCP讲座”、“MCP学习”请求。

name: geniml
description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.
description_zh: 使用 Geniml 进行审计的本地基因组区间工作流程：验证 BED 和宇宙合同，规划 Region2Vec 或 scEmbed 运行，检查模型/分词器兼容性，并评估共识宇宙。

name: medchem
description: Medicinal chemistry filters for compound triage. Apply drug-likeness rules (Lipinski, Veber, CNS), structural alert catalogs (PAINS, NIBR, ChEMBL), complexity metrics, and the medchem query language for library filtering.
description_zh: 药物化学用于化合物筛选。应用药物相似性规则（Lipinski、Veber、CNS）、结构警示目录（PAINS、NIBR、ChEMBL）、复杂度指标以及药物化学查询语言进行库筛选。

name: treatment-plans
description: Format and structurally validate local treatment-plan documentation after clinical decisions have already been supplied and verified by authorized licensed professionals. Use for source traceability, clinician-authored intervention records, goals and checkpoints, shared-decision records, reconciliation handoffs, and release gates—not for clinical decision-making.
description_zh: 在临床决策已由授权专业人员提供并验证后，对本地治疗方案文档进行格式化和结构验证。用于源可追溯性、临床医生撰写的干预记录、目标与检查点、共同决策记录、协调交接和发布门禁——而非用于临床决策。

name: pytdc
description: Use Therapeutics Data Commons through the PyTDC Python package for registry discovery, approved dataset access, task-aware splits, evaluator metrics, benchmark groups, and bounded molecular-oracle workflows.
description_zh: 通过 PyTDC Python 包使用 Therapeutics Data Commons 进行注册发现、批准数据集访问、任务感知拆分、评估器指标、基准组以及有界分子预言机工作流。

name: scvelo
description: RNA velocity analysis with scVelo. Estimate cell state transitions from unspliced/spliced mRNA dynamics, infer trajectory directions, compute latent time, and identify driver genes in single-cell RNA-seq data. Complements Scanpy/scVI-tools for trajectory inference.
description_zh: 使用scVelo进行RNA速度分析。根据未剪接/剪接mRNA动力学估计细胞状态转换，推断轨迹方向，计算潜在时间，并在单细胞RNA测序数据中识别驱动基因。可与Scanpy/scVI-tools结合进行轨迹推断。

name: n8n-agents-official
description: Use when building or editing any AI feature in n8n: AI Agents, Text Classifier, Information Extractor, Sentiment Analysis, Summarization Chain, Basic LLM Chain, embeddings, vector stores, single one-shot LLM calls, or AI media generation (image / audio / video) via the native LangChain provider nodes. Triggers on any `@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.*` node, "agent", "chat assistant", "LLM with tools", "tool calling", "fromAi", "system prompt", "memory window", "structured output", "outputParser", "function calling", "RAG", "vector store", "embeddings", "classify with AI", "extract fields with LLM", "sentiment analysis", "summarize with LLM", "single LLM call", chat triggers with files, AI image / video / audio generation, or any multi-turn or one-shot LLM behavior.
description_zh: 在构建或编辑 n8n 中的任何 AI 功能时使用：AI Agents、Text Classifier、Information Extractor、Sentiment Analysis、Summarization Chain、Basic LLM Chain、embeddings、vector stores、单个 one-shot LLM 调用，或通过原生 LangChain 提供者节点进行 AI 媒体生成（图像/音频/视频）。在任意 `@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.*` 节点上触发，包括“agent”、“chat assistant”、“带工具的 LLM”、“工具调用”、“fromAi”、“system prompt”、“memory window”、“结构化输出”、“outputParser”、“function calling”、“RAG”、“vector store”、“embeddings”、“AI 分类”、“使用 LLM 提取字段”、“情感分析”、“使用 LLM 摘要”、“单个 LLM 调用”、带文件的聊天触发器、AI 图像/视频/音频生成，或任何多轮或 one-shot LLM 行为。

name: cirq
description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.
description_zh: 谷歌量子计算框架。在针对谷歌量子AI硬件、设计抗噪声电路或运行量子特性化实验时使用。最适合谷歌硬件、噪声建模和低级电路设计。对于IBM硬件，请使用qiskit；对于带自动微分的量子机器学习，请使用pennylane；对于物理模拟，请使用qutip。

name: pyopenms
description: Complete mass spectrometry analysis platform. Use for proteomics and metabolomics workflows—feature detection, peptide/protein identification, label-free and isobaric quantification, adduct/accurate-mass annotation, and complex LC-MS/MS pipelines. Supports extensive file formats and algorithms. For simple spectral comparison and small-molecule library matching use matchms.
description_zh: 完整的质谱分析平台。用于蛋白质组学和代谢组学工作流程——特征检测、肽/蛋白质鉴定、无标记和同位素标记定量、加合物/精确质量标注，以及复杂的LC-MS/MS流程。支持广泛的文件格式和算法。对于简单的光谱比较和中小分子库匹配，请使用matchms。

name: usfiscaldata
description: Query the U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data REST API for federal financial data. No API key required. Use for national debt (Debt to the Penny), Daily Treasury Statements, Monthly Treasury Statements, Treasury securities auctions, interest rates, foreign exchange rates, savings bonds, or U.S. government revenue and spending statistics.
description_zh: 查询美国财政部财政数据REST API以获取联邦财务数据。无需API密钥。可用于国家债务（精确到分）、每日财政部声明、每月财政部声明、财政部证券拍卖、利率、外汇汇率、储蓄债券，或美国政府的收入和支出统计数据。

name: partner-enablement
description: Sequence the training, content, and certification a B2B partner program needs to make partners self-sufficient sellers - the partner enablement roadmap, not the training content itself. Covers the skills-gap needs assessment, enablement tracks split by partner role and type, certification design and refresh cadence, and a pilot cohort, all designed backwards from the partner's first deal. Also covers B2C analogs (franchise, dealer, ambassador education). Use whenever the user mentions partner enablement, partner certification, channel partner training, a partner onboarding curriculum, or ramping partners to a first deal, even if they never say enablement. Do NOT use for affiliate welcome emails - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-onboarding-sequence instead.
description_zh: 为B2B合作伙伴计划制定培训、内容和认证流程，使合作伙伴成为自给自足的销售者——这是合作伙伴赋能路线图，而非具体的培训内容。涵盖技能差距需求评估、按合作伙伴角色和类型划分的赋能路径、认证设计及更新周期，以及试点群体，所有设计均以合作伙伴的首笔交易为起点逆向规划。此外还涵盖B2C类比（特许经营、经销商、大使教育）。在用户提及合作伙伴赋能、合作伙伴认证、渠道合作伙伴培训、合作伙伴入职课程或加速合作伙伴达成首笔交易时使用，即使他们未提及赋能。切勿用于联盟营销欢迎邮件——应使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-onboarding-sequence。

name: tao-finetune-cosmos-embed
description: Cosmos-Embed1 video-text embedding for text-to-video retrieval, video-to-video search, semantic deduplication, and fine-tuning. Use when the user asks to "fine-tune Cosmos-Embed1", "run cosmos-embed inference", "export Cosmos-Embed1", "embed videos", or "search videos with text".
description_zh: Cosmos-Embed1视频-文本嵌入，用于文本到视频检索、视频到视频搜索、语义去重和微调。当用户要求“微调Cosmos-Embed1”、“运行cosmos-embed推理”、“导出Cosmos-Embed1”、“嵌入视频”或“用文本搜索视频”时使用。

name: tao-finetune-cosmos-reason
description: Shared Cosmos3 frontend that explicitly routes Cosmos Framework and Cosmos-RL, validates runtime model/video-dataset/SLURM inputs, consumes an SQSH or packaged backend image, optionally plans explicit clean source builds, prepares checkpoints, validates the first update in-process, and returns token-weighted losses and task-aware accuracy.
description_zh: 共享 Cosmos3 前端，明确路由 Cosmos 框架和 Cosmos-RL，验证运行时模型/视频数据集/SLURM 输入，消费 SQSH 或打包的后端镜像，可选地规划显式清理源构建，准备检查点，在进程内验证首次更新，并返回 token 加权损失和任务感知准确率。

name: quick-mockups
description: Create multiple UI design mockups in parallel. Use when asked to create mockups, wireframes, or design variations for a feature. Creates HTML files using Mantine v7 + Tailwind following Civitai's design system.
description_zh: 并行创建多个 UI 设计原型。在要求创建原型、线框图或设计变体时使用。使用 Mantine v7 + Tailwind 根据 Civitai 的设计系统创建 HTML 文件。

name: cobrapy
description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.
description_zh: 基于约束的代谢建模（COBRA）。包括FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样、SBML模型，用于系统生物学和代谢工程分析。

name: etetoolkit
description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.
description_zh: 使用 ETE 4 分析、操作、比较、注释和可视化系统发育树或其他层次结构树。用于 Newick/Nexus 树的输入输出、拓扑编辑和模式匹配、Robinson-Foulds 比较以及基因树进化事件和同源重排，支持 NCBI/GTDB 分类学、SmartView 探索和出版物渲染。请勿使用它从原始序列推断树；应先对序列进行比对，再推断树。

name: flowio
description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.
description_zh: 使用 FlowIO 读取、检查和写入 Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0、3.0 和 3.1 文件。用于低级 FCS 元数据和通道检查、NumPy 事件提取、多数据集文件、表格导出以及 FCS 3.1 创建；使用 FlowKit 进行补偿、流式细胞术转换、门控或 FlowJo 工作区操作。

name: gtars
description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.
description_zh: 使用Gtars进行本地基因组区间模型和集合代数、重叠和计数、共识和覆盖率、分词、片段处理以及refget/BEDbase规划，支持Python、Rust和CLI。

name: histolab
description: Lightweight WSI tile extraction and preprocessing. Use for basic slide processing, tissue detection, tile extraction, and stain normalization for H&E images. Best for simple pipelines, dataset preparation, and quick tile-based analysis. For advanced spatial proteomics, multiplexed imaging, or deep learning pipelines use pathml.
description_zh: 轻量级 WSI 图像瓦片提取和预处理。适用于基础切片处理、组织检测、瓦片提取以及 H&E 图像的染色归一化。最适合简单流程、数据集准备和基于瓦片的快速分析。对于高级空间蛋白质组学、多重成像或深度学习流程，请使用 pathml。

name: molfeat
description: Molecular featurization for ML (100+ featurizers). ECFP, MACCS, descriptors, pretrained models (ChemBERTa), convert SMILES to features, for QSAR and molecular ML.
description_zh: 分子特征化用于机器学习（100多种特征化工具）。ECFP、MACCS、描述符、预训练模型（ChemBERTa）、将SMILES转换为特征，用于QSAR和分子机器学习。

name: tilegym-cutile-python
description: Expert cuTile programming assistant. Write high-performance GPU kernels using cuTile's tile-based programming model with proper validation and optimization. Supports deep agent orchestration for complex multi-kernel tasks.
description_zh: cuTile专业编程助手。使用cuTile的基于瓦片编程模型编写高性能GPU内核，并进行适当的验证和优化。支持深度代理编排，用于复杂的多内核任务。

name: aws-solution-architect
description: Design AWS architectures for startups using serverless patterns and IaC templates. Use when asked to design serverless architecture, create CloudFormation templates, optimize AWS costs, set up CI/CD pipelines, or migrate to AWS. Covers Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ECS, Aurora, and cost optimization.
description_zh: 为初创公司设计采用无服务器模式和基础设施即代码模板的 AWS 架构。在需要设计无服务器架构、创建 CloudFormation 模板、优化 AWS 成本、设置 CI/CD 管道或迁移至 AWS 时使用。涵盖 Lambda、API Gateway、DynamoDB、ECS、Aurora 以及成本优化。

name: extract
description: Turn a proven pattern or debugging solution into a standalone reusable skill with SKILL.md, reference docs, and examples. Use when the user runs /si:extract or asks to package a recurring solution from memory into a skill.
description_zh: 将一个经过验证的模式或调试解决方案，通过 SKILL.md、参考文档和示例，转化为一个独立的可重用技能。当用户运行 /si:extract 或要求将内存中的重复解决方案打包成技能时使用。

name: tear-sheet
description: Generate professional company tear sheets using S&P Capital IQ data via the Kensho LLM-ready API MCP server. Use this skill whenever the user asks for a tear sheet, company one-pager, company profile, fact sheet, company snapshot, or company overview document — especially when they mention a specific company name or ticker. Also trigger when users ask for equity research summaries, M&A company profiles, corporate development target profiles, sales/BD meeting prep documents, or any concise single-company financial summary. This skill supports four audience types: equity research, investment banking/M&A, corporate development, and sales/business development. If the user doesn't specify an audience, ask. Works for both public and private companies.
description_zh: 通过Kensho LLM-ready API MCP服务器，使用S&P Capital IQ数据生成专业的公司传单。当用户要求获取公司传单、公司单页、公司简介、事实清单、公司快照或公司概览文件时，使用此技能——尤其是在用户提及特定公司名称或股票代码时。此外，当用户要求获取股票研究报告摘要、并购公司简介、企业发展战略目标简介、销售/BD会议准备文件或任何简洁的单公司财务摘要时，也会触发此技能。该技能支持四种受众类型：股票研究、投资银行/并购、企业发展和销售/业务发展。如果用户未指定受众类型，系统会询问。适用于上市公司和私营公司。

name: matchms
description: Process, clean, compare, and search tandem mass spectra with matchms. Use for MS/MS file I/O, metadata harmonization, peak filtering, spectral similarity, library matching, score matrices, and molecular-similarity networks. Use pyopenms instead for LC-MS feature detection or proteomics pipelines.
description_zh: 使用 matchms 对串联质谱进行进程、清洗、比较和搜索。用于 MS/MS 文件 I/O、元数据协调、峰过滤、光谱相似性、库匹配、评分矩阵和分子相似性网络。对于 LC-MS 特征检测或蛋白质组学流程，请改用 pyopenms。

name: pennylane
description: Hardware-agnostic quantum ML framework with automatic differentiation. Use when training quantum circuits via gradients, building hybrid quantum-classical models, or needing device portability across IBM/Google/Rigetti/IonQ. Best for variational algorithms (VQE, QAOA), quantum neural networks, and integration with PyTorch or JAX. For hardware-specific optimizations use qiskit (IBM) or cirq (Google); for open quantum systems use qutip.
description_zh: 硬件无关的量子机器学习框架，支持自动微分。适用于通过梯度训练量子电路、构建混合量子-经典模型，或需要在 IBM/Google/Rigetti/IonQ 等设备间实现移植性。最适合变分算法（VQE、QAOA）、量子神经网络，以及与 PyTorch 或 JAX 集成。若需硬件特定优化，请使用 qiskit（IBM）或 cirq（Google）；若需处理开放量子系统，请使用 qutip。

name: redis-semantic-cache
description: Redis LangCache guidance for semantic caching of LLM responses on Redis Cloud — calling search/set via the SDK or REST API, tuning the similarity threshold, separating caches per task type, and filtering with custom attributes. Use when caching LLM completions or RAG answers to cut API cost and latency, building a cache-aside layer in front of OpenAI / Anthropic / etc., tuning hit rate vs precision, or splitting one app's LLM workloads into multiple LangCache caches.
description_zh: Redis LangCache 指南：在 Redis Cloud 上对 LLM 响应进行语义缓存——通过 SDK 或 REST API 调用 search/set，调整相似度阈值，按任务类型分离缓存，以及使用自定义属性进行过滤。适用于缓存 LLM 完成或 RAG 响应以降低 API 成本和延迟，在 OpenAI / Anthropic 等服务前构建缓存旁路层，调整命中率与精确度的平衡，或将单个应用的 LLM 工作负载分散到多个 LangCache 缓存中。

name: labarchive-integration
description: Securely integrate with the official LabArchives ELN REST-like API and Inventory API v1. Use for regional endpoint selection, signed-request construction, user authorization and UID flows, local LA container validation, and verified LabArchives integration workflows.
description_zh: 安全地与官方LabArchives ELN REST式API和Inventory API v1集成。用于区域端点选择、签名请求构建、用户授权和UID流程、本地LA容器验证以及经过验证的LabArchives集成工作流。

name: protocolsio-integration
description: Read, validate, and safely export protocols.io data with current official REST/MCP contracts, or create non-executing mutation plans. The bundled client makes bounded official-host GET requests only with explicit --execute. Use only for tasks explicitly targeting protocols.io or an exact protocols.io protocol version.
description_zh: 使用当前官方的REST/MCP合约读取、验证并安全地导出protocols.io数据，或创建非执行的变异计划。捆绑的客户端仅在使用显式--execute标志时才向官方主机发起有界的GET请求。仅用于明确针对protocols.io或特定protocols.io协议版本的任务。

name: partnerships-hiring
description: Employer-side partnerships hiring across the field's four sub-disciplines - channel/alliance, affiliate, influencer/creator, referral. Calibrates the scorecard to company type (startup generalist, scale-up specialist, enterprise per-hyperscaler headcount, PLG integrations-first), builds the channel-manager loop with its named judgment test and negotiation role-play, sources candidates from the field's job board and communities, and gates compensation on live verification since public benchmarks disagree by 2-3x. States plainly where no documented loop exists for a sub-discipline. Use whenever the user asks how to hire a partner manager, write a partnerships job posting, design an interview loop, or source candidates. Do NOT use for candidate-side prep (mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partnerships-career).
description_zh: 雇主方合作伙伴招聘，覆盖该领域的四个子学科——渠道/联盟、联盟伙伴、影响者/创作者、推荐人。根据公司类型（初创公司通才、成长型公司专家、企业按超大规模头部人数、PLG首推整合）校准评分卡，建立渠道经理闭环，包含其指定的判断测试和谈判角色扮演，从该领域的招聘网站和社区挖掘候选人，并通过实时验证控制薪酬，因为公开基准存在2-3倍的差异。明确指出哪些子学科没有文档化的闭环。当用户询问如何招聘合作伙伴经理、撰写合作伙伴职位发布、设计面试闭环或挖掘候选人时，请使用。禁止用于候选人方准备（mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partnerships-career）。

name: browserstack
description: Run tests on BrowserStack. Use when user mentions "browserstack", "cross-browser", "cloud testing", "browser matrix", "test on safari", "test on firefox", or "browser compatibility".
description_zh: 在 BrowserStack 上运行测试。当用户提到“browserstack”、“跨浏览器”、“云测试”、“浏览器矩阵”、“在 Safari 上测试”、“在 Firefox 上测试”或“浏览器兼容性”时使用。

name: elevenlabs-agents
description: Build conversational AI voice agents on the ElevenLabs platform. Configure agent + tools + knowledge base, integrate SDK (React / React Native / Swift / JS / server-side), test, deploy. Use whenever the user mentions ElevenLabs, building a voice agent, an AI phone system, an AI receptionist, conversational AI, or troubleshooting deprecated @11labs packages, webhook errors, CSP violations, localhost allowlist, or tool parsing errors.
description_zh: 在ElevenLabs平台上构建对话式AI语音代理。配置代理+工具+知识库，集成SDK（React / React Native / Swift / JS / 服务器端），测试，部署。当用户提及ElevenLabs、构建语音代理、AI电话系统、AI接待员、对话式AI，或排查过时@11labs包、webhook错误、CSP违规、localhost白名单或工具解析错误时使用。

name: opentrons-integration
description: Author, review, migrate, simulate, and troubleshoot official Opentrons Python Protocol API v2 protocols for Flex and OT-2 robots. Use for robot-specific liquid handling, deck and labware setup, pipettes, modules, runtime parameters, liquid classes, and Opentrons App analysis. Use pylabrobot instead when one workflow must support multiple robot vendors.
description_zh: 为Flex和OT-2机器人编写、审查、迁移、模拟和排错官方Opentrons Python协议API v2协议。用于机器人特定的液体处理、台面和实验室设备设置、移液器、模块、运行时参数、液体类以及Opentrons应用分析。当单个工作流需要支持多个机器人供应商时，请使用pylabrobot。

name: qutip
description: Simulate and audit closed and open quantum-system models with QuTiP 5, including deterministic, trajectory, steady-state, spectral, and phase-space workflows. Use for local quantum-dynamics work where physical assumptions, dimensions, and numerical convergence must be explicit.
description_zh: 使用QuTiP 5模拟和审计封闭式和开放式量子系统模型，包括确定性、轨迹、稳态、频谱和相空间工作流程。用于本地量子动力学工作，其中物理假设、维度和数值收敛必须明确。

name: tiledbvcf
description: Efficient storage and retrieval of genomic variant data using TileDB. Scalable VCF/BCF ingestion, incremental sample addition, compressed storage, parallel queries, and export capabilities for population genomics.
description_zh: 使用 TileDB 进行基因组变异数据的有效存储和检索。支持可扩展的 VCF/BCF 数据摄取、增量样本添加、压缩存储、并行查询以及适用于群体遗传学的导出功能。

name: partner-tiering
description: Design or redesign the tier structure inside an existing B2B partner program - qualification criteria, benefit bundles, tier count, promotion and demotion rules, review cadence for registered/silver/gold-style ladders, and migration of the current partner base. Also covers the B2C affiliate, creator and loyalty tier contrast. Use whenever the user mentions partner tiers, tier criteria, tier benefits, tier compression, demotion rules, or reseller, MSP and agency tier design, even if they never say tiering. Do NOT use for standing up a partner program from scratch - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-channel-program instead. Affiliate commission payout tiers are a separate skill.
description_zh: 设计或重新设计现有B2B合作伙伴计划中的层级结构——资格标准、权益包、层级数量、晋升与降级规则、注册/白银/黄金风格梯级的审核周期，以及当前合作伙伴基础的迁移。同时涵盖B2C联盟、创作者和忠诚度层级的对比。当用户提及合作伙伴层级、层级标准、层级权益、层级压缩、降级规则，或经销商、MSP和代理层级设计时，即使他们从未提及层级制，也请使用此技能。不适用于从零建立合作伙伴计划——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-channel-program。联盟佣金支付层级是单独的技能。

name: tao-launch-workflow
description: The mandatory pre-launch gate and four-verb execution contract for every TAO workflow or action. Invoke BEFORE launching anything side-effecting — AutoML, train, evaluate, inference, export, TensorRT engine generation, or DEFT/application workflows — on any execution platform. Covers platform selection, credentials, image confirmation, dataset intake, preflight, the launch review, job records, monitoring, and failure/retry classification. Trigger phrases include "train this model", "run AutoML", "launch on SLURM/docker/k8s/brev/virtualenv", "evaluate my checkpoint", "start a TAO job".
description_zh: 每个TAO工作流或操作的强制性预发布门禁和四动词执行合同。在启动任何有副作用的操作之前调用——AutoML、训练、评估、推理、导出、TensorRT引擎生成或DEFT/应用程序工作流——在任何执行平台上。涵盖平台选择、凭证、图像确认、数据集摄入、预检、启动审查、作业记录、监控以及失败/重试分类。触发短语包括“训练此模型”、“运行AutoML”、“在SLURM/docker/k8s/brev/virtualenv上启动”、“评估我的检查点”、“启动TAO作业”。

name: design-code-architecture
description: Guided journey from an app idea to a deliberate architecture: boundaries, domain model, data decisions, and resilience, making only the expensive-to-reverse decisions and deferring the rest. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - clean-architecture, domain-driven-design, system-design, ddia-systems, software-design-philosophy, release-it, pragmatic-programmer, 37signals-way - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (ARCHITECTURE.md, DESIGN-CODE-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to design a new app's architecture, choose boundaries and a domain model, decide monolith versus microservices, or says 'how should I structure this app'. If a codebase already exists, use remove-technical-debt (aged), improve-code-quality (fresh prototype), or architecture-optimization (slow but working); if unvalidated, run create-business or create-app first. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从应用程序构思到精心设计的架构：边界、领域模型、数据决策和韧性，仅做出难以逆转的高成本决策，其余则推迟处理。分阶段协调八项技能——清晰架构、领域驱动设计、系统设计、DDIA系统、软件设计哲学、发布它、实用程序员、37信号方法——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹中（ARCHITECTURE.md、DESIGN-CODE-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md），以便跨会话继续旅程。当用户希望设计新应用程序的架构、选择边界和领域模型、决定单体与微服务，或说“我应该如何构建这个应用程序”时使用。如果代码库已存在，使用移除技术债务（陈旧）、提升代码质量（新鲜原型）或架构优化（缓慢但可用）；如果未验证，则先运行创建业务或创建应用程序。对于单一框架，直接调用该技能。

name: rowan
description: Rowan is a cloud-native molecular modeling and medicinal-chemistry workflow platform with a Python API. Use for pKa and macropKa prediction, conformer and tautomer ensembles, docking and analogue docking, protein-ligand cofolding, MSA generation, molecular dynamics, permeability, descriptor workflows, and related small-molecule or protein modeling tasks. Ideal for programmatic batch screening, multi-step chemistry pipelines, and workflows that would otherwise require maintaining local HPC/GPU infrastructure.
description_zh: 接骨木是一个基于云的原生分子建模和药物化学工作流平台，提供Python API。可用于pKa和macropKa预测、构象和互变异构体集合、对接和类似物对接、蛋白质-配体共折叠、MSA生成、分子动力学、通透性、描述符工作流以及相关的小分子或蛋白质建模任务。非常适合程序化批量筛选、多步化学管道以及那些原本需要维护本地HPC/GPU基础设施的工作流。

name: partner-ecosystem
description: Map a company's partner and channel ecosystem as a strategy exercise  - an inventory of every partner type (resellers, distributors, MSPs, ISVs, SIs, affiliates, marketplaces, plus retail, creator, licensing and co-branding partners for consumer brands), partner account overlap analysis, channel coverage gaps and conflict zones, a weighted partner scorecard, and a prioritization 2x2. Use whenever the user mentions partner ecosystem mapping, a partner landscape, channel coverage, partner type classification, ecosystem whitespace, or which partner categories deserve investment, even if they never say ecosystem. Do NOT use for sequencing which category to launch next  - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-ecosystem-expansion instead.
description_zh: 将一家公司的合作伙伴和渠道生态系统作为战略练习进行映射——包括对每种合作伙伴类型（分销商、经销商、MSP、ISV、SI、联盟伙伴、市场平台，以及面向消费品牌的零售商、创作者、许可和联合品牌合作伙伴）的清单，合作伙伴账户重叠分析、渠道覆盖空白和冲突区域、加权合作伙伴评分卡，以及优先级2x2矩阵。每当用户提到合作伙伴生态系统映射、合作伙伴格局、渠道覆盖、合作伙伴类型分类、生态系统空白，或哪些合作伙伴类别值得投资时，即使他们从未提及生态系统，也使用此方法。禁止用于确定下一个启动哪个类别——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-ecosystem-expansion。

name: partnerships-career
description: Plans a partnerships career from the candidate side across the field's four sub-disciplines - channel/alliance, affiliate, influencer/creator, referral. Covers the internal-transfer entry tactic, the company-type hiring bar, channel-manager interview-loop prep including the negotiation role-play and the "same deal in December as January" judgment test, job-posting red-flag reads, and offer evaluation gated on live verification since published comp benchmarks disagree by 2-3x. States plainly that no cross-company career ladder is published for this field. Use whenever the user asks how to break into partnerships, prep a partner-manager interview, read a posting, or evaluate an offer. Do NOT use for the hiring/employer side (mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partnerships-hiring).
description_zh: 从候选人角度，规划合作伙伴职业发展，涵盖该领域的四个子学科——渠道/联盟、联盟营销、影响者/创作者、推荐。包括内部转岗的入门策略、公司类型的招聘门槛、渠道经理面试准备（包括谈判角色扮演和“十二月与一月同价”的判断测试）、职位发布中的警示标志解读，以及基于实时验证的录用评估（因行业薪酬基准存在2-3倍的差异）。明确指出该领域未公布跨公司职业晋升路径。在用户询问如何进入合作伙伴领域、准备合作伙伴经理面试、阅读职位发布或评估录用时使用。禁止用于招聘/雇主方（mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partnerships-hiring）。

name: polars-bio
description: High-performance genomic interval operations and bioinformatics file I/O on Polars DataFrames. Overlap, nearest, merge, coverage, complement, subtract for BED/VCF/BAM/GFF intervals. Streaming, cloud-native, faster bioframe alternative.
description_zh: 在 Polars DataFrame 上进行高性能基因组区间操作和生物信息学文件 I/O。支持 BED/VCF/BAM/GFF 区间的重叠、最近邻、合并、覆盖率、补集和差集操作。流式处理、云原生、生物信息学框架（bioframe）更快的替代方案。

name: partner-marketplace-strategy
description: Decide which third-party marketplaces to list on, how much to invest in each, what ROI to expect, and when to delist  - marketplace prioritization for partner teams. Covers cloud marketplace listing strategy, SaaS app store and integration directory prioritization, and retail marketplace selection for ecommerce (1P vs 3P vs hybrid), with a readiness gate, weighted scorecard, and provenance-flagged ROI expectations. Use whenever the user mentions AWS, Azure or GCP marketplaces, an app store listing, an integration directory, or asks whether a marketplace listing is worth it, even if they never say marketplace strategy. Do NOT use for choosing which partner category to launch next  - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-ecosystem-expansion instead.
description_zh: 决定在哪些第三方市场列出产品、每个市场投入多少资金、预期多少投资回报率（ROI）以及何时下架产品——这是合作伙伴团队的第三方市场优先级排序。涵盖云市场列出策略、SaaS应用商店和集成目录优先级排序，以及电商零售市场的选择（1P vs 3P vs 混合模式），包含准备就绪门槛、加权评分卡和已验证ROI预期。当用户提及AWS、Azure或GCP市场、应用商店列出、集成目录，或询问是否值得列出市场时，即使他们从未提及市场策略，也请使用。不适用于选择下一个启动的合作伙伴类别——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-ecosystem-expansion。

name: critique-typography
description: Critique a rendered screen's typography — scale usage, readability, consistency, and token compliance. Use when reviewing type on a screen. For defining the scale itself, use `typography-scale` (ui-design).

name: google-like-a-spy
description: Craft advanced search-engine queries and Google dorks to surface hidden files, documents and mentions. Covers site:, filetype:, inurl:, intitle:, intext: and before:/after: operators, verbatim search, exposed directory listings, config files, backups and open S3 buckets, and the operator differences between Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Yandex. Applies to data-exposure audits, pre-engagement reconnaissance, competitive and regulatory research, and insider-leak investigation. Reference at useosint.com/skills/google-like-a-spy.
description_zh: 制作高级搜索引擎查询和Google挖掘，以发现隐藏的文件、文档和提及内容。涵盖site:、filetype:、inurl:、intitle:、intext:和before:/after:运算符、逐字搜索、暴露的目录列表、配置文件、备份文件和开放的S3存储桶，以及Google、Bing、DuckDuckGo和Yandex之间的运算符差异。在构建Google挖掘、搜寻泄露文档，或在粘贴网站和文档存储库中搜索姓名、电子邮件或选择器时使用。适用于数据暴露审计、合作前侦察、竞争和监管研究，以及内部泄露调查。参考useosint.com/skills/google-like-a-spy。

name: lamindb
description: Use when working with LaminDB, the open-source lineage-native lakehouse for biological datasets and models. Covers setup, artifact registration, query/search, lineage tracking, validation, ontology-backed annotation with Bionty, collections, branches, storage, and workflow integrations.
description_zh: 在使用LaminDB（生物数据集和模型的开源谱系原生湖仓）时使用。涵盖设置、工件注册、查询/搜索、谱系跟踪、验证、基于Bionty的本体支持注释、集合、分支、存储以及工作流集成。

name: qiskit
description: Build, simulate, transpile, and execute quantum circuits with Qiskit and IBM Quantum Runtime. Use for Qiskit 2.x circuits and operators, V2 Sampler or Estimator primitives, target-aware transpilation, local or noisy simulation, IBM QPU execution, Runtime sessions or batches, error mitigation, and Qiskit ecosystem packages.
description_zh: 使用Qiskit和IBM Quantum Runtime构建、模拟、转换编译和执行量子电路。适用于Qiskit 2.x电路和算子、V2采样器或估计器原语、目标感知转换编译、本地或噪声模拟、IBM QPU执行、运行时会话或批处理、错误缓解以及Qiskit生态系统包。

name: research-planning
description: Design research plans and paper architectures. Given a research topic or idea, generate structured plans with methodology outlines, paper structure, dependency-ordered task lists, UML diagrams, and experiment designs. Use when starting a new research project or paper.
description_zh: 设计研究计划与论文架构。针对一个研究主题或想法，生成结构化计划，包括方法论大纲、论文结构、依赖排序的任务列表、UML图和实验设计。适用于开始新的研究项目或论文时使用。

name: react-2026
description: Provides a comprehensive guide to the modern React 2026 stack. Use when starting a new React project or modernizing an existing one with current frameworks, build tools, routing, state management, or AI integration.
description_zh: 提供一份关于现代 React 2026 技术栈的全面指南。适用于启动新 React 项目或使用当前框架、构建工具、路由、状态管理或 AI 集成来现代化现有项目。

name: improve-code-quality
description: Guided journey from a working-but-untested vibe-coded prototype to a production-ready product with tests, clean structure, a business-rules boundary, and resilience at scale. Orchestrates nine skills phase by phase - working-with-legacy-code, clean-code, refactoring-patterns, software-design-philosophy, clean-architecture, pragmatic-programmer, release-it, system-design, ddia-systems - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (TESTING.md, TECH-DEBT.md, IMPROVE-CODE-QUALITY-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to harden an AI-generated prototype, add tests before refactoring, make code safe to change, or says 'this works on my machine but I am scared to touch it'. For an aged codebase, remove-technical-debt; for greenfield structure, design-code-architecture; for a product and UX pass, improve-app; to optimize speed and structure, architecture-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从功能但未经测试的 vibe-coded 原型，引导至具备测试、清晰结构、业务规则边界和规模化弹性的生产就绪产品。分阶段协调九项技能——处理遗留代码、编写清晰代码、重构模式、软件设计哲学、清晰架构、实用程序员、发布就绪、系统设计、ddia系统——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹（TESTING.md、TECH-DEBT.md、IMPROVE-CODE-QUALITY-PLAN.md）中，以便跨会话继续进行。当用户希望加固 AI 生成的原型、在重构前添加测试、使代码易于修改，或表示“我的机器上可以运行，但我害怕触碰它”时使用。对于陈旧的代码库，执行 remove-technical-debt；对于空白结构，设计 code-architecture；对于产品和 UX 验收，执行 improve-app；为优化速度和结构，执行 architecture-optimization。对于单个框架，直接调用相应技能。

name: dnanexus-integration
description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.
description_zh: 使用 dx CLI、dxpy、应用程序/小程序、原生工作流、dxCompiler 和 Nextflow 在 DNAnexus 上构建和运行可重复的基因组工作负载。用于 DNAnexus 数据传输、dxapp.json 开发、执行监控、工作流导入和项目自动化。

name: neuropixels-analysis
description: Analyze Neuropixels extracellular recordings end-to-end with SpikeInterface. Covers loading SpikeGLX/Open Ephys/NWB data, preprocessing, drift/motion correction, Kilosort4 (and CPU) spike sorting, quality metrics, and unit curation (threshold-based, model-based UnitRefine, and AI-assisted visual review). Use when working with Neuropixels 1.0/2.0 recordings, spike sorting, or extracellular electrophysiology analysis.
description_zh: 使用SpikeInterface对Neuropixels细胞外记录进行端到端分析。涵盖加载SpikeGLX/Open Ephys/NWB数据、预处理、漂移/运动校正、Kilosort4（及CPU）尖峰分选、质量指标和单元筛选（基于阈值的筛选、基于模型的UnitRefine和AI辅助视觉审查）。适用于处理Neuropixels 1.0/2.0记录、尖峰分选或细胞外电生理分析。

name: gtm-developer-ecosystem
description: Build and scale developer-led adoption through ecosystem programs. Use when deciding open vs curated ecosystems, building developer programs, scaling platform adoption, or designing student program pipelines.
description_zh: 通过生态系统计划推动开发者主导的采用并实现规模化。在决定开放型与精选型生态系统、构建开发者计划、扩大平台采用范围或设计学生项目管道时使用。

name: export-download-debugging
description: Diagnose and fix browser, preview, or Electron export/download failures, especially image export issues involving Save As, Blob/Data URLs, the File System Access API, createWritable failures, and 0 KB files.
description_zh: 诊断和修复浏览器、预览或 Electron 导出/下载失败问题，特别是涉及“另存为”、Blob/Data URL、文件系统访问 API、createWritable 失败以及 0 KB 文件等图像导出问题。

name: qwencloud-vision
description: Understand images and videos with Qwen vision models. TRIGGER when: user wants to analyze, describe, or extract information from images or videos, OCR text extraction, chart/table reading, visual reasoning, multi-image comparison, screenshot understanding, video comprehension, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-vision). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to generate/create images (use qwencloud-image-generation), generate videos (use qwencloud-video-generation), text-only tasks without visual input, or non-Qwen vision tasks.
description_zh: 使用 Qwen 视觉模型理解图像和视频。在以下情况时触发：用户希望分析、描述或从图像或视频中提取信息，OCR 文本提取，图表/表格读取，视觉推理，多图像比较，截图理解，视频理解，或明确通过名称调用此技能（例如使用 qwencloud-vision）。不触发的情况：用户希望生成/创建图像（使用 qwencloud-image-generation），生成视频（使用 qwencloud-video-generation），仅文本的任务且没有视觉输入，或非 Qwen 视觉任务。

name: keyword-research
description: Use when the user asks to "find keywords", "挖词", or "搜什么词"; prioritizes search volume, keyword difficulty, intent, and topic clusters from provided or connected data. Not for competitor-relative coverage gaps — use content-gap-analysis. 关键词研究/内容选题
description_zh: 当用户询问“查找关键词”、“挖词”或“搜索什么词”时使用；优先考虑搜索量、关键词难度、意图以及从提供或连接数据中获取的主题簇。不用于竞争对手相对的覆盖差距——应使用内容差距分析。关键词研究/内容选题

name: plan-payroll
description: Runs the payroll-confidence chain end to end — forecasts cash across the payroll window with cash-flow-snapshot, ranks and drafts overdue-invoice reminders with invoice-chase to close any gap, then assembles timesheets, flags every anomaly, and stages the run with payroll-prep. On Gusto the run is staged for the owner to submit; on QuickBooks Payroll, or with no payroll system, the last step is a validated run sheet the owner keys in. This chain never presses the payroll button. Builds on the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), with Gmail or M365, PayPal, Square, Stripe, and either Gusto or QuickBooks Payroll adding detail, and falls back to CSV and timesheet uploads. Use it whenever payroll is the worry, including "can I make payroll," "payroll is due Friday," "plan payroll," "will I have enough to pay the crew," or "I need to run payroll but money is tight." Accepts optional horizon and payroll-date arguments.
description_zh: 执行端到端的薪酬置信链——通过现金流快照在薪酬窗口内预测现金流，使用发票追索对逾期发票进行排名和草拟提醒以弥补任何差距，然后组装工时表、标记所有异常，并使用薪酬准备阶段运行。在Gusto上，运行结果会提交给负责人；在QuickBooks Payroll或无薪酬系统的情况下，最后一步是负责人输入的已验证运行表。这个链永远不会按下薪酬按钮。基于总账（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero或Zoho Books），结合Gmail或M365、PayPal、Square、Stripe，以及Gusto或QuickBooks Payroll添加细节，并回退到CSV和工时表上传。无论何时薪酬成为担忧时，都可以使用它，包括“我能发工资吗”、“薪酬周五到期”、“计划薪酬”、“我有足够的钱支付团队”或“我需要运行薪酬但资金紧张”。接受可选的视野和薪酬日期参数。

name: sentry-debug-issue
description: Debug and fix a Sentry issue — find it (by link, ID, or search), pull full context (stack trace, breadcrumbs, trace, logs), optionally run Seer root-cause / autofix, apply the code fix, and resolve it via a `Fixes PROJECT-NAME-12A` commit/PR. Use when working a known error or hunting one down to fix.
description_zh: 调试并修复Sentry问题——找到它（通过链接、ID或搜索），拉取完整上下文（堆栈跟踪、面包屑、跟踪、日志），可选择运行Seer根本原因/自动修复，应用代码修复，并通过`Fixes PROJECT-NAME-12A`提交/PR解决。用于处理已知错误或追踪并修复错误时使用。

name: glycoengineering
description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.
description_zh: 分析和设计蛋白质糖基化。扫描序列以寻找N-糖基化序列子（N-X-S/T），预测O-糖基化热点，并获取精选的糖基工程工具（NetOGlyc、GlycoShield、GlycoWorkbench）。用于糖蛋白工程、治疗性抗体优化和疫苗设计。

name: latchbio-integration
description: Build, register, debug, and operate bioinformatics workflows on Latch using the Python SDK, CLI, Latch Data and Registry, Nextflow, Snakemake, programmatic execution, and Latch MCP. Use when authoring or deploying Latch workflows, configuring resources or interfaces, moving data, integrating Registry, or launching and monitoring runs.
description_zh: 使用 Python SDK、CLI、Latch 数据和注册中心、Nextflow、Snakemake、程序化执行以及 Latch MCP 在 Latch 上构建、注册、调试和操作生物信息学工作流。适用于编写或部署 Latch 工作流、配置资源或接口、移动数据、集成注册中心，或启动和监控运行。

name: primekg
description: Query the Precision Medicine Knowledge Graph (PrimeKG) for multiscale biological data including genes, drugs, diseases, phenotypes, and more.
description_zh: 查询精准医学知识图谱（PrimeKG）中的多尺度生物数据，包括基因、药物、疾病、表型等。

name: pylabrobot
description: Develop and review PyLabRobot lab-automation resources, liquid-handling plans, offline simulations, and supported-device integrations. Use for PyLabRobot protocols or API questions; keep physical execution behind an explicit operator safety gate.
description_zh: 开发并审查PyLabRobot实验室自动化资源、液体处理计划、离线仿真以及受支持设备的集成。用于PyLabRobot协议或API问题；将物理执行保留在明确的操作员安全门之后。

name: partner-performance
description: Measure and review the performance of individual partners in a B2B partner program - the per-partner scorecard (dimensions, weights, targets, red-flag thresholds, data sources), the review cadence and QBR structure, and the underperformance ladder from trigger through corrective action to de-tier or exit. Also covers the B2C affiliate and creator review contrast. Use whenever the user mentions a partner scorecard, partner reviews, a channel partner QBR, a partner health check, or an underperforming channel partner, even if they never say performance. One partner at a time. Do NOT use for designing the tier ladder itself - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-tiering instead.
description_zh: 测量和评估B2B合作伙伴计划中单个合作伙伴的表现——包括每个合作伙伴的评分卡（维度、权重、目标、红色标志阈值、数据来源）、审查频率和QBR结构，以及从触发到纠正措施再到降级或退出的表现不佳阶梯。同时涵盖B2C联盟和创作者审查的对比。每当用户提到合作伙伴评分卡、合作伙伴审查、渠道合作伙伴QBR、合作伙伴健康状况或表现不佳的渠道合作伙伴时，即使他们从未提及绩效，也使用此内容。一次处理一个合作伙伴。不用于设计层级阶梯本身——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-tiering。

name: powerpoint-ppt
description: PowerPoint (.pptx) manipulation via MCP server. Use for creating slides, formatting presentations, managing placeholders, adding images, applying templates, or extracting text from .pptx files.
description_zh: 通过MCP服务器进行PowerPoint (.pptx) 操作。用于创建幻灯片、格式化演示文稿、管理占位符、添加图片、应用模板或从.pptx文件中提取文本。

name: gtm-operating-cadence
description: Design meeting rhythms, metric reporting, quarterly planning, and decision-making velocity for scaling companies. Use when decisions are slow, planning is broken, the company is growing but alignment is worse, or leadership meetings consume all time without producing decisions.
description_zh: 为成长型公司设计会议节奏、指标报告、季度规划和决策速度。适用于决策缓慢、规划失效、公司虽在增长但协同性更差，或领导会议占用所有时间却未产生决策的情况。

name: mmx-cli
description: Use mmx to generate text, images, video, speech, and music via the MiniMax AI platform. Use when the user wants to create media content, chat with MiniMax models, perform web search, or manage MiniMax API resources from the terminal.

name: owasp-security-check
description: Security audit guidelines for web applications and REST APIs based on OWASP Top 10 and web security best practices. Use when checking code for vulnerabilities, reviewing auth/authz, auditing APIs, or before production deployment.
description_zh: 基于OWASP Top 10和网络安全最佳实践，适用于Web应用程序和REST API的安全审计指南。在检查代码漏洞、审查认证/授权、审计API或生产部署前使用。

name: neobrutalism
description: Modern take on brutalism with bold borders, vivid accent colors, and raw, high-contrast layouts on warm surfaces.
description_zh: 现代 brutalism 风格，采用粗犷的边框、鲜明的强调色，以及温暖表面上的原始高对比度布局。

name: shadcn
description: Shadcn/ui-inspired design with minimal, clean components, monochrome palette, and utility-first patterns.
description_zh: 基于 Shadcn 的设计，采用极简、干净的组件、单色调色板和实用优先的模式。

name: create-business
description: Guided journey from raw idea to a validated, positioned, priced business with a chosen beachhead. Orchestrates ten skills phase by phase - jobs-to-be-done, mom-test, design-sprint, lean-startup, good-strategy-bad-strategy, blue-ocean-strategy, obviously-awesome, hundred-million-offers, monetizing-innovation, crossing-the-chasm - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (CUSTOMER.md, POSITIONING.md, OFFER.md, CREATE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to start a new business, validate a startup idea, find product-market fit before building, or says 'I have an idea for a company'. Do not use once the business has paying customers: use grow-business to add revenue and customers, or improve-business to fix strategy and operations. For building the product itself use create-app or create-website. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从原始想法到经过验证、定位和定价的具有选定立足点的商业，提供引导式旅程。分阶段协调十项技能——待完成工作、用户测试、设计冲刺、精益创业、好策略与坏策略、蓝海战略、显而易见的绝佳方案、一亿美元机会、创新变现、跨越鸿沟——在每个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹（CUSTOMER.md、POSITIONING.md、OFFER.md、CREATE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md）中，以便跨会话继续旅程。当用户想创办新企业、验证创业想法、在构建产品前找到产品市场契合度，或说“我有一个公司想法”时使用。一旦企业拥有付费客户，则不再使用：应使用grow-business增加收入和客户，或使用improve-business调整策略和运营。若要构建产品本身，请使用create-app或create-website。若要单独使用某个框架，直接调用该技能。

name: dart-use-path-package
description: Cross-platform file and directory path manipulation, segment splitting, extension extraction, and context conversion using `package:path` and `package:file`. Use when writing, inspecting, joining, splitting, or refactoring file paths, directory names, or extensions, or replacing raw string path operations (`.split('/')`, `'$dir/$file'`, `.endsWith('.ext')`, `.replaceAll('\\', '/')`). Don't use for HTTP network URI routing, database query strings, or non-path string processing.
description_zh: 跨平台文件和目录路径操作，包括路径分段、扩展名提取和上下文转换，使用 `package:path` 和 `package:file`。在编写、检查、连接、分割或重构文件路径、目录名或扩展名时使用，或用于替换原始字符串路径操作（`.split('/')`、`'$dir/$file'`、`.endsWith('.ext')`、`.replaceAll('\\', '/')`）。不适用于 HTTP 网络URI路由、数据库查询字符串或非路径字符串处理。

name: synthetic-monitoring-checks
description: Author Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring checks, with deep coverage of k6 scripted and browser checks: SM's single-VU/single-iteration execution model, assertions that actually fail probe_success (expect() and fail() vs bare check()), secrets, deterministic scripts, robust browser locators, local validation with k6 run, deployment via UI/API/Terraform, verifying probe_success, and rollback. Also helps choose the simplest sufficient check type (HTTP/ping/DNS/TCP, MultiHTTP, scripted, browser). Use when writing a synthetic check, monitoring a login/checkout/signup flow in production, converting a k6 script or an OpenAPI spec into a check, authoring a browser check, validating a user journey, or asking "is my site up from multiple regions". NOT for load, stress, or performance testing — SM runs one iteration per execution; for load tests use the grafana-k6 plugin or Grafana Cloud k6. For the broad Grafana Cloud Testing overview (SM + k6 Cloud + Faro), use the testing skill.
description_zh: Grafana Cloud 合成监控的作者检查，对 k6 脚本和浏览器检查有深度覆盖：SM 的单 VU/单迭代执行模型、实际失败的 probe_success 断言（expect() 和 fail() 与裸检查的对比）、密钥、确定性脚本、健壮的浏览器定位器、使用 k6 运行进行本地验证、通过 UI/API/Terraform 部署、验证 probe_success 以及回滚。同时有助于选择最简单的充分检查类型（HTTP/ping/DNS/TCP、MultiHTTP、脚本、浏览器）。在编写合成检查、监控生产环境中的登录/结算/注册流程、将 k6 脚本或 OpenAPI 规范转换为检查、编写浏览器检查、验证用户旅程或询问“我的网站是否从多个区域正常”时使用。不适用于负载、压力或性能测试——SM 每次执行只运行一次迭代；对于负载测试，请使用 grafana-k6 插件或 Grafana Cloud k6。对于广泛的 Grafana Cloud 测试概述（SM + k6 Cloud + Faro），请使用测试技能。

name: omero-integration
description: Securely inspect and automate microscopy data workflows against OMERO.server with omero-py, BlitzGateway, OMERO CLI, tables, annotations, ROIs, rendering, and documented OMERO.web APIs. Use for scoped OMERO inventory, metadata export, import/export planning, or reviewed write workflows.
description_zh: 使用 omero-py、BlitzGateway、OMERO CLI、表格、注释、ROI、渲染以及文档化的 OMERO.web API，安全地检查和自动化与 OMERO.server 的显微镜数据工作流程。可用于限定范围的 OMERO 库管理、元数据导出、导入/导出规划或经过审核的写入工作流程。

name: referral-incentive-design
description: Design the reward structure of a customer refer-a-friend program - who gets rewarded (referrer, friend, or both), reward type (cash, account credit, discount, product value, status), how much to pay against LTV/CAC and gross margin, when the payout fires, and whether to build a tiered reward ladder. Use whenever the user mentions referral incentives, refer-a-friend rewards, referral bonus amounts, give-X-get-Y offers, double-sided referral rewards, or asks how big a referral reward should be, even if they never say incentive. Covers end-customer rewards only. Do NOT use for commission rates paid to professional affiliates - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-commission-structure instead.
description_zh: 设计客户推荐好友计划的奖励机制——包括谁会获得奖励（推荐人、好友或两者）、奖励类型（现金、账户余额、折扣、产品价值、等级）、支付金额与客户终身价值（LTV）/客户获取成本（CAC）及毛利率的关系、奖励发放时间，以及是否建立分层奖励阶梯。在用户提及推荐激励、推荐好友奖励、推荐奖金金额、以X换Y的优惠、双向推荐奖励，或询问推荐奖励应设定多大时使用，即使他们从未提及激励。仅涵盖终端客户奖励。请勿用于支付给专业联盟的佣金率——应使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-commission-structure。

name: tao-finetune-clip
description: CLIP vision-language model for image-text retrieval, zero-shot classification, embedding extraction, ONNX export, and TensorRT deployment. Use when fine-tuning or training CLIP, running zero-shot classification, computing image embeddings, or deploying CLIP to ONNX/TensorRT. This is a single-action model skill; do not use it for an iterative weak-attribute improvement loop that keeps retraining and evaluating until progress stops, which belongs to tao-run-deft-pas.
description_zh: CLIP视觉语言模型用于图像-文本检索、零样本分类、嵌入提取、ONNX导出和TensorRT部署。在微调或训练CLIP、运行零样本分类、计算图像嵌入或将CLIP部署到ONNX/TensorRT时使用。这是一个单步操作模型技能；不要用于迭代弱属性改进循环，该循环会不断重新训练和评估直到进度停止，这属于tao-run-deft-pas。

name: tao-port-huggingface-model
description: Integrate a HuggingFace Computer Vision model into the NVIDIA TAO Toolkit ecosystem (tao-core config, tao-pytorch trainer, tao-deploy TensorRT pipeline). Use when the user asks to "integrate a HuggingFace model into TAO", "add an HF model to TAO Toolkit", "wire a HuggingFace ViT/DETR/ SegFormer into tao-pytorch", "build a TAO trainer + deploy pipeline for an HF CV model", or pastes a HuggingFace model URL/ID and wants it turned into a TAO model. Covers the full 7-phase loop: prerequisites check, HuggingFace inspection and validation, codebase exploration, tao-core configuration and native trainer implementation, ONNX export plus TensorRT deploy integration, packaging and L0 testing, container-based end-to-end validation, and (conditional) accuracy/latency tuning. Supports classification, object detection, semantic / instance / panoptic segmentation, zero-shot detection, and depth estimation.
description_zh: 将 HuggingFace 计算机视觉模型集成到 NVIDIA TAO 工具包生态系统中（包括 tao-core 配置、tao-pytorch 训练器、tao-deploy TensorRT 管道）。当用户要求“将 HuggingFace 模型集成到 TAO 中”、“向 TAO 工具包添加 HF 模型”、“将 HuggingFace ViT/DETR/SegFormer 链接到 tao-pytorch”、“为 HF 计算机视觉模型构建 TAO 训练器 + 部署管道”，或粘贴 HuggingFace 模型 URL/ID 并希望将其转换为 TAO 模型时使用。涵盖完整的 7 阶段循环：前提条件检查、HuggingFace 检查与验证、代码库探索、tao-core 配置与原生训练器实现、ONNX 导出及 TensorRT 部署集成、打包与 L0 测试、基于容器的端到端验证，以及（条件性）精度/延迟调优。支持分类、目标检测、语义/实例/全景分割、零样本检测和深度估计。

name: tao-run-automl
description: Run container-backed AutoML / hyperparameter optimization (HPO) for NVIDIA TAO networks using AutoMLRunner. Handles algorithm selection (bayesian, hyperband, asha, bohb, llm, hybrid, autoresearch), WandB experiment tracking, job execution on any TAO SDK platform, result interpretation, and per-rec custom evaluation hooks. Use when the user mentions TAO AutoML, hyperparameter optimization, HPO, automl, automl_settings, AutoMLRunner, tao_automl, bayesian search, hyperband, ASHA, LLM-guided search, autoresearch, or wants to tune train/evaluate/inference/distill/prune/quantize for a TAO network. Model actions use the resolved image; venv training requires an explicit request. Platform-agnostic — runs on any SDK (Brev, SLURM, Kubernetes, Docker). Do not use generic "keep improving" language alone to override a matching domain-specific DEFT workflow; attribute-labelled CLIP / SigLIP image-retrieval loops belong to tao-run-deft-pas unless HPO is explicit.
description_zh: 使用 AutoMLRunner 运行基于容器的 NVIDIA TAO 网络的 AutoML / 超参数优化 (HPO)。支持算法选择（贝叶斯、Hyperband、ASHA、BOHB、LLM、混合、AutoResearch）、WandB 实验跟踪、在任何 TAO SDK 平台上执行作业、结果解释以及每条记录的定制评估钩子。当用户提到 TAO AutoML、超参数优化、HPO、automl、automl_settings、AutoMLRunner、tao_automl、贝叶斯搜索、Hyperband、ASHA、LLM 指导搜索、AutoResearch，或希望对 TAO 网络进行训练/评估/推理/蒸馏/剪枝/量化时使用。模型操作使用解析的镜像；venv 训练需要明确请求。平台无关性——可在任何 SDK（Brev、SLURM、Kubernetes、Docker）上运行。不要单独使用通用的“持续改进”语言来覆盖匹配的特定领域 DEFT 工作流；标记为 CLIP / SigLIP 的图像检索循环属于 tao-run-deft-pas，除非明确指定了 HPO。

name: core-agent-browser
description: Internal support skill for agent-browser CLI workflows used by rust-learner, docs-researcher, and crate-researcher. Use only when browser automation is explicitly required.
description_zh: 为 rust-learner、docs-researcher 和 crate-researcher 使用的 agent-browser CLI 工作流程提供内部支持技能。仅在明确需要浏览器自动化时使用。

name: promote
description: Graduate a proven pattern from auto-memory (MEMORY.md) to CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/ for permanent enforcement. Use when the user runs /si:promote or asks to make a learned behavior permanent.
description_zh: 从自动记忆（MEMORY.md）中毕业一个已验证的模式到 CLAUDE.md 或 .claude/rules/，以永久执行。当用户运行 /si:promote 或要求将学习到的行为设为永久时使用。

name: chakra-ui-migrate
description: Migrate Chakra UI projects from v2 to v3, covering package changes, codemods, provider setup, color mode, prop renaming, compound components, theming, recipes, and Next.js updates. Use this skill whenever a user is upgrading Chakra UI versions, encountering breaking changes after an upgrade, converting old v2 patterns (ColorModeScript, useColorModeValue, styleConfig, extendTheme, isDisabled, colorScheme, @chakra-ui/icons, framer-motion dependency), fixing compound component patterns, or asking about differences between Chakra UI v2 and v3 — even if they don't say "migrate" or "upgrade" explicitly.
description_zh: 将 Chakra UI 项目从 v2 迁移到 v3，涵盖包的变更、代码转换、提供者设置、色彩模式、属性重命名、复合组件、主题定制、解决方案以及 Next.js 的更新。在用户升级 Chakra UI 版本、升级后遇到破坏性变更、转换旧的 v2 模式（ColorModeScript、useColorModeValue、styleConfig、extendTheme、isDisabled、colorScheme、@chakra-ui/icons、framer-motion 依赖）、修复复合组件模式，或询问 Chakra UI v2 和 v3 之间差异时，均可使用此技能——即使他们没有明确提及“迁移”或“升级”。

name: co-selling-strategy
description: Design the operating model for how direct sales and partner sellers collaborate on shared deals - deal registration policy (protection windows, approval SLA, rejection grounds), deal credit and attribution split (partner-sourced vs partner-influenced, comp neutrality), and channel rules of engagement between direct and partner sellers. Covers B2B co-sell motions at the policy level. Use whenever the user mentions co-selling, partner deal registration, deal credit splits, partner attribution policy, or reps and partners working the same account, even if they never say co-sell. Do NOT use for adjudicating a live contested deal - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-channel-conflict instead.
description_zh: 设计直接销售和合作伙伴销售在共享交易中协作的运营模式——交易注册政策（保护期、审批服务水平协议、拒绝理由）、交易信用和归属分配（合作伙伴来源与合作伙伴影响、补偿中立性），以及直接销售和合作伙伴销售之间的渠道参与规则。在政策层面涵盖B2B联合销售行为。当用户提及联合销售、合作伙伴交易注册、交易信用分配、合作伙伴归属政策，或代表和合作伙伴共同处理同一账户时，即使他们从未提及联合销售，也请使用。不应用于裁决正在进行的争议交易——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@partner-channel-conflict。

name: setup-sandbox
description: Set up the initial file system for a new sandbox. Fetches the account's organizations and artists via the Recoup CLI and scaffolds the folder structure. Use when a sandbox has just been created and has no existing file system. Before running, check if the sandbox already has an orgs/ directory — if it does, this skill is not needed.

name: remove-technical-debt
description: Guided journey from a large aged codebase everyone fears to touch to one that is safe to change, legible, bounded, and resilient - paid down in place without a rewrite. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - working-with-legacy-code, refactoring-patterns, clean-code, software-design-philosophy, clean-architecture, pragmatic-programmer, release-it, domain-driven-design - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (TESTING.md, TECH-DEBT.md, REMOVE-TECHNICAL-DEBT-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to tame a legacy codebase, pay down technical debt safely, avoid a big-bang rewrite, or says 'we are afraid to touch this code'. For a fresh vibe-coded prototype, improve-code-quality; for greenfield structure, design-code-architecture; for a product-and-UX pass, improve-app; to optimize a working codebase for speed, architecture-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从每个人都不敢触碰的大型陈旧代码库，引导至一个安全可改、易于阅读、边界清晰且富有弹性的代码库——无需重写即可就地优化。分阶段逐步实施八项技能：处理遗留代码、重构模式、编写清晰代码、软件设计哲学、清晰架构、务实编程、发布代码、领域驱动设计——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹中（TESTING.md、TECH-DEBT.md、REMOVE-TECHNICAL-DEBT-PLAN.md），以便跨会话继续进行。当用户希望驯服遗留代码库、安全偿还技术债务、避免大规模重写，或表示“我们不敢触碰这段代码”时使用。对于清新风格的代码原型，使用improve-code-quality；对于空白地构建项目，使用design-code-architecture；对于产品和用户体验优化，使用improve-app；为优化现有代码库的性能，使用architecture-optimization。对于单一框架，可直接调用相应技能。

name: ib-check-deck
description: Investment banking presentation quality checker. Reviews a pitch deck or client-ready presentation for (1) number consistency across slides, (2) data-narrative alignment, (3) language polish against IB standards, (4) visual and formatting QC. Use whenever the user asks to review, check, QC, proof, or do a final pass on a deck, pitch, or client materials — including requests like "check my numbers", "reconcile figures across slides", "is this client-ready", or "what am I missing before I send this out".
description_zh: 投资银行演示文稿质量检查工具。用于审核提案演示文稿或客户准备好的演示文稿，检查内容包括：(1) 幻灯片间数字的一致性，(2) 数据与叙述的匹配度，(3) 符合投资银行业标准的语言润色，(4) 视觉效果和格式质量检查。用户在需要审核、检查、质检、校对或对演示文稿、提案或客户材料进行最终检查时均可使用——包括类似“检查我的数据”、“核对幻灯片间数据”、“这是否符合客户要求”或“在发送前我遗漏了什么”等请求。

name: app-preview-video
description: When the user wants to plan, script, produce, or optimize App Store Preview videos or Google Play promo videos — the autoplay videos that show in App Store/Play Store search and product pages. Use when the user mentions "App Preview", "preview video", "app store video", "promo video", "Play Store video", "video poster frame", "YouTube promo for Play Store", "30 second app video", "video script", "video specs", or "should I add a preview video". For static screenshots, see screenshot-optimization. For A/B testing the video, see ab-test-store-listing. For broader creative briefs, see screenshot-optimization (covers stills).
description_zh: 当用户需要规划、编写脚本、制作或优化 App Store 预览视频或 Google Play 推广视频时——这些自动播放的视频会显示在 App Store/Play Store 的搜索和产品页面上。当用户提到“App 预览”、“预览视频”、“App Store 视频”、“推广视频”、“Play Store 视频”、“视频海报帧”、“YouTube 推广视频”、“30 秒 App 视频”、“视频脚本”、“视频规格”或“我是否应该添加预览视频”时，请使用此功能。静态截图请参考 screenshot-optimization。视频 A/B 测试请参考 ab-test-store-listing。更广泛的创意简报请参考 screenshot-optimization（涵盖静态图像）。

name: deep-research
description: Creates reusable, source-traced research reports and coordinates provider/mode lanes with original exports. Use for 深度研究, 调研报告, literature reviews, market or company research, and ChatGPT/Kimi/UniFuncs research routes. Technology choice uses tech-selection; competitor code uses competitors-analysis.
description_zh: 创建可重用、来源可追溯的研究报告，并与原始出口协调供应商/模式通道。用于深度研究、调研报告、文献综述、市场或公司研究，以及ChatGPT/Kimi/UniFuncs研究路线。技术选择使用tech-selection；竞争对手代码使用competitors-analysis。

name: influencer-measurement-framework
description: Design the pre-launch measurement plan for one influencer or creator campaign - KPIs matched to the objective (awareness, engagement, conversion, affiliate-linked, always-on ambassador), an attribution method and data source behind each KPI, reporting cadence per stakeholder, and declared blind spots. Delivered as a measurement plan document before launch, for B2B and B2C alike. Use whenever the user mentions influencer KPIs, creator campaign attribution, campaign reporting, or asks how to measure a creator partnership, even if they never say measurement. Do NOT use for an ongoing affiliate program dashboard - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-performance-dashboard instead.
description_zh: 设计一个针对单个网红或创作者推广活动的预热期衡量计划——KPI需与目标匹配（知名度、互动、转化、联盟营销关联、持续大使），明确每个KPI背后的归因方法和数据来源，以及各利益相关者的报告频率，并指出已知的盲点。该衡量计划文档应在推广活动启动前交付，适用于B2B和B2C场景。当用户提及网红KPI、创作者活动归因、活动报告，或询问如何衡量创作者合作时，即使他们未明确提及“衡量”，也应使用此计划。不适用于持续性的联盟营销仪表盘——应使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-performance-dashboard。

name: tao-generate-video-reasoning-annotations
description: Multi-step video annotation pipeline that turns raw videos into Chain-of-Thought training data — multi-level captions, structured descriptions, and QA pairs (MCQ, binary, open-ended) with reasoning traces, via VLM/LLM distillation. Use when the user wants to "create video training data", "generate video QA datasets", "build CoT reasoning traces from videos", "auto-label videos", or run the video_reasoning_annotation pipeline. Triggers include "video annotation", "video CoT", "video QA", "chain-of-thought", "video captioning pipeline", "video distillation".
description_zh: 多步骤视频标注流程，将原始视频转换为思维链训练数据——包括多级标题、结构化描述以及问答对（多项选择、二元选择、开放式），并附带推理轨迹，通过视觉语言模型/大型语言模型蒸馏实现。当用户需要“创建视频训练数据”、“生成视频问答数据集”、“从视频中构建思维链推理轨迹”、“自动标注视频”或运行`video_reasoning_annotation`流程时使用。触发词包括“视频标注”、“视频思维链”、“视频问答”、“思维链”、“视频标题生成流程”、“视频蒸馏”。

name: tao-list-capabilities
description: Answer what the TAO Skill Bank plugin can do by generating the response from packaged application, data, model, AutoML, and platform manifests. Use when the user asks "what can TAO Skill Bank do", "list TAO models", "which TAO workflows are available", or "what supports AutoML".
description_zh: 通过从打包的应用、数据、模型、AutoML和平台清单中生成响应来回答用户关于TAO技能库插件能做什么的问题。当用户询问“TAO技能库能做什么”、“列出TAO模型”、“有哪些可用的TAO工作流”或“哪些支持AutoML”时使用。

name: sosumi
description: Fetches Apple documentation as Markdown via Sosumi. Use for Apple API reference, Human Interface Guidelines, WWDC transcripts, and external Swift-DocC pages.

name: seeker-connect
description: Connect a web dapp to the Seeker device's built-in wallet with Seeker Connect. Use when adding wallet connection, sign-in with Solana, message signing, or transaction signing to a website that runs in the browser on a Seeker phone, registering the "Seeker Connect" Wallet Standard wallet, choosing the Nostr relay for relayDomain, using the seeker-connect-button element, or debugging SeekerConnectError codes like association-failed.

name: creator-ugc-marketing
description: When the user wants to plan, brief, source, or measure organic creator / influencer / UGC marketing for their app — including TikTok creators, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, micro-influencers, paid creator briefs, UGC ad creative for Meta/TikTok, affiliate programs, and seeding strategy. Use when the user mentions "creators", "influencers", "TikTok marketing", "UGC", "user-generated content", "creator briefs", "creator outreach", "influencer marketing", "Reels", "Shorts", "creator gifting", "seeding", "affiliate", "Whop", "TikTok Spark Ads", "Instagram collab posts", or "I want my app to go viral on TikTok". For paid social ad campaigns (Meta/TikTok ad accounts), see ua-campaign. For PR / press, see press-and-pr. For viral in-app loops, see referral-program.
description_zh: 当用户希望为其应用规划、简报、采购或衡量有机创作者/网红/UGC营销时——包括抖音创作者、Instagram Reels、YouTube Shorts、微型网红、付费创作者简报、Meta/TikTok的UGC广告创意、联盟计划以及种子策略。当用户提及“创作者”、“网红”、“抖音营销”、“UGC”、“用户生成内容”、“创作者简报”、“创作者拓展”、“网红营销”、“Reels”、“Shorts”、“创作者赠礼”、“种子策略”、“联盟”、“Whop”、“抖音Spark广告”、“Instagram合作帖子”或“我想让我的应用在抖音上病毒式传播”时使用。对于付费社交广告活动（Meta/TikTok广告账户），请参阅ua-campaign。对于公关/媒体，请参阅press-and-pr。对于应用内的病毒式循环，请参阅referral-program。

name: tao-convert-dataset-format
description: Run `tao-daft convert` to convert NVIDIA TAO DAFT datasets between supported formats. Do not use for non-DAFT data. Use when the user asks to convert a DAFT dataset, change DAFT format, change a TAO dataset format, or run `tao-daft convert`.
description_zh: 运行 `tao-daft convert` 命令，可在支持的格式之间转换 NVIDIA TAO DAFT 数据集。请勿用于非 DAFT 数据。当用户要求转换 DAFT 数据集、更改 DAFT 格式、更改 TAO 数据集格式或运行 `tao-daft convert` 时使用。

name: qqmusic
description: QQ Music — search songs, albums, playlists, music videos, artists; daily recommendations; music charts & rankings; AI-powered playlists; personalized listening reports & music insights. QQ音乐助手：搜索、每日推荐、排行榜、AI歌单、听歌报告、AI解读。
description_zh: QQ音乐 — 搜索歌曲、专辑、歌单、音乐视频、艺人；每日推荐；音乐排行榜 & 排名；AI驱动歌单；个性化听歌报告 & 音乐洞察。QQ音乐助手：搜索、每日推荐、排行榜、AI歌单、听歌报告、AI解读。

name: phoenix-tracing
description: OpenInference semantic conventions and instrumentation for Phoenix AI observability. Use when implementing LLM tracing, creating custom spans, or deploying to production.
description_zh: OpenInference 语义规范和 Phoenix AI 可观测性工具的仪器化。在实现 LLM 追踪、创建自定义跨度或部署到生产环境时使用。

name: bento
description: Modular grid layout with card-like blocks, clear hierarchy, soft spacing, and subtle visual contrast for organized, scannable interfaces.
description_zh: 模块化网格布局，采用卡片式模块，层次分明，间距柔和，视觉对比微妙，用于构建有序且易于浏览的界面。

name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.
description_zh: 在 Ginkgo Bioworks 云实验室（cloud.ginkgo.bio）上提交和管理协议，这是一个用于在可重构自动化车（RAC）上执行自主实验室操作的网页界面。当用户希望运行蛋白质表达和纯化（无细胞、大肠杆菌或毕赤酵母）、HiBiT 或 A280 或 LabChip 定量、IVT mRNA/circRNA 合成、热位移/可开发性检测、Echo-MS 酶或分析物方法、SPR 目标上载、荧光像素艺术，或与其他 Ginkgo 云实验室服务交互时使用。涵盖协议选择、输入准备、定价和订购流程。

name: pr-feedback-quality-gate
description: Safely track pull request feedback, resolve review comments or merge conflicts, validate fixes, and use a read-only cross-review before committing or pushing follow-up changes.
description_zh: 安全地跟踪拉取请求的反馈，解决评审评论或合并冲突，验证修复，并在提交或推送后续更改之前使用只读交叉评审。

name: paperzilla
description: Chat with your agent about projects, recommendations, and canonical papers in Paperzilla. Use when users ask for recent project recommendations, canonical paper details, markdown-based summaries, recommendation feedback, feed export, or Atom feed URLs.
description_zh: 与 Paperzilla 中的代理就项目、推荐及经典论文进行交流。当用户请求近期项目推荐、经典论文详情、基于 Markdown 的摘要、推荐反馈、信息流导出或 Atom 信息流 URL 时，使用此功能。

name: senior-backend
description: Designs and implements backend systems including REST APIs, microservices, database architectures, authentication flows, and security hardening. Use when the user asks to "design REST APIs", "optimize database queries", "implement authentication", "build microservices", "review backend code", "set up GraphQL", "handle database migrations", or "load test APIs". Covers Node.js/Express/Fastify development, PostgreSQL optimization, API security, and backend architecture patterns.
description_zh: 设计和实现包括REST API、微服务、数据库架构、认证流程和安全加固的后端系统。当用户要求“设计REST API”、“优化数据库查询”、“实现认证”、“构建微服务”、“审查后端代码”、“设置GraphQL”、“处理数据库迁移”或“对API进行负载测试”时使用。涵盖Node.js/Express/Fastify开发、PostgreSQL优化、API安全以及后端架构模式。

name: funding-digest
description: Generate a polished one-page PowerPoint slide summarizing key takeaways from recent funding rounds and notable capital markets activity across a user's watched sectors or companies. Use this skill when the user asks for a deal flow summary, weekly recap, funding digest, transaction roundup, or capital markets briefing. Triggers on: 'deal flow digest', 'weekly funding recap', 'deal roundup', 'transaction summary this week', 'what happened in [sector] this week', 'capital markets update', or any request to compile recent funding activity into a briefing slide. Produces a professional single-slide PPTX with key takeaways, valuation data, and Capital IQ deal links.
description_zh: 生成一份精炼的单页PPT幻灯片，总结用户关注领域或公司近期融资轮次和资本市场活动的关键要点。当用户要求获取交易流摘要、每周回顾、融资摘要、交易汇总或资本市场简报时，使用此技能。触发条件包括："交易流摘要"、"每周融资回顾"、"交易汇总"、"本周交易总结"、"本周[领域]发生了什么"、"资本市场更新"，或任何要求将近期融资活动汇总成简报幻灯片的请求。生成一份专业的单页PPTX文件，包含关键要点、估值数据以及Capital IQ交易链接。

name: imagencn
description: Multi-platform AI image generation via DashScope/Ark/Hunyuan/Zhipu/StepFun plus Grok/OpenAI/Gemini/FLUX (international), specializing in Chinese text rendering and photorealistic images
description_zh: 通过DashScope/Ark/Hunyuan/Zhipu/StepFun结合Grok/OpenAI/Gemini/FLUX（国际版）实现跨平台AI图像生成，专注于中文文本渲染和照片级真实图像

name: build-loop-claude-code
description: Use when building features with **Claude Code** in any codebase and the work should go through a disciplined build → review → test → fix loop. Triggers on "run the build loop", "build the next task", "continue the plan", "build this feature properly", or any request to implement work from a plan file or a direct feature prompt. Builds from the plan (or the prompt if no plan exists), runs Claude Code's `/review` (plus `/security-review` for sensitive surfaces) and fixes every issue found, tests and verifies the feature end to end, fixes anything testing surfaces, and reports back once complete. Repeats until all plan tasks are checked off.
description_zh: 在构建任何代码库中的 **Claude Code** 功能时使用，工作应遵循严格的构建 → 审查 → 测试 → 修复循环。在以下情况下触发："运行构建循环"、"构建下一个任务"、"继续计划"、"正确构建此功能"，或从计划文件或直接功能提示中实施工作的任何请求。从计划（如果不存在计划则从提示）构建，运行 Claude Code 的 `/review`（对敏感表面额外运行 `/security-review`）并修复所有发现的问题，进行端到端测试并验证功能，修复测试表面上的任何问题，并在完成后报告。重复此过程，直到所有计划任务都被标记完成。

name: stitch-design-taste
description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.
description_zh: Google Stitch 的语义设计系统技能。生成对代理友好的 DESIGN.md 文件，强制执行高端、反通用的 UI 标准——严格的排版、校准的色彩、非对称布局、持续的微动效果以及硬件加速性能。

name: om-spec-writing
description: Write and review feature specifications to staff-engineer standards. Skeleton-first drafting with a hard Open Questions gate, research against market leaders, an implementation breakdown into phases and steps that feeds om-auto-create-pr, and a severity-ranked architectural review format. Use when starting a new spec or reviewing one.
description_zh: 编写和评审符合员工工程师标准的特性规格。采用“骨架先行”的草稿方式，设置严格的“开放问题”关卡，对市场领先者进行研究，将实施分解为阶段和步骤以供 om-auto-create-pr 使用，并采用按严重程度排序的架构评审格式。在开始编写新规格或评审现有规格时使用。

name: fsi-strip-profile
description: Creates professional investment banking strip profiles (company profiles) for pitch books, deal materials, and client presentations. Generates 1-4 information-dense slides with quadrant layouts, charts, and tables.
description_zh: 创建专业的投资银行条形图资料（公司资料），用于路演书、交易材料和客户演示。生成1-4张信息密集型幻灯片，采用象限布局、图表和表格。

name: skill-creator
description: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Claude's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations.
description_zh: 创建有效技能的指南。当用户希望创建一项新技能（或更新一项现有技能），以扩展Claude的功能，并融入专业知识、工作流程或工具集成时，应使用此技能。

name: business-pulse
description: Produces a one-page cross-functional business snapshot for SMB owners — cash position (the ledger: MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), sales trend (PayPal/Square/Stripe), pipeline movement (HubSpot), this week's commitments (Calendar), urgent watch-list items (Gmail or M365, Slack), and the single most important thing needing attention today. Proactively tries every available connector and gracefully scopes to whatever is connected — one connector gives a partial pulse; the full stack gives the full picture. Trigger when the user asks how the business is doing, wants a snapshot, a daily brief, a Friday recap, or says anything like "what am I missing" or "catch me up on the business." A start-of-week briefing routes to /monday-brief, which runs this skill as its first link.
description_zh: 生成面向中小型企业主的一页跨职能业务快照——现金状况（总账：MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero或Zoho Books）、销售趋势（PayPal/Square/Stripe）、项目进展（HubSpot）、本周承诺事项（日历）、紧急关注事项（Gmail或M365、Slack），以及今天最需要关注的一件重要事情。主动尝试所有可用的连接器，并优雅地扩展到已连接的内容——一个连接器提供部分脉搏；完整堆栈呈现完整图景。当用户询问业务状况、需要快照、每日简报、周五回顾，或说出类似“我错过了什么”或“帮我了解一下业务”等话时触发。每周开始的简报会路由到/monday-brief，该链接将此技能作为首个环节运行。

name: tao-generate-image-grounding
description: Two-step image grounding pipeline: extracts referring expressions from (image, caption) pairs and grounds them to pixel-space bounding boxes via a VLM. Use when the user wants to ground captions to bboxes, generate phrase-grounded annotations, auto-label images for grounding, or run the image_grounding pipeline. Triggers include 'image grounding', 'phrase grounding', 'ground captions', 'auto-label image grounding', 'image_grounding'.
description_zh: 两步图像定位流程：从（图像，标题）对中提取指代表达式，并通过视觉语言模型（VLM）将其定位到像素空间的边界框。当用户希望将标题定位到边界框、生成短语定位的标注、自动标注图像进行定位或运行图像定位流程时使用。触发词包括“图像定位”、“短语定位”、“定位标题”、“自动标注图像定位”、“图像定位”。

name: tao-train-image-classification
description: PyTorch-based TAO image classification. Supports a wide range of backbones (FAN, EfficientNet, ResNet, etc.) with distillation and quantization for deployment. Use when training, evaluating, distilling, quantizing, exporting, or running inference for a TAO image-classification (PyT) model. Trigger phrases include "train image classifier", "TAO classification", "ResNet/EfficientNet/FAN backbone classifier", "classification-pyt".
description_zh: 基于 PyTorch 的 TAO 图像分类。支持多种骨干网络（FAN、EfficientNet、ResNet 等），并支持蒸馏和量化以进行部署。用于对 TAO 图像分类（PyT）模型进行训练、评估、蒸馏、量化、导出或运行推理。触发短语包括“训练图像分类器”、“TAO 分类”、“ResNet/EfficientNet/FAN 骨干网络分类器”、“classification-pyt”。

name: tao-train-ocrnet
description: OCRNet for scene text recognition. Recognizes text content from cropped text-region images and supports CTC and attention-based decoders. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, pruning, quantizing, retraining, or running inference for a TAO OCRNet model. Trigger phrases include "train OCRNet", "scene text recognition", "OCR cropped text", "CTC / attention text decoder".
description_zh: OCRNet 用于场景文字识别。可识别裁剪文本区域图像中的文字内容，并支持 CTC 和基于注意力的解码器。在训练、评估、导出、剪枝、量化、重新训练或对 TAO OCRNet 模型运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练 OCRNet”、“场景文字识别”、“OCR 裁剪文本”、“CTC / 注意力文本解码器”。

name: aesthetic-usability
description: Apply the Aesthetic-Usability Effect — polished, consistent interfaces are perceived as more usable and forgive minor friction. Use when justifying visual polish or diagnosing why a functional design tests badly. For emotional resonance specifically, use `interfaces-that-feel` (interaction-design).
description_zh: 应用美学可用性效应——精致且一致的界面会被感知为更易用，并能容忍轻微的摩擦。在论证视觉打磨的必要性，或诊断功能设计为何测试表现不佳时使用此条。若专门针对情感共鸣，请使用 `interfaces-that-feel`（交互设计）。

name: rev-u3d-dump
description: Dump Unity IL2CPP symbols from iOS/Android builds. Extract method names, addresses, and type info from IL2CPP binaries and global-metadata.dat, then generate IDA/Ghidra import scripts.
description_zh: 从 iOS/Android 构建中转储 Unity IL2CPP 符号。从 IL2CPP 二进制文件和 global-metadata.dat 中提取方法名称、地址和类型信息，然后生成 IDA/Ghidra 导入脚本。

name: tao-run-on-kubernetes
description: Kubernetes execution platform — submits TAO container jobs as k8s Jobs with NVIDIA GPU scheduling; single-pod for one node, Indexed Jobs for multi-node distributed training. Use when running on EKS / GKE / AKS / on-prem clusters with the NVIDIA GPU Operator installed, or when integrating TAO into an existing k8s-native ML platform.
description_zh: Kubernetes执行平台——将TAO容器作业作为k8s作业提交，并支持NVIDIA GPU调度；单节点使用单Pod，多节点分布式训练使用Indexed Jobs。适用于在安装了NVIDIA GPU Operator的EKS/GKE/AKS/本地集群上运行，或是在现有k8s原生ML平台上集成TAO时使用。

name: tinybird
description: Tinybird file formats, SQL rules, optimization patterns, and best practices for datasources, pipes, endpoints, and materialized views.
description_zh: Tinybird 文件格式、SQL 规则、优化模式以及数据源、管道、端点和物化视图的最佳实践。

name: wordpress-content
description: Create and manage WordPress posts, pages, media, categories, tags, and menus via WP-CLI or the REST API. Use whenever the user wants to publish a blog post on WordPress, update a page, upload media, manage categories or tags, update navigation menus, schedule posts, or do bulk content operations on a WordPress site.
description_zh: 通过 WP-CLI 或 REST API 创建和管理 WordPress 文章、页面、媒体、分类、标签和菜单。在用户希望发布 WordPress 博客文章、更新页面、上传媒体、管理分类或标签、更新导航菜单、安排文章发布或在 WordPress 网站上进行批量内容操作时使用。

name: drizzle
description: Type-safe SQL ORM for TypeScript with zero runtime overhead
description_zh: 类型安全的 TypeScript SQL ORM，零运行时开销

name: telegram-reader
description: Read Telegram channels and groups for financial news and market research with the tdl CLI: list chats and channels, find a channel by name, and export recent messages or a date or ID range. Use this skill whenever the user wants to check their Telegram, see what's new in their channels, read or export messages from a news, crypto, or trading channel or group, or gather market news and signals posted on Telegram. Read-only: it cannot send messages or join or leave channels.
description_zh: 使用 tdl CLI 阅读Telegram频道和群组，获取财经新闻和市场研究：列出群组和频道、按名称查找频道、导出最近消息或特定日期或ID范围内的消息。当用户需要检查Telegram、查看其频道中的最新动态、阅读或导出新闻、加密货币或交易频道或群组中的消息，或收集Telegram上发布的市场新闻和信号时，请使用此技能。仅读权限：无法发送消息或加入/离开频道。

name: n8n-error-handling-official
description: Use when building any webhook-triggered workflow, scheduled/production-bound workflow, wiring a per-node error output, or any workflow where silent failure would drop user-visible work. Triggers on "webhook", "respond to webhook", "API", "production", "error", "failure", "5xx", "try/catch", "error workflow", "onError", "continueErrorOutput", "error branch", "node error output", "output(1)", "main[1]", "scheduled", or any workflow that runs unattended.
description_zh: 在构建任何由 webhook 触发的流程、计划/生产相关流程、为每个节点配置错误输出，或任何在静默失败时会丢失用户可见工作的流程时使用。触发条件包括："webhook"、"响应 webhook"、"API"、"生产"、"错误"、"失败"、"5xx"、"try/catch"、"错误流程"、"onError"、"continueErrorOutput"、"错误分支"、"节点错误输出"、"output(1)"、"main[1]"、"计划"或任何无人值守运行的流程。

name: tao-run-inference-service
description: Start, query, and stop a network-specific TAO inference microservice ({network_arch}-inference-microservice) by delegating container execution to the appropriate platform skill. Handles container image resolution, job-payload JSON construction, and the service registry. Use when the user wants to run inference on a TAO model checkpoint using a microservice container, deploy a TAO inference endpoint, or stop a running inference container.
description_zh: 通过将容器执行委托给相应的平台技能，启动、查询和停止特定网络的TAO推理微服务（{network_arch}-inference-microservice）。处理容器镜像解析、任务负载JSON构建和服务注册。当用户希望使用微服务容器在TAO模型检查点上进行推理、部署TAO推理端点或停止正在运行的推理容器时使用。

name: upstash-qstash-js
description: Work with the @upstash/qstash TypeScript/JavaScript SDK, an HTTP-based message queue, task scheduler, and background job system for serverless and edge runtimes (Next.js, Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Node.js). Use when publishing messages to HTTP endpoints or URL groups, running background jobs without a long-running worker process, scheduling with cron expressions, delaying messages, building FIFO queues with parallelism and flow control, configuring retries and callbacks, handling a dead letter queue (DLQ), deduplicating messages, fanning out to multiple endpoints, verifying QStash webhook signatures (Next.js App Router, Pages Router, and Edge Runtime), running a local QStash dev server, or migrating regions. Also use when the user asks for a serverless cron job, async task queue, job scheduler, delayed delivery, webhook delivery with retries, or event-driven messaging between services.
