description_zh: 使用 @upstash/qstash TypeScript/JavaScript SDK，这是一个基于 HTTP 的消息队列、任务调度器和后台作业系统，适用于无服务器和边缘运行时（Next.js、Vercel、Cloudflare Workers、Deno、Node.js）。在以下场景中使用：向 HTTP 端点或 URL 组发布消息、无需长时间运行的 Worker 进程即可运行后台作业、使用 Cron 表达式进行调度、延迟消息、构建具有并行性和流量控制的 FIFO 队列、配置重试和回调、处理死信队列（DLQ）、去重消息、分发给多个端点、验证 QStash webhook 签名（Next.js App Router、Pages Router 和 Edge Runtime）、运行本地 QStash 开发服务器或迁移区域。当用户需要无服务器 Cron 作业、异步任务队列、作业调度器、延迟交付、带重试的 webhook 交付或服务间事件驱动消息时，也请使用。

name: clean-code-principles
description: SOLID principles, design patterns, DRY, KISS, and clean code fundamentals. Use when reviewing architecture, checking code quality, refactoring, or discussing design decisions. Triggers on "review architecture", "check code quality", "SOLID principles", "design patterns", or "clean code".
description_zh: SOLID原则、设计模式、DRY、KISS以及干净代码的基础知识。在审查架构、检查代码质量、重构或讨论设计决策时使用。在“审查架构”、“检查代码质量”、“SOLID原则”、“设计模式”或“干净代码”时触发。

name: tao-analyze-changenet-rca
description: Performs deep Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on NVIDIA TAO Visual ChangeNet classification experiments with image-evidence-driven investigation. Use when analyzing ChangeNet model failures, investigating poor recall / FAR / PASS-NO_PASS metrics, auditing visual inspection pipeline quality, or running an RCA report for an AOI defect-detection model. Trigger phrases include "RCA on my ChangeNet model", "why is my AOI model failing", "audit ChangeNet predictions", "investigate FAR regressions", "root cause analysis on visual-changenet".
description_zh: 对NVIDIA TAO Visual ChangeNet分类实验进行深度根本原因分析（RCA），采用图像证据驱动的调查方法。在分析ChangeNet模型故障、调查低召回率/FAR/PASS-NO_PASS指标、审核视觉检查流程质量，或为AOI缺陷检测模型运行RCA报告时使用。触发短语包括“我的ChangeNet模型进行RCA”、“我的AOI模型为何失败”、“审核ChangeNet预测结果”、“调查FAR回归问题”、“对视觉ChangeNet进行根本原因分析”。

name: tao-train-optical-inspection
description: Optical Inspection for defect detection using Siamese networks. Compares image pairs to detect manufacturing defects, anomalies, or quality issues. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO Optical Inspection model on AOI / quality-control data. Trigger phrases include "train optical inspection", "AOI defect detection", "Siamese defect classifier", "PCB / manufacturing inspection".
description_zh: 使用 Siamese 网络进行光学检测以发现缺陷。通过比较图像对来检测制造缺陷、异常或质量问题。在训练、评估、导出或对 AOI / 质量控制数据上的 TAO 光学检测模型进行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练光学检测”、“AOI 缺陷检测”、“Siamese 缺陷分类器”、“PCB / 制造检测”。

name: improve-app
description: Guided journey from a shipped app that works but feels rough to a product that fits the job, flows without friction, reads clearly, and persuades honestly. Orchestrates nine skills phase by phase - jobs-to-be-done, ux-heuristics, design-everyday-things, refactoring-ui, microinteractions, made-to-stick, influence-psychology, high-perf-browser, steve-jobs-design-review - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (CUSTOMER.md, DESIGN.md, POSITIONING.md, IMPROVE-APP-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to fix a clunky product, cut UX friction, sharpen in-app copy, or says 'the app works but feels rough'. Not for code, tests, or hardening - use improve-code-quality (fresh prototype) or remove-technical-debt (aged); no app yet, create-app; needs growth loops, grow-app; marketing-site friction, improve-website; one leaking flow, conversion-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从功能可用但体验粗糙的应用程序，引导至契合需求、流畅无阻、清晰易读且真诚说服的产品。分阶段逐步掌握九项技能——待完成工作（Jobs-to-be-Done）、UX启发式方法、日常设计、UI重构、微交互、粘性设计、影响力心理学、高性能浏览器、乔布斯设计评审——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹（CUSTOMER.md、DESIGN.md、POSITIONING.md、IMPROVE-APP-PLAN.md）中，以便跨会话继续旅程。适用于用户希望修复体验不佳的产品、减少UX摩擦、优化应用内文案，或表示“应用功能正常但感觉粗糙”的情况。不适用于代码、测试或性能优化——使用improve-code-quality（全新原型）或remove-technical-debt（陈旧）；尚未开发应用，则创建-app；需要增长循环，则grow-app；营销网站摩擦，则improve-website；存在一个流失流程，则conversion-optimization。若针对单一框架，可直接调用相应技能。

name: qdrant-performance-optimization
description: Navigation hub linking sub-skills for proactive Qdrant tuning: search speed, indexing performance, and memory usage optimization. Use when planning configuration or capacity changes to improve speed and efficiency. For diagnosing an active production slowdown or analyzing live metrics, use qdrant-monitoring instead.
description_zh: 导航中心链接子技能，用于主动优化Qdrant：搜索速度、索引性能和内存使用优化。在规划配置或容量变更时使用，以提升速度和效率。若需诊断活跃生产中的减速问题或分析实时指标，请使用qdrant-monitoring。

name: brand-identity
description: Create a visual identity brief for a brand — logo direction, color palette, typography, imagery style, and design system foundations. Use when the user says "visual identity", "brand identity", "logo brief", "logo direction", "design brief", "brand design", "color palette for my brand", "typography for my brand", "visual language", "design system", "brand look and feel", "what should my brand look like", or is briefing a designer or design agency. Also use when the user has a brand strategy and wants to translate it into visual design direction.
description_zh: 为品牌创建一个视觉识别简报——包括标志方向、色彩搭配、字体、图像风格和设计系统基础。当用户说“视觉识别”、“品牌识别”、“标志简报”、“标志方向”、“设计简报”、“品牌设计”、“我的品牌的色彩搭配”、“我的品牌的字体”、“视觉语言”、“设计系统”、“品牌外观和感觉”、“我的品牌应该是什么样子”，或正在向设计师或设计机构进行简报时使用。此外，当用户拥有品牌策略并希望将其转化为视觉设计方向时，也使用此简报。

name: migrate
description: Migrate from Cypress or Selenium to Playwright. Use when user mentions "cypress", "selenium", "migrate tests", "convert tests", "switch to playwright", "move from cypress", or "replace selenium".
description_zh: 从 Cypress 或 Selenium 迁移到 Playwright。当用户提到“cypress”、“selenium”、“迁移测试”、“转换测试”、“切换到 Playwright”、“从 Cypress 迁移”或“替换 Selenium”时使用。

name: close-month
description: Closes the books and turns them into a decision as a three-link chain — month-end-prep reconciles the ledger against every connected payment processor and writes the P&L narrative, cash-flow-snapshot then refreshes the 30/60/90-day forecast off the newly closed numbers rather than raw ones, and report-builder publishes and distributes the close packet. Requires a ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) and uses Gusto, PayPal, Ramp, Shopify, Square, and Stripe when connected, falling back to statement or CSV uploads. Trigger on "close the month," "month-end," "close the books," "reconcile," "send the close packet to my accountant," or when the owner asks why revenue or margin moved last month. An owner who wants only the reconciliation and its flags, with no forecast refresh and no packet distribution, routes to month-end-prep directly.
description_zh: 关闭账簿并将其转化为一个三链决策——月度结账准备将总账与每个连接的支付处理器进行核对并撰写损益说明，现金流快照则基于新关闭的数字而非原始数据刷新30/60/90天预测，报告构建器发布并分发结账包。需要总账（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero或Zoho Books）并使用Gusto、PayPal、Ramp、Shopify、Square和Stripe（连接时）进行操作，若连接失败则回退至报表或CSV上传。触发条件为“结账月份”、“月度结账”、“关闭账簿”、“核对”、“将结账包发送给我的会计师”或当所有者询问上月收入或利润变动原因时。若所有者仅需要核对及其标记，无需刷新预测和分发包，则直接路由至月度结账准备。

name: tao-train-action-recognition
description: Action recognition from video sequences. Supports RGB, optical flow, and joint (multi-stream) input types for classifying temporal actions in video clips. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference on a TAO action-recognition model. Trigger phrases include "train action recognition", "video action classification", "RGB + optical flow action model", "TAO ActionRecognition".
description_zh: 从视频序列中进行动作识别。支持 RGB、光流以及联合（多流）输入类型，用于对视频片段中的时序动作进行分类。在对 TAO 动作识别模型进行训练、评估、导出或运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“train action recognition”、“video action classification”、“RGB + optical flow action model”、“TAO ActionRecognition”。

name: tao-train-grounding-dino
description: Grounding DINO for open-set object detection. Combines DINO-style detection with a BERT text encoder for language-guided detection — detects objects described by text prompts without a fixed class vocabulary. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Grounding DINO model. Trigger phrases include "train Grounding DINO", "open-vocabulary detection", "text-prompted detector", "language-guided object detection".
description_zh: 用于开放集目标检测的 Grounding DINO。结合 DINO 风格检测器与 BERT 文本编码器，实现语言引导的检测——可通过文本提示检测物体，无需固定的类别词汇表。适用于 TAO Grounding DINO 模型的训练、评估、导出、量化或推理等场景。触发短语包括“train Grounding DINO”、“open-vocabulary detection”、“text-prompted detector”、“language-guided object detection”。

name: tao-train-pose-classification
description: Pose classification using ST-GCN (Spatial Temporal Graph Convolutional Network). Classifies skeleton sequences into action categories from pose-keypoint data. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO pose-classification model. Trigger phrases include "train pose classification", "skeleton action recognition", "ST-GCN", "keypoint sequence classifier".
description_zh: 基于 ST-GCN（时空图卷积网络）的姿态分类。将骨骼序列姿态关键点数据分类到动作类别中。在对 TAO 姿态分类模型进行训练、评估、导出或执行推理时使用。触发短语包括：“训练姿态分类”、“骨骼动作识别”、“ST-GCN” 以及“关键点序列分类器”。

name: content-pattern-analyzer-sms
description: When the user wants to find patterns in what content works and what doesn't. Also use when the user mentions 'what's working,' 'content patterns,' 'best topics,' 'best format,' 'best time to post,' 'analyze my content,' 'do more of,' 'do less of,' or 'what should I change.' For raw metrics, see performance-analyzer-sms. For audience-specific analysis, see audience-growth-tracker-sms. For actionable recommendations, see optimization-advisor-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要找出哪些内容有效、哪些无效时，也可以使用。此外，当用户提到“什么有效”、“内容模式”、“最佳主题”、“最佳格式”、“最佳发布时间”、“分析我的内容”、“多做些”、“少做些”或“我应该改变什么”时，也可以使用。对于原始指标，请参阅 performance-analyzer-sms。对于针对特定受众的分析，请参阅 audience-growth-tracker-sms。对于可操作的推荐，请参阅 optimization-advisor-sms。

name: referral-abuse-guardrails
description: Define the operational guardrails that stop end customers from gaming a refer-a-friend program - reward caps, velocity limits and cooldowns, reward-hold windows tied to the refund window, eligibility rules, identity-verification gates, a published enforcement ladder, and abuse-monitoring signals. Produces a guardrail spec for B2C and B2B SaaS referral program managers. Use whenever the user mentions referral abuse, self-referral, fake accounts claiming referral rewards, referral rings, or a referral code leaking to coupon forums, even if they never say abuse. Do NOT use for professional-affiliate traffic fraud - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-fraud-detection instead.
description_zh: 定义防止终端用户滥用推荐好友计划的操作规范——包括奖励上限、速率限制和冷却期、与退款窗口绑定的奖励冻结期、资格规则、身份验证关卡、公开的处罚阶梯，以及滥用监控信号。为B2C和B2B SaaS推荐计划管理者生成规范文档。在用户提及推荐滥用、自我推荐、虚假账户声称获得推荐奖励、推荐环或推荐码泄露至优惠券论坛时使用，即使他们并未明确提及滥用。禁止用于专业联盟流量欺诈——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-fraud-detection。

name: framer-motion
description: Use when implementing Disney's 12 animation principles with Framer Motion in React applications
description_zh: 在 React 应用中使用 Framer Motion 实现 Disney 的 12 条动画原则时使用

name: markitdown
description: Guide for using Microsoft MarkItDown - a Python utility for converting files to Markdown. Use when converting PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, audio, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, ZIP, YouTube URLs, EPubs, Jupyter notebooks, RSS feeds, or Wikipedia pages to Markdown format. Also use for document processing pipelines, LLM preprocessing, or text extraction tasks.
description_zh: 使用 Microsoft MarkItDown 指南——一个用于将文件转换为 Markdown 的 Python 工具。在将 PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Excel、图像、音频、HTML、CSV、JSON、XML、ZIP、YouTube URL、EPubs、Jupyter 笔记本、RSS 源或维基百科页面转换为 Markdown 格式时使用。也适用于文档处理管道、LLM 预处理或文本提取任务。

name: tao-analyze-gaps-visual-changenet
description: Performs gap analysis on NVIDIA TAO VCN Classify (Visual Component Net) experiments by invoking the pinned TAO data-services container directly via `docker run … gap_analysis vcn_aoi …` — picks the optimal decision threshold, ranks per-sample weakness, and emits a top-K weakest parquet expanded per-lighting for downstream augmentation. Use when analyzing VCN classification failures, picking SDA augmentation targets, or auditing PASS/NO_PASS boundary cases.
description_zh: 通过直接调用固定好的 TAO 数据服务容器 `docker run … gap_analysis vcn_aoi …` 对 NVIDIA TAO VCN Classify（视觉组件网络）实验进行差距分析——选择最优决策阈值，对每样本弱点进行排序，并输出按光照条件扩展的 Top-K 最弱 Parquet 文件以供下游增强使用。适用于分析 VCN 分类失败案例、选择 SDA 增强目标或审计 PASS/NO_PASS 边界情况。

name: tao-train-nvpanoptix3d
description: NVPanoptix3D for panoptic 3D scene reconstruction from posed RGB images. Produces 3D panoptic segmentation (semantic, instance, and panoptic masks) with occupancy completion. Built on a VGGT backbone with a Mask2Former-style head and 3D frustum reconstruction. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO NVPanoptix3D model. Trigger phrases include "train NVPanoptix3D", "panoptic 3D reconstruction", "3D scene segmentation", "occupancy completion".
description_zh: NVPanoptix3D 用于从姿态 RGB 图像中进行全景 3D 场景重建。生成具有占用补全的全景 3D 分割（语义、实例和全景掩码），基于 VGGT 主干，采用 Mask2Former 风格的头部和 3D 极限锥重建。用于训练、评估、导出或运行 TAO NVPanoptix3D 模型的推理。触发短语包括“训练 NVPanoptix3D”、“全景 3D 重建”、“3D 场景分割”、“占用补全”。

name: deck-refresh
description: Updates a presentation with new numbers — quarterly refreshes, earnings updates, comp rolls, rebased market data. Use whenever the user asks to "update the deck with Q4 numbers", "refresh the comps", "roll this forward", "swap in the new earnings", "change all the $485M to $512M", or any request to swap figures across an existing deck without rebuilding it.
description_zh: 使用最新数据更新演示文稿——包括季度刷新、盈利更新、可比公司数据滚动以及重基准的市场数据。当用户要求"用第四季度数据更新演示文稿"、"刷新可比公司数据"、"将此数据向前滚动"、"替换新的盈利数据"、"将所有4.85亿美元更改为5.12亿美元"，或提出任何跨现有演示文稿替换数字的请求时，均使用此功能，而无需重新构建整个演示文稿。

name: swap-curve-strategy
description: Analyze the interest rate swap curve by pricing swaps at multiple tenors, overlaying government and inflation curves, and identifying curve trade opportunities. Use when analyzing swap curves, computing swap spreads, decomposing real rates, identifying steepener/flattener/butterfly trades, or comparing swap rates across currencies.
description_zh: 通过分析在多个期限上的掉期定价，叠加政府债券利率曲线与通胀曲线，并识别曲线交易机会，来分析利率掉期曲线。当需要分析掉期曲线、计算掉期利差、分解实际利率、识别蝶式交易（如陡峭化、平坦化或蝶式策略），或跨币种比较掉期利率时，使用此方法。

name: huggingface-local-models
description: Use to select models to run locally with llama.cpp and GGUF on CPU, Mac Metal, CUDA, or ROCm. Covers finding GGUFs, quant selection, running servers, exact GGUF file lookup, conversion, and OpenAI-compatible local serving.
description_zh: 用于选择在本地使用 llama.cpp 和 GGUF 通过 CPU、Mac Metal、CUDA 或 ROCm 运行模型。涵盖查找 GGUF、量化选择、运行服务器、精确 GGUF 文件查找、转换以及 OpenAI 兼容的本地服务。

name: tao-train-reid
description: Person re-identification (ReID). Learns discriminative embeddings to match the same person across different camera views, based on metric learning. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO person re-identification model. Trigger phrases include "train ReID", "person re-identification", "cross-camera person matching", "ReID embeddings", "person re-id".
description_zh: 行人重识别（ReID）。通过度量学习学习判别性嵌入，以匹配不同摄像头视角下的同一个人。在训练、评估、导出或对TAO行人重识别模型进行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练ReID”、“行人重识别”、“跨摄像头行人匹配”、“ReID嵌入”、“行人重识别”。

name: r3f-animation
description: Animate React Three Fiber objects with useFrame, damping, and GLTF clips. Use for procedural motion, animation transitions, or demand-loop animation; use physics guidance for collision-driven movement.
description_zh: 使用 useFrame、阻尼和 GLTF 剪辑来为 React Three Fiber 对象添加动画效果。可用于程序化运动、动画过渡或需求循环动画；使用物理引导实现基于碰撞的运动。

name: bulk-operations
description: Foundation patterns for the `hubspot` CLI — JSONL piping, batch read, pagination, dry-run/digest/confirm for destructive ops, and `hubspot history` for recovery. Every other skill builds on this one.
description_zh: `hubspot` CLI 的基础模式——JSONL 管道、批量读取、分页、破坏性操作的 dry-run/摘要/确认，以及用于恢复的 `hubspot history`。其他所有技能都建立在这个基础之上。

name: img2threejs
description: Turn an object or character reference image into a quality-gated, animation-ready procedural Three.js model built in code. Use for image-to-3D reconstruction, detail-accurate object rebuilds, stylized/likeness-maximized human characters, sculpt specs, and staged code generation.

name: crm-data-quality
description: Find incomplete records, normalize field values in bulk, dedupe with `hubspot objects merge`, and audit custom properties. Builds on `bulk-operations` for JSONL piping and dry-run/digest/confirm.
description_zh: 查找不完整的记录，批量规范化字段值，使用 `hubspot objects merge` 进行去重，并审核自定义属性。基于 `bulk-operations` 进行 JSONL 管道处理以及 dry-run/digest/confirm 操作。

name: scss-best-practices
description: SCSS/Sassy CSS best practices and coding guidelines for maintainable, scalable stylesheets
description_zh: SCSS / Sassy CSS 最佳实践与编码规范，用于打造可维护、可扩展的样式表

name: tao-train-depth-anything-v2
description: Monocular depth estimation using Metric Depth Anything v2 or Relative Depth Anything architectures. Predicts per-pixel depth from single RGB images. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO monocular depth model. Trigger phrases include "train monocular depth", "DepthAnything v2", "metric depth from single image", "monocular depth estimation".
description_zh: 使用 Metric Depth Anything v2 或 Relative Depth Anything 架构进行单目深度估计。从单张 RGB 图像中预测每像素深度。在训练、评估、导出或运行 TAO 单目深度模型推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练单目深度”、“DepthAnything v2”、“单张图像的度量深度”、“单目深度估计”。

name: tao-train-dino
description: DINO (DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes) for 2D object detection. Transformer-based detector with denoising training, multi-scale features, and optional distillation support. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, distilling, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO DINO detector. Trigger phrases include "train DINO", "DETR object detection", "TAO 2D detection", "DINO with distillation".
description_zh: DINO（改进去噪锚框的DETR）用于2D目标检测。基于Transformer的检测器，支持去噪训练、多尺度特征，以及可选的蒸馏支持。在训练、评估、导出、蒸馏、量化或为TAO DINO检测器运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练DINO”、“DETR目标检测”、“TAO 2D检测”、“带蒸馏的DINO”。

name: tao-train-mask2former
description: Mask2Former for universal image segmentation (panoptic, instance, and semantic). Transformer-based with masked attention for high-quality segmentation results. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Mask2Former model. Trigger phrases include "train Mask2Former", "universal segmentation", "panoptic / instance / semantic segmentation", "masked-attention transformer segmenter".
description_zh: Mask2Former 用于通用图像分割（全景、实例和语义）。基于 Transformer，使用掩码注意力机制以获得高质量的分割结果。在训练、评估、导出、量化或运行 TAO Mask2Former 模型的推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练 Mask2Former”、“通用分割”、“全景/实例/语义分割”、“掩码注意力 Transformer 分割器”。

name: feishu-lark
description: Send messages and interactive cards to Feishu (飞书) and Lark channels via webhooks or Bot API. Create rich-text announcements, marketing updates, and team notifications. Trigger phrases: "post to feishu", "feishu message", "lark message", "feishu webhook", "lark webhook", "send to feishu", "send to lark", "feishu bot", "lark bot", "飞书", "飞书机器人".
description_zh: 通过webhooks或Bot API向飞书（Feishu）和Lark频道发送消息和交互式卡片。创建富文本公告、营销更新和团队通知。触发短语："post to feishu"、"feishu message"、"lark message"、"feishu webhook"、"lark webhook"、"send to feishu"、"send to lark"、"feishu bot"、"lark bot"、"飞书"、"飞书机器人"。

name: testrail
description: Sync tests with TestRail. Use when user mentions "testrail", "test management", "test cases", "test run", "sync test cases", "push results to testrail", or "import from testrail".
description_zh: 与 TestRail 同步测试。当用户提及“testrail”、“测试管理”、“测试用例”、“测试运行”、“同步测试用例”、“将结果推送到 testrail”或“从 testrail 导入”时，使用此功能。

name: adk-frontend
description: Guidelines for building frontend applications that integrate with Botpress ADK bots - covering authentication, type generation, client setup, and calling bot actions
description_zh: 构建与 Botpress ADK 机器人集成的前端应用程序指南 - 涵盖认证、类型生成、客户端设置和调用机器人操作

name: microsoft-sharepoint
description: Microsoft Sharepoint integration. Manage Sites. Use when the user wants to interact with Microsoft Sharepoint data.
description_zh: Microsoft Sharepoint 集成。管理站点。当用户希望与 Microsoft Sharepoint 数据进行交互时使用。

name: huggingface-best
description: Use when the user asks about finding the best, top, or recommended model for a task, wants to know what AI model to use, or wants to compare models by benchmark scores. Triggers on: "best model for X", "what model should I use for", "top models for [task]", "which model runs on my laptop/machine/device", "recommend a model for", "what LLM should I use for", "compare models for", "what's state of the art for", or any question about choosing an AI model for a specific use case. Always use this skill when the user wants model recommendations or comparisons, even if they don't explicitly mention HuggingFace or benchmarks.
description_zh: 当用户询问如何找到最佳、顶尖或推荐的模型用于某项任务，想知道应使用哪个AI模型，或想通过基准分数比较模型时，请使用此功能。触发条件包括："X的最佳模型"、"我应该使用什么模型用于"、"顶尖的[任务]模型"、"哪个模型可以在我的笔记本电脑/机器/设备上运行"、"推荐一个用于的模型"、"我应该使用什么LLM用于"、"比较用于的模型"、"当前最先进的技术是什么"，或任何关于为特定用例选择AI模型的问题。当用户需要模型推荐或比较时，无论他们是否明确提到HuggingFace或基准测试，都应始终使用此技能。

name: tao-analyze-gaps-vlm-bcq
description: Extract false-positive and false-negative gaps from VLM binary-classification-question (BCQ, yes/no) predictions. Use when the user asks to "analyze VLM BCQ gaps", "extract VLM false positives and false negatives", or identify failure cases from a predictions JSON for DEFT root-cause analysis on a binary-classification VLM workflow.
description_zh: 从VLM二元分类问题（BCQ，是/否）预测中提取假阳性（false-positive）和假阴性（false-negative）的差距。当用户要求“分析VLM BCQ差距”、“提取VLM假阳性和假阴性”或从预测的JSON中识别失败案例，用于二元分类VLM工作流程的DEFT根本原因分析时使用。

name: scientific-visualization
description: Create publication figures with matplotlib/seaborn/plotly. Multi-panel layouts, error bars, significance markers, colorblind-safe, export PDF/EPS/TIFF, for journal-ready scientific plots.
description_zh: 使用matplotlib/seaborn/plotly创建出版物图形。支持多面板布局、误差线、显著性标记、色盲安全配色，可导出PDF/EPS/TIFF格式，适用于期刊发布的科学图形。

name: tao-train-metric-learning-recognition
description: Metric-learning recognition (ml-recog) for fine-grained visual recognition. Learns embeddings for retrieval-based matching (e.g., retail product recognition) using triplet / contrastive losses. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO metric-learning recognition model. Trigger phrases include "train metric learning", "ml-recog", "retrieval embeddings", "triplet loss recognition", "fine-grained matching".
description_zh: 度量学习识别（ml-recog）用于细粒度视觉识别。通过三元组/对比损失学习嵌入，以实现基于检索的匹配（例如，零售产品识别）。在训练、评估、导出或对TAO度量学习识别模型运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练度量学习”、“ml-recog”、“检索嵌入”、“三元组损失识别”、“细粒度匹配”。

name: tao-train-nvdinov2
description: NVDINOv2 for self-supervised visual representation learning. Trains vision transformers via self-distillation (teacher-student) without labels and produces general-purpose visual features. Use when training, exporting, or running inference for a TAO NVDINOv2 backbone. Trigger phrases include "train NVDINOv2", "self-supervised ViT pretraining", "DINOv2 backbone", "visual representation learning".
description_zh: 用于自监督视觉表征学习的NVDINOv2。通过自蒸馏（师生）方式训练视觉Transformer，无需标签即可生成通用视觉特征。在训练、导出或为TAO NVDINOv2主干网络运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练NVDINOv2”、“自监督ViT预训练”、“DINOv2主干网络”、“视觉表征学习”。

name: tao-train-rtdetr
description: RT-DETR (Real-Time DEtection TRansformer) for 2D object detection. Designed for real-time inference with competitive accuracy and supports distillation and quantization for deployment optimization. Use when training, evaluating, distilling, quantizing, exporting, or running inference for a TAO RT-DETR model. Trigger phrases include "train RT-DETR", "real-time DETR", "low-latency object detection", "RT-DETR distillation / quantization".
description_zh: RT-DETR（实时检测Transformer）用于二维目标检测。专为实时推理设计，具有竞争力的准确率，并支持蒸馏和量化以优化部署。在训练、评估、蒸馏、量化、导出或运行TAO RT-DETR模型推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练RT-DETR”、“实时DETR”、“低延迟目标检测”、“RT-DETR蒸馏/量化”。

name: tao-train-visual-changenet
description: Visual ChangeNet for binary image classification and segmentation in AOI defect detection. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for PCB defect detection or visual inspection, comparing image pairs for PASS/NO_PASS classification, or producing change-segmentation masks. Trigger phrases include "train Visual ChangeNet", "ChangeNet classify", "ChangeNet segment", "AOI defect detection", "PCB inspection model".
description_zh: 用于AOI缺陷检测中的二值图像分类和分割的Visual ChangeNet。在训练、评估、导出或运行PCB缺陷检测或视觉检测的推理时使用，用于比较图像对以进行PASS/NO_PASS分类，或生成变化分割掩码。触发短语包括“训练Visual ChangeNet”、“ChangeNet分类”、“ChangeNet分割”、“AOI缺陷检测”、“PCB检测模型”。

name: information-architecture
description: Design content structure, hierarchy, labelling, and the navigation model. Use when organising what exists. For the UI that exposes it use `navigation-patterns` (interaction-design); for user-generated grouping evidence use `card-sort-analysis` (design-research).
description_zh: 设计内容结构、层级、标签和导航模型。在整理现有内容时使用。对于展示这些内容的 UI，使用 `navigation-patterns`（交互设计）；对于用户生成的分组证据，使用 `card-sort-analysis`（设计研究）。

name: deepseek-ocr
description: Expert skill for using DeepSeek-OCR, a vision-language model for optical character recognition with context optical compression supporting documents, PDFs, and images.
description_zh: 使用 DeepSeek-OCR 的专业技能，DeepSeek-OCR 是一种支持上下文光学压缩的视觉语言模型，用于光学字符识别，可处理文档、PDF 和图像。

name: firebase
description: Firebase gives you a complete backend in minutes - auth, database, storage, functions, hosting. But the ease of setup hides real complexity. Security rules are your last line of defense, and they're often wrong.
description_zh: Firebase可在几分钟内为你提供完整的后端服务——认证、数据库、存储、函数、托管。但便捷的设置隐藏了真正的复杂性。安全规则是你的最后一道防线，而且它们往往设置错误。

name: tao-generate-referring-expressions
description: Four-step image referring-expression pipeline: turns images plus KITTI bounding-box labels into region descriptions, scene captions, grounded referring expressions, and (optionally) verified expressions via VLM distillation. Use when the user wants to generate referring-expression annotations from images with KITTI labels, build region descriptions, produce grouped grounding phrases tied to bboxes, run a double-check verification pass on grounding expressions, auto-label traffic / scene images for referring datasets, or run the image_referring_expression pipeline. Triggers include 'referring expression', 'region description', 'KITTI labels', 'spatial relationship annotation', 'auto-label image referring expression', 'image_referring_expression'.
description_zh: 四步图像指代表达流程：将图像与KITTI边界框标签转化为区域描述、场景字幕、锚定指代表达式，以及（可选的）验证表达式，通过VLM蒸馏实现。当用户需要从带有KITTI标签的图像中生成指代表达式标注、构建区域描述、生成与边界框绑定的分组锚定短语、对锚定表达式进行双重验证、自动标注交通/场景图像用于指代表达数据集，或运行image_referring_expression流程时使用。触发条件包括“指代表达”、“区域描述”、“KITTI标签”、“空间关系标注”、“自动标注图像指代表达”、“image_referring_expression”。

name: tao-run-automl-deft-pipeline
description: Run the canonical NVIDIA AOI three-phase training pipeline — Phase 1 AutoML baseline (HPO), Phase 2 DEFT loop (RCA → SDG → mining → plain-train retrain), Phase 3 AutoML refinement on the DEFT-augmented dataset. Use when the user asks to "run the AOI workflow", "fine-tune my PCB AOI model end-to-end", "improve my AOI ChangeNet model", or "AOI workflow with AutoML" request — route here instead of tao-run-deft-aoi directly unless the user explicitly asks for the DEFT loop ONLY (e.g. "run JUST the DEFT loop", "skip AutoML, only DEFT"). Also handles the same three-phase pattern for non-AOI DEFT applications — AutoML baseline then DEFT loop warm-started from AutoML's winning HPs then post-DEFT AutoML refinement on the iteration-augmented dataset. Trigger phrases include "run the AOI workflow", "AOI end-to-end", "AutoML + DEFT", "AutoML then DEFT", "tune hyperparameters then DEFT", "DEFT with AutoML at both ends", "warm-start DEFT", "improve my AOI model".
description_zh: 运行标准的NVIDIA AOI三阶段训练流程——第一阶段AutoML基线（HPO），第二阶段DEFT循环（RCA → SDG → 挖掘 → plain-train再训练），第三阶段在DEFT增强数据集上进行AutoML优化。当用户要求“运行AOI工作流”、“端到端微调我的PCB AOI模型”、“改进我的AOI ChangeNet模型”或“带AutoML的AOI工作流”时使用——除非用户明确要求仅运行DEFT循环（例如“仅运行DEFT循环”、“跳过AutoML，仅DEFT”），否则应将请求路由至此，而不是直接调用tao-run-deft-aoi。同时处理非AOI DEFT应用的相同三阶段模式——AutoML基线后从AutoML的获胜HP处启动DEFT循环热启动，然后在迭代增强数据集上进行DEFT后的AutoML优化。触发短语包括“运行AOI工作流”、“AOI端到端”、“AutoML + DEFT”、“AutoML然后DEFT”、“微调超参数然后DEFT”、“两端带AutoML的DEFT”、“DEFT热启动”、“改进我的AOI模型”。

name: tao-run-deft-aoi
description: Run the full DEFT AOI improvement loop for NVIDIA TAO VisualChangeNet / ChangeNet PCB inspection models: baseline evaluate, RCA, Cosmos AnomalyGen / AMP synthetic defects, k-NN mining, retraining, and deployment gating against a customer-defined primary metric and optional constraints. Use only when the request identifies an AOI / automated-optical-inspection, PCB-defect, VisualChangeNet, or ChangeNet workflow. Supports air-gapped/offline runs with pre-staged assets. Never infer AOI from generic iterative-improvement language. Do not use for CLIP / SigLIP image retrieval, attribute-labelled image data, standalone TAO training, one-off inference, generic anomaly generation, or RCA-only analysis.
description_zh: 运行完整的DEFT AOI改进循环，针对NVIDIA TAO VisualChangeNet/ChangeNet PCB检测模型：基线评估、RCA、Cosmos AnomalyGen/AMP合成缺陷、k-NN挖掘、重新训练，以及基于客户定义的主要指标和可选约束条件的部署门控。仅在请求明确标识AOI/自动光学检测、PCB缺陷、VisualChangeNet或ChangeNet工作流时使用。支持使用预置资产的离线运行。不得从通用迭代改进语言中推断AOI。不应用于CLIP/SigLIP图像检索、属性标记图像数据、独立TAO训练、一次性推理、通用异常生成或仅RCA分析。

name: tao-run-on-brev
description: Run a TAO training/evaluation/inference container on an NVIDIA Brev GPU instance. Instance provisioning (create/search/stop/delete/login) is delegated to the official brev-cli agent skill or the Brev MCP server; this skill covers only the TAO-specific part — running the container over `brev exec` via the four-verb docker contract. Trigger phrases include "run on Brev", "Brev GPU instance", "TAO on Brev", "submit job to Brev".
description_zh: 在NVIDIA Brev GPU实例上运行TAO训练/评估/推理容器。实例的创建、搜索、停止、删除和登录等操作由官方brev-cli代理技能或Brev MCP服务器负责；该技能仅涵盖TAO特定的部分——通过`brev exec`和四动词docker合约来运行容器。触发短语包括"在Brev上运行"、"Brev GPU实例"、"Brev上的TAO"、"向Brev提交任务"。

name: tao-train-segformer
description: SegFormer for semantic segmentation. Lightweight transformer-based architecture with hierarchical feature extraction, efficient for real-time segmentation tasks. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO SegFormer model. Trigger phrases include "train SegFormer", "semantic segmentation", "lightweight transformer segmenter", "real-time semantic segmentation".
description_zh: 用于语义分割的SegFormer。基于轻量级Transformer的架构，具有层次化特征提取功能，适用于实时分割任务。在训练、评估、导出、量化或运行TAO SegFormer模型推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练SegFormer”、“语义分割”、“轻量级Transformer分割器”、“实时语义分割”。

name: wechat-article-search
description: 搜索微信公众号文章技能。通过微信搜索获取文章列表，覆盖科技/AI、社会热点、财经、教育、职场等各类中文资讯；可按关键词检索并返回标题、概要、发布时间、来源公众号与链接。当用户需要查找微信公众号文章、整理参考资料或快速获取文章信息时使用此技能。
description_zh: 搜索微信公众号文章技能。通过微信搜索获取文章列表，覆盖科技/AI、社会热点、财经、教育、职场等各类中文资讯；可按关键词检索并返回标题、概要、发布时间、来源公众号与链接。当用户需要查找微信公众号文章、整理参考资料或快速获取文章信息时使用此技能。

name: tao-train-centerpose
description: CenterPose for keypoint / pose estimation. Detects object centers and regresses keypoint locations for 6-DoF object pose estimation. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO CenterPose model. Trigger phrases include "train CenterPose", "6-DoF object pose", "keypoint estimation", "object pose regression".
description_zh: CenterPose用于关键点/姿态估计。检测对象中心并回归关键点位置，以进行6自由度（6-DoF）对象姿态估计。在训练、评估、导出或运行TAO CenterPose模型推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练CenterPose”、“6-DoF对象姿态”、“关键点估计”、“对象姿态回归”。

name: tao-train-mask-auto-encoder
description: Masked Auto-Encoder (MAE) for self-supervised pretraining and fine-tuning. Masks random patches and reconstructs them to learn visual representations; supports pretrain and finetune stages. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO MAE backbone. Trigger phrases include "pretrain MAE", "self-supervised vision pretraining", "Masked Autoencoder", "Mask Auto-Encoder", "MAE fine-tune".
description_zh: 用于自监督预训练和微调的掩码自动编码器（MAE）。随机遮盖图像块并重建它们以学习视觉表示；支持预训练和微调阶段。在训练、评估、导出或对TAO MAE主干网络进行推理时使用。触发短语包括“预训练MAE”、“自监督视觉预训练”、“掩码自动编码器”、“掩码自动编码器”、“MAE微调”。

name: tao-train-mask-auto-label
description: MAL (Mask Auto-Label) for weakly-supervised segmentation. Produces segmentation masks from minimal annotations (point or box annotations) using a ViT-MAE backbone. Use when training, evaluating, or running inference for a TAO MAL model. Trigger phrases include "train MAL", "Mask Auto-Label", "weakly-supervised segmentation", "box-prompted segmentation", "minimal-annotation mask prediction".
description_zh: 用于弱监督分割的MAL（Mask Auto-Label）。使用ViT-MAE主干网络，根据极少量标注（点或框标注）生成分割掩码。在训练、评估或运行TAO MAL模型推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练MAL”、“Mask Auto-Label”、“弱监督分割”、“框提示分割”、“极少量标注掩码预测”。

name: tao-train-pointpillars
description: PointPillars for 3D object detection from LiDAR point clouds. Encodes point clouds into a pseudo-image via a pillar-based representation, then applies 2D detection — used in autonomous driving and robotics. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, pruning, retraining, or running inference for a TAO PointPillars model. Trigger phrases include "train PointPillars", "LiDAR 3D detection", "point-cloud object detection", "pillar-based 3D detector".
description_zh: 用于从激光雷达点云进行3D目标检测的PointPillars。通过基于柱体的表示将点云编码为伪图像，然后应用2D检测——用于自动驾驶和机器人领域。在训练、评估、导出、剪枝、重新训练或为TAO PointPillars模型运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练PointPillars”、“激光雷达3D检测”、“点云目标检测”、“基于柱体的3D检测器”。

name: tao-train-single-step
description: Standard single-step train/eval/export workflow for any TAO model. Use when training a TAO model on a dataset without iterative data augmentation, AutoML, or DEFT loops. Trigger phrases include "single train run", "train then evaluate then export", "plain TAO training", "normal training", "no AutoML", "skip the loop". Routes through the per-model SKILL.md for action specifics and through `tao-launch-workflow` for platform/credentials/dataset intake.
description_zh: 适用于任何 TAO 模型的标准单步训练/评估/导出工作流程。在无迭代数据增强、AutoML 或 DEFT 循环的情况下训练 TAO 模型时使用。触发短语包括“单次训练运行”、“训练后评估后导出”、“纯 TAO 训练”、“常规训练”、“无 AutoML”、“跳过循环”。具体操作通过每个模型的 SKILL.md 路由，平台/凭证/数据集输入通过 `tao-launch-workflow` 路由。

name: neumorphism
description: Soft, extruded UI elements with inner and outer shadows on monochromatic surfaces for a tactile, embedded look.
description_zh: 在单色表面上，具有内阴影和外阴影的柔软挤压式UI元素，呈现触感嵌入的外观。

name: logfire-query
description: Query and analyze Logfire telemetry data — traces, logs, spans, metrics, summaries, and SQL results. Use this skill when the user asks to "query logfire", "search traces", "find logs", "query data", "search spans", "look up errors in logfire", "get metrics from logfire", "analyze telemetry", "summarize errors", "find root cause", or add Logfire querying capabilities to code. Do not use this skill for direct Logfire UI, browser, live-view, Explore-page, or link-opening requests; use logfire-ui instead. If "show" or "view" wording is ambiguous, ask whether the user wants a UI view or query analysis.
description_zh: 查询和分析Logfire遥测数据——追踪、日志、跨度、指标、摘要和SQL结果。当用户要求“查询Logfire”、“搜索追踪”、“查找日志”、“查询数据”、“搜索跨度”、“在Logfire中查找错误”、“从Logfire获取指标”、“分析遥测数据”、“总结错误”、“查找根本原因”或向代码中添加Logfire查询功能时，使用此技能。不要使用此技能用于直接Logfire UI、浏览器、实时视图、探索页面或链接打开请求；应使用logfire-ui。如果“显示”或“查看”措辞含糊不清，请询问用户是想进行UI视图还是查询分析。

name: refined
description: Carefully curated, modern minimal style with elegant serif typography and understated, sophisticated palettes.
description_zh: 精心策划，现代简约风格，搭配优雅的衬线字体和低调、精致的调色板。

name: mapbox-search-patterns
description: Expert guidance on choosing the right Mapbox search tool and parameters for geocoding, POI search, and location discovery
description_zh: 关于选择合适的 Mapbox 搜索工具和参数进行地理编码、兴趣点搜索和位置发现的专业指导

name: tao-train-bevfusion
description: BEVFusion for multi-sensor 3D object detection. Fuses LiDAR point clouds and camera images in bird's-eye-view (BEV) space, used in autonomous driving for robust 3D perception. Use when training, evaluating, or running inference for a TAO BEVFusion model. Trigger phrases include "train BEVFusion", "LiDAR + camera fusion", "BEV 3D detection", "multi-sensor 3D perception".
description_zh: 用于多传感器三维目标检测的 BEVFusion。在鸟瞰视图（BEV）空间中融合 LiDAR 点云和相机图像，用于自动驾驶中的鲁棒三维感知。在训练、评估或运行 TAO BEVFusion 模型时使用。触发短语包括“训练 BEVFusion”、“LiDAR + 相机融合”、“BEV 三维检测”、“多传感器三维感知”。

name: tao-train-ocdnet
description: OCDNet for scene text detection. Detects arbitrary-oriented text regions in natural images using a differentiable binarization approach. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, pruning, quantizing, retraining, or running inference for a TAO OCDNet model. Trigger phrases include "train OCDNet", "scene text detection", "arbitrary-oriented text boxes", "differentiable binarization detector".
description_zh: OCDNet用于场景文字检测。它使用可微分的二值化方法检测自然图像中的任意方向文字区域。在训练、评估、导出、剪枝、量化、重新训练或运行TAO OCDNet模型推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练OCDNet”、“场景文字检测”、“任意方向文字框”、“可微分二值化检测器”。

name: tao-train-mask-grounding-dino
description: Mask Grounding DINO for grounded instance segmentation. Extends Grounding DINO with a mask-prediction head for open-set segmentation guided by text prompts. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Mask-Grounding-DINO model. Trigger phrases include "train Mask Grounding DINO", "open-vocabulary segmentation", "text-prompted instance segmentation", "grounded mask DETR".
description_zh: 用于有监督实例分割的Mask Grounding DINO。通过添加一个用于开放集分割的文本提示引导的掩码预测头扩展了Grounding DINO。在训练、评估、导出、量化或运行TAO Mask-Grounding-DINO模型时使用。触发短语包括“训练Mask Grounding DINO”、“开放词汇分割”、“文本提示实例分割”、“有监督掩码检测DETR”。

name: tao-train-oneformer
description: OneFormer for universal image segmentation. Unifies panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation with a single architecture using task-conditioned queries. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO OneFormer model. Trigger phrases include "train OneFormer", "universal segmentation", "task-conditioned segmentation", "panoptic / instance / semantic in one model".
description_zh: OneFormer 用于通用图像分割。通过任务条件查询，使用单一架构统一了全景、实例和语义分割。在训练、评估、导出、量化或运行 TAO OneFormer 模型推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练 OneFormer”、“通用分割”、“任务条件分割”、“全景/实例/语义在一个模型中”。

name: tao-validate-dataset-format
description: Run `tao-daft validate` to check NVIDIA TAO DAFT datasets for structure, schema, and cross-reference errors. Do not use for non-DAFT formats. Use when the user asks to validate a DAFT dataset, check DAFT schema, validate a TAO dataset format, or run `tao-daft validate`.
description_zh: 运行 `tao-daft validate` 来检查 NVIDIA TAO DAFT 数据集的结构、模式以及交叉引用错误。不要用于非 DAFT 格式。当用户要求验证 DAFT 数据集、检查 DAFT 模式、验证 TAO 数据集格式或运行 `tao-daft validate` 时使用。

name: critique-composition
description: Critique a rendered screen's composition — balance, whitespace, rhythm, and gestalt grouping. Use when a layout feels off but hierarchy is fine. For emphasis and eye flow specifically, use `critique-visual-hierarchy`.
description_zh: 评估渲染屏幕的构图——平衡、空白、节奏和整体分组。当布局感觉不对但层级结构良好时使用。特别强调视觉流动时，请使用 `critique-visual-hierarchy`。

name: bib-search-citation
description: Search and cite from local BibTeX/BibLaTeX .bib libraries, including Zotero exports. Use to find, filter, preview, export, or generate LaTeX/Typst citation snippets by topic, author, year, venue, DOI, arXiv ID, keywords, abstract, fields, recency, or claim support. Do not use for manuscript writing or polishing.
description_zh: 搜索并引用本地BibTeX/BibLaTeX .bib库，包括Zotero导出内容。用于按主题、作者、年份、会议、DOI、arXiv ID、关键词、摘要、领域、时效性或论点支持查找、筛选、预览、导出或生成LaTeX/Typst引用片段。不应用于稿件撰写或润色。

name: survey-generation
description: Generate complete academic survey papers using multi-LLM parallel outline generation, RAG-based subsection writing, citation validation, and local coherence enhancement. Based on AutoSurvey pipeline. Use for writing comprehensive literature surveys.
description_zh: 使用多LLM并行大纲生成、基于RAG的子章节撰写、引用验证和局部连贯性增强，生成完整的学术调查论文。基于AutoSurvey流程。用于撰写全面的文献综述。

name: appwrite-typescript
description: Appwrite TypeScript SDK skill. Use when building browser-based JavaScript/TypeScript apps, React Native mobile apps, or server-side Node.js/Deno backends with Appwrite. Covers client-side auth (email, OAuth, anonymous), database queries, file uploads, real-time subscriptions, and server-side admin via API keys for user management, database administration, storage, and functions.
description_zh: Appwrite TypeScript SDK 技能。在构建基于浏览器的 JavaScript/TypeScript 应用、React Native 移动应用，或使用 Appwrite 构建 Node.js/Deno 服务器端后端时使用。涵盖客户端认证（电子邮件、OAuth、匿名）、数据库查询、文件上传、实时订阅，以及通过 API 密钥进行服务器端管理（用户管理、数据库管理、存储和函数）。

name: influencer-negotiation-playbook
description: Prepare a brand-side partnership manager to negotiate deal terms with an influencer or creator, from the creator's first positive reply to a signed contract - a written playbook of term-by-term opening positions, a concession ladder, red-flag responses, and walk-away thresholds covering rates, usage rights, exclusivity, revision limits, payment terms, and kill fees. Covers B2C brand collabs and B2B creator programs. Use whenever the user mentions creator rates, creator deal terms, usage rights, exclusivity, or negotiating with a creator's talent manager, even if they never say negotiation. Requires the user's own rate benchmarks. Do NOT use for the first-touch pitch - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-outreach instead.
description_zh: 准备一个品牌方合作伙伴关系经理，用于与影响者或创作者协商交易条款，从创作者首次积极回复到签署合同——一份逐条阐述立场、让步阶梯、警示性回应以及退出阈值的书面操作手册，涵盖费率、使用权、独家性、修改限制、付款条款和终止费用。适用于B2C品牌合作和B2B创作者项目。无论用户是否提及谈判，只要提及创作者费率、创作者交易条款、使用权、独家性或与创作者经纪人谈判，都需要使用。需要用户提供自身的费率基准。不适用于初次接触的提案——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@influencer-outreach。

name: tao-train-deformable-detr
description: Deformable DETR for 2D object detection. Uses deformable attention for efficient multi-scale feature processing, lighter than DINO with competitive accuracy. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Deformable-DETR model. Trigger phrases include "train deformable-detr", "Deformable DETR object detection", "lightweight DETR detector".
description_zh: 用于二维目标检测的可变形DETR。采用可变形注意力机制进行高效的多尺度特征处理，比DINO更轻量，但精度具有竞争力。在训练、评估、导出、量化或运行TAO可变形DETR模型的推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练可变形DETR”、“可变形DETR目标检测”、“轻量级DETR检测器”。

name: tilegym-monkey-patch-kernels-to-transformers
description: Integrate TileGym kernels into Hugging Face `transformers` models by replacing the library's submodule(s) and certain class(es)' implementations, and patching certain class(es)' init/forward/load weight methods prior to instantiating models. Used when the user requires integrating TileGym kernels into `transformers` models.
description_zh: 将 TileGym 内核集成到 Hugging Face 的 `transformers` 模型中，通过替换库的子模块以及某些类的实现，并在实例化模型之前修补某些类的初始化/前向/加载权重方法。用于用户需要将 TileGym 内核集成到 `transformers` 模型中的情况。

name: crypto-ta-analyzer
description: Run multi-indicator technical analysis on crypto or market OHLCV data. Use for deterministic trend, momentum, volume, and divergence analysis.
description_zh: 对加密货币或市场 OHLCV 数据进行多指标技术分析。用于确定性趋势、动量、成交量和背离分析。

name: professional
description: Polished, business-ready design with modern typography, structured layouts, and a trustworthy visual identity.
description_zh: 现代感十足的排版、结构化的布局和值得信赖的视觉识别，打造出专业且商业化的设计。

name: influencer-outreach
description: Draft the personalized first-touch pitch message and follow-up plan used to propose a partnership to one already-vetted influencer or creator - personalization angle, the compensation stated on offer, a message fitted to the channel the creator actually lists (email, DM, or their manager), and a bounded follow-up cadence. Covers B2C brand collabs and B2B creator programs (newsletter writers, podcasters, industry experts). Use whenever the user mentions pitching a creator, DMing an influencer, a collab proposal, or a creator outreach message, even if they never say outreach. Stops at the first positive reply. Do NOT use for list-scale affiliate recruitment - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-recruitment-outreach instead.
description_zh: 草拟用于向已筛选的网红或创作者提出合作建议的个性化初次接触推销信息和后续计划——个性化角度、报价中说明的补偿、适配创作者实际列出的渠道（电子邮件、私信或其经纪人）的信息，以及有界限的后续跟进节奏。涵盖B2C品牌合作和B2B创作者项目（如订阅栏作者、播客主、行业专家）。在用户提及推销创作者、私信联系网红、合作提案或创作者接触信息时使用，即使他们未明确提及接触。在收到第一个积极回复时停止。不适用于大规模的联盟招募——请使用mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@affiliate-recruitment-outreach。

name: tao-mine-aoi-images
description: Runs the DEFT embed-then-mine workflow for VCN AOI iterations — embeds the gap-analysis target parquet, embeds a source pool, and mines nearest-neighbour source images for downstream augmentation. Use as the immediate next step after `tao-route-visual-changenet-samples` when expanding a real-image augmentation queue from the mining subset.
description_zh: 运行 DEFT 嵌入然后挖掘工作流程，用于 VCN AOI 迭代——嵌入差距分析目标 Parquet 文件，嵌入一个源池，并挖掘最近邻源图像以进行下游增强。在从挖掘子集中扩展真实图像增强队列时，作为 `tao-route-visual-changenet-samples` 的直接下一步步骤使用。

name: tao-run-on-slurm
description: Remote SLURM GPU cluster execution over SSH with sbatch/srun, Pyxis/Enroot containers, and Lustre-backed results. Use when running TAO training/eval/inference jobs on an on-prem or DGX SLURM cluster. Trigger phrases include "run on SLURM", "submit sbatch", "DGX SLURM cluster", "Pyxis/Enroot container", "Lustre dataset".
description_zh: 通过SSH使用sbatch/srun远程执行SLURM GPU集群，结合Pyxis/Enroot容器，以及Lustre存储的执行结果。适用于在本地或DGX SLURM集群上运行TAO训练/评估/推理任务。触发短语包括"在SLURM上运行"、"提交sbatch"、"DGX SLURM集群"、"Pyxis/Enroot容器"、"Lustre数据集"。

name: om-check-and-commit
description: Verify that the current branch is ready to publish by running every configured validation command in order, fix straightforward failures (including locale-file drift when the repo checks it), and once everything passes commit and push the current branch. Use when the user asks to check the branch, make CI-style verification pass, then commit and push.
description_zh: 验证当前分支是否已准备好发布，需按顺序运行所有配置的验证命令，修复明显的失败情况（包括当仓库检查时出现的本地化文件漂移问题），一旦所有检查通过，则提交并推送当前分支。当用户要求检查分支、执行类似CI的验证通过后，再提交和推送。

name: copywriting
description: Write rigorous, conversion-focused marketing copy for landing pages and emails. Enforces brief confirmation and strict no-fabrication rules.
description_zh: 为落地页和电子邮件撰写严谨、以转化为中心的营销文案。执行简短的确认流程和严格的禁止虚构规则。

name: multi-tenant-architecture
description: Designs tenant isolation, hostname routing, custom-domain lifecycle, and plan limits on Cloudflare or Vercel. Use when asked to "isolate tenant data", "support custom domains", "build a white-label platform", or assess PSL registration. For general module structure use codebase-architecture; for SEO content use seo.
description_zh: 在 Cloudflare 或 Vercel 上设计租户隔离、主机名路由、自定义域名生命周期和计划限制。当被要求“隔离租户数据”、“支持自定义域名”、“构建白标平台”或评估 PSL 注册时使用。对于通用模块结构，请使用 codebase-architecture；对于 SEO 内容，请使用 seo。

name: n8n-credentials-and-security-official
description: Use when handling any auth, API keys, tokens, OAuth, bearer tokens, basic auth, or secret values in n8n workflows. Triggers on "API key", "token", "bearer", "OAuth", "secret", "auth", "credentials", "Authorization header", "x-api-key", or any node configuration that mentions a third-party service.
description_zh: 在处理n8n工作流中的任何认证、API密钥、令牌、OAuth、持有者令牌、基本认证或秘密值时使用。当触发“API密钥”、“令牌”、“持有者”、“OAuth”、“秘密”、“认证”、“凭证”、“授权头”、“x-api-key”或任何提及第三方服务的节点配置时。

name: tao-train-foundation-stereo
description: Stereo depth estimation using FoundationStereo. Predicts disparity maps from stereo image pairs for 3D reconstruction. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO FoundationStereo model. Trigger phrases include "train stereo depth", "FoundationStereo", "stereo disparity estimation", "3D reconstruction from stereo".
description_zh: 使用 FoundationStereo 进行立体深度估计。从立体图像对中预测视差图，用于 3D 重建。在训练、评估、导出或运行 TAO FoundationStereo 模型的推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练立体深度”、“FoundationStereo”、“立体视差估计”、“立体 3D 重建”。

name: tao-train-sparse4d
description: Sparse4D for multi-camera temporal 3D object detection and tracking. Uses sparse queries with deformable attention across camera views and time for end-to-end 3D perception, with an instance bank for temporal tracking. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, quantizing, or running inference for a TAO Sparse4D model. Trigger phrases include "train Sparse4D", "multi-camera 3D detection", "temporal 3D tracker", "sparse query 3D perception".
description_zh: Sparse4D 用于多摄像机时间三维目标检测与跟踪。采用跨摄像机视图和时间域的可变形注意力机制进行稀疏查询，实现端到端三维感知，并配备实例库以支持时间跟踪。适用于对 TAO Sparse4D 模型进行训练、评估、导出、量化或运行推理。触发短语包括“训练 Sparse4D”、“多摄像机三维检测”、“时间三维跟踪器”、“稀疏查询三维感知”。

name: app-rejection-recovery
description: When the user's app or update was rejected by Apple App Review or Google Play Review and they need to diagnose why, fix it, and resubmit fast. Use when the user mentions "app rejected", "App Review rejection", "guideline violation", "Apple rejected my app", "Google Play rejected", "Play policy violation", "Resolution Center", "metadata rejection", "binary rejection", "guideline 2.1", "guideline 4.3", "guideline 5.1.1", "Sign in with Apple required", "Apple ID rejection", "Play Store suspension", "appeal", "I need to respond to App Review", or "expedited review". For pre-submission listing health, see aso-audit. For metadata-only fixes, see metadata-optimization.
description_zh: 当用户的 App 或更新被苹果 App 审核或 Google Play 审核拒绝，并且他们需要快速诊断原因、修复并重新提交时使用。适用于用户提到“App 被拒绝”、“App 审核拒绝”、“违反指南”、“苹果拒绝了我的 App”、“Google Play 拒绝”、“Play 政策违规”、“决议中心”、“元数据拒绝”、“二进制拒绝”、“指南 2.1”、“指南 4.3”、“指南 5.1.1”、“需要使用 Apple 登录”、“Apple ID 拒绝”、“Play 商店暂停”、“申诉”、“我需要回复 App 审核”或“加急审核”等情况。对于提交前的列表健康检查，请参考 aso-audit。对于仅涉及元数据的修复，请参考 metadata-optimization。

name: tao-train-fast-foundation-stereo
description: Real-time stereo depth estimation using FastFoundationStereo (FFS), the distilled bp2 commercial variant of FoundationStereo. Predicts disparity maps from stereo image pairs with ~10× lower latency than full FoundationStereo. Use when training, evaluating, exporting, or running inference for a TAO FastFoundationStereo (FFS) model. Trigger phrases include "train fast stereo", "real-time stereo disparity", "FastFoundationStereo", "distilled stereo depth".
description_zh: 使用 FastFoundationStereo (FFS)，即 FoundationStereo 的精炼版 bp2 商业变体，进行实时立体深度估计。相较于完整的 FoundationStereo，其从立体图像对预测视差图时的延迟降低了约 10 倍。适用于对 TAO FastFoundationStereo (FFS) 模型进行训练、评估、导出或运行推理时使用。触发短语包括“训练快速立体”、“实时立体视差”、“FastFoundationStereo”、“精炼立体深度”。

name: grow-website
description: Guided journey from a website with traffic it under-converts to a research-driven growth engine that captures more leads, persuades more buyers, sells a sharper offer, and earns referrals. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - cro-methodology, scorecard-marketing, storybrand-messaging, made-to-stick, influence-psychology, hundred-million-offers, contagious, one-page-marketing - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (WEBSITE.md, OFFER.md, MARKETING.md, GROW-WEBSITE-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to raise conversion on a site that already has traffic, capture more leads, sharpen a weak offer, add referral loops, or says 'my site gets visitors but nobody buys'. If a broken funnel or usability friction is the real blocker, run improve-website first; if there is no site yet, use create-website; for one leaking flow, conversion-optimization. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从流量转化率较低的网站出发，通过研究驱动的增长引擎，实现更多潜在客户获取、增强购买者说服力、优化产品卖点并赢得口碑推荐。分阶段运用八项技能——包括 cro 方法论、计分卡营销、故事品牌传播、粘性内容制作、影响力心理学、百万级产品策略、病毒式传播、单页营销——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档文件夹（WEBSITE.md、OFFER.md、MARKETING.md、GROW-WEBSITE-PLAN.md）中，确保用户在不同会话中能继续旅程。适用于用户希望提升已有流量网站的转化率、获取更多潜在客户、优化薄弱产品卖点、增加口碑推荐，或表示“我的网站有访客但没人购买”的情况。若存在漏斗断裂或可用性障碍，应先运行 improve-website；若尚未建立网站，则使用 create-website；针对单一漏损流程，采用 conversion-optimization。若需独立使用某项技能，可直接调用该技能。

name: build-mvp
description: Use inside a product repository when the user wants the full MVP built from their BuilderOS spec documents. Triggers on phrases like "build my MVP", "build the app", "execute the roadmap", "start the build", "work through the whole roadmap", "build everything", or any request to implement the entire plan rather than a single task or phase. Requires `docs/prd.md` and `docs/product-roadmap.md` (plus `docs/product-vision.md` and `docs/design.md` for context). Works through every roadmap task in order — implementing, testing, and verifying each before moving on, marking checkboxes and updating the status line — and runs until all tasks are complete and the magic moment works end to end, then initializes git with an initial commit and offers to connect a remote repo.
description_zh: 在产品仓库中使用，当用户希望根据其 BuilderOS 规范文档构建完整的 MVP 时。在类似 "build my MVP"、"build the app"、"execute the roadmap"、"start the build"、"work through the whole roadmap"、"build everything" 或任何要求实现整个计划而非单个任务或阶段的请求时触发。需要 `docs/prd.md` 和 `docs/product-roadmap.md`（以及 `docs/product-vision.md` 和 `docs/design.md` 以提供背景信息）。按顺序处理每个路线图任务——在继续之前实施、测试和验证每个任务，勾选复选框并更新状态行——直到所有任务完成且魔法时刻端到端运行成功，然后使用初始提交初始化 git，并提供连接远程仓库的选项。

name: release-management
description: Manage music releases using RELEASE.md documents stored in releases/{release-slug}/ within an artist workspace. Triggers when the user mentions an artist's album, EP, single, or project — or asks about release planning, DSP pitches, metadata, marketing, press materials, physical production, or tour coordination. First infer which artist and release the user means, then find or create the RELEASE.md. Use this skill to create, update, or pull data from release documents, and to generate deliverables like DSP pitches, press one-sheets, and production specs.

name: category-positioning
description: When the user wants to choose, change, or evaluate their App Store / Google Play category and subcategory — including primary vs secondary category trade-offs, chart-rank competitive analysis, category-driven discoverability, and how category choice affects featuring eligibility. Use when the user mentions "which category", "App Store category", "primary category", "secondary category", "change my category", "Health & Fitness vs Lifestyle", "Productivity vs Utilities", "rank higher in a smaller category", "category chart", "subcategory", "Play Store category", or "should I switch categories". For full ASO health beyond category, see aso-audit. For competitor analysis within the chosen category, see competitor-analysis. For chart movements within categories, see market-movers.
description_zh: 当用户想要选择、更改或评估其 App Store / Google Play 类别和子类别时——包括主要类别与次要类别的权衡、图表排名的竞争分析、类别驱动的可发现性，以及类别选择如何影响精选资格。在用户提及“哪个类别”、“App Store 类别”、“主要类别”、“次要类别”、“更改我的类别”、“健康与健身 vs 生活方式”、“生产力 vs 实用工具”、“在较小的类别中排名更高”、“类别图表”、“子类别”、“Play Store 类别”或“我应该切换类别”时使用。关于类别之外的完整 ASO 健康，请参阅 aso-audit。关于所选类别内的竞争对手分析，请参阅 competitor-analysis。关于类别内的图表变动，请参阅 market-movers。

name: platform-strategy-sms
description: When the user wants platform-specific tactical guidance for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Threads, or Bluesky. Also use when the user mentions 'LinkedIn strategy,' 'Twitter strategy,' 'Threads strategy,' 'Bluesky strategy,' 'algorithm,' 'what works on LinkedIn,' 'cross-posting,' 'platform differences,' 'adapt my content,' or 'which platform should I focus on.' For overall content strategy, see content-strategy-sms. For writing posts, see post-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户需要特定平台的策略性指导时，例如LinkedIn、Twitter/X、Threads或Bluesky。也适用于用户提及“LinkedIn策略”、“Twitter策略”、“Threads策略”、“Bluesky策略”、“算法”、“LinkedIn上哪些内容有效”、“跨平台发布”、“平台差异”、“调整我的内容”或“我应该专注于哪个平台”等情况。关于整体内容策略，请参考content-strategy-sms。关于撰写帖子，请参考post-writer-sms。

name: algorithm-design
description: Design algorithms with LaTeX pseudocode and UML diagrams. Generate algorithmic environments, Mermaid class/sequence diagrams, and ensure consistency between pseudocode and implementation. Use when formalizing methods for a paper.
description_zh: 使用 LaTeX 伪代码和 UML 图表设计算法。生成算法环境、Mermaid 类/序列图，并确保伪代码与实现的一致性。在为论文形式化方法时使用。

name: create-app
description: Guided journey from a raw app idea to a validated, cleanly architected first version that ships on a sustainable cadence. Orchestrates ten skills phase by phase - lean-startup, design-sprint, clean-architecture, domain-driven-design, clean-code, pragmatic-programmer, system-design, ios-hig-design, 37signals-way, software-design-philosophy - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (PRODUCT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, EXPERIMENTS.md, CREATE-APP-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to build a new app, validate an idea before writing code, architect an MVP that will not need a rewrite, or says 'help me build my app the right way'. App already exists: use improve-app or grow-app. Business idea not yet validated: run create-business first. Marketing site only: use create-website. Architecture-only question: design-code-architecture. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从原始应用想法引导至经过验证、架构清晰的第一版，并以可持续的节奏发布。分阶段协调十项技能——精益创业、设计冲刺、清晰架构、领域驱动设计、代码整洁、务实程序员、系统设计、iOS人机界面设计、37signals方法、软件设计哲学——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹（PRODUCT.md、ARCHITECTURE.md、EXPERIMENTS.md、CREATE-APP-PLAN.md）中，以便跨会话继续旅程。当用户希望开发新应用、在编写代码前验证想法、构建无需重写的MVP，或说“帮我以正确方式构建应用”时使用。应用已存在：使用improve-app或grow-app。商业想法尚未验证：先运行create-business。仅用于营销网站：使用create-website。仅涉及架构问题：使用design-code-architecture。若仅针对单个框架，直接调用该技能。

name: adk-evals
description: Complete reference for writing, running, and iterating on evals (automated conversation tests) for ADK agents. Covers eval file format, all assertion types, CLI usage, and per-primitive testing patterns.
description_zh: ADK 代理的 evals（自动化对话测试）编写、运行和迭代完整参考。涵盖 eval 文件格式、所有断言类型、CLI 使用以及针对每个原语（primitive）的测试模式。

name: frontend-design
description: Strict frontend design guardrails for building modern, minimal-visual-noise, airy, non-generic app UIs. Use whenever creating or changing frontend UI, React components, shadcn/ui themes, Tailwind styles, app layouts, or first-version product screens. This skill complements vertical/domain skills like CPQ, CRM, and similar app builders: follow the selected domain skill's workflow and layout requirements, then enforce this skill's shared visual rules for brand-aware theming, generous spacing, typography, contrast, roundedness, shadows, surface hierarchy, cardless defaults, no-sidebar defaults, and anti-pattern avoidance.
description_zh: 严格的前端设计规范，用于构建现代、视觉干扰少、通透且非通用的应用 UI。在创建或修改前端 UI、React 组件、shadcn/ui 主题、Tailwind 样式、应用布局或首版产品界面时，均需使用。此技能与垂直/领域技能（如 CPQ、CRM 及类似应用构建器）相辅相成：遵循所选领域技能的工作流程和布局要求，然后应用此技能的共享视觉规则，包括品牌感知主题、充足的间距、字体排印、对比度、圆角、阴影、表面层级、无卡片默认设置、无侧边栏默认设置以及反模式规避。

name: tao-route-visual-changenet-samples
description: Routes the weakest VCN samples (output of `tao-analyze-gaps-visual-changenet`) into per-augmentation-module subsets based on each module's label eligibility. Use when the user asks to "route VCN gap samples", "split AOI gaps for k-NN mining and AnomalyGen", or prepare the immediate next step after DEFT gap analysis in a VCN AOI SDA iteration.
description_zh: 将最弱的 VCN 样本（`tao-analyze-gaps-visual-changenet` 的输出）根据每个模块的标签资格路由到每个增强模块的子集中。当用户要求“路由 VCN 间隙样本”、“为 k-NN 挖掘和 AnomalyGen 分割 AOI 间隙”，或在 VCN AOI SDA 迭代中 DEFT 间隙分析后的下一步骤准备时使用。

name: intended-vs-implemented
description: The method for finding the gap between what a system is supposed to do and what the code actually does — the class of bug generic scanners miss because they have no model of intent. Defines what counts as documented intent, what counts as implementation evidence, which mismatches matter, and how to avoid hand-wavy findings. Use when auditing AI-built code, reviewing access control against documented permissions, or checking whether a codebase matches its own documentation.
description_zh: 寻找系统预期功能与代码实际功能之间差异的方法——即通用扫描器因缺乏意图模型而遗漏的bug类别。定义了何为文档意图、何为实现证据、哪些不匹配是重要的，以及如何避免模糊不清的发现。适用于审计AI生成的代码、审查访问控制是否符合文档权限，或检查代码库是否与其自身文档一致。

name: minimax-music-gen
description: Use when user wants to generate music, songs, or audio tracks. Triggers on any request involving music creation, song writing, lyrics generation, audio production, or covers. Also triggers when user provides lyrics and wants them turned into a song, or describes a mood/scene and wants background music. Supports multilingual triggers — match equivalent phrases in any language. Do NOT use for music playback of existing files, music theory questions, or music recommendation without generation.
description_zh: 当用户想要生成音乐、歌曲或音频轨道时使用。在涉及音乐创作、歌曲创作、歌词生成、音频制作或翻唱的任何请求中都会触发。当用户提供歌词并希望将其转化为歌曲，或描述一种情绪/场景并希望获得背景音乐时也会触发。支持多语言触发——匹配任何语言中的等效短语。请勿用于现有文件的播放、音乐理论问题或无需生成的音乐推荐。

name: grow-business
description: Guided journey from a business with lucky months to a repeatable growth engine that produces a forecast. Orchestrates nine skills phase by phase - one-page-marketing, hundred-million-offers, predictable-revenue, contagious, influence-psychology, crossing-the-chasm, cold-start-problem, lean-analytics, negotiation - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (MARKETING.md, OFFER.md, METRICS.md, GROW-BUSINESS-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to build a marketing and sales system, manufacture predictable pipeline, engineer word-of-mouth and referrals, or says 'revenue is real but lumpy and I need growth that repeats'. If the offer, retention, or operations underneath are broken, run improve-business first; with no paying customers yet, start with create-business; when the product itself must carry the growth loops, use grow-app. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从一家拥有幸运月份的企业，引导至可重复增长的引擎，并生成预测。分阶段协调九项技能——单页营销、百万级报价、可预测收入、病毒式传播、影响力心理学、跨越鸿沟、冷启动问题、精益分析、谈判——在每个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹（MARKETING.md、OFFER.md、METRICS.md、GROW-BUSINESS-PLAN.md）中，以便跨会话继续旅程。当用户希望构建营销和销售系统、制造可预测的管道、设计口碑和转介绍，或表示“收入真实但波动，我需要可重复的增长”时使用。如果底层报价、留存或运营存在问题，先运行improve-business；尚未有付费客户时，从create-business开始；当产品本身需要承载增长循环时，使用grow-app。对于单一框架，直接调用该技能。

name: wp-patterns
description: Pattern: create or update WordPress block patterns (starter pages, templates, template parts, Query Loop layouts), review pattern registration, block markup, categories, accessibility, or i18n/escaping, or improve pattern design quality. Route custom blocks to wp-block-development; route frontend interactivity to wp-interactivity-api.
description_zh: 模式：创建或更新 WordPress 块模式（启动页面、模板、模板部分、查询循环布局），审查模式注册、块标记、分类、可访问性或 i18n/转义，或提高模式设计质量。将自定义块路由到 wp-block-development；将前端交互路由到 wp-interactivity-api。

name: flows-code-review
description: Run the technical (code) review step of Flows app certification in a local git app. Loads flows-review-checks for the actual bar, then writes artifacts under reviews/code-review/feedback-round-<N>/. Use when the user asks for a Flows code review, technical review, pre-submit review, app certification code review, or "run flows-code-review". Re-run until 0 open Must Fix items remain before moving on to flows-design-review.
description_zh: 在本地git应用中运行Flows应用认证的技术（代码）审查步骤。加载实际bar的flows-review-checks，然后在reviews/code-review/feedback-round-<N>/下写入工件。当用户要求Flows代码审查、技术审查、提交前审查、应用认证代码审查或"运行flows-code-review"时使用。重新运行，直到0个开放Must Fix项目存在，然后继续进行flows-design-review。

name: parallel-memory
description: Recall past Parallel Task, Monitor, and FindAll runs when they may help; evict runs or clear memory when asked.
description_zh: 回想过去可能有助于的并行任务、监控和查找全部运行；在需要时清除运行或内存。

name: workflow-automation
description: List, inspect, create, update, and delete HubSpot workflows (v4 flows API) from the `hubspot` agent CLI, not the `hs` developer CLI. Classic v3 contact-based workflows are not covered.
description_zh: 从 `hubspot` 代理 CLI 而不是 `hs` 开发者 CLI 中列出、检查、创建、更新和删除 HubSpot 工作流（v4 流程 API），经典 v3 基于联系人的工作流不在此范围内。

name: loop
description: Start an autonomous experiment loop with user-selected interval (10min, 1h, daily, weekly, monthly). Uses CronCreate for scheduling. Use when the user runs /ar:loop or asks to run an autoresearch experiment continuously on a schedule.
description_zh: 启动用户自定义间隔（10分钟、1小时、每日、每周、每月）的自主实验循环。使用CronCreate进行调度。当用户运行/ar:loop或要求按计划持续运行自动研究实验时使用。

name: adk-debugger
description: Systematic debugging for ADK agents — trace reading, log analysis, common failure diagnosis, and the debug loop.
description_zh: 对ADK代理进行系统化调试——跟踪读取、日志分析、常见故障诊断以及调试循环。

name: r3f-geometry
description: Build React Three Fiber geometry, custom buffers, instanced meshes, points, and lines. Use for shape construction and geometry draw-call optimization, rather than material appearance.
description_zh: 构建 React Three Fiber 几何体，自定义缓冲区、实例化网格、点和线。用于形状构建和几何绘制调用优化，而非材质外观。

name: sf-apex
description: Generates and reviews Salesforce Apex code with 150-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user writes, reviews, or fixes Apex classes, triggers, test classes, batch/queueable/schedulable jobs, or touches .cls/.trigger files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: LWC JavaScript (use sf-lwc), Flow XML (use sf-flow), SOQL-only queries (use sf-soql), or non-Salesforce code.
description_zh: 生成并评审Salesforce Apex代码，采用150分制评分。触发条件：当用户编写、评审或修复Apex类、触发器、测试类、批处理/可排队/可计划作业，或修改.class/.trigger文件时。不触发条件：LWC JavaScript（使用sf-lwc）、Flow XML（使用sf-flow）、仅SOQL查询（使用sf-soql）或非Salesforce代码。

name: improve-business
description: Guided journey from a stalled, plateaued business to one with an honest diagnosis, a working operating rhythm, and offers repriced to real value. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - good-strategy-bad-strategy, traction-eos, high-output-management, team-topologies, drive-motivation, lean-analytics, negotiation, monetizing-innovation - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (STRATEGY.md, OPERATIONS.md, METRICS.md, IMPROVE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to fix a business that has plateaued, diagnose why growth stalled, tighten strategy and execution, re-motivate a team, or says 'revenue is flat and I do not know why'. Starting from scratch with no customers: use create-business. Once the fundamentals work and the goal is expansion: use grow-business. When the product itself drags the business down: use improve-app. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 从停滞、发展停滞的企业到拥有真实诊断、有效运营节奏和重新定价以体现真实价值的引导式旅程。分阶段协调八项技能——好策略-坏策略、牵引力-EOS、高产出管理、团队拓扑结构、驱动动机、精益分析、谈判、创新变现——在每一个决策点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目文档/文件夹（STRATEGY.md、OPERATIONS.md、METRICS.md、IMPROVE-BUSINESS-PLAN.md）中，以便跨会话继续旅程。当用户希望修复发展停滞的企业、诊断增长停滞的原因、收紧战略与执行、重新激励团队，或表示“收入持平且不知原因”时使用。从零开始且没有客户：使用create-business。一旦基础工作正常且目标是扩张：使用grow-business。当产品本身拖累企业时：使用improve-app。若要单独使用某个框架，直接调用该技能。

name: joint-gtm-planning
description: Plan one joint go-to-market motion with one already-chosen partner - the joint value proposition, co-marketing campaign shape, launch sequencing, budget and market-development funds, the lead-sharing and attribution agreement, and the closing debrief. Covers B2B vendor-to-vendor co-marketing, consumer co-branding, and creator collaborations. Use whenever the user mentions a joint GTM plan, partner co-marketing, a joint webinar or integration launch, or a better-together story with a named partner, even if they never say GTM. Macro strategy only, no ad copy, email bodies, or asset production. Do NOT use for direct-vs-partner deal policy - use mbfinotti/partnerships-skills@co-selling-strategy instead.

name: pydantic
description: Pydantic is a Python data validation and serialization library, based on type hints. Use this skill whenever you need to do relatively complex data modeling using Pydantic, e.g. when adding constraints, defining a model hierarchy with subclasses, etc.
description_zh: Pydantic 是一个基于类型提示的 Python 数据验证和序列化库。当您需要使用 Pydantic 进行相对复杂的数据建模时，请使用此功能，例如添加约束、定义具有子类的模型层次结构等。

name: playwright-cli
description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.
description_zh: 自动化浏览器交互，测试网页并使用 Playwright 测试。

name: conversation-memory
description: Persistent memory systems for LLM conversations including short-term, long-term, and entity-based memory
description_zh: 用于LLM对话的持久化内存系统，包括短期记忆、长期记忆和基于实体的记忆

name: n8n-error-handling
description: Wire n8n error handling so failures are loud, structured, and recoverable. Use when building any webhook/API workflow, a scheduled or unattended workflow, or any path where a silent failure would drop user-visible work — and whenever the user mentions error handling, onError, continueErrorOutput, error branches/outputs, retries, retryOnFail, Respond to Webhook status codes, 4xx/5xx, Error Trigger, or "my workflow fails silently". Covers per-node error outputs and wiring, retry/self-healing, error-trigger workflows, and 4xx/5xx response shapes.
description_zh: 为n8n配置错误处理，确保失败时能发出响亮、结构化且可恢复的提示。适用于构建任何webhook/API工作流、计划或非计划工作流，或任何在静默失败时会中断用户可见工作的路径——以及每当用户提及错误处理、onError、continueErrorOutput、错误分支/输出、重试、retryOnFail、响应Webhook状态码、4xx/5xx、错误触发器或"我的工作流静默失败"时。涵盖每个节点的错误输出和连接、重试/自我修复、错误触发工作流以及4xx/5xx响应形状。

name: papercuts
description: Log genuine, recurring repository friction to .agents/PAPERCUTS.md — confusing setup, a flaky repo command or script, a misleading in-repo error, stale generated files, or a non-obvious gotcha that will cost the next contributor time. Also use to review, deduplicate, and resolve existing entries. Gate hard before logging: only friction the repository itself can fix counts. Never log the agent's own sandbox/permission errors, shell-scripting mistakes, transient flakiness, or third-party tool quirks the repo can't change.
description_zh: 记录真实的、反复出现的仓库摩擦问题到 .agents/PAPERCUTS.md — 模糊不清的设置、不可靠的仓库命令或脚本、误导性的仓库内错误、过时的生成文件，或对后续贡献者会造成时间成本的显而易见的陷阱。同时用于审查、去重和解决现有条目。在记录前严格把关：只有仓库本身能解决的问题才算摩擦。切勿记录代理自身的沙盒/权限错误、shell脚本错误、暂时性的不稳定问题，或仓库无法改变的第三方工具怪癖。

name: kotlin-tooling-cocoapods-spm-migration
description: Migrate KMP projects from CocoaPods (kotlin("native.cocoapods")) to Swift Package Manager (swiftPMDependencies DSL) — replaces pod() with swiftPackage(), transforms cocoapods.* imports to swiftPMImport.*, and reconfigures the Xcode project.
description_zh: 将 KMP 项目从 CocoaPods (kotlin("native.cocoapods")) 迁移到 Swift Package Manager (swiftPMDependencies DSL) — 替换 pod() 为 swiftPackage()，将 cocoapods.* 导入转换为 swiftPMImport.*，并重新配置 Xcode 项目。

name: htmx
description: HTMX development guidelines for building dynamic web applications with minimal JavaScript using HTML attributes.
description_zh: 使用 HTML 属性以最少的 JavaScript 构建动态 Web 应用的 HTMX 开发指南。

name: modern
description: Contemporary editorial style with serif typography, minimal palettes, and clean layouts for polished digital products.
description_zh: 现代编辑风格，采用衬线字体、简约调色板和清晰布局，为精致数字产品打造。

name: dingtalk-message
description: 钉钉消息发送。当用户提到"钉钉消息"、"发消息"、"发通知"、"群通知"、"群消息"、"Webhook"、"机器人消息"、"机器人发消息"、"工作通知"、"单聊消息"、"群聊消息"、"撤回消息"、"消息已读"、"发送Markdown"、"发卡片消息"、"ActionCard"、"@某人"、"@员工"、"at某人"、"提醒某人"、"dingtalk message"、"send message"、"robot message"、"work notification"时使用此技能。支持：群自定义 Webhook 机器人（文本/Markdown/ActionCard/Link/FeedCard + 加签 + @某人）、企业内部应用机器人单聊和群聊发送、消息撤回、已读查询、工作通知等全部消息类操作。
description_zh: 钉钉消息发送。当用户提到"钉钉消息"、"发消息"、"发通知"、"群通知"、"群消息"、"Webhook"、"机器人消息"、"机器人发消息"、"工作通知"、"单聊消息"、"群聊消息"、"撤回消息"、"消息已读"、"发送Markdown"、"发卡片消息"、"ActionCard"、"@某人"、"@员工"、"at某人"、"提醒某人"、"dingtalk message"、"send message"、"robot message"、"work notification"时使用此技能。支持：群自定义 Webhook 机器人（文本/Markdown/ActionCard/Link/FeedCard + 加签 + @某人）、企业内部应用机器人单聊和群聊发送、消息撤回、已读查询、工作通知等全部消息类操作。

name: code-debugging
description: Debug experiment code with structured error analysis. Categorize errors, apply targeted fixes with retry logic, and use reflection to prevent recurring issues. Use when experiment code fails or produces incorrect results.
description_zh: 使用结构化错误分析来调试实验代码。对错误进行分类，应用具有重试逻辑的针对性修复，并使用反射来防止重复出现的问题。当实验代码失败或产生错误结果时使用。

name: n8n-code-nodes-official
description: Use when the user reaches for a Code node, mentions writing JavaScript or Python in n8n, or any custom logic comes up in workflow design. Triggers on "Code node", "Code", "JavaScript", "Python", "custom logic", "transform data", "$input", "$json transformation", "loop in code", "write a function", or any time the obvious answer seems to be "just put it in code."
description_zh: 当用户选择 Code 节点、提及在 n8n 中编写 JavaScript 或 Python，或工作流设计中出现任何自定义逻辑时使用。触发条件包括 "Code 节点"、"Code"、"JavaScript"、"Python"、"自定义逻辑"、"转换数据"、"$input"、"JSON 转换"、"代码中的循环"、"编写函数"，或任何明显答案似乎是 "直接用代码实现" 的情况。

name: redis-clustering
description: Redis Cluster and replication guidance covering hash tags for multi-key operations, avoiding CROSSSLOT errors, and reading from replicas to scale read-heavy workloads. Use when designing keys for a sharded Redis Cluster, debugging CROSSSLOT errors on MGET / SDIFF / pipelines, configuring a multi-key transaction in a cluster, or routing reads to replicas for caches, analytics, or dashboards.
description_zh: Redis 集群和复制指南，涵盖多键操作中的哈希标签、避免 CROSSSLOT 错误，以及从从节点读取以扩展读密集型工作负载。在为分片的 Redis 集群设计键、调试 MGET / SDIFF / 管道上的 CROSSSLOT 错误、在集群中配置多键事务，或为缓存、分析或仪表板将读取路由到从节点时使用。

name: gcp-cloud-run
description: Specialized skill for building production-ready serverless applications on GCP. Covers Cloud Run services (containerized), Cloud Run Functions (event-driven), cold start optimization, and event-driven architecture with Pub/Sub.
description_zh: 针对在 GCP 上构建生产级无服务器应用程序的专业技能。涵盖 Cloud Run 服务（容器化）、Cloud Run 函数（事件驱动）、冷启动优化以及使用 Pub/Sub 的事件驱动架构。

name: tailwind-design-system
description: Build production-ready design systems with Tailwind CSS, including design tokens, component variants, responsive patterns, and accessibility.
description_zh: 使用 Tailwind CSS 构建 production-ready 设计系统，包括设计令牌、组件变体、响应式模式和可访问性。

name: apollo-kotlin
description: Guide for building applications with Apollo Kotlin, the GraphQL client library for Android and Kotlin. Use this skill when: (1) setting up Apollo Kotlin in a Gradle project for Android, Kotlin/JVM, or KMP, (2) configuring schema download and codegen for GraphQL services, (3) configuring an `ApolloClient` with auth, interceptors, and caching, (4) writing queries, mutations, or subscriptions,
description_zh: 使用 Apollo Kotlin 构建 Android 和 Kotlin 应用的指南，Apollo Kotlin 是用于 Android 和 Kotlin 的 GraphQL 客户端库。在以下情况使用此技能：(1) 在 Android、Kotlin/JVM 或 KMP 的 Gradle 项目中设置 Apollo Kotlin，(2) 配置 GraphQL 服务的模式下载和代码生成，(3) 配置带有认证、拦截器和缓存的 `ApolloClient`，(4) 编写查询、变异或订阅。

name: ruff-recursive-fix
description: Run Ruff checks with optional scope and rule overrides, apply safe and unsafe autofixes iteratively, review each change, and resolve remaining findings with targeted edits or user decisions.
description_zh: 使用可选的作用域和规则覆盖运行 Ruff 检查，迭代应用安全和不安全的自动修复，审查每个更改，并使用针对性的编辑或用户决策解决剩余问题。

name: context-window-management
description: Strategies for managing LLM context windows including summarization, trimming, routing, and avoiding context rot
description_zh: 管理大语言模型（LLM）上下文窗口的策略，包括摘要、裁剪、路由和避免上下文陈旧。

name: caption-writer-sms
description: When the user wants to write a caption for a visual-first social media post on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, or YouTube. Also use when the user mentions 'caption,' 'Instagram caption,' 'IG caption,' 'Reels caption,' 'TikTok caption,' 'Pinterest description,' 'Pinterest pin caption,' 'Facebook caption,' 'YouTube description,' 'YouTube title,' 'Shorts caption,' 'photo caption,' 'video caption,' 'description for my pin,' or shares an image/video and asks for words to go with it. For text-first standalone posts on LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Threads, or Bluesky, see post-writer-sms. For multi-slide carousels, see carousel-writer-sms. For opening lines, see hook-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要为 Facebook、Instagram、TikTok、Pinterest 或 YouTube 的视觉优先社交媒体帖子撰写标题时，也适用于用户提及“标题”、“Instagram 标题”、“IG 标题”、“Reels 标题”、“TikTok 标题”、“Pinterest 描述”、“Pinterest 钉子标题”、“Facebook 标题”、“YouTube 描述”、“YouTube 标题”、“Shorts 标题”、“照片标题”、“视频标题”、“我的钉子描述”，或分享图片/视频并询问配合的文字时。对于 LinkedIn、Twitter/X、Threads 或 Bluesky 的纯文本独立帖子，请参考 post-writer-sms。对于多页轮播图，请参考 carousel-writer-sms。对于开头句子，请参考 hook-writer-sms。

name: contemporary
description: Current-era minimalist design with bento grids, dark mode support, and high-performance accessible layouts.
description_zh: 当前时代的极简设计，采用便当网格布局，支持暗黑模式，并具有高性能的可访问布局。

name: hono-api-scaffolder
description: Scaffold Hono API routes for Cloudflare Workers. Produces route files, middleware, typed bindings, Zod validation, error handling, and API_ENDPOINTS.md documentation. Use after a project is set up with cloudflare-worker-builder or vite-flare-starter, when you need to add API routes, create endpoints, or generate API documentation.
description_zh: 为 Cloudflare Workers 构建 Hono API 路由。生成路由文件、中间件、类型绑定、Zod 验证、错误处理和 API_ENDPOINTS.md 文档。在项目使用 cloudflare-worker-builder 或 vite-flare-starter 设置完成后，当您需要添加 API 路由、创建端点或生成 API 文档时使用。

name: grow-app
description: Guided journey from an app people sign up for and then quietly abandon to a sealed retention engine with a habit loop, an activated first run, and one metric the whole team trusts. Orchestrates eight skills phase by phase - hooked-ux, improve-retention, continuous-discovery, lean-ux, inspired-product, lean-analytics, microinteractions, drive-motivation - asking the user questions at every decision point and recording results in the project docs/ folder (PRODUCT.md, METRICS.md, GROW-APP-PLAN.md) so the journey resumes across sessions. Use when the user wants to lift activation and retention, design a habit loop, fix a leaky onboarding funnel, or says 'users sign up then disappear'. Do not use to fix broken UX or performance that no engagement mechanic can paper over - run improve-app first; if there is no app yet, use create-app. For one framework in isolation, invoke that skill directly.
description_zh: 将用户注册后便悄然弃用的应用，改造为具备习惯回路、已激活的初次体验以及全团队共同认可的唯一核心指标的封闭留存引擎。按阶段协同八项技能——hooked-ux、improve-retention、continuous-discovery、lean-ux、inspired-product、lean-analytics、microinteractions、drive-motivation——在每个决策节点向用户提问，并将结果记录在项目的 docs/ 目录下（PRODUCT.md、METRICS.md、GROW-APP-PLAN.md），以便跨会话延续该旅程。当用户希望提升激活与留存、设计习惯回路、修复漏损的入门转化漏斗，或表示“用户注册后便消失”时，应使用本能力。不要用它来修复已损坏的用户体验或性能问题——这些问题无法被任何参与机制掩盖——请优先运行 improve-app；若尚无应用，请使用 create-app。若只需单独使用某一框架，请直接调用对应技能。

name: graphic-designer
description: Create LinkedIn post graphics. Decides between an HTML/CSS structured graphic or an AI-generated infographic based on the post content. Use this skill whenever the user says "design a graphic", "create a visual", "make an image", "graphic for my post", "LinkedIn image", or wants any visual content to pair with a LinkedIn post. Also trigger when the user finishes writing a post and wants a matching graphic.
description_zh: 创建领英帖子图形。根据帖子内容，决定使用HTML/CSS结构化图形还是AI生成的信息图。每当用户说“设计一个图形”、“创建一个视觉”、“制作一张图片”、“我帖子的图形”、“领英图片”，或者想要任何与领英帖子配对的视觉内容时，使用此技能。此外，当用户完成写帖子并想要匹配的图形时也会触发。

name: code-simplifier
description: Code simplification skill for improving clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving exact behavior. Use when simplifying code, reducing complexity, cleaning up recent changes, applying refactoring patterns, or improving readability. Triggers on tasks involving code cleanup, simplification, refactoring, or readability improvements.
description_zh: 代码简化技巧，旨在提高代码的清晰度、一致性和可维护性，同时保持精确的行为。适用于简化代码、降低复杂度、清理近期更改、应用重构模式或提升可读性。在涉及代码清理、简化、重构或可读性改进的任务中触发。

name: adk-docs
description: guidelines for creating, reviewing, updating, and searching ADK documentation - use when users ask about writing, maintaining, or auditing ADK bot docs
description_zh: 创建、审阅、更新和搜索ADK文档的指南 - 当用户询问关于编写、维护或审计ADK机器人文档时使用

name: reference-design-contract
description:
Turn vague taste, screenshots, URLs, product notes, or "make it feel like this"
references into a grounded DESIGN.md plus an implementation handoff. Use it
before prototypes, decks, redesigns, or image remix work when the user needs
a reusable visual direction rather than a one-off prompt.
description_zh: 将模糊的口味、截图、URL、产品说明或“让它感觉像这样”的参考转化为一个具体的 DESIGN.md 以及一个实施交接。在原型、提案、重新设计或图像混搭工作之前使用它，当用户需要一个可复用的视觉方向而不是一次性提示时。

name: material
description: Google's Material Design with layered surfaces, dynamic theming, built-in motion, and responsive cross-platform patterns.
description_zh: 谷歌的Material Design，具有分层表面、动态主题、内置动效以及响应式跨平台模式。

name: office-productivity
description: Office productivity workflow covering document creation, spreadsheet automation, presentation generation, and integration with LibreOffice and Microsoft Office formats.
description_zh: 办公生产力工作流程，涵盖文档创建、电子表格自动化、演示文稿生成，以及与LibreOffice和Microsoft Office格式的集成。

name: play-billing-library-version-upgrade
description: Use this skill when upgrading or migrating an Android project from any legacy Google Play Billing Library (PBL) version to the latest stable version of PBL.
description_zh: 在将 Android 项目从任何旧版 Google Play Billing Library (PBL) 升级或迁移到最新稳定版 PBL 时，请使用此功能。

name: futuristic
