description: Forward-looking design with tech-inspired typography, modern layouts, and a sleek, innovation-driven aesthetic.
description_zh: 面向未来的设计，融合科技灵感字体、现代布局，以及流畅、创新驱动美学。

name: systematic-debugging
description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
description_zh: 在遇到任何错误、测试失败或意外行为时，请在提出修复方案之前使用。

name: assess-react-native-migration
description: Assesses whether and how an existing mobile product should migrate to React Native. Use when auditing one or more product repositories for migration readiness, including products whose iOS, Android, and other clients live in separate directories or repositories; choosing brownfield, greenfield, or a checkpoint-based path; defining a representative trial; or preparing a baseline and ROI decision before implementation. When product scope or material evidence is unavailable, grills the stakeholder with exactly one question per turn instead of sending a questionnaire.
description_zh: 评估现有移动产品是否以及如何迁移到 React Native。在审核一个或多个产品仓库以评估迁移准备情况时使用，包括那些 iOS、Android 和其他客户端位于不同目录或仓库中的产品；选择采用旧场改造、新场改造或基于检查点的路径；定义代表性测试；或在实施前准备基线和投资回报率决策。当产品范围或实质性证据不可用时，每次向利益相关者提出一个精确的问题，而不是发送问卷。

name: tilegym-improve-cutile-kernel-perf
description: Iteratively optimize cuTile kernel performance through systematic profiling, bottleneck analysis, IR comparison, and targeted tuning. Covers tile sizes, occupancy, autotune configs, TMA, latency hints, persistent scheduling, num_ctas, flush_to_zero, and IR-level debugging. Use when asked to "optimize cutile kernel", "improve kernel perf", "tune cutile performance", "make kernel faster", or iteratively benchmark and refine a cuTile GPU kernel in the TileGym project.
description_zh: 通过系统性的性能分析、瓶颈分析、IR比较和针对性调优，迭代优化cuTile内核性能。涵盖瓦片大小、占用率、自动调优配置、TMA、延迟提示、持久调度、num_ctas、flush_to_zero以及IR级别的调试。在以下情况下使用：被要求“优化cuTile内核”、“提升内核性能”、“调优cuTile性能”、“使内核运行更快”，或在TileGym项目中迭代基准测试和优化cuTile GPU内核。

name: sleek
description: Modern minimalist aesthetic with clean lines, intentional color palette, subtle interactions, and consistent spacing.
description_zh: 现代极简美学，以简洁的线条、精心搭配的色彩、微妙的交互和一致的间距为特点。

name: business-analyst
description: Master modern business analysis with AI-powered analytics, real-time dashboards, and data-driven insights. Build comprehensive KPI frameworks, predictive models, and strategic recommendations.
description_zh: 掌握现代商业分析，借助AI驱动的分析工具、实时仪表盘和数据洞察力。构建全面的KPI框架、预测模型和战略建议。

name: code-review
description: Use this when reviewing AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix) code, either self-review at the end of development before opening a PR, or reviewing an existing pull request. Validates block structure, CSS and JS patterns, DOM output, Lighthouse performance, and accessibility against EDS best practices, and posts findings as review comments or GitHub suggestions.
description_zh: 在审查 AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix) 代码时使用此功能，无论是开发结束后自我审查再打开 PR，还是审查现有的拉取请求。它将根据 EDS 最佳实践验证代码的模块结构、CSS 和 JS 模板、DOM 输出、Lighthouse 性能和可访问性，并将审查结果作为评论或 GitHub 建议发布。

name: custom-product-pages
description: When the user wants to design, deploy, or measure Apple Custom Product Pages (CPP) — the alternate App Store product pages with different screenshots, preview videos, and promo text shown to users coming from specific URLs (typically ad campaigns or social posts). Use when the user mentions "Custom Product Page", "CPP", "alternate product page", "App Store URL variant", "ASA CPP", "campaign-specific landing page", "product page per audience", "App Store Connect CPP", "ppoUrl", "?cpp=" parameter, or "show different screenshots to different ad audiences". For App Store A/B tests on the default page, see ab-test-store-listing. For paid ad campaigns that route to CPPs, see apple-search-ads or ua-campaign.
description_zh: 当用户需要设计、部署或衡量 Apple 定制产品页面（CPP）时——这些针对从特定 URL（通常是广告活动或社交帖子）访问的用户显示不同截图、预览视频和促销文本的 App Store 替代产品页面。在用户提及“定制产品页面”、“CPP”、“替代产品页面”、“App Store URL 变体”、“ASA CPP”、“活动特定落地页”、“面向不同受众的产品页面”、“App Store Connect CPP”、“ppoUrl”、“?cpp=”参数或“向不同广告受众展示不同截图”时使用。对于默认页面的 App Store A/B 测试，请参阅 ab-test-store-listing。对于路由到 CPP 的付费广告活动，请参阅 apple-search-ads 或 ua-campaign。

name: r3f-postprocessing
description: Configure React Three Fiber postprocessing, bloom, selection effects, ambient occlusion, and depth of field. Use for composer pipelines and screen-space effects, rather than mesh material shaders.
description_zh: 配置 React Three Fiber 的后处理效果，包括辉光、选择、环境光遮蔽和景深。用于合成器管线和屏幕空间效果，而不是网格材质着色器。

name: cinematic-gsap-lenis-motion-system
description: Create premium cinematic web motion systems with GSAP, ScrollTrigger, and Lenis. Use for luxury editorial websites, creative studio portfolios, Awwwards-style interactions, smooth scroll reveals, staggered text, parallax, pinned sections, magnetic hover states, custom cursors, and mouse-reactive layered movement.
description_zh: 使用 GSAP、ScrollTrigger 和 Lenis 创建高端电影级网页动态系统。适用于奢华编辑网站、创意工作室作品集、Awwwards 风格的交互效果、平滑滚动揭示、错落文字、视差效果、固定区域、磁吸悬停状态、自定义光标以及鼠标响应式分层运动。

name: autoresearchclaw-autonomous-research
description: Fully autonomous research pipeline that turns a topic idea into a complete academic paper with real citations, experiments, and conference-ready LaTeX.
description_zh: 一个完全自动化的研究流程，能够将一个主题想法转化为包含真实引用、实验以及适用于会议的LaTeX格式的完整学术论文。

name: wandb-primary
description: Primary W&B skill for broad or mixed Weights & Biases work: project overviews, W&B runs and artifacts, Weave traces and evaluations, Reports, and Launch workflows. Use when the task spans multiple W&B surfaces or the user asks generally what is happening in a W&B project.
description_zh: 主要W&B技能，适用于广泛的或混合的Weights & Biases工作：项目概览、W&B运行和工件、Weave跟踪和评估、报告以及发布工作流。当任务跨越多个W&B界面，或用户询问W&B项目中一般发生的情况时使用。

name: day1-onboarding
description: AI Native Camp Day 1 온보딩. Claude와 대화하면서 Claude Code를 익힌다. "1일차", "Day 1", "온보딩" 요청에 사용.

name: phoenix-evals
description: Build and run evaluators for AI/LLM applications using Phoenix.
description_zh: 使用 Phoenix 构建并运行 AI/LLM 应用的评估器。

name: animation-on-scroll
description: Create an on-scroll animation trigger using IntersectionObserver with Tailwind-friendly animation classes and keyframes. Use when asked for scroll-reveal, animate-on-scroll, or sequencing element animations when they enter the viewport.

name: brutalism
description: Raw, anti-design aesthetic inspired by concrete architecture with unadorned elements, jarring layouts, and functional minimalism.
description_zh: 源自混凝土建筑的原始、反设计美学，以未加修饰的元素、令人惊愕的布局和功能性极简主义为特点。

name: r3f-materials
description: Choose and configure React Three Fiber surface materials, PBR, transparency, and transmission. Use for mesh appearance and material cost; use shader guidance for custom GLSL or TSL code.
description_zh: 选择并配置 React Three Fiber 表面材质、PBR、透明度和透射效果。用于网格外观和材质成本；使用着色器指导进行自定义 GLSL 或 TSL 代码。

name: senior-frontend
description: Frontend development skill for React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS applications. Use when building React components, optimizing Next.js performance, analyzing bundle sizes, scaffolding frontend projects, implementing accessibility, or reviewing frontend code quality.
description_zh: React、Next.js、TypeScript和Tailwind CSS应用程序的前端开发技能。在构建React组件、优化Next.js性能、分析打包大小、搭建前端项目、实现可访问性或审查前端代码质量时使用。

name: social-media-analyzer
description: Social media campaign analysis and performance tracking. Calculates engagement rates, ROI, and benchmarks across platforms. Use when analyzing social media performance, calculating engagement rate, measuring campaign ROI, comparing platform metrics, or benchmarking against industry standards. Also use when the user mentions "social media audit," "engagement rate," or "which platform performs best."
description_zh: 社交媒体活动分析和绩效追踪。计算各平台的参与率、投资回报率（ROI）和基准。在分析社交媒体绩效、计算参与率、衡量活动ROI、比较平台指标或与行业标准进行基准比较时使用。当用户提及“社交媒体审计”、“参与率”或“哪个平台表现最佳”时，也请使用。

name: claymorphism
description: Soft, rounded 3D-like shapes mimicking malleable clay with playful, puffy elements and colorful surfaces.
description_zh: 柔软、圆润的3D形状，模仿可塑粘土，带有俏皮、蓬松的元素和多彩表面。

name: corporate
description: Professional, brand-aligned design with structured grids, minimalist layouts, and consistent enterprise patterns.
description_zh: 专业、符合品牌的设计，采用结构化网格、极简布局和一致的企业模式。

name: rebuttal-writing
description: Write point-by-point rebuttals to reviewer comments. Extract concerns from reviews, generate evidence-based responses, and format as a structured rebuttal document. Use after receiving peer review feedback.
description_zh: 逐条回应审稿人意见。从审稿意见中提取关切点，生成基于证据的回应，并按结构化方式编排为一份回应文档。在收到同行评审反馈后使用。

name: pptx-official
description: A user may ask you to create, edit, or analyze the contents of a .pptx file. A .pptx file is essentially a ZIP archive containing XML files and other resources that you can read or edit. You have different tools and workflows available for different tasks.
description_zh: 用户可能会要求您创建、编辑或分析 .pptx 文件的内容。本质上，.pptx 文件是一个包含 XML 文件和其他资源的 ZIP 压缩包，您可以读取或编辑这些内容。针对不同的任务，您可以使用不同的工具和工作流程。

name: storytelling
description: Narrative-driven design using visuals, copy, and interaction to guide users through engaging, emotionally resonant journeys.
description_zh: 以视觉、文案和交互为驱动，通过叙事性设计引导用户经历引人入胜、富有情感共鸣的旅程。

name: huggingface-paper-publisher
description: Publish and manage research papers on Hugging Face Hub. Supports creating paper pages, linking papers to models/datasets, claiming authorship, and generating professional markdown-based research articles.
description_zh: 在 Hugging Face Hub 上发布和管理研究论文。支持创建论文页面、将论文链接到模型/数据集、认领作者身份以及生成基于专业 Markdown 的研究文章。

name: github-workflow-automation

name: building-blocks
description: Use this when implementing code changes in AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix), whether new or modified blocks, core functionality (scripts.js, styles, delayed.js, etc.), or both. Creates and modifies block folders and decorate functions, updates core scripts, scopes CSS, and wires up delayed loading. For the overall development process use content-driven-development.
description_zh: 在实施 AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix) 中的代码更改时使用此功能，无论是新增或修改的模块，还是核心功能（scripts.js、样式、delayed.js 等），或两者兼有。创建和修改模块文件夹，装饰函数，更新核心脚本，作用域 CSS，并配置延迟加载。对于整体开发流程，请使用内容驱动开发。

Searches the aem.live documentation, ranks matching pages by relevance, fetches full articles, and surfaces code examples and deprecation warnings.
description_zh: 当您需要更多关于AEM Edge Delivery Services（EDS，Franklin，Helix）功能的信息或实施指导，而现有的网络搜索工具无法提供相关结果时，请使用此功能。它将搜索aem.live文档，按相关性对匹配页面进行排序，获取完整文章，并展示代码示例和弃用警告。

name: n8n-agents
description: Design n8n AI agents the right way. Use when building or editing any @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.* AI node — an AI Agent, LLM chain, Text Classifier, or Information Extractor — and whenever the user mentions AI agents, LLM with tools, tool calling, $fromAI, system prompts, agent memory, sessionId, structured/JSON output, output parser, RAG, vector store, a chat assistant/bot, or human-in-the-loop review. Covers Agent-vs-chain-vs-classifier choice, the model/memory/tools/outputParser slots, tool names/descriptions as prompt, structured output with autoFix, memory, RAG, human review, and chat topologies.
description_zh: 以正确的方式设计 n8n AI 代理。在构建或编辑任何 @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.* AI 节点时使用——无论是 AI 代理、LLM 链、文本分类器还是信息提取器——以及每当用户提及 AI 代理、带工具的 LLM、工具调用、$fromAI、系统提示、代理内存、sessionId、结构化/JSON 输出、输出解析器、RAG、向量存储、聊天助手/机器人或人机审核时。涵盖代理-链-分类器选择、模型/内存/工具/输出解析器插槽、工具名称/描述作为提示、带自动修复的结构化输出、内存、RAG、人机审核以及聊天拓扑结构。

name: azure-architecture-autopilot
description:
Design Azure infrastructure using natural language, or analyze existing Azure resources to auto-generate architecture diagrams, refine them through conversation, and deploy with Bicep.
When to use this skill: - "Create X on Azure", "Set up a RAG architecture" (new design) - "Analyze my current Azure infrastructure", "Draw a diagram for rg-xxx" (existing analysis) - "Foundry is slow", "I want to reduce costs", "Strengthen security" (natural language modification) - Azure resource deployment, Bicep template generation, IaC code generation - Microsoft Foundry, AI Search, OpenAI, Fabric, ADLS Gen2, Databricks, and all Azure services
description_zh:
使用自然语言设计 Azure 基础设施，或分析现有的 Azure 资源以自动生成架构图，通过对话进行优化，并使用 Bicep 进行部署。

- "在 Azure 上创建 X"，"设置 RAG 架构"（新设计）  
- "分析我的当前 Azure 基础设施"，"为 rg-xxx 绘制图表"（现有分析）  
- "Foundry 运行缓慢"，"我想降低成本"，"加强安全性"（自然语言修改）  
- Azure 资源部署、Bicep 模板生成、IaC 代码生成  
- Microsoft Foundry、AI Search、OpenAI、Fabric、ADLS Gen2、Databricks 以及所有 Azure 服务

name: ctx-stats
description:
Show how much context window context-mode saved this session.
Displays token consumption, context savings ratio, and per-tool breakdown.
Read-only — shows stats only, no reset capability.
To wipe the knowledge base entirely, use ctx_purge instead.
Trigger: /context-mode:ctx-stats

展示此会话中上下文窗口模式节省了多少上下文。
显示令牌消耗、上下文节省比例以及按工具细分的数据。
只读 — 仅显示统计数据，无重置功能。
要完全清除知识库，请使用 ctx_purge。
触发：/context-mode:ctx-stats

name: image-to-code
description: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping old ones, avoid lazy under-generation, avoid cards-inside-cards-inside-cards UI, and keep the hero clean, spacious, readable, and visible on a small laptop.

Scans local block folders, searches the Block Collection for common blocks, resolves each block's purpose, and returns a consolidated block inventory annotated with per-block purpose and availability. Do not invoke directly — called by page-import as a pipeline step.

Does not cover language-specific syntax — delegates to specialized skills.

Use when writing or refactoring CMakeLists.txt, configuring out-of-source builds, selecting generators (Ninja, Make, VS), managing targets and dependencies with target_link_libraries, integrating external packages via find_package or FetchContent, enabling sanitizers, setting up toolchain files for cross-compilation, or exporting CMake packages. Activates on queries about CMakeLists.txt, cmake configure errors, target properties, install rules, CPack, or CMake presets.

name: remotion

description_zh: json-render 的 Remotion 渲染器，可将 JSON 时间线规范转换为视频。适用于使用 @json-render/remotion、从 JSON 构建视频组合、创建视频目录或渲染 AI 生成的视频时间线。

name: kotlin-multiplatform
description:
Platform abstraction decision-making for Amethyst KMP project. Guides when to abstract vs keep platform-specific,
source set placement (commonMain, jvmAndroid, platform-specific), expect/actual patterns. Covers primary targets
(Android, JVM/Desktop, iOS — all mature) with web/wasm as possible future targets. Integrates with gradle-expert for dependency issues.
Triggers on: abstraction decisions ("should I share this?"), source set placement questions, expect/actual creation,
build.gradle.kts work, incorrect placement detection, KMP dependency suggestions.
description_zh: 紫晶 KMP 项目的平台抽象决策。指导何时进行抽象与何时保留平台特定实现，包括源集放置（commonMain、jvmAndroid、平台特定源集）以及 expect/actual 模式。涵盖主要目标平台（Android、JVM/桌面、iOS——均为成熟平台），并将 Web/WASM 作为可能的未来目标平台。与 gradle-expert 集成以解决依赖问题。触发场景包括：抽象决策（“我应该共享此代码吗？”）、源集放置问题、创建 expect/actual、编辑 build.gradle.kts、检测不正确的放置以及 KMP 依赖建议。

name: r3f-shaders

name: agent-owasp-compliance
description:
Check any AI agent codebase against the OWASP Agentic Security Initiative (ASI) Top 10 risks.
Use this skill when:
- Evaluating an agent system's security posture before production deployment
- Running a compliance check against OWASP ASI 2026 standards
- Mapping existing security controls to the 10 agentic risks
- Generating a compliance report for security review or audit
- Comparing agent framework security features against the standard
- Any request like "is my agent OWASP compliant?", "check ASI compliance", or "agentic security audit"
description_zh:
将任何 AI 智能体代码库对照 OWASP 智能体安全计划（ASI）的十大风险进行检查。
在以下场景中使用此技能：
- 在部署到生产环境之前，评估智能体系统的安全态势
- 依据 OWASP ASI 2026 标准进行合规性检查
- 将现有的安全控制措施映射到这十大智能体风险上
- 为安全审查或审计生成合规报告
- 将智能体框架的安全特性与该标准进行对比
- 任何类似“我的智能体是否符合 OWASP 标准？”、“检查 ASI 合规性”或“智能体安全审计”的请求

name: minimalist-ui
description: Clean editorial-style interfaces. Warm monochrome palette, typographic contrast, flat bento grids, muted pastels. No gradients, no heavy shadows.

name: content-driven-development
description: Use this when making any AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix) code change — new blocks, block modifications, CSS styling, bug fixes, core functionality (scripts.js, styles, delayed.js), or any JavaScript/CSS work that needs validation. Covers the Content Driven Development process — identifying or creating real test content before writing code, designing an author-friendly content model, and validating against that content throughout development. Do not use for documentation-only changes or configuration changes that do not affect authoring.
description_zh: 在进行任何 AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix) 代码更改时使用——新增模块、模块修改、CSS 样式、错误修复、核心功能（scripts.js、样式、delayed.js）或任何需要验证的 JavaScript/CSS 工作。涵盖内容驱动开发流程——在编写代码前识别或创建真实测试内容、设计用户友好的内容模型，并在整个开发过程中针对该内容进行验证。仅用于文档更改或不会影响内容编辑的配置更改。

name: attribution-setup
description: When the user wants to set up, debug, or interpret app install attribution — including SKAdNetwork (SKAN), Apple's AdAttributionKit, Google Play Install Referrer, MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Branch, Kochava), deep links, deferred deep links, conversion values, postback windows, or privacy thresholds. Use when the user mentions "SKAdNetwork", "SKAN", "SKAN 4", "AdAttributionKit", "AAK", "MMP", "AppsFlyer", "Adjust", "Singular", "Branch", "attribution", "conversion value", "postback", "Install Referrer", "deferred deep link", "iOS 14.5", "ATT", "App Tracking Transparency", "IDFA", or "I can't measure my ad campaigns". For paid campaign strategy, see ua-campaign and apple-search-ads. For analytics events, see app-analytics.
description_zh: 当用户需要设置、调试或解释应用安装归因时——包括SKAdNetwork（SKAN）、苹果的AdAttributionKit、Google Play安装推荐、MMP（AppsFlyer、Adjust、Singular、Branch、Kochava）、深度链接、延迟深度链接、转化值、回传窗口或隐私阈值。当用户提到“SKAdNetwork”、“SKAN”、“SKAN 4”、“AdAttributionKit”、“AAK”、“MMP”、“AppsFlyer”、“Adjust”、“Singular”、“Branch”、“归因”、“转化值”、“回传”、“安装推荐”、“延迟深度链接”、“iOS 14.5”、“ATT”、“App Tracking Transparency”、“IDFA”或“我无法衡量我的广告活动”时使用。对于付费活动策略，请参阅ua-campaign和apple-search-ads。对于分析事件，请参阅app-analytics。

name: images-search
description: USE FOR image search. Returns images with title, source URL, thumbnail. Supports SafeSearch filter. Up to 200 results.
description_zh: 用于图像搜索。返回包含标题、来源URL和缩略图的图片。支持安全搜索过滤器。最多可返回200条结果。

name: code-craft
description: Apply Jess's engineering conventions to architecture, boundary typing, error handling, and abstraction decisions.
description_zh: 将 Jess 的工程规范应用于架构、边界类型、错误处理和抽象决策。

name: shipping-artifacts
description: The durable documentation set that makes an AI-built (vibe-coded) app reviewable before shipping. A small core every app needs — architecture, user/permission flows, permissions, variables/secrets, and a test-coverage map — plus conditional docs added only when they apply: emails, scheduled work, SEO, and embedded agents/automation. Defines what each doc must capture and how a reviewer or auditor uses it. Use when documenting a codebase for handoff, mapping user journeys and trust-boundary crossings, planning test coverage, or preparing for a security or performance audit.
description_zh: 能够确保在交付前对AI构建（vibe-coded）的应用进行可审查的耐久性文档集。每个应用都需要的小核心——架构、用户/权限流程、权限、变量/密钥，以及测试覆盖率地图——再加上仅在适用时添加的条件性文档：电子邮件、计划任务、SEO和嵌入式代理/自动化。定义了每份文档必须捕获的内容以及审查者或审计员如何使用它。在为代码库交接、映射用户旅程和信任边界跨越、规划测试覆盖率或准备安全或性能审计时使用。

name: databricks-core
description: Databricks CLI operations and the parent/entry-point skill for Databricks CLI use: authentication, profile selection, and bundles. Load this first for CLI, auth, profile, and bundle tasks, then load the matching product skill. For finding or exploring data, answering questions about the data, or generating SQL, load the databricks-data-discovery skill (it routes to Genie One). Contains up-to-date guidelines for Databricks-related CLI tasks.
description_zh: Databricks CLI 操作及其父/入口技能使用：认证、配置文件选择和软件包。首先加载此技能以用于 CLI、认证、配置文件和软件包任务，然后加载匹配的产品技能。对于查找或探索数据、回答数据相关的问题或生成 SQL，请加载 databricks-data-discovery 技能（它路由到 Genie One）。包含与 Databricks 相关的 CLI 任务最新指南。

name: ship-it
description: Use when asked to ship a completed change, commit and open a PR, or push changes and watch CI. Use babysit for monitoring an existing PR.
description_zh: 当被要求提交一个完成的变更、提交并打开一个PR，或推送变更并监视CI时使用。使用babysit来监控一个现有的PR。

name: storage-analyzer
description: macOS / Windows 只读存储分析助手（自动识别系统）。扫描整机磁盘占用，找出 占空间大户，把每一项分成 🟢可自动清理 / 🟡需人工判断 / 🔴谨慎清理 三级并给出 可执行处置方案，生成排版精美、可折叠、命令可一键复制的交互式 HTML 报告，并可 起本地服务在网页上一键删除（移废纸篓/直接删）。扫描全程只读。务必在以下场景 使用：用户说"存储分析""磁盘满了""C盘/硬盘满了""空间不够""清理空间" "清理磁盘""占空间""哪些东西占地方""帮我看看存储""看一下电脑存储/空间" "存储空间""电脑空间不够""内存满了/不够/不足""看下内存/存储"（中文口语里 "内存"常指存储空间）"storage analysis""disk cleanup""清缓存""磁盘清理"； 或用户抱怨电脑没空间、想知道什么东西吃硬盘、想要清理建议时。注意：若用户明确 指运行内存/RAM（如"哪个进程吃内存""内存占用高"想看活动监视器），那是 RAM 不是存储，不属于本 skill。
description_zh: macOS / Windows 只读存储分析助手（自动识别系统）。扫描整机磁盘占用，找出占空间大户，将每一项分为 🟢可自动清理 / 🟡需人工判断 / 🔴谨慎清理 三级，并提供可执行处置方案，生成排版精美、可折叠、命令可一键复制的交互式 HTML 报告，并可启动本地服务在网页上一键删除（清废纸篓/直接删除）。扫描全程仅读。务必在以下场景使用：用户说"存储分析""磁盘满了""C盘/硬盘满了""空间不够""清理空间""清理磁盘""占空间""哪些东西占地方""帮我看看存储""看一下电脑存储/空间""存储空间""电脑空间不够""内存满了/不够/不足""看下内存/存储"（中文口语中"内存"常指存储空间）"storage analysis""disk cleanup""清缓存""磁盘清理"；或用户抱怨电脑没空间、想知道什么东西占用硬盘、需要清理建议时。注意：若用户明确指运行内存/RAM（如"哪个进程吃内存""内存占用高"想看活动监视器），那是 RAM 不是存储，不属于本技能。

name: wiki-context-pack
description: Produce a token-bounded, citation-ready context slice from an existing Obsidian vault for a downstream agent or task. Use for "/wiki-context-pack", "use my vault as context", "context slice for X", "pack the wiki for my agent", or "bounded context for Y".
description_zh: 从现有的 Obsidian 库中生成一个受令牌限制且可直接引用的上下文切片，供下游智能体或任务使用。适用于以下场景：“/wiki-context-pack”、“使用我的库作为上下文”、“为 X 提供上下文切片”、“为我的智能体打包维基”，或“为 Y 提供受限上下文”。

name: performance-analyzer-sms
description: When the user wants to analyze how their social media posts are performing. Also use when the user mentions 'analytics,' 'performance,' 'how did my posts do,' 'engagement,' 'impressions,' 'what's working,' 'post metrics,' 'my best posts,' or 'why isn't this post performing.' Uses BlackTwist analytics when available, works from user-provided data otherwise. For audience growth specifically, see audience-growth-tracker-sms. For pattern detection, see content-pattern-analyzer-sms. For actionable next steps, see optimization-advisor-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要分析其社交媒体帖子的表现时，也适用于用户提到“分析”、“表现”、“我的帖子表现如何”、“互动”、“曝光量”、“哪些有效”、“帖子指标”、“我的最佳帖子”或“为什么这个帖子表现不佳”等情况。当可用时，使用 BlackTwist 分析工具；否则，使用用户提供的数据。针对受众增长，请参阅 audience-growth-tracker-sms。针对模式检测，请参阅 content-pattern-analyzer-sms。针对可执行的下一步行动，请参阅 optimization-advisor-sms。

name: deslop
description: Remove AI writing patterns from prose. Use this skill when writing, drafting, editing, reviewing, or revising any text to eliminate predictable AI tells, slop, and formulaic patterns. Trigger this skill whenever the user asks to "deslop", "de-AI", "make it sound human," "remove AI patterns," "remove AI tropes," "clean up AI writing," fix "slop," "deslop" text, or review prose for authenticity. Also use when the user asks you to write or draft anything and wants it to sound natural rather than AI-generated. Common use cases include scientific writing (manuscripts, abstracts, cover letters, grant narratives, discussion sections, peer review responses), blog posts, newsletters, memos, reports, and any other substantial prose.
description_zh: 从散文中去除AI写作模式。在写作、起草、编辑、审阅或修改任何文本时使用此技能，以消除可预测的AI特征、冗余内容和公式化模式。当用户要求“去除冗余”、“去除AI影响”、“使其听起来更自然”、“去除AI模式”、“去除AI陈词滥调”、“清理AI写作”、“修正冗余内容”、“去除冗余文本”或审阅散文以检验其真实性时，请触发此技能。此外，当用户要求您撰写或起草任何内容，并希望其听起来自然而非AI生成时，也请使用此技能。常见应用场景包括科学写作（手稿、摘要、封面信、资助申请叙述、讨论部分、同行评审回复）、博客文章、简报、备忘录、报告以及任何其他重要的散文。

name: merge-open-prs
description: Use when asked to merge all open PRs or land a specified set of PRs together.
description_zh: 当被要求合并所有打开的 PR 或一起合并指定的 PR 集合时使用。

name: content-writer
description: Use when the user asks to "write SEO content", "draft a blog post / landing page", "update outdated content", or "fix traffic/ranking decay"; two modes — new drafts pages with keywords, headers, snippets, and evidence boundaries; refresh scores decay, prioritizes update work, and produces a republish plan with GEO guidance. Not for AI-citation/GEO readiness scoring — use geo-content-optimizer; not for publish-gate scoring — use content-quality-auditor. SEO文章写作/内容更新/排名恢复
description_zh: 当用户要求“撰写SEO内容”、“起草博客文章/着陆页”、“更新过时内容”或“修复流量/排名衰减”时使用；两种模式——新草稿页面包含关键词、标题、片段和证据边界；刷新衰减分数，优先处理更新工作，并生成带有GEO指导的重新发布计划。不适用于AI引用/GEO准备评分——请使用geo-content-optimizer；不适用于发布门禁评分——请使用content-quality-auditor。SEO文章写作/内容更新/排名恢复

name: icon-retrieval
description: Search icons through HTTP API and retrieve SVG strings with curl.
description_zh: 通过 HTTP API 搜索图标，并使用 curl 获取 SVG 字符串。

name: swift-style
description: Swift code style conventions for clean, readable code. Use when writing Swift code to ensure consistent formatting, naming, organization, and idiomatic patterns.
description_zh: Swift代码风格规范，用于编写干净、易读的代码。在编写Swift代码时使用，以确保一致的格式、命名、组织以及惯用法。

name: tag-release
description: Use when asked to tag or cut a patch, minor, or major release.
description_zh: 当被要求标记或裁剪补丁、次要或主要版本时使用。

name: analyze-and-plan
description: Use this when you need to define acceptance criteria, write requirements, scope work, or create a definition of done for AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS) tasks such as new blocks, variants, behavior modifications, CSS-only changes, or bug fixes. Covers analyzing development requirements, producing task breakdowns, identifying edge cases, and documenting the analysis.
description_zh: 在需要定义验收标准、编写需求、界定工作范围或为 AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS) 任务（如新模块、变体、行为修改、纯 CSS 修改或 Bug 修复）创建完成定义时使用。涵盖分析开发需求、生成任务分解、识别边缘情况以及记录分析。

name: deal-management
description: Run the full deal lifecycle from CLI — discover pipelines/stages, qualify MQLs into deals with associations, advance/reassign in bulk, hunt stalled deals, and close.
description_zh: 从命令行界面（CLI）运行完整的交易生命周期——发现流程/阶段，将MQL（潜在客户资格）转化为交易并建立关联，批量推进/重新分配，追踪停滞的交易，并完成关闭。

name: openseo-review-web-content
description: Write and review content for the OpenSEO website (web/) — blog posts, guides, feature pages, FAQs. Distills the philosophy for on-brand, useful, accurate content. Use whenever adding or editing user-facing prose in web/content or web/src.
description_zh: 为 OpenSEO 网站（web/）撰写和审阅内容——博客文章、指南、功能页面、常见问题解答。提炼品牌化、实用、准确的内容理念。在 web/content 或 web/src 中添加或编辑面向用户的前端文本时，均需使用。

name: dropshipping-product-research
description: Product research for dropshipping businesses. Identify profitable products with reliable suppliers, healthy margins, and manageable competition. Evaluates shipping times, return risk, and marketing viability.
description_zh: 为代发货业务进行产品调研。识别具有可靠供应商、健康利润空间和可控竞争压力的盈利产品。评估运输时间、退货风险和营销可行性。

name: content-modeling
description: Use this when you are building new AEM Edge Delivery Services blocks or changing the initial structure that authors work with in an existing block. Covers designing content models that are easy for authors to use.
description_zh: 在构建新的 AEM Edge Delivery Services 组件或更改现有组件中作者所使用初始结构时使用。涵盖设计易于作者使用的 内容模型。

name: x-mastery-mentor
description:
$10K/hr级X/Twitter运营导师。基于Nicolas Cole、Dickie Bush、Sahil Bloom、Justin Welsh、
Dan Koe、Alex Hormozi六位顶级创作者的方法论 + X开源算法深度分析 + AI/科技赛道专精策略，
提炼6个核心心智模型、10条决策启发式、完整的选题-写作-增长操作手册。
通用方法论为底座，AI/科技赛道为专精。
当用户提到「X运营」「推特」「Twitter」「怎么写推文」「怎么涨粉」「X策略」「推特选题」「tweet」「thread」「X算法」时使用。
即使用户只是说「这条推文怎么写」「帮我想个X内容」「推特增长」「发推」「write a tweet」「X account」「grow on X」也应触发。

name: neki
description: Overview and information about Neki, the sharded Postgres product by PlanetScale. Load when working with Neki-related tasks and the need to scale or shard postgres. Load when facing Postgres scaling or sharding issues.
description_zh: Neki的概述和信息，它是PlanetScale提供的分片Postgres产品。在处理与Neki相关的任务以及需要扩展或分片Postgres时加载。在面临Postgres扩展或分片问题时加载。

name: code-review-quality
description: Conduct context-driven code reviews focusing on quality, testability, and maintainability. Use when reviewing code, providing feedback, or establishing review practices.
description_zh: 进行以场景为基础的代码审查，重点关注质量、可测试性和可维护性。在审查代码、提供反馈或建立审查实践时使用。

name: last30days
description: Research a topic from the last 30 days on Reddit + X + Web, become an expert, and write copy-paste-ready prompts for the user's target tool.
description_zh: 从过去30天内，在Reddit、X（推特）和网络上研究一个主题，成为该领域的专家，并为用户的靶标工具撰写可复制粘贴的提示。

name: custom-object-management
description: Discover, create, update, and delete custom CRM object schemas. Use when defining a new object type, inspecting existing schemas, or removing one. Record CRUD on custom objects is identical to standard objects — see `bulk-operations`.
description_zh: 发现、创建、更新和删除自定义CRM对象模式。在定义新对象类型、检查现有模式或删除时使用。自定义对象上的CRUD记录与标准对象相同——请参阅 `bulk-operations`。

name: sales-reporting
description: Daily briefings, pipeline snapshots, and win/loss analysis from the terminal — closing-this-week, open pipeline by stage/owner, and closed-won vs closed-lost over a period.
description_zh: 每日简报、项目流程快照以及终端的赢/输分析——本周关闭、按阶段/负责人划分的开立流程，以及一段时间内的已关闭赢/输对比。

name: gh-stack
description: Use when working in a checked-out PR stack, handling dependent PRs or branch layers, or planning to split work into stacked PRs.
description_zh: 在处理已签出的PR堆栈、依赖的PR或分支层时使用，或计划将工作拆分为堆叠的PR。

name: claude-security
description: Claude Security: scan the codebase (the whole repository or a scoped part of it), scan changes (this branch's or a pull request's diff, or one commit), or suggest patches (findings turned into targeted patch files, each verified by a panel of agents, that you apply when you choose). Use when the user asks to scan, audit or check code with Claude Security, to scan their changes with Claude Security, or to fix or patch Claude Security findings.
description_zh: Claude 安全：扫描代码库（整个仓库或其部分范围）、扫描变更（此分支或拉取请求的差异，或单个提交），或建议补丁（将发现的问题转化为目标补丁文件，每个补丁文件都经过代理小组验证，您可以在选择时应用）。当用户要求使用 Claude 安全扫描、审计或检查代码，使用 Claude 安全扫描其变更，或修复或应用 Claude 安全发现的问题时使用。

name: n8n-self-hosting
description: Deploy a production self-hosted n8n end-to-end to a fresh Linux VM over SSH, using Docker Compose behind a Caddy reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS. Use whenever the user wants to self-host, install, provision, or deploy n8n on their own server/VPS (Hetzner, DigitalOcean, AWS EC2, bare metal) — single/regular mode or queue mode with workers — or to update, back up, restore, or harden such an instance, or make Python Code nodes run on it (task runners). For SELF-HOSTED n8n (Docker), not n8n Cloud and not building workflows. The skill makes the agent ask single-vs-queue first, collect domain/SSH/timezone inputs, generate fresh secrets on the box, and bring the stack up with TLS. Trigger on "deploy n8n", "self-host n8n", "n8n docker compose", "n8n queue mode / workers", "n8n reverse proxy / SSL", "back up / update my n8n", "Python runner unavailable" / "n8nio/runners sidecar", or "we don't want to give every user the OAuth client secret" / "enable Sign in with Google" (credential overwrites).
description_zh: 在新的 Linux 虚拟机 (VM) 上通过 SSH 部署生产环境的自托管 n8n，使用 Docker Compose 作为 Caddy 反向代理，并自动启用 HTTPS。当用户希望在自己的服务器/VPS（Hetzner、DigitalOcean、AWS EC2、裸金属服务器）上自行托管、安装、配置或部署 n8n（单线程/常规模式或队列模式带工作进程）时使用，或者用于更新、备份、恢复或加固此类实例，或让 Python 代码节点在其上运行（任务执行者）。针对自托管 n8n（Docker），而非 n8n 云服务，也不涉及工作流构建。该技能会先询问单线程与队列模式，收集域名/SSH/时区输入，在服务器上生成新的密钥，并使用 TLS 启动堆栈。触发条件包括："部署 n8n"、"自托管 n8n"、"n8n Docker Compose"、"n8n 队列模式/工作进程"、"n8n 反向代理/SSL"、"备份/更新我的 n8n"、"Python 执行者不可用" / "n8nio/runners 侧边容器"，或 "我们不想给每个用户都提供 OAuth 客户端密钥" / "启用 Google 登录"（凭证覆盖）。

name: speckit-clarify
description: Identify underspecified areas in the current feature spec by asking up to 5 highly targeted clarification questions and encoding answers back into the spec.
description_zh: 通过提出最多5个高度针对性的澄清问题，识别当前功能规范中未明确说明的部分，并将答案编码回规范中。

name: data-enrichment
description: Match external CSV/JSONL records to CRM contacts (by email) or companies (by domain) and write enriched data back in one pass using `hubspot objects upsert`.
description_zh: 将外部 CSV/JSONL 记录与 CRM 联系人（通过电子邮件）或公司（通过域名）进行匹配，并使用 `hubspot objects upsert` 在一次操作中写入丰富数据。

name: diffity-tour
description: Create a guided code tour that walks through the codebase to answer a question or explain a feature. Opens in the browser with step-by-step navigation and highlighted code.
description_zh: 创建一个引导式代码巡游，通过代码库来回答问题或解释功能。在浏览器中打开，提供逐步导航和高亮代码。

name: template-skill
description: Reusable template for authoring new Agent Skills with clear triggers, workflow, and I/O contracts.
description_zh: 可复用模板，用于编写新的 Agent 技能，具有明确的触发器、工作流和 I/O 合同。

name: listenhub
description:
ListenHub CLI skills router. Routes to the correct skill based on user intent.
Triggers on: "make a podcast", "explainer video", "read aloud", "TTS",
"generate image", "generate video", "做播客", "解说视频", "朗读", "生成图片",
"生成视频", "幻灯片", "slides", "音乐", "music", "generate music", "翻唱",
"混音", "remix", "续写", "extend", "纯音乐", "instrumental", "配乐",
"soundtrack", "分轨", "stem", "识别歌词", "克隆人声", "vocal clone",
"cover song", "pixverse", "口型", "lipsync", "对口型",
"parse URL", "解析链接", "提取内容".
description_zh:
ListenHub CLI 技能路由器。根据用户意图路由到正确的技能。
触发条件： "制作播客"、"解说视频"、"朗读"、"TTS"、"生成图片"、"生成视频"、"做播客"、"解说视频"、"朗读"、"生成图片"、"生成视频"、"幻灯片"、"slides"、"音乐"、"music"、"生成音乐"、"翻唱"、"混音"、"remix"、"续写"、"extend"、"纯音乐"、"instrumental"、"配乐"、"soundtrack"、"分轨"、"stem"、"识别歌词"、"克隆人声"、"vocal clone"、"cover song"、"pixverse"、"口型"、"lipsync"、"对口型"、"解析链接"、"提取内容"。

name: ttscn
description: Multi-platform Chinese & multilingual TTS text-to-speech via Edge/Doubao/CosyVoice/Qwen3/StepFun/GLM-TTS/Azure/Tencent/Baidu/MiniMax/Xunfei plus ElevenLabs/OpenAI/Google/Atlas Cloud — 15 backends, word-level timestamps, [PAUSE:x] pause markers, pinyin pronunciation overrides
description_zh: 多平台中文及多语言TTS文本转语音，通过Edge/Doubao/CosyVoice/Qwen3/StepFun/GLM-TTS/Azure/Tencent/Baidu/MiniMax/Xunfei plus ElevenLabs/OpenAI/Google/Atlas Cloud — 15后端，词级时间戳，[PAUSE:x]暂停标记，拼音发音覆盖

name: job-post-builder
description: Builds end-to-end hiring packets — job post, structured interview guide with scoring rubric, and offer letter template — from a hiring brief. Triggers on: "help me hire", "we're hiring for", "write a job post", "job description", "JD", "open role", "create a job ad", "interview questions", "scoring rubric", "draft an offer letter", "send an offer", "make a hiring packet", or any request to recruit for a position. When in doubt, trigger — covers the full hiring workflow from job post through DocuSign envelope creation via browser. Does NOT screen or rank applicants.
description_zh: 从招聘简报中构建端到端的招聘包——包括职位发布、结构化面试指南（含评分标准）和录用通知书模板。触发条件包括："帮我招聘"、"我们正在招聘"、"撰写职位发布"、"职位描述"、"JD"、"空缺职位"、"创建招聘广告"、"面试问题"、"评分标准"、"草拟录用通知书"、"发送录用通知"、"制作招聘包"，或任何关于招聘职位的请求。如有疑问，请触发——涵盖从职位发布到通过浏览器创建DocuSign信封的完整招聘流程。不筛选或排名申请人。

name: web-to-app-funnel
description: When the user wants to design or optimize the funnel that takes web visitors into installing and onboarding the app — including smart app banners, web-to-app deep links, deferred deep links, web onboarding (Stripe-paid web flow before app install), QR codes, "open in app" CTAs, and the trade-off between paying on web vs in-app. Use when the user mentions "web to app", "smart app banner", "Stripe before app", "web paywall before install", "Branch web SDK", "web funnel for app", "AppsFlyer OneLink web", "Universal Links", "App Links", "QR code to app", "open in app", "deferred deep link from web", or "should I sell on web first then push to app". For pure in-app onboarding, see onboarding-optimization. For deep link infra, see attribution-setup.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计或优化将网页访客引导至应用安装和引导的漏斗时——包括智能应用横幅、网页到应用的深度链接、延迟深度链接、网页引导（应用安装前的Stripe付费网页流程）、二维码、“在应用中打开”的CTA，以及网页支付与应用内支付之间的权衡。在用户提及“网页到应用”、“智能应用横幅”、“应用安装前的Stripe”、“安装前的网页支付墙”、“Branch网页SDK”、“应用网页漏斗”、“AppsFlyer OneLink网页”、“通用链接”、“应用链接”、“二维码到应用”、“在应用中打开”、“网页延迟深度链接”，或“我是否应该先在网页上销售然后推送到应用”时使用。对于纯应用内引导，请参阅onboarding-optimization。对于深度链接基础设施，请参阅attribution-setup。

name: doodle
description: Hand-drawn, sketch-like style with doodles, handwritten fonts, and imperfect lines for a playful, informal feel.
description_zh: 手绘风格，类似草图，带有涂鸦、手写字体和不完美的线条，营造出一种俏皮、非正式的感觉。

name: related-work-writing
description: Write Related Work sections that compare and contrast prior work with your approach. Organize by theme, cite broadly, and explain how your work differs. Use when writing or improving the Related Work section of a paper.
description_zh: 撰写“相关工作”部分，将先前研究与你的方法进行比较和对比。按主题组织，广泛引用，并解释你的研究与先前研究有何不同。在撰写或改进论文的“相关工作”部分时使用。

name: paper
description: Paper-textured, print-inspired design with minimal colors, clean serif/sans typography, and tactile surface qualities.
description_zh: 纸质纹理、印刷灵感设计，色彩简约，字体干净利落，具有触感表面质感。

name: parallel-agents
description: Use when agents work concurrently in a codebase, shared files have recurring merge conflicts, or AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md needs maintenance.
description_zh: 当代理在代码库中并发工作时，共享文件频繁出现合并冲突，或需要维护 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 文件时使用。

name: using-n8n-skills-official
description: Use when working with n8n workflows in any capacity. The always-on protocol for the n8n-skills plugin, loaded by the SessionStart hook every session. Routes to the right skill, summarizes every n8n MCP tool (closing the deferred-description gap), and lists the cross-cutting rules.
description_zh: 在处理任何与n8n工作流相关的工作时使用。n8n-skills插件的常在线协议，由SessionStart钩子在每个会话中加载。路由到正确的技能，总结每个n8n MCP工具（关闭延迟描述的差距），并列出跨切面的规则。

name: learn-agent-skills
description: Focused interactive tutor for the Agent Skills Engineering path in AI Engineering from Scratch. Start or resume this route when a learner wants to create, discover, invoke, secure, evaluate, package, or port Agent Skills. Teaches one lesson per invocation and records evidence in AGENT-SKILLS-LEARNING.md.
description_zh: AI工程从零开始的智能体技能工程路径的专注互动式导师。当学习者想要创建、发现、调用、保护、评估、打包或移植智能体技能时，可以开始或继续这条路线。每次调用会教授一个课程，并将证据记录在AGENT-SKILLS-LEARNING.md中。

name: tanstack-db
description: Reactive client-first store for your API with collections, live queries, and optimistic mutations.
description_zh: 为您的API提供响应式、客户端优先的存储，支持集合、实时查询和乐观突变。

name: core-dynamic-skills
description: Internal command support for dynamic Rust crate skill management. Use only when explicitly invoked by /sync-crate-skills, /clean-crate-skills, or /update-crate-skill.
description_zh: 动态 Rust crate 技能管理的内部命令支持。仅在 /sync-crate-skills、/clean-crate-skills 或 /update-crate-skill 明确调用时使用。

name: creative
description: Playful, character-driven design with expressive typography and bold graphics for landing pages and creative projects.
description_zh: 具有趣味性、角色驱动的设计，结合富有表现力的字体和大胆的图形，适用于着陆页和创意项目。

name: adk-dev-console
description: Explains the ADK Dev Console — what each tab shows, how to read Agent Steps, traces, multi-agent dashboard, agent switching, console modes, and other UI features visible at localhost:3001 during adk dev
description_zh: 解释了ADK开发控制台——每个选项卡显示的内容、如何阅读代理步骤、跟踪记录、多代理仪表板、代理切换、控制台模式以及其他在adk dev期间在localhost:3001可见的UI功能。

name: editor
description: Understand, generate, and edit footage with Diffusion Studio: analyze video/audio/images, generate them with AI, and compose video compositions. Use for any media analysis, media generation, or video editing task.
description_zh: 理解、生成和编辑视频片段：使用Diffusion Studio分析视频/音频/图像，利用AI生成它们，并组合视频创作。适用于任何媒体分析、媒体生成或视频编辑任务。

name: communication-history
description: Retrieve activity history (calls, emails, notes, meetings, tasks) for a CRM record and assemble pre-call briefs.
description_zh: 检索CRM记录的活动历史（电话、邮件、笔记、会议、任务），并汇编通话前简报。

name: research-paper-writing
description: Improve academic paper writing quality for ML/CV/NLP-style papers with clear section structure, paragraph flow, and reviewer-facing presentation. Use when drafting or revising Abstract, Introduction, Related Work, Method, Experiments, or Conclusion; polishing figures/tables; checking claim-support alignment; or performing self-review before submission.
description_zh: 提升机器学习/计算机视觉/自然语言处理风格学术论文的写作质量，包括清晰的章节结构、段落逻辑和面向审稿人的呈现方式。适用于撰写或修改摘要、引言、相关工作、方法、实验或结论；润色图表；检查论点与论据的对应关系；或在提交前进行自我审查。

name: tilegym-cutile-autotuning
description: Use when adding, modifying, optimizing, or debugging CuTile autotuning code. Trigger signals: `exhaustive_search` / `replace_hints` / `hints_fn` / `cuda.tile.tune` in code, `autotune` in filenames, or correctness/performance issues in autotuned CuTile kernels. Covers: tune-once/cache/launch pattern, per-architecture configs (sm80–sm120), parameter space design (tile sizes, occupancy, num_ctas), and 7 common pitfalls with solutions.
description_zh: 在添加、修改、优化或调试 CuTile 自动调优代码时使用。触发信号：代码中的 `exhaustive_search` / `replace_hints` / `hints_fn` / `cuda.tile.tune`，文件名中的 `autotune`，或自动调优 CuTile 内核的正确性问题/性能问题。涵盖内容：一次性调优/缓存/启动模式、针对不同架构的配置（sm80–sm120）、参数空间设计（瓦片大小、占用率、CTA 数量），以及 7 个常见陷阱及解决方案。

name: om-verify-in-repo
description: Read-only triage gate for an autofix chain. Decides whether a tracker issue is a real, still-unfixed defect on the current branch. Stops the chain cleanly with NO_ACTION_NEEDED when the issue is already fixed, already in progress by someone else, already covered by an open PR, or not actually a bug.
description_zh: 只读的自动修复链的筛选门。用于判断跟踪问题是否为当前分支上真实且尚未修复的缺陷。当问题已修复、正在由他人处理、已被开放的PR覆盖，或并非实际错误时，该门会以NO_ACTION_NEEDED干净地终止链。

name: learn-mcp
description: Focused interactive tutor for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) path in AI Engineering from Scratch. Start or resume this route when a learner wants to build, secure, debug, verify, or operate MCP clients, servers, transports, gateways, registries, or conformance gates. Teaches one lesson per invocation and records wire evidence in MCP-LEARNING.md.
description_zh: 专注于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 路径的 AI 工程从零开始的交互式导师。当学习者想要构建、安全、调试、验证或操作 MCP 客户端、服务器、传输、网关、注册表或一致性门时，可以开始或继续此路线。每次调用教授一个课程，并将网络证据记录在 MCP-LEARNING.md 中。

name: colorful
description: Vibrant, high-contrast palettes and gradients for engaging, memorable, and modern user experiences.
description_zh: 鲜艳、高对比度的调色板和渐变，为用户带来引人入胜、令人难忘且现代的体验。

name: sales-execution
description: Log sales activities — calls, notes, meetings, tasks — against contacts and deals, with the mandatory create-then-associate step that makes them visible in the CRM.
description_zh: 记录销售活动（如电话、笔记、会议、任务）与联系人及交易相关联，并通过强制性的“先创建后关联”步骤使其在CRM系统中可见。

name: generate-import-html
description: Use this when the page-import pipeline needs to produce structured HTML from authoring analysis for AEM Edge Delivery Services. Covers building section structure, applying block tables, handling metadata, and managing the images folder. Do not invoke directly — called by page-import as a pipeline step.
description_zh: 当页面导入管道需要为AEM Edge交付服务从创作分析生成结构化HTML时使用。涵盖构建部分结构、应用区块表格、处理元数据和管理图片文件夹。不要直接调用——作为管道步骤由页面导入调用。

name: gradient
description: Smooth color transitions and gradient-rich surfaces for modern, playful interfaces with visual depth.
description_zh: 平滑的色彩过渡和富含渐变效果的表面，为现代、活泼的界面增添视觉深度。

name: n8n-subworkflows
description: Build reusable, composable n8n sub-workflows. Use when extracting shared logic, building anything multi-step or reused across workflows, or any workflow over ~10 nodes — and whenever the user mentions sub-workflows, Execute Workflow, reuse, shared/common logic, modular workflows, "Define Below" inputs, waitForSubWorkflow, mode each vs all, or exposing a workflow as an agent tool. Covers typed sub-workflow inputs, all-vs-each execution, verb-first naming for discovery, stateless vs stateful design, and splitting by input shape.
description_zh: 构建可重用、可组合的n8n子工作流。适用于提取共享逻辑、构建多步骤或跨工作流重用的工作流，或任何包含超过10个节点的子工作流——以及当用户提及子工作流、执行工作流、重用、共享/通用逻辑、模块化工作流、"在下方定义"输入、waitForSubWorkflow、模式每个与全部、或以代理工具形式暴露工作流时。涵盖类型化的子工作流输入、全执行与每个执行、动词优先命名以实现发现、无状态与有状态设计，以及按输入形状拆分。

name: finance-sentiment
description: Fetch normalized stock sentiment across Reddit, X.com, financial news, and Polymarket from the Adanos Finance API: buzz score, bullish percentage, mention or trade counts, and trend. Use this skill whenever the user asks how much a stock is being discussed or how hot it is on social platforms, how many Reddit mentions or Polymarket bets a company has, whether Reddit, X, and news agree, or wants to compare stock buzz and sentiment across tickers. Read-only: it never places trades or modifies anything.
description_zh: 从Adanos Finance API获取Reddit、X.com、财经新闻和Polymarket的标准化股票情绪：包括热度指数、看涨百分比、提及或交易次数以及趋势。当用户询问某股票在社交平台上的讨论热度、公司有多少Reddit提及或Polymarket投注、Reddit、X和新闻是否一致，或想要比较不同股票代码的热度与情绪时，使用此技能。仅读权限：它从不进行交易或修改任何内容。

name: testing-blocks
description: Use this when you have made AEM Edge Delivery Services code changes to blocks, scripts, or styles and need to validate them before opening a pull request. Covers unit testing for utilities and logic, browser testing with Playwright, linting, and guidance on what to test and how.
description_zh: 当您对 AEM Edge Delivery Services 的代码（块、脚本或样式）进行了更改，并在打开拉取请求之前需要验证它们时，请使用此功能。它涵盖了实用工具和逻辑的单元测试、使用 Playwright 进行的浏览器测试、代码风格检查，以及关于要测试的内容和方法的指导。

name: cosmic
description: Futuristic sci-fi aesthetic with dark themes, vibrant neon accents, and immersive spatial elements.
description_zh: 未来科幻美学，以暗黑主题为主，搭配鲜艳的霓虹点缀，并融入沉浸式的空间元素。

name: ui-designer
description: Extract design systems from reference UI images and generate implementation-ready UI design prompts. Use when users provide UI screenshots/mockups and want to create consistent designs, generate design systems, or build MVP UIs matching reference aesthetics.
description_zh: 从参考UI图像中提取设计系统，并生成可用于实现的UI设计提示。当用户提供UI截图/模型，并希望创建一致的设计、生成设计系统或构建符合参考美学的MVP UI时使用。

name: landing-page
description: Use when designing or rewriting a high-converting landing page (single-offer page) for SaaS/apps/services. Covers structure, layout patterns, conversion strategies, copywriting, SEO/AEO, and common pitfalls.
description_zh: 在为 SaaS/应用程序/服务设计或重写高转化率落地页（单产品页）时使用。涵盖结构、布局模式、转化策略、文案写作、SEO/AEO 以及常见陷阱。

name: agent-integration
description: Integrate a raw customer agent repo with Veris end to end. Installs or verifies veris-cli, logs in, creates or reuses a Veris environment, analyzes the repo, generates or updates `.veris/veris.yaml`, `.veris/Dockerfile.sandbox`, `.veris/.dockerignore`, configures runtime env vars, and can finish with `veris env push`. Use when a repo has no Veris setup yet, or when an existing `.veris/` integration is stale and needs to be refreshed.
description_zh: 与 Veris 端到端集成原始客户代理仓库。安装或验证 veris-cli，登录，创建或复用 Veris 环境，分析仓库，生成或更新 `.veris/veris.yaml`、`.veris/Dockerfile.sandbox`、`.veris/.dockerignore`，配置运行时环境变量，并可通过 `veris env push` 完成操作。当仓库尚未设置 Veris，或现有的 `.veris/` 集成已过时需要刷新时使用。

name: devops-deployment
description: Use when setting up CI/CD pipelines, containerizing applications, deploying to Kubernetes, or writing infrastructure as code. DevOps & Deployment covers GitHub Actions, Docker, Helm, and Terraform patterns.
description_zh: 在设置 CI/CD 管道、容器化应用程序、部署到 Kubernetes 或编写基础设施即代码时使用。DevOps & Deployment 涵盖 GitHub Actions、Docker、Helm 和 Terraform 模式。

name: month-end-prep
description: Reconciles the accounting ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books) against PayPal, Shopify, Square, and Stripe settlements, flags transactions that need attention, suspicious duplicates, and missing receipts, then writes a plain-English P&L narrative and exports a close packet (xlsx + one-page PDF). This is the first link of the /close-month command; a request to close the month or the books routes there, and the command runs this skill before refreshing the forecast and distributing the packet. Use this skill directly only when the owner wants the reconciliation alone, with no forecast refresh and no distribution: "just reconcile, no packet," "what's missing from the books," "flag the duplicates and missing receipts," or "write the P&L narrative for this month."
description_zh: 与会计总账（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero 或 Zoho Books）进行核对，对照 PayPal、Shopify、Square 和 Stripe 的结算记录，标记需要关注的事项、可疑重复交易以及缺失的收据，然后生成简体中文的损益表叙述，并导出关闭包（xlsx + 一页 PDF）。这是 /close-month 命令的第一步；请求关闭月份或账簿时会跳转至此，命令在刷新预测并分发包之前会先运行此技能。仅在所有者仅需要核对功能时直接使用此技能，无需刷新预测和分发包：例如“仅核对，不生成包”、“账簿缺失内容是什么”、“标记重复交易和缺失收据”或“为本月撰写损益表叙述”。

name: cypress-tap
description: Drives a running Cypress open-mode session through `cypress tap` to run and rerun specs, wait for fresh results, inspect reporter and command logs, and query or rewind the app under test through DOM, accessibility, styles, and snapshots. Use when authoring or debugging Cypress e2e or component specs, discovering selectors, diagnosing failures, or verifying test behavior without GUI interaction. Not for one-shot headless runs. Requires Cypress 15.21+, a Chromium-family browser, and a running `cypress open` session.
description_zh: 通过 `cypress tap` 驱动 Cypress 的运行中 Cypress 开放模式会话，用于运行和重复执行测试用例，等待最新结果，检查报告器和命令日志，并通过 DOM、可访问性、样式和快照查询或回放测试应用。适用于编写或调试 Cypress 端到端或组件测试用例、发现选择器、诊断失败或验证测试行为，无需 GUI 交互。不适用于一次性无头运行。需要 Cypress 15.21+、Chromium 家族浏览器以及正在运行的 `cypress open` 会话。

name: aws-serverless
description: Specialized skill for building production-ready serverless applications on AWS. Covers Lambda functions, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS event-driven patterns, SAM/CDK deployment, and cold start optimization.
description_zh: 针对在 AWS 上构建生产级无服务器应用程序的专业技能。涵盖 Lambda 函数、API Gateway、DynamoDB、SQS/SNS 事件驱动模式、SAM/CDK 部署以及冷启动优化。

name: artistic
description: High-contrast, expressive style with creative typography and bold color choices for visually striking interfaces.
description_zh: 高对比度、富有表现力的风格，结合创意字体设计和大胆的色彩选择，打造视觉冲击力强的界面。

name: bold
description: Strong visual presence with heavyweight typography, high-contrast colors, and commanding layouts.
description_zh: 具有强烈的视觉冲击力，采用粗重的字体、高对比度的色彩和具有权威感的布局。

name: spacious
description: Generous whitespace, consistent padding, and grid-based layouts for clean, readable, and breathing interfaces.
description_zh: 使用充足的空白、一致的填充以及基于网格的布局，打造干净、易读且富有呼吸感的界面。

name: tesseract-video
description: Edit existing footage into finished videos locally with Tesseract. Make cuts, preserve dialogue, add purposeful sound design, mix audio, and decide where native motion-graphics scenes or overlays improve the story. Use for video editing and revising Tesseract projects, not avatar or video generation.
description_zh: 使用Tesseract在本地编辑现有素材，制作成最终视频。进行剪辑、保留对话、添加有目的的音效设计、混音，并决定在何处使用本地动态图形场景或覆盖层能提升故事性。用于视频编辑和修订Tesseract项目，不用于头像或视频生成。

name: block-collection-and-party
description: Use this when you are starting AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix) development and want an existing reference to build from, such as a block, build tool, code snippet, integration pattern, or plugin. Searches the Block Collection and Block Party repositories, matches candidates against the need, and returns a suitable starting point to clone or adapt.
description_zh: 在开始 AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix) 开发时使用此功能，您需要一个现有的参考作为构建基础，例如模块、构建工具、代码片段、集成模式或插件。该功能会搜索 Block Collection 和 Block Party 仓库，将候选项与需求进行匹配，并返回一个合适的起点供您克隆或适配。

name: find-test-content
description: Use this when you need to find existing pages that already use a specific block in an AEM Edge Delivery Services project, for example to locate test content or examples during block development. Covers reporting page URLs with occurrence counts and block variants. This searches existing content; to import a new page from a URL use page-import.
description_zh: 当您需要在 AEM Edge Delivery Services 项目中查找已使用特定块的现有页面时使用此功能，例如在块开发过程中定位测试内容或示例。它涵盖报告页面 URL 及其出现次数和块变体。此功能搜索现有内容；要从 URL 导入新页面，请使用 page-import。

name: identify-page-structure
description: Use this when the page-import pipeline needs to identify section boundaries and content sequences within a scraped webpage for AEM Edge Delivery Services import. Outputs an ordered list of sections, the content sequence within each section, and candidate block-type annotations via two-level analysis (sections, then sequences per section). Do not invoke directly — called by page-import as a pipeline step.
description_zh: 当页面导入管道需要识别抓取网页中的章节边界和内容序列以供AEM Edge Delivery Services导入时使用。通过双层分析（先分析章节，再分析每个章节的内容序列）输出章节的有序列表、每个章节内的内容序列以及候选块类型注释。不要直接调用——作为管道步骤由页面导入调用。

name: flat
description: Two-dimensional minimalist style with vibrant colors, clean typography, and no 3D effects for fast, user-friendly interfaces.
description_zh: 二维极简风格，色彩鲜明，排版简洁，无3D效果，打造快速、用户友好的界面。

name: thread-writer-sms
description: When the user wants to write a multi-part thread or content series for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram (Reel/carousel/Story series), TikTok (multi-part videos), YouTube (video series, multi-Short series), or Facebook. Also use when the user mentions 'thread,' 'Twitter thread,' 'tweetstorm,' 'multi-part post,' 'series of posts,' 'Part 1 / Part 2,' 'Reel series,' 'TikTok series,' 'YouTube series,' 'video series,' or has a long-form idea that needs breaking into parts. For single posts, see post-writer-sms. For carousels, see carousel-writer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要为Twitter/X、LinkedIn、Threads、Instagram（Reel/轮播/故事系列）、TikTok（多段视频）、YouTube（视频系列、多Short系列）或Facebook撰写多部分线程或内容系列时，也使用。此外，当用户提到“thread”、“Twitter thread”、“tweetstorm”、“多部分帖子”、“帖子系列”、“第1部分 / 第2部分”、“Reel系列”、“TikTok系列”、“YouTube系列”、“视频系列”，或有一个需要拆分成多个部分的长篇想法时。对于单篇帖子，请参考post-writer-sms。对于轮播，请参考carousel-writer-sms。

name: design-taste-frontend-v1
description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.
description_zh: 原始的v1风味技能，为依赖其精确行为的项目保留。当前默认的是`design-taste-frontend`（v2实验性版本），这是一个大幅重写。仅在需要精确向后兼容时使用此v1安装名称。

name: imagegen-frontend-web
description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.
description_zh: 高端前端图像方向技能，用于生成优质、注重转化的网站设计参考。**关键输出规则** — 每个部分生成一张独立的水平图像。一个包含8个部分的着陆页会产生8张图像。切勿将多个部分压缩到一张图像中。强调构图多样性（不总是左文右图）、背景图像的自由度、多样的行动号召（CTA）、多样的英雄版式（巨型/中置/极简迷你）、叙事概念脉络、二次阅读时刻，以及所有图像中单一一致的调色板。针对开发者或编码模型能够精确复制的着陆页、营销网站和产品对比图进行优化。

name: chrome-cdp-live-browser
description: Give AI agents access to your live Chrome session via CDP — interact with open tabs, logged-in accounts, and current page state
description_zh: 通过 CDP 赋予 AI 代理访问您的实时 Chrome 会话权限——与打开的标签页、已登录的账户以及当前页面状态进行交互

name: lightpanda-browser
description: Expert skill for Lightpanda — the headless browser built in Zig for AI agents and automation. 9x less memory, 11x faster than Chrome. Installation, CLI, CDP server, Playwright/Puppeteer integration, and web scraping.
description_zh: Lightpanda的专业技能——专为AI代理和自动化构建的Zig语言开发的头less浏览器。内存占用减少9倍，速度比Chrome快11倍。支持安装、CLI、CDP服务器、Playwright/Puppeteer集成以及网络爬取。

name: alphaear-news
description: Fetch hot finance news, unified trends, and prediction financial market data. Use when the user needs real-time financial news, trend reports from multiple finance sources (Weibo, Zhihu, WallstreetCN, etc.), or Polymarket finance market prediction data.
description_zh: 获取热门财经新闻、统一趋势和预测金融市场数据。当用户需要实时财经新闻、来自多个财经来源（微博、知乎、华尔街见闻等）的趋势报告，或Polymarket财经市场预测数据时使用。

name: bazi-mingli
description: 八字命理 (Bazi / Four Pillars of Destiny) divination skill. Use when users request birth chart analysis, fortune telling based on birth date/time, or Chinese astrology. Triggers on: 八字, 四柱, 命盤, 排盤, 算命, 命理, 生辰八字, 天干地支, 五行, 流年, 大運, bazi, four pillars, Chinese astrology, birth chart.

name: core-fix-skill-docs
description: Internal maintenance support for checking and fixing generated Rust skill documentation references. Use only when explicitly invoked by /fix-skill-docs.
description_zh: 内部维护支持，用于检查和修复生成的 Rust 技能文档引用。仅在 /fix-skill-docs 明确调用时使用。

name: tax-season-organizer
description:
Prepares tax-season materials for the owner's accountant, not tax advice. US federal tax; a non-US business gets its closed-books packet instead. Two modes: (1) quarterly estimated tax from YTD net income in the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books); (2) year-end 1099 prep, scanning the ledger, PayPal, and Stripe for contractors paid over USD 600 into a 1099-NEC list with missing W-9 flags.
Any tax request routes first to /tax-prep, which confirms the books are closed and reconciled before running this skill. Use this skill directly only when the owner says the period's books are already closed: "books are closed, now do the 1099s," "run the quarterly estimate off the closed numbers," or "just the contractor W-9 list."
description_zh:
为业主的会计师准备税务季节材料，非税务建议。美国联邦税；非美国企业则获取其封账资料包。两种模式：(1) 从总账中的年度净收入计算季度预估税（支持MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero或Zoho Books）；(2) 年终1099准备，扫描总账、PayPal和Stripe，将支付超过600美元的承包商信息整理到1099-NEC列表中，并标记缺失W-9信息。

任何税务请求首先路由至/tax-prep，该流程会确认账目已封账并核对无误后，再运行此技能。仅在业主确认该期账目已封账时，方可直接使用此技能："账目已封，现在处理1099"、"基于封账数据运行季度预估"或"仅生成承包商W-9列表"。

name: agentic
description: Conversational AI-first interface with minimal controls, clear outcomes, and delegated task flows for agentic workflows.
description_zh: 以对话式AI优先的界面，具有最少的控制选项、清晰的结果以及委托的任务流程，适用于自主式工作流。

name: clone-website
description: Reverse-engineer and clone one or more websites in one shot — extracts assets, CSS, and content section-by-section and proactively dispatches parallel builder agents in worktrees as it goes. Use this whenever the user wants to clone, replicate, rebuild, reverse-engineer, or copy any website. Also triggers on phrases like "make a copy of this site", "rebuild this page", or "pixel-perfect clone". The request must include one or more target URLs.
description_zh: 一次性逆向工程并克隆一个或多个网站——逐段提取资源、CSS和内容，并在过程中主动在工作树中派遣并行构建代理。用户在任何时候想要克隆、复制、重建、逆向工程或复制任何网站时都可以使用此功能。同时，在类似“复制此网站”、“重建此页面”或“像素级克隆”的短语触发下也会执行。请求必须包含一个或多个目标URL。

name: form-design
description: Design a form end to end — field order, grouping, validation, and completion. Use when the artifact is a form. For product-wide error strategy use `error-handling-ux`; for first-run signup use `onboarding-design`.
description_zh: 设计端到端的表单——包括字段顺序、分组、验证和完成。当工件是表单时使用。对于全产品的错误策略使用 `error-handling-ux`；对于首次注册使用 `onboarding-design`。

name: core-actionbook
description: Internal support skill for actionbook MCP selectors used by Rust documentation research workflows. Use only when another rust-skills workflow explicitly requests actionbook-backed selectors.
description_zh: 用于 Rust 文档研究工作流的 actionbook MCP 选择器的内部支持技能。仅在另一个 rust-skills 工作流明确请求 actionbook 支持的选择器时使用。

name: page-import
description: Use this when importing or migrating a single webpage from any URL into canonical EDS block format — structured HTML that authors edit in DA — including when the request uses terms like migrate, migration, or migrating. Covers scraping the page, analyzing structure, mapping to existing blocks, and generating HTML for immediate local preview. Use the snowflake skill instead when the user wants to preserve the original DOM byte-for-byte (static-to-EDS overlay); for building new blocks from scratch use content-driven-development.
description_zh: 在从任何 URL 导入或迁移单个网页到规范 EDS 块格式时使用——即作者在 DA 中编辑的结构化 HTML——包括当请求使用迁移、迁移或迁移等术语时。涵盖抓取页面、分析结构、映射到现有块以及生成 HTML 以进行本地预览。当用户希望保留原始 DOM 字节对字节（静态到 EDS 叠加）时，请使用雪花技能；从零开始构建新块请使用内容驱动开发。

name: product-sense-interview-answer
description: Structure a spoken PM product-sense answer with assumptions, segmentation, pain-point prioritization, and MVP tradeoffs. Use when practicing design, improve, or build-next interview questions.
description_zh: 构建一个口头形式的 PM 产品认知回答，包含假设、分段、痛点优先级排序以及 MVP 的权衡。在练习设计、改进或构建下一阶段面试问题时使用。

name: table-generation
description: Generate publication-quality LaTeX tables from experimental results. Convert JSON/CSV data to booktabs-styled tables with bold best results, multi-row layouts, and proper captions. Use when creating result tables, comparison tables, or ablation tables for papers.
description_zh: 从实验结果生成符合出版标准的 LaTeX 表格。将 JSON/CSV 数据转换为 booktabs 风格的表格，突出显示最佳结果、采用多行布局并添加合适的标题。适用于为论文创建结果表格、对比表格或消融表格。

name: tesseract-motion
description: Create editable motion graphics locally in Tesseract, including full-frame animated scenes, typography, diagrams, lower thirds, and overlays on supplied footage. Use for focused motion-design work; use tesseract-video for assembling or revising a complete footage edit.
description_zh: 在 Tesseract 中本地创建可编辑的运动图形，包括全帧动画场景、字体设计、图表、底部字幕和覆盖在提供的素材上的叠加层。用于专注的运动设计工作；使用 tesseract-video 来组装或修订完整的素材剪辑。

name: dramatic
description: High-contrast, theatrical design with bold layouts, immersive visuals, and unconventional compositions that command attention.
description_zh: 高对比度、戏剧化的设计，采用大胆的布局、沉浸式视觉效果和非常规的构图，引人注目。

name: friendly
description: Approachable, intuitive design with rounded elements, ample whitespace, and soft pastel color palettes.
description_zh: 简洁、直观的设计，采用圆润的元素、充足的留白和柔和的粉彩色调。

name: dt-alerting
description: End-to-end Dynatrace alerting lifecycle — anomaly detector setup and model selection (static threshold, adaptive baseline, seasonal baseline), alert event storage in Grail, problem grouping and denoising by root cause analysis, and workflow-based notification routing (email, Slack, ServiceNow, webhook). Use when configuring alerting, choosing between detector types, querying alert event history, understanding why alerts merged into a problem, or setting up problem-triggered notifications.
description_zh: 端到端 Dynatrace 告警生命周期——异常检测器设置和模型选择（静态阈值、自适应基线、季节性基线）、告警事件在 Grail 中的存储、通过根本原因分析进行问题分组和去噪，以及基于工作流的告警通知路由（电子邮件、Slack、ServiceNow、webhook）。在配置告警、选择检测器类型、查询告警事件历史、了解告警为何合并为问题，或设置问题触发的通知时使用。

name: ant
description: Structured, enterprise-focused design system emphasizing clarity, consistency, and efficiency for data-dense web applications.
description_zh: 面向企业、结构化的设计系统，强调清晰性、一致性和效率，适用于数据密集型网络应用程序。

name: news-search
description: USE FOR news search. Returns news articles with title, URL, description, age, thumbnail, profile. Supports freshness and date range filtering, SafeSearch filter and Goggles for custom ranking.
description_zh: 用于新闻搜索。返回包含标题、URL、描述、年龄、缩略图和简介的新闻文章。支持新鲜度与日期范围筛选、安全搜索过滤以及Goggles进行自定义排序。

name: threejs
description: Use when building or debugging interactive 3D scenes on the web with Three.js (scene/camera/renderer, lights/materials, GLTF loading, controls, performance). Helpful for designers shipping 3D UI moments.
description_zh: 在构建或调试基于Three.js的Web交互式3D场景时使用（场景/相机/渲染器、灯光/材质、GLTF加载、控件、性能）。对发布3D UI界面的设计师很有帮助。

name: tilegym-converting-cutile-to-triton
description: Converts cuTile GPU kernels (@ct.kernel) to Triton (@triton.jit). Handles standard in-repo conversion, debugging (cudaErrorIllegalAddress, shape mismatch, numerical mismatch), and mapping cuTile idioms (ct.load/ct.store, ct.Constant, ct.launch) to Triton equivalents. Covers dual-kernel layout flags (e.g. transpose=True/False + autotune grid via META) per translations/advanced-patterns.md. Use when converting, porting, or translating cuTile kernels to Triton, or debugging existing Triton translations.
description_zh: 将 cuTile GPU 内核（@ct.kernel）转换为 Triton（@triton.jit）。处理标准库内转换、调试（cudaErrorIllegalAddress、形状不匹配、数值不匹配），并将 cuTile 语法（ct.load/ct.store、ct.Constant、ct.launch）映射到 Triton 的等效功能。涵盖双内核布局标志（例如 transpose=True/False + 通过 META 自动调整网格），具体参考 translations/advanced-patterns.md。在将 cuTile 内核转换为 Triton、移植或翻译时，或调试现有 Triton 转换时使用。

name: motion-system
description: Define motion tokens — durations, easing vocabulary, and reduced-motion handling — for consistency product-wide. Use when standardising motion across a system. For crafting one specific animation, use `animation-principles` (interaction-design).
description_zh: 定义运动标记——持续时间、缓动词汇和减少运动处理——以实现产品范围内的统一性。在系统内标准化运动时使用。若要创建特定的动画，请使用 `animation-principles`（交互设计）。

name: authoring-analysis
description: Use this when the page-import pipeline needs to determine the authoring approach (default content vs blocks) for scraped content before generating import HTML for AEM Edge Delivery Services. Covers validating block selection and section styling for import/migration. Do not invoke directly — called by page-import as a pipeline step.
description_zh: 在页面导入流程需要确定抓取内容的创作方式（默认内容与块）以生成 AEM Edge Delivery Services 的导入 HTML 之前，请使用此功能。涵盖验证导入/迁移的块选择和区域样式。不要直接调用——作为页面导入流程中的一个步骤被调用。

name: improve-skill-quality
description: Diagnoses and fixes skills in the dotnet/skills repository that lose to their own baseline, fail to activate, time out, or return "no credible improvement". Use when an evaluation verdict is a regression or underpowered, when a skill regressed after a change, when /evaluate reports no results, or when deciding whether a weak skill should be strengthened or retired. Do not use for scaffolding a brand-new skill (use create-skill) or a brand-new eval (use create-skill-test).
description_zh: 诊断并修复 dotnet/skills 仓库中因自身基线而表现不佳、无法激活、超时或返回“无可信改进”的技能。在以下情况使用：评估结果为退化或能力不足时，技能在变更后退化时，/evaluate 报告无结果时，或决定是否应加强或淘汰薄弱技能时。不应用于为全新的技能搭建框架（使用 create-skill）或全新的评估（使用 create-skill-test）。

name: google-cloud-storage-bucket-architect
description: Creates Cloud Storage (Google Cloud Storage, or GCS) buckets. Analyzes the workload (sensitive data, media hosting, ingestion, web hosting, archiving, backup, logging, analytics, AI/ML, or general-purpose), validates project-level security settings, and designs a secure-by-default, cost-effective configuration (location, storage class, uniform bucket-level access, public access prevention, soft delete, lifecycle) before creating it. Use whenever a user wants to create, make, set up, provision, or spin up a bucket, or needs object storage for an app, service, pipeline, or dataset — even a "simple" or "default" bucket, or when bucket creation is one step in a larger workflow. Outputs or executes the creation via gcloud, the JSON/REST API, Terraform, or SDK client libraries (C++, Java, Python, Go). Don't use for anything other than creating new buckets — for uploads, downloads, access changes, or reconfiguring existing buckets, use google-cloud-storage-basics.
description_zh: 创建 Cloud Storage（Google Cloud Storage，简称 GCS）存储桶。分析工作负载类型（如敏感数据、媒体托管、数据摄取、网站托管、归档、备份、日志记录、分析、人工智能/机器学习或通用用途），验证项目级安全设置，并设计一个默认安全且经济高效的配置（位置、存储类别、统一存储桶级访问权限、公共访问阻止、软删除、生命周期）后再创建存储桶。当用户需要创建、构建、设置、配置或启动存储桶，或需要为应用程序、服务、管道或数据集提供对象存储时使用——即使是“简单”或“默认”存储桶，或当存储桶创建是更大型工作流程的一部分时。通过 gcloud、JSON/REST API、Terraform 或 C++、Java、Python、Go 的 SDK 客户端库输出或执行创建操作。除创建新存储桶外，不要用于其他任何用途——对于上传、下载、访问更改或重新配置现有存储桶，请使用 google-cloud-storage-basics。

name: team-ownership
description: Assign and reassign CRM record ownership, audit who-owns-what across object types, and handle rep transitions. Built on `bulk-operations`.
description_zh: 分配和重新分配CRM记录的所有权，跨对象类型审计谁拥有什么，并处理代表过渡。基于`bulk-operations`构建。

name: google-ads
description: When the user wants to set up, optimize, or manage Google Ads campaigns. Also use when the user mentions "Google Ads," "Google Search Ads," "PPC," "SEM," "PMF testing with ads," "test product-market fit," "Responsive Search Ads," "RSA," "Performance Max," "Quality Score," "keyword bidding," or "Google Display/YouTube ads." For paid mix, use paid-ads-strategy.
description_zh: 当用户想要设置、优化或管理 Google Ads 活动。也适用于用户提到“Google Ads”、“Google 搜索广告”、“PPC”、“SEM”、“使用广告进行产品市场匹配测试”、“测试产品市场契合度”、“响应式搜索广告”、“RSA”、“表现最大化”、“质量得分”、“关键词竞价”或“Google 展示/YouTube 广告”。对于付费组合，使用 paid-ads-strategy。

name: cloudbase-document-database-in-wechat-miniprogram
description: Use CloudBase document database WeChat MiniProgram SDK to query, create, update, and delete data. Supports complex queries, pagination, aggregation, and geolocation queries.
description_zh: 使用 CloudBase 文档数据库微信小程序 SDK 进行数据查询、创建、更新和删除。支持复杂查询、分页、聚合和地理位置查询。

name: responsive-patterns
description: Responsive design with Container Queries, fluid typography, cqi/cqb units, subgrid, intrinsic layouts, foldable devices, and mobile-first patterns for React applications. Use when building responsive layouts or container queries.
description_zh: 使用容器查询、流体排版、cqi/cqb单位、子网格、内在布局、可折叠设备和移动优先模式，为React应用程序实现响应式设计。适用于构建响应式布局或容器查询。

name: csharp-concurrency-patterns
description: Choosing the right concurrency abstraction in .NET - from async/await for I/O to Channels for producer/consumer to Akka.NET for stateful entity management. Avoid locks and manual synchronization unless absolutely necessary.
description_zh: 在 .NET 中选择合适的并发抽象——从 async/await 用于 I/O，到 Channels 用于生产者/消费者，再到 Akka.NET 用于有状态实体管理。除非绝对必要，否则避免使用锁和手动同步。

name: page-decomposition
description: Use this when the page-import pipeline needs to analyze the content sequences within a single section and describe them neutrally for AEM Edge Delivery Services. Covers identifying breaking points between default content and blocks, one section at a time. Do not invoke directly — called by page-import per section.
description_zh: 当页面导入管道需要分析单个部分内的内容序列，并针对AEM Edge交付服务进行中立描述时，请使用此功能。它涵盖逐个部分识别默认内容与模块之间的断点。不要直接调用——由页面导入按部分调用。

name: agentmail-cli
description: Operate AgentMail from a shell with the official CLI. Use when the user wants commands for listing or creating inboxes, reading or searching mail, sending or replying, managing drafts, or scripting JSON/YAML output; do not use for SDK code, MCP setup, or framework adapters.
description_zh: 使用官方 CLI 从 Shell 操作 AgentMail。当用户需要用于列出或创建收件箱、阅读或搜索邮件、发送或回复、管理草稿或脚本 JSON/YAML 输出等命令时使用；不应用于 SDK 代码、MCP 设置或框架适配器。

name: referral-program
description: When the user wants to design, launch, or optimize an in-app referral / invite / share-to-earn program — including reward structure, mechanics, fraud prevention, deep link setup, and viral coefficient measurement. Use when the user mentions "referral program", "invite a friend", "refer and earn", "share to earn", "viral loop", "viral coefficient", "K-factor", "double-sided rewards", "give X get X", "referral rewards", "invite link", "share sheet", "Branch referrals", "in-app invites", or "how to make my app go viral". For deep link infrastructure that referrals depend on, see attribution-setup. For organic content-driven virality (UGC, creator), see creator-ugc-marketing.
description_zh: 当用户想要设计、启动或优化应用内的推荐/邀请/分享赚钱计划时——包括奖励机制、运作方式、欺诈防范、深度链接设置和病毒系数测量。在用户提及“推荐计划”、“邀请好友”、“推荐赚钱”、“分享赚钱”、“病毒循环”、“病毒系数”、“K因子”、“双向奖励”、“X换X”、“推荐奖励”、“邀请链接”、“分享菜单”、“Branch推荐”、“应用内邀请”或“如何让我的应用病毒化”时使用。对于推荐依赖的深度链接基础设施，请参阅attribution-setup。对于由有机内容驱动的病毒传播（UGC、创作者），请参阅creator-ugc-marketing。

name: diffity-tree
description: Open the diffity file tree browser to browse and comment on repository files
description_zh: 打开diffity文件树浏览器，浏览和评论存储库文件

name: optimization-advisor-sms
description: When the user wants concrete recommendations on how to improve their social media performance. Also use when the user mentions 'what should I do next,' 'how do I improve,' 'optimize my social media,' 'recommendations,' 'suggestions,' 'next steps,' 'what's my biggest opportunity,' or 'help me grow.' Synthesizes insights from performance, audience, and pattern analysis into prioritized actions. For raw analytics, see performance-analyzer-sms. For growth tracking, see audience-growth-tracker-sms. For pattern detection, see content-pattern-analyzer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户希望获得关于如何提升其社交媒体表现的明确建议时，也适用于用户提及“我接下来该做什么”、“如何改进”、“优化我的社交媒体”、“建议”、“建议”、“下一步”、“我最大的机会是什么”或“帮助我成长”时。该功能将基于表现、受众和模式分析的综合洞察，转化为优先行动。原始分析数据请参考 performance-analyzer-sms。增长追踪请参考 audience-growth-tracker-sms。模式检测请参考 content-pattern-analyzer-sms。

name: n8n-expressions-official
description: Use when writing or reviewing n8n expressions (`{{...}}` syntax), `$json` / `$node` references, Luxon date code, or expression errors. Triggers on `{{}}`, `$json`, `$node`, `$input`, `DateTime`, `Luxon`, "expression error", "evaluating", "format date", "transform field", or any node-parameter assignment.
description_zh: 在编写或审查 n8n 表达式（`{{...}}` 语法）、`$json` / `$node` 引用、Luxon 日期代码或表达式错误时使用。触发于 `{{}}`、`$json`、`$node`、`$input`、`DateTime`、`Luxon`、"表达式错误"、“正在计算”、“格式日期”、“转换字段”或任何节点参数赋值。

name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
description: Elite mobile app image-generation skill for creating premium, app-native screen concepts and flows. Designed for iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products. Prioritizes clean hierarchy, comfortably readable text, strong multi-screen consistency, controlled color palettes, non-generic creative direction, textured surfaces, image-led composition, tasteful custom iconography, and clean phone mockup framing. By default, screens should be shown inside a subtle premium iPhone or similar phone mockup with a visible frame, while the main focus stays on the app content itself. This skill generates images only. It does not write code.
description_zh: 高端移动应用图像生成技能，用于创建优质、原生应用界面概念和流程。专为iOS、Android及跨平台移动产品设计。优先考虑清晰的层级结构、舒适易读的文本、强多屏一致性、受控的配色方案、非同质化的创意方向、纹理表面、以图像为主的构图、雅致的定制图标以及干净的手机模型框架。默认情况下，界面应展示在带有可见边框的精致iPhone或类似手机模型内，而主要焦点应保持在应用内容本身。此技能仅生成图像，不编写代码。

name: efcore-patterns
description: Entity Framework Core best practices including NoTracking by default, query splitting for navigation collections, migration management, dedicated migration services, and common pitfalls to avoid.
description_zh: Entity Framework Core 最佳实践，包括默认不跟踪（NoTracking）、导航集合的查询拆分、迁移管理、专用迁移服务以及常见的需要避免的陷阱。

name: preview-import
description: Use this when you need to preview and verify content you imported into a local AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS, Franklin, Helix) dev server on localhost. Starts the dev server against the imported HTML, checks block rendering, inspects DOM structure, compares against the original page, and troubleshoots broken references and 404s.
description_zh: 当您需要预览和验证导入到本地AEM Edge Delivery Services（EDS，Franklin，Helix）开发服务器上的内容时，请使用此功能。该功能会启动开发服务器，针对导入的HTML进行检查，验证组件渲染，检查DOM结构，与原始页面进行比较，并解决断链和404错误问题。

name: ios-swift-development
description: Develop native iOS apps with Swift. Covers MVVM architecture, SwiftUI, URLSession for networking, Combine for reactive programming, and Core Data persistence.
description_zh: 使用 Swift 开发原生 iOS 应用。涵盖 MVVM 架构、SwiftUI、URLSession 网络通信、Combine 反应式编程以及 Core Data 持久化。

name: fantasy
description: Game-inspired fantasy aesthetic with bold, premium visuals, rich color palettes, and immersive thematic elements.
description_zh: 以游戏为灵感的幻想美学，具有大胆、高端的视觉效果、丰富的调色板和沉浸式的主题元素。

name: doc
description: Write grounded docs, READMEs, repo instructions or continuity handoffs. Use when: these documents are requested; no reports as a routine completion ritual.
description_zh: 撰写基于事实的文档、README文件、仓库说明或工作交接。在以下情况下使用：当这些文档被要求时；不以常规完成仪式的形式提交报告。

name: sf-lwc
description: Lightning Web Components with PICKLES methodology and 165-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user creates/edits LWC components, touches lwc/**/*.js, .html, .css, .js-meta.xml files, or asks about wire service, SLDS, or Jest LWC tests. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Apex classes (use sf-apex), Aura components, or Visualforce.
description_zh: 使用PICKLES方法论和165分评分标准的Lightning Web Components。触发条件：当用户创建/编辑LWC组件、触碰lwc/**/*.js、.html、.css、.js-meta.xml文件，或询问有关wire service、SLDS或Jest LWC测试时。不触发条件：Apex类（使用sf-apex）、Aura组件或Visualforce。

name: planetscale-best-practices-matrix
description: A concise feature matrix for deciding which PlanetScale safety, observability, and automation recommendations apply by engine.
description_zh: 一个简洁的功能矩阵，用于根据引擎决定哪些 PlanetScale 安全性、可观察性和自动化建议适用。

name: cafe
description: Cozy cafe-inspired interface with warm tones, soft typography, and clean layouts for a relaxed browsing experience.
description_zh: 温馨咖啡馆风格的界面，采用暖色调、柔和的字体和简洁的布局，为用户带来轻松的浏览体验。

name: dithered
description: Dot-pattern rendering technique that simulates shades with a limited palette for nostalgic, retro, high-contrast visuals.
description_zh: 点阵渲染技术，使用有限的调色板模拟色调，以营造怀旧、复古、高对比度的视觉效果。

name: mono
description: Monospace-driven, matrix-inspired design with high-contrast elements, compact density, and a hacker-chic aesthetic.
description_zh: 基于等宽字体的矩阵式设计，具有高对比度元素、紧凑密度和黑客时尚美学。

name: customer-retention
description: Identify inactive/at-risk customers via CRM filters and create follow-up tasks at scale. Builds on `bulk-operations`; defers activity-creation specifics to `sales-execution`.
description_zh: 通过CRM筛选识别非活跃/有风险的客户，并大规模创建跟进任务。基于`bulk-operations`；将活动创建的具体细节推迟到`sales-execution`。

name: self-review
description: Automatically review an academic paper using the NeurIPS review form with three reviewer personas, ensemble scoring, and reflection refinement. Extracts text from PDF, runs structured review, and outputs actionable feedback. Use when the user wants to review a paper before submission or get feedback on a draft.
description_zh: 使用 NeurIPS 审稿表格，结合三个审稿人角色、集成评分和反思优化，自动对学术论文进行审阅。从 PDF 中提取文本，执行结构化审稿，并输出可操作的反馈。适用于用户在提交前审阅论文或获取草稿反馈的情况。

name: vintage
description: 1950s-1990s nostalgia with skeuomorphic touches, grainy textures, retro color palettes, and pixel-style typography.
description_zh: 20世纪50年代至90年代怀旧的风格，带有拟物化设计元素、颗粒状纹理、复古调色板和像素风格字体。

name: huggingface-tool-builder
description: Use this skill when the user wants to build tool/scripts or achieve a task where using data from the Hugging Face API would help. This is especially useful when chaining or combining API calls or the task will be repeated/automated. This Skill creates a reusable script to fetch, enrich or process data.
description_zh: 当用户想要构建工具/脚本或完成一个任务，而使用 Hugging Face API 的数据会很有帮助时，请使用此技能。这在链式调用或组合 API 调用，或任务将被重复/自动化时尤其有用。此技能会创建一个可重用的脚本，用于获取、丰富或处理数据。

name: typescript
description: TypeScript performance, tsconfig, type errors, async patterns — triggered when the user asks to "optimize TypeScript performance", "speed up tsc compilation", "configure tsconfig.json", "fix type errors", "improve async patterns", or encounters TS errors (TS2322, TS2339, "is not assignable to"). Also triggers on .ts, .tsx, .d.ts file work involving type definitions, module organization, or memory management. Does NOT cover TypeScript basics, framework-specific patterns, or testing.
description_zh: TypeScript性能、tsconfig、类型错误、异步模式——在用户要求“优化TypeScript性能”、“加速tsc编译”、“配置tsconfig.json”、“修复类型错误”、“改进异步模式”，或遇到TS错误（TS2322、TS2339、“不可赋值给”）时触发。也适用于涉及类型定义、模块组织或内存管理的.ts、.tsx、.d.ts文件工作。不包括TypeScript基础知识、特定框架模式或测试。

name: react-ui-patterns
description: Modern React UI patterns for loading states, error handling, and data fetching. Use when building UI components, handling async data, or managing UI states.
description_zh: 现代 React UI 模式，用于加载状态、错误处理和数据获取。在构建 UI 组件、处理异步数据或管理 UI 状态时使用。

name: lead-triage
description: Score and route an inbound lead, or rank a backlog of leads, against your ICP and qualification framework, then recommend a priority and next action. Use when the user asks "triage this lead", "triage my leads", "rank my lead backlog", "is [company] a good lead", "qualify [lead]", or pastes or uploads lead info.
description_zh: 对入站线索进行评分和分配路线，或根据您的ICP（理想客户画像）和资格框架对线索积压进行排序，然后推荐优先级和下一步行动。当用户询问“处理这个线索”、“处理我的线索”、“排序我的线索积压”、“[公司]是否是一个好的线索”、“资格认证[线索]”，或粘贴或上传线索信息时使用。

name: android-design-guidelines
description: Material Design 3 and Android platform guidelines. Use when building Android apps with Jetpack Compose or XML layouts, implementing Material You, navigation, or accessibility. Triggers on tasks involving Android UI, Compose components, dynamic color, or Material Design compliance.

name: stream
description: Stream router for Chat, Video, Feeds, and Moderation. Use when the user wants to build a new app with Stream, scaffold a project, add Chat/Video/Feeds/Moderation to an existing app, integrate Stream, audit or migrate an integration, build for Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit/iOS/Xcode/Android/Kotlin/React Native/Expo/Flutter, query Stream data, list channels, list calls, show flagged messages, find users, run getstream CLI commands, install the Stream CLI, set up Stream, configure moderation, search Stream SDK documentation, or look up Stream React/iOS/Android/Node/Flutter/Unity SDK methods. Routes to the right sub-skill based on the task.
