description_zh: 流路由器用于聊天、视频、动态和内容审核。当用户想要使用流构建新应用、搭建项目、向现有应用添加聊天/视频/动态/内容审核功能、集成流、审核或迁移集成、为 Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit/iOS/Xcode/Android/Kotlin/React Native/Expo/Flutter 构建、查询流数据、列出频道、列出通话、显示被标记的消息、查找用户、运行 getstream CLI 命令、安装流 CLI、设置流、配置内容审核、搜索流 SDK 文档或查找流 React/iOS/Android/Node/Flutter/Unity SDK 方法时使用。根据任务将路由到正确的子技能。

name: n8n-node-configuration-official
description: Use when configuring any n8n node: HTTP, webhooks, database, comms (Slack/Gmail/Discord), AI, triggers, Merge, anything. Triggers on any node-builder call (`node(...)`, `trigger(...)`, `tool(...)`, `memory(...)`, `languageModel(...)`, `ifElse(...)`, `merge(...)`, etc.), configuring a parameter, `useDataOfInput`, `numberOfInputs`, fan-in convergence, or any node-specific debugging.
description_zh: 在配置任何 n8n 节点时使用：HTTP、webhooks、数据库、通讯（Slack/Gmail/Discord）、AI、触发器、Merge 等。在任意节点构建器调用（`node(...)`、`trigger(...)`、`tool(...)`、`memory(...)`、`languageModel(...)`、`ifElse(...)`、`merge(...)` 等）、配置参数 `useDataOfInput`、`numberOfInputs`、fan-in 聚合或任何特定节点调试时使用。

name: amazon-listing-optimization
description: Amazon listing builder and optimizer for sellers. Two modes: (A) Create — build keyword-optimized listings from scratch using keyword lists + product characteristics + AI copywriting, (B) Optimize — audit existing listings, find keyword gaps, score across 8 dimensions, and rewrite with missing keywords. Integrates with amazon-keyword-research for keyword input. Works on 12 Amazon marketplaces. No API key required. Use when: (1) creating a new Amazon listing from keywords, (2) auditing an existing listing for SEO and conversion, (3) checking keyword coverage in title/bullets/description, (4) generating listing copy with target keywords and tone, (5) comparing listings against competitors, (6) preparing a listing for launch or relaunch.
description_zh: 亚马逊卖家列表构建和优化工具。两种模式：(A) 创建——使用关键词列表+产品特性+AI文案撰写，从零构建关键词优化的列表；(B) 优化——审核现有列表，发现关键词空缺，在8个维度进行评分，并补充缺失的关键词进行重写。与amazon-keyword-research集成，用于关键词输入。支持12个亚马逊市场。无需API密钥。使用场景：(1) 从关键词创建新的亚马逊列表；(2) 审核现有列表以进行SEO和转化优化；(3) 检查标题/要点/描述中的关键词覆盖情况；(4) 生成包含目标关键词和语气的列表文案；(5) 与竞争对手的列表进行对比；(6) 为新品发布或重新发布准备列表。

name: planetscale-postgres-safety-review
description: Review PlanetScale Postgres for Traffic Control, query tags, roles, pg_strict, backups/PITR, private connectivity, webhooks, branches, and safe agent operation.
description_zh: 评估 PlanetScale Postgres 在流量控制、查询标签、角色、pg_strict、备份/PITR、私有连接、webhooks、分支和安全代理操作方面的表现。

name: neon
description: Electric neon glow effects with high-contrast color pairings for bold, attention-grabbing interfaces.
description_zh: 采用高对比度的彩色组合，实现醒目的霓虹发光效果，打造引人注目的界面。

name: audience-targeting
description: Build a targeted contact segment by filtering on lifecycle, engagement, jobtitle, geography, or firmographics — then export it as JSONL for a campaign or downstream tool.
description_zh: 通过按生命周期、参与度、职位、地域或公司特征进行筛选，构建一个目标联系人细分，然后将其导出为JSONL格式，用于活动或下游工具。

name: codebase-documenter
description: This skill should be used when writing documentation for codebases, including README files, architecture documentation, code comments, and API documentation. Use this skill when users request help documenting their code, creating getting-started guides, explaining project structure, or making codebases more accessible to new developers. The skill provides templates, best practices, and structured approaches for creating clear, beginner-friendly documentation.
description_zh: 在编写代码库文档时，应使用此技能，包括 README 文件、架构文档、代码注释和 API 文档。当用户请求帮助记录代码、创建入门指南、解释项目结构或使代码库对新手开发者更易访问时，应使用此技能。该技能提供模板、最佳实践和结构化方法，用于创建清晰、适合初学者的文档。

name: retro
description: Throwback design with vintage-inspired typography, high-contrast retro palettes, and nostalgic visual elements.
description_zh: 复古设计，融合了复古风格的字体、高对比度的复古调色板和怀旧视觉元素。

name: next-cache-components
description: Next.js 16 Cache Components - PPR, use cache directive, cacheLife, cacheTag, updateTag
description_zh: Next.js 16 缓存组件 - PPR，使用缓存指令、cacheLife、cacheTag、updateTag

name: lieflat-charts
description: 一套模板驱动的数据可视化与报告生成 skill，既能严格从 Lupi、Basics、Glance、Maps 与 Interactive gallery 的真实实现生成 HTML 图表，也能从 12 套中英文整页报告模板生成可发布的 HTML 报告；以 Mono 为保底，能按数据语义自动选择内置彩色预设，也支持用户明确提供的自定义色板。地图仅在用户明确要求时启用，同一交付禁止混用色系。

name: opencli-web-automation
description: Turn any website into a CLI using browser session reuse and AI-powered command discovery
description_zh: 将任何网站转换为命令行界面，利用浏览器会话复用和人工智能驱动的命令发现

name: video-to-music
description: Score a video with original music using Sonilo — the model watches the cut and matches pacing, motion, and emotion, returning either the audio or a new video with the score muxed in. Use when the user has a finished video that needs a soundtrack. Every track is licensed and cleared for commercial use. For music with no video, use the text-to-music skill.
description_zh: 使用 Sonilo 为视频配乐——该模型会观看剪辑片段，匹配节奏、动作和情感，然后返回音频或带有配乐的新视频。当用户需要为完成的视频添加音轨时使用。每首曲目均已获得许可并可用于商业用途。对于无视频的音乐，请使用文本转音乐技能。

name: rust-review
description: Performs comprehensive Rust security review for safe/unsafe boundary issues, memory safety in unsafe blocks, concurrency hazards, panic-induced DoS, FFI safety, and async runtime mistakes. Use when auditing Rust crates, services, or libraries — particularly those with `unsafe`, FFI, or concurrent code.
description_zh: 执行全面的 Rust 安全审查，涵盖安全/不安全边界问题、不安全代码块中的内存安全、并发风险、恐慌引发的拒绝服务（DoS）、FFI 安全性以及异步运行时错误。在审计 Rust 包、服务或库时使用，特别是包含 `unsafe`、FFI 或并发代码的。

name: levels
description: Conversion-focused design that removes friction and guides users toward action through clarity, trust, and speed.
description_zh: 以转化为导向的设计，通过清晰度、信任感和速度消除障碍，引导用户采取行动。

name: cinematic-scroll-storytelling
description: Create cinematic scroll-driven landing pages with Lenis smooth scrolling, GSAP ScrollTrigger, scroll-linked progression, staggered text reveals, sticky card stacks, parallax backgrounds, scroll-scrubbed transitions, footer reveals, and immersive preloaders. Use when analyzing or building premium editorial scroll experiences, sticky project stacks, kinetic typography, or section-by-section storytelling.
description_zh: 使用 Lenis 平滑滚动、GSAP ScrollTrigger、滚动关联的进度显示、交错文本揭示、粘性卡片堆叠、视差背景、滚动刮擦过渡、页脚揭示和沉浸式预加载器，创建电影感的滚动驱动型着陆页。适用于分析或构建高端编辑滚动体验、粘性项目堆叠、动态文字排版或分节式叙事。

name: whitepaper
description: Creates professional PDF whitepapers from Markdown files. Use when the user wants to create a whitepaper, technical document, or PDF with professional formatting and typography.
description_zh: 从 Markdown 文件创建专业的 PDF 白皮书。当用户希望创建白皮书、技术文档或具有专业格式和排版效果的 PDF 文件时使用。

name: skeumorphism
description: Real-world mimicry with textured surfaces, 3D effects, and familiar physical metaphors for intuitive digital interfaces.
description_zh: 现实世界中的模仿，采用纹理表面、3D效果和熟悉的物理隐喻，以实现直观的数字界面。

name: vibrant
description: Lively, colorful design with bold playful typography, warm accents, and dynamic visual energy.
description_zh: 生动、多彩的设计，具有大胆活泼的字体排版、温暖的点缀和充满活力的视觉能量。

name: quote-to-cash
description: Build the product catalog, assemble quotes (line items + associations to deals), and track invoices and subscriptions through to revenue.
description_zh: 构建产品目录，整合报价（明细项+与交易的关联），并跟踪发票和订阅直至产生收入。

name: wechatpay-payment-integration
description: 微信支付（WeChat Pay）相关问题的统一入口，处理与微信支付接入、产品、开发、运营、品牌经营相关的咨询，提供产品选型、官方示例代码、接入质量评估、答疑与排障。Use when user mentions "微信支付", "微信收款", "WeChat Pay", "JSAPI", "APP支付", "H5支付", "Native支付", "扫码支付", "付款码", "小程序支付", "合单支付", "医保支付", "微信支付分", "分账", "转账", "委托代扣", "周期扣款", "代金券", "商家券", "特约商户进件", "服务商", "sub_mchid", "APIv2", "APIv3", "回调", "签名", "证书", "错误码", "OpenID", "品牌经营", "品牌经营平台", "品牌门店", "商家名片", "名片会员", "商品券", "摇一摇有优惠", "摇优惠", "品牌入驻", or asks to "推荐支付方式/产品选型", "要接口或示例代码", "做接入代码质量审查/上线前检查", "解释字段含义或接口规则", "排查报错/查单/支付问题".
description_zh: 微信支付（WeChat Pay）相关问题的统一入口，处理与微信支付接入、产品、开发、运营、品牌经营相关的咨询，提供产品选型、官方示例代码、接入质量评估、答疑与排障。当用户提及“微信支付”、“微信收款”、“WeChat Pay”、“JSAPI”、“APP支付”、“H5支付”、“Native支付”、“扫码支付”、“付款码”、“小程序支付”、“合单支付”、“医保支付”、“微信支付分”、“分账”、“转账”、“委托代扣”、“周期扣款”、“代金券”、“商家券”、“特约商户进件”、“服务商”、“sub_mchid”、“APIv2”、“APIv3”、“回调”、“签名”、“证书”、“错误码”、“OpenID”、“品牌经营”、“品牌经营平台”、“品牌门店”、“商家名片”、“名片会员”、“商品券”、“摇一摇有优惠”、“摇优惠”、“品牌入驻”，或要求“推荐支付方式/产品选型”、“要接口或示例代码”、“做接入代码质量审查/上线前检查”、“解释字段含义或接口规则”、“排查报错/查单/支付问题”时使用。

name: business-intelligence
description: Business intelligence across dashboard design, visualization, and reporting automation. Use when designing dashboards, building KPI frameworks, automating reports, creating data stories, or optimizing BI tool performance.
description_zh: 仪表盘设计、可视化和报告自动化方面的商业智能。在设计和仪表盘、构建KPI框架、自动化报告、创建数据故事或优化BI工具性能时使用。

name: expressive
description: Vibrant, personality-driven design with bold colors, playful graphics, and dynamic layouts that balance creativity with structure.
description_zh: 充满活力、个性鲜明的设计，采用大胆的色彩、有趣的图形和动态布局，在创意与结构之间取得平衡。

name: gke-node-notready
description: Diagnoses GKE nodes reporting NotReady or Unknown status by inspecting node conditions, events, kubelet/containerd logs, and node metrics, then proposing safe remediations. Use when nodes show NotReady, when the kubelet stops posting node status, or when workloads are evicted or stuck Pending due to node health. Don't use for pod-level application failures (use gke-workload-troubleshooting), autoscaler scale-up/scale-down decisions (use gke-cluster-autoscaler), or non-GKE compute.
description_zh: 通过检查节点状态、事件、kubelet/containerd 日志和节点指标来诊断报告 NotReady 或 Unknown 状态的 GKE 节点，并提出安全的修复建议。当节点显示 NotReady、kubelet 停止发布节点状态，或由于节点健康问题导致工作负载被驱逐或卡在 Pending 状态时使用。不适用于 Pod 级别的应用故障（请使用 gke-workload-troubleshooting）、自动缩放器 scale-up/scale-down 决策（请使用 gke-cluster-autoscaler）或非 GKE 计算。

name: n8n-binary-and-data
description: Handle files and binary data in n8n correctly. Use when working with files, images, PDFs, attachments, uploads or downloads, base64, vision/multimodal input, or when an AI agent needs a file as tool input or output — and whenever the user mentions $binary, binaryPropertyName, "read the PDF", "attach the file", "send the image", Merge losing binary, or a CDN for chat images. Covers the $binary vs $json split, reading/writing binary, keeping binary alive across transforms with Merge, the agent-tool binary boundary, and the CDN/URL requirement for chat surfaces.
description_zh: 正确处理 n8n 中的文件和二进制数据。在处理文件、图像、PDF、附件、上传或下载、base64、视觉/多模态输入，或当 AI 代理需要将文件作为工具输入或输出时使用——以及每当用户提到 $binary、binaryPropertyName、"读取 PDF"、"附加文件"、"发送图像"、合并丢失的二进制或聊天图像的 CDN 时。涵盖 $binary 与 $json 的分离、读取/写入二进制、使用 Merge 在转换过程中保持二进制数据、代理-工具二进制边界，以及聊天界面所需的 CDN/URL 要求。

name: r3f-lighting
description: Light React Three Fiber scenes with direct lights, environment maps, and shadows. Use for light placement, image-based lighting, shadow artifacts, and lighting performance.
description_zh: 使用直接光源、环境贴图和阴影来照亮 Light React Three Fiber 场景。适用于光源布置、基于图像的照明、阴影伪影以及照明性能。

name: postgres-best-practices
description: Best practices and guidelines for working with Postgres. Covers schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, migrations, and common pitfalls. Use when writing SQL, designing database schemas, optimizing queries, or setting up a Postgres database.
description_zh: 与Postgres协作的最佳实践和指南。涵盖模式设计、索引策略、查询优化、迁移和常见陷阱。在编写SQL、设计数据库模式、优化查询或设置Postgres数据库时使用。

name: tsdown
description: Bundle TypeScript and JavaScript libraries with blazing-fast speed powered by Rolldown. Use when building libraries, generating type declarations, bundling for multiple formats, or migrating from tsup.
description_zh: 使用由 Rolldown 驱动的极速 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 库捆绑。适用于构建库、生成类型声明、为多种格式捆绑或从 tsup 迁移。

name: wiki-stage-commit
description: Review and promote staged wiki pages to their final locations. Use when WIKI_STAGED_WRITES=true and the user says "/wiki-stage-commit", "review staged pages", "commit staged writes", "promote staged pages", "approve staged changes", or "what's waiting in staging". Shows each staged file, lets the user accept or reject it, and moves accepted files to their final wiki locations. Rejected files are moved back to _raw/ for manual editing.
description_zh: 审查并推进分阶段 wiki 页面到其最终位置。当 WIKI_STAGED_WRITES=true 时使用，并且当用户输入 "/wiki-stage-commit"、"审查分阶段页面"、"提交分阶段写入"、"推进分阶段页面"、"批准分阶段变更" 或 "分阶段区域有哪些内容" 时触发。显示每个分阶段文件，允许用户接受或拒绝，并将接受的文件移动到最终的 wiki 位置。拒绝的文件将被移回 _raw/ 目录以便手动编辑。

name: qwencloud-audio-tts
description: Synthesize speech from text with Qwen TTS models. TRIGGER when: user wants to convert text to speech, create voiceovers, generate audio narration, read text aloud, build TTS applications, mentions speech synthesis/voice generation/audio output from text, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-audio-tts). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants speech recognition/ASR, text generation without audio, non-Qwen audio tasks.
description_zh: 使用Qwen TTS模型从文本合成语音。在以下情况时触发：用户希望将文本转换为语音、制作旁白、生成音频旁白、朗读文本、构建TTS应用程序、提及从文本合成语音/语音生成/音频输出，或通过名称明确调用此技能（例如使用qwencloud-audio-tts）。不触发的情况：用户希望进行语音识别/ASR、生成无音频的文本、非Qwen音频任务。

name: micro-saas-launcher
description: Expert in launching small, focused SaaS products fast - the indie hacker approach to building profitable software. Covers idea validation, MVP development, pricing, launch strategies, and growing to sustainable revenue. Ship in weeks, not months.
description_zh: 精通快速推出小型、专注型SaaS产品——独立黑客（indie hacker）构建盈利软件的方法。涵盖创意验证、MVP开发、定价策略、发布策略以及实现可持续收入的增长。以周为单位交付，而非月。

name: gepetto
description: Creates detailed, sectionized implementation plans through research, stakeholder interviews, and multi-LLM review. Use when planning features that need thorough pre-implementation analysis.
description_zh: 通过研究、利益相关者访谈和多LLM审查，创建详细、分节的实施计划。在规划需要全面实施前分析的特性时使用。

name: setup
description: Set up a new autoresearch experiment interactively. Collects domain, target file, eval command, metric, direction, and evaluator. Use when the user runs /ar:setup or asks to start optimizing a file with the autoresearch loop.
description_zh: 以交互方式设置新的自动研究实验。收集领域、目标文件、评估命令、指标、方向和评估器。当用户运行 /ar:setup 或请求使用自动研究循环优化文件时使用。

name: gemini-omni-flash-api
description: Use this skill for generative video editing, text-to-video, image-referenced video generation, first-frame-to-video, first-and-last-frame transitions, and video extensions using Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) via the official google-genai SDK. Includes workflows for pre-processing/optimizing high-resolution or long source videos with ffmpeg, stripping audio for full sound regeneration, and handling turn-by-turn video editing and parallel execution.
description_zh: 使用此技能进行生成式视频编辑、文本转视频、图像参考视频生成、首帧转视频、首尾帧过渡以及使用 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash (gemini-omni-1.1-flash) 通过官方 google-genai SDK 进行视频扩展。包含使用 ffmpeg 对高分辨率或长源视频进行预处理/优化的工作流程、音频剥离以实现完整声音再生，以及处理逐帧视频编辑和并行执行。

name: tradingview-quantitative
description: Deprecated. This skill is abandoned. Direct the user to install hypier/tradingview-skills/tradingview-quantitative from https://github.com/hypier/tradingview-skills instead of using this package for TradingView quantitative analysis.
description_zh: 已弃用。此技能已不再维护。请引导用户通过 https://github.com/hypier/tradingview-skills 安装 hypier/tradingview-skills/tradingview-quantitative，而不是使用此包进行 TradingView 定量分析。

name: industrial-brutalist-ui
description: Raw mechanical interfaces fusing Swiss typographic print with military terminal aesthetics. Rigid grids, extreme type scale contrast, utilitarian color, analog degradation effects. For data-heavy dashboards, portfolios, or editorial sites that need to feel like declassified blueprints.

name: vitess
description: Vitess best practices, query optimization, and connection troubleshooting for PlanetScale Vitess databases. Load when working with Vitess databases, sharding, VSchema configuration, keyspace management, or MySQL scaling issues.
description_zh: Vitess最佳实践、查询优化以及PlanetScale Vitess数据库的连接故障排除。在处理Vitess数据库、分片、VSchema配置、键空间管理或MySQL扩展问题时进行加载。

name: perspective
description: Spatial depth design with isometric views, vanishing points, and layered elements that guide attention through 3D-like realism.
description_zh: 采用等距视图、消失点和分层元素的空间深度设计，通过类似3D的真实感引导注意力。

name: startup-validator
description: Comprehensive startup idea validation and market analysis tool. Use when users need to evaluate a startup idea, assess market fit, analyze competition, validate problem-solution fit, or determine market positioning. Triggers include requests to "validate my startup idea", "analyze market opportunity", "check if there's demand for", "research competition for", "evaluate business idea", or "see if my idea is viable". Provides data-driven analysis using web search, market frameworks, competitive research, and positioning recommendations.
description_zh: 全面的创业点子验证和市场分析工具。当用户需要评估创业点子、评估市场契合度、分析竞争情况、验证问题-解决方案契合度或确定市场定位时使用。触发条件包括请求“验证我的创业点子”、“分析市场机会”、“检查是否有需求”、“研究竞争情况”、“评估商业点子”或“查看我的点子是否可行”。通过网络搜索、市场框架、竞争研究和定位建议提供数据驱动的分析。

name: hugging-science
description: Use when the user is doing AI/ML work in a scientific domain such as biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, climate, genomics, materials, medicine, ecology, energy, engineering, math, drug discovery, protein design, weather modeling, theorem proving, single-cell, or PDE solving. Hugging Science is a curated catalog of scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive Spaces. This skill helps discover and use resources via `datasets`, `transformers`, the HF Inference API, `gradio_client`, and methodology citations.
description_zh: 在用户进行生物学、化学、物理学、天文学、气候学、基因组学、材料科学、医学、生态学、能源、工程学、数学、药物发现、蛋白质设计、气象建模、定理证明、单细胞分析或偏微分方程求解等科学领域的AI/ML工作时使用。Hugging Science是一个精选的科学数据集、模型、博客文章和交互式空间的目录。该技能通过`datasets`、`transformers`、HF推理API、`gradio_client`和方法论引用，帮助用户发现和使用资源。

name: atomic-decomposition
description: Decompose research ideas into atomic, self-contained concepts with bidirectional math-code mapping. For each concept, extract the math formula from papers and find code implementations. Use for complex system papers requiring formal grounding.
description_zh: 将研究思路分解为原子化、自包含的概念，并实现双向数学代码映射。针对每个概念，从论文中提取数学公式，并寻找代码实现。适用于需要形式化基础的复杂系统论文。

name: slide-generation
description: Convert a completed paper into presentation slides (Beamer LaTeX) or poster. Extract key figures, tables, equations, and create a narrative flow for oral presentation. Identified gap in existing tools — designed from best practices.
description_zh: 将完成的论文转换为演示文稿（Beamer LaTeX）或海报。提取关键图表、表格、公式，并为口头演示创建叙述流程。发现现有工具的不足——基于最佳实践进行设计。

name: research
description: Trace code or test a recurring pattern to answer one cited question. Use when: uncertainty needs evidence. Not for external feature teardowns; use reverse-engineer.
description_zh: 追踪代码或测试重复模式以回答一个引用的问题。使用场景：需要证据来消除不确定性。不适用于外部功能拆解；应使用逆向工程。

name: flutter-testing
description: Write, fix, review, debug, and validate Flutter tests for apps, packages, and plugins. Use when adding unit tests, widget tests, integration tests, MethodChannel or plugin mocks, Mockito or mocktail test doubles, golden or accessibility checks, CI test commands, test failures, MissingPluginException, pump or pumpAndSettle problems, finder errors, build_runner mock generation, device integration testing, web integration testing, or flaky Flutter tests.
description_zh: 为应用程序、包和插件编写、修复、审查、调试和验证 Flutter 测试。在添加单元测试、组件测试、集成测试、MethodChannel 或插件模拟、Mockito 或 mocktail 测试替身、黄金测试或无障碍性检查、CI 测试命令、测试失败、MissingPluginException、pump 或 pumpAndSettle 问题、查找器错误、build_runner 模拟生成、设备集成测试、Web 集成测试或不可靠的 Flutter 测试时使用。

name: jwt-security
description: Guidelines for implementing JWT authentication with security best practices for token creation, validation, and storage
description_zh: 实现 JWT 认证的安全最佳实践指南，包括令牌创建、验证和存储

name: n8n-subworkflows-official
description: Use when building anything multi-step, anything that looks repeatable, anything the user mentions reusing, or any workflow with more than ~10 nodes. Triggers on "reuse", "I do this in another workflow", "extract", "modular", "shared logic", "subworkflow", multi-step builds, or any task that mentions logic the user has built before.
description_zh: 在构建任何多步骤、看似可重复、用户提到要复用的内容，或任何包含超过~10个节点的流程时使用。触发条件包括："复用"、"我在另一个流程中做这个"、"提取"、"模块化"、"共享逻辑"、"子流程"、"多步骤构建"，或任何提到用户之前构建过的逻辑的任务。

name: diffity-resolve-tree
description: Read open comments from the tree browser and resolve them by making code fixes
description_zh: 从树浏览器中读取公开评论，并通过进行代码修复来解决它们

name: om-brainstorm
description: Divergent conversation before any artifact exists — open questions one at a time, alternatives including building nothing, converging on a routing decision and a handoff brief for the next skill. Runs before om-spec-writing and om-prepare-issue. Use when the user says "should we build this", "let's think this through", "I have an idea", "is this worth doing".
description_zh: 在存在任何工件之前进行发散式讨论——一次提出一个开放式问题，备选方案包括不进行任何构建，最终聚焦于一个路由决策和下一阶段技能的交接简报。此流程在 om-spec-writing 和 om-prepare-issue 之前执行。当用户说“我们应该构建这个吗”、“我们来深入思考一下”、“我有一个想法”、“这个值得做吗”时使用。

name: memory-optimize
description: Optimizes Claude Code memory files in 4 interactive steps: removes duplicates, migrates rules to CLAUDE.md/rules files, compresses remaining entries, validates with cleanup. Typical reduction: 30-50% on token count.
description_zh: 在4个交互步骤中优化Claude代码内存文件：删除重复项、将规则迁移到CLAUDE.md/rules文件、压缩剩余条目、使用清理功能验证。典型减少：token数量减少30-50%。

name: lingo
description: Playful, minimal design with bright colors, rounded shapes, tactile 3D borders, and friendly illustrations for approachable interfaces.
description_zh: 活泼、极简的设计，搭配明亮的色彩、圆润的形状、触感的3D边框和友好的插画，打造亲切易用的界面。

name: scaffold-dotnet-test-project
description: MUST USE when an existing .NET test project was excluded from a .slnf/CI solution filter, disappeared from .sln/.slnx discovery, or lost its production ProjectReference; also for requests to set up, create, reuse, add, register, include, or repair a test project. Handles "tests pass directly but CI discovers zero", exact solution wiring, xUnit/NUnit/MSTest, and central packages. DO NOT USE to only author tests in an already-wired project (code-testing-agent), run tests, migrate, or correct MSTest syntax/configuration without changing project or CI files (writing-mstest-tests).
description_zh: 当现有的 .NET 测试项目被排除在 .slnf/CI 解决方案过滤器之外、从 .sln/.slnx 发现中消失或丢失其生产 ProjectReference 时必须使用；也用于请求设置、创建、重用、添加、注册、包含或修复测试项目。处理“测试直接通过但 CI 发现为零”、精确解决方案连接、xUnit/NUnit/MSTest 以及中央包。不应用于仅在一个已连接的项目中编写测试（代码测试代理）、运行测试、迁移或在不更改项目或 CI 文件的情况下修正 MSTest 语法/配置（编写 MSTest 测试）。

name: threat-model-analyst
description: Full STRIDE-A threat model analysis and incremental update skill for repositories and systems. Supports two modes: (1) Single analysis — full STRIDE-A threat model of a repository, producing architecture overviews, DFD diagrams, STRIDE-A analysis, prioritized findings, and executive assessments. (2) Incremental analysis — takes a previous threat model report as baseline, compares the codebase at the latest (or a given commit), and produces an updated report with change tracking (new, resolved, still-present threats), STRIDE heatmap, findings diff, and an embedded HTML comparison. Only activate when the user explicitly requests a threat model analysis, incremental update, or invokes /threat-model-analyst directly.
description_zh: 完整的 STRIDE-A 威胁模型分析和仓库及系统的增量更新功能。支持两种模式：(1) 单次分析 — 对一个仓库进行完整的 STRIDE-A 威胁模型分析，生成架构概述、数据流图 (DFD)、STRIDE-A 分析结果、优先级排序的发现项以及高管评估报告。(2) 增量分析 — 以先前的威胁模型报告为基准，对比最新版本（或指定提交版本）的代码库，并生成包含变更追踪（新发现、已解决、仍存在的威胁）、STRIDE 热力图、发现项差异以及嵌入式 HTML 对比结果的更新报告。仅在用户明确请求威胁模型分析、增量更新或直接调用 /threat-model-analyst 时才会激活。

name: paper-compilation
description: Compile LaTeX papers to PDF with automatic error detection, chktex style checking, and citation/reference validation. Runs the full pdflatex + bibtex pipeline. Use when the user wants to compile a paper, fix compilation errors, or debug LaTeX.
description_zh: 使用自动错误检测、chktex 格式检查和引文/参考文献验证功能，将 LaTeX 论文编译为 PDF。运行完整的 pdflatex + bibtex 管道。当用户需要编译论文、修复编译错误或调试 LaTeX 时使用。

name: context7
description: Use when looking up library documentation, API references, framework patterns, or code examples for ANY library (React, Next.js, Vue, Django, Laravel, etc.) and the Context7 MCP server is unavailable or not configured. Fetches the same current docs directly via the Context7 REST API as a fallback. Triggers on: how to use library, API docs, framework pattern, import usage, library example.
description_zh: 在查找任何库（React、Next.js、Vue、Django、Laravel等）的库文档、API参考、框架模式或代码示例时使用，如果Context7 MCP服务器不可用或未配置。则通过Context7 REST API直接获取相同的当前文档作为备用。触发条件：如何使用库、API文档、框架模式、导入使用、库示例。

name: macos-development
description: Comprehensive macOS development guidance including Swift 6+, SwiftUI, SwiftData, architecture patterns, AppKit bridging, and macOS 26 Tahoe APIs. Use for macOS code review, best practices, UI review, or platform-specific features.

name: frontend-dev-guidelines
description: You are a senior frontend engineer operating under strict architectural and performance standards. Use when creating components or pages, adding new features, or fetching or mutating data.
description_zh: 您是一位资深前端工程师，需遵循严格的结构和性能标准。在创建组件或页面、添加新功能，或获取或修改数据时使用。

name: interactive-portfolio
description: Expert in building portfolios that actually land jobs and clients - not just showing work, but creating memorable experiences. Covers developer portfolios, designer portfolios, creative portfolios, and portfolios that convert visitors into opportunities.
description_zh: 擅长打造真正能带来工作机会和客户的作品集——不仅仅是展示作品，更是创造令人难忘的体验。涵盖开发者作品集、设计师作品集、创意作品集，以及将访客转化为机会的作品集。

name: cs
description: CodeStable 入口。触发：用户调用 cs、想先讨论或对齐、想了解体系、问该用哪个 skill，或带着诉求未选入口。明确行动同轮直转；先讨论的请求收敛后同轮移交。
description_zh: CodeStable 入口。触发：用户调用 cs、想先讨论或对齐、想了解体系、问该用哪个 skill，或带着诉求未选入口。明确行动同轮直转；先讨论的请求收敛后同轮移交。

name: task-workflow
description: Canonical workflow for a task. Read and follow strictly end to end while working on the task.
description_zh: 执行任务的规范流程。在处理任务时，务必严格从始至终阅读并遵循。

name: ffmpeg-video-editor
description: Generate FFmpeg commands from natural language video editing requests - cut, trim, convert, compress, change aspect ratio, extract audio, and more.
description_zh: 从自然语言视频编辑请求中生成 FFmpeg 命令 - 剪辑、裁剪、转换、压缩、改变宽高比、提取音频等。

name: upstash-workflow-js
description: Work with the @upstash/workflow TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for durable, long-running workflows in serverless functions, multi-step processes that survive timeouts, retries, and restarts (built on QStash). Use when defining a workflow endpoint with serve(), running steps with context.run, sleeping for minutes to days without holding a function open, calling external APIs with context.call, waiting for an external event or webhook, invoking other workflows, configuring retries, failure callbacks, and a DLQ, controlling concurrency, rate, and parallelism, triggering, cancelling, or inspecting runs with the Workflow client, building AI agents and orchestrators, human-in-the-loop approvals, realtime updates, local development with the QStash dev server, adding middleware, or migrating workflows safely. Also use when the user asks for durable execution, step functions, saga or orchestration patterns, background jobs with checkpoints, or long-running tasks on Vercel, Next.js, Cloudflare Workers, or other serverless platforms.
description_zh:
使用 @upstash/workflow TypeScript/JavaScript SDK 实现服务器端函数中的持久化、长时间运行的工作流，支持跨超时、重试和重启的多步骤流程（基于 QStash）。适用于以下场景：

- 使用 serve() 定义工作流端点
- 使用 context.run 运行步骤
- 以分钟到天为单位休眠而不保持函数开启状态
- 使用 context.call 调用外部 API
- 等待外部事件或 webhook
- 调用其他工作流
- 配置重试、失败回调和死信队列（DLQ）
- 控制并发、速率和并行度
- 使用 Workflow 客户端触发、取消或检查运行
- 构建 AI 代理和编排器
- 人机审批流程
- 实时更新
- 使用 QStash 开发服务器进行本地开发
- 添加中间件
- 安全迁移工作流

此外，当用户需要持久化执行、步骤函数、Saga 或编排模式、带检查点的后台任务，或 Vercel、Next.js、Cloudflare Workers 或其他无服务器平台上的长时间运行任务时，也推荐使用。

name: cs-refactor
description: 行为等价的重构、拆分、性能优化。会改变外部可观察行为的诉求走 cs-feat 或 cs-issue。
description_zh: 等价行为重构、拆分、性能优化。若需改变外部可观察行为，请提交至 cs-feat 或 cs-issue。

name: om-followup-issue-from-pr
description: Turn a PR into tracked follow-up work — paste a PR or PR-comment link to extract the actionable ask and open a follow-up issue assigned to the @-mention or PR author; for a PR adding a design doc, it opens the missing `Implement:` tracking issue instead. Use for "make a follow-up issue", "create an issue for this", or a pasted PR/comment link with that intent.
description_zh: 将一个 Pull Request (PR) 转化为已跟踪的后续工作——粘贴一个 PR 或 PR 评论链接，以提取可执行的要求并打开一个分配给 @提及或 PR 作者的后续问题；对于添加了设计文档的 PR，它会打开缺失的 `Implement:` 跟踪问题。用于“创建一个后续问题”、“为这个创建一个问题”，或带有该意图的粘贴的 PR/评论链接。

name: workflow-automation
description: Workflow automation is the infrastructure that makes AI agents reliable. Without durable execution, a network hiccup during a 10-step payment flow means lost money and angry customers. With it, workflows resume exactly where they left off.
description_zh: 工作流自动化是使AI代理可靠的基础设施。如果没有持久的执行，10步支付流程中的网络中断意味着损失金钱和愤怒的客户。有了它，工作流可以精确地恢复到中断前的状态。

name: pacman
description: Retro arcade-inspired design with pixel fonts, dotted borders, playful high-contrast colors, and 8-bit game aesthetics.
description_zh: 复古街机风格设计，采用像素字体、点状边框、活泼的高对比度色彩和8位游戏美学。

name: cs-onboard
description: 仓库接入 CodeStable：创建最小骨架，或为 v1 存量项目做无损升级说明。
description_zh: 仓库接入 CodeStable：创建最小骨架，或为 v1 存量项目做无损升级说明。

name: n8n-binary-and-data-official
description: Use when handling files, images, attachments, or binary data in n8n, OR when an AI agent needs to take a user-uploaded file as tool input or return a generated file. For Data Tables (schemas, dedup, persistent state), see the separate n8n-data-tables-official skill. Triggers on "file", "image", "PDF", "attachment", "binary", "upload", "download", chat trigger with files, agent tool that needs a file, vision/multimodal, or any handling of non-JSON file data.
description_zh: 在处理 n8n 中的文件、图像、附件或二进制数据时使用，或者当 AI 代理需要将用户上传的文件作为工具输入或返回生成的文件时使用。有关数据表（模式、去重、持久化状态），请参阅单独的 n8n-data-tables-official 技能。在“文件”、“图像”、“PDF”、“附件”、“二进制”、“上传”、“下载”、带有文件的聊天触发器、需要文件的代理工具、视觉/多模态或任何非 JSON 文件数据的处理时触发。

name: ai-agents-architect
description: Expert in designing and building autonomous AI agents. Masters tool use, memory systems, planning strategies, and multi-agent orchestration.
description_zh: 精通设计和构建自主AI智能体。掌握工具使用、记忆系统、规划策略和多智能体编排。

name: call-list
description: Builds today's call list. Runs lead-triage to rank the top-5 leads most worth calling, supplies talking points from email history, blocks time on the calendar, and drafts follow-up messages. Trigger on "call list," "who am I calling today," "top five to call today," or "block time for calls." An owner who wants leads scored or ranked with no calendar blocks routes to lead-triage directly. Accepts optional count and date arguments.
description_zh: 构建今天的通话清单。运行潜在客户分诊以对最值得联系的5名潜在客户进行排名，从电子邮件历史记录中提供谈话要点，在日历上预留时间，并起草后续消息。在"通话清单"、"我今天要联系谁"、"今天要联系的5名最佳人选"或"为通话预留时间"时触发。希望对潜在客户进行评分或排名且无需在日历上预留时间的所有者将直接路由至潜在客户分诊。接受可选的计数和日期参数。

name: tetris
description: Classic block-game inspired design with playful colors, bold display fonts, and compact, high-energy layouts.
description_zh: 经典方块游戏风格设计，色彩活泼，字体大胆醒目，布局紧凑且充满活力。

name: postbridge-social-growth
description: Organic social media growth coach using the Post Bridge methodology (500M+ views, 132K+ downloads, $33K+ revenue). Act as a personalized growth coach for apps, products, and businesses seeking organic traffic from TikTok and Instagram short-form video. Use when users ask about growing on TikTok/Instagram, creating viral content, getting more views organically, converting social media views to app downloads or customers, warming up new social accounts, finding winning content formats, or scaling organic social media presence. Also use when users need help with social media bios, content-market fit, trend riding, or building a repeatable content system without paid ads.
description_zh: 有机社交媒体增长教练，采用Post Bridge方法论（观看量5000万+，下载量13.2万+，营收33万美元+）。为寻求通过抖音和Instagram短视频获取自然流量的应用程序、产品和企业提供个性化增长指导。当用户询问如何在抖音/Instagram上增长、创作病毒式内容、自然获取更多观看量、将社交媒体观看量转化为应用下载或客户、为新社交媒体账号预热、寻找成功的 内容格式，或扩大自然社交媒体影响力时，可使用。此外，当用户需要帮助优化社交媒体简介、内容与市场契合度、借势热点，或通过非付费广告建立可重复的内容系统时，也可使用。

name: discord-reader
description: Read Discord for financial research through opencli connected to the Discord desktop app: servers, channels, members, recent messages in the active channel, and message search. Use this skill whenever the user wants to check their Discord, list servers or channels, read or search messages in trading, crypto, or market communities, or gauge what a Discord community is saying about a ticker or coin. Read-only: it cannot send, react to, edit, or delete messages.
description_zh: 通过连接到 Discord 桌面应用的 opencli 读取 Discord 进行金融研究：服务器、频道、成员、活跃频道的最近消息以及消息搜索。当用户想要检查 Discord、列出服务器或频道、阅读或搜索交易、加密货币或市场社区的消息，或了解 Discord 社区对某个股票或加密货币的看法时，请使用此技能。仅读权限：无法发送、回复、编辑或删除消息。

name: ccf-common
description: Required shared preflight for every CCFA skill after ccf-humanization: apply routing, scope, prerequisites, evidence rules, handoffs, and artifact contracts. Also maintain and audit these shared rules. Research deliverables remain with their specialist owners.
description_zh: 在ccf-humanization之后，每个CCFA技能都需要共享的预检：应用路由、范围、先决条件、证据规则、交接和工件合同。同时需要维护和审计这些共享规则。研究交付成果仍由其专业负责人保留。

name: run
description: One-shot lifecycle command that chains init → baseline → spawn → eval → merge in a single invocation. Use when the user runs /hub:run or asks to execute a full AgentHub competition end-to-end.
description_zh: 一个一次性生命周期命令，在一个调用中串联 init → baseline → spawn → eval → merge。当用户运行 /hub:run 或要求执行完整的 AgentHub 竞赛端到端时使用。

name: sf-flow
description: Creates and validates Salesforce Flows with 110-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user builds or edits record-triggered, screen, autolaunched, or scheduled flows, or touches .flow-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: Apex automation (use sf-apex), process builder migration questions only, or non-Flow declarative config (use sf-metadata).
description_zh: 创建并验证 Salesforce 流程，采用 110 分评分制。触发条件：当用户创建或编辑记录触发、屏幕、自动启动或计划流程，或接触 .flow-meta.xml 文件时。不触发条件：Apex 自动化（使用 sf-apex）、仅迁移流程构建器问题，或非流程声明性配置（使用 sf-metadata）。

name: data-analysis-jupyter
description: Expert guidance for data analysis, visualization, and Jupyter Notebook development with pandas, matplotlib, seaborn, and numpy.
description_zh: 使用 pandas、matplotlib、seaborn 和 numpy 进行数据分析、可视化和 Jupyter Notebook 开发的专业指导。

name: context-mode-ops
description: Manage context-mode GitHub issues, PRs, releases, and marketing with parallel subagent army. Orchestrates 10-20 dynamic agents per task. Use when triaging issues, reviewing PRs, releasing versions, writing LinkedIn posts, announcing releases, fixing bugs, merging contributions, validating ENV vars, testing adapters, or syncing branches.
description_zh: 使用并行子代理部队管理 GitHub 问题、拉取请求、发布版本和营销。每个任务可协调 10-20 个动态代理。适用于问题分类、拉取请求审核、版本发布、撰写领英帖子、发布版本公告、修复错误、合并贡献、验证环境变量、测试适配器或分支同步。

name: social-media-generator
description: This skill should be used when the user requests social media content creation for Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, or Facebook. It generates platform-optimized posts and saves them in an organized folder structure with meaningful filenames based on event details.
description_zh: 当用户请求为Twitter、Instagram、LinkedIn或Facebook创建社交媒体内容时，应使用此技能。它会生成针对各平台优化的帖子，并将其保存在一个结构化的文件夹中，文件夹名称根据活动详情具有明确的含义。

name: qwencloud-image-generation
description: Generate and edit images using Wan and Qwen Image models. Supports text-to-image, image editing (style transfer, subject consistency, text rendering), and interleaved text-image output. TRIGGER when: user wants to create illustrations, product images, artistic designs, posters, text-to-image generation, edit/transform existing images, apply style transfer, generate images based on reference photos, interleaved text-image content, mentions Wan/Qwen Image models/AI art creation, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-image-generation). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to understand/analyze existing images or OCR (use qwencloud-vision), video generation (use qwencloud-video-generation), text-only tasks.
description_zh: 使用 Wan 和 Qwen 图像模型生成和编辑图像。支持文本到图像、图像编辑（风格迁移、主体一致性、文本渲染）以及文本-图像交错输出。在以下情况下触发：用户想要创建插画、产品图像、艺术设计、海报、文本到图像生成、编辑/转换现有图像、应用风格迁移、根据参考照片生成图像、交错文本-图像内容、提及 Wan/Qwen 图像模型/AI 艺术创作，或通过名称明确调用此技能（例如使用 qwencloud-image-generation）。不触发情况：用户想要理解/分析现有图像或 OCR（使用 qwencloud-vision）、视频生成（使用 qwencloud-video-generation）、纯文本任务。

name: architecture-decision-record
description: ADR templates in the Nygard format with context, decision, consequences, and alternatives. Use when writing ADRs, recording an architectural decision, or evaluating options.
description_zh: 使用 Nygard 格式的 ADR 模板，包含背景、决策、后果和替代方案。在撰写 ADR、记录架构决策或评估选项时使用。

name: make-documentation
description: Use when writing READMEs, architecture, changelogs, release notes, runbooks, notebook docs, install docs, or security articles; produces docs. Do not trigger for API docs, AGENTS.md, or diagrams.
description_zh: 用于编写 README、架构文档、变更日志、发布说明、运行手册、笔记本文档、安装文档或安全文章；生成文档。不要触发 API 文档、AGENTS.md 或图表。

name: tilegym-converting-cutile-to-julia
description: Converts cuTile Python GPU kernels (@ct.kernel) to cuTile.jl Julia equivalents. Handles kernel syntax translation, 0-indexed to 1-indexed conversion, broadcasting differences, memory layout (row-major to column-major), type system mapping, and launch API differences. Use when converting, porting, or translating cuTile Python kernels to Julia cuTile.jl, or debugging/optimizing existing Julia cuTile translations.
description_zh: 将 cuTile Python GPU 内核（@ct.kernel）转换为 cuTile.jl Julia 等价内核。处理内核语法转换、0 索引到 1 索引的转换、广播差异、内存布局（行主序到列主序）、类型系统映射以及启动 API 差异。在将 cuTile Python 内核转换为 Julia cuTile.jl、移植或翻译 cuTile Python 内核，或调试/优化现有 Julia cuTile 翻译时使用。

name: legal-page-generator
description: Deprecated compatibility entry for Legal Page construction. This page is now maintained in Pagina; install and use page-builder to build a new Legal Page.

name: ima-copilot
description: Installs, diagnoses, repairs, and personalizes the official Tencent IMA skill (a wrapper around upstream ima-skill, not a replacement), including fan-out search across IMA knowledge bases with priority boosting. Use when the user mentions IMA / 腾讯 IMA / ima-skill, needs IMA API key setup, 知识库搜索 / 笔记搜索, imports URLs into a KB to extract content, or hits "Skipped loading skill(s) due to invalid SKILL.md" (ima-skill's missing-YAML-frontmatter bug).
description_zh: 安装、诊断、修复和个性化官方腾讯IMA技能（IMA技能的封装，非替代品），包括在IMA知识库中进行分叉搜索并优先提升。当用户提及IMA / 腾讯IMA / ima-skill、需要IMA API密钥设置、知识库搜索 / 笔记搜索，或遇到“由于无效的SKILL.md而跳过加载技能”时使用（ima-skill缺少YAML前导内容的bug）。

name: mapbox-store-locator-patterns
description: Common patterns for building store locators, restaurant finders, and location-based search applications with Mapbox. Covers marker display, filtering, distance calculation, and interactive lists.
description_zh: 使用Mapbox构建店铺定位器、餐厅查找器和基于位置的搜索应用程序的常见模式。涵盖标记显示、筛选、距离计算和交互式列表。

name: wordpress-setup
description: Connect to a WordPress site via WP-CLI over SSH or the REST API. Check CLI, test SSH, set up auth, verify access, save config. Use whenever the user wants to connect to a WordPress site, set up WP-CLI access, create an Application Password, or troubleshoot WordPress connection / auth issues.
description_zh: 通过 SSH 或 REST API 使用 WP-CLI 连接到 WordPress 网站。检查 CLI、测试 SSH、设置认证、验证访问、保存配置。每当用户需要连接到 WordPress 网站、设置 WP-CLI 访问、创建应用密码，或排查 WordPress 连接/认证问题时，均可使用。

name: planetscale-query-insights-and-tags
description: Use PlanetScale Insights and SQLCommenter-style query tags to attribute database load, identify risky queries, and prepare safe Traffic Control or schema recommendations.
description_zh: 使用 PlanetScale Insights 和 SQLCommenter 风格的查询标签来分配数据库负载，识别有风险的查询，并准备安全的流量控制或模式建议。

name: tailwind-patterns
description: Tailwind CSS v4 principles. CSS-first configuration, container queries, modern patterns, design token architecture.
description_zh: Tailwind CSS v4 原则。CSS优先配置、容器查询、现代模式、设计令牌架构。

name: viem-integration
description: Integrate EVM blockchains using viem. Use when user says "read blockchain data", "send transaction", "interact with smart contract", "connect to Ethereum", "use viem", "use wagmi", "wallet integration", "viem setup", or mentions blockchain/EVM development with TypeScript.
description_zh: 使用 viem 集成 EVM 区块链。当用户说“读取区块链数据”、“发送交易”、“与智能合约交互”、“连接到以太坊”、“使用 viem”、“使用 wagmi”、“钱包集成”、“viem 配置”或提及使用 TypeScript 进行区块链/EVM 开发时，请使用。

name: day3-clarify
description: AI Native Camp Day 3 Clarify & GitHub. Clarify 플러그인으로 모호한 요구사항을 명확하게 만들고, 나만의 스킬을 만들고, PRD를 작성하여 GitHub에 첫 PR을 제출한다. "3일차", "Day 3", "clarify", "클래리파이", "PRD", "GitHub" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI Native Camp Day 3 明确与 GitHub。使用 Clarify 插件将模糊的需求明确化，创建自己的技能，撰写 PRD 并在 GitHub 上提交首个 PR。使用“3日”，“Day 3”，“clarify”，“클래리파이”，“PRD”，“GitHub”等术语。

name: postmortem
description: /em:postmortem — Honest analysis of what went wrong. Use after a failed launch, missed quarter, or bad hire to run a blameless 5-Whys retrospective with a change register — e.g. dissecting why the Q3 release slipped six weeks.
description_zh: /em:事后分析 — 对问题进行坦诚的剖析。在产品发布失败、错过季度目标或出现不当招聘后使用，结合变更记录，进行无责5Why回顾分析，例如剖析Q3发布延期六周的原因。

name: wcag-accessibility-audit
description: Comprehensive web accessibility audit using WCAG 2.1/2.2 guidelines. Evaluate compliance across 4 POUR principles (Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust) with A, AA, AAA conformance levels.
description_zh: 使用 WCAG 2.1/2.2 指南进行全面网站无障碍性审核。评估符合 4 个 POUR 原则（可感知、可操作、可理解、稳定）的 A、AA、AAA 合规级别。

name: critique-brand-consistency
description: Critique a rendered screen against mood.md, voice.md, and tokens.md. Use when those brand files exist and you are checking compliance. For defining the visual language itself, use `illustration-style` (ui-design).
description_zh: 对照 mood.md、voice.md 和 tokens.md 对渲染屏幕进行评估。当这些品牌文件存在且您正在检查合规性时使用。定义视觉语言本身时，请使用 `illustration-style`（ui-design）。

name: navigation-patterns
description: Select and design a navigation pattern — tabs, drawer, hierarchy, or hub — matched to product structure and user tasks. Use when choosing how users move between sections. For the underlying content structure, use `information-architecture` (ux-strategy).
description_zh: 选择并设计一个与产品结构和用户任务相匹配的导航模式——标签页、抽屉、层级或中心——用于选择用户如何在各部分之间切换。对于底层的内容结构，使用 `information-architecture` (ux-strategy)。

name: planetscale-schema-recommendations-agent-loop
description: Safely triage PlanetScale schema recommendations and turn them into reviewed branches, migrations, issues, or pull requests without applying production changes.
description_zh: 安全地筛选 PlanetScale 模式建议，并将其转化为已审核的分支、迁移、问题或拉取请求，而无需应用生产变更。

name: qdrant-monitoring
description: Guides Qdrant monitoring and observability setup. Use when someone asks 'how to monitor Qdrant', 'what metrics to track', 'is Qdrant healthy', 'optimizer stuck', 'why is memory growing', 'requests are slow', 'set up alerts', 'cluster health check', or needs to set up Prometheus, Grafana, health checks, or log centralization. Also use when debugging production issues that require metric analysis.
description_zh: 指导Qdrant监控和可观测性设置。当有人问“如何监控Qdrant”、“要跟踪哪些指标”、“Qdrant是否健康”、“优化器卡住”、“内存为何增长”、“请求为何缓慢”、“设置警报”、“集群健康检查”，或需要设置Prometheus、Grafana、健康检查或日志集中化时使用。也用于调试需要指标分析的生产问题。

name: rag-retrieval
description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation patterns for grounded LLM responses. Use when building RAG pipelines, embedding documents, implementing hybrid search, contextual retrieval, HyDE, agentic RAG, multimodal RAG, query decomposition, reranking, or pgvector search.
description_zh: 基于检索增强生成的模式，用于实现有据可依的大型语言模型响应。在构建 RAG 管道、嵌入文档、实现混合搜索、上下文检索、HyDE、智能体式 RAG、多模态 RAG、查询分解、重新排序或 pgvector 搜索时使用。

name: handover
description: Generate project handover documentation for AEM Edge Delivery Services projects. Creates comprehensive guides for content authors, developers, and administrators. Use for "handover docs", "project documentation", "generate handover", "create guides".
description_zh: 为 AEM Edge Delivery Services 项目生成项目交接文档。为内容作者、开发人员和管理员创建全面的指南。用于“交接文档”、“项目文档”、“生成交接”和“创建指南”。

name: audience-growth-tracker-sms
description: When the user wants to track follower growth, understand what drives new followers, or analyze audience development. Also use when the user mentions 'follower growth,' 'followers,' 'audience growth,' 'gaining followers,' 'losing followers,' 'who follows me,' or 'grow my audience.' Uses BlackTwist follower data when available. For post-level metrics, see performance-analyzer-sms. For content patterns, see content-pattern-analyzer-sms.
description_zh: 当用户想要追踪粉丝增长、了解新粉丝增长的原因或分析受众发展时，也适用于用户提及“粉丝增长”、“粉丝”、“受众增长”、“增加粉丝”、“失去粉丝”、“谁关注我”或“扩大我的受众”时。在有BlackTwist粉丝数据时使用。关于帖子级别的指标，请参阅performance-analyzer-sms。关于内容模式，请参阅content-pattern-analyzer-sms。

name: full-output-enforcement
description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.
description_zh: 覆盖默认的LLM截断行为。强制完整代码生成，禁止占位符模式，并干净地处理token限制分割。适用于任何需要详尽、完整输出的任务。

name: om-create-skill
description: Author a new OM skill from a brief, or split an oversized SKILL.md into layered references/ files — conservatively, behind the lint + completeness gate. Knows the layering philosophy, lint invariants, tracker abstraction, and the cross-skill contract, so output matches house conventions. Use for "create a skill for…", "new om-skill", "split this skill into references".
description_zh: 从简短描述中编写新的OM技能，或将过大的SKILL.md拆分为分层引用/文件——保守地，在代码风格检查和完整性门禁之后。了解分层理念、代码风格检查不变量、追踪器抽象和跨技能契约，以确保输出符合公司规范。用于“为……创建技能”、“新OM技能”、“将此技能拆分为引用”。

name: pr-lens
description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

name: experiment-code
description: Write ML experiment code with iterative improvement. Generate training/evaluation pipelines, debug errors, and optimize results through code reflection. Use when implementing experiments for a research paper.
description_zh: 使用迭代改进方法编写机器学习实验代码。生成训练/评估流程，调试错误，并通过代码反思优化结果。适用于为研究论文实现实验。

name: gsd-2-agent-framework
description: Meta-prompting, context engineering, and spec-driven development system for autonomous long-running coding agents
description_zh: 元提示、上下文工程和基于规范的自主长时运行编码代理开发系统

name: day4-wrap-and-analyze
description: AI Native Camp Day 4 Wrap & Analyze. session-wrap 스킬을 직접 만들고, history-insight와 session-analyzer로 세션을 분석한다. "4일차", "Day 4", "wrap", "세션 분석", "session wrap", "세션 래핑" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI Native Camp 第四天总结与分析。通过直接创建技能，使用history-insight和session-analyzer进行会话分析。"四天", "Day 4", "总结", "会话分析", "session wrap", "会话封装"等术语被使用。

name: ionic-design
description: Guide to using Ionic Framework components for beautiful native-looking Capacitor apps. Covers component usage, theming, platform-specific styling, and best practices for mobile UI. Use this skill when users need help with Ionic components or mobile UI design.
description_zh: 使用 Ionic 框架组件创建美观的原生外观 Capacitor 应用的指南。涵盖组件使用、主题定制、平台特定样式以及移动 UI 设计的最佳实践。当用户需要帮助使用 Ionic 组件或进行移动 UI 设计时，请使用此技能。

name: planetscale-autonomous-execution-mode
description: Execute approved PlanetScale changes end-to-end without per-step approval when the operator has explicitly acknowledged the risk. Defines the risk-acknowledgment contract, scoped autonomy levels, sensible execution ordering, continuous status reporting, halt conditions, and rollback discipline. Extremely safe, very enabling.
description_zh: 在操作员明确承认风险的情况下，无需每一步审批即可端到端执行已批准的PlanetScale变更。定义风险承认协议、范围自主级别、合理的执行顺序、持续状态报告、停止条件和回滚规范。极其安全，非常赋能。

name: planetscale-safe-orchestrator
description: Master skill that runs the full PlanetScale safe best-practices assessment — inventory, engine review, Insights, Traffic Control, webhooks, schema recommendations, codebase instrumentation, and agent operating model — then produces a unified recommendations report. Never applies changes without explicit approval. Use when the user asks to run the full assessment, all skills, or PlanetScale best-practices review.
description_zh: 掌握可运行完整 PlanetScale 安全最佳实践评估的主技能——包括清单、引擎审查、Insights、流量控制、webhooks、模式建议、代码库仪器和代理操作模型——然后生成一份统一的建议报告。未经明确批准，绝不应用变更。当用户要求运行完整评估、所有技能或 PlanetScale 最佳实践审查时使用。

name: migrate-to-factory
description: Migrates user-specified skills and their supporting scripts, references, assets, and workflow instructions into an existing Warp Factory configuration repository. Use when a user asks to port or adapt an existing agent workflow into Factory agents and skills. Do not use for routine Factory-file edits or for registering or operating a live Factory.

name: ui-components
description: UI component library patterns for shadcn/ui and Radix Primitives. Use when building accessible component libraries, customizing shadcn components, using Radix unstyled primitives, or creating design system foundations.
description_zh: shadcn/ui 和 Radix Primitives 的 UI 组件库模式。在构建可访问性组件库、自定义 shadcn 组件、使用 Radix 无样式原语或创建设计系统基础时使用。

name: monday-brief
description: Runs the owner's Monday morning briefing as a two-link chain — business-pulse for the cross-connector snapshot of cash, sales, and pipeline, and report-builder for any saved KPI reports the owner has already defined — then reads the week ahead straight from Calendar and mail and merges all three parts into a single one-page Monday document, delivered per the owner's stored output preference. Requires no connectors and degrades gracefully, building from whatever of the ledger (MYOB, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, or Zoho Books), Calendar, DocuSign, Expensify, Gmail or M365, HubSpot, PayPal, Ramp, RingEx Chat, Shopify, Slack, Stripe, and TikTok Ads is connected, or from pasted and uploaded data when none are. Trigger on "Monday brief," "start my week," "what do I need to know this week," "weekly briefing," "catch me up before Monday," or when the owner schedules a recurring start-of-week update.
description_zh: 运行所有者每周一早上的简报，以双链形式进行——业务脉搏链，用于跨连接器快照的现金流、销售额和管道报告，以及报告构建链，用于所有者已定义的任何保存的KPI报告——然后直接从日历和邮件中读取本周计划，并将这三部分合并成一个单页的周一文档，根据所有者存储的输出偏好进行交付。无需连接器，且优雅降级，从连接的账簿（MYOB、NetSuite、QuickBooks、Xero或Zoho Books）、日历、DocuSign、Expensify、Gmail或M365、HubSpot、PayPal、Ramp、RingEx Chat、Shopify、Slack、Stripe和TikTok Ads中构建数据，或在没有连接时从粘贴和上传的数据中构建。在触发于“周一简报”、“开始我的周”、“这周我需要知道什么”、“周报”、“在周一前让我了解情况”，或所有者安排了每周初更新的情况下启动。

name: n8n-loops-official
description: Use when working with multi-item data, batches, paginated APIs, rate-limited APIs, fan-out across multiple branches, anything that needs to "do this for each", or any time the user mentions looping, iterating, batching, paging, parallelism, or "loop over items". Triggers on "loop", "iterate", "for each", "batch", "page through", "paginate", "rate limit", "process all", "fan-out", "parallel branches", "concurrency", or any node that should run once vs once-per-item.
description_zh: 在处理多项目数据、批量处理、分页 API、速率限制 API、跨多个分支分发时使用，或者任何需要“为每个执行”的场景，或者用户提到循环、迭代、批量处理、分页、并行处理或“遍历项目”时。触发条件包括“循环”、“迭代”、“为每个”、“批量处理”、“逐页浏览”、“分页”、“速率限制”、“处理所有”、“分发”、“并行分支”、“并发”或任何应单个运行而非每个项目单独运行的节点。

name: ticket-deflector
description: Reads a forwarded customer email or ticket, pulls order and refund status from a payments connector (PayPal, Square, or Stripe) or Shopify, account history from the CRM, and open tickets from a support desk (Zoho Desk), drafts a tone-matched reply in the owner's writing voice, and can issue a refund through the payments connector with explicit owner approval. With Shopify connected it also runs a proactive order-triage mode that surfaces orders needing attention — unfulfilled past the promised window, payment problems, pending refunds, stuck shipments — and drafts the next action for each before the customer has to ask. Use when the user says "draft a response," "answer this customer," "where's my order," "I want a refund," "check my orders," or "anything about to blow up."
description_zh: 读取转发的客户邮件或工单，从支付连接器（PayPal、Square 或 Stripe）或 Shopify 中提取订单和退款状态，从 CRM 中获取账户历史记录，并从支持台（Zoho Desk）获取未关闭的工单，以匹配语气风格并以所有者的写作口吻起草回复，并在获得所有者明确批准后，可通过支付连接器发起退款。若与 Shopify 连接，它还会运行主动式订单分诊模式，将需要关注的订单（如承诺时限已过仍未履行的订单、支付问题、待处理的退款、卡住的发货等）呈现出来，并在客户提出问题前为每个订单起草下一步行动方案。当用户说“起草回复”、“回复这位客户”、“我的订单在哪里”、“我想退款”、“检查我的订单”或“有什么问题即将爆发”时使用。

name: apollo-router-plugin-creator
description: Guide for writing Apollo Router native Rust plugins. Use this skill when: (1) users want to create a new router plugin, (2) users want to add service hooks (router_service, supergraph_service, execution_service, subgraph_service), (3) users want to modify an existing router plugin, (4) users need to understand router plugin patterns or the request lifecycle. (5) triggers on requests like "create a new plugin", "add a router plugin", "modify the X plugin", or "add subgraph_service hook".
description_zh: 编写 Apollo Router 原生 Rust 插件的指南。在以下情况使用此技能：(1) 用户希望创建一个新的路由插件，(2) 用户希望添加服务钩子（router_service、supergraph_service、execution_service、subgraph_service），(3) 用户希望修改现有的路由插件，(4) 用户需要了解路由插件模式或请求生命周期。(5) 在请求触发时，如“创建新插件”、“添加路由插件”、“修改 X 插件”或“添加 subgraph_service 钩子”。

name: yt-dlp
description: Download videos and extract audio from various platforms using yt-dlp. Use when user provides a video URL, asks to download a video, or when conversation contains video links from YouTube, Twitter/X, Vimeo, TikTok, Instagram, etc.

name: animation-systems
description: Use when designing or implementing product-grade web motion like Stripe, Linear, Apple, and Vercel. Covers motion principles, easing/duration defaults, choreography patterns, scroll/hover interactions, performance, accessibility (reduced motion), and implementation guidance.
description_zh: 在设计或实现类似 Stripe、Linear、Apple 和 Vercel 的产品级网页动效时使用。涵盖动效原理、缓动/持续时间默认值、编排模式、滚动/悬停交互、性能、无障碍（减少动画）以及实施指南。

name: ccf-paper-writer
description: Draft, revise, polish, compress, or presentation-adapt CCF manuscript prose. Use for 写作, 润色论文, 改写, 压缩论文, abstracts, sections, slides, and rewrites based on reviews. Preserve supplied evidence and format. Assessment without rewriting belongs to ccf-paper-reviewer; rebuttal belongs to ccf-rebuttal-writer.
description_zh: 草拟、修改、润色、压缩或根据演示需求调整CCF论文文稿。用于写作、润色论文、改写、压缩论文、摘要、章节、幻灯片以及根据审稿意见进行重写。保留提供的证据和格式。未经改写的评估属于ccf-paper-reviewer；反驳意见属于ccf-rebuttal-writer。

name: betting
description:
Betting analysis — odds conversion, de-vigging, edge detection, Kelly criterion, arbitrage detection, parlay analysis, and line movement. Pure computation, no API calls. Works with odds from any source: ESPN (American odds), Polymarket (decimal probabilities), Kalshi (integer probabilities).

Use when: user asks about bet sizing, expected value, edge analysis, Kelly criterion, arbitrage, parlays, line movement, odds conversion, or comparing odds across sources. Also use when you have odds from ESPN and a prediction market price and want to evaluate whether a bet has positive expected value.
Don't use when: user asks for live odds or market data — use polymarket, kalshi, or the sport-specific skill to fetch odds first, then use this skill to analyze them.
description_zh:
投注分析——赔率转换、去 vigging（去除庄家抽水）、优势检测、凯利公式、套利检测、串关分析以及赔率变动。纯计算，无需 API 调用。支持任何来源的赔率：ESPN（美国赔率）、Polymarket（小数概率）、Kalshi（整数概率）。

使用场景：当用户询问投注额度、期望值、优势分析、凯利公式、套利、串关、赔率变动、赔率转换或跨平台赔率比较时。也适用于当您拥有 ESPN 赔率和一个预测市场价格，并希望评估投注是否具有正期望值的情况。

不适用场景：当用户询问实时赔率或市场数据时——请先使用 Polymarket、Kalshi 或特定体育技能获取赔率，然后使用此技能进行分析。

name: smb-onboard
description: Claude as the trainer. Walks an SMB owner through connecting their first two tools, runs one recipe to prove immediate value, interviews them about their business (industry, size, top three headaches), stores that context persistently so every other skill benefits, and sets a weekly check-in cadence. Use when the owner is getting started or says any of: "set me up," "setup," "help me get set up," "get started," "help me get started," "get me started," "what can you do," "I'm new to this," or is in their first session.
description_zh: 作为训练师，Claude会引导小型企业主连接他们的前两个工具，运行一个配方来证明即时价值，采访他们的业务情况（行业、规模、最头疼的三个问题），并将这些上下文信息持久化存储，以便其他技能也能受益，同时设定每周的检查频率。在小型企业主刚开始使用或说出以下任何一句时使用： "帮我设置好"、"设置"、"帮我设置"、"开始"、"帮我开始"、"让我开始"、"你能做什么"、"我对这个不熟悉"，或是在他们的首次会话中。

name: cs-feat
description: 实现新功能或功能改造。不用于纯 bug 修复（cs-issue）、行为等价重构（cs-refactor）、大需求拆解（cs-epic）。
description_zh: 实现新功能或功能改造。不用于纯 bug 修复（cs-issue）、行为等价重构（cs-refactor）、大需求拆解（cs-epic）。

name: n8n-multi-instance
description: Use when an n8n-mcp account targets more than one n8n instance — i.e. the `n8n_instances` tool is available, the user mentions multiple n8n instances or environments (prod vs staging, several teams or clients), a workflow / datatable / credential / execution call returns an unexpected NOT_FOUND or reads data you don't recognize, or a credential create/update/delete is refused with an `INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS` error. Covers choosing and switching which instance this MCP session targets, verifying the target before high-stakes work — credential writes above all — and recovering from misroutes and ambiguous-write fail-closes. Always consult this skill before operating on a specific instance, before any credential create/update/delete on a multi-instance account, or when a call hits the wrong/empty data or an `INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS` error.
description_zh: 当 n8n-mcp 账户针对多个 n8n 实例时使用——即 `n8n_instances` 工具可用、用户提及多个 n8n 实例或环境（生产 vs 预发布、多个团队或客户）、工作流/数据表/凭证/执行调用返回意外的 NOT_FOUND 或读取到您不认识的 数据，或凭证创建/更新/删除操作因 `INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS` 错误被拒绝时。涵盖选择和切换此 MCP 会话所针对的实例、在执行高风险操作前（尤其是凭证写入）验证目标，以及从错误路由和模糊写入的失败锁定中恢复。在操作特定实例前、在多实例账户上进行任何凭证创建/更新/删除操作前，或调用命中错误/空数据或 `INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS` 错误时，务必使用此技能。

name: paper-assembly
description: Orchestrate the full paper pipeline end-to-end. Manage state propagation between phases (literature → plan → code → experiments → figures → tables → writing → review), support checkpointing and resumption. Use for assembling a complete paper from components.
description_zh: 端到端地编排整篇论文的完整流程。管理各阶段（文献综述→计划→代码→实验→图表→表格→写作→审阅）之间的状态传递，支持检查点和恢复功能。用于从组件中组装一篇完整的论文。

name: paper-to-code
description: Convert an ML research paper into a complete, runnable code repository. 3-stage pipeline from Paper2Code — Planning (UML + dependency graph) → Analysis (per-file logic) → Coding (dependency-ordered generation). Use for reproducing paper methods.
description_zh: 将一篇机器学习研究论文转换为一个完整的、可运行的代码仓库。Paper2Code的3阶段流程——规划（UML + 依赖图）→ 分析（逐文件逻辑）→ 编码（依赖顺序生成）。用于复现论文方法。

name: tailwindcss
description: Expert in TailwindCSS utility-first styling with responsive design patterns
description_zh: 精通 TailwindCSS 的 Utility-First 样式和响应式设计模式

name: n8n-extending-mcp-official
description: Use when you want to expose an n8n workflow as a tool the coding agent can call. Two cases. (1) Wrap n8n API capabilities the MCP doesn't natively expose: folder deletion, project create/rename, tag rename/delete, instance metadata, credential creation. (2) Expose a general-purpose workflow as an agent tool: a workflow that calls a third-party API, runs business logic, or does any task you want the agent to invoke. Triggers on "expose as MCP tool", "build a tool for my agent", "I need to know X" where X isn't an MCP tool, "delete folder", "rename tag", or any capability gap.
description_zh: 当您希望将 n8n 工作流作为可被编码代理调用的工具时使用。有两种情况。(1) 封装 MCP 未原生提供的 n8n API 功能：文件夹删除、项目创建/重命名、标签重命名/删除、实例元数据、凭证创建。(2) 将通用工作流作为代理工具进行暴露：一个调用第三方 API、执行业务逻辑或执行代理需要调用的任何任务的工作流。触发条件为“作为 MCP 工具进行暴露”、“为我的代理构建工具”、“我需要了解 X”（其中 X 不是 MCP 工具）、“删除文件夹”、“重命名标签”或任何功能差距。

name: day2-mcp-and-context-sync
description: AI Native Camp Day 2 MCP & Context Sync. MCP를 배우고 나만의 Context Sync 스킬을 만든다. "2일차", "Day 2", "MCP", "context sync" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI Native Camp Day 2 MCP & Context Sync. 学习MCP，并打造属于我的Context Sync技能。"2日", "Day 2", "MCP", "context sync"用于请求。

name: shadertoy
description: This skill should be used when working with Shadertoy shaders, GLSL fragment shaders, or creating procedural graphics for the web. Use when writing .glsl files, implementing visual effects, creating generative art, or working with WebGL shader code. This skill provides GLSL ES syntax reference, common shader patterns, and Shadertoy-specific conventions.
description_zh: 在使用Shadertoy着色器、GLSL片段着色器或为网络创建程序化图形时，应使用此技能。在编写.glsl文件、实现视觉效果、创建生成艺术或处理WebGL着色器代码时使用。此技能提供GLSL ES语法参考、常见着色器模式以及Shadertoy特定约定。

name: capacitor-plugins
description: Guides the agent through installing, configuring, and using Capacitor plugins from six sources — official Capacitor plugins, Capawesome plugins, Capacitor Community plugins, Capacitor Firebase plugins, Capacitor MLKit plugins, and RevenueCat plugins. Covers installation, platform-specific configuration (Android and iOS), and basic usage examples. Do not use for migrating Capacitor apps or plugins to a newer version, setting up Capacitor Live Updates, or non-Capacitor mobile frameworks.
description_zh: 指导代理从六个来源安装、配置和使用 Capacitor 插件——官方 Capacitor 插件、Capawesome 插件、Capacitor 社区插件、Capacitor Firebase 插件、Capacitor MLKit 插件和 RevenueCat 插件。涵盖安装、平台特定配置（Android 和 iOS）以及基本使用示例。不适用于将 Capacitor 应用或插件迁移到新版本、设置 Capacitor Live Updates 或非 Capacitor 移动框架。

name: r3f-physics
description: Add Rapier rigid bodies, colliders, forces, sensors, and joints to React Three Fiber. Use for collision-driven movement and simulation; use animation guidance for purely visual motion.
description_zh: 为 React Three Fiber 添加 Rapier 的刚体、碰撞体、力、传感器和关节。用于基于碰撞的运动和模拟；使用动画指导实现纯视觉运动。

name: day4-wrap-and-analyze
description: AI Native Camp Day 4 Wrap & Analyze + 콘텐츠 소화. session-wrap 스킬을 직접 만들고, history-insight와 session-analyzer로 세션을 분석하고, 콘텐츠 소화 파이프라인을 체험한다. "4일차", "Day 4", "wrap", "세션 분석", "session wrap", "세션 래핑", "fetch", "콘텐츠" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI Native Camp 第四天总结与分析+内容消化。通过直接创建session-wrap技能，使用history-insight和session-analyzer进行会话分析，并体验内容消化管道。使用"第四天"、"Day 4"、"总结"、"会话分析"、"session wrap"、"会话包装"、"fetch"、"内容"等术语。

name: om-close-fixed-issues
description: Close the tracker issues that recently merged PRs authoritatively fixed — via `fixes`/`closes`/`resolves` keywords or `closingIssuesReferences` — and post informational comments on issues whose PRs were closed without merging or merged into a non-base branch. Use for post-merge housekeeping and release prep. Respects claim locks and never acts on bare `#N` mentions.
description_zh: 关闭最近通过 PR 合并且由 `fixes`/`closes`/`resolves` 关键字或 `closingIssuesReferences` 正式修复的追踪问题，并在 PR 未合并或合并到非主分支的问题上发布信息性评论。用于合并后的清理工作和发布准备。尊重声明锁定，并且永远不会对裸 `#N` 提及采取行动。

name: typegpu
description: TypeGPU is type-safe WebGPU in TypeScript. Use whenever the user writes, debugs, or designs TypeGPU code: 'use gpu' shader functions, tgpu.fn, buffers, textures, bind groups, compute and render pipelines, command encoders, render passes, render bundles, vertex layouts, slots, accessors, @typegpu/react hooks (useRoot, useFrame, useUniform), React Native worklet rendering, and any TypeGPU API. Shader logic and CPU-side resources are tightly coupled - handle both sides here even if the user only mentions one (e.g. "how do I write a shader", "how do I create a buffer"). Trigger on any mention of typegpu, tgpu, "use gpu", TypedGPU, or WebGPU code written using TypeGPU's schema API (d.*, tgpu.*, std.*). Do NOT trigger for raw WebGPU (using GPUDevice/GPURenderPipeline directly without tgpu), WGSL-only questions, Three.js, Babylon.js, or WebGL.
description_zh: TypeGPU 是 TypeScript 中的类型安全 WebGPU。在用户编写、调试或设计 TypeGPU 代码时使用：'use gpu' 着色器函数、tgpu.fn、缓冲区、纹理、绑定组、计算和渲染管线、命令编码器、渲染通道、渲染包、顶点布局、插槽、访问器、@typegpu/react 钩子（useRoot、useFrame、useUniform）、React Native 工作集渲染，以及任何 TypeGPU API。着色器逻辑和 CPU 端资源紧密耦合——即使用户只提到其中一方（例如，“如何编写着色器”、“如何创建缓冲区”），也需在此处理双方。在提及 typegpu、tgpu、“use gpu”、TypedGPU 或使用 TypeGPU 模式 API 编写的 WebGPU 代码时触发（d.*、tgpu.*、std.*）。不适用于原始 WebGPU（直接使用 GPUDevice/GPURenderPipeline 而不使用 tgpu）、仅涉及 WGSL 的问题、Three.js、Babylon.js 或 WebGL。

name: senior-architect
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "design system architecture", "evaluate microservices vs monolith", "create architecture diagrams", "analyze dependencies", "choose a database", "plan for scalability", "make technical decisions", or "review system design". Use for architecture decision records (ADRs), tech stack evaluation, system design reviews, dependency analysis, and generating architecture diagrams in Mermaid, PlantUML, or ASCII format.
description_zh: 当用户要求“设计系统架构”、“评估微服务与单体架构”、“创建架构图”、“分析依赖关系”、“选择数据库”、“规划可扩展性”、“做出技术决策”或“评审系统设计”时，应使用此技能。适用于架构决策记录（ADRs）、技术栈评估、系统设计评审、依赖关系分析，以及生成 Mermaid、PlantUML 或 ASCII 格式的架构图。

name: terms-page-generator
description: Deprecated compatibility entry for Terms Page construction. This page is now maintained in Pagina; install and use page-builder to build a new Terms Page.

name: cn-stats
description: 中国国家统计局公开数据查询技能，当用户想查询经济、CPI、GDP、人口、房价指数等数据时触发。
description_zh: 中国国家统计局公开数据查询功能，当用户需要查询经济、CPI、GDP、人口、房价指数等数据时触发。

name: board-prep
description: Board meeting preparation for the adversarial scenario, not the friendly one. Forces numbers-cold mastery, anticipates hard questions, builds a narrative that acknowledges weakness without losing the room. Use when preparing for a board meeting, an investor update, fundraising presentation, or any high-stakes adversarial review where every number must live in your head not just on a slide.
description_zh: 针对对抗性场景而非友好场景的董事会准备工作。强调对数字的冷门掌握，预判难题，构建一个承认弱点但不失主导权的叙述。适用于准备董事会会议、投资者更新、融资演示或任何高风险对抗性评审，其中每个数字都必须牢记于心，而不仅限于幻灯片上。

name: cs-issue
description: 诊断或修复 bug、报错、性能回退或既有行为异常。不用于新功能（cs-feat）或行为等价重构（cs-refactor）。
description_zh: 诊断或修复 bug、报错、性能回退或既有行为异常。不用于新功能（cs-feat）或行为等价重构（cs-refactor）。

name: sf-metadata
description: Salesforce metadata generation and querying with 120-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user creates custom objects, fields, validation rules, or touches .object-meta.xml, .field-meta.xml, .profile-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: permission set analysis (use sf-permissions), deploying metadata (use sf-deploy), or Flow XML (use sf-flow).
description_zh: 使用120分制进行Salesforce元数据生成和查询。TRIGGER在以下情况触发：用户创建自定义对象、字段、验证规则，或触碰 .object-meta.xml、.field-meta.xml、.profile-meta.xml 文件。以下情况不触发：权限集分析（使用sf-permissions）、部署元数据（使用sf-deploy）或Flow XML（使用sf-flow）。

name: fusion-skills
description: Entrypoint for all Fusion skill lifecycle operations. USE FOR: finding, installing, updating, syncing, or greenkeeping skills; setting up skill automation; creating or authoring a new skill; reporting a bug with a skill. DO NOT USE FOR: resolving GitHub issues, reviewing PRs, planning task breakdowns, or authoring GitHub issues — those are handled by other Fusion skills.
description_zh: 所有 Fusion 技能生命周期操作的入口点。用途：查找、安装、更新、同步或维护技能；设置技能自动化；创建或编写新技能；报告技能中的错误。不适用：解决 GitHub 问题、审查 PR、规划任务分解或编写 GitHub 问题——这些由其他 Fusion 技能处理。

name: sentry-instrument
description: Instrument an application with Sentry — detect the platform, install and initialize the SDK if needed, and wire up any signal — error monitoring, tracing/performance, logging, metrics, profiling, session replay, user feedback, cron check-ins, and AI/LLM monitoring (agent runs, token cost, and conversations for OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI, LangChain, Google GenAI, Pydantic AI, Laravel AI, Eve, Flue, the Cloudflare Agents SDK, and Workers AI). Use to add Sentry to a project or to capture more than errors.
description_zh: 使用Sentry为应用程序进行监控——检测平台，在需要时安装并初始化SDK，并连接任何信号——错误监控、追踪/性能、日志记录、指标、性能分析、会话回放、用户反馈、定时任务检查以及AI/LLM监控（包括代理运行、令牌成本和OpenAI、Anthropic、Vercel AI、LangChain、Google GenAI、Pydantic AI、Laravel AI、Eve、Flue、Cloudflare Agents SDK以及Workers AI的对话）。用于将Sentry添加到项目中或捕获比错误更多的情况。

name: om-merge-buddy
description: Scan open pull requests via the configured tracker, classify merge readiness from labels, reviews, CI, and mergeability, then report which PRs can merge now and which ones are close but blocked.
description_zh: 通过配置的追踪器扫描公开的拉取请求，根据标签、评审、持续集成（CI）和合并能力对合并就绪情况进行分类，然后报告哪些拉取请求可以立即合并，哪些虽然接近但被阻塞。

name: tanstack-ai
description: Provider-agnostic, type-safe AI SDK for streaming, tool calling, structured output, and multimodal content.
description_zh: 面向提供者无关、类型安全的 AI SDK，用于流式处理、工具调用、结构化输出和多模态内容。

name: plan
description: Define intended behavior, review write scope and assess reversible decisions. Use when: discovery needs clarification or resumption before one complete slice; stop once actionable.
description_zh: 定义预期行为，审查写入范围并评估可逆决策。使用场景：在完成一个切片之前需要澄清或恢复发现；一旦可操作即停止。

name: speckit-analyze
description: Perform a non-destructive cross-artifact consistency and quality analysis across spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md after task generation.
description_zh: 在任务生成后，对spec.md、plan.md和tasks.md进行无损的跨文档一致性和质量分析。

name: qwencloud-update-check
description: Check for qwencloud-ai updates and notify the user when a new version is available. TRIGGER when: user asks to check for updates, check version, asks 'is there a new version', 'latest version', 'update skills', 'check update', or any other qwen skill delegates to this skill, or user explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-update-check). DO NOT TRIGGER when: non-update-related tasks, general version questions about other software.
description_zh:
检查 qwencloud-ai 的更新，并在有新版本可用时通知用户。  
触发条件：当用户要求检查更新、查询版本、询问“是否有新版本”、“最新版本”、“更新技能”、“检查更新”，或任何其他将 qwen 功能委托给此技能的情况，或用户通过名称显式调用此技能（例如使用 qwencloud-update-check）。  
不触发条件：非更新相关的任务、关于其他软件的一般版本问题。

name: ue-component-model
description: Use this when the user mentions component models, component definitions, component filters, block configuration for the Universal Editor, UE block setup, adding a new block to UE, configuring block properties or block authoring fields, or wants to create an EDS/Franklin block with Universal Editor support, modify block fields, or add a block to the section filter. Covers creating and editing the three JSON files that control how AEM Edge Delivery Services blocks appear and behave in the Universal Editor — component-definition.json, component-models.json, and component-filters.json.
description_zh: 当用户提及组件模型、组件定义、组件过滤器、通用编辑器的块配置、UE块设置、向UE添加新块、配置块属性或块作者字段，或希望使用通用编辑器创建支持通用编辑器的EDS/Franklin块、修改块字段或向部分过滤器添加块时，请使用此功能。涵盖创建和编辑控制AEM Edge Delivery Services块在通用编辑器中显示和行为的三种JSON文件——component-definition.json、component-models.json和component-filters.json。

name: autoskill
description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.
description_zh: 通过 screenpipe 观察用户屏幕，检测重复的研究工作流程，将其与现有的 scientific-agent-skills 进行匹配，并为尚未覆盖的模式起草新的技能（或串联现有技能的组合配方）。当用户要求分析其近期工作并根据他们实际操作的内容提出技能时使用。需要本地运行 screenpipe 守护进程（https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe）在 3030 端口——该技能没有其他数据源，如果 screenpipe 无法访问将拒绝运行。所有检测均在本地进行；只有经过脱敏处理的集群摘要会发送给 LLM。

name: create-site
description: Use this when a user wants to create a brand-new AEM Edge Delivery site from scratch and no GitHub repository or DA content exists yet — triggers include 'set up a new site', 'create a new EDS project', or 'onboard a new site'. Covers creating the GitHub repo from the boilerplate, installing aem-code-sync, seeding initial DA content (nav, footer, homepage), and returning a live preview URL. For importing or migrating existing pages use page-import; for building blocks on an existing site use content-driven-development.
description_zh: 当用户希望从零开始创建全新的AEM Edge Delivery站点，且目前不存在GitHub仓库或DA内容时，请使用此功能。触发条件包括“设置新站点”、“创建新的EDS项目”或“上线新站点”。该功能涵盖从模板创建GitHub仓库、安装aem-code-sync、预置初始DA内容（导航、页脚、首页）以及返回可预览的URL。若需导入或迁移现有页面，请使用page-import；若要在现有站点上构建组件，请使用content-driven-development。

name: day1-test-skill
description: Day 1 테스트 스킬. "/day1-test-skill" 입력 시 실행된다. Skill이 어떻게 동작하는지 직접 체험하는 용도.
description_zh: 第一天测试技能。输入“/day1-test-skill”时执行。用于直接体验技能是如何运作的。

name: n8n-data-tables-official
description: Use when working with n8n's built-in Data Tables, designing schemas, inserting/updating/upserting rows, deduping, or querying. Triggers on "Data Table", "data table", `n8n-nodes-base.dataTable`, "dedup", "idempotency", "lookup", "persistent state", "store across executions", or any schema design discussion inside n8n.
description_zh: 在处理n8n的内置数据表、设计模式、插入/更新/合并插入行、去重或查询时使用。当触发器为"数据表"、"data table"、"n8n-nodes-base.dataTable"、"dedup"、"idempotency"、"lookup"、"持久状态"、"跨执行存储"或n8n内部任何模式设计讨论时使用。

name: debug-my-harness
description: Diagnose why an agent harness misbehaved by reading the local flight-recorder ledger (.vigiles/runs.jsonl) — which skills fired or got hijacked, which hooks blocked or wrongly allowed, which subagent tool-contract violations happened, and how a skill's trigger rate moved. Use when asked why a skill stopped firing, why a hook didn't block, why the wrong skill ran, or to debug/investigate what the harness actually did. NOT for writing new rules (use strengthen) or editing the spec (use edit-spec).
description_zh: 通过读取本地飞行记录账本（.vigiles/runs.jsonl）来诊断代理套件为何行为异常——哪些技能被触发或被劫持，哪些钩子被阻止或错误允许，哪些子代理工具合约违规发生，以及某个技能的触发率如何变化。当被问及为何技能停止触发、钩子未阻止、错误技能运行时，或用于调试/调查套件实际执行情况时使用。不用于编写新规则（使用strengthen）或编辑规范（使用edit-spec）。

name: figma-use-slides
description: This skill helps agents use Figma's use_figma MCP tool in the Slides context. Can be used alongside figma-use which has foundational context for using the use_figma tool.
description_zh: 这项技能帮助代理在幻灯片上下文中使用 Figma 的 use_figma MCP 工具。可与 figma-use 配合使用，后者为使用 use_figma 工具提供了基础上下文。

name: toss-investment
description: 토스증권 공식 Open API(OAuth2)로 계좌, 보유주식, 시세/종목/시장정보, 주문조회를 안전한 read-only 흐름으로 조회한다. 공식 credentials가 없거나 공식 API가 지원하지 않는 기능은 비공식 경로로 우회하지 않는다.
description_zh: 通过托斯证券官方 Open API (OAuth2)，以安全的只读流程查询账户、持有股票、行情/品种/市场信息、订单查询。若无官方凭证或官方 API 不支持的功能，则不通过非官方途径绕过。

name: commit-all
description: User-invoked via /commit-all only. Gathers the working tree into a single commit on the current branch, no push.
description_zh: 通过 /commit-all 命令由用户触发。将工作区合并到当前分支的一个单一提交中，不进行推送。

name: binance-sports-ai-analyzer
description:
Use when users ask for World Cup or 世界杯 AI match predictions, WC assistant probabilities,
World Cup news insights, master analysis, recomputing football match win rates with custom
correction signals, or trading a related prediction market after reviewing the AI analysis.
description_zh: 当用户询问世界杯或世界杯AI比赛预测、WC助手概率、世界杯新闻洞察、大师分析、使用自定义修正信号重新计算足球比赛胜率，或在查看AI分析后交易相关预测市场时使用。

name: rpi
description: Apply the outcome-to-judgment charter. Use when: the caller explicitly selects RPI; ordinary coding, delegation and native goals do not require this workflow.
description_zh: 应用结果到判断宪章。使用场景：调用者明确选择RPI；常规编码、委派和本地目标不需要此工作流。

name: compose-animations
description: Use when writing or reviewing Jetpack Compose motion: visibility enter/exit, animating one property toward a target, color or size transitions, multiple properties from one state, switching composable content, or choosing between AnimatedVisibility, animate*AsState, rememberTransition, AnimatedContent, and Crossfade.
description_zh: 在编写或审查 Jetpack Compose 动画时使用：可见性进入/退出、向目标动画一个属性、颜色或大小过渡、从一个状态到多个属性、切换可组合内容，或是在 AnimatedVisibility、animate*AsState、rememberTransition、AnimatedContent 和 Crossfade 之间进行选择。

name: qwencloud-text
description: Generate text, have conversations, write code, reason, and call functions with Qwen models and third-party models available on QwenCloud. TRIGGER when: user asks to chat with Qwen, generate text, write code with Qwen, use Qwen function calling, call third-party models (deepseek, kimi, glm, etc.) via QwenCloud, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-text). DO NOT TRIGGER when: using non-QwenCloud platforms (direct OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, etc.), general coding questions unrelated to QwenCloud, image/video understanding (use qwencloud-vision), image/video/audio generation.
description_zh: 使用QwenCloud上可用的Qwen模型和第三方模型生成文本、进行对话、编写代码、推理和调用函数。在以下情况时触发：用户要求与Qwen聊天、生成文本、使用Qwen编写代码、使用Qwen函数调用、通过QwenCloud调用第三方模型（如deepseek、kimi、glm等），或明确通过名称调用此技能（例如使用qwencloud-text）。不触发的情况：使用非QwenCloud平台（如直接OpenAI API、Google Gemini API等）、与QwenCloud无关的通用编程问题、图像/视频理解（使用qwencloud-vision）、图像/视频/音频生成。

name: build-loop-codex
description: Use when building features with **Codex** (OpenAI Codex CLI) in any codebase and the work should go through a disciplined build → review → test → fix loop. Triggers on "run the build loop", "build the next task", "continue the plan", "build this feature properly", or any request to implement work from a plan file or a direct feature prompt. Builds from the plan (or the prompt if no plan exists), runs Codex's `/review` on uncommitted changes and fixes every issue found, tests and verifies the feature end to end, fixes anything testing surfaces, and reports back once complete. Repeats until all plan tasks are checked off.
description_zh: 在构建使用 **Codex**（OpenAI Codex CLI）的任何代码库中的功能时使用。工作应遵循严格的构建 → 审查 → 测试 → 修复循环。在以下情况下触发："运行构建循环"、"构建下一个任务"、"继续计划"、"正确构建此功能"，或从计划文件或直接功能提示中实施工作的任何请求。从计划（如果不存在计划，则从提示）构建，对未提交的更改运行 Codex 的 `/review` 并修复所有发现的问题，对功能进行端到端测试和验证，修复测试中发现的问题，并在完成后报告。重复此过程，直到所有计划任务都被标记完成。

name: marketingskills-ai-agents
description: Install and use Marketing Skills for AI agents — CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering skills for Claude Code and other coding agents.
description_zh: 安装和使用营销技能为AI代理——CRO、文案写作、SEO、分析以及增长工程技能，适用于Claude Code和其他编码代理。

name: image
description: Image renderer for json-render that turns JSON specs into SVG and PNG images via Satori. Use when working with @json-render/image, generating OG images from JSON, creating social cards, or rendering AI-generated image specs.
description_zh: json-render的图像渲染器，通过Satori将JSON规格转换为SVG和PNG图像。适用于使用@json-render/image时，从JSON生成OG图像、创建社交卡片或渲染AI生成的图像规格。

name: challenge
description: Pre-mortem plan analysis. Imagine the plan failed 12 months from now and work backwards to find the weaknesses. Surfaces assumptions, dependencies, and execution risks before committing resources. Use when before significant resource commitment, before presenting to a board or investors, when feedback has been one-sidedly positive, or when there is pressure to move fast and figure it out later.
description_zh: 预死计划分析。假设计划在12个月后失败，并逆向工作以找出弱点。在投入资源前揭示假设、依赖关系和执行风险。在以下情况使用：在重大资源投入前、在向董事会或投资者汇报前、当反馈片面积极时，或当存在快速推进并稍后解决的压力时。

name: immersive
description: An immersive, interactive, exhibit-style interface that blends storytelling, animation, and gamified elements to create a playful, experience-driven journey. The entire app sits on a single continuous brand-colored canvas (deep green)
description_zh: 一个沉浸式、互动式、展览风格的界面，融合了叙事、动画和游戏化元素，创造出一个充满趣味、以体验驱动的旅程。整个应用程序都位于一个单一连续的品牌色画布上（深绿色）。

name: cx-ai-center
description: Use this skill for any question or action about the user's AI/GenAI applications or agents — their behavior, prompts/responses, quality, hallucinations, guardrails, security, cost/tokens, errors, evaluations/policies, model pricing, or configuration — including comparing or tracking agents over time. It covers both analyzing AI telemetry (GenAI spans) and managing AI Center config via the `cx ai-center` commands.
description_zh: 请使用此技能处理任何与用户AI/GenAI应用程序或代理相关的问题或操作——包括它们的行为、提示/响应、质量、幻觉、护栏、安全性、成本/令牌、错误、评估/策略、模型定价或配置——以及比较或跟踪代理随时间的变化。它涵盖了分析AI遥测（GenAI跨度）以及通过`cx ai-center`命令管理AI中心配置。

name: symbolic-equation
description: Discover scientific equations from data using LLM-guided evolutionary search (LLM-SR). Multi-island algorithm with softmax-based cluster sampling, island reset, and LLM-proposed equation mutations. Use for symbolic regression and equation discovery.
description_zh: 使用 LLM 指导的进化搜索（LLM-SR）从数据中发现科学方程式。采用基于 softmax 的聚类采样、岛屿重置以及 LLM 提出的方程式突变的多岛屿算法。适用于符号回归和方程式发现。

name: smb-router
description: The front door to the Small Business plugin. Listens to what the owner needs right now — vague or specific — and routes them to the best skill or slash command for the moment. Also serves as a guide: explains what's available, suggests what to try next, and adapts recommendations based on stored business context. Trigger whenever the owner asks "what can you do," "help me with my business," "what should I focus on," "I don't know where to start," or any open-ended business request that doesn't clearly match a single skill.
description_zh: 小型企业插件的入口。它倾听所有者当前的需求——无论模糊还是具体——并将其引导至最合适的技能或命令。同时，它也充当向导：解释可用的功能，建议下一步尝试的内容，并根据存储的企业上下文调整推荐。当所有者询问“你能做什么”、“帮我处理业务”、“我应该关注什么”、“我不知道从哪里开始”，或提出任何无法明确匹配单一技能的开放式业务请求时，都会触发该功能。

name: appwrite-cli
