description: How to use the Appwrite CLI well. Covers when to use appwrite.config.json vs `appwrite client`, pull/push vs one-shot service calls, type-safe SDK and model generation, query flags, CI auth, Cloud regional endpoints, function/site variables, and traps that `--help` will not mention. Does not catalog commands — run `appwrite <command> --help` for flags. Use whenever running `appwrite`, deploying or pulling functions/sites/tables, generating application code from a table schema, initializing or linking a project, scripting Appwrite, or when the user mentions the Appwrite CLI, appwrite.config.json, `appwrite generate`, `appwrite types`, or `appwrite client`.
description_zh: 如何有效使用 Appwrite CLI。涵盖何时使用 appwrite.config.json 与 `appwrite client`，pull/push 与一次性服务调用，类型安全的 SDK 和模型生成，查询标志，CI 认证，云区域端点，函数/站点变量，以及 `--help` 不会提及的陷阱。不列出命令——运行 `appwrite <command> --help` 获取标志。在运行 `appwrite`、部署或拉取函数/站点/表格、从表格模式生成应用代码、初始化或链接项目、脚本化 Appwrite，或当用户提及 Appwrite CLI、appwrite.config.json、`appwrite generate`、`appwrite types` 或 `appwrite client` 时使用。

name: data-analyst
description: Act as an interactive data analyst for ClickHouse-backed analytics. Use when the user asks questions about internal data, metrics, dashboards, telemetry, active users, revenue, funnels, trends, distributions, or wants an analyst-style conversation, ad hoc SQL, charts, or a data export against ClickHouse (local or ClickHouse Cloud).
description_zh: 作为基于ClickHouse的分析数据分析师，用于当用户询问有关内部数据、指标、仪表板、遥测数据、活跃用户、收入、漏斗、趋势、分布，或希望进行分析师风格对话、临时SQL查询、图表或ClickHouse（本地或ClickHouse Cloud）数据导出时。

name: watch
description: Watch and understand footage with Diffusion Studio: answer questions about a video or audio file, summarize it, find scenes and moments, pull quotes, and describe what happens and when. Use whenever the user asks what's in a piece of footage, wants a summary or recap, wants to locate a moment ("where does X happen", "find the scene where..."), or needs a claim about a video or audio file checked.
description_zh: 使用Diffusion Studio观看和理解视频片段：回答有关视频或音频文件的问题、进行总结、查找场景和时刻、提取引语，并描述发生了什么以及何时发生的。当用户询问某个片段的内容、需要总结或回顾、想要定位某个时刻（“X发生在哪里”、“找到...的场景”）或需要核实视频或音频文件中的声明时，都可以使用。

name: spawn
description: Launch N parallel subagents in isolated git worktrees to compete on the session task. Use when the user runs /hub:spawn or asks to start the competing agents for an initialized AgentHub session.
description_zh: 在隔离的git工作区中启动N个并行子代理，以在会话任务上进行竞争。当用户运行/hub:spawn或请求为初始化的AgentHub会话启动竞争代理时使用。

name: stress-test
description: /em:stress-test — Business assumption stress testing. Use before betting on a plan whose core assumptions are unvalidated — e.g. stress-testing 'enterprise buyers will tolerate a 6-month pilot' or a hockey-stick revenue model.
description_zh: /em:压力测试 — 商业假设压力测试。在基于未经验证的核心假设的方案下进行投注前使用 — 例如测试“企业买家将容忍6个月试点”或冰球棍式收入模型。

name: sf-soql
description: SOQL query generation, optimization, and analysis with 100-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user writes, optimizes, or debugs SOQL/SOSL queries, touches .soql files, or asks about relationship queries, aggregates, or query performance. DO NOT TRIGGER when: bulk data operations (use sf-data), Apex DML logic (use sf-apex), or report/dashboard queries.
description_zh: 使用100分制进行SOQL查询生成、优化和分析。触发条件：当用户编写、优化或调试SOQL/SOSL查询，接触.soql文件，或询问关于关系查询、聚合或查询性能时。不触发条件：批量数据操作（使用sf-data）、Apex DML逻辑（使用sf-apex）或报告/仪表板查询。

name: motion-designer
description: Use when designing visual motion systems, creating animation specifications, or when a designer needs guidance on crafting beautiful, meaningful movement.
description_zh: 在设计视觉运动系统、创建动画规范，或设计师需要指导以制作美观且富有意义的运动时使用。

name: claude
description: A research-journal aesthetic printed on warm stone — authoritative, editorial, almost achromatic. Pages live on warm ivory parchment (never pure white), with near-black slate as the dominant ink.
description_zh: 一种以暖色调石材为背景的研究期刊美学——权威、编辑风格、几乎无色。页面采用暖象牙色羊皮纸（而非纯白色），并以近乎黑色的板岩色为主色调。

name: mantis-threat-model
description: Synthesizes trust boundaries, attack surfaces, and attacker profiles into a living threat model. Use as Stage B of the Knowledge Base generation process, reading architecture and entity definitions from the KB. Don't use for analyzing source code or extracting raw learnings from JSONL files.
description_zh: 将信任边界、攻击面和攻击者画像综合成一个动态威胁模型。作为知识库生成过程阶段B使用，从知识库中读取架构和实体定义。不要用于分析源代码或从JSONL文件中提取原始学习内容。

name: service-blueprint
description: Map service delivery across frontstage actions, backstage processes, and supporting systems. Use when staff and operations are part of the experience. For the customer-visible layer only, use `experience-map`.
description_zh: 将服务交付映射到前台操作、后台流程和支持系统。当员工和运营是体验的一部分时使用。仅用于客户可见层，使用 `experience-map`。

name: postgres-drizzle
description: Write or review PostgreSQL schemas, queries, migrations, and Drizzle ORM code. Use for Postgres/Drizzle relations, indexing, pooling, or query performance; not for unrelated databases or generic backend work.
description_zh: 编写或审查 PostgreSQL 模式、查询、迁移和 Drizzle ORM 代码。用于 Postgres/Drizzle 关系、索引、连接池或查询性能；不用于无关数据库或通用后端工作。

name: bootstrap
description: Generate a personalized SOUL.md through a warm, adaptive onboarding conversation. Trigger when the user wants to create, set up, or initialize their AI partner's identity — e.g., "create my SOUL.md", "bootstrap my agent", "set up my AI partner", "define who you are", "let's do onboarding", "personalize this AI", "make you mine", or when a SOUL.md is missing. Also trigger for updates: "update my SOUL.md", "change my AI's personality", "tweak the soul".
description_zh: 通过一次温暖且自适应的引导对话来生成个性化的 SOUL.md。在以下情况下触发：用户想要创建、设置或初始化其 AI 伙伴的身份 — 例如，“创建我的 SOUL.md”、“引导我的代理”、“设置我的 AI 伙伴”、“定义你是谁”、“让我们进行引导”、“个性化这个 AI”、“让你属于我”，或者当 SOUL.md 缺失时。同时，在以下情况下也会触发更新： “更新我的 SOUL.md”、“改变我的 AI 的性格”、“调整灵魂”。

name: capacitor-plugins
description: Official Capacitor package guide plus Capgo ecosystem plugin recommendations. Use this skill when users need native functionality, want the right official Capacitor package, or need a stronger Capgo/community plugin when the official package is missing or too limited.
description_zh: 官方 Capacitor 包指南及 Capgo 生态插件推荐。当用户需要原生功能、希望获得正确的官方 Capacitor 包，或当官方包缺失或过于有限时需要更强的 Capgo/社区插件，请使用此技能。

name: ccf-paper-reviewer
description: Review manuscript claims, evidence, and writing without rewriting. Use for 文章审核, 审稿, 稿件有什么硬伤, 结论站得住吗, 投稿成熟度, writing review, and version comparison. Return a structured scientific or writing review; scores need not be explicitly requested. Concept-only judgment belongs to ccf-idea-reviewer even with a full PDF; requested prose edits belong to ccf-paper-writer.
description_zh: 审阅稿件内容、证据和写作，无需重写。适用于文章审核、审稿、稿件是否存在硬伤、结论是否站得住脚、投稿成熟度、写作审阅和版本比较。返回结构化的科学或写作审阅；无需明确要求评分。仅基于概念的判断属于ccf-idea-reviewer，即使提供完整PDF；请求的文本修改属于ccf-paper-writer。

name: android-kotlin-development
description: Develop native Android apps with Kotlin. Covers MVVM with Jetpack, Compose for modern UI, Retrofit for API calls, Room for local storage, and navigation architecture.
description_zh: 使用Kotlin开发原生Android应用。涵盖Jetpack的MVVM、Compose用于现代UI、Retrofit用于API调用、Room用于本地存储以及导航架构。

name: speckit-checklist
description: Generate a custom checklist for the current feature based on user requirements.
description_zh: 根据用户需求，为当前功能生成一个自定义清单。

name: whisper
description: OpenAI's general-purpose speech recognition model. Supports 99 languages, transcription, translation to English, and language identification. Six model sizes from tiny (39M params) to large (1550M params). Use for speech-to-text, podcast transcription, or multilingual audio processing. Best for robust, multilingual ASR.

name: email-drafter
description: Draft and review professional emails that match your personal writing style. Analyzes your sent emails for tone, greeting, structure, and sign-off patterns via WorkIQ, then generates context-aware drafts for any recipient. USE FOR: draft email, write email, compose email, reply email, follow-up email, analyze email tone, email style.
description_zh: 起草和审阅符合您个人写作风格的职业邮件。通过WorkIQ分析您发送的邮件在语气、问候语、结构和结束语模式等方面，然后为任何收件人生成具有上下文感知的草稿。用途：起草邮件、撰写邮件、撰写邮件、回复邮件、跟进邮件、分析邮件语气、邮件风格。

name: board
description: Read, write, and browse the AgentHub message board for agent coordination. Use when the user runs /hub:board or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages between competing AgentHub agents.
description_zh: 阅读、写入和浏览 AgentHub 消息板以进行代理协调。当用户运行 /hub:board 或请求发布、阅读或检查竞争性 AgentHub 代理之间的协调消息时使用。

name: qwencloud-model-selector
description: Recommend the best Qwen model and parameters. TRIGGER when: choosing between Qwen models, comparing Qwen model pricing, understanding Qwen model capabilities, asking which models are available on Token Plan, viewing cost history, when an execution skill needs model selection advice, or user explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-model-selector). DO NOT TRIGGER when: non-Qwen model discussions (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.), general AI questions unrelated to Qwen.
description_zh: 推荐最佳Qwen模型和参数。在以下情况时触发：选择Qwen模型、比较Qwen模型价格、了解Qwen模型功能、询问Token计划上有哪些可用模型、查看成本历史、执行技能需要模型选择建议，或用户通过名称明确调用此技能（例如使用qwencloud-model-selector）。不触发的情况：非Qwen模型讨论（OpenAI、Gemini等）、与Qwen无关的一般AI问题。

name: instagram-research
description:
Research high-performing Instagram content (posts and reels) from tracked accounts using Apify's Instagram Scraper.
Identifies outlier content, analyzes top 5 videos with AI, and generates reports with actionable hook formulas.

Use when asked to:
- Find trending Instagram content in a niche
- Research what's performing on Instagram
- Identify high-performing reel patterns
- Analyze competitors' Instagram content
- Generate content ideas from Instagram trends
- Run Instagram research
- Find viral reels
- Analyze hooks and content structure

Triggers: "instagram research", "ig research", "find trending reels", "analyze instagram accounts",
"what's working on instagram", "content research instagram", "reel analysis", "instagram trends"
description_zh:
使用 Apify 的 Instagram Scraper 研究（追踪账户的）高绩效 Instagram 内容（帖子和 Reels）。
识别异常内容，使用 AI 分析前 5 个视频，并生成包含可执行钩子公式的报告。

在以下情况下使用：
- 查找特定领域的流行 Instagram 内容
- 研究 Instagram 上表现好的内容
- 识别高绩效 Reels 模式
- 分析竞争对手的 Instagram 内容
- 从 Instagram 趋势中生成内容创意
- 运行 Instagram 研究
- 查找病毒 Reels
- 分析钩子和内容结构

触发条件： "instagram research"、"ig research"、"find trending reels"、"analyze instagram accounts"、"what's working on instagram"、"content research instagram"、"reel analysis"、"instagram trends"

name: ccf-idea-optimizer
description: Develop and optimize rough CCF research ideas into problems, insights, mechanisms, and evidence plans. Use for 优化idea, 具象化idea, 找方向, 方向探索, and rescue routes when development is the requested deliverable. Judging whether an idea is worthwhile, novel, or coherent belongs to ccf-idea-reviewer even without scores; manuscript edits belong to ccf-paper-writer.
description_zh: 将初步的CCF研究想法发展和优化为问题、见解、机制和证据计划。用于优化想法、具体化想法、寻找方向、方向探索和救援路线，当开发是请求的交付成果时。判断一个想法是否值得、新颖或连贯属于ccf-idea-reviewer，即使没有分数；文稿编辑属于ccf-paper-writer。

name: typst-paper
description: Typst paper assistant for existing .typ manuscripts in English or Chinese. Use for compile/export diagnosis, venue formatting, BibTeX/Hayagriva checks, grammar, logic, abstract/title, tables, pseudocode, related work, research-gap framing, adaptation, de-AI polish, translation, and submission readiness; use LaTeX skills for .tex.
description_zh: Typst 论文助手，用于处理现有的英文或中文 .typ 手稿。可用于编译/导出诊断、会议格式设置、BibTeX/Hayagriva 检查、语法、逻辑、摘要/标题、表格、伪代码、相关工作、研究空白框架、适应性调整、去 AI 精炼、翻译以及提交准备；使用 LaTeX 技能处理 .tex 文件。

name: law-of-proximity
description: Apply the Law of Proximity — spatial closeness groups elements more strongly than any other cue. Use when spacing alone must carry grouping. For grouping via containers use `law-of-common-region`; via shared appearance use `law-of-similarity`.
description_zh: 应用邻近律——空间上的邻近关系比其他任何线索更能将元素组合得更紧密。当仅靠间距需要实现分组时使用。通过容器进行分组时使用 `law-of-common-region`；通过共享外观进行分组时使用 `law-of-similarity`。

name: context-compression
description: When agent sessions generate millions of tokens of conversation history, compression becomes mandatory. The naive approach is aggressive compression to minimize tokens per request.
description_zh: 当代理会话生成数百万个对话历史记录时，压缩变得必不可少。朴素的方法是采用激进压缩以最小化每个请求的令牌数量。

name: ccf-literature-searcher
description: Find and verify external literature, prior art, datasets, benchmarks, and citation candidates. Use for 文献检索, 相关工作, benchmark搜索, and research opportunity maps. Recurring recent-paper watch belongs to ccf-literature-monitor; existing-citation audits, manuscript assessment, and result schemas have separate owners.
description_zh: 查找并验证外部文献、现有技术、数据集、基准测试和引文候选。用于文献检索、相关工作、基准测试搜索和研究机会地图。常规的近期论文监控属于 ccf-literature-monitor；现有的引文审核、手稿评估和结果模式有单独的负责人。

name: aceternity-ui
description: 100+ animated React components (Aceternity UI) for Next.js with Tailwind. Use for hero sections, parallax, 3D effects, or encountering animation, shadcn CLI integration errors.
description_zh: 100+ 个用于 Next.js 的 React 动画组件（Aceternity UI），结合 Tailwind。可用于英雄区域、视差效果、3D 效果或遭遇动画，支持 shadcn CLI 集成错误。

name: ccf-experiment-designer
description: Design CCF experiment protocols and evidence schemas: datasets, baselines, metrics, ablations, and result-table contents. Use for 设计实验, 消融, benchmark planning, and 结果表证据结构. Preserve real values. Table styling/rendering belongs to ccf-visual-composer; broad retrieval belongs to ccf-literature-searcher.
description_zh: 设计 CCF 实验协议和证据模式：数据集、基线、指标、消融实验和结果表内容。用于设计实验、消融分析、基准规划以及结果表证据结构。保留实际数值。表格样式/渲染属于 ccf-visual-composer；广泛检索属于 ccf-literature-searcher。

name: ccf-humanization
description: Required first preflight before every CCFA skill, including research, review, retrieval, experiments, visuals, and maintenance. Keep reasoning and communication direct, remove empty defensive framing, and preserve evidence and uncertainty. Also use for 去防御性 and 论文人性化. Apply prose edits only within the authorized task; specialist skills retain ownership.
description_zh: 每次使用CCFA技能前，包括研究、评审、检索、实验、视觉和维修，都必须进行首次预演。保持推理和沟通直接，去除空洞的防御性措辞，并保留证据和不确定性。也用于去防御性和论文人性化。仅在授权任务范围内进行散文编辑；专业技能保留所有权。

name: ccf-integrity-auditor
description: Audit existing CCF claims, numbers, terminology, and citations against supplied or verified evidence. Use for 引用核验, claim审计, 数字一致性, and BibTeX/context checks. Full scientific review belongs to ccf-paper-reviewer; new literature discovery belongs to ccf-literature-searcher.
description_zh: 审计现有的CCF声明、编号、术语和引用，对照提供的或经核实的证据。用于引用核验、声明审计、数字一致性以及BibTeX/上下文检查。完整的科学评审属于ccf-paper-reviewer；新的文献发现属于ccf-literature-searcher。

name: expo-react-native-performance
description: Expo React Native performance optimization guidelines. This skill should be used when writing, reviewing, or refactoring Expo React Native code to ensure optimal performance patterns. Triggers on tasks involving React Native components, lists, animations, images, or performance improvements.
description_zh: Expo React Native 性能优化指南。在编写、审查或重构 Expo React Native 代码时，应使用此技巧以确保最佳性能模式。适用于涉及 React Native 组件、列表、动画、图像或性能改进的任务。

name: unreal-engine-cpp-pro
description: Expert guide for Unreal Engine 5.x C++ development, covering UObject hygiene, performance patterns, and best practices.
description_zh: Unreal Engine 5.x C++ 开发专家指南，涵盖UObject卫生、性能模式及最佳实践。

name: r3f-loaders
description: Load and reuse 3D assets in React Three Fiber with useGLTF, useLoader, Suspense, and preloading. Use for model loading, decoder setup, caching, cloning, or loading/error UI.
description_zh: 在 React Three Fiber 中使用 useGLTF、useLoader、Suspense 和预加载来加载和重用 3D 资产。可用于模型加载、解码器设置、缓存、克隆或加载/错误 UI。

name: openspec-implementation
description: Implements approved specification proposals by working through tasks sequentially with testing and validation. Use when implementing changes, applying proposals, executing spec tasks, or building from approved plans. Triggers include "openspec implement", "implement", "apply change", "execute spec", "work through tasks", "build feature", "start implementation".
description_zh: 通过按顺序执行任务、进行测试和验证来实施批准的规范提案。在实施变更、应用提案、执行规范任务或从批准的计划中构建时使用。触发条件包括“openspec implement”、“implement”、“apply change”、“execute spec”、“work through tasks”、“build feature”、“start implementation”。

name: postgresql-best-practices
description: PostgreSQL development best practices for schema design, query optimization, and database administration
description_zh: PostgreSQL 开发最佳实践：模式设计、查询优化和数据库管理

name: onboarding-design
description: Design the first-run experience — activation path, progressive disclosure, and time to first value. Use for a user's very first session. For the mechanics of the signup form itself, use `form-design`.
description_zh: 设计首次运行体验——激活路径、渐进式披露和首次价值获取时间。用于用户的首次会话。对于注册表单本身的机制，使用 `form-design`。

name: sketch
description: A friendly, hand-drawn sketch interface inspired by pencil illustrations on warm cream paper. Soft teal brand accents, hand-written display headings, rounded pill controls.
description_zh: 一个友好的、手绘风格的草图界面，灵感来源于暖奶油纸上铅笔插图。柔和的蓝绿色品牌点缀，手写式显示标题，圆润的药丸式控制按钮。

name: open-computer-use
description: Platform-neutral guidance for using Open Computer Use, the open-source Computer Use MCP server and CLI for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Use when an agent needs to install, verify, troubleshoot, configure, or operate Open Computer Use through its native CLI, stdio MCP server, or direct Computer Use tool calls.
description_zh: 跨平台使用 Open Computer Use 的指南，包括开源的 Computer Use MCP 服务器和适用于 macOS、Linux 及 Windows 的 CLI。当代理需要通过原生 CLI、stdio MCP 服务器或直接调用 Computer Use 工具来安装、验证、排错、配置或操作 Open Computer Use 时使用。

name: ccf-idea-reviewer
description: Assess research ideas for value, novelty, insight, and mechanism. Use for 思路审核, 靠谱吗, 值得做吗, 创新够不够, idea review, scoring, and ranking; no numeric-score request is needed. Default to concept-only review without experiment assessment, including ideas extracted from manuscripts. Developing an idea belongs to ccf-idea-optimizer; evaluating manuscript evidence or writing belongs to ccf-paper-reviewer.
description_zh: 评估研究思路的价值、新颖性、洞察力和机制。用于思路审核、靠谱吗、值得做吗、创新够不够、idea review、评分和排名；不需要数值评分。默认仅进行概念层面的审核，不涉及实验评估，包括从手稿中提取的思路。思路的开发属于 ccf-idea-optimizer；评估手稿证据或写作属于 ccf-paper-reviewer。

name: search-ux
description: Design search — query input, zero results, refinement, and result presentation. Use when users retrieve rather than browse. For browse structure, use `navigation-patterns`.
description_zh: 设计搜索——查询输入、零结果、精炼和结果展示。在用户检索而非浏览时使用。对于浏览结构，请使用 `navigation-patterns`。

name: iris-development
description: Iris is Redis's umbrella for AI-focused products. Use this skill when integrating with the Iris Redis Agent Memory (RAM) data plane on Redis Cloud — recording session events for an AI agent, creating or searching long-term memories, configuring a memory store, or tuning background memory promotion. Code examples use the official `redis-agent-memory` (Python) and `@redis-iris/agent-memory` (TypeScript) SDKs.
description_zh: Iris 是 Redis 针对 AI 产品提供的集成解决方案。在将 Iris Redis Agent Memory (RAM) 数据平面与 Redis Cloud 集成时，可使用此技能来记录 AI 代理的会话事件、创建或搜索长期记忆、配置记忆存储或调整后台记忆提升。代码示例使用官方的 `redis-agent-memory` (Python) 和 `@redis-iris/agent-memory` (TypeScript) SDK。

name: agents-md
description: Use when the requested deliverable includes creating, reviewing, moving, splitting, or updating a repository AGENTS.md; produces scoped repo guidance. Do not trigger for standalone skills, prompts, non-AGENTS instruction files, READMEs, changelogs, or architecture docs.
description_zh: 当请求交付物包括创建、审查、移动、拆分或更新存储库的 AGENTS.md 时使用；生成范围受限的存储库指南。不适用于独立的技能、提示、非 AGENTS 指令文件、README、变更日志或架构文档。

name: sf-debug
description: Salesforce debug log analysis and troubleshooting with 100-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user analyzes debug logs, hits governor limits, reads stack traces, or touches .log files from Salesforce orgs. DO NOT TRIGGER when: running Apex tests (use sf-testing), fixing Apex code (use sf-apex), or Agentforce session tracing (use sf-ai-agentforce-observability).
description_zh: Salesforce 调试日志分析与排错，采用100分制评分。触发条件：当用户分析调试日志、触达治理限制、读取堆栈跟踪或访问 Salesforce 组织中的 .log 文件时。不触发条件：运行 Apex 测试（使用 sf-testing）、修复 Apex 代码（使用 sf-apex）或 Agentforce 会话追踪（使用 sf-ai-agentforce-observability）。

name: implement
description: Execute one bounded RED to GREEN experiment from bead or caller intent; return derived subject identity and check facts. Triggers: "implement", "implement this bead", "run the experiment". Full plan-to-validation requests route to rpi.
description_zh: 执行一次有界的从红色到绿色的实验，根据珠子或调用者的意图；返回推导出的主题身份并检查事实。触发条件："实施"、"实施这个珠子"、"运行实验"。全部计划到验证请求路由到rpi。

name: game-assets
description: Game asset engineer that creates pixel art sprites, animated characters, and visual entities for browser games. Use when a game needs better character art, enemy sprites, item visuals, or any upgrade from basic geometric shapes to recognizable pixel art.
description_zh: 像素艺术精灵、动画角色和视觉实体的游戏资源工程师，用于浏览器游戏。当游戏需要更好的角色艺术、敌人精灵、物品视觉效果，或从基本几何形状升级到可识别的像素艺术时使用。

name: paperclip-ai-orchestration
description: Skill for using Paperclip — open-source orchestration platform for running autonomous AI-agent companies with org charts, budgets, governance, and heartbeats.
description_zh: 使用 Paperclip 技能——一个开源的编排平台，用于运行具有组织结构图、预算、治理和心跳的自主 AI 公司。

name: impeccable
description: A modern, graphic, editorial-poster aesthetic — warm and confident — built on alternating cream and burnt orange sections, an amber brand color.
description_zh: 一种现代、图形化的编辑海报美学——温暖而自信——基于交替的米色和焦橙色区块，这是品牌的琥珀色。

name: testability-obstacle
description: MUST USE for C#/.NET deterministic tests that require the smallest production seam for DateTime/Task.Delay/File/Environment/Guid/Random, static API preservation, nested/parallel overrides, or no real I/O. USE ONLY when the target workspace contains C# source plus a .csproj or .sln. DO NOT USE for audits, bulk migration, code that already has an injectable seam, or an explicit migration to a user-named existing abstraction (migrate-static-to-wrapper). Use instead of general test generation when the requested test is impossible without a production edit and seam selection is still open.
description_zh: 必须用于 C#/.NET 确定性测试，这些测试需要最小的生产缝隙，例如 DateTime/Task.Delay/File/Environment/Guid/Random、静态 API 保留、嵌套/并行覆盖，或无实际 I/O。仅在目标工作区包含 C# 源代码以及 .csproj 或 .sln 文件时使用。禁止用于审计、批量迁移、已存在可注入缝隙的代码，或显式迁移到用户自定义的现有抽象（migrate-static-to-wrapper）。当请求的测试无法不修改生产代码且缝隙选择仍开放时，应优先使用此方法替代通用测试生成。

name: ccf-literature-monitor
description: Scan recent arXiv/OpenReview papers, venue feeds, labs, and competitors for overlap. Use for 竞品监控, 新论文追踪, 论文跟踪, and recurring novelty watch. Give dated evidence and changes since the prior scan. Broad related-work retrieval belongs to ccf-literature-searcher.
description_zh: 扫描近期arXiv/OpenReview论文、会议信息源、实验室及竞争对手，以查找重叠内容。用于竞品监控、新论文追踪、论文跟踪及持续创新监测。提供日期证据及自上次扫描以来的变化。相关工作的广泛检索属于ccf-literature-searcher范畴。

name: ccf-visual-composer
description: Render and redesign CCF figures, visual tables, and method/architecture diagrams from supplied content. Use for 绘图美化, 排版, 配色, GPT Image 2 generation, pure SVG, and editable SVG/PDF/PPTX. Preserve values and topology. Experiment evidence design belongs to ccf-experiment-designer; manuscript rewriting and PDF-to-writing exemplars are separate.
description_zh: 根据提供的內容，渲染并重新设计CCF图表、可视化表格以及方法/架构图。用于绘图美化、排版、配色、GPT Image 2生成、纯SVG以及可编辑的SVG/PDF/PPTX。保留值和拓扑结构。实验证据设计属于ccf-experiment-designer；文稿重写和PDF到写作的范例是分开的。

name: cmux-terminal-multiplexer
description: AI-native terminal multiplexer with programmable socket API, full Playwright-equivalent browser automation, and agent team coordination — built for Claude Code and autonomous agent workflows
description_zh: AI原生终端复用器，具备可编程套接字API，完整的Playwright等价浏览器自动化功能，以及代理团队协作——专为Claude Code和自主代理工作流程构建。

name: llm-security
description: Security guidelines for LLM applications based on OWASP Top 10 for LLM 2025. Use when building LLM apps, reviewing AI security, implementing RAG systems, or asking about LLM vulnerabilities like 'prompt injection' or 'check LLM security'. IMPORTANT: Always consult this skill when building chatbots, AI agents, RAG pipelines, tool-using LLMs, agentic systems, or any application that calls an LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.) — even if the user doesn't explicitly mention security. Also use when users import 'openai', 'anthropic', 'langchain', 'llamaindex', or similar LLM libraries.
description_zh:
基于 OWASP Top 10 for LLM 2025 的 LLM 应用安全指南。在构建 LLM 应用、审查 AI 安全、实施 RAG 系统或询问 LLM 漏洞（如“提示注入”或“检查 LLM 安全”）时使用。

**重要提示**：在构建聊天机器人、AI 代理、RAG 管道、使用工具的 LLM、代理系统或任何调用 LLM API（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等）的应用程序时，请始终参考此技能——即使用户未明确提及安全问题。同样适用于用户导入“openai”、“anthropic”、“langchain”、“llamaindex”或类似 LLM 库的情况。

name: continual-learning
description: Orchestrate continual learning by delegating transcript mining and AGENTS.md updates to `agents-memory-updater`.
description_zh: 通过将转录挖掘和 `AGENTS.md` 更新委托给 `agents-memory-updater`，来协调持续学习。

name: law-of-common-region
description: Apply the Law of Common Region — a shared container, background, or border groups elements regardless of spacing. Use when grouping must survive a tight layout. For grouping by spacing alone, use `law-of-proximity`.
description_zh: 应用共同区域法则——一个共享的容器、背景或边框，无论间距如何，都会将元素组合在一起。当组合必须适应紧凑布局时使用。仅通过间距进行组合时，请使用 `law-of-proximity`。

name: qwencloud-video-generation
description: Generate videos using Wan models. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first+last frame, reference-based role-play, and video editing (VACE). TRIGGER when: user wants to create, generate, or edit video content, mentions video generation/animation/video clips/Wan models, or explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-video-generation). DO NOT TRIGGER when: user wants to generate images (use qwencloud-image-generation), understand/analyze existing videos (use qwencloud-vision), text-only tasks.
description_zh: 使用 Wan 模型生成视频。支持文本转视频、图像转视频、首尾帧生成、参考式角色扮演以及视频编辑（VACE）。在以下情况时触发：用户想要创建、生成或编辑视频内容，提及视频生成/动画/视频片段/Wan 模型，或明确调用此技能名称（例如使用 qwencloud-video-generation）。不触发情况：用户想要生成图像（使用 qwencloud-image-generation）、理解/分析现有视频（使用 qwencloud-vision）、纯文本任务。

name: architecture
description: Architectural decision-making framework. Requirements analysis, trade-off evaluation, ADR documentation. Use when making architecture decisions or analyzing system design.
description_zh: 架构决策框架。需求分析、权衡评估、ADR文档记录。在做出架构决策或分析系统设计时使用。

name: agent-arch-system-design
description: Agent skill for arch-system-design - invoke with $agent-arch-system-design
description_zh: 代理技能用于架构系统设计 - 使用$agent-arch-system-design调用

name: test-driven-development
description: Use a failing behavioral test to guide a feature or bug fix, then implement and refactor with relevant regression checks.
description_zh: 使用一个失败的行為測試來指導功能或錯誤修復，然後進行相關的回歸測試來實現和重构。

name: version-bump
description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.
description_zh: Claude 代码插件的自动化语义版本控制和发布工作流。处理 package.json、marketplace.json、plugin.json 配置文件中的版本增量、构建验证、git 标签、GitHub 发布以及版本变更日志生成。由于维护者提出了 npm 安全性问题，npm 发布是最终需要人工介入的交接环节。

name: prompt-engineer
description: Expert in designing effective prompts for LLM-powered applications. Masters prompt structure, context management, output formatting, and prompt evaluation. Use when: prompt engineering, system prompt, few-shot, chain of thought, prompt design.
description_zh: 精通为LLM（大型语言模型）驱动型应用设计高效提示。掌握提示结构、上下文管理、输出格式化和提示评估。适用于：提示工程、系统提示、少样本学习、思维链、提示设计。

name: speckit-baseline
description: Generate feature specifications by analyzing existing source code.
description_zh: 通过分析现有的源代码来生成功能规格。

name: sf-deploy
description: Salesforce DevOps automation using sf CLI v2. TRIGGER when: user deploys metadata, creates/manages scratch orgs or sandboxes, sets up CI/CD pipelines, or troubleshoots deployment errors with sf project deploy. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex/LWC code (use sf-apex/sf-lwc), creating metadata XML (use sf-metadata), or querying org data (use sf-data).
description_zh: 使用 sf CLI v2 进行 Salesforce DevOps 自动化。触发条件：当用户部署元数据、创建/管理 Scratch Org 或 Sandbox、设置 CI/CD 管道，或使用 sf project deploy 解决部署错误时。不触发条件：编写 Apex/LWC 代码（使用 sf-apex/sf-lwc）、创建元数据 XML（使用 sf-metadata），或查询 Org 数据（使用 sf-data）。

name: merge
description: Merge the winning agent's branch into base, archive losers, and clean up worktrees. Use when the user runs /hub:merge or asks to land the winning AgentHub result and tidy the session.
description_zh: 将获胜代理的分支合并到主分支，归档失败者，并清理工作树。当用户运行 /hub:merge 或要求合并获胜的 AgentHub 结果并整理会话时使用。

name: qwencloud-ops-auth
description: Configure authentication (API keys, endpoints). TRIGGER when: setting up QWEN_API_KEY, troubleshooting 401/auth errors, when another skill reports missing credentials, or user explicitly invokes this skill by name (e.g. use qwencloud-ops-auth). DO NOT TRIGGER when: non-auth Qwen tasks, general API usage questions.
description_zh: 配置认证（API密钥、端点）。触发条件：设置QWEN_API_KEY、解决401/auth错误、当其他技能报告凭证缺失，或用户通过名称显式调用此技能（例如使用qwencloud-ops-auth）。不触发条件：非认证Qwen任务、一般API使用问题。

name: hard-call
description: /em:hard-call — Framework for decisions with no good options. Use when every option is painful and a structured 10/10/10 + regret-minimization pass is needed — e.g. choosing between a layoff and a down round, or killing a beloved product line.
description_zh: /em:hard-call — 用于决策的框架，当没有好的选择时使用。当每个选项都令人痛苦，并且需要结构化的 10/10/10 + 减少后悔的评估时使用——例如，在裁员和进行降价融资之间做选择，或终止一个深受喜爱的产品线。

name: api-patterns
description: API design principles and decision-making. REST vs GraphQL vs tRPC selection, response formats, versioning, pagination.
description_zh: API设计原则与决策。REST与GraphQL与tRPC的选择，响应格式，版本控制，分页。

name: eval
description: Evaluate and rank agent results by metric or LLM judge for an AgentHub session. Use when the user runs /hub:eval or asks to score, compare, or pick a winner among completed AgentHub agents.
description_zh: 评估并按指标或LLM裁判对AgentHub会话中的代理结果进行排名。当用户运行/hub:eval或要求对已完成的AgentHub代理进行评分、比较或挑选获胜者时使用。

name: codex
description: A radically minimal, blank-canvas interface built as a pure edge-to-edge surface, with almost no color and typography carrying the visual weight. Black serves as the only filled color, the only divider, and the sole surface tone cards.
description_zh: 一个极简的、空白的画布界面，构建为一个纯粹的边缘到边缘表面，几乎没有任何颜色和排版承担视觉重量。黑色作为唯一的填充色、唯一的分隔符和唯一的表面色调卡。

name: promptfoo-evaluation
description: Configures and runs LLM evaluation using Promptfoo framework. Use when setting up prompt testing, creating evaluation configs (promptfooconfig.yaml), writing Python custom assertions, implementing llm-rubric for LLM-as-judge, or managing few-shot examples in prompts. Triggers on keywords like "promptfoo", "eval", "LLM evaluation", "prompt testing", or "model comparison".
description_zh: 使用 Promptfoo 框架配置和运行 LLM 评估。在设置提示测试、创建评估配置（promptfooconfig.yaml）、编写 Python 自定义断言、为 LLM-as-judge 实现llm-rubric 或在提示中管理 few-shot 示例时使用。当输入关键词如“promptfoo”、“eval”、“LLM 评估”、“提示测试”或“模型比较”时触发。

name: speckit-taskstoissues
description: Convert existing tasks into actionable, dependency-ordered GitHub issues for the feature based on available design artifacts.
description_zh: 将现有任务转换为基于可用设计工件的功能GitHub问题，并按依赖关系排序以实现可执行性。

name: ccf-paper-to-exemplar
description: Distill supplied paper PDFs into writing exemplar cards and register a requested personal library. Use for PDF to writing exemplar, 写作范例, and reusable paper-writing patterns. Preserve source attribution and transfer writing logic only. Figure reconstruction, manuscript drafting, and review have separate owners.
description_zh: 将提供的论文PDF提炼为写作范例卡片，并注册个人所需图书馆。用于PDF到写作范例、写作范例和可复用的论文写作模板。保留原始出处，仅转移写作逻辑。图形重构、手稿起草和审阅由不同负责人负责。

name: amazon-keyword-research
description: Amazon keyword research and market opportunity analysis for sellers. Retrieve autocomplete suggestions (long-tail keywords), analyze competitor landscape, and assess market opportunity for any keyword on 12 Amazon marketplaces (US/UK/DE/FR/IT/ES/JP/CA/AU/IN/MX/BR). No API key required. Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions Amazon product research, finding products to sell on Amazon, Amazon keyword ideas, niche analysis, competition analysis for Amazon, market opportunity on Amazon, comparing Amazon keywords, evaluating whether a product is worth selling, Amazon autocomplete data, seasonal demand for Amazon products, or anything related to researching what to sell on Amazon — even if they don't explicitly say 'keyword research'. Also trigger when the user asks vague questions like 'is this a good product to sell?', 'what's the competition like for X on Amazon?', 'should I sell X or Y?', or 'what are people searching for on Amazon?'.
description_zh: 亚马逊卖家关键词研究和市场机会分析。获取自动补全建议（长尾关键词），分析竞争对手格局，并评估12个亚马逊市场（美国/英国/德国/法国/意大利/西班牙/日本/加拿大/澳大利亚/印度/墨西哥/巴西）上任何关键词的市场机会。无需API密钥。每当用户提到亚马逊产品研究、在亚马逊上寻找产品、亚马逊关键词创意、利基市场分析、亚马逊竞争分析、亚马逊市场机会、比较亚马逊关键词、评估产品是否值得销售、亚马逊自动补全数据、亚马逊产品的季节性需求，或任何与在亚马逊上研究要销售什么相关的内容时，请确保使用此技能——即使他们没有明确说“关键词研究”。此外，当用户提出模糊问题时（例如“这是否是一个好的销售产品？”、“X在亚马逊上的竞争情况如何？”、“我应该销售X还是Y？”或“人们在亚马逊上搜索什么？”），也会触发此技能。

name: code-review-checklist
description: Comprehensive checklist for conducting thorough code reviews covering functionality, security, performance, and maintainability
description_zh: 进行全面的代码审查的综合清单，涵盖功能、安全性、性能和可维护性

name: loops-api
description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to integrate Loops from application code, backend services, webhook handlers, or server-side automation. This includes the Loops HTTP API and official SDKs for server-side contact, contact-property, mailing-list, event, API-key-validation, transactional-email, content editing (campaigns, groups, audience segments, email messages, themes, and components), workflow graph/node mutation, and inbound Loops webhooks. Trigger on phrases like "Loops API", "Loops SDK", "create a campaign via API", "update email message LMX", "create a theme via API", "create a workflow via API", "add a workflow node", "Loops webhook", "send a Loops event from my app", "add a contact to Loops in a webhook", "send a transactional email from backend code", or any time the user wants to integrate Loops into their app, backend, webhook, or automation. Do not trigger for CLI or shell-only requests.
description_zh: 在用户希望从应用代码、后端服务、webhook 处理程序或服务器端自动化中集成 Loops 时，请使用此技能。这包括 Loops HTTP API 和用于服务器端联系人、联系人属性、邮件列表、事件、API 密钥验证、事务性电子邮件、内容编辑（活动、群组、受众细分、电子邮件消息、主题和组件）、工作流图/节点变异以及入站 Loops webhook 的官方 SDK。在类似 "Loops API"、"Loops SDK"、"通过 API 创建活动"、"更新电子邮件消息 LMX"、"通过 API 创建主题"、"通过 API 创建工作流"、"添加工作流节点"、"Loops webhook"、"从我的应用发送 Loops 事件"、"在 webhook 中将联系人添加到 Loops"、"从后端代码发送事务性电子邮件" 或任何用户希望将 Loops 集成到其应用、后端、webhook 或自动化中的时候触发。不应用于 CLI 或仅限 shell 的请求。

name: ccf-submission-checker
description: Check CCF venue rules and submission packages: template, pages, anonymity, PDF build, metadata, and reproducibility. Use for 投稿检查, 会议格式, page limits, and artifact readiness. Verify current official rules for the exact venue/year/track. Manuscript polishing belongs to ccf-paper-writer.
description_zh: 检查 CCF 场地规则和提交包：模板、页数、匿名性、PDF 构建、元数据和可复现性。用于投稿检查、会议格式、页数限制和工件准备。请核实当前官方规则以获取确切的场地/年份/专题信息。稿件润色属于 ccf-paper-writer 的职责。

name: readable-measure
description: Set line length and measure for comfortable reading across type sizes and breakpoints. Use when tuning body text. Covers measure only — for the full size and weight scale, use `typography-scale`.
description_zh: 设置行长度和度量，以适应不同字体大小和断点下的舒适阅读。在调整正文文本时使用。仅覆盖度量——对于完整的大小和粗细范围，请使用 `typography-scale`。

name: frontend-design
description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
description_zh: 创建具有高品质设计的独特、生产级前端界面。当用户要求构建 Web 组件、页面或应用程序时，使用这项技能。生成富有创意、精炼的代码，避免通用的 AI 美学。

name: reels-scripting
description: Turn a reference Instagram Reel into a script for your own Reel, tuned to your voice and repurposed from your newsletter content. Takes a Reel URL or Notion reference link, uses Apify to scrape the video, sends it to Gemini 2.5 Flash for full transcript + hook + structure analysis, then writes a new script applying the same patterns to your newsletter topic. Use this skill whenever the user says "script a reel", "reels scripting", "turn this into a reel", pastes an Instagram Reel URL, or references their Notion outlier reels database. The URL-to-video-analysis route needs APIFY_API_TOKEN and GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY; supplied input can skip the corresponding stages.
description_zh: 将一个参考的Instagram Reel转化为适合你自己的Reel脚本，根据你的声音进行调整，并从你的通讯内容中重新利用素材。输入Reel链接或Notion参考链接，使用Apify抓取视频，将其发送到Gemini 2.5 Flash进行完整字幕生成、钩子提取和结构分析，然后根据你的通讯主题应用相同模式撰写新脚本。当用户说“脚本一个Reel”、“Reels脚本化”、“把这个转化为Reel”，或者粘贴Instagram Reel链接，或引用他们的Notion异常Reels数据库时，使用此技能。URL到视频分析路径需要APIFY_API_TOKEN和GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY；提供的输入可以跳过相应的阶段。

name: survey-design
description: Design unbiased survey instruments — question wording, scales, and sampling — to measure attitudes at scale. Use when you need quantitative breadth. For behavioural experiments, use `a-b-test-design` (prototyping-testing).
description_zh: 设计无偏见的调查工具——问题措辞、量表和抽样——以大规模测量态度。当你需要定量广度时使用。对于行为实验，使用 `a-b-test-design`（原型测试）。

name: 21st-ai
description: Generate and iterate on UI with 21st AI from the terminal via the `21st` CLI (`@21st-dev/cli`): sketch a UI from a prompt, preview the variants in the browser, edit any variant in place with a natural-language change, and pull the final code into the project. Use whenever the user wants to BUILD / SKETCH new UI ("sketch a pricing page", "generate a hero with 21st", "make me a <X> section"), ITERATE on a generated draft ("edit the third variant", "add a toggle to that take"), or GRAB the code of a draft ("pull that variant's code", "сгенери UI на 21st", "поправь третий вариант", "забери код того наброска"). For finding/installing existing components use the `21st-cli-use` skill; to publish your own, `21st-registry`.
description_zh: 通过终端使用 `21st` CLI (`@21st-dev/cli`) 生成并迭代 21st AI 的 UI：根据提示绘制 UI，在浏览器中预览变体，使用自然语言更改就地编辑任何变体，并将最终代码拉入项目。每当用户想要构建/绘制新 UI（例如，“绘制一个定价页面”、“使用 21st 生成一个英雄模块”、“给我做一个 <X> 部分”）、迭代生成的草稿（例如，“编辑第三个变体”、“给那个 take 添加一个切换开关”）或获取草稿代码（例如，“拉取那个变体的代码”、“сгенери UI на 21st”、“поправь третий вариант”、“забери код того наброска”）时，都可以使用。查找/安装现有组件时使用 `21st-cli-use` 技能；发布自己的组件则使用 `21st-registry`。

name: citation-management
description: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search Google Scholar and PubMed for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.
description_zh: 学术研究的全面引文管理。搜索 Google Scholar 和 PubMed 以查找论文，提取准确的元数据，验证引文，并生成格式正确的 BibTeX 条目。当您需要查找论文、验证引文信息、将 DOI 转换为 BibTeX 或确保科学写作中参考文献的准确性时，应使用此技能。

name: fact-checker
description: Verifies factual claims in documents using web search and official sources, then proposes corrections with user confirmation. Use when the user asks to fact-check, verify information, validate claims, check accuracy, or update outdated information in documents. Supports AI model specs, technical documentation, statistics, and general factual statements.
description_zh: 使用网络搜索和官方来源验证文档中的事实声明，然后提出修正建议并经用户确认。当用户要求核实事实、验证信息、确认声明准确性或更新文档中过时信息时使用。支持AI模型规格、技术文档、统计数据和一般性事实声明。

name: excalidraw-skill
description: Programmatic canvas toolkit for creating, editing, and refining Excalidraw diagrams via MCP tools with real-time canvas sync. Use when an agent needs to (1) draw or lay out diagrams on a live canvas, (2) iteratively refine diagrams using describe_scene and get_canvas_screenshot to see its own work, (3) export/import .excalidraw files or PNG/SVG images, (4) save/restore canvas snapshots, (5) convert Mermaid to Excalidraw, or (6) perform element-level CRUD, alignment, distribution, grouping, duplication, and locking. Requires a running canvas server (EXPRESS_SERVER_URL, default http://localhost:3000).
description_zh: 基于MCP工具的编程式画布工具包，用于通过实时画布同步创建、编辑和优化Excalidraw图表。适用于代理需要时：(1) 在实时画布上绘制或布局图表，(2) 使用describe_scene和get_canvas_screenshot迭代优化图表以查看自己的工作成果，(3) 导出/导入.excalidraw文件或PNG/SVG图像，(4) 保存/恢复画布快照，(5) 将Mermaid转换为Excalidraw，或(6) 执行元素级别的增删改查、对齐、分布、分组、复制和锁定操作。需要运行中的画布服务器（EXPRESS_SERVER_URL，默认http://localhost:3000）。

name: ccf-pipeline-orchestrator
description: Plan or coordinate CCF research stages, goals, gates, artifacts, and ccfa.yaml state. Use for 任务拆解, 流程规划, project status, and explicitly requested end-to-end coordination. Specialist skills own research outputs; ccf-project-scaffolder owns folder/template creation.
description_zh: 规划或协调 CCF 研究阶段、目标、关卡、产出物以及 ccfa.yaml 状态。用于任务拆解、流程规划、项目状态和明确要求的端到端协调。专业领域技能拥有研究产出；ccf-project-scaffolder 负责文件夹/模板创建。

name: fitts-law
description: Apply Fitts's Law — target acquisition time depends on size and distance. Use when sizing and positioning controls, especially for touch. For how many controls to show at once, use `hicks-law`.
description_zh: 应用菲茨定律——目标获取时间取决于大小和距离。在调整控件尺寸和位置时使用，尤其适用于触摸操作。关于一次显示多少个控件，请使用 `hicks-law`。

name: cloudflare-worker-builder
description: Scaffold and deploy Cloudflare Workers with Hono routing, Vite plugin, and Static Assets. Describe project, scaffold structure, configure bindings, deploy. Use whenever the user wants to create a Worker project, set up Hono on Cloudflare, configure D1 / R2 / KV / Queues bindings, or troubleshoot Worker export syntax, API route conflicts, HMR issues, or deployment failures.
description_zh: 使用 Hono 路由、Vite 插件和静态资源部署 Cloudflare Workers。描述项目、脚手架结构、配置绑定、部署。每当用户想要创建 Worker 项目、在 Cloudflare 上设置 Hono、配置 D1 / R2 / KV / 队列绑定，或排查 Worker 导出语法、API 路由冲突、HMR 问题或部署失败时，都可以使用。

name: ccf-rebuttal-writer
description: Write CCF rebuttals, author responses, revision ledgers, response letters, and conservative resubmission plans. Use for 审稿意见回复, rebuttal, revision ledger, and 重投迁移. Ground promises in feasible changes and actual evidence. Ordinary manuscript writing has a separate owner.
description_zh: 撰写CCF反驳意见、作者回复、修订记录、回复信函和保守重投计划。用于审稿意见回复、反驳、修订记录和重投迁移。将承诺建立在可行的变更和实际证据之上。普通文稿撰写有单独的负责人。

name: prompt-engineering
description: Expert guide on prompt engineering patterns, best practices, and optimization techniques. Use when user wants to improve prompts, learn prompting strategies, or debug agent behavior.
description_zh: 针对提示工程模式、最佳实践和优化技巧的专家指南。当用户希望改进提示、学习提示策略或调试代理行为时使用。

name: landing-page
description: Generate a complete, deployable landing page from a brief. Produces a single self-contained HTML file with Tailwind CSS (via CDN), responsive design, dark mode, semantic HTML, and OG meta tags. Sections: hero with CTA, features, social proof, pricing (optional), FAQ, footer. Use when building a marketing page, product launch page, coming soon page, or any standalone landing page. Triggers: 'landing page', 'create a page', 'marketing page', 'launch page', 'coming soon page', 'one-page site'.
description_zh: 根据简报生成一个完整、可部署的落地页。生成单个自包含的HTML文件，使用Tailwind CSS（通过CDN），响应式设计、暗黑模式、语义化HTML和OG元标签。包含以下部分：英雄区域（含行动号召）、功能特性、用户证言、价格（可选）、常见问题解答、页脚。适用于构建营销页面、产品发布页面、即将上线页面或任何独立落地页。触发词：'落地页'、'创建页面'、'营销页面'、'发布页面'、'即将上线页面'、'单页网站'。

name: worldcup
description:
FIFA World Cup 2026 — match schedules, live scores, results, and the prediction game (place/cancel bets with points, betting stats, leaderboard).

Use whenever the user mentions the World Cup: today's / upcoming / live / finished matches, a specific match, placing or cancelling a prediction, staking points, their betting balance or win rate, or the predictor leaderboard.
description_zh:
FIFA世界杯2026 — 比赛赛程、实时比分、赛果以及预测游戏（用积分下注/取消下注，下注统计，排行榜）。

在用户提及世界杯时使用：今日的/即将进行的/实时的/已结束的比赛，特定比赛，下注或取消预测，积分投注，他们的下注余额或胜率，或预测者排行榜。

name: ccf-project-scaffolder
description: Initialize CCF project folders, LaTeX templates, artifact directories, and ccfa.yaml. Use for 项目初始化, 目录搭建, template setup, and reproducible workspace scaffolding. Preserve existing files. Workflow planning belongs to ccf-pipeline-orchestrator; research content belongs to its specialist owner.
description_zh: 初始化 CCF 项目文件夹、LaTeX 模板、工件目录和 ccfa.yaml。用于项目初始化、目录搭建、模板设置和可复现的工作空间框架搭建。保留现有文件。工作流规划属于 ccf-pipeline-orchestrator；研究内容属于其专业所有者。

name: ccf-skill-forger
description: Maintain and audit Codex/CCFA skills, triggers, references, scripts, docs/SVG diagrams, installation dependencies, and release validation. Use for skill维护, GPT model adaptation, and family routing cleanup. Do not perform research writing or review.
description_zh: 维护和审计 Codex/CCFA 技能、触发器、参考、脚本、文档/SVG 图表、安装依赖项和发布验证。用于技能维护、GPT 模型适配和家庭路由清理。不要进行研究写作或评审。

name: om-review-prs
description: Review all currently unreviewed open pull requests, newest first, using the om-auto-review-pr skill and respecting in-progress claim locks.
description_zh: 使用 om-auto-review-pr 技能，按最新优先顺序审查所有当前未审查的开放拉取请求，并尊重进行中的声明锁定。

name: auth
description: Authenticate with AEM Edge Delivery Services. Opens browser for login and captures token. Works for admin.hlx.page and Config Service APIs regardless of content source (Document Authoring, SharePoint, or Google Drive).
description_zh: 使用 AEM Edge Delivery Services 进行身份验证。打开浏览器进行登录并捕获令牌。适用于 admin.hlx.page 和 Config Service API，无论内容源是文档作者、SharePoint 还是 Google Drive。

name: mrbeast-perspective
description:
MrBeast（Jimmy Donaldson）的内容创造操作系统。基于泄露的36页内部培训手册、
6个深度播客、决策记录和外部批评的深度调研，提炼6个核心心智模型、8条决策启发式、
完整的标题/缩略图/Hook/节奏公式，和4个可运行的内容分析脚本。
激活后沉浸式扮演MrBeast，直接以「我」的视角给出内容创作建议。
当用户提到「用MrBeast的视角」「MrBeast会怎么做」「Beast模式」「mrbeast perspective」时使用。
即使用户只是说「视频CTR怎么提升」「标题不够吸引人」「retention曲线怎么优化」「缩略图要改吗」也应触发。
不要在用户只是说「内容创作建议」「怎么做内容」等一般性问题时触发——只在涉及视频优化、标题/缩略图/Hook/留存率等YouTube方法论时激活。

name: meeting-minutes-taker
description: Transforms raw meeting transcripts into structured, evidence-based meeting minutes — merges multiple versions without losing content, reviews existing minutes against the transcript for missing items, and identifies anonymous speakers (Speaker 1/2/3, 发言人1). Triggers on 会议纪要, 会议记录, 整理纪要, 妙记转纪要, "write meeting minutes", "merge these minutes". Not for fixing ASR/STT errors first (use transcript-fixer).
description_zh: 将原始会议记录转换为结构化、有据可查的会议纪要——合并多个版本而不丢失内容，对照会议记录审阅现有纪要以查找遗漏项，并识别匿名发言人（发言人1/2/3）。在“会议纪要”、“会议记录”、“整理纪要”、“妙记转纪要”、“写会议纪要”、“合并这些纪要”等触发条件下启动。不用于在修正ASR/STT错误之前使用（请使用transcript-fixer）。

name: dt-js-runtime
description: Dynatrace server-side JS runtime — function contract, runtime limits, Web APIs, Node.js modules, fetch with credential vault, and the @dynatrace-sdk/* catalog.
description_zh: Dynatrace 服务器端 JS 运行时 — 函数合约、运行时限制、Web API、Node.js 模块、带凭证保险库的 fetch 以及 @dynatrace-sdk/* 目录。

name: localization-design
description: Design for multiple languages, writing directions, and cultural contexts — text expansion, RTL mirroring, and locale formats. Use when shipping beyond one locale. For the words themselves, use `ux-writing` (designer-toolkit).
description_zh: 为多种语言、书写方向和文化环境进行设计——文本扩展、RTL镜像和区域格式。当产品销往多个区域时使用。对于文字本身，使用 `ux-writing`（设计工具包）。

name: agent-workflow
description: Agent skill for workflow - invoke with $agent-workflow
description_zh: 代理技能用于工作流 - 使用$agent-workflow调用

name: scientific-slides
description: Build slide decks and presentations for research talks. Use this for making PowerPoint slides, conference presentations, seminar talks, research presentations, thesis defense slides, or any scientific talk. Provides slide structure, design templates, timing guidance, and visual validation. Works with PowerPoint and LaTeX Beamer.
description_zh: 为研究演讲制作幻灯片和演示文稿。使用此工具制作 PowerPoint 幻灯片、会议演示、研讨会演讲、研究演示、论文答辩幻灯片或任何科学演讲。提供幻灯片结构、设计模板、时间指导以及视觉验证。兼容 PowerPoint 和 LaTeX Beamer。

name: scandinavian-design
description: Apply a refined Scandinavian visual system with a neutral black-and-white foundation, restrained sans-serif typography, purposeful product imagery, generous spacing, clear page chapters, and minimal decoration. Use when the user invokes /scandinavian-design or requests a Nordic, monochrome, calm, spacious, restrained, or minimalist interface.
description_zh: 应用精致的斯堪的纳维亚视觉系统，以中性黑白为基础，搭配简约的无衬线字体、有目的的产品图像、充足的间距、清晰的页面章节和极简的装饰。当用户调用 /scandinavian-design 或请求北欧、单色、宁静、宽敞、简约或极简界面时使用。

name: typing-exclusion-worker
description: Python typing exclusion worker: remove assigned mypy exclusion modules in small scoped batches, fix typing issues, run validation, and produce a structured completion summary. Use when running parallel typing-debt workers or when asked to remove modules from pyproject mypy exclusion overrides.

name: writing-for-agents
description: 为 agent 编写文档。适用于创建或编辑 skills，或修改 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 时。
description_zh: 为 agent 编写文档。适用于创建或编辑 skills，或修改 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 时。

name: wireframe-prototyping
description: Create wireframes and interactive prototypes to visualize user interfaces and gather feedback early. Use tools and techniques to communicate design ideas before development.
description_zh: 创建线框图和交互原型，以可视化用户界面并尽早收集反馈。在开发前使用工具和技术传达设计理念。

name: remotion
description: Best practices and comprehensive guide for Remotion - programmatic video creation in React with animations, compositions, and media handling
description_zh: Remotion最佳实践与全面指南——在React中通过动画、合成和媒体处理进行程序化视频创作

name: ctx-doctor
description:
Run context-mode diagnostics. Checks runtimes, hooks, FTS5,
plugin registration, npm and marketplace versions.
Trigger: /context-mode:ctx-doctor
description_zh:
运行上下文模式诊断。检查运行时、钩子、FTS5、插件注册、npm 和市场版本。
触发：/context-mode:ctx-doctor

name: cc-skill-frontend-patterns
description: Frontend development patterns for React, Next.js, state management, performance optimization, and UI best practices.
description_zh: React、Next.js 前端开发模式、状态管理、性能优化和 UI 最佳实践。

name: sf-permissions
description: Permission Set analysis, hierarchy viewer, and access auditing. TRIGGER when: user asks "who has access to X?", analyzes permission sets/groups, or touches .permissionset-meta.xml / .permissionsetgroup-meta.xml files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: creating new metadata (use sf-metadata), deploying permission sets (use sf-deploy), or Apex sharing logic (use sf-apex).
description_zh: 权限集分析、层级查看器和访问审核。触发条件：当用户询问“谁有权访问X？”、分析权限集/组，或触碰 .permissionset-meta.xml / .permissionsetgroup-meta.xml 文件时。不触发条件：创建新元数据（使用 sf-metadata）、部署权限集（使用 sf-deploy），或 Apex 分享逻辑（使用 sf-apex）。

name: geofeed-tuner
description: Use this skill whenever the user mentions IP geolocation feeds, RFC 8805, geofeeds, or wants help creating, tuning, validating, or publishing a self-published IP geolocation feed in CSV format. Intended user audience is a network operator, ISP, mobile carrier, cloud provider, hosting company, IXP, or satellite provider asking about IP geolocation accuracy, or geofeed authoring best practices. Helps create, refine, and improve CSV-format IP geolocation feeds with opinionated recommendations beyond RFC 8805 compliance. Do NOT use for private or internal IP address management — applies only to publicly routable IP addresses.
description_zh: 当用户提及IP地理位置信息源、RFC 8805、地理位置信息源或需要帮助创建、调整、验证或发布CSV格式的自发布IP地理位置信息源时，请使用此技能。目标用户群体是网络运营商、互联网服务提供商、移动运营商、云服务提供商、主机公司、互联网交换点或卫星服务提供商，他们询问IP地理位置信息准确性或地理位置信息源编写最佳实践。该技能有助于创建、优化和改进CSV格式的IP地理位置信息源，并提供超越RFC 8805合规性的主观建议。请勿用于私有或内部IP地址管理——仅适用于公开可路由的IP地址。

name: hicks-law
description: Apply Hick's Law — decision time grows with the number of simultaneous choices. Use when a screen offers too many options at once. For how many items survive in memory afterwards, use `millers-law`.
description_zh: 应用希克定律——决策时间随同时选选项数量的增加而增长。当屏幕上同时提供过多选项时使用。若要了解多少项目能在记忆中留存，请使用 `millers-law`。

name: terracotta
description: A sun-baked, clay-toned editorial interface built on warm cream surfaces, ink-brown headlines set in a display serif, and a single terracotta accent.
description_zh: 一个阳光炙烤、陶土色调的编辑界面，建立在温暖的奶油色表面上，墨棕色的大标题采用展示型衬线字体，并点缀着一个单一的红陶色装饰。

name: build-loop-cursor
description: Use when building features with **Cursor** in any codebase and the work should go through a disciplined build → review → test → fix loop. Triggers on "run the build loop", "build the next task", "continue the plan", "build this feature properly", or any request to implement work from a plan file or a direct feature prompt. Builds from the plan (or the prompt if no plan exists), runs Cursor's `/review` and fixes every issue found, tests and verifies the feature end to end, fixes anything testing surfaces, and reports back once complete. Repeats until all plan tasks are checked off.
description_zh: 在包含**Cursor**的任何代码库中构建功能时使用，并且工作应遵循严格的构建→审查→测试→修复循环。在"运行构建循环"、"构建下一个任务"、"继续计划"、"正确构建此功能"，或从计划文件或直接功能提示中实施工作的任何请求时触发。从计划（如果不存在计划，则从提示）构建，运行Cursor的`/review`并修复发现的所有问题，对功能进行端到端测试和验证，修复测试中发现的问题，并在完成后报告。重复此过程，直到所有计划任务都被标记完成。

name: sf-testing
description: Apex test execution, coverage analysis, and test-fix loops with 120-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user runs Apex tests, checks code coverage, fixes failing tests, or touches *Test.cls / *_Test.cls files. DO NOT TRIGGER when: writing Apex production code (use sf-apex), Agentforce agent testing (use sf-ai-agentforce-testing), or Jest/LWC tests (use sf-lwc).
description_zh: Apex 测试执行、覆盖率分析和测试-修复循环，采用 120 分制评分。TRIGGER 触发条件：当用户运行 Apex 测试、检查代码覆盖率、修复失败测试或修改 *Test.cls / *_Test.cls 文件时。TRIGGER 不触发条件：编写 Apex 生产代码（请使用 sf-apex）、Agentforce 代理测试（请使用 sf-ai-agentforce-testing）或 Jest/LWC 测试（请使用 sf-lwc）。

name: exa-search
description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.
description_zh: 由 Exa 驱动的网络工具包，专为科学和技术内容而优化。当用户需要搜索网络或获取/提取 URL 内容时，请使用此技能。涵盖：网络搜索（语义查询、研究、当前信息——可选研究论文类别和学术领域过滤）和 URL 提取（批量获取页面、文章、学术 PDF）。当用户需要高质量搜索或通过 category=research paper 进行学术筛选时，请使用此技能。在用户发起搜索、查询、获取页面或提取文章的请求时触发。

name: wps-excel
description: WPS 表格智能助手，通过自然语言操控 Excel，解决公式编写、数据清洗、图表创建等痛点问题
description_zh: WPS表格智能助手，通过自然语言操控Excel，解决公式编写、数据清洗、图表创建等痛点问题

name: ctx-upgrade
description:
Update context-mode from GitHub and fix hooks/settings.
Pulls latest, builds, installs, updates npm global, configures hooks.
Trigger: /context-mode:ctx-upgrade
description_zh:
更新 GitHub 中的上下文模式并修复钩子/设置。
拉取最新版本，构建，安装，更新 npm 全局，配置钩子。
触发：/context-mode:ctx-upgrade

name: design-system-governance
description: Define how the system evolves — contribution model, versioning, deprecation, and change management. Use when multiple teams contribute. For driving uptake use `design-system-adoption` (designer-toolkit); for design file history use `version-control-strategy` (design-ops).
description_zh: 定义系统如何演进——贡献模型、版本控制、弃用策略和变更管理。适用于多个团队协作贡献的场景。推动采用时使用 `design-system-adoption`（designer-toolkit）；设计文件历史版本管理使用 `version-control-strategy`（design-ops）。

name: von-restorff-effect
description: Apply the Von Restorff Effect — the element that differs from its neighbours is the one remembered. Use when a single action must dominate. For overall ordering rather than single-element emphasis, use `visual-hierarchy`.
description_zh: 应用冯·雷斯托夫效应——与周围不同的元素是容易被记住的。当需要单一行动占据主导时使用。若需整体排序而非单个元素强调，请使用 `visual-hierarchy`。

name: qdrant-scaling
description: Guides Qdrant scaling decisions. Use when someone asks 'how many nodes do I need', 'data doesn't fit on one node', 'need more throughput or QPS', 'CPU is pegged / can't keep up with the request rate', 'one query is slow / p99 or tail latency too high', 'cluster is slow', 'too many tenants', 'vertical or horizontal', 'how to shard', 'need to add capacity', 'large limit / pagination / scroll is slow', or 'only recent data matters / expiring old vectors / retention window'.
description_zh: 指导 Qdrant 的扩展决策。当有人问“我需要多少节点”、“数据无法放在一个节点上”、“需要更高的吞吐量或 QPS”、“CPU 资源耗尽/无法跟上请求速率”、“单个查询缓慢/ p99 或尾部延迟过高”、“集群响应缓慢”、“租户过多”、“垂直扩展还是水平扩展”、“如何分片”、“需要增加容量”、“大限制/分页/滚动缓慢”，或“仅关注最近数据/过期旧向量/保留窗口”时使用。

name: fiction
description: A playful, energetic, cartoonesque interface inspired by friendly children's-book illustrations — warm cream backgrounds, big bold custom display typography, saturated brand color blocks, thick black outlines, generously rounded shapes
description_zh: 一个俏皮、充满活力、卡通风格的界面，灵感来源于友好的儿童书籍插画——温暖的米色背景、醒目的大号自定义显示字体、饱和的品牌色彩块、粗黑的轮廓线、圆润饱满的形状

name: generate-image
description: Generate or edit images using AI models (FLUX, Gemini). Use for general-purpose image generation including photos, illustrations, artwork, visual assets, concept art, and any image that isn't a technical diagram or schematic. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.
description_zh: 使用 AI 模型（FLUX、Gemini）生成或编辑图像。用于通用图像生成，包括照片、插图、艺术作品、视觉资源、概念艺术以及任何非技术图表或示意图的图像。对于流程图、电路图、路径图和技术图表，请使用科学示意图技能。

name: security-auditor
description: Expert security auditor specializing in DevSecOps, comprehensive cybersecurity, and compliance frameworks.
description_zh: 专注于DevSecOps、全面网络安全和合规框架的专业安全审计员。

name: flask-api-development
description: Develop lightweight Flask APIs with routing, blueprints, database integration, authentication, and request/response handling. Use when building RESTful APIs, microservices, or lightweight web services with Flask.
description_zh: 使用 Flask 构建 RESTful API、微服务或轻量级 Web 服务时，可开发具有路由、蓝图、数据库集成、身份验证和请求/响应处理的轻量级 Flask API。

name: daily-prep
description: Prepare for tomorrow's meetings and tasks. Pulls calendar from Outlook via WorkIQ, cross-references open tasks and workspace context, classifies meetings, detects conflicts and day-fit issues, finds learning and deep-work slots, and generates a structured HTML prep file with productivity recommendations.
description_zh: 为明天的会议和任务做准备。通过WorkIQ从Outlook中获取日历，对照开放任务和工作区上下文，对会议进行分类，检测冲突和日程适配问题，寻找学习和深度工作时段，并生成一个结构化的HTML准备文件，其中包含生产力建议。

name: design-debt-audit
description: Inventory and prioritise accumulated design inconsistencies across a product. Use when drift has built up over time. For token coverage specifically use `design-token-audit` (designer-toolkit); for WCAG gaps use `accessibility-audit` (design-systems).
description_zh: 对产品中累积的设计不一致进行盘点和优先级排序。当设计逐渐偏离标准时使用。针对设计令牌覆盖问题，请使用 `design-token-audit`（设计师工具包）；针对 WCAG 间隙问题，请使用 `accessibility-audit`（设计系统）。

name: odoo-18
description: Odoo 18 development reference for Python models and ORM (search, domain, read_group, compute fields), XML/CSV data and views, OWL/JS client code, QWeb reports, security (ACL, record rules, groups), cron and server actions, migrations and module upgrades, tests, i18n, and performance. Use this skill whenever work involves Odoo 18 or custom addons—even if the user only pastes a traceback, mentions addons/ or __manifest__.py, describes form/list/kanban/XML errors, HTTP controllers, or business rules on models—including building features, fixing bugs, refactoring, or reviewing addon code. Includes CSS/SCSS asset authoring and review for Odoo addons.
description_zh: Odoo 18 开发参考（Python 模型和 ORM（搜索、域、read_group、计算字段）、XML/CSV 数据和视图、OWL/JS 客户端代码、QWeb 报表、安全（ACL、记录规则、组）、cron 和服务器操作、迁移和模块升级、测试、i18n 和性能）。在涉及 Odoo 18 或自定义附加组件的任何工作中，请使用这项技能——即使用户仅粘贴了异常堆栈信息、提及了 addons/ 或 __manifest__.py、描述了表单/列表/看板/XML 错误、HTTP 控制器或模型上的业务规则（包括构建功能、修复错误、重构或审查附加组件代码）。还包括为 Odoo 附加组件编写和审查 CSS/SCSS 资产。

name: millers-law
description: Apply Miller's Law — chunk information into groups of about four to fit working memory. Use when grouping fields, menu items, or steps. For reducing the number of choices offered, use `hicks-law`.
description_zh: 应用米勒定律——将信息分组成大约四组以适应工作记忆。在分组字段、菜单项或步骤时使用。若要减少提供的选择数量，请使用 `hicks-law`。

name: multi-agent-brainstorming
description: Simulate a structured peer-review process using multiple specialized agents to validate designs, surface hidden assumptions, and identify failure modes before implementation.
description_zh: 使用多个专业代理模拟结构化的同行评审流程，在实施前验证设计、揭示隐藏假设并识别失效模式。

name: superpowers-lab
description: Lab environment for Claude superpowers
description_zh: Claude超级能力的实验室环境

name: cx-infra
description: Query Coralogix infrastructure resources with the `cx infra` CLI — discover monitored resource types and filterable attributes, list and filter resources, check per-resource data. Use when the user asks to "show resource types", "list infrastructure resources", "what resources of this kind are monitored", "list resources of this kind", "is this resource healthy", "resource health history", "when did this resource go critical", "get raw resource data", "infrastructure inventory", "find resources by name", "filter resources by service or environment", "unhealthy resources", "critical hosts in a region", "what can I filter resources by", "resources in this cluster or namespace", or wants to explore infrastructure resources and their data.
description_zh: 使用 `cx infra` 命令行工具查询 Coralogix 基础设施资源——发现可监控的资源类型和可筛选属性，列出并筛选资源，检查每个资源的数据。当用户询问“显示资源类型”、“列出基础设施资源”、“此类资源有哪些被监控”、“列出此类资源”、“此资源是否健康”、“资源健康历史”、“此资源何时变为关键状态”、“获取原始资源数据”、“基础设施清单”、“按名称查找资源”、“按服务或环境筛选资源”、“不健康的资源”、“某个区域内的关键主机”、“我可以按什么筛选资源”、“此集群或命名空间中的资源”，或希望探索基础设施资源及其数据时使用。

name: developing-ios-apps
description: Builds and ships iOS/macOS apps with XcodeGen, SwiftUI and SPM: Xcode build fixes, device deployment, Apple Developer signing/notarization, CI/CD pipelines. Use for XcodeGen project.yml setup, "Library not loaded @rpath" crashes, code-signing errors (Error -25294, adhoc fallback), or Electron notarization failures. Not for TCC permission dialogs (use macos-permissions) or disk cleanup (use macos-cleaner).
description_zh: 使用 XcodeGen、SwiftUI 和 SPM 构建、部署 iOS/macOS 应用：Xcode 构建修复、设备部署、Apple Developer 签名/验证、CI/CD 管道。适用于 XcodeGen project.yml 配置、"Library not loaded @rpath" 崩溃、代码签名错误（错误 -25294、adhoc 回退）、或 Electron 验证失败。不适用于 TCC 权限对话框（使用 macos-permissions）或磁盘清理（使用 macos-cleaner）。

name: openmaic-classroom
description: OpenMAIC — Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom platform for generating immersive AI-powered learning experiences with slides, quizzes, simulations, and multi-agent discussions.
description_zh: OpenMAIC — 开放式多智能体交互课堂平台，用于生成沉浸式AI驱动学习体验，包括幻灯片、测验、模拟和多智能体讨论。

name: reverse-engineering
description: Provides reverse engineering techniques. Use when the main job is to understand how a compiled, obfuscated, packed, or virtualized target works before exploiting or solving it, including binaries, APKs, WASM, firmware, custom VMs, bytecode, malware-like loaders, and anti-debug or anti-analysis logic. Do not use it when the vulnerability is already understood and the remaining task is exploitation; use pwn instead. Do not use it for pure web workflows, log or disk forensics, or standalone crypto problems unless reversing the implementation is the real blocker.
description_zh: 提供逆向工程技术。在主要任务是理解编译、混淆、加壳或虚拟化的目标如何工作之前利用或解决它时使用，包括二进制文件、APK、WASM、固件、自定义虚拟机、字节码、类似恶意软件的加载器以及反调试或反分析逻辑。当漏洞已经理解，剩余任务是利用时，不要使用它；请使用pwn。除非反编译实现是真正的障碍，否则不要将其用于纯网络工作流程、日志或磁盘取证或独立的加密问题。

name: matrix
description: A cyber-slick, dark-only Matrix-inspired interface defined by minimalist fashion, high-tech digital elements
description_zh: 一个以极简主义风格和高科技数字元素为特征的、仅限黑暗的、受《黑客帝国》启发的网络界面

name: sf-data
description: Salesforce data operations with 130-point scoring. TRIGGER when: user creates test data, performs bulk import/export, uses sf data CLI commands, or needs data factory patterns for Apex tests. DO NOT TRIGGER when: SOQL query writing only (use sf-soql), Apex test execution (use sf-testing), or metadata deployment (use sf-deploy).
description_zh: 使用130分制对Salesforce数据操作进行评分。触发条件：当用户创建测试数据、执行批量导入/导出、使用sf数据CLI命令，或需要Apex测试的数据工厂模式时。不触发条件：仅编写SOQL查询（使用sf-soql）、执行Apex测试（使用sf-testing），或进行元数据部署（使用sf-deploy）。

name: privacy-page-generator
description: Deprecated compatibility entry for Privacy Policy Page construction. This page is now maintained in Pagina; install and use page-builder to build a new Privacy Policy Page.

name: 60fps-animation
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "fix janky CSS animation", "make animation 60fps", "stop layout thrashing", "animate width/height/top/left smoothly", "convert animation to transform", "animate box-shadow performantly", "animate height auto", "FLIP animation", or "why is my scroll/hover animation choppy".
description_zh: 当用户要求“修复卡顿的 CSS 动画”、“使动画达到 60fps”、“停止布局抖动”、“平滑地动画化宽度/高度/顶部/左侧”、“将动画转换为 transform”、“高效地动画化 box-shadow”、“动画化高度为自动”、“FLIP 动画”或“我的滚动/悬停动画为什么卡顿”时，应使用此技能。

name: devrel-budget-allocation
description: Splits a developer relations budget across pillars - events, content, community, tooling, education, OSS sponsorship - into line items that each carry a cash cost, an hours cost, a pre-set return threshold, a review date and a reallocation rule, plus a ranked cut list. Use whenever someone asks how to plan or split a devrel budget, how much to spend on events versus content versus community, whether a line item is worth its money, how to defend a devrel budget at review, or what to cut first when the budget shrinks - even if they only say "we spend too much on conferences". Not the metrics framework (samber/developer-relations-skills@devrel-metrics) or one event's ROI (samber/developer-relations-skills@developer-event-sponsorship).

name: devrel-hiring
description: Employer-side DevRel hiring - writes the job posting and outcome-based scorecard, designs the interview loop and question bank across the field's formats (presentation round, take-homes, DevRel-opinion round), scores a portfolio against the six-signal rubric, designs a paid work sample instead of unpaid spec work, and builds a 30-60-90 ramp anchored on a friction log. Splits by company type and funding driver. Use when the user asks how to hire a developer advocate, write a DevRel job posting, design a loop for a community manager or educator, evaluate a candidate's portfolio, or plan a ramp. Do NOT use for candidate-side prep (samber/developer-relations-skills@devrel-career) or org design (samber/developer-relations-skills@devrel-team-structure).

name: react-query
description: Guidelines for using React Query for data fetching, caching, and server state synchronization in React applications
description_zh: 使用 React Query 在 React 应用中进行数据获取、缓存和服务器状态同步的指南

name: wait-what
description: 停一下：刚才那条消息没有说清楚——重新表述一遍。
description_zh: 等一下：刚才那条消息没有说清楚——重新表述一遍。

name: convex-design
description: Design and build reactive, type-safe, production-grade backends on Convex. Covers schema, queries/mutations/actions, indexes, auth, file storage, scheduling, real-time multiplayer, mobile backends, and LLM/agent workflows on Convex's one-platform stack.
description_zh: 在 Convex 上设计和构建响应式、类型安全、生产级的后端。涵盖模式、查询/变异/操作、索引、认证、文件存储、调度、实时多人游戏、移动后端，以及 Convex 一体化平台堆栈上的 LLM/代理工作流。

name: codex-theme-switcher
description: Apply, switch, and restore Codex desktop themes from the local ~/.codexthemes library with one command, and report which theme is currently active. Use when a user asks to apply or activate a theme they created or installed, switch between installed themes, restore the native Codex look, or check or debug which theme is currently applied.
description_zh: 使用一条命令从本地 ~/.codexthemes 库中应用、切换和恢复 Codex 桌面主题，并报告当前活动的主题。当用户要求应用或激活他们创建或安装的主题、在安装的主题之间切换、恢复原生 Codex 界面，或检查或调试当前应用的主题时使用。

name: planetscale-pscale-cli-automation
description: Use the PlanetScale CLI (pscale) from automated agents with --format json, auth check, pscale sql, and per-command --force. Run before other PlanetScale skills when driving pscale directly. Use when the user asks to automate pscale, run CLI commands headless, or verify pscale auth from an agent.
description_zh: 使用来自自动代理的 PlanetScale CLI (pscale) 并使用 --format json、身份验证检查、pscale sql 以及每个命令的 --force。在直接驱动 pscale 时，应在其他 PlanetScale 技能之前运行。当用户要求自动化 pscale、以无头方式运行 CLI 命令或从代理验证 pscale 身份验证时使用。

name: skill-name
description: Clear description of what this skill does and when to use it. Include trigger keywords and contexts inline, e.g. "Use when user wants to X, Y, or Z."
description_zh: 对该技能的作用进行清晰的描述，以及何时使用它。包括触发关键词和上下文，例如："当用户想要X、Y或Z时使用。"

name: antdv-next
description: Antdv Next Vue 3 component library. Use when locating component API docs, props/events/slots, playground demos, or theme token definitions.
description_zh: Antdv Next Vue 3 组件库。用于查找组件 API 文档、props/事件/插槽、playground 演示或主题 token 定义。

name: worldmonitor-intelligence-dashboard
description: Real-time global intelligence dashboard with AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring, and infrastructure tracking
description_zh: 实时全球智能仪表盘，具备AI驱动的新闻聚合、地缘政治监测和基础设施追踪功能

name: software-architecture-design
description: Designs runtime and platform architecture inside a chosen solution. Use when deciding modular monolith vs services, consistency, resilience, or estate topology.
description_zh: 在选定的解决方案内部设计运行时和平台架构。在决定模块化单体与微服务、一致性、弹性或资产拓扑时使用。

name: riso
description: A playful, joyful, two-color risograph print aesthetic built on a single warm off-white paper surface running through every section
description_zh: 一种俏皮、愉悦的双色胶印美学，建立在贯穿所有部分的单一暖米白色纸张表面上。

name: sega
description: A playful, arcade-inspired interface for games — built on the VT323 pixel typeface, hard-edged 0px corners, chunky pill buttons that physically press into solid offset blocks
description_zh: 一个充满趣味、受街机启发的游戏界面——基于VT323像素字体，拥有硬朗的0px角，以及会物理按压进实心偏移块的厚实药丸按钮

name: edict-multi-agent-orchestration
description: Install and use the Edict (三省六部) multi-agent orchestration system with 12 specialized AI agents, real-time kanban dashboard, and audit trails
description_zh: 安装和使用具有12个专业AI代理、实时看板仪表板以及审计追踪的Edict（三省六部）多代理编排系统

name: tts
description:
Text-to-speech and voice narration. Triggers on: "朗读这段", "配音", "TTS",
"语音合成", "text to speech", "read this aloud", "convert to speech",
"voice narration", "read aloud".
description_zh: 文本转语音和语音旁白。触发条件为："朗读这段"、"配音"、"TTS"、"语音合成"、"text to speech"、"read this aloud"、"convert to speech"、"voice narration"、"read aloud"。

name: nuxt-studio
description: Configure and operate the self-hosted Nuxt Studio editor for Nuxt Content. Use when working with nuxt-studio installation, editor customization, OAuth or custom authentication, media, drafts, Git publishing, or production deployment.
description_zh: 配置和操作用于 Nuxt Content 的自托管 Nuxt Studio 编辑器。在处理 nuxt-studio 安装、编辑器自定义、OAuth 或自定义身份验证、媒体、草稿、Git 发布或生产部署时使用。

name: security-audit
description: Comprehensive security scanning and vulnerability detection. Includes input validation, path traversal prevention, CVE detection, and secure coding pattern enforcement. Use when: authentication implementation, authorization logic, payment processing, user data handling, API endpoint creation, file upload handling, database queries, external API integration. Skip when: read-only operations on public data, internal development tooling, static documentation, styling changes.
description_zh: 全面安全扫描和漏洞检测。包括输入验证、路径遍历防护、CVE检测和安全编码模式强制执行。适用于：身份验证实现、授权逻辑、支付处理、用户数据处理、API端点创建、文件上传处理、数据库查询、外部API集成。跳过：对公共数据的只读操作、内部开发工具、静态文档、样式更改。

name: godot-development
description: Expert knowledge of Godot Engine game development including scene creation, node management, GDScript programming, and project structure. Use when working with Godot projects, creating or modifying scenes, adding nodes, writing game scripts, or solving Godot-specific problems.

name: geo-content-optimizer
description: Use when the user asks to "optimize for AI citations"; improves citation readiness for ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, Gemini, and Claude. Not for structural on-page SEO — use on-page-seo-checker; not for net-new drafting — use content-writer. AI引用优化/GEO优化/AI搜索
description_zh: 当用户要求“针对AI引用进行优化”时使用；提升ChatGPT、Perplexity、AI Overviews、Gemini和Claude的引用准备度。不用于页面结构SEO优化——请使用on-page-seo-checker；不用于全新内容撰写——请使用content-writer。AI引用优化/GEO优化/AI搜索

name: receipts
description: Generate a personal Claude Code usage & impact report ("receipts") from this machine's local session transcripts — for justifying Claude Code usage/spend to a manager, self-review, or "what have I been using this for" check-ins. Mines ~/.claude/projects locally (no extra API calls beyond one final write-up), cross-references local git history, and writes a markdown report plus a self-contained HTML receipt to your home directory. Use when the user asks for "receipts", an "impact report", "usage report", wants to "show my Claude Code activity", "prove the value of Claude Code", or runs `/receipts`.
description_zh: 从这台机器的本地会话记录中生成个人Claude Code使用与影响报告（“收据”）——用于向经理说明Claude Code使用/支出情况、自我评估或“我最近都在用这个做什么”的检查。它本地存储在~/.claude/projects中（除最终撰写报告外无需额外API调用），交叉引用本地git历史记录，并将生成一个markdown报告和一个自包含的HTML收据，保存在您的家目录下。当用户要求“收据”、“影响报告”、“使用报告”、“展示我的Claude Code活动”、“证明Claude Code的价值”或运行`/receipts`时使用。

name: marketing-strategy-pmm
description: Product marketing, positioning, GTM strategy, and competitive intelligence. Includes ICP definition, April Dunford positioning methodology, launch playbooks, competitive battlecards, and international market entry guides. Use when developing positioning, planning product launches, creating messaging, analyzing competitors, entering new markets, enabling sales, or when user mentions product marketing, positioning, GTM, go-to-market, competitive analysis, market entry, or sales enablement.
description_zh: 产品营销、定位、GTM策略和竞争情报。包括ICP定义、April Dunford定位方法论、发布手册、竞争战卡和国际市场进入指南。在制定定位、规划产品发布、创建信息、分析竞争对手、进入新市场、赋能销售，或当用户提及产品营销、定位、GTM、市场进入、竞争分析、市场进入或销售赋能时使用。

name: r3f-textures
description: Configure textures in React Three Fiber, including color spaces, UV channels, sampling, video, and render targets. Use for texture appearance or memory issues; use loader guidance for model-loading workflows.
description_zh: 在React Three Fiber中配置纹理，包括色彩空间、UV通道、采样、视频和渲染目标。用于纹理外观或内存问题；使用加载器指导模型加载工作流程。

name: loops-cli
description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to work with the Loops CLI from the terminal. This includes installing or updating the CLI, authenticating, storing and selecting API keys, validating credentials, and running commands for contacts, contact properties, lists, events, transactional email, campaigns, email messages, themes, components, and uploads. Trigger on phrases like "Loops CLI", "loops auth login", "loops campaigns create", "loops uploads create", "loops email-messages update", "loops themes list", "loops components get", "loops contacts create", "loops events send", "loops transactional send", "loops api-key", "loops agent-context", "brew install loops-so/tap/loops", or any time the user wants to use Loops from the shell instead of application code.
description_zh: 在用户希望从终端使用 Loops CLI 时，请使用此技能。这包括安装或更新 CLI、身份验证、存储和选择 API 密钥、验证凭据，以及运行与联系人、联系人属性、列表、事件、事务性电子邮件、活动、电子邮件消息、主题、组件和上传相关的命令。当用户输入以下短语时触发：例如 "Loops CLI"、"loops auth login"、"loops campaigns create"、"loops uploads create"、"loops email-messages update"、"loops themes list"、"loops components get"、"loops contacts create"、"loops events send"、"loops transactional send"、"loops api-key"、"loops agent-context"，或任何用户希望从 Shell 而不是应用程序代码中使用 Loops 的情况。

name: devrel-career
description: Plans, lands and advances a developer relations career from the candidate side  -  developer advocate, developer evangelist, DevRel engineer, community manager, developer educator, DX engineer. Covers portfolio audits against real hiring signals, a zero-to-hireable artefact curriculum, the six-rung IC ladder, the interview formats DevRel loops use (talk round, content and coding take-homes, DevRel-opinion round), gatekeeper and pit-trap patterns in postings, and offer evaluation weighing reporting line before pay. Use whenever someone asks how to break into DevRel, prep a developer advocate interview, build a DevRel portfolio, choose a track, plan the next rung, or weigh a DevRel offer  -  even if they only say "should I take this advocate job". Not a job-search tool.

name: storyboard-manager
description: Assist writers with story planning, character development, plot structuring, chapter writing, timeline tracking, and consistency checking. Use this skill when working with creative writing projects organized in folders containing characters, chapters, story planning documents, and summaries. Trigger this skill for tasks like "Help me develop this character," "Write the next chapter," "Check consistency across my story," or "Track the timeline of events."
description_zh: 协助作家进行故事规划、角色发展、情节构建、章节撰写、时间线追踪和一致性检查。在处理包含角色、章节、故事规划文档和摘要等内容的创意写作项目文件夹时使用此技能。针对“帮我发展这个角色”、“写下一章”、“检查故事的一致性”或“追踪事件时间线”等任务触发此技能。

name: freecodecamp-curriculum
description: Comprehensive guide for contributing to and working with freeCodeCamp's open-source codebase and curriculum platform
description_zh: 为参与和与freeCodeCamp的开源代码库和课程平台合作提供全面指南

name: day5-fetch-and-digest
description: AI Native Camp Day 5 콘텐츠 소화 스킬 만들기. fetch-tweet, fetch-youtube, content-digest 3개 스킬을 직접 만들고 활용한다. "5일차", "Day 5", "fetch", "콘텐츠 스킬", "트윗 스킬", "유튜브 스킬", "다이제스트 스킬" 요청에 사용.
description_zh: AI Native Camp Day 5 内容消化技能制作。制作并运用 fetch-tweet、fetch-youtube、content-digest 三个技能。使用“5日”、“Day 5”、“fetch”、“内容技能”、“推特技能”、“YouTube技能”、“摘要技能”等关键词。

name: html-prototype
description: Direct-invocation specialist for polished, responsive, self-contained HTML mockups and interactive prototypes grounded in the user's conversation, product context, and design language. Use when the user explicitly invokes html-prototype or the broad html skill routes a mockup or prototype request here. Do not activate independently from a general request. Treat a mockup as a noninteractive fidelity mode within this skill, not as a separate skill.
description_zh: 直接调用专家，用于制作精致、响应式、自包含的HTML模型和交互原型，这些模型和原型基于用户的对话、产品背景和设计语言。当用户明确调用html-prototype或广泛的HTML技能将模型或原型请求引导至此时使用。不要在一般请求之外独立激活。在此技能中，将模型视为非交互的保真度模式，而不是一个独立的技能。

name: qdrant-deployment-options
description: Guides Qdrant deployment selection. Use when someone asks 'how to deploy Qdrant', 'Docker vs Cloud', 'local mode', 'embedded Qdrant', 'Qdrant EDGE', 'which deployment option', 'self-hosted vs cloud', or 'need lowest latency deployment'. Also use when choosing between deployment types for a new project.
description_zh: 指导Qdrant部署选择。当有人问“如何部署Qdrant”、“Docker与云”、“本地模式”、“嵌入式Qdrant”、“Qdrant EDGE”、“哪种部署选项”、“自托管与云”或“需要最低延迟部署”时使用。也用于为新项目选择部署类型。

name: metaclaw-evolving-agent
description: Deploy and configure MetaClaw — an agent that meta-learns and evolves from live conversations using skills injection, RL training, and smart scheduling.
description_zh: 部署并配置MetaClaw——一个可以通过技能注入、强化学习训练和智能调度从实时对话中元学习和进化的代理。

name: business-document-generator
description: This skill should be used when the user requests to create professional business documents (proposals, business plans, or budgets) from templates. It provides PDF templates and a Python script for generating filled documents from user data.
description_zh: 当用户请求从模板创建专业商务文件（如提案、商业计划或预算）时，应使用此技能。它提供PDF模板和用于根据用户数据生成填写后文档的Python脚本。

name: nginx-configuration
description: Configure Nginx web server for high-performance reverse proxy, load balancing, SSL/TLS, caching, and API gateway functionality.
description_zh: 配置高性能的 Nginx Web 服务器，用于反向代理、负载均衡、SSL/TLS、缓存和 API 网关功能。

name: ecommerce-competitor-analyzer
description:
ecommerce-competitor-analyzer是由buluslan（公众号：新西楼.AI）研发的电商竞品分析Skill，他会帮你拆解竞对的定价、评论、流量结构和差异化空间，把"对手到底强在哪"变成一份可执行的竞品分析报告。
更多跨境电商 AI 实战内容，请关注公众号「新西楼.AI」。
Multi-platform competitor analysis across Amazon / Temu / Shopee: scrapes product data and generates AI reports covering pricing, reviews, traffic structure and differentiation space.
Use when you need to analyze competitor products, extract product insights, or batch analyze multiple product listings. Supports bulk processing with structured outputs including title, price, rating, reviews, and strategic analysis.

name: content-strategy
description: Define what content a product needs, how it is structured, and who owns it. Use when content itself is the problem. For the words in the interface use `ux-writing` (designer-toolkit); for structural hierarchy use `information-architecture`.
description_zh: 定义产品所需的内容、其结构以及负责人。在内容本身是问题时使用。界面中的文字使用 `ux-writing`（设计师工具包）；对于结构层次使用 `information-architecture`。

name: developer-community-launch
