description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上将面部与特定音频轨道进行口型同步。支持 ByteDance OmniHuman（从肖像+音频生成驱动全身的虚拟形象）、Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro（最先进的视频口型同步技术）、Kling lipsync（音频转视频和文本转视频，语音同步）、Creatify lipsync。该技能会根据用户的实际意图选择合适的输出方式——肖像静态图+音频（生成虚拟形象）、源视频+音频（在现有素材上实现口型替换），或根据脚本生成并同步。触发条件包括“口型同步”、“lip sync”、“让这个视频说话”、“音频对口型匹配”、“视频配音”、“语音对口型同步”、“Sync Labs”、“旁白同步”，或任何明确要求从音频轨道驱动面部口型的指令。

name: nano-banana-2
description: Generate images with Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini-family flash-tier text-to-image) on RunComfy — bundled with the model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper output than naive prompting against the same model. Documents Nano Banana 2's strengths (rapid iteration, in-image typography rendering, predictable framing, optional web-grounded context), the resolution-tier pricing, the safety-tolerance dial, and when to route to Nano Banana Pro / GPT Image 2 / Flux 2 / Seedream instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/text-to-image` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana", "nano-banana-2", "nano banana 2", "google image gen", "gemini image", or any explicit ask to generate with this model.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上使用Google Nano Banana 2（Gemini系列闪速级文本到图像）生成图像——该模型捆绑了其文档化的提示模式，因此该技能比针对同一模型的朴素提示能产生更精准的输出。文档记录了Nano Banana 2的优势（快速迭代、图像内文字渲染、可预测的构图、可选的基于网络的上下文）、分辨率等级的定价、安全容忍度调节器，以及何时路由到Nano Banana Pro / GPT Image 2 / Flux 2 / Seedream。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/text-to-image`。当触发“nano banana”、“nano-banana-2”、“nano banana 2”、“google image gen”、“gemini image”或明确要求使用此模型生成图像时，将自动触发。

name: nano-banana-edit
description: Edit images with Google Nano Banana 2 (image-to-image edit endpoint) on RunComfy. Documents Nano Banana Edit's strengths (preserve subject identity, swap background, localize edits with spatial language, multi-image batch edits up to 20 inputs), the schema, and when to route to GPT Image 2 edit / Flux Kontext / Nano Banana 2 t2i instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana edit", "edit with nano banana", "image edit nano banana", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上使用 Google Nano Banana 2（图像到图像编辑端点）编辑图像。文档中 Nano Banana Edit 的优势（保留主体身份、更换背景、使用空间语言进行本地化编辑、支持最多 20 张输入的多图像批量编辑）、架构以及何时路由到 GPT Image 2 编辑 / Flux Kontext / Nano Banana 2 t2i。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit`。当触发 "nano banana edit"、"使用 nano banana 编辑"、"图像编辑 nano banana" 或任何明确要求使用此模型的请求时，将自动触发。

name: relight
description: Relight a still image — change the lighting setup, color temperature, direction, or mood — on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Qwen Edit 2509's dedicated `relight` LoRA endpoint for purpose-built relighting, with fallback to identity-preserving edit endpoints (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when prose lighting language is enough. Use for product relighting (studio softbox → window light), portrait mood shift (overcast → golden hour), or color-grade change. Triggers on "relight", "relighting", "change the lighting", "make it golden hour", "studio lighting", "rim light", "blue hour", "soft window light", "change light direction", "color temperature", or any explicit ask to alter how a still is lit.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` 命令行界面 (CLI) 重新照亮静态图像——更改光照设置、色温、方向或氛围。该功能会调用 Qwen Edit 2509 的专用 `relight` LoRA 端点进行定制化重光照，若仅需要通过文字描述光照效果，则回退至保留图像身份的编辑端点（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT Image 2 Edit、FLUX Kontext Pro）。适用于产品重光照（影棚柔光箱 → 窗户光）、肖像氛围转换（阴天 → 金色时刻）或色彩分级调整。当输入“重新照亮”、“正在重新照亮”、“更改光照”、“打造金色时刻”、“影棚光照”、“轮廓光”、“蓝调时刻”、“柔光窗户光”、“改变光线方向”、“色温”或任何明确要求调整静态图像光照方式时，该功能将被触发。

name: runcomfy-cli
description: Run any model on RunComfy from the command line. The `runcomfy` CLI is one binary, one auth, hundreds of model endpoints — image generation, image edit, video generation, image-to-video, lip-sync, face swap, video edit, inpainting, outpainting, extend, ControlNet, relight, upscale, LoRA training and more. Submit a request, poll for status, download the output. This skill teaches the agent how to install, authenticate, discover model schemas, invoke models, stream / poll / no-wait, script in JSON output mode, and handle errors. Triggers on "runcomfy cli", "install runcomfy", "runcomfy login", "runcomfy run", "runcomfy whoami", "runcomfy api", or any explicit ask to call a RunComfy model from a script or terminal. Sibling skills (ai-image-generation, ai-video-generation, image-edit, video-edit, face-swap, lipsync, image-to-video, image-inpainting, image-outpainting, video-extend, controlnet-pose, relight) all dispatch through this CLI.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 中通过命令行运行任何模型。`runcomfy` 命令行界面（CLI）是一个二进制文件、一个认证、数百个模型端点——包括图像生成、图像编辑、视频生成、图像转视频、口型同步、人脸交换、视频编辑、图像修复、图像扩展、ControlNet、重新光照、放大、LoRA 训练等。提交请求、轮询状态、下载输出。这项技能将教会代理如何安装、认证、发现模型架构、调用模型、流式传输/轮询/无需等待、以 JSON 输出模式编写脚本，以及处理错误。当触发 "runcomfy cli"、"安装 runcomfy"、"runcomfy 登录"、"runcomfy 运行"、"runcomfy whoami"、"runcomfy api" 或任何明确要求从脚本或终端调用 RunComfy 模型的指令时，将触发此技能。同属技能（ai-image-generation、ai-video-generation、图像编辑、视频编辑、人脸交换、口型同步、图像转视频、图像修复、图像扩展、controlnet-pose、重新光照）均通过此 CLI 进行调度。

name: seedance-v2
description: Generate cinematic short-form video with ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Pro on RunComfy. Documents Seedance 2.0 Pro's strengths (multi-modal references — up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio — synchronized in-pass audio with natural lip-sync, cinematic motion refinement), the 4–15s duration schema, and when to route to HappyHorse 1.0 / Wan 2.7 / Kling instead. Calls `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-v2/pro` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "seedance", "seedance 2", "seedance v2", "seedance pro", "bytedance video", or any explicit ask to generate video with this model.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上使用ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Pro生成电影短片。文档中记录了Seedance 2.0 Pro的优势（多模态参考——最多9张图片、3个视频、3段音频同步播放，带自然口型同步的同步音频，电影级动作优化），4-15秒的时长模式，以及何时路由到HappyHorse 1.0 / Wan 2.7 / Kling。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-v2/pro`。当触发"seedance"、"seedance 2"、"seedance v2"、"seedance pro"、"bytedance video"或明确要求使用该模型生成视频时，将自动执行。

name: video-edit
description: Edit existing video on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Wan 2.7 Edit-Video (general restyle / background swap / packaging swap, identity + motion preservation), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control (transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character), or Lucy Edit Restyle (lightweight identity-stable restyle / outfit swap). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "video edit", "edit video", "restyle video", "swap video background", "motion control", "outfit swap video", or any explicit ask to transform a video.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上编辑现有视频——这项技能是一个智能路由器，将用户的意图匹配到RunComfy目录中的正确编辑模型。选择Wan 2.7 Edit-Video（通用重制/背景替换/包装替换，保留身份+运动），Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control（将参考视频的精确运动转移到目标角色），或Lucy Edit Restyle（轻量级身份稳定重制/服装替换）。捆绑每个模型的文档化提示模式，使技能在不浪费错误模型的迭代次数的情况下获得更精准的编辑。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>`。在“视频编辑”、“编辑视频”、“重制视频”、“替换视频背景”、“运动控制”、“服装替换视频”，或任何明确要求转换视频的指令时触发。

name: video-extend
description: Extend or continue an existing video clip on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Google Veo 3-1's `extend-video` and `fast/extend-video` endpoints — pick the source video plus a prompt describing what should happen next, and the model produces a clip that continues the original with consistent motion, lighting, and subject identity. Use when the user has a short Veo clip and wants it longer, or wants a chained narrative built shot-by-shot from a single seed clip. Triggers on "extend video", "continue video", "longer video", "video extend", "make this clip longer", "Veo extend", "chain video shots", "video continuation", or any explicit ask to take an existing video and add more frames after it.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上扩展或继续现有的视频片段。该功能路由至 Google Veo 3-1 的 `extend-video` 和 `fast/extend-video` 端点——选择源视频并输入一个描述接下来应该发生什么的提示，模型将生成一个与原视频保持一致的运动、光照和主体身份的片段。适用于用户希望将较短的 Veo 视频延长，或希望从单个种子视频逐帧构建链式叙事的场景。当用户触发以下关键词时，该功能将被激活："扩展视频"、"继续视频"、"更长的视频"、"视频扩展"、"让这个片段更长"、"Veo 扩展"、"链式视频拍摄"、"视频延续"，或任何明确要求在现有视频后添加更多帧的请求。

name: video-inpainting
description: Region edits across video frames on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — remove an object that appears across many frames, clean up wires or watermarks, replace a region with matching motion. Routes across Wan 2-7 edit-video (default, prompt-driven region edits with spatial language), Lucy Edit Restyle (identity-stable region-aware restyle), and Seedream 4-0 edit-sequential (when treating the clip as a frame stack). Picks the right route based on whether the change is prose-driven, identity-locked, or needs frame-by-frame still inpaint chained into a video. Triggers on "video inpaint", "video inpainting", "remove from video", "mask region in video", "clean up video", "remove object from clip", "video patch", "frame-by-frame edit", "remove watermark from video", "remove passing person", or any explicit ask to edit a region across video frames.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 中对视频帧进行区域编辑——移除在多帧中出现的对象、清理线路或水印、用匹配的运动替换区域。路由至 Wan 2-7 edit-video（默认，使用空间语言的提示驱动区域编辑）、Lucy Edit Restyle（身份稳定的区域感知重绘）以及 Seedream 4-0 edit-sequential（将片段视为帧堆栈时）。根据更改是文本驱动、身份锁定，还是需要逐帧静态填充链式合成视频，选择合适的路由。在“视频填充”、“视频填充修复”、“从视频中移除”、“视频中遮罩区域”、“清理视频”、“从片段中移除对象”、“视频补丁”、“逐帧编辑”、“从视频中移除水印”、“移除经过的人物”，或任何明确要求跨视频帧编辑区域的指令时触发。

name: video-outpainting
description: Video outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend the spatial canvas of a video, change aspect ratio (9:16 vertical to 16:9 horizontal or vice versa), add environment beyond the original frame while preserving the central action. Routes prompt-shaped spatial extension through Wan 2-7 edit-video and points the agent at dedicated ComfyUI outpaint workflows when seam quality matters for hero delivery. Triggers on "video outpaint", "video outpainting", "extend video canvas", "expand video frame", "uncrop video", "aspect ratio change", "vertical to horizontal video", "16:9 from 9:16", "TikTok to YouTube", or any explicit ask to extend a video spatially beyond its original frame.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上进行视频外绘——扩展视频的空间画布，改变长宽比（从 9:16 垂直变为 16:9 水平或反之），在保留中心动作的同时添加原始帧外的环境。通过 Wan 2-7 的编辑视频功能，将提示形状的空间扩展路由到 ComfyUI 外绘工作流程，并在需要高质量边缘处理以突出主体时，将代理指向专门的外绘工作流程。在以下触发条件下激活："视频外绘"、"视频外绘"、"扩展视频画布"、"扩展视频帧"、"去裁剪视频"、"长宽比改变"、"垂直视频转为水平视频"、"从 9:16 转为 16:9"、"TikTok 转为 YouTube"，或任何明确要求在原始帧外扩展视频空间的请求。

name: wan-2-7
description: Generate text-to-video with Wan 2.7 (Wan-AI's flagship motion model) on RunComfy. Documents Wan 2.7's strengths (multi-reference conditioning, audio-driven lip-sync via `audio_url`, smoother transitions, prompt expansion), the duration / resolution / aspect-ratio schema, and when to route to HappyHorse 1.0 / Seedance 2.0 / Kling / LTX 2 instead. Calls `runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-2-7/text-to-video` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "wan", "wan 2.7", "wan-2-7", "wan video", or any explicit ask to generate video with this model.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上使用Wan 2.7（Wan-AI的旗舰运动模型）生成文本到视频。文档中描述了Wan 2.7的优势（多参考条件、通过`audio_url`实现音频驱动唇同步、更平滑的过渡、提示扩展），以及时长/分辨率/宽高比方案，并说明了何时应路由到HappyHorse 1.0 / Seedance 2.0 / Kling / LTX 2。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run wan-ai/wan-2-7/text-to-video`。当触发"wan"、"wan 2.7"、"wan-2-7"、"wan video"或明确要求使用此模型生成视频时，将自动执行。

name: reddit-automation
description: Find Reddit threads where people are genuinely asking for what you offer, then draft short, genuinely helpful replies — disclosing your affiliation honestly and naming your product only when it truly answers the question. Two moves: discovery — scan the right subreddits for real needs (recommendation asks, expressed pain, competitor mentions) and rank the few threads where you can actually help; drafting — write from real experience, respect each community's self-promo rules, and keep a human in the loop to review and post. This markets on Reddit the honest way: contribute value, disclose who you are, never astroturf. Distilled from the playbook behind doany.ai's Reddit agent. Triggers on "find reddit opportunities", "reddit marketing", "reddit automation", "reply on reddit for my product", "reddit community engagement", "reddit lead gen", or any ask to turn Reddit threads into genuine, disclosed marketing replies.
description_zh: 找到那些真正在询问你所提供内容的相关 Reddit 主题，然后撰写简短且真正有帮助的回复——诚实地披露你的关联关系，仅在产品确实能回答问题时才提及你的产品。两步操作：发现——扫描正确的 Subreddit 以寻找真实需求（如推荐请求、表达痛点、提及竞争对手），并筛选出你能实际提供帮助的少数主题；撰写——基于真实经验撰写，尊重每个社区的自我推广规则，并保持人类审核环节以进行发布。这种方式诚实地在 Reddit 上进行营销：贡献价值，披露你的身份，绝不进行虚假宣传。源自 doany.ai Reddit 代理背后的操作手册。当触发“寻找 Reddit 机会”、“Reddit 营销”、“Reddit 自动化”、“为我的产品回复 Reddit”、“Reddit 社区互动”、“Reddit 领域生成”或任何将 Reddit 主题转化为真实、披露的营销回复的请求时，将自动执行。

Documents GPT Image Edit's strengths (preservation language, multilingual in-image text editing, multi-reference up to 10 images, layout / typography precision), the schema, and when to route to Nano Banana Edit / Flux Kontext / GPT Image 2 t2i instead. Calls `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "gpt image edit", "gpt-image-edit", "chatgpt image edit", "edit with gpt image 2", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上使用OpenAI GPT Image 2（ChatGPT Images 2.0的`/edit`端点）编辑图像——该技能捆绑了模型的文档化提示模式，使其比针对同一模型进行简单提示时能产生更精准的输出。记录GPT Image Edit的优势（保留语言、图像内多语言文本编辑、最多支持10张参考图像、布局/排版精确性）、架构，以及何时应路由至Nano Banana Edit / Flux Kontext / GPT Image 2 t2i。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit`。当触发“gpt image edit”、“gpt-image-edit”、“chatgpt image edit”、“edit with gpt image 2”，或明确要求使用此模型进行编辑时，将自动触发。

name: happyhorse-1-0
description: Generate text-to-video with HappyHorse 1.0 on RunComfy. Documents HappyHorse 1.0's strengths (#1 on Artificial Analysis Video Arena, native 1080p with in-pass synchronized audio, multi-shot character consistency, 6-language prompt support), the duration / aspect-ratio / resolution schema, and when to route to Wan 2.7 / Seedance 2 / LTX 2 instead. Calls `runcomfy run happyhorse/happyhorse-1-0/text-to-video` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "happyhorse", "happy horse", "happyhorse 1.0", "happyhorse video", or any explicit ask to generate video with this model.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上使用HappyHorse 1.0生成文本视频。记录HappyHorse 1.0的优势（在人工智能视频分析竞技场排名第一、原生1080p带同步音频、多帧角色一致性、支持6种语言提示），以及时长/宽高比/分辨率方案，并说明何时应路由至Wan 2.7 / Seedance 2 / LTX 2。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run happyhorse/happyhorse-1-0/text-to-video`。当触发"happyhorse"、"happy horse"、"happyhorse 1.0"、"happyhorse video"或明确要求使用此模型生成视频时，将自动执行。

name: image-edit
description: Edit images on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Nano Banana Edit (batch up to 20, identity-preserving default), OpenAI GPT Image 2 Edit (multilingual in-image text rewrite, multi-ref composition, layout precision), Flux Kontext Pro (single-ref high-fidelity local edit), or Z-Image Turbo Inpaint (mask-driven precise region edit). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image edit", "edit image", "image-to-image", "i2i", "swap background", "remove object", "rewrite headline", or any explicit ask to edit a single or batch of images.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上编辑图片——这项技能是一个智能路由器，它将用户的意图与RunComfy目录中的正确编辑模型相匹配。选择Nano Banana Edit（批量最多20张，默认保留身份）、OpenAI GPT Image 2 Edit（多语言图像内文本重写、多参考组合、布局精确）、Flux Kontext Pro（单参考高保真本地编辑）或Z-Image Turbo Inpaint（掩码驱动精确区域编辑）。捆绑每个模型的文档提示模式，使技能在无需在错误模型上浪费迭代的情况下获得更精准的编辑。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/edit`。在"图片编辑"、"编辑图片"、"图像到图像"、"i2i"、"更换背景"、"移除对象"、"重写标题"或任何明确要求编辑单张或批量图片的指令时触发。

name: image-inpainting
description: Mask-driven image inpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Tongyi MAI Z-Image Turbo Inpainting (the dedicated inpainting endpoint with mask, strength, and control-scale) and to identity-preserving edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask isn't available and the region must be described instead. Use for object removal, watermark removal, region replacement, blemish cleanup, and any controlled local edit where a binary mask defines the target area. Triggers on "inpaint", "inpainting", "image inpaint", "remove from image", "fill region", "mask-driven edit", "remove watermark", "remove object", "patch the photo", "fill the hole", or any explicit ask to edit a specific masked region of a still.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上通过 `runcomfy` 命令行界面进行基于掩码的图像修复。当没有掩码可用且必须描述区域时，会路由到 Tongyi MAI Z-图像加速修复（具有掩码、强度和控制比例的专用修复端点）以及到身份保持编辑模型（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT 图像 2 Edit、FLUX Kontext Pro）。用于对象移除、水印移除、区域替换、瑕疵清理以及任何受控的局部编辑，其中二值掩码定义目标区域。在以下情况下触发："修复"、"图像修复"、"填充区域"、"移除图像中的对象"、"填充区域"、"基于掩码的编辑"、"移除水印"、"移除对象"、"修复照片"、"填充漏洞"，或任何明确要求编辑静态图像特定掩码区域的请求。

name: image-outpainting
description: Image outpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — extend a still beyond its original canvas, fill in what the camera didn't capture, change aspect ratio (square → 16:9, portrait → landscape) while preserving the original content. Routes across Nano Banana 2 Edit (default, spatial-language driven), GPT Image 2 Edit (multi-ref with reference-style matching), FLUX Kontext Pro (single-shot maximum-preservation), and the brand edit endpoints (Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2). Picks the right route based on whether the outpaint is prose-driven, reference-driven, or brand-locked. Triggers on "outpaint", "outpainting", "extend image canvas", "expand the image", "fill in around the photo", "uncrop", "change aspect ratio", "extend frame", "wide-screen from square", or any explicit ask to add canvas around an existing still.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` CLI 在 RunComfy 上进行图像外扩——将静态图像扩展到原始画布之外，填补相机未捕捉的部分，同时保持原始内容不变。可调整宽高比（方形转为 16:9，竖版转为横版）。支持以下路线：Nano Banana 2 Edit（默认，基于空间语言驱动）、GPT Image 2 Edit（多参考与参考式匹配）、FLUX Kontext Pro（单次最大保留）、以及品牌编辑端点（Seedream / Dreamina / Qwen / FLUX 2）。根据外扩需求是文本驱动、参考驱动还是品牌锁定，自动选择最合适的路线。触发条件包括："outpaint"、"outpainting"、"extend image canvas"、"expand the image"、"fill in around the photo"、"uncrop"、"change aspect ratio"、"extend frame"、"wide-screen from square"，或任何明确要求在现有静态图像周围添加画布的指令。

name: image-to-video
description: Animate any still image on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right i2v model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks HappyHorse 1.0 I2V (Arena #1, native audio, identity preservation) for general animations, Wan 2.7 with `audio_url` for custom-voiceover lip-sync, or Seedance 2.0 Pro for multi-modal animation from image + reference video + reference audio. Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the caller gets sharper output without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/image-to-video` (or endpoint variant) through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "image to video", "image-to-video", "i2v", "animate image", "make this move", or any explicit ask to turn a still into video.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上为任何静态图像添加动画效果——这项技能是一个智能路由器，能够将用户的意图匹配到RunComfy目录中正确的i2v模型。对于常规动画，选择HappyHorse 1.0 I2V（竞技场#1，原生音频，身份保留）；需要自定义旁白口型时，使用带有`audio_url`的Wan 2.7；而进行多模态动画时，则选用Seedance 2.0 Pro（基于图像+参考视频+参考音频）。每个模型都捆绑了文档中记录的提示模式，以便调用者获得更精准的输出，避免在错误模型上浪费迭代次数。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/image-to-video`（或其端点变体）。当触发“图像转视频”、“image-to-video”、“i2v”、“为图像添加动画”、“让这个动起来”或任何明确要求将静态图像转换为视频的指令时，即可激活该功能。

name: kling-3-0
description: Kling 3.0 video generation on RunComfy. Kling 3.0 (also called Kling V3.0) is Kuaishou Technology's third-generation multi-shot video model with native synchronized audio and consistent character identity across shots. This skill covers all six Kling 3.0 endpoints, spanning three rendering tiers (Standard, Pro, 4K) and two modes (text-to-video, image-to-video). Calls runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<tier>/<mode> through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "kling", "kling 3.0", "kling v3", "kling pro", "kling 4k", "kling text to video", "kling image to video", or any explicit ask to generate or animate with Kling 3.0.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上生成Kling 3.0视频。Kling 3.0（也称为Kling V3.0）是快手科技研发的第三代多镜头视频模型，具有原生同步音频和跨镜头一致的角色身份。该技能涵盖Kling 3.0的所有六个端点，覆盖三个渲染层级（标准、专业、4K）和两种模式（文本转视频、图像转视频）。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run kling/kling-3.0/<层级>/<模式>`。当触发“kling”、“kling 3.0”、“kling v3”、“kling专业”、“kling 4K”、“kling文本转视频”、“kling图像转视频”，或明确要求使用Kling 3.0生成或动画化时，即可激活该功能。

name: lipsync
description: Lip-sync a face to a specific audio track on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across ByteDance OmniHuman (audio-driven full-body avatar from a portrait + audio), Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro (state-of-the-art mouth sync onto a video), Kling lipsync (audio-to- video and text-to-video with synced speech), and Creatify lipsync. The skill picks the right endpoint for the user's actual intent — portrait still + audio (avatar-style), source video + audio (mouth- swap on existing footage), or generate-and-sync from a script. Triggers on "lip sync", "lipsync", "make this video speak", "match audio to mouth", "dub video", "sync lips to voice", "Sync Labs", "voiceover sync", or any explicit ask to drive a face's mouth from an audio track.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` 命令行在 RunComfy 中为特定音频轨道进行口型同步。支持 ByteDance OmniHuman（从肖像和音频生成驱动全身的虚拟形象）、Sync Labs sync v2 / Pro（最先进的视频口型同步技术）、Kling lipsync（音频到视频和文本到视频的同步语音）、以及 Creatify lipsync。该技能会根据用户的实际意图选择合适的终端——肖像静态图+音频（虚拟形象风格）、源视频+音频（在现有素材上进行口型替换），或从脚本生成并同步。触发条件包括“口型同步”、“lipsync”、“让这个视频说话”、“匹配音频到口型”、“配音视频”、“同步口型到语音”、“Sync Labs”、“配音同步”，或任何明确要求从音频轨道驱动虚拟形象口型的指令。

name: nano-banana-2
description: Generate images with Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini-family flash-tier text-to-image) on RunComfy — bundled with the model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper output than naive prompting against the same model. Documents Nano Banana 2's strengths (rapid iteration, in-image typography rendering, predictable framing, optional web-grounded context), the resolution-tier pricing, the safety-tolerance dial, and when to route to Nano Banana Pro / GPT Image 2 / Flux 2 / Seedream instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/text-to-image` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana", "nano-banana-2", "nano banana 2", "google image gen", "gemini image", or any explicit ask to generate with this model.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上使用Google Nano Banana 2（Gemini系列闪速级文本到图像）生成图像——该模型捆绑了其文档化的提示模式，因此该技能比针对同一模型进行简单提示能产生更精准的输出。文档记录了Nano Banana 2的优势（快速迭代、图像内文字渲染、可预测的构图、可选的基于网络的上下文）、分辨率等级的定价、安全容忍度调节器，以及何时路由到Nano Banana Pro / GPT Image 2 / Flux 2 / Seedream。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/text-to-image`。当触发“nano banana”、“nano-banana-2”、“nano banana 2”、“google image gen”、“gemini image”或明确要求使用此模型生成图像时，将自动触发。

name: nano-banana-edit
description: Edit images with Google Nano Banana 2 (image-to-image edit endpoint) on RunComfy. Documents Nano Banana Edit's strengths (preserve subject identity, swap background, localize edits with spatial language, multi-image batch edits up to 20 inputs), the schema, and when to route to GPT Image 2 edit / Flux Kontext / Nano Banana 2 t2i instead. Calls `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "nano banana edit", "edit with nano banana", "image edit nano banana", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 上使用 Google Nano Banana 2（图像到图像编辑端点）编辑图像。文档中 Nano Banana Edit 的优势（保留主体身份、更换背景、使用空间语言进行本地化编辑、支持多达 20 张输入的多图像批量编辑），其架构，以及何时路由到 GPT Image 2 编辑 / Flux Kontext / Nano Banana 2 t2i。通过本地 RunComfy CLI 调用 `runcomfy run google/nano-banana-2/edit`。当触发“nano banana edit”、“使用 nano banana 编辑”、“image edit nano banana”或任何明确要求使用此模型的请求时，将自动触发。

name: relight
description: Relight a still image — change the lighting setup, color temperature, direction, or mood — on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Qwen Edit 2509's dedicated `relight` LoRA endpoint for purpose-built relighting, with fallback to identity-preserving edit endpoints (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when prose lighting language is enough. Use for product relighting (studio softbox → window light), portrait mood shift (overcast → golden hour), or color-grade change. Triggers on "relight", "relighting", "change the lighting", "make it golden hour", "studio lighting", "rim light", "blue hour", "soft window light", "change light direction", "color temperature", or any explicit ask to alter how a still is lit.
description_zh: 通过 `runcomfy` 命令行界面 (CLI) 重新照亮静态图像——更改光照设置、色温、方向或氛围。该功能会调用 Qwen Edit 2509 的专用 `relight` LoRA 端点进行定制化重光照，若仅需要通过文字描述光照效果，则回退至保留图像身份的编辑端点（Nano Banana 2 Edit、GPT Image 2 Edit、FLUX Kontext Pro）。适用于产品重光照（影棚柔光箱 → 窗户光）、肖像氛围转换（阴天 → 黄金时刻）或色彩分级调整。当输入“重新照亮”、“正在重新照亮”、“更改光照”、“让它变成黄金时刻”、“影棚光照”、“轮廓光”、“蓝调时刻”、“柔光窗户光”、“改变光的方向”、“色温”或任何明确要求改变静态图像光照方式的指令时，该功能将被触发。

name: runcomfy-cli
description: Run any model on RunComfy from the command line. The `runcomfy` CLI is one binary, one auth, hundreds of model endpoints — image generation, image edit, video generation, image-to-video, lip-sync, face swap, video edit, inpainting, outpainting, extend, ControlNet, relight, upscale, LoRA training and more. Submit a request, poll for status, download the output. This skill teaches the agent how to install, authenticate, discover model schemas, invoke models, stream / poll / no-wait, script in JSON output mode, and handle errors. Also covers the catalog (`models list` / `get`), account balance, Serverless ComfyUI deployments (`deployments`), and LoRA training (`datasets`, `train`). Triggers on "runcomfy cli", "install runcomfy", "runcomfy login", "runcomfy run", "runcomfy whoami", "runcomfy api", "runcomfy deployments", "runcomfy train", "deploy a comfyui workflow", "train a lora on runcomfy", or any explicit ask to call a RunComfy model from a script or terminal. Sibling skills (ai-image-generation, ai-video-generation, image-edit, video-edit, face-swap, lipsync, image-to-video, image-inpainting, image-outpainting, video-extend, controlnet-pose, relight) all dispatch through this CLI.
description_zh: 在 RunComfy 中通过命令行运行任何模型。`runcomfy` 命令行界面（CLI）是一个二进制文件，一个认证，数百个模型端点——图像生成、图像编辑、视频生成、图像转视频、口型同步、人脸交换、视频编辑、图像修复、图像扩展、ControlNet、重新光照、放大、LoRA 训练等。提交请求、轮询状态、下载输出。这项技能教会代理如何安装、认证、发现模型架构、调用模型、流式传输/轮询/无需等待、以 JSON 输出模式编写脚本，以及处理错误。还涵盖了目录（`models list` / `get`）、账户余额、Serverless ComfyUI 部署（`deployments`）和 LoRA 训练（`datasets`、`train`）。当触发 "runcomfy cli"、"安装 runcomfy"、"runcomfy 登录"、"runcomfy 运行"、"runcomfy whoami"、"runcomfy api"、"runcomfy deployments"、"runcomfy train"、"部署一个 comfyui 工作流"、"在 runcomfy 上训练一个 lora"，或任何明确要求从脚本或终端调用 RunComfy 模型的请求时，将触发此技能。同属技能（ai-image-generation、ai-video-generation、图像编辑、视频编辑、人脸交换、口型同步、图像转视频、图像修复、图像扩展、controlnet-pose、重新光照）均通过此 CLI 分发。

name: seedance-v2
description: Generate cinematic short-form video with ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Pro on RunComfy. Documents Seedance 2.0 Pro's strengths (multi-modal references — up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio — synchronized in-pass audio with natural lip-sync, cinematic motion refinement), the 4–15s duration schema, and when to route to HappyHorse 1.0 / Wan 2.7 / Kling instead. Calls `runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-v2/pro` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "seedance", "seedance 2", "seedance v2", "seedance pro", "bytedance video", or any explicit ask to generate video with this model.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上使用ByteDance Seedance 2.0 Pro生成电影短片。文档中列出了Seedance 2.0 Pro的优势（多模态参考——最多9张图片、3个视频、3段音频——同步实时音频与自然口型同步、电影级动作优化），4-15秒的时长模式，以及何时路由到HappyHorse 1.0 / Wan 2.7 / Kling。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run bytedance/seedance-v2/pro`。当触发"seedance"、"seedance 2"、"seedance v2"、"seedance pro"、"bytedance video"或明确要求使用该模型生成视频时，将自动执行。

name: video-edit
description: Edit existing video on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Wan 2.7 Edit-Video (general restyle / background swap / packaging swap, identity + motion preservation), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control (transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character), or Lucy Edit Restyle (lightweight identity-stable restyle / outfit swap). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "video edit", "edit video", "restyle video", "swap video background", "motion control", "outfit swap video", or any explicit ask to transform a video.
description_zh: 在RunComfy上编辑现有视频——这项技能是一个智能路由器，将用户的意图匹配到RunComfy目录中的正确编辑模型。选择Wan 2.7 Edit-Video（通用重制/背景替换/包装替换，保留身份+运动），Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control（将参考视频的精确运动转移到目标角色），或Lucy Edit Restyle（轻量级身份稳定重制/服装替换）。捆绑每个模型的文档提示模式，使技能在无需在错误模型上浪费迭代的情况下获得更精准的编辑。通过本地RunComfy CLI调用`runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>`。在“视频编辑”、“编辑视频”、“重制视频”、“替换视频背景”、“运动控制”、“服装替换视频”，或任何明确要求转换视频的指令时触发。

name: video-extend
description: Extend or continue an existing video clip on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Google Veo 3-1's `extend-video` and `fast/extend-video` endpoints — pick the source video plus a prompt describing what should happen next, and the model produces a clip that continues the original with consistent motion, lighting, and subject identity.
